name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.lin_cast
statement:
theorem lin_cast (f : LinDiagram R a b) (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b') :
    P.lin (LinDiagram.cast f ha hb) =
      eqToHom (congrArg P.obj ha.symm) ≫ P.lin f ≫ eqToHom (congrArg P.obj hb)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.castHom_rfl
statement: @[simp] theorem castHom_rfl (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b) : P.castHom rfl rfl f = f

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.castHom_diag
statement:
@[simp] theorem castHom_diag (f : a ⟶ b) (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b') :
    P.castHom ha hb (P.diag f) = P.diag (Diagram.cast f ha hb)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.castHom_lin
statement:
@[simp] theorem castHom_lin (f : LinDiagram R a b) (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b') :
    P.castHom ha hb (P.lin f) = P.lin (LinDiagram.cast f ha hb)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.castHom_castHom
statement:
@[simp] theorem castHom_castHom (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b') (ha' : a' = a'') (hb' : b' = b'')
    (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b) :
    P.castHom ha' hb' (P.castHom ha hb f) = P.castHom (ha.trans ha') (hb.trans hb') f
proof:
:= by
  subst ha hb ha' hb'; simp

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.castHom_comp
statement:
theorem castHom_comp (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b') (hc : c = c') (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b)
    (g : P.obj b ⟶ P.obj c) :
    P.castHom ha hc (f ≫ g) = P.castHom ha hb f ≫ P.castHom hb hc g
proof:
:= by
  subst ha hb hc; simp

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.castHom_id
statement: @[simp] theorem castHom_id (ha : a = a') : P.castHom ha ha (𝟙 (P.obj a)) = 𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.castHom_eqToHom
statement:
theorem castHom_eqToHom (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b') (h : P.obj a = P.obj b) :
    P.castHom ha hb (eqToHom h) = eqToHom (by rw [← ha, ← hb, h])

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.castHom_eq_iff
statement:
theorem castHom_eq_iff (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b') (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b)
    (g : P.obj a' ⟶ P.obj b') : P.castHom ha hb f = g ↔ f = P.castHom ha.symm hb.symm g

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.castHom_injective
statement: theorem castHom_injective (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b') : Function.Injective (P.castHom ha hb)
proof:
:= by
  intro f g h
  subst ha hb
  simpa using h

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.castHom_inj
statement:
@[simp] theorem castHom_inj (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b') {f g : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b} :
    P.castHom ha hb f = P.castHom ha hb g ↔ f = g

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.whisk_castHom
statement:
theorem whisk_castHom (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b') (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b) (u : Obj S)
    (v : List S.Colour) :
    P.whisk (P.castHom ha hb f) u v =
      P.castHom (congrArg (Obj.whisker · u v) ha) (congrArg (Obj.whisker · u v) hb)
        (P.whisk f u v)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.castLinearEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem castLinearEquiv_apply (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b') (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b) :
    P.castLinearEquiv ha hb f = P.castHom ha hb f

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.castLinearEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem castLinearEquiv_symm_apply (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b')
    (f : P.obj a' ⟶ P.obj b') :
    (P.castLinearEquiv ha hb).symm f = P.castHom ha.symm hb.symm f

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.castHom_add
statement:
theorem castHom_add (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b') (f g : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b) :
    P.castHom ha hb (f + g) = P.castHom ha hb f + P.castHom ha hb g

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.castHom_sub
statement:
theorem castHom_sub (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b') (f g : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b) :
    P.castHom ha hb (f - g) = P.castHom ha hb f - P.castHom ha hb g

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.castHom_neg
statement:
theorem castHom_neg (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b') (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b) :
    P.castHom ha hb (-f) = -P.castHom ha hb f

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.castHom_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem castHom_zero (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b') :
    P.castHom ha hb (0 : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b) = 0

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.castHom_smul
statement:
theorem castHom_smul (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b') (r : R) (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b) :
    P.castHom ha hb (r • f) = r • P.castHom ha hb f

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.endCast_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem endCast_apply (h : a = a') (f : End (P.obj a)) : P.endCast h f = P.castHom h h f

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.endCast_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem endCast_symm_apply (h : a = a') (f : End (P.obj a')) :
    (P.endCast h).symm f = P.castHom h.symm h.symm f

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.diag_eq_castHom_of_layers_eq
statement:
theorem diag_eq_castHom_of_layers_eq (f : a ⟶ b) (g : a' ⟶ b') (ha : a' = a) (hb : b' = b)
    (h : Diagram.layers f = Diagram.layers g) : P.diag f = P.castHom ha hb (P.diag g)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.diag_transfer
statement:
theorem diag_transfer (A B : a ⟶ b) (A' B' : a' ⟶ b') (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b')
    (hA : Diagram.layers A = Diagram.layers A') (hB : Diagram.layers B = Diagram.layers B')
    (h : P.diag A' = P.diag B') : P.diag A = P.diag B
proof:
:= by
  rw [P.diag_eq_castHom_of_layers_eq A A' ha.symm hb.symm hA,
    P.diag_eq_castHom_of_layers_eq B B' ha.symm hb.symm hB, h]

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.diag_eq_diag_iff_of_layers_eq
statement:
theorem diag_eq_diag_iff_of_layers_eq (A B : a ⟶ b) (A' B' : a' ⟶ b') (ha : a = a')
    (hb : b = b') (hA : Diagram.layers A = Diagram.layers A')
    (hB : Diagram.layers B = Diagram.layers B') : P.diag A = P.diag B ↔ P.diag A' = P.diag B'
proof:
:=
  ⟨P.diag_transfer A' B' A B ha.symm hb.symm hA.symm hB.symm,
    P.diag_transfer A B A' B' ha hb hA hB⟩

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.mem_subalgebra_of_layers
statement:
theorem mem_subalgebra_of_layers {a : Obj S}
    (ha : ∀ (L : Layer S), L.Valid → L.dom = a → L.cod = a) (A : Subalgebra R (End (P.obj a)))
    (hA : ∀ (L : Layer S) (hv : L.Valid) (hd : L.dom = a), P.layer L hv hd (ha L hv hd) ∈ A)
    (f : End (P.obj a)) : f ∈ A
proof:
:= by
  let M : ∀ x y : Obj S, Submodule R (P.obj x ⟶ P.obj y) := fun x y =>
    { carrier := {g | ∀ (hx : x = a) (hy : y = a), P.castHom hx hy g ∈ A}
      add_mem' := fun hf hg hx hy => by
        rw [castHom_add]; exact A.add_mem (hf hx hy) (hg hx hy)
      zero_mem' := fun hx hy => by rw [castHom_zero]; exact A.zero_mem
      smul_mem' := fun r g hg hx hy => by rw [castHom_smul]; exact A.smul_mem (hg hx hy) r }
  have key := P.mem_of_layers {x | x = a} (fun L hv hL => ha L hv hL) M
    (fun x hx hx' _ => by rw [castHom_id]; exact A.one_mem)
    (fun {x y z} _ hy _ g g' hg hg' hx hz => by
      rw [P.castHom_comp hx hy hz]; exact A.mul_mem (hg' hy hz) (hg hx hy))
    (fun L hv hL hx hy => by
      rw [castHom_diag]
      exact hA L hv hx) rfl rfl f
  simpa using key rfl rfl

name: StringDiagrams.Layer.Valid.genWhiskerOK
statement:
theorem Layer.Valid.genWhiskerOK {L : Layer S} (hv : L.Valid) :
    (S.genDom L.gen).WhiskerOK ⟨L.start, L.left⟩ L.right
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨hv.left_ok, hv.left_end, ?_⟩
  show S.ok (S.endR (S.left L.gen) (S.dom L.gen)) L.right
  rw [hv.dom_end]; exact hv.right_ok

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.oddCountList_append
statement:
theorem oddCountList_append (ls ms : List (Layer S)) :
    oddCountList (ls ++ ms) = oddCountList ls + oddCountList ms

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.oddCountList_map_whisker
statement:
@[simp] theorem oddCountList_map_whisker (ls : List (Layer S)) (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour) :
    oddCountList (ls.map (·.whisker u v)) = oddCountList ls

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.oddCountList_singleton
statement: theorem oddCountList_singleton (L : Layer S) : oddCountList [L] = (S.odd L.gen).toNat
proof:
:= by
  cases h : S.odd L.gen <;> simp [oddCountList, h]

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.oddCount_comp
statement: theorem oddCount_comp (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) : oddCount (f ≫ g) = oddCount f + oddCount g

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.oddCount_whisker
statement:
@[simp] theorem oddCount_whisker (f : a ⟶ b) (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour)
    (hw : a.WhiskerOK u v) : oddCount (whisker f u v hw) = oddCount f

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.oddCount_cast
statement:
@[simp] theorem oddCount_cast {a' b' : Obj S} (f : a ⟶ b) (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b') :
    oddCount (cast f ha hb) = oddCount f

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.hasParity_zero
statement: theorem hasParity_zero (p : ℕ) : HasParity (0 : LinDiagram R a b) p
proof:
:= by
  intro d hd; simp at hd

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.hasParity_single
statement:
theorem hasParity_single {d : a ⟶ b} {p : ℕ} (h : Diagram.oddCount d % 2 = p % 2) (r : R) :
    HasParity (Finsupp.single d r : LinDiagram R a b) p
proof:
:= by
  intro e he
  rw [Finset.mem_singleton.mp (Finsupp.support_single_subset he)]; exact h

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.hasParity_of
statement:
theorem hasParity_of {d : a ⟶ b} {p : ℕ} (h : Diagram.oddCount d % 2 = p % 2) :
    HasParity (of d : LinDiagram R a b) p

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.HasParity.smul
statement:
theorem HasParity.smul {F : LinDiagram R a b} {p : ℕ} (hF : F.HasParity p) (r : R) :
    HasParity (r • F) p
proof:
:=
  fun d hd => hF d (Finsupp.support_smul hd)

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.HasParity.add
statement:
theorem HasParity.add {F G : LinDiagram R a b} {p : ℕ} (hF : F.HasParity p) (hG : G.HasParity p) :
    HasParity (F + G) p
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro d hd
  rcases Finset.mem_union.mp (Finsupp.support_add hd) with h | h
  · exact hF d h
  · exact hG d h

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.parityInv_single
statement:
theorem parityInv_single (d : a ⟶ b) (r : R) :
    parityInv (Finsupp.single d r : LinDiagram R a b) =
      ((-1 : R) ^ Diagram.oddCount d) • (Finsupp.single d r : LinDiagram R a b)
proof:
:= by
  refine (Finsupp.linearCombination_single R (v := fun d : a ⟶ b =>
    ((-1 : R) ^ Diagram.oddCount d) • (of d : LinDiagram R a b)) r d).trans ?_
  rw [smul_comm, Finsupp.smul_single_one]

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.parityInv_of
statement:
theorem parityInv_of (d : a ⟶ b) :
    parityInv (of d : LinDiagram R a b) = ((-1 : R) ^ Diagram.oddCount d) • of d

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.parityInv_eq_of_hasParity
statement:
theorem parityInv_eq_of_hasParity {F : LinDiagram R a b} {p : ℕ} (hF : F.HasParity p) :
    parityInv F = ((-1 : R) ^ p) • F
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← Finsupp.sum_single F]
  conv_rhs => rw [← Finsupp.sum_single F]
  rw [map_finsuppSum, Finsupp.smul_sum]
  refine Finsupp.sum_congr fun d hd => ?_
  rw [parityInv_single, neg_one_pow_eq_pow_mod_two, hF d hd, ← neg_one_pow_eq_pow_mod_two]

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.single_eq_smul_of
statement:
theorem single_eq_smul_of (d : a ⟶ b) (r : R) :
    (Finsupp.single d r : LinDiagram R a b) = r • of d

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.smul_comp_lin
statement:
theorem smul_comp_lin (r : R) (F : LinDiagram R a b) (G : LinDiagram R b c) :
    (r • F) ≫ G = r • (F ≫ G)

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.comp_smul_lin
statement:
theorem comp_smul_lin (F : LinDiagram R a b) (r : R) (G : LinDiagram R b c) :
    F ≫ (r • G) = r • (F ≫ G)

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.single_comp_single
statement:
theorem single_comp_single (d : a ⟶ b) (e : b ⟶ c) (r s : R) :
    (Finsupp.single d r ≫ Finsupp.single e s : Free.of R a ⟶ Free.of R c) =
      Finsupp.single (d ≫ e) (r * s)
proof:
:=
  Free.single_comp_single R (Obj S) d e r s

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.parityInv_comp
statement:
theorem parityInv_comp (F : LinDiagram R a b) (G : LinDiagram R b c) :
    parityInv (F ≫ G) = parityInv F ≫ parityInv G
proof:
:= by
  induction F using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add F₁ F₂ h₁ h₂ => rw [Preadditive.add_comp, map_add, h₁, h₂, map_add, Preadditive.add_comp]
  | single d r =>
    induction G using Finsupp.induction_linear with
    | zero => simp
    | add G₁ G₂ h₁ h₂ =>
      rw [Preadditive.comp_add, map_add, h₁, h₂, map_add, Preadditive.comp_add]
    | single e s =>
      rw [single_comp_single, parityInv_single, parityInv_single, parityInv_single,
        Linear.smul_comp, Linear.comp_smul, single_comp_single, smul_smul, Diagram.oddCount_comp,
        pow_add, mul_comm ((-1 : R) ^ _)]

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.parityInv_parityInv
statement: theorem parityInv_parityInv (F : LinDiagram R a b) : parityInv (parityInv F) = F
proof:
:= by
  induction F using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add F₁ F₂ h₁ h₂ => rw [map_add, map_add, h₁, h₂]
  | single d r =>
    rw [parityInv_single, map_smul, parityInv_single, smul_smul, ← pow_add, ← two_mul, pow_mul,
      neg_one_sq, one_pow, one_smul]

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.parityInv_whisker
statement:
theorem parityInv_whisker (F : LinDiagram R a b) (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour)
    (hw : a.WhiskerOK u v) : parityInv (whisker F u v hw) = whisker (parityInv F) u v hw
proof:
:= by
  induction F using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp [whisker]
  | add F₁ F₂ h₁ h₂ => rw [whisker_add, map_add, h₁, h₂, map_add, whisker_add]
  | single d r =>
    rw [whisker_single, parityInv_single, parityInv_single, whisker_smul, whisker_single,
      Diagram.oddCount_whisker]

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.parityInv_cast
statement:
theorem parityInv_cast {a' b' : Obj S} (F : LinDiagram R a b) (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b') :
    parityInv (cast F ha hb) = cast (parityInv F) ha hb

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.toList_apply
statement:
theorem toList_apply (F : LinDiagram R a b) :
    toList F = Finsupp.mapDomain Diagram.layers F

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.toList_single
statement:
theorem toList_single (d : a ⟶ b) (r : R) :
    toList (Finsupp.single d r : LinDiagram R a b) = Finsupp.single (Diagram.layers d) r

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.toList_of
statement:
theorem toList_of (d : a ⟶ b) :
    toList (of d : LinDiagram R a b) = Finsupp.single (Diagram.layers d) 1

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.toList_injective
statement: theorem toList_injective : Function.Injective (toList : LinDiagram R a b → _)

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.toList_mapDomain
statement:
theorem toList_mapDomain {a' b' : Obj S} (φ : (a ⟶ b) → (a' ⟶ b'))
    (ψ : List (Layer S) → List (Layer S)) (h : ∀ d, Diagram.layers (φ d) = ψ (Diagram.layers d))
    (F : LinDiagram R a b) :
    toList (Finsupp.mapDomain φ F : LinDiagram R a' b') = Finsupp.mapDomain ψ (toList F)
proof:
:= by
  rw [toList_apply, toList_apply, ← Finsupp.mapDomain_comp, ← Finsupp.mapDomain_comp]
  congr 1; funext d; exact h d

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.toList_cast
statement:
theorem toList_cast {a' b' : Obj S} (F : LinDiagram R a b) (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b') :
    toList (cast F ha hb) = toList F
proof:
:= by
  rw [cast, toList_mapDomain (fun d => Diagram.cast d ha hb) id (fun _ => rfl),
    Finsupp.mapDomain_id]

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.toList_whisker
statement:
theorem toList_whisker (F : LinDiagram R a b) (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour)
    (hw : a.WhiskerOK u v) :
    toList (whisker F u v hw) = Finsupp.mapDomain (List.map (·.whisker u v)) (toList F)

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.toList_comp_of
statement:
theorem toList_comp_of (F : LinDiagram R a b) (g : b ⟶ c) :
    toList (F ≫ of g) = Finsupp.mapDomain (· ++ Diagram.layers g) (toList F)
proof:
:= by
  induction F using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add F₁ F₂ h₁ h₂ => rw [Preadditive.add_comp, map_add, h₁, h₂, map_add, Finsupp.mapDomain_add]
  | single d r =>
    rw [single_comp_single, mul_one, toList_single, toList_single, Finsupp.mapDomain_single,
      Diagram.layers_comp]

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.toList_of_comp
statement:
theorem toList_of_comp (f : a ⟶ b) (G : LinDiagram R b c) :
    toList (of f ≫ G) = Finsupp.mapDomain (Diagram.layers f ++ ·) (toList G)
proof:
:= by
  induction G using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add G₁ G₂ h₁ h₂ => rw [Preadditive.comp_add, map_add, h₁, h₂, map_add, Finsupp.mapDomain_add]
  | single d r =>
    rw [single_comp_single, one_mul, toList_single, toList_single, Finsupp.mapDomain_single,
      Diagram.layers_comp]

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.parityList_single
statement:
theorem parityList_single (l : List (Layer S)) (r : R) :
    parityList (Finsupp.single l r) = ((-1 : R) ^ Diagram.oddCountList l) • Finsupp.single l r
proof:
:= by
  refine (Finsupp.linearCombination_single R (v := fun l : List (Layer S) =>
    ((-1 : R) ^ Diagram.oddCountList l) • Finsupp.single l (1 : R)) r l).trans ?_
  rw [smul_comm, Finsupp.smul_single_one]

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.toList_parityInv
statement: theorem toList_parityInv (F : LinDiagram R a b) : toList (parityInv F) = parityList (toList F)
proof:
:= by
  induction F using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add F₁ F₂ h₁ h₂ => rw [map_add, map_add, h₁, h₂, map_add, map_add]
  | single d r =>
    rw [parityInv_single, map_smul, toList_single, parityList_single]; rfl

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.parityList_mapDomain
statement:
theorem parityList_mapDomain (φ : List (Layer S) → List (Layer S)) (k : ℕ)
    (hφ : ∀ l, Diagram.oddCountList (φ l) = Diagram.oddCountList l + k)
    (X : List (Layer S) →₀ R) :
    parityList (Finsupp.mapDomain φ X) = ((-1 : R) ^ k) • Finsupp.mapDomain φ (parityList X)
proof:
:= by
  induction X using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add X₁ X₂ h₁ h₂ => rw [Finsupp.mapDomain_add, map_add, h₁, h₂, map_add,
      Finsupp.mapDomain_add, smul_add]
  | single l r =>
    rw [Finsupp.mapDomain_single, parityList_single, parityList_single, Finsupp.mapDomain_smul,
      Finsupp.mapDomain_single, smul_smul, hφ, pow_add, mul_comm]

name: StringDiagrams.LocalDerivation.derivL_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem derivL_nil : D.derivL [] = 0

name: StringDiagrams.LocalDerivation.derivL_cons
statement:
theorem derivL_cons (L : Layer S) (ls : List (Layer S)) :
    D.derivL (L :: ls) = ((-1 : R) ^ oddCountList ls) •
      Finsupp.mapDomain (fun l => l.map (·.whisker ⟨L.start, L.left⟩ L.right) ++ ls)
        (toList (D.δ L.gen)) +
      Finsupp.mapDomain (L :: ·) (D.derivL ls)

name: StringDiagrams.LocalDerivation.toList_layerDeriv
statement:
theorem toList_layerDeriv (L : Layer S) (hv : L.Valid) :
    toList (D.layerDeriv L hv) =
      Finsupp.mapDomain (List.map (·.whisker ⟨L.start, L.left⟩ L.right)) (toList (D.δ L.gen))

name: StringDiagrams.LocalDerivation.toList_derivList
statement:
theorem toList_derivList (a : Obj S) (ls : List (Layer S)) (b : Obj S) (h : Chain a ls b) :
    toList (D.derivList a ls b h) = D.derivL ls
proof:
:= by
  induction ls generalizing a with
  | nil => simp [derivList]
  | cons L ls ih =>
    rw [derivList, toList_cast, map_add, map_smul, toList_comp_of, toList_of_comp, ih,
      toList_layerDeriv, ← Finsupp.mapDomain_comp, derivL_cons]
    rfl

name: StringDiagrams.LocalDerivation.toList_derivDiag
statement: theorem toList_derivDiag (d : a ⟶ b) : toList (D.derivDiag d) = D.derivL (Diagram.layers d)

name: StringDiagrams.LocalDerivation.derivFree_single
statement:
theorem derivFree_single (d : a ⟶ b) (r : R) :
    D.derivFree (Finsupp.single d r : LinDiagram R a b) = r • D.derivDiag d

name: StringDiagrams.LocalDerivation.derivFree_of
statement: @[simp] theorem derivFree_of (d : a ⟶ b) : D.derivFree (of d : LinDiagram R a b) = D.derivDiag d

name: StringDiagrams.LocalDerivation.derivDiag_layer
statement:
theorem derivDiag_layer (L : Layer S) (hv : L.Valid) (ha : L.dom = a) (hb : L.cod = b) :
    D.derivDiag (Diagram.layer L hv ha hb) = LinDiagram.cast (D.layerDeriv L hv) ha hb
proof:
:= by
  apply toList_injective
  rw [toList_derivDiag, toList_cast, toList_layerDeriv, layers_layer, derivL_cons, derivL_nil,
    Finsupp.mapDomain_zero, add_zero, oddCountList_nil, pow_zero, one_smul]
  simp only [List.append_nil]

name: StringDiagrams.LocalDerivation.derivDiag_layer_of
statement:
theorem derivDiag_layer_of (L : Layer S) (hv : L.Valid) (ha : L.dom = a) (hb : L.cod = b)
    (d : S.genDom L.gen ⟶ S.genCod L.gen) (hd : D.δ L.gen = of d) :
    D.derivDiag (Diagram.layer L hv ha hb) =
      of (Diagram.cast (Diagram.whisker d ⟨L.start, L.left⟩ L.right hv.genWhiskerOK) ha hb)
proof:
:= by
  rw [derivDiag_layer, layerDeriv, hd, whisker_of, cast_of]

name: StringDiagrams.LocalDerivation.derivDiag_id
statement: theorem derivDiag_id (a : Obj S) : D.derivDiag (𝟙 a) = (0 : LinDiagram R a a)

name: StringDiagrams.LocalDerivation.derivDiag_eqToHom
statement: theorem derivDiag_eqToHom (h : a = b) : D.derivDiag (eqToHom h) = (0 : LinDiagram R a b)

name: StringDiagrams.LocalDerivation.derivL_append
statement:
theorem derivL_append (ls ms : List (Layer S)) :
    D.derivL (ls ++ ms) = ((-1 : R) ^ oddCountList ms) •
      Finsupp.mapDomain (· ++ ms) (D.derivL ls) + Finsupp.mapDomain (ls ++ ·) (D.derivL ms)
proof:
:= by
  induction ls with
  | nil =>
    simp only [derivL_nil, Finsupp.mapDomain_zero, smul_zero, zero_add, List.nil_append]
    exact Finsupp.mapDomain_id.symm
  | cons L ls ih =>
    rw [List.cons_append, derivL_cons, derivL_cons, ih, oddCountList_append]
    simp only [Finsupp.mapDomain_add, Finsupp.mapDomain_smul, ← Finsupp.mapDomain_comp,
      Function.comp_def, List.append_assoc, List.cons_append, smul_add, smul_smul, pow_add]
    rw [mul_comm ((-1 : R) ^ oddCountList ms)]
    abel

name: StringDiagrams.LocalDerivation.derivDiag_comp
statement:
theorem derivDiag_comp (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) :
    D.derivDiag (f ≫ g) =
      ((-1 : R) ^ oddCount g) • (D.derivDiag f ≫ of g) + of f ≫ D.derivDiag g
proof:
:= by
  apply toList_injective
  rw [toList_derivDiag, layers_comp, derivL_append, map_add, map_smul, toList_comp_of,
    toList_of_comp, toList_derivDiag, toList_derivDiag]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.LocalDerivation.derivFree_single_comp_single
statement:
theorem derivFree_single_comp_single (d : a ⟶ b) (e : b ⟶ c) (r s : R) :
    D.derivFree ((Finsupp.single d r : LinDiagram R a b) ≫ (Finsupp.single e s : LinDiagram R b c)) =
      D.derivFree (Finsupp.single d r : LinDiagram R a b) ≫
          parityInv (Finsupp.single e s : LinDiagram R b c) +
        (Finsupp.single d r : LinDiagram R a b) ≫ D.derivFree (Finsupp.single e s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [single_comp_single, derivFree_single, derivFree_single, derivFree_single,
    parityInv_single, derivDiag_comp, single_eq_smul_of d r, single_eq_smul_of e s]
  simp only [LinDiagram.smul_comp_lin, LinDiagram.comp_smul_lin, smul_add, smul_smul]
  rw [LinDiagram.comp_smul_lin, LinDiagram.smul_comp_lin, smul_smul, smul_smul]
  module

name: StringDiagrams.LocalDerivation.derivFree_comp
statement:
theorem derivFree_comp (F : LinDiagram R a b) (G : LinDiagram R b c) :
    D.derivFree (F ≫ G) = D.derivFree F ≫ parityInv G + F ≫ D.derivFree G
proof:
:= by
  induction F using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add F₁ F₂ h₁ h₂ =>
    rw [Preadditive.add_comp, map_add, h₁, h₂, map_add, Preadditive.add_comp,
      Preadditive.add_comp]
    abel
  | single d r =>
    induction G using Finsupp.induction_linear with
    | zero => simp
    | add G₁ G₂ h₁ h₂ =>
      rw [Preadditive.comp_add, map_add, h₁, h₂, map_add, map_add, Preadditive.comp_add,
        Preadditive.comp_add]
      abel
    | single e s => exact D.derivFree_single_comp_single d e r s

name: StringDiagrams.LocalDerivation.derivL_map_whisker
statement:
theorem derivL_map_whisker (ls : List (Layer S)) (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour) :
    D.derivL (ls.map (·.whisker u v)) =
      Finsupp.mapDomain (List.map (·.whisker u v)) (D.derivL ls)
proof:
:= by
  induction ls with
  | nil => simp
  | cons L ls ih =>
    rw [List.map_cons, derivL_cons, derivL_cons, ih, oddCountList_map_whisker]
    simp only [Finsupp.mapDomain_add, Finsupp.mapDomain_smul, ← Finsupp.mapDomain_comp,
      Function.comp_def, List.map_append, List.map_map, List.map_cons]
    congr 3
    funext l
    congr 1
    apply List.map_congr_left
    intro X _
    simp [Layer.whisker, List.append_assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.LocalDerivation.derivDiag_whisker
statement:
theorem derivDiag_whisker (d : a ⟶ b) (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour) (hw : a.WhiskerOK u v) :
    D.derivDiag (Diagram.whisker d u v hw) = LinDiagram.whisker (D.derivDiag d) u v hw
proof:
:= by
  apply toList_injective
  rw [toList_derivDiag, toList_whisker, toList_derivDiag, layers_whisker, derivL_map_whisker]

name: StringDiagrams.LocalDerivation.derivFree_whisker
statement:
theorem derivFree_whisker (F : LinDiagram R a b) (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour)
    (hw : a.WhiskerOK u v) :
    D.derivFree (LinDiagram.whisker F u v hw) = LinDiagram.whisker (D.derivFree F) u v hw
proof:
:= by
  induction F using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp [LinDiagram.whisker]
  | add F₁ F₂ h₁ h₂ => rw [whisker_add, map_add, h₁, h₂, map_add, whisker_add]
  | single d r =>
    rw [whisker_single, derivFree_single, derivFree_single, whisker_smul, derivDiag_whisker]

name: StringDiagrams.LocalDerivation.derivFree_whisk
statement:
theorem derivFree_whisk (F : LinDiagram R a b) (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour) :
    D.derivFree (LinDiagram.whisk F u v) = LinDiagram.whisk (D.derivFree F) u v
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : a.WhiskerOK u v
  · rw [whisk_of_ok _ h, whisk_of_ok _ h, derivFree_whisker]
  · rw [whisk_of_not_ok _ h, whisk_of_not_ok _ h, map_zero]

name: StringDiagrams.LocalDerivation.derivFree_cast
statement:
theorem derivFree_cast {a' b' : Obj S} (F : LinDiagram R a b) (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b') :
    D.derivFree (LinDiagram.cast F ha hb) = LinDiagram.cast (D.derivFree F) ha hb

name: StringDiagrams.LocalDerivation.parityList_derivL
statement:
theorem parityList_derivL (ls : List (Layer S)) :
    parityList (D.derivL ls) = -(((-1 : R) ^ oddCountList ls) • D.derivL ls)
proof:
:= by
  induction ls with
  | nil => simp
  | cons L ls ih =>
    have hδ : parityList (toList (D.δ L.gen)) =
        ((-1 : R) ^ ((S.odd L.gen).toNat + 1)) • toList (D.δ L.gen) := by
      rw [← toList_parityInv, parityInv_eq_of_hasParity (D.hasParity L.gen), map_smul]
    rw [derivL_cons, map_add, map_smul,
      parityList_mapDomain _ (oddCountList ls) (fun l => by
        rw [oddCountList_append, oddCountList_map_whisker]),
      parityList_mapDomain _ (S.odd L.gen).toNat (fun l => by
        rw [oddCountList_cons, oddCountList_singleton, add_comm]),
      hδ, ih, oddCountList_cons, oddCountList_singleton]
    simp only [Finsupp.mapDomain_smul]
    have e : ∀ X : List (Layer S) →₀ R, ∀ f : List (Layer S) → List (Layer S),
        Finsupp.mapDomain f (-X) = -Finsupp.mapDomain f X :=
      fun X f => (Finsupp.lmapDomain R R f).map_neg X
    rw [e]
    simp only [smul_add, smul_neg, smul_smul, pow_add, pow_one, Finsupp.mapDomain_smul]
    module

name: StringDiagrams.LocalDerivation.parityInv_derivDiag
statement:
theorem parityInv_derivDiag (d : a ⟶ b) :
    parityInv (D.derivDiag d) = -(((-1 : R) ^ oddCount d) • D.derivDiag d)
proof:
:= by
  apply toList_injective
  rw [toList_parityInv, toList_derivDiag, parityList_derivL, map_neg, map_smul, toList_derivDiag]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.LocalDerivation.parityInv_derivFree
statement:
theorem parityInv_derivFree (F : LinDiagram R a b) :
    parityInv (D.derivFree F) = -D.derivFree (parityInv F)
proof:
:= by
  induction F using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add F₁ F₂ h₁ h₂ => rw [map_add, map_add, h₁, h₂, map_add, map_add, neg_add]
  | single d r =>
    rw [derivFree_single, map_smul, parityInv_derivDiag, parityInv_single, map_smul,
      derivFree_single, smul_neg, smul_smul, smul_smul, mul_comm]

name: StringDiagrams.LocalDerivation.derivFree_derivFree_comp
statement:
theorem derivFree_derivFree_comp (F : LinDiagram R a b) (G : LinDiagram R b c) :
    D.derivFree (D.derivFree (F ≫ G)) =
      D.derivFree (D.derivFree F) ≫ G + F ≫ D.derivFree (D.derivFree G)
proof:
:= by
  rw [derivFree_comp, map_add, derivFree_comp, derivFree_comp, parityInv_parityInv,
    parityInv_derivFree, Preadditive.comp_neg]
  abel

name: StringDiagrams.Layer.whisker_nil_nil
statement:
theorem Layer.whisker_nil_nil [Subsingleton S.Region] (L : Layer S) (r : S.Region) :
    L.whisker ⟨r, []⟩ [] = L

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.layers_ofGen
statement: @[simp] theorem layers_ofGen (g : S.Gen) : layers (ofGen g) = [S.genLayer g]

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.oddCount_ofGen
statement: @[simp] theorem oddCount_ofGen (g : S.Gen) : oddCount (ofGen g) = (S.odd g).toNat

statement:
@[simp] theorem oddCount_whiskerL {b b' : Obj S} (a : Obj S) (g : b ⟶ b') :

statement:
@[simp] theorem oddCount_whiskerR {a a' : Obj S} (f : a ⟶ a') (b : Obj S) :

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.ofLayer_eq_whisker_ofGen

theorem ofLayer_eq_whisker_ofGen (L : Layer S) (hv : L.Valid) :

name: StringDiagrams.InterchangeData.tensor_dom
statement: theorem tensor_dom : (S.genDom x.g).tensor x.rightDom = x.dom
proof:
:=
  Obj.ext (Subsingleton.elim _ _)
    (by simp [Obj.tensor, rightDom, midObj, Signature.genDom, InterchangeData.dom])

name: StringDiagrams.InterchangeData.tensor_cod
statement: theorem tensor_cod : (S.genCod x.g).tensor x.rightCod = x.cod
proof:
:=
  Obj.ext (Subsingleton.elim _ _)
    (by simp [Obj.tensor, rightCod, midObj, Signature.genCod, InterchangeData.cod])

name: StringDiagrams.InterchangeData.layers_leftBelow
statement:
theorem layers_leftBelow (f : S.genDom x.g ⟶ S.genCod x.g) :
    layers (x.leftBelow f) =
      (layers f).map (·.whisker ⟨x.start, []⟩ (x.mid ++ S.dom x.h)) ++ [x.gh₂]
proof:
:= by
  simp only [leftBelow, rightGen, layers_cast, layers_comp, layers_whiskerR, layers_whiskerL,
    layers_ofGen, List.map_cons, List.map_nil]
  congr 1
  · exact List.map_congr_left fun L _ => Layer.ext (Subsingleton.elim _ _) rfl rfl rfl
  · congr 1
    exact Layer.ext (Subsingleton.elim _ _)
      (by simp [Layer.wl, Signature.genLayer, Signature.genCod, midObj, gh₂]) rfl rfl

name: StringDiagrams.InterchangeData.layers_leftAbove
statement:
theorem layers_leftAbove (f : S.genDom x.g ⟶ S.genCod x.g) :
    layers (x.leftAbove f) =
      x.hg₁ :: (layers f).map (·.whisker ⟨x.start, []⟩ (x.mid ++ S.cod x.h))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [leftAbove, rightGen, layers_cast, layers_comp, layers_whiskerR, layers_whiskerL,
    layers_ofGen, List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.cons_append, List.nil_append]
  congr 1
  · exact Layer.ext (Subsingleton.elim _ _)
      (by simp [Layer.wl, Signature.genLayer, Signature.genDom, midObj, hg₁]) rfl rfl
  · exact List.map_congr_left fun L _ => Layer.ext (Subsingleton.elim _ _) rfl rfl rfl

name: StringDiagrams.InterchangeData.layers_rightAbove
statement:
theorem layers_rightAbove (e : S.genDom x.h ⟶ S.genCod x.h) :
    layers (x.rightAbove e) =
      x.gh₁ :: (layers e).map (·.whisker ⟨x.start, S.cod x.g ++ x.mid⟩ [])
proof:
:= by
  simp only [rightAbove, layers_cast, layers_comp, layers_whiskerR, layers_whiskerL,
    layers_ofGen, List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.cons_append, List.nil_append, List.map_map]
  congr 1
  · exact Layer.ext (Subsingleton.elim _ _) rfl rfl
      (by simp [Layer.wr, Signature.genLayer, rightDom, midObj, Obj.tensor, Signature.genDom,
        gh₁])
  · exact List.map_congr_left fun L _ => Layer.ext (Subsingleton.elim _ _)
      (by simp [Layer.wl, Layer.whisker, Signature.genCod, midObj]) rfl (by simp [Layer.wl, Layer.whisker])

name: StringDiagrams.InterchangeData.layers_rightBelow
statement:
theorem layers_rightBelow (e : S.genDom x.h ⟶ S.genCod x.h) :
    layers (x.rightBelow e) =
      (layers e).map (·.whisker ⟨x.start, S.dom x.g ++ x.mid⟩ []) ++ [x.hg₂]
proof:
:= by
  simp only [rightBelow, layers_cast, layers_comp, layers_whiskerR, layers_whiskerL,
    layers_ofGen, List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.map_map]
  congr 1
  · exact List.map_congr_left fun L _ => Layer.ext (Subsingleton.elim _ _)
      (by simp [Layer.wl, Layer.whisker, Signature.genDom, midObj]) rfl (by simp [Layer.wl, Layer.whisker])
  · congr 1
    exact Layer.ext (Subsingleton.elim _ _) rfl rfl
      (by simp [Layer.wr, Signature.genLayer, rightCod, midObj, Obj.tensor, Signature.genCod,
        hg₂])

name: StringDiagrams.InterchangeData.oddCount_gh_eq_hg
statement: theorem oddCount_gh_eq_hg (hx : x.Valid) : oddCount (ghDiagram hx) = oddCount (hgDiagram hx)
proof:
:= by
  show oddCountList [x.gh₁, x.gh₂] = oddCountList [x.hg₁, x.hg₂]
  rw [oddCountList_cons, oddCountList_cons x.hg₁, oddCountList_singleton, oddCountList_singleton,
    oddCountList_singleton, oddCountList_singleton]
  exact add_comm _ _

name: StringDiagrams.InterchangeData.sign_eq
statement:
theorem sign_eq (R : Type w) [CommRing R] :
    ((x.sign : ℤ) : R) = (-1 : R) ^ ((S.odd x.g).toNat * (S.odd x.h).toNat)
proof:
:= by
  unfold sign
  cases S.odd x.g <;> cases S.odd x.h <;> simp

name: StringDiagrams.LocalDerivation.derivDiag_ofGen
statement: theorem derivDiag_ofGen (g : S.Gen) : D.derivDiag (ofGen g) = D.δ g
proof:
:= by
  apply toList_injective
  rw [toList_derivDiag, layers_ofGen, derivL_cons, derivL_nil, Finsupp.mapDomain_zero, add_zero,
    oddCountList_nil, pow_zero, one_smul]
  have e : (fun l : List (Layer S) =>
      l.map (·.whisker ⟨(S.genLayer g).start, (S.genLayer g).left⟩ (S.genLayer g).right) ++
        []) = id := by
    funext l; simp [Layer.whisker_nil_nil, Signature.genLayer]
  rw [e, Finsupp.mapDomain_id]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.LocalDerivation.derivDiag_gh
statement:
theorem derivDiag_gh (x : InterchangeData S) (hx : x.Valid) :
    D.derivDiag (InterchangeData.ghDiagram hx) =
      ((-1 : R) ^ (S.odd x.h).toNat) • Finsupp.mapDomain x.leftBelow (D.δ x.g) +
        Finsupp.mapDomain x.rightAbove (D.δ x.h)
proof:
:= by
  apply toList_injective
  rw [map_add, map_smul, toList_mapDomain _ (fun l => l.map (·.whisker ⟨x.start, []⟩ (x.mid ++ S.dom x.h)) ++ [x.gh₂])
      x.layers_leftBelow,
    toList_mapDomain _ (fun l => x.gh₁ :: l.map (·.whisker ⟨x.start, S.cod x.g ++ x.mid⟩ []))
      x.layers_rightAbove, toList_derivDiag]
  show D.derivL [x.gh₁, x.gh₂] = _
  rw [derivL_cons, derivL_cons, derivL_nil, Finsupp.mapDomain_zero, add_zero, oddCountList_nil,
    pow_zero, one_smul, oddCountList_singleton, ← Finsupp.mapDomain_comp]
  simp only [Function.comp_def, List.append_nil]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.LocalDerivation.derivDiag_hg
statement:
theorem derivDiag_hg (x : InterchangeData S) (hx : x.Valid) :
    D.derivDiag (InterchangeData.hgDiagram hx) =
      ((-1 : R) ^ (S.odd x.g).toNat) • Finsupp.mapDomain x.rightBelow (D.δ x.h) +
        Finsupp.mapDomain x.leftAbove (D.δ x.g)
proof:
:= by
  apply toList_injective
  rw [map_add, map_smul, toList_mapDomain _ (fun l => l.map (·.whisker ⟨x.start, S.dom x.g ++ x.mid⟩ []) ++ [x.hg₂])
      x.layers_rightBelow,
    toList_mapDomain _ (fun l => x.hg₁ :: l.map (·.whisker ⟨x.start, []⟩ (x.mid ++ S.cod x.h)))
      x.layers_leftAbove, toList_derivDiag]
  show D.derivL [x.hg₁, x.hg₂] = _
  rw [derivL_cons, derivL_cons, derivL_nil, Finsupp.mapDomain_zero, add_zero, oddCountList_nil,
    pow_zero, one_smul, oddCountList_singleton, ← Finsupp.mapDomain_comp]
  simp only [Function.comp_def, List.append_nil]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.LocalDerivation.diag_cast_interchange
statement:
theorem diag_cast_interchange {a a' b b' c c' : Obj S} (f : a ⟶ a') (g : b ⟶ b')
    (hc : a.tensor b = c) (hc' : a'.tensor b' = c') :
    P.diag (cast (whiskerR f b ≫ whiskerL a' g) hc hc') =
      ((-1 : R) ^ (oddCount f * oddCount g)) •
        P.diag (cast (whiskerL a g ≫ whiskerR f b') hc hc')
proof:
:= by
  subst hc hc'
  rw [cast_rfl, cast_rfl, P.diag_interchange_diagrams, ← Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul R]
  push_cast; rfl

name: StringDiagrams.LocalDerivation.lin_mapDomain_eq_smul
statement:
theorem lin_mapDomain_eq_smul {a b c d : Obj S} (φ ψ : (a ⟶ b) → (c ⟶ d))
    (F : LinDiagram R a b) (k : R)
    (h : ∀ e ∈ Finsupp.support F, P.diag (φ e) = k • P.diag (ψ e)) :
    P.lin (Finsupp.mapDomain φ F : LinDiagram R c d) =
      k • P.lin (Finsupp.mapDomain ψ F : LinDiagram R c d)
proof:
:= by
  have hF : ∀ χ : (a ⟶ b) → (c ⟶ d), P.lin (Finsupp.mapDomain χ F : LinDiagram R c d) =
      F.sum fun e r => r • P.diag (χ e) := by
    intro χ
    show (P.linFunctor.mapLinearMap R) (F.sum fun e r => Finsupp.single (χ e) r) = _
    rw [map_finsuppSum]
    exact Finsupp.sum_congr fun e _ => P.lin_single (χ e) _
  rw [hF, hF, Finsupp.smul_sum]
  exact Finsupp.sum_congr fun e he => by rw [h e he, smul_comm]

name: StringDiagrams.LocalDerivation.neg_one_pow_of_mod
statement: theorem neg_one_pow_of_mod {m n : ℕ} (h : m % 2 = n % 2) : (-1 : R) ^ m = (-1) ^ n

name: StringDiagrams.LocalDerivation.lin_derivFree_interchange
statement:
theorem lin_derivFree_interchange (x : InterchangeData S) (hx : x.Valid) :
    P.lin (D.derivFree (InterchangeData.rel R hx)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ : P.lin (Finsupp.mapDomain x.leftBelow (D.δ x.g) : LinDiagram R x.dom x.cod) =
      ((-1 : R) ^ (((S.odd x.g).toNat + 1) * (S.odd x.h).toNat)) •
        P.lin (Finsupp.mapDomain x.leftAbove (D.δ x.g) : LinDiagram R x.dom x.cod) := by
    refine lin_mapDomain_eq_smul P _ _ _ _ fun e he => ?_
    refine (diag_cast_interchange P e x.rightGen _ _).trans ?_
    rw [InterchangeData.rightGen, oddCount_whiskerL, oddCount_ofGen, pow_mul, pow_mul,
      neg_one_pow_of_mod (D.hasParity x.g e he)]
    rfl
  have h₂ : P.lin (Finsupp.mapDomain x.rightAbove (D.δ x.h) : LinDiagram R x.dom x.cod) =
      ((-1 : R) ^ ((S.odd x.g).toNat * ((S.odd x.h).toNat + 1))) •
        P.lin (Finsupp.mapDomain x.rightBelow (D.δ x.h) : LinDiagram R x.dom x.cod) := by
    refine lin_mapDomain_eq_smul P _ _ _ _ fun e he => ?_
    refine (diag_cast_interchange P (ofGen x.g) (whiskerL x.midObj e) _ _).trans ?_
    rw [oddCount_whiskerL, oddCount_ofGen, mul_comm, pow_mul,
      neg_one_pow_of_mod (D.hasParity x.h e he), ← pow_mul, mul_comm]
    rfl
  rw [InterchangeData.rel, map_sub, map_smul, derivFree_of, derivFree_of, derivDiag_gh,
    derivDiag_hg, P.lin_sub, P.lin_smul, P.lin_add, P.lin_add, P.lin_smul, P.lin_smul, h₁, h₂,
    InterchangeData.sign_eq]
  cases S.odd x.g <;> cases S.odd x.h <;> simp <;> abel

name: StringDiagrams.LocalDerivation.Compatible.parityInv_allRel
statement:
theorem Compatible.parityInv_allRel (hP : D.Compatible P) (k : P.AllRel) :
    ∃ p : ℕ, parityInv k.rel = ((-1 : R) ^ p) • k.rel
proof:
:= by
  cases k with
  | user i =>
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hP.hasParity i
    exact ⟨p, parityInv_eq_of_hasParity hp⟩
  | interchange x hx =>
    refine ⟨oddCount (InterchangeData.ghDiagram hx), ?_⟩
    show parityInv (InterchangeData.rel R hx) = _ • InterchangeData.rel R hx
    rw [InterchangeData.rel, map_sub, map_smul, parityInv_of, parityInv_of,
      x.oddCount_gh_eq_hg hx, smul_sub, smul_comm]

name: StringDiagrams.LocalDerivation.Compatible.derivFree_allRel_mem_ideal
statement:
theorem Compatible.derivFree_allRel_mem_ideal (hP : D.Compatible P) (k : P.AllRel) :
    D.derivFree k.rel ∈ P.ideal k.dom k.cod
proof:
:= by
  have h : P.lin (D.derivFree k.rel) = 0 := by
    cases k with
    | user i => exact hP.rel i
    | interchange x hx => exact D.lin_derivFree_interchange P x hx
  rw [← P.lin_zero, P.lin_eq_iff, sub_zero] at h
  exact h

name: StringDiagrams.LocalDerivation.derivFree_mem_ideal
statement:
theorem derivFree_mem_ideal (hP : D.Compatible P) {a b : Obj S} {F : LinDiagram R a b}
    (hF : F ∈ P.ideal a b) : D.derivFree F ∈ P.ideal a b
proof:
:= by
  induction hF using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨k, u, v, hw, pre, post⟩ := hy
    have hW : LinDiagram.whisker k.rel u v hw ∈ P.ideal _ _ := P.whisker_rel_mem_ideal k u v hw
    have hdW : D.derivFree (LinDiagram.whisker k.rel u v hw) ∈ P.ideal _ _ := by
      rw [derivFree_whisker, ← LinDiagram.whisk_of_ok _ hw]
      exact P.whisk_mem_ideal (hP.derivFree_allRel_mem_ideal k) u v
    have hσW : parityInv (LinDiagram.whisker k.rel u v hw) ∈ P.ideal _ _ := by
      obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hP.parityInv_allRel k
      rw [parityInv_whisker, hp, whisker_smul]
      exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hW
    rw [derivFree_comp, derivFree_comp, parityInv_comp]
    exact Submodule.add_mem _ (P.comp_mem_ideal _ (P.mem_ideal_comp hσW _))
      (P.comp_mem_ideal _ (Submodule.add_mem _ (P.mem_ideal_comp hdW _) (P.mem_ideal_comp hW _)))
  | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  | add y z _ _ hy hz => rw [map_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hy hz
  | smul r y _ hy => rw [map_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ r hy

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.deriv_lin
statement: @[simp] theorem deriv_lin (F : LinDiagram R a b) : P.deriv hP (P.lin F) = P.lin (D.derivFree F)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.deriv_diag
statement: theorem deriv_diag (d : a ⟶ b) : P.deriv hP (P.diag d) = P.lin (D.derivDiag d)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.deriv_ofGen
statement: theorem deriv_ofGen (g : S.Gen) : P.deriv hP (P.diag (ofGen g)) = P.lin (D.δ g)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.deriv_layer
statement:
theorem deriv_layer (L : Layer S) (hv : L.Valid) (ha : L.dom = a) (hb : L.cod = b) :
    P.deriv hP (P.diag (Diagram.layer L hv ha hb)) =
      P.lin (LinDiagram.cast (D.layerDeriv L hv) ha hb)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.deriv_layer_of
statement:
theorem deriv_layer_of (L : Layer S) (hv : L.Valid) (ha : L.dom = a) (hb : L.cod = b)
    (d : S.genDom L.gen ⟶ S.genCod L.gen) (hd : D.δ L.gen = LinDiagram.of d) :
    P.deriv hP (P.diag (Diagram.layer L hv ha hb)) =
      P.diag (Diagram.cast (Diagram.whisker d ⟨L.start, L.left⟩ L.right hv.genWhiskerOK) ha hb)
proof:
:= by
  rw [deriv_diag, derivDiag_layer_of D L hv ha hb d hd, lin_of]

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.deriv_id
statement: theorem deriv_id (a : Obj S) : P.deriv hP (𝟙 (P.obj a)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← diag_id, deriv_diag, derivDiag_id, lin_zero]

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.deriv_comp_lin
statement:
theorem deriv_comp_lin (F : LinDiagram R a b) (G : LinDiagram R b c) :
    P.deriv hP (P.lin F ≫ P.lin G) =
      P.deriv hP (P.lin F) ≫ P.lin (parityInv G) + P.lin F ≫ P.deriv hP (P.lin G)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← lin_comp, deriv_lin, derivFree_comp, lin_add, lin_comp, lin_comp]; rfl

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.deriv_comp
statement:
theorem deriv_comp (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b) {G : LinDiagram R b c} {p : ℕ} (hG : G.HasParity p) :
    P.deriv hP (f ≫ P.lin G) =
      ((-1 : R) ^ p) • (P.deriv hP f ≫ P.lin G) + f ≫ P.deriv hP (P.lin G)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨F, rfl⟩ := P.lin_surjective f
  rw [deriv_comp_lin, parityInv_eq_of_hasParity hG, lin_smul, Linear.comp_smul]

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.deriv_comp_diag
statement:
theorem deriv_comp_diag (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b) (g : b ⟶ c) :
    P.deriv hP (f ≫ P.diag g) =
      ((-1 : R) ^ oddCount g) • (P.deriv hP f ≫ P.diag g) + f ≫ P.deriv hP (P.diag g)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.derivEnd_apply
statement: theorem derivEnd_apply (f : End (P.obj a)) : P.derivEnd hP a f = P.deriv hP f

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.deriv_mul
statement:
theorem deriv_mul (f g : End (P.obj a)) {F : LinDiagram R a a} {p : ℕ} (hF : F.HasParity p)
    (hf : P.lin F = f) :
    P.derivEnd hP a (f * g) = P.derivEnd hP a f * g + ((-1 : R) ^ p) • (f * P.derivEnd hP a g)
proof:
:= by
  subst hf
  rw [End.mul_def, End.mul_def, End.mul_def, derivEnd_apply, derivEnd_apply, derivEnd_apply,
    P.deriv_comp hP g hF, add_comm]

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.deriv_whisk
statement:
theorem deriv_whisk (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b) (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour) :
    P.deriv hP (P.whisk f u v) = P.whisk (P.deriv hP f) u v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨F, rfl⟩ := P.lin_surjective f
  rw [whisk_lin, deriv_lin, deriv_lin, whisk_lin, derivFree_whisk]

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.deriv_deriv_comp
statement:
theorem deriv_deriv_comp (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b) (g : P.obj b ⟶ P.obj c) :
    P.deriv hP (P.deriv hP (f ≫ g)) =
      P.deriv hP (P.deriv hP f) ≫ g + f ≫ P.deriv hP (P.deriv hP g)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨F, rfl⟩ := P.lin_surjective f
  obtain ⟨G, rfl⟩ := P.lin_surjective g
  rw [← lin_comp, deriv_lin, deriv_lin, derivFree_derivFree_comp, lin_add, lin_comp, lin_comp]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.deriv_deriv_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  refine P.hom_induction_layers (p := fun f => P.deriv hP (P.deriv hP f) = 0) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ f
  · intro a b e
    subst e
    rw [eqToHom_refl, diag_id, deriv_id, map_zero]
  · intro L hv
    have e : P.diag (ofLayer L hv) = P.whisk (P.diag (ofGen L.gen)) ⟨L.start, L.left⟩ L.right := by
      rw [P.whisk_diag _ _ _ hv.genWhiskerOK, ofLayer_eq_whisker_ofGen]
    have h₂ : P.deriv hP (P.deriv hP
        (P.whisk (P.diag (ofGen L.gen)) ⟨L.start, L.left⟩ L.right)) = 0 := by
      rw [deriv_whisk, deriv_whisk, h, whisk_zero]
    show P.deriv hP (P.deriv hP (P.diag (ofLayer L hv))) = 0
    rw [e]; exact h₂
  · intro a b c f g hf hg
    show P.deriv hP (P.deriv hP (f ≫ g)) = 0
    rw [deriv_deriv_comp, hf, hg, Limits.zero_comp, Limits.comp_zero, add_zero]
  · intro a b
    show P.deriv hP (P.deriv hP 0) = 0
    rw [map_zero, map_zero]
  · intro a b f g hf hg
    show P.deriv hP (P.deriv hP (f + g)) = 0
    rw [map_add, map_add, hf, hg, add_zero]
  · intro a b r f hf
    show P.deriv hP (P.deriv hP (r • f)) = 0
    rw [map_smul, map_smul, hf, smul_zero]

name: StringDiagrams.Obj.nil_start
statement: @[simp] theorem nil_start (r : S.Region) : (nil r).start = r

name: StringDiagrams.Obj.nil_word

name: StringDiagrams.Obj.tensor_eq_whisker_nil_of_start
statement:
theorem tensor_eq_whisker_nil_of_start {a : Obj S} (b : Obj S) {r : S.Region}
    (h : a.start = r) : a.tensor b = a.whisker (nil r) b.word
proof:
:= by
  ext
  · exact h
  · simp [tensor, whisker, nil]

name: StringDiagrams.Obj.nil_tensor
statement: theorem nil_tensor {b : Obj S} {r : S.Region} (h : b.start = r) : (nil r).tensor b = b
proof:

name: StringDiagrams.Obj.Composable.tensor_left

theorem Composable.nil_right (ha : a.WF) {r : S.Region} (h : a.endR = r) :

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.wRAt_comp
statement:
theorem wRAt_comp (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj a') (f' : P.obj a' ⟶ P.obj a'') (b : Obj S) :
    P.wRAt r (f ≫ f') b ha ha'' = P.wRAt r f b ha ha' ≫ P.wRAt r f' b ha' ha''

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.wRAt_add
statement:
theorem wRAt_add (f f' : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj a') (b : Obj S) :
    P.wRAt r (f + f') b ha ha' = P.wRAt r f b ha ha' + P.wRAt r f' b ha ha'

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.wRAt_smul
statement:
theorem wRAt_smul (x : R) (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj a') (b : Obj S) :
    P.wRAt r (x • f) b ha ha' = x • P.wRAt r f b ha ha'

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.wRAt_zero
statement: theorem wRAt_zero (b : Obj S) : P.wRAt r (0 : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj a') b ha ha' = 0

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.wRAt_id
statement:
theorem wRAt_id (b : Obj S) (hb : S.ok a.endR b.word) :
    P.wRAt r (𝟙 (P.obj a)) b ha ha = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  have hw : a.WhiskerOK (Obj.nil r) b.word := ⟨trivial, ha.symm, hb⟩
  simp [wRAt, P.whisk_id a _ _ hw]

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.wRAt_eqToHom
statement:
theorem wRAt_eqToHom (h : P.obj a = P.obj a') (b : Obj S) (hb : S.ok a.endR b.word)
    (ha : a.start = r) (ha' : a'.start = r) :
    P.wRAt r (eqToHom h) b ha ha' = eqToHom (by rw [P.obj_injective h])
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl := P.obj_injective h
  simp [P.wRAt_id ha b hb]

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.wRAt_diag
statement:
theorem wRAt_diag (f : a ⟶ a') (b : Obj S) (h : a.Composable b) (ha : a.start = r)
    (ha' : a'.start = r) : P.wRAt r (P.diag f) b ha ha' = P.diag (Diagram.rwhisker f b h)
proof:
:= by
  have hw : a.WhiskerOK (Obj.nil r) b.word := ⟨trivial, ha.symm, h.ok_endR⟩
  rw [wRAt, P.whisk_diag f _ _ hw]
  simp only [P.eqToHom_obj, ← P.diag_comp]
  apply P.diag_eq_of_layers_eq
  simp only [Diagram.layers_comp, Diagram.layers_eqToHom, Diagram.layers_whisker,
    Diagram.layers_rwhisker, List.nil_append, List.append_nil]
  exact List.map_congr_left fun L hL =>
    Layer.ext (by show r = L.start; rw [(Diagram.chain f).start_of_mem hL, ha]) (List.nil_append _)
      rfl rfl

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.wL_id_of_composable
statement: theorem wL_id_of_composable (h : a.Composable b) : P.wL a (𝟙 (P.obj b)) = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  simp [wL, P.whisk_id b a [] ⟨h.left_wf, h.endR_eq, trivial⟩]

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.wL_eqToHom_of_composable
statement:
theorem wL_eqToHom_of_composable (h : P.obj b = P.obj b') (hab : a.Composable b) :
    P.wL a (eqToHom h) = eqToHom (by rw [P.obj_injective h])
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl := P.obj_injective h
  simp [P.wL_id_of_composable hab]

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.wL_diag_of_composable
statement:
theorem wL_diag_of_composable (a : Obj S) (g : b ⟶ b') (h : a.Composable b) :
    P.wL a (P.diag g) = P.diag (Diagram.lwhisker a g h)
proof:
:= by
  rw [wL, P.whisk_diag g a [] ⟨h.left_wf, h.endR_eq, trivial⟩]
  simp only [P.eqToHom_obj, ← P.diag_comp]
  apply P.diag_eq_of_layers_eq
  simp only [Diagram.layers_comp, Diagram.layers_eqToHom, Diagram.layers_lwhisker,
    List.nil_append, List.append_nil]
  exact List.map_congr_left fun L _ => Layer.ext rfl rfl rfl (List.append_nil _)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.wL_tensor
statement:
theorem wL_tensor (hab : a.Composable b) (hbc : b.Composable c) (g : P.obj c ⟶ P.obj c') :
    P.wL (a.tensor b) g =
      eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.tensor_assoc a b c)) ≫ P.wL a (P.wL b g) ≫
        eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.tensor_assoc a b c')).symm
proof:
:= by
  induction g using P.hom_induction with
  | diag d =>
    rw [P.wL_diag_of_composable _ d (hab.tensor_left hbc), P.wL_diag_of_composable _ d hbc,
      P.wL_diag_of_composable _ _ (hab.tensor_right hbc)]
    simp only [P.eqToHom_obj, ← P.diag_comp]
    apply P.diag_eq_of_layers_eq
    simp [Layer.wl, Obj.tensor]
  | zero => simp [wL_zero]
  | add f g hf hg => simp only [wL_add, Preadditive.add_comp, Preadditive.comp_add, hf, hg]
  | smul x f hf => simp only [wL_smul, Linear.smul_comp, Linear.comp_smul, hf]

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.wRAt_tensor
statement:
theorem wRAt_tensor (hab : a.Composable b) (hbc : b.Composable c) (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj a')
    (ha : a.start = r) (ha' : a'.start = r) :
    P.wRAt r f (b.tensor c) ha ha' =
      eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.tensor_assoc a b c)).symm ≫
        P.wRAt r (P.wRAt r f b ha ha') c ha ha' ≫
          eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.tensor_assoc a' b c))
proof:
:= by
  induction f using P.hom_induction with
  | diag d =>
    have h₁ : (a.tensor b).Composable c := hab.tensor_left hbc
    rw [P.wRAt_diag d _ hab, P.wRAt_diag _ c h₁, P.wRAt_diag d _ (hab.tensor_right hbc)]
    simp only [P.eqToHom_obj, ← P.diag_comp]
    apply P.diag_eq_of_layers_eq
    simp [Layer.wr, Obj.tensor]
  | zero => simp [wRAt_zero]
  | add f g hf hg => simp only [wRAt_add, Preadditive.add_comp, Preadditive.comp_add, hf, hg]
  | smul x f hf => simp only [wRAt_smul, Linear.smul_comp, Linear.comp_smul, hf]

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.wRAt_wL
statement:
theorem wRAt_wL (hab : a.Composable b) (hbc : b.Composable c) (g : P.obj b ⟶ P.obj b')
    (ha : a.start = r) (hb : b.start = s) (hb' : b'.start = s) :
    P.wRAt r (P.wL a g) c ha ha =
      eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.tensor_assoc a b c)) ≫ P.wL a (P.wRAt s g c hb hb') ≫
        eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.tensor_assoc a b' c)).symm
proof:
:= by
  induction g using P.hom_induction with
  | diag d =>
    rw [P.wL_diag_of_composable _ d hab, P.wRAt_diag _ c (hab.tensor_left hbc),
      P.wRAt_diag d c hbc, P.wL_diag_of_composable _ _ (hab.tensor_right hbc)]
    simp only [P.eqToHom_obj, ← P.diag_comp]
    apply P.diag_eq_of_layers_eq
    simp [Layer.wr, Layer.wl, Obj.tensor]
  | zero => simp [wRAt_zero, wL_zero]
  | add f g hf hg =>
    simp only [wRAt_add, wL_add, Preadditive.add_comp, Preadditive.comp_add, hf, hg]
  | smul x f hf => simp only [wRAt_smul, wL_smul, Linear.smul_comp, Linear.comp_smul, hf]

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.wL_nil
statement:
theorem wL_nil (g : P.obj b ⟶ P.obj b') (hb : b.WF) (hs : b.start = r) (hs' : b'.start = r) :
    P.wL (Obj.nil r) g =
      eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.nil_tensor hs)) ≫ g ≫
        eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.nil_tensor hs')).symm
proof:
:= by
  induction g using P.hom_induction with
  | diag d =>
    rw [P.wL_diag_of_composable _ d (Obj.Composable.nil_left hb hs)]
    simp only [P.eqToHom_obj, ← P.diag_comp]
    apply P.diag_eq_of_layers_eq
    simp only [Diagram.layers_comp, Diagram.layers_eqToHom, Diagram.layers_lwhisker,
      List.nil_append, List.append_nil]
    conv_rhs => rw [← List.map_id (Diagram.layers d)]
    exact List.map_congr_left fun L hL =>
      Layer.ext (by show r = L.start; rw [(Diagram.chain d).start_of_mem hL, hs])
        (List.nil_append _) rfl rfl
  | zero => simp [wL_zero]
  | add f g hf hg => simp only [wL_add, Preadditive.add_comp, Preadditive.comp_add, hf, hg]
  | smul x f hf => simp only [wL_smul, Linear.smul_comp, Linear.comp_smul, hf]

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.wRAt_nil
statement:
theorem wRAt_nil (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj a') (ha : a.WF) (he : a.endR = s) (hr : a.start = r)
    (hr' : a'.start = r) :
    P.wRAt r f (Obj.nil s) hr hr' =
      eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.tensor_nil a s)) ≫ f ≫
        eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.tensor_nil a' s)).symm
proof:
:= by
  induction f using P.hom_induction with
  | diag d =>
    rw [P.wRAt_diag d _ (Obj.Composable.nil_right ha he)]
    simp only [P.eqToHom_obj, ← P.diag_comp]
    apply P.diag_eq_of_layers_eq
    simp only [Diagram.layers_comp, Diagram.layers_eqToHom, Diagram.layers_rwhisker,
      List.nil_append, List.append_nil, Obj.nil_word]
    conv_rhs => rw [← List.map_id (Diagram.layers d)]
    exact List.map_congr_left fun L _ => Layer.ext rfl rfl rfl (List.append_nil _)
  | zero => simp [wRAt_zero]
  | add f g hf hg => simp only [wRAt_add, Preadditive.add_comp, Preadditive.comp_add, hf, hg]
  | smul x f hf => simp only [wRAt_smul, Linear.smul_comp, Linear.comp_smul, hf]

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.wRAt_diag_comp_wL_diag
statement:
theorem wRAt_diag_comp_wL_diag (h : a.Composable b) (f : a ⟶ a') (g : b ⟶ b')
    (ha : a.start = r) (ha' : a'.start = r) :
    P.wRAt r (P.diag f) b ha ha' ≫ P.wL a' (P.diag g) =
      ((-1 : ℤ) ^ (Diagram.oddCount f * Diagram.oddCount g)) •
        (P.wL a (P.diag g) ≫ P.wRAt r (P.diag f) b' ha ha')
proof:
:= by
  rw [P.wRAt_diag f b h, P.wL_diag_of_composable a' g (h.map_left f),
    P.wL_diag_of_composable a g h, P.wRAt_diag f b' (h.map_right g), ← P.diag_comp,
    ← P.diag_comp, P.diag_interchange_of_composable]

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.wRAt_comp_wL
statement:
theorem wRAt_comp_wL [S.IsEven] (h : a.Composable b) (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj a')
    (g : P.obj b ⟶ P.obj b') (ha : a.start = r) (ha' : a'.start = r) :
    P.wRAt r f b ha ha' ≫ P.wL a' g = P.wL a g ≫ P.wRAt r f b' ha ha'
proof:
:= by
  induction f using P.hom_induction with
  | diag d =>
    induction g using P.hom_induction with
    | diag e =>
      rw [P.wRAt_diag_comp_wL_diag h d e, Diagram.oddCount_eq_zero, zero_mul, pow_zero,
        one_smul]
    | zero => simp [wL_zero]
    | add g g' hg hg' =>
      simp only [wL_add, Preadditive.add_comp, Preadditive.comp_add, hg, hg']
    | smul x g hg => simp only [wL_smul, Linear.smul_comp, Linear.comp_smul, hg]
  | zero => simp [wRAt_zero]
  | add f f' hf hf' => simp only [wRAt_add, Preadditive.add_comp, Preadditive.comp_add, hf, hf']
  | smul x f hf => simp only [wRAt_smul, Linear.smul_comp, Linear.comp_smul, hf]

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.hcomp_diag
statement:
theorem hcomp_diag (h : a.Composable b) (f : a ⟶ a') (g : b ⟶ b') (ha : a.start = r)
    (ha' : a'.start = r) :
    P.hcomp r (P.diag f) (P.diag g) ha ha' =
      P.diag (Diagram.rwhisker f b h ≫ Diagram.lwhisker a' g (h.map_left f))
proof:
:= by
  rw [hcomp, P.wRAt_diag f b h, P.wL_diag_of_composable a' g (h.map_left f), P.diag_comp]

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.hcomp_id
statement:
theorem hcomp_id (h : a.Composable b) (ha : a.start = r) :
    P.hcomp r (𝟙 (P.obj a)) (𝟙 (P.obj b)) ha ha = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  rw [hcomp, P.wRAt_id ha b h.ok_endR, P.wL_id_of_composable h, Category.comp_id]

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.hcomp_eq
statement:
theorem hcomp_eq [S.IsEven] (h : a.Composable b) (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj a')
    (g : P.obj b ⟶ P.obj b') (ha : a.start = r) (ha' : a'.start = r) :
    P.hcomp r f g ha ha' = P.wL a g ≫ P.wRAt r f b' ha ha'
proof:
:=
  P.wRAt_comp_wL h f g ha ha'

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.hcomp_comp
statement:
theorem hcomp_comp [S.IsEven] (h : a'.Composable b) (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj a')
    (f' : P.obj a' ⟶ P.obj a'') (g : P.obj b ⟶ P.obj b') (g' : P.obj b' ⟶ P.obj b'')
    (ha : a.start = r) (ha' : a'.start = r) (ha'' : a''.start = r) :
    P.hcomp r (f ≫ f') (g ≫ g') ha ha'' =
      P.hcomp r f g ha ha' ≫ P.hcomp r f' g' ha' ha''
proof:
:= by
  simp only [hcomp, P.wRAt_comp ha ha' ha'', wL_comp, Category.assoc]
  rw [← Category.assoc (P.wRAt r f' b ha' ha''), P.wRAt_comp_wL h f' g ha' ha'',
    Category.assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.Bicat.Hom.composable
statement: theorem Hom.composable (a : Hom l m) (b : Hom m n) : a.obj.Composable b.obj

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.Bicat.Hom.id_obj
statement: @[simp] theorem Hom.id_obj (l : P.Bicat) : (Hom.id l).obj = Obj.nil l.region

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.Bicat.Hom.comp_obj
statement:
@[simp] theorem Hom.comp_obj (a : Hom l m) (b : Hom m n) :
    (a.comp b).obj = a.obj.tensor b.obj

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.Bicat.isoOfEq_eq_eqToIso
statement:
theorem isoOfEq_eq_eqToIso {a b : Hom l m} (e : a.obj = b.obj) (e' : a = b) :
    isoOfEq e = eqToIso e'
proof:
:= by
  subst e'
  apply Iso.ext
  exact eqToHom_refl (P.obj a.obj) (congrArg P.obj e)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.Bicat.pentagon_aux
statement:
theorem pentagon_aux (a : Hom l m) (b : Hom m n) (c : Hom n k) (d : Hom k j) :
    P.wRAt l.region (eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.tensor_assoc a.obj b.obj c.obj))) d.obj
        a.start_eq a.start_eq ≫
      eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.tensor_assoc a.obj (b.obj.tensor c.obj) d.obj)) ≫
        P.wL a.obj (eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.tensor_assoc b.obj c.obj d.obj))) =
      eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.tensor_assoc (a.obj.tensor b.obj) c.obj d.obj)) ≫
        eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.tensor_assoc a.obj b.obj (c.obj.tensor d.obj)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [P.wRAt_eqToHom _ _ (((a.comp b).comp c).composable d).ok_endR,
    P.wL_eqToHom_of_composable _ (a.composable ((b.comp c).comp d))]
  simp

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.Bicat.triangle_aux
statement:
theorem triangle_aux (a : Hom l m) (b : Hom m n) :
    eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.tensor_assoc a.obj (Obj.nil m.region) b.obj)) ≫
        P.wL a.obj (eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.nil_tensor b.start_eq))) =
      P.wRAt l.region (eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.tensor_nil a.obj m.region))) b.obj
        a.start_eq a.start_eq
proof:
:= by
  rw [P.wRAt_eqToHom _ _ ((a.comp (Hom.id m)).composable b).ok_endR,
    P.wL_eqToHom_of_composable _ (a.composable ((Hom.id m).comp b))]
  simp

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.Bicat.whiskerLeft_eq
statement:
theorem Bicat.whiskerLeft_eq (a : l ⟶ m) {b b' : m ⟶ n} (θ : b ⟶ b') :
    a ◁ θ = P.wL (Bicat.Hom.obj a) θ

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.Bicat.whiskerRight_eq
statement:
theorem Bicat.whiskerRight_eq {a a' : l ⟶ m} (η : a ⟶ a') (b : m ⟶ n) :
    η ▷ b = P.wRAt l.region η (Bicat.Hom.obj b) (Bicat.Hom.start_eq a) (Bicat.Hom.start_eq a')

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.of_comp
statement: theorem of_comp (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) : (of (f ≫ g) : LinDiagram R a c) = of f ≫ of g
proof:
:= by
  have := Free.single_comp_single R (Obj S) f g (1 : R) 1
  rw [one_mul] at this
  exact this.symm

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.cast_neg
statement:
@[simp] theorem cast_neg {a' b' : Obj S} (f : LinDiagram R a b) (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b') :

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.cast_smul
statement:
@[simp] theorem cast_smul {a' b' : Obj S} (r : R) (f : LinDiagram R a b) (ha : a = a')

statement: @[simp] theorem cast_rfl (f : LinDiagram R a b) : cast f rfl rfl = f

name: StringDiagrams.InterchangeData.valid_of_subsingleton
statement: theorem valid_of_subsingleton [Subsingleton S.Region] : x.Valid

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.comp_mem_ideal
statement:
theorem comp_mem_ideal {a b c : Obj S} (g : LinDiagram R a b) {f : LinDiagram R b c}
    (hf : f ∈ P.ideal b c) : g ≫ f ∈ P.ideal a c
proof:
:= by
  induction hf using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨k, u, v, hw, pre, post⟩ := hx
    apply Submodule.subset_span
    rw [← Category.assoc]
    exact IdealGen.intro k u v hw _ post
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [Preadditive.comp_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hx hy
  | smul r x _ hx => rw [Linear.comp_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ r hx

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.mem_ideal_comp
statement:
theorem mem_ideal_comp {a b c : Obj S} {f : LinDiagram R a b} (hf : f ∈ P.ideal a b)
    (g : LinDiagram R b c) : f ≫ g ∈ P.ideal a c
proof:
:= by
  induction hf using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨k, u, v, hw, pre, post⟩ := hx
    apply Submodule.subset_span
    simp only [Category.assoc]
    exact IdealGen.intro k u v hw pre _
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [Preadditive.add_comp]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hx hy
  | smul r x _ hx => rw [Linear.smul_comp]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ r hx

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.whisker_rel_mem_ideal
statement:
theorem whisker_rel_mem_ideal (k : P.AllRel) (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour)
    (hw : k.dom.WhiskerOK u v) : LinDiagram.whisker k.rel u v hw ∈ P.ideal _ _
proof:
:= by
  apply Submodule.subset_span
  have := IdealGen.intro (P := P) k u v hw (𝟙 _) (𝟙 _)
  simpa using this

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.homRel_add
statement:
theorem homRel_add : ∀ ⦃X Y : Free R (Obj S)⦄ (f₁ f₂ g₁ g₂ : X ⟶ Y) (_ : P.homRel f₁ f₂)
    (_ : P.homRel g₁ g₂), P.homRel (f₁ + g₁) (f₂ + g₂)
proof:
:= by
  intro X Y f₁ f₂ g₁ g₂ h₁ h₂
  unfold homRel at *
  rw [add_sub_add_comm]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ h₁ h₂

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.homRel_smul
statement:
theorem homRel_smul : ∀ (a : R) ⦃X Y : Free R (Obj S)⦄ (f₁ f₂ : X ⟶ Y) (_ : P.homRel f₁ f₂),
    P.homRel (a • f₁) (a • f₂)
proof:
:= by
  intro a X Y f₁ f₂ h
  unfold homRel at *
  rw [← smul_sub]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ a h

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.lin_comp
statement:
@[simp] theorem lin_comp {a b c : Obj S} (f : LinDiagram R a b) (g : LinDiagram R b c) :
    P.lin (f ≫ g) = P.lin f ≫ P.lin g

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.lin_add
statement:
@[simp] theorem lin_add {a b : Obj S} (f g : LinDiagram R a b) :
    P.lin (f + g) = P.lin f + P.lin g

@[simp] theorem lin_sub {a b : Obj S} (f g : LinDiagram R a b) :

@[simp] theorem lin_neg {a b : Obj S} (f : LinDiagram R a b) :

statement: @[simp] theorem lin_zero {a b : Obj S} : P.lin (0 : LinDiagram R a b) = 0

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.lin_smul
statement:
@[simp] theorem lin_smul {a b : Obj S} (r : R) (f : LinDiagram R a b) :
    P.lin (r • f) = r • P.lin f

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.lin_id
statement: @[simp] theorem lin_id (a : Obj S) : P.lin (𝟙 (Free.of R a)) = 𝟙 (P.obj a)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.lin_single
statement:
theorem lin_single {a b : Obj S} (f : a ⟶ b) (r : R) :
    P.lin (Finsupp.single f r : LinDiagram R a b) = r • P.diag f
proof:
:= by
  rw [diag, ← lin_smul]; congr 1; exact (Finsupp.smul_single_one f r).symm

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.diag_comp

@[simp] theorem diag_comp {a b c : Obj S} (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) :

statement: @[simp] theorem diag_id (a : Obj S) : P.diag (𝟙 a) = 𝟙 (P.obj a)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.diag_eq_of_layers_eq
statement:
theorem diag_eq_of_layers_eq {a b : Obj S} {f g : a ⟶ b}
    (h : Diagram.layers f = Diagram.layers g) : P.diag f = P.diag g

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.lin_eq_iff
statement:
theorem lin_eq_iff {a b : Obj S} (f g : LinDiagram R a b) :
    P.lin f = P.lin g ↔ f - g ∈ P.ideal a b

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.lin_rel
statement:
theorem lin_rel (i : P.Rel) (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour) (hw : (P.dom i).WhiskerOK u v) :
    P.lin (LinDiagram.whisker (P.rel i) u v hw) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← P.lin_zero, lin_eq_iff, sub_zero]
  exact P.whisker_rel_mem_ideal (.user i) u v hw

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.lin_rel_cast
statement:
theorem lin_rel_cast (i : P.Rel) (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour) (hw : (P.dom i).WhiskerOK u v)
    {a b : Obj S} (ha : (P.dom i).whisker u v = a) (hb : (P.cod i).whisker u v = b) :
    P.lin (LinDiagram.cast (LinDiagram.whisker (P.rel i) u v hw) ha hb) = 0
proof:
:= by
  subst ha hb; rw [LinDiagram.cast_rfl]; exact P.lin_rel i u v hw

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.lin_of
statement: @[simp] theorem lin_of {a b : Obj S} (f : a ⟶ b) : P.lin (LinDiagram.of f) = P.diag f

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.lin_interchange
statement:
theorem lin_interchange (x : InterchangeData S) (hx : x.Valid) (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour)
    (hw : x.dom.WhiskerOK u v) :
    P.lin (LinDiagram.whisker (InterchangeData.rel R hx) u v hw) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← P.lin_zero, lin_eq_iff, sub_zero]
  exact P.whisker_rel_mem_ideal (.interchange x hx) u v hw

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.lin_interchange_cast
statement:
theorem lin_interchange_cast (x : InterchangeData S) (hx : x.Valid) (u : Obj S)
    (v : List S.Colour) (hw : x.dom.WhiskerOK u v) {a b : Obj S} (ha : x.dom.whisker u v = a)
    (hb : x.cod.whisker u v = b) :
    P.lin (LinDiagram.cast (LinDiagram.whisker (InterchangeData.rel R hx) u v hw) ha hb) = 0
proof:
:= by
  subst ha hb; rw [LinDiagram.cast_rfl]; exact P.lin_interchange x hx u v hw

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.diag_interchange
statement:
theorem diag_interchange (x : InterchangeData S) (hx : x.Valid) (u : Obj S)
    (v : List S.Colour) (hw : x.dom.WhiskerOK u v) {a b : Obj S} (ha : x.dom.whisker u v = a)
    (hb : x.cod.whisker u v = b) :
    P.diag (Diagram.cast (Diagram.whisker (InterchangeData.ghDiagram hx) u v hw) ha hb) =
      ((x.sign : ℤ) : R) •
        P.diag (Diagram.cast (Diagram.whisker (InterchangeData.hgDiagram hx) u v hw) ha hb)
proof:
:= by
  have := P.lin_interchange_cast x hx u v hw ha hb
  rw [InterchangeData.rel, LinDiagram.whisker_sub, LinDiagram.whisker_smul, LinDiagram.cast_sub,
    LinDiagram.cast_smul, LinDiagram.whisker_of, LinDiagram.whisker_of, LinDiagram.cast_of,
    LinDiagram.cast_of, lin_sub, lin_smul, lin_of, lin_of, sub_eq_zero] at this
  exact this

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.diag_cast
statement:
theorem diag_cast {a b a' b' : Obj S} (f : a ⟶ b) (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b') :

      eqToHom (congrArg P.obj ha.symm) ≫ P.diag f ≫ eqToHom (congrArg P.obj hb)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.diag_eq_of_layers_eq'
statement:
theorem diag_eq_of_layers_eq' {a b a' b' : Obj S} (f : a ⟶ b) (g : a' ⟶ b') (ha : a = a')
    (hb : b = b') (h : Diagram.layers f = Diagram.layers g) :
    P.diag f = eqToHom (congrArg P.obj ha) ≫ P.diag g ≫ eqToHom (congrArg P.obj hb.symm)
