:= by
  subst ha hb; simp only [eqToHom_refl, Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id]
  exact P.diag_eq_of_layers_eq h

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.wL_comp
statement:
theorem wL_comp (a : Obj S) (g : P.obj b ⟶ P.obj b') (g' : P.obj b' ⟶ P.obj b'') :
    P.wL a (g ≫ g') = P.wL a g ≫ P.wL a g'

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.wL_add
statement:
theorem wL_add (a : Obj S) (g g' : P.obj b ⟶ P.obj b') :
    P.wL a (g + g') = P.wL a g + P.wL a g'

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.wL_smul
statement:
theorem wL_smul (a : Obj S) (r : R) (g : P.obj b ⟶ P.obj b') :
    P.wL a (r • g) = r • P.wL a g

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.wL_zero
statement: theorem wL_zero (a : Obj S) : P.wL a (0 : P.obj b ⟶ P.obj b') = 0

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.wR_comp
statement:
theorem wR_comp (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj a') (f' : P.obj a' ⟶ P.obj a'') (b : Obj S) :
    P.wR (f ≫ f') b = P.wR f b ≫ P.wR f' b

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.wR_add
statement:
theorem wR_add (f f' : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj a') (b : Obj S) :
    P.wR (f + f') b = P.wR f b + P.wR f' b

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.wR_smul
statement:
theorem wR_smul (r : R) (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj a') (b : Obj S) :
    P.wR (r • f) b = r • P.wR f b

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.wR_zero
statement: theorem wR_zero (b : Obj S) : P.wR (0 : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj a') b = 0

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.wL_diag
statement: theorem wL_diag (a : Obj S) (g : b ⟶ b') : P.wL a (P.diag g) = P.diag (Diagram.whiskerL a g)
proof:
:= by
  rw [wL, P.whisk_diag g _ _ (Obj.whiskerOK_of_subsingleton _ _ _)]
  simp only [P.eqToHom_obj, ← P.diag_comp]
  apply P.diag_eq_of_layers_eq
  simp only [Diagram.layers_comp, Diagram.layers_eqToHom, Diagram.layers_whisker,
    Diagram.layers_whiskerL, List.nil_append, List.append_nil]
  exact List.map_congr_left fun L _ => Layer.ext rfl rfl rfl (List.append_nil _)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.wL_id
statement: theorem wL_id (a b : Obj S) : P.wL a (𝟙 (P.obj b)) = 𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.wL_eqToHom
statement:
theorem wL_eqToHom (a : Obj S) (h : P.obj b = P.obj b') :
    P.wL a (eqToHom h) = eqToHom (by rw [P.obj_injective h])
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl := P.obj_injective h
  simp [wL_id]

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.wL_wL
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem wL_wL (a b : Obj S) (h : P.obj c ⟶ P.obj c') :
    P.wL (a.tensor b) h ≫ eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.tensor_assoc a b c')) =
      eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.tensor_assoc a b c)) ≫ P.wL a (P.wL b h)
proof:
:= by
  induction h using P.hom_induction with
  | diag d =>
    simp only [wL_diag, P.eqToHom_obj, ← P.diag_comp]
    apply P.diag_eq_of_layers_eq
    simp only [Diagram.layers_comp, Diagram.layers_eqToHom, Diagram.layers_whiskerL]
    simp [Layer.wl, Obj.tensor]
  | zero => simp [wL_zero]
  | add f g hf hg => simp only [wL_add, Preadditive.add_comp, Preadditive.comp_add, hf, hg]
  | smul r f hf => simp only [wL_smul, Linear.smul_comp, Linear.comp_smul, hf]

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.wR_diag
statement: theorem wR_diag (f : a ⟶ a') (b : Obj S) : P.wR (P.diag f) b = P.diag (Diagram.whiskerR f b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [wR, P.whisk_diag f _ _ (Obj.whiskerOK_of_subsingleton _ _ _)]
  simp only [P.eqToHom_obj, ← P.diag_comp]
  apply P.diag_eq_of_layers_eq
  simp only [Diagram.layers_comp, Diagram.layers_eqToHom, Diagram.layers_whisker,
    Diagram.layers_whiskerR, List.nil_append, List.append_nil]
  exact List.map_congr_left fun L _ =>
    Layer.ext (Subsingleton.elim _ _) (List.nil_append _) rfl rfl

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.wR_id
statement: theorem wR_id (a b : Obj S) : P.wR (𝟙 (P.obj a)) b = 𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.wR_eqToHom
statement:
theorem wR_eqToHom (h : P.obj a = P.obj a') (b : Obj S) :
    P.wR (eqToHom h) b = eqToHom (by rw [P.obj_injective h])
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl := P.obj_injective h
  simp [wR_id]

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.wR_wR
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem wR_wR (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj a') (b c : Obj S) :
    P.wR (P.wR f b) c ≫ eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.tensor_assoc a' b c)) =
      eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.tensor_assoc a b c)) ≫ P.wR f (b.tensor c)
proof:
:= by
  induction f using P.hom_induction with
  | diag d =>
    simp only [wR_diag, P.eqToHom_obj, ← P.diag_comp]
    apply P.diag_eq_of_layers_eq
    simp only [Diagram.layers_comp, Diagram.layers_eqToHom, Diagram.layers_whiskerR]
    simp [Layer.wr, Obj.tensor]
  | zero => simp [wR_zero]
  | add f g hf hg => simp only [wR_add, Preadditive.add_comp, Preadditive.comp_add, hf, hg]
  | smul r f hf => simp only [wR_smul, Linear.smul_comp, Linear.comp_smul, hf]

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.wL_wR
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem wL_wR (a : Obj S) (g : P.obj b ⟶ P.obj b') (c : Obj S) :
    P.wR (P.wL a g) c ≫ eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.tensor_assoc a b' c)) =
      eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.tensor_assoc a b c)) ≫ P.wL a (P.wR g c)
proof:
:= by
  induction g using P.hom_induction with
  | diag d =>
    simp only [wL_diag, wR_diag, P.eqToHom_obj, ← P.diag_comp]
    apply P.diag_eq_of_layers_eq
    simp only [Diagram.layers_comp, Diagram.layers_eqToHom, Diagram.layers_whiskerL,
      Diagram.layers_whiskerR]
    simp [Layer.wr, Layer.wl]
  | zero => simp [wR_zero, wL_zero]
  | add f g hf hg => simp only [wR_add, wL_add, Preadditive.add_comp, Preadditive.comp_add, hf, hg]
  | smul r f hf => simp only [wR_smul, wL_smul, Linear.smul_comp, Linear.comp_smul, hf]

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.unit_wL
statement:
theorem unit_wL (g : P.obj b ⟶ P.obj b') :
    P.wL Obj.unit g ≫ eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.unit_tensor b')) =
      eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.unit_tensor b)) ≫ g
proof:
:= by
  induction g using P.hom_induction with
  | diag d =>
    simp only [wL_diag, P.eqToHom_obj, ← P.diag_comp]
    apply P.diag_eq_of_layers_eq
    simp only [Diagram.layers_comp, Diagram.layers_eqToHom, Diagram.layers_whiskerL,
      List.nil_append, List.append_nil]
    conv_rhs => rw [← List.map_id (Diagram.layers d)]
    exact List.map_congr_left fun L _ =>
      Layer.ext (Subsingleton.elim _ _) (List.nil_append _) rfl rfl
  | zero => simp [wL_zero]
  | add f g hf hg => simp only [wL_add, Preadditive.add_comp, Preadditive.comp_add, hf, hg]
  | smul r f hf => simp only [wL_smul, Linear.smul_comp, Linear.comp_smul, hf]

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.wR_unit
statement:
theorem wR_unit (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj a') :
    P.wR f Obj.unit ≫ eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.tensor_unit a')) =
      eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.tensor_unit a)) ≫ f
proof:
:= by
  induction f using P.hom_induction with
  | diag d =>
    simp only [wR_diag, P.eqToHom_obj, ← P.diag_comp]
    apply P.diag_eq_of_layers_eq
    simp only [Diagram.layers_comp, Diagram.layers_eqToHom, Diagram.layers_whiskerR,
      List.nil_append, List.append_nil]
    conv_rhs => rw [← List.map_id (Diagram.layers d)]
    exact List.map_congr_left fun L _ => Layer.ext rfl rfl rfl (List.append_nil _)
  | zero => simp [wR_zero]
  | add f g hf hg => simp only [wR_add, Preadditive.add_comp, Preadditive.comp_add, hf, hg]
  | smul r f hf => simp only [wR_smul, Linear.smul_comp, Linear.comp_smul, hf]

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.wR_comp_wL
statement:
theorem wR_comp_wL [S.IsEven] (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj a') (g : P.obj b ⟶ P.obj b') :
    P.wR f b ≫ P.wL a' g = P.wL a g ≫ P.wR f b'
proof:
:= by
  induction f using P.hom_induction with
  | diag d =>
    induction g using P.hom_induction with
    | diag e =>
      rw [wR_diag, wR_diag, wL_diag, wL_diag, ← diag_comp, ← diag_comp,
        P.diag_interchange_diagrams, Diagram.oddCount_eq_zero, zero_mul, pow_zero, one_smul]
    | zero => simp [wL_zero]
    | add g g' hg hg' =>
      simp only [wL_add, Preadditive.add_comp, Preadditive.comp_add, hg, hg']
    | smul r g hg => simp only [wL_smul, Linear.smul_comp, Linear.comp_smul, hg]
  | zero => simp [wR_zero]
  | add f f' hf hf' => simp only [wR_add, Preadditive.add_comp, Preadditive.comp_add, hf, hf']
  | smul r f hf => simp only [wR_smul, Linear.smul_comp, Linear.comp_smul, hf]

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.tensor_comp_aux
statement:
theorem tensor_comp_aux [S.IsEven] (f₁ : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj a') (g₁ : P.obj a' ⟶ P.obj a'')
    (f₂ : P.obj b ⟶ P.obj b') (g₂ : P.obj b' ⟶ P.obj b'') :
    P.wR (f₁ ≫ g₁) b ≫ P.wL a'' (f₂ ≫ g₂) =
      (P.wR f₁ b ≫ P.wL a' f₂) ≫ (P.wR g₁ b' ≫ P.wL a'' g₂)
proof:
:= by
  rw [wR_comp, wL_comp, Category.assoc, Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc (P.wR g₁ b),
    P.wR_comp_wL g₁ f₂, Category.assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.associator_naturality_aux
statement:
theorem associator_naturality_aux {a₁ a₂ a₃ b₁ b₂ b₃ : Obj S} (f₁ : P.obj a₁ ⟶ P.obj b₁)
    (f₂ : P.obj a₂ ⟶ P.obj b₂) (f₃ : P.obj a₃ ⟶ P.obj b₃) :
    (P.wR (P.wR f₁ a₂ ≫ P.wL b₁ f₂) a₃ ≫ P.wL (b₁.tensor b₂) f₃) ≫
        eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.tensor_assoc b₁ b₂ b₃)) =
      eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.tensor_assoc a₁ a₂ a₃)) ≫
        (P.wR f₁ (a₂.tensor a₃) ≫ P.wL b₁ (P.wR f₂ a₃ ≫ P.wL b₂ f₃))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [wR_comp, wL_comp, Category.assoc]
  rw [P.wL_wL, P.wL_wR_assoc, P.wR_wR_assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.pentagon_aux
statement:
theorem pentagon_aux (a b c d : Obj S) :
    P.wR (eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.tensor_assoc a b c))) d ≫
        eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.tensor_assoc a (b.tensor c) d)) ≫
          P.wL a (eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.tensor_assoc b c d))) =
      eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.tensor_assoc (a.tensor b) c d)) ≫
        eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.tensor_assoc a b (c.tensor d)))

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.triangle_aux
statement:
theorem triangle_aux (a b : Obj S) :
    eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.tensor_assoc a Obj.unit b)) ≫
        P.wL a (eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.unit_tensor b))) =
      P.wR (eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.tensor_unit a))) b

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.obj_tensor
statement: theorem obj_tensor (a b : Obj S) : P.obj a ⊗ P.obj b = P.obj (a.tensor b)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.obj_unit
statement: theorem obj_unit : 𝟙_ P.Presented = P.obj Obj.unit

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.whiskerRight_eq
statement:
theorem whiskerRight_eq {a a' : Obj S} (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj a') (b : Obj S) :
    f ▷ P.obj b = P.wR f b

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.whiskerLeft_eq
statement:
theorem whiskerLeft_eq (a : Obj S) {b b' : Obj S} (g : P.obj b ⟶ P.obj b') :
    P.obj a ◁ g = P.wL a g

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.diag_whiskerRight
statement:
@[simp] theorem diag_whiskerRight {a a' : Obj S} (f : a ⟶ a') (b : Obj S) :
    P.diag f ▷ P.obj b = P.diag (Diagram.whiskerR f b)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.diag_whiskerLeft
statement:
@[simp] theorem diag_whiskerLeft (a : Obj S) {b b' : Obj S} (g : b ⟶ b') :
    P.obj a ◁ P.diag g = P.diag (Diagram.whiskerL a g)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.tensor_assoc_obj
statement: theorem tensor_assoc_obj (X Y Z : P.Presented) : (X ⊗ Y) ⊗ Z = X ⊗ (Y ⊗ Z)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.unit_tensor_obj
statement: theorem unit_tensor_obj (X : P.Presented) : 𝟙_ P.Presented ⊗ X = X

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.tensor_unit_obj
statement: theorem tensor_unit_obj (X : P.Presented) : X ⊗ 𝟙_ P.Presented = X

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.associator_eq
statement: theorem associator_eq (X Y Z : P.Presented) : α_ X Y Z = eqToIso (P.tensor_assoc_obj X Y Z)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.leftUnitor_eq
statement: theorem leftUnitor_eq (X : P.Presented) : λ_ X = eqToIso (P.unit_tensor_obj X)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.rightUnitor_eq
statement: theorem rightUnitor_eq (X : P.Presented) : ρ_ X = eqToIso (P.tensor_unit_obj X)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.whiskerRight_eqToHom
statement:
theorem whiskerRight_eqToHom {X X' : P.Presented} (h : X = X') (Y : P.Presented) :
    eqToHom h ▷ Y = eqToHom (congrArg (· ⊗ Y) h)
proof:
:= by
  subst h; exact P.wR_id (P.toObj X) (P.toObj Y)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.whiskerLeft_eqToHom
statement:
theorem whiskerLeft_eqToHom (X : P.Presented) {Y Y' : P.Presented} (h : Y = Y') :
    X ◁ eqToHom h = eqToHom (congrArg (X ⊗ ·) h)
proof:
:= by
  subst h; exact P.wL_id (P.toObj X) (P.toObj Y)

name: StringDiagrams.Layer.Valid.dom_obj_ok
statement: theorem Layer.Valid.dom_obj_ok {L : Layer S} (h : L.Valid) : L.dom.Ok
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Obj.Ok, Layer.dom, Signature.ok_append, Signature.endR_append]
  rw [h.left_end, h.dom_end]
  exact ⟨⟨h.left_ok, h.dom_ok⟩, h.right_ok⟩

name: StringDiagrams.Layer.Valid.cod_obj_ok
statement: theorem Layer.Valid.cod_obj_ok {L : Layer S} (h : L.Valid) : L.cod.Ok
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Obj.Ok, Layer.cod, Signature.ok_append, Signature.endR_append]
  rw [h.left_end, h.cod_end]
  exact ⟨⟨h.left_ok, h.cod_ok⟩, h.right_ok⟩

name: StringDiagrams.Chain.ok
statement: theorem Chain.ok {a b : Obj S} {ls : List (Layer S)} (h : Chain a ls b) (ha : a.Ok) : b.Ok
proof:
:= by
  induction ls generalizing a with
  | nil => cases h; exact ha
  | cons L ls ih => exact ih h.2.2 h.1.cod_obj_ok

name: StringDiagrams.Chain.congr
statement:
theorem Chain.congr {a a' b b' : Obj S} {ls : List (Layer S)} (h : Chain a ls b) (ha : a = a')
    (hb : b = b') : Chain a' ls b'
proof:
:= by
  subst ha hb; exact h

name: StringDiagrams.Chain.of_append
statement:
theorem Chain.of_append {a b : Obj S} {ls ms : List (Layer S)} (h : Chain a (ls ++ ms) b) :
    Chain a ls (Chain.target a ls) ∧ Chain (Chain.target a ls) ms b
proof:
:= by
  induction ls generalizing a with
  | nil => exact ⟨rfl, h⟩
  | cons L ls ih =>
    obtain ⟨hv, rfl, hc⟩ := h
    obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := ih hc
    exact ⟨⟨hv, rfl, h₁⟩, h₂⟩

name: StringDiagrams.Chain.target_unique
statement:
theorem Chain.target_unique {a b b' : Obj S} {ls : List (Layer S)} (h : Chain a ls b)
    (h' : Chain a ls b') : b = b'

name: StringDiagrams.Chain.source_eq
statement:
theorem Chain.source_eq {a a' b : Obj S} {ls : List (Layer S)} (hne : ls ≠ [])
    (h : Chain a ls b) (h' : Chain a' ls b) : a = a'
proof:
:= by
  cases ls with
  | nil => exact absurd rfl hne
  | cons L ls => exact h.2.1.symm.trans h'.2.1

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.diag_mk_append
statement:
theorem diag_mk_append {a b c : Obj S} {ls ms : List (Layer S)} (h₁ : Chain a ls b)
    (h₂ : Chain b ms c) :
    P.diag (Diagram.mk (ls ++ ms) (h₁.append h₂)) = P.diag (Diagram.mk ls h₁) ≫ P.diag (Diagram.mk ms h₂)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.diag_eq_of_diag_eq_of_layers
statement:
theorem diag_eq_of_diag_eq_of_layers {a b a' b' : Obj S} (f₁ f₂ : a ⟶ b) (g₁ g₂ : a' ⟶ b')
    (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b') (h₁ : Diagram.layers f₁ = Diagram.layers g₁)
    (h₂ : Diagram.layers f₂ = Diagram.layers g₂) (h : P.diag g₁ = P.diag g₂) :
    P.diag f₁ = P.diag f₂
proof:
:= by
  subst ha hb
  rw [P.diag_eq_of_layers_eq h₁, P.diag_eq_of_layers_eq h₂, h]

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.diag_eq_of_layers_eq_append
statement:
theorem diag_eq_of_layers_eq_append {a b : Obj S} (f₁ f₂ : a ⟶ b) (X Y Z Z' : List (Layer S))
    (h₁ : Diagram.layers f₁ = X ++ Z ++ Y) (h₂ : Diagram.layers f₂ = X ++ Z' ++ Y)
    (hZ : ∀ (c d : Obj S) (g₁ g₂ : c ⟶ d), Chain a X c → Diagram.layers g₁ = Z →
      Diagram.layers g₂ = Z' → P.diag g₁ = P.diag g₂) :
    P.diag f₁ = P.diag f₂
proof:
:= by
  have c₁ := Diagram.chain f₁
  have c₂ := Diagram.chain f₂
  rw [h₁, List.append_assoc] at c₁
  rw [h₂, List.append_assoc] at c₂
  obtain ⟨hX, hZY⟩ := c₁.of_append
  obtain ⟨hX', hZY'⟩ := c₂.of_append
  obtain ⟨hZ₁, hY⟩ := hZY.of_append
  obtain ⟨hZ₂, hY'⟩ := hZY'.of_append
  
  have hd : Chain.target (Chain.target a X) Z = Chain.target (Chain.target a X) Z' := by
    by_cases hYe : Y = []
    · subst hYe; exact hY.trans hY'.symm
    · exact Chain.source_eq hYe hY hY'
  have e₁ : f₁ = Diagram.mk X hX ≫ Diagram.mk Z hZ₁ ≫ Diagram.mk Y hY := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change Diagram.layers f₁ = Diagram.layers (Diagram.mk X hX ≫ Diagram.mk Z hZ₁ ≫ Diagram.mk Y hY)
    rw [h₁, Diagram.layers_comp, Diagram.layers_comp, List.append_assoc]; rfl
  have e₂ : f₂ = Diagram.mk X hX' ≫ Diagram.mk Z' (hZ₂.congr rfl hd.symm) ≫
      Diagram.mk Y (hY'.congr hd.symm rfl) := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change Diagram.layers f₂ = Diagram.layers (Diagram.mk X hX' ≫ Diagram.mk Z' _ ≫ Diagram.mk Y _)
    rw [h₂, Diagram.layers_comp, Diagram.layers_comp, List.append_assoc]; rfl
  rw [e₁, e₂, P.diag_comp, P.diag_comp, P.diag_comp, P.diag_comp,
    hZ _ _ (Diagram.mk Z hZ₁) (Diagram.mk Z' (hZ₂.congr rfl hd.symm)) hX rfl rfl]

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.SideBySideOK.parts
statement:
theorem SideBySideOK.parts {a b : Obj S} (h : SideBySideOK u m v a b) :
    S.ok u.start u.word ∧ a.Ok ∧ S.ok a.endR m ∧ b.Ok ∧ S.ok b.endR v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hok, hu, hm⟩ := h
  have hu' : S.endR u.start u.word = a.start := hu
  simp only [Signature.ok_append, Signature.endR_append, hu'] at hok
  obtain ⟨⟨⟨⟨h₁, h₂⟩, h₃⟩, h₄⟩, h₅⟩ := hok
  have ha : S.endR a.start a.word = a.endR := rfl
  rw [ha, hm] at h₄ h₅
  exact ⟨h₁, h₂, h₃, h₄, h₅⟩

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.SideBySideOK.of_ok
statement:
theorem SideBySideOK.of_ok {a b : Obj S} (hu : S.ok u.start u.word) (ha : a.Ok)
    (hm : S.ok a.endR m) (hb : b.Ok) (hv : S.ok b.endR v) (hua : u.endR = a.start)
    (hmb : S.endR a.endR m = b.start) : SideBySideOK u m v a b
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, hua, hmb⟩
  have hu' : S.endR u.start u.word = a.start := hua
  have ha' : S.endR a.start a.word = a.endR := rfl
  simp only [Signature.ok_append, Signature.endR_append, hu', ha', hmb]
  exact ⟨⟨⟨⟨hu, ha⟩, hm⟩, hb⟩, hv⟩

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.SideBySideOK.chain
statement:
theorem SideBySideOK.chain {a a' b b' : Obj S} (h : SideBySideOK u m v a b) {F G : List (Layer S)}
    (hF : Chain a F a') (hG : Chain b G b') : SideBySideOK u m v a' b'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hu, ha, hm, hb, hv⟩ := h.parts
  refine .of_ok hu (hF.ok ha) (by rw [hF.endR_eq]; exact hm) (hG.ok hb)
    (by rw [hG.endR_eq]; exact hv) (by rw [hF.start_eq]; exact h.left_end)
    (by rw [hF.endR_eq, hG.start_eq]; exact h.mid_end)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.chain_leftLayers
statement:
theorem chain_leftLayers {a a' e : Obj S} {F : List (Layer S)} (hF : Chain a F a')
    (h : SideBySideOK u m v a e) :
    Chain (sbs u m v a e) (leftLayers u m v F e) (sbs u m v a' e)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hu, -, hm, he, hv⟩ := h.parts
  have hw : a.WhiskerOK u (m ++ e.word ++ v) := by
    refine ⟨hu, h.left_end, ?_⟩
    simp only [Signature.ok_append, Signature.endR_append, h.mid_end]
    exact ⟨⟨hm, he⟩, hv⟩
  exact (hF.whisker hw).congr (by simp [Obj.whisker]) (by simp [Obj.whisker])

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.chain_rightLayers
statement:
theorem chain_rightLayers {b b' c : Obj S} {G : List (Layer S)} (hG : Chain b G b')
    (h : SideBySideOK u m v c b) :
    Chain (sbs u m v c b) (rightLayers u m v G c) (sbs u m v c b')
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hu, hc, hm, -, hv⟩ := h.parts
  have hw : b.WhiskerOK ⟨u.start, u.word ++ c.word ++ m⟩ v := by
    have hu' : S.endR u.start u.word = c.start := h.left_end
    have hc' : S.endR c.start c.word = c.endR := rfl
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, hv⟩
    · simp only [Signature.ok_append, Signature.endR_append, hu', hc']; exact ⟨⟨hu, hc⟩, hm⟩
    · show S.endR u.start (u.word ++ c.word ++ m) = b.start
      simp only [Signature.endR_append, hu', hc', h.mid_end]
  exact (hG.whisker hw).congr (by simp [Obj.whisker]) (by simp [Obj.whisker])

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.diag_interchange_layer_right
statement:
theorem diag_interchange_layer_right {a a' : Obj S} {F : List (Layer S)} (hF : Chain a F a')
    {M : Layer S} (hM : M.Valid) (heven : ∀ L ∈ F, S.odd L.gen = false ∨ S.odd M.gen = false)
    (h : SideBySideOK u m v a M.dom)
    (f₁ f₂ : sbs u m v a M.dom ⟶ sbs u m v a' M.cod)
    (h₁ : Diagram.layers f₁ = leftLayers u m v F M.dom ++ rightLayers u m v [M] a')
    (h₂ : Diagram.layers f₂ = rightLayers u m v [M] a ++ leftLayers u m v F M.cod) :
    P.diag f₁ = P.diag f₂
proof:
:= by
  induction F generalizing a with
  | nil =>
    cases hF
    exact P.diag_eq_of_layers_eq (by rw [h₁, h₂]; simp)
  | cons L F ih =>
    obtain ⟨hv, rfl, hc⟩ := hF
    have hL : SideBySideOK u m v L.cod M.dom := h.chain (F := [L]) (G := []) ⟨hv, rfl, rfl⟩ rfl
    have hLM : SideBySideOK u m v L.dom M.cod := h.chain (F := []) (G := [M]) rfl ⟨hM, rfl, rfl⟩
    
    have c₃ : Chain (sbs u m v L.dom M.dom)
        (rightLayers u m v [M] L.dom ++ leftLayers u m v (L :: F) M.cod) (sbs u m v a' M.cod) :=
      (chain_rightLayers (G := [M]) ⟨hM, rfl, rfl⟩ h).append
        (chain_leftLayers ⟨hv, rfl, hc⟩ hLM)
    have c₄ : Chain (sbs u m v L.dom M.dom)
        (leftLayers u m v [L] M.dom ++ rightLayers u m v [M] L.cod ++ leftLayers u m v F M.cod)
        (sbs u m v a' M.cod) :=
      ((chain_leftLayers (F := [L]) ⟨hv, rfl, rfl⟩ h).append
        (chain_rightLayers (G := [M]) ⟨hM, rfl, rfl⟩ hL)).append
        (chain_leftLayers hc (h.chain (F := [L]) (G := [M]) ⟨hv, rfl, rfl⟩ ⟨hM, rfl, rfl⟩))
    
    have step₁ : P.diag f₁ = P.diag (Diagram.mk _ c₄) := by
      refine P.diag_eq_of_layers_eq_append f₁ _ (leftLayers u m v [L] M.dom) []
        (leftLayers u m v F M.dom ++ rightLayers u m v [M] a')
        (rightLayers u m v [M] L.cod ++ leftLayers u m v F M.cod)
        (by rw [h₁]; simp) (by simp [Diagram.mk, Diagram.layers]) ?_
      intro c d g₁ g₂ hX hg₁ hg₂
      obtain rfl := Chain.target_unique hX (chain_leftLayers (F := [L]) ⟨hv, rfl, rfl⟩ h)
      have hg := Diagram.chain g₁
      rw [hg₁] at hg
      obtain rfl := Chain.target_unique hg ((chain_leftLayers hc hL).append
        (chain_rightLayers (G := [M]) ⟨hM, rfl, rfl⟩ (hL.chain (G := []) hc rfl)))
      exact ih hc (fun L' hL' => heven L' (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hL')) hL g₁ g₂ hg₁ hg₂
    
    have step₂ : P.diag (Diagram.mk _ c₄) = P.diag (Diagram.mk _ c₃) := by
      refine P.diag_eq_of_layers_eq_append _ _ [] (leftLayers u m v F M.cod)
        (leftLayers u m v [L] M.dom ++ rightLayers u m v [M] L.cod)
        (rightLayers u m v [M] L.dom ++ leftLayers u m v [L] M.cod)
        (by simp [Diagram.mk, Diagram.layers]) (by simp [Diagram.mk, Diagram.layers]) ?_
      intro c d g₁ g₂ _ hg₁ hg₂
      refine P.diag_interchange_of_layers_of_even u.start (u.word ++ L.left)
        (L.right ++ m ++ M.left) (M.right ++ v) L.gen M.gen
        (heven L List.mem_cons_self) g₁ g₂ ?_ ?_
      · rw [hg₁]; simp [Layer.whisker, Layer.dom, Layer.cod]
      · rw [hg₂]; simp [Layer.whisker, Layer.dom, Layer.cod]
    rw [step₁, step₂]
    exact P.diag_eq_of_layers_eq (by rw [h₂]; simp [Diagram.mk, Diagram.layers])

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.diag_interchange_layers_of_even
statement:
theorem diag_interchange_layers_of_even {a a' b b' : Obj S} {F G : List (Layer S)}
    (hF : Chain a F a') (hG : Chain b G b')
    (heven : ∀ L ∈ F, ∀ M ∈ G, S.odd L.gen = false ∨ S.odd M.gen = false)
    (h : SideBySideOK u m v a b) (f₁ f₂ : sbs u m v a b ⟶ sbs u m v a' b')
    (h₁ : Diagram.layers f₁ = leftLayers u m v F b ++ rightLayers u m v G a')
    (h₂ : Diagram.layers f₂ = rightLayers u m v G a ++ leftLayers u m v F b') :
    P.diag f₁ = P.diag f₂
proof:
:= by
  induction G generalizing b with
  | nil =>
    cases hG
    exact P.diag_eq_of_layers_eq (by rw [h₁, h₂]; simp)
  | cons M G ih =>
    obtain ⟨hM, rfl, hc⟩ := hG
    have hM' : SideBySideOK u m v a M.cod := h.chain (F := []) (G := [M]) rfl ⟨hM, rfl, rfl⟩
    
    have c₃ : Chain (sbs u m v a M.dom)
        (rightLayers u m v [M] a ++ leftLayers u m v F M.cod ++ rightLayers u m v G a')
        (sbs u m v a' b') :=
      ((chain_rightLayers (G := [M]) ⟨hM, rfl, rfl⟩ h).append (chain_leftLayers hF hM')).append
        (chain_rightLayers hc (hM'.chain (G := []) hF rfl))
    have step₁ : P.diag f₁ = P.diag (Diagram.mk _ c₃) := by
      refine P.diag_eq_of_layers_eq_append f₁ _ [] (rightLayers u m v G a')
        (leftLayers u m v F M.dom ++ rightLayers u m v [M] a')
        (rightLayers u m v [M] a ++ leftLayers u m v F M.cod)
        (by rw [h₁]; simp) (by simp [Diagram.mk, Diagram.layers]) ?_
      intro c d g₁ g₂ hX hg₁ hg₂
      cases hX
      have hg := Diagram.chain g₁
      rw [hg₁] at hg
      obtain rfl := Chain.target_unique hg ((chain_leftLayers hF h).append
        (chain_rightLayers (G := [M]) ⟨hM, rfl, rfl⟩ (h.chain (G := []) hF rfl)))
      exact P.diag_interchange_layer_right u m v hF hM
        (fun L hL => heven L hL M List.mem_cons_self) h g₁ g₂ hg₁ hg₂
    have step₂ : P.diag (Diagram.mk _ c₃) = P.diag f₂ := by
      refine P.diag_eq_of_layers_eq_append _ f₂ (rightLayers u m v [M] a) []
        (leftLayers u m v F M.cod ++ rightLayers u m v G a')
        (rightLayers u m v G a ++ leftLayers u m v F b')
        (by simp [Diagram.mk, Diagram.layers]) (by rw [h₂]; simp) ?_
      intro c d g₁ g₂ hX hg₁ hg₂
      obtain rfl := Chain.target_unique hX (chain_rightLayers (G := [M]) ⟨hM, rfl, rfl⟩ h)
      have hg := Diagram.chain g₁
      rw [hg₁] at hg
      obtain rfl := Chain.target_unique hg ((chain_leftLayers hF hM').append
        (chain_rightLayers hc (hM'.chain (G := []) hF rfl)))
      exact ih hc (fun L hL M' hM'' => heven L hL M' (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hM'')) hM' g₁ g₂
        hg₁ hg₂
    exact step₁.trans step₂

name: StringDiagrams.Obj.wf_mk
statement: @[simp] theorem wf_mk (r : S.Region) (w : List S.Colour) : (⟨r, w⟩ : Obj S).WF ↔ S.ok r w

name: StringDiagrams.Obj.Composable.ok_endR
statement: theorem Composable.ok_endR {a b : Obj S} (h : a.Composable b) : S.ok a.endR b.word

name: StringDiagrams.Obj.endR_tensor
statement: theorem endR_tensor (a b : Obj S) : (a.tensor b).endR = S.endR a.endR b.word

name: StringDiagrams.Obj.Composable.endR_tensor
statement:
theorem Composable.endR_tensor {a b : Obj S} (h : a.Composable b) :
    (a.tensor b).endR = b.endR

name: StringDiagrams.Obj.Composable.wf_tensor
statement: theorem Composable.wf_tensor {a b : Obj S} (h : a.Composable b) : (a.tensor b).WF
proof:
:= by
  show S.ok a.start (a.word ++ b.word)
  rw [Signature.ok_append]; exact ⟨h.left_wf, h.ok_endR⟩

name: StringDiagrams.Layer.Valid.wf_dom
statement: theorem Layer.Valid.wf_dom {L : Layer S} (h : L.Valid) : L.dom.WF
proof:
:= by
  show S.ok L.start (L.left ++ S.dom L.gen ++ L.right)
  simp only [Signature.ok_append, Signature.endR_append, h.left_end, h.dom_end]
  exact ⟨⟨h.left_ok, h.dom_ok⟩, h.right_ok⟩

name: StringDiagrams.Layer.Valid.wf_cod
statement: theorem Layer.Valid.wf_cod {L : Layer S} (h : L.Valid) : L.cod.WF
proof:
:= by
  show S.ok L.start (L.left ++ S.cod L.gen ++ L.right)
  simp only [Signature.ok_append, Signature.endR_append, h.left_end, h.cod_end]
  exact ⟨⟨h.left_ok, h.cod_ok⟩, h.right_ok⟩

name: StringDiagrams.Chain.wf
statement: theorem Chain.wf {a b : Obj S} {ls : List (Layer S)} (h : Chain a ls b) (ha : a.WF) : b.WF
proof:
:= by
  induction ls generalizing a with
  | nil => cases h; exact ha
  | cons L ls ih => exact ih h.2.2 h.1.wf_cod

name: StringDiagrams.Chain.start_of_mem
statement:
theorem Chain.start_of_mem {a b : Obj S} {ls : List (Layer S)} (h : Chain a ls b) {L : Layer S}
    (hL : L ∈ ls) : L.start = a.start
proof:
:= by
  induction ls generalizing a with
  | nil => cases hL
  | cons M ls ih =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl, hc⟩ := h
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hL with rfl | hL
    · rfl
    · have := ih hc hL
      exact this

name: StringDiagrams.Obj.Composable.map_left
statement: theorem map_left (h : a.Composable b) (f : a ⟶ a') : a'.Composable b
proof:
:=
  ⟨(Diagram.chain f).wf h.left_wf, by rw [(Diagram.chain f).endR_eq]; exact h.endR_eq,
    h.right_wf⟩

name: StringDiagrams.Obj.Composable.map_right
statement: theorem map_right (h : a.Composable b) (g : b ⟶ b') : a.Composable b'
proof:
:=
  ⟨h.left_wf, by rw [(Diagram.chain g).start_eq]; exact h.endR_eq,
    (Diagram.chain g).wf h.right_wf⟩

name: StringDiagrams.Layer.Valid.wr
statement:
theorem Valid.wr {L : Layer S} (h : L.Valid) {v : List S.Colour} (hv : S.ok L.dom.endR v) :
    (L.wr v).Valid where
  left_ok
proof:
:= h.left_ok
  left_end := h.left_end
  dom_ok := h.dom_ok
  dom_end := h.dom_end
  cod_ok := h.cod_ok
  cod_end := h.cod_end
  right_ok := by
    show S.ok (S.right L.gen) (L.right ++ v)
    rw [Signature.ok_append, ← h.endR_dom]; exact ⟨h.right_ok, hv⟩

name: StringDiagrams.Layer.Valid.wl
statement:
theorem Valid.wl {L : Layer S} (h : L.Valid) {w : Obj S} (hw : w.WF) (he : w.endR = L.start) :
    (L.wl w).Valid where
  left_ok
proof:
:= by
    have he' : S.endR w.start w.word = L.start := he
    show S.ok w.start (w.word ++ L.left)
    rw [Signature.ok_append, he']; exact ⟨hw, h.left_ok⟩
  left_end := by
    have he' : S.endR w.start w.word = L.start := he
    show S.endR w.start (w.word ++ L.left) = S.left L.gen
    rw [Signature.endR_append, he']; exact h.left_end
  dom_ok := h.dom_ok
  dom_end := h.dom_end
  cod_ok := h.cod_ok
  cod_end := h.cod_end
  right_ok := h.right_ok

name: StringDiagrams.Chain.rwhisker
statement:
theorem Chain.rwhisker {a a' : Obj S} {ls : List (Layer S)} (h : Chain a ls a') (b : Obj S)
    (hb : S.ok a.endR b.word) :
    Chain (a.tensor b) (ls.map (·.wr b.word)) (a'.tensor b)
proof:
:= by
  induction ls generalizing a with
  | nil => cases h; rfl
  | cons L ls ih =>
    obtain ⟨hv, rfl, hc⟩ := h
    exact ⟨hv.wr hb, L.wr_dom b, by rw [L.wr_cod]; exact ih hc (by rwa [hv.endR_eq])⟩

name: StringDiagrams.Chain.lwhisker
statement:
theorem Chain.lwhisker {b b' : Obj S} {ls : List (Layer S)} (h : Chain b ls b') (a : Obj S)
    (ha : a.WF) (he : a.endR = b.start) :
    Chain (a.tensor b) (ls.map (·.wl a)) (a.tensor b')
proof:
:= by
  induction ls generalizing b with
  | nil => cases h; rfl
  | cons L ls ih =>
    obtain ⟨hv, rfl, hc⟩ := h
    exact ⟨hv.wl ha he, L.wl_dom a, by rw [L.wl_cod]; exact ih hc he⟩

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.layers_rwhisker
statement:
@[simp] theorem layers_rwhisker (f : a ⟶ a') (b : Obj S) (h : a.Composable b) :
    layers (rwhisker f b h) = (layers f).map (·.wr b.word)

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.layers_lwhisker
statement:
@[simp] theorem layers_lwhisker (a : Obj S) (g : b ⟶ b') (h : a.Composable b) :
    layers (lwhisker a g h) = (layers g).map (·.wl a)

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.rwhisker_id
statement: theorem rwhisker_id (a b : Obj S) (h : a.Composable b) : rwhisker (𝟙 a) b h = 𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.lwhisker_id
statement: theorem lwhisker_id (a b : Obj S) (h : a.Composable b) : lwhisker a (𝟙 b) h = 𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.rwhisker_comp
statement:
theorem rwhisker_comp (f : a ⟶ a') (f' : a' ⟶ a'') (b : Obj S) (h : a.Composable b)
    (h' : a'.Composable b) : rwhisker (f ≫ f') b h = rwhisker f b h ≫ rwhisker f' b h'

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.lwhisker_comp
statement:
theorem lwhisker_comp (a : Obj S) (g : b ⟶ b') (g' : b' ⟶ b'') (h : a.Composable b)
    (h' : a.Composable b') : lwhisker a (g ≫ g') h = lwhisker a g h ≫ lwhisker a g' h'

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.rwhisker_eq_whiskerR
statement:
theorem rwhisker_eq_whiskerR [Subsingleton S.Region] (f : a ⟶ a') (b : Obj S)
    (h : a.Composable b) : rwhisker f b h = whiskerR f b

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.lwhisker_eq_whiskerL
statement:
theorem lwhisker_eq_whiskerL [Subsingleton S.Region] (a : Obj S) (g : b ⟶ b')
    (h : a.Composable b) : lwhisker a g h = whiskerL a g

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.oddCount_rwhisker
statement:
@[simp] theorem oddCount_rwhisker (f : a ⟶ a') (b : Obj S) (h : a.Composable b) :
    oddCount (rwhisker f b h) = oddCount f

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.oddCount_lwhisker
statement:
@[simp] theorem oddCount_lwhisker (a : Obj S) (g : b ⟶ b') (h : a.Composable b) :
    oddCount (lwhisker a g h) = oddCount g

name: StringDiagrams.InterchangeData.valid_ofLayers
statement:
theorem valid_ofLayers {L M : Layer S} (hL : L.Valid) (hM : M.Valid)
    (h : L.dom.endR = M.start) : (ofLayers L M).Valid
proof:
:= by
  have hRM : S.endR (S.right L.gen) L.right = M.start := by rw [← hL.endR_dom, h]
  refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩,
    ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
  all_goals
    simp only [ofLayers, gh₁, gh₂, hg₁, hg₂, Signature.ok_append, Signature.endR_append,
      Signature.ok_nil, Signature.endR_nil, hL.dom_end, hL.cod_end, hRM, hM.left_end, hM.dom_end,
      hM.cod_end, hL.dom_ok, hL.cod_ok, hL.right_ok, hM.left_ok, hM.dom_ok, hM.cod_ok,
      and_true]

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.diag_swap_layers_of_composable
statement:
theorem diag_swap_layers_of_composable (L M : Layer S) (hL : L.Valid) (hM : M.Valid)
    (h : L.dom.Composable M.dom) (h₁ : L.cod.Composable M.dom) (h₂ : L.dom.Composable M.cod) :
    P.diag (rwhisker (ofLayer L hL) M.dom h ≫ lwhisker L.cod (ofLayer M hM) h₁) =
      ((-1 : ℤ) ^ (oddCountList [L] * oddCountList [M])) •
        P.diag (lwhisker L.dom (ofLayer M hM) h ≫ rwhisker (ofLayer L hL) M.cod h₂)
proof:
:= by
  let x : InterchangeData S := InterchangeData.ofLayers L M
  have hx : x.Valid := InterchangeData.valid_ofLayers hL hM h.endR_eq
  let u : Obj S := ⟨L.start, L.left⟩
  have hw : x.dom.WhiskerOK u M.right := by
    refine ⟨hL.left_ok, hL.left_end, ?_⟩
    have : x.dom.endR = S.right M.gen := by
      have hRM : S.endR (S.right L.gen) L.right = M.start := by
        rw [← hL.endR_dom]; exact h.endR_eq
      simp [x, InterchangeData.ofLayers, InterchangeData.dom, Obj.endR, hL.dom_end, hRM,
        hM.left_end, hM.dom_end]
    rw [this]; exact hM.right_ok
  have ha : x.dom.whisker u M.right = L.dom.tensor M.dom := by
    simp [x, u, InterchangeData.ofLayers, InterchangeData.dom, Obj.whisker, Obj.tensor,
      Layer.dom]
  have hb : x.cod.whisker u M.right = L.cod.tensor M.cod := by
    simp [x, u, InterchangeData.ofLayers, InterchangeData.cod, Obj.whisker, Obj.tensor,
      Layer.cod]
  have key := P.diag_interchange x hx u M.right hw ha hb
  have hs : ((x.sign : ℤ) : R) = (((-1 : ℤ) ^ (oddCountList [L] * oddCountList [M]) : ℤ) : R) := by
    congr 1
    by_cases hL' : S.odd L.gen <;> by_cases hM' : S.odd M.gen <;>
      simp [x, InterchangeData.ofLayers, InterchangeData.sign, oddCountList, hL', hM']
  rw [hs, Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul] at key
  refine Eq.trans (P.diag_eq_of_layers_eq ?_) (key.trans (congrArg _ (P.diag_eq_of_layers_eq ?_)))
  all_goals simp only [Diagram.layers_comp, layers_rwhisker, layers_lwhisker, Diagram.layers_cast,
    layers_whisker, layers_ofLayer]
  all_goals simp [x, u, InterchangeData.ofLayers, InterchangeData.ghDiagram,
      InterchangeData.hgDiagram, InterchangeData.gh₁, InterchangeData.gh₂, InterchangeData.hg₁,
      InterchangeData.hg₂, Layer.whisker, Layer.wr, Layer.wl, Layer.dom, Layer.cod]

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.diag_swap_layer_right_of_composable
statement:
theorem diag_swap_layer_right_of_composable (f : a ⟶ a') (M : Layer S) (hM : M.Valid)
    (h : a.Composable M.dom) (h₁ : a'.Composable M.dom) (h₂ : a.Composable M.cod) :
    P.diag (rwhisker f M.dom h ≫ lwhisker a' (ofLayer M hM) h₁) =
      ((-1 : ℤ) ^ (oddCount f * oddCountList [M])) •
        P.diag (lwhisker a (ofLayer M hM) h ≫ rwhisker f M.cod h₂)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ls, hf⟩ := f
  induction ls generalizing a with
  | nil =>
    cases hf
    simp only [oddCount, Diagram.layers, oddCountList_nil, zero_mul, pow_zero, one_smul]
    apply P.diag_eq_of_layers_eq
    simp only [layers_comp, layers_rwhisker, layers_lwhisker, layers_ofLayer]
    rfl
  | cons L ls ih =>
    obtain ⟨hv, rfl, hc⟩ := hf
    have e₁ : (⟨L :: ls, hv, rfl, hc⟩ : L.dom ⟶ a') = ofLayer L hv ≫ (⟨ls, hc⟩ : L.cod ⟶ a') := by
      ext; rfl
    have hodd : oddCount (⟨L :: ls, hv, rfl, hc⟩ : L.dom ⟶ a') =
        oddCountList [L] + oddCount (⟨ls, hc⟩ : L.cod ⟶ a') := oddCountList_cons L ls
    have hL₁ : L.cod.Composable M.dom := h.map_left (ofLayer L hv)
    have hL₂ : L.cod.Composable M.cod := hL₁.map_right (ofLayer M hM)
    rw [hodd, e₁, rwhisker_comp _ _ _ h hL₁, rwhisker_comp _ _ _ h₂ hL₂, Category.assoc,
      P.diag_comp, ih hL₁ hL₂ hc, Linear.comp_smul, ← P.diag_comp, ← Category.assoc,
      P.diag_comp (_ ≫ _), P.diag_swap_layers_of_composable L M hv hM h hL₁ h₂, Linear.smul_comp,
      smul_smul, ← P.diag_comp, Category.assoc, add_mul, pow_add, mul_comm]

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.diag_interchange_of_composable'
statement:
theorem diag_interchange_of_composable' (f : a ⟶ a') (g : b ⟶ b') (h : a.Composable b)
    (h₁ : a'.Composable b) (h₂ : a.Composable b') :
    P.diag (rwhisker f b h ≫ lwhisker a' g h₁) =
      ((-1 : ℤ) ^ (oddCount f * oddCount g)) • P.diag (lwhisker a g h ≫ rwhisker f b' h₂)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ms, hg⟩ := g
  induction ms generalizing b with
  | nil =>
    cases hg
    simp only [oddCount, Diagram.layers, oddCountList_nil, mul_zero, pow_zero, one_smul]
    apply P.diag_eq_of_layers_eq
    simp only [layers_comp, layers_rwhisker, layers_lwhisker]
    show _ ++ [] = [] ++ _
    simp
  | cons M ms ih =>
    obtain ⟨hv, rfl, hc⟩ := hg
    have e₁ : (⟨M :: ms, hv, rfl, hc⟩ : M.dom ⟶ b') = ofLayer M hv ≫ (⟨ms, hc⟩ : M.cod ⟶ b') := by
      ext; rfl
    have hodd : oddCount (⟨M :: ms, hv, rfl, hc⟩ : M.dom ⟶ b') =
        oddCountList [M] + oddCount (⟨ms, hc⟩ : M.cod ⟶ b') := oddCountList_cons M ms
    have hM₁ : a.Composable M.cod := h.map_right (ofLayer M hv)
    have hM₂ : a'.Composable M.cod := h₁.map_right (ofLayer M hv)
    rw [hodd, e₁, lwhisker_comp _ _ _ h hM₁, lwhisker_comp _ _ _ h₁ hM₂, ← Category.assoc,
      P.diag_comp (_ ≫ _), P.diag_swap_layer_right_of_composable f M hv h h₁ hM₁,
      Linear.smul_comp, P.diag_comp (lwhisker a _ _) (rwhisker f M.cod _), Category.assoc,
      ← P.diag_comp (rwhisker f M.cod _), ih hM₁ hM₂ hc, Linear.comp_smul, smul_smul,
      ← P.diag_comp, mul_add, pow_add, Category.assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.diag_interchange_of_composable
statement:
theorem diag_interchange_of_composable (f : a ⟶ a') (g : b ⟶ b') (h : a.Composable b) :
    P.diag (rwhisker f b h ≫ lwhisker a' g (h.map_left f)) =
      ((-1 : ℤ) ^ (oddCount f * oddCount g)) •
        P.diag (lwhisker a g h ≫ rwhisker f b' (h.map_right g))

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.eq_layer_comp
statement:
theorem eq_layer_comp {L : Layer S} {ls : List (Layer S)} (h : Chain a (L :: ls) b) :
    mk (L :: ls) h = layer L h.1 h.2.1 rfl ≫ mk ls h.2.2

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.mk_nil
statement: theorem mk_nil (h : Chain a [] b) : mk [] h = eqToHom h
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl : a = b := h
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.hom_induction
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, rfl⟩ := P.linFunctor.map_surjective f
  change p (P.lin f)
  induction f using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => rw [lin_zero]; exact zero
  | add f g hf hg => rw [lin_add]; exact add _ _ hf hg
  | single d r => exact (congrArg p (P.lin_single d r)).mpr (smul r _ (diag d))

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.diag_induction
statement:
theorem diag_induction {p : ∀ {a b : Obj S}, (P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b) → Prop}
    (nil : ∀ {a b : Obj S} (h : a = b), p (P.diag (eqToHom h)))
    (cons : ∀ {b : Obj S} (L : Layer S) (hv : L.Valid) (d : L.cod ⟶ b),
      p (P.diag d) → p (P.diag (Diagram.ofLayer L hv ≫ d)))
    {a b : Obj S} (d : a ⟶ b) : p (P.diag d)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ls, h⟩ := d
  induction ls generalizing a with
  | nil =>
    have e : (⟨[], h⟩ : a ⟶ b) = eqToHom h := Diagram.mk_nil h
    rw [e]; exact nil h
  | cons L ls ih =>
    obtain ⟨hv, rfl, hc⟩ := h
    exact cons L hv _ (ih hc)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.hom_induction_layers
statement:
theorem hom_induction_layers {p : ∀ {a b : Obj S}, (P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b) → Prop}
    (nil : ∀ {a b : Obj S} (h : a = b), p (P.diag (eqToHom h)))
    (layer : ∀ (L : Layer S) (hv : L.Valid), p (P.diag (Diagram.ofLayer L hv)))
    (comp : ∀ {a b c : Obj S} (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b) (g : P.obj b ⟶ P.obj c),
      p f → p g → p (f ≫ g))
    (zero : ∀ {a b : Obj S}, p (0 : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b))
    (add : ∀ {a b : Obj S} (f g : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b), p f → p g → p (f + g))
    (smul : ∀ {a b : Obj S} (r : R) (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b), p f → p (r • f))
    {a b : Obj S} (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b) : p f
proof:
:=
  P.hom_induction (p := p)
    (P.diag_induction (p := p) nil fun L hv d hd => by
      rw [diag_comp]; exact comp _ _ (layer L hv) hd)
    zero add smul f

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.linearMap_ext_diag
statement:
theorem linearMap_ext_diag {a b : Obj S} {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    {φ ψ : (P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b) →ₗ[R] M} (h : ∀ d : a ⟶ b, φ (P.diag d) = ψ (P.diag d)) :
    φ = ψ
proof:
:= by
  ext f
  induction f using P.hom_induction with
  | diag d => exact h d
  | zero => simp
  | add f g hf hg => rw [map_add, map_add, hf, hg]
  | smul r f hf => rw [map_smul, map_smul, hf]

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.closed_aux
statement:
private theorem closed_aux (M : ∀ a b : Obj S, Submodule R (P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b))
    (hid : ∀ a ∈ C, 𝟙 (P.obj a) ∈ M a a)
    (hcomp : ∀ {a b c : Obj S}, a ∈ C → b ∈ C → c ∈ C → ∀ (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b)
      (g : P.obj b ⟶ P.obj c), f ∈ M a b → g ∈ M b c → f ≫ g ∈ M a c)
    (hlayer : ∀ (L : Layer S) (hv : L.Valid), L.dom ∈ C →
      P.diag (Diagram.ofLayer L hv) ∈ M L.dom L.cod)
    {a b : Obj S} (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b) :
    a ∈ C → (b ∈ C → f ∈ M a b) ∧ (b ∉ C → f = 0)
proof:
:= by
  induction f using P.hom_induction_layers with
  | nil h =>
    subst h
    intro ha
    exact ⟨fun _ => by simpa using hid _ ha, fun hb => absurd ha hb⟩
  | layer L hv =>
    intro ha
    exact ⟨fun _ => hlayer L hv ha, fun hb => absurd (hC L hv ha) hb⟩
  | comp f g hf hg =>
    rename_i a b c
    intro ha
    by_cases hb : b ∈ C
    · refine ⟨fun hc => hcomp ha hb hc f g ((hf ha).1 hb) ((hg hb).1 hc), fun hc => ?_⟩
      rw [(hg hb).2 hc, Limits.comp_zero]
    · have hf0 : f = 0 := (hf ha).2 hb
      subst hf0
      exact ⟨fun _ => by rw [Limits.zero_comp]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _,
        fun _ => Limits.zero_comp⟩
  | zero => exact fun _ => ⟨fun _ => Submodule.zero_mem _, fun _ => rfl⟩
  | add f g hf hg =>
    intro ha
    exact ⟨fun hb => Submodule.add_mem _ ((hf ha).1 hb) ((hg ha).1 hb),
      fun hb => by rw [(hf ha).2 hb, (hg ha).2 hb, add_zero]⟩
  | smul r f hf =>
    intro ha
    exact ⟨fun hb => Submodule.smul_mem _ r ((hf ha).1 hb), fun hb => by rw [(hf ha).2 hb, smul_zero]⟩

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.eq_zero_of_mem_of_not_mem
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_mem_of_not_mem {a b : Obj S} (ha : a ∈ C) (hb : b ∉ C)
    (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b) : f = 0
proof:
:=
  (P.closed_aux C hC (fun _ _ => ⊤) (fun _ _ => trivial) (fun _ _ _ _ _ _ _ => trivial)
    (fun _ _ _ => trivial) f ha).2 hb

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.mem_of_layers
statement:
theorem mem_of_layers (M : ∀ a b : Obj S, Submodule R (P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b))
    (hid : ∀ a ∈ C, 𝟙 (P.obj a) ∈ M a a)
    (hcomp : ∀ {a b c : Obj S}, a ∈ C → b ∈ C → c ∈ C → ∀ (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b)
      (g : P.obj b ⟶ P.obj c), f ∈ M a b → g ∈ M b c → f ≫ g ∈ M a c)
    (hlayer : ∀ (L : Layer S) (hv : L.Valid), L.dom ∈ C →
      P.diag (Diagram.ofLayer L hv) ∈ M L.dom L.cod)
    {a b : Obj S} (ha : a ∈ C) (hb : b ∈ C) (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b) : f ∈ M a b
proof:
:=
  (P.closed_aux C hC M hid hcomp hlayer f ha).1 hb

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.eq_zero_of_invariant
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_invariant {ι : Type*} (κ : Obj S → ι)
    (hκ : ∀ (L : Layer S), L.Valid → κ L.cod = κ L.dom) {a b : Obj S} (h : κ a ≠ κ b)
    (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b) : f = 0
proof:
:=
  P.eq_zero_of_mem_of_not_mem {x | κ x = κ a} (fun L hv hL => (hκ L hv).trans hL) rfl
    (fun hb => h hb.symm) f

name: StringDiagrams.append_three_inj
proof:
:= by
  rw [List.append_assoc, List.append_assoc] at h
  obtain ⟨rfl, h'⟩ := List.append_inj h hl
  obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := List.append_inj h' hw
  exact ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩

name: StringDiagrams.Layer.eq_of_dom_eq
statement:
theorem eq_of_dom_eq {L L' : Layer S} (hd : L.dom = L'.dom)
    (hl : L.left.length = L'.left.length) (hg : L.gen = L'.gen) : L = L'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨st, l, g, r⟩ := L
  obtain ⟨st', l', g', r'⟩ := L'
  simp only at hl hg
  subst hg
  have hs : st = st' := congrArg Obj.start hd
  obtain ⟨rfl, -, rfl⟩ := append_three_inj (congrArg Obj.word hd) hl rfl
  rw [hs]

name: StringDiagrams.Layer.eq_of_cod_eq
statement:
theorem eq_of_cod_eq {L L' : Layer S} (hc : L.cod = L'.cod)
    (hl : L.left.length = L'.left.length) (hg : L.gen = L'.gen) : L = L'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨st, l, g, r⟩ := L
  obtain ⟨st', l', g', r'⟩ := L'
  simp only at hl hg
  subst hg
  have hs : st = st' := congrArg Obj.start hc
  obtain ⟨rfl, -, rfl⟩ := append_three_inj (congrArg Obj.word hc) hl rfl
  rw [hs]

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.diag_interchange_of_layers
statement:
theorem diag_interchange_of_layers {a b : Obj S} (r : S.Region) (l m v : List S.Colour)
    (g h : S.Gen) (f₁ f₂ : a ⟶ b)
    (h₁ : Diagram.layers f₁ = [⟨r, l, g, m ++ S.dom h ++ v⟩, ⟨r, l ++ S.cod g ++ m, h, v⟩])
    (h₂ : Diagram.layers f₂ = [⟨r, l ++ S.dom g ++ m, h, v⟩, ⟨r, l, g, m ++ S.cod h ++ v⟩]) :
    P.diag f₁ = ((if S.odd g && S.odd h then -1 else 1 : ℤ) : R) • P.diag f₂
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ha, -, hb⟩ := Diagram.eq_of_layers_eq_pair f₁ h₁
  have hc := Diagram.chain f₁
  rw [h₁] at hc
  obtain ⟨hv₁, -, hv₂, -, -⟩ := hc
  
  have hlg : S.endR r l = S.left g := hv₁.left_end
  have hmh : S.endR (S.right g) m = S.left h := by
    have := hv₂.left_end
    simp only [Signature.endR_append] at this
    rwa [hlg, hv₁.cod_end] at this
  have hm : S.ok (S.right g) m := by
    have := hv₁.right_ok
    simp only [Signature.ok_append] at this
    exact this.1.1
  let L : Layer S := ⟨r, l, g, []⟩
  let M : Layer S := ⟨S.right g, m, h, v⟩
  have hL : L.Valid := ⟨hv₁.left_ok, hv₁.left_end, hv₁.dom_ok, hv₁.dom_end, hv₁.cod_ok,
    hv₁.cod_end, trivial⟩
  have hM : M.Valid := ⟨hm, hmh, hv₂.dom_ok, hv₂.dom_end, hv₂.cod_ok, hv₂.cod_end, hv₂.right_ok⟩
  have hLM : L.dom.endR = M.start := by
    simp [L, M, Layer.dom, Obj.endR, hlg, hv₁.dom_end]
  let x : InterchangeData S := InterchangeData.ofLayers L M
  have hx : x.Valid := InterchangeData.valid_ofLayers hL hM hLM
  let u : Obj S := ⟨r, l⟩
  have hw : x.dom.WhiskerOK u v := by
    refine ⟨hv₁.left_ok, hlg, ?_⟩
    have : x.dom.endR = S.right h := by
      simp [x, L, M, InterchangeData.ofLayers, InterchangeData.dom, Obj.endR, hv₁.dom_end, hmh,
        hv₂.dom_end]
    rw [this]; exact hv₂.right_ok
  have ha' : x.dom.whisker u v = a := by
    rw [ha]
    simp [x, u, L, M, InterchangeData.ofLayers, InterchangeData.dom, Obj.whisker, Layer.dom]
  have hb' : x.cod.whisker u v = b := by
    rw [hb]
    simp [x, u, L, M, InterchangeData.ofLayers, InterchangeData.cod, Obj.whisker, Layer.cod]
  have key := P.diag_interchange x hx u v hw ha' hb'
  refine Eq.trans (P.diag_eq_of_layers_eq ?_) (key.trans (congrArg _ (P.diag_eq_of_layers_eq ?_)))
  all_goals simp only [Diagram.layers_cast, Diagram.layers_whisker]
  · simp [h₁, x, u, L, M, InterchangeData.ofLayers, InterchangeData.ghDiagram,
      InterchangeData.gh₁, InterchangeData.gh₂, Layer.whisker]
  · simp [h₂, x, u, L, M, InterchangeData.ofLayers, InterchangeData.hgDiagram,
      InterchangeData.hg₁, InterchangeData.hg₂, Layer.whisker]

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.diag_interchange_of_layers_of_even
statement:
theorem diag_interchange_of_layers_of_even {a b : Obj S} (r : S.Region) (l m v : List S.Colour)
    (g h : S.Gen) (hgh : S.odd g = false ∨ S.odd h = false) (f₁ f₂ : a ⟶ b)
    (h₁ : Diagram.layers f₁ = [⟨r, l, g, m ++ S.dom h ++ v⟩, ⟨r, l ++ S.cod g ++ m, h, v⟩])
    (h₂ : Diagram.layers f₂ = [⟨r, l ++ S.dom g ++ m, h, v⟩, ⟨r, l, g, m ++ S.cod h ++ v⟩]) :
    P.diag f₁ = P.diag f₂
proof:
:= by
  rw [P.diag_interchange_of_layers r l m v g h f₁ f₂ h₁ h₂]
  rcases hgh with hg | hh <;> simp [*]

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.diag_interchange_of_layers_of_odd
statement:
theorem diag_interchange_of_layers_of_odd {a b : Obj S} (r : S.Region) (l m v : List S.Colour)
    (g h : S.Gen) (hg : S.odd g = true) (hh : S.odd h = true) (f₁ f₂ : a ⟶ b)
    (h₁ : Diagram.layers f₁ = [⟨r, l, g, m ++ S.dom h ++ v⟩, ⟨r, l ++ S.cod g ++ m, h, v⟩])
    (h₂ : Diagram.layers f₂ = [⟨r, l ++ S.dom g ++ m, h, v⟩, ⟨r, l, g, m ++ S.cod h ++ v⟩]) :
    P.diag f₁ = -P.diag f₂
proof:
:= by
  rw [P.diag_interchange_of_layers r l m v g h f₁ f₂ h₁ h₂]
  simp [hg, hh]

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.linAlgHom_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem linAlgHom_apply (a : Obj S) (f : End (Free.of R a)) : P.linAlgHom a f = P.lin f

name: StringDiagrams.Signature.ok_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem ok_nil (r : S.Region) : S.ok r []

name: StringDiagrams.Signature.ok_cons
statement:
@[simp] theorem ok_cons (r : S.Region) (c : S.Colour) (w : List S.Colour) :
    S.ok r (c :: w) ↔ S.colourSrc c = r ∧ S.ok (S.colourTgt c) w

name: StringDiagrams.Signature.endR_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem endR_nil (r : S.Region) : S.endR r [] = r

name: StringDiagrams.Signature.endR_cons

name: StringDiagrams.Signature.ok_append
statement:
@[simp] theorem ok_append (r : S.Region) (w w' : List S.Colour) :
    S.ok r (w ++ w') ↔ S.ok r w ∧ S.ok (S.endR r w) w'
proof:
:= by
  induction w generalizing r with
  | nil => simp
  | cons c w ih => simp [ih, and_assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.Signature.endR_append
statement:
@[simp] theorem endR_append (r : S.Region) (w w' : List S.Colour) :
    S.endR r (w ++ w') = S.endR (S.endR r w) w'
proof:
:= by
  induction w generalizing r with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons c w ih => simp [ih]

name: StringDiagrams.Signature.ok_of_subsingleton
statement:

    S.ok r w
proof:
:= by
  induction w generalizing r with
  | nil => trivial
  | cons c w ih => exact ⟨Subsingleton.elim _ _, ih _⟩

name: StringDiagrams.Layer.dom_word
statement: @[simp] theorem dom_word (L : Layer S) : L.dom.word = L.left ++ S.dom L.gen ++ L.right

name: StringDiagrams.Layer.cod_word
statement: @[simp] theorem cod_word (L : Layer S) : L.cod.word = L.left ++ S.cod L.gen ++ L.right

name: StringDiagrams.Layer.valid_of_subsingleton
statement:
theorem valid_of_subsingleton [Subsingleton S.Region] (L : Layer S) : L.Valid where
  left_ok
proof:
:= Signature.ok_of_subsingleton _ _
  left_end := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  dom_ok := Signature.ok_of_subsingleton _ _
  dom_end := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  cod_ok := Signature.ok_of_subsingleton _ _
  cod_end := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  right_ok := Signature.ok_of_subsingleton _ _

name: StringDiagrams.Layer.Valid.endR_dom
statement:
theorem Valid.endR_dom {L : Layer S} (h : L.Valid) :
    L.dom.endR = S.endR (S.right L.gen) L.right

name: StringDiagrams.Layer.Valid.endR_cod
statement:
theorem Valid.endR_cod {L : Layer S} (h : L.Valid) :
    L.cod.endR = S.endR (S.right L.gen) L.right

name: StringDiagrams.Layer.Valid.endR_eq
statement: theorem Valid.endR_eq {L : Layer S} (h : L.Valid) : L.cod.endR = L.dom.endR

name: StringDiagrams.Layer.whisker_dom
statement:
@[simp] theorem whisker_dom (L : Layer S) (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour) :
    (L.whisker u v).dom = L.dom.whisker u v

name: StringDiagrams.Layer.whisker_cod
statement:
@[simp] theorem whisker_cod (L : Layer S) (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour) :
    (L.whisker u v).cod = L.cod.whisker u v

name: StringDiagrams.Layer.Valid.whisker
statement:
theorem Valid.whisker {L : Layer S} (h : L.Valid) {u : Obj S} {v : List S.Colour}
    (hw : L.dom.WhiskerOK u v) : (L.whisker u v).Valid
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hu, hue, hv⟩ := hw
  have hue' : S.endR u.start u.word = L.start := hue
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, h.dom_ok, h.dom_end, h.cod_ok, h.cod_end, ?_⟩
  · show S.ok u.start (u.word ++ L.left)
    rw [Signature.ok_append, hue']; exact ⟨hu, h.left_ok⟩
  · show S.endR u.start (u.word ++ L.left) = S.left L.gen
    rw [Signature.endR_append, hue']; exact h.left_end
  · show S.ok (S.right L.gen) (L.right ++ v)
    rw [Signature.ok_append]; exact ⟨h.right_ok, by rw [← h.endR_dom]; exact hv⟩

name: StringDiagrams.chain_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem chain_nil (a b : Obj S) : Chain a [] b ↔ a = b

name: StringDiagrams.chain_cons
statement:
@[simp] theorem chain_cons (a b : Obj S) (L : Layer S) (ls : List (Layer S)) :
    Chain a (L :: ls) b ↔ L.Valid ∧ L.dom = a ∧ Chain L.cod ls b

name: StringDiagrams.Chain.append
statement:
theorem Chain.append {a b c : Obj S} {ls ms : List (Layer S)} (h₁ : Chain a ls b)
    (h₂ : Chain b ms c) : Chain a (ls ++ ms) c
proof:
:= by
  induction ls generalizing a with
  | nil => cases h₁; exact h₂
  | cons L ls ih => exact ⟨h₁.1, h₁.2.1, ih h₁.2.2⟩

name: StringDiagrams.Chain.start_eq
statement:
theorem Chain.start_eq {a b : Obj S} {ls : List (Layer S)} (h : Chain a ls b) :
    b.start = a.start
proof:
:= by
  induction ls generalizing a with
  | nil => cases h; rfl
  | cons L ls ih => rw [ih h.2.2, ← h.2.1]; rfl

name: StringDiagrams.Chain.endR_eq
statement:
theorem Chain.endR_eq {a b : Obj S} {ls : List (Layer S)} (h : Chain a ls b) :
    b.endR = a.endR
proof:
:= by
  induction ls generalizing a with
  | nil => cases h; rfl
  | cons L ls ih => rw [ih h.2.2, h.1.endR_eq, h.2.1]

name: StringDiagrams.Chain.whiskerOK
statement:
theorem Chain.whiskerOK {a b : Obj S} {ls : List (Layer S)} (h : Chain a ls b)
    {u : Obj S} {v : List S.Colour} (hw : a.WhiskerOK u v) : b.WhiskerOK u v
proof:
:=
  ⟨hw.1, by rw [h.start_eq]; exact hw.2.1, by rw [h.endR_eq]; exact hw.2.2⟩

name: StringDiagrams.Chain.whisker
statement:
theorem Chain.whisker {a b : Obj S} {ls : List (Layer S)} (h : Chain a ls b)
    {u : Obj S} {v : List S.Colour} (hw : a.WhiskerOK u v) :
    Chain (a.whisker u v) (ls.map (·.whisker u v)) (b.whisker u v)
proof:
:= by
  induction ls generalizing a with
  | nil => cases h; rfl
  | cons L ls ih =>
    obtain ⟨hv, rfl, hc⟩ := h
    rw [List.map_cons, chain_cons, Layer.whisker_dom, Layer.whisker_cod]
    have hw' : L.cod.WhiskerOK u v := Chain.whiskerOK (ls := [L]) ⟨hv, rfl, rfl⟩ hw
    exact ⟨hv.whisker hw, rfl, ih hc hw'⟩

name: StringDiagrams.Chain.target_eq
statement:
theorem Chain.target_eq {a b : Obj S} {ls : List (Layer S)} (h : Chain a ls b) :
    Chain.target a ls = b
proof:
:= by
  induction ls generalizing a with
  | nil => exact h
  | cons L ls ih => exact ih h.2.2

name: StringDiagrams.Chain.target_append_singleton
statement:
@[simp] theorem Chain.target_append_singleton (a : Obj S) (ls : List (Layer S)) (L : Layer S) :
    Chain.target a (ls ++ [L]) = L.cod
proof:
:= by
  induction ls generalizing a with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons L' ls ih => exact ih _

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.chain
statement: theorem chain (f : a ⟶ b) : Chain a (layers f) b

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.layers_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem layers_mk (ls : List (Layer S)) (h : Chain a ls b) :
    layers (mk ls h) = ls

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.ext
statement: @[ext] theorem ext {f g : a ⟶ b} (h : layers f = layers g) : f = g

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.layers_id
statement: @[simp] theorem layers_id (a : Obj S) : layers (𝟙 a) = []

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.layers_comp
statement: @[simp] theorem layers_comp (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) : layers (f ≫ g) = layers f ++ layers g

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.layers_eqToHom
statement: @[simp] theorem layers_eqToHom (h : a = b) : layers (eqToHom h) = []

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.layers_ofLayer
statement: @[simp] theorem layers_ofLayer (L : Layer S) (hv : L.Valid) : layers (ofLayer L hv) = [L]

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.layers_layer
statement:
@[simp] theorem layers_layer (L : Layer S) (hv : L.Valid) (ha : L.dom = a) (hb : L.cod = b) :
    layers (layer L hv ha hb) = [L]

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.layers_cast
statement:
@[simp] theorem layers_cast {a' b' : Obj S} (f : a ⟶ b) (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b') :
    layers (cast f ha hb) = layers f

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.cast_eq
statement:
theorem cast_eq {a' b' : Obj S} (f : a ⟶ b) (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b') :
    cast f ha hb = eqToHom ha.symm ≫ f ≫ eqToHom hb

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.cast_rfl
statement: @[simp] theorem cast_rfl (f : a ⟶ b) : cast f rfl rfl = f

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.cast_cast
statement:
@[simp] theorem cast_cast {a' b' a'' b'' : Obj S} (f : a ⟶ b) (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b')
    (ha' : a' = a'') (hb' : b' = b'') :
    cast (cast f ha hb) ha' hb' = cast f (ha.trans ha') (hb.trans hb')

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.cast_comp
statement:
theorem cast_comp {a' b' c' : Obj S} (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b')
    (hc : c = c') : cast (f ≫ g) ha hc = cast f ha hb ≫ cast g hb hc

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.cast_id
statement:
@[simp] theorem cast_id {a' a'' : Obj S} (ha : a = a') (ha' : a = a'') :
    cast (𝟙 a) ha' ha = eqToHom (ha'.symm.trans ha)

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.eq_cast_of_layers_eq
statement:
theorem eq_cast_of_layers_eq {a' b' : Obj S} {f : a ⟶ b} {g : a' ⟶ b'} (ha : a' = a)
    (hb : b' = b) (h : layers f = layers g) : f = cast g ha hb

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.eq_dom_of_layers_eq_cons
statement:
theorem eq_dom_of_layers_eq_cons (f : a ⟶ b) {L : Layer S} {ls : List (Layer S)}
    (h : layers f = L :: ls) : a = L.dom
proof:
:= by
  have := chain f
  rw [h] at this
  exact this.2.1.symm

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.eq_cod_of_layers_eq_append
statement:
theorem eq_cod_of_layers_eq_append (f : a ⟶ b) {L : Layer S} {ls : List (Layer S)}
    (h : layers f = ls ++ [L]) : b = L.cod
proof:
:= by
  have := (chain f).target_eq
  rw [h, Chain.target_append_singleton] at this
  exact this.symm

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.eq_of_layers_eq_singleton
statement:
theorem eq_of_layers_eq_singleton (f : a ⟶ b) {L : Layer S} (h : layers f = [L]) :
    a = L.dom ∧ b = L.cod

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.eq_of_layers_eq_pair
statement:
theorem eq_of_layers_eq_pair (f : a ⟶ b) {L₁ L₂ : Layer S} (h : layers f = [L₁, L₂]) :
    a = L₁.dom ∧ L₁.cod = L₂.dom ∧ b = L₂.cod
proof:
:= by
  have := chain f
  rw [h] at this
  exact ⟨this.2.1.symm, this.2.2.2.1.symm, this.2.2.2.2.symm⟩

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.eq_of_layers_eq_triple
statement:
theorem eq_of_layers_eq_triple (f : a ⟶ b) {L₁ L₂ L₃ : Layer S} (h : layers f = [L₁, L₂, L₃]) :
    a = L₁.dom ∧ L₁.cod = L₂.dom ∧ L₂.cod = L₃.dom ∧ b = L₃.cod
proof:
:= by
  have := chain f
  rw [h] at this
  exact ⟨this.2.1.symm, this.2.2.2.1.symm, this.2.2.2.2.2.1.symm, this.2.2.2.2.2.2.symm⟩

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.layers_whisker
statement:
@[simp] theorem layers_whisker (f : a ⟶ b) (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour)
    (hw : a.WhiskerOK u v) : layers (whisker f u v hw) = (layers f).map (·.whisker u v)

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.whisker_id
statement:
theorem whisker_id (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour) (hw : a.WhiskerOK u v) :
    whisker (𝟙 a) u v hw = 𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.whisker_comp
statement:
theorem whisker_comp (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour)
    (hw : a.WhiskerOK u v) :
    whisker (f ≫ g) u v hw = whisker f u v hw ≫ whisker g u v ((chain f).whiskerOK hw)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.nil_composable
statement: theorem nil_composable (r : S.Region) : (Obj.nil r).Composable (Obj.nil r)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.wRAt_nil_nil
statement:
theorem wRAt_nil_nil (r : S.Region) (f : P.obj (Obj.nil r) ⟶ P.obj (Obj.nil r)) :
    P.wRAt r f (Obj.nil r) rfl rfl = f
proof:
:= by
  rw [P.wRAt_nil (s := r) (r := r) f trivial rfl rfl rfl]
  simp

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.wL_nil_nil
statement:
theorem wL_nil_nil (r : S.Region) (g : P.obj (Obj.nil r) ⟶ P.obj (Obj.nil r)) :
    P.wL (Obj.nil r) g = g
proof:
:= by
  rw [P.wL_nil (r := r) g trivial rfl rfl]
  simp

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.nil_comp_comm
statement:
theorem nil_comp_comm [S.IsEven] (r : S.Region) (f g : P.obj (Obj.nil r) ⟶ P.obj (Obj.nil r)) :
    f ≫ g = g ≫ f
proof:
:= by
  have key := P.wRAt_comp_wL (r := r) (nil_composable r) f g rfl rfl
  rwa [wRAt_nil_nil, wL_nil_nil] at key

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.nil_commute
statement: theorem nil_commute [S.IsEven] (r : S.Region) (f g : End (P.obj (Obj.nil r))) : Commute f g

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.nil_comp_comm_super
proof:
:= by
  have key := P.wRAt_comp_wL_super (r := r) (nil_composable r) hf hg rfl rfl
  rwa [wRAt_nil_nil, wL_nil_nil] at key

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.unit_comp_comm
statement:
theorem unit_comp_comm [S.IsEven] [Inhabited S.Region]
    (f g : P.obj Obj.unit ⟶ P.obj Obj.unit) : f ≫ g = g ≫ f

name: StringDiagrams.endList_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem endList_nil (i : ι) : endList A i [] = 1

name: StringDiagrams.endList_cons
statement:
@[simp] theorem endList_cons (i : ι) (L : Layer S) (ls : List (Layer S)) :
    endList A i (L :: ls) = endList A i ls * A L i

name: StringDiagrams.endList_singleton
statement: @[simp 1100] theorem endList_singleton (i : ι) (L : Layer S) : endList A i [L] = A L i

name: StringDiagrams.endList_append
statement:
@[simp] theorem endList_append (i : ι) (ls ms : List (Layer S)) :
    endList A i (ls ++ ms) = endList A i ms * endList A i ls
proof:
:= by
  induction ls with
  | nil => rw [List.nil_append, endList_nil, mul_one]
  | cons L ls ih => rw [List.cons_append, endList_cons, ih, endList_cons, mul_assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.Chain.index_eq
statement:
theorem Chain.index_eq {κ : Obj S → ι} (hκ : ∀ L : Layer S, L.Valid → κ L.cod = κ L.dom) :
    ∀ {a b : Obj S} {ls : List (Layer S)}, Chain a ls b → κ b = κ a
proof:
| _, _, [], h => by cases h; rfl
  | _, _, L :: _, ⟨hv, hd, hc⟩ => by rw [Chain.index_eq hκ hc, hκ L hv, hd]

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.index_eq
statement:
theorem Diagram.index_eq {κ : Obj S → ι} (hκ : ∀ L : Layer S, L.Valid → κ L.cod = κ L.dom)
    {a b : Obj S} (f : a ⟶ b) : κ b = κ a

name: StringDiagrams.Interpretation.mapChain_transport
statement:
theorem mapChain_transport (hA : I.LayerTransport (A := A) hobj hκ) :
    ∀ {a b : Obj S} {ls : List (Layer S)} (h : Chain a ls b) {i : ι} (ha : κ a = i)
      (hb : κ b = i),
      eqToHom ((hobj a).trans (congrArg X ha)).symm ≫ I.mapChain a ls b h ≫
        eqToHom ((hobj b).trans (congrArg X hb)) = endList A i ls
proof:
| a, b, [], h, i, ha, hb => by
    cases h
    simp [mapChain, End.one_def]
  | a, b, L :: ls, ⟨hv, hd, hc⟩, i, ha, hb => by
    subst ha hd
    have ih := mapChain_transport hA hc (hκ L hv) hb
    rw [endList_cons, End.mul_def, ← hA L hv, ← ih]
    simp [mapChain]

name: StringDiagrams.Interpretation.map_transport
statement:
theorem map_transport (hA : I.LayerTransport (A := A) hobj hκ) {a b : Obj S} (f : a ⟶ b)
    {i : ι} (ha : κ a = i) (hb : κ b = i) :
    eqToHom ((hobj a).trans (congrArg X ha)).symm ≫ I.functor.map f ≫
        eqToHom ((hobj b).trans (congrArg X hb)) = endList A i (Diagram.layers f)

name: StringDiagrams.Interpretation.ofEnd_obj
statement: @[simp] theorem ofEnd_obj (a : Obj S) : (ofEnd κ X A hκ).obj a = X (κ a)

name: StringDiagrams.Interpretation.ofEnd_layerTransport
statement:
theorem ofEnd_layerTransport :
    (ofEnd κ X A hκ).LayerTransport (A := A) (fun _ => rfl) hκ

name: StringDiagrams.Interpretation.ofEnd_map_transport
statement:
theorem ofEnd_map_transport {a b : Obj S} (f : a ⟶ b) {i : ι} (ha : κ a = i) (hb : κ b = i) :
    eqToHom (congrArg X ha).symm ≫ (ofEnd κ X A hκ).functor.map f ≫ eqToHom (congrArg X hb) =
      endList A i (Diagram.layers f)
proof:
:=
  Interpretation.map_transport (I := ofEnd κ X A hκ) (X := X) (κ := κ) (A := A) (hκ := hκ)
    (hobj := fun _ => rfl) ofEnd_layerTransport f ha hb

name: StringDiagrams.Interpretation.ofEnd_map_end
statement:
theorem ofEnd_map_end {a : Obj S} (f : a ⟶ a) :
    (ofEnd κ X A hκ).functor.map f = endList A (κ a) (Diagram.layers f)
proof:
:= by
  simpa using ofEnd_map_transport (hκ := hκ) (A := A) f rfl rfl

name: StringDiagrams.linEnd_single
statement:
@[simp] theorem linEnd_single (d : a ⟶ b) (r : R) :
    linEnd A i (Finsupp.single d r : LinDiagram R a b) = r • endList A i (Diagram.layers d)

name: StringDiagrams.linEnd_of
statement:
@[simp] theorem linEnd_of (d : a ⟶ b) :
    linEnd A i (LinDiagram.of d : LinDiagram R a b) = endList A i (Diagram.layers d)

name: StringDiagrams.linEndW_single
statement:
@[simp] theorem linEndW_single (d : a ⟶ b) (r : R) :
    linEndW A i u v (Finsupp.single d r : LinDiagram R a b) =
      r • endList A i ((Diagram.layers d).map (·.whisker u v))

name: StringDiagrams.linEndW_of
statement:
@[simp] theorem linEndW_of (d : a ⟶ b) :
    linEndW A i u v (LinDiagram.of d : LinDiagram R a b) =
      endList A i ((Diagram.layers d).map (·.whisker u v))

name: StringDiagrams.linEnd_whisker
statement:
theorem linEnd_whisker (Y : LinDiagram R a b) (hw : a.WhiskerOK u v) :
    linEnd A i (LinDiagram.whisker Y u v hw) = linEndW A i u v Y

name: StringDiagrams.Interpretation.freeLift_map_transport
statement:
theorem freeLift_map_transport (hA : I.LayerTransport (A := A) hobj hκ) {a b : Obj S}
    (Y : LinDiagram R a b) {i : ι} (ha : κ a = i) (hb : κ b = i) :
    eqToHom ((hobj a).trans (congrArg X ha)).symm ≫ (freeLift R I.functor).map Y ≫
        eqToHom ((hobj b).trans (congrArg X hb)) = linEnd A i Y
proof:
:= by
  induction Y using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero =>
    rw [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_zero, Limits.zero_comp, Limits.comp_zero, map_zero]
  | add Y Z hY hZ =>
    rw [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_add, Preadditive.add_comp, Preadditive.comp_add, hY, hZ,
      map_add]
  | single d r =>
    rw [freeLift_map_single, Linear.smul_comp, Linear.comp_smul, linEnd_single]
    exact congrArg (r • ·) (map_transport hA d ha hb)

name: StringDiagrams.Interpretation.freeLift_map_eq_zero
statement:
theorem freeLift_map_eq_zero (hA : I.LayerTransport (A := A) hobj hκ) {a b : Obj S}
    {Y : LinDiagram R a b} (h : linEnd A (κ a) Y = 0) : (freeLift R I.functor).map Y = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hab : κ b = κ a
  · have e := freeLift_map_transport hA Y rfl hab
    rw [h] at e
    have e' := congrArg (fun g => eqToHom ((hobj a).trans (congrArg X rfl)) ≫ g ≫
      eqToHom ((hobj b).trans (congrArg X hab)).symm) e
    simpa using e'
  · have : IsEmpty (a ⟶ b) := ⟨fun f => hab (Diagram.index_eq hκ f)⟩
    have hY : Y = 0 := Finsupp.ext (α := a ⟶ b) fun d => (IsEmpty.false d).elim
    rw [hY, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_zero]

name: StringDiagrams.Interpretation.freeLift_map_whisker_eq_zero
statement:
theorem freeLift_map_whisker_eq_zero (hA : I.LayerTransport (A := A) hobj hκ) {a b : Obj S}
    {u : Obj S} {v : List S.Colour} {Y : LinDiagram R a b} (hw : a.WhiskerOK u v)
    (h : linEndW A (κ (a.whisker u v)) u v Y = 0) :
    (freeLift R I.functor).map (LinDiagram.whisker Y u v hw) = 0

name: StringDiagrams.Interpretation.respects_of_linEndW
statement:
theorem respects_of_linEndW (hA : I.LayerTransport (A := A) hobj hκ) (P : Presentation S R)
    (hrel : ∀ (r : P.Rel) (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour), (P.dom r).WhiskerOK u v →
      linEndW A (κ ((P.dom r).whisker u v)) u v (P.rel r) = 0)
    (hint : ∀ (x : InterchangeData S) (hx : x.Valid) (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour),
      x.dom.WhiskerOK u v →
      linEndW A (κ (x.dom.whisker u v)) u v (InterchangeData.rel R hx) = 0) :
    P.Respects I.functor where
  rel r u v hw
proof:
:= freeLift_map_whisker_eq_zero hA hw (hrel r u v hw)
  interchange x hx u v hw := freeLift_map_whisker_eq_zero hA hw (hint x hx u v hw)

name: StringDiagrams.Interpretation.lift_diag_transport
statement:
theorem lift_diag_transport (hA : I.LayerTransport (A := A) hobj hκ) {P : Presentation S R}
    (hF : P.Respects I.functor) {a b : Obj S} (f : a ⟶ b) {i : ι} (ha : κ a = i)
    (hb : κ b = i) :
    eqToHom ((hobj a).trans (congrArg X ha)).symm ≫ (P.lift hF).map (P.diag f) ≫
        eqToHom ((hobj b).trans (congrArg X hb)) = endList A i (Diagram.layers f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Presentation.lift_diag]
  exact map_transport hA f ha hb

name: StringDiagrams.linEndW_interchange
statement:
theorem linEndW_interchange (x : InterchangeData S) (hx : x.Valid) (u : Obj S)
    (v : List S.Colour) (i : ι) :
    linEndW A i u v (InterchangeData.rel R hx) =
      A ⟨u.start, u.word ++ (S.cod x.g ++ x.mid), x.h, v⟩ i *
          A ⟨u.start, u.word, x.g, x.mid ++ (S.dom x.h ++ v)⟩ i -
        ((x.sign : ℤ) : R) •
          (A ⟨u.start, u.word, x.g, x.mid ++ (S.cod x.h ++ v)⟩ i *
            A ⟨u.start, u.word ++ (S.dom x.g ++ x.mid), x.h, v⟩ i)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [InterchangeData.rel, map_sub, map_smul, linEndW_of, InterchangeData.ghDiagram,
    InterchangeData.hgDiagram, Diagram.layers_mk, List.map_cons, List.map_nil, endList_cons,
    endList_nil, one_mul, InterchangeData.gh₁, InterchangeData.gh₂, InterchangeData.hg₁,
    InterchangeData.hg₂, Layer.whisker, List.append_nil, List.nil_append, List.append_assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.linEndW_interchange_eq_zero
statement:
theorem linEndW_interchange_eq_zero {κ : Obj S → ι}
    (hcomm : ∀ (s : S.Region) (l m r : List S.Colour) (g g' : S.Gen),
      let i := κ ⟨s, l ++ (S.dom g ++ (m ++ (S.dom g' ++ r)))⟩
      A ⟨s, l ++ (S.cod g ++ m), g', r⟩ i * A ⟨s, l, g, m ++ (S.dom g' ++ r)⟩ i =
        (((⟨s, g, m, g'⟩ : InterchangeData S).sign : ℤ) : R) •
          (A ⟨s, l, g, m ++ (S.cod g' ++ r)⟩ i * A ⟨s, l ++ (S.dom g ++ m), g', r⟩ i))
    (x : InterchangeData S) (hx : x.Valid) (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour) :
    linEndW A (κ (x.dom.whisker u v)) u v (InterchangeData.rel R hx) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hd : x.dom.whisker u v =
      ⟨u.start, u.word ++ (S.dom x.g ++ (x.mid ++ (S.dom x.h ++ v)))⟩ := by
    simp [InterchangeData.dom, Obj.whisker]
  rw [linEndW_interchange, hd, hcomm u.start u.word x.mid v x.g x.h, sub_eq_zero]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.SingleColour.list_eq_of_length_eq
statement:
theorem list_eq_of_length_eq {α : Type*} [Subsingleton α] {l₁ l₂ : List α}
    (h : l₁.length = l₂.length) : l₁ = l₂
proof:
:= by
  induction l₁ generalizing l₂ with
  | nil => cases l₂ with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons _ _ => simp at h
  | cons a l ih => cases l₂ with
    | nil => simp at h
    | cons b l₂ =>
      rw [Subsingleton.elim a b, ih (by simpa using h)]

name: StringDiagrams.SingleColour.list_eq_iff
statement:
theorem list_eq_iff {α : Type*} [Subsingleton α] {l₁ l₂ : List α} :

name: StringDiagrams.SingleColour.list_eq_replicate

theorem list_eq_replicate {α : Type*} [Subsingleton α] [Inhabited α] (l : List α) :

name: StringDiagrams.SingleColour.word_eq_iff
statement:
@[simp] theorem word_eq_iff [Subsingleton S.Colour] {l₁ l₂ : List S.Colour} :

theorem whisker_strands {a : Obj S} {i j n : ℕ} (h : i + a.word.length + j = n) :

name: StringDiagrams.SingleColour.layer_ext_iff'
statement:
theorem layer_ext_iff' {L₁ L₂ : Layer S} :
    L₁ = L₂ ↔ L₁.left = L₂.left ∧ L₁.gen = L₂.gen ∧ L₁.right = L₂.right
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro rfl; exact ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨h₁, h₂, h₃⟩; exact Layer.ext (Subsingleton.elim _ _) h₁ h₂ h₃

name: StringDiagrams.SingleColour.layer_eq_iff
statement:
@[simp] theorem layer_eq_iff {L₁ L₂ : Layer S} :
    L₁ = L₂ ↔ L₁.left.length = L₂.left.length ∧ L₁.gen = L₂.gen ∧
      L₁.right.length = L₂.right.length

name: StringDiagrams.SingleColour.layer_ext
statement:
theorem layer_ext {L₁ L₂ : Layer S} (hl : L₁.left.length = L₂.left.length)
    (hg : L₁.gen = L₂.gen) (hr : L₁.right.length = L₂.right.length) : L₁ = L₂

statement: theorem lay_valid (i : ℕ) (g : S.Gen) (j : ℕ) : (lay i g j).Valid

theorem lay_dom (i : ℕ) (g : S.Gen) (j : ℕ) :

theorem lay_cod (i : ℕ) (g : S.Gen) (j : ℕ) :

statement: theorem eq_lay (L : Layer S) : L = lay L.left.length L.gen L.right.length

statement:
theorem lay_eq_iff {i i' j j' : ℕ} {g g' : S.Gen} :
    lay i g j = lay i' g' j' ↔ i = i' ∧ g = g' ∧ j = j'

name: StringDiagrams.SingleColour.lay_whisker
statement:
@[simp] theorem lay_whisker (i : ℕ) (g : S.Gen) (j k l : ℕ) :
    (lay i g j).whisker (strands k) (List.replicate l default) = lay (k + i) g (j + l)

name: StringDiagrams.SingleColour.layers_dlay
StringDiagrams.SingleColour.relation_at
statement:
theorem relation_at (r : P.Rel) (i j : ℕ) {n m : ℕ} (hn : i + (P.dom r).word.length + j = n)
    (hm : i + (P.cod r).word.length + j = m) :
    P.lin (LinDiagram.cast (LinDiagram.whisker (P.rel r) (strands i) (List.replicate j default)
      (Obj.whiskerOK_of_subsingleton _ _ _)) (whisker_strands hn) (whisker_strands hm)) = 0

name: StringDiagrams.SingleColour.layers_whisker_strands
statement:
theorem layers_whisker_strands {a b : Obj S} (f : a ⟶ b) (k l : ℕ) (hw : a.WhiskerOK (strands k)
    (List.replicate l default)) :
    Diagram.layers (Diagram.whisker f (strands k) (List.replicate l default) hw) =
      (Diagram.layers f).map fun L => lay (k + L.left.length) L.gen (L.right.length + l)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Diagram.layers_whisker]
  refine List.map_congr_left fun L _ => ?_
  simp [Layer.whisker]

name: StringDiagrams.SingleColour.interchange_at
statement:
theorem interchange_at (g h : S.Gen) (i m j : ℕ) {n₀ n₁ n₂ n₃ : ℕ}
    (h₀ : i + (S.dom g).length + m + (S.dom h).length + j = n₀)
    (h₁ : i + (S.cod g).length + m + (S.dom h).length + j = n₁)
    (h₂ : i + (S.dom g).length + m + (S.cod h).length + j = n₂)
    (h₃ : i + (S.cod g).length + m + (S.cod h).length + j = n₃) :
    P.diag (dlay i g (m + (S.dom h).length + j) (by omega) (by omega) :
        (strands n₀ : Obj S) ⟶ strands n₁) ≫
      P.diag (dlay (i + (S.cod g).length + m) h j (by omega) (by omega) :
        (strands n₁ : Obj S) ⟶ strands n₃) =
    ((if S.odd g && S.odd h then -1 else 1 : ℤ) : R) •
      (P.diag (dlay (i + (S.dom g).length + m) h j (by omega) (by omega) :
          (strands n₀ : Obj S) ⟶ strands n₂) ≫
        P.diag (dlay i g (m + (S.cod h).length + j) (by omega) (by omega) :
          (strands n₂ : Obj S) ⟶ strands n₃))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← P.diag_comp, ← P.diag_comp]
  refine P.diag_interchange_of_layers default (List.replicate i default)
    (List.replicate m default) (List.replicate j default) g h _ _ ?_ ?_
  · simp [lay]; omega
  · simp [lay]; omega

name: StringDiagrams.SingleColour.interchange_at_of_even
statement:
theorem interchange_at_of_even (g h : S.Gen) (hgh : S.odd g = false ∨ S.odd h = false)
    (i m j : ℕ) {n₀ n₁ n₂ n₃ : ℕ}
    (h₀ : i + (S.dom g).length + m + (S.dom h).length + j = n₀)
    (h₁ : i + (S.cod g).length + m + (S.dom h).length + j = n₁)
    (h₂ : i + (S.dom g).length + m + (S.cod h).length + j = n₂)
    (h₃ : i + (S.cod g).length + m + (S.cod h).length + j = n₃) :
    P.diag (dlay i g (m + (S.dom h).length + j) (by omega) (by omega) :
        (strands n₀ : Obj S) ⟶ strands n₁) ≫
      P.diag (dlay (i + (S.cod g).length + m) h j (by omega) (by omega) :
        (strands n₁ : Obj S) ⟶ strands n₃) =
    P.diag (dlay (i + (S.dom g).length + m) h j (by omega) (by omega) :
        (strands n₀ : Obj S) ⟶ strands n₂) ≫
      P.diag (dlay i g (m + (S.cod h).length + j) (by omega) (by omega) :
        (strands n₂ : Obj S) ⟶ strands n₃)
proof:
:= by
  rw [interchange_at P g h i m j h₀ h₁ h₂ h₃]
  rcases hgh with hg | hh <;> simp [*]

name: StringDiagrams.SingleColour.interchange_at_of_odd
statement:
theorem interchange_at_of_odd (g h : S.Gen) (hg : S.odd g = true) (hh : S.odd h = true)
    (i m j : ℕ) {n₀ n₁ n₂ n₃ : ℕ}
    (h₀ : i + (S.dom g).length + m + (S.dom h).length + j = n₀)
    (h₁ : i + (S.cod g).length + m + (S.dom h).length + j = n₁)
    (h₂ : i + (S.dom g).length + m + (S.cod h).length + j = n₂)
    (h₃ : i + (S.cod g).length + m + (S.cod h).length + j = n₃) :
    P.diag (dlay i g (m + (S.dom h).length + j) (by omega) (by omega) :
        (strands n₀ : Obj S) ⟶ strands n₁) ≫
      P.diag (dlay (i + (S.cod g).length + m) h j (by omega) (by omega) :
        (strands n₁ : Obj S) ⟶ strands n₃) =
    -(P.diag (dlay (i + (S.dom g).length + m) h j (by omega) (by omega) :
        (strands n₀ : Obj S) ⟶ strands n₂) ≫
      P.diag (dlay i g (m + (S.cod h).length + j) (by omega) (by omega) :
        (strands n₂ : Obj S) ⟶ strands n₃))
proof:
:= by
  rw [interchange_at P g h i m j h₀ h₁ h₂ h₃]
  simp [hg, hh]

name: StringDiagrams.SingleColour.layer_cod_length
statement: theorem layer_cod_length (L : Layer S) : L.cod.word.length = L.dom.word.length

name: StringDiagrams.SingleColour.chain_length_eq
statement:
theorem chain_length_eq {a b : Obj S} {ls : List (Layer S)} (h : Chain a ls b) :
    b.word.length = a.word.length
proof:
:= by
  induction ls generalizing a with
  | nil => cases h; rfl
  | cons L ls ih => rw [ih h.2.2, layer_cod_length hS, h.2.1]

name: StringDiagrams.SingleColour.eq_zero_of_length_ne
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_length_ne {a b : Obj S} (h : a.word.length ≠ b.word.length)
    (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b) : f = 0
proof:
:=
  P.eq_zero_of_invariant (fun a => a.word.length) (fun L _ => layer_cod_length hS L) h f

name: StringDiagrams.SingleColour.mem_subalgebra_of_dlay
statement:
theorem mem_subalgebra_of_dlay (n : ℕ) (A : Subalgebra R (End (P.obj (strands n : Obj S))))
    (hA : ∀ (i : ℕ) (g : S.Gen) (j : ℕ) (h : i + (S.dom g).length + j = n),
      P.diag (dlay i g j h (by rw [hS]; exact h)) ∈ A)
    (f : End (P.obj (strands n : Obj S))) : f ∈ A
proof:
:= by
  refine P.mem_subalgebra_of_layers (fun L _ hL => obj_ext ?_) A (fun L hv hd => ?_) f
  · rw [layer_cod_length hS, hL]
  · have hn : L.left.length + (S.dom L.gen).length + L.right.length = n := by
      have := congrArg (fun a : Obj S => a.word.length) hd
      simp [Layer.dom] at this; omega
    convert hA L.left.length L.gen L.right.length hn using 1
    exact P.diag_eq_of_layers_eq (by simp)

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.degree_mk
statement:
theorem degree_mk (ls : List (Layer S)) (h : Chain a ls b) :
    degree deg (mk ls h) = (ls.map fun L => deg L.gen).sum

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.degree_id
statement: @[simp] theorem degree_id (a : Obj S) : degree deg (𝟙 a) = 0

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.degree_comp
statement:
@[simp] theorem degree_comp (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) :
    degree deg (f ≫ g) = degree deg f + degree deg g

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.degree_eqToHom
statement: @[simp] theorem degree_eqToHom (h : a = b) : degree deg (eqToHom h) = 0

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.degree_ofLayer
statement:
@[simp] theorem degree_ofLayer (L : Layer S) (hv : L.Valid) :
    degree deg (ofLayer L hv) = deg L.gen

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.degree_layer
statement:
@[simp] theorem degree_layer (L : Layer S) (hv : L.Valid) (ha : L.dom = a) (hb : L.cod = b) :
    degree deg (layer L hv ha hb) = deg L.gen

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.degree_cast
statement:
@[simp] theorem degree_cast {a' b' : Obj S} (f : a ⟶ b) (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b') :
    degree deg (cast f ha hb) = degree deg f

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.degree_whisker
statement:
@[simp] theorem degree_whisker (f : a ⟶ b) (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour)
    (hw : a.WhiskerOK u v) : degree deg (whisker f u v hw) = degree deg f

name: StringDiagrams.InterchangeData.degree_ghDiagram
statement:
@[simp] theorem degree_ghDiagram (hx : x.Valid) :
    Diagram.degree deg (ghDiagram hx) = deg x.g + deg x.h

name: StringDiagrams.InterchangeData.degree_hgDiagram
statement:
@[simp] theorem degree_hgDiagram (hx : x.Valid) :
    Diagram.degree deg (hgDiagram hx) = deg x.g + deg x.h
proof:
:= by
  simp [hgDiagram, Diagram.degree_mk, hg₁, hg₂, add_comm]

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.mem_homDeg_iff
statement:
theorem mem_homDeg_iff {f : LinDiagram R a b} {d : A} :
    f ∈ homDeg R deg a b d ↔
      ∀ g : a ⟶ b, f.toFinsupp g ≠ 0 → Diagram.degree deg g = d
proof:
:= by
  rw [homDeg, Finsupp.mem_supported]
  exact ⟨fun h g hg => h (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mpr hg),
    fun h g hg => h g (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hg)⟩

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.single_mem_homDeg
statement:
theorem single_mem_homDeg (g : a ⟶ b) (r : R) :
    (Finsupp.single g r : LinDiagram R a b) ∈ homDeg R deg a b (Diagram.degree deg g)

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.of_mem_homDeg
statement:
theorem of_mem_homDeg (g : a ⟶ b) :
    (of g : LinDiagram R a b) ∈ homDeg R deg a b (Diagram.degree deg g)

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.of_mem_homDeg'
statement:
theorem of_mem_homDeg' {g : a ⟶ b} {d : A} (h : Diagram.degree deg g = d) :
    (of g : LinDiagram R a b) ∈ homDeg R deg a b d

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.id_mem_homDeg
statement: theorem id_mem_homDeg (a : Obj S) : 𝟙 (Free.of R a) ∈ homDeg R deg a a 0

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.comp_mem_homDeg
proof:
:= by
  rw [homDeg, Finsupp.supported_eq_span_single] at hf hg
  induction hf using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := hx
    induction hg using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem y hy =>
      obtain ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩ := hy
      have := of_comp (R := R) p q
      refine this ▸ of_mem_homDeg' ?_
      exact (Diagram.degree_comp deg p q).trans (congrArg₂ _ hp hq)
    | zero => rw [Limits.comp_zero]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _
