    | add y z _ _ hy hz => rw [Preadditive.comp_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hy hz
    | smul r y _ hy => rw [Linear.comp_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ r hy
  | zero => rw [Limits.zero_comp]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  | add y z _ _ hy hz => rw [Preadditive.add_comp]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hy hz
  | smul r y _ hy => rw [Linear.smul_comp]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ r hy

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.mapDomain_mem_homDeg
statement:
theorem mapDomain_mem_homDeg {a' b' : Obj S} (φ : (a ⟶ b) → (a' ⟶ b'))
    (hφ : ∀ g, Diagram.degree deg (φ g) = Diagram.degree deg g) {f : LinDiagram R a b} {d : A}
    (hf : f ∈ homDeg R deg a b d) :
    (Finsupp.mapDomain φ f : LinDiagram R a' b') ∈ homDeg R deg a' b' d
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [homDeg, Finsupp.mem_supported] at hf ⊢
  intro g hg
  obtain ⟨g', hg', rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp (Finsupp.mapDomain_support hg)
  show Diagram.degree deg (φ g') = d
  rw [hφ]; exact hf hg'

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.whisker_mem_homDeg
statement:
theorem whisker_mem_homDeg {f : LinDiagram R a b} {d : A} (hf : f ∈ homDeg R deg a b d)
    (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour) (hw : a.WhiskerOK u v) :
    whisker f u v hw ∈ homDeg R deg _ _ d
proof:
:=
  mapDomain_mem_homDeg _ (fun g => Diagram.degree_whisker deg g u v hw) hf

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.whisk_mem_homDeg
statement:
theorem whisk_mem_homDeg {f : LinDiagram R a b} {d : A} (hf : f ∈ homDeg R deg a b d)
    (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour) : whisk f u v ∈ homDeg R deg _ _ d
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : a.WhiskerOK u v
  · rw [whisk_of_ok _ h]; exact whisker_mem_homDeg hf u v h
  · rw [whisk_of_not_ok _ h]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.cast_mem_homDeg
proof:
:=
  mapDomain_mem_homDeg _ (fun g => Diagram.degree_cast deg g ha hb) hf

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.homogeneousComponent_apply
statement:
theorem homogeneousComponent_apply (d : A) (f : LinDiagram R a b) :
    homogeneousComponent deg d f = Finsupp.filter (fun g => Diagram.degree deg g = d) f

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.homogeneousComponent_mem
statement:
theorem homogeneousComponent_mem (d : A) (f : LinDiagram R a b) :
    homogeneousComponent deg d f ∈ homDeg R deg a b d
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [mem_homDeg_iff]
  intro g hg
  by_contra h
  exact hg (Finsupp.filter_apply_neg _ _ h)

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.homogeneousComponent_of_mem
statement:
theorem homogeneousComponent_of_mem {f : LinDiagram R a b} {d : A}
    (hf : f ∈ homDeg R deg a b d) : homogeneousComponent deg d f = f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [homogeneousComponent_apply, Finsupp.filter_eq_self_iff]
  exact (mem_homDeg_iff.mp hf)

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.homogeneousComponent_of_mem_of_ne
statement:
theorem homogeneousComponent_of_mem_of_ne {f : LinDiagram R a b} {d e : A}
    (hf : f ∈ homDeg R deg a b e) (h : e ≠ d) : homogeneousComponent deg d f = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [homogeneousComponent_apply, Finsupp.filter_eq_zero_iff]
  intro g hg
  by_contra h'
  exact h ((mem_homDeg_iff.mp hf g h').symm.trans hg)

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.sum_homogeneousComponent
statement:
theorem sum_homogeneousComponent [DecidableEq A] (f : LinDiagram R a b) :
    ∑ d ∈ (Finsupp.support f.toFinsupp).image (Diagram.degree deg),
      homogeneousComponent deg d f = f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine Finsupp.ext fun g => ?_
  erw [Finsupp.finsetSum_apply]
  simp only [homogeneousComponent_apply, Finsupp.filter_apply]
  by_cases hg : g ∈ Finsupp.support f.toFinsupp
  · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (Diagram.degree deg g)]
    · simp
    · intro d _ hd; simp [Ne.symm hd]
    · intro h; exact absurd (Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hg) h
  · rw [Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp hg]
    simp

name: StringDiagrams.InterchangeData.rel_mem_homDeg
StringDiagrams.Presentation.IsHomogeneous.allRel
statement:
theorem IsHomogeneous.allRel (hP : P.IsHomogeneous deg) (k : P.AllRel) :
    ∃ d, k.rel ∈ LinDiagram.homDeg R deg k.dom k.cod d
proof:
:= by
  cases k with
  | user i => exact hP i
  | interchange x hx => exact ⟨_, InterchangeData.rel_mem_homDeg deg R hx⟩

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.homogeneousComponent_comp_comp_mem_ideal
statement:
theorem homogeneousComponent_comp_comp_mem_ideal {a' b' : Obj S} {W : LinDiagram R a' b'}
    {e : A} (hW : W ∈ LinDiagram.homDeg R deg a' b' e) (hWI : W ∈ P.ideal a' b')
    (pre : LinDiagram R a a') (post : LinDiagram R b' b) (d : A) :
    LinDiagram.homogeneousComponent deg d (pre ≫ W ≫ post) ∈ P.ideal a b
proof:
:= by
  induction pre using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => erw [Limits.zero_comp, map_zero]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  | add f₁ f₂ h₁ h₂ =>
    erw [Preadditive.add_comp, map_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ h₁ h₂
  | single p r =>
    induction post using Finsupp.induction_linear with
    | zero => erw [Limits.comp_zero, Limits.comp_zero, map_zero]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _
    | add g₁ g₂ h₁ h₂ =>
      erw [Preadditive.comp_add, Preadditive.comp_add, map_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ h₁ h₂
    | single q s =>
      have hX := LinDiagram.comp_mem_homDeg (LinDiagram.single_mem_homDeg (deg := deg) p r)
        (LinDiagram.comp_mem_homDeg hW (LinDiagram.single_mem_homDeg (deg := deg) q s))
      have hXI : (Finsupp.single p r : LinDiagram R a a') ≫ W ≫
          (Finsupp.single q s : LinDiagram R b' b) ∈ P.ideal a b :=
        P.comp_mem_ideal _ (P.mem_ideal_comp hWI _)
      by_cases hd : Diagram.degree deg p + (e + Diagram.degree deg q) = d
      · have key := LinDiagram.homogeneousComponent_of_mem (hd ▸ hX)
        erw [key]; exact hXI
      · have key := LinDiagram.homogeneousComponent_of_mem_of_ne hX hd
        erw [key]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.homogeneousComponent_mem_ideal
statement:
theorem homogeneousComponent_mem_ideal (hP : P.IsHomogeneous deg) {f : LinDiagram R a b}
    (hf : f ∈ P.ideal a b) (d : A) : LinDiagram.homogeneousComponent deg d f ∈ P.ideal a b
proof:
:= by
  induction hf using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨k, u, v, hw, pre, post⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := hP.allRel k
    exact homogeneousComponent_comp_comp_mem_ideal (LinDiagram.whisker_mem_homDeg he u v hw)
      (P.whisker_rel_mem_ideal k u v hw) pre post d
  | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hx hy
  | smul r x _ hx => rw [map_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ r hx

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.linMap_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem linMap_apply (f : LinDiagram R a b) : P.linMap a b f = P.lin f

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.mem_homDeg_iff
statement:
theorem mem_homDeg_iff {x : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b} {d : A} :
    x ∈ P.homDeg deg a b d ↔ ∃ f ∈ LinDiagram.homDeg R deg a b d, P.lin f = x

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.lin_mem_homDeg
statement:
theorem lin_mem_homDeg {f : LinDiagram R a b} {d : A}
    (hf : f ∈ LinDiagram.homDeg R deg a b d) : P.lin f ∈ P.homDeg deg a b d

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.diag_mem_homDeg
statement: theorem diag_mem_homDeg (g : a ⟶ b) : P.diag g ∈ P.homDeg deg a b (Diagram.degree deg g)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.diag_mem_homDeg'
statement:
theorem diag_mem_homDeg' {g : a ⟶ b} {d : A} (h : Diagram.degree deg g = d) :
    P.diag g ∈ P.homDeg deg a b d

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.id_mem_homDeg
statement: theorem id_mem_homDeg (a : Obj S) : 𝟙 (P.obj a) ∈ P.homDeg deg a a 0

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.comp_mem_homDeg
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, hf', rfl⟩ := mem_homDeg_iff.mp hf
  obtain ⟨g, hg', rfl⟩ := mem_homDeg_iff.mp hg
  rw [← lin_comp]
  exact lin_mem_homDeg (LinDiagram.comp_mem_homDeg hf' hg')

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.whisk_mem_homDeg
statement:
theorem whisk_mem_homDeg {f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b} {d : A} (hf : f ∈ P.homDeg deg a b d)
    (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour) : P.whisk f u v ∈ P.homDeg deg _ _ d
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, hf', rfl⟩ := mem_homDeg_iff.mp hf
  rw [whisk_lin]
  exact lin_mem_homDeg (LinDiagram.whisk_mem_homDeg hf' u v)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.iSup_homDeg
statement: theorem iSup_homDeg (a b : Obj S) : ⨆ d, P.homDeg deg a b d = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_top_iff]
  rintro x -
  induction x using P.hom_induction with
  | diag g => exact Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem _ (P.diag_mem_homDeg g)
  | zero => exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  | add f g hf hg => exact Submodule.add_mem _ hf hg
  | smul r f hf => exact Submodule.smul_mem _ r hf

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.homogeneousComponent_lin
statement:
@[simp] theorem homogeneousComponent_lin (hP : P.IsHomogeneous deg) (d : A)
    (f : LinDiagram R a b) :
    homogeneousComponent hP d (P.lin f) = P.lin (LinDiagram.homogeneousComponent deg d f)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.homogeneousComponent_mem
statement:
theorem homogeneousComponent_mem (hP : P.IsHomogeneous deg) (d : A) (x : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b) :
    homogeneousComponent hP d x ∈ P.homDeg deg a b d
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := P.lin_surjective x
  rw [homogeneousComponent_lin]
  exact lin_mem_homDeg (LinDiagram.homogeneousComponent_mem d x)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.homogeneousComponent_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩ := mem_homDeg_iff.mp hx
  rw [homogeneousComponent_lin, LinDiagram.homogeneousComponent_of_mem hf]

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.homogeneousComponent_of_mem_of_ne
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩ := mem_homDeg_iff.mp hx
  rw [homogeneousComponent_lin, LinDiagram.homogeneousComponent_of_mem_of_ne hf h, lin_zero]

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.iSupIndep_homDeg
statement:
theorem iSupIndep_homDeg (hP : P.IsHomogeneous deg) (a b : Obj S) :
    iSupIndep (P.homDeg deg a b)
proof:
:= by
  intro d
  rw [Submodule.disjoint_def]
  intro x hx hx'
  have hker : (⨆ (e) (_ : e ≠ d), P.homDeg deg a b e) ≤
      LinearMap.ker (homogeneousComponent hP d) :=
    iSup₂_le fun e he y hy => homogeneousComponent_of_mem_of_ne hP hy he
  rw [← homogeneousComponent_of_mem hP hx]
  exact hker hx'

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.isInternal_homDeg
statement:
theorem isInternal_homDeg [DecidableEq A] (hP : P.IsHomogeneous deg) (a b : Obj S) :
    DirectSum.IsInternal (P.homDeg deg a b)
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.isInternal_submodule_of_iSupIndep_of_iSup_eq_top (iSupIndep_homDeg hP a b)
    (iSup_homDeg P deg a b)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.decompose_apply
statement:
theorem decompose_apply [DecidableEq A] (hP : P.IsHomogeneous deg) (x : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b)
    (d : A) :
    letI := decomposition hP a b
    (DirectSum.decompose (P.homDeg deg a b) x d : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b) =
      homogeneousComponent hP d x
proof:
:= by
  let := decomposition hP a b
  induction x using P.hom_induction with
  | diag g =>
    by_cases h : Diagram.degree deg g = d
    · rw [DirectSum.decompose_of_mem_same _ (h ▸ P.diag_mem_homDeg g),
        homogeneousComponent_of_mem hP (h ▸ P.diag_mem_homDeg g)]
    · rw [DirectSum.decompose_of_mem_ne _ (P.diag_mem_homDeg g) h,
        homogeneousComponent_of_mem_of_ne hP (P.diag_mem_homDeg g) h]
  | zero => simp
  | add f g hf hg =>
    rw [DirectSum.decompose_add, DirectSum.add_apply, Submodule.coe_add, hf, hg, map_add]
  | smul r f hf =>
    rw [DirectSum.decompose_smul, DirectSum.smul_apply, Submodule.coe_smul, hf, map_smul]

name: StringDiagrams.Obj.tensor_start
statement: @[simp] theorem tensor_start (u u' : Obj S) : (u.tensor u').start = u.start

name: StringDiagrams.Obj.tensor_word
statement: @[simp] theorem tensor_word (u u' : Obj S) : (u.tensor u').word = u.word ++ u'.word

name: StringDiagrams.Obj.whisker_whisker
statement:
theorem whisker_whisker (a u' u : Obj S) (v' v : List S.Colour) :
    (a.whisker u' v').whisker u v = a.whisker (u.tensor u') (v' ++ v)

name: StringDiagrams.Obj.WhiskerOK.trans
statement:
theorem WhiskerOK.trans {a u' u : Obj S} {v' v : List S.Colour} (h' : a.WhiskerOK u' v')
    (h : (a.whisker u' v').WhiskerOK u v) : a.WhiskerOK (u.tensor u') (v' ++ v)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hu', hue', hv'⟩ := h'
  obtain ⟨hu, hue, hv⟩ := h
  have hue₀ : S.endR u.start u.word = u'.start := hue
  have hue'₀ : S.endR u'.start u'.word = a.start := hue'
  have hend : (a.whisker u' v').endR = S.endR a.endR v' := by
    simp [endR, whisker, hue'₀]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [tensor, Signature.ok_append, hue₀]; exact ⟨hu, hu'⟩
  · simp [endR, tensor, hue₀, hue'₀]
  · rw [Signature.ok_append]; exact ⟨hv', hend ▸ hv⟩

name: StringDiagrams.Layer.whisker_whisker
statement:
theorem Layer.whisker_whisker (L : Layer S) (u' u : Obj S) (v' v : List S.Colour) :
    (L.whisker u' v').whisker u v = L.whisker (u.tensor u') (v' ++ v)

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.whisker_whisker
statement:
theorem whisker_whisker (f : a ⟶ b) (u' u : Obj S) (v' v : List S.Colour)
    (h' : a.WhiskerOK u' v') (h : (a.whisker u' v').WhiskerOK u v) :
    whisker (whisker f u' v' h') u v h =
      cast (whisker f (u.tensor u') (v' ++ v) (h'.trans h)) (Obj.whisker_whisker _ _ _ _ _).symm
        (Obj.whisker_whisker _ _ _ _ _).symm

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.whisker_cast
statement:
theorem whisker_cast {a' b' : Obj S} (f : a ⟶ b) (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b') (u : Obj S)
    (v : List S.Colour) (hw : a'.WhiskerOK u v) :
    whisker (cast f ha hb) u v hw =
      cast (whisker f u v (ha ▸ hw)) (by rw [ha]) (by rw [hb])

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.whisk_of_ok
statement:
theorem whisk_of_ok (f : LinDiagram R a b) {u : Obj S} {v : List S.Colour}
    (h : a.WhiskerOK u v) : whisk f u v = whisker f u v h

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.whisk_of_not_ok
statement:
theorem whisk_of_not_ok (f : LinDiagram R a b) {u : Obj S} {v : List S.Colour}
    (h : ¬ a.WhiskerOK u v) : whisk f u v = 0

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.whisk_add
statement:
theorem whisk_add (f g : LinDiagram R a b) (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour) :
    whisk (f + g) u v = whisk f u v + whisk g u v
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : a.WhiskerOK u v
  · simp only [whisk_of_ok _ h, whisker_add]
  · simp only [whisk_of_not_ok _ h, add_zero]

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.whisk_smul
statement:
theorem whisk_smul (r : R) (f : LinDiagram R a b) (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour) :
    whisk (r • f) u v = r • whisk f u v
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : a.WhiskerOK u v
  · simp only [whisk_of_ok _ h, whisker_smul]
  · simp only [whisk_of_not_ok _ h, smul_zero]

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.whisk_sub
statement:
theorem whisk_sub (f g : LinDiagram R a b) (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour) :
    whisk (f - g) u v = whisk f u v - whisk g u v
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : a.WhiskerOK u v
  · simp only [whisk_of_ok _ h, whisker_sub]
  · simp only [whisk_of_not_ok _ h, sub_zero]

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.whisk_zero
statement: theorem whisk_zero (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour) : whisk (0 : LinDiagram R a b) u v = 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa using whisk_smul (0 : R) (0 : LinDiagram R a b) u v

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.whiskerOK_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem whiskerOK_of_ne_zero {f : LinDiagram R a b} (hf : f ≠ 0) {u : Obj S}
    {v : List S.Colour} (h : a.WhiskerOK u v) : b.WhiskerOK u v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, -⟩ := Finsupp.ne_iff.mp hf
  exact (Diagram.chain d).whiskerOK h

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.whisker_comp
statement:
theorem whisker_comp (f : LinDiagram R a b) (g : LinDiagram R b c) (u : Obj S)
    (v : List S.Colour) (ha : a.WhiskerOK u v) (hb : b.WhiskerOK u v) :
    whisker (f ≫ g) u v ha = whisker f u v ha ≫ whisker g u v hb
proof:
:= by
  induction f using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => rw [Limits.zero_comp, whisker_zero, whisker_zero, Limits.zero_comp]
  | add f₁ f₂ h₁ h₂ => rw [Preadditive.add_comp, whisker_add, h₁, h₂, whisker_add,
      Preadditive.add_comp]
  | single d r =>
    induction g using Finsupp.induction_linear with
    | zero => rw [Limits.comp_zero, whisker_zero, whisker_zero, Limits.comp_zero]
    | add g₁ g₂ h₁ h₂ => rw [Preadditive.comp_add, whisker_add, h₁, h₂, whisker_add,
        Preadditive.comp_add]
    | single e s =>
      have h₁ := Free.single_comp_single R (Obj S) d e r s
      have h₂ := Free.single_comp_single R (Obj S) (Diagram.whisker d u v ha)
        (Diagram.whisker e u v hb) r s
      erw [h₁, whisker_single, whisker_single, whisker_single, h₂, Diagram.whisker_comp]
      rfl

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.whisk_comp
statement:
theorem whisk_comp (f : LinDiagram R a b) (g : LinDiagram R b c) (u : Obj S)
    (v : List S.Colour) : whisk (f ≫ g) u v = whisk f u v ≫ whisk g u v
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ha : a.WhiskerOK u v
  · by_cases hf : f = 0
    · subst hf; simp [whisk_zero]
    · have hb := whiskerOK_of_ne_zero hf ha
      rw [whisk_of_ok _ ha, whisk_of_ok _ ha, whisk_of_ok _ hb, whisker_comp _ _ _ _ ha hb]
  · rw [whisk_of_not_ok _ ha, whisk_of_not_ok _ ha, Limits.zero_comp]

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.whisk_id
statement:
theorem whisk_id (a : Obj S) (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour) (h : a.WhiskerOK u v) :
    whisk (𝟙 (Free.of R a)) u v = 𝟙 (Free.of R (a.whisker u v))

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.cast_eq_comp
statement:
theorem cast_eq_comp {a' b' : Obj S} (f : LinDiagram R a b) (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b') :
    cast f ha hb = eqToHom (by rw [ha]) ≫ f ≫ eqToHom (by rw [hb])

name: StringDiagrams.LinDiagram.whisker_whisker
statement:
theorem whisker_whisker (f : LinDiagram R a b) (u' u : Obj S) (v' v : List S.Colour)
    (h' : a.WhiskerOK u' v') (h : (a.whisker u' v').WhiskerOK u v) :
    whisker (whisker f u' v' h') u v h =
      cast (whisker f (u.tensor u') (v' ++ v) (h'.trans h)) (Obj.whisker_whisker _ _ _ _ _).symm
        (Obj.whisker_whisker _ _ _ _ _).symm
proof:
:= by
  simp only [whisker, cast]
  refine Finsupp.mapDomain_comp.symm.trans (Eq.trans ?_ Finsupp.mapDomain_comp)
  congr 1
  funext d
  exact Diagram.whisker_whisker d u' u v' v h' h

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.whisk_mem_ideal
statement:
theorem whisk_mem_ideal {a b : Obj S} {f : LinDiagram R a b} (hf : f ∈ P.ideal a b)
    (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour) : LinDiagram.whisk f u v ∈ P.ideal _ _
proof:
:= by
  induction hf using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨k, u', v', hw', pre, post⟩ := hx
    rw [LinDiagram.whisk_comp, LinDiagram.whisk_comp]
    by_cases hk : (k.dom.whisker u' v').WhiskerOK u v
    · rw [LinDiagram.whisk_of_ok _ hk, LinDiagram.whisker_whisker _ _ _ _ _ hw' hk,
        LinDiagram.cast_eq_comp]
      apply Submodule.subset_span
      have := IdealGen.intro (P := P) k (u.tensor u') (v' ++ v) (hw'.trans hk)
        (LinDiagram.whisk pre u v ≫ eqToHom (by rw [Obj.whisker_whisker]))
        (eqToHom (by rw [Obj.whisker_whisker]) ≫ LinDiagram.whisk post u v)
      simpa only [Category.assoc, Set.mem_ofPred_eq] using this
    · rw [LinDiagram.whisk_of_not_ok _ hk, Limits.zero_comp, Limits.comp_zero]
      exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  | zero => rw [LinDiagram.whisk_zero]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [LinDiagram.whisk_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hx hy
  | smul r x _ hx => rw [LinDiagram.whisk_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ r hx

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.whisk_lin
statement:
@[simp] theorem whisk_lin {a b : Obj S} (f : LinDiagram R a b) (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour) :
    P.whisk (P.lin f) u v = P.lin (LinDiagram.whisk f u v)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.whisk_diag
statement:
theorem whisk_diag {a b : Obj S} (f : a ⟶ b) (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour)
    (h : a.WhiskerOK u v) : P.whisk (P.diag f) u v = P.diag (Diagram.whisker f u v h)
proof:
:= by
  rw [diag, whisk_lin, LinDiagram.whisk_of_ok _ h, LinDiagram.whisker_of, lin_of]

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.lin_surjective
statement: theorem lin_surjective {a b : Obj S} (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b) : ∃ g, P.lin g = f

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.whisk_comp
statement:
theorem whisk_comp {a b c : Obj S} (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b) (g : P.obj b ⟶ P.obj c) (u : Obj S)
    (v : List S.Colour) : P.whisk (f ≫ g) u v = P.whisk f u v ≫ P.whisk g u v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, rfl⟩ := P.lin_surjective f
  obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := P.lin_surjective g
  rw [← lin_comp, whisk_lin, whisk_lin, whisk_lin, LinDiagram.whisk_comp, lin_comp]

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.whisk_id
statement:
theorem whisk_id (a : Obj S) (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour) (h : a.WhiskerOK u v) :
    P.whisk (𝟙 (P.obj a)) u v = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  rw [← lin_id, whisk_lin, LinDiagram.whisk_id a u v h, lin_id]

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.whisk_add
statement:
theorem whisk_add {a b : Obj S} (f g : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b) (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour) :
    P.whisk (f + g) u v = P.whisk f u v + P.whisk g u v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, rfl⟩ := P.lin_surjective f
  obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := P.lin_surjective g
  rw [← lin_add, whisk_lin, whisk_lin, whisk_lin, LinDiagram.whisk_add, lin_add]

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.whisk_smul
statement:
theorem whisk_smul {a b : Obj S} (r : R) (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b) (u : Obj S)
    (v : List S.Colour) : P.whisk (r • f) u v = r • P.whisk f u v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, rfl⟩ := P.lin_surjective f
  rw [← lin_smul, whisk_lin, whisk_lin, LinDiagram.whisk_smul, lin_smul]

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.whisk_sub
statement:
theorem whisk_sub {a b : Obj S} (f g : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b) (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour) :
    P.whisk (f - g) u v = P.whisk f u v - P.whisk g u v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, rfl⟩ := P.lin_surjective f
  obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := P.lin_surjective g
  rw [← lin_sub, whisk_lin, whisk_lin, whisk_lin, LinDiagram.whisk_sub, lin_sub]

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.whisk_zero
statement:
theorem whisk_zero {a b : Obj S} (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour) :
    P.whisk (0 : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b) u v = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← P.lin_zero, whisk_lin, LinDiagram.whisk_zero, lin_zero]

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.lin_eqToHom
statement:
@[simp] theorem lin_eqToHom {a b : Obj S} (h : a = b) :
    P.lin (eqToHom (congrArg (Free.of R) h)) = eqToHom (congrArg P.obj h)
proof:
:= by
  subst h; exact P.lin_id a

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.whisk_eqToHom
statement:
theorem whisk_eqToHom {a b : Obj S} (h : a = b) (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour)
    (hw : a.WhiskerOK u v) :
    P.whisk (eqToHom (congrArg P.obj h)) u v =
      eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (congrArg (Obj.whisker · u v) h))
proof:
:= by
  subst h; exact P.whisk_id a u v hw

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.whisk_whisk
statement:
theorem whisk_whisk {a b : Obj S} (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b) (u' u : Obj S) (v' v : List S.Colour)
    (h' : a.WhiskerOK u' v') (h : (a.whisker u' v').WhiskerOK u v) :
    P.whisk (P.whisk f u' v') u v =
      eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.whisker_whisker a u' u v' v)) ≫
        P.whisk f (u.tensor u') (v' ++ v) ≫
          eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.whisker_whisker b u' u v' v).symm)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, rfl⟩ := P.lin_surjective f
  rw [whisk_lin, whisk_lin, whisk_lin, LinDiagram.whisk_of_ok _ h', LinDiagram.whisk_of_ok _ h,
    LinDiagram.whisk_of_ok _ (h'.trans h), LinDiagram.whisker_whisker _ _ _ _ _ h' h,
    LinDiagram.cast_eq_comp, lin_comp, lin_comp, lin_eqToHom, lin_eqToHom]
  · exact (Obj.whisker_whisker _ _ _ _ _).symm
  · exact Obj.whisker_whisker _ _ _ _ _

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.Bicat.comp_def
statement:
theorem comp_def (f : x ⟶ y) (g : y ⟶ z) :
    f ≫ g = ((toHom f ≫ toHom g : P.obj x.obj ⟶ P.obj z.obj) : x ⟶ z)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.Bicat.id_def
statement: theorem id_def (x : l ⟶ m) : 𝟙 x = ((𝟙 (P.obj x.obj) : P.obj x.obj ⟶ P.obj x.obj) : x ⟶ x)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.Bicat.add_def
statement:
theorem add_def (f g : x ⟶ y) :
    f + g = ((toHom f + toHom g : P.obj x.obj ⟶ P.obj y.obj) : x ⟶ y)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.Bicat.sub_def
statement:
theorem sub_def (f g : x ⟶ y) :
    f - g = ((toHom f - toHom g : P.obj x.obj ⟶ P.obj y.obj) : x ⟶ y)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.Bicat.neg_def
statement: theorem neg_def (f : x ⟶ y) : -f = ((-toHom f : P.obj x.obj ⟶ P.obj y.obj) : x ⟶ y)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.Bicat.zero_def
statement: theorem zero_def : (0 : x ⟶ y) = ((0 : P.obj x.obj ⟶ P.obj y.obj) : x ⟶ y)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.Bicat.smul_def
statement:
theorem smul_def (r : R) (f : x ⟶ y) :
    r • f = ((r • toHom f : P.obj x.obj ⟶ P.obj y.obj) : x ⟶ y)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.Bicat.toHom_comp
statement: theorem toHom_comp (f : x ⟶ y) (g : y ⟶ z) : toHom (f ≫ g) = toHom f ≫ toHom g

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.Bicat.toHom_id
statement: theorem toHom_id (x : l ⟶ m) : toHom (𝟙 x) = 𝟙 (P.obj x.obj)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.Bicat.toHom_add
statement: theorem toHom_add (f g : x ⟶ y) : toHom (f + g) = toHom f + toHom g

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.Bicat.toHom_sub
statement: theorem toHom_sub (f g : x ⟶ y) : toHom (f - g) = toHom f - toHom g

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.Bicat.toHom_neg
statement: theorem toHom_neg (f : x ⟶ y) : toHom (-f) = -toHom f

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.Bicat.toHom_zero
statement: theorem toHom_zero : toHom (0 : x ⟶ y) = 0

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.Bicat.toHom_smul
statement: theorem toHom_smul (r : R) (f : x ⟶ y) : toHom (r • f) = r • toHom f

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.Bicat.toHom_eqToHom
statement:
theorem toHom_eqToHom (h : x = y) :
    toHom (eqToHom h) = eqToHom (congrArg (fun z : l ⟶ m => P.obj z.obj) h)

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.res_ext_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem res_ext_apply (i : ι) (x : M i) : Q.res i (Q.ext i x) = x

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.opList_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem opList_nil : Q.opList [] = LinearMap.id

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.opList_cons
statement:
@[simp] theorem opList_cons (L : Layer S) (ls : List (Layer S)) :
    Q.opList (L :: ls) = Q.opList ls ∘ₗ Q.op L

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.opList_append
statement:
@[simp] theorem opList_append (ls ms : List (Layer S)) :
    Q.opList (ls ++ ms) = Q.opList ms ∘ₗ Q.opList ls
proof:
:= by
  induction ls with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons L ls ih => rw [List.cons_append, opList_cons, ih, opList_cons, LinearMap.comp_assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.opList_singleton
statement: @[simp 1100] theorem opList_singleton (L : Layer S) : Q.opList [L] = Q.op L

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.opList_nil_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem opList_nil_apply (x : V) : Q.opList [] x = x

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.opList_cons_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem opList_cons_apply (L : Layer S) (ls : List (Layer S)) (x : V) :
    Q.opList (L :: ls) x = Q.opList ls (Q.op L x)

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.res_opList_ext_res
statement:
theorem res_opList_ext_res {a b : Obj S} {ls : List (Layer S)} (h : Chain a ls b) (x : V) :
    Q.res (Q.κ b) (Q.opList ls (Q.ext (Q.κ a) (Q.res (Q.κ a) x))) =
      Q.res (Q.κ b) (Q.opList ls x)
proof:
:= by
  induction ls generalizing a x with
  | nil =>
    cases h
    simp
  | cons L ls ih =>
    obtain ⟨hv, rfl, hc⟩ := h
    have hL := LinearMap.congr_fun (Q.res_op_ext_res L hv) x
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply] at hL
    simp only [opList_cons, LinearMap.comp_apply]
    rw [← ih hc, hL, ih hc]

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.functor_obj
statement: @[simp] theorem functor_obj (a : Obj S) : Q.functor.obj a = mod (M := M) (Q.κ a)

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.interp_obj
statement: @[simp] theorem interp_obj (a : Obj S) : Q.interp.obj a = mod (M := M) (Q.κ a)

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.interp_layer
statement:
@[simp] theorem interp_layer (L : Layer S) (hv : L.Valid) :
    Q.interp.layer L hv = ModuleCat.ofHom (Q.res (Q.κ L.cod) ∘ₗ Q.op L ∘ₗ Q.ext (Q.κ L.dom))

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.interp_mapChain_hom
statement:
theorem interp_mapChain_hom {a b : Obj S} (ls : List (Layer S)) (h : Chain a ls b) :
    (Q.interp.mapChain a ls b h).hom = Q.res (Q.κ b) ∘ₗ Q.opList ls ∘ₗ Q.ext (Q.κ a)
proof:
:= by
  induction ls generalizing a with
  | nil =>
    cases h
    refine LinearMap.ext fun x => ?_
    simp only [Interpretation.mapChain, eqToHom_refl, ModuleCat.hom_id, opList_nil,
      LinearMap.id_comp, LinearMap.id_apply]
    exact (Q.res_ext_apply _ x).symm
  | cons L ls ih =>
    obtain ⟨hv, rfl, hc⟩ := h
    refine LinearMap.ext fun x => ?_
    simp only [Interpretation.mapChain, eqToHom_refl, Category.id_comp, ModuleCat.hom_comp, ih hc,
      interp_layer, ModuleCat.hom_ofHom, LinearMap.comp_apply, opList_cons]
    exact Q.res_opList_ext_res hc _

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.functor_map_hom
statement:
theorem functor_map_hom {a b : Obj S} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (Q.functor.map f).hom = Q.res (Q.κ b) ∘ₗ Q.opList (Diagram.layers f) ∘ₗ Q.ext (Q.κ a)

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.functor_map_apply
statement:
theorem functor_map_apply {a b : Obj S} (f : a ⟶ b) (x : M (Q.κ a)) :
    (Q.functor.map f).hom x = Q.res (Q.κ b) (Q.opList (Diagram.layers f) (Q.ext (Q.κ a) x))

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.functor_map_transport
statement:
theorem functor_map_transport {a b : Obj S} {i j : ι} (f : a ⟶ b) (ha : Q.κ a = i)
    (hb : Q.κ b = j) :
    eqToHom (congrArg (mod (M := M)) ha.symm) ≫ Q.functor.map f ≫
        eqToHom (congrArg (mod (M := M)) hb) =
      ModuleCat.ofHom (Q.res j ∘ₗ Q.opList (Diagram.layers f) ∘ₗ Q.ext i)
proof:
:= by
  subst ha hb
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  simp only [eqToHom_refl, Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id, functor_map_hom,
    ModuleCat.hom_ofHom]

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.functor_map_layer_hom
statement:
theorem functor_map_layer_hom (L : Layer S) (hv : L.Valid) {a b : Obj S} (ha : L.dom = a)
    (hb : L.cod = b) :
    (Q.functor.map (Diagram.layer L hv ha hb)).hom =
      Q.res (Q.κ b) ∘ₗ Q.op L ∘ₗ Q.ext (Q.κ a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [functor_map_hom, Diagram.layers_layer, opList_cons, opList_nil, LinearMap.id_comp]

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.eval_single
statement:
@[simp] theorem eval_single (d : a ⟶ b) (r : R) :
    Q.eval i j (Finsupp.single d r : LinDiagram R a b) =
      r • (Q.res j ∘ₗ Q.opList (Diagram.layers d) ∘ₗ Q.ext i)

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.eval_of
statement:
@[simp] theorem eval_of (d : a ⟶ b) :
    Q.eval i j (LinDiagram.of d : LinDiagram R a b) =
      Q.res j ∘ₗ Q.opList (Diagram.layers d) ∘ₗ Q.ext i

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.eval_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem eval_zero : Q.eval i j (0 : LinDiagram R a b) = 0

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.eval_add
statement:
@[simp] theorem eval_add (X Y : LinDiagram R a b) :
    Q.eval i j (X + Y : LinDiagram R a b) = Q.eval i j X + Q.eval i j Y

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.eval_sub
statement:
@[simp] theorem eval_sub (X Y : LinDiagram R a b) :
    Q.eval i j (X - Y : LinDiagram R a b) = Q.eval i j X - Q.eval i j Y

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.eval_neg
statement:
@[simp] theorem eval_neg (X : LinDiagram R a b) :
    Q.eval i j (-X : LinDiagram R a b) = -Q.eval i j X

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.eval_smul
statement:
@[simp] theorem eval_smul (r : R) (X : LinDiagram R a b) :
    Q.eval i j (r • X : LinDiagram R a b) = r • Q.eval i j X

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.evalW_single
statement:
@[simp] theorem evalW_single (d : a ⟶ b) (r : R) :
    Q.evalW i j u v (Finsupp.single d r : LinDiagram R a b) =
      r • (Q.res j ∘ₗ Q.opList ((Diagram.layers d).map (·.whisker u v)) ∘ₗ Q.ext i)

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.evalW_of
statement:
@[simp] theorem evalW_of (d : a ⟶ b) :
    Q.evalW i j u v (LinDiagram.of d : LinDiagram R a b) =
      Q.res j ∘ₗ Q.opList ((Diagram.layers d).map (·.whisker u v)) ∘ₗ Q.ext i

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.evalW_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem evalW_zero : Q.evalW i j u v (0 : LinDiagram R a b) = 0

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.evalW_add
statement:
@[simp] theorem evalW_add (X Y : LinDiagram R a b) :
    Q.evalW i j u v (X + Y : LinDiagram R a b) = Q.evalW i j u v X + Q.evalW i j u v Y

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.evalW_sub
statement:
@[simp] theorem evalW_sub (X Y : LinDiagram R a b) :
    Q.evalW i j u v (X - Y : LinDiagram R a b) = Q.evalW i j u v X - Q.evalW i j u v Y

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.evalW_neg
statement:
@[simp] theorem evalW_neg (X : LinDiagram R a b) :
    Q.evalW i j u v (-X : LinDiagram R a b) = -Q.evalW i j u v X

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.evalW_smul
statement:
@[simp] theorem evalW_smul (r : R) (X : LinDiagram R a b) :
    Q.evalW i j u v (r • X : LinDiagram R a b) = r • Q.evalW i j u v X

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.eval_of_apply
statement:
theorem eval_of_apply (d : a ⟶ b) (x : M i) :
    Q.eval i j (LinDiagram.of d : LinDiagram R a b) x =
      Q.res j (Q.opList (Diagram.layers d) (Q.ext i x))

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.evalW_of_apply
statement:
theorem evalW_of_apply (d : a ⟶ b) (x : M i) :
    Q.evalW i j u v (LinDiagram.of d : LinDiagram R a b) x =
      Q.res j (Q.opList ((Diagram.layers d).map (·.whisker u v)) (Q.ext i x))

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.eval_whisker
statement:
theorem eval_whisker (X : LinDiagram R a b) (hw : a.WhiskerOK u v) :
    Q.eval i j (LinDiagram.whisker X u v hw) = Q.evalW i j u v X

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.freeLift_map_hom
statement:
theorem freeLift_map_hom {a b : Obj S} (X : LinDiagram R a b) :
    ((freeLift R Q.functor).map X).hom = Q.eval (Q.κ a) (Q.κ b) X
proof:
:= by
  induction X using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero =>
    rw [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_zero]
    exact (Q.eval_zero _ _).symm
  | add X Y hX hY =>
    rw [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_add, ModuleCat.hom_add, hX, hY]
    exact (Q.eval_add _ _ X Y).symm
  | single d r =>
    rw [freeLift_map_single, ModuleCat.hom_smul, eval_single]
    exact congrArg (r • ·) (Q.functor_map_hom d)

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.freeLift_map_whisker_hom
statement:
theorem freeLift_map_whisker_hom {a b : Obj S} (X : LinDiagram R a b) (u : Obj S)
    (v : List S.Colour) (hw : a.WhiskerOK u v) :
    ((freeLift R Q.functor).map (LinDiagram.whisker X u v hw)).hom =
      Q.evalW (Q.κ (a.whisker u v)) (Q.κ (b.whisker u v)) u v X

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.freeLift_map_eq_zero
statement:
theorem freeLift_map_eq_zero {a b : Obj S} {i j : ι} (ha : Q.κ a = i) (hb : Q.κ b = j)
    {X : LinDiagram R a b} (h : Q.eval i j X = 0) : (freeLift R Q.functor).map X = 0
proof:
:= by
  subst ha hb
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  rw [freeLift_map_hom, h]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.freeLift_map_whisker_eq_zero
StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.respects_of
statement:
theorem respects_of
    (hrel : ∀ (r : P.Rel) (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour), (P.dom r).WhiskerOK u v →
      Q.evalW (Q.κ ((P.dom r).whisker u v)) (Q.κ ((P.cod r).whisker u v)) u v (P.rel r) = 0)
    (hint : ∀ (x : InterchangeData S) (hx : x.Valid) (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour),
      x.dom.WhiskerOK u v →
      Q.evalW (Q.κ (x.dom.whisker u v)) (Q.κ (x.cod.whisker u v)) u v
        (InterchangeData.rel R hx) = 0) :
    P.Respects Q.functor where
  rel r u v hw
proof:
:= Q.freeLift_map_whisker_eq_zero rfl rfl hw (hrel r u v hw)
  interchange x hx u v hw := Q.freeLift_map_whisker_eq_zero rfl rfl hw (hint x hx u v hw)

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.evalW_interchange
statement:
theorem evalW_interchange (x : InterchangeData S) (hx : x.Valid) (u : Obj S)
    (v : List S.Colour) (i j : ι) :
    Q.evalW i j u v (InterchangeData.rel R hx) =
      Q.res j ∘ₗ Q.op ⟨u.start, u.word ++ (S.cod x.g ++ x.mid), x.h, v⟩ ∘ₗ
          Q.op ⟨u.start, u.word, x.g, x.mid ++ (S.dom x.h ++ v)⟩ ∘ₗ Q.ext i -
        ((x.sign : ℤ) : R) •
          (Q.res j ∘ₗ Q.op ⟨u.start, u.word, x.g, x.mid ++ (S.cod x.h ++ v)⟩ ∘ₗ
            Q.op ⟨u.start, u.word ++ (S.dom x.g ++ x.mid), x.h, v⟩ ∘ₗ Q.ext i)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [InterchangeData.rel, evalW_sub, evalW_smul, evalW_of, InterchangeData.ghDiagram,
    InterchangeData.hgDiagram, Diagram.layers_mk, List.map_cons, List.map_nil, opList_cons,
    opList_nil, LinearMap.id_comp, LinearMap.comp_assoc, InterchangeData.gh₁,
    InterchangeData.gh₂, InterchangeData.hg₁, InterchangeData.hg₂, Layer.whisker,
    List.append_nil, List.nil_append, List.append_assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.evalW_interchange_eq_zero
statement:
theorem evalW_interchange_eq_zero
    (hcomm : ∀ (s : S.Region) (l m r : List S.Colour) (g g' : S.Gen),
      Q.res (Q.κ ⟨s, l ++ (S.cod g ++ (m ++ (S.cod g' ++ r)))⟩) ∘ₗ
          Q.op ⟨s, l ++ (S.cod g ++ m), g', r⟩ ∘ₗ Q.op ⟨s, l, g, m ++ (S.dom g' ++ r)⟩ ∘ₗ
          Q.ext (Q.κ ⟨s, l ++ (S.dom g ++ (m ++ (S.dom g' ++ r)))⟩) =
        (((⟨s, g, m, g'⟩ : InterchangeData S).sign : ℤ) : R) •
          (Q.res (Q.κ ⟨s, l ++ (S.cod g ++ (m ++ (S.cod g' ++ r)))⟩) ∘ₗ
            Q.op ⟨s, l, g, m ++ (S.cod g' ++ r)⟩ ∘ₗ Q.op ⟨s, l ++ (S.dom g ++ m), g', r⟩ ∘ₗ
            Q.ext (Q.κ ⟨s, l ++ (S.dom g ++ (m ++ (S.dom g' ++ r)))⟩)))
    (x : InterchangeData S) (hx : x.Valid) (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour) :
    Q.evalW (Q.κ (x.dom.whisker u v)) (Q.κ (x.cod.whisker u v)) u v
      (InterchangeData.rel R hx) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hd : x.dom.whisker u v =
      ⟨u.start, u.word ++ (S.dom x.g ++ (x.mid ++ (S.dom x.h ++ v)))⟩ := by
    simp [InterchangeData.dom, Obj.whisker]
  have hc : x.cod.whisker u v =
      ⟨u.start, u.word ++ (S.cod x.g ++ (x.mid ++ (S.cod x.h ++ v)))⟩ := by
    simp [InterchangeData.cod, Obj.whisker]
  rw [hd, hc, evalW_interchange, hcomm u.start u.word x.mid v x.g x.h, sub_eq_zero]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.evalW_interchange_eq_zero_of_comm
statement:
theorem evalW_interchange_eq_zero_of_comm
    (hcomm : ∀ (s : S.Region) (l m r : List S.Colour) (g g' : S.Gen),
      Q.op ⟨s, l ++ (S.cod g ++ m), g', r⟩ ∘ₗ Q.op ⟨s, l, g, m ++ (S.dom g' ++ r)⟩ =
        (((⟨s, g, m, g'⟩ : InterchangeData S).sign : ℤ) : R) •
          (Q.op ⟨s, l, g, m ++ (S.cod g' ++ r)⟩ ∘ₗ Q.op ⟨s, l ++ (S.dom g ++ m), g', r⟩))
    (x : InterchangeData S) (hx : x.Valid) (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour) :
    Q.evalW (Q.κ (x.dom.whisker u v)) (Q.κ (x.cod.whisker u v)) u v
      (InterchangeData.rel R hx) = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine Q.evalW_interchange_eq_zero (fun s l m r g g' => LinearMap.ext fun y => ?_) x hx u v
  have h := congrArg (Q.res (Q.κ ⟨s, l ++ (S.cod g ++ (m ++ (S.cod g' ++ r)))⟩))
    (LinearMap.congr_fun (hcomm s l m r g g')
      (Q.ext (Q.κ ⟨s, l ++ (S.dom g ++ (m ++ (S.dom g' ++ r)))⟩) y))
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, map_smul] at h ⊢
  exact h

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.uniform_ext
statement: @[simp] theorem uniform_ext (i : Unit) : (uniform op).ext i = LinearMap.id

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.uniform_res
statement: @[simp] theorem uniform_res (i : Unit) : (uniform op).res i = LinearMap.id

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.uniform_op
statement: @[simp] theorem uniform_op (L : Layer S) : (uniform op).op L = op L

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.uniform_functor_map_hom
statement:
theorem uniform_functor_map_hom {a b : Obj S} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    ((uniform op).functor.map f).hom = (uniform op).opList (Diagram.layers f)

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.uniform_opList_cons
statement:
@[simp] theorem uniform_opList_cons (L : Layer S) (ls : List (Layer S)) :
    (uniform op).opList (L :: ls) = (uniform op).opList ls ∘ₗ op L

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.uniform_opList_singleton
statement:
@[simp 1100] theorem uniform_opList_singleton (L : Layer S) :
    (uniform op).opList [L] = op L

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.uniform_opList_cons_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem uniform_opList_cons_apply (L : Layer S) (ls : List (Layer S)) (x : V) :
    (uniform op).opList (L :: ls) x = (uniform op).opList ls (op L x)

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.uniform_eval_of
statement:
@[simp] theorem uniform_eval_of (i j : Unit) {a b : Obj S} (d : a ⟶ b) :
    (uniform op).eval i j (LinDiagram.of d : LinDiagram R a b) =
      (uniform op).opList (Diagram.layers d)

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.uniform_evalW_of
statement:
@[simp] theorem uniform_evalW_of (i j : Unit) (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour) {a b : Obj S}
    (d : a ⟶ b) :
    (uniform op).evalW i j u v (LinDiagram.of d : LinDiagram R a b) =
      (uniform op).opList ((Diagram.layers d).map (·.whisker u v))
proof:
:=
  (uniform op).evalW_of i j u v d

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.uniform_eval_of_apply
statement:
theorem uniform_eval_of_apply (i j : Unit) {a b : Obj S} (d : a ⟶ b) (x : V) :
    (uniform op).eval i j (LinDiagram.of d : LinDiagram R a b) x =
      (uniform op).opList (Diagram.layers d) x

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.uniform_evalW_of_apply
statement:
theorem uniform_evalW_of_apply (i j : Unit) (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour) {a b : Obj S}
    (d : a ⟶ b) (x : V) :
    (uniform op).evalW i j u v (LinDiagram.of d : LinDiagram R a b) x =
      (uniform op).opList ((Diagram.layers d).map (·.whisker u v)) x

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.piList_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem piList_nil (i : ι) : piList A i [] = 1

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.piList_cons
statement:
@[simp] theorem piList_cons (i : ι) (L : Layer S) (ls : List (Layer S)) :
    piList A i (L :: ls) = piList A i ls * A L i

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.piList_singleton
statement: @[simp 1100] theorem piList_singleton (i : ι) (L : Layer S) : piList A i [L] = A L i

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.pi_op_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem pi_op_apply (L : Layer S) (F : ∀ i, M i) (i : ι) :
    (pi κ A hκ).op L F i = A L i (F i)

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.pi_res_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem pi_res_apply (i : ι) (F : ∀ i, M i) : (pi κ A hκ).res i F = F i

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.pi_ext_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem pi_ext_apply (i : ι) (x : M i) : (pi κ A hκ).ext i x = Pi.single i x

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.pi_opList_apply
statement:
theorem pi_opList_apply (ls : List (Layer S)) (F : ∀ i, M i) (i : ι) :
    (pi κ A hκ).opList ls F i = piList A i ls (F i)
proof:
:= by
  induction ls generalizing F with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons L ls ih => simp [ih, Module.End.mul_apply]

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.pi_res_opList_ext
statement:
theorem pi_res_opList_ext (i : ι) (ls : List (Layer S)) :
    (pi κ A hκ).res i ∘ₗ (pi κ A hκ).opList ls ∘ₗ (pi κ A hκ).ext i = piList A i ls
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine LinearMap.ext fun x => ?_
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, pi_res_apply, pi_opList_apply]
  congr 1
  exact Pi.single_eq_same (M := M) i x

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.pi_functor_map_transport
statement:
theorem pi_functor_map_transport {a b : Obj S} {i : ι} (f : a ⟶ b) (ha : κ a = i)
    (hb : κ b = i) :
    eqToHom (congrArg (mod (M := M)) ha.symm) ≫ (pi κ A hκ).functor.map f ≫
        eqToHom (congrArg (mod (M := M)) hb) =
      ModuleCat.ofHom (piList A i (Diagram.layers f))
proof:
:= by
  rw [(pi κ A hκ).functor_map_transport f ha hb, pi_res_opList_ext]

name: StringDiagrams.LocalInterpretation.pi_evalW_of
statement:
theorem pi_evalW_of (i : ι) (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour) {a b : Obj S} (d : a ⟶ b) :
    (pi κ A hκ).evalW i i u v (LinDiagram.of d : LinDiagram R a b) =
      piList A i ((Diagram.layers d).map (·.whisker u v))

name: StringDiagrams.freeLift_map_hom_apply
proof:
:= by
  rw [freeLift_map]
  change (ModuleCat.homLinearEquiv (S := R) (X.sum fun d r => r • F.map d)) x = _
  rw [map_finsuppSum, Finsupp.sum, Finsupp.sum, LinearMap.sum_apply]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.freeLift_map_sub_smul_hom_apply
statement:
theorem freeLift_map_sub_smul_hom_apply (F : Obj S ⥤ ModuleCat.{w₂} R) {a b : Obj S}
    (d₁ d₂ : a ⟶ b) (c : R) (x : F.obj a) :
    ((freeLift R F).map (LinDiagram.of d₁ - c • LinDiagram.of d₂ : LinDiagram R a b)).hom x =
      (F.map d₁).hom x - c • (F.map d₂).hom x
proof:
:= by
  rw [Functor.map_sub, Functor.map_smul, freeLift_map_of, freeLift_map_of, ModuleCat.hom_sub,
    ModuleCat.hom_smul, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.freeLift_map_whisker_sub_smul_hom_apply
statement:
theorem freeLift_map_whisker_sub_smul_hom_apply (F : Obj S ⥤ ModuleCat.{w₂} R) {a b : Obj S}
    (d₁ d₂ : a ⟶ b) (c : R) (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour) (hw : a.WhiskerOK u v)
    (x : F.obj (a.whisker u v)) :
    ((freeLift R F).map (LinDiagram.whisker
        (LinDiagram.of d₁ - c • LinDiagram.of d₂ : LinDiagram R a b) u v hw)).hom x =
      (F.map (Diagram.whisker d₁ u v hw)).hom x - c • (F.map (Diagram.whisker d₂ u v hw)).hom x
proof:
:= by
  rw [freeLift_map_whisker_sub_smul, ModuleCat.hom_sub, ModuleCat.hom_smul,
    LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.int_smul_eq_zsmul
statement:
theorem int_smul_eq_zsmul (P : Presentation S ℤ) (n : ℤ) (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b) :
    @HSMul.hSMul ℤ _ _ (@instHSMul _ _ (@SMulZeroClass.toSMul _ _ _
      (@DistribSMul.toSMulZeroClass _ _ _ (@DistribMulAction.toDistribSMul _ _ _ _
        (@Module.toDistribMulAction _ _ _ _ (P.instLinear.homModule (P.obj a) (P.obj b)))))))
      n f = n • f

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.hom_induction_int
proof:
:= by
  refine P.hom_induction diag zero add (fun n g hg => ?_) f
  rw [P.int_smul_eq_zsmul]
  have hn : ∀ k : ℕ, p ((k : ℤ) • g) := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => rw [Nat.cast_zero, zero_smul]; exact zero
    | succ k ih => rw [Nat.cast_succ, add_smul, one_smul]; exact add _ _ ih hg
  obtain ⟨k, rfl | rfl⟩ := Int.eq_nat_or_neg n
  · exact hn k
  · rw [neg_smul]; exact neg _ (hn k)

name: StringDiagrams.Interpretation.mapChain_append
statement:
theorem mapChain_append {a b c : Obj S} {ls ms : List (Layer S)} (h₁ : Chain a ls b)
    (h₂ : Chain b ms c) :
    I.mapChain a (ls ++ ms) c (h₁.append h₂) = I.mapChain a ls b h₁ ≫ I.mapChain b ms c h₂
proof:
:= by
  induction ls generalizing a with
  | nil => cases h₁; simp [mapChain]
  | cons L ls ih => simp only [List.cons_append, mapChain, Category.assoc, ← ih]

name: StringDiagrams.Interpretation.functor_obj
statement: @[simp] theorem functor_obj (a : Obj S) : I.functor.obj a = I.obj a

name: StringDiagrams.Interpretation.functor_map
statement:
theorem functor_map (f : a ⟶ b) :
    I.functor.map f = I.mapChain a (Diagram.layers f) b (Diagram.chain f)

name: StringDiagrams.Interpretation.functor_map_layer
statement:
@[simp] theorem functor_map_layer (L : Layer S) (hv : L.Valid) {a b : Obj S} (ha : L.dom = a)
    (hb : L.cod = b) :
    I.functor.map (Diagram.layer L hv ha hb) =
      eqToHom (congrArg I.obj ha.symm) ≫ I.layer L hv ≫ eqToHom (congrArg I.obj hb)

name: StringDiagrams.Interpretation.functor_map_ofLayer
statement:
theorem functor_map_ofLayer (L : Layer S) (hv : L.Valid) :
    I.functor.map (Diagram.ofLayer L hv) = I.layer L hv
proof:
:= by
  show eqToHom (congrArg I.obj rfl) ≫ I.layer L hv ≫ eqToHom (congrArg I.obj rfl) = _
  simp

name: StringDiagrams.Interpretation.functor_map_mk_cons
statement:
theorem functor_map_mk_cons {a b : Obj S} (L : Layer S) (ls : List (Layer S))
    (h : Chain a (L :: ls) b) :
    I.functor.map (Diagram.mk (L :: ls) h) =
      eqToHom (congrArg I.obj h.2.1.symm) ≫ I.layer L h.1 ≫
        I.functor.map (Diagram.mk ls h.2.2)

name: StringDiagrams.Interpretation.functor_map_mk_nil
statement:
theorem functor_map_mk_nil {a b : Obj S} (h : Chain a [] b) :
    I.functor.map (Diagram.mk [] h) = eqToHom (congrArg I.obj h)

name: StringDiagrams.freeLift_obj
statement:
@[simp] theorem freeLift_obj (F : Obj S ⥤ D) (a : Free R (Obj S)) :
    (freeLift R F).obj a = F.obj a

name: StringDiagrams.freeLift_map
statement:
theorem freeLift_map (F : Obj S ⥤ D) {a b : Free R (Obj S)} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (freeLift R F).map f = f.sum fun f' r => r • F.map f'

name: StringDiagrams.freeLift_map_single
statement:
theorem freeLift_map_single (F : Obj S ⥤ D) {a b : Obj S} (f : a ⟶ b) (r : R) :
    (freeLift R F).map (Finsupp.single f r : LinDiagram R a b) = r • F.map f

name: StringDiagrams.freeLift_map_of
statement:
@[simp] theorem freeLift_map_of (F : Obj S ⥤ D) {a b : Obj S} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (freeLift R F).map (LinDiagram.of f : LinDiagram R a b) = F.map f

name: StringDiagrams.freeLift_map_whisker_single
statement:
theorem freeLift_map_whisker_single (F : Obj S ⥤ D) {a b : Obj S} (f : a ⟶ b) (r : R)
    (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour) (hw : a.WhiskerOK u v) :
    (freeLift R F).map (LinDiagram.whisker (Finsupp.single f r : LinDiagram R a b) u v hw) =
      r • F.map (Diagram.whisker f u v hw)
proof:
:= by
  rw [LinDiagram.whisker_single]; exact freeLift_map_single F _ r

name: StringDiagrams.freeLift_map_whisker_of
statement:
@[simp] theorem freeLift_map_whisker_of (F : Obj S ⥤ D) {a b : Obj S} (f : a ⟶ b) (u : Obj S)
    (v : List S.Colour) (hw : a.WhiskerOK u v) :
    (freeLift R F).map (LinDiagram.whisker (LinDiagram.of f : LinDiagram R a b) u v hw) =
      F.map (Diagram.whisker f u v hw)

name: StringDiagrams.freeLift_map_whisker_sub_smul
statement:
theorem freeLift_map_whisker_sub_smul (F : Obj S ⥤ D) {a b : Obj S} (d₁ d₂ : a ⟶ b) (c : R)
    (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour) (hw : a.WhiskerOK u v) :
    (freeLift R F).map (LinDiagram.whisker
        (LinDiagram.of d₁ - c • LinDiagram.of d₂ : LinDiagram R a b) u v hw) =
      F.map (Diagram.whisker d₁ u v hw) - c • F.map (Diagram.whisker d₂ u v hw)
proof:
:= by
  rw [LinDiagram.whisker_sub, LinDiagram.whisker_smul, Functor.map_sub, Functor.map_smul,
    freeLift_map_whisker_of, freeLift_map_whisker_of]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.freeLift_map_whisker_sub
statement:
theorem freeLift_map_whisker_sub (F : Obj S ⥤ D) {a b : Obj S} (d₁ d₂ : a ⟶ b)
    (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour) (hw : a.WhiskerOK u v) :
    (freeLift R F).map (LinDiagram.whisker
        (LinDiagram.of d₁ - LinDiagram.of d₂ : LinDiagram R a b) u v hw) =
      F.map (Diagram.whisker d₁ u v hw) - F.map (Diagram.whisker d₂ u v hw)
proof:
:= by
  rw [LinDiagram.whisker_sub, Functor.map_sub, freeLift_map_whisker_of, freeLift_map_whisker_of]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.Respects.allRel
statement:
theorem Respects.allRel (hF : P.Respects F) (k : P.AllRel) (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour)
    (hw : k.dom.WhiskerOK u v) : (freeLift R F).map (LinDiagram.whisker k.rel u v hw) = 0
proof:
:= by
  cases k with
  | user i => exact hF.rel i u v hw
  | interchange x hx => exact hF.interchange x hx u v hw

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.Respects.map_eq_zero
statement:
theorem Respects.map_eq_zero (hF : P.Respects F) {a b : Obj S} {f : LinDiagram R a b}
    (hf : f ∈ P.ideal a b) : (freeLift R F).map f = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction hf using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨k, u, v, hw, pre, post⟩ := hx
    rw [Functor.map_comp, Functor.map_comp, hF.allRel k u v hw, Limits.zero_comp, Limits.comp_zero]
  | zero => exact Functor.map_zero _ _ _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [Functor.map_add, hx, hy, add_zero]
  | smul r x _ hx => rw [Functor.map_smul, hx, smul_zero]

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.lift_obj
statement: @[simp] theorem lift_obj (hF : P.Respects F) (a : Obj S) : (P.lift hF).obj (P.obj a) = F.obj a

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.lift_lin
statement:
@[simp] theorem lift_lin (hF : P.Respects F) {a b : Obj S} (f : LinDiagram R a b) :
    (P.lift hF).map (P.lin f) = (freeLift R F).map f

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.lift_diag
statement:
@[simp] theorem lift_diag (hF : P.Respects F) {a b : Obj S} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (P.lift hF).map (P.diag f) = F.map f

name: StringDiagrams.Layer.wr_gen
statement: @[simp] theorem wr_gen (L : Layer S) (v : List S.Colour) : (L.wr v).gen = L.gen

name: StringDiagrams.Layer.wl_gen
statement: @[simp] theorem wl_gen (w : Obj S) (L : Layer S) : (L.wl w).gen = L.gen

name: StringDiagrams.Layer.wr_dom
statement: theorem wr_dom (L : Layer S) (b : Obj S) : (L.wr b.word).dom = L.dom.tensor b

name: StringDiagrams.Layer.wr_cod
statement: theorem wr_cod (L : Layer S) (b : Obj S) : (L.wr b.word).cod = L.cod.tensor b

name: StringDiagrams.Layer.wl_dom
statement: theorem wl_dom (a : Obj S) (L : Layer S) : (L.wl a).dom = a.tensor L.dom

name: StringDiagrams.Layer.wl_cod
statement: theorem wl_cod (a : Obj S) (L : Layer S) : (L.wl a).cod = a.tensor L.cod

name: StringDiagrams.Chain.wr
statement:
theorem Chain.wr [Subsingleton S.Region] {a a' : Obj S} {ls : List (Layer S)} (h : Chain a ls a') (b : Obj S) :
    Chain (a.tensor b) (ls.map (·.wr b.word)) (a'.tensor b)
proof:
:= by
  induction ls generalizing a with
  | nil => cases h; rfl
  | cons L ls ih =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl, hc⟩ := h
    exact ⟨Layer.valid_of_subsingleton _, L.wr_dom b, by rw [L.wr_cod]; exact ih hc⟩

name: StringDiagrams.Chain.wl
statement:
theorem Chain.wl [Subsingleton S.Region] {b b' : Obj S} {ls : List (Layer S)} (h : Chain b ls b') (a : Obj S) :
    Chain (a.tensor b) (ls.map (·.wl a)) (a.tensor b')
proof:
:= by
  induction ls generalizing b with
  | nil => cases h; rfl
  | cons L ls ih =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl, hc⟩ := h
    exact ⟨Layer.valid_of_subsingleton _, L.wl_dom a, by rw [L.wl_cod]; exact ih hc⟩

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.layers_whiskerR
statement:
@[simp] theorem layers_whiskerR [Subsingleton S.Region] (f : a ⟶ a') (b : Obj S) :
    layers (whiskerR f b) = (layers f).map (·.wr b.word)

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.layers_whiskerL
statement:
@[simp] theorem layers_whiskerL [Subsingleton S.Region] (a : Obj S) (g : b ⟶ b') :
    layers (whiskerL a g) = (layers g).map (·.wl a)

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.whiskerR_comp
statement:
theorem whiskerR_comp [Subsingleton S.Region] (f : a ⟶ a') (f' : a' ⟶ a'') (b : Obj S) :
    whiskerR (f ≫ f') b = whiskerR f b ≫ whiskerR f' b

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.whiskerL_comp
statement:
theorem whiskerL_comp [Subsingleton S.Region] (a : Obj S) (g : b ⟶ b') (g' : b' ⟶ b'') :
    whiskerL a (g ≫ g') = whiskerL a g ≫ whiskerL a g'

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.oddCountList_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem oddCountList_nil : oddCountList ([] : List (Layer S)) = 0

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.oddCountList_cons
statement:
theorem oddCountList_cons (L : Layer S) (ls : List (Layer S)) :
    oddCountList (L :: ls) = oddCountList [L] + oddCountList ls
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : S.odd L.gen <;> simp [oddCountList, h, add_comm]

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.oddCountList_map_wr
statement:
@[simp] theorem oddCountList_map_wr (ls : List (Layer S)) (v : List S.Colour) :
    oddCountList (ls.map (·.wr v)) = oddCountList ls

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.oddCountList_map_wl
statement:
@[simp] theorem oddCountList_map_wl (ls : List (Layer S)) (w : Obj S) :
    oddCountList (ls.map (·.wl w)) = oddCountList ls

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.diag_mk_congr
statement:
theorem diag_mk_congr {a b : Obj S} {ls ms : List (Layer S)} (h : ls = ms) (hl : Chain a ls b)
    (hm : Chain a ms b) : P.diag (Diagram.mk ls hl) = P.diag (Diagram.mk ms hm)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.diag_swap_layers
statement:
theorem diag_swap_layers (L M : Layer S) :
    P.diag (whiskerR (ofLayer L (Layer.valid_of_subsingleton L)) M.dom ≫
        whiskerL L.cod (ofLayer M (Layer.valid_of_subsingleton M))) =
      ((-1 : ℤ) ^ (oddCountList [L] * oddCountList [M])) •
        P.diag (whiskerL L.dom (ofLayer M (Layer.valid_of_subsingleton M)) ≫
          whiskerR (ofLayer L (Layer.valid_of_subsingleton L)) M.cod)
proof:
:= by
  let x : InterchangeData S := ⟨L.start, L.gen, L.right ++ M.left, M.gen⟩
  have hx : x.Valid := InterchangeData.valid_of_subsingleton x
  let u : Obj S := ⟨L.start, L.left⟩
  have hw : x.dom.WhiskerOK u M.right := Obj.whiskerOK_of_subsingleton _ _ _
  have ha : x.dom.whisker u M.right = L.dom.tensor M.dom := by
    simp [x, u, InterchangeData.dom, Obj.whisker, Obj.tensor, Layer.dom]
  have hb : x.cod.whisker u M.right = L.cod.tensor M.cod := by
    simp [x, u, InterchangeData.cod, Obj.whisker, Obj.tensor, Layer.cod]
  have key := P.diag_interchange x hx u M.right hw ha hb
  have hs : ((x.sign : ℤ) : R) = (((-1 : ℤ) ^ (oddCountList [L] * oddCountList [M]) : ℤ) : R) := by
    congr 1
    by_cases hL : S.odd L.gen <;> by_cases hM : S.odd M.gen <;>
      simp [x, InterchangeData.sign, oddCountList, hL, hM]
  rw [hs, Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul] at key
  refine Eq.trans (P.diag_eq_of_layers_eq ?_) (key.trans (congrArg _ (P.diag_eq_of_layers_eq ?_)))
  all_goals simp only [Diagram.layers_comp, layers_whiskerR, layers_whiskerL, Diagram.layers_cast,
    layers_whisker, layers_ofLayer]
  all_goals simp [x, u, InterchangeData.ghDiagram, InterchangeData.hgDiagram, InterchangeData.gh₁,
      InterchangeData.gh₂, InterchangeData.hg₁, InterchangeData.hg₂, Layer.whisker, Layer.wr,
      Layer.wl, Layer.dom, Layer.cod]

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.diag_swap_layer_right
statement:
theorem diag_swap_layer_right (f : a ⟶ a') (M : Layer S) :
    P.diag (whiskerR f M.dom ≫ whiskerL a' (ofLayer M (Layer.valid_of_subsingleton M))) =
      ((-1 : ℤ) ^ (oddCount f * oddCountList [M])) •
        P.diag (whiskerL a (ofLayer M (Layer.valid_of_subsingleton M)) ≫ whiskerR f M.cod)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ls, h⟩ := f
  induction ls generalizing a with
  | nil =>
    cases h
    simp only [oddCount, Diagram.layers, oddCountList_nil, zero_mul, pow_zero, one_smul]
    apply P.diag_eq_of_layers_eq
    simp only [layers_comp, layers_whiskerR, layers_whiskerL, layers_ofLayer]
    rfl
  | cons L ls ih =>
    obtain ⟨hv, rfl, hc⟩ := h
    have e₁ : (⟨L :: ls, hv, rfl, hc⟩ : L.dom ⟶ a') = ofLayer L hv ≫ (⟨ls, hc⟩ : L.cod ⟶ a') := by
      ext; rfl
    have hodd : oddCount (⟨L :: ls, hv, rfl, hc⟩ : L.dom ⟶ a') =
        oddCountList [L] + oddCount (⟨ls, hc⟩ : L.cod ⟶ a') := oddCountList_cons L ls
    rw [hodd, e₁, whiskerR_comp, whiskerR_comp, Category.assoc, P.diag_comp, ih hc,
      Linear.comp_smul, ← P.diag_comp, ← Category.assoc, P.diag_comp (_ ≫ _),
      P.diag_swap_layers, Linear.smul_comp, smul_smul, ← P.diag_comp, Category.assoc,
      add_mul, pow_add, mul_comm]

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.diag_interchange_diagrams
statement:
theorem diag_interchange_diagrams (f : a ⟶ a') (g : b ⟶ b') :
    P.diag (whiskerR f b ≫ whiskerL a' g) =
      ((-1 : ℤ) ^ (oddCount f * oddCount g)) • P.diag (whiskerL a g ≫ whiskerR f b')
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ms, h⟩ := g
  induction ms generalizing b with
  | nil =>
    cases h
    simp only [oddCount, Diagram.layers, oddCountList_nil, mul_zero, pow_zero, one_smul]
    apply P.diag_eq_of_layers_eq
    simp only [layers_comp, layers_whiskerR, layers_whiskerL]
    show _ ++ [] = [] ++ _
    simp
  | cons M ms ih =>
    obtain ⟨hv, rfl, hc⟩ := h
    have e₁ : (⟨M :: ms, hv, rfl, hc⟩ : M.dom ⟶ b') = ofLayer M hv ≫ (⟨ms, hc⟩ : M.cod ⟶ b') := by
      ext; rfl
    have hodd : oddCount (⟨M :: ms, hv, rfl, hc⟩ : M.dom ⟶ b') =
        oddCountList [M] + oddCount (⟨ms, hc⟩ : M.cod ⟶ b') := oddCountList_cons M ms
    rw [hodd, e₁, whiskerL_comp, whiskerL_comp, ← Category.assoc, P.diag_comp (_ ≫ _),
      P.diag_swap_layer_right, Linear.smul_comp, P.diag_comp (whiskerL a _) (whiskerR f M.cod),
      Category.assoc, ← P.diag_comp (whiskerR f M.cod), ih hc, Linear.comp_smul, smul_smul,
      ← P.diag_comp, mul_add, pow_add, Category.assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.WordRw.swap_cons
statement:
theorem swap_cons {α : Type*} [Semigroup α] {a b : α} (h : a * b = b * a) (t : α) :
    a * (b * t) = b * (a * t)

name: StringDiagrams.OpLayerMap.chain
statement:
theorem chain {a b : Obj S} {ls : List (Layer S)} (h : Chain a ls b) :
    Chain (φ.obj b) (ls.map φ.layer).reverse (φ.obj a)
proof:
:= by
  induction ls generalizing a with
  | nil => exact (congrArg φ.obj h).symm
  | cons L ls ih =>
    obtain ⟨hv, rfl, hc⟩ := h
    rw [List.map_cons, List.reverse_cons]
    exact (ih hc).append ⟨φ.valid hv, φ.dom_eq hv, φ.cod_eq hv⟩

name: StringDiagrams.OpLayerMap.layers_map
statement:
@[simp] theorem layers_map {a b : Obj S} (d : a ⟶ b) :
    Diagram.layers (φ.map d) = ((Diagram.layers d).map φ.layer).reverse

name: StringDiagrams.OpLayerMap.map_id
statement: @[simp] theorem map_id (a : Obj S) : φ.map (𝟙 a) = 𝟙 (φ.obj a)

name: StringDiagrams.OpLayerMap.map_comp
statement:
@[simp] theorem map_comp {a b c : Obj S} (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) :
    φ.map (f ≫ g) = φ.map g ≫ φ.map f

name: StringDiagrams.OpLayerMap.map_cast
statement:
theorem map_cast {a b a' b' : Obj S} (d : a ⟶ b) (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b') :
    φ.map (Diagram.cast d ha hb) =
      Diagram.cast (φ.map d) (congrArg φ.obj hb) (congrArg φ.obj ha)

name: StringDiagrams.OpLayerMap.map_eqToHom
statement:
theorem map_eqToHom {a b : Obj S} (h : a = b) :
    φ.map (eqToHom h) = eqToHom (congrArg φ.obj h.symm)

name: StringDiagrams.OpLayerMap.map_ofLayer
statement:
theorem map_ofLayer (L : Layer S) (hv : L.Valid) :
    φ.map (Diagram.ofLayer L hv) =
      Diagram.layer (φ.layer L) (φ.valid hv) (φ.dom_eq hv) (φ.cod_eq hv)

name: StringDiagrams.OpLayerMap.comp_map
statement:
theorem comp_map {S'' : Signature.{u₀, u₁, u₂}} (ψ : OpLayerMap S' S'') {a b : Obj S}
    (d : a ⟶ b) : (φ.comp ψ).map d = ψ.map (φ.map d)

name: StringDiagrams.OpLayerMap.lin_of
statement:
@[simp] theorem lin_of {a b : Obj S} (d : a ⟶ b) :
    φ.lin (LinDiagram.of d : LinDiagram R a b) = LinDiagram.of (φ.map d)

name: StringDiagrams.OpLayerMap.linMap_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem linMap_apply {a b : Obj S} (f : LinDiagram R a b) :
    φ.linMap a b f = φ.lin f

name: StringDiagrams.OpLayerMap.lin_add
statement: theorem lin_add {a b : Obj S} (f g : LinDiagram R a b) : φ.lin (f + g) = φ.lin f + φ.lin g

name: StringDiagrams.OpLayerMap.lin_sub
statement: theorem lin_sub {a b : Obj S} (f g : LinDiagram R a b) : φ.lin (f - g) = φ.lin f - φ.lin g

name: StringDiagrams.OpLayerMap.lin_smul
statement: theorem lin_smul {a b : Obj S} (r : R) (f : LinDiagram R a b) : φ.lin (r • f) = r • φ.lin f

name: StringDiagrams.OpLayerMap.lin_zero
statement: theorem lin_zero {a b : Obj S} : φ.lin (0 : LinDiagram R a b) = 0

name: StringDiagrams.OpLayerMap.lin_comp
statement:
theorem lin_comp {a b c : Obj S} (f : LinDiagram R a b) (g : LinDiagram R b c) :
    φ.lin (f ≫ g) = φ.lin g ≫ φ.lin f
proof:
:= by
  induction f using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => rw [Limits.zero_comp, lin_zero, lin_zero, Limits.comp_zero]
  | add f₁ f₂ h₁ h₂ =>
    rw [Preadditive.add_comp, lin_add, lin_add, h₁, h₂, Preadditive.comp_add]
  | single d r =>
    induction g using Finsupp.induction_linear with
    | zero => rw [Limits.comp_zero, lin_zero, lin_zero, Limits.zero_comp]
    | add g₁ g₂ h₁ h₂ =>
      rw [Preadditive.comp_add, lin_add, lin_add, h₁, h₂, Preadditive.add_comp]
    | single e s =>
      erw [Free.single_comp_single]
      rw [lin, lin, lin, Finsupp.mapDomain_single, Finsupp.mapDomain_single,
        Finsupp.mapDomain_single, map_comp]
      erw [Free.single_comp_single]
      rw [mul_comm]

name: StringDiagrams.OpLayerMap.toPresented_obj
statement:
@[simp] theorem toPresented_obj (a : Obj S) :
    (φ.toPresented Q χ).obj a = op (Q.obj (φ.obj a))

name: StringDiagrams.OpLayerMap.toPresented_map
statement:
@[simp] theorem toPresented_map {a b : Obj S} (d : a ⟶ b) :
    (φ.toPresented Q χ).map d = (Diagram.weight χ d • Q.diag (φ.map d)).op

name: StringDiagrams.OpLayerMap.unop_smul_hom
statement: theorem unop_smul_hom {X Y : Q.Presentedᵒᵖ} (r : R) (f : X ⟶ Y) : (r • f).unop = r • f.unop

name: StringDiagrams.OpLayerMap.op_smul_hom
statement: theorem op_smul_hom {X Y : Q.Presented} (r : R) (f : X ⟶ Y) : (r • f).op = r • f.op

name: StringDiagrams.OpLayerMap.unop_sub_hom
statement: theorem unop_sub_hom {X Y : Q.Presentedᵒᵖ} (f g : X ⟶ Y) : (f - g).unop = f.unop - g.unop

name: StringDiagrams.OpLayerMap.freeLift_toPresented_of
statement:
theorem freeLift_toPresented_of {a b : Obj S} (d : a ⟶ b) :
    (freeLift R (φ.toPresented Q χ)).map (LinDiagram.of d : LinDiagram R a b) =
      (Diagram.weight χ d • Q.diag (φ.map d)).op

name: StringDiagrams.OpLayerMap.freeLift_toPresented_one
statement:
theorem freeLift_toPresented_one {a b : Obj S} (f : LinDiagram R a b) :
    (freeLift R (φ.toPresented Q fun _ => 1)).map f = (Q.lin (φ.lin f)).op
proof:
:= by
  induction f using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => rw [Functor.map_zero, lin, Finsupp.mapDomain_zero, Q.lin_zero]; rfl
  | add f g hf hg =>
    rw [Functor.map_add, hf, hg, lin_add, Q.lin_add]; rfl
  | single d r =>
    rw [freeLift_map_single, lin, Finsupp.mapDomain_single, Q.lin_single, toPresented_map,
      Diagram.weight_one, one_smul]
    rfl

name: StringDiagrams.OpLayerMap.WhiskerData.map_whisker
statement:
theorem map_whisker {i : ι} {a b : Obj S} (d : a ⟶ b) (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour)
    (ha : W.Admissible a) (hw : a.WhiskerOK u v) :
    (φ i).map (Diagram.whisker d u v hw) =
      Diagram.cast (Diagram.whisker ((φ (W.idx i a u v)).map d) (W.left i a u v)
          (W.right i a u v) (W.whiskerOK ha hw ⟨d⟩))
        (W.obj_whisker ha hw ⟨d⟩) (W.obj_whisker ha hw ⟨𝟙 a⟩)
proof:
:= by
  apply Diagram.ext
  simp only [layers_map, Diagram.layers_whisker, Diagram.layers_cast, List.map_map,
    List.map_reverse]
  congr 1
  refine List.map_congr_left fun L hL => ?_
  exact W.layer_whisker ha hw ((Diagram.chain d).valid_of_mem hL)
    ((Diagram.chain d).nonempty_of_mem hL)

name: StringDiagrams.OpLayerMap.WhiskerData.toPresented_map_whisker
statement:
theorem toPresented_map_whisker {i : ι} {a b : Obj S} (d : a ⟶ b) (u : Obj S)
    (v : List S.Colour) (ha : W.Admissible a) (hw : a.WhiskerOK u v) :
    ((φ i).toPresented Q χ).map (Diagram.whisker d u v hw) =
      (eqToHom (congrArg Q.obj (W.obj_whisker ha hw ⟨d⟩).symm) ≫
        Q.whisk (((φ (W.idx i a u v)).toPresented Q χ).map d).unop (W.left i a u v)
          (W.right i a u v) ≫
        eqToHom (congrArg Q.obj (W.obj_whisker ha hw ⟨𝟙 a⟩))).op
proof:
:= by
  rw [toPresented_map, toPresented_map, W.map_whisker _ _ _ ha, Diagram.weight_whisker, Q.diag_cast,
    Quiver.Hom.unop_op, Q.whisk_smul, Q.whisk_diag _ _ _ (W.whiskerOK ha hw ⟨d⟩),
    Linear.smul_comp, Linear.comp_smul]

name: StringDiagrams.OpLayerMap.WhiskerData.freeLift_whisker_eq_zero
statement:
theorem freeLift_whisker_eq_zero {i : ι} {a b : Obj S} (f : LinDiagram R a b) (u : Obj S)
    (v : List S.Colour) (ha : W.Admissible a) (hw : a.WhiskerOK u v)
    (hf : (freeLift R ((φ (W.idx i a u v)).toPresented Q χ)).map f = 0) :
    (freeLift R ((φ i).toPresented Q χ)).map (LinDiagram.whisker f u v hw) = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h0 : f = 0
  · subst h0
    rw [show LinDiagram.whisker (0 : LinDiagram R a b) u v hw = 0 from Finsupp.mapDomain_zero,
      Functor.map_zero]
  obtain ⟨d₀, -⟩ := Finsupp.ne_iff.mp h0
  have ea := congrArg Q.obj (W.obj_whisker (i := i) ha hw ⟨𝟙 a⟩)
  have eb := congrArg Q.obj (W.obj_whisker (i := i) ha hw ⟨d₀⟩).symm
  let T : (op (Q.obj ((φ (W.idx i a u v)).obj a)) ⟶ op (Q.obj ((φ (W.idx i a u v)).obj b)))
      →ₗ[R] (op (Q.obj ((φ i).obj (a.whisker u v))) ⟶ op (Q.obj ((φ i).obj (b.whisker u v)))) :=
    { toFun := fun x =>
        (eqToHom eb ≫ Q.whisk x.unop (W.left i a u v) (W.right i a u v) ≫ eqToHom ea).op
      map_add' := fun x y => by
        simp only [unop_add, Q.whisk_add, Preadditive.add_comp, Preadditive.comp_add, op_add]
      map_smul' := fun r x => by
        simp only [unop_smul_hom, Q.whisk_smul, Linear.smul_comp, Linear.comp_smul,
          RingHom.id_apply, op_smul_hom] }
  have := freeLift_map_mapDomain (F := (φ (W.idx i a u v)).toPresented Q χ)
    (G := (φ i).toPresented Q χ) (fun d => Diagram.whisker d u v hw) T
    (fun d => W.toPresented_map_whisker Q χ d u v ha hw) f
  exact this.trans (by rw [hf, map_zero])

name: StringDiagrams.OpLayerMap.respects
statement:
theorem respects {φ : ι → OpLayerMap S S'} (W : WhiskerData φ)
    (hadm : ∀ r, W.Admissible (P.dom r))
    (hrel : ∀ i r, (freeLift R ((φ i).toPresented Q χ)).map (P.rel r) = 0)
    (hint : ∀ i (x : InterchangeData S) (hx : x.Valid),
      (freeLift R ((φ i).toPresented Q χ)).map (InterchangeData.rel R hx) = 0) (i : ι) :
    P.Respects ((φ i).toPresented Q χ)
proof:
:=
  P.respects_of_whisker_on (fun i => (φ i).toPresented Q χ) W.Admissible hadm
    (fun _ => W.admissible_interchange)
    (fun _ _ _ f u v ha hw hf => W.freeLift_whisker_eq_zero Q χ f u v ha hw (hf _)) hrel hint i

name: StringDiagrams.OpLayerMap.lift_obj
statement:
@[simp] theorem lift_obj (a : Obj S) :
    (lift P W hadm hrel hint i).obj (P.obj a) = op (Q.obj ((φ i).obj a))

name: StringDiagrams.OpLayerMap.lift_diag
statement:
@[simp] theorem lift_diag {a b : Obj S} (d : a ⟶ b) :
    (lift P W hadm hrel hint i).map (P.diag d) = (Diagram.weight χ d • Q.diag ((φ i).map d)).op

name: StringDiagrams.OpLayerMap.lift_lin
statement:
theorem lift_lin {a b : Obj S} (f : LinDiagram R a b) :
    (lift P W hadm hrel hint i).map (P.lin f) = (freeLift R ((φ i).toPresented Q χ)).map f

name: StringDiagrams.OpLayerMap.lift_whisk
statement:
theorem lift_whisk {a b : Obj S} (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b) {u : Obj S} {v : List S.Colour}
    (ha : W.Admissible a) (hw : a.WhiskerOK u v) (hb : Nonempty (a ⟶ b)) :
    ((lift P W hadm hrel hint i).map (P.whisk f u v)).unop =
      eqToHom (congrArg Q.obj (W.obj_whisker ha hw hb).symm) ≫
        Q.whisk ((lift P W hadm hrel hint (W.idx i a u v)).map f).unop (W.left i a u v)
          (W.right i a u v) ≫
        eqToHom (congrArg Q.obj (W.obj_whisker ha hw ⟨𝟙 a⟩))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, rfl⟩ := P.lin_surjective f
  rw [Presentation.whisk_lin, LinDiagram.whisk_of_ok _ hw, lift_lin, lift_lin]
  have := freeLift_map_mapDomain (F := (φ (W.idx i a u v)).toPresented Q χ)
    (G := (φ i).toPresented Q χ) (fun d => Diagram.whisker d u v hw)
    { toFun := fun x => (eqToHom (congrArg Q.obj (W.obj_whisker ha hw hb).symm) ≫
        Q.whisk x.unop (W.left i a u v) (W.right i a u v) ≫
          eqToHom (congrArg Q.obj (W.obj_whisker ha hw ⟨𝟙 a⟩))).op
      map_add' := fun x y => by
        simp only [unop_add, Q.whisk_add, Preadditive.add_comp, Preadditive.comp_add, op_add]
      map_smul' := fun r x => by
        simp only [unop_smul_hom, Q.whisk_smul, Linear.smul_comp, Linear.comp_smul,
          RingHom.id_apply, op_smul_hom] }
    (fun d => W.toPresented_map_whisker Q χ d u v ha hw) f
  exact congrArg Quiver.Hom.unop this

name: StringDiagrams.OpLayerMap.toPresented_interchange_reflect
statement:
theorem toPresented_interchange_reflect {x : InterchangeData S} (hx : x.Valid)
    (x' : InterchangeData S') (h₁ : φ.layer x.gh₂ = x'.hg₁) (h₂ : φ.layer x.gh₁ = x'.hg₂)
    (h₃ : φ.layer x.hg₂ = x'.gh₁) (h₄ : φ.layer x.hg₁ = x'.gh₂) (hs : x'.sign = x.sign) :
    (freeLift R (φ.toPresented Q χ)).map (InterchangeData.rel R hx) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hx' : x'.Valid :=
    ⟨h₃ ▸ φ.valid hx.hg₂, h₄ ▸ φ.valid hx.hg₁, h₁ ▸ φ.valid hx.gh₂, h₂ ▸ φ.valid hx.gh₁⟩
  have ha : φ.obj x.cod = x'.dom := by
    rw [← x.gh₂_cod, ← φ.dom_eq hx.gh₂, h₁, x'.hg₁_dom]
  have hb : φ.obj x.dom = x'.cod := by
    rw [← x.gh₁_dom, ← φ.cod_eq hx.gh₁, h₂, x'.hg₂_cod]
  have e₁ := Q.diag_eq_of_layers_eq' (φ.map (InterchangeData.ghDiagram hx))
    (InterchangeData.hgDiagram hx') ha hb (by simp [InterchangeData.ghDiagram,
      InterchangeData.hgDiagram, h₁, h₂])
  have e₂ := Q.diag_eq_of_layers_eq' (φ.map (InterchangeData.hgDiagram hx))
    (InterchangeData.ghDiagram hx') ha hb (by simp [InterchangeData.ghDiagram,
      InterchangeData.hgDiagram, h₃, h₄])
  apply Quiver.Hom.unop_inj
  rw [InterchangeData.rel, Functor.map_sub, Functor.map_smul, freeLift_toPresented_of,
    freeLift_toPresented_of, e₁, e₂, Q.diag_ghDiagram hx', hs, InterchangeData.weight_hg]
  simp only [unop_sub_hom, unop_smul_hom, Quiver.Hom.unop_op, Limits.unop_zero, Linear.smul_comp,
    Linear.comp_smul, smul_smul, x.sign_cast_mul_self_assoc, sub_self]

name: StringDiagrams.OpLayerMap.toPresented_interchange_rotate
statement:
theorem toPresented_interchange_rotate {x : InterchangeData S} (hx : x.Valid)
    (x' : InterchangeData S') (h₁ : φ.layer x.gh₂ = x'.gh₁) (h₂ : φ.layer x.gh₁ = x'.gh₂)
    (h₃ : φ.layer x.hg₂ = x'.hg₁) (h₄ : φ.layer x.hg₁ = x'.hg₂) (hs : x'.sign = x.sign) :
    (freeLift R (φ.toPresented Q χ)).map (InterchangeData.rel R hx) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hx' : x'.Valid :=
    ⟨h₁ ▸ φ.valid hx.gh₂, h₂ ▸ φ.valid hx.gh₁, h₃ ▸ φ.valid hx.hg₂, h₄ ▸ φ.valid hx.hg₁⟩
  have ha : φ.obj x.cod = x'.dom := by
    rw [← x.gh₂_cod, ← φ.dom_eq hx.gh₂, h₁, x'.gh₁_dom]
  have hb : φ.obj x.dom = x'.cod := by
    rw [← x.gh₁_dom, ← φ.cod_eq hx.gh₁, h₂, x'.gh₂_cod]
  have e₁ := Q.diag_eq_of_layers_eq' (φ.map (InterchangeData.ghDiagram hx))
    (InterchangeData.ghDiagram hx') ha hb (by simp [InterchangeData.ghDiagram, h₁, h₂])
  have e₂ := Q.diag_eq_of_layers_eq' (φ.map (InterchangeData.hgDiagram hx))
    (InterchangeData.hgDiagram hx') ha hb (by simp [InterchangeData.hgDiagram, h₃, h₄])
  apply Quiver.Hom.unop_inj
  rw [InterchangeData.rel, Functor.map_sub, Functor.map_smul, freeLift_toPresented_of,
    freeLift_toPresented_of, e₁, e₂, Q.diag_ghDiagram hx', hs, InterchangeData.weight_hg]
  simp only [unop_sub_hom, unop_smul_hom, Quiver.Hom.unop_op, Limits.unop_zero, Linear.smul_comp,
    Linear.comp_smul, smul_comm (Diagram.weight χ _), sub_self]

name: StringDiagrams.OpLayerMap.PreservesDeg.degree_map
statement:
theorem PreservesDeg.degree_map (h : φ.PreservesDeg deg deg') {a b : Obj S} (d : a ⟶ b) :
    Diagram.degree deg' (φ.map d) = Diagram.degree deg d
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Diagram.degree, layers_map, List.map_reverse, List.sum_reverse, List.map_map]
  congr 1
  exact List.map_congr_left fun L hL => h ((Diagram.chain d).valid_of_mem hL)

name: StringDiagrams.OpLayerMap.preservesDeg_parityDeg
statement:
theorem preservesDeg_parityDeg
    (h : ∀ {L : Layer S}, L.Valid → S'.odd (φ.layer L).gen = S.odd L.gen) :
    φ.PreservesDeg (Presentation.parityDeg S) (Presentation.parityDeg S')
proof:
:= fun hv => by
  simp only [Presentation.parityDeg, h hv]

name: StringDiagrams.OpLayerMap.PreservesDeg.toPresented_mem_homDeg
proof:
:= by
  rw [LinDiagram.homDeg, Finsupp.supported_eq_span_single] at hf
  induction hf using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨d, hd, rfl⟩ := hy
    rw [freeLift_map_single, toPresented_map, unop_smul_hom, Quiver.Hom.unop_op, smul_smul]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Presentation.diag_mem_homDeg' ((h.degree_map d).trans hd))
  | zero => rw [Functor.map_zero, Limits.unop_zero]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  | add y z _ _ hy hz => rw [Functor.map_add, unop_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hy hz
  | smul r y _ hy => rw [Functor.map_smul, unop_smul_hom]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ r hy

name: StringDiagrams.OpLayerMap.lift_mem_homDeg
statement:
theorem lift_mem_homDeg {P : Presentation.{w, v} S R} {φ : ι → OpLayerMap S S'}
    (W : WhiskerData φ) (hadm : ∀ r, W.Admissible (P.dom r))
    (hrel : ∀ i r, (freeLift R ((φ i).toPresented Q χ)).map (P.rel r) = 0)
    (hint : ∀ i (x : InterchangeData S) (hx : x.Valid),
      (freeLift R ((φ i).toPresented Q χ)).map (InterchangeData.rel R hx) = 0) (i : ι)
    (h : (φ i).PreservesDeg deg deg') {a b : Obj S} {x : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b} {e : A}
    (hx : x ∈ P.homDeg deg a b e) :
    ((lift P W hadm hrel hint i).map x).unop ∈ Q.homDeg deg' ((φ i).obj b) ((φ i).obj a) e
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩ := Presentation.mem_homDeg_iff.mp hx
  rw [lift_lin]
  exact h.toPresented_mem_homDeg Q χ hf

name: StringDiagrams.Chain.valid_of_mem
statement:
theorem Chain.valid_of_mem {a b : Obj S} {ls : List (Layer S)} (h : Chain a ls b) {L : Layer S}
    (hL : L ∈ ls) : L.Valid
proof:
:= by
  induction ls generalizing a with
  | nil => cases hL
  | cons M ls ih =>
    obtain ⟨hv, rfl, hc⟩ := h
    rcases List.mem_cons.1 hL with rfl | hL
    · exact hv
    · exact ih hc hL

name: StringDiagrams.Chain.nonempty_of_mem
statement:
theorem Chain.nonempty_of_mem {a b : Obj S} {ls : List (Layer S)} (h : Chain a ls b)
    {L : Layer S} (hL : L ∈ ls) : Nonempty (a ⟶ L.dom)
proof:
:= by
  induction ls generalizing a with
  | nil => cases hL
  | cons M ls ih =>
    obtain ⟨hv, rfl, hc⟩ := h
    rcases List.mem_cons.1 hL with rfl | hL
    · exact ⟨𝟙 _⟩
    · obtain ⟨d⟩ := ih hc hL
      exact ⟨Diagram.ofLayer M hv ≫ d⟩

name: StringDiagrams.Layer.Valid.nonempty_cod
statement:
theorem Layer.Valid.nonempty_cod {a : Obj S} {L : Layer S} (hv : L.Valid)
    (h : Nonempty (a ⟶ L.dom)) : Nonempty (a ⟶ L.cod)
proof:
:=
  h.map fun d => d ≫ Diagram.ofLayer L hv

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.weightList_nil

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.weightList_cons

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.weightList_map
statement:
theorem weightList_map {S' : Signature.{u₀', u₁', u₂'}} (χ' : S'.Gen → R) (f : Layer S → Layer S')

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.weight_comp
statement:
@[simp] theorem weight_comp (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) :

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.weight_eqToHom
statement: @[simp] theorem weight_eqToHom (h : a = b) : weight χ (eqToHom h) = 1

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.weight_cast
statement:
@[simp] theorem weight_cast {a' b' : Obj S} (f : a ⟶ b) (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b') :

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.weight_whisker

@[simp] theorem weight_whisker (f : a ⟶ b) (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour)

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.weight_ofLayer

@[simp] theorem weight_ofLayer (L : Layer S) (hv : L.Valid) :
