name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.weight_one
statement: @[simp] theorem weight_one (f : a ⟶ b) : weight (fun _ => (1 : R)) f = 1

name: StringDiagrams.freeLift_map_mapDomain
statement:
theorem freeLift_map_mapDomain {S₁ : Signature.{u₀', u₁', u₂'}} {F : Obj S ⥤ D}
    {G : Obj S₁ ⥤ D} {a b : Obj S} {a₁ b₁ : Obj S₁} (τ : (a ⟶ b) → (a₁ ⟶ b₁))
    (T : (F.obj a ⟶ F.obj b) →ₗ[R] (G.obj a₁ ⟶ G.obj b₁)) (h : ∀ d, G.map (τ d) = T (F.map d))
    (f : LinDiagram R a b) :
    (freeLift R G).map (Finsupp.mapDomain τ f : LinDiagram R a₁ b₁) =
      T ((freeLift R F).map f)
proof:
:= by
  induction f using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero =>
    rw [Finsupp.mapDomain_zero]
    exact ((freeLift R G).map_zero _ _).trans (by rw [Functor.map_zero, map_zero])
  | add f g hf hg =>
    rw [Finsupp.mapDomain_add]
    exact ((freeLift R G).map_add).trans (by rw [hf, hg, Functor.map_add, map_add])
  | single d r =>
    rw [Finsupp.mapDomain_single, freeLift_map_single, freeLift_map_single, h, map_smul]

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.respects_of_whisker
statement:
theorem respects_of_whisker {ι : Sort*} (F : ι → Obj S ⥤ D)
    (hwhisk : ∀ (i : ι) {a b : Obj S} (f : LinDiagram R a b) (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour)
      (hw : a.WhiskerOK u v), (∀ j, (freeLift R (F j)).map f = 0) →
        (freeLift R (F i)).map (LinDiagram.whisker f u v hw) = 0)
    (hrel : ∀ i r, (freeLift R (F i)).map (P.rel r) = 0)
    (hint : ∀ i (x : InterchangeData S) (hx : x.Valid),
      (freeLift R (F i)).map (InterchangeData.rel R hx) = 0) (i : ι) : P.Respects (F i) where
  rel r u v hw
proof:
:= hwhisk i _ u v hw fun j => hrel j r
  interchange x hx u v hw := hwhisk i _ u v hw fun j => hint j x hx

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.wfDom_of_subsingleton
statement: theorem wfDom_of_subsingleton [Subsingleton S.Region] : P.WFDom

name: StringDiagrams.InterchangeData.Valid.wf_dom
statement:
theorem _root_.StringDiagrams.InterchangeData.Valid.wf_dom {x : InterchangeData S}
    (hx : x.Valid) : x.dom.WF

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.respects_of_whisker_on
statement:
theorem respects_of_whisker_on {ι : Sort*} (F : ι → Obj S ⥤ D) (A : Obj S → Prop)
    (hA : ∀ r, A (P.dom r)) (hAx : ∀ x : InterchangeData S, x.Valid → A x.dom)
    (hwhisk : ∀ (i : ι) {a b : Obj S} (f : LinDiagram R a b) (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour),
      A a → ∀ (hw : a.WhiskerOK u v), (∀ j, (freeLift R (F j)).map f = 0) →
        (freeLift R (F i)).map (LinDiagram.whisker f u v hw) = 0)
    (hrel : ∀ i r, (freeLift R (F i)).map (P.rel r) = 0)
    (hint : ∀ i (x : InterchangeData S) (hx : x.Valid),
      (freeLift R (F i)).map (InterchangeData.rel R hx) = 0) (i : ι) : P.Respects (F i) where
  rel r u v hw
proof:
:= hwhisk i _ u v (hA r) hw fun j => hrel j r
  interchange x hx u v hw := hwhisk i _ u v (hAx x hx) hw fun j => hint j x hx

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.diag_ghDiagram
statement:
theorem Presentation.diag_ghDiagram (P : Presentation.{w, v} S R) {x : InterchangeData S}
    (hx : x.Valid) :
    P.diag (InterchangeData.ghDiagram hx) =
      ((x.sign : ℤ) : R) • P.diag (InterchangeData.hgDiagram hx)
proof:
:= by
  have hw : x.dom.WhiskerOK ⟨x.start, []⟩ [] := ⟨trivial, rfl, trivial⟩
  have ha : x.dom.whisker ⟨x.start, []⟩ [] = x.dom := Obj.ext rfl (by simp [Obj.whisker])
  have hb : x.cod.whisker ⟨x.start, []⟩ [] = x.cod := Obj.ext rfl (by simp [Obj.whisker])
  have key := P.diag_interchange x hx ⟨x.start, []⟩ [] hw ha hb
  refine Eq.trans (P.diag_eq_of_layers_eq ?_) (key.trans (congrArg _ (P.diag_eq_of_layers_eq ?_)))
  all_goals
    simp [InterchangeData.ghDiagram, InterchangeData.hgDiagram, InterchangeData.gh₁,
      InterchangeData.gh₂, InterchangeData.hg₁, InterchangeData.hg₂, Layer.whisker]

name: StringDiagrams.InterchangeData.sign_mul_self
statement: theorem InterchangeData.sign_mul_self (x : InterchangeData S) : x.sign * x.sign = 1

name: StringDiagrams.InterchangeData.sign_cast_mul_self
statement:
theorem InterchangeData.sign_cast_mul_self (x : InterchangeData S) :
    ((x.sign : ℤ) : R) * ((x.sign : ℤ) : R) = 1

name: StringDiagrams.InterchangeData.sign_cast_mul_self_assoc
statement:
theorem InterchangeData.sign_cast_mul_self_assoc (x : InterchangeData S) (r : R) :
    ((x.sign : ℤ) : R) * (r * ((x.sign : ℤ) : R)) = r
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_comm r, ← mul_assoc, x.sign_cast_mul_self, one_mul]

name: StringDiagrams.InterchangeData.weight_hg
statement:
theorem InterchangeData.weight_hg (χ : S.Gen → R) {x : InterchangeData S} (hx : x.Valid) :
    Diagram.weight χ (InterchangeData.hgDiagram hx) =
      Diagram.weight χ (InterchangeData.ghDiagram hx)
proof:
:= by
  simp [Diagram.weight, InterchangeData.ghDiagram, InterchangeData.hgDiagram,
    InterchangeData.gh₁, InterchangeData.gh₂, InterchangeData.hg₁, InterchangeData.hg₂, mul_comm]

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.diag_hgDiagram
statement:
theorem Presentation.diag_hgDiagram (P : Presentation.{w, v} S R) {x : InterchangeData S}
    (hx : x.Valid) :
    P.diag (InterchangeData.hgDiagram hx) =
      ((x.sign : ℤ) : R) • P.diag (InterchangeData.ghDiagram hx)
proof:
:= by
  rw [P.diag_ghDiagram hx, smul_smul, ← Int.cast_mul, x.sign_mul_self, Int.cast_one, one_smul]

name: StringDiagrams.LayerMap.chain
statement:
theorem chain {a b : Obj S} {ls : List (Layer S)} (h : Chain a ls b) :
    Chain (φ.obj a) (ls.map φ.layer) (φ.obj b)
proof:
:= by
  induction ls generalizing a with
  | nil => exact congrArg φ.obj h
  | cons L ls ih =>
    obtain ⟨hv, rfl, hc⟩ := h
    exact ⟨φ.valid hv, φ.dom_eq hv, by rw [φ.cod_eq hv]; exact ih hc⟩

name: StringDiagrams.LayerMap.layers_map
statement:
@[simp] theorem layers_map {a b : Obj S} (d : a ⟶ b) :
    Diagram.layers (φ.map d) = (Diagram.layers d).map φ.layer

name: StringDiagrams.LayerMap.map_id
statement: @[simp] theorem map_id (a : Obj S) : φ.map (𝟙 a) = 𝟙 (φ.obj a)

name: StringDiagrams.LayerMap.map_comp
statement:
@[simp] theorem map_comp {a b c : Obj S} (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) :
    φ.map (f ≫ g) = φ.map f ≫ φ.map g

name: StringDiagrams.LayerMap.map_cast
statement:
theorem map_cast {a b a' b' : Obj S} (d : a ⟶ b) (ha : a = a') (hb : b = b') :
    φ.map (Diagram.cast d ha hb) =
      Diagram.cast (φ.map d) (congrArg φ.obj ha) (congrArg φ.obj hb)

name: StringDiagrams.LayerMap.map_eqToHom
statement: theorem map_eqToHom {a b : Obj S} (h : a = b) : φ.map (eqToHom h) = eqToHom (congrArg φ.obj h)

name: StringDiagrams.LayerMap.map_ofLayer
statement:
theorem map_ofLayer (L : Layer S) (hv : L.Valid) :
    φ.map (Diagram.ofLayer L hv) =
      Diagram.layer (φ.layer L) (φ.valid hv) (φ.dom_eq hv) (φ.cod_eq hv)

name: StringDiagrams.LayerMap.lin_of
statement:
@[simp] theorem lin_of {a b : Obj S} (d : a ⟶ b) :
    φ.lin (LinDiagram.of d : LinDiagram R a b) = LinDiagram.of (φ.map d)

name: StringDiagrams.LayerMap.linMap_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem linMap_apply {a b : Obj S} (f : LinDiagram R a b) :
    φ.linMap a b f = φ.lin f

name: StringDiagrams.LayerMap.lin_add
statement: theorem lin_add {a b : Obj S} (f g : LinDiagram R a b) : φ.lin (f + g) = φ.lin f + φ.lin g

name: StringDiagrams.LayerMap.lin_sub
statement: theorem lin_sub {a b : Obj S} (f g : LinDiagram R a b) : φ.lin (f - g) = φ.lin f - φ.lin g

name: StringDiagrams.LayerMap.lin_smul
statement: theorem lin_smul {a b : Obj S} (r : R) (f : LinDiagram R a b) : φ.lin (r • f) = r • φ.lin f

name: StringDiagrams.LayerMap.toPresented_obj
statement: @[simp] theorem toPresented_obj (a : Obj S) : (φ.toPresented Q χ).obj a = Q.obj (φ.obj a)

name: StringDiagrams.LayerMap.toPresented_map
statement:
@[simp] theorem toPresented_map {a b : Obj S} (d : a ⟶ b) :
    (φ.toPresented Q χ).map d = Diagram.weight χ d • Q.diag (φ.map d)

name: StringDiagrams.LayerMap.freeLift_toPresented_of
statement:
theorem freeLift_toPresented_of {a b : Obj S} (d : a ⟶ b) :
    (freeLift R (φ.toPresented Q χ)).map (LinDiagram.of d : LinDiagram R a b) =
      Diagram.weight χ d • Q.diag (φ.map d)

name: StringDiagrams.LayerMap.freeLift_toPresented_one
statement:
theorem freeLift_toPresented_one {a b : Obj S} (f : LinDiagram R a b) :
    (freeLift R (φ.toPresented Q fun _ => 1)).map f = Q.lin (φ.lin f)
proof:
:= by
  induction f using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => rw [Functor.map_zero, lin, Finsupp.mapDomain_zero, Q.lin_zero]
  | add f g hf hg =>
    rw [Functor.map_add, hf, hg, lin_add, Q.lin_add]
  | single d r =>
    rw [freeLift_map_single, lin, Finsupp.mapDomain_single, Q.lin_single, toPresented_map,
      Diagram.weight_one, one_smul]

name: StringDiagrams.LayerMap.WhiskerData.map_whisker
statement:
theorem map_whisker {i : ι} {a b : Obj S} (d : a ⟶ b) (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour)
    (ha : W.Admissible a) (hw : a.WhiskerOK u v) :
    (φ i).map (Diagram.whisker d u v hw) =
      Diagram.cast (Diagram.whisker ((φ (W.idx i a u v)).map d) (W.left i a u v)
          (W.right i a u v) (W.whiskerOK ha hw))
        (W.obj_whisker ha hw ⟨𝟙 a⟩) (W.obj_whisker ha hw ⟨d⟩)
proof:
:= by
  apply Diagram.ext
  simp only [layers_map, Diagram.layers_whisker, Diagram.layers_cast, List.map_map]
  refine List.map_congr_left fun L hL => ?_
  exact W.layer_whisker ha hw ((Diagram.chain d).valid_of_mem hL)
    ((Diagram.chain d).nonempty_of_mem hL)

name: StringDiagrams.LayerMap.WhiskerData.toPresented_map_whisker
statement:
theorem toPresented_map_whisker {i : ι} {a b : Obj S} (d : a ⟶ b) (u : Obj S)
    (v : List S.Colour) (ha : W.Admissible a) (hw : a.WhiskerOK u v) :
    ((φ i).toPresented Q χ).map (Diagram.whisker d u v hw) =
      eqToHom (congrArg Q.obj (W.obj_whisker ha hw ⟨𝟙 a⟩).symm) ≫
        Q.whisk (((φ (W.idx i a u v)).toPresented Q χ).map d) (W.left i a u v)
          (W.right i a u v) ≫
        eqToHom (congrArg Q.obj (W.obj_whisker ha hw ⟨d⟩))
proof:
:= by
  rw [toPresented_map, toPresented_map, W.map_whisker _ _ _ ha, Diagram.weight_whisker, Q.diag_cast,
    Q.whisk_smul, Q.whisk_diag _ _ _ (W.whiskerOK ha hw), Linear.smul_comp, Linear.comp_smul]

name: StringDiagrams.LayerMap.WhiskerData.freeLift_whisker_eq_zero
statement:
theorem freeLift_whisker_eq_zero {i : ι} {a b : Obj S} (f : LinDiagram R a b) (u : Obj S)
    (v : List S.Colour) (ha : W.Admissible a) (hw : a.WhiskerOK u v)
    (hf : (freeLift R ((φ (W.idx i a u v)).toPresented Q χ)).map f = 0) :
    (freeLift R ((φ i).toPresented Q χ)).map (LinDiagram.whisker f u v hw) = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h0 : f = 0
  · subst h0
    rw [show LinDiagram.whisker (0 : LinDiagram R a b) u v hw = 0 from Finsupp.mapDomain_zero,
      Functor.map_zero]
  obtain ⟨d₀, -⟩ := Finsupp.ne_iff.mp h0
  have ea := congrArg Q.obj (W.obj_whisker (i := i) ha hw ⟨𝟙 a⟩).symm
  have eb := congrArg Q.obj (W.obj_whisker (i := i) ha hw ⟨d₀⟩)
  let T : (Q.obj ((φ (W.idx i a u v)).obj a) ⟶ Q.obj ((φ (W.idx i a u v)).obj b)) →ₗ[R]
      (Q.obj ((φ i).obj (a.whisker u v)) ⟶ Q.obj ((φ i).obj (b.whisker u v))) :=
    { toFun := fun x => eqToHom ea ≫ Q.whisk x (W.left i a u v) (W.right i a u v) ≫ eqToHom eb
      map_add' := fun x y => by
        simp only [Q.whisk_add, Preadditive.add_comp, Preadditive.comp_add]
      map_smul' := fun r x => by
        simp only [Q.whisk_smul, Linear.smul_comp, Linear.comp_smul, RingHom.id_apply] }
  have := freeLift_map_mapDomain (F := (φ (W.idx i a u v)).toPresented Q χ)
    (G := (φ i).toPresented Q χ) (fun d => Diagram.whisker d u v hw) T
    (fun d => W.toPresented_map_whisker Q χ d u v ha hw) f
  exact this.trans (by rw [hf, map_zero])

name: StringDiagrams.LayerMap.respects
statement:
theorem respects {φ : ι → LayerMap S S'} (W : WhiskerData φ)
    (hadm : ∀ r, W.Admissible (P.dom r))
    (hrel : ∀ i r, (freeLift R ((φ i).toPresented Q χ)).map (P.rel r) = 0)
    (hint : ∀ i (x : InterchangeData S) (hx : x.Valid),
      (freeLift R ((φ i).toPresented Q χ)).map (InterchangeData.rel R hx) = 0) (i : ι) :
    P.Respects ((φ i).toPresented Q χ)
proof:
:=
  P.respects_of_whisker_on (fun i => (φ i).toPresented Q χ) W.Admissible hadm
    (fun _ => W.admissible_interchange)
    (fun _ _ _ f u v ha hw hf => W.freeLift_whisker_eq_zero Q χ f u v ha hw (hf _)) hrel hint i

name: StringDiagrams.LayerMap.lift_obj
statement:
@[simp] theorem lift_obj (a : Obj S) :
    (lift P W hadm hrel hint i).obj (P.obj a) = Q.obj ((φ i).obj a)

name: StringDiagrams.LayerMap.lift_diag
statement:
@[simp] theorem lift_diag {a b : Obj S} (d : a ⟶ b) :
    (lift P W hadm hrel hint i).map (P.diag d) = Diagram.weight χ d • Q.diag ((φ i).map d)

name: StringDiagrams.LayerMap.lift_lin
statement:
theorem lift_lin {a b : Obj S} (f : LinDiagram R a b) :
    (lift P W hadm hrel hint i).map (P.lin f) = (freeLift R ((φ i).toPresented Q χ)).map f

name: StringDiagrams.LayerMap.lift_whisk
statement:
theorem lift_whisk {a b : Obj S} (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b) {u : Obj S} {v : List S.Colour}
    (ha : W.Admissible a) (hw : a.WhiskerOK u v) (hb : Nonempty (a ⟶ b)) :
    (lift P W hadm hrel hint i).map (P.whisk f u v) =
      eqToHom (congrArg Q.obj (W.obj_whisker ha hw ⟨𝟙 a⟩).symm) ≫
        Q.whisk ((lift P W hadm hrel hint (W.idx i a u v)).map f) (W.left i a u v)
          (W.right i a u v) ≫
        eqToHom (congrArg Q.obj (W.obj_whisker ha hw hb))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, rfl⟩ := P.lin_surjective f
  rw [Presentation.whisk_lin, LinDiagram.whisk_of_ok _ hw, lift_lin, lift_lin]
  exact freeLift_map_mapDomain (F := (φ (W.idx i a u v)).toPresented Q χ)
    (G := (φ i).toPresented Q χ) (fun d => Diagram.whisker d u v hw)
    { toFun := fun x => eqToHom (congrArg Q.obj (W.obj_whisker ha hw ⟨𝟙 a⟩).symm) ≫
        Q.whisk x (W.left i a u v) (W.right i a u v) ≫
          eqToHom (congrArg Q.obj (W.obj_whisker ha hw hb))
      map_add' := fun x y => by
        simp only [Q.whisk_add, Preadditive.add_comp, Preadditive.comp_add]
      map_smul' := fun r x => by
        simp only [Q.whisk_smul, Linear.smul_comp, Linear.comp_smul, RingHom.id_apply] }
    (fun d => W.toPresented_map_whisker Q χ d u v ha hw) f

name: StringDiagrams.LayerMap.toPresented_interchange
statement:
theorem toPresented_interchange {x : InterchangeData S} (hx : x.Valid) (x' : InterchangeData S')
    (h₁ : φ.layer x.gh₁ = x'.gh₁) (h₂ : φ.layer x.gh₂ = x'.gh₂) (h₃ : φ.layer x.hg₁ = x'.hg₁)
    (h₄ : φ.layer x.hg₂ = x'.hg₂) (hs : x'.sign = x.sign) :
    (freeLift R (φ.toPresented Q χ)).map (InterchangeData.rel R hx) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hx' : x'.Valid :=
    ⟨h₁ ▸ φ.valid hx.gh₁, h₂ ▸ φ.valid hx.gh₂, h₃ ▸ φ.valid hx.hg₁, h₄ ▸ φ.valid hx.hg₂⟩
  have ha : φ.obj x.dom = x'.dom := by
    rw [← x.gh₁_dom, ← φ.dom_eq hx.gh₁, h₁, x'.gh₁_dom]
  have hb : φ.obj x.cod = x'.cod := by
    rw [← x.gh₂_cod, ← φ.cod_eq hx.gh₂, h₂, x'.gh₂_cod]
  have e₁ := Q.diag_eq_of_layers_eq' (φ.map (InterchangeData.ghDiagram hx))
    (InterchangeData.ghDiagram hx') ha hb (by simp [InterchangeData.ghDiagram, h₁, h₂])
  have e₂ := Q.diag_eq_of_layers_eq' (φ.map (InterchangeData.hgDiagram hx))
    (InterchangeData.hgDiagram hx') ha hb (by simp [InterchangeData.hgDiagram, h₃, h₄])
  rw [InterchangeData.rel, Functor.map_sub, Functor.map_smul, freeLift_toPresented_of,
    freeLift_toPresented_of, e₁, e₂, Q.diag_ghDiagram hx', hs, InterchangeData.weight_hg,
    sub_eq_zero]
  simp only [Linear.smul_comp, Linear.comp_smul, smul_comm (Diagram.weight χ _)]

name: StringDiagrams.LayerMap.toPresented_interchange_swap
statement:
theorem toPresented_interchange_swap {x : InterchangeData S} (hx : x.Valid)
    (x' : InterchangeData S') (h₁ : φ.layer x.gh₁ = x'.hg₁) (h₂ : φ.layer x.gh₂ = x'.hg₂)
    (h₃ : φ.layer x.hg₁ = x'.gh₁) (h₄ : φ.layer x.hg₂ = x'.gh₂) (hs : x'.sign = x.sign) :
    (freeLift R (φ.toPresented Q χ)).map (InterchangeData.rel R hx) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hx' : x'.Valid :=
    ⟨h₃ ▸ φ.valid hx.hg₁, h₄ ▸ φ.valid hx.hg₂, h₁ ▸ φ.valid hx.gh₁, h₂ ▸ φ.valid hx.gh₂⟩
  have ha : φ.obj x.dom = x'.dom := by
    rw [← x.gh₁_dom, ← φ.dom_eq hx.gh₁, h₁, x'.hg₁_dom]
  have hb : φ.obj x.cod = x'.cod := by
    rw [← x.gh₂_cod, ← φ.cod_eq hx.gh₂, h₂, x'.hg₂_cod]
  have e₁ := Q.diag_eq_of_layers_eq' (φ.map (InterchangeData.ghDiagram hx))
    (InterchangeData.hgDiagram hx') ha hb (by simp [InterchangeData.ghDiagram,
      InterchangeData.hgDiagram, h₁, h₂])
  have e₂ := Q.diag_eq_of_layers_eq' (φ.map (InterchangeData.hgDiagram hx))
    (InterchangeData.ghDiagram hx') ha hb (by simp [InterchangeData.ghDiagram,
      InterchangeData.hgDiagram, h₃, h₄])
  rw [InterchangeData.rel, Functor.map_sub, Functor.map_smul, freeLift_toPresented_of,
    freeLift_toPresented_of, e₁, e₂, Q.diag_ghDiagram hx', hs, InterchangeData.weight_hg,
    sub_eq_zero]
  simp only [Linear.smul_comp, Linear.comp_smul, smul_smul, x.sign_cast_mul_self_assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.LayerMap.PreservesDeg.degree_map
statement:
theorem PreservesDeg.degree_map (h : φ.PreservesDeg deg deg') {a b : Obj S} (d : a ⟶ b) :
    Diagram.degree deg' (φ.map d) = Diagram.degree deg d
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Diagram.degree, layers_map, List.map_map]
  congr 1
  exact List.map_congr_left fun L hL => h ((Diagram.chain d).valid_of_mem hL)

name: StringDiagrams.LayerMap.preservesDeg_parityDeg
statement:
theorem preservesDeg_parityDeg
    (h : ∀ {L : Layer S}, L.Valid → S'.odd (φ.layer L).gen = S.odd L.gen) :
    φ.PreservesDeg (Presentation.parityDeg S) (Presentation.parityDeg S')
proof:
:= fun hv => by
  simp only [Presentation.parityDeg, h hv]

name: StringDiagrams.LayerMap.PreservesDeg.toPresented_mem_homDeg
proof:
:= by
  rw [LinDiagram.homDeg, Finsupp.supported_eq_span_single] at hf
  induction hf using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨d, hd, rfl⟩ := hy
    rw [freeLift_map_single, toPresented_map, smul_smul]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Presentation.diag_mem_homDeg' ((h.degree_map d).trans hd))
  | zero => rw [Functor.map_zero]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  | add y z _ _ hy hz => rw [Functor.map_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hy hz
  | smul r y _ hy => rw [Functor.map_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ r hy

name: StringDiagrams.LayerMap.lift_mem_homDeg
statement:
theorem lift_mem_homDeg {P : Presentation.{w, v} S R} {φ : ι → LayerMap S S'} (W : WhiskerData φ)
    (hadm : ∀ r, W.Admissible (P.dom r))
    (hrel : ∀ i r, (freeLift R ((φ i).toPresented Q χ)).map (P.rel r) = 0)
    (hint : ∀ i (x : InterchangeData S) (hx : x.Valid),
      (freeLift R ((φ i).toPresented Q χ)).map (InterchangeData.rel R hx) = 0) (i : ι)
    (h : (φ i).PreservesDeg deg deg') {a b : Obj S} {x : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b} {e : A}
    (hx : x ∈ P.homDeg deg a b e) :
    (lift P W hadm hrel hint i).map x ∈ Q.homDeg deg' ((φ i).obj a) ((φ i).obj b) e
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩ := Presentation.mem_homDeg_iff.mp hx
  rw [lift_lin]
  exact h.toPresented_mem_homDeg Q χ hf

name: StringDiagrams.LocalMap.functor_map_layer
statement:
theorem functor_map_layer (L : Layer S) (hv : L.Valid) {a b : Obj S} (ha : L.dom = a)
    (hb : L.cod = b) :
    φ.functor.map (Diagram.layer L hv ha hb) =
      eqToHom (congrArg (fun x => Q.obj (φ.obj x)) ha.symm) ≫ φ.layer L hv ≫
        eqToHom (congrArg (fun x => Q.obj (φ.obj x)) hb)

name: StringDiagrams.LocalMap.WhiskerData.functor_map_whisker_aux
statement:
theorem functor_map_whisker_aux {i : ι} {a u : Obj S} {v : List S.Colour}
    (ha : W.Admissible a) (hw : a.WhiskerOK u v) :
    ∀ (ls : List (Layer S)) {c b : Obj S} (hcr : Nonempty (a ⟶ c)) (hc : Chain c ls b)
      (hwc : c.WhiskerOK u v),
      (φ i).functor.map (Diagram.whisker (Diagram.mk ls hc) u v hwc) =
        eqToHom (congrArg Q.obj (W.obj_whisker ha hw hcr).symm) ≫
          Q.whisk ((φ (W.idx i a u v)).functor.map (Diagram.mk ls hc)) (W.left i a u v)
            (W.right i a u v) ≫
          eqToHom (congrArg Q.obj (W.obj_whisker ha hw
            (hcr.map fun d => d ≫ Diagram.mk ls hc)))
proof:
:= by
  intro ls
  induction ls with
  | nil =>
    intro c b hcr hc hwc
    cases hc
    rw [show Diagram.mk [] (rfl : Chain c [] c) = 𝟙 c from rfl, Diagram.whisker_id,
      CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id]
    simp only [functor_obj]
    rw [Q.whisk_id _ _ _ (W.whiskerOK ha hw hcr), Category.id_comp, eqToHom_trans, eqToHom_refl]
  | cons L ls ih =>
    intro c b hcr hc hwc
    obtain ⟨hv, rfl, hc'⟩ := hc
    have e : Diagram.mk (L :: ls) (show Chain L.dom (L :: ls) b from ⟨hv, rfl, hc'⟩) =
        Diagram.ofLayer L hv ≫ Diagram.mk ls hc' := Diagram.ext rfl
    have hwc' : L.cod.WhiskerOK u v := Chain.whiskerOK (ls := [L]) ⟨hv, rfl, rfl⟩ hwc
    have hcr' : Nonempty (a ⟶ L.cod) := hv.nonempty_cod hcr
    have hv' : (L.whisker u v).Valid := hv.whisker hwc
    have el : Diagram.whisker (Diagram.ofLayer L hv) u v hwc =
        Diagram.layer (L.whisker u v) hv' (L.whisker_dom u v) (L.whisker_cod u v) :=
      Diagram.ext rfl
    rw [e, Diagram.whisker_comp, Functor.map_comp, el, functor_map_layer, ih hcr' hc' hwc',
      Functor.map_comp, functor_map_ofLayer, Q.whisk_comp,
      W.layer_whisker ha hw hv hcr hv'
        (by rw [L.whisker_dom]; exact congrArg Q.obj (W.obj_whisker ha hw hcr).symm)
        (by rw [L.whisker_cod]; exact congrArg Q.obj (W.obj_whisker ha hw hcr'))]
    simp only [Category.assoc, eqToHom_trans_assoc, eqToHom_refl, Category.id_comp]

name: StringDiagrams.LocalMap.WhiskerData.functor_map_whisker
statement:
theorem functor_map_whisker {i : ι} {a b : Obj S} (d : a ⟶ b) (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour)
    (ha : W.Admissible a) (hw : a.WhiskerOK u v) :
    (φ i).functor.map (Diagram.whisker d u v hw) =
      eqToHom (congrArg Q.obj (W.obj_whisker ha hw ⟨𝟙 a⟩).symm) ≫
        Q.whisk ((φ (W.idx i a u v)).functor.map d) (W.left i a u v) (W.right i a u v) ≫
        eqToHom (congrArg Q.obj (W.obj_whisker ha hw ⟨d⟩))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ls, hc⟩ := d
  exact W.functor_map_whisker_aux ha hw ls ⟨𝟙 a⟩ hc hw

name: StringDiagrams.LocalMap.WhiskerData.freeLift_whisker_eq_zero
statement:
theorem freeLift_whisker_eq_zero {i : ι} {a b : Obj S} (f : LinDiagram R a b) (u : Obj S)
    (v : List S.Colour) (ha : W.Admissible a) (hw : a.WhiskerOK u v)
    (hf : (freeLift R (φ (W.idx i a u v)).functor).map f = 0) :
    (freeLift R (φ i).functor).map (LinDiagram.whisker f u v hw) = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h0 : f = 0
  · subst h0
    rw [show LinDiagram.whisker (0 : LinDiagram R a b) u v hw = 0 from Finsupp.mapDomain_zero,
      Functor.map_zero]
  obtain ⟨d₀, -⟩ := Finsupp.ne_iff.mp h0
  have ea := congrArg Q.obj (W.obj_whisker (i := i) ha hw ⟨𝟙 a⟩).symm
  have eb := congrArg Q.obj (W.obj_whisker (i := i) ha hw ⟨d₀⟩)
  let T : (Q.obj ((φ (W.idx i a u v)).obj a) ⟶ Q.obj ((φ (W.idx i a u v)).obj b)) →ₗ[R]
      (Q.obj ((φ i).obj (a.whisker u v)) ⟶ Q.obj ((φ i).obj (b.whisker u v))) :=
    { toFun := fun x => eqToHom ea ≫ Q.whisk x (W.left i a u v) (W.right i a u v) ≫ eqToHom eb
      map_add' := fun x y => by
        simp only [Q.whisk_add, Preadditive.add_comp, Preadditive.comp_add]
      map_smul' := fun r x => by
        simp only [Q.whisk_smul, Linear.smul_comp, Linear.comp_smul, RingHom.id_apply] }
  have := freeLift_map_mapDomain (F := (φ (W.idx i a u v)).functor) (G := (φ i).functor)
    (fun d => Diagram.whisker d u v hw) T (fun d => W.functor_map_whisker d u v ha hw) f
  exact this.trans (by rw [hf, map_zero])

name: StringDiagrams.LocalMap.respects
statement:
theorem respects {φ : ι → LocalMap S Q} (W : WhiskerData φ)
    (hadm : ∀ r, W.Admissible (P.dom r))
    (hrel : ∀ i r, (freeLift R (φ i).functor).map (P.rel r) = 0)
    (hint : ∀ i (x : InterchangeData S) (hx : x.Valid),
      (freeLift R (φ i).functor).map (InterchangeData.rel R hx) = 0) (i : ι) :
    P.Respects (φ i).functor
proof:
:=
  P.respects_of_whisker_on (fun i => (φ i).functor) W.Admissible hadm
    (fun _ => W.admissible_interchange)
    (fun _ _ _ f u v ha hw hf => W.freeLift_whisker_eq_zero f u v ha hw (hf _)) hrel hint i

name: StringDiagrams.LocalMap.lift_obj
statement:
@[simp] theorem lift_obj (a : Obj S) :
    (lift P W hadm hrel hint i).obj (P.obj a) = Q.obj ((φ i).obj a)

name: StringDiagrams.LocalMap.lift_diag
statement:
@[simp] theorem lift_diag {a b : Obj S} (d : a ⟶ b) :
    (lift P W hadm hrel hint i).map (P.diag d) = (φ i).functor.map d

name: StringDiagrams.LocalMap.lift_lin
statement:
theorem lift_lin {a b : Obj S} (f : LinDiagram R a b) :
    (lift P W hadm hrel hint i).map (P.lin f) = (freeLift R (φ i).functor).map f

name: StringDiagrams.LocalMap.lift_layer
statement:
theorem lift_layer (L : Layer S) (hv : L.Valid) :
    (lift P W hadm hrel hint i).map (P.diag (Diagram.ofLayer L hv)) = (φ i).layer L hv

name: StringDiagrams.LocalMap.lift_whisk
statement:
theorem lift_whisk {a b : Obj S} (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b) {u : Obj S} {v : List S.Colour}
    (ha : W.Admissible a) (hw : a.WhiskerOK u v) (hb : Nonempty (a ⟶ b)) :
    (lift P W hadm hrel hint i).map (P.whisk f u v) =
      eqToHom (congrArg Q.obj (W.obj_whisker ha hw ⟨𝟙 a⟩).symm) ≫
        Q.whisk ((lift P W hadm hrel hint (W.idx i a u v)).map f) (W.left i a u v)
          (W.right i a u v) ≫
        eqToHom (congrArg Q.obj (W.obj_whisker ha hw hb))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, rfl⟩ := P.lin_surjective f
  rw [Presentation.whisk_lin, LinDiagram.whisk_of_ok _ hw, lift_lin, lift_lin]
  exact freeLift_map_mapDomain (F := (φ (W.idx i a u v)).functor) (G := (φ i).functor)
    (fun d => Diagram.whisker d u v hw)
    { toFun := fun x => eqToHom (congrArg Q.obj (W.obj_whisker ha hw ⟨𝟙 a⟩).symm) ≫
        Q.whisk x (W.left i a u v) (W.right i a u v) ≫
          eqToHom (congrArg Q.obj (W.obj_whisker ha hw hb))
      map_add' := fun x y => by
        simp only [Q.whisk_add, Preadditive.add_comp, Preadditive.comp_add]
      map_smul' := fun r x => by
        simp only [Q.whisk_smul, Linear.smul_comp, Linear.comp_smul, RingHom.id_apply] }
    (fun d => W.functor_map_whisker d u v ha hw) f

name: StringDiagrams.LocalMap.PreservesDeg.functor_map_mem
statement:
theorem PreservesDeg.functor_map_mem (h : φ.PreservesDeg deg deg') {a b : Obj S} (d : a ⟶ b) :
    φ.functor.map d ∈ Q.homDeg deg' (φ.obj a) (φ.obj b) (Diagram.degree deg d)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ls, hc⟩ := d
  induction ls generalizing a with
  | nil =>
    cases hc
    change φ.functor.map (𝟙 _) ∈ Q.homDeg deg' _ _ (Diagram.degree deg (𝟙 _))
    rw [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id, Diagram.degree_id]
    exact Presentation.id_mem_homDeg Q deg' _
  | cons L ls ih =>
    obtain ⟨hv, rfl, hc'⟩ := hc
    have e : (⟨L :: ls, hv, rfl, hc'⟩ : L.dom ⟶ b) = Diagram.ofLayer L hv ≫ ⟨ls, hc'⟩ :=
      Diagram.ext rfl
    rw [e, Functor.map_comp, functor_map_ofLayer, Diagram.degree_comp, Diagram.degree_ofLayer]
    exact Presentation.comp_mem_homDeg (h L hv) (ih hc')

name: StringDiagrams.LocalMap.PreservesDeg.freeLift_mem
proof:
:= by
  rw [LinDiagram.homDeg, Finsupp.supported_eq_span_single] at hf
  induction hf using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨d, hd, rfl⟩ := hy
    rw [freeLift_map_single]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (hd ▸ h.functor_map_mem d)
  | zero => rw [Functor.map_zero]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  | add y z _ _ hy hz => rw [Functor.map_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hy hz
  | smul r y _ hy => rw [Functor.map_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ r hy

name: StringDiagrams.LocalMap.lift_mem_homDeg
statement:
theorem lift_mem_homDeg {P : Presentation.{w, v} S R} {φ : ι → LocalMap S Q}
    (W : WhiskerData φ) (hadm : ∀ r, W.Admissible (P.dom r))
    (hrel : ∀ i r, (freeLift R (φ i).functor).map (P.rel r) = 0)
    (hint : ∀ i (x : InterchangeData S) (hx : x.Valid),
      (freeLift R (φ i).functor).map (InterchangeData.rel R hx) = 0) (i : ι)
    (h : (φ i).PreservesDeg deg deg') {a b : Obj S} {x : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b} {e : A}
    (hx : x ∈ P.homDeg deg a b e) :
    (lift P W hadm hrel hint i).map x ∈ Q.homDeg deg' ((φ i).obj a) ((φ i).obj b) e
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩ := Presentation.mem_homDeg_iff.mp hx
  rw [lift_lin]
  exact h.freeLift_mem hf

name: StringDiagrams.LocalMap.whisk_congr'
StringDiagrams.LocalMap.whisker_genDom
statement:
theorem whisker_genDom (L : Layer S) :
    (genDom κ L.gen).whisker (κ.obj ⟨L.start, L.left⟩) (κ.word L.right) = κ.obj L.dom

name: StringDiagrams.LocalMap.whisker_genCod
statement:
theorem whisker_genCod (L : Layer S) :
    (genCod κ L.gen).whisker (κ.obj ⟨L.start, L.left⟩) (κ.word L.right) = κ.obj L.cod

name: StringDiagrams.LocalMap.genDom_whiskerOK
statement:
theorem genDom_whiskerOK {L : Layer S} (hv : L.Valid) :
    (genDom κ L.gen).WhiskerOK (κ.obj ⟨L.start, L.left⟩) (κ.word L.right)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨κ.ok_map hv.left_ok, ?_, ?_⟩
  · show S'.endR (κ.region L.start) (κ.word L.left) = κ.region (S.left L.gen)
    rw [κ.endR_map, hv.left_end]
  · show S'.ok (S'.endR (κ.region (S.left L.gen)) (κ.word (S.dom L.gen))) _
    rw [κ.endR_map, hv.dom_end]; exact κ.ok_map hv.right_ok

name: StringDiagrams.LocalMap.ofGen_obj
statement: @[simp] theorem ofGen_obj (a : Obj S) : (ofGen κ img).obj a = κ.obj a

name: StringDiagrams.LocalMap.ofGen_layer
statement:
theorem ofGen_layer (L : Layer S) (hv : L.Valid) :
    (ofGen κ img).layer L hv = eqToHom (congrArg Q.obj (whisker_genDom κ L)).symm ≫
      Q.whisk (img L.gen) (κ.obj ⟨L.start, L.left⟩) (κ.word L.right) ≫
        eqToHom (congrArg Q.obj (whisker_genCod κ L))

name: StringDiagrams.LocalMap.whisk_nil_eq_wRAt
statement:
private theorem whisk_nil_eq_wRAt {a a' : Obj S'} (f : Q.obj a ⟶ Q.obj a') {r : S'.Region}
    (b : Obj S') (ha : a.start = r) (ha' : a'.start = r) :
    Q.whisk f (Obj.nil r) b.word =
      eqToHom (congrArg Q.obj (Obj.tensor_eq_whisker_nil_of_start b ha)).symm ≫
        Q.wRAt r f b ha ha' ≫
          eqToHom (congrArg Q.obj (Obj.tensor_eq_whisker_nil_of_start b ha'))

name: StringDiagrams.LocalMap.whisk_eq_wL
statement:
private theorem whisk_eq_wL {b b' : Obj S'} (g : Q.obj b ⟶ Q.obj b') (a : Obj S') :
    Q.whisk g a [] =
      eqToHom (congrArg Q.obj (Obj.tensor_eq_whisker_nil a b)).symm ≫ Q.wL a g ≫
        eqToHom (congrArg Q.obj (Obj.tensor_eq_whisker_nil a b'))

name: StringDiagrams.LocalMap.ofGen_interchange
statement:
theorem ofGen_interchange
    (himg : ∀ g, img g ∈ Q.homDeg (Presentation.parityDeg S') (genDom κ g) (genCod κ g)
      (Presentation.parityDeg S g))
    {x : InterchangeData S} (hx : x.Valid) :
    (freeLift R (ofGen κ img).functor).map (InterchangeData.rel R hx) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hs : x.start = S.left x.g := hx.gh₁.left_end
  have e₀ : S.endR (S.right x.g) x.mid = S.left x.h := by
    have h₀ := hx.gh₁.left_end
    have h₁ := hx.hg₁.left_end
    have h₂ := hx.gh₁.dom_end
    simp only [InterchangeData.hg₁, InterchangeData.gh₁, Signature.endR_append,
      Signature.endR_nil] at h₀ h₁ h₂
    rwa [h₀, h₂] at h₁
  have hmok : S.ok (S.right x.g) x.mid := ((Signature.ok_append _ _ _).1 hx.gh₁.right_ok).1
  set r := κ.region (S.left x.g) with hr
  let A := genDom κ x.g
  let A' := genCod κ x.g
  let M : Obj S' := κ.obj ⟨S.right x.g, x.mid⟩
  let Dh := genDom κ x.h
  let Ch := genCod κ x.h
  have hMend : M.endR = κ.region (S.left x.h) := by
    show S'.endR (κ.region (S.right x.g)) (κ.word x.mid) = _
    rw [κ.endR_map, e₀]
  have hMD : M.Composable Dh := ⟨κ.ok_map hmok, hMend, κ.ok_map hx.hg₁.dom_ok⟩
  have hMC : M.Composable Ch := ⟨κ.ok_map hmok, hMend, κ.ok_map hx.hg₁.cod_ok⟩
  have hgd : S.endR (S.left x.g) (S.dom x.g) = S.right x.g := hx.gh₁.dom_end
  have hgc : S.endR (S.left x.g) (S.cod x.g) = S.right x.g := hx.gh₁.cod_end
  have hAM : A.Composable M := ⟨κ.ok_map hx.gh₁.dom_ok, by
    show S'.endR (κ.region (S.left x.g)) (κ.word (S.dom x.g)) = _
    rw [κ.endR_map, hgd]; rfl, κ.ok_map hmok⟩
  have hA'M : A'.Composable M := ⟨κ.ok_map hx.gh₁.cod_ok, by
    show S'.endR (κ.region (S.left x.g)) (κ.word (S.cod x.g)) = _
    rw [κ.endR_map, hgc]; rfl, κ.ok_map hmok⟩
  have hA : A.start = r := rfl
  have hA' : A'.start = r := rfl
  let G := Q.wL M (img x.h)
  have hG := Q.wL_mem (Presentation.parityDeg S') M (himg x.h)
  have key := Q.wRAt_comp_wL_super (hAM.tensor_right hMD) (himg x.g) hG hA hA'
  have hk : ((Supercategory.koszulSign (Presentation.parityDeg S x.g)
      (Presentation.parityDeg S x.h) : ℤ) : R) = ((x.sign : ℤ) : R) := by
    congr 1
    unfold InterchangeData.sign Presentation.parityDeg
    cases S.odd x.g <;> cases S.odd x.h <;> simp
  have oE₁ : κ.obj x.dom = A.tensor (M.tensor Dh) := by
    refine Obj.ext (by simp [A, InterchangeData.dom, genDom, ColourMap.obj, Obj.tensor, hs]) ?_
    simp [A, M, Dh, InterchangeData.dom, genDom, ColourMap.obj, Obj.tensor]
  have oE₂ : A'.tensor (M.tensor Ch) = κ.obj x.cod := by
    refine Obj.ext (by simp [A', InterchangeData.cod, genCod, ColourMap.obj, Obj.tensor, hs]) ?_
    simp [A', M, Ch, InterchangeData.cod, genCod, ColourMap.obj, Obj.tensor]
  have hgh : (ofGen κ img).functor.map (InterchangeData.ghDiagram hx) =
      eqToHom (congrArg Q.obj oE₁) ≫ (Q.wRAt r (img x.g) (M.tensor Dh) hA hA' ≫ Q.wL A' G) ≫
        eqToHom (congrArg Q.obj oE₂) := by
    unfold InterchangeData.ghDiagram
    show (ofGen κ img).toInterpretation.functor.map _ = _
    rw [Interpretation.functor_map_mk_cons, Interpretation.functor_map_mk_cons,
      Interpretation.functor_map_mk_nil]
    rw [toInterpretation_layer, ofGen_layer, ofGen_layer,
      whisk_congr' (img x.gh₁.gen) (u' := Obj.nil r) (v' := (M.tensor Dh).word)
        (by simp [ColourMap.obj, InterchangeData.gh₁, Obj.nil, hs, r])
        (by simp [InterchangeData.gh₁, M, Dh, genDom, ColourMap.obj, Obj.tensor]),
      whisk_nil_eq_wRAt (img x.gh₁.gen) (M.tensor Dh) hA hA',
      whisk_congr' (img x.gh₂.gen) (u' := A'.tensor M) (v' := [])
        (by simp [ColourMap.obj, InterchangeData.gh₂, A', M, genCod, Obj.tensor, hs])
        (by simp [InterchangeData.gh₂]),
      whisk_eq_wL (img x.gh₂.gen) (A'.tensor M), Q.wL_tensor hA'M hMD]
    simp only [Category.assoc, eqToHom_trans_assoc, eqToHom_trans, eqToHom_refl,
      Category.id_comp]
    rfl
  have hhg : (ofGen κ img).functor.map (InterchangeData.hgDiagram hx) =
      eqToHom (congrArg Q.obj oE₁) ≫ (Q.wL A G ≫ Q.wRAt r (img x.g) (M.tensor Ch) hA hA') ≫
        eqToHom (congrArg Q.obj oE₂) := by
    unfold InterchangeData.hgDiagram
    show (ofGen κ img).toInterpretation.functor.map _ = _
    rw [Interpretation.functor_map_mk_cons, Interpretation.functor_map_mk_cons,
      Interpretation.functor_map_mk_nil]
    rw [toInterpretation_layer, ofGen_layer, ofGen_layer,
      whisk_congr' (img x.hg₁.gen) (u' := A.tensor M) (v' := [])
        (by simp [ColourMap.obj, InterchangeData.hg₁, A, M, genDom, Obj.tensor, hs])
        (by simp [InterchangeData.hg₁]),
      whisk_eq_wL (img x.hg₁.gen) (A.tensor M), Q.wL_tensor hAM hMD,
      whisk_congr' (img x.hg₂.gen) (u' := Obj.nil r) (v' := (M.tensor Ch).word)
        (by simp [ColourMap.obj, InterchangeData.hg₂, Obj.nil, hs, r])
        (by simp [InterchangeData.hg₂, M, Ch, genCod, ColourMap.obj, Obj.tensor]),
      whisk_nil_eq_wRAt (img x.hg₂.gen) (M.tensor Ch) hA hA']
    simp only [Category.assoc, eqToHom_trans_assoc, eqToHom_trans, eqToHom_refl,
      Category.id_comp]
    rfl
  have key' : Q.wRAt r (img x.g) (M.tensor Dh) hA hA' ≫ Q.wL A' G =
      ((x.sign : ℤ) : R) • (Q.wL A G ≫ Q.wRAt r (img x.g) (M.tensor Ch) hA hA') := by
    rw [← hk, Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul]; exact key
  rw [InterchangeData.rel, Functor.map_sub, Functor.map_smul, freeLift_map_of, freeLift_map_of,
    hgh, hhg, key', Linear.smul_comp, Linear.comp_smul, sub_self]

name: StringDiagrams.LocalMap.parity_of_isEven
statement:
theorem parity_of_isEven [S.IsEven] [S'.IsEven] (g : S.Gen) :
    img g ∈ Q.homDeg (Presentation.parityDeg S') (genDom κ g) (genCod κ g)
      (Presentation.parityDeg S g)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := Q.lin_surjective (img g)
  rw [← hf, show Presentation.parityDeg S g = 0 by
    simp [Presentation.parityDeg, Signature.IsEven.odd_eq_false]]
  exact Presentation.lin_mem_homDeg (LinDiagram.mem_homDeg_iff.mpr fun d _ => by
    rw [Diagram.degree_parityDeg, Diagram.oddCount_eq_zero, Nat.cast_zero])

name: StringDiagrams.LocalMap.ofGen_preservesDeg
proof:
:= fun L _ => by
  have := Presentation.comp_mem_homDeg (Presentation.eqToHom_mem_homDeg (P := Q) deg'
    (congrArg Q.obj (whisker_genDom κ L)).symm) (Presentation.comp_mem_homDeg
      (Presentation.whisk_mem_homDeg (himg L.gen) (κ.obj ⟨L.start, L.left⟩) (κ.word L.right))
      (Presentation.eqToHom_mem_homDeg (P := Q) deg' (congrArg Q.obj (whisker_genCod κ L))))
  rwa [zero_add, add_zero] at this

name: StringDiagrams.LocalMap.liftGen_obj
statement:
@[simp] theorem liftGen_obj (a : Obj S) :
    (liftGen κ img P himg hrel).obj (P.obj a) = Q.obj (κ.obj a)

name: StringDiagrams.LocalMap.liftGen_diag
statement:
theorem liftGen_diag {a b : Obj S} (d : a ⟶ b) :
    (liftGen κ img P himg hrel).map (P.diag d) = (ofGen κ img).functor.map d

name: StringDiagrams.LocalMap.liftGen_lin
statement:
theorem liftGen_lin {a b : Obj S} (f : LinDiagram R a b) :
    (liftGen κ img P himg hrel).map (P.lin f) = (freeLift R (ofGen κ img).functor).map f

name: StringDiagrams.LocalMap.liftGen_layer
statement:
theorem liftGen_layer (L : Layer S) (hv : L.Valid) :
    (liftGen κ img P himg hrel).map (P.diag (Diagram.ofLayer L hv)) =
      eqToHom (congrArg Q.obj (whisker_genDom κ L)).symm ≫
        Q.whisk (img L.gen) (κ.obj ⟨L.start, L.left⟩) (κ.word L.right) ≫
          eqToHom (congrArg Q.obj (whisker_genCod κ L))

name: StringDiagrams.LocalMap.liftGen_whisk
statement:
theorem liftGen_whisk {a b : Obj S} (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b) {u : Obj S} {v : List S.Colour}
    (hw : a.WhiskerOK u v) (hb : Nonempty (a ⟶ b)) :
    (liftGen κ img P himg hrel).map (P.whisk f u v) =
      eqToHom (congrArg Q.obj (κ.obj_whisker a u v)) ≫
        Q.whisk ((liftGen κ img P himg hrel).map f) (κ.obj u) (κ.word v) ≫
          eqToHom (congrArg Q.obj (κ.obj_whisker b u v)).symm
proof:
:=
  lift_whisk (P := P) (ofGen_whiskerData κ img) (fun _ => trivial) (fun _ => hrel)
    (fun _ _ hx => ofGen_interchange κ img himg hx) () f trivial hw hb

name: StringDiagrams.ColourMap.word_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem word_nil : κ.word [] = []

name: StringDiagrams.ColourMap.word_append
statement: @[simp] theorem word_append (w w' : List S.Colour) : κ.word (w ++ w') = κ.word w ++ κ.word w'

name: StringDiagrams.ColourMap.word_cons
statement:
theorem word_cons (c : S.Colour) (w : List S.Colour) :
    κ.word (c :: w) = κ.colour c :: κ.word w

name: StringDiagrams.ColourMap.endR_map
statement:
theorem endR_map (r : S.Region) (w : List S.Colour) :
    S'.endR (κ.region r) (κ.word w) = κ.region (S.endR r w)
proof:
:= by
  rw [κ.word_eq]
  induction w generalizing r with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons c w ih => rw [List.map_cons, Signature.endR_cons, κ.colourTgt, ih]; rfl

name: StringDiagrams.ColourMap.ok_map
statement:
theorem ok_map {r : S.Region} {w : List S.Colour} (h : S.ok r w) :
    S'.ok (κ.region r) (κ.word w)
proof:
:= by
  rw [κ.word_eq]
  induction w generalizing r with
  | nil => trivial
  | cons c w ih =>
    obtain ⟨hc, hw⟩ := h
    exact ⟨by rw [κ.colourSrc, hc], by rw [κ.colourTgt]; exact ih hw⟩

name: StringDiagrams.ColourMap.obj_start
statement: @[simp] theorem obj_start (a : Obj S) : (κ.obj a).start = κ.region a.start

name: StringDiagrams.ColourMap.obj_word
statement: @[simp] theorem obj_word (a : Obj S) : (κ.obj a).word = κ.word a.word

name: StringDiagrams.ColourMap.obj_endR
statement: theorem obj_endR (a : Obj S) : (κ.obj a).endR = κ.region a.endR

name: StringDiagrams.ColourMap.obj_whisker
statement:
theorem obj_whisker (a u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour) :
    κ.obj (a.whisker u v) = (κ.obj a).whisker (κ.obj u) (κ.word v)

name: StringDiagrams.ColourMap.whiskerOK
statement:
theorem whiskerOK {a u : Obj S} {v : List S.Colour} (hw : a.WhiskerOK u v) :
    (κ.obj a).WhiskerOK (κ.obj u) (κ.word v)
proof:
:=
  ⟨κ.ok_map hw.1, by rw [obj_endR, hw.2.1]; rfl, by rw [obj_endR]; exact κ.ok_map hw.2.2⟩

name: StringDiagrams.SigMap.layer_valid
statement:
theorem layer_valid {L : Layer S} (hv : L.Valid) : (φ.layer L).Valid where
  left_ok
proof:
:= φ.ok_map hv.left_ok
  left_end := by
    show S'.endR (φ.region L.start) (φ.word L.left) = S'.left (φ.gen L.gen)
    rw [φ.endR_map, hv.left_end, φ.left]
  dom_ok := by
    show S'.ok (S'.left (φ.gen L.gen)) (S'.dom (φ.gen L.gen))
    rw [φ.left, φ.dom]; exact φ.ok_map hv.dom_ok
  dom_end := by
    show S'.endR (S'.left (φ.gen L.gen)) (S'.dom (φ.gen L.gen)) = S'.right (φ.gen L.gen)
    rw [φ.left, φ.dom, φ.endR_map, hv.dom_end, φ.right]
  cod_ok := by
    show S'.ok (S'.left (φ.gen L.gen)) (S'.cod (φ.gen L.gen))
    rw [φ.left, φ.cod]; exact φ.ok_map hv.cod_ok
  cod_end := by
    show S'.endR (S'.left (φ.gen L.gen)) (S'.cod (φ.gen L.gen)) = S'.right (φ.gen L.gen)
    rw [φ.left, φ.cod, φ.endR_map, hv.cod_end, φ.right]
  right_ok := by
    show S'.ok (S'.right (φ.gen L.gen)) _
    rw [φ.right]; exact φ.ok_map hv.right_ok

name: StringDiagrams.SigMap.layer_whisker
statement:
theorem layer_whisker (L : Layer S) (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour) :
    φ.layer (L.whisker u v) = (φ.layer L).whisker (φ.obj u) (φ.word v)

name: StringDiagrams.SigMap.toPresented_interchange
statement:
theorem toPresented_interchange (hodd : ∀ g, S'.odd (φ.gen g) = S.odd g)
    {x : InterchangeData S} (hx : x.Valid) :
    (freeLift R (φ.toLayerMap.toPresented Q χ)).map (InterchangeData.rel R hx) = 0
proof:
:=
  φ.toLayerMap.toPresented_interchange Q χ hx ⟨φ.region x.start, φ.gen x.g,
      φ.word x.mid, φ.gen x.h⟩
    (by simp [layer, InterchangeData.gh₁, φ.dom])
    (by simp [layer, InterchangeData.gh₂, φ.cod])
    (by simp [layer, InterchangeData.hg₁, φ.dom])
    (by simp [layer, InterchangeData.hg₂, φ.cod])
    (by simp [InterchangeData.sign, hodd])

name: StringDiagrams.SigMap.lift_obj
statement: @[simp] theorem lift_obj (a : Obj S) : (φ.lift P hodd hrel).obj (P.obj a) = Q.obj (φ.obj a)

name: StringDiagrams.SigMap.lift_diag
statement:
@[simp] theorem lift_diag {a b : Obj S} (d : a ⟶ b) :
    (φ.lift P hodd hrel).map (P.diag d) = Diagram.weight χ d • Q.diag (φ.toLayerMap.map d)

name: StringDiagrams.SigMap.lift_lin
statement:
theorem lift_lin {a b : Obj S} (f : LinDiagram R a b) :
    (φ.lift P hodd hrel).map (P.lin f) = (freeLift R (φ.toLayerMap.toPresented Q χ)).map f

name: StringDiagrams.SigMap.lift_whisk
statement:
theorem lift_whisk {a b : Obj S} (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b) {u : Obj S} {v : List S.Colour}
    (hw : a.WhiskerOK u v) :
    (φ.lift P hodd hrel).map (P.whisk f u v) =
      eqToHom (congrArg Q.obj (φ.obj_whisker a u v)) ≫
        Q.whisk ((φ.lift P hodd hrel).map f) (φ.obj u) (φ.word v) ≫
          eqToHom (congrArg Q.obj (φ.obj_whisker b u v)).symm
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, rfl⟩ := P.lin_surjective f
  rw [Presentation.whisk_lin, LinDiagram.whisk_of_ok _ hw, lift_lin, lift_lin]
  exact freeLift_map_mapDomain (F := φ.toLayerMap.toPresented Q χ)
    (G := φ.toLayerMap.toPresented Q χ) (fun d => Diagram.whisker d u v hw)
    { toFun := fun x => eqToHom (congrArg Q.obj (φ.obj_whisker a u v)) ≫
        Q.whisk x (φ.obj u) (φ.word v) ≫
          eqToHom (congrArg Q.obj (φ.obj_whisker b u v)).symm
      map_add' := fun x y => by
        simp only [Q.whisk_add, Preadditive.add_comp, Preadditive.comp_add]
      map_smul' := fun r x => by
        simp only [Q.whisk_smul, Linear.smul_comp, Linear.comp_smul, RingHom.id_apply] }
    (fun d => φ.whiskerData.toPresented_map_whisker (i := ()) Q χ d u v trivial hw) f

name: StringDiagrams.SigFlip.layer_valid
statement:
theorem layer_valid {L : Layer S} (hv : L.Valid) : (φ.layer L).Valid where
  left_ok
proof:
:= φ.ok_map hv.left_ok
  left_end := by
    show S'.endR (φ.region L.start) (φ.word L.left) = S'.left (φ.gen L.gen)
    rw [φ.endR_map, hv.left_end, φ.left]
  dom_ok := by
    show S'.ok (S'.left (φ.gen L.gen)) (S'.dom (φ.gen L.gen))
    rw [φ.left, φ.dom]; exact φ.ok_map hv.cod_ok
  dom_end := by
    show S'.endR (S'.left (φ.gen L.gen)) (S'.dom (φ.gen L.gen)) = S'.right (φ.gen L.gen)
    rw [φ.left, φ.dom, φ.endR_map, hv.cod_end, φ.right]
  cod_ok := by
    show S'.ok (S'.left (φ.gen L.gen)) (S'.cod (φ.gen L.gen))
    rw [φ.left, φ.cod]; exact φ.ok_map hv.dom_ok
  cod_end := by
    show S'.endR (S'.left (φ.gen L.gen)) (S'.cod (φ.gen L.gen)) = S'.right (φ.gen L.gen)
    rw [φ.left, φ.cod, φ.endR_map, hv.dom_end, φ.right]
  right_ok := by
    show S'.ok (S'.right (φ.gen L.gen)) _
    rw [φ.right]; exact φ.ok_map hv.right_ok

name: StringDiagrams.SigFlip.layer_whisker
statement:
theorem layer_whisker (L : Layer S) (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour) :
    φ.layer (L.whisker u v) = (φ.layer L).whisker (φ.obj u) (φ.word v)

name: StringDiagrams.SigFlip.toPresented_interchange
statement:
theorem toPresented_interchange (hodd : ∀ g, S'.odd (φ.gen g) = S.odd g)
    {x : InterchangeData S} (hx : x.Valid) :
    (freeLift R (φ.toOpLayerMap.toPresented Q χ)).map (InterchangeData.rel R hx) = 0
proof:
:=
  φ.toOpLayerMap.toPresented_interchange_reflect Q χ hx ⟨φ.region x.start, φ.gen x.g,
      φ.word x.mid, φ.gen x.h⟩
    (by simp [layer, InterchangeData.gh₂, InterchangeData.hg₁, φ.dom])
    (by simp [layer, InterchangeData.gh₁, InterchangeData.hg₂, φ.cod])
    (by simp [layer, InterchangeData.hg₂, InterchangeData.gh₁, φ.dom])
    (by simp [layer, InterchangeData.hg₁, InterchangeData.gh₂, φ.cod])
    (by simp [InterchangeData.sign, hodd])

name: StringDiagrams.SigFlip.lift_obj
statement:
@[simp] theorem lift_obj (a : Obj S) :
    (φ.lift P hodd hrel).obj (P.obj a) = op (Q.obj (φ.obj a))

name: StringDiagrams.SigFlip.lift_diag
statement:
@[simp] theorem lift_diag {a b : Obj S} (d : a ⟶ b) :
    (φ.lift P hodd hrel).map (P.diag d) =
      (Diagram.weight χ d • Q.diag (φ.toOpLayerMap.map d)).op

name: StringDiagrams.SigFlip.lift_lin
statement:
theorem lift_lin {a b : Obj S} (f : LinDiagram R a b) :
    (φ.lift P hodd hrel).map (P.lin f) = (freeLift R (φ.toOpLayerMap.toPresented Q χ)).map f

name: StringDiagrams.SigFlip.lift_whisk
statement:
theorem lift_whisk {a b : Obj S} (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b) {u : Obj S} {v : List S.Colour}
    (hw : a.WhiskerOK u v) (hb : Nonempty (a ⟶ b)) :
    ((φ.lift P hodd hrel).map (P.whisk f u v)).unop =
      eqToHom (congrArg Q.obj (φ.obj_whisker b u v)) ≫
        Q.whisk ((φ.lift P hodd hrel).map f).unop (φ.obj u) (φ.word v) ≫
          eqToHom (congrArg Q.obj (φ.obj_whisker a u v)).symm
proof:
:=
  OpLayerMap.lift_whisk (P := P) φ.whiskerData (fun _ => trivial) (fun _ => hrel)
    (fun _ _ hx => φ.toPresented_interchange Q χ hodd hx) () f trivial hw hb

name: StringDiagrams.MirrorColourMap.word_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem word_nil : κ.word [] = []

name: StringDiagrams.MirrorColourMap.word_cons
statement:
theorem word_cons (c : S.Colour) (w : List S.Colour) :
    κ.word (c :: w) = κ.word w ++ [κ.colour c]

name: StringDiagrams.MirrorColourMap.word_append
statement: theorem word_append (w w' : List S.Colour) : κ.word (w ++ w') = κ.word w' ++ κ.word w

name: StringDiagrams.MirrorColourMap.ok_word
statement:
theorem ok_word {r : S.Region} {w : List S.Colour} (h : S.ok r w) :
    S'.ok (κ.region (S.endR r w)) (κ.word w) ∧
      S'.endR (κ.region (S.endR r w)) (κ.word w) = κ.region r
proof:
:= by
  induction w generalizing r with
  | nil => exact ⟨trivial, rfl⟩
  | cons c w ih =>
    obtain ⟨hc, hw⟩ := h
    obtain ⟨ih₁, ih₂⟩ := ih hw
    rw [Signature.endR_cons, word_cons, Signature.ok_append, Signature.endR_append, ih₂]
    refine ⟨⟨ih₁, by rw [κ.colourSrc], trivial⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [Signature.endR_cons, Signature.endR_nil, κ.colourTgt, hc]

name: StringDiagrams.MirrorColourMap.obj_start
statement: @[simp] theorem obj_start (a : Obj S) : (κ.obj a).start = κ.region a.endR

name: StringDiagrams.MirrorColourMap.obj_word
statement: @[simp] theorem obj_word (a : Obj S) : (κ.obj a).word = κ.word a.word

name: StringDiagrams.MirrorColourMap.obj_endR
statement: theorem obj_endR {a : Obj S} (ha : a.WF) : (κ.obj a).endR = κ.region a.start

name: StringDiagrams.MirrorColourMap.whiskerOK
statement:
theorem whiskerOK {a u : Obj S} {v : List S.Colour} (ha : a.WF) (hw : a.WhiskerOK u v) :
    (κ.obj a).WhiskerOK (κ.leftObj a v) (κ.word u.word)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hu, hue, hv⟩ := hw
  refine ⟨(κ.ok_word hv).1, (κ.ok_word hv).2, ?_⟩
  rw [κ.obj_endR ha, ← hue]
  exact (κ.ok_word hu).1

name: StringDiagrams.MirrorColourMap.obj_whisker
statement:
theorem obj_whisker {a u : Obj S} {v : List S.Colour} (hue : u.endR = a.start) :
    (κ.obj a).whisker (κ.leftObj a v) (κ.word u.word) = κ.obj (a.whisker u v)
proof:
:= by
  refine Obj.ext ?_ ?_
  · show κ.region (S.endR a.endR v) = κ.region (S.endR u.start (u.word ++ a.word ++ v))
    rw [Signature.endR_append, Signature.endR_append]
    rw [show S.endR u.start u.word = a.start from hue]
    rfl
  · simp [Obj.whisker, leftObj, word_append, List.append_assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.SigMirror.dom'
statement: theorem dom' (g : S.Gen) : S'.dom (φ.gen g) = φ.word (S.dom g)

name: StringDiagrams.SigMirror.cod'
statement: theorem cod' (g : S.Gen) : S'.cod (φ.gen g) = φ.word (S.cod g)

name: StringDiagrams.SigMirror.layer_valid
statement: theorem layer_valid {L : Layer S} (hv : L.Valid) : (φ.layer L).Valid
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h₁, h₂, h₃, h₄, h₅, h₆, h₇⟩ := hv
  refine ⟨(φ.ok_word h₇).1, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · show S'.endR (φ.region (S.endR (S.right L.gen) L.right)) (φ.word L.right) =
      S'.left (φ.gen L.gen)
    rw [(φ.ok_word h₇).2, φ.left]
  · show S'.ok (S'.left (φ.gen L.gen)) (S'.dom (φ.gen L.gen))
    rw [φ.left, φ.dom', ← h₄]; exact (φ.ok_word h₃).1
  · show S'.endR (S'.left (φ.gen L.gen)) (S'.dom (φ.gen L.gen)) = S'.right (φ.gen L.gen)
    rw [φ.left, φ.dom', φ.right, ← h₄]; exact (φ.ok_word h₃).2
  · show S'.ok (S'.left (φ.gen L.gen)) (S'.cod (φ.gen L.gen))
    rw [φ.left, φ.cod', ← h₆]; exact (φ.ok_word h₅).1
  · show S'.endR (S'.left (φ.gen L.gen)) (S'.cod (φ.gen L.gen)) = S'.right (φ.gen L.gen)
    rw [φ.left, φ.cod', φ.right, ← h₆]; exact (φ.ok_word h₅).2
  · show S'.ok (S'.right (φ.gen L.gen)) (φ.word L.left)
    rw [φ.right, ← h₂]; exact (φ.ok_word h₁).1

name: StringDiagrams.SigMirror.layer_dom
statement: theorem layer_dom {L : Layer S} (hv : L.Valid) : (φ.layer L).dom = φ.obj L.dom
proof:
:= by
  refine Obj.ext ?_ ?_
  · show φ.region (S.endR (S.right L.gen) L.right) = φ.region L.dom.endR
    rw [hv.endR_dom]
  · simp [layer, MirrorColourMap.obj, Layer.dom, φ.dom', MirrorColourMap.word_append,
      List.append_assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.SigMirror.layer_cod
statement: theorem layer_cod {L : Layer S} (hv : L.Valid) : (φ.layer L).cod = φ.obj L.cod
proof:
:= by
  refine Obj.ext ?_ ?_
  · show φ.region (S.endR (S.right L.gen) L.right) = φ.region L.cod.endR
    rw [hv.endR_cod]
  · simp [layer, MirrorColourMap.obj, Layer.cod, φ.cod', MirrorColourMap.word_append,
      List.append_assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.SigMirror.layer_whisker
statement:
theorem layer_whisker {L : Layer S} (hv : L.Valid) (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour) :
    φ.layer (L.whisker u v) = (φ.layer L).whisker (φ.leftObj L.dom v) (φ.word u.word)
proof:
:= by
  refine Layer.ext ?_ ?_ rfl ?_
  · show φ.region (S.endR (S.right L.gen) (L.right ++ v)) = φ.region (S.endR L.dom.endR v)
    rw [Signature.endR_append, hv.endR_dom]
  · simp [layer, Layer.whisker, MirrorColourMap.leftObj, MirrorColourMap.word_append]
  · simp [layer, Layer.whisker, MirrorColourMap.word_append]

name: StringDiagrams.SigMirror.toPresented_interchange
statement:
theorem toPresented_interchange (hodd : ∀ g, S'.odd (φ.gen g) = S.odd g)
    {x : InterchangeData S} (hx : x.Valid) :
    (freeLift R (φ.toLayerMap.toPresented Q χ)).map (InterchangeData.rel R hx) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have e₀ : S.endR (S.right x.g) x.mid = S.left x.h := by
    have h₀ := hx.gh₁.left_end
    have h₁ := hx.hg₁.left_end
    have h₂ := hx.gh₁.dom_end
    simp only [InterchangeData.hg₁, InterchangeData.gh₁, Signature.endR_append,
      Signature.endR_nil] at h₀ h₁ h₂
    rwa [h₀, h₂] at h₁
  have e₁ : S.endR (S.right x.g) (x.mid ++ S.dom x.h) = S.right x.h := by
    rw [Signature.endR_append, e₀]; exact hx.hg₁.dom_end
  have e₂ : S.endR (S.right x.g) (x.mid ++ S.cod x.h) = S.right x.h := by
    rw [Signature.endR_append, e₀]; exact hx.hg₁.cod_end
  refine φ.toLayerMap.toPresented_interchange_swap Q χ hx
    ⟨φ.region (S.right x.h), φ.gen x.h, φ.word x.mid, φ.gen x.g⟩ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · refine Layer.ext (by simp [layer, InterchangeData.gh₁, InterchangeData.hg₁, e₁]) ?_ rfl ?_
    · simp [layer, InterchangeData.gh₁, InterchangeData.hg₁, φ.dom',
        MirrorColourMap.word_append]
    · rfl
  · refine Layer.ext rfl ?_ rfl ?_
    · rfl
    · simp [layer, InterchangeData.gh₂, InterchangeData.hg₂, φ.cod',
        MirrorColourMap.word_append]
  · refine Layer.ext rfl ?_ rfl ?_
    · rfl
    · simp [layer, InterchangeData.hg₁, InterchangeData.gh₁, φ.dom',
        MirrorColourMap.word_append]
  · refine Layer.ext (by simp [layer, InterchangeData.hg₂, InterchangeData.gh₂, e₂]) ?_ rfl ?_
    · simp [layer, InterchangeData.hg₂, InterchangeData.gh₂, φ.cod',
        MirrorColourMap.word_append]
    · rfl
  · simp [InterchangeData.sign, hodd, Bool.and_comm]

name: StringDiagrams.SigMirror.lift_obj
statement:
@[simp] theorem lift_obj (a : Obj S) :
    (φ.lift P hodd hwf hrel).obj (P.obj a) = Q.obj (φ.obj a)

name: StringDiagrams.SigMirror.lift_diag
statement:
@[simp] theorem lift_diag {a b : Obj S} (d : a ⟶ b) :
    (φ.lift P hodd hwf hrel).map (P.diag d) = Diagram.weight χ d • Q.diag (φ.toLayerMap.map d)

name: StringDiagrams.SigMirror.lift_lin
statement:
theorem lift_lin {a b : Obj S} (f : LinDiagram R a b) :
    (φ.lift P hodd hwf hrel).map (P.lin f) = (freeLift R (φ.toLayerMap.toPresented Q χ)).map f

name: StringDiagrams.SigMirror.lift_whisk
statement:
theorem lift_whisk {a b : Obj S} (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b) {u : Obj S} {v : List S.Colour}
    (ha : a.WF) (hw : a.WhiskerOK u v) (hb : Nonempty (a ⟶ b)) :
    (φ.lift P hodd hwf hrel).map (P.whisk f u v) =
      eqToHom (congrArg Q.obj (φ.whiskerData.obj_whisker (i := ()) ha hw ⟨𝟙 a⟩).symm) ≫
        Q.whisk ((φ.lift P hodd hwf hrel).map f) (φ.leftObj a v) (φ.word u.word) ≫
          eqToHom (congrArg Q.obj (φ.whiskerData.obj_whisker (i := ()) ha hw hb))
proof:
:=
  LayerMap.lift_whisk (P := P) φ.whiskerData hwf (fun _ => hrel)
    (fun _ _ hx => φ.toPresented_interchange Q χ hodd hx) () f ha hw hb

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.oddCountList_map
statement:
theorem Diagram.oddCountList_map {S' : Signature.{u₀', u₁', u₂'}} (f : Layer S → Layer S')
    (ls : List (Layer S)) (h : ∀ L ∈ ls, S'.odd (f L).gen = S.odd L.gen) :
    Diagram.oddCountList (ls.map f) = Diagram.oddCountList ls
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Diagram.oddCountList, List.filter_map, List.length_map]
  congr 1
  exact List.filter_congr fun L hL => by simp [h L hL]

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.oddCountList_reverse
statement:
theorem Diagram.oddCountList_reverse (ls : List (Layer S)) :
    Diagram.oddCountList ls.reverse = Diagram.oddCountList ls

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.diag_interchange_of_composable_symm
statement:
theorem diag_interchange_of_composable_symm {a a' b b' : Obj S} (f : a ⟶ a') (g : b ⟶ b')
    (h : a.Composable b) (h₁ : a'.Composable b) (h₂ : a.Composable b') :
    P.diag (Diagram.lwhisker a g h ≫ Diagram.rwhisker f b' h₂) =
      ((-1 : ℤ) ^ (Diagram.oddCount f * Diagram.oddCount g)) •
        P.diag (Diagram.rwhisker f b h ≫ Diagram.lwhisker a' g h₁)
proof:
:= by
  rw [P.diag_interchange_of_composable' f g h h₁ h₂, smul_smul, ← pow_add, ← two_mul,
    pow_mul, neg_one_sq, one_pow, one_smul]

name: StringDiagrams.ColourMap.obj_tensor
statement: theorem obj_tensor (a b : Obj S) : κ.obj (a.tensor b) = (κ.obj a).tensor (κ.obj b)

name: StringDiagrams.ColourMap.composable
statement: theorem composable {a b : Obj S} (h : a.Composable b) : (κ.obj a).Composable (κ.obj b)
proof:
:=
  ⟨κ.ok_map h.left_wf, by rw [obj_endR, h.endR_eq]; rfl, κ.ok_map h.right_wf⟩

name: StringDiagrams.SigMap.map_rwhisker
statement:
theorem map_rwhisker {a a' : Obj S} (f : a ⟶ a') (b : Obj S) (h : a.Composable b) :
    φ.toLayerMap.map (Diagram.rwhisker f b h) =
      Diagram.cast (Diagram.rwhisker (φ.toLayerMap.map f) (φ.obj b) (φ.composable h))
        (φ.obj_tensor a b).symm (φ.obj_tensor a' b).symm

name: StringDiagrams.SigMap.map_lwhisker
statement:
theorem map_lwhisker (a : Obj S) {b b' : Obj S} (g : b ⟶ b') (h : a.Composable b) :
    φ.toLayerMap.map (Diagram.lwhisker a g h) =
      Diagram.cast (Diagram.lwhisker (φ.obj a) (φ.toLayerMap.map g) (φ.composable h))
        (φ.obj_tensor a b).symm (φ.obj_tensor a b').symm

name: StringDiagrams.SigMap.map_tensor
statement:
theorem map_tensor {a a' b b' : Obj S} (f : a ⟶ a') (g : b ⟶ b') (h : a.Composable b) :
    φ.toLayerMap.map (Diagram.rwhisker f b h ≫ Diagram.lwhisker a' g (h.map_left f)) =
      Diagram.cast (Diagram.rwhisker (φ.toLayerMap.map f) (φ.obj b) (φ.composable h) ≫
          Diagram.lwhisker (φ.obj a') (φ.toLayerMap.map g) (φ.composable (h.map_left f)))
        (φ.obj_tensor a b).symm (φ.obj_tensor a' b').symm
proof:
:=
  Diagram.ext (by simp [layer, Layer.wl, Layer.wr, ColourMap.obj, Function.comp_def])

name: StringDiagrams.SigFlip.map_rwhisker
statement:
theorem map_rwhisker {a a' : Obj S} (f : a ⟶ a') (b : Obj S) (h : a.Composable b) :
    φ.toOpLayerMap.map (Diagram.rwhisker f b h) =
      Diagram.cast (Diagram.rwhisker (φ.toOpLayerMap.map f) (φ.obj b)
          (φ.composable (h.map_left f)))
        (φ.obj_tensor a' b).symm (φ.obj_tensor a b).symm
proof:
:=
  Diagram.ext (by simp [layer, Layer.wr, ColourMap.obj, Function.comp_def, List.map_reverse])

name: StringDiagrams.SigFlip.map_lwhisker
statement:
theorem map_lwhisker (a : Obj S) {b b' : Obj S} (g : b ⟶ b') (h : a.Composable b) :
    φ.toOpLayerMap.map (Diagram.lwhisker a g h) =
      Diagram.cast (Diagram.lwhisker (φ.obj a) (φ.toOpLayerMap.map g)
          (φ.composable (h.map_right g)))
        (φ.obj_tensor a b').symm (φ.obj_tensor a b).symm
proof:
:=
  Diagram.ext (by simp [layer, Layer.wl, ColourMap.obj, Function.comp_def, List.map_reverse])

name: StringDiagrams.SigFlip.oddCount_map
statement:
theorem oddCount_map (hodd : ∀ g, S'.odd (φ.gen g) = S.odd g) {a b : Obj S} (d : a ⟶ b) :
    Diagram.oddCount (φ.toOpLayerMap.map d) = Diagram.oddCount d
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Diagram.oddCount, OpLayerMap.layers_map, Diagram.oddCountList_reverse]
  exact Diagram.oddCountList_map _ _ fun L _ => hodd L.gen

name: StringDiagrams.SigFlip.diag_map_tensor
statement:
theorem diag_map_tensor (hodd : ∀ g, S'.odd (φ.gen g) = S.odd g) {a a' b b' : Obj S}
    (f : a ⟶ a') (g : b ⟶ b') (h : a.Composable b) :
    Q.diag (φ.toOpLayerMap.map (Diagram.rwhisker f b h ≫ Diagram.lwhisker a' g (h.map_left f))) =
      ((-1 : ℤ) ^ (Diagram.oddCount f * Diagram.oddCount g)) •
        (eqToHom (congrArg Q.obj (φ.obj_tensor a' b')) ≫
          Q.diag (Diagram.rwhisker (φ.toOpLayerMap.map f) (φ.obj b')
              (φ.composable ((h.map_left f).map_right g)) ≫
            Diagram.lwhisker (φ.obj a) (φ.toOpLayerMap.map g) (φ.composable (h.map_right g))) ≫
          eqToHom (congrArg Q.obj (φ.obj_tensor a b)).symm)
proof:
:= by
  have key := Q.diag_interchange_of_composable_symm (φ.toOpLayerMap.map f)
    (φ.toOpLayerMap.map g) (φ.composable ((h.map_left f).map_right g))
    (φ.composable (h.map_right g)) (φ.composable (h.map_left f))
  rw [φ.oddCount_map hodd, φ.oddCount_map hodd] at key
  rw [OpLayerMap.map_comp, φ.map_rwhisker, φ.map_lwhisker, Q.diag_comp, Q.diag_cast,
    Q.diag_cast]
  simp only [Category.assoc, eqToHom_trans_assoc, eqToHom_refl, Category.id_comp]
  rw [← Category.assoc (Q.diag _) (Q.diag _), ← Q.diag_comp]
  erw [key]
  rw [Linear.smul_comp, Linear.comp_smul]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.MirrorColourMap.obj_tensor
statement:
theorem obj_tensor {a b : Obj S} (h : a.Composable b) :
    κ.obj (a.tensor b) = (κ.obj b).tensor (κ.obj a)
proof:
:= by
  refine Obj.ext ?_ ?_
  · show κ.region (S.endR a.start (a.word ++ b.word)) = κ.region b.endR
    rw [Signature.endR_append]
    exact congrArg (fun r => κ.region (S.endR r b.word)) h.endR_eq
  · simp [obj, Obj.tensor, word_append]

name: StringDiagrams.MirrorColourMap.composable
statement: theorem composable {a b : Obj S} (h : a.Composable b) : (κ.obj b).Composable (κ.obj a)
proof:
:=
  ⟨(κ.ok_word h.right_wf).1, by rw [κ.obj_endR h.right_wf, ← h.endR_eq]; rfl,
    (κ.ok_word h.left_wf).1⟩

name: StringDiagrams.SigMirror.map_rwhisker
statement:
theorem map_rwhisker {a a' : Obj S} (f : a ⟶ a') (b : Obj S) (h : a.Composable b) :
    φ.toLayerMap.map (Diagram.rwhisker f b h) =
      Diagram.cast (Diagram.lwhisker (φ.obj b) (φ.toLayerMap.map f) (φ.composable h))
        (φ.obj_tensor h).symm (φ.obj_tensor (h.map_left f)).symm
proof:
:= by
  apply Diagram.ext
  simp only [LayerMap.layers_map, Diagram.layers_rwhisker, Diagram.layers_cast,
    Diagram.layers_lwhisker, List.map_map]
  refine List.map_congr_left fun L hL => ?_
  have hv := (Diagram.chain f).valid_of_mem hL
  obtain ⟨d⟩ := (Diagram.chain f).nonempty_of_mem hL
  refine Layer.ext ?_ ?_ rfl rfl
  · show φ.region (S.endR (S.right L.gen) (L.right ++ b.word)) = φ.region b.endR
    rw [Signature.endR_append, ← hv.endR_dom, (Diagram.chain d).endR_eq, h.endR_eq]
    rfl
  · simp [layer, Layer.wr, Layer.wl, MirrorColourMap.obj, MirrorColourMap.word_append]

name: StringDiagrams.SigMirror.map_lwhisker
statement:
theorem map_lwhisker (a : Obj S) {b b' : Obj S} (g : b ⟶ b') (h : a.Composable b) :
    φ.toLayerMap.map (Diagram.lwhisker a g h) =
      Diagram.cast (Diagram.rwhisker (φ.toLayerMap.map g) (φ.obj a) (φ.composable h))
        (φ.obj_tensor h).symm (φ.obj_tensor (h.map_right g)).symm
proof:
:=
  Diagram.ext (by
    simp [layer, Layer.wr, Layer.wl, MirrorColourMap.obj, MirrorColourMap.word_append,
      Function.comp_def])

name: StringDiagrams.SigMirror.oddCount_map
statement:
theorem oddCount_map (hodd : ∀ g, S'.odd (φ.gen g) = S.odd g) {a b : Obj S} (d : a ⟶ b) :
    Diagram.oddCount (φ.toLayerMap.map d) = Diagram.oddCount d
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Diagram.oddCount, LayerMap.layers_map]
  exact Diagram.oddCountList_map _ _ fun L _ => hodd L.gen

name: StringDiagrams.SigMirror.diag_map_tensor
statement:
theorem diag_map_tensor (hodd : ∀ g, S'.odd (φ.gen g) = S.odd g) {a a' b b' : Obj S}
    (f : a ⟶ a') (g : b ⟶ b') (h : a.Composable b) :
    Q.diag (φ.toLayerMap.map (Diagram.rwhisker f b h ≫ Diagram.lwhisker a' g (h.map_left f))) =
      ((-1 : ℤ) ^ (Diagram.oddCount f * Diagram.oddCount g)) •
        (eqToHom (congrArg Q.obj (φ.obj_tensor h)) ≫
          Q.diag (Diagram.rwhisker (φ.toLayerMap.map g) (φ.obj a) (φ.composable h) ≫
            Diagram.lwhisker (φ.obj b') (φ.toLayerMap.map f) (φ.composable (h.map_right g))) ≫
          eqToHom (congrArg Q.obj (φ.obj_tensor ((h.map_left f).map_right g))).symm)
proof:
:= by
  have key := Q.diag_interchange_of_composable_symm (φ.toLayerMap.map g)
    (φ.toLayerMap.map f) (φ.composable h) (φ.composable (h.map_right g))
    (φ.composable (h.map_left f))
  rw [φ.oddCount_map hodd, φ.oddCount_map hodd, mul_comm] at key
  rw [LayerMap.map_comp, φ.map_rwhisker, φ.map_lwhisker, Q.diag_comp, Q.diag_cast,
    Q.diag_cast]
  simp only [Category.assoc, eqToHom_trans_assoc, eqToHom_refl, Category.id_comp]
  rw [← Category.assoc (Q.diag _) (Q.diag _), ← Q.diag_comp]
  erw [key]
  rw [Linear.smul_comp, Linear.comp_smul]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.MatEnd.ext
statement: @[ext] theorem ext {f g : MatEnd X} (h : ∀ i j, f i j = g i j) : f = g
proof:
:=
  funext fun i => funext fun j => h i j

name: StringDiagrams.MatEnd.add_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem add_apply (f g : MatEnd X) (i j : ι) : (f + g) i j = f i j + g i j

name: StringDiagrams.MatEnd.sub_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem sub_apply (f g : MatEnd X) (i j : ι) : (f - g) i j = f i j - g i j

name: StringDiagrams.MatEnd.neg_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem neg_apply (f : MatEnd X) (i j : ι) : (-f) i j = -f i j

name: StringDiagrams.MatEnd.zero_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem zero_apply (i j : ι) : (0 : MatEnd X) i j = 0

name: StringDiagrams.MatEnd.smul_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem smul_apply [CategoryTheory.Linear R C] (r : R) (f : MatEnd X) (i j : ι) :
    (r • f) i j = r • f i j

name: StringDiagrams.MatEnd.sum_apply
statement:
theorem sum_apply {α : Type*} (s : Finset α) (f : α → MatEnd X) (i j : ι) :
    (∑ a ∈ s, f a) i j = ∑ a ∈ s, f a i j
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.cons_induction with
  | empty => rfl
  | cons a s ha ih => rw [Finset.sum_cons, Finset.sum_cons, add_apply, ih]

name: StringDiagrams.MatEnd.entry_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem entry_apply [CategoryTheory.Linear R C] (i j : ι) (f : MatEnd X) :
    entry R i j f = f i j

name: StringDiagrams.MatEnd.single_apply_self
statement: @[simp] theorem single_apply_self (i j : ι) (f : X i ⟶ X j) : single i j f i j = f

name: StringDiagrams.MatEnd.single_apply_of_ne
statement:
theorem single_apply_of_ne {i j i' j' : ι} (f : X i ⟶ X j) (h : ¬ (i' = i ∧ j' = j)) :
    single i j f i' j' = 0

name: StringDiagrams.MatEnd.single_apply
statement:
theorem single_apply (i j : ι) (f : X i ⟶ X j) (i' j' : ι) :
    single i j f i' j' = if h : i' = i ∧ j' = j then
      eqToHom (congrArg X h.1) ≫ f ≫ eqToHom (congrArg X h.2.symm) else 0

name: StringDiagrams.MatEnd.single_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem single_zero (i j : ι) : single i j (0 : X i ⟶ X j) = 0

name: StringDiagrams.MatEnd.single_add
statement:
theorem single_add (i j : ι) (f g : X i ⟶ X j) :
    single i j (f + g) = single i j f + single i j g
proof:
:= by
  ext i' j'; simp only [single_apply, add_apply]; split_ifs <;> simp

name: StringDiagrams.MatEnd.single_sub
statement:
theorem single_sub (i j : ι) (f g : X i ⟶ X j) :
    single i j (f - g) = single i j f - single i j g
proof:
:= by
  ext i' j'; simp only [single_apply, sub_apply]; split_ifs <;> simp

name: StringDiagrams.MatEnd.single_neg
statement: theorem single_neg (i j : ι) (f : X i ⟶ X j) : single i j (-f) = -single i j f
proof:
:= by
  ext i' j'; simp only [single_apply, neg_apply]; split_ifs <;> simp

name: StringDiagrams.MatEnd.single_smul
statement:
theorem single_smul [CategoryTheory.Linear R C] (i j : ι) (r : R) (f : X i ⟶ X j) :
    single i j (r • f) = r • single i j f
proof:
:= by
  ext i' j'; simp only [single_apply, smul_apply]; split_ifs <;> simp

name: StringDiagrams.MatEnd.single_sum
statement:
theorem single_sum {α : Type*} (s : Finset α) (i j : ι) (f : α → (X i ⟶ X j)) :
    single i j (∑ a ∈ s, f a) = ∑ a ∈ s, single i j (f a)
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.cons_induction with
  | empty => simp
  | cons a s ha ih => rw [Finset.sum_cons, Finset.sum_cons, single_add, ih]

name: StringDiagrams.MatEnd.singleₗ_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem singleₗ_apply [CategoryTheory.Linear R C] (i j : ι) (f : X i ⟶ X j) :
    singleₗ R i j f = single i j f

name: StringDiagrams.MatEnd.single_eqToHom
statement:
theorem single_eqToHom {i j j' : ι} (f : X i ⟶ X j) (h : j = j') :
    single i j' (f ≫ eqToHom (congrArg X h)) = single i j f

name: StringDiagrams.MatEnd.single_eqToHom_left
statement:
theorem single_eqToHom_left {i i' j : ι} (f : X i ⟶ X j) (h : i' = i) :
    single i' j (eqToHom (congrArg X h) ≫ f) = single i j f

name: StringDiagrams.MatEnd.one_apply
statement:
theorem one_apply (i j : ι) :
    (1 : MatEnd X) i j = if h : i = j then eqToHom (congrArg X h) else 0

name: StringDiagrams.MatEnd.one_apply_self
statement: @[simp] theorem one_apply_self (i : ι) : (1 : MatEnd X) i i = 𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.MatEnd.one_apply_of_ne
statement: theorem one_apply_of_ne {i j : ι} (h : i ≠ j) : (1 : MatEnd X) i j = 0

name: StringDiagrams.MatEnd.mul_apply
statement: theorem mul_apply (f g : MatEnd X) (i l : ι) : (f * g) i l = ∑ j, g i j ≫ f j l

name: StringDiagrams.MatEnd.mul_assoc'
statement: private theorem mul_assoc' (f g h : MatEnd X) : f * g * h = f * (g * h)
proof:
:= by
  ext i l
  simp only [mul_apply, comp_sum, sum_comp, Category.assoc]
  exact Finset.sum_comm

name: StringDiagrams.MatEnd.one_mul'
statement: private theorem one_mul' (f : MatEnd X) : 1 * f = f
proof:
:= by
  ext i l
  simp only [mul_apply, one_apply, comp_dite, Limits.comp_zero]
  rw [Finset.sum_dite_eq' Finset.univ l]
  simp

name: StringDiagrams.MatEnd.mul_one'
statement: private theorem mul_one' (f : MatEnd X) : f * 1 = f
proof:
:= by
  ext i l
  simp only [mul_apply, one_apply, dite_comp, Limits.zero_comp]
  rw [Finset.sum_dite_eq Finset.univ i]
  simp

name: StringDiagrams.MatEnd.single_mul_single
statement:
theorem single_mul_single (i j l : ι) (f : X i ⟶ X j) (g : X j ⟶ X l) :
    single j l g * single i j f = single i l (f ≫ g)
proof:
:= by
  ext i' l'
  rw [mul_apply]
  by_cases hi : i' = i
  · subst hi
    by_cases hl : l' = l
    · subst hl
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single j]
      · simp
      · intro j' _ hj'; rw [single_apply_of_ne _ (fun h => hj' h.2), Limits.zero_comp]
      · simp
    · rw [single_apply_of_ne _ (fun h => hl h.2)]
      exact Finset.sum_eq_zero fun j' _ => by
        rw [single_apply_of_ne (i' := j') (j' := l') g (fun h => hl h.2), Limits.comp_zero]
  · rw [single_apply_of_ne _ (fun h => hi h.1)]
    exact Finset.sum_eq_zero fun j' _ => by
      rw [single_apply_of_ne (i' := i') f (fun h => hi h.1), Limits.zero_comp]

name: StringDiagrams.MatEnd.single_mul_single_of_ne
statement:
theorem single_mul_single_of_ne {i j j' l : ι} (f : X i ⟶ X j) (g : X j' ⟶ X l) (h : j ≠ j') :
    single j' l g * single i j f = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext i' l'
  rw [mul_apply, zero_apply]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun m _ => ?_
  by_cases hm : m = j
  · subst hm; rw [single_apply_of_ne (i' := m) g (fun h' => h h'.1), Limits.comp_zero]
  · rw [single_apply_of_ne (j' := m) f (fun h' => hm h'.2), Limits.zero_comp]

name: StringDiagrams.MatEnd.one_eq_sum_single
statement: theorem one_eq_sum_single : (1 : MatEnd X) = ∑ i, single i i (𝟙 (X i))
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  rw [sum_apply, Finset.sum_eq_single i]
  · by_cases h : i = j
    · subst h; simp
    · rw [one_apply_of_ne h, single_apply_of_ne _ (fun h' => h h'.2.symm)]
  · intro b _ hb; exact single_apply_of_ne _ (fun h => hb h.1.symm)
  · simp

name: StringDiagrams.MatEnd.eq_sum_single
statement: theorem eq_sum_single (f : MatEnd X) : f = ∑ i, ∑ j, single i j (f i j)
proof:
:= by
  ext i' j'
  rw [sum_apply, Finset.sum_eq_single i', sum_apply, Finset.sum_eq_single j']
  · simp
  · intro b _ hb; exact single_apply_of_ne _ (fun h => hb h.2.symm)
  · simp
  · intro b _ hb
    rw [sum_apply]
    exact Finset.sum_eq_zero fun c _ => single_apply_of_ne _ (fun h => hb h.1.symm)
  · simp

name: StringDiagrams.MatEnd.idem_mul_idem
statement: theorem idem_mul_idem (i : ι) : (idem i : MatEnd X) * idem i = idem i

name: StringDiagrams.MatEnd.isIdempotentElem_idem
statement: theorem isIdempotentElem_idem (i : ι) : IsIdempotentElem (idem i : MatEnd X)

name: StringDiagrams.MatEnd.idem_mul_idem_of_ne
statement: theorem idem_mul_idem_of_ne {i j : ι} (h : i ≠ j) : (idem i : MatEnd X) * idem j = 0

name: StringDiagrams.MatEnd.sum_idem
statement: theorem sum_idem : ∑ i, (idem i : MatEnd X) = 1

name: StringDiagrams.MatEnd.idem_mul_mul_idem
statement:
theorem idem_mul_mul_idem (f : MatEnd X) (i j : ι) :
    idem j * f * idem i = single i j (f i j)
proof:
:= by
  ext i' j'
  simp only [mul_apply, single_apply]
  by_cases hi : i' = i
  · subst hi
    by_cases hj : j' = j
    · subst hj
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i', Finset.sum_eq_single j'] <;>
        simp +contextual [Ne.symm]
    · simp [hj]
  · simp [hi]

name: StringDiagrams.MatEnd.single_mul
statement:
theorem single_mul {i j : ι} (f : X i ⟶ X j) (g : MatEnd X) (i' l : ι) :
    (g * single i j f) i' l = if h : i' = i then eqToHom (congrArg X h) ≫ f ≫ g j l else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_apply, Finset.sum_eq_single j]
  · by_cases h : i' = i
    · subst h; simp
    · simp [single_apply, h]
  · intro b _ hb; rw [single_apply_of_ne _ (fun h => hb h.2), Limits.zero_comp]
  · simp

name: StringDiagrams.MatEnd.mul_single
statement:
theorem mul_single {j l : ι} (f : X j ⟶ X l) (g : MatEnd X) (i l' : ι) :
    (single j l f * g) i l' = if h : l' = l then g i j ≫ f ≫ eqToHom (congrArg X h.symm) else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_apply, Finset.sum_eq_single j]
  · by_cases h : l' = l
    · subst h; simp
    · simp [single_apply, h]
  · intro b _ hb; rw [single_apply_of_ne _ (fun h => hb h.1), Limits.comp_zero]
  · simp

name: StringDiagrams.MatEnd.map_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem map_apply (F : C ⥤ D) [F.Additive] [F.Linear R] (f : MatEnd X) (i j : ι) :
    map R F X f i j = F.map (f i j)

name: StringDiagrams.MatEnd.map_single
statement:
theorem map_single (F : C ⥤ D) [F.Additive] [F.Linear R] (i j : ι) (f : X i ⟶ X j) :
    map R F X (single i j f) = single i j (F.map f)
proof:
:= by
  ext i' j'
  rw [map_apply]
  by_cases h : i' = i ∧ j' = j
  · obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := h; simp
  · rw [single_apply_of_ne _ h, single_apply_of_ne _ h, F.map_zero]

name: StringDiagrams.MatEnd.biproductAlgEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem biproductAlgEquiv_apply (f : End (⨁ Y)) (i j : J) :
    biproductAlgEquiv R Y f i j = biproduct.ι Y i ≫ f ≫ biproduct.π Y j

name: StringDiagrams.MatEnd.biproductAlgEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
theorem biproductAlgEquiv_symm_apply (m : MatEnd Y) :
    (biproductAlgEquiv R Y).symm m = ∑ i, ∑ j, biproduct.π Y i ≫ m i j ≫ biproduct.ι Y j

name: StringDiagrams.MatEnd.biproductAlgEquiv_π_ι
statement:
theorem biproductAlgEquiv_π_ι (i : J) :
    biproductAlgEquiv R Y (biproduct.π Y i ≫ biproduct.ι Y i) = idem i
proof:
:= by
  ext i' j'
  rw [biproductAlgEquiv_apply, idem, single_apply]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  by_cases h : i' = i ∧ j' = i
  · obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := h; simp
  · rw [dite_eq_right h]
    by_cases hi : i' = i
    · subst hi
      rw [biproduct.ι_π_self_assoc, biproduct.ι_π_ne _ (fun e => h ⟨rfl, e.symm⟩)]
    · rw [biproduct.ι_π_ne_assoc Y hi, Limits.zero_comp]

name: StringDiagrams.MatEnd.blockMapₗ_apply
statement:
theorem blockMapₗ_apply (T : BlockTransport R e Y Z) (φ : ∀ t, A →ₐ[R] MatEnd (Y t)) (r : A) :
    blockMapₗ T φ r = ∑ t, ∑ i, ∑ j, single (e (t, i)) (e (t, j)) (T.F t i j (φ t r i j))

name: StringDiagrams.MatEnd.blockMapₗ_one
statement:
theorem blockMapₗ_one (T : BlockTransport R e Y Z) (φ : ∀ t, A →ₐ[R] MatEnd (Y t)) :
    blockMapₗ T φ 1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [blockMapₗ_apply, one_eq_sum_single]
  have h1 : ∀ t i j, single (e (t, i)) (e (t, j)) (T.F t i j ((φ t 1) i j)) =
      if i = j then single (e (t, i)) (e (t, i)) (𝟙 _) else 0 := by
    intro t i j
    rw [map_one]
    split_ifs with h
    · subst h; rw [one_apply_self, T.map_id]
    · rw [one_apply_of_ne h, map_zero, single_zero]
  simp only [h1, Finset.sum_ite_eq, Finset.mem_univ, ite_true]
  rw [← Fintype.sum_prod_type', ← e.sum_comp]

name: StringDiagrams.MatEnd.blockMapₗ_mul
statement:
theorem blockMapₗ_mul (T : BlockTransport R e Y Z) (φ : ∀ t, A →ₐ[R] MatEnd (Y t))
    (r r' : A) : blockMapₗ T φ (r * r') = blockMapₗ T φ r * blockMapₗ T φ r'
proof:
:= by
  simp only [blockMapₗ_apply, Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun t _ => ?_
  have hcol : ∀ i m, ∑ t', ∑ i', ∑ j', single (e (t', i')) (e (t', j'))
      (T.F t' i' j' (φ t' r i' j')) * single (e (t, i)) (e (t, m)) (T.F t i m (φ t r' i m)) =
      ∑ j, single (e (t, i)) (e (t, j)) (T.F t i m (φ t r' i m) ≫ T.F t m j (φ t r m j)) := by
    intro i m
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single t]
    · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single m]
      · exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => single_mul_single _ _ _ _ _
      · intro i' _ hi'
        exact Finset.sum_eq_zero fun j' _ => single_mul_single_of_ne _ _
          (fun h => hi' (Prod.ext_iff.1 (e.injective h)).2.symm)
      · simp
    · intro t' _ ht'
      refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i' _ => Finset.sum_eq_zero fun j' _ => ?_
      exact single_mul_single_of_ne _ _ (fun h => ht' (Prod.ext_iff.1 (e.injective h)).1.symm)
    · simp
  simp only [hcol]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
  rw [map_mul, mul_apply, map_sum, single_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun m _ => ?_
  rw [T.map_comp]

name: StringDiagrams.MatEnd.blockMap_apply
statement:
theorem blockMap_apply (T : BlockTransport R e Y Z) (φ : ∀ t, A →ₐ[R] MatEnd (Y t)) (r : A) :
    blockMap T φ r = ∑ t, ∑ i, ∑ j, single (e (t, i)) (e (t, j)) (T.F t i j (φ t r i j))

name: StringDiagrams.MatEnd.blockMap_apply_block
statement:
theorem blockMap_apply_block (T : BlockTransport R e Y Z) (φ : ∀ t, A →ₐ[R] MatEnd (Y t))
    (r : A) (t : κ) (i j : ι') :
    blockMap T φ r (e (t, i)) (e (t, j)) = T.F t i j (φ t r i j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [blockMap_apply, sum_apply, Finset.sum_eq_single t]
  · rw [sum_apply, Finset.sum_eq_single i]
    · rw [sum_apply, Finset.sum_eq_single j]
      · exact single_apply_self _ _ _
      · intro j' _ hj'
        exact single_apply_of_ne _ (fun h => hj' (Prod.ext_iff.1 (e.injective h.2.symm)).2)
      · simp
    · intro i' _ hi'
      rw [sum_apply]
      exact Finset.sum_eq_zero fun j' _ =>
        single_apply_of_ne _ (fun h => hi' (Prod.ext_iff.1 (e.injective h.1.symm)).2)
    · simp
  · intro t' _ ht'
    rw [sum_apply]
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i' _ => ?_
    rw [sum_apply]
    exact Finset.sum_eq_zero fun j' _ =>
      single_apply_of_ne _ (fun h => ht' (Prod.ext_iff.1 (e.injective h.1.symm)).1)
  · simp

name: StringDiagrams.MatEnd.blockMap_apply_ne
statement:
theorem blockMap_apply_ne (T : BlockTransport R e Y Z) (φ : ∀ t, A →ₐ[R] MatEnd (Y t))
    (r : A) {t t' : κ} (i j : ι') (h : t ≠ t') :
    blockMap T φ r (e (t, i)) (e (t', j)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [blockMap_apply, sum_apply]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun t'' _ => ?_
  rw [sum_apply]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i' _ => ?_
  rw [sum_apply]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun j' _ => single_apply_of_ne _ fun hh => h ?_
  have h1 := (Prod.ext_iff.1 (e.injective hh.1)).1
  have h2 := (Prod.ext_iff.1 (e.injective hh.2)).1
  exact h1.trans h2.symm

name: StringDiagrams.MatEnd.blockMap_eq_of_idem
statement:
theorem blockMap_eq_of_idem (T : BlockTransport R e Y Z) (φ : ∀ t, A →ₐ[R] MatEnd (Y t))
    (r : A) (i : ι') (h : ∀ t, φ t r = idem i) :
    blockMap T φ r = ∑ t, idem (e (t, i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [blockMap_apply]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun t _ => ?_
  rw [h t, idem, Finset.sum_eq_single i]
  · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]
    · rw [single_apply_self, T.map_id]
    · intro j _ hj
      rw [single_apply_of_ne _ (fun h' => hj h'.2), map_zero, single_zero]
    · simp
  · intro i' _ hi'
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun j _ => ?_
    rw [single_apply_of_ne _ (fun h' => hi' h'.1), map_zero, single_zero]
  · simp

name: StringDiagrams.KrullSchmidt.nonempty_iso_sumList_of_perm
statement:
theorem nonempty_iso_sumList_of_perm {l l' : List (IndecClass C)} (h : l.Perm l') :
    Nonempty (sumList l ≅ sumList l')
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | nil => exact ⟨Iso.refl _⟩
  | cons b _ ih => exact ⟨biprod.mapIso (Iso.refl b.rep) ih.some⟩
  | swap a b l =>
    exact ⟨(biprod.associator _ _ _).symm ≪≫
      biprod.mapIso (biprod.braiding _ _) (Iso.refl _) ≪≫ biprod.associator _ _ _⟩
  | trans _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => exact ⟨ih₁.some ≪≫ ih₂.some⟩

name: StringDiagrams.KrullSchmidt.exists_iso_sumList
statement:
theorem exists_iso_sumList (X : C) :
    ∃ l : List (IndecClass C), Nonempty (X ≅ sumList l)
proof:
:= by
  induction h : Module.finrank k (X ⟶ X) using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing X with
  | _ n ih =>
    by_cases h0 : IsZero X
    · exact ⟨[], ⟨h0.iso (isZero_zero C)⟩⟩
    by_cases hi : IsIndec X
    · obtain ⟨e⟩ := IndecClass.exists_iso_rep hi
      exact ⟨[Quotient.mk (indecSetoid C) ⟨X, hi⟩],
        ⟨e ≪≫ isoBiprodZero (isZero_zero C)⟩⟩
    obtain ⟨e, he, he0, he1⟩ : ∃ e : X ⟶ X, e ≫ e = e ∧ e ≠ 0 ∧ e ≠ 𝟙 X := by
      by_contra hne
      push Not at hne
      exact hi ⟨h0, fun e he => by
        by_cases h' : e = 0
        · exact Or.inl h'
        · exact Or.inr (hne e he h')⟩
    obtain ⟨Y, Z, i, p, i', p', h₁, h₂, h₃, h₄, h₅, h₆⟩ := exists_split e he
    have hY : ¬ IsZero Y := fun hY => he0 (by rw [← h₅, hY.eq_of_src i, Limits.comp_zero])
    have hZ : ¬ IsZero Z := fun hZ => he1 (by
      have : 𝟙 X - e = 0 := by rw [← h₆, hZ.eq_of_src i', Limits.comp_zero]
      exact (sub_eq_zero.1 this).symm)
    obtain ⟨l, ⟨el⟩⟩ := ih _ (by rw [← h]; exact finrank_end_lt k i p i' p' h₁ h₂ h₃ h₄ hZ) Y rfl
    obtain ⟨m, ⟨em⟩⟩ := ih _ (by rw [← h]; exact finrank_end_lt k i' p' i p h₂ h₁ h₄ h₃ hY) Z rfl
