    exact ⟨l ++ m, ⟨isoOfData i p i' p' h₁ h₂ h₃ h₄ (by rw [h₅, h₆, add_sub_cancel]) ≪≫
      biprod.mapIso el em ≪≫ (sumListAppendIso l m).symm⟩⟩

name: StringDiagrams.KrullSchmidt.repr_mk_sumList
statement:
theorem repr_mk_sumList [DecidableEq (IndecClass C)] (l : List (IndecClass C))
    (b : IndecClass C) : (indecBasis k).repr (K₀.mk (sumList l)) b = l.count b
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp [sumList, K₀.mk_zero]
  | cons a l ih =>
    rw [sumList, K₀.mk_biprod, map_add, Finsupp.add_apply, ← indecBasis_apply k a,
      Module.Basis.repr_self, Finsupp.single_apply, ih, List.count_cons]
    by_cases h : a = b
    · subst h; simp [add_comm]
    · simp [h]

name: StringDiagrams.KrullSchmidt.perm_of_mk_sumList_eq
statement:
theorem perm_of_mk_sumList_eq {l l' : List (IndecClass C)}
    (h : K₀.mk (sumList l) = K₀.mk (sumList l')) : l.Perm l'
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [List.perm_iff_count]
  intro b
  have := congrArg (fun x => (indecBasis k).repr x b) h
  simp only [repr_mk_sumList] at this
  simpa only [List.count_eq_countP, Bool.beq_eq_decide_eq] using Int.natCast_inj.mp this

name: StringDiagrams.KrullSchmidt.nonempty_iso_sumList_iff
statement:
theorem nonempty_iso_sumList_iff {l l' : List (IndecClass C)} :
    Nonempty (sumList l ≅ sumList l') ↔ l.Perm l'

name: StringDiagrams.KrullSchmidt.mk_eq_mk_iff
statement: theorem mk_eq_mk_iff {X Y : C} : K₀.mk X = K₀.mk Y ↔ Nonempty (X ≅ Y)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun ⟨e⟩ => K₀.mk_eq_mk_of_iso e⟩
  obtain ⟨l, ⟨e⟩⟩ := exists_iso_sumList k X
  obtain ⟨m, ⟨f⟩⟩ := exists_iso_sumList k Y
  have hp : l.Perm m := perm_of_mk_sumList_eq k
    (by rw [← K₀.mk_eq_mk_of_iso e, ← K₀.mk_eq_mk_of_iso f, h])
  exact ⟨e ≪≫ (nonempty_iso_sumList_of_perm hp).some ≪≫ f.symm⟩

name: StringDiagrams.KrullSchmidt.cancel_biprod
statement: theorem cancel_biprod {X Y Z : C} (e : X ⊞ Z ≅ Y ⊞ Z) : Nonempty (X ≅ Y)
proof:
:= by
  apply (mk_eq_mk_iff k).1
  have h := K₀.mk_eq_mk_of_iso e
  simpa only [K₀.mk_biprod, add_left_inj] using h

name: StringDiagrams.EquivalencePowers.pow_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem pow_zero : pow e 0 = 𝟭 C

name: StringDiagrams.EquivalencePowers.powNat_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem powNat_zero : powNat e 0 = 𝟭 C

name: StringDiagrams.EquivalencePowers.powNat_succ
statement: @[simp] theorem powNat_succ (n : ℕ) : powNat e (n + 1) = powNat e n ⋙ e.functor

name: StringDiagrams.EquivalencePowers.powNeg_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem powNeg_zero : powNeg e 0 = 𝟭 C

name: StringDiagrams.EquivalencePowers.powNeg_succ
statement: @[simp] theorem powNeg_succ (n : ℕ) : powNeg e (n + 1) = powNeg e n ⋙ e.inverse

name: StringDiagrams.KrullSchmidt.isIndec_obj_iff
statement:
theorem isIndec_obj_iff {D : Type*} [Category D] [Preadditive D]
    (F : 𝒞 ⥤ D) [F.Full] [F.Faithful] [F.Additive] (X : 𝒞) :
    IsIndec (F.obj X) ↔ IsIndec X
proof:
:= by
  have hz : IsZero (F.obj X) ↔ IsZero X := by
    simp only [IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero, ← F.map_id X, ← F.map_zero (X := X) (Y := X),
      F.map_injective.eq_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h0, hi⟩
    refine ⟨fun h => h0 (hz.2 h), fun e he => ?_⟩
    rcases hi (F.map e) (by rw [← F.map_comp, he]) with h | h
    · exact Or.inl (F.map_injective (by simpa using h))
    · exact Or.inr (F.map_injective (by simpa using h))
  · rintro ⟨h0, hi⟩
    refine ⟨fun h => h0 (hz.1 h), fun e he => ?_⟩
    have hp : F.preimage e ≫ F.preimage e = F.preimage e := by
      apply F.map_injective
      simpa using he
    rcases hi (F.preimage e) hp with h | h
    · left
      simpa using congrArg F.map h
    · right
      simpa using congrArg F.map h

name: StringDiagrams.KrullSchmidt.idem_one_sub
statement: theorem idem_one_sub {X : 𝒞} {e : X ⟶ X} (he : e ≫ e = e) : (𝟙 X - e) ≫ (𝟙 X - e) = 𝟙 X - e

name: StringDiagrams.KrullSchmidt.exists_split
statement:
theorem exists_split [IsIdempotentComplete 𝒞] {X : 𝒞} (e : X ⟶ X) (he : e ≫ e = e) :
    ∃ (Y Z : 𝒞) (i : Y ⟶ X) (p : X ⟶ Y) (i' : Z ⟶ X) (p' : X ⟶ Z), i ≫ p = 𝟙 Y ∧
      i' ≫ p' = 𝟙 Z ∧ i ≫ p' = 0 ∧ i' ≫ p = 0 ∧ p ≫ i = e ∧ p' ≫ i' = 𝟙 X - e
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Y, i, p, h₁, h₂⟩ := IsIdempotentComplete.idempotents_split X e he
  obtain ⟨Z, i', p', h₁', h₂'⟩ :=
    IsIdempotentComplete.idempotents_split X (𝟙 X - e) (idem_one_sub he)
  have hi : i = i ≫ e := by rw [← h₂, ← Category.assoc, h₁, Category.id_comp]
  have hp' : p' = (𝟙 X - e) ≫ p' := by rw [← h₂', Category.assoc, h₁', Category.comp_id]
  have hi' : i' = i' ≫ (𝟙 X - e) := by rw [← h₂', ← Category.assoc, h₁', Category.id_comp]
  have hp : p = e ≫ p := by rw [← h₂, Category.assoc, h₁, Category.comp_id]
  refine ⟨Y, Z, i, p, i', p', h₁, h₁', ?_, ?_, h₂, h₂'⟩
  · rw [hi, hp', Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc e]
    simp [Preadditive.comp_sub, he]
  · rw [hi', hp, Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc (𝟙 X - e)]
    simp [Preadditive.sub_comp, he]

name: StringDiagrams.KrullSchmidt.IsIndec.isZero_or_isZero
statement:
theorem IsIndec.isZero_or_isZero {X Y Z : 𝒞} (hX : IsIndec X) (φ : X ≅ Y ⊞ Z) :
    IsZero Y ∨ IsZero Z
proof:
:= by
  set e := φ.hom ≫ biprod.fst ≫ biprod.inl ≫ φ.inv
  have he : e ≫ e = e := by simp [e]
  rcases hX.2 e he with h | h
  · left
    rw [IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero]
    have : biprod.inl ≫ φ.inv ≫ e ≫ φ.hom ≫ biprod.fst = 𝟙 Y := by simp [e]
    rw [← this, h]; simp
  · right
    rw [IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero]
    have : biprod.inr ≫ φ.inv ≫ (𝟙 X - e) ≫ φ.hom ≫ biprod.snd = 𝟙 Z := by
      simp [e, Preadditive.sub_comp]
    rw [← this, h, sub_self]; simp

name: StringDiagrams.KrullSchmidt.isIndec_iff
statement:
theorem isIndec_iff [IsIdempotentComplete 𝒞] {X : 𝒞} :
    IsIndec X ↔ ¬ IsZero X ∧ ∀ Y Z : 𝒞, Nonempty (X ≅ Y ⊞ Z) → IsZero Y ∨ IsZero Z
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ⟨h.1, fun Y Z ⟨φ⟩ => h.isZero_or_isZero φ⟩, fun ⟨h0, h⟩ => ⟨h0, fun e he => ?_⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨Y, Z, i, p, i', p', h₁, h₂, h₃, h₄, h₅, h₆⟩ := exists_split e he
  rcases h Y Z ⟨isoOfData i p i' p' h₁ h₂ h₃ h₄ (by rw [h₅, h₆, add_sub_cancel])⟩ with hY | hZ
  · left; rw [← h₅, hY.eq_of_src i, Limits.comp_zero]
  · right
    have : 𝟙 X - e = 0 := by rw [← h₆, hZ.eq_of_src i', Limits.comp_zero]
    exact (sub_eq_zero.1 this).symm

name: StringDiagrams.KrullSchmidt.isIndec_iff_indecomposable
statement:
theorem isIndec_iff_indecomposable [HasBinaryBiproducts 𝒞] [IsIdempotentComplete 𝒞] (X : 𝒞) :
    IsIndec X ↔ CategoryTheory.Indecomposable X
proof:
:= by
  rw [isIndec_iff, CategoryTheory.Indecomposable]
  exact and_congr_right fun _ => ⟨fun h Y Z e => h Y Z ⟨e⟩,
    fun h Y Z ⟨e⟩ => h Y Z e⟩

name: StringDiagrams.KrullSchmidt.mk_eq_add_of_iso
statement:
theorem mk_eq_add_of_iso {X Y Z : 𝒞} (e : X ≅ Y ⊞ Z) :
    K₀.mk X = K₀.mk Y + K₀.mk Z

name: StringDiagrams.KrullSchmidt.mk_isZero
statement: theorem mk_isZero {X : 𝒞} (hX : IsZero X) : K₀.mk X = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hXX : IsZero (X ⊞ X) := by
    rw [IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero]
    apply biprod.hom_ext <;> exact hX.eq_of_tgt _ _
  have h := K₀.mk_biprod X X
  rw [K₀.mk_eq_mk_of_iso (hXX.iso hX)] at h
  exact left_eq_add.mp h

name: StringDiagrams.KrullSchmidt.finrank_end_pos
statement: theorem finrank_end_pos {X : 𝒞} (hX : ¬ IsZero X) : 0 < finrank k (X ⟶ X)
proof:
:= by
  refine Module.finrank_pos_iff_exists_ne_zero.2 ⟨𝟙 X, fun h => hX ?_⟩
  rwa [IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero]

name: StringDiagrams.KrullSchmidt.finrank_end_lt
statement:
theorem finrank_end_lt {X Y Z : 𝒞} (i : Y ⟶ X) (p : X ⟶ Y) (i' : Z ⟶ X) (p' : X ⟶ Z)
    (h₁ : i ≫ p = 𝟙 Y) (h₂ : i' ≫ p' = 𝟙 Z) (h₃ : i ≫ p' = 0) (h₄ : i' ≫ p = 0)
    (hZ : ¬ IsZero Z) : finrank k (Y ⟶ Y) < finrank k (X ⟶ X)
proof:
:= by
  let Φ : ((Y ⟶ Y) × (Z ⟶ Z)) →ₗ[k] (X ⟶ X) :=
    (Linear.leftComp k X p ∘ₗ Linear.rightComp k Y i) ∘ₗ LinearMap.fst k _ _ +
      (Linear.leftComp k X p' ∘ₗ Linear.rightComp k Z i') ∘ₗ LinearMap.snd k _ _
  have hΦ' : ∀ fg, Φ fg = p ≫ fg.1 ≫ i + p' ≫ fg.2 ≫ i' := fun fg => rfl
  have hΦ : Function.Injective Φ := by
    intro a b hab
    rw [hΦ', hΦ'] at hab
    have e₁ := congrArg (fun g => i ≫ g ≫ p) hab
    have e₂ := congrArg (fun g => i' ≫ g ≫ p') hab
    simp only [Preadditive.add_comp,
      Category.assoc, reassoc_of% h₁, reassoc_of% h₂, h₁, h₂, h₃,
      h₄, Limits.comp_zero, add_zero, zero_add, Category.comp_id] at e₁ e₂
    exact Prod.ext e₁ e₂
  have := LinearMap.finrank_le_finrank_of_injective hΦ
  rw [Module.finrank_prod] at this
  have := finrank_end_pos k hZ
  omega

name: StringDiagrams.KrullSchmidt.of_mem_closure_indec
statement:
theorem of_mem_closure_indec (X : 𝒞) :
    K₀.mk X ∈ AddSubmonoid.closure {x | ∃ Z : 𝒞, IsIndec Z ∧ x = K₀.mk Z}
proof:
:= by
  induction h : finrank k (X ⟶ X) using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing X with
  | _ n ih =>
    by_cases h0 : IsZero X
    · rw [mk_isZero h0]; exact AddSubmonoid.zero_mem _
    by_cases hi : IsIndec X
    · exact AddSubmonoid.subset_closure ⟨X, hi, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨e, he, he0, he1⟩ : ∃ e : X ⟶ X, e ≫ e = e ∧ e ≠ 0 ∧ e ≠ 𝟙 X := by
      by_contra hne
      push Not at hne
      exact hi ⟨h0, fun e he => by
        by_cases h' : e = 0
        · exact Or.inl h'
        · exact Or.inr (hne e he h')⟩
    obtain ⟨Y, Z, i, p, i', p', h₁, h₂, h₃, h₄, h₅, h₆⟩ := exists_split e he
    have hY : ¬ IsZero Y := fun hY => he0 (by rw [← h₅, hY.eq_of_src i, Limits.comp_zero])
    have hZ : ¬ IsZero Z := fun hZ => he1 (by
      have : 𝟙 X - e = 0 := by rw [← h₆, hZ.eq_of_src i', Limits.comp_zero]
      exact (sub_eq_zero.1 this).symm)
    rw [mk_eq_add_of_iso (isoOfData i p i' p' h₁ h₂ h₃ h₄
      (by rw [h₅, h₆, add_sub_cancel]))]
    refine AddSubmonoid.add_mem _ (ih _ ?_ Y rfl) (ih _ ?_ Z rfl)
    · rw [← h]; exact finrank_end_lt k i p i' p' h₁ h₂ h₃ h₄ hZ
    · rw [← h]; exact finrank_end_lt k i' p' i p h₂ h₁ h₄ h₃ hY

name: StringDiagrams.KrullSchmidt.IsIndec.isNilpotent_or_isUnit
statement:
theorem IsIndec.isNilpotent_or_isUnit {X : 𝒞} (hX : IsIndec X) (f : End X) :
    IsNilpotent f ∨ IsUnit f
proof:
:= by
  have : FiniteDimensional k (End X) := HomFinite.finiteDimensional X X
  refine FiniteDimensionalAlgebra.isNilpotent_or_isUnit_of_idempotent k (fun e he => ?_) f
  have he' : e ≫ e = e := by rw [← End.mul_def]; exact he.eq
  rcases hX.2 e he' with h | h
  · exact Or.inl h
  · exact Or.inr h

name: StringDiagrams.KrullSchmidt.IsIndec.nontrivial
statement: theorem IsIndec.nontrivial {X : 𝒞} (hX : IsIndec X) : Nontrivial (End X)

name: StringDiagrams.KrullSchmidt.IsIndec.isLocalRing
statement: theorem IsIndec.isLocalRing {X : 𝒞} (hX : IsIndec X) : IsLocalRing (End X)
proof:
:=
  have := hX.nontrivial
  IsLocalRing.of_isUnit_or_isUnit_one_sub_self fun a =>
    (hX.isNilpotent_or_isUnit k a).elim (fun h => Or.inr h.isUnit_one_sub) Or.inl

name: StringDiagrams.KrullSchmidt.nonunits_add'
statement:
theorem nonunits_add' {R : Type*} [Ring R] [IsLocalRing R] {a b : R} (ha : ¬ IsUnit a)
    (hb : ¬ IsUnit b) : ¬ IsUnit (a + b)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨u, hu⟩
  have h : (↑u⁻¹ * a) + (↑u⁻¹ * b) = 1 := by rw [← mul_add, ← hu, Units.inv_mul]
  rcases IsLocalRing.isUnit_or_isUnit_of_add_one h with h' | h'
  · exact ha ((Units.isUnit_units_mul u⁻¹ a).1 h')
  · exact hb ((Units.isUnit_units_mul u⁻¹ b).1 h')

name: StringDiagrams.KrullSchmidt.mem_rad
statement:
theorem mem_rad {Z X : 𝒞} {hZ : IsIndec Z} {f : Z ⟶ X} :
    f ∈ rad k hZ X ↔ ∀ g : X ⟶ Z, ¬ IsUnit (M := End Z) (f ≫ g)

name: StringDiagrams.KrullSchmidt.rad_map_postIso
statement:
theorem rad_map_postIso {Z : 𝒞} (hZ : IsIndec Z) {X X' : 𝒞} (φ : X ≅ X') :
    (rad k hZ X).map (postIso k Z φ).toLinearMap = rad k hZ X'
proof:
:= by
  ext f
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨f₀, hf₀, rfl⟩ g
    simpa using hf₀ (φ.hom ≫ g)
  · intro hf
    refine ⟨f ≫ φ.inv, fun g => ?_, by simp⟩
    simpa using hf (φ.inv ≫ g)

name: StringDiagrams.KrullSchmidt.mult_iso
statement:
theorem mult_iso {Z : 𝒞} (hZ : IsIndec Z) {X X' : 𝒞} (φ : X ≅ X') :
    mult k hZ X = mult k hZ X'
proof:
:= by
  unfold mult
  rw [(postIso k Z φ).finrank_eq, ← rad_map_postIso k hZ φ, LinearEquiv.finrank_map_eq]

name: StringDiagrams.KrullSchmidt.finrank_submodule_prod
statement:
theorem finrank_submodule_prod {M N : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module k M] [AddCommGroup N]
    [Module k N] [FiniteDimensional k M] [FiniteDimensional k N] (p : Submodule k M)
    (q : Submodule k N) : finrank k (p.prod q) = finrank k p + finrank k q
proof:
:= by
  let e : p.prod q ≃ₗ[k] p × q :=
    { toFun := fun x => (⟨x.1.1, (Submodule.mem_prod.1 x.2).1⟩, ⟨x.1.2, (Submodule.mem_prod.1 x.2).2⟩)
      invFun := fun y => ⟨(y.1.1, y.2.1), Submodule.mem_prod.2 ⟨y.1.2, y.2.2⟩⟩
      map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl
      map_smul' := fun _ _ => rfl
      left_inv := fun _ => rfl
      right_inv := fun _ => rfl }
  rw [e.finrank_eq, Module.finrank_prod]

name: StringDiagrams.KrullSchmidt.rad_map_biprodEquiv
statement:
theorem rad_map_biprodEquiv {Z : 𝒞} (hZ : IsIndec Z) (X Y : 𝒞) :
    (rad k hZ (X ⊞ Y)).map (biprodEquiv k Z X Y).toLinearMap = (rad k hZ X).prod (rad k hZ Y)
proof:
:= by
  ext ⟨a, b⟩
  simp only [Submodule.mem_map, Submodule.mem_prod, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, biprodEquiv_apply,
    Prod.mk.injEq]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨f, hf, rfl, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨fun g => by simpa using hf (biprod.fst ≫ g), fun g => by simpa using hf (biprod.snd ≫ g)⟩
  · rintro ⟨ha, hb⟩
    refine ⟨biprod.lift a b, fun g => ?_, by simp, by simp⟩
    have := hZ.isLocalRing k
    rw [biprod.lift_eq, Preadditive.add_comp, Category.assoc, Category.assoc]
    exact nonunits_add' (R := End Z) (ha _) (hb _)

name: StringDiagrams.KrullSchmidt.mult_biprod
statement:
theorem mult_biprod {Z : 𝒞} (hZ : IsIndec Z) (X Y : 𝒞) :
    mult k hZ (X ⊞ Y) = mult k hZ X + mult k hZ Y
proof:
:= by
  unfold mult
  rw [(biprodEquiv k Z X Y).finrank_eq, Module.finrank_prod, ← LinearEquiv.finrank_map_eq
    (biprodEquiv k Z X Y), rad_map_biprodEquiv, finrank_submodule_prod]
  push_cast; ring

name: StringDiagrams.KrullSchmidt.multK_of
statement:
@[simp] theorem multK_of {Z : 𝒞} (hZ : IsIndec Z) (X : 𝒞) :
    multK k hZ (K₀.mk X) = mult k hZ X

name: StringDiagrams.KrullSchmidt.multK_self_pos
statement: theorem multK_self_pos {Z : 𝒞} (hZ : IsIndec Z) : 0 < multK k hZ (K₀.mk Z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [multK_of, mult, sub_pos, Nat.cast_lt]
  refine Submodule.finrank_lt fun h => ?_
  have : 𝟙 Z ∈ rad k hZ Z := h ▸ Submodule.mem_top
  exact this (𝟙 Z) (by rw [Category.comp_id]; exact isUnit_one)

name: StringDiagrams.KrullSchmidt.multK_of_not_iso
statement:
theorem multK_of_not_iso {Z Z' : 𝒞} (hZ : IsIndec Z) (hZ' : IsIndec Z')
    (h : ¬ Nonempty (Z ≅ Z')) : multK k hZ (K₀.mk Z') = 0
proof:
:= by
  have htop : rad k hZ Z' = ⊤ := by
    refine eq_top_iff.2 fun f _ g hfg => h ?_
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hfg
    have hv : f ≫ g ≫ (↑u⁻¹ : End Z) = 𝟙 Z := by
      have := u.inv_mul
      rw [End.mul_def, hu] at this
      rw [← Category.assoc]; exact this
    set g' : Z' ⟶ Z := g ≫ (↑u⁻¹ : End Z)
    have he : (g' ≫ f) ≫ (g' ≫ f) = g' ≫ f := by
      rw [Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc f, hv, Category.id_comp]
    rcases hZ'.2 _ he with h0 | h1
    · exfalso
      apply hZ.1
      rw [IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero]
      calc 𝟙 Z = (f ≫ g') ≫ (f ≫ g') := by rw [hv, Category.id_comp]
        _ = f ≫ (g' ≫ f) ≫ g' := by simp only [Category.assoc]
        _ = 0 := by rw [h0]; simp
    · exact ⟨⟨f, g', hv, h1⟩⟩
  rw [multK_of, mult, htop, finrank_top, sub_self]

name: StringDiagrams.KrullSchmidt.IndecClass.isIndec_rep
statement: theorem IndecClass.isIndec_rep (b : IndecClass 𝒞) : IsIndec b.rep

name: StringDiagrams.KrullSchmidt.IndecClass.eq_of_iso
statement: theorem IndecClass.eq_of_iso {b b' : IndecClass 𝒞} (e : b.rep ≅ b'.rep) : b = b'
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Quotient.out_eq b, ← Quotient.out_eq b']
  exact Quotient.sound ⟨e⟩

name: StringDiagrams.KrullSchmidt.IndecClass.exists_iso_rep
statement:
theorem IndecClass.exists_iso_rep {X : 𝒞} (hX : IsIndec X) :
    Nonempty (X ≅ IndecClass.rep (Quotient.mk (indecSetoid 𝒞) ⟨X, hX⟩))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := Quotient.mk_out (s := indecSetoid 𝒞) ⟨X, hX⟩
  exact ⟨e.symm⟩

name: StringDiagrams.KrullSchmidt.linearIndependent_indec
statement:
theorem linearIndependent_indec :
    LinearIndependent ℤ (fun b : IndecClass 𝒞 => K₀.mk b.rep)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [linearIndependent_iff']
  intro s g hg b₀ hb₀
  have key := congrArg (multK k b₀.isIndec_rep) hg
  rw [map_sum, map_zero] at key
  simp only [map_zsmul, zsmul_eq_mul] at key
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single b₀] at key
  · exact (mul_eq_zero.1 key).resolve_right (ne_of_gt (multK_self_pos k b₀.isIndec_rep))
  · intro b _ hb
    rw [multK_of_not_iso k b₀.isIndec_rep b.isIndec_rep
      (fun ⟨e⟩ => hb (IndecClass.eq_of_iso e).symm), mul_zero]
  · exact fun h => (h hb₀).elim

name: StringDiagrams.KrullSchmidt.mk_mem_span
statement:
theorem mk_mem_span (X : 𝒞) :
    K₀.mk X ∈ Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range fun b : IndecClass 𝒞 => K₀.mk b.rep)
proof:
:= by
  have h := of_mem_closure_indec k X
  refine (AddSubmonoid.closure_le (S := (Submodule.span ℤ
    (Set.range fun b : IndecClass 𝒞 => K₀.mk b.rep)).toAddSubmonoid)).2 ?_ h
  rintro _ ⟨Z, hZ, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := IndecClass.exists_iso_rep hZ
  change K₀.mk Z ∈ Submodule.span _ _
  rw [K₀.mk_eq_mk_of_iso e]
  exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨_, rfl⟩

name: StringDiagrams.KrullSchmidt.mem_span_indec
statement:
theorem mem_span_indec (x : K₀ 𝒞) :
    x ∈ Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range fun b : IndecClass 𝒞 => K₀.mk b.rep)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using K₀.induction_on with
  | mk X => exact mk_mem_span k X
  | zero => exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  | add x y hx hy => exact Submodule.add_mem _ hx hy
  | neg x hx => exact Submodule.neg_mem _ hx

name: StringDiagrams.KrullSchmidt.indecBasis_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem indecBasis_apply (b : IndecClass 𝒞) : indecBasis k b = K₀.mk b.rep

name: StringDiagrams.KrullSchmidt.free
statement: theorem free : Module.Free ℤ (K₀ 𝒞)

name: StringDiagrams.Render.xmlEntity?_length
statement:
theorem xmlEntity?_length {cs rest : List Char} {d : Char} (h : xmlEntity? cs = some (d, rest)) :
    rest.length < cs.length
proof:
:= by
  unfold xmlEntity? at h
  split at h <;> first | (cases h; simp only [List.length_cons]; omega) | cases h

name: StringDiagrams.Render.xmlUnescapeAux_cons
statement:
theorem xmlUnescapeAux_cons {c : Char} (h : c ≠ '&') (cs : List Char) :
    xmlUnescapeAux (c :: cs) = c :: xmlUnescapeAux cs

name: StringDiagrams.Render.xmlUnescapeAux_escapeChar_append
statement:
theorem xmlUnescapeAux_escapeChar_append (c : Char) (rest : List Char) :
    xmlUnescapeAux (xmlEscapeChar c ++ rest) = c :: xmlUnescapeAux rest
proof:
:= by
  unfold xmlEscapeChar
  split
  all_goals first
    | (rwa [List.singleton_append, xmlUnescapeAux_cons])
    | (simp only [List.cons_append, List.nil_append]; rw [xmlUnescapeAux]; rfl)

name: StringDiagrams.Render.xmlUnescape_xmlEscape
statement: @[simp] theorem xmlUnescape_xmlEscape (s : String) : xmlUnescape (xmlEscape s) = s
proof:
:= by
  suffices h : ∀ l : List Char, xmlUnescapeAux (l.flatMap xmlEscapeChar) = l by
    rw [xmlUnescape, xmlEscape, String.toList_ofList, h, String.ofList_toList]
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => simp [xmlUnescapeAux]
  | cons c l ih => rw [List.flatMap_cons, xmlUnescapeAux_escapeChar_append, ih]

name: StringDiagrams.Pivotal.rotate_eq_rightMate
statement: theorem rotate_eq_rightMate (α : f ⟶ f') : rotate α = rightMate (biadj f) (biadj f') α

name: StringDiagrams.Pivotal.rotate_eq_leftMate
statement: theorem rotate_eq_leftMate (α : f ⟶ f') : rotate α = leftMate (biadj f) (biadj f') α

name: StringDiagrams.Pivotal.rotate_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rotate_id (f : a ⟶ b) : rotate (𝟙 f) = 𝟙 (dual f)

name: StringDiagrams.Pivotal.rotate_comp
statement:
@[simp]

name: StringDiagrams.Pivotal.rotate_rotate
statement:
theorem rotate_rotate {f f' : a ⟶ b} (α : f ⟶ f') :
    rotate (rotate α) = (pivotalIso f).inv ≫ α ≫ (pivotalIso f').hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [rotate, rightMate_eq_comp' _ (biadj f').symm _ (biadj f).symm, rightMate_symm_rotate]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.Pivotal.pivotalIso_hom_naturality

name: StringDiagrams.Pivotal.rotate_whiskerRight
statement:
theorem rotate_whiskerRight {f f' : a ⟶ b} (α : f ⟶ f') (h : b ⟶ c) :
    rotate (α ▷ h) = (dualCompIso f' h).hom ≫ dual h ◁ rotate α ≫ (dualCompIso f h).inv
proof:
:= by
  rw [rotate, rightMate_eq_comp' _ ((biadj f).comp (biadj h)) _ ((biadj f').comp (biadj h)),
    rightMate_whiskerRight]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.Pivotal.rotate_whiskerLeft

    rotate (h ◁ α) = (dualCompIso h f').hom ≫ rotate α ▷ dual h ≫ (dualCompIso h f).inv
proof:
:= by
  rw [rotate, rightMate_eq_comp' _ ((biadj h).comp (biadj f)) _ ((biadj h).comp (biadj f')),
    rightMate_whiskerLeft]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.unit_comp_whiskerRight_eq
statement:
theorem unit_comp_whiskerRight_eq (α : l₂ ⟶ l₁) :
    adj₂.unit ≫ α ▷ r₂ = adj₁.unit ≫ l₁ ◁ conjugateEquiv adj₁ adj₂ α
proof:
:= by
  rw [conjugateEquiv_apply']
  symm
  calc
    _ = 𝟙 _ ⊗≫ (adj₁.unit ▷ 𝟙 c ≫ (l₁ ≫ r₁) ◁ adj₂.unit) ⊗≫ l₁ ◁ r₁ ◁ α ▷ r₂ ⊗≫
          l₁ ◁ adj₁.counit ▷ r₂ ⊗≫ 𝟙 _ := by
      bicategory
    _ = 𝟙 _ ⊗≫ adj₂.unit ⊗≫ (adj₁.unit ▷ (l₂ ≫ r₂) ≫ (l₁ ≫ r₁) ◁ (α ▷ r₂)) ⊗≫
          l₁ ◁ adj₁.counit ▷ r₂ ⊗≫ 𝟙 _ := by
      rw [← whisker_exchange]; bicategory
    _ = 𝟙 _ ⊗≫ adj₂.unit ⊗≫ α ▷ r₂ ⊗≫ leftZigzag adj₁.unit adj₁.counit ▷ r₂ ⊗≫ 𝟙 _ := by
      rw [← whisker_exchange]; bicategory
    _ = _ := by
      rw [adj₁.left_triangle]; bicategory

name: StringDiagrams.whiskerLeft_comp_counit_eq
statement:
theorem whiskerLeft_comp_counit_eq (α : l₂ ⟶ l₁) :
    r₁ ◁ α ≫ adj₁.counit = conjugateEquiv adj₁ adj₂ α ▷ l₂ ≫ adj₂.counit
proof:
:= by
  rw [conjugateEquiv_apply']
  symm
  calc
    _ = 𝟙 _ ⊗≫ r₁ ◁ adj₂.unit ▷ l₂ ⊗≫ r₁ ◁ α ▷ r₂ ▷ l₂ ⊗≫
          (adj₁.counit ▷ (r₂ ≫ l₂) ≫ 𝟙 d ◁ adj₂.counit) ⊗≫ 𝟙 _ := by
      bicategory
    _ = 𝟙 _ ⊗≫ r₁ ◁ adj₂.unit ▷ l₂ ⊗≫ r₁ ◁ (α ▷ (r₂ ≫ l₂) ≫ l₁ ◁ adj₂.counit) ⊗≫
          adj₁.counit := by
      rw [← whisker_exchange]; bicategory
    _ = 𝟙 _ ⊗≫ r₁ ◁ leftZigzag adj₂.unit adj₂.counit ⊗≫ r₁ ◁ α ⊗≫ adj₁.counit := by
      rw [← whisker_exchange]; bicategory
    _ = _ := by
      rw [adj₂.left_triangle]; bicategory

name: StringDiagrams.unit_comp_whiskerLeft_injective
statement:
theorem unit_comp_whiskerLeft_injective {r₂ : d ⟶ c} {β β' : r₁ ⟶ r₂}
    (h : adj₁.unit ≫ l₁ ◁ β = adj₁.unit ≫ l₁ ◁ β') : β = β'
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ γ : r₁ ⟶ r₂, γ = (ρ_ _).inv ≫ r₁ ◁ (adj₁.unit ≫ l₁ ◁ γ) ≫ (α_ _ _ _).inv ≫
      adj₁.counit ▷ r₂ ≫ (λ_ _).hom := by
    intro γ
    calc
      γ = 𝟙 _ ⊗≫ rightZigzag adj₁.unit adj₁.counit ⊗≫ γ := by
        rw [adj₁.right_triangle]; bicategory
      _ = 𝟙 _ ⊗≫ r₁ ◁ adj₁.unit ⊗≫ (adj₁.counit ▷ r₁ ≫ 𝟙 d ◁ γ) ⊗≫ 𝟙 _ := by
        bicategory
      _ = _ := by
        rw [← whisker_exchange]; bicategory
  rw [key β, key β', h]

name: StringDiagrams.conjugateEquiv_eq_of_unit
statement:
theorem conjugateEquiv_eq_of_unit (α : l₂ ⟶ l₁) (β : r₁ ⟶ r₂)
    (h : adj₂.unit ≫ α ▷ r₂ = adj₁.unit ≫ l₁ ◁ β) : conjugateEquiv adj₁ adj₂ α = β

name: StringDiagrams.conjugateEquiv_eq_iff_unit
statement:
theorem conjugateEquiv_eq_iff_unit (α : l₂ ⟶ l₁) (β : r₁ ⟶ r₂) :
    conjugateEquiv adj₁ adj₂ α = β ↔ adj₂.unit ≫ α ▷ r₂ = adj₁.unit ≫ l₁ ◁ β
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => h ▸ unit_comp_whiskerRight_eq adj₁ adj₂ α, conjugateEquiv_eq_of_unit adj₁ adj₂ α β⟩

name: StringDiagrams.unit_comp_whiskerLeft_eq
statement:
theorem unit_comp_whiskerLeft_eq (β : r₁ ⟶ r₂) :
    adj₁.unit ≫ l₁ ◁ β = adj₂.unit ≫ (conjugateEquiv adj₁ adj₂).symm β ▷ r₂
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← Equiv.apply_symm_apply (conjugateEquiv adj₁ adj₂) β]
  rw [unit_comp_whiskerRight_eq]

name: StringDiagrams.whiskerRight_comp_counit_eq
statement:
theorem whiskerRight_comp_counit_eq (β : r₁ ⟶ r₂) :
    β ▷ l₂ ≫ adj₂.counit = r₁ ◁ (conjugateEquiv adj₁ adj₂).symm β ≫ adj₁.counit
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← Equiv.apply_symm_apply (conjugateEquiv adj₁ adj₂) β]
  rw [whiskerLeft_comp_counit_eq]

name: StringDiagrams.conjugateEquiv_whiskerRight
statement:
theorem conjugateEquiv_whiskerRight {l₁ l₂ : c ⟶ d} {r₁ r₂ : d ⟶ c} (adj₁ : l₁ ⊣ r₁)
    (adj₂ : l₂ ⊣ r₂) {f : d ⟶ e} {g : e ⟶ d} (adj : f ⊣ g) (α : l₂ ⟶ l₁) :
    conjugateEquiv (adj₁.comp adj) (adj₂.comp adj) (α ▷ f) =
      g ◁ conjugateEquiv adj₁ adj₂ α
proof:
:= by
  apply conjugateEquiv_eq_of_unit
  have h := unit_comp_whiskerRight_eq adj₁ adj₂ α
  dsimp only [Adjunction.comp, Adjunction.compUnit]
  calc
    _ = 𝟙 _ ⊗≫ adj₂.unit ⊗≫ (l₂ ◁ adj.unit ≫ α ▷ (f ≫ g)) ▷ r₂ ⊗≫ 𝟙 _ := by
      bicategory
    _ = 𝟙 _ ⊗≫ (adj₂.unit ≫ α ▷ r₂) ⊗≫ l₁ ◁ adj.unit ▷ r₂ ⊗≫ 𝟙 _ := by
      rw [whisker_exchange]; bicategory
    _ = 𝟙 _ ⊗≫ adj₁.unit ⊗≫ l₁ ◁ (𝟙 d ◁ conjugateEquiv adj₁ adj₂ α ≫ adj.unit ▷ r₂) ⊗≫
          𝟙 _ := by
      rw [h]; bicategory
    _ = _ := by
      rw [whisker_exchange]; bicategory

name: StringDiagrams.conjugateEquiv_whiskerLeft
statement:
theorem conjugateEquiv_whiskerLeft {l₁ l₂ : c ⟶ d} {r₁ r₂ : d ⟶ c} (adj₁ : l₁ ⊣ r₁)
    (adj₂ : l₂ ⊣ r₂) {f : e ⟶ c} {g : c ⟶ e} (adj : f ⊣ g) (α : l₂ ⟶ l₁) :
    conjugateEquiv (adj.comp adj₁) (adj.comp adj₂) (f ◁ α) =
      conjugateEquiv adj₁ adj₂ α ▷ g
proof:
:= by
  apply conjugateEquiv_eq_of_unit
  have h := unit_comp_whiskerRight_eq adj₁ adj₂ α
  dsimp only [Adjunction.comp, Adjunction.compUnit]
  calc
    _ = 𝟙 _ ⊗≫ adj.unit ⊗≫ f ◁ (adj₂.unit ≫ α ▷ r₂) ▷ g ⊗≫ 𝟙 _ := by
      bicategory
    _ = _ := by
      rw [h]; bicategory

name: StringDiagrams.conjugateEquiv_symm_whiskerLeft
statement:
theorem conjugateEquiv_symm_whiskerLeft {l₁ l₂ : c ⟶ d} {r₁ r₂ : d ⟶ c} (adj₁ : l₁ ⊣ r₁)
    (adj₂ : l₂ ⊣ r₂) {f : d ⟶ e} {g : e ⟶ d} (adj : f ⊣ g) (β : r₁ ⟶ r₂) :
    (conjugateEquiv (adj₁.comp adj) (adj₂.comp adj)).symm (g ◁ β) =
      (conjugateEquiv adj₁ adj₂).symm β ▷ f

name: StringDiagrams.conjugateEquiv_symm_whiskerRight
statement:
theorem conjugateEquiv_symm_whiskerRight {l₁ l₂ : c ⟶ d} {r₁ r₂ : d ⟶ c} (adj₁ : l₁ ⊣ r₁)
    (adj₂ : l₂ ⊣ r₂) {f : e ⟶ c} {g : c ⟶ e} (adj : f ⊣ g) (β : r₁ ⟶ r₂) :
    (conjugateEquiv (adj.comp adj₁) (adj.comp adj₂)).symm (β ▷ g) =
      f ◁ (conjugateEquiv adj₁ adj₂).symm β

name: StringDiagrams.Layer.Valid.toPivotal
statement:
theorem Layer.Valid.toPivotal {L : Layer S} (h : L.Valid) : (L.toPivotal D).Valid where
  left_ok
proof:
:= (Signature.pivotal_ok D _ _).2 h.left_ok
  left_end := (Signature.pivotal_endR D _ _).trans h.left_end

theorem pivotalBiadj_symm_heq (c : S.Colour) :
    HEq (pivotalBiadj E Q hz (Q.colourHom c) c rfl).symm
      (pivotalBiadj E Q hz (Q.dualColourHom E.toColourDuality.pivotal c) (E.dual c) rfl)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [pivotalBiadj, ColourCupsCaps.biadjunctions, biadjunctionOfZigzag, Biadjunction.symm]
  refine Biadjunction.heq_mk ?_ ?_ ?_
  · exact Bicat.Hom.ext (Obj.ext rfl (by show [c] = [E.dual (E.dual c)]; rw [E.dual_dual]))
  · refine adjunctionOfZigzag_heq rfl ?_ ?_ ?_ _ _ _ _
    · exact Bicat.Hom.ext (Obj.ext rfl (by show [c] = [E.dual (E.dual c)]; rw [E.dual_dual]))
    · simp [pivotalCupsCaps]
    · simp [pivotalCupsCaps]
  · refine adjunctionOfZigzag_heq ?_ rfl ?_ ?_ _ _ _ _
    · exact Bicat.Hom.ext (Obj.ext rfl (by show [c] = [E.dual (E.dual c)]; rw [E.dual_dual]))
    · simp [pivotalCupsCaps, cupD, E.dual_dual]

proof:

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.pivotal_isCyclic_cup
statement:
theorem pivotal_isCyclic_cup (c : S.Colour) (hg : (S.pivotal E.toColourDuality).GenValid (.cup c)) :
    Biadjunction.IsCyclic (biadj (pivotalBiadj E Q hz) (Q.genDom (.cup c) hg))
      (biadj (pivotalBiadj E Q hz) (Q.genCod (.cup c) hg)) (Q.gen2 (.cup c) hg)
proof:
:= by
  set xc := Q.colourHom c
  set yc := Q.dualColourHom E.toColourDuality.pivotal c
  have e : biadj (pivotalBiadj E Q hz) (Q.genDom (.cup c) hg) = Biadjunction.id _ := nilBiadj_id _ rfl
  rw [e]
  have k₁ := isCyclic_left_unit (pivotalBiadj E Q hz xc c rfl)
  have k₂ := (pivotalBiadj_symm_isCyclic E Q hz c).whiskerLeft (pivotalBiadj E Q hz xc c rfl)
  have k₃ := (isCyclic_biadj_single (pivotalBiadj E Q hz) xc c rfl).inv.hcomp
    (isCyclic_biadj_single (pivotalBiadj E Q hz) yc (E.dual c) rfl).inv
  have k₄ := isCyclic_biadj_comp (pivotalBiadj E Q hz) xc yc
  have k₅ := isCyclic_biadj_eqToHom (pivotalBiadj E Q hz) (show xc ≫ yc = Q.genCod (.cup c) hg from rfl)
  have key := k₁.comp (k₂.comp (k₃.comp (k₄.comp k₅)))
  simp only [IsIso.inv_id, Bicategory.id_whiskerRight, Bicategory.whiskerLeft_id,
    Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id, eqToHom_refl] at key
  have e₃ : (pivotalBiadj E Q hz xc c rfl).left.unit = Q.gen2 (.cup c) hg := by
    show Q.diag _ = Q.diag _
    exact Q.diag_eq_of_layers_eq rfl
  have e₄ : (pivotalBiadj E Q hz xc c rfl).left.unit ≫ 𝟙 (xc ≫ yc) = Q.gen2 (.cup c) hg :=
    (Category.comp_id _).trans e₃
  rw [e₄] at key
  exact key

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.pivotal_isCyclic_cap
statement:
theorem pivotal_isCyclic_cap (c : S.Colour) (hg : (S.pivotal E.toColourDuality).GenValid (.cap c)) :
    Biadjunction.IsCyclic (biadj (pivotalBiadj E Q hz) (Q.genDom (.cap c) hg))
      (biadj (pivotalBiadj E Q hz) (Q.genCod (.cap c) hg)) (Q.gen2 (.cap c) hg)
proof:
:= by
  set xc := Q.colourHom c
  set yc := Q.dualColourHom E.toColourDuality.pivotal c
  have e : biadj (pivotalBiadj E Q hz) (Q.genCod (.cap c) hg) = Biadjunction.id _ :=
    nilBiadj_id _ rfl
  rw [e]
  have k₀ := isCyclic_biadj_eqToHom (pivotalBiadj E Q hz)
    (show Q.genDom (.cap c) hg = yc ≫ xc from rfl)
  have k₁ := isCyclic_biadj_comp_symm (pivotalBiadj E Q hz) yc xc
  have k₂ := (isCyclic_biadj_single (pivotalBiadj E Q hz) yc (E.dual c) rfl).hcomp
    (isCyclic_biadj_single (pivotalBiadj E Q hz) xc c rfl)
  have k₃ := (pivotalBiadj_symm_isCyclic E Q hz c).inv.whiskerRight (pivotalBiadj E Q hz xc c rfl)
  have k₄ := isCyclic_left_counit (pivotalBiadj E Q hz xc c rfl)
  have key := k₀.comp (k₁.comp (k₂.comp (k₃.comp k₄)))
  simp only [IsIso.inv_id, Bicategory.id_whiskerRight, Bicategory.whiskerLeft_id,
    Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id, eqToHom_refl] at key
  have e₃ : (pivotalBiadj E Q hz xc c rfl).left.counit = Q.gen2 (.cap c) hg := by
    show Q.diag _ = Q.diag _
    exact Q.diag_eq_of_layers_eq rfl
  have e₄ : 𝟙 (Q.dualHom E.toColourDuality.pivotal (Q.colourHom c)) ▷ xc ≫
      (pivotalBiadj E Q hz xc c rfl).left.counit = Q.gen2 (.cap c) hg := by
    rw [Bicategory.id_whiskerRight]
    exact (Category.id_comp _).trans e₃
  rw [e₄] at key
  exact key

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.pivotal_isCyclic
statement:
theorem pivotal_isCyclic
    (hgen : ∀ (g : S.Gen) (hg : (S.pivotal E.toColourDuality).GenValid (.gen g)),
      Biadjunction.IsCyclic (biadj (pivotalBiadj E Q hz) (Q.genDom (.gen g) hg))
        (biadj (pivotalBiadj E Q hz) (Q.genCod (.gen g) hg)) (Q.gen2 (.gen g) hg))
    {l m : Q.Bicat} {x x' : l ⟶ m} (θ : x ⟶ x') :
    Biadjunction.IsCyclic (biadj (pivotalBiadj E Q hz) x) (biadj (pivotalBiadj E Q hz) x') θ
proof:
:=
  isCyclic_of_generators _ (fun g hg => by
    cases g with
    | gen g => exact hgen g hg
    | cup c => exact pivotal_isCyclic_cup E Q hz c hg
    | cap c => exact pivotal_isCyclic_cap E Q hz c hg) θ

name: StringDiagrams.Biadjunction.IsCyclic.inv
statement:
theorem IsCyclic.inv {P : f ⊣⊢ g} {P' : f' ⊣⊢ g'} {α : f ⟶ f'} [IsIso α]
    (h : IsCyclic P P' α) : IsCyclic P' P (CategoryTheory.inv α)
proof:
:= by
  have hr : rightMate P' P (CategoryTheory.inv α) ≫ rightMate P P' α = 𝟙 _ := by
    rw [← rightMate_comp, IsIso.hom_inv_id, rightMate_id]
  have hl : leftMate P' P (CategoryTheory.inv α) ≫ leftMate P P' α = 𝟙 _ := by
    rw [← leftMate_comp, IsIso.hom_inv_id, leftMate_id]
  have : IsIso (rightMate P P' α) :=
    ⟨rightMate P' P (CategoryTheory.inv α),
      by rw [← rightMate_comp, IsIso.inv_hom_id, rightMate_id], hr⟩
  rw [← h.eq] at hl
  rw [IsCyclic, IsIso.eq_inv_of_inv_hom_id hr, IsIso.eq_inv_of_inv_hom_id hl]

proof:

  rwa [IsIso.Iso.inv_hom] at this

name: StringDiagrams.Biadjunction.rightMate_left_unit
statement:
theorem rightMate_left_unit (P : f ⊣⊢ g) :
    rightMate (id a) (P.comp P.symm) P.left.unit = P.right.counit
proof:
:= by
  apply conjugateEquiv_eq_of_unit
  simp only [id_left, comp_left, symm_left, Adjunction.id, Adjunction.comp_unit,
    Adjunction.compUnit]
  symm
  calc
    _ = P.left.unit ⊗≫ f ◁ leftZigzag P.right.unit P.right.counit ⊗≫ 𝟙 _ := by
      bicategory
    _ = _ := by
      rw [P.right.left_triangle]; bicategory

    leftMate (id a) (P.comp P.symm) P.left.unit = P.right.counit

  rw [leftMate, Equiv.symm_apply_eq]
  symm
  apply conjugateEquiv_eq_of_unit
  simp only [id_right, comp_right, symm_right, Adjunction.id, Adjunction.comp_unit,
    Adjunction.compUnit]
  calc
    _ = P.left.unit ⊗≫ rightZigzag P.right.unit P.right.counit ▷ g ⊗≫ 𝟙 _ := by
      bicategory
    _ = _ := by
      rw [P.right.right_triangle]; bicategory

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.whisker_nil_start_eq_cast
statement:
theorem whisker_nil_start_eq_cast (d : a ⟶ b) (hw : a.WhiskerOK (Obj.nil a.start) [])
    (ha : a = a.whisker (Obj.nil a.start) []) (hb : b = b.whisker (Obj.nil a.start) []) :
    whisker d (Obj.nil a.start) [] hw = cast d ha hb
proof:
:= by
  apply Diagram.ext
  simp only [layers_whisker, layers_cast]
  conv_rhs => rw [← List.map_id (layers d)]
  exact List.map_congr_left fun L hL =>
    show L.whisker (Obj.nil a.start) [] = id L from
      Layer.ext ((chain d).start_of_mem hL).symm (by simp [Layer.whisker]) rfl
        (by simp [Layer.whisker])

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.lin_rel_self
statement: theorem lin_rel_self (i : P.Rel) : P.lin (P.rel i) = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h0 : P.rel i = 0
  · rw [h0, lin_zero]
  obtain ⟨d, -⟩ := Finsupp.ne_iff.mp h0
  have hw : (P.dom i).WhiskerOK (Obj.nil (P.dom i).start) [] := ⟨trivial, rfl, trivial⟩
  have ha : P.dom i = (P.dom i).whisker (Obj.nil (P.dom i).start) [] :=
    Obj.ext rfl (by simp [Obj.whisker])
  have hb : P.cod i = (P.cod i).whisker (Obj.nil (P.dom i).start) [] :=
    Obj.ext (Diagram.chain (d : P.dom i ⟶ P.cod i)).start_eq (by simp [Obj.whisker])
  have key := P.lin_rel i _ [] hw
  have e : LinDiagram.whisker (P.rel i) (Obj.nil (P.dom i).start) [] hw =
      LinDiagram.cast (P.rel i) ha hb := by
    unfold LinDiagram.whisker LinDiagram.cast
    congr 1
    funext d'
    exact Diagram.whisker_nil_start_eq_cast d' hw ha hb
  rw [e, lin_cast] at key
  have := congrArg (fun t => eqToHom (congrArg P.obj ha) ≫ t ≫ eqToHom (congrArg P.obj hb.symm))
    key
  simpa using this

theorem diag_eq_of_rel (i : P.Rel) {d₁ d₂ : P.dom i ⟶ P.cod i}

proof:
:= by
  have := P.lin_rel_self i
  rwa [h, lin_sub, lin_of, lin_of, sub_eq_zero] at this

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.leftZigzag_eq
statement:
theorem leftZigzag_eq (x : l ⟶ m) (y : m ⟶ l) (η : 𝟙 l ⟶ x ≫ y) (ε : y ≫ x ⟶ 𝟙 m) :
    leftZigzag η ε = η ▷ x ≫ (α_ x y x).hom ≫ x ◁ ε

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.rightZigzag_eq
statement:
theorem rightZigzag_eq (x : l ⟶ m) (y : m ⟶ l) (η : 𝟙 l ⟶ x ≫ y) (ε : y ≫ x ⟶ 𝟙 m) :
    rightZigzag η ε = y ◁ η ≫ (α_ y x y).inv ≫ ε ▷ y

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.leftZigzag_diag
statement:
theorem leftZigzag_diag (x : l ⟶ m) (y : m ⟶ l) (cup : Obj.nil l.region ⟶ x.obj.tensor y.obj)
    (cap : y.obj.tensor x.obj ⟶ Obj.nil m.region) :
    leftZigzag (P.diag cup : 𝟙 l ⟶ x ≫ y) (P.diag cap : y ≫ x ⟶ 𝟙 m) =
      (λ_ x).hom ≫ (P.diag (P.leftZigzagD x y cup cap) : x ⟶ x) ≫ (ρ_ x).inv
proof:
:= by
  rw [leftZigzag_eq]
  change P.wRAt l.region (P.diag cup) x.obj rfl x.start_eq ≫
      eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.tensor_assoc x.obj y.obj x.obj)) ≫ P.wL x.obj (P.diag cap) =
    eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.nil_tensor x.start_eq)) ≫ P.diag (P.leftZigzagD x y cup cap) ≫
      eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.tensor_nil x.obj m.region).symm)
  rw [P.wRAt_diag cup _ (Bicat.Hom.composable (𝟙 l) x),
    P.wL_diag_of_composable _ cap (Bicat.Hom.composable x (y ≫ x))]
  simp [Diagram.leftZigzag, Diagram.cast_eq, P.diag_eqToHom]

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.rightZigzag_diag
statement:
theorem rightZigzag_diag (x : l ⟶ m) (y : m ⟶ l) (cup : Obj.nil l.region ⟶ x.obj.tensor y.obj)
    (cap : y.obj.tensor x.obj ⟶ Obj.nil m.region) :
    rightZigzag (P.diag cup : 𝟙 l ⟶ x ≫ y) (P.diag cap : y ≫ x ⟶ 𝟙 m) =
      (ρ_ y).hom ≫ (P.diag (P.rightZigzagD x y cup cap) : y ⟶ y) ≫ (λ_ y).inv
proof:
:= by
  rw [rightZigzag_eq]
  change P.wL y.obj (P.diag cup) ≫
      eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.tensor_assoc y.obj x.obj y.obj).symm) ≫
        P.wRAt m.region (P.diag cap) y.obj (y ≫ x).start_eq rfl =
    eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.tensor_nil y.obj l.region)) ≫
      P.diag (P.rightZigzagD x y cup cap) ≫
        eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (Obj.nil_tensor y.start_eq).symm)
  rw [P.wRAt_diag cap _ (Bicat.Hom.composable (y ≫ x) y),
    P.wL_diag_of_composable _ cup (Bicat.Hom.composable y (𝟙 l))]
  simp [Diagram.rightZigzag, Diagram.cast_eq, P.diag_eqToHom]

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.diag_eq_id_of_rel
statement:
theorem diag_eq_id_of_rel {a : Obj S} (i : P.Rel) {z e : P.dom i ⟶ P.cod i}
    (he : Diagram.layers e = []) (hi : P.rel i = LinDiagram.of z - LinDiagram.of e)
    (hdom : P.dom i = a) (Z : a ⟶ a) (hz : Diagram.layers z = Diagram.layers Z) :
    P.diag Z = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  have hcod : P.cod i = a := (Diagram.eq_of_layers_eq_nil e he).symm.trans hdom
  rw [P.diag_eq_of_layers_eq' Z z hdom.symm hcod.symm hz.symm, P.diag_eq_eqToHom_of_rel i he hi]
  simp

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.adjunctionOfRels_unit
statement:
@[simp] theorem adjunctionOfRels_unit (x : l ⟶ m) (y : m ⟶ l)
    (cup : Obj.nil l.region ⟶ x.obj.tensor y.obj) (cap : y.obj.tensor x.obj ⟶ Obj.nil m.region)
    (i : P.Rel) {z e : P.dom i ⟶ P.cod i} (he : Diagram.layers e = [])
    (hi : P.rel i = LinDiagram.of z - LinDiagram.of e) (hidom : P.dom i = x.obj)
    (hz : Diagram.layers z = Diagram.layers (P.leftZigzagD x y cup cap))
    (j : P.Rel) {z' e' : P.dom j ⟶ P.cod j} (he' : Diagram.layers e' = [])
    (hj : P.rel j = LinDiagram.of z' - LinDiagram.of e') (hjdom : P.dom j = y.obj)
    (hz' : Diagram.layers z' = Diagram.layers (P.rightZigzagD x y cup cap)) :
    (adjunctionOfRels x y cup cap i he hi hidom hz j he' hj hjdom hz').unit = P.diag cup

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.adjunctionOfRels_counit
statement:
@[simp] theorem adjunctionOfRels_counit (x : l ⟶ m) (y : m ⟶ l)
    (cup : Obj.nil l.region ⟶ x.obj.tensor y.obj) (cap : y.obj.tensor x.obj ⟶ Obj.nil m.region)
    (i : P.Rel) {z e : P.dom i ⟶ P.cod i} (he : Diagram.layers e = [])
    (hi : P.rel i = LinDiagram.of z - LinDiagram.of e) (hidom : P.dom i = x.obj)
    (hz : Diagram.layers z = Diagram.layers (P.leftZigzagD x y cup cap))
    (j : P.Rel) {z' e' : P.dom j ⟶ P.cod j} (he' : Diagram.layers e' = [])
    (hj : P.rel j = LinDiagram.of z' - LinDiagram.of e') (hjdom : P.dom j = y.obj)
    (hz' : Diagram.layers z' = Diagram.layers (P.rightZigzagD x y cup cap)) :
    (adjunctionOfRels x y cup cap i he hi hidom hz j he' hj hjdom hz').counit = P.diag cap

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.layers_leftZigzagM
statement:
@[simp] theorem layers_leftZigzagM (cup : Obj.unit ⟶ x.tensor y) (cap : y.tensor x ⟶ Obj.unit) :
    layers (leftZigzagM cup cap) = (layers cup).map (·.wr x.word) ++ (layers cap).map (·.wl x)

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.layers_rightZigzagM
statement:
@[simp] theorem layers_rightZigzagM (cup : Obj.unit ⟶ x.tensor y) (cap : y.tensor x ⟶ Obj.unit) :
    layers (rightZigzagM cup cap) = (layers cup).map (·.wl y) ++ (layers cap).map (·.wr y.word)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.evaluation_coevaluation_diag
statement:
theorem evaluation_coevaluation_diag (cup : Obj.unit ⟶ x.tensor y) (cap : y.tensor x ⟶ Obj.unit) :
    (P.diag cup : 𝟙_ P.Presented ⟶ P.obj x ⊗ P.obj y) ▷ P.obj x ≫ (MonoidalCategory.associator _ _ _).hom ≫
        P.obj x ◁ (P.diag cap : P.obj y ⊗ P.obj x ⟶ 𝟙_ P.Presented) =
      (λ_ (P.obj x)).hom ≫ P.diag (Diagram.leftZigzagM cup cap) ≫ (ρ_ (P.obj x)).inv
proof:
:= by
  change P.wR (P.diag cup) x ≫ _ ≫ P.wL x (P.diag cap) = _
  simp [wR_diag, wL_diag, associator_eq, leftUnitor_eq, rightUnitor_eq, Diagram.leftZigzagM,
    Diagram.cast_eq, P.diag_eqToHom]

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.coevaluation_evaluation_diag
statement:
theorem coevaluation_evaluation_diag (cup : Obj.unit ⟶ x.tensor y) (cap : y.tensor x ⟶ Obj.unit) :
    P.obj y ◁ (P.diag cup : 𝟙_ P.Presented ⟶ P.obj x ⊗ P.obj y) ≫ (MonoidalCategory.associator _ _ _).inv ≫
        (P.diag cap : P.obj y ⊗ P.obj x ⟶ 𝟙_ P.Presented) ▷ P.obj y =
      (ρ_ (P.obj y)).hom ≫ P.diag (Diagram.rightZigzagM cup cap) ≫ (λ_ (P.obj y)).inv
proof:
:= by
  change P.wL y (P.diag cup) ≫ _ ≫ P.wR (P.diag cap) y = _
  simp [wR_diag, wL_diag, associator_eq, leftUnitor_eq, rightUnitor_eq, Diagram.rightZigzagM,
    Diagram.cast_eq, P.diag_eqToHom]

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.exactPairingOfZigzag_coevaluation
statement:
theorem exactPairingOfZigzag_coevaluation (cup : Obj.unit ⟶ x.tensor y)
    (cap : y.tensor x ⟶ Obj.unit) (hl : P.diag (Diagram.leftZigzagM cup cap) = 𝟙 _)
    (hr : P.diag (Diagram.rightZigzagM cup cap) = 𝟙 _) :
    @ExactPairing.coevaluation _ _ _ _ _ (P.exactPairingOfZigzag cup cap hl hr) = P.diag cup

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.exactPairingOfZigzag_evaluation
statement:

name: StringDiagrams.Signature.ColourDuality.dualWord_eq
statement: theorem dualWord_eq (w : List S.Colour) : D.dualWord w = (w.map D.dual).reverse
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons c w ih => simp [ih]

name: StringDiagrams.Signature.ColourDuality.dualWord_append
statement:
@[simp] theorem dualWord_append (u w : List S.Colour) :
    D.dualWord (u ++ w) = D.dualWord w ++ D.dualWord u

name: StringDiagrams.Signature.ColourDuality.ok_dualWord
statement:
theorem ok_dualWord (r : S.Region) (w : List S.Colour) (h : S.ok r w) :
    S.ok (S.endR r w) (D.dualWord w) ∧ S.endR (S.endR r w) (D.dualWord w) = r
proof:
:= by
  induction w generalizing r with
  | nil => exact ⟨trivial, rfl⟩
  | cons c w ih =>
    obtain ⟨hc, hw⟩ := h
    obtain ⟨ih₁, ih₂⟩ := ih _ hw
    simp only [Signature.endR_cons, dualWord_cons, Signature.ok_append, Signature.endR_append,
      ih₂, Signature.ok_cons, Signature.ok_nil, and_true, Signature.endR_nil, D.src_dual,
      D.tgt_dual, hc]
    exact ih₁

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.dualHom_obj
statement:
@[simp] theorem dualHom_obj {l m : P.Bicat} (x : l ⟶ m) :
    (P.dualHom D x).obj = ⟨m.region, D.dualWord x.obj.word⟩

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.dualHom_comp
statement:
@[simp] theorem dualHom_comp {l m n : P.Bicat} (x : l ⟶ m) (y : m ⟶ n) :
    P.dualHom D (x ≫ y) = P.dualHom D y ≫ P.dualHom D x
proof:
:=
  Bicat.Hom.ext (Obj.ext rfl (by
    show D.dualWord (x.obj.word ++ y.obj.word) = D.dualWord y.obj.word ++ D.dualWord x.obj.word
    simp))

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.headHom_comp_tailHom
statement:
theorem headHom_comp_tailHom {l m : P.Bicat} (x : l ⟶ m) (c : S.Colour) (w : List S.Colour)
    (hx : x.obj.word = c :: w) : P.headHom x c w hx ≫ P.tailHom x c w hx = x
proof:
:=
  Bicat.Hom.ext (Obj.ext x.start_eq.symm (by
    show [c] ++ w = x.obj.word
    rw [hx]; rfl))

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.dualHom_tail_comp_head
statement:
theorem dualHom_tail_comp_head {l m : P.Bicat} (x : l ⟶ m) (c : S.Colour) (w : List S.Colour)
    (hx : x.obj.word = c :: w) :
    P.dualHom D (P.tailHom x c w hx) ≫ P.dualHom D (P.headHom x c w hx) = P.dualHom D x

theorem IsCyclic.add {P : f ⊣⊢ g} {P' : f' ⊣⊢ g'} {α β : f ⟶ f'} (hα : IsCyclic P P' α)

name: StringDiagrams.Biadjunction.IsCyclic.sum
statement:
theorem IsCyclic.sum {ι : Type*} {P : f ⊣⊢ g} {P' : f' ⊣⊢ g'} (s : Finset ι)
    {α : ι → (f ⟶ f')} (h : ∀ i ∈ s, IsCyclic P P' (α i)) :
    IsCyclic P P' (∑ i ∈ s, α i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsCyclic, rightMate_sum, leftMate_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i hi => (h i hi).eq

name: StringDiagrams.ColourCupCapDiagrams.layers_whisker_nil_of_start
statement:
theorem layers_whisker_nil_of_start {a b : Obj S} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (Diagram.layers f).map (·.whisker ⟨a.start, []⟩ []) = Diagram.layers f
proof:
:= by
  conv_rhs => rw [← List.map_id (Diagram.layers f)]
  exact List.map_congr_left fun L hL =>
    Layer.ext ((Diagram.chain f).start_of_mem hL).symm (List.nil_append _) rfl (List.append_nil _)

name: StringDiagrams.ColourCupCapDiagrams.layers_cupW_append
statement:
theorem layers_cupW_append (u w : List S.Colour) (h : S.ok r (u ++ w)) :
    Diagram.layers (K.cupW r (u ++ w) h) =
      Diagram.layers (K.cupW r u ((Signature.ok_append r u w).1 h).1) ++
        (Diagram.layers (K.cupW (S.endR r u) w ((Signature.ok_append r u w).1 h).2)).map
          (·.whisker ⟨r, u⟩ (D.dualWord u))
proof:
:= by
  induction u generalizing r with
  | nil => exact (layers_whisker_nil_of_start (K.cupW r w h)).symm
  | cons c u ih =>
    simp only [List.cons_append, layers_cupW_cons, ih, List.map_append, List.map_map,
      List.append_assoc]
    congr 2
    exact List.map_congr_left fun L _ => by
      simp [Layer.whisker_whisker, Obj.tensor]

name: StringDiagrams.ColourCupCapDiagrams.layers_rotR

    Diagram.layers (K.rotR d hu hs) =

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.Bicat.diag_comp_diag
statement:
theorem Bicat.diag_comp_diag {x y z : l ⟶ m} (d : x.obj ⟶ y.obj) (e : y.obj ⟶ z.obj) :
    Bicat.homOf (x := x) (x' := y) (P.diag d) ≫ Bicat.homOf (x' := z) (P.diag e) =
      Bicat.homOf (P.diag (d ≫ e))

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.Bicat.id_eq_diag
statement: theorem Bicat.id_eq_diag (x : l ⟶ m) : 𝟙 x = (P.diag (𝟙 x.obj) : x ⟶ x)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.Bicat.eqToHom_eq_diag
statement:
theorem Bicat.eqToHom_eq_diag {x y : l ⟶ m} (h : x = y) :
    eqToHom h = (P.diag (eqToHom (congrArg Bicat.Hom.obj h)) : x ⟶ y)
proof:
:= by
  subst h; exact Bicat.id_eq_diag P x

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.Bicat.whiskerLeft_diag
statement:
theorem Bicat.whiskerLeft_diag (x : l ⟶ m) {y y' : m ⟶ n} (d : y.obj ⟶ y'.obj) :
    x ◁ (P.diag d : y ⟶ y') =
      (P.diag (Diagram.lwhisker x.obj d (Bicat.Hom.composable x y) :
        (x ≫ y).obj ⟶ (x ≫ y').obj) : x ≫ y ⟶ x ≫ y')

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.Bicat.diag_whiskerRight
statement:
theorem Bicat.diag_whiskerRight {x x' : l ⟶ m} (d : x.obj ⟶ x'.obj) (y : m ⟶ n) :
    (P.diag d : x ⟶ x') ▷ y =
      (P.diag (Diagram.rwhisker d y.obj (Bicat.Hom.composable x y) :
        (x ≫ y).obj ⟶ (x' ≫ y).obj) : x ≫ y ⟶ x' ≫ y)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.ColourCupsCaps.biadjunctions_left_unit
statement:
theorem ColourCupsCaps.biadjunctions_left_unit (Q : ColourCupsCaps P D) (x : l ⟶ m) (c : S.Colour)
    (hx : x.obj.word = [c]) (h₁ : Obj.nil (S.colourSrc c) = (𝟙 l : l ⟶ l).obj)
    (h₂ : (⟨S.colourSrc c, [c, D.dual c]⟩ : Obj S) = (x ≫ P.dualHom D x).obj) :
    (Q.biadjunctions x c hx).left.unit = P.diag (Diagram.cast (Q.cup c) h₁ h₂)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.ColourCupsCaps.biadjunctions_left_counit
statement:
theorem ColourCupsCaps.biadjunctions_left_counit (Q : ColourCupsCaps P D) (x : l ⟶ m)
    (c : S.Colour) (hx : x.obj.word = [c])
    (h₁ : (⟨S.colourTgt c, [D.dual c, c]⟩ : Obj S) = (P.dualHom D x ≫ x).obj)
    (h₂ : Obj.nil (S.colourTgt c) = (𝟙 m : m ⟶ m).obj) :
    (Q.biadjunctions x c hx).left.counit = P.diag (Diagram.cast (Q.cap c) h₁ h₂)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.ColourCupsCaps.biadjunctions_right_unit
statement:
theorem ColourCupsCaps.biadjunctions_right_unit (Q : ColourCupsCaps P D) (x : l ⟶ m)

    (h₂ : (⟨S.colourTgt c, [D.dual c, c]⟩ : Obj S) = (P.dualHom D x ≫ x).obj) :

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.ColourCupsCaps.biadjunctions_right_counit
statement:
theorem ColourCupsCaps.biadjunctions_right_counit (Q : ColourCupsCaps P D) (x : l ⟶ m)

    (h₂ : Obj.nil (S.colourSrc c) = (𝟙 l : l ⟶ l).obj) :
    (Q.biadjunctions x c hx).right.counit = P.diag (Diagram.cast (Q.cap' c) h₁ h₂)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.biadjW_left_unit_eq_wordCup
statement:
theorem biadjW_left_unit_eq_wordCup (Q : ColourCupsCaps P D) (w : List S.Colour) :
    ∀ {l m : P.Bicat} (x : l ⟶ m) (hx : x.obj.word = w),
      (biadjW Q.biadjunctions w x hx).left.unit = P.diag (Q.toDiagrams.wordCup x)
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil =>
    intro l m x hx
    refine P.diag_eq_of_layers_eq ?_
    simp [ColourCupCapDiagrams.layers_cupW_congr _ hx]
  | cons c w ih =>
    intro l m x hx
    rw [biadjW_cons_left_unit]
    have ih' : (biadj Q.biadjunctions (P.tailHom x c w hx)).left.unit = _ :=
      ih (P.tailHom x c w hx) rfl
    rw [ih']
    simp [bicategoricalComp, Strict.associator_eqToIso, Strict.leftUnitor_eqToIso]
    rw [ColourCupsCaps.biadjunctions_left_unit Q (P.headHom x c w hx) c rfl
      (congrArg Obj.nil (Bicat.Hom.colourSrc_eq_of_word_eq_cons x hx))
      (Obj.ext (Bicat.Hom.colourSrc_eq_of_word_eq_cons x hx) rfl)]
    simp only [Bicat.whiskerLeft_diag, Bicat.diag_whiskerRight, Bicat.eqToHom_eq_diag,
      Bicat.id_eq_diag]
    simp only [Bicat.diag_comp_diag]
    apply P.diag_eq_of_layers_eq
    simp only [Diagram.layers_comp, Diagram.layers_cast, Diagram.layers_lwhisker,
      Diagram.layers_rwhisker, Diagram.layers_eqToHom,
      List.nil_append, List.append_nil, layers_wordCup,
      ColourCupCapDiagrams.layers_cupW_congr _ hx, ColourCupCapDiagrams.layers_cupW_cons,
      List.map_map]
    erw [Diagram.layers_id]
    simp only [List.map_nil, List.nil_append, List.append_nil]
    rfl

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.biadjW_left_counit_eq_wordCap
statement:
theorem biadjW_left_counit_eq_wordCap (Q : ColourCupsCaps P D) (w : List S.Colour) :
    ∀ {l m : P.Bicat} (x : l ⟶ m) (hx : x.obj.word = w),
      (biadjW Q.biadjunctions w x hx).left.counit = P.diag (Q.toDiagrams.wordCap x)
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil =>
    intro l m x hx
    refine P.diag_eq_of_layers_eq ?_
    simp [ColourCupCapDiagrams.layers_capW_congr _ hx]
  | cons c w ih =>
    intro l m x hx
    rw [biadjW_cons_left_counit]
    have ih' : (biadj Q.biadjunctions (P.tailHom x c w hx)).left.counit = _ :=
      ih (P.tailHom x c w hx) rfl
    rw [ih']
    simp [bicategoricalComp, Strict.associator_eqToIso, Strict.leftUnitor_eqToIso]
    rw [ColourCupsCaps.biadjunctions_left_counit Q (P.headHom x c w hx) c rfl rfl rfl]
    simp only [Bicat.whiskerLeft_diag, Bicat.diag_whiskerRight, Bicat.eqToHom_eq_diag,
      Bicat.id_eq_diag]
    simp only [Bicat.diag_comp_diag]
    apply P.diag_eq_of_layers_eq
    simp only [Diagram.layers_comp, Diagram.layers_cast, Diagram.layers_lwhisker,
      Diagram.layers_rwhisker, Diagram.layers_eqToHom,
      List.nil_append, layers_wordCap,
      ColourCupCapDiagrams.layers_capW_congr _ hx, ColourCupCapDiagrams.layers_capW_cons,
      List.map_map]
    erw [Diagram.layers_id]
    simp only [List.map_nil, List.nil_append]
    congr 1
    exact List.map_congr_left fun L _ =>
      Layer.ext (Bicat.Hom.endR_region (P.tailHom x c w hx)).symm rfl rfl rfl

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.biadjW_right_unit_eq_wordCup'
statement:
theorem biadjW_right_unit_eq_wordCup' (Q : ColourCupsCaps P D) (w : List S.Colour) :

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.biadjW_right_counit_eq_wordCap'
statement:
theorem biadjW_right_counit_eq_wordCap' (Q : ColourCupsCaps P D) (w : List S.Colour) :

    simp [bicategoricalComp, Strict.associator_eqToIso, Strict.leftUnitor_eqToIso]
    rw [ColourCupsCaps.biadjunctions_right_counit Q (P.headHom x c w hx) c rfl
      (Obj.ext (Bicat.Hom.colourSrc_eq_of_word_eq_cons x hx) rfl)
      (congrArg Obj.nil (Bicat.Hom.colourSrc_eq_of_word_eq_cons x hx))]
    simp only [Bicat.whiskerLeft_diag, Bicat.diag_whiskerRight, Bicat.eqToHom_eq_diag]
    simp only [Bicat.diag_comp_diag]
    apply P.diag_eq_of_layers_eq
    simp only [Diagram.layers_comp, Diagram.layers_cast, Diagram.layers_lwhisker,
      Diagram.layers_rwhisker, Diagram.layers_eqToHom,
      List.nil_append, layers_wordCap',
      ColourCupCapDiagrams.layers_cap'W_congr _ hx, ColourCupCapDiagrams.layers_cap'W_cons,
      List.map_map]
    rfl

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.isCyclic_gen_iff
statement:
theorem isCyclic_gen_iff (g : S.Gen) (hg : S.GenValid g) :
    Biadjunction.IsCyclic (biadj Q.biadjunctions (P.genDom g hg))
        (biadj Q.biadjunctions (P.genCod g hg)) (P.gen2 g hg) ↔
      P.diag (Q.toDiagrams.genRotR g hg) = P.diag (Q.toDiagrams.genRotL g hg)
proof:
:= by
  have e₁ : P.diag (Q.toDiagrams.rotateR (x := P.genDom g hg) (x' := P.genCod g hg)
      (genDiag g hg)) = P.diag (Q.toDiagrams.genRotR g hg) :=
    P.diag_eq_of_layers_eq (by
      simp only [ColourCupCapDiagrams.rotateR, ColourCupCapDiagrams.genRotR]
      rfl)
  have e₂ : P.diag (Q.toDiagrams.rotateL (x := P.genDom g hg) (x' := P.genCod g hg)
      (genDiag g hg)) = P.diag (Q.toDiagrams.genRotL g hg) :=
    P.diag_eq_of_layers_eq (by
      simp only [ColourCupCapDiagrams.rotateL, ColourCupCapDiagrams.genRotL]
      rfl)
  rw [← e₁, ← e₂]
  exact isCyclic_biadj_diag_iff Q (x := P.genDom g hg) (x' := P.genCod g hg) (genDiag g hg)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.diag_eq_diag_of_rel

theorem diag_eq_diag_of_rel {a b : Obj S} (d₁ d₂ : a ⟶ b) (i : P.Rel)
    {r₁ r₂ : P.dom i ⟶ P.cod i} (hi : P.rel i = LinDiagram.of r₁ - LinDiagram.of r₂)
    (hdom : P.dom i = a) (hcod : P.cod i = b) (h₁ : Diagram.layers r₁ = Diagram.layers d₁)
    (h₂ : Diagram.layers r₂ = Diagram.layers d₂) : P.diag d₁ = P.diag d₂
proof:
:= by
  rw [P.diag_eq_of_layers_eq' _ r₁ hdom.symm hcod.symm h₁.symm,
    P.diag_eq_of_layers_eq' _ r₂ hdom.symm hcod.symm h₂.symm, P.diag_eq_of_rel i hi]

statement:
theorem isCyclic_gen_of_rel (g : S.Gen) (hg : S.GenValid g) (i : P.Rel)
    {r₁ r₂ : P.dom i ⟶ P.cod i} (hi : P.rel i = LinDiagram.of r₁ - LinDiagram.of r₂)
    (hdom : P.dom i = ⟨S.right g, D.dualWord (S.cod g)⟩)
    (hcod : P.cod i = ⟨S.right g, D.dualWord (S.dom g)⟩)
    (h₁ : Diagram.layers r₁ = Diagram.layers (Q.toDiagrams.genRotR g hg))
    (h₂ : Diagram.layers r₂ = Diagram.layers (Q.toDiagrams.genRotL g hg)) :
    Biadjunction.IsCyclic (biadj Q.biadjunctions (P.genDom g hg))
      (biadj Q.biadjunctions (P.genCod g hg)) (P.gen2 g hg)
proof:
:=
  (isCyclic_gen_iff Q g hg).2 (diag_eq_diag_of_rel _ _ i hi hdom hcod h₁ h₂)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.isCyclic_of_genRot
statement:

    (hrot : ∀ (g : S.Gen) (hg : S.GenValid g),

name: StringDiagrams.Biadjunction.rightTrace_comp
statement:
theorem rightTrace_comp (P : f ⊣⊢ g) (P' : f' ⊣⊢ g') (α : f ⟶ f') (β : f' ⟶ f) :
    rightTrace P (α ≫ β) = rightTrace P' (β ≫ doubleMate P P' α)
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ : P.left.unit ≫ α ▷ g = P'.left.unit ≫ f' ◁ rightMate P P' α :=
    unit_comp_whiskerRight_eq P'.left P.left α
  have h₂ : f ◁ rightMate P P' α ≫ P.right.counit =
      doubleMate P P' α ▷ g' ≫ P'.right.counit :=
    whiskerLeft_comp_counit_eq P.right P'.right (rightMate P P' α)
  simp only [rightTrace, comp_whiskerRight, Category.assoc]
  rw [reassoc_of% h₁, whisker_exchange_assoc, h₂]

name: StringDiagrams.Biadjunction.leftTrace_comp
statement:
theorem leftTrace_comp (P : f ⊣⊢ g) (P' : f' ⊣⊢ g') (α : f ⟶ f') (β : f' ⟶ f) :
    leftTrace P (α ≫ β) = leftTrace P' (doubleMate P' P β ≫ α)
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ : g ◁ β ≫ P.left.counit = rightMate P' P β ▷ f' ≫ P'.left.counit :=
    whiskerLeft_comp_counit_eq P.left P'.left β
  have h₂ : P.right.unit ≫ rightMate P' P β ▷ f =
      P'.right.unit ≫ g' ◁ doubleMate P' P β :=
    unit_comp_whiskerRight_eq P'.right P.right (rightMate P' P β)
  simp only [leftTrace, Bicategory.whiskerLeft_comp, Category.assoc]
  rw [h₁, whisker_exchange_assoc, reassoc_of% h₂]

statement:
theorem rightTrace_comp_comm_of_isCyclic_right {P : f ⊣⊢ g} {P' : f' ⊣⊢ g'} (α : f ⟶ f')
    {β : f' ⟶ f} (hβ : IsCyclic P' P β) :
    rightTrace P (α ≫ β) = rightTrace P' (β ≫ α)

name: StringDiagrams.Biadjunction.leftTrace_comp_comm_of_isCyclic_right
statement:
theorem leftTrace_comp_comm_of_isCyclic_right {P : f ⊣⊢ g} {P' : f' ⊣⊢ g'} (α : f ⟶ f')
    {β : f' ⟶ f} (hβ : IsCyclic P' P β) :
    leftTrace P (α ≫ β) = leftTrace P' (β ≫ α)

StringDiagrams.Biadjunction.rightTrace_eq_leftTrace_rightMate
statement:
theorem rightTrace_eq_leftTrace_rightMate (P : f ⊣⊢ g) (α : f ⟶ f) :
    rightTrace P α = leftTrace P.symm (rightMate P P α)
proof:
:= by
  rw [rightTrace, leftTrace_symm, reassoc_of% (unit_comp_whiskerRight_eq P.left P.left α)]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.Biadjunction.rightTrace_eq_leftTrace_leftMate
statement:
theorem rightTrace_eq_leftTrace_leftMate (P : f ⊣⊢ g) (α : f ⟶ f) :
    rightTrace P α = leftTrace P.symm (leftMate P P α)
proof:
:= by
  rw [rightTrace, leftTrace_symm, whiskerRight_comp_counit_eq P.right P.right α]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.Biadjunction.leftTrace_eq_rightTrace_rightMate
statement:
theorem leftTrace_eq_rightTrace_rightMate (P : f ⊣⊢ g) (α : f ⟶ f) :
    leftTrace P α = rightTrace P.symm (rightMate P P α)
proof:
:= by
  rw [leftTrace, rightTrace_symm, whiskerLeft_comp_counit_eq P.left P.left α]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.Biadjunction.leftTrace_eq_rightTrace_leftMate
statement:
theorem leftTrace_eq_rightTrace_leftMate (P : f ⊣⊢ g) (α : f ⟶ f) :
    leftTrace P α = rightTrace P.symm (leftMate P P α)
proof:
:= by
