proof:
:= by
  simp only [balance, map_add, tmul_add]; abel

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.balance_mem_part
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.sub_mem _ (SVec.tmul_mem_part (SVec.apply_mem_part (M.ract_mem q b hb) hm) hn)
    ?_
  have := SVec.tmul_mem_part hm (SVec.apply_mem_part (N.lact_mem q b hb) hn)
  rwa [← add_assoc, add_right_comm] at this

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.balance_mem_balanceRel_of_mem
proof:
:=
  Submodule.subset_span ⟨p, q, r, m, b, n, hm, hb, hn, rfl⟩

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.balanceRel_le
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.span_le.2 ?_
  rintro x ⟨p, q, r, m, b, n, hm, hb, hn, rfl⟩
  exact h p q r m b n hm hb hn

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.balanceRel_odd
statement: theorem balanceRel_odd : ∀ x ∈ balanceRel M N, (SVec.tensorObj M.toSVec N.toSVec).odd x ∈ balanceRel M N
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  refine balanceRel_le M N (S := (balanceRel M N).comap (SVec.tensorObj M.toSVec N.toSVec).odd)
    (fun p q r m b n hm hb hn => ?_) hx
  rw [Submodule.mem_comap, ← SVec.proj_one, SVec.proj_apply_of_mem_part _ (balance_mem_part M N hm hb hn)]
  split_ifs
  · exact balance_mem_balanceRel_of_mem M N hm hb hn
  · exact Submodule.zero_mem _

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.balance_mem
statement: theorem balance_mem (m : M.toSVec) (b : B) (n : N.toSVec) : balance M N m b n ∈ balanceRel M N
proof:
:= by
  rw [← SVec.proj_apply_add M.toSVec m, ← algProj_add_algProj ℬ b, ← SVec.proj_apply_add N.toSVec n,
    balance_add_left, balance_add_middle, balance_add_middle, balance_add_right,
    balance_add_right, balance_add_right, balance_add_right]
  refine Submodule.add_mem _ (Submodule.add_mem _ (Submodule.add_mem _ ?_ ?_)
    (Submodule.add_mem _ ?_ ?_)) (Submodule.add_mem _ (Submodule.add_mem _ ?_ ?_)
    (Submodule.add_mem _ ?_ ?_)) <;>
  exact balance_mem_balanceRel_of_mem M N (SVec.proj_mem_part _ _ _) (algProj_mem ℬ _ _)
    (SVec.proj_mem_part _ _ _)

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.balanceRel_lact
statement: theorem balanceRel_lact (a : A) : ∀ x ∈ balanceRel M N, (tensorK M N).lact a x ∈ balanceRel M N
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  refine balanceRel_le M N (S := (balanceRel M N).comap (SVec.toLinearMap ((tensorK M N).lact a)))
    (fun p q r m b n hm hb hn => ?_) hx
  change (tensorK M N).lact a (balance M N m b n) ∈ balanceRel M N
  have : (tensorK M N).lact a (balance M N m b n) = balance M N (M.lact a m) b n := by
    simp only [balance, map_sub, tensorK_lact_tmul]
    rw [← SVec.comp_apply, ← M.lact_ract, SVec.comp_apply]
  rw [this]
  exact balance_mem M N _ b n

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.balanceRel_ract
statement: theorem balanceRel_ract (c : C) : ∀ x ∈ balanceRel M N, (tensorK M N).ract c x ∈ balanceRel M N
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  refine balanceRel_le M N (S := (balanceRel M N).comap (SVec.toLinearMap ((tensorK M N).ract c)))
    (fun p q r m b n hm hb hn => ?_) hx
  change (tensorK M N).ract c (balance M N m b n) ∈ balanceRel M N
  have : (tensorK M N).ract c (balance M N m b n) = balance M N m b (N.ract c n) := by
    simp only [balance, map_sub, tensorK_ract_tmul]
    rw [← SVec.comp_apply, N.lact_ract, SVec.comp_apply]
  rw [this]
  exact balance_mem M N m b _

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.mem_balanceSub
statement:
theorem mem_balanceSub {x : SVec.tensorObj M.toSVec N.toSVec} :
    x ∈ balanceSub M N ↔ x ∈ balanceRel M N

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.tensorMk_tmul
statement: theorem tensorMk_tmul (m : M.toSVec) (n : N.toSVec) : tensorMk M N (m ⊗ₜ n) = btmul M N m n

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.tensorMkHom_apply
statement:
theorem tensorMkHom_apply (x : SVec.tensorObj M.toSVec N.toSVec) :

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.tensorMkHom_mem
statement: theorem tensorMkHom_mem : tensorMkHom M N ∈ SVec.parityHom _ (tensor M N).toSVec 0

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.tensorMk_add
statement:
theorem tensorMk_add (x y : SVec.tensorObj M.toSVec N.toSVec) :
    tensorMk M N (x + y) = tensorMk M N x + tensorMk M N y

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.tensorMk_smul
statement:
theorem tensorMk_smul (r : k) (x : SVec.tensorObj M.toSVec N.toSVec) :

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.tensorMk_zsmul
statement:
theorem tensorMk_zsmul (n : ℤ) (x : SVec.tensorObj M.toSVec N.toSVec) :
    tensorMk M N (n • x) = n • tensorMk M N x

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.tensorMk_zero
statement: theorem tensorMk_zero : tensorMk M N 0 = 0

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.tensorMk_surjective
statement: theorem tensorMk_surjective : Function.Surjective (tensorMk M N)

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.tensorMk_eq_tensorMk
statement:
theorem tensorMk_eq_tensorMk {x y : SVec.tensorObj M.toSVec N.toSVec} :
    tensorMk M N x = tensorMk M N y ↔ x - y ∈ balanceRel M N

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.btmul_add_left
statement:
theorem btmul_add_left (m m' : M.toSVec) (n : N.toSVec) :
    btmul M N (m + m') n = btmul M N m n + btmul M N m' n
proof:
:= by
  rw [← tensorMk_tmul, add_tmul, tensorMk_add]; rfl

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.btmul_add_right
statement:
theorem btmul_add_right (m : M.toSVec) (n n' : N.toSVec) :
    btmul M N m (n + n') = btmul M N m n + btmul M N m n'
proof:
:= by
  rw [← tensorMk_tmul, tmul_add, tensorMk_add]; rfl

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.btmul_smul_left
statement:
theorem btmul_smul_left (r : k) (m : M.toSVec) (n : N.toSVec) :
    btmul M N (r • m) n = r • btmul M N m n
proof:
:= by
  rw [← tensorMk_tmul, ← smul_tmul', tensorMk_smul]; rfl

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.btmul_smul_right
statement:
theorem btmul_smul_right (r : k) (m : M.toSVec) (n : N.toSVec) :
    btmul M N m (r • n) = r • btmul M N m n
proof:
:= by
  rw [← tensorMk_tmul, tmul_smul, tensorMk_smul]; rfl

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.btmul_zsmul_left
statement:
theorem btmul_zsmul_left (z : ℤ) (m : M.toSVec) (n : N.toSVec) :
    btmul M N (z • m) n = z • btmul M N m n
proof:
:= by
  rw [← tensorMk_tmul, ← smul_tmul', tensorMk_zsmul]; rfl

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.btmul_zero_left
statement: theorem btmul_zero_left (n : N.toSVec) : btmul M N 0 n = 0

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.btmul_zero_right
statement: theorem btmul_zero_right (m : M.toSVec) : btmul M N m 0 = 0

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.btmul_ract_lact
statement:
theorem btmul_ract_lact (m : M.toSVec) (b : B) (n : N.toSVec) :
    btmul M N (M.ract b m) n = btmul M N m (N.lact b n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← tensorMk_tmul, ← tensorMk_tmul, tensorMk_eq_tensorMk]
  exact balance_mem M N m b n

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.lact_tensorMk
statement:
theorem lact_tensorMk (a : A) (x : SVec.tensorObj M.toSVec N.toSVec) :
    (tensor M N).lact a (tensorMk M N x) = tensorMk M N ((tensorK M N).lact a x)

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.ract_tensorMk
statement:
theorem ract_tensorMk (c : C) (x : SVec.tensorObj M.toSVec N.toSVec) :
    (tensor M N).ract c (tensorMk M N x) = tensorMk M N ((tensorK M N).ract c x)

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.lact_btmul
statement:
theorem lact_btmul (a : A) (m : M.toSVec) (n : N.toSVec) :
    (tensor M N).lact a (btmul M N m n) = btmul M N (M.lact a m) n

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.ract_btmul
statement:
theorem ract_btmul (c : C) (m : M.toSVec) (n : N.toSVec) :
    (tensor M N).ract c (btmul M N m n) = btmul M N m (N.ract c n)

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.tensorMk_mem_part
statement:
theorem tensorMk_mem_part {p : ZMod 2} {x : SVec.tensorObj M.toSVec N.toSVec}
    (hx : x ∈ (SVec.tensorObj M.toSVec N.toSVec).part p) : tensorMk M N x ∈ (tensor M N).toSVec.part p

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.btmul_mem_part
statement:
theorem btmul_mem_part {p q : ZMod 2} {m : M.toSVec} {n : N.toSVec} (hm : m ∈ M.toSVec.part p)
    (hn : n ∈ N.toSVec.part q) : btmul M N m n ∈ (tensor M N).toSVec.part (p + q)

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.proj_tensorMk
statement:
theorem proj_tensorMk (p : ZMod 2) (x : SVec.tensorObj M.toSVec N.toSVec) :
    (tensor M N).toSVec.proj p (tensorMk M N x) =
      tensorMk M N ((SVec.tensorObj M.toSVec N.toSVec).proj p x)

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.tensor_induction_on
statement:
theorem tensor_induction_on {P : (tensor M N).toSVec → Prop} (x : (tensor M N).toSVec) (zero : P 0)
    (btmul : ∀ m n, P (btmul M N m n)) (add : ∀ x y, P x → P y → P (x + y)) : P x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using SVec.quot_induction_on with
  | h v =>
    induction v using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
    | tmul m n => exact btmul m n
    | add x y hx hy => exact add _ _ hx hy

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.tensor_induction_on_homogeneous
statement:
theorem tensor_induction_on_homogeneous {P : (tensor M N).toSVec → Prop} (x : (tensor M N).toSVec)
    (zero : P 0)
    (btmul : ∀ (p q : ZMod 2) (m : M.toSVec) (n : N.toSVec), m ∈ M.toSVec.part p →
      n ∈ N.toSVec.part q → P (btmul M N m n))
    (add : ∀ x y, P x → P y → P (x + y)) : P x
proof:
:= by
  refine tensor_induction_on x zero (fun m n => ?_) add
  rw [← SVec.proj_apply_add M.toSVec m, ← SVec.proj_apply_add N.toSVec n, btmul_add_left,
    btmul_add_right, btmul_add_right]
  exact add _ _ (add _ _ (btmul 0 0 _ _ (SVec.proj_mem_part _ _ _) (SVec.proj_mem_part _ _ _))
      (btmul 0 1 _ _ (SVec.proj_mem_part _ _ _) (SVec.proj_mem_part _ _ _)))
    (add _ _ (btmul 1 0 _ _ (SVec.proj_mem_part _ _ _) (SVec.proj_mem_part _ _ _))
      (btmul 1 1 _ _ (SVec.proj_mem_part _ _ _) (SVec.proj_mem_part _ _ _)))

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.tensor_hom_ext
statement:
theorem tensor_hom_ext {W : SVec k} {f g : (tensor M N).toSVec ⟶ W}
    (h : ∀ m n, f (btmul M N m n) = g (btmul M N m n)) : f = g
proof:
:=
  SVec.hom_ext fun x => tensor_induction_on (P := fun x => f x = g x) x (by simp) h
    (fun x y hx hy => by rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy])

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.tensor_hom_ext_homogeneous
proof:
:=
  SVec.hom_ext fun x => tensor_induction_on_homogeneous (P := fun x => f x = g x) x (by simp) h
    (fun x y hx hy => by rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy])

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.tensor_mem_parity_of_btmul
statement:
theorem tensor_mem_parity_of_btmul {W : SVec k} {f : (tensor M N).toSVec ⟶ W} {s : ZMod 2}
    (h : ∀ (p q : ZMod 2) (m : M.toSVec) (n : N.toSVec), m ∈ M.toSVec.part p →
      n ∈ N.toSVec.part q → f (btmul M N m n) ∈ W.part (p + q + s)) :
    f ∈ SVec.parityHom (tensor M N).toSVec W s
proof:
:= by
  intro q
  refine tensor_hom_ext_homogeneous M N fun p r m n hm hn => ?_
  change f ((tensor M N).toSVec.proj q (btmul M N m n)) = W.proj (q + s) (f (btmul M N m n))
  rw [SVec.proj_apply_of_mem_part _ (btmul_mem_part M N hm hn),
    SVec.proj_apply_of_mem_part _ (h p r m n hm hn)]
  by_cases hq : q = p + r
  · rw [ite_eq_left hq, ite_eq_left (by rw [hq])]
  · rw [ite_eq_right hq, ite_eq_right (fun e => hq (add_right_cancel e)), map_zero]

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.tensorLift_btmul
statement:
@[simp] theorem tensorLift_btmul (m : M.toSVec) (n : N.toSVec) :
    tensorLift f hf (btmul M N m n) = f m n

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.tensorLift_tensorMk
statement:
theorem tensorLift_tensorMk (x : SVec.tensorObj M.toSVec N.toSVec) :
    tensorLift f hf (tensorMk M N x) = TensorProduct.lift f x

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.whiskerRight_balance
statement:
theorem whiskerRight_balance (m : M.toSVec) (b : B) (n : N.toSVec) :
    SVec.whiskerRight f.1 N.toSVec (balance M N m b n) = balance M' N (f.1 m) b n
proof:
:= by
  have h : f.1 (M.ract b m) = M'.ract b (f.1 m) :=
    congrArg (fun φ : M.toSVec ⟶ M'.toSVec => φ m) (f.2.2 b)
  rw [balance, balance, SVec.hom_map_sub, SVec.whiskerRight_tmul, SVec.whiskerRight_tmul, h]

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.whiskerRight_mem_balanceSub
statement:
theorem whiskerRight_mem_balanceSub :
    ∀ x ∈ balanceSub M N, SVec.whiskerRight f.1 N.toSVec x ∈ balanceSub M' N
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  refine balanceRel_le M N
    (S := (balanceRel M' N).comap (SVec.toLinearMap (SVec.whiskerRight f.1 N.toSVec)))
    (fun p q r m b n _ _ _ => ?_) hx
  change SVec.whiskerRight f.1 N.toSVec (balance M N m b n) ∈ balanceRel M' N
  rw [whiskerRight_balance]
  exact balance_mem M' N _ b n

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.isHom_whiskerRight
statement:
theorem isHom_whiskerRight :
    IsHom (tensorK M N) (tensorK M' N) (SVec.whiskerRight f.1 N.toSVec)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun p a ha => ?_, fun c => ?_⟩
  · change SVec.whiskerRight (M.lact a) N.toSVec ≫ SVec.whiskerRight f.1 N.toSVec =
      twist k p (SVec.whiskerRight f.1 N.toSVec) ≫ SVec.whiskerRight (M'.lact a) N.toSVec
    rw [← SVec.comp_whiskerRight, f.2.1 p a ha, SVec.comp_whiskerRight, SVec.twist_whiskerRight]
  · exact TensorProduct.ext' fun _ _ => rfl

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.whiskerRight_tensorMk
statement:
theorem whiskerRight_tensorMk (x : SVec.tensorObj M.toSVec N.toSVec) :
    (whiskerRight f N).1 (tensorMk M N x) = tensorMk M' N (SVec.whiskerRight f.1 N.toSVec x)

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.whiskerRight_btmul
statement:
theorem whiskerRight_btmul (m : M.toSVec) (n : N.toSVec) :
    (whiskerRight f N).1 (btmul M N m n) = btmul M' N (f.1 m) n

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.id_whiskerRight
statement: theorem id_whiskerRight : whiskerRight (𝟙 M) N = 𝟙 (tensor M N)

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.comp_whiskerRight
statement:
theorem comp_whiskerRight {M'' : SuperBimodule 𝒜 ℬ} (f' : M' ⟶ M'') :
    whiskerRight (f ≫ f') N = whiskerRight f N ≫ whiskerRight f' N

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.add_whiskerRight
statement:
theorem add_whiskerRight (f' : M ⟶ M') :
    whiskerRight (f + f') N = whiskerRight f N + whiskerRight f' N
proof:
:=
  hom_ext (tensor_hom_ext M N fun m n => by
    simp only [whiskerRight_btmul, add_val, SVec.add_apply, btmul_add_left])

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.smul_whiskerRight
statement: theorem smul_whiskerRight (r : k) : whiskerRight (r • f) N = r • whiskerRight f N
proof:
:=
  hom_ext (tensor_hom_ext M N fun m n => by
    simp only [whiskerRight_btmul, smul_val, SVec.smul_apply, btmul_smul_left])

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.whiskerLeft_balance_of_mem
statement:
theorem whiskerLeft_balance_of_mem {q : ZMod 2} {g : N.toSVec ⟶ N'.toSVec} (hg : IsHom N N' g)
    (hgq : g ∈ SVec.parityHom N.toSVec N'.toSVec q) {p : ZMod 2} {m : M.toSVec}
    (hm : m ∈ M.toSVec.part p) {r : ZMod 2} {b : B} (hb : b ∈ ℬ r) (n : N.toSVec) :
    SVec.whiskerLeft M.toSVec g (balance M N m b n) = sign k ((p + r) * q) • balance M N' m b (g n)
proof:
:= by
  have h : g (N.lact b n) = sign k (r * q) • N'.lact b (g n) :=
    congrArg (fun φ : N.toSVec ⟶ N'.toSVec => φ n) (((isHom_iff_of_mem hgq).1 hg).1 r b hb)
  rw [balance, SVec.hom_map_sub, SVec.whiskerLeft_tmul hgq (SVec.apply_mem_part (M.ract_mem r b hb) hm),
    SVec.whiskerLeft_tmul hgq hm, h, tmul_smul, smul_smul, ← sign_add, ← add_mul, balance,
    smul_sub]

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.whiskerLeft_mem_balanceRel_of_mem
statement:
theorem whiskerLeft_mem_balanceRel_of_mem {q : ZMod 2} {g : N.toSVec ⟶ N'.toSVec} (hg : IsHom N N' g)
    (hgq : g ∈ SVec.parityHom N.toSVec N'.toSVec q) :
    ∀ x ∈ balanceRel M N, SVec.whiskerLeft M.toSVec g x ∈ balanceRel M N'
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  refine balanceRel_le M N
    (S := (balanceRel M N').comap (SVec.toLinearMap (SVec.whiskerLeft M.toSVec g)))
    (fun p q r m b n hm hb _ => ?_) hx
  change SVec.whiskerLeft M.toSVec g (balance M N m b n) ∈ balanceRel M N'
  rw [whiskerLeft_balance_of_mem M hg hgq hm hb]
  exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (balance_mem M N' m b _)

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.whiskerLeft_mem_balanceSub
statement:
theorem whiskerLeft_mem_balanceSub :
    ∀ x ∈ balanceSub M N, SVec.whiskerLeft M.toSVec g.1 x ∈ balanceSub M N'
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  have e : SVec.whiskerLeft M.toSVec g.1 =
      SVec.whiskerLeft M.toSVec (proj k 0 g.1) + SVec.whiskerLeft M.toSVec (proj k 1 g.1) := by
    rw [← SVec.whiskerLeft_add, proj_add_proj]
  rw [mem_balanceSub, e, SVec.add_apply]
  exact Submodule.add_mem _
    (whiskerLeft_mem_balanceRel_of_mem M (g.2.proj 0) (proj_mem 0 g.1) x hx)
    (whiskerLeft_mem_balanceRel_of_mem M (g.2.proj 1) (proj_mem 1 g.1) x hx)

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.lactK_comp_whiskerLeft
statement:
theorem lactK_comp_whiskerLeft {p : ZMod 2} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ 𝒜 p) (g : N.toSVec ⟶ N'.toSVec) :
    SVec.whiskerRight (M.lact a) N.toSVec ≫ SVec.whiskerLeft M.toSVec g =
      twist k p (SVec.whiskerLeft M.toSVec g) ≫ SVec.whiskerRight (M.lact a) N'.toSVec
proof:
:= by
  rw [SVec.twist_whiskerLeft]
  refine Supercategory.induction_on (R := k) g ?_ (fun q g hg => ?_) (fun g g' hg hg' => ?_)
  · rw [SVec.whiskerLeft_zero, map_zero, SVec.whiskerLeft_zero, Limits.zero_comp, Limits.comp_zero]
  · rw [SVec.super_interchange (M.lact_mem p a ha) hg, twist_of_mem p hg, SVec.whiskerLeft_smul,
      Linear.smul_comp, koszulSign_smul (R := k)]
  · rw [SVec.whiskerLeft_add, map_add, SVec.whiskerLeft_add, Preadditive.comp_add,
      Preadditive.add_comp, hg, hg']

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.ractK_comp_whiskerLeft_of_mem
statement:
theorem ractK_comp_whiskerLeft_of_mem {q : ZMod 2} {g : N.toSVec ⟶ N'.toSVec} (hg : IsHom N N' g)
    (hgq : g ∈ SVec.parityHom N.toSVec N'.toSVec q) (c : C) :
    ractK M N c ≫ SVec.whiskerLeft M.toSVec g = SVec.whiskerLeft M.toSVec g ≫ ractK M N' c
proof:
:= by
  rw [SVec.whiskerLeft_of_mem _ hgq, ractK_apply, ractK_apply]
  change map (M.toSVec.sgn q) (SVec.toLinearMap g) ∘ₗ map LinearMap.id (SVec.toLinearMap (N.ract c)) =
    map LinearMap.id (SVec.toLinearMap (N'.ract c)) ∘ₗ map (M.toSVec.sgn q) (SVec.toLinearMap g)
  rw [← map_comp, ← map_comp, LinearMap.comp_id, LinearMap.id_comp, ← SVec.toLinearMap_comp,
    ← SVec.toLinearMap_comp, hg.2 c]

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.isHom_whiskerLeft
statement: theorem isHom_whiskerLeft : IsHom (tensorK M N) (tensorK M N') (SVec.whiskerLeft M.toSVec g.1)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun p a ha => lactK_comp_whiskerLeft M ha g.1, fun c => ?_⟩
  have e : SVec.whiskerLeft M.toSVec g.1 =
      SVec.whiskerLeft M.toSVec (proj k 0 g.1) + SVec.whiskerLeft M.toSVec (proj k 1 g.1) := by
    rw [← SVec.whiskerLeft_add, proj_add_proj]
  change ractK M N c ≫ SVec.whiskerLeft M.toSVec g.1 = SVec.whiskerLeft M.toSVec g.1 ≫ ractK M N' c
  rw [e, Preadditive.comp_add, Preadditive.add_comp,
    ractK_comp_whiskerLeft_of_mem M (g.2.proj 0) (proj_mem 0 g.1),
    ractK_comp_whiskerLeft_of_mem M (g.2.proj 1) (proj_mem 1 g.1)]

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.whiskerLeft_tensorMk
statement:
theorem whiskerLeft_tensorMk (x : SVec.tensorObj M.toSVec N.toSVec) :
    (whiskerLeft M g).1 (tensorMk M N x) = tensorMk M N' (SVec.whiskerLeft M.toSVec g.1 x)

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.whiskerLeft_btmul
proof:
:= by
  rw [← tensorMk_tmul, whiskerLeft_tensorMk, SVec.whiskerLeft_tmul (mem_parity_iff.1 hg) hm,
    tensorMk_smul, tensorMk_tmul]

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.whiskerLeft_btmul_even
statement:
theorem whiskerLeft_btmul_even (hg : g ∈ parity (R := k) N N' 0) (m : M.toSVec) (n : N.toSVec) :
    (whiskerLeft M g).1 (btmul M N m n) = btmul M N' m (g.1 n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← tensorMk_tmul, whiskerLeft_tensorMk, SVec.whiskerLeft_even _ (mem_parity_iff.1 hg)]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.whiskerLeft_id
statement: theorem whiskerLeft_id : whiskerLeft M (𝟙 N) = 𝟙 (tensor M N)
proof:
:=
  hom_ext (SVec.quot_hom_ext _ _ fun x => by
    change tensorMk M N (SVec.whiskerLeft M.toSVec (𝟙 N.toSVec) x) = tensorMk M N x
    rw [SVec.whiskerLeft_id]; rfl)

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.whiskerLeft_comp
statement:
theorem whiskerLeft_comp {N'' : SuperBimodule ℬ 𝒞} (g' : N' ⟶ N'') :
    whiskerLeft M (g ≫ g') = whiskerLeft M g ≫ whiskerLeft M g'
proof:
:=
  hom_ext (SVec.quot_hom_ext _ _ fun x => by
    change tensorMk M N'' (SVec.whiskerLeft M.toSVec (g.1 ≫ g'.1) x) =
      tensorMk M N'' (SVec.whiskerLeft M.toSVec g'.1 (SVec.whiskerLeft M.toSVec g.1 x))
    rw [SVec.whiskerLeft_comp]; rfl)

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.whiskerLeft_add
statement: theorem whiskerLeft_add (g' : N ⟶ N') : whiskerLeft M (g + g') = whiskerLeft M g + whiskerLeft M g'
proof:
:=
  hom_ext (SVec.quot_hom_ext _ _ fun x => by
    change tensorMk M N' (SVec.whiskerLeft M.toSVec (g.1 + g'.1) x) =
      tensorMk M N' (SVec.whiskerLeft M.toSVec g.1 x) + tensorMk M N' (SVec.whiskerLeft M.toSVec g'.1 x)
    rw [SVec.whiskerLeft_add]; rfl)

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.whiskerLeft_smul
statement: theorem whiskerLeft_smul (r : k) : whiskerLeft M (r • g) = r • whiskerLeft M g
proof:
:=
  hom_ext (SVec.quot_hom_ext _ _ fun x => by
    change tensorMk M N' (SVec.whiskerLeft M.toSVec (r • g.1) x) =
      r • tensorMk M N' (SVec.whiskerLeft M.toSVec g.1 x)
    rw [SVec.whiskerLeft_smul]; rfl)

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.whiskerLeft_mem
statement:
theorem whiskerLeft_mem {q : ZMod 2} (hg : g ∈ parity (R := k) N N' q) :
    whiskerLeft M g ∈ parity (R := k) (tensor M N) (tensor M N') q

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.whiskerRight_mem
StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.super_interchange
proof:
:=
  hom_ext (SVec.quot_hom_ext _ _ fun x => by
    change tensorMk M' N' ((SVec.whiskerRight f.1 N.toSVec ≫ SVec.whiskerLeft M'.toSVec g.1) x) =
      koszulSign p q • tensorMk M' N' ((SVec.whiskerLeft M.toSVec g.1 ≫ SVec.whiskerRight f.1 N'.toSVec) x)
    rw [SVec.super_interchange (mem_parity_iff.1 hf) (mem_parity_iff.1 hg), SVec.zsmul_apply,
      tensorMk_zsmul])

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.tensor_hom_ext_left
statement:
theorem tensor_hom_ext_left {W : SVec k} {f g : (tensor (tensor M N) P).toSVec ⟶ W}
    (h : ∀ m n p, f (btmul _ P (btmul M N m n) p) = g (btmul _ P (btmul M N m n) p)) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  refine tensor_hom_ext _ P fun x p => ?_
  induction x using tensor_induction_on with
  | zero => rw [btmul_zero_left, SVec.hom_map_zero, SVec.hom_map_zero]
  | btmul m n => exact h m n p
  | add x y hx hy => rw [btmul_add_left, SVec.hom_map_add, SVec.hom_map_add, hx, hy]

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.tensor_hom_ext_right
statement:
theorem tensor_hom_ext_right {W : SVec k} {f g : (tensor M (tensor N P)).toSVec ⟶ W}
    (h : ∀ m n p, f (btmul M _ m (btmul N P n p)) = g (btmul M _ m (btmul N P n p))) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  refine tensor_hom_ext M _ fun m x => ?_
  induction x using tensor_induction_on with
  | zero => rw [btmul_zero_right, SVec.hom_map_zero, SVec.hom_map_zero]
  | btmul n p => exact h m n p
  | add x y hx hy => rw [btmul_add_right, SVec.hom_map_add, SVec.hom_map_add, hx, hy]

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.tensor_hom_ext_left_homogeneous
statement:
theorem tensor_hom_ext_left_homogeneous {W : SVec k} {f g : (tensor (tensor M N) P).toSVec ⟶ W}
    (h : ∀ (p q r : ZMod 2) (m : M.toSVec) (n : N.toSVec) (x : P.toSVec), m ∈ M.toSVec.part p →
      n ∈ N.toSVec.part q → x ∈ P.toSVec.part r →
      f (btmul _ P (btmul M N m n) x) = g (btmul _ P (btmul M N m n) x)) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  refine tensor_hom_ext_homogeneous _ P fun s r y x hy hx => ?_
  rw [← (SVec.mem_part_iff _).1 hy]
  clear hy
  induction y using tensor_induction_on_homogeneous with
  | zero => rw [map_zero, btmul_zero_left, SVec.hom_map_zero, SVec.hom_map_zero]
  | btmul p q m n hm hn =>
    rw [SVec.proj_apply_of_mem_part _ (btmul_mem_part M N hm hn)]
    split_ifs
    · exact h p q r m n x hm hn hx
    · rw [btmul_zero_left, SVec.hom_map_zero, SVec.hom_map_zero]
  | add y z hy hz => rw [map_add, btmul_add_left, SVec.hom_map_add, SVec.hom_map_add, hy, hz]

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.tensor_mem_parity_of_btmul_left
proof:
:= by
  intro t
  refine tensor_hom_ext_left_homogeneous M N P fun p q r m n x hm hn hx => ?_
  change f ((tensor (tensor M N) P).toSVec.proj t (btmul _ P (btmul M N m n) x)) =
    W.proj (t + s) (f (btmul _ P (btmul M N m n) x))
  rw [SVec.proj_apply_of_mem_part _ (btmul_mem_part _ P (btmul_mem_part M N hm hn) hx),
    SVec.proj_apply_of_mem_part _ (h p q r m n x hm hn hx)]
  by_cases ht : t = p + q + r
  · rw [ite_eq_left ht, ite_eq_left (by rw [ht])]
  · rw [ite_eq_right ht, ite_eq_right (fun e => ht (add_right_cancel e)), SVec.hom_map_zero]

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.assocTri_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem assocTri_apply (m : M.toSVec) (n : N.toSVec) (p : P.toSVec) :
    assocTri M N P m n p = btmul M _ m (btmul N P n p)

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.assocTri_balanced
statement:
theorem assocTri_balanced (m : M.toSVec) (b : B) (n : N.toSVec) :
    assocTri M N P (M.ract b m) n = assocTri M N P m (N.lact b n)
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.ext fun p => by rw [assocTri_apply, assocTri_apply, btmul_ract_lact, lact_btmul]

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.assocBi_balanced
statement:
theorem assocBi_balanced (x : (tensor M N).toSVec) (c : C) (p : P.toSVec) :
    assocBi M N P ((tensor M N).ract c x) p = assocBi M N P x (P.lact c p)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using tensor_induction_on with
  | zero => rw [SVec.hom_map_zero, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply]
  | btmul m n =>
    rw [ract_btmul, assocBi, tensorLift_btmul, tensorLift_btmul, assocTri_apply, assocTri_apply,
      btmul_ract_lact]
  | add x y hx hy =>
    rw [SVec.hom_map_add, map_add, map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.add_apply, hx, hy]

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.assocHom_btmul
statement:
@[simp] theorem assocHom_btmul (m : M.toSVec) (n : N.toSVec) (p : P.toSVec) :
    assocHom M N P (btmul _ P (btmul M N m n) p) = btmul M _ m (btmul N P n p)
proof:
:= by
  rw [assocHom, SVec.ofHom_apply, tensorLift_btmul, assocBi, tensorLift_btmul, assocTri_apply]

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.assocInvTri_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem assocInvTri_apply (n : N.toSVec) (p : P.toSVec) (m : M.toSVec) :
    assocInvTri M N P n p m = btmul _ P (btmul M N m n) p

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.assocInvTri_balanced
statement:
theorem assocInvTri_balanced (n : N.toSVec) (c : C) (p : P.toSVec) :
    assocInvTri M N P (N.ract c n) p = assocInvTri M N P n (P.lact c p)
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.ext fun m => by
    rw [assocInvTri_apply, assocInvTri_apply, ← ract_btmul, btmul_ract_lact]

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.assocInvBi_balanced
statement:
theorem assocInvBi_balanced (m : M.toSVec) (b : B) (y : (tensor N P).toSVec) :
    (assocInvBi M N P).flip (M.ract b m) y = (assocInvBi M N P).flip m ((tensor N P).lact b y)
proof:
:= by
  induction y using tensor_induction_on with
  | zero =>
    rw [LinearMap.flip_apply, LinearMap.flip_apply, SVec.hom_map_zero, map_zero]
    rfl
  | btmul n p =>
    rw [LinearMap.flip_apply, LinearMap.flip_apply, lact_btmul, assocInvBi, tensorLift_btmul,
      tensorLift_btmul, assocInvTri_apply, assocInvTri_apply, btmul_ract_lact]
  | add y z hy hz =>
    simp only [LinearMap.flip_apply, map_add] at hy hz ⊢
    rw [hy, hz]

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.assocInv_btmul
statement:
@[simp] theorem assocInv_btmul (m : M.toSVec) (n : N.toSVec) (p : P.toSVec) :
    assocInv M N P (btmul M _ m (btmul N P n p)) = btmul _ P (btmul M N m n) p
proof:
:= by
  rw [assocInv, SVec.ofHom_apply, tensorLift_btmul, LinearMap.flip_apply, assocInvBi,
    tensorLift_btmul, assocInvTri_apply]

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.assocHom_mem
statement:
theorem assocHom_mem :
    assocHom M N P ∈ SVec.parityHom (tensor (tensor M N) P).toSVec (tensor M (tensor N P)).toSVec 0
proof:
:=
  tensor_mem_parity_of_btmul_left M N P fun p q r m n x hm hn hx => by
    rw [assocHom_btmul, add_zero, add_assoc]
    exact btmul_mem_part M _ hm (btmul_mem_part N P hn hx)

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.assocInv_mem
statement:
theorem assocInv_mem :
    assocInv M N P ∈ SVec.parityHom (tensor M (tensor N P)).toSVec (tensor (tensor M N) P).toSVec 0
proof:
:=
  inv_mem (assocSVecIso M N P) (assocHom_mem M N P)

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.isHom_assocHom
statement: theorem isHom_assocHom : IsHom (tensor (tensor M N) P) (tensor M (tensor N P)) (assocHom M N P)
proof:
:=
  isHom_of_even (assocHom_mem M N P)
    (fun a => tensor_hom_ext_left M N P fun m n p => by
      rw [SVec.comp_apply, SVec.comp_apply, lact_btmul, lact_btmul, assocHom_btmul, assocHom_btmul,
        lact_btmul])
    (fun d => tensor_hom_ext_left M N P fun m n p => by
      rw [SVec.comp_apply, SVec.comp_apply, ract_btmul, assocHom_btmul, assocHom_btmul, ract_btmul,
        ract_btmul])

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.isHom_assocInv
statement: theorem isHom_assocInv : IsHom (tensor M (tensor N P)) (tensor (tensor M N) P) (assocInv M N P)
proof:
:=
  isHom_of_even (assocInv_mem M N P)
    (fun a => tensor_hom_ext_right M N P fun m n p => by
      rw [SVec.comp_apply, SVec.comp_apply, lact_btmul, assocInv_btmul, assocInv_btmul, lact_btmul,
        lact_btmul])
    (fun d => tensor_hom_ext_right M N P fun m n p => by
      rw [SVec.comp_apply, SVec.comp_apply, ract_btmul, ract_btmul, assocInv_btmul, assocInv_btmul,
        ract_btmul])

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.assoc_hom_btmul
statement:
@[simp] theorem assoc_hom_btmul (m : M.toSVec) (n : N.toSVec) (p : P.toSVec) :
    (assoc M N P).hom.1 (btmul _ P (btmul M N m n) p) = btmul M _ m (btmul N P n p)
proof:
:=
  assocHom_btmul M N P m n p

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.assoc_inv_btmul
statement:
@[simp] theorem assoc_inv_btmul (m : M.toSVec) (n : N.toSVec) (p : P.toSVec) :
    (assoc M N P).inv.1 (btmul M _ m (btmul N P n p)) = btmul _ P (btmul M N m n) p
proof:
:=
  assocInv_btmul M N P m n p

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.assoc_hom_mem
statement:
theorem assoc_hom_mem [GradedAlgebra 𝒟] :
    (assoc M N P).hom ∈ parity (R := k) (tensor (tensor M N) P) (tensor M (tensor N P)) 0

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.assoc_inv_mem
statement:
theorem assoc_inv_mem [GradedAlgebra 𝒟] :
    (assoc M N P).inv ∈ parity (R := k) (tensor M (tensor N P)) (tensor (tensor M N) P) 0

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.whiskerLeft_zero
statement: theorem whiskerLeft_zero {N' : SuperBimodule ℬ 𝒞} : whiskerLeft M (0 : N ⟶ N') = 0
proof:
:=
  hom_ext (SVec.quot_hom_ext _ _ fun x => by
    change tensorMk M N' (SVec.whiskerLeft M.toSVec (0 : N.toSVec ⟶ N'.toSVec) x) = 0
    rw [SVec.whiskerLeft_zero]; rfl)

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.zero_whiskerRight
statement: theorem zero_whiskerRight {M' : SuperBimodule 𝒜 ℬ} : whiskerRight (0 : M ⟶ M') N = 0
proof:
:=
  hom_ext (SVec.quot_hom_ext _ _ fun x => by
    change tensorMk M' N (SVec.whiskerRight (0 : M.toSVec ⟶ M'.toSVec) N.toSVec x) = 0
    rw [SVec.whiskerRight_zero]; rfl)

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.assoc_naturality_left
statement:
theorem assoc_naturality_left {M' : SuperBimodule 𝒜 ℬ} (f : M ⟶ M') :
    whiskerRight (whiskerRight f N) P ≫ (assoc M' N P).hom =
      (assoc M N P).hom ≫ whiskerRight f (tensor N P)
proof:
:=
  hom_ext (tensor_hom_ext_left M N P fun m n p => by
    rw [comp_val, comp_val, SVec.comp_apply, SVec.comp_apply, whiskerRight_btmul,
      whiskerRight_btmul, assoc_hom_btmul, assoc_hom_btmul, whiskerRight_btmul])

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.assoc_naturality_middle
statement:
theorem assoc_naturality_middle [GradedAlgebra 𝒟] {N' : SuperBimodule ℬ 𝒞} (g : N ⟶ N') :
    whiskerRight (whiskerLeft M g) P ≫ (assoc M N' P).hom =
      (assoc M N P).hom ≫ whiskerLeft M (whiskerRight g P)
proof:
:= by
  refine Supercategory.induction_on (R := k) g ?_ (fun q g hg => ?_) (fun g g' hg hg' => ?_)
  · rw [whiskerLeft_zero, zero_whiskerRight, zero_whiskerRight, whiskerLeft_zero,
      Limits.zero_comp, Limits.comp_zero]
  · refine hom_ext (tensor_hom_ext_left_homogeneous M N P fun p r s m n x hm hn _ => ?_)
    rw [comp_val, comp_val, SVec.comp_apply, SVec.comp_apply, whiskerRight_btmul,
      whiskerLeft_btmul M g hg hm, btmul_smul_left, SVec.hom_map_smul, assoc_hom_btmul,
      assoc_hom_btmul, whiskerLeft_btmul M _ (whiskerRight_mem _ hg P) hm, whiskerRight_btmul]
  · rw [whiskerLeft_add, add_whiskerRight, Preadditive.add_comp, hg, hg', add_whiskerRight,
      whiskerLeft_add, Preadditive.comp_add]

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.assoc_naturality_right
statement:
theorem assoc_naturality_right [GradedAlgebra 𝒟] {P' : SuperBimodule 𝒞 𝒟} (h : P ⟶ P') :
    whiskerLeft (tensor M N) h ≫ (assoc M N P').hom =
      (assoc M N P).hom ≫ whiskerLeft M (whiskerLeft N h)
proof:
:= by
  refine Supercategory.induction_on (R := k) h ?_ (fun r h hh => ?_) (fun h h' hh hh' => ?_)
  · rw [whiskerLeft_zero, whiskerLeft_zero, whiskerLeft_zero, Limits.zero_comp, Limits.comp_zero]
  · refine hom_ext (tensor_hom_ext_left_homogeneous M N P fun p q s m n x hm hn hx => ?_)
    rw [comp_val, comp_val, SVec.comp_apply, SVec.comp_apply,
      whiskerLeft_btmul _ h hh (btmul_mem_part M N hm hn), SVec.hom_map_smul, assoc_hom_btmul,
      assoc_hom_btmul, whiskerLeft_btmul M _ (whiskerLeft_mem N h hh) hm,
      whiskerLeft_btmul N h hh hn, btmul_smul_right, smul_smul, ← sign_add, ← add_mul]
  · rw [whiskerLeft_add, whiskerLeft_add, whiskerLeft_add, Preadditive.add_comp, hh, hh',
      Preadditive.comp_add]

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.pentagon
statement:
theorem pentagon [GradedAlgebra 𝒟] [GradedAlgebra ℰ] (Q : SuperBimodule 𝒟 ℰ) :
    whiskerRight (assoc M N P).hom Q ≫ (assoc M (tensor N P) Q).hom ≫
        whiskerLeft M (assoc N P Q).hom =
      (assoc (tensor M N) P Q).hom ≫ (assoc M N (tensor P Q)).hom
proof:
:= by
  refine hom_ext (tensor_hom_ext_left (tensor M N) P Q fun x p q => ?_)
  induction x using tensor_induction_on with
  | zero => rw [btmul_zero_left, btmul_zero_left, SVec.hom_map_zero, SVec.hom_map_zero]
  | btmul m n =>
    simp only [comp_val, SVec.comp_apply]
    rw [whiskerRight_btmul, assoc_hom_btmul, assoc_hom_btmul,
      whiskerLeft_btmul_even M _ (assoc_hom_mem N P Q), assoc_hom_btmul, assoc_hom_btmul,
      assoc_hom_btmul]
  | add x y hx hy =>
    rw [btmul_add_left, btmul_add_left, SVec.hom_map_add, SVec.hom_map_add, hx, hy]

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.pentagon_inv
statement:
theorem pentagon_inv [GradedAlgebra 𝒟] [GradedAlgebra ℰ] (Q : SuperBimodule 𝒟 ℰ) :
    whiskerLeft M (assoc N P Q).inv ≫ (assoc M (tensor N P) Q).inv ≫
        whiskerRight (assoc M N P).inv Q =
      (assoc M N (tensor P Q)).inv ≫ (assoc (tensor M N) P Q).inv
proof:
:= by
  refine hom_ext (tensor_hom_ext_right M N (tensor P Q) fun m n x => ?_)
  induction x using tensor_induction_on with
  | zero => rw [btmul_zero_right, btmul_zero_right, SVec.hom_map_zero, SVec.hom_map_zero]
  | btmul p q =>
    simp only [comp_val, SVec.comp_apply]
    rw [whiskerLeft_btmul_even M _ (assoc_inv_mem N P Q), assoc_inv_btmul, assoc_inv_btmul,
      whiskerRight_btmul, assoc_inv_btmul, assoc_inv_btmul, assoc_inv_btmul]
  | add x y hx hy =>
    rw [btmul_add_right, btmul_add_right, SVec.hom_map_add, SVec.hom_map_add, hx, hy]

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.regularSVec_proj
statement: theorem regularSVec_proj (p : ZMod 2) : (regularSVec 𝒜).proj p = algProj 𝒜 p
proof:
:= by
  rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one p with rfl | rfl
  · rw [SVec.proj_zero]
    ext a
    rw [LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.id_apply]
    exact (eq_sub_of_add_eq (algProj_add_algProj 𝒜 a)).symm
  · rfl

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.mem_regularSVec_part_iff
statement: theorem mem_regularSVec_part_iff {p : ZMod 2} {a : A} : a ∈ (regularSVec 𝒜).part p ↔ a ∈ 𝒜 p
proof:
:= by
  rw [SVec.mem_part_iff, regularSVec_proj]
  exact (mem_iff_proj (R := k) (C := SuperalgebraCat 𝒜) (X := SuperalgebraCat.star 𝒜)
    (Y := SuperalgebraCat.star 𝒜)).symm

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.regular_lact_apply
statement: theorem regular_lact_apply (a x : A) : (regular 𝒜).lact a x = a * x

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.regular_ract_apply
statement: theorem regular_ract_apply (b x : A) : (regular 𝒜).ract b x = x * b

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.lact_regular_ract
statement:
theorem lact_regular_ract (a b : A) (m : M.toSVec) :
    M.lact ((regular 𝒜).ract b a) m = M.lact a (M.lact b m)

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.leftUnitorHom_btmul
statement:
@[simp] theorem leftUnitorHom_btmul (a : A) (m : M.toSVec) :
    leftUnitorHom M (btmul (regular 𝒜) M a m) = M.lact a m

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.leftUnitorInv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem leftUnitorInv_apply (m : M.toSVec) :
    leftUnitorInv M m = btmul (regular 𝒜) M (1 : A) m

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.leftUnitorHom_mem
statement:
theorem leftUnitorHom_mem :
    leftUnitorHom M ∈ SVec.parityHom (tensor (regular 𝒜) M).toSVec M.toSVec 0
proof:
:=
  tensor_mem_parity_of_btmul (regular 𝒜) M fun p q a m ha hm => by
    rw [leftUnitorHom_btmul, add_zero, add_comm]
    exact SVec.apply_mem_part (M.lact_mem p a ((mem_regularSVec_part_iff 𝒜).1 ha)) hm

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.isHom_leftUnitorHom
statement: theorem isHom_leftUnitorHom : IsHom (tensor (regular 𝒜) M) M (leftUnitorHom M)
proof:
:=
  isHom_of_even (leftUnitorHom_mem M)
    (fun a => tensor_hom_ext (regular 𝒜) M fun a' m => by
      rw [SVec.comp_apply, SVec.comp_apply, lact_btmul, leftUnitorHom_btmul, leftUnitorHom_btmul,
        regular_lact_apply, M.lact_mul, SVec.comp_apply])
    (fun b => tensor_hom_ext (regular 𝒜) M fun a' m => by
      have h := congrArg (fun φ : M.toSVec ⟶ M.toSVec => φ m) (M.lact_ract a' b)
      simp only [SVec.comp_apply] at h
      rw [SVec.comp_apply, SVec.comp_apply, ract_btmul, leftUnitorHom_btmul, leftUnitorHom_btmul, h])

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.isHom_leftUnitorInv
statement: theorem isHom_leftUnitorInv : IsHom M (tensor (regular 𝒜) M) (leftUnitorInv M)
proof:
:=
  isHom_of_even (inv_mem (leftUnitorSVecIso M) (leftUnitorHom_mem M))
    (fun a => SVec.hom_ext fun m => by
      rw [SVec.comp_apply, SVec.comp_apply, leftUnitorInv_apply, leftUnitorInv_apply, lact_btmul,
        ← btmul_ract_lact, regular_ract_apply, regular_lact_apply, one_mul, mul_one])
    (fun b => SVec.hom_ext fun m => by
      rw [SVec.comp_apply, SVec.comp_apply, leftUnitorInv_apply, leftUnitorInv_apply, ract_btmul])

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.leftUnitor_hom_btmul
statement:
@[simp] theorem leftUnitor_hom_btmul (a : A) (m : M.toSVec) :
    (leftUnitor M).hom.1 (btmul (regular 𝒜) M a m) = M.lact a m

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.leftUnitor_inv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem leftUnitor_inv_apply (m : M.toSVec) :
    (leftUnitor M).inv.1 m = btmul (regular 𝒜) M (1 : A) m

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.rightUnitorBi_apply
statement: theorem rightUnitorBi_apply (m : M.toSVec) (b : B) : rightUnitorBi M m b = M.ract b m

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.rightUnitorBi_balanced
statement:
theorem rightUnitorBi_balanced (m : M.toSVec) (b b' : B) :
    rightUnitorBi M (M.ract b m) b' = rightUnitorBi M m ((regular ℬ).lact b b')
proof:
:= by
  rw [rightUnitorBi_apply, rightUnitorBi_apply, regular_lact_apply, M.ract_mul]; rfl

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.rightUnitorHom_btmul
statement:
@[simp] theorem rightUnitorHom_btmul (m : M.toSVec) (b : B) :
    rightUnitorHom M (btmul M (regular ℬ) m b) = M.ract b m

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.rightUnitorInv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem rightUnitorInv_apply (m : M.toSVec) :
    rightUnitorInv M m = btmul M (regular ℬ) m (1 : B)

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.rightUnitorHom_mem
statement:
theorem rightUnitorHom_mem :
    rightUnitorHom M ∈ SVec.parityHom (tensor M (regular ℬ)).toSVec M.toSVec 0
proof:
:=
  tensor_mem_parity_of_btmul M (regular ℬ) fun p q m b hm hb => by
    rw [rightUnitorHom_btmul, add_zero]
    exact SVec.apply_mem_part (M.ract_mem q b ((mem_regularSVec_part_iff ℬ).1 hb)) hm

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.isHom_rightUnitorHom
statement: theorem isHom_rightUnitorHom : IsHom (tensor M (regular ℬ)) M (rightUnitorHom M)
proof:
:=
  isHom_of_even (rightUnitorHom_mem M)
    (fun a => tensor_hom_ext M (regular ℬ) fun m b => by
      have h := congrArg (fun φ : M.toSVec ⟶ M.toSVec => φ m) (M.lact_ract a b)
      simp only [SVec.comp_apply] at h
      rw [SVec.comp_apply, SVec.comp_apply, lact_btmul, rightUnitorHom_btmul, rightUnitorHom_btmul, h])
    (fun b' => tensor_hom_ext M (regular ℬ) fun m b => by
      rw [SVec.comp_apply, SVec.comp_apply, ract_btmul, rightUnitorHom_btmul, rightUnitorHom_btmul,
        regular_ract_apply, M.ract_mul, SVec.comp_apply])

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.isHom_rightUnitorInv
statement: theorem isHom_rightUnitorInv : IsHom M (tensor M (regular ℬ)) (rightUnitorInv M)
proof:
:=
  isHom_of_even (inv_mem (rightUnitorSVecIso M) (rightUnitorHom_mem M))
    (fun a => SVec.hom_ext fun m => by
      rw [SVec.comp_apply, SVec.comp_apply, rightUnitorInv_apply, rightUnitorInv_apply, lact_btmul])
    (fun b => SVec.hom_ext fun m => by
      rw [SVec.comp_apply, SVec.comp_apply, rightUnitorInv_apply, rightUnitorInv_apply, ract_btmul,
        btmul_ract_lact, regular_lact_apply, regular_ract_apply, one_mul, mul_one])

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.rightUnitor_hom_btmul
statement:
@[simp] theorem rightUnitor_hom_btmul (m : M.toSVec) (b : B) :
    (rightUnitor M).hom.1 (btmul M (regular ℬ) m b) = M.ract b m

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.rightUnitor_inv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem rightUnitor_inv_apply (m : M.toSVec) :
    (rightUnitor M).inv.1 m = btmul M (regular ℬ) m (1 : B)

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.rightUnitor_hom_mem
statement: theorem rightUnitor_hom_mem : (rightUnitor M).hom ∈ parity (R := k) (tensor M (regular ℬ)) M 0

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.leftUnitor_hom_mem
statement: theorem leftUnitor_hom_mem : (leftUnitor M).hom ∈ parity (R := k) (tensor (regular 𝒜) M) M 0

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.leftUnitor_naturality
statement:
theorem leftUnitor_naturality {M' : SuperBimodule 𝒜 ℬ} (f : M ⟶ M') :
    whiskerLeft (regular 𝒜) f ≫ (leftUnitor M').hom = (leftUnitor M).hom ≫ f
proof:
:= by
  refine Supercategory.induction_on (R := k) f ?_ (fun q f hf => ?_) (fun f f' hf hf' => ?_)
  · rw [whiskerLeft_zero, Limits.zero_comp, Limits.comp_zero]
  · refine hom_ext (tensor_hom_ext_homogeneous (regular 𝒜) M fun p r a m ha _ => ?_)
    have h := congrArg (fun φ : M.toSVec ⟶ M'.toSVec => φ m)
      (((isHom_iff_of_mem (mem_parity_iff.1 hf)).1 f.2).1 p a ((mem_regularSVec_part_iff 𝒜).1 ha))
    simp only [SVec.comp_apply, SVec.smul_apply] at h
    rw [comp_val, comp_val, SVec.comp_apply, SVec.comp_apply, whiskerLeft_btmul _ f hf ha,
      SVec.hom_map_smul, leftUnitor_hom_btmul, leftUnitor_hom_btmul, h]
  · rw [whiskerLeft_add, Preadditive.add_comp, hf, hf', Preadditive.comp_add]

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.rightUnitor_naturality
statement:
theorem rightUnitor_naturality {M' : SuperBimodule 𝒜 ℬ} (f : M ⟶ M') :
    whiskerRight f (regular ℬ) ≫ (rightUnitor M').hom = (rightUnitor M).hom ≫ f
proof:
:=
  hom_ext (tensor_hom_ext M (regular ℬ) fun m b => by
    have h := congrArg (fun φ : M.toSVec ⟶ M'.toSVec => φ m) (f.2.2 b)
    simp only [SVec.comp_apply] at h
    rw [comp_val, comp_val, SVec.comp_apply, SVec.comp_apply, whiskerRight_btmul,
      rightUnitor_hom_btmul, rightUnitor_hom_btmul, h])

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.triangle
statement:
theorem triangle [GradedAlgebra 𝒞] (N : SuperBimodule ℬ 𝒞) :
    (assoc M (regular ℬ) N).hom ≫ whiskerLeft M (leftUnitor N).hom =
      whiskerRight (rightUnitor M).hom N
proof:
:=
  hom_ext (tensor_hom_ext_left M (regular ℬ) N fun m b n => by
    rw [comp_val, SVec.comp_apply, assoc_hom_btmul, whiskerLeft_btmul_even M _ (leftUnitor_hom_mem N),
      leftUnitor_hom_btmul, whiskerRight_btmul, rightUnitor_hom_btmul, btmul_ract_lact])

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSOp.triangle_inverse
statement:
private theorem triangle_inverse {a b c : B} (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) :
    f ◁ (leftUnitor g).inv ≫ (associator f (𝟙 b) g).inv = (rightUnitor f).inv ▷ g
proof:
:= by
  have h : (associator f (𝟙 b) g) ≪≫ whiskerLeftIso (R := R) f (leftUnitor g) =
      whiskerRightIso (R := R) (rightUnitor f) g := Iso.ext (triangle (R := R) f g)
  exact congrArg Iso.inv h

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoCategory.precomp_comm
statement:
theorem precomp_comm {a b c : B} (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) :
    (ξHom (R := R) (f ≫ g)).hom ≫ f ◁ (ξHom (R := R) g).inv =
      (α_ f g (𝛑 c)).hom ▷ 𝛑 c ≫ (α_ f (g ≫ 𝛑 c) (𝛑 c)).hom
proof:
:= by
  have key : (ξHom (R := R) (f ≫ g)).hom ≫ f ◁ (ξHom (R := R) g).inv =
      (α_ (f ≫ g) (𝛑 c) (𝛑 c)).hom ≫ (α_ f g (𝛑 c ≫ 𝛑 c)).hom ≫
        f ◁ g ◁ ((𝛏 c).hom ≫ (𝛏 c).inv) ≫ f ◁ (α_ g (𝛑 c) (𝛑 c)).inv := by
    rw [ξHom_hom, ξHom_inv]; bicategory
  rw [key, Iso.hom_inv_id]
  bicategory

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoCategory.precompPi_β_hom_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem precompPi_β_hom_app (c : B) {a b : B} (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) :
    (precompPi R c f).β.hom.app g = (α_ f g (𝛑 c)).hom

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoCategory.precompPi_β_inv_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem precompPi_β_inv_app (c : B) {a b : B} (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) :
    (precompPi R c f).β.inv.app g = (α_ f g (𝛑 c)).inv

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoCategory.βR_hom
statement:
theorem βR_hom {a b c : B} (f : a ⟶ b) (h : b ⟶ c) :
    (βR (R := R) f h).hom = (α_ f h (𝛑 c)).hom ≫ f ◁ (𝛃 h).hom ≫ (α_ f (𝛑 b) h).inv

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoCategory.βR_inv
statement:
theorem βR_inv {a b c : B} (f : a ⟶ b) (h : b ⟶ c) :
    (βR (R := R) f h).inv = (α_ f (𝛑 b) h).hom ≫ f ◁ (𝛃 h).inv ≫ (α_ f h (𝛑 c)).inv

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoCategory.βR_naturality
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem βR_naturality {a b c : B} {f g : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ g) (h : b ⟶ c) :
    η ▷ h ▷ 𝛑 c ≫ (βR (R := R) g h).hom = (βR (R := R) f h).hom ≫ η ▷ 𝛑 b ▷ h
proof:
:= by
  simp only [βR_hom, Category.assoc]
  rw [associator_naturality_left_assoc, ← whisker_exchange_assoc,
    associator_inv_naturality_left]

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoCategory.β_pi_comp_hom
statement:
theorem β_pi_comp_hom {b c : B} (h : b ⟶ c) :
    (𝛃 (h ≫ 𝛑 c)).hom = -((𝛃 h).hom ▷ 𝛑 c ≫ (α_ (𝛑 b) h (𝛑 c)).hom)
proof:
:= by
  rw [β_comp, β_pi, PreadditiveBicategory.whiskerLeft_neg, Bicategory.whiskerLeft_id]
  simp

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoCategory.β_pi_comp_inv
statement:
theorem β_pi_comp_inv {b c : B} (h : b ⟶ c) :
    (𝛃 (h ≫ 𝛑 c)).inv = -((α_ (𝛑 b) h (𝛑 c)).inv ≫ (𝛃 h).inv ▷ 𝛑 c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cancel_epi (𝛃 (h ≫ 𝛑 c)).hom, Iso.hom_inv_id, β_pi_comp_hom]
  simp

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoCategory.βR_inv_naturality_right
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem βR_inv_naturality_right {a b c : B} (f : a ⟶ b) {h i : b ⟶ c} (θ : h ⟶ i) :
    (f ≫ 𝛑 b) ◁ θ ≫ (βR (R := R) f i).inv = (βR (R := R) f h).inv ≫ (f ◁ θ) ▷ 𝛑 c
proof:
:= by
  simp only [βR_inv, Category.assoc]
  rw [associator_naturality_right_assoc, ← Bicategory.whiskerLeft_comp_assoc,
    β_inv_naturality, Bicategory.whiskerLeft_comp_assoc, associator_inv_naturality_middle]

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoCategory.βR_comm
statement:
theorem βR_comm {a b c : B} (f : a ⟶ b) (h : b ⟶ c) :
    (ξHom (R := R) (f ≫ h)).hom ≫ (ξHom (R := R) f).inv ▷ h =
      (βR (R := R) f h).hom ▷ 𝛑 c ≫ (βR (R := R) (f ≫ 𝛑 b) h).hom
proof:
:= by
  have hc := ξ_comm (R := R) h
  have key : (ξHom (R := R) (f ≫ h)).hom ≫ (ξHom (R := R) f).inv ▷ h =
      (α_ (f ≫ h) (𝛑 c) (𝛑 c)).hom ≫ (α_ f h (𝛑 c ≫ 𝛑 c)).hom ≫
        f ◁ (h ◁ (𝛏 c).hom ≫ (ρ_ h).hom ≫ (λ_ h).inv ≫ (𝛏 b).inv ▷ h) ≫
          (α_ f (𝛑 b ≫ 𝛑 b) h).inv ≫ (α_ f (𝛑 b) (𝛑 b)).inv ▷ h := by
    rw [ξHom_hom, ξHom_inv]; bicategory
  rw [key, hc, βR_hom, βR_hom]
  bicategory

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoCategory.postcompPi_β_hom_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem postcompPi_β_hom_app (a : B) {b c : B} (h : b ⟶ c) (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (postcompPi R a h).β.hom.app f = (βR (R := R) f h).hom

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoCategory.postcompPi_β_inv_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem postcompPi_β_inv_app (a : B) {b c : B} (h : b ⟶ c) (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (postcompPi R a h).β.inv.app f = (βR (R := R) f h).inv

name: StringDiagrams.Associated2.id_obj
statement: @[simp] theorem id_obj (a : Associated2 R B) : (𝟙 a : a ⟶ a).obj = 𝟙 a.obj

name: StringDiagrams.Associated2.hom₂_ext
statement:
@[ext] theorem hom₂_ext {f g : a ⟶ b} {η θ : f ⟶ g} (h₁ : η.1 = θ.1) (h₂ : η.2 = θ.2) :
    η = θ

name: StringDiagrams.Associated2.comp₂_fst
statement:
@[simp] theorem comp₂_fst {f g h : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ g) (θ : g ⟶ h) :
    (η ≫ θ).1 = η.1 ≫ θ.1 - η.2 ≫ θ.2 ▷ 𝛑 b.obj ≫ (ξHom (R := R) h.obj).hom

name: StringDiagrams.Associated2.comp₂_snd
statement:
@[simp] theorem comp₂_snd {f g h : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ g) (θ : g ⟶ h) :
    (η ≫ θ).2 = η.1 ≫ θ.2 + η.2 ≫ (PiCategory.pi (R := R)).map θ.1

name: StringDiagrams.Associated2.id₂_fst
statement: @[simp] theorem id₂_fst (f : a ⟶ b) : (𝟙 f : f ⟶ f).1 = 𝟙 f.obj

statement: @[simp] theorem id₂_snd (f : a ⟶ b) : (𝟙 f : f ⟶ f).2 = 0

name: StringDiagrams.Associated2.add₂_fst
statement: @[simp] theorem add₂_fst {f g : a ⟶ b} (η θ : f ⟶ g) : (η + θ).1 = η.1 + θ.1

name: StringDiagrams.Associated2.add₂_snd
statement: @[simp] theorem add₂_snd {f g : a ⟶ b} (η θ : f ⟶ g) : (η + θ).2 = η.2 + θ.2

name: StringDiagrams.Associated2.neg₂_fst
statement: @[simp] theorem neg₂_fst {f g : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ g) : (-η).1 = -η.1

name: StringDiagrams.Associated2.neg₂_snd
statement: @[simp] theorem neg₂_snd {f g : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ g) : (-η).2 = -η.2

name: StringDiagrams.Associated2.zero₂_fst
statement: @[simp] theorem zero₂_fst {f g : a ⟶ b} : (0 : f ⟶ g).1 = 0

name: StringDiagrams.Associated2.zero₂_snd
statement: @[simp] theorem zero₂_snd {f g : a ⟶ b} : (0 : f ⟶ g).2 = 0

name: StringDiagrams.Associated2.smul₂_fst
statement: @[simp] theorem smul₂_fst {f g : a ⟶ b} (r : R) (η : f ⟶ g) : (r • η).1 = r • η.1

name: StringDiagrams.Associated2.smul₂_snd
statement: @[simp] theorem smul₂_snd {f g : a ⟶ b} (r : R) (η : f ⟶ g) : (r • η).2 = r • η.2

name: StringDiagrams.Associated2.comp_obj
statement: @[simp] theorem comp_obj (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) : (f ≫ g).obj = f.obj ≫ g.obj

name: StringDiagrams.Associated2.whiskerLeft_fst
statement:
@[simp] theorem whiskerLeft_fst (f : a ⟶ b) {g h : b ⟶ c} (η : g ⟶ h) :
    (f ◁ η).1 = f.obj ◁ η.1

name: StringDiagrams.Associated2.whiskerLeft_snd
statement:
@[simp] theorem whiskerLeft_snd (f : a ⟶ b) {g h : b ⟶ c} (η : g ⟶ h) :
    (f ◁ η).2 = f.obj ◁ η.2 ≫ (α_ f.obj h.obj (𝛑 c.obj)).inv

name: StringDiagrams.Associated2.whiskerRight_fst
statement:
@[simp] theorem whiskerRight_fst {f g : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ g) (h : b ⟶ c) :
    (η ▷ h).1 = η.1 ▷ h.obj

name: StringDiagrams.Associated2.whiskerRight_snd
statement:
@[simp] theorem whiskerRight_snd {f g : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ g) (h : b ⟶ c) :
    (η ▷ h).2 = η.2 ▷ h.obj ≫ (βR (R := R) g.obj h.obj).inv

name: StringDiagrams.Associated2.associator_hom_fst
statement:
@[simp] theorem associator_hom_fst (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) (h : c ⟶ d) :

name: StringDiagrams.Associated2.associator_hom_snd
statement:
@[simp] theorem associator_hom_snd (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) (h : c ⟶ d) :

name: StringDiagrams.Associated2.associator_inv_fst

name: StringDiagrams.Associated2.associator_inv_snd
statement:
@[simp] theorem associator_inv_snd (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) (h : c ⟶ d) :
    (associator f g h).inv.2 = 0

name: StringDiagrams.Associated2.leftUnitor_hom_fst
statement: @[simp] theorem leftUnitor_hom_fst (f : a ⟶ b) : (leftUnitor f).hom.1 = (λ_ f.obj).hom

statement: @[simp] theorem leftUnitor_hom_snd (f : a ⟶ b) : (leftUnitor f).hom.2 = 0

name: StringDiagrams.Associated2.leftUnitor_inv_fst
statement: @[simp] theorem leftUnitor_inv_fst (f : a ⟶ b) : (leftUnitor f).inv.1 = (λ_ f.obj).inv

name: StringDiagrams.Associated2.lNat_isPiNatural
statement:
theorem lNat_isPiNatural (b c : B) :
    IsPiNatural R (precompPi R c (𝟙 b)) (PiFunctor.id R (b ⟶ c)) (lNat b c)
proof:
:= fun g => by
  simp only [lNat, precompPi_β_hom_app, PiFunctor.id_β, Iso.refl_hom, NatTrans.id_app,
    Functor.id_obj, pi_obj, pi_map]
  bicategory

name: StringDiagrams.Associated2.rNat_isPiNatural
statement:
theorem rNat_isPiNatural (a b : B) :
    IsPiNatural R (postcompPi R a (𝟙 b)) (PiFunctor.id R (a ⟶ b)) (rNat a b)
proof:
:= fun f => by
  simp only [rNat, postcompPi_β_hom_app, PiFunctor.id_β, Iso.refl_hom, NatTrans.id_app,
    Functor.id_obj, pi_obj, pi_map, βR_hom, β_id]
  bicategory

name: StringDiagrams.Associated2.αNatRight_isPiNatural
statement:
theorem αNatRight_isPiNatural (d : B) {a b c : B} (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) :
    IsPiNatural R (precompPi R d (f ≫ g)) ((precompPi R d g).comp (precompPi R d f))
      (αNatRight d f g)
proof:
:= fun h => by
  simp only [αNatRight, precompPi_β_hom_app, PiFunctor.comp_β, NatIso.ofComponents_hom_app,
    Iso.trans_hom, Iso.app_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom, Functor.comp_obj, precomp_map,
    pi_obj, pi_map]
  bicategory

name: StringDiagrams.Associated2.αNatLeft_isPiNatural
statement:
theorem αNatLeft_isPiNatural (a : B) {b c d : B} (g : b ⟶ c) (h : c ⟶ d) :
    IsPiNatural R ((postcompPi R a g).comp (postcompPi R a h)) (postcompPi R a (g ≫ h))
      (αNatLeft a g h)
proof:
:= fun f => by
  simp only [αNatLeft, postcompPi_β_hom_app, PiFunctor.comp_β, NatIso.ofComponents_hom_app,
    Iso.trans_hom, Iso.app_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom, Functor.comp_obj,
    postcomp_map, pi_obj, pi_map, βR_hom, β_comp]
  bicategory

name: StringDiagrams.Associated2.αNatMiddle_isPiNatural
statement:
theorem αNatMiddle_isPiNatural {a b c d : B} (f : a ⟶ b) (h : c ⟶ d) :
    IsPiNatural R ((precompPi R c f).comp (postcompPi R a h))
      ((postcompPi R b h).comp (precompPi R d f)) (αNatMiddle f h)
proof:
:= fun g => by
  simp only [αNatMiddle, postcompPi_β_hom_app, precompPi_β_hom_app, PiFunctor.comp_β,
    NatIso.ofComponents_hom_app, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.app_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom,
    Functor.comp_obj, postcomp_map, precomp_map, pi_obj, pi_map,
    βR_hom]
  bicategory

name: StringDiagrams.Associated2.map_map_map
statement:
theorem map_map_map {C D E : Type*} [Category C] [Preadditive C] [Linear R C] [PiCategory R C]
    [Category D] [Preadditive D] [Linear R D] [PiCategory R D] [Category E] [Preadditive E]
    [Linear R E] [PiCategory R E] {F : C ⥤ D} {G : D ⥤ E} [F.Additive] [G.Additive]
    (hF : PiFunctor R F) (hG : PiFunctor R G) {X Y : Associated R C} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    (Associated.map hG).map ((Associated.map hF).map f) = (Associated.map (hF.comp hG)).map f

name: StringDiagrams.Associated2.odd_odd_key
statement:
theorem odd_odd_key {a b c : B} {f g : a ⟶ b} {h i : b ⟶ c} (η : f ⟶ g ≫ 𝛑 b)
    (θ : h ⟶ i ≫ 𝛑 c) :
    (η ▷ h ≫ (βR (R := R) g h).inv) ≫ (g ◁ θ ≫ (α_ g i (𝛑 c)).inv) ▷ 𝛑 c =
      -((f ◁ θ ≫ (α_ f i (𝛑 c)).inv) ≫ (η ▷ i ≫ (βR (R := R) g i).inv) ▷ 𝛑 c)
proof:
:= by
  have e1 : f ◁ θ ≫ (α_ f i (𝛑 c)).inv ≫ (η ▷ i) ▷ 𝛑 c =
      η ▷ h ≫ (g ≫ 𝛑 b) ◁ θ ≫ (α_ (g ≫ 𝛑 b) i (𝛑 c)).inv := by
    rw [← associator_inv_naturality_left, whisker_exchange_assoc]
  simp only [Category.assoc, Bicategory.comp_whiskerRight]
  rw [reassoc_of% e1, ← βR_inv_naturality_right_assoc, βR_inv, βR_inv, β_pi_comp_inv]
  simp only [PreadditiveBicategory.whiskerLeft_neg, Preadditive.neg_comp, Preadditive.comp_neg]
  congr 1
  bicategory

name: StringDiagrams.Associated2.mem_parity_zero'
statement:
theorem mem_parity_zero' {f g : a ⟶ b} {η : f ⟶ g} :
    η ∈ parity (R := R) f g 0 ↔ η.2 = 0

name: StringDiagrams.Associated2.mem_parity_one'
statement:
theorem mem_parity_one' {f g : a ⟶ b} {η : f ⟶ g} :
    η ∈ parity (R := R) f g 1 ↔ η.1 = 0

name: StringDiagrams.Associated2.super_interchange'
proof:
:= by
  rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one p with rfl | rfl <;>
    rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one q with rfl | rfl
  · rw [mem_parity_zero'] at hη hθ
    rw [koszulSign_zero_left, one_smul]
    ext
    · simp [hη, hθ, whisker_exchange]
    · simp [hη, hθ]
  · rw [mem_parity_zero'] at hη; rw [mem_parity_one'] at hθ
    rw [koszulSign_zero_left, one_smul]
    ext
    · simp [hη, hθ]
    · simp only [comp₂_snd, whiskerRight_fst, whiskerLeft_snd, whiskerRight_snd,
        whiskerLeft_fst, hη, hθ, PreadditiveBicategory.zero_whiskerRight,
        PreadditiveBicategory.whiskerLeft_zero, Limits.zero_comp, add_zero, zero_add,
        Category.assoc, pi_map]
      rw [← whisker_exchange_assoc]
      erw [associator_inv_naturality_left]
  · rw [mem_parity_one'] at hη; rw [mem_parity_zero'] at hθ
    rw [koszulSign_zero_right, one_smul]
    ext
    · simp [hη, hθ]
    · simp only [comp₂_snd, whiskerRight_fst, whiskerLeft_snd, whiskerRight_snd,
        whiskerLeft_fst, hη, hθ, PreadditiveBicategory.zero_whiskerRight,
        PreadditiveBicategory.whiskerLeft_zero, Limits.zero_comp, add_zero, zero_add,
        Limits.comp_zero, Category.assoc, pi_map]
      rw [← βR_inv_naturality_right, whisker_exchange_assoc]
      rfl
  · rw [mem_parity_one'] at hη hθ
    rw [koszulSign_one_one, neg_one_smul]
    ext
    · simp only [comp₂_fst, whiskerRight_fst, whiskerLeft_snd, whiskerRight_snd,
        whiskerLeft_fst, neg₂_fst, hη, hθ, PreadditiveBicategory.zero_whiskerRight,
        PreadditiveBicategory.whiskerLeft_zero, Limits.zero_comp, zero_sub, neg_neg]
      rw [← Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc, odd_odd_key]
      simp
    · simp [hη, hθ]

name: StringDiagrams.Associated2.hcomp_odd_odd
statement:
theorem hcomp_odd_odd {f h : a ⟶ b} {g k : b ⟶ c} {x : f ⟶ h} {y : g ⟶ k} (hx : x.1 = 0)
    (hy : y.1 = 0) :
    TwoSupercategory.hcomp x y =
      Associated.homMk (R := R) (X := ⟨f.obj ≫ g.obj⟩) (Y := ⟨h.obj ≫ k.obj⟩)
        ((x.2 ▷ g.obj ≫ (h.obj ≫ 𝛑 b.obj) ◁ y.2) ≫ (α_ h.obj (𝛑 b.obj) (k.obj ≫ 𝛑 c.obj)).hom ≫
          h.obj ◁ (α_ (𝛑 b.obj) k.obj (𝛑 c.obj)).inv ≫ h.obj ◁ ((𝛃 k.obj).inv ▷ 𝛑 c.obj) ≫
          (α_ h.obj (k.obj ≫ 𝛑 c.obj) (𝛑 c.obj)).inv ≫ (α_ h.obj k.obj (𝛑 c.obj)).inv ▷ 𝛑 c.obj ≫
          (ξHom (R := R) (h.obj ≫ k.obj)).hom) 0
proof:
:= by
  ext
  · simp only [TwoSupercategory.hcomp, comp₂_fst, whiskerRight_fst, whiskerLeft_fst,
      whiskerRight_snd, whiskerLeft_snd, hx, hy, PreadditiveBicategory.zero_whiskerRight,
      PreadditiveBicategory.whiskerLeft_zero, Limits.zero_comp, zero_sub,
      Associated.homMk_fst, Bicategory.comp_whiskerRight, Category.assoc]
    rw [← Category.assoc ((βR (R := R) h.obj g.obj).inv), ← βR_inv_naturality_right, βR_inv]
    erw [β_pi_comp_inv]
    simp only [PreadditiveBicategory.whiskerLeft_neg, Preadditive.neg_comp, Preadditive.comp_neg,
      neg_neg, Category.assoc, Bicategory.whiskerLeft_comp]
    rfl
  · simp [TwoSupercategory.hcomp, hx, hy]

name: StringDiagrams.Associated2.β_hom_eq
statement:
theorem β_hom_eq (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (PiTwoSupercategory.β (R := R) f).hom =
      Associated.homMk (R := R) (X := ⟨f.obj ≫ 𝛑 b.obj⟩) (Y := ⟨𝛑 a.obj ≫ f.obj⟩)
        (𝛃 f.obj).hom 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cancel_mono (TwoSupercategory.whiskerRightIso (R := R) (PiTwoSupercategory.ζ (R := R) a)
    f).hom, TwoSupercategory.whiskerRightIso_hom, PiTwoSupercategory.β_hom_comp_ζ]
  ext
  · simp [ζ_eq]
  · simp [ζ_eq]
    rw [βR_inv]
    simp only [Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
    rw [← leftUnitor_inv_naturality_assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.Associated2.ξ_hom_eq
statement:
theorem ξ_hom_eq (a : Associated2 R B) :

proof:
:= by
  ext
  · simp [PiTwoSupercategory.ξ_hom, ζ_eq]
    rw [βR_inv, β_pi_inv]
    simp [ξHom_hom]
  · simp [PiTwoSupercategory.ξ_hom, ζ_eq]

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoFunctor.natHom_isPiNatural
statement:
theorem natHom_isPiNatural (hη : hF.IsPiTwoNatural hG η) (a b : B) :
    PiFunctor.IsPiNatural R ((hF.homPi R a b).comp (postcompPi R (F.obj a) (η.app b)))
      ((hG.homPi R a b).comp (precompPi R (G.obj b) (η.app a))) (natHom hF hG η a b)
proof:
:=
  fun f => by
  have hc : (F.mapComp f (𝛑 b)).inv ▷ η.app b ≫ η.naturality (f ≫ 𝛑 b) =
      (α_ (F.map f) (F.map (𝛑 b)) (η.app b)).hom ≫ F.map f ◁ η.naturality (𝛑 b) ≫
        (α_ (F.map f) (η.app b) (G.map (𝛑 b))).inv ≫ η.naturality f ▷ G.map (𝛑 b) ≫
          (α_ (η.app a) (G.map f) (G.map (𝛑 b))).hom ≫ η.app a ◁ (G.mapComp f (𝛑 b)).inv := by
    have e := η.naturality_comp f (𝛑 b)
    simp only [Pseudofunctor.toOplax_mapComp, Pseudofunctor.toOplax_toPrelaxFunctor] at e
    rw [← cancel_mono (η.app a ◁ (G.mapComp f (𝛑 b)).hom)]
    simp only [Category.assoc, Bicategory.whiskerLeft_inv_hom, Category.comp_id]
    rw [e, Bicategory.inv_hom_whiskerRight_assoc]
  simp only [natHom, PiFunctor.comp_β, NatIso.ofComponents_hom_app, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.app_hom,
    Functor.mapIso_hom, Functor.comp_obj,
    postcomp_map, precomp_map, postcompPi_β_hom_app, precompPi_β_hom_app,
    homPi_β_hom_app, βHom_hom, pi_obj, pi_map, βR_hom, Bicategory.comp_whiskerRight,
    Category.assoc]
  rw [hc]
  simp only [Pseudofunctor.toOplax_toPrelaxFunctor]
  have c1 : (α_ (F.map f) (η.app b) (𝛑 (G.obj b))).hom ≫ F.map f ◁ (𝛃 (η.app b)).hom ≫
      (α_ (F.map f) (𝛑 (F.obj b)) (η.app b)).inv ≫ (F.map f ◁ (hF.j b).hom) ▷ η.app b ≫
        (α_ (F.map f) (F.map (𝛑 b)) (η.app b)).hom ≫ F.map f ◁ η.naturality (𝛑 b) =
      (α_ (F.map f) (η.app b) (𝛑 (G.obj b))).hom ≫
        F.map f ◁ ((𝛃 (η.app b)).hom ≫ (hF.j b).hom ▷ η.app b ≫ η.naturality (𝛑 b)) := by
    bicategory
  erw [reassoc_of% c1]
  rw [hη b]
  have c2 : (α_ (F.map f) (η.app b) (𝛑 (G.obj b))).hom ≫ F.map f ◁ η.app b ◁ (hG.j b).hom ≫
      (α_ (F.map f) (η.app b) (G.map (𝛑 b))).inv =
      (F.map f ≫ η.app b) ◁ (hG.j b).hom := by bicategory
  rw [reassoc_of% c2, whisker_exchange_assoc, associator_naturality_right_assoc,
    Bicategory.whiskerLeft_comp]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoFunctor.isPiTwoNatural_id
statement:
theorem isPiTwoNatural_id (hF : PiTwoFunctor R F) :
    hF.IsPiTwoNatural hF (Oplax.OplaxTrans.id F.toOplax)
proof:
:= fun a => by
  simp only [Oplax.OplaxTrans.id, β_id, Pseudofunctor.toOplax_toPrelaxFunctor]
  bicategory

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoFunctor.IsPiTwoNatural.vcomp
proof:
:= fun a => by
  simp only [Oplax.OplaxTrans.vcomp, β_comp, Pseudofunctor.toOplax_toPrelaxFunctor,
    Category.assoc]
  have c1 : (α_ (η.app a) (θ.app a) (𝛑 (H.obj a))).hom ≫ η.app a ◁ (𝛃 (θ.app a)).hom ≫
      (α_ (η.app a) (𝛑 (G.obj a)) (θ.app a)).inv ≫ (𝛃 (η.app a)).hom ▷ θ.app a ≫
        (α_ (𝛑 (F.obj a)) (η.app a) (θ.app a)).hom ≫ (hF.j a).hom ▷ (η.app a ≫ θ.app a) ≫
          (α_ (F.map (𝛑 a)) (η.app a) (θ.app a)).inv ≫ η.naturality (𝛑 a) ▷ θ.app a ≫
            (α_ (η.app a) (G.map (𝛑 a)) (θ.app a)).hom ≫ η.app a ◁ θ.naturality (𝛑 a) ≫
              (α_ (η.app a) (θ.app a) (H.map (𝛑 a))).inv =
      (α_ (η.app a) (θ.app a) (𝛑 (H.obj a))).hom ≫ η.app a ◁ (𝛃 (θ.app a)).hom ≫
        (α_ (η.app a) (𝛑 (G.obj a)) (θ.app a)).inv ≫
          ((𝛃 (η.app a)).hom ≫ (hF.j a).hom ▷ η.app a ≫ η.naturality (𝛑 a)) ▷ θ.app a ≫
            (α_ (η.app a) (G.map (𝛑 a)) (θ.app a)).hom ≫ η.app a ◁ θ.naturality (𝛑 a) ≫
              (α_ (η.app a) (θ.app a) (H.map (𝛑 a))).inv := by
    bicategory
  rw [c1, hη a]
  have c2 : (α_ (η.app a) (θ.app a) (𝛑 (H.obj a))).hom ≫ η.app a ◁ (𝛃 (θ.app a)).hom ≫
      (α_ (η.app a) (𝛑 (G.obj a)) (θ.app a)).inv ≫ (η.app a ◁ (hG.j a).hom) ▷ θ.app a ≫
        (α_ (η.app a) (G.map (𝛑 a)) (θ.app a)).hom ≫ η.app a ◁ θ.naturality (𝛑 a) ≫
          (α_ (η.app a) (θ.app a) (H.map (𝛑 a))).inv =
      (α_ (η.app a) (θ.app a) (𝛑 (H.obj a))).hom ≫
        η.app a ◁ ((𝛃 (θ.app a)).hom ≫ (hG.j a).hom ▷ θ.app a ≫ θ.naturality (𝛑 a)) ≫
          (α_ (η.app a) (θ.app a) (H.map (𝛑 a))).inv := by
    bicategory
  rw [c2, hθ a]
  bicategory

statement:
theorem mapTwoNat_vcomp {η : Oplax.OplaxTrans F.toOplax G.toOplax}

    mapTwoNat hF hH (hη.vcomp hθ) = (mapTwoNat hF hG hη).vcomp (mapTwoNat hG hH hθ)

:= by
  refine TwoNatTrans.ext_of_eq rfl fun f => ?_
  simp only [eqToHom_refl, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp, mapTwoNat_x,
    Oplax.OplaxTrans.vcomp, TwoNatTrans.vcomp_x]
  apply Associated2.hom₂_ext
  · simp only [Associated2.comp₂_fst, Associated2.whiskerLeft_fst, Associated2.whiskerLeft_snd,
      Associated2.whiskerRight_fst, Associated2.whiskerRight_snd, Associated2.associator_hom_fst,
      Associated2.associator_hom_snd, Associated2.associator_inv_fst,
      Associated2.associator_inv_snd, Associated.homMk_fst, Associated.homMk_snd,
      PreadditiveBicategory.zero_whiskerRight, PreadditiveBicategory.whiskerLeft_zero,
      Limits.zero_comp, Limits.comp_zero, sub_zero,
      Associated2.comp_obj, Pseudofunctor.toOplax_toPrelaxFunctor]
    rfl
  · simp only [Associated2.comp₂_snd, Associated2.whiskerLeft_fst, Associated2.whiskerLeft_snd,
      Associated2.whiskerRight_fst, Associated2.whiskerRight_snd, Associated2.associator_hom_fst,
      Associated2.associator_hom_snd, Associated2.associator_inv_fst,
      Associated2.associator_inv_snd, Associated.homMk_fst, Associated.homMk_snd,
      PreadditiveBicategory.zero_whiskerRight, PreadditiveBicategory.whiskerLeft_zero,
      Limits.zero_comp, Limits.comp_zero, add_zero, pi_map]

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.mapQPiSupermodification_whiskerLeft
statement:
theorem mapQPiSupermodification_whiskerLeft (θ : TwoNatTrans F G)
    {ψ ψ' : TwoNatTrans G H} (α : ψ ⟶ ψ') :
    mapQPiSupermodification (TwoNatTrans.whiskerLeft θ α) =
      eqToHom (mapQPiNatTrans_vcomp θ ψ) ≫
        TwoNatTrans.whiskerLeft (mapQPiNatTrans θ) (mapQPiSupermodification α) ≫
          eqToHom (mapQPiNatTrans_vcomp θ ψ').symm
proof:
:= by
  apply TwoNatTrans.hom_ext
  intro a
  simp only [TwoNatTrans.comp_app, TwoNatTrans.eqToHom_app]
  simp only [eqToHom_refl, Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id]

      eqToHom (mapQPiNatTrans_vcomp θ ψ) ≫

          eqToHom (mapQPiNatTrans_vcomp θ' ψ).symm
proof:
:= by
