name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.twoJ_naturality
statement:
theorem twoJ_naturality (F : TwoSuperfunctor R B C) :
    (twoJ R B).comp (mapQPi F) = F.comp (twoJ R C)
proof:
:= by
  refine TwoEnvelope.twoSuperfunctor_ext rfl HEq.rfl HEq.rfl (heq_of_eq ?_) (heq_of_eq ?_)
  · funext a b c f g
    apply Iso.ext
    apply Envelope.hom_ext
    change (F.mapComp f g).hom ≫ F.map₂ (𝟙 (f ≫ g)) = 𝟙 _ ≫ (F.mapComp f g).hom
    rw [F.map₂_id, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]
  · funext a
    apply Iso.ext
    apply Envelope.hom_ext
    change (F.mapId a).hom ≫ F.map₂ (𝟙 (𝟙 a)) = 𝟙 _ ≫ (F.mapId a).hom
    rw [F.map₂_id, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.precomposeTwoJ_mapComp_hom
statement:
theorem precomposeTwoJ_mapComp_hom (S : TwoSuperfunctor R (QPiTwoEnvelope R B) C)
    {a b c : B} (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) :
    (((twoJ R B).comp S).mapComp f g).hom = (S.mapComp (Jm f) (Jm g)).hom
proof:
:= by
  change _ ≫ S.map₂ (𝟙 _) = _
  rw [S.map₂_id, Category.comp_id]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.precomposeTwoJ_mapId_hom
statement:
theorem precomposeTwoJ_mapId_hom (S : TwoSuperfunctor R (QPiTwoEnvelope R B) C) (a : B) :
    (((twoJ R B).comp S).mapId a).hom = (S.mapId ⟨⟨a⟩⟩).hom
proof:
:= by
  change _ ≫ S.map₂ (𝟙 _) = _
  rw [S.map₂_id, Category.comp_id]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.postcomposeTwoJ_mapComp_hom
statement:
theorem postcomposeTwoJ_mapComp_hom (F : TwoSuperfunctor R B C)
    {a b c : B} (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) :
    ((F.comp (twoJ R C)).mapComp f g).hom = J2 (F.mapComp f g).hom

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.postcomposeTwoJ_mapId_hom
statement:
theorem postcomposeTwoJ_mapId_hom (F : TwoSuperfunctor R B C) (a : B) :
    ((F.comp (twoJ R C)).mapId a).hom = J2 (F.mapId a).hom

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.hext_of_eq
statement:
theorem hext_of_eq {F' G' : TwoSuperfunctor R B C} (hF : F = F') (hG : G = G')
    {θ : TwoNatTrans F G} {ψ : TwoNatTrans F' G'} (hX : HEq θ.X ψ.X)
    (hx : ∀ {a b : B} (f : a ⟶ b), HEq (θ.x f) (ψ.x f)) : HEq θ ψ
proof:
:= by
  subst F'
  subst G'
  exact heq_of_eq (TwoEnvelope.twoNatTrans_ext (eq_of_heq hX) hx)

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.twoJ_naturality_natTrans
statement:
theorem twoJ_naturality_natTrans (θ : TwoNatTrans F G) :
    cast (congrArg₂ (fun S T => TwoNatTrans S T) (twoJ_naturality F) (twoJ_naturality G))
      (precomposeTwoJ (mapQPiNatTrans θ)) = postcomposeTwoJ θ
proof:
:= by
  apply eq_of_heq
  exact (cast_heq _ _).trans
    (TwoNatTrans.hext_of_eq (twoJ_naturality F) (twoJ_naturality G) HEq.rfl
      (fun _ => HEq.rfl))

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.precomposeTwoJ_isGraded
statement:
theorem precomposeTwoJ_isGraded [∀ a b : B, GradedSupercategory R (a ⟶ b)]
    [∀ a b : C, GradedSupercategory R (a ⟶ b)]
    {S T : TwoSuperfunctor R (QPiTwoEnvelope R B) C} {θ : TwoNatTrans S T}
    (hθ : θ.IsGraded) : (precomposeTwoJ θ).IsGraded

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.postcomposeTwoJ_isGraded_iff
statement:
theorem postcomposeTwoJ_isGraded_iff [∀ a b : B, GradedSupercategory R (a ⟶ b)]
    [∀ a b : C, GradedSupercategory R (a ⟶ b)] (θ : TwoNatTrans F G) :
    (postcomposeTwoJ θ).IsGraded ↔ θ.IsGraded
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h a b f
    exact h f
  · intro h a b f
    exact h f

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.twoJ_naturality_gradedNatTrans
statement:
theorem twoJ_naturality_gradedNatTrans [∀ a b : B, GradedSupercategory R (a ⟶ b)]
    [∀ a b : C, GradedSupercategory R (a ⟶ b)]
    (θ : {θ : TwoNatTrans F G // θ.IsGraded}) :
    (⟨cast (congrArg₂ (fun S T => TwoNatTrans S T) (twoJ_naturality F) (twoJ_naturality G))
      (precomposeTwoJ (mapGradedTwoNatTrans θ).1), by
        dsimp only [mapGradedTwoNatTrans]
        rw [twoJ_naturality_natTrans]
        exact (postcomposeTwoJ_isGraded_iff θ.1).2 θ.2⟩ :
      {ψ : TwoNatTrans (F.comp (twoJ R C)) (G.comp (twoJ R C)) // ψ.IsGraded}) =
    ⟨postcomposeTwoJ θ.1, (postcomposeTwoJ_isGraded_iff θ.1).2 θ.2⟩
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact twoJ_naturality_natTrans θ.1

name: StringDiagrams.Underlying2.id_obj
statement: @[simp] theorem id_obj (a : Underlying2 R B) : (𝟙 a : a ⟶ a).obj = 𝟙 a.obj

name: StringDiagrams.Underlying2.comp_obj
statement: @[simp] theorem comp_obj (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) : (f ≫ g).obj = f.obj ≫ g.obj

name: StringDiagrams.Underlying2.comp₂_val
statement: @[simp] theorem comp₂_val {f g h : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ g) (θ : g ⟶ h) : (η ≫ θ).1 = η.1 ≫ θ.1

name: StringDiagrams.Underlying2.id₂_val
statement: @[simp] theorem id₂_val (f : a ⟶ b) : (𝟙 f : f ⟶ f).1 = 𝟙 f.obj

name: StringDiagrams.Underlying2.hom1_obj
statement: @[simp] theorem hom1_obj {a b : B} (f : a ⟶ b) : (hom1 (R := R) f).obj = f

name: StringDiagrams.Underlying2.whiskerLeft_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem whiskerLeft_val (f : a ⟶ b) {g h : b ⟶ c} (η : g ⟶ h) :
    (Bicategory.whiskerLeft f η).1 = f.obj ◁ η.1

name: StringDiagrams.Underlying2.whiskerRight_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem whiskerRight_val {f g : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ g) (h : b ⟶ c) :
    (Bicategory.whiskerRight η h).1 = η.1 ▷ h.obj

name: StringDiagrams.Underlying2.associator_hom_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem associator_hom_val (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) (h : c ⟶ d) :
    (Bicategory.associator f g h).hom.1 = (associator f.obj g.obj h.obj).hom

name: StringDiagrams.Underlying2.associator_inv_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem associator_inv_val (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) (h : c ⟶ d) :
    (Bicategory.associator f g h).inv.1 = (associator f.obj g.obj h.obj).inv

name: StringDiagrams.Underlying2.leftUnitor_hom_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem leftUnitor_hom_val (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (Bicategory.leftUnitor f).hom.1 = (leftUnitor f.obj).hom

name: StringDiagrams.Underlying2.leftUnitor_inv_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem leftUnitor_inv_val (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (Bicategory.leftUnitor f).inv.1 = (leftUnitor f.obj).inv

name: StringDiagrams.Underlying2.rightUnitor_hom_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem rightUnitor_hom_val (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (Bicategory.rightUnitor f).hom.1 = (rightUnitor f.obj).hom

name: StringDiagrams.Underlying2.rightUnitor_inv_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem rightUnitor_inv_val (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (Bicategory.rightUnitor f).inv.1 = (rightUnitor f.obj).inv

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.associator_naturality_left
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem associator_naturality_left {f f' : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ f') (g : b ⟶ c) (h : c ⟶ d) :
    η ▷ g ▷ h ≫ (associator f' g h).hom = (associator f g h).hom ≫ η ▷ (g ≫ h)

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.associator_inv_naturality_left
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem associator_inv_naturality_left {f f' : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ f') (g : b ⟶ c) (h : c ⟶ d) :
    η ▷ (g ≫ h) ≫ (associator f' g h).inv = (associator f g h).inv ≫ η ▷ g ▷ h

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.associator_naturality_middle
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem associator_naturality_middle (f : a ⟶ b) {g g' : b ⟶ c} (η : g ⟶ g') (h : c ⟶ d) :
    (f ◁ η) ▷ h ≫ (associator f g' h).hom = (associator f g h).hom ≫ f ◁ (η ▷ h)

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.associator_inv_naturality_middle
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem associator_inv_naturality_middle (f : a ⟶ b) {g g' : b ⟶ c} (η : g ⟶ g')
    (h : c ⟶ d) :
    f ◁ (η ▷ h) ≫ (associator f g' h).inv = (associator f g h).inv ≫ (f ◁ η) ▷ h

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.associator_naturality_right
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem associator_naturality_right (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) {h h' : c ⟶ d} (η : h ⟶ h') :
    (f ≫ g) ◁ η ≫ (associator f g h').hom = (associator f g h).hom ≫ f ◁ g ◁ η

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.associator_inv_naturality_right
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem associator_inv_naturality_right (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) {h h' : c ⟶ d}
    (η : h ⟶ h') :
    f ◁ g ◁ η ≫ (associator f g h').inv = (associator f g h).inv ≫ (f ≫ g) ◁ η

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.leftUnitor_naturality
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem leftUnitor_naturality {f g : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ g) :
    𝟙 a ◁ η ≫ (leftUnitor g).hom = (leftUnitor f).hom ≫ η

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.leftUnitor_inv_naturality
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem leftUnitor_inv_naturality {f g : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ g) :
    η ≫ (leftUnitor g).inv = (leftUnitor f).inv ≫ 𝟙 a ◁ η

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.rightUnitor_naturality
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem rightUnitor_naturality {f g : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ g) :
    η ▷ 𝟙 b ≫ (rightUnitor g).hom = (rightUnitor f).hom ≫ η

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.rightUnitor_inv_naturality
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem rightUnitor_inv_naturality {f g : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ g) :
    η ≫ (rightUnitor g).inv = (rightUnitor f).inv ≫ η ▷ 𝟙 b

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.whiskerLeft_hom_inv
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)] theorem whiskerLeft_hom_inv (f : a ⟶ b) {g h : b ⟶ c} (e : g ≅ h) :
    f ◁ e.hom ≫ f ◁ e.inv = 𝟙 (f ≫ g)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← whiskerLeft_comp (R := R), e.hom_inv_id, whiskerLeft_id (R := R)]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.whiskerLeft_inv_hom
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)] theorem whiskerLeft_inv_hom (f : a ⟶ b) {g h : b ⟶ c} (e : g ≅ h) :
    f ◁ e.inv ≫ f ◁ e.hom = 𝟙 (f ≫ h)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← whiskerLeft_comp (R := R), e.inv_hom_id, whiskerLeft_id (R := R)]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.hom_inv_whiskerRight
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)] theorem hom_inv_whiskerRight {f g : a ⟶ b} (e : f ≅ g) (h : b ⟶ c) :
    e.hom ▷ h ≫ e.inv ▷ h = 𝟙 (f ≫ h)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← comp_whiskerRight (R := R), e.hom_inv_id, id_whiskerRight (R := R)]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.inv_hom_whiskerRight
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)] theorem inv_hom_whiskerRight {f g : a ⟶ b} (e : f ≅ g) (h : b ⟶ c) :
    e.inv ▷ h ≫ e.hom ▷ h = 𝟙 (g ≫ h)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← comp_whiskerRight (R := R), e.inv_hom_id, id_whiskerRight (R := R)]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.whiskerLeft_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem whiskerLeft_zero (f : a ⟶ b) (g h : b ⟶ c) : f ◁ (0 : g ⟶ h) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← zero_smul R (0 : g ⟶ h), whiskerLeft_smul, zero_smul]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.zero_whiskerRight
statement: @[simp] theorem zero_whiskerRight (f g : a ⟶ b) (h : b ⟶ c) : (0 : f ⟶ g) ▷ h = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← zero_smul R (0 : f ⟶ g), smul_whiskerRight, zero_smul]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.whiskerLeft_neg
statement: @[simp] theorem whiskerLeft_neg (f : a ⟶ b) {g h : b ⟶ c} (η : g ⟶ h) : f ◁ (-η) = -(f ◁ η)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← neg_one_smul R η, whiskerLeft_smul, neg_one_smul]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.neg_whiskerRight
statement: @[simp] theorem neg_whiskerRight {f g : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ g) (h : b ⟶ c) : (-η) ▷ h = -(η ▷ h)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← neg_one_smul R η, smul_whiskerRight, neg_one_smul]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.whiskerLeft_zsmul
statement:
theorem whiskerLeft_zsmul (f : a ⟶ b) {g h : b ⟶ c} (n : ℤ) (η : g ⟶ h) :
    f ◁ (n • η) = n • (f ◁ η)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul R, whiskerLeft_smul, Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.zsmul_whiskerRight
statement:
theorem zsmul_whiskerRight {f g : a ⟶ b} (n : ℤ) (η : f ⟶ g) (h : b ⟶ c) :
    (n • η) ▷ h = n • (η ▷ h)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul R, smul_whiskerRight, Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.whiskerLeft_comp'
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem whiskerLeft_comp' (f : a ⟶ b) {g h i : b ⟶ c} (η : g ⟶ h) (θ : h ⟶ i) :
    f ◁ (η ≫ θ) = f ◁ η ≫ f ◁ θ

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.comp_whiskerRight'
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem comp_whiskerRight' {f g h : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ g) (θ : g ⟶ h) (i : b ⟶ c) :
    (η ≫ θ) ▷ i = η ▷ i ≫ θ ▷ i

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.super_interchange_assoc
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Category.assoc, super_interchange hη hθ, Linear.smul_comp, Category.assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.whisker_exchange_of_even_left
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem whisker_exchange_of_even_left {f g : a ⟶ b} {h i : b ⟶ c} {η : f ⟶ g}
    (hη : η ∈ parity (R := R) f g 0) (θ : h ⟶ i) :
    η ▷ h ≫ g ◁ θ = f ◁ θ ≫ η ▷ i
proof:
:= by
  refine induction_on (R := R) θ (by simp [whiskerLeft_zero R])
    (fun q θ hθ => ?_) (fun θ θ' h h' => ?_)
  · rw [super_interchange hη hθ, koszulSign_zero_left, one_smul]
  · rw [whiskerLeft_add (R := R), whiskerLeft_add (R := R), Preadditive.comp_add,
      Preadditive.add_comp, h, h']

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.whisker_exchange_of_even_right
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem whisker_exchange_of_even_right {f g : a ⟶ b} {h i : b ⟶ c} (η : f ⟶ g) {θ : h ⟶ i}
    (hθ : θ ∈ parity (R := R) h i 0) :
    η ▷ h ≫ g ◁ θ = f ◁ θ ≫ η ▷ i
proof:
:= by
  refine induction_on (R := R) η (by simp [zero_whiskerRight R])
    (fun q η hη => ?_) (fun η η' h h' => ?_)
  · rw [super_interchange hη hθ, koszulSign_zero_right, one_smul]
  · rw [add_whiskerRight (R := R), add_whiskerRight (R := R), Preadditive.comp_add,
      Preadditive.add_comp, h, h']

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.unitors_equal
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem unitors_equal (a : B) : (leftUnitor (𝟙 a)).hom = (rightUnitor (𝟙 a)).hom

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.unitors_inv_equal
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem unitors_inv_equal (a : B) : (leftUnitor (𝟙 a)).inv = (rightUnitor (𝟙 a)).inv

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.leftUnitor_comp
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem leftUnitor_comp (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) :
    (leftUnitor (f ≫ g)).hom = (associator (𝟙 a) f g).inv ≫ (leftUnitor f).hom ▷ g
proof:
:=
  congrArg Subtype.val
    (Bicategory.leftUnitor_comp (B := Underlying2 R B) (a := ⟨a⟩) (b := ⟨b⟩) (c := ⟨c⟩) (Underlying2.hom1 f) (Underlying2.hom1 g))

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.leftUnitor_comp_inv
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem leftUnitor_comp_inv (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) :
    (leftUnitor (f ≫ g)).inv = (leftUnitor f).inv ▷ g ≫ (associator (𝟙 a) f g).hom
proof:
:=
  congrArg Subtype.val
    (Bicategory.leftUnitor_comp_inv (B := Underlying2 R B) (a := ⟨a⟩) (b := ⟨b⟩) (c := ⟨c⟩)
      (Underlying2.hom1 f) (Underlying2.hom1 g))

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.rightUnitor_comp
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem rightUnitor_comp (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) :
    (rightUnitor (f ≫ g)).hom = (associator f g (𝟙 c)).hom ≫ f ◁ (rightUnitor g).hom
proof:
:=
  congrArg Subtype.val
    (Bicategory.rightUnitor_comp (B := Underlying2 R B) (a := ⟨a⟩) (b := ⟨b⟩) (c := ⟨c⟩)
      (Underlying2.hom1 f) (Underlying2.hom1 g))

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.rightUnitor_comp_inv
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem rightUnitor_comp_inv (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) :
    (rightUnitor (f ≫ g)).inv = f ◁ (rightUnitor g).inv ≫ (associator f g (𝟙 c)).inv
proof:
:=
  congrArg Subtype.val
    (Bicategory.rightUnitor_comp_inv (B := Underlying2 R B) (a := ⟨a⟩) (b := ⟨b⟩) (c := ⟨c⟩)
      (Underlying2.hom1 f) (Underlying2.hom1 g))

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.leftUnitor_whiskerRight
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem leftUnitor_whiskerRight (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) :
    (leftUnitor f).hom ▷ g = (associator (𝟙 a) f g).hom ≫ (leftUnitor (f ≫ g)).hom
proof:
:=
  congrArg Subtype.val
    (Bicategory.leftUnitor_whiskerRight (B := Underlying2 R B) (a := ⟨a⟩) (b := ⟨b⟩)
      (c := ⟨c⟩) (Underlying2.hom1 f) (Underlying2.hom1 g))

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.whiskerLeft_rightUnitor
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem whiskerLeft_rightUnitor (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) :
    f ◁ (rightUnitor g).hom = (associator f g (𝟙 c)).inv ≫ (rightUnitor (f ≫ g)).hom
proof:
:=
  congrArg Subtype.val
    (Bicategory.whiskerLeft_rightUnitor (B := Underlying2 R B) (a := ⟨a⟩) (b := ⟨b⟩)
      (c := ⟨c⟩) (Underlying2.hom1 f) (Underlying2.hom1 g))

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.pentagon_inv
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem pentagon_inv (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) (h : c ⟶ d) (i : d ⟶ e) :
    f ◁ (associator g h i).inv ≫ (associator f (g ≫ h) i).inv ≫ (associator f g h).inv ▷ i =
      (associator f g (h ≫ i)).inv ≫ (associator (f ≫ g) h i).inv
proof:
:=
  congrArg Subtype.val
    (Bicategory.pentagon_inv (B := Underlying2 R B) (a := ⟨a⟩) (b := ⟨b⟩) (c := ⟨c⟩)
      (d := ⟨d⟩) (e := ⟨e⟩) (Underlying2.hom1 f) (Underlying2.hom1 g) (Underlying2.hom1 h) (Underlying2.hom1 i))

name: StringDiagrams.K₀.int_T_smul
statement:
theorem int_T_smul (n : ℤ) (x : K₀ C) :
    letI := moduleLaurentInt k C
    (T n : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) • x =
      (((qUnit k C) ^ n : (AddMonoid.End (K₀ C))ˣ) : AddMonoid.End (K₀ C)) x
proof:
:= by
  change laurentEnd k C
    (AddMonoidAlgebra.mapRingHom ℤ (Int.castRingHom Zπ) (T n)) x = _
  rw [T, AddMonoidAlgebra.mapRingHom_single, map_one, ← T, laurentEnd_T]

name: StringDiagrams.K₀.int_T_one_smul_mk
statement:
theorem int_T_one_smul_mk (X : C) :
    letI := moduleLaurentInt k C
    (T 1 : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) • K₀.mk X = K₀.mk ((QPiCategory.Q (R := k)).obj X)
proof:
:= by
  let := moduleLaurentInt k C
  rw [int_T_smul, zpow_one]
  exact map_mk _ _

name: StringDiagrams.KrullSchmidt.indecQ_rep_iso
statement:
theorem indecQ_rep_iso (i : IndecClass C) :
    Nonempty ((QPiCategory.Q (R := k)).obj i.rep ≅ (indecQ k i).rep)
proof:
:= by
  let e := QPiCategory.qEquivalence k C
  have : e.functor.Additive := QPiCategory.Q_additive
  have h : indecQ k i = Quotient.mk (indecSetoid C)
      ⟨(QPiCategory.Q (R := k)).obj i.rep,
        (isIndec_obj_iff e.functor i.rep).2
          i.isIndec_rep⟩ := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← Quotient.out_eq i]
    rfl
  rw [h]
  exact IndecClass.exists_iso_rep _

name: StringDiagrams.KrullSchmidt.int_T_one_smul_indec
statement:
theorem int_T_one_smul_indec (i : IndecClass C) :
    letI := K₀.moduleLaurentInt k C
    (T 1 : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) • K₀.mk i.rep = K₀.mk (indecQ k i).rep
proof:
:= by
  let := K₀.moduleLaurentInt k C
  rw [K₀.int_T_smul, zpow_one]
  change K₀.map (QPiCategory.Q (R := k)) (K₀.mk i.rep) = _
  rw [K₀.map_mk]
  exact K₀.mk_eq_mk_of_iso (indecQ_rep_iso k i).some

name: StringDiagrams.KrullSchmidt.int_T_smul_indec
statement:
theorem int_T_smul_indec (n : ℤ) (i : IndecClass C) :
    letI := K₀.moduleLaurentInt k C
    (T n : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) • K₀.mk i.rep = K₀.mk (indecShift k n i).rep
proof:
:= by
  let := K₀.moduleLaurentInt k C
  let := indecShiftAction k (C := C)
  change (T n : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) • K₀.mk i.rep = K₀.mk (n +ᵥ i).rep
  induction n using Int.induction_on generalizing i with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [show (n + 1 : ℤ) = 1 + n by omega, T_add, mul_smul, ih,
      int_T_one_smul_indec, add_vadd]
    change K₀.mk ((indecQ k) (_ +ᵥ i)).rep =
      K₀.mk ((indecQ k ^ (1 : ℤ)) (_ +ᵥ i)).rep
    rw [zpow_one]
  | pred n ih =>
    have inj : Function.Injective (fun x : K₀ C => (T 1 : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) • x) := by
      intro x y h
      have h' := congrArg (fun x : K₀ C => (T (-1) : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) • x) h
      simpa only [← mul_smul, ← T_add, neg_add_cancel, T_zero, one_smul] using h'
    apply inj
    dsimp only
    rw [← mul_smul, ← T_add, show (1 + (-(n : ℤ) - 1)) = -(n : ℤ) by omega, ih,
      int_T_one_smul_indec]
    have heq : (indecQ k) ((-(n : ℤ) - 1) +ᵥ i) = -(n : ℤ) +ᵥ i := by
      change (indecQ k) ((indecQ k ^ (-(n : ℤ) - 1)) i) = _
      rw [← Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, ← zpow_one_add, show (1 + (-(n : ℤ) - 1)) = -(n : ℤ) by omega]
      rfl
    rw [heq]

name: StringDiagrams.KrullSchmidt.indec_shift_free
statement:
theorem indec_shift_free (h : ShiftHomBoundedBelow k (C := C)) :
    ∀ (i : IndecClass C) (n : ℤ), indecShift k n i = i → n = 0
proof:
:= by
  let := indecShiftAction k (C := C)
  apply LaurentBasis.free_of_boundedBelow
  intro i
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := h i
  refine ⟨N, fun n hn => ?_⟩
  by_contra hlt
  have hzero := hN n (by omega)
  change Subsingleton ((n +ᵥ i).rep ⟶ i.rep) at hzero
  rw [hn] at hzero
  have hid : (𝟙 i.rep : i.rep ⟶ i.rep) = 0 := hzero.elim _ _
  exact i.isIndec_rep.1 ((IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero i.rep).2 hid)

name: StringDiagrams.KrullSchmidt.laurentBasis_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem laurentBasis_apply (h : ShiftHomBoundedBelow k (C := C))
    (o : @Quotient (IndecClass C) (@AddAction.orbitRel ℤ _ _ (indecShiftAction k))) :
    laurentBasis k h o = K₀.mk o.out.rep
proof:
:= by
  let := K₀.moduleLaurentInt k C
  let := indecShiftAction k (C := C)
  have hb : ∀ (n : ℤ) (i : IndecClass C), (T n : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) • (indecBasis k) i =
      (indecBasis k) (n +ᵥ i) := by
    intro n i
    simp only [indecBasis_apply]
    exact int_T_smul_indec k n i
  exact (LaurentBasis.ofOrbits_apply (indecBasis k) hb (indec_shift_free k h) o).trans
    (indecBasis_apply k o.out)

name: StringDiagrams.KrullSchmidt.k0_free_laurentInt
statement:
theorem k0_free_laurentInt (h : ShiftHomBoundedBelow k (C := C)) :
    letI := K₀.moduleLaurentInt k C
    Module.Free (LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (K₀ C)
proof:
:= by
  let := K₀.moduleLaurentInt k C
  exact Module.Free.of_basis (laurentBasis k h)

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.isHom_iff_of_mem
statement:
theorem isHom_iff_of_mem {V W : SuperBimodule 𝒜 ℬ} {q : ZMod 2} {f : V.toSVec ⟶ W.toSVec}
    (hf : f ∈ parity (R := k) V.toSVec W.toSVec q) :
    IsHom V W f ↔ (∀ (p : ZMod 2) (a : A), a ∈ 𝒜 p →
      V.lact a ≫ f = sign k (p * q) • (f ≫ W.lact a)) ∧
      ∀ b : B, V.ract b ≫ f = f ≫ W.ract b
proof:
:= by
  simp only [IsHom, twist_of_mem _ hf, Linear.smul_comp]

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.isHom_id
statement: theorem isHom_id (V : SuperBimodule 𝒜 ℬ) : IsHom V V (𝟙 V.toSVec)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun p a _ => by rw [twist_id, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp],
    fun b => by rw [Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]⟩

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.IsHom.comp
statement:
theorem IsHom.comp {U V W : SuperBimodule 𝒜 ℬ} {f : U.toSVec ⟶ V.toSVec}
    {g : V.toSVec ⟶ W.toSVec} (hf : IsHom U V f) (hg : IsHom V W g) : IsHom U W (f ≫ g)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun p a ha => by
      rw [← Category.assoc, hf.1 p a ha, Category.assoc, hg.1 p a ha, twist_comp,
        Category.assoc],
    fun b => by rw [← Category.assoc, hf.2, Category.assoc, hg.2, Category.assoc]⟩

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.hom_ext
statement: @[ext] theorem hom_ext {V W : SuperBimodule 𝒜 ℬ} {f g : V ⟶ W} (h : f.1 = g.1) : f = g

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.id_val
statement: @[simp] theorem id_val (V : SuperBimodule 𝒜 ℬ) : (𝟙 V : V ⟶ V).1 = 𝟙 V.toSVec

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.comp_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem comp_val {U V W : SuperBimodule 𝒜 ℬ} (f : U ⟶ V) (g : V ⟶ W) :
    (f ≫ g).1 = f.1 ≫ g.1

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.add_val
statement: @[simp] theorem add_val {V W : SuperBimodule 𝒜 ℬ} (f g : V ⟶ W) : (f + g).1 = f.1 + g.1

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.smul_val
statement: @[simp] theorem smul_val {V W : SuperBimodule 𝒜 ℬ} (r : k) (f : V ⟶ W) : (r • f).1 = r • f.1

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.IsHom.ract_comp_proj
statement:
theorem IsHom.ract_comp_proj {f : V.toSVec ⟶ W.toSVec} (hf : IsHom V W f) (q : ZMod 2) (b : B) :
    V.ract b ≫ proj k q f = proj k q f ≫ W.ract b
proof:
:= by
  refine DirectSum.Decomposition.inductionOn ℬ (motive := fun b => V.ract b ≫ proj k q f =
    proj k q f ≫ W.ract b) (by simp) (fun {r} b => ?_) (fun b b' h h' => ?_) b
  · have h := congrArg (proj k (r + q)) (hf.2 b)
    rwa [proj_comp_of_mem_left q (V.ract_mem r b b.2), add_comm,
      proj_comp_of_mem_right q f (W.ract_mem r b b.2)] at h
  · simp only [map_add, Preadditive.add_comp, Preadditive.comp_add, h, h']

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.IsHom.proj
statement:
theorem IsHom.proj {f : V.toSVec ⟶ W.toSVec} (hf : IsHom V W f) (q : ZMod 2) :
    IsHom V W (proj k q f)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun p a ha => ?_, hf.ract_comp_proj q⟩
  have h := congrArg (Supercategory.proj k (p + q)) (hf.1 p a ha)
  rwa [proj_comp_of_mem_left q (V.lact_mem p a ha), add_comm,
    proj_comp_of_mem_right q _ (W.lact_mem p a ha), proj_twist,
    ← twist_of_mem p (proj_mem q f)] at h

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.mem_parity_iff
statement:
theorem mem_parity_iff {V W : SuperBimodule 𝒜 ℬ} {p : ZMod 2} {f : V ⟶ W} :
    f ∈ parity (R := k) V W p ↔ f.1 ∈ parity (R := k) V.toSVec W.toSVec p

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.twist_lact_comp_ract
statement:
theorem twist_lact_comp_ract (V : SuperBimodule 𝒜 ℬ) (a : A) (b : B) :
    twist k 1 (V.lact a) ≫ V.ract b = V.ract b ≫ twist k 1 (V.lact a)
proof:
:= by
  refine DirectSum.Decomposition.inductionOn 𝒜 (motive := fun a =>
    twist k 1 (V.lact a) ≫ V.ract b = V.ract b ≫ twist k 1 (V.lact a)) (by simp)
    (fun {r} a => ?_) (fun a a' h h' => ?_) a
  · rw [twist_one_of_mem (V.lact_mem r a a.2), Linear.smul_comp, Linear.comp_smul, V.lact_ract]
  · simp only [map_add, Preadditive.add_comp, Preadditive.comp_add, h, h']

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.piObj_lact_of_mem
statement:
theorem piObj_lact_of_mem (V : SuperBimodule 𝒜 ℬ) {p : ZMod 2} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ 𝒜 p) :
    (piObj V).lact a = SVec.piHom (sign k p • V.lact a)
proof:
:= by
  change SVec.piHom (twist k 1 (V.lact a)) = _
  rw [twist_one_of_mem (V.lact_mem p a ha)]

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.piObj_ract
statement: theorem piObj_ract (V : SuperBimodule 𝒜 ℬ) (b : B) : (piObj V).ract b = SVec.piHom (V.ract b)

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.isHom_ζ
statement: theorem isHom_ζ (V : SuperBimodule 𝒜 ℬ) : IsHom (piObj V) V (SVec.ζIso V.toSVec).hom
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun p a ha => ?_, fun b => rfl⟩
  have hζ : (SVec.ζIso V.toSVec).hom ∈ parity (R := k) (piObj V).toSVec V.toSVec 1 :=
    SVec.ζIso_hom_mem _
  rw [piObj_lact_of_mem V ha, twist_of_mem p hζ, mul_one, Linear.smul_comp, map_smul]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.isHom_ζ_inv
statement: theorem isHom_ζ_inv (V : SuperBimodule 𝒜 ℬ) : IsHom V (piObj V) (SVec.ζIso V.toSVec).inv
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun p a ha => ?_, fun b => rfl⟩
  have hζ : (SVec.ζIso V.toSVec).inv ∈ parity (R := k) V.toSVec (piObj V).toSVec 1 :=
    inv_mem _ (SVec.ζIso_hom_mem _)
  rw [piObj_lact_of_mem V ha, twist_of_mem p hζ, mul_one,
    Linear.smul_comp, map_smul, Linear.comp_smul, smul_smul, sign_mul_self, one_smul]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.ζIso_hom_mem
statement:
theorem ζIso_hom_mem (V : SuperBimodule 𝒜 ℬ) :
    (ζIso V).hom ∈ parity (R := k) (piObj V) V 1

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.pi_map_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  change SVec.toLinearMap (twist k 1 f).1 = _
  rw [twist_of_mem 1 hf, one_mul]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.ξ_hom
statement:
theorem ξ_hom (V : SuperBimodule 𝒜 ℬ) :
    SVec.toLinearMap (PiSupercategory.ξ (R := k) V).hom.1 =
      (-LinearMap.id : V.toSVec.carrier →ₗ[k] V.toSVec.carrier)

name: StringDiagrams.Int.forall_of_step
statement:
theorem Int.forall_of_step {P : ℤ → Prop} (h0 : P 0) (step : ∀ i, P (i + 1) ↔ P i) (i : ℤ) :
    P i
proof:
:= by
  induction i using Int.induction_on with
  | zero => exact h0
  | succ k ih => exact (step k).2 ih
  | pred k ih =>
    exact (step (-(k : ℤ) - 1)).1 (by rw [show -(k : ℤ) - 1 + 1 = -k by ring]; exact ih)

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftFunctor.id_F
statement: @[simp] theorem id_F : (id d).F = 𝟭 S

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftFunctor.id_γ_hom_app
statement: @[simp] theorem id_γ_hom_app (X : S) : (id d).γ.hom.app X = 𝟙 (d.Q.obj X)

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftFunctor.comp_F
statement:
@[simp] theorem comp_F (Φ : ShiftFunctor R d d') (Ψ : ShiftFunctor R d' d'') :
    (Φ.comp Ψ).F = Φ.F ⋙ Ψ.F

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftFunctor.comp_γ_hom_app
statement:
theorem comp_γ_hom_app (Φ : ShiftFunctor R d d') (Ψ : ShiftFunctor R d' d'') (X : S) :
    (Φ.comp Ψ).γ.hom.app X = Ψ.γ.hom.app (Φ.F.obj X) ≫ Ψ.F.map (Φ.γ.hom.app X)

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftFunctor.comp_γ_inv_app
statement:
theorem comp_γ_inv_app (Φ : ShiftFunctor R d d') (Ψ : ShiftFunctor R d' d'') (X : S) :
    (Φ.comp Ψ).γ.inv.app X = Ψ.F.map (Φ.γ.inv.app X) ≫ Ψ.γ.inv.app (Φ.F.obj X)

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftFunctor.Γ_zero_hom_app
statement: theorem Γ_zero_hom_app (Φ : ShiftFunctor R d d') (X : S) : (Φ.Γ 0).hom.app X = 𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftFunctor.Γ_zero_inv_app
statement: theorem Γ_zero_inv_app (Φ : ShiftFunctor R d d') (X : S) : (Φ.Γ 0).inv.app X = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cancel_epi ((Φ.Γ 0).hom.app X), Iso.hom_inv_id_app, Γ_zero_hom_app, Category.comp_id]

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftFunctor.Γ_id_hom_app
statement: theorem Γ_id_hom_app (i : ℤ) (X : S) : ((id d).Γ i).hom.app X = 𝟙 ((d.pow i).obj X)
proof:
:= by
  refine Int.forall_of_step (P := fun i => ((id d).Γ i).hom.app X = 𝟙 ((d.pow i).obj X))
    (Γ_zero_hom_app _ X) (fun i => ?_) i
  rw [Γ_succ_hom_app]
  constructor
  · intro h
    apply d.Q.map_injective
    rw [← cancel_epi ((d.succ i).inv.app X), ← cancel_mono ((d.succ i).hom.app X)]
    simpa using h
  · intro h
    rw [h]
    simp

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftFunctor.Γ_id_inv_app
statement: theorem Γ_id_inv_app (i : ℤ) (X : S) : ((id d).Γ i).inv.app X = 𝟙 ((d.pow i).obj X)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cancel_epi (((id d).Γ i).hom.app X), Iso.hom_inv_id_app, Γ_id_hom_app]
  exact (Category.id_comp _).symm

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftFunctor.Γ_comp_hom_app
statement:
theorem Γ_comp_hom_app (Φ : ShiftFunctor R d d') (Ψ : ShiftFunctor R d' d'') (i : ℤ) (X : S) :
    ((Φ.comp Ψ).Γ i).hom.app X = (Ψ.Γ i).hom.app (Φ.F.obj X) ≫ Ψ.F.map ((Φ.Γ i).hom.app X)
proof:
:= by
  refine Int.forall_of_step (P := fun i => ((Φ.comp Ψ).Γ i).hom.app X =
    (Ψ.Γ i).hom.app (Φ.F.obj X) ≫ Ψ.F.map ((Φ.Γ i).hom.app X)) ?_ (fun i => ?_) i
  · rw [Γ_zero_hom_app, Γ_zero_hom_app, Γ_zero_hom_app]; simp
  · have key : (Ψ.Γ (i + 1)).hom.app (Φ.F.obj X) ≫ Ψ.F.map ((Φ.Γ (i + 1)).hom.app X) =
        (d''.succ i).inv.app (Ψ.F.obj (Φ.F.obj X)) ≫
          d''.Q.map ((Ψ.Γ i).hom.app (Φ.F.obj X) ≫ Ψ.F.map ((Φ.Γ i).hom.app X)) ≫
            (Φ.comp Ψ).γ.hom.app ((d.pow i).obj X) ≫ (Φ.comp Ψ).F.map ((d.succ i).hom.app X) := by
      rw [Γ_succ_hom_app, Γ_succ_hom_app, comp_γ_hom_app]
      simp only [Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc, comp_F, Functor.comp_map]
      rw [← Ψ.F.map_comp_assoc ((d'.succ i).hom.app _), Iso.hom_inv_id_app]
      erw [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id, Category.id_comp]
      have n := Ψ.γ.hom.naturality ((Φ.Γ i).hom.app X)
      simp only [Functor.comp_obj, Functor.comp_map] at n
      rw [reassoc_of% n]
    rw [Γ_succ_hom_app (Φ.comp Ψ), key]
    constructor
    · intro h
      exact d''.Q.map_injective ((cancel_mono _).1 ((cancel_epi _).1 h))
    · intro h; rw [h]; rfl

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftFunctor.Γ_comp_inv_app
statement:
theorem Γ_comp_inv_app (Φ : ShiftFunctor R d d') (Ψ : ShiftFunctor R d' d'') (i : ℤ) (X : S) :
    ((Φ.comp Ψ).Γ i).inv.app X = Ψ.F.map ((Φ.Γ i).inv.app X) ≫ (Ψ.Γ i).inv.app (Φ.F.obj X)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cancel_epi (((Φ.comp Ψ).Γ i).hom.app X), Iso.hom_inv_id_app, Γ_comp_hom_app]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [← Ψ.F.map_comp_assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_app]
  erw [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id, Category.id_comp, Iso.hom_inv_id_app]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftFunctor.famMapₗ_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem famMapₗ_apply (Φ : ShiftFunctor R d d') {m : ℤ} {X Y : S} (f : d.Fam R m X Y) :
    ((Φ.famMapₗ m X Y f : d'.Fam R m (Φ.F.obj X) (Φ.F.obj Y)) : d'.FamAll _ _) =
      Φ.famMap f.1

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftFunctor.famMap_id
statement: theorem famMap_id {X Y : S} (f : d.FamAll X Y) : (id d).famMap f = f
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp [famMap, Γ_id_hom_app, Γ_id_inv_app]

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftFunctor.famMap_comp
statement:
theorem famMap_comp (Φ : ShiftFunctor R d d') (Ψ : ShiftFunctor R d' d'') {X Y : S}
    (f : d.FamAll X Y) : (Φ.comp Ψ).famMap f = Ψ.famMap (Φ.famMap f)
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp [famMap, Γ_comp_hom_app, Γ_comp_inv_app]

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftFunctor.self_F
statement: @[simp] theorem self_F : (self d).F = d.Q

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftFunctor.self_γ_hom_app
statement: @[simp] theorem self_γ_hom_app (X : S) : (self d).γ.hom.app X = 𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftFunctor.Γ_self_hom_app
statement:
theorem Γ_self_hom_app (i : ℤ) (X : S) :
    ((self d).Γ i).hom.app X ≫ (d.succ i).hom.app X = (d.comm i).hom.app X
proof:
:= by
  refine Int.forall_of_step (P := fun i => ((self d).Γ i).hom.app X ≫ (d.succ i).hom.app X =
    (d.comm i).hom.app X) ?_ (fun i => ?_) i
  · rw [Γ_zero_hom_app, comm_zero_hom_app, Category.id_comp]; rfl
  · rw [Γ_succ_hom_app, comm_succ]
    simp only [self_F, self_γ_hom_app, Functor.comp_obj, Category.id_comp, Category.assoc,
      cancel_epi]
    constructor
    · intro h
      apply d.Q.map_injective
      rw [← cancel_mono ((d.succ (i + 1)).hom.app X), ← h, d.Q.map_comp, Category.assoc]
    · intro h
      rw [← h, d.Q.map_comp, Category.assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftFunctor.Γ_hom_app_comp_of_even
statement:
theorem Γ_hom_app_comp_of_even {Φ Ψ : ShiftFunctor R d d'} (x : ∀ X, Φ.F.obj X ⟶ Ψ.F.obj X)
    (hnat : ∀ {X Y : S} (g : X ⟶ Y), g ∈ parity (R := R) X Y 0 →
      Φ.F.map g ≫ x Y = x X ≫ Ψ.F.map g)
    (hx : ∀ X, Φ.γ.hom.app X ≫ x (d.Q.obj X) = d'.Q.map (x X) ≫ Ψ.γ.hom.app X)
    (i : ℤ) (X : S) :
    (Φ.Γ i).hom.app X ≫ x ((d.pow i).obj X) = (d'.pow i).map (x X) ≫ (Ψ.Γ i).hom.app X
proof:
:= by
  refine Int.forall_of_step (P := fun i => (Φ.Γ i).hom.app X ≫ x ((d.pow i).obj X) =
    (d'.pow i).map (x X) ≫ (Ψ.Γ i).hom.app X) ?_ (fun i => ?_) i
  · rw [Γ_zero_hom_app, Γ_zero_hom_app]; simp
  · have e1 : (Φ.Γ (i + 1)).hom.app X ≫ x ((d.pow (i + 1)).obj X) =
        (d'.succ i).inv.app (Φ.F.obj X) ≫
          d'.Q.map ((Φ.Γ i).hom.app X ≫ x ((d.pow i).obj X)) ≫
            Ψ.γ.hom.app ((d.pow i).obj X) ≫ Ψ.F.map ((d.succ i).hom.app X) := by
      rw [Γ_succ_hom_app]
      simp only [Category.assoc, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp]
      rw [hnat _ (d.succ_hom_mem i X)]
      erw [reassoc_of% (hx ((d.pow i).obj X))]
    have e2 : (d'.pow (i + 1)).map (x X) ≫ (Ψ.Γ (i + 1)).hom.app X =
        (d'.succ i).inv.app (Φ.F.obj X) ≫
          d'.Q.map ((d'.pow i).map (x X) ≫ (Ψ.Γ i).hom.app X) ≫
            Ψ.γ.hom.app ((d.pow i).obj X) ≫ Ψ.F.map ((d.succ i).hom.app X) := by
      rw [Γ_succ_hom_app, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc]
      have n := (d'.succ i).inv.naturality (x X)
      simp only [Functor.comp_obj, Functor.comp_map] at n
      rw [reassoc_of% n]
    show _ = _ ↔ _ = _
    rw [e1, e2, cancel_epi, cancel_mono]
    exact ⟨fun h => d'.Q.map_injective h, fun h => by rw [h]⟩

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftFunctor.Γ_inv_app_comp_of_even
statement:
theorem Γ_inv_app_comp_of_even {Φ Ψ : ShiftFunctor R d d'} (x : ∀ X, Φ.F.obj X ⟶ Ψ.F.obj X)
    (hnat : ∀ {X Y : S} (g : X ⟶ Y), g ∈ parity (R := R) X Y 0 →
      Φ.F.map g ≫ x Y = x X ≫ Ψ.F.map g)
    (hx : ∀ X, Φ.γ.hom.app X ≫ x (d.Q.obj X) = d'.Q.map (x X) ≫ Ψ.γ.hom.app X)
    (i : ℤ) (X : S) :
    (Φ.Γ i).inv.app X ≫ (d'.pow i).map (x X) = x ((d.pow i).obj X) ≫ (Ψ.Γ i).inv.app X
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cancel_mono ((Ψ.Γ i).hom.app X), Category.assoc, ← Γ_hom_app_comp_of_even x hnat hx,
    Iso.inv_hom_id_app_assoc, Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_app]
  exact (Category.comp_id _).symm

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.map_map_comp
statement:
theorem map_map_comp (Φ : ShiftFunctor R d d') (Ψ : ShiftFunctor R d' d'') {X Y : Orbit d}
    (x : X ⟶ Y) : (map Ψ).map ((map Φ).map x) = (map (Φ.comp Ψ)).map x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using Hom.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | add x y hx hy => rw [(map _).map_add, (map _).map_add, (map _).map_add, hx, hy]
  | lof m f =>
    rw [map_map_lof]
    erw [map_map_lof, map_map_lof]
    congr 1
    exact Subtype.ext (famMap_comp Φ Ψ f.1).symm

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.map_comp
statement:
theorem map_comp (Φ : ShiftFunctor R d d') (Ψ : ShiftFunctor R d' d'') :
    map (Φ.comp Ψ) = map Φ ⋙ map Ψ
proof:
:=
  CategoryTheory.Functor.ext (fun _ => rfl) fun X Y x => by
    simp only [Functor.comp_map, eqToHom_refl, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]
    exact (map_map_comp Φ Ψ x).symm

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.map_map_id
statement: theorem map_map_id {X Y : Orbit d} (x : X ⟶ Y) : (map (ShiftFunctor.id d)).map x = x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using Hom.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | add x y hx hy => rw [(map _).map_add, hx, hy]
  | lof m f =>
    rw [map_map_lof]
    congr 1
    exact Subtype.ext (famMap_id f.1)

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.map_id
statement: theorem map_id : map (ShiftFunctor.id d) = 𝟭 (Orbit d)
proof:
:=
  CategoryTheory.Functor.ext (fun _ => rfl) fun X Y x => by
    simp only [Functor.id_map, eqToHom_refl, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]
    exact map_map_id x

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.map_congr
statement:
theorem map_congr {Φ Ψ : ShiftFunctor R d d'} (hF : Φ.F = Ψ.F)
    (hγ : ∀ X, Φ.γ.hom.app X ≫ eqToHom (congrArg (fun F : S ⥤ S' => F.obj (d.Q.obj X)) hF) =
      eqToHom (congrArg (fun F : S ⥤ S' => d'.Q.obj (F.obj X)) hF) ≫ Ψ.γ.hom.app X) :
    map Φ = map Ψ
proof:
:= by
  cases Φ with
  | mk F γ hγm =>
    cases Ψ with
    | mk G γ' hγm' =>
      dsimp only at hF hγ
      subst hF
      obtain rfl : γ = γ' := by
        ext X
        simpa using hγ X
      rfl

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.map_ι_map
statement:
theorem map_ι_map (Φ : ShiftFunctor R d d') {X Y : S} (g : X ⟶ Y) :
    (map Φ).map ((ι d).map g) = (ι d').map (Φ.F.map g)
proof:
:= by
  have := CategoryTheory.Functor.congr_hom (ι_comp_map Φ) g
  simpa only [Functor.comp_map, eqToHom_refl, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp] using this

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.map_map_comp_ι_map
statement:
theorem map_map_comp_ι_map {Φ Ψ : ShiftFunctor R d d'} (x : Φ.F ⟶ Ψ.F)
    (hx : ∀ X, Φ.γ.hom.app X ≫ x.app (d.Q.obj X) = d'.Q.map (x.app X) ≫ Ψ.γ.hom.app X)
    {X Y : Orbit d} (z : X ⟶ Y) :
    (map Φ).map z ≫ (ι d').map (x.app Y.obj) = (ι d').map (x.app X.obj) ≫ (map Ψ).map z

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.map_congr'
statement:
theorem map_congr' {Φ Ψ : ShiftFunctor R d d'} (hobj : ∀ X, Φ.F.obj X = Ψ.F.obj X)
    (hmap : ∀ {X Y : S} (g : X ⟶ Y),
      Φ.F.map g = eqToHom (hobj X) ≫ Ψ.F.map g ≫ eqToHom (hobj Y).symm)
    (hγ : ∀ X, Φ.γ.hom.app X ≫ eqToHom (hobj (d.Q.obj X)) =
      eqToHom (congrArg d'.Q.obj (hobj X)) ≫ Ψ.γ.hom.app X) :
    map Φ = map Ψ
proof:
:=
  map_congr (CategoryTheory.Functor.ext hobj fun _ _ g => hmap g) fun X => hγ X

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.map_σIso_hom
statement:
theorem map_σIso_hom (Φ : ShiftFunctor R d d') (X : Orbit d) :
    (map Φ).map (σIso X).hom =
      (ι d').map (Φ.γ.inv.app X.obj) ≫ (σIso (⟨Φ.F.obj X.obj⟩ : Orbit d')).hom
proof:
:= by
  show (map Φ).map (d.lof (-1) _ _ _) = d'.compL _ _ _ (d'.lof 0 _ _ _) (d'.lof (-1) _ _ _)
  rw [map_map_lof, compL_lof_lof]
  refine d'.lof_congr (by norm_num) ?_
  rw [famCompₗ_apply]
  refine Fam.eq_of_entry (Φ.famMap_mem (d.famσ_mem X.obj))
    (by simpa using famComp_mem (d'.mapFam _).2 (d'.famσ_mem _)) (i₀ := 0) (j₀ := 0 + 1)
    (by norm_num) ?_
  simp only [famMapₗ_apply, famMap, famComp, mapFam]
  rw [show (0 : ℤ) - 0 = 0 by ring, diagFam_self, famσ_succ, famσ_succ, comm_zero_hom_app,
    comm_zero_hom_app, Γ_zero_hom_app, Γ_succ_inv_app, Γ_zero_inv_app, succ_zero_hom_app,
    succ_zero_inv_app]
  simp
  erw [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id, Category.id_comp]
  exact (Category.comp_id _).symm

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.map_σIso_inv
statement:
theorem map_σIso_inv (Φ : ShiftFunctor R d d') (X : Orbit d) :
    (map Φ).map (σIso X).inv =
      (σIso (⟨Φ.F.obj X.obj⟩ : Orbit d')).inv ≫ (ι d').map (Φ.γ.hom.app X.obj)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cancel_epi ((map Φ).map (σIso X).hom), ← Functor.map_comp, Iso.hom_inv_id,
    CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id, map_σIso_hom, Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc,
    ← Functor.map_comp, Iso.inv_hom_id_app, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.map_self_comp_σIso_hom
statement:
theorem map_self_comp_σIso_hom {X Y : Orbit d} (z : X ⟶ Y) :
    (map (ShiftFunctor.self d)).map z ≫ (σIso Y).hom = (σIso X).hom ≫ z
proof:
:= by
  induction z using Hom.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | add x y hx hy => rw [(map _).map_add, Preadditive.add_comp, Preadditive.comp_add, hx, hy]
  | lof m f =>
    show d.compL _ _ _ ((map (ShiftFunctor.self d)).map (d.lof m _ _ f)) (d.lof (-1) _ _ _) =
      d.compL _ _ _ (d.lof (-1) _ _ _) (d.lof m _ _ f)
    rw [map_map_lof]
    erw [compL_lof_lof, compL_lof_lof]
    refine d.lof_congr (by ring) ?_
    rw [famCompₗ_apply, famCompₗ_apply]
    ext i k
    simp only [famComp, famMapₗ_apply]
    by_cases h : i - m + 1 = k
    · subst h
      rw [famσ_succ, show i - -1 = i + 1 by ring, famσ_succ]
      show (((ShiftFunctor.self d).Γ i).hom.app X.obj ≫ d.Q.map (f.1 i (i - m)) ≫
        ((ShiftFunctor.self d).Γ (i - m)).inv.app Y.obj) ≫ (d.comm (i - m)).hom.app Y.obj =
          (d.comm i).hom.app X.obj ≫ f.1 (i + 1) (i - m + 1)
      rw [Fam.compat f.2, ← Γ_self_hom_app, ← Γ_self_hom_app]
      simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_app_assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_app_assoc]
    · have h1 : d.famσ Y.obj (i - m) k = 0 := by rw [famσ, dite_eq_right (by omega)]
      have h2 : f.1 (i - -1) k = 0 := Fam.eq_zero f.2 (by omega)
      rw [h1, h2, Limits.comp_zero, Limits.comp_zero]

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.map_map_comp_ι
statement:
theorem map_map_comp_ι {Φ Ψ : ShiftFunctor R d d'} {p : ZMod 2} {x : ∀ X, Φ.F.obj X ⟶ Ψ.F.obj X}
    (hx : IsSupernatural R p x)
    (hγ : ∀ X, Φ.γ.hom.app X ≫ x (d.Q.obj X) = d'.Q.map (x X) ≫ Ψ.γ.hom.app X)
    {X Y : Orbit d} {q : ZMod 2} {z : X ⟶ Y} (hz : z ∈ parity (R := R) X Y q) :
    (map Φ).map z ≫ (ι d').map (x Y.obj) =
      sign R (p * q) • ((ι d').map (x X.obj) ≫ (map Ψ).map z)
proof:
:= by
  have hnat : ∀ {X Y : S} (g : X ⟶ Y), g ∈ parity (R := R) X Y 0 →
      Φ.F.map g ≫ x Y = x X ≫ Ψ.F.map g := fun g hg => by
    rw [hx.naturality hg, mul_zero, sign_zero, one_smul]
  rw [← d.projHom_of_mem hz]
  clear hz
  induction z using Hom.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | add z z' hz hz' =>
    rw [map_add, (map _).map_add, (map _).map_add, Preadditive.add_comp, Preadditive.comp_add,
      smul_add, hz, hz']
  | lof m f =>
    rw [projHom_lof]
    show d'.compL _ _ _ ((map Φ).map (d.lof m _ _ _)) (d'.lof 0 _ _ _) =
      sign R (p * q) • d'.compL _ _ _ (d'.lof 0 _ _ _) ((map Ψ).map (d.lof m _ _ _))
    rw [map_map_lof, map_map_lof]
    erw [compL_lof_lof, compL_lof_lof]
    rw [← map_smul]
    refine d'.lof_congr (by ring) ?_
    rw [Submodule.coe_smul, famCompₗ_apply, famCompₗ_apply]
    ext i k
    simp only [famComp, mapFam, FamAll.smul_apply, famMapₗ_apply]
    rw [show i - 0 = i by ring, diagFam_self]
    by_cases h : i - m = k
    · subst h
      rw [diagFam_self]
      simp only [famMap, famProj_apply, Category.assoc]
      rw [Γ_inv_app_comp_of_even x hnat hγ,
        reassoc_of% (hx.naturality (proj_mem q (f.1 i (i - m))))]
      simp only [Linear.comp_smul, Linear.smul_comp, Category.assoc]
      rw [← Category.assoc ((Φ.Γ i).hom.app _), Γ_hom_app_comp_of_even x hnat hγ, Category.assoc]
    · have h1 : Ψ.famMap (d.famProj R q m X.obj Y.obj f).1 i k = 0 := by
        rw [famMap, Fam.eq_zero (d.famProj R q m X.obj Y.obj f).2 (by omega)]; simp
      rw [h1, Limits.comp_zero, smul_zero]
      simp [diagFam, h]

name: StringDiagrams.KrullSchmidtExamples.isIndec_unitObj
statement: theorem isIndec_unitObj (a : ZMod 2) : IsIndec (SKarUnit.obj ℚ a)
proof:
:= by
  apply (isIndec_obj_iff (SKar.of ℚ (UnitSupercat ℚ)) (⟨⟨a, ()⟩⟩ : SKarUnit.D ℚ)).2
  constructor
  · intro h
    have h' := congrArg SKarUnit.scal ((IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero _).1 h)
    simp at h'
  · intro e he
    have he' : SKarUnit.scal e * SKarUnit.scal e = SKarUnit.scal e :=
      congrArg SKarUnit.scal he
    have h := mul_eq_zero.mp (show SKarUnit.scal e * (SKarUnit.scal e - 1) = 0 by
      rw [mul_sub, mul_one, he', sub_self])
    exact h.elim (fun h => Or.inl (SKarUnit.hom_ext h))
      (fun h => Or.inr (SKarUnit.hom_ext (sub_eq_zero.mp h)))

name: StringDiagrams.KrullSchmidtExamples.unitObj_class_ne_zero
statement: theorem unitObj_class_ne_zero (a : ZMod 2) : K₀.mk (SKarUnit.obj ℚ a) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hp := multK_self_pos ℚ (isIndec_unitObj a)
  rw [h, map_zero] at hp
  exact (lt_irrefl 0) hp

name: StringDiagrams.PiSOp.reverse_sign_equation
statement:
theorem reverse_sign_equation {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    (p q : ZMod 2) {x y : M} (h : sign R q • y = sign R p • x) :
    sign R q • x = sign R p • y
proof:
:= by
  have e := congrArg (fun z => sign R p • z) h
  rw [sign_smul_sign_smul] at e
  rw [← e, smul_comm (sign R q) (sign R p), sign_smul_sign_smul]

name: StringDiagrams.PiSOp.reverseComparison_naturality_left
statement:
theorem reverseComparison_naturality_left {a b c : TwoSOp R (TwoEnvelope R B)}
    {f g : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ g) (h : b ⟶ c) :
    (reverseHom a b).map η ▷ (reverseHom b c).obj h ≫ (reverseComparison g h).hom =
      (reverseComparison f h).hom ≫ (reverseHom a c).map (η ▷ h)
proof:
:= by
  apply (bridge (R := R) (C := a.unop.as ⟶ c.unop.as)).map_injective
  change bridge.map (_ ≫ (sign R ((SOp.unop g).par * (SOp.unop h).par) • 𝟙 _)) =
    bridge.map ((sign R ((SOp.unop f).par * (SOp.unop h).par) • 𝟙 _) ≫ reverseBridgeMap (η ▷ h))
  erw [Linear.comp_smul, Category.comp_id, Linear.smul_comp, Category.id_comp,
    Functor.map_smul, Functor.map_smul]
  erw [bridge_reverseBridgeMap (R := R) (C := a.unop.as ⟶ c.unop.as) (η ▷ h)]
  have e := comparison_naturality_left (R := R) (B := B)
    (a := reverseObj a) (b := reverseObj b) (c := reverseObj c)
    ((reverseHom a b).map η) ((reverseHom b c).obj h)
  change bridge.map (reverseBridgeMap η) ▷ h ≫
      (sign R ((SOp.unop g).par * (SOp.unop h).par) • 𝟙 _) =
    (sign R ((SOp.unop f).par * (SOp.unop h).par) • 𝟙 _) ≫
      bridge.map ((reverseHom a b).map η ▷ (reverseHom b c).obj h) at e
  erw [bridge_reverseBridgeMap (R := R) (C := a.unop.as ⟶ b.unop.as) η,
    Linear.comp_smul, Category.comp_id,
    Linear.smul_comp, Category.id_comp] at e
  exact reverse_sign_equation _ _ e

name: StringDiagrams.PiSOp.reverseComparison_naturality_right
statement:
theorem reverseComparison_naturality_right {a b c : TwoSOp R (TwoEnvelope R B)}
    (f : a ⟶ b) {g h : b ⟶ c} (η : g ⟶ h) :
    (reverseHom a b).obj f ◁ (reverseHom b c).map η ≫ (reverseComparison f h).hom =
      (reverseComparison f g).hom ≫ (reverseHom a c).map (f ◁ η)
proof:
:= by
  apply (bridge (R := R) (C := a.unop.as ⟶ c.unop.as)).map_injective
  change bridge.map (_ ≫ (sign R ((SOp.unop f).par * (SOp.unop h).par) • 𝟙 _)) =
    bridge.map ((sign R ((SOp.unop f).par * (SOp.unop g).par) • 𝟙 _) ≫ reverseBridgeMap (f ◁ η))
  erw [Linear.comp_smul, Category.comp_id, Linear.smul_comp, Category.id_comp,
    Functor.map_smul, Functor.map_smul]
  erw [bridge_reverseBridgeMap (R := R) (C := a.unop.as ⟶ c.unop.as) (f ◁ η)]
  have e := comparison_naturality_right (R := R) (B := B)
    (a := reverseObj a) (b := reverseObj b) (c := reverseObj c)
    ((reverseHom a b).obj f) ((reverseHom b c).map η)
  change f ◁ bridge.map (reverseBridgeMap η) ≫
      (sign R ((SOp.unop f).par * (SOp.unop h).par) • 𝟙 _) =
    (sign R ((SOp.unop f).par * (SOp.unop g).par) • 𝟙 _) ≫
      bridge.map ((reverseHom a b).obj f ◁ (reverseHom b c).map η) at e
  erw [bridge_reverseBridgeMap (R := R) (C := b.unop.as ⟶ c.unop.as) η,
    Linear.comp_smul, Category.comp_id,
    Linear.smul_comp, Category.id_comp] at e
  exact reverse_sign_equation _ _ e

name: StringDiagrams.QEnvelope.toHom_smul
statement:
@[simp] theorem toHom_smul {X Y : QEnvelope R C} (r : R) (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    toHom (r • f) = r • toHom f

name: StringDiagrams.QEnvelope.mem_parity_iff
statement:
theorem mem_parity_iff {X Y : QEnvelope R C} {f : X ⟶ Y} {p : ZMod 2} :
    f ∈ parity (R := R) X Y p ↔ toHom f ∈ parity (R := R) X.obj Y.obj p

name: StringDiagrams.QEnvelope.toHom_proj
statement:
theorem toHom_proj (p : ZMod 2) {X Y : QEnvelope R C} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    toHom (proj R p f) = proj R p (toHom f)
proof:
:= by
  let g : X ⟶ Y := ofHom (proj R p (toHom f))
  let h : X ⟶ Y := ofHom (proj R (p + 1) (toHom f))
  have e : f = g + h := (proj_add_proj_add_one (R := R) p (toHom f)).symm
  rw [proj_eq_of_add e (proj_mem (R := R) (C := C) p (toHom f))
    (proj_mem (R := R) (C := C) (p + 1) (toHom f))]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.QEnvelope.isInternal_shift
statement:
theorem isInternal_shift (X Y : C) (s : ℤ) :
    DirectSum.IsInternal fun n => degree (R := R) X Y (n + s)
proof:
:= by
  have h := (DirectSum.isInternal_submodule_iff_iSupIndep_and_iSup_eq_top _).1
    (isInternal_degree (R := R) X Y)
  rw [DirectSum.isInternal_submodule_iff_iSupIndep_and_iSup_eq_top]
  exact ⟨h.1.comp (add_left_injective s), by
    rw [← h.2]; exact (Equiv.addRight s).iSup_comp (g := fun n => degree (R := R) X Y n)⟩

name: StringDiagrams.QEnvelope.mem_degree_iff
statement:
theorem mem_degree_iff {X Y : QEnvelope R C} {f : X ⟶ Y} {k : ℤ} :
    f ∈ degree (R := R) X Y k ↔ toHom f ∈ degree (R := R) X.obj Y.obj (k + (X.shift - Y.shift))

name: StringDiagrams.QEnvelope.ofHom_mem_degree
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_degree_iff, toHom_ofHom]
  convert hf using 2; ring

name: StringDiagrams.QEnvelope.shiftIso_hom_mem
statement:
theorem shiftIso_hom_mem (X : QEnvelope R C) :
    (shiftIso X).hom ∈ parity (R := R) ((J R C).obj X.obj) X 0

name: StringDiagrams.QEnvelope.shiftIso_hom_mem_degree
statement:
theorem shiftIso_hom_mem_degree (X : QEnvelope R C) :
    (shiftIso X).hom ∈ degree (R := R) ((J R C).obj X.obj) X X.shift
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_degree_iff]
  show 𝟙 X.obj ∈ _
  simpa using! id_mem_degree (R := R) X.obj

name: StringDiagrams.QEnvelope.J_comp_extend
statement: theorem J_comp_extend : J R C ⋙ extend R F = F
proof:
:=
  CategoryTheory.Functor.ext (fun _ => rfl) (fun X Y f => by
    change (σPow R 0 (F.obj X)).hom ≫ F.map f ≫ (σPow R 0 (F.obj Y)).inv = 𝟙 _ ≫ F.map f ≫ 𝟙 _
    simp)

name: StringDiagrams.QEnvelope.isGradedSupernatural_extendNat
statement:
theorem isGradedSupernatural_extendNat [G.Linear R] {p : ZMod 2} {n : ℤ}
    {x : ∀ X, F.obj X ⟶ G.obj X} (hx : IsGradedSupernatural R p n x) :
    IsGradedSupernatural R p n (F := extend R F) (G := extend R G) (extendNat R F G x) where
  mem X
proof:
:= by
    have := comp_mem (comp_mem (σPow_hom_mem (R := R) X.shift (F.obj X.obj)) (hx.mem X.obj))
      (σPow_inv_mem (R := R) X.shift (G.obj X.obj))
    simpa [extendNat] using! this
  naturality {X Y q f} hf := by
    simp only [extend_map, extendNat, Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
    rw [reassoc_of% (hx.naturality (f := toHom f) hf), Linear.smul_comp, Linear.comp_smul]
    simp only [Category.assoc]
  mem_degree X := by
    have := comp_mem_degree (comp_mem_degree
      (σPow_hom_mem_degree (R := R) X.shift (F.obj X.obj)) (hx.mem_degree X.obj))
      (σPow_inv_mem_degree (R := R) X.shift (G.obj X.obj))
    rw [show -X.shift + n + X.shift = n by ring] at this
    simpa [extendNat] using! this

name: StringDiagrams.QEnvelope.extendNat_J
statement:
@[simp] theorem extendNat_J (x : ∀ X, F.obj X ⟶ G.obj X) (X : C) :
    extendNat R F G x ((J R C).obj X) = x X
proof:
:= by
  change (σPow R 0 (F.obj X)).hom ≫ x X ≫ (σPow R 0 (G.obj X)).inv = x X
  simp

name: StringDiagrams.QEnvelope.eq_of_restrict_eq
proof:
:= by
  funext X
  have hu : (isoOfIso (Iso.refl X.obj) : (J R C).obj X.obj ≅ X).hom ∈
      parity (R := R) ((J R C).obj X.obj) X 0 := id_mem (R := R) X.obj
  have e1 := hy.naturality hu
  have e2 := hy'.naturality hu
  rw [h X.obj, ← e2] at e1
  exact (cancel_epi (H.mapIso (isoOfIso (Iso.refl X.obj) : (J R C).obj X.obj ≅ X)).hom).1 e1

name: StringDiagrams.QEnvelope.isGradedSupernatural_restrict
statement:
theorem isGradedSupernatural_restrict {H K : QEnvelope R C ⥤ B} {p : ZMod 2} {n : ℤ}
    {y : ∀ X, H.obj X ⟶ K.obj X} (hy : IsGradedSupernatural R p n y) :
    IsGradedSupernatural R p n (F := J R C ⋙ H) (G := J R C ⋙ K)
      fun X => y ((J R C).obj X)

name: StringDiagrams.QEnvelope.extendRestrictIso_hom_mem
statement:
theorem extendRestrictIso_hom_mem (H : QEnvelope R C ⥤ B) [H.Additive] [H.Linear R]
    [IsGradedSuperfunctor R H] (X : QEnvelope R C) :
    (extendRestrictIso H).hom.app X ∈ parity (R := R) _ (H.obj X) 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa [extendRestrictIso] using! comp_mem (σPow_hom_mem (R := R) X.shift _)
    (map_mem H (shiftIso_hom_mem (R := R) X))

name: StringDiagrams.QEnvelope.extendRestrictIso_hom_mem_degree
statement:
theorem extendRestrictIso_hom_mem_degree (H : QEnvelope R C ⥤ B) [H.Additive] [H.Linear R]
    [IsGradedSuperfunctor R H] (X : QEnvelope R C) :
    (extendRestrictIso H).hom.app X ∈ degree (R := R) _ (H.obj X) 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa [extendRestrictIso] using! comp_mem_degree (σPow_hom_mem_degree (R := R) X.shift _)
    (map_mem_degree H (shiftIso_hom_mem_degree (R := R) X))

statement:

statement:
theorem ζIso_mem_degree (X : Envelope R D) :
    (ζIso X).hom ∈ degree (R := R) (⟨X.par + 1, X.obj⟩ : Envelope R D) X 0

name: StringDiagrams.Envelope.shiftIso_hom_mem_degree
statement:
theorem shiftIso_hom_mem_degree (X : Envelope R D) :
    (shiftIso X).hom ∈ degree (R := R) ((J R D).obj X.obj) X 0

name: StringDiagrams.Envelope.ζPow_hom_mem_degree
statement:
theorem ζPow_hom_mem_degree (a : ZMod 2) (X : B) :
    (ζPow R a X).hom ∈ degree (R := R) (piPow R a X) X 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one a with rfl | rfl
  · exact id_mem_degree X
  · exact QPiSupercategory.ζ_hom_mem_degree X

name: StringDiagrams.Envelope.ζPow_inv_mem_degree
statement:
theorem ζPow_inv_mem_degree (a : ZMod 2) (X : B) :
    (ζPow R a X).inv ∈ degree (R := R) X (piPow R a X) 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa using inv_mem_degree _ (ζPow_hom_mem_degree (R := R) a X)

name: StringDiagrams.Envelope.extendNat_mem_degree
proof:
:= by
  have := comp_mem_degree (comp_mem_degree (ζPow_hom_mem_degree X.par (F.obj X.obj)) (hx X.obj))
    (ζPow_inv_mem_degree X.par (G.obj X.obj))
  simp only [zero_add, add_zero] at this
  exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (by simpa [Category.assoc] using! this)

name: StringDiagrams.Envelope.extendIso_hom_app
statement:
theorem extendIso_hom_app {G G' : D ⥤ B} [G.Additive] [G.Linear R] [IsSuperfunctor R G]
    [G'.Additive] [G'.Linear R] [IsSuperfunctor R G'] (α : G ≅ G')
    (hα : ∀ X, α.hom.app X ∈ parity (R := R) (G.obj X) (G'.obj X) 0) (X : Envelope R D) :
    (extendIso α hα).hom.app X = extendNat R G G' 0 (fun X => α.hom.app X) X

name: StringDiagrams.QPiEnvelope.toHom_ofHom
statement:
@[simp] theorem toHom_ofHom {X Y : QPiEnvelope R C} (f : X.obj.obj ⟶ Y.obj.obj) :

@[simp] theorem toHom_comp {X Y Z : QPiEnvelope R C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) :

name: StringDiagrams.QPiEnvelope.ofHom_mem
proof:
:= by

name: StringDiagrams.QPiEnvelope.ofHom_mem_degree
StringDiagrams.QPiEnvelope.idIso_mem
statement:
theorem idIso_mem {X Y : QPiEnvelope R C} (hXY : X.par = Y.par) (hobj : X.obj.obj = Y.obj.obj)
    (e : X.obj.obj ≅ Y.obj.obj) (he : e = eqToIso hobj) :
    (Envelope.isoOfIso (QEnvelope.isoOfIso e) : X ≅ Y).hom ∈ parity (R := R) X Y 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ⟨m, x⟩⟩ := X
  obtain ⟨b, ⟨n, y⟩⟩ := Y
  simp only at hXY hobj
  subst hXY hobj he
  rw [Envelope.mem_parity_iff]
  show 𝟙 x ∈ parity (R := R) x x (0 + (a + a))
  rw [zmod2_add_self, add_zero]; exact id_mem x

name: StringDiagrams.QPiEnvelope.QPiComplete.exists_iso
statement:
theorem QPiComplete.exists_iso (h : QPiComplete R C) (m : ℤ) :
    ∀ (a : ZMod 2) (X : C), ∃ (Y : C) (e : Y ≅ X),
      e.hom ∈ parity (R := R) Y X a ∧ e.hom ∈ degree (R := R) Y X m
proof:
:= by
  induction m using Int.induction_on with
  | zero =>
    intro a X
    rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one a with rfl | rfl
    · exact ⟨X, Iso.refl X, id_mem X, id_mem_degree X⟩
    · exact (h X).2.2
  | succ k ih =>
    intro a X
    obtain ⟨Y, e, he, he'⟩ := ih a X
    obtain ⟨Z, e₂, he₂, he₂'⟩ := (h Y).1
    refine ⟨Z, e₂ ≪≫ e, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa using comp_mem he₂ he
    · simpa [add_comm] using comp_mem_degree he₂' he'
  | pred k ih =>
    intro a X
    obtain ⟨Y, e, he, he'⟩ := ih a X
    obtain ⟨Z, e₂, he₂, he₂'⟩ := (h Y).2.1
    refine ⟨Z, e₂ ≪≫ e, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa using comp_mem he₂ he
    · have := comp_mem_degree he₂' he'
      rwa [show -1 + (-(k : ℤ)) = -(k : ℤ) - 1 by ring] at this

name: StringDiagrams.QPiEnvelope.J_gradedEvenlyDense_iff
statement: theorem J_gradedEvenlyDense_iff : GradedEvenlyDense R (J R C) ↔ QPiComplete R C
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h X
    have key : ∀ (m : ℤ) (a : ZMod 2), ∃ (Y : C) (e : Y ≅ X),
        e.hom ∈ parity (R := R) Y X a ∧ e.hom ∈ degree (R := R) Y X (-m) := by
      intro m a
      obtain ⟨Y, e, he, he'⟩ := h (QPiEnvelope.mk m a X)
      refine ⟨Y, QEnvelope.isoToIso (Envelope.isoToIso e), ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [Envelope.mem_parity_iff] at he
        simpa using! he
      · rw [Envelope.mem_degree_iff, QEnvelope.mem_degree_iff] at he'
        simpa using! he'
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa using key (-1) 0
    · simpa using key 1 0
    · simpa using key 0 1
  · intro h X
    obtain ⟨a, ⟨m, X⟩⟩ := X
    obtain ⟨Y, e, he, he'⟩ := h.exists_iso (-m) a X
    refine ⟨Y, Envelope.isoOfIso (QEnvelope.isoOfIso e), ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [Envelope.mem_parity_iff]
      show e.hom ∈ parity (R := R) Y X (0 + (0 + a))
      simpa using he
    · rw [Envelope.mem_degree_iff, QEnvelope.mem_degree_iff]
      show e.hom ∈ degree (R := R) Y X (0 + (0 - m))
      simpa using he'

statement: theorem J_comp_extend : J R C ⋙ extend R F = F

name: StringDiagrams.QPiEnvelope.isGradedSupernatural_extendNat
StringDiagrams.QPiEnvelope.extendNat_J
statement:
@[simp] theorem extendNat_J (p : ZMod 2) (x : ∀ X, F.obj X ⟶ G.obj X) (X : C) :
    extendNat R F G p x ⟨0, ⟨0, X⟩⟩ = x X
proof:
:= by
  simp [extendNat, Envelope.extendNat, QEnvelope.extendNat]
  exact Category.id_comp _

name: StringDiagrams.QPiEnvelope.eq_of_restrict_eq
statement:
theorem eq_of_restrict_eq [PiSupercategory R B] {H K : QPiEnvelope R C ⥤ B} [H.Additive]
    [H.Linear R] [IsSuperfunctor R H] [K.Additive] [K.Linear R] [IsSuperfunctor R K]
    {p : ZMod 2} {y y' : ∀ X, H.obj X ⟶ K.obj X} (hy : IsSupernatural R p y)
    (hy' : IsSupernatural R p y') (h : ∀ X : C, y ((J R C).obj X) = y' ((J R C).obj X)) :
    y = y'
proof:
:=
  Envelope.eq_of_restrict_eq hy hy' fun X =>
    congrFun (QEnvelope.eq_of_restrict_eq (H := Envelope.J R _ ⋙ H) (K := Envelope.J R _ ⋙ K)
      (hy.whiskerLeft (Envelope.J R _)) (hy'.whiskerLeft (Envelope.J R _)) h) X

name: StringDiagrams.QPiEnvelope.eq_extendNat
proof:
:=
  eq_of_restrict_eq hy (isGradedSupernatural_extendNat hx).toIsSupernatural fun X => by
    rw [h]; exact (extendNat_J p x X).symm

name: StringDiagrams.QPiEnvelope.restrict_bijective
statement:
theorem restrict_bijective (p : ZMod 2) (n : ℤ) :
    Function.Bijective (fun y : {y : ∀ X, (extend R F).obj X ⟶ (extend R G).obj X //
        IsGradedSupernatural R p n (F := extend R F) (G := extend R G) y} =>
      (⟨fun X => y.1 ((J R C).obj X), y.2.whiskerLeft (J R C)⟩ :
        {x : ∀ X, (J R C ⋙ extend R F).obj X ⟶ (J R C ⋙ extend R G).obj X //
          IsGradedSupernatural R p n (F := J R C ⋙ extend R F) (G := J R C ⋙ extend R G) x}))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro y y' hyy
    exact Subtype.ext (eq_of_restrict_eq y.2.toIsSupernatural y'.2.toIsSupernatural
      fun X => congrFun (congrArg Subtype.val hyy) X)
  · intro x
    have hx : IsGradedSupernatural R p n (F := F) (G := G) x.1 := by
      have h1 := J_comp_extend (R := R) F
      have h2 := J_comp_extend (R := R) G
      exact ⟨⟨fun X => x.2.mem X, fun hf => by
          have := x.2.naturality hf
          rw [eq_of_heq (Functor.hcongr_hom h1 _), eq_of_heq (Functor.hcongr_hom h2 _)] at this
          exact this⟩, fun X => x.2.mem_degree X⟩
    exact ⟨⟨extendNat R F G p x.1, isGradedSupernatural_extendNat hx⟩,
      Subtype.ext (funext fun X => extendNat_J p x.1 X)⟩

name: StringDiagrams.QPiEnvelope.extendNat_id
statement:
theorem extendNat_id :
    extendNat R F F 0 (fun X => 𝟙 (F.obj X)) = fun X => 𝟙 ((extend R F).obj X)
proof:
:=
  eq_of_restrict_eq (isGradedSupernatural_extendNat isGradedSupernatural_id).toIsSupernatural
    isSupernatural_id fun X => extendNat_J 0 _ X

name: StringDiagrams.QPiEnvelope.extendNat_comp
statement:
theorem extendNat_comp {H : C ⥤ B} [H.Additive] [H.Linear R] [IsGradedSuperfunctor R H]
    {p q : ZMod 2} {m n : ℤ} {x : ∀ X, F.obj X ⟶ G.obj X} {y : ∀ X, G.obj X ⟶ H.obj X}
    (hx : IsGradedSupernatural R p m x) (hy : IsGradedSupernatural R q n y) :
    extendNat R F H (p + q) (fun X => x X ≫ y X) =
      fun X => extendNat R F G p x X ≫ extendNat R G H q y X
proof:
:=
  eq_of_restrict_eq (isGradedSupernatural_extendNat (hx.comp hy)).toIsSupernatural
    ((isGradedSupernatural_extendNat hx).toIsSupernatural.comp
      (isGradedSupernatural_extendNat hy).toIsSupernatural) fun X =>
    (extendNat_J (p + q) _ X).trans
      (congrArg₂ (· ≫ ·) (extendNat_J p x X).symm (extendNat_J q y X).symm)

name: StringDiagrams.QPiEnvelope.extendRestrictIso_hom_mem
statement:
theorem extendRestrictIso_hom_mem (H : QPiEnvelope R C ⥤ B) [H.Additive] [H.Linear R]
    [IsGradedSuperfunctor R H] (X : QPiEnvelope R C) :
    (extendRestrictIso H).hom.app X ∈ parity (R := R) _ (H.obj X) 0
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := (Envelope.isSupernatural_extendNat (isSupernatural_of_natTrans
    (QEnvelope.extendRestrictIso (Envelope.J R _ ⋙ H)).hom
    (QEnvelope.extendRestrictIso_hom_mem _))).mem X
  have h2 := Envelope.extendRestrictIso_hom_mem H X
  simpa using! comp_mem h1 h2

name: StringDiagrams.QPiEnvelope.extendRestrictIso_hom_mem_degree
statement:
theorem extendRestrictIso_hom_mem_degree (H : QPiEnvelope R C ⥤ B) [H.Additive] [H.Linear R]
    [IsGradedSuperfunctor R H] (X : QPiEnvelope R C) :
    (extendRestrictIso H).hom.app X ∈ degree (R := R) _ (H.obj X) 0
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := Envelope.extendNat_mem_degree (p := 0)
    (x := fun X => (QEnvelope.extendRestrictIso (Envelope.J R _ ⋙ H)).hom.app X)
    (QEnvelope.extendRestrictIso_hom_mem_degree _) X
  have h2 : (Envelope.extendRestrictIso H).hom.app X ∈ degree (R := R) _ (H.obj X) 0 := by
    have := comp_mem_degree (Envelope.ζPow_hom_mem_degree (R := R) X.par
      (H.obj ((Envelope.J R _).obj X.obj))) (map_mem_degree H
      (Envelope.shiftIso_hom_mem_degree (R := R) X))
    simpa [Envelope.extendRestrictIso] using! this
  simpa using! comp_mem_degree h1 h2

name: StringDiagrams.QPiEnvelope.J_comp_map
statement: theorem J_comp_map (F : C ⥤ D) : J R C ⋙ map R F = F ⋙ J R D

name: StringDiagrams.QPiEnvelope.map_id
statement: theorem map_id : map R (𝟭 C) = 𝟭 (QPiEnvelope R C)

statement:
theorem map_comp {E : Type*} [Category E] [Preadditive E] [Linear R E] [Supercategory R E]

    map R (F ⋙ G) = map R F ⋙ map R G

name: StringDiagrams.QPiEnvelope.map_Q_obj
statement:
theorem map_Q_obj (F : C ⥤ D) (X : QPiEnvelope R C) :
    (map R F).obj ((QPiSupercategory.Q (R := R)).obj X) =

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.vcomp_unit_coherence
statement:
theorem vcomp_unit_coherence {a b : C} (A : a ⟶ b) :
    (associator A (𝟙 b) (𝟙 b)).inv ≫ (rightUnitor A).hom ▷ 𝟙 b ≫ (leftUnitor A).inv ▷ 𝟙 b ≫
        (associator (𝟙 a) A (𝟙 b)).hom ≫ 𝟙 a ◁ (rightUnitor A).hom ≫
        𝟙 a ◁ (leftUnitor A).inv ≫ (associator (𝟙 a) (𝟙 a) A).inv ≫
        (leftUnitor (𝟙 a)).hom ▷ A =
      A ◁ (leftUnitor (𝟙 b)).hom ≫ (rightUnitor A).hom ≫ (leftUnitor A).inv
proof:
:= by
  have h : ∀ (A' : (⟨a⟩ : Underlying2 R C) ⟶ ⟨b⟩),
      (Bicategory.associator A' (𝟙 _) (𝟙 _)).inv ≫ Bicategory.whiskerRight (Bicategory.rightUnitor A').hom (𝟙 _) ≫
        Bicategory.whiskerRight (Bicategory.leftUnitor A').inv (𝟙 _) ≫
        (Bicategory.associator (𝟙 _) A' (𝟙 _)).hom ≫
        Bicategory.whiskerLeft (𝟙 _) (Bicategory.rightUnitor A').hom ≫
        Bicategory.whiskerLeft (𝟙 _) (Bicategory.leftUnitor A').inv ≫
        (Bicategory.associator (𝟙 _) (𝟙 _) A').inv ≫
        Bicategory.whiskerRight (Bicategory.leftUnitor (𝟙 _)).hom A' =
      Bicategory.whiskerLeft A' (Bicategory.leftUnitor (𝟙 _)).hom ≫ (Bicategory.rightUnitor A').hom ≫
        (Bicategory.leftUnitor A').inv := by
    intro A'
    bicategory_coherence
  have h' := congrArg Subtype.val (h (Underlying2.hom1 A))
  simp only [Underlying2.comp₂_val, Underlying2.whiskerLeft_val, Underlying2.whiskerRight_val,
    Underlying2.associator_hom_val, Underlying2.associator_inv_val, Underlying2.leftUnitor_hom_val,
    Underlying2.leftUnitor_inv_val, Underlying2.rightUnitor_hom_val, Underlying2.hom1_obj,
    Underlying2.id_obj] at h'
  exact h'

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.vcomp_unitors_naturality
statement:
theorem vcomp_unitors_naturality {a b : C} {A B : a ⟶ b} (φ : A ⟶ B) (ψ : B ⟶ A)
    (h : φ ≫ ψ = 𝟙 A) :
    ((associator A (𝟙 b) (𝟙 b)).inv ≫
        ((rightUnitor A).hom ≫ φ ≫ (leftUnitor B).inv) ▷ 𝟙 b ≫
        (associator (𝟙 a) B (𝟙 b)).hom ≫ 𝟙 a ◁ ((rightUnitor B).hom ≫ ψ ≫ (leftUnitor A).inv) ≫
        (associator (𝟙 a) (𝟙 a) A).inv) ≫ (leftUnitor (𝟙 a)).hom ▷ A =
      A ◁ (leftUnitor (𝟙 b)).hom ≫ (rightUnitor A).hom ≫ (leftUnitor A).inv
proof:
:= by
  have nat : φ ▷ 𝟙 b ≫ (leftUnitor B).inv ▷ 𝟙 b ≫ (associator (𝟙 a) B (𝟙 b)).hom ≫
      𝟙 a ◁ (rightUnitor B).hom = (leftUnitor A).inv ▷ 𝟙 b ≫ (associator (𝟙 a) A (𝟙 b)).hom ≫
      𝟙 a ◁ (rightUnitor A).hom ≫ 𝟙 a ◁ φ := by
    rw [← Category.assoc, ← comp_whiskerRight (R := R), leftUnitor_inv_naturality R,
      comp_whiskerRight (R := R), Category.assoc, associator_naturality_middle_assoc R,
      ← whiskerLeft_comp (R := R), rightUnitor_naturality R, whiskerLeft_comp (R := R)]
  simp only [comp_whiskerRight (R := R), whiskerLeft_comp (R := R), Category.assoc]
  rw [reassoc_of% nat, TwoEnvelope.whiskerLeft_comp_comp R (𝟙 a) φ ψ, h,
    whiskerLeft_id (R := R), Category.id_comp]
  simpa only [Category.assoc] using vcomp_unit_coherence R A

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.twoSuperfunctor_ext
statement:
theorem twoSuperfunctor_ext {F G : TwoSuperfunctor R B C} (h_obj : F.obj = G.obj)
    (h_map : HEq @F.map @G.map) (h_map₂ : HEq @F.map₂ @G.map₂)
    (h_comp : HEq @F.mapComp @G.mapComp) (h_id : HEq F.mapId G.mapId) : F = G
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨obj, map, map₂, _, _, _, _, _, mapComp, mapId, _, _, _, _, _, _, _⟩ := F
  obtain ⟨obj', map', map₂', _, _, _, _, _, mapComp', mapId', _, _, _, _, _, _, _⟩ := G
  dsimp only at h_obj h_map h_map₂ h_comp h_id
  subst h_obj
  cases h_map
  cases h_map₂
  cases h_comp
  cases h_id
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.twoJ_comp_extend
statement: theorem twoJ_comp_extend (F : TwoSuperfunctor R B C) : (twoJ R B).comp (extend F) = F
proof:
:= by
  refine twoSuperfunctor_ext rfl HEq.rfl (heq_of_eq ?_) (heq_of_eq ?_) (heq_of_eq ?_)
  · funext a b f g η
    show 𝟙 _ ≫ F.map₂ η ≫ 𝟙 _ = _
    rw [Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id]
  · funext a b c f g
    apply Iso.ext
    show (extendComp F (Jm (R := R) f) (Jm g)).hom ≫
      (extend F).map₂ (𝟙 (Jm (R := R) f ≫ Jm g)) = _
    rw [(extend F).map₂_id]
    erw [Category.comp_id]
    exact extendComp_J F (a := ⟨a⟩) (b := ⟨b⟩) (c := ⟨c⟩) f g
  · funext a
    apply Iso.ext
    show (F.mapId a).hom ≫ (extend F).map₂ (𝟙 (𝟙 (⟨a⟩ : TwoEnvelope R B))) = _
    rw [(extend F).map₂_id]
    erw [Category.comp_id]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.restrict_eq_comp
statement: theorem restrict_eq_comp : restrict T = (twoJ R B).comp T
proof:
:= by
  refine twoSuperfunctor_ext rfl HEq.rfl HEq.rfl (heq_of_eq ?_) (heq_of_eq ?_)
  · funext a b c f g
    apply Iso.ext
    show (T.mapComp (Jm (R := R) f) (Jm g)).hom = (T.mapComp (Jm f) (Jm g)).hom ≫
      T.map₂ (𝟙 (Jm (R := R) f ≫ Jm g))
    rw [T.map₂_id]
    erw [Category.comp_id]
  · funext a
    apply Iso.ext
    show (T.mapId ⟨a⟩).hom = (T.mapId ⟨a⟩).hom ≫ T.map₂ (𝟙 (𝟙 (⟨a⟩ : TwoEnvelope R B)))
    rw [T.map₂_id]
    erw [Category.comp_id]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.extendTwoNatTrans_vcomp
statement:
theorem extendTwoNatTrans_vcomp (θ : TwoNatTrans F G) (θ' : TwoNatTrans G H) :
    extendTwoNatTrans (TwoNatTrans.vcomp θ θ') =
      TwoNatTrans.vcomp (extendTwoNatTrans θ) (extendTwoNatTrans θ')
proof:
:= by
  rw [← extendTwoNatTrans_restrictTwoNatTrans
    (TwoNatTrans.vcomp (extendTwoNatTrans θ) (extendTwoNatTrans θ'))]
  congr 1
  refine twoNatTrans_ext rfl fun {a b} f => heq_of_eq ?_
  rw [restrictTwoNatTrans_x, TwoNatTrans.vcomp_x, TwoNatTrans.vcomp_x]
  have h₁ : (extendTwoNatTrans θ).x
      ((Envelope.J R (a ⟶ b)).obj f : (⟨a⟩ : TwoEnvelope R B) ⟶ ⟨b⟩) = θ.x f :=
    extendX_J (a := (⟨a⟩ : TwoEnvelope R B)) (b := ⟨b⟩) θ f
  have h₂ : (extendTwoNatTrans θ').x
      ((Envelope.J R (a ⟶ b)).obj f : (⟨a⟩ : TwoEnvelope R B) ⟶ ⟨b⟩) = θ'.x f :=
    extendX_J (a := (⟨a⟩ : TwoEnvelope R B)) (b := ⟨b⟩) θ' f
  rw [h₁, h₂]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.hcomp_mem
StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.hcomp_eq
StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.hcomp_comp_hcomp
statement:
theorem hcomp_comp_hcomp {a b c : B} {f g k : a ⟶ b} {h i l : b ⟶ c} {pu py : ZMod 2}
    (x : f ⟶ g) (u : g ⟶ k) (y : h ⟶ i) (v : i ⟶ l) (hu : u ∈ parity (R := R) g k pu)
    (hy : y ∈ parity (R := R) h i py) :
    hcomp x y ≫ hcomp u v = koszulSign pu py • hcomp (x ≫ u) (y ≫ v)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [hcomp, Category.assoc]
  rw [← Category.assoc (g ◁ y), ← koszulSign_smul_smul pu py (g ◁ y ≫ u ▷ i),
    ← super_interchange hu hy, Linear.smul_comp, Linear.comp_smul,
    comp_whiskerRight (R := R), whiskerLeft_comp (R := R)]
  simp only [Category.assoc]

proof:

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSuperBimodule.tensorProj_balance_mem
statement:
theorem tensorProj_balance_mem (n : ℤ) (m : M.toSuperBimodule.toSVec) (b : B)
    (x : N.toSuperBimodule.toSVec) :
    GradedSuperspace.tensorProj M.toGradedSuperspace N.toGradedSuperspace n
      (balance M.toSuperBimodule N.toSuperBimodule m b x) ∈
        balanceRel M.toSuperBimodule N.toSuperBimodule
proof:
:= by
  refine M.toGradedSuperspace.induction_on_deg m ?_ (fun r m hm => ?_) (fun m m' hm hm' => ?_)
  · rw [show balance M.toSuperBimodule N.toSuperBimodule 0 b x = 0 by simp [balance], map_zero]
    exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  · refine DirectSum.Decomposition.inductionOn ℋ.degree (motive := fun b =>
      GradedSuperspace.tensorProj M.toGradedSuperspace N.toGradedSuperspace n
        (balance M.toSuperBimodule N.toSuperBimodule m b x) ∈
          balanceRel M.toSuperBimodule N.toSuperBimodule) ?_ (fun {s} b => ?_)
      (fun b b' hb hb' => ?_) b
    · dsimp only
      rw [show balance M.toSuperBimodule N.toSuperBimodule m 0 x = 0 by simp [balance], map_zero]
      exact Submodule.zero_mem _
    · dsimp only
      refine N.toGradedSuperspace.induction_on_deg x ?_ (fun t x hx => ?_) (fun x x' hx hx' => ?_)
      · rw [show balance M.toSuperBimodule N.toSuperBimodule m b 0 = 0 by simp [balance], map_zero]
        exact Submodule.zero_mem _
      · rw [balance, map_sub,
          GradedSuperspace.tensorProj_tmul _ _ n (r + s) t (M.ract_mem b.2 hm) hx,
          GradedSuperspace.tensorProj_tmul _ _ n r (t + s) hm (N.lact_mem b.2 hx)]
        by_cases h : r + s + t = n
        · rw [ite_eq_left h, ite_eq_left (by omega)]
          exact balance_mem _ _ m b x
        · rw [ite_eq_right h, ite_eq_right (by omega), sub_zero]
          exact Submodule.zero_mem _
      · rw [balance_add_right, map_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hx hx'
    · dsimp only at hb hb' ⊢
      rw [balance_add_middle, map_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hb hb'
  · rw [balance_add_left, map_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hm hm'

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSuperBimodule.balanceRel_tensorProj

StringDiagrams.GradedSuperBimodule.tensorDeg_le_iff
statement:
theorem tensorDeg_le_iff {n : ℤ}
    {S : Submodule k (SuperBimodule.tensor M.toSuperBimodule N.toSuperBimodule).toSVec} :
    tensorDeg M N n ≤ S ↔ ∀ (r s : ℤ), r + s = n → ∀ m ∈ M.deg r, ∀ x ∈ N.deg s,
      btmul M.toSuperBimodule N.toSuperBimodule m x ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensorDeg, Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap, GradedSuperspace.tensorDeg_le_iff]
  exact Iff.rfl

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSuperBimodule.isInternal_tensorDeg
statement: theorem isInternal_tensorDeg : DirectSum.IsInternal (tensorDeg M N)
proof:
:= by
  rw [DirectSum.isInternal_submodule_iff_iSupIndep_and_iSup_eq_top]
  constructor
  · refine iSupIndep_of_projections _ (fun n => SVec.toLinearMap (tensorProjQ M N n))
      (fun n => ?_) (fun n m hmn => ?_)
    · rw [tensorDeg, Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap]
      intro x hx
      rw [Submodule.mem_comap, LinearMap.mem_eqLocus]
      change tensorProjQ M N n (tensorMk _ _ x) = tensorMk _ _ x
      rw [tensorProjQ_tensorMk, GradedSuperspace.tensorProj_of_mem _ _ hx]
    · rw [tensorDeg, Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap]
      intro x hx
      rw [Submodule.mem_comap, LinearMap.mem_ker]
      change tensorProjQ M N n (tensorMk _ _ x) = 0
      rw [tensorProjQ_tensorMk, GradedSuperspace.tensorProj_of_mem_ne _ _ hmn hx, tensorMk_zero]
  · change ⨆ n, (tensorDegK M N n).map _ = ⊤
    rw [← Submodule.map_iSup, GradedSuperspace.iSup_tensorDeg_eq_top, Submodule.map_top,
      LinearMap.range_eq_top]
    exact tensorMk_surjective _ _

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSuperBimodule.whiskerRight_mem_degHom
statement:
theorem whiskerRight_mem_degHom {M M' : GradedSuperBimodule 𝒢 ℋ} {n : ℤ}
    {f : M.toSuperBimodule ⟶ M'.toSuperBimodule} (hf : f ∈ degHom M M' n)
    (N : GradedSuperBimodule ℋ 𝒦) :
    SuperBimodule.whiskerRight f N.toSuperBimodule ∈ degHom (M.tensor N) (M'.tensor N) n
proof:
:= by
  refine (mem_degHom_iff _).2 fun d x hx => ?_
  refine (tensorDeg_le_iff M N (S := ((M'.tensor N).deg (d + n)).comap
    (SVec.toLinearMap (SuperBimodule.whiskerRight f N.toSuperBimodule).1))).2
    (fun r s hrs m hm y hy => ?_) hx
  rw [Submodule.mem_comap]
  change btmul _ _ (f.1 m) y ∈ _
  subst hrs
  rw [add_right_comm]
  exact btmul_mem_tensorDeg M' N ((mem_degHom_iff _).1 hf r m hm) hy

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSuperBimodule.whiskerLeft_mem_degHom
proof:
:= by
  refine (mem_degHom_iff _).2 fun d x hx => ?_
  refine (tensorDeg_le_iff M N (S := ((M.tensor N').deg (d + n)).comap
    (SVec.toLinearMap (SuperBimodule.whiskerLeft M.toSuperBimodule g).1))).2
    (fun r s hrs m hm y hy => ?_) hx
  rw [Submodule.mem_comap]
  change tensorMk _ _ (SVec.whiskerLeft M.toSuperBimodule.toSVec g.1 (m ⊗ₜ y)) ∈ _
  subst hrs
  exact Submodule.mem_map_of_mem (GradedSuperspace.whiskerLeft_mem_degHom M.toGradedSuperspace
    (show g.1 ∈ GradedSuperspace.degHom N.toGradedSuperspace N'.toGradedSuperspace n from hg)
    (r + s) _ (GradedSuperspace.tmul_mem_tensorDeg _ _ hm hy))

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSuperBimodule.whiskerRight_mem_hom
statement:
theorem whiskerRight_mem_hom {M M' : GradedSuperBimodule 𝒢 ℋ}
    {f : M.toSuperBimodule ⟶ M'.toSuperBimodule} (hf : f ∈ (family 𝒢 ℋ).hom M M')
    (N : GradedSuperBimodule ℋ 𝒦) :
    SuperBimodule.whiskerRight f N.toSuperBimodule ∈ (family 𝒢 𝒦).hom (M.tensor N) (M'.tensor N)
proof:
:= by
  refine (family 𝒢 ℋ).hom_induction hf
    (fun n f hf => (family 𝒢 𝒦).mem_hom_of_mem (whiskerRight_mem_degHom hf N)) ?_ ?_
  · rw [SuperBimodule.zero_whiskerRight]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  · intro f f' hf hf'
    rw [SuperBimodule.add_whiskerRight]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hf hf'

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSuperBimodule.whiskerLeft_mem_hom
proof:
:= by
  refine (family ℋ 𝒦).hom_induction hg
    (fun n g hg => (family 𝒢 𝒦).mem_hom_of_mem (whiskerLeft_mem_degHom M hg)) ?_ ?_
  · rw [SuperBimodule.whiskerLeft_zero]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  · intro g g' hg hg'
    rw [SuperBimodule.whiskerLeft_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hg hg'

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSuperBimodule.assoc_hom_mem_degHom
statement:
theorem assoc_hom_mem_degHom :
    (SuperBimodule.assoc M.toSuperBimodule N.toSuperBimodule P.toSuperBimodule).hom ∈
      degHom ((M.tensor N).tensor P) (M.tensor (N.tensor P)) 0
proof:
:= by
  refine (mem_degHom_iff _).2 fun d x hx => ?_
  refine (tensorDeg_le_iff (M.tensor N) P (S := ((M.tensor (N.tensor P)).deg (d + 0)).comap
    (SVec.toLinearMap (SuperBimodule.assoc M.toSuperBimodule N.toSuperBimodule P.toSuperBimodule).hom.1))).2
    (fun r s hrs y hy p hp => ?_) hx
  rw [Submodule.mem_comap]
  refine (tensorDeg_le_iff M N (S := ((M.tensor (N.tensor P)).deg (d + 0)).comap
    (SVec.toLinearMap (SuperBimodule.assoc M.toSuperBimodule N.toSuperBimodule P.toSuperBimodule).hom.1 ∘ₗ
      (btmulBi (SuperBimodule.tensor M.toSuperBimodule N.toSuperBimodule) P.toSuperBimodule).flip p))).2
    (fun a b hab m hm n hn => ?_) hy
  rw [Submodule.mem_comap]
  change (SuperBimodule.assoc M.toSuperBimodule N.toSuperBimodule P.toSuperBimodule).hom.1
    (btmul _ _ (btmul _ _ m n) p) ∈ _
  rw [assoc_hom_btmul]
  subst hrs hab
  rw [add_zero, add_assoc]
  exact btmul_mem_tensorDeg M (N.tensor P) hm (btmul_mem_tensorDeg N P hn hp)

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSuperBimodule.assoc_inv_mem_degHom
statement:
theorem assoc_inv_mem_degHom :
    (SuperBimodule.assoc M.toSuperBimodule N.toSuperBimodule P.toSuperBimodule).inv ∈
      degHom (M.tensor (N.tensor P)) ((M.tensor N).tensor P) 0
proof:
:= by
  refine (mem_degHom_iff _).2 fun d x hx => ?_
  refine (tensorDeg_le_iff M (N.tensor P) (S := (((M.tensor N).tensor P).deg (d + 0)).comap
    (SVec.toLinearMap (SuperBimodule.assoc M.toSuperBimodule N.toSuperBimodule P.toSuperBimodule).inv.1))).2
    (fun r s hrs m hm y hy => ?_) hx
  rw [Submodule.mem_comap]
  refine (tensorDeg_le_iff N P (S := (((M.tensor N).tensor P).deg (d + 0)).comap
    (SVec.toLinearMap (SuperBimodule.assoc M.toSuperBimodule N.toSuperBimodule P.toSuperBimodule).inv.1 ∘ₗ
      btmulBi M.toSuperBimodule (SuperBimodule.tensor N.toSuperBimodule P.toSuperBimodule) m))).2
    (fun a b hab n hn p hp => ?_) hy
  rw [Submodule.mem_comap]
  change (SuperBimodule.assoc M.toSuperBimodule N.toSuperBimodule P.toSuperBimodule).inv.1
    (btmul _ _ m (btmul _ _ n p)) ∈ _
  rw [assoc_inv_btmul]
  subst hrs hab
  rw [add_zero, ← add_assoc]
  exact btmul_mem_tensorDeg (M.tensor N) P (btmul_mem_tensorDeg M N hm hn) hp

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSuperBimodule.leftUnitor_hom_mem_degHom
statement:
theorem leftUnitor_hom_mem_degHom :
    (SuperBimodule.leftUnitor M.toSuperBimodule).hom ∈ degHom ((regular 𝒢).tensor M) M 0
proof:
:= by
  refine (mem_degHom_iff _).2 fun d x hx => ?_
  refine (tensorDeg_le_iff (regular 𝒢) M (S := (M.deg (d + 0)).comap
    (SVec.toLinearMap (SuperBimodule.leftUnitor M.toSuperBimodule).hom.1))).2
    (fun r s hrs a ha m hm => ?_) hx
  rw [Submodule.mem_comap]
  change leftUnitorHom M.toSuperBimodule (btmul _ _ a m) ∈ _
  rw [leftUnitorHom_btmul]
  subst hrs
  rw [add_zero, add_comm]
  exact M.lact_mem ha hm

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSuperBimodule.leftUnitor_inv_mem_degHom
statement:
theorem leftUnitor_inv_mem_degHom :
    (SuperBimodule.leftUnitor M.toSuperBimodule).inv ∈ degHom M ((regular 𝒢).tensor M) 0
proof:
:=
  (mem_degHom_iff _).2 fun d m hm => by
    change btmul (SuperBimodule.regular 𝒢.parity) M.toSuperBimodule (1 : A) m ∈ _
    rw [add_zero]
    have := btmul_mem_tensorDeg (regular 𝒢) M (SetLike.GradedOne.one_mem : (1 : A) ∈ 𝒢.degree 0) hm
    rwa [zero_add] at this

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSuperBimodule.rightUnitor_hom_mem_degHom
statement:
theorem rightUnitor_hom_mem_degHom :
    (SuperBimodule.rightUnitor M.toSuperBimodule).hom ∈ degHom (M.tensor (regular ℋ)) M 0
proof:
:= by
  refine (mem_degHom_iff _).2 fun d x hx => ?_
  refine (tensorDeg_le_iff M (regular ℋ) (S := (M.deg (d + 0)).comap
    (SVec.toLinearMap (SuperBimodule.rightUnitor M.toSuperBimodule).hom.1))).2
    (fun r s hrs m hm b hb => ?_) hx
  rw [Submodule.mem_comap]
  change rightUnitorHom M.toSuperBimodule (btmul _ _ m b) ∈ _
  rw [rightUnitorHom_btmul]
  subst hrs
  rw [add_zero]
  exact M.ract_mem hb hm

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSuperBimodule.rightUnitor_inv_mem_degHom
statement:
theorem rightUnitor_inv_mem_degHom :
    (SuperBimodule.rightUnitor M.toSuperBimodule).inv ∈ degHom M (M.tensor (regular ℋ)) 0
proof:
:=
  (mem_degHom_iff _).2 fun d m hm => by
    change btmul M.toSuperBimodule (SuperBimodule.regular ℋ.parity) m (1 : B) ∈ _
    rw [add_zero]
    have := btmul_mem_tensorDeg M (regular ℋ) hm (SetLike.GradedOne.one_mem : (1 : B) ∈ ℋ.degree 0)
    rwa [add_zero] at this
