name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.idIso_hom_mem
statement:
theorem idIso_hom_mem {a : QPiTwoEnvelope R B} {f : a ⟶ a} (hf : f.par = 0) (hobj : f.obj.obj = 𝟙 a.as.as)
    (e : f.obj.obj ≅ 𝟙 a.as.as) (he : e = eqToIso hobj) :
    (Envelope.isoOfIso (QEnvelope.isoOfIso e) : f ≅ 𝟙 a).hom ∈ parity (R := R) f (𝟙 a) 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, ⟨m, x⟩⟩ := f
  simp only at hf hobj
  subst hf hobj he
  show 𝟙 _ ∈ parity (R := R) (C := a.as.as ⟶ a.as.as) _ _ (0 + (0 + 0))
  simpa using id_mem (R := R) (𝟙 a.as.as)

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.toHom_hcomp
statement:
theorem toHom_hcomp {a b c : QPiTwoEnvelope R B} {f h : a ⟶ b} {g k : b ⟶ c} {x : f ⟶ h}
    {y : g ⟶ k} {px py : ZMod 2} (hx : toHom x ∈ parity (R := R) f.obj.obj h.obj.obj px)
    (hy : toHom y ∈ parity (R := R) g.obj.obj k.obj.obj py) :
    toHom (hcomp x y) =
      sign R (g.par * px + py * h.par + g.par * h.par + f.par * g.par) • hcomp (toHom x) (toHom y)
proof:
:=
  congrArg QEnvelope.toHom (TwoEnvelope.toHom_hcomp (R := R) (B := QTwoEnvelope R B) hx hy)

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.ofHom_mem_degree
StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.qpiComplete2_iff
statement:
theorem qpiComplete2_iff : QPiComplete2 (R := R) (B := B) ↔
    ∀ a b : B, QPiEnvelope.QPiComplete R (a ⟶ b)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h a b F
    have key : ∀ (p : ZMod 2) (n : ℤ), (∃ (f : a ⟶ a) (e : f ≅ 𝟙 a),
        e.hom ∈ parity (R := R) f (𝟙 a) p ∧ e.hom ∈ degree (R := R) f (𝟙 a) n) →
        ∃ (Y : a ⟶ b) (e : Y ≅ F), e.hom ∈ parity (R := R) Y F p ∧
          e.hom ∈ degree (R := R) Y F n := by
      rintro p n ⟨f, e, he, he'⟩
      refine ⟨f ≫ F, whiskerRightIso (R := R) e F ≪≫ leftUnitor F, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simpa using comp_mem (whiskerRight_mem F he) (leftUnitor_hom_mem (R := R) F)
      · simpa using comp_mem_degree (GradedTwoSupercategory.whiskerRight_mem_degree F he')
          (GradedTwoSupercategory.leftUnitor_hom_mem_degree (R := R) F)
    exact ⟨key 0 1 (h a).1, key 0 (-1) (h a).2.1, key 1 0 (h a).2.2⟩
  · intro h a
    exact ⟨(h a a (𝟙 a)).1, (h a a (𝟙 a)).2.1, (h a a (𝟙 a)).2.2⟩

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.J_gradedEvenlyDense_iff

    (∀ a b : B, GradedEvenlyDense R (QPiEnvelope.J R (a ⟶ b))) ↔ QPiComplete2 (R := R) (B := B)
proof:
:= by
  rw [qpiComplete2_iff]
  exact forall_congr' fun a => forall_congr' fun b => QPiEnvelope.J_gradedEvenlyDense_iff

name: StringDiagrams.SuperalgebraCat.proj_eq_decompose
statement:
theorem proj_eq_decompose (p : ZMod 2) {X Y : SuperalgebraCat 𝒜} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    proj k p f = (DirectSum.decompose 𝒜 (toElem f) p : A)
proof:
:= by
  refine DirectSum.Decomposition.inductionOn 𝒜
    (motive := fun a => proj k p (ofElem a : X ⟶ Y) = (DirectSum.decompose 𝒜 a p : A)) ?_ ?_ ?_
    (toElem f)
  · change proj k p (ofElem (0 : A) : X ⟶ Y) = (DirectSum.decompose 𝒜 (0 : A) p : A)
    rw [DirectSum.decompose_zero, DirectSum.zero_apply, Submodule.coe_zero]
    exact map_zero _
  · intro q a
    by_cases h : q = p
    · subst h
      rw [proj_of_mem ((mem_parity_iff 𝒜 (f := (ofElem (a : A) : X ⟶ Y))).2 a.2),
        DirectSum.decompose_of_mem_same 𝒜 a.2]
      rfl
    · rw [proj_of_mem_ne ((mem_parity_iff 𝒜 (f := (ofElem (a : A) : X ⟶ Y))).2 a.2) h,
        DirectSum.decompose_of_mem_ne 𝒜 a.2 h]
  · intro a b ha hb
    rw [show (ofElem (a + b) : X ⟶ Y) = ofElem a + ofElem b from rfl, map_add, ha, hb,
      DirectSum.decompose_add, DirectSum.add_apply, Submodule.coe_add]

name: StringDiagrams.SuperalgebraCat.mem_degree_iff

theorem mem_degree_iff (𝒢 : GradedSuperalgebra k A) {X Y : SuperalgebraCat 𝒢.parity} {n : ℤ}

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.proj_val
statement:
theorem proj_val (p : ZMod 2) {V W : SuperBimodule 𝒜 ℬ} (f : V ⟶ W) :
    (proj k p f).1 = proj k p f.1
proof:
:= by
  have e : f = ⟨proj k p f.1, f.2.proj p⟩ + ⟨proj k (p + 1) f.1, f.2.proj (p + 1)⟩ :=
    Subtype.ext (proj_add_proj_add_one (R := k) p f.1).symm
  rw [proj_eq_of_add e (mem_parity_iff.2 (proj_mem p _)) (mem_parity_iff.2 (proj_mem _ _))]

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSuperBimodule.mem_degHom_iff
statement:
theorem mem_degHom_iff {n : ℤ} {f : V.toSuperBimodule ⟶ W.toSuperBimodule} :
    f ∈ degHom V W n ↔

statement:
theorem Q_map_val {V W : GSMod 𝒢 ℋ} (f : V ⟶ W) :
    ((QPiSupercategory.Q (R := k)).map f).1 = f.1
proof:
:= by
  change ((σIso V.as).hom ≫ f ≫ (σIso W.as).inv).1 = _
  rw [comp_val, comp_val]
  change 𝟙 V.as.toSuperBimodule ≫ f.1 ≫ 𝟙 W.as.toSuperBimodule = f.1
  rw [Category.id_comp]

  rw [comp_val, comp_val]
  change 𝟙 V.as.toSuperBimodule ≫ f.1 ≫ 𝟙 W.as.toSuperBimodule = f.1

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.map_mem
StringDiagrams.Supercategory.map_proj
proof:
:= by
  refine induction_on (R := R) f (by simp) (fun q g hg => ?_) (fun g h hg hh => ?_)
  · by_cases h : q = p
    · subst h; rw [proj_of_mem hg, proj_of_mem (map_mem F hg)]
    · rw [proj_of_mem_ne hg h, proj_of_mem_ne (map_mem F hg) h, F.map_zero]
  · rw [map_add, F.map_add, hg, hh, F.map_add, map_add]

    F.map (twist R p f) = twist R p (F.map f)
proof:
:= by

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.SuperNatTrans.isSupernatural
statement:
theorem SuperNatTrans.isSupernatural {F G : C ⥤ D} (t : SuperNatTrans R F G) (p : ZMod 2) :
    IsSupernatural R p (t.app p) where
  mem
proof:
:= t.app_mem p
  naturality hf := by rw [t.naturality p _ hf, koszulSign_smul (R := R)]

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.IsSupernatural.toSuperNatTrans_app
StringDiagrams.Supercategory.IsSupernatural.toSuperNatTrans_isHomogeneous
proof:
:= fun q hq => by

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.isSupernatural_iff
statement:
theorem isSupernatural_iff {F G : C ⥤ D} {p : ZMod 2} {x : ∀ X, F.obj X ⟶ G.obj X} :
    IsSupernatural R p x ↔
      ∃ t : SuperNatTrans R F G, t.IsHomogeneous p ∧ t.app p = x
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun hx => ⟨hx.toSuperNatTrans, hx.toSuperNatTrans_isHomogeneous, hx.toSuperNatTrans_app⟩,
    fun ⟨t, _, ht⟩ => ht ▸ t.isSupernatural p⟩

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.IsSupernatural.naturality_twist
proof:
:= by
  refine induction_on (R := R) f (by simp) (fun q g hg => ?_) (fun g h hg hh => ?_)
  · rw [hx.naturality hg, twist_of_mem p hg, G.map_smul, Linear.comp_smul]
  · rw [F.map_add, Preadditive.add_comp, hg, hh, map_add, G.map_add, Preadditive.comp_add]

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.IsSupernatural.of_twist
statement:
theorem IsSupernatural.of_twist [G.Linear R] {p : ZMod 2} {x : ∀ X, F.obj X ⟶ G.obj X}
    (mem : ∀ X, x X ∈ parity (R := R) (F.obj X) (G.obj X) p)
    (nat : ∀ {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y), F.map f ≫ x Y = x X ≫ G.map (twist R p f)) :
    IsSupernatural R p x where
  mem
proof:
:= mem
  naturality hf := by rw [nat, twist_of_mem p hf, G.map_smul, Linear.comp_smul]

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.IsSupernatural.naturality_zero
StringDiagrams.Supercategory.isSupernatural_of_natTrans
statement:
theorem isSupernatural_of_natTrans [G.Linear R] (x : F ⟶ G)
    (mem : ∀ X, x.app X ∈ parity (R := R) (F.obj X) (G.obj X) 0) :
    IsSupernatural R 0 x.app
proof:
:=
  IsSupernatural.of_twist mem fun f => by rw [twist_zero, x.naturality]

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.isSupernatural_id
statement: theorem isSupernatural_id [F.Linear R] : IsSupernatural R 0 fun X => 𝟙 (F.obj X)
proof:
:=
  IsSupernatural.of_twist (fun X => id_mem _) fun f => by simp

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.IsSupernatural.comp
statement:
theorem IsSupernatural.comp [F.Additive] [G.Additive] [G.Linear R] [H.Additive] [H.Linear R]
    {p q : ZMod 2} {x : ∀ X, F.obj X ⟶ G.obj X}
    {y : ∀ X, G.obj X ⟶ H.obj X} (hx : IsSupernatural R p x) (hy : IsSupernatural R q y) :
    IsSupernatural R (p + q) fun X => x X ≫ y X
proof:
:=
  IsSupernatural.of_twist (fun X => comp_mem (hx.mem X) (hy.mem X)) fun f => by
    rw [← Category.assoc, hx.naturality_twist, Category.assoc, hy.naturality_twist,
      add_comm p q, twist_add, Category.assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.IsSupernatural.whiskerRight
statement:
theorem IsSupernatural.whiskerRight [F.Additive] [G.Additive] [G.Linear R] {p : ZMod 2}
    {x : ∀ X, F.obj X ⟶ G.obj X} (hx : IsSupernatural R p x) (K : D ⥤ E) [K.Additive]
    [K.Linear R] [IsSuperfunctor R K] :
    IsSupernatural R p (F := F ⋙ K) (G := G ⋙ K) fun X => K.map (x X) where
  mem X
proof:
:= Supercategory.map_mem K (hx.mem X)
  naturality hf := by
    simp only [Functor.comp_map]
    rw [← K.map_comp, hx.naturality hf, K.map_smul, K.map_comp]

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.IsSupernatural.whiskerLeft
statement:
theorem IsSupernatural.whiskerLeft {B : Type*} [Category B] [Preadditive B] [Linear R B]
    [Supercategory R B] {p : ZMod 2} {x : ∀ X, F.obj X ⟶ G.obj X} (hx : IsSupernatural R p x)
    (K : B ⥤ C) [K.Additive] [K.Linear R] [IsSuperfunctor R K] :
    IsSupernatural R p (F := K ⋙ F) (G := K ⋙ G) fun X => x (K.obj X) where
  mem X
proof:
:= hx.mem (K.obj X)
  naturality hf := hx.naturality (Supercategory.map_mem K hf)

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.mem_of_map_mem
statement:
theorem mem_of_map_mem (F : C ⥤ D) [F.Additive] [F.Linear R] [IsSuperfunctor R F] [F.Faithful]
    {X Y : C} {p : ZMod 2} {f : X ⟶ Y} (hf : F.map f ∈ parity (R := R) (F.obj X) (F.obj Y) p) :
    f ∈ parity (R := R) X Y p
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : proj R (p + 1) f = 0 := F.map_injective (by
    rw [map_proj, F.map_zero, proj_of_mem_ne hf (Ne.symm (zmod2_add_one_ne p))])
  have h := proj_add_proj (R := R) f
  rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one p with rfl | rfl
  · rw [show (0 : ZMod 2) + 1 = 1 from rfl] at h0
    rw [h0, add_zero] at h; exact h ▸ proj_mem _ _
  · rw [show (1 : ZMod 2) + 1 = 0 from rfl] at h0
    rw [h0, zero_add] at h; exact h ▸ proj_mem _ _

theorem Superequivalence.evenlyDense {F : C ⥤ D} (e : Superequivalence R F) :

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.exists_strict_twoSuperequivalent
statement:
theorem exists_strict_twoSuperequivalent :
    ∃ (C : Type u₁) (_ : BicategoryStruct.{max u₁ v w, max u₁ v w} C)
      (_ : ∀ a b : C, Preadditive (a ⟶ b)) (_ : ∀ a b : C, Linear R (a ⟶ b))
      (_ : ∀ a b : C, Supercategory R (a ⟶ b)) (_ : TwoSupercategory R C),
      BicategoryStruct.Strict C ∧ TwoSuperfunctor.TwoSuperequivalent R B C
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, i₁, i₂, i₃, i₄, i₅, hs, h⟩ := exists_strict_localTwoSuperequivalent R B
  exact ⟨C, i₁, i₂, i₃, i₄, i₅, hs, h.twoSuperequivalent⟩

name: StringDiagrams.GSKar.baseShift_nat_obj
statement:
theorem baseShift_nat_obj (n : ℕ) (X : ShiftBase k C) :
    (EquivalencePowers.powNat (QPiCategory.qEquivalence k (ShiftBase k C)) n).obj X =
      ⟨⟨⟨X.obj.obj.par, ⟨X.obj.obj.obj.shift + n, X.obj.obj.obj.obj⟩⟩⟩⟩
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => ext <;> simp
  | succ n ih =>
    change (QPiCategory.Q (R := k)).obj
      ((EquivalencePowers.powNat (QPiCategory.qEquivalence k (ShiftBase k C)) n).obj X) = _
    rw [ih]
    change (⟨⟨⟨X.obj.obj.par, ⟨(X.obj.obj.obj.shift + n) + 1,
      X.obj.obj.obj.obj⟩⟩⟩⟩ : ShiftBase k C) = _
    congr 4; omega

name: StringDiagrams.GSKar.baseShift_neg_obj
statement:
theorem baseShift_neg_obj (n : ℕ) (X : ShiftBase k C) :
    (EquivalencePowers.powNeg (QPiCategory.qEquivalence k (ShiftBase k C)) n).obj X =
      ⟨⟨⟨X.obj.obj.par, ⟨X.obj.obj.obj.shift - n, X.obj.obj.obj.obj⟩⟩⟩⟩
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => ext <;> simp
  | succ n ih =>
    change (QPiCategory.Qinv (R := k)).obj
      ((EquivalencePowers.powNeg (QPiCategory.qEquivalence k (ShiftBase k C)) n).obj X) = _
    rw [ih]
    change (⟨⟨⟨X.obj.obj.par, ⟨(X.obj.obj.obj.shift - n) - 1,
      X.obj.obj.obj.obj⟩⟩⟩⟩ : ShiftBase k C) = _
    congr 4; omega

name: StringDiagrams.GSKar.baseShift_obj
statement:
theorem baseShift_obj (n : ℤ) (X : ShiftBase k C) :
    (baseShift n).obj X =
      ⟨⟨⟨X.obj.obj.par, ⟨X.obj.obj.obj.shift + n, X.obj.obj.obj.obj⟩⟩⟩⟩
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | ofNat n => exact baseShift_nat_obj n X
  | negSucc n =>
    change (EquivalencePowers.powNeg _ (n + 1)).obj X = _
    rw [baseShift_neg_obj]
    congr 4

name: StringDiagrams.GSKar.int_T_smul_mk
statement:
theorem int_T_smul_mk (n : ℤ) (P : GSKar k C) :
    letI := K₀.moduleLaurentInt k (GSKar k C)
    (LaurentPolynomial.T n : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) • K₀.mk P =
      K₀.mk ((shiftFunctor n).obj P)
proof:
:= by
  let := K₀.moduleLaurentInt k (GSKar k C)
  open LaurentPolynomial in
  induction n using Int.induction_on with
  | zero =>
    simp only [T_zero, one_smul]
    exact K₀.mk_eq_mk_of_iso (shiftZeroIso.app P).symm
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [show (n + 1 : ℤ) = 1 + n by omega, T_add, mul_smul, ih,
      K₀.int_T_one_smul_mk]
    simpa only [add_comm (1 : ℤ), Functor.comp_obj] using K₀.mk_eq_mk_of_iso ((shiftSuccIso (n : ℤ)).app P)
  | pred n ih =>
    have inj : Function.Injective (fun x : K₀ (GSKar k C) =>
        (T 1 : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) • x) := by
      intro x y h
      have h' := congrArg (fun x : K₀ (GSKar k C) => (T (-1) : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) • x) h
      simpa only [← mul_smul, ← T_add, neg_add_cancel, T_zero, one_smul] using h'
    apply inj
    dsimp only
    rw [← mul_smul, ← T_add, show 1 + (-(n : ℤ) - 1) = -(n : ℤ) by omega,
      ih, K₀.int_T_one_smul_mk]
    exact K₀.mk_eq_mk_of_iso (((shiftSuccIso (-(n : ℤ) - 1)).app P) ≪≫
      eqToIso (by congr 2; omega)).symm

name: StringDiagrams.GSKar.shift_hom_boundedBelow
statement:
theorem shift_hom_boundedBelow (h : HomBoundedBelow (k := k) (C := C))
    (P Q : GSKar k C) :
    ∃ N : ℤ, ∀ n < N, Subsingleton ((shiftFunctor n).obj P ⟶ Q)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  choose N hN using h
  let bounds : P.X.ι × Q.X.ι → ℤ := fun ij =>
    N (P.X.X ij.1).obj.obj.obj.obj (Q.X.X ij.2).obj.obj.obj.obj -
      (P.X.X ij.1).obj.obj.obj.shift + (Q.X.X ij.2).obj.obj.obj.shift
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := (Set.finite_range bounds).bddBelow
  refine ⟨B, fun n hn => ⟨fun f g => ?_⟩⟩
  have zero : ∀ f : (shiftFunctor n).obj P ⟶ Q, f = 0 := by
    intro f
    apply Karoubi.hom_ext
    funext i j
    have hs : Subsingleton ((baseShift n).obj (P.X.X i) ⟶ Q.X.X j) := by
      rw [baseShift_obj]
      refine ⟨fun a b => ?_⟩
      have hz : ∀ a : (⟨⟨⟨(P.X.X i).obj.obj.par,
          ⟨(P.X.X i).obj.obj.obj.shift + n, (P.X.X i).obj.obj.obj.obj⟩⟩⟩⟩ : ShiftBase k C) ⟶
          Q.X.X j, a = 0 := by
        intro a
        apply Subtype.ext
        apply Subtype.ext
        have hf := a.val.property
        change a.val.val ∈ degree (R := k)
          (P.X.X i).obj.obj.obj.obj (Q.X.X j).obj.obj.obj.obj
          (0 + (((P.X.X i).obj.obj.obj.shift + n) - (Q.X.X j).obj.obj.obj.shift)) at hf
        have hb := hB (Set.mem_range_self (i, j))
        dsimp [bounds] at hb
        rw [hN _ _ _ (by omega)] at hf
        exact hf
      rw [hz a, hz b]
    exact hs.elim _ _
  rw [zero f, zero g]

name: StringDiagrams.GSKar.shiftHomBoundedBelow
statement:
theorem shiftHomBoundedBelow [DegreeHomFinite (k := k) (C := C)]
    (h : HomBoundedBelow (k := k) (C := C)) :
    KrullSchmidt.ShiftHomBoundedBelow k (C := GSKar k C)
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := shift_hom_boundedBelow h i.rep i.rep
  refine ⟨N, fun n hn => ?_⟩
  have heq : K₀.mk ((shiftFunctor n).obj i.rep) =
      K₀.mk (KrullSchmidt.indecShift k n i).rep := by
    rw [← int_T_smul_mk]
    exact KrullSchmidt.int_T_smul_indec k n i
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := (KrullSchmidt.mk_eq_mk_iff k).1 heq
  let := hN n hn
  exact ⟨fun f g => (cancel_epi e.hom).1 (Subsingleton.elim _ _)⟩

statement:
theorem k0_free_laurentInt (𝒢 : GradedSuperalgebra k A)
    (hfin : ∀ n : ℤ, FiniteDimensional k (𝒢.degree n))
    (hbelow : ∃ N : ℤ, ∀ n < N, 𝒢.degree n = ⊥) :
    letI := K₀.moduleLaurentInt k (GSKar k (SuperalgebraCat 𝒢.parity))
