name: StringDiagrams.SVec.ext_tensor₃
statement:
theorem ext_tensor₃ {U V W : SVec k} {M : Type u} [AddCommGroup M] [Module k M]
    {f g : (U ⊗[k] V) ⊗[k] W →ₗ[k] M}
    (h : ∀ p q r (u : U) (v : V) (w : W), u ∈ U.part p → v ∈ V.part q → w ∈ W.part r →
      f ((u ⊗ₜ v) ⊗ₜ w) = g ((u ⊗ₜ v) ⊗ₜ w)) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  apply TensorProduct.ext'
  intro x w
  have key : ∀ r, f ∘ₗ (TensorProduct.mk k (U ⊗[k] V) W).flip (W.proj r w) =
      g ∘ₗ (TensorProduct.mk k (U ⊗[k] V) W).flip (W.proj r w) := fun r =>
    ext_tensor fun p q u v hu hv => h p q r u v _ hu hv (proj_mem_part W r w)
  rw [← proj_apply_add W w, tmul_add, map_add, map_add]
  exact congrArg₂ (· + ·) (LinearMap.congr_fun (key 0) x) (LinearMap.congr_fun (key 1) x)

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.ext_tensor₃'
statement:
theorem ext_tensor₃' {U V W : SVec k} {M : Type u} [AddCommGroup M] [Module k M]
    {f g : U ⊗[k] (V ⊗[k] W) →ₗ[k] M}
    (h : ∀ p q r (u : U) (v : V) (w : W), u ∈ U.part p → v ∈ V.part q → w ∈ W.part r →
      f (u ⊗ₜ (v ⊗ₜ w)) = g (u ⊗ₜ (v ⊗ₜ w))) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  apply TensorProduct.ext'
  intro u y
  have key : ∀ p, f ∘ₗ TensorProduct.mk k U (V ⊗[k] W) (U.proj p u) =
      g ∘ₗ TensorProduct.mk k U (V ⊗[k] W) (U.proj p u) := fun p =>
    ext_tensor fun q r v w hv hw => h p q r _ v w (proj_mem_part U p u) hv hw
  rw [← proj_apply_add U u, add_tmul, map_add, map_add]
  exact congrArg₂ (· + ·) (LinearMap.congr_fun (key 0) y) (LinearMap.congr_fun (key 1) y)

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.braidingMap_tmul
statement:
theorem braidingMap_tmul {V W : SVec k} {p q : ZMod 2} {v : V} {w : W} (hv : v ∈ V.part p)
    (hw : w ∈ W.part q) : braidingMap V W (v ⊗ₜ w) = sign k (p * q) • (w ⊗ₜ v)
proof:
:= by
  change TensorProduct.comm k V W
    ((map (V.proj 0) LinearMap.id + map (V.proj 1) (W.sgn 1) : V ⊗[k] W →ₗ[k] V ⊗[k] W)
      (v ⊗ₜ w)) = _
  rw [LinearMap.add_apply, map_tmul, map_tmul, proj_apply_of_mem_part _ hv,
    proj_apply_of_mem_part _ hv, LinearMap.id_apply, sgn_apply_of_mem _ hw]
  rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one p with rfl | rfl
  · simp
  · simp [smul_tmul']

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.braidingMap_mem
statement:
theorem braidingMap_mem (V W : SVec k) :
    braidingMap V W ∈ parityHom (tensorObj V W) (tensorObj W V) 0
proof:
:= by
  intro r
  refine ext_tensor fun p q v w hv hw => ?_
  change braidingMap V W ((tensorObj V W).proj r (v ⊗ₜ w)) =
    (tensorObj W V).proj (r + 0) (braidingMap V W (v ⊗ₜ w))
  rw [add_zero, proj_apply_of_mem_part _ (tmul_mem_part hv hw), braidingMap_tmul hv hw, map_smul,
    proj_apply_of_mem_part _ (tmul_mem_part hw hv), add_comm q p]
  split_ifs
  · rw [braidingMap_tmul hv hw]
  · rw [smul_zero]; exact map_zero (toLinearMap (braidingMap V W))

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.braidingMap_comp_braidingMap
statement:
theorem braidingMap_comp_braidingMap (V W : SVec k) :
    braidingMap V W ≫ braidingMap W V = 𝟙 (tensorObj V W)
proof:
:=
  ext_tensor fun p q v w hv hw => by
    change braidingMap W V (braidingMap V W (v ⊗ₜ w)) = v ⊗ₜ w
    rw [braidingMap_tmul hv hw, map_smul, braidingMap_tmul hw hv, mul_comm,
      sign_smul_sign_smul]

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.braidingMap_naturality_right
statement:
theorem braidingMap_naturality_right (X : SVec k) {Y Z : SVec k} (f : Y ⟶ Z) :
    whiskerLeft X f ≫ braidingMap X Z = braidingMap X Y ≫ whiskerRight f X
proof:
:= by
  refine Supercategory.induction_on (R := k) f ?_ ?_ ?_
  · rw [whiskerLeft_zero, whiskerRight_zero, Limits.zero_comp, Limits.comp_zero]
  · intro b f hf
    refine ext_tensor fun p q x y hx hy => ?_
    change braidingMap X Z (whiskerLeft X f (x ⊗ₜ y)) = whiskerRight f X (braidingMap X Y (x ⊗ₜ y))
    rw [whiskerLeft_tmul hf hx, map_smul, braidingMap_tmul hx (apply_mem_part hf hy),
      braidingMap_tmul hx hy, map_smul, whiskerRight_tmul, smul_smul, ← sign_add]
    congr 2
    rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one p with rfl | rfl <;>
      rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one q with rfl | rfl <;>
      rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one b with rfl | rfl <;> decide
  · intro f f' hf hf'
    rw [whiskerLeft_add, Preadditive.add_comp, hf, hf', whiskerRight_add, Preadditive.comp_add]

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.braidingMap_naturality_left
statement:
theorem braidingMap_naturality_left {X Y : SVec k} (f : X ⟶ Y) (Z : SVec k) :
    whiskerRight f Z ≫ braidingMap Y Z = braidingMap X Z ≫ whiskerLeft Z f
proof:
:= by
  refine Supercategory.induction_on (R := k) f ?_ ?_ ?_
  · rw [whiskerLeft_zero, whiskerRight_zero, Limits.zero_comp, Limits.comp_zero]
  · intro b f hf
    refine ext_tensor fun p q x z hx hz => ?_
    change braidingMap Y Z (whiskerRight f Z (x ⊗ₜ z)) = whiskerLeft Z f (braidingMap X Z (x ⊗ₜ z))
    rw [whiskerRight_tmul, braidingMap_tmul (apply_mem_part hf hx) hz, braidingMap_tmul hx hz,
      map_smul, whiskerLeft_tmul hf hz, smul_smul, ← sign_add]
    congr 2
    rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one p with rfl | rfl <;>
      rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one q with rfl | rfl <;>
      rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one b with rfl | rfl <;> decide
  · intro f f' hf hf'
    rw [whiskerRight_add, Preadditive.add_comp, hf, hf', whiskerLeft_add, Preadditive.comp_add]

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.hexagon_forward
statement:
theorem hexagon_forward (X Y Z : SVec k) :
    (α_ X Y Z).hom ≫ braidingMap X (tensorObj Y Z) ≫ (α_ Y Z X).hom =
      whiskerRight (braidingMap X Y) Z ≫ (α_ Y X Z).hom ≫ whiskerLeft Y (braidingMap X Z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [whiskerLeft_even Y (braidingMap_mem X Z)]
  refine ext_tensor₃ fun p q r x y z hx hy hz => ?_
  change (α_ Y Z X).hom (braidingMap X (tensorObj Y Z) ((α_ X Y Z).hom ((x ⊗ₜ y) ⊗ₜ z))) =
    map LinearMap.id (toLinearMap (braidingMap X Z))
      ((α_ Y X Z).hom (whiskerRight (braidingMap X Y) Z ((x ⊗ₜ y) ⊗ₜ z)))
  rw [associator_hom_tmul, braidingMap_tmul hx (tmul_mem_part hy hz), map_smul,
    associator_hom_tmul, whiskerRight_tmul, braidingMap_tmul hx hy, ← smul_tmul', map_smul,
    associator_hom_tmul, map_smul, map_tmul, LinearMap.id_apply, coe_toLinearMap,
    braidingMap_tmul hx hz, tmul_smul, smul_smul, ← sign_add, mul_add]

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.hexagon_reverse
statement:
theorem hexagon_reverse (X Y Z : SVec k) :
    (α_ X Y Z).inv ≫ braidingMap (tensorObj X Y) Z ≫ (α_ Z X Y).inv =
      whiskerLeft X (braidingMap Y Z) ≫ (α_ X Z Y).inv ≫ whiskerRight (braidingMap X Z) Y
proof:
:= by
  rw [whiskerLeft_even X (braidingMap_mem Y Z)]
  refine ext_tensor₃' fun p q r x y z hx hy hz => ?_
  change (α_ Z X Y).inv (braidingMap (tensorObj X Y) Z ((α_ X Y Z).inv (x ⊗ₜ (y ⊗ₜ z)))) =
    whiskerRight (braidingMap X Z) Y
      ((α_ X Z Y).inv (map LinearMap.id (toLinearMap (braidingMap Y Z)) (x ⊗ₜ (y ⊗ₜ z))))
  rw [associator_inv_tmul, braidingMap_tmul (tmul_mem_part hx hy) hz, map_smul,
    associator_inv_tmul, map_tmul, LinearMap.id_apply, coe_toLinearMap, braidingMap_tmul hy hz,
    tmul_smul, map_smul, associator_inv_tmul, map_smul, whiskerRight_tmul,
    braidingMap_tmul hx hz, ← smul_tmul', smul_smul, ← sign_add, add_mul, add_comm]

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.braiding_hom
statement:
theorem braiding_hom (V W : SVec k) :
    (BraidedMonoidalSupercategory.braiding (R := k) V W).hom = braidingMap V W

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.braiding_hom_tmul
statement:
theorem braiding_hom_tmul {V W : SVec k} {p q : ZMod 2} {v : V} {w : W} (hv : v ∈ V.part p)
    (hw : w ∈ W.part q) :
    (BraidedMonoidalSupercategory.braiding (R := k) V W).hom (v ⊗ₜ w) =
      sign k (p * q) • (w ⊗ₜ v)

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.braiding_hom_comp_braiding_hom
statement:
theorem braiding_hom_comp_braiding_hom (V W : SVec k) :
    (BraidedMonoidalSupercategory.braiding (R := k) V W).hom ≫
      (BraidedMonoidalSupercategory.braiding (R := k) W V).hom = 𝟙 (V ⊗ W)

name: StringDiagrams.UnitEnvelope.one_mem
statement: theorem one_mem (a b : ZMod 2) : one (k := k) a b ∈ parity (R := k) (P k a) (P k b) (a + b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Envelope.mem_parity_iff]
  show (1 : k) ∈ trivialGrading k (a + b + (a + b))
  rw [zmod2_add_self, trivialGrading_zero]; trivial

name: StringDiagrams.UnitEnvelope.homEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem homEquiv_symm_apply (a b : ZMod 2) (r : k) :
    (homEquiv (k := k) a b).symm r = r • one a b

name: StringDiagrams.UnitEnvelope.tensorObj_eq
statement: theorem tensorObj_eq (a b : ZMod 2) : P k b ⊗ P k a = P k (a + b)

name: StringDiagrams.UnitEnvelope.toHom_one_tensor_one
statement:
theorem toHom_one_tensor_one (a b c d : ZMod 2) :
    SuperalgebraCat.toElem (Envelope.toHom
      (MonoidalSupercategory.superTensorHom (one (k := k) b d) (one a c))) =
      sign k ((a + c) * b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Envelope.toHom_superTensorHom (pf := 0) (pg := 0) (UnitSupercat.mem_parity_zero _)
    (UnitSupercat.mem_parity_zero _)]
  show sign k (b * 0 + 0 * c + b * c + b * a) * (1 * 1) = _
  rw [mul_one, mul_one]
  congr 1
  ring

name: StringDiagrams.UnitEnvelope.extendSVec_obj_zero
statement: theorem extendSVec_obj_zero : (F̃).obj (P k 0) = SVec.unit

name: StringDiagrams.UnitEnvelope.extendSVec_obj_one
statement: theorem extendSVec_obj_one : (F̃).obj (P k 1) = SVec.piObj SVec.unit

name: StringDiagrams.UnitEnvelope.oneElt_mem
statement: theorem oneElt_mem (a : ZMod 2) : oneElt k a ∈ ((F̃).obj (P k a)).part a
proof:
:= by
  rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one a with rfl | rfl
  · rw [SVec.mem_part_zero_iff]; rfl
  · show (1 : k) ∈ (SVec.piObj SVec.unit).part 1
    rw [SVec.piObj_part, SVec.zmod2_one_add_one, SVec.mem_part_zero_iff]; rfl

name: StringDiagrams.UnitEnvelope.extendSVec_map_one
statement: theorem extendSVec_map_one (a b : ZMod 2) : (F̃).map (one a b) (oneElt k a) = oneElt k b
proof:
:= by
  rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one a with rfl | rfl <;>
  rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one b with rfl | rfl <;>
  · show (1 : k) • (1 : k) = 1
    exact one_smul k _

name: StringDiagrams.UnitEnvelope.unit_whiskerLeft_one_tmul
proof:
:= by
  rw [SVec.whiskerLeft_tmul' (p := 0) hg (by rw [SVec.mem_part_zero_iff]; rfl), zero_mul,
    sign_zero, one_smul]

name: StringDiagrams.UnitEnvelope.extendSVec_μ_one_tmul_one
statement:
theorem extendSVec_μ_one_tmul_one (a b : ZMod 2) :
    ((extendSVec k).μIso (P k b) (P k a)).hom (oneElt k b ⊗ₜ oneElt k a) = oneElt k (b + a)
proof:
:= by
  have h := unit_whiskerLeft_one_tmul (Envelope.ζPow_hom_mem (R := k) a (SVec.unit : SVec k))
  rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one a with rfl | rfl <;>
  rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one b with rfl | rfl <;>
  · simp only [extendSVec, Envelope.extendMonoidal_μIso_hom, Envelope.extendμ, SVec.comp_apply]
    erw [SVec.whiskerRight_tmul', h]
    show (1 : k) * 1 = 1
    rw [mul_one]

name: StringDiagrams.UnitEnvelope.superTensorHom_extendSVec_one
statement:
theorem superTensorHom_extendSVec_one (a b c d : ZMod 2) :
    MonoidalSupercategory.superTensorHom ((F̃).map (one b d)) ((F̃).map (one a c))
        (oneElt k b ⊗ₜ oneElt k a) = sign k ((a + c) * b) • (oneElt k d ⊗ₜ oneElt k c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [SVec.superTensorHom_tmul _ (map_mem (F̃) (one_mem a c)) (oneElt_mem b),
    extendSVec_map_one, extendSVec_map_one]

name: StringDiagrams.BimodCat.eq_pt
statement: theorem eq_pt (X : BimodCat 𝒜 ℬ) : X = pt 𝒜 ℬ

name: StringDiagrams.BimodCat.tmul_mem
statement:
theorem tmul_mem {X Y : BimodCat 𝒜 ℬ} {p q : ZMod 2} {a : A} {b : B} (ha : a ∈ 𝒜 p) (hb : b ∈ ℬ q) :
    (tmul a b : X ⟶ Y) ∈ parity (R := k) X Y (p + q)

name: StringDiagrams.BimodCat.id_eq_tmul
statement: theorem id_eq_tmul (X : BimodCat 𝒜 ℬ) : 𝟙 X = tmul 1 1

name: StringDiagrams.BimodCat.tmul_comp_tmul
statement:
theorem tmul_comp_tmul {X Y Z : BimodCat 𝒜 ℬ} {p q q' : ZMod 2} {a a' : A} {b b' : B}
    (ha : a ∈ 𝒜 p) (hb : b ∈ ℬ q) (hb' : b' ∈ ℬ q') :
    (tmul a b : X ⟶ Y) ≫ (tmul a' b' : Y ⟶ Z) =
      sign k (p * q' + q * q') • (tmul (a' * a) (b * b') : X ⟶ Z)
proof:
:= by
  have h := BoxProd.tmulHom_comp_tmulHom (k := k) (X := X) (Y := Y) (Z := Z)
    (f := SuperalgebraCat.ofElem a) ha (SuperalgebraCat.ofElem (SuperOpposite.op ℬ b))
    (SuperalgebraCat.ofElem a') (l := SuperalgebraCat.ofElem (SuperOpposite.op ℬ b')) hb'
  have e1 : ((SuperalgebraCat.ofElem a : X.fst ⟶ Y.fst) ≫ (SuperalgebraCat.ofElem a' : Y.fst ⟶ Z.fst)) =
      SuperalgebraCat.ofElem (a' * a) := rfl
  have e2 : ((SuperalgebraCat.ofElem (SuperOpposite.op ℬ b) : X.snd ⟶ Y.snd) ≫
        (SuperalgebraCat.ofElem (SuperOpposite.op ℬ b') : Y.snd ⟶ Z.snd)) =
      sign k (q * q') • SuperalgebraCat.ofElem (SuperOpposite.op ℬ (b * b')) := by
    change (SuperalgebraCat.ofElem (SuperOpposite.mulBilin ℬ b' b) : X.snd ⟶ Z.snd) = _
    rw [SuperOpposite.mulBilin_of_mem ℬ hb' hb, mul_comm q' q]
    rfl
  rw [e1, e2, koszulSign_smul (R := k), BoxProd.tmulHom_smul_right] at h
  change BoxProd.tmulHom _ _ ≫ BoxProd.tmulHom _ _ = _
  rw [h, sign_add, mul_smul]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.BimodCat.hom_ext_tmul
statement:
theorem hom_ext_tmul {X Y : BimodCat 𝒜 ℬ} {M : Type u} [AddCommGroup M] [Module k M]
    {φ ψ : (X ⟶ Y) →ₗ[k] M}
    (h : ∀ (p q : ZMod 2) (a : A) (b : B), a ∈ 𝒜 p → b ∈ ℬ q → φ (tmul a b) = ψ (tmul a b)) :
    φ = ψ
proof:
:=
  BoxProd.hom_ext_homogeneous fun p q a b ha hb => h p q a b ha hb

name: StringDiagrams.BimodCat.induction_on
statement:
theorem induction_on {X Y : BimodCat 𝒜 ℬ} {P : (X ⟶ Y) → Prop} (x : X ⟶ Y) (zero : P 0)
    (tmul : ∀ (p q : ZMod 2) (a : A) (b : B), a ∈ 𝒜 p → b ∈ ℬ q → P (tmul a b))
    (add : ∀ x y, P x → P y → P (x + y)) : P x
proof:
:=
  BoxProd.induction_on_homogeneous x zero (fun p q a b ha hb => tmul p q a b ha hb) add

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.hom_ext_part
statement:
theorem _root_.StringDiagrams.SVec.hom_ext_part {V W : SVec k} {f g : V ⟶ W}
    (h : ∀ (q : ZMod 2) (v : V), v ∈ V.part q → f v = g v) : f = g

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.sgnHom_mem
statement: theorem sgnHom_mem (V : SVec k) (q : ZMod 2) : sgnHom V q ∈ SVec.parityHom V V 0

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.sgnHom_apply_of_mem
statement:
theorem sgnHom_apply_of_mem {V : SVec k} (q : ZMod 2) {s : ZMod 2} {v : V} (hv : v ∈ V.part s) :
    sgnHom V q v = sign k (s * q) • v

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.sgnHom_comp_sgnHom
statement:
theorem sgnHom_comp_sgnHom (V : SVec k) (q q' : ZMod 2) :
    sgnHom V q ≫ sgnHom V q' = sgnHom V (q + q')
proof:
:= by
  change SVec.ofHom (V.sgn q' ∘ₗ V.sgn q) = _
  rw [SVec.sgn_comp_sgn, add_comm]

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.sgnHom_zero
statement: theorem sgnHom_zero (V : SVec k) : sgnHom V 0 = 𝟙 V

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.comp_sgnHom_of_mem
statement:
theorem comp_sgnHom_of_mem {V W : SVec k} {p : ZMod 2} {f : V ⟶ W} (hf : f ∈ SVec.parityHom V W p)
    (q : ZMod 2) : f ≫ sgnHom W q = sign k (p * q) • (sgnHom V q ≫ f)

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.sract_apply
statement:
theorem sract_apply (b : B) :
    sract M b = M.ract (algProj ℬ 0 b) + sgnHom M.toSVec 1 ≫ M.ract (algProj ℬ 1 b)

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.sract_of_mem
statement: theorem sract_of_mem {q : ZMod 2} {b : B} (hb : b ∈ ℬ q) : sract M b = sgnHom M.toSVec q ≫ M.ract b
proof:
:= by
  rw [sract_apply]
  rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one q with rfl | rfl
  · rw [algProj_of_mem ℬ hb, algProj_of_mem_ne ℬ hb (by decide), map_zero, Limits.comp_zero,
      add_zero, sgnHom_zero, Category.id_comp]
  · rw [algProj_of_mem ℬ hb, algProj_of_mem_ne ℬ hb (by decide), map_zero, zero_add]

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.sract_apply_of_mem
statement:
theorem sract_apply_of_mem {q : ZMod 2} {b : B} (hb : b ∈ ℬ q) {s : ZMod 2} {v : M.toSVec}
    (hv : v ∈ M.toSVec.part s) : sract M b v = sign k (s * q) • M.ract b v
proof:
:= by
  rw [sract_of_mem M hb, SVec.comp_apply, sgnHom_apply_of_mem q hv, SVec.hom_map_smul]

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.toFunctorBilin_apply
statement:
theorem toFunctorBilin_apply (a : A) (b : B) :
    toFunctorBilin M a (SuperOpposite.op ℬ b) = sract M b ≫ M.lact a

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.toFunctorBilin_apply_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  rw [toFunctorBilin_apply, SVec.comp_apply, sract_apply_of_mem M hb hv, SVec.hom_map_smul]

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.toFunctorMap_tmul
statement:
theorem toFunctorMap_tmul (X Y : BimodCat 𝒜 ℬ) (a : A) (b : B) :
    toFunctorMap M X Y (tmul a b) = sract M b ≫ M.lact a

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.toFunctorMap_comp
statement:
theorem toFunctorMap_comp {X Y Z : BimodCat 𝒜 ℬ} (x : X ⟶ Y) (y : Y ⟶ Z) :
    toFunctorMap M X Z (x ≫ y) = toFunctorMap M X Y x ≫ toFunctorMap M Y Z y
proof:
:= by
  induction x using BimodCat.induction_on with
  | zero => rw [Limits.zero_comp, map_zero, map_zero, Limits.zero_comp]
  | add x x' hx hx' => rw [Preadditive.add_comp, map_add, map_add, hx, hx', Preadditive.add_comp]
  | tmul p q a b ha hb =>
    induction y using BimodCat.induction_on with
    | zero => rw [Limits.comp_zero, map_zero, map_zero, Limits.comp_zero]
    | add y y' hy hy' => rw [Preadditive.comp_add, map_add, map_add, hy, hy', Preadditive.comp_add]
    | tmul p' q' a' b' ha' hb' =>
      rw [tmul_comp_tmul ha hb hb', map_smul, toFunctorMap_tmul, toFunctorMap_tmul,
        toFunctorMap_tmul]
      refine SVec.hom_ext_part fun s v hv => ?_
      have h1 : M.ract b v ∈ M.toSVec.part (s + q) := SVec.apply_mem_part (M.ract_mem q b hb) hv
      have h2 : M.lact a (M.ract b v) ∈ M.toSVec.part (s + q + p) :=
        SVec.apply_mem_part (M.lact_mem p a ha) h1
      have h3 : M.ract b' (M.lact a (M.ract b v)) = M.lact a (M.ract b' (M.ract b v)) := by
        have := congrArg (fun φ : M.toSVec ⟶ M.toSVec => φ (M.ract b v)) (M.lact_ract a b')
        simp only [SVec.comp_apply] at this
        exact this
      simp only [SVec.smul_apply, SVec.comp_apply]
      rw [sract_apply_of_mem M (SetLike.GradedMul.mul_mem hb hb') hv, sract_apply_of_mem M hb hv]
      simp only [SVec.hom_map_smul]
      rw [sract_apply_of_mem M hb' h2]
      simp only [SVec.hom_map_smul, smul_smul, ← sign_add]
      rw [M.lact_mul, M.ract_mul, SVec.comp_apply, SVec.comp_apply, h3]
      congr 2
      ring

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.toFunctor_obj
statement: theorem toFunctor_obj (X : BimodCat 𝒜 ℬ) : (toFunctor M).obj X = M.toSVec

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.toFunctor_map
statement: theorem toFunctor_map {X Y : BimodCat 𝒜 ℬ} (x : X ⟶ Y) : (toFunctor M).map x = toFunctorMap M X Y x

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.toFunctor_map_tmul
statement:
theorem toFunctor_map_tmul {X Y : BimodCat 𝒜 ℬ} (a : A) (b : B) :
    (toFunctor M).map (tmul a b : X ⟶ Y) = sract M b ≫ M.lact a
proof:
:=
  toFunctorMap_tmul M X Y a b

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.toFunctor_map_tmul_apply
statement:
theorem toFunctor_map_tmul_apply {X Y : BimodCat 𝒜 ℬ} (a : A) {q : ZMod 2} {b : B} (hb : b ∈ ℬ q)
    {s : ZMod 2} {v : M.toSVec} (hv : v ∈ M.toSVec.part s) :
    (toFunctor M).map (tmul a b : X ⟶ Y) v = sign k (s * q) • M.lact a (M.ract b v)
proof:
:= by
  change (sract M b ≫ M.lact a) v = _
  rw [SVec.comp_apply, sract_apply_of_mem M hb hv, SVec.hom_map_smul]

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.toFunctor_map_mem
statement:
theorem toFunctor_map_mem {X Y : BimodCat 𝒜 ℬ} {p : ZMod 2} {x : X ⟶ Y} (hx : x ∈ parity (R := k) X Y p) :
    (toFunctor M).map x ∈ parity (R := k) M.toSVec M.toSVec p
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ x : X ⟶ Y, (toFunctor M).map (Supercategory.proj k p x) ∈
      SVec.parityHom M.toSVec M.toSVec p := by
    intro x
    induction x using BimodCat.induction_on with
    | zero => rw [map_zero, Functor.map_zero]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _
    | add x x' hx hx' => rw [map_add, Functor.map_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hx hx'
    | tmul a' b' a b ha hb =>
      by_cases h : a' + b' = p
      · subst h
        rw [Supercategory.proj_of_mem (tmul_mem ha hb), toFunctor_map_tmul, sract_of_mem M hb,
          Category.assoc]
        simpa [add_comm] using! comp_mem (sgnHom_mem M.toSVec b') (comp_mem (M.ract_mem b' b hb)
          (M.lact_mem a' a ha))
      · rw [Supercategory.proj_of_mem_ne (tmul_mem ha hb) h, Functor.map_zero]
        exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  have := key x
  rwa [Supercategory.proj_of_mem hx] at this

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.Superfunctor.map_zero'
statement:
theorem _root_.StringDiagrams.Supercategory.Superfunctor.map_zero'
    (V : Superfunctor k (BimodCat 𝒜 ℬ) (SVec k)) {X Y : BimodCat 𝒜 ℬ} :
    V.map (0 : X ⟶ Y) = 0

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.Superfunctor.map_add'
statement:
theorem _root_.StringDiagrams.Supercategory.Superfunctor.map_add'
    (V : Superfunctor k (BimodCat 𝒜 ℬ) (SVec k)) {X Y : BimodCat 𝒜 ℬ} (x y : X ⟶ Y) :
    V.map (x + y) = V.map x + V.map y

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.Superfunctor.map_smul'
statement:
theorem _root_.StringDiagrams.Supercategory.Superfunctor.map_smul'
    (V : Superfunctor k (BimodCat 𝒜 ℬ) (SVec k)) {X Y : BimodCat 𝒜 ℬ} (r : k) (x : X ⟶ Y) :
    V.map (r • x) = r • V.map x

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.tmulLeft_apply
statement: theorem tmulLeft_apply (a : A) : tmulLeft 𝒜 ℬ a = tmul a 1

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.tmulRight_apply
statement: theorem tmulRight_apply (b : B) : tmulRight 𝒜 ℬ b = tmul 1 b

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.ofFunctorRact_apply
statement:
theorem ofFunctorRact_apply (b : B) :
    ofFunctorRact V b = V.map (tmulRight 𝒜 ℬ (algProj ℬ 0 b)) +
      sgnHom (V.obj (pt 𝒜 ℬ)) 1 ≫ V.map (tmulRight 𝒜 ℬ (algProj ℬ 1 b))

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.ofFunctorRact_of_mem
statement:
theorem ofFunctorRact_of_mem {q : ZMod 2} {b : B} (hb : b ∈ ℬ q) :
    ofFunctorRact V b = sgnHom (V.obj (pt 𝒜 ℬ)) q ≫ V.map (tmul 1 b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ofFunctorRact_apply]
  rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one q with rfl | rfl
  · rw [algProj_of_mem ℬ hb, algProj_of_mem_ne ℬ hb (by decide), sgnHom_zero, Category.id_comp,
      map_zero, Superfunctor.map_zero', Limits.comp_zero, add_zero, tmulRight_apply]
  · rw [algProj_of_mem ℬ hb, algProj_of_mem_ne ℬ hb (by decide), map_zero, Superfunctor.map_zero',
      zero_add, tmulRight_apply]

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.map_tmul_mem
statement:
theorem map_tmul_mem {p q : ZMod 2} {a : A} {b : B} (ha : a ∈ 𝒜 p) (hb : b ∈ ℬ q) :
    V.map (tmul a b : pt 𝒜 ℬ ⟶ pt 𝒜 ℬ) ∈ parity (R := k) _ _ (p + q)

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.map_tmul_comp_tmul
statement:
theorem map_tmul_comp_tmul {p q q' : ZMod 2} {a a' : A} {b b' : B} (ha : a ∈ 𝒜 p) (hb : b ∈ ℬ q)
    (hb' : b' ∈ ℬ q') :
    V.map (tmul a b : pt 𝒜 ℬ ⟶ pt 𝒜 ℬ) ≫ V.map (tmul a' b' : pt 𝒜 ℬ ⟶ pt 𝒜 ℬ) =
      sign k (p * q' + q * q') • V.map (tmul (a' * a) (b * b') : pt 𝒜 ℬ ⟶ pt 𝒜 ℬ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← V.toFunctor.map_comp, tmul_comp_tmul ha hb hb']
  exact V.toFunctor.map_smul _ _

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.ofFunctor_toSVec
statement: theorem ofFunctor_toSVec : (ofFunctor V).toSVec = V.obj (pt 𝒜 ℬ)

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.ofFunctor_lact
statement: theorem ofFunctor_lact (a : A) : (ofFunctor V).lact a = V.map (tmul a 1)

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.ofFunctor_ract_of_mem
statement:
theorem ofFunctor_ract_of_mem {q : ZMod 2} {b : B} (hb : b ∈ ℬ q) :
    (ofFunctor V).ract b = sgnHom (V.obj (pt 𝒜 ℬ)) q ≫ V.map (tmul 1 b)

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.ofFunctor_lact_ract_apply
proof:
:= by
  rw [ofFunctor_ract_of_mem V hb]
  show (V.map (tmul a 1) : V.obj (pt 𝒜 ℬ) ⟶ V.obj (pt 𝒜 ℬ))
    ((sgnHom (V.obj (pt 𝒜 ℬ)) q ≫ V.map (tmul 1 b)) v) = _
  rw [SVec.comp_apply, sgnHom_apply_of_mem q hv, SVec.hom_map_smul, SVec.hom_map_smul,
    ← SVec.comp_apply, map_tmul_comp_tmul V SetLike.GradedOne.one_mem hb SetLike.GradedOne.one_mem,
    zero_mul, mul_zero, add_zero, sign_zero, one_smul, mul_one, mul_one]

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.ofFunctor_toSuperfunctor
statement: theorem ofFunctor_toSuperfunctor (M : SuperBimodule 𝒜 ℬ) : ofFunctor (toSuperfunctor M) = M
proof:
:= by
  have hl : (ofFunctor (toSuperfunctor M)).lact = M.lact := LinearMap.ext fun a => by
    change (toFunctor M).map (tmul a 1) = M.lact a
    rw [toFunctor_map_tmul, sract_of_mem M SetLike.GradedOne.one_mem, sgnHom_zero,
      Category.id_comp, M.ract_one, Category.id_comp]
  have hr : (ofFunctor (toSuperfunctor M)).ract = M.ract := LinearMap.ext fun b => by
    induction b using alg_induction_on ℬ with
    | zero => rw [map_zero, map_zero]
    | add b₁ b₂ h₁ h₂ => rw [map_add, map_add, h₁, h₂]
    | hom q b hb =>
      rw [ofFunctor_ract_of_mem _ hb]
      change sgnHom M.toSVec q ≫ (toFunctor M).map (tmul 1 b) = M.ract b
      rw [toFunctor_map_tmul, sract_of_mem M hb, M.lact_one, Category.comp_id, ← Category.assoc,
        sgnHom_comp_sgnHom, zmod2_add_self, sgnHom_zero, Category.id_comp]
  revert hl hr
  cases M
  intro hl hr
  unfold ofFunctor
  congr 1

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.toFunctor_ofFunctor_map
statement:
theorem toFunctor_ofFunctor_map (V : Superfunctor k (BimodCat 𝒜 ℬ) (SVec k)) {X Y : BimodCat 𝒜 ℬ}
    (x : X ⟶ Y) : (toFunctor (ofFunctor V)).map x = V.map x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using BimodCat.induction_on with
  | zero => rw [Functor.map_zero, Superfunctor.map_zero']
  | add x x' hx hx' => rw [Functor.map_add, Superfunctor.map_add', hx, hx']
  | tmul p q a b ha hb =>
    rw [toFunctor_map_tmul, sract_of_mem _ hb, ofFunctor_ract_of_mem V hb, ofFunctor_lact]
    change ((sgnHom (V.obj (pt 𝒜 ℬ)) q ≫ sgnHom (V.obj (pt 𝒜 ℬ)) q) ≫ V.map (tmul 1 b)) ≫
      V.map (tmul a 1) = V.map (tmul a b)
    rw [sgnHom_comp_sgnHom, zmod2_add_self, sgnHom_zero, Category.id_comp,
      map_tmul_comp_tmul V SetLike.GradedOne.one_mem hb SetLike.GradedOne.one_mem, zero_mul,
      mul_zero, add_zero, sign_zero, one_smul, mul_one, mul_one]

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.toSuperfunctor_ofFunctor
statement:
theorem toSuperfunctor_ofFunctor (V : Superfunctor k (BimodCat 𝒜 ℬ) (SVec k)) :
    toSuperfunctor (ofFunctor V) = V
proof:
:= by
  refine Superfunctor.ext (CategoryTheory.Functor.ext (fun X => rfl) fun X Y x => ?_)
  simp only [eqToHom_refl, Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id]
  exact toFunctor_ofFunctor_map V x

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.total_eq_twist
statement:
theorem total_eq_twist {V W : Superfunctor k (BimodCat 𝒜 ℬ) (SVec k)} (x : V ⟶ W) (p : ZMod 2)
    (X : BimodCat 𝒜 ℬ) :
    twist k p (SuperNatTrans.total x X) = x.app 0 X + sign k p • x.app 1 X
proof:
:= by
  rw [SuperNatTrans.total, map_add, twist_of_mem p (x.app_mem 0 X), twist_of_mem p (x.app_mem 1 X),
    mul_zero, sign_zero, one_smul, mul_one]

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.isHom_total
statement:
theorem isHom_total {V W : Superfunctor k (BimodCat 𝒜 ℬ) (SVec k)} (x : V ⟶ W) :
    IsHom (ofFunctor V) (ofFunctor W) (SuperNatTrans.total x (pt 𝒜 ℬ))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun p a ha => ?_, fun b => ?_⟩
  · have h0 := x.naturality 0 (tmul a 1 : pt 𝒜 ℬ ⟶ pt 𝒜 ℬ) (tmul_mem ha SetLike.GradedOne.one_mem)
    have h1 := x.naturality 1 (tmul a 1 : pt 𝒜 ℬ ⟶ pt 𝒜 ℬ) (tmul_mem ha SetLike.GradedOne.one_mem)
    rw [koszulSign_zero_left, one_smul] at h0
    rw [koszulSign_smul (R := k), one_mul, add_zero] at h1
    change V.map (tmul a 1) ≫ SuperNatTrans.total x (pt 𝒜 ℬ) =
      twist k p (SuperNatTrans.total x (pt 𝒜 ℬ)) ≫ W.map (tmul a 1)
    rw [total_eq_twist, SuperNatTrans.total, Preadditive.comp_add, Preadditive.add_comp,
      Linear.smul_comp, h0, h1]
  · induction b using alg_induction_on ℬ with
    | zero => simp only [map_zero, Limits.zero_comp, Limits.comp_zero]
    | add b₁ b₂ h₁ h₂ => simp only [map_add, Preadditive.add_comp, Preadditive.comp_add, h₁, h₂]
    | hom q b hb =>
      have key : ∀ s : ZMod 2, (ofFunctor V).ract b ≫ x.app s (pt 𝒜 ℬ) =
          x.app s (pt 𝒜 ℬ) ≫ (ofFunctor W).ract b := by
        intro s
        have h := x.naturality s (tmul 1 b : pt 𝒜 ℬ ⟶ pt 𝒜 ℬ) (tmul_mem SetLike.GradedOne.one_mem hb)
        rw [zero_add, koszulSign_smul (R := k)] at h
        have hs : sgnHom (V.obj (pt 𝒜 ℬ)) q ≫ x.app s (pt 𝒜 ℬ) =
            sign k (s * q) • (x.app s (pt 𝒜 ℬ) ≫ sgnHom (W.obj (pt 𝒜 ℬ)) q) := by
          rw [comp_sgnHom_of_mem (x.app_mem s (pt 𝒜 ℬ)) q, smul_smul, sign_mul_self, one_smul]
        rw [ofFunctor_ract_of_mem V hb, ofFunctor_ract_of_mem W hb]
        change sgnHom (V.obj (pt 𝒜 ℬ)) q ≫ V.map (tmul 1 b) ≫ x.app s (pt 𝒜 ℬ) =
          x.app s (pt 𝒜 ℬ) ≫ sgnHom (W.obj (pt 𝒜 ℬ)) q ≫ W.map (tmul 1 b)
        rw [h, Linear.comp_smul, ← Category.assoc, hs, Linear.smul_comp, smul_smul, sign_mul_self,
          one_smul, Category.assoc]
      rw [SuperNatTrans.total, Preadditive.comp_add, Preadditive.add_comp, key, key]

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.homOfNatTrans_val
statement:
theorem homOfNatTrans_val {V W : Superfunctor k (BimodCat 𝒜 ℬ) (SVec k)} (x : V ⟶ W) :
    (homOfNatTrans x).1 = x.app 0 (pt 𝒜 ℬ) + x.app 1 (pt 𝒜 ℬ)

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.toFunctor_map_proj_comp_proj
statement:
theorem toFunctor_map_proj_comp_proj {M N : SuperBimodule 𝒜 ℬ} (f : M ⟶ N) (s t : ZMod 2)
    {X Y : BimodCat 𝒜 ℬ} (x : X ⟶ Y) :
    ((toFunctor M).map ((BoxProd.homObj k X Y).proj t x) : M.toSVec ⟶ M.toSVec) ≫
        (proj k s f.1 : M.toSVec ⟶ N.toSVec) =
      koszulSign s t • ((proj k s f.1 : M.toSVec ⟶ N.toSVec) ≫
        ((toFunctor N).map ((BoxProd.homObj k X Y).proj t x) : N.toSVec ⟶ N.toSVec))
proof:
:= by
  induction x using BimodCat.induction_on with
  | zero => simp only [map_zero, Functor.map_zero, Limits.zero_comp, Limits.comp_zero, smul_zero]
  | add x x' hx hx' =>
    rw [map_add, Functor.map_add, Functor.map_add, Preadditive.add_comp, Preadditive.comp_add, hx,
      hx', smul_add]
  | tmul p q a b ha hb =>
    rw [SVec.proj_apply_of_mem_part _ (tmul_mem ha hb)]
    split_ifs with h
    · subst h
      have hf := (isHom_iff_of_mem (proj_mem s f.1)).1 (f.2.proj s)
      have hs : sgnHom M.toSVec q ≫ proj k s f.1 =
          sign k (s * q) • (proj k s f.1 ≫ sgnHom N.toSVec q) := by
        rw [comp_sgnHom_of_mem (proj_mem s f.1) q, smul_smul, sign_mul_self, one_smul]
      rw [toFunctor_map_tmul, toFunctor_map_tmul, sract_of_mem M hb, sract_of_mem N hb,
        koszulSign_smul (R := k)]
      simp only [Category.assoc]
      rw [hf.1 p a ha, Linear.comp_smul, Linear.comp_smul, ← Category.assoc (M.ract b), hf.2 b,
        Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc (sgnHom M.toSVec q), hs, Linear.smul_comp, smul_smul,
        ← sign_add, show p * s + s * q = s * (p + q) by ring]
      simp only [Category.assoc]
    · simp only [Functor.map_zero, Limits.zero_comp, Limits.comp_zero, smul_zero]

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.natTransOfHom_app
statement:
theorem natTransOfHom_app {M N : SuperBimodule 𝒜 ℬ} (f : M ⟶ N) (s : ZMod 2) (X : BimodCat 𝒜 ℬ) :
    (natTransOfHom f).app s X = proj k s f.1

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.homOfNatTrans_natTransOfHom
statement:
theorem homOfNatTrans_natTransOfHom {M N : SuperBimodule 𝒜 ℬ} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    (homOfNatTrans (natTransOfHom f)).1 = f.1

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.natTransOfHom_homOfNatTrans
statement:
theorem natTransOfHom_homOfNatTrans {V W : Superfunctor k (BimodCat 𝒜 ℬ) (SVec k)} (x : V ⟶ W)
    (s : ZMod 2) (X : BimodCat 𝒜 ℬ) :
    (natTransOfHom (homOfNatTrans x)).app s X = x.app s X
proof:
:= by
  rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one s with rfl | rfl
  · show proj k 0 (x.app 0 (pt 𝒜 ℬ) + x.app 1 (pt 𝒜 ℬ)) = x.app 0 (pt 𝒜 ℬ)
    rw [map_add, proj_of_mem (x.app_mem 0 _), proj_of_mem_ne (x.app_mem 1 _) (by decide), add_zero]
  · show proj k 1 (x.app 0 (pt 𝒜 ℬ) + x.app 1 (pt 𝒜 ℬ)) = x.app 1 (pt 𝒜 ℬ)
    rw [map_add, proj_of_mem (x.app_mem 1 _), proj_of_mem_ne (x.app_mem 0 _) (by decide), zero_add]

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.natTransOfHom_comp_app
statement:
theorem natTransOfHom_comp_app {M N P : SuperBimodule 𝒜 ℬ} (f : M ⟶ N) (g : N ⟶ P) (s : ZMod 2)
    (X : BimodCat 𝒜 ℬ) :
    (natTransOfHom (f ≫ g)).app s X =
      (natTransOfHom f ≫ natTransOfHom g : toSuperfunctor M ⟶ toSuperfunctor P).app s X
proof:
:= by
  rw [Superfunctor.comp_app]
  simp only [natTransOfHom_app, comp_val]
  have h0 := proj_comp_of_mem_left s (proj_mem (R := k) 0 f.1) g.1
  have h1 := proj_comp_of_mem_left (s + 1) (proj_mem (R := k) 1 f.1) g.1
  rw [zero_add] at h0
  rw [show (1 : ZMod 2) + (s + 1) = s by rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one s with rfl | rfl <;> rfl]
    at h1
  rw [← h0, ← h1, ← (proj k s).map_add, ← Preadditive.add_comp, proj_add_proj]

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.bimoduleFunctor_map
statement:
theorem bimoduleFunctor_map {M N : SuperBimodule 𝒜 ℬ} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    (bimoduleFunctor 𝒜 ℬ).map f = natTransOfHom f

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.evalSuperfunctor_obj
statement:
theorem evalSuperfunctor_obj (V : Superfunctor k (BimodCat 𝒜 ℬ) (SVec k)) :
    (evalSuperfunctor 𝒜 ℬ).obj V = ofFunctor V

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.bimoduleSuperfunctor_obj
statement:
theorem bimoduleSuperfunctor_obj (M : SuperBimodule 𝒜 ℬ) :
    Superfunctor.obj (bimoduleSuperfunctor 𝒜 ℬ) M = toSuperfunctor M

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.eqToHom_val
statement:
theorem eqToHom_val {M N : SuperBimodule 𝒜 ℬ} (h : M = N) :
    (eqToHom h).1 = eqToHom (congrArg SuperBimodule.toSVec h)

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.bimodule_comp_eval
statement:
theorem bimodule_comp_eval :
    (bimoduleSuperfunctor 𝒜 ℬ).comp (evalSuperfunctor 𝒜 ℬ) =
      Superfunctor.id k (SuperBimodule 𝒜 ℬ)
proof:
:= by
  refine Superfunctor.ext (CategoryTheory.Functor.ext
    (fun M => show ofFunctor (toSuperfunctor M) = M from ofFunctor_toSuperfunctor M)
    fun M N f => hom_ext ?_)
  rw [comp_val, comp_val, eqToHom_val, eqToHom_val]
  change (homOfNatTrans (natTransOfHom f)).1 = _
  rw [homOfNatTrans_natTransOfHom]
  exact ((Category.id_comp _).trans (Category.comp_id _)).symm

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.eqToHom_app
statement:
theorem eqToHom_app {V W : Superfunctor k (BimodCat 𝒜 ℬ) (SVec k)} (h : V = W) (s : ZMod 2)
    (X : BimodCat 𝒜 ℬ) :
    (eqToHom h).app s X =
      if s = 0 then
        eqToHom (congrArg (fun F : Superfunctor k (BimodCat 𝒜 ℬ) (SVec k) => F.obj X) h)
      else 0

name: StringDiagrams.SuperBimodule.eval_comp_bimodule
statement:
theorem eval_comp_bimodule :
    (evalSuperfunctor 𝒜 ℬ).comp (bimoduleSuperfunctor 𝒜 ℬ) =
      Superfunctor.id k (Superfunctor k (BimodCat 𝒜 ℬ) (SVec k))
proof:
:= by
  refine Superfunctor.ext (CategoryTheory.Functor.ext
    (fun V => show toSuperfunctor (ofFunctor V) = V from toSuperfunctor_ofFunctor V)
    fun V W x => Superfunctor.hom_ext fun s X => ?_)
  change (natTransOfHom (homOfNatTrans x)).app s X = _
  rw [natTransOfHom_homOfNatTrans, Superfunctor.comp_app, Superfunctor.comp_app, eqToHom_app,
    eqToHom_app, eqToHom_app, eqToHom_app]
  rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one s with rfl | rfl
  · simp only [ite_true, ite_eq_right (show (1 : ZMod 2) ≠ 0 by decide), Limits.comp_zero, add_zero,
      zero_add, Limits.zero_comp]
    exact ((Category.id_comp _).trans (Category.comp_id _)).symm
  · simp only [ite_true, ite_eq_right (show (1 : ZMod 2) ≠ 0 by decide), Limits.comp_zero, zero_add,
      SuperNatTrans.zmod2_one_add_one, Limits.zero_comp, add_zero]
    exact ((Category.id_comp _).trans (Category.comp_id _)).symm

name: StringDiagrams.Karoubi.mkHom_f
statement:
@[simp] theorem mkHom_f {P Q : Karoubi C} (c : P.X ⟶ Q.X) (h : P.p ≫ c = c ≫ Q.p) :
    (mkHom c h).f = c ≫ Q.p

name: StringDiagrams.Karoubi.mkHom_congr
statement:
theorem mkHom_congr {P Q : Karoubi C} {c c' : P.X ⟶ Q.X} (h : P.p ≫ c = c ≫ Q.p)
    (h' : P.p ≫ c' = c' ≫ Q.p) (e : c = c') : mkHom c h = mkHom c' h'

name: StringDiagrams.Karoubi.mkHom_comp_mkHom
statement:
theorem mkHom_comp_mkHom {P Q S : Karoubi C} (c : P.X ⟶ Q.X) (h : P.p ≫ c = c ≫ Q.p)
    (c' : Q.X ⟶ S.X) (h' : Q.p ≫ c' = c' ≫ S.p) :
    mkHom c h ≫ mkHom c' h' = mkHom (c ≫ c') (by rw [reassoc_of% h, h', Category.assoc])
proof:
:=
  Idempotents.Karoubi.hom_ext _ _ (by
    simp only [Idempotents.Karoubi.comp_f, mkHom_f, Category.assoc]
    rw [reassoc_of% h', S.idem])

name: StringDiagrams.Karoubi.mkHom_comp_f
statement:
theorem mkHom_comp_f {P Q S : Karoubi C} (c : P.X ⟶ Q.X) (h : P.p ≫ c = c ≫ Q.p) (ψ : Q ⟶ S) :
    (mkHom c h ≫ ψ).f = c ≫ ψ.f

name: StringDiagrams.Karoubi.comp_mkHom_f
statement:
theorem comp_mkHom_f {P Q S : Karoubi C} (ψ : P ⟶ Q) (c : Q.X ⟶ S.X) (h : Q.p ≫ c = c ≫ S.p) :
    (ψ ≫ mkHom c h).f = ψ.f ≫ c ≫ S.p

name: StringDiagrams.Karoubi.id_eq_mkHom
statement: theorem id_eq_mkHom (P : Karoubi C) : 𝟙 P = mkHom (𝟙 P.X) (by simp)

name: StringDiagrams.Karoubi.comm_inv
statement:
theorem comm_inv {P Q : Karoubi C} (e : P.X ≅ Q.X) (h : P.p ≫ e.hom = e.hom ≫ Q.p) :
    Q.p ≫ e.inv = e.inv ≫ P.p
proof:
:= by
  rw [Iso.eq_inv_comp, ← Category.assoc, ← h, Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]

name: StringDiagrams.KarBicat.hcomp_f'
statement:
theorem hcomp_f' {P P' : a ⟶ b} {Q Q' : b ⟶ c} (η : P ⟶ P') (θ : Q ⟶ Q') :
    (hcomp η θ).f = hcomp₂ η.f θ.f

name: StringDiagrams.KarBicat.hcomp_id_id
statement: theorem hcomp_id_id (P : a ⟶ b) (Q : b ⟶ c) : hcomp (𝟙 P) (𝟙 Q) = 𝟙 (P ≫ Q)

name: StringDiagrams.KarBicat.hcomp_comp
statement:
theorem hcomp_comp {P₁ P₂ P₃ : a ⟶ b} {Q₁ Q₂ Q₃ : b ⟶ c} (η₁ : P₁ ⟶ P₂) (θ₁ : Q₁ ⟶ Q₂)
    (η₂ : P₂ ⟶ P₃) (θ₂ : Q₂ ⟶ Q₃) :
    hcomp (η₁ ≫ η₂) (θ₁ ≫ θ₂) = hcomp η₁ θ₁ ≫ hcomp η₂ θ₂

name: StringDiagrams.KarBicat.hcomp_mkHom_id'
statement:
theorem hcomp_mkHom_id' {P P' : a ⟶ b} (φ : P.X ⟶ P'.X) (h : P.p ≫ φ = φ ≫ P'.p) (Q : b ⟶ c) :
    hcomp (mkHom φ h) (𝟙 Q) = mkHom (φ ▷ Q.X) (by
      show hcomp₂ P.p Q.p ≫ φ ▷ Q.X = φ ▷ Q.X ≫ hcomp₂ P'.p Q.p
      rw [← hcomp₂_id_right φ, ← hcomp₂_comp, ← hcomp₂_comp, h, Category.id_comp,
        Category.comp_id])
proof:
:=
  Idempotents.Karoubi.hom_ext _ _ (by
    show hcomp₂ (φ ≫ P'.p) Q.p = φ ▷ Q.X ≫ hcomp₂ P'.p Q.p
    simp only [hcomp₂, comp_whiskerRight, Category.assoc])

name: StringDiagrams.KarBicat.hcomp_id_mkHom'
statement:
theorem hcomp_id_mkHom' (P : a ⟶ b) {Q Q' : b ⟶ c} (φ : Q.X ⟶ Q'.X) (h : Q.p ≫ φ = φ ≫ Q'.p) :
    hcomp (𝟙 P) (mkHom φ h) = mkHom (P.X ◁ φ) (by
      show hcomp₂ P.p Q.p ≫ P.X ◁ φ = P.X ◁ φ ≫ hcomp₂ P.p Q'.p
      rw [← hcomp₂_id_left P.X φ, ← hcomp₂_comp, ← hcomp₂_comp, h, Category.id_comp,
        Category.comp_id])
proof:
:=
  Idempotents.Karoubi.hom_ext _ _ (by
    show hcomp₂ P.p (φ ≫ Q'.p) = P.X ◁ φ ≫ hcomp₂ P.p Q'.p
    simp only [hcomp₂, Bicategory.whiskerLeft_comp]
    rw [whisker_exchange_assoc])

name: StringDiagrams.KarBicat.assoc_comm
statement:
theorem assoc_comm (P : a ⟶ b) (Q : b ⟶ c) (S : c ⟶ d) :
    ((P ≫ Q) ≫ S).p ≫ (α_ P.X Q.X S.X).hom = (α_ P.X Q.X S.X).hom ≫ (P ≫ Q ≫ S).p

name: StringDiagrams.KarBicat.assoc_inv_comm
statement:
theorem assoc_inv_comm (P : a ⟶ b) (Q : b ⟶ c) (S : c ⟶ d) :
    (P ≫ Q ≫ S).p ≫ (α_ P.X Q.X S.X).inv = (α_ P.X Q.X S.X).inv ≫ ((P ≫ Q) ≫ S).p

name: StringDiagrams.KarBicat.leftUnitor_comm
statement: theorem leftUnitor_comm (P : a ⟶ b) : (𝟙 a ≫ P).p ≫ (λ_ P.X).hom = (λ_ P.X).hom ≫ P.p
proof:
:= by
  show hcomp₂ (𝟙 (𝟙 a.obj)) P.p ≫ (λ_ P.X).hom = (λ_ P.X).hom ≫ P.p
  rw [hcomp₂_id_left, leftUnitor_naturality]

name: StringDiagrams.KarBicat.leftUnitor_inv_comm
statement:
theorem leftUnitor_inv_comm (P : a ⟶ b) :
    P.p ≫ (λ_ P.X).inv = (λ_ P.X).inv ≫ (𝟙 a ≫ P).p
proof:
:= by
  show P.p ≫ (λ_ P.X).inv = (λ_ P.X).inv ≫ hcomp₂ (𝟙 (𝟙 a.obj)) P.p
  rw [hcomp₂_id_left, leftUnitor_inv_naturality]

name: StringDiagrams.KarBicat.rightUnitor_comm
statement: theorem rightUnitor_comm (P : a ⟶ b) : (P ≫ 𝟙 b).p ≫ (ρ_ P.X).hom = (ρ_ P.X).hom ≫ P.p
proof:
:= by
  show hcomp₂ P.p (𝟙 (𝟙 b.obj)) ≫ (ρ_ P.X).hom = (ρ_ P.X).hom ≫ P.p
  rw [hcomp₂_id_right, rightUnitor_naturality]

name: StringDiagrams.KarBicat.rightUnitor_inv_comm
statement:
theorem rightUnitor_inv_comm (P : a ⟶ b) :
    P.p ≫ (ρ_ P.X).inv = (ρ_ P.X).inv ≫ (P ≫ 𝟙 b).p
proof:
:= by
  show P.p ≫ (ρ_ P.X).inv = (ρ_ P.X).inv ≫ hcomp₂ P.p (𝟙 (𝟙 b.obj))
  rw [hcomp₂_id_right, rightUnitor_inv_naturality]

name: StringDiagrams.KarBicat.associator_hom'
statement:
theorem associator_hom' (P : a ⟶ b) (Q : b ⟶ c) (S : c ⟶ d) :
    (associator P Q S).hom = mkHom (α_ P.X Q.X S.X).hom (assoc_comm P Q S)

name: StringDiagrams.KarBicat.leftUnitor_hom'
statement:
theorem leftUnitor_hom' (P : a ⟶ b) :
    (leftUnitor P).hom = mkHom (λ_ P.X).hom (leftUnitor_comm P)

name: StringDiagrams.KarBicat.rightUnitor_hom'
statement:
theorem rightUnitor_hom' (P : a ⟶ b) :
    (rightUnitor P).hom = mkHom (ρ_ P.X).hom (rightUnitor_comm P)

name: StringDiagrams.KarBicat.of_X
statement: @[simp] theorem of_X {a b : B} (f : a ⟶ b) : (of f).X = f

name: StringDiagrams.KarBicat.of_p
statement: @[simp] theorem of_p {a b : B} (f : a ⟶ b) : (of f).p = 𝟙 f

name: StringDiagrams.KarBicat.id_eq
statement: theorem id_eq (a : KarBicat B) : 𝟙 a = of (𝟙 a.obj)

name: StringDiagrams.KarBicat.id_X
statement: @[simp] theorem id_X (a : KarBicat B) : (𝟙 a : a ⟶ a).X = 𝟙 a.obj

name: StringDiagrams.KarBicat.id_p
statement: @[simp] theorem id_p (a : KarBicat B) : (𝟙 a : a ⟶ a).p = 𝟙 (𝟙 a.obj)

name: StringDiagrams.KarBicat.comp_X
statement: @[simp] theorem comp_X {a b c : KarBicat B} (P : a ⟶ b) (Q : b ⟶ c) : (P ≫ Q).X = P.X ≫ Q.X

name: StringDiagrams.KarBicat.comp_p
statement:
@[simp] theorem comp_p {a b c : KarBicat B} (P : a ⟶ b) (Q : b ⟶ c) :
    (P ≫ Q).p = hcomp₂ P.p Q.p

name: StringDiagrams.KarBicat.comp_f
statement: @[simp] theorem comp_f {P Q S : a ⟶ b} (η : P ⟶ Q) (θ : Q ⟶ S) : (η ≫ θ).f = η.f ≫ θ.f

name: StringDiagrams.KarBicat.id_f
statement: @[simp] theorem id_f (P : a ⟶ b) : (𝟙 P : P ⟶ P).f = P.p

name: StringDiagrams.KarBicat.whiskerLeft_f
statement:
@[simp] theorem whiskerLeft_f (P : a ⟶ b) {Q Q' : b ⟶ c} (θ : Q ⟶ Q') :
    (P ◁ θ).f = hcomp₂ P.p θ.f

name: StringDiagrams.KarBicat.whiskerRight_f
statement:
@[simp] theorem whiskerRight_f {P P' : a ⟶ b} (η : P ⟶ P') (Q : b ⟶ c) :
    (η ▷ Q).f = hcomp₂ η.f Q.p

name: StringDiagrams.KarBicat.mkHom_comp_mkHom
statement:
theorem mkHom_comp_mkHom {P Q S : a ⟶ b} (φ : P.X ⟶ Q.X) (h : P.p ≫ φ = φ ≫ Q.p)
    (φ' : Q.X ⟶ S.X) (h' : Q.p ≫ φ' = φ' ≫ S.p) :
    mkHom φ h ≫ mkHom φ' h' = mkHom (φ ≫ φ') (by rw [reassoc_of% h, h', Category.assoc])

name: StringDiagrams.KarBicat.mkHom_comp_f
statement:
theorem mkHom_comp_f {P Q S : a ⟶ b} (φ : P.X ⟶ Q.X) (h : P.p ≫ φ = φ ≫ Q.p) (ψ : Q ⟶ S) :
    (mkHom φ h ≫ ψ).f = φ ≫ ψ.f

name: StringDiagrams.KarBicat.comp_mkHom_f
statement:
theorem comp_mkHom_f {P Q S : a ⟶ b} (ψ : P ⟶ Q) (φ : Q.X ⟶ S.X) (h : Q.p ≫ φ = φ ≫ S.p) :
    (ψ ≫ mkHom φ h).f = ψ.f ≫ φ ≫ S.p

name: StringDiagrams.KarBicat.id_eq_mkHom
statement: theorem id_eq_mkHom (P : a ⟶ b) : 𝟙 P = mkHom (𝟙 P.X) (by simp)

name: StringDiagrams.KarBicat.mkHom_congr
statement:
theorem mkHom_congr {P Q : a ⟶ b} {φ φ' : P.X ⟶ Q.X} (h : P.p ≫ φ = φ ≫ Q.p)
    (h' : P.p ≫ φ' = φ' ≫ Q.p) (e : φ = φ') : mkHom φ h = mkHom φ' h'

name: StringDiagrams.KarBicat.associator_hom_eq
statement:
theorem associator_hom_eq (P : a ⟶ b) (Q : b ⟶ c) (S : c ⟶ d) :
    (α_ P Q S).hom = mkHom (α_ P.X Q.X S.X).hom (assoc_comm P Q S)

name: StringDiagrams.KarBicat.associator_inv_eq
statement:
theorem associator_inv_eq (P : a ⟶ b) (Q : b ⟶ c) (S : c ⟶ d) :
    (α_ P Q S).inv = mkHom (α_ P.X Q.X S.X).inv (assoc_inv_comm P Q S)

name: StringDiagrams.KarBicat.leftUnitor_hom_eq
statement: theorem leftUnitor_hom_eq (P : a ⟶ b) : (λ_ P).hom = mkHom (λ_ P.X).hom (leftUnitor_comm P)

name: StringDiagrams.KarBicat.leftUnitor_inv_eq
statement:
theorem leftUnitor_inv_eq (P : a ⟶ b) :
    (λ_ P).inv = mkHom (λ_ P.X).inv (leftUnitor_inv_comm P)

name: StringDiagrams.KarBicat.rightUnitor_hom_eq
statement:
theorem rightUnitor_hom_eq (P : a ⟶ b) :
    (ρ_ P).hom = mkHom (ρ_ P.X).hom (rightUnitor_comm P)

name: StringDiagrams.KarBicat.rightUnitor_inv_eq
statement:
theorem rightUnitor_inv_eq (P : a ⟶ b) :
    (ρ_ P).inv = mkHom (ρ_ P.X).inv (rightUnitor_inv_comm P)

name: StringDiagrams.KarBicat.whiskerLeft_mkHom
statement:
theorem whiskerLeft_mkHom (P : a ⟶ b) {Q Q' : b ⟶ c} (φ : Q.X ⟶ Q'.X) (h : Q.p ≫ φ = φ ≫ Q'.p) :
    P ◁ mkHom φ h = mkHom (P.X ◁ φ) (by
      show hcomp₂ P.p Q.p ≫ P.X ◁ φ = P.X ◁ φ ≫ hcomp₂ P.p Q'.p
      rw [← hcomp₂_id_left P.X φ, ← hcomp₂_comp, ← hcomp₂_comp, h, Category.id_comp,
        Category.comp_id])

name: StringDiagrams.KarBicat.mkHom_whiskerRight
statement:
theorem mkHom_whiskerRight {P P' : a ⟶ b} (φ : P.X ⟶ P'.X) (h : P.p ≫ φ = φ ≫ P'.p) (Q : b ⟶ c) :
    mkHom φ h ▷ Q = mkHom (φ ▷ Q.X) (by
      show hcomp₂ P.p Q.p ≫ φ ▷ Q.X = φ ▷ Q.X ≫ hcomp₂ P'.p Q.p
      rw [← hcomp₂_id_right φ, ← hcomp₂_comp, ← hcomp₂_comp, h, Category.id_comp,
        Category.comp_id])

name: StringDiagrams.KarBicat.add_f
statement: @[simp] theorem add_f {P Q : a ⟶ b} (η θ : P ⟶ Q) : (η + θ).f = η.f + θ.f

name: StringDiagrams.KarBicat.neg_f
statement: @[simp] theorem neg_f {P Q : a ⟶ b} (η : P ⟶ Q) : (-η).f = -η.f

name: StringDiagrams.KarBicat.zero_f
statement: @[simp] theorem zero_f {P Q : a ⟶ b} : (0 : P ⟶ Q).f = 0

name: StringDiagrams.KarBicat.smul_f
statement: @[simp] theorem smul_f {P Q : a ⟶ b} (r : R) (η : P ⟶ Q) : (r • η).f = r • η.f

name: StringDiagrams.KarBicat.braid_comm
statement:
theorem braid_comm {q : b.obj ⟶ b.obj} {q' : a.obj ⟶ a.obj} (P : a ⟶ b)
    (e : ∀ f : a.obj ⟶ b.obj, f ≫ q ≅ q' ≫ f)
    (he : ∀ {f g : a.obj ⟶ b.obj} (η : f ⟶ g), (e f).hom ≫ q' ◁ η = η ▷ q ≫ (e g).hom) :
    (P ≫ of q).p ≫ (e P.X).hom = (e P.X).hom ≫ (of q' ≫ P).p
proof:
:= by
  show hcomp₂ P.p (𝟙 q) ≫ (e P.X).hom = (e P.X).hom ≫ hcomp₂ (𝟙 q') P.p
  rw [hcomp₂_id_right, hcomp₂_id_left, he]

name: StringDiagrams.KarBicat.braidIso_hom
statement:
theorem braidIso_hom {q : b.obj ⟶ b.obj} {q' : a.obj ⟶ a.obj} (P : a ⟶ b)
    (e : ∀ f : a.obj ⟶ b.obj, f ≫ q ≅ q' ≫ f)
    (he : ∀ {f g : a.obj ⟶ b.obj} (η : f ⟶ g), (e f).hom ≫ q' ◁ η = η ▷ q ≫ (e g).hom) :
    (braidIso P e he).hom = mkHom (e P.X).hom (braid_comm P e he)

name: StringDiagrams.KarBicat.braidIso_inv
statement:
theorem braidIso_inv {q : b.obj ⟶ b.obj} {q' : a.obj ⟶ a.obj} (P : a ⟶ b)
    (e : ∀ f : a.obj ⟶ b.obj, f ≫ q ≅ q' ≫ f)
    (he : ∀ {f g : a.obj ⟶ b.obj} (η : f ⟶ g), (e f).hom ≫ q' ◁ η = η ▷ q ≫ (e g).hom) :
    (braidIso P e he).inv =
      mkHom (e P.X).inv (comm_inv (P := P ≫ of q) (Q := of q' ≫ P) (e P.X) (braid_comm P e he))

name: StringDiagrams.KarBicat.braidIso_naturality
statement:
theorem braidIso_naturality {q : b.obj ⟶ b.obj} {q' : a.obj ⟶ a.obj}
    (e : ∀ f : a.obj ⟶ b.obj, f ≫ q ≅ q' ≫ f)
    (he : ∀ {f g : a.obj ⟶ b.obj} (η : f ⟶ g), (e f).hom ≫ q' ◁ η = η ▷ q ≫ (e g).hom)
    {P P' : a ⟶ b} (η : P ⟶ P') :
    (braidIso P e he).hom ≫ of q' ◁ η = η ▷ of q ≫ (braidIso P' e he).hom
proof:
:= by
  apply Idempotents.Karoubi.hom_ext
  rw [braidIso_hom, braidIso_hom, mkHom_comp_f, comp_mkHom_f, whiskerLeft_f, whiskerRight_f,
    comp_p, of_p, of_p]
  simp only [hcomp₂, Bicategory.id_whiskerRight, Category.id_comp, Bicategory.whiskerLeft_id,
    Category.comp_id]
  conv_lhs => rw [← Idempotents.Karoubi.comp_p η]
  rw [Bicategory.whiskerLeft_comp, ← Category.assoc, he, Category.assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.KarBicat.unit_comm
statement:
theorem unit_comm {q q' : a.obj ⟶ a.obj} (e : q ≫ q' ≅ 𝟙 a.obj) :
    (of q ≫ of q').p ≫ e.hom = e.hom ≫ (𝟙 a : a ⟶ a).p
proof:
:= by
  show hcomp₂ (𝟙 q) (𝟙 q') ≫ e.hom = e.hom ≫ 𝟙 (𝟙 a.obj)
  rw [hcomp₂_id_id, Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id]

name: StringDiagrams.KarBicat.unitIso_hom
statement:
theorem unitIso_hom {q q' : a.obj ⟶ a.obj} (e : q ≫ q' ≅ 𝟙 a.obj) :
    (unitIso e).hom = mkHom e.hom (unit_comm e)

name: StringDiagrams.KarBicat.unitIso_inv
statement:
theorem unitIso_inv {q q' : a.obj ⟶ a.obj} (e : q ≫ q' ≅ 𝟙 a.obj) :
    (unitIso e).inv = mkHom e.inv (comm_inv (P := of q ≫ of q') (Q := 𝟙 a) e (unit_comm e))

name: StringDiagrams.KarBicat.βIso_hom
statement:
theorem βIso_hom (P : a ⟶ b) :
    (βIso P).hom = mkHom (𝛃 P.X).hom (braid_comm P 𝛃 (fun η => PiTwoCategory.β_naturality η))

name: StringDiagrams.KarBicat.βIso_inv
statement:
theorem βIso_inv (P : a ⟶ b) :
    (βIso P).inv = mkHom (𝛃 P.X).inv (comm_inv (P := P ≫ of (𝛑 b.obj)) (Q := of (𝛑 a.obj) ≫ P)
      (𝛃 P.X) (braid_comm P 𝛃 (fun η => PiTwoCategory.β_naturality η)))

name: StringDiagrams.KarBicat.βIso_naturality
statement:
theorem βIso_naturality {P P' : a ⟶ b} (η : P ⟶ P') :
    (βIso P).hom ≫ of (𝛑 a.obj) ◁ η = η ▷ of (𝛑 b.obj) ≫ (βIso P').hom
proof:
:=
  braidIso_naturality 𝛃 (fun η => PiTwoCategory.β_naturality η) η

name: StringDiagrams.KarBicat.βIso_comp
statement:
theorem βIso_comp (P : a ⟶ b) (Q : b ⟶ c) :
    (βIso (P ≫ Q)).hom = (α_ P Q (of (𝛑 c.obj))).hom ≫ P ◁ (βIso Q).hom ≫
      (α_ P (of (𝛑 b.obj)) Q).inv ≫ (βIso P).hom ▷ Q ≫ (α_ (of (𝛑 a.obj)) P Q).hom
proof:
:= by
  simp only [βIso_hom, associator_hom_eq, associator_inv_eq, whiskerLeft_mkHom,
    mkHom_whiskerRight]
  rw [mkHom_comp_mkHom, mkHom_comp_mkHom, mkHom_comp_mkHom, mkHom_comp_mkHom]
  refine mkHom_congr _ _ ?_
  exact PiTwoCategory.β_comp (R := R) P.X Q.X

name: StringDiagrams.KarBicat.βIso_id
statement:
theorem βIso_id (a : KarBicat B) :
    (βIso (𝟙 a)).hom = (λ_ (of (𝛑 a.obj))).hom ≫ (ρ_ (of (𝛑 a.obj))).inv
proof:
:= by
  simp only [βIso_hom, leftUnitor_hom_eq, rightUnitor_inv_eq]
  rw [mkHom_comp_mkHom]
  refine mkHom_congr _ _ ?_
  exact PiTwoCategory.β_id (R := R) a.obj

name: StringDiagrams.KarBicat.βIso_pi
statement: theorem βIso_pi (a : KarBicat B) : (βIso (of (𝛑 a.obj))).hom = -𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  apply Idempotents.Karoubi.hom_ext
  rw [βIso_hom, mkHom_f, neg_f, id_f]
  simp only [comp_p, comp_X, of_X, hcomp₂_id_id, Category.comp_id]
  exact PiTwoCategory.β_pi (R := R) a.obj

name: StringDiagrams.KarBicat.ξ_comm_aux
statement:
theorem ξ_comm_aux (P : a ⟶ b) :
    P ◁ (unitIso (𝛏 b.obj)).hom ≫ (ρ_ P).hom ≫ (λ_ P).inv ≫ (unitIso (𝛏 a.obj)).inv ▷ P =
      (α_ P (of (𝛑 b.obj)) (of (𝛑 b.obj))).inv ≫ (βIso P).hom ▷ of (𝛑 b.obj) ≫
        (α_ (of (𝛑 a.obj)) P (of (𝛑 b.obj))).hom ≫ of (𝛑 a.obj) ◁ (βIso P).hom ≫
        (α_ (of (𝛑 a.obj)) (of (𝛑 a.obj)) P).inv
proof:
:= by
  simp only [βIso_hom, unitIso_hom, unitIso_inv, associator_hom_eq, associator_inv_eq,
    leftUnitor_inv_eq, rightUnitor_hom_eq, whiskerLeft_mkHom, mkHom_whiskerRight]
  rw [mkHom_comp_mkHom, mkHom_comp_mkHom, mkHom_comp_mkHom, mkHom_comp_mkHom, mkHom_comp_mkHom,
    mkHom_comp_mkHom, mkHom_comp_mkHom]
  refine mkHom_congr _ _ ?_
  exact PiTwoCategory.ξ_comm (R := R) P.X

name: StringDiagrams.KarBicat.pi_eq
statement: @[simp] theorem pi_eq (a : KarBicat B) : 𝛑 a = of (𝛑 a.obj)

name: StringDiagrams.KarBicat.β_eq
statement: theorem β_eq (P : a ⟶ b) : 𝛃 P = βIso P

name: StringDiagrams.KarBicat.β_hom_eq
statement:
theorem β_hom_eq (P : a ⟶ b) :
    (𝛃 P).hom = mkHom (𝛃 P.X).hom (braid_comm P 𝛃 (fun η => PiTwoCategory.β_naturality η))

name: StringDiagrams.KarBicat.β_inv_eq
statement:
theorem β_inv_eq (P : a ⟶ b) :
    (𝛃 P).inv = mkHom (𝛃 P.X).inv (comm_inv (P := P ≫ of (𝛑 b.obj)) (Q := of (𝛑 a.obj) ≫ P)
      (𝛃 P.X) (braid_comm P 𝛃 (fun η => PiTwoCategory.β_naturality η)))

name: StringDiagrams.KarBicat.ξ_eq
statement: theorem ξ_eq (a : KarBicat B) : 𝛏 a = unitIso (𝛏 a.obj)

name: StringDiagrams.KarBicat.ξ_hom_eq
statement: theorem ξ_hom_eq (a : KarBicat B) : (𝛏 a).hom = mkHom (𝛏 a.obj).hom (unit_comm (𝛏 a.obj))

name: StringDiagrams.KarBicat.γIso_hom
statement:
theorem γIso_hom (P : a ⟶ b) :
    (γIso P).hom = mkHom (𝛄 P.X).hom (braid_comm P 𝛄 (fun η => QPiTwoCategory.γ_naturality η))

name: StringDiagrams.KarBicat.γIso_naturality
statement:
theorem γIso_naturality {P P' : a ⟶ b} (η : P ⟶ P') :
    (γIso P).hom ≫ of (𝐪 a.obj) ◁ η = η ▷ of (𝐪 b.obj) ≫ (γIso P').hom
proof:
:=
  braidIso_naturality 𝛄 (fun η => QPiTwoCategory.γ_naturality η) η

name: StringDiagrams.KarBicat.γIso_comp
statement:
theorem γIso_comp (P : a ⟶ b) (Q : b ⟶ c) :
    (γIso (P ≫ Q)).hom = (α_ P Q (of (𝐪 c.obj))).hom ≫ P ◁ (γIso Q).hom ≫
      (α_ P (of (𝐪 b.obj)) Q).inv ≫ (γIso P).hom ▷ Q ≫ (α_ (of (𝐪 a.obj)) P Q).hom
proof:
:= by
  simp only [γIso_hom, associator_hom_eq, associator_inv_eq, whiskerLeft_mkHom,
    mkHom_whiskerRight]
  rw [mkHom_comp_mkHom, mkHom_comp_mkHom, mkHom_comp_mkHom, mkHom_comp_mkHom]
  refine mkHom_congr _ _ ?_
  exact QPiTwoCategory.γ_comp (R := R) P.X Q.X

name: StringDiagrams.KarBicat.γIso_id
statement:
theorem γIso_id (a : KarBicat B) :
    (γIso (𝟙 a)).hom = (λ_ (of (𝐪 a.obj))).hom ≫ (ρ_ (of (𝐪 a.obj))).inv
proof:
:= by
  simp only [γIso_hom, leftUnitor_hom_eq, rightUnitor_inv_eq]
  rw [mkHom_comp_mkHom]
  refine mkHom_congr _ _ ?_
  exact QPiTwoCategory.γ_id (R := R) a.obj

name: StringDiagrams.KarBicat.γIso_q
statement: theorem γIso_q (a : KarBicat B) : (γIso (of (𝐪 a.obj))).hom = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  rw [γIso_hom, id_eq_mkHom]
  refine mkHom_congr _ _ ?_
  exact QPiTwoCategory.γ_q (R := R) a.obj

name: StringDiagrams.KarBicat.γIso_pi
statement: theorem γIso_pi (a : KarBicat B) : (γIso (of (𝛑 a.obj))).hom = (βIso (of (𝐪 a.obj))).inv
proof:
:= by
  rw [γIso_hom, βIso_inv]
  refine mkHom_congr _ _ ?_
  exact QPiTwoCategory.γ_pi (R := R) a.obj

name: StringDiagrams.KarBicat.q_ii_aux
statement:
theorem q_ii_aux (a : KarBicat B) :
    (unitIso (QPiTwoCategory.ii (R := R) a.obj)).hom ▷ of (𝐪 a.obj) ≫ (λ_ (of (𝐪 a.obj))).hom =
      (α_ (of (𝐪 a.obj)) (of (𝐪⁻¹ a.obj)) (of (𝐪 a.obj))).hom ≫
        of (𝐪 a.obj) ◁ (unitIso (QPiTwoCategory.jj (R := R) a.obj)).hom ≫
        (ρ_ (of (𝐪 a.obj))).hom
proof:
:= by
  simp only [unitIso_hom, associator_hom_eq, leftUnitor_hom_eq, rightUnitor_hom_eq,
    whiskerLeft_mkHom, mkHom_whiskerRight]
  rw [mkHom_comp_mkHom, mkHom_comp_mkHom, mkHom_comp_mkHom]
  refine mkHom_congr _ _ ?_
  exact QPiTwoCategory.q_ii (R := R) a.obj

name: StringDiagrams.KarBicat.ii_qinv_aux
statement:
theorem ii_qinv_aux (a : KarBicat B) :
    of (𝐪⁻¹ a.obj) ◁ (unitIso (QPiTwoCategory.ii (R := R) a.obj)).hom ≫
        (ρ_ (of (𝐪⁻¹ a.obj))).hom =
      (α_ (of (𝐪⁻¹ a.obj)) (of (𝐪 a.obj)) (of (𝐪⁻¹ a.obj))).inv ≫
        (unitIso (QPiTwoCategory.jj (R := R) a.obj)).hom ▷ of (𝐪⁻¹ a.obj) ≫
        (λ_ (of (𝐪⁻¹ a.obj))).hom
proof:
:= by
  simp only [unitIso_hom, associator_inv_eq, leftUnitor_hom_eq, rightUnitor_hom_eq,
    whiskerLeft_mkHom, mkHom_whiskerRight]
  rw [mkHom_comp_mkHom, mkHom_comp_mkHom, mkHom_comp_mkHom]
  refine mkHom_congr _ _ ?_
  exact QPiTwoCategory.ii_qinv (R := R) a.obj

name: StringDiagrams.KarBicat.q_eq
statement: @[simp] theorem q_eq (a : KarBicat B) : 𝐪 a = of (𝐪 a.obj)

name: StringDiagrams.KarBicat.qinv_eq
statement: @[simp] theorem qinv_eq (a : KarBicat B) : 𝐪⁻¹ a = of (𝐪⁻¹ a.obj)

name: StringDiagrams.KarBicat.γ_eq
statement: theorem γ_eq (P : a ⟶ b) : 𝛄 P = γIso P

name: StringDiagrams.KarBicat.γ_hom_eq
statement:
theorem γ_hom_eq (P : a ⟶ b) :
    (𝛄 P).hom = mkHom (𝛄 P.X).hom (braid_comm P 𝛄 (fun η => QPiTwoCategory.γ_naturality η))

name: StringDiagrams.KarBicat.ii_eq
statement:
theorem ii_eq (a : KarBicat B) :
    QPiTwoCategory.ii (R := R) a = unitIso (QPiTwoCategory.ii (R := R) a.obj)

name: StringDiagrams.KarBicat.jj_eq
statement:
theorem jj_eq (a : KarBicat B) :
    QPiTwoCategory.jj (R := R) a = unitIso (QPiTwoCategory.jj (R := R) a.obj)

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.Superfunctor.mem_parity_of_proj
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_iff_proj] at hx ⊢
  rw [← h, hx]

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.Superfunctor.map_proj_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : q = p
  · subst h; rw [proj_of_mem hx, proj_of_mem hφ]
  · rw [proj_of_mem_ne hx h, proj_of_mem_ne hφ h, map_zero]

name: StringDiagrams.BoxUnit.comp_eq
statement:
theorem comp_eq {X Y Z : BoxUnit.{w, u} k} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) :
    (f ≫ g : k) = (g : k) * (f : k)

name: StringDiagrams.BoxUnit.id_eq
statement: theorem id_eq (X : BoxUnit.{w, u} k) : (𝟙 X : k) = 1

name: StringDiagrams.BoxUnit.mem_parity_zero
statement: theorem mem_parity_zero {X Y : BoxUnit.{w, u} k} (f : X ⟶ Y) : f ∈ parity (R := k) X Y 0
proof:
:= by
  change (f : k) ∈ trivialGrading k 0
  rw [trivialGrading_zero]; trivial

name: StringDiagrams.BoxProd.induction_on_tmulHom
statement:
theorem induction_on_tmulHom {X Y : BoxProd k C D} {P : (X ⟶ Y) → Prop} (x : X ⟶ Y)
    (zero : P 0)
    (tmul : ∀ (p q : ZMod 2) (f : X.fst ⟶ Y.fst) (g : X.snd ⟶ Y.snd),
      f ∈ parity (R := k) X.fst Y.fst p → g ∈ parity (R := k) X.snd Y.snd q → P (tmulHom f g))
    (add : ∀ x y, P x → P y → P (x + y)) : P x
proof:
:=
  induction_on_homogeneous (P := P) x zero tmul add

name: StringDiagrams.BoxProd.superfunctor_ext
statement:
theorem superfunctor_ext {E : Type w₃} [Category.{u} E] [Preadditive E] [Linear k E]
    [Supercategory k E] {Φ Ψ : Superfunctor k (BoxProd k C D) E}
    (hobj : ∀ X, Φ.obj X = Ψ.obj X)
    (hmap : ∀ (X Y : BoxProd k C D) (f : X.fst ⟶ Y.fst) (g : X.snd ⟶ Y.snd),
      Φ.map (tmulHom f g) ≍ Ψ.map (tmulHom f g)) :
    Φ = Ψ
proof:
:= by
  refine Superfunctor.ext (CategoryTheory.Functor.ext hobj fun X Y x => ?_)
  induction x using induction_on_tmulHom with
  | zero => simp only [Functor.map_zero, Limits.zero_comp, Limits.comp_zero]
  | tmul _ _ f g _ _ => exact (conj_eqToHom_iff_heq _ _ (hobj X) (hobj Y)).2 (hmap X Y f g)
  | add x y hx hy =>
    rw [Functor.map_add, Functor.map_add, hx, hy, Preadditive.add_comp, Preadditive.comp_add]

name: StringDiagrams.BoxProd.tmulHom_mem_parity
StringDiagrams.BoxProd.tmulHom_zero_left
statement:
theorem tmulHom_zero_left {X Y : BoxProd k C D} (g : X.snd ⟶ Y.snd) :
    tmulHom (0 : X.fst ⟶ Y.fst) g = 0

name: StringDiagrams.BoxProd.tmulHom_zero_right
statement:
theorem tmulHom_zero_right {X Y : BoxProd k C D} (f : X.fst ⟶ Y.fst) :
    tmulHom f (0 : X.snd ⟶ Y.snd) = 0

name: StringDiagrams.BoxProd.tmulHom_zsmul_left
statement:
theorem tmulHom_zsmul_left {X Y : BoxProd k C D} (n : ℤ) (f : X.fst ⟶ Y.fst)
    (g : X.snd ⟶ Y.snd) : tmulHom (n • f) g = n • tmulHom f g
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul k, ← Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul k, tmulHom_smul_left]

name: StringDiagrams.BoxProd.tmulHom_zsmul_right
statement:
theorem tmulHom_zsmul_right {X Y : BoxProd k C D} (n : ℤ) (f : X.fst ⟶ Y.fst)
    (g : X.snd ⟶ Y.snd) : tmulHom f (n • g) = n • tmulHom f g
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul k, ← Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul k, tmulHom_smul_right]

name: StringDiagrams.BoxProd.mapHom_tmul
statement:
theorem mapHom_tmul {X Y : BoxProd k C D} (f : X.fst ⟶ Y.fst) (g : X.snd ⟶ Y.snd) :
    mapHom F G X Y (tmulHom f g) = tmulHom (F.map f) (G.map g)

name: StringDiagrams.BoxProd.mapHom_comp
statement:
theorem mapHom_comp {X Y Z : BoxProd k C D} (x : X ⟶ Y) (y : Y ⟶ Z) :
    mapHom F G X Z (x ≫ y) = mapHom F G X Y x ≫ mapHom F G Y Z y
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_on_tmulHom with
  | zero => rw [Limits.zero_comp, map_zero, map_zero, Limits.zero_comp]
  | add x x' hx hx' => rw [Preadditive.add_comp, map_add, map_add, Preadditive.add_comp, hx, hx']
  | tmul a b f g hf hg =>
    induction y using induction_on_tmulHom with
    | zero => rw [Limits.comp_zero, map_zero, map_zero, Limits.comp_zero]
    | add y y' hy hy' => rw [Preadditive.comp_add, map_add, map_add, Preadditive.comp_add, hy, hy']
    | tmul c d h l hh hl =>
      rw [mapHom_tmul, mapHom_tmul, tmulHom_comp_tmulHom hf g h hl,
        tmulHom_comp_tmulHom (F.map_mem hf) _ _ (G.map_mem hl), map_zsmul, mapHom_tmul]
      simp only [Superfunctor.map, Functor.map_comp]

name: StringDiagrams.BoxProd.mapHom_proj
statement:
theorem mapHom_proj {X Y : BoxProd k C D} (p : ZMod 2) (x : X ⟶ Y) :
    mapHom F G X Y (proj k p x) = proj k p (mapHom F G X Y x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_on_tmulHom with
  | zero => simp only [map_zero]
  | add x x' hx hx' => simp only [map_add, hx, hx']
  | tmul a b f g hf hg =>
    refine Superfunctor.map_proj_of_mem _ (tmulHom_mem_parity hf hg) ?_ p
    rw [mapHom_tmul]
    exact tmulHom_mem_parity (X := mapObj F G X) (Y := mapObj F G Y) (F.map_mem hf) (G.map_mem hg)

name: StringDiagrams.BoxProd.map_obj
statement: @[simp] theorem map_obj (X : BoxProd k C D) : (map F G).obj X = ⟨F.obj X.fst, G.obj X.snd⟩

name: StringDiagrams.BoxProd.map_map
statement: theorem map_map {X Y : BoxProd k C D} (x : X ⟶ Y) : (map F G).map x = mapHom F G X Y x

name: StringDiagrams.BoxProd.map_tmulHom
statement:
@[simp] theorem map_tmulHom {X Y : BoxProd k C D} (f : X.fst ⟶ Y.fst) (g : X.snd ⟶ Y.snd) :
    (map F G).map (tmulHom f g) = tmulHom (F.map f) (G.map g)

name: StringDiagrams.BoxProd.map_id
statement: theorem map_id : map (Superfunctor.id k C) (Superfunctor.id k D) = Superfunctor.id k _

name: StringDiagrams.BoxProd.map_comp
statement:
theorem map_comp (F : Superfunctor k C C') (F' : Superfunctor k C' C'')
    (G : Superfunctor k D D') (G' : Superfunctor k D' D'') :
    map (F.comp F') (G.comp G') = (map F G).comp (map F' G')

name: StringDiagrams.BoxProd.induction_on_homogeneous₃
statement:
theorem induction_on_homogeneous₃ {X Y : BoxProd k (BoxProd k C D) E} {P : (X ⟶ Y) → Prop}
    (x : X ⟶ Y) (zero : P 0)
    (tmul : ∀ (a b c : ZMod 2) (f : X.fst.fst ⟶ Y.fst.fst) (g : X.fst.snd ⟶ Y.fst.snd)
      (h : X.snd ⟶ Y.snd), f ∈ parity (R := k) _ _ a → g ∈ parity (R := k) _ _ b →
      h ∈ parity (R := k) _ _ c → P (tmulHom (tmulHom (X := X.fst) (Y := Y.fst) f g) h))
    (add : ∀ x y, P x → P y → P (x + y)) : P x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_on_tmulHom with
  | zero => exact zero
  | add x y hx hy => exact add x y hx hy
  | tmul p c y h hy hh =>
    clear hy
    induction y using induction_on_tmulHom with
    | zero => convert zero using 1; exact zero_tmul _ _
    | add y y' h₁ h₂ => convert add _ _ h₁ h₂ using 1; exact add_tmul _ _ _
    | tmul a b f g hf hg => exact tmul a b c f g h hf hg hh

name: StringDiagrams.BoxProd.induction_on_homogeneous₃'
statement:
theorem induction_on_homogeneous₃' {X Y : BoxProd k C (BoxProd k D E)} {P : (X ⟶ Y) → Prop}
    (x : X ⟶ Y) (zero : P 0)
    (tmul : ∀ (a b c : ZMod 2) (f : X.fst ⟶ Y.fst) (g : X.snd.fst ⟶ Y.snd.fst)
      (h : X.snd.snd ⟶ Y.snd.snd), f ∈ parity (R := k) _ _ a → g ∈ parity (R := k) _ _ b →
      h ∈ parity (R := k) _ _ c → P (tmulHom (X := X) (Y := Y) f (tmulHom (X := X.snd) (Y := Y.snd) g h)))
    (add : ∀ x y, P x → P y → P (x + y)) : P x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_on_tmulHom with
  | zero => exact zero
  | add x y hx hy => exact add x y hx hy
  | tmul a p f y hf hy =>
    clear hy
    induction y using induction_on_tmulHom with
    | zero => convert zero using 1; exact tmul_zero _ _
    | add y y' h₁ h₂ => convert add _ _ h₁ h₂ using 1; exact tmul_add _ _ _
    | tmul b c g h hg hh => exact tmul a b c f g h hf hg hh

name: StringDiagrams.BoxProd.assocHom_tmul
statement:
theorem assocHom_tmul {X Y : BoxProd k (BoxProd k C D) E} (f : X.fst.fst ⟶ Y.fst.fst)
    (g : X.fst.snd ⟶ Y.fst.snd) (h : X.snd ⟶ Y.snd) :
    assocHom X Y (tmulHom (tmulHom (X := X.fst) (Y := Y.fst) f g) h) =
      tmulHom (X := assocObj C D E X) (Y := assocObj C D E Y) f
        (tmulHom (X := (assocObj C D E X).snd) (Y := (assocObj C D E Y).snd) g h)

name: StringDiagrams.BoxProd.assocInvHom_tmul
statement:
theorem assocInvHom_tmul {X Y : BoxProd k C (BoxProd k D E)} (f : X.fst ⟶ Y.fst)
    (g : X.snd.fst ⟶ Y.snd.fst) (h : X.snd.snd ⟶ Y.snd.snd) :
    assocInvHom X Y (tmulHom (X := X) (Y := Y) f (tmulHom (X := X.snd) (Y := Y.snd) g h)) =
      tmulHom (tmulHom (X := (assocInvObj C D E X).fst) (Y := (assocInvObj C D E Y).fst) f g) h

name: StringDiagrams.BoxProd.assocHom_assocInvHom
statement:
theorem assocHom_assocInvHom {X Y : BoxProd k C (BoxProd k D E)} (x : X ⟶ Y) :
    assocHom (assocInvObj C D E X) (assocInvObj C D E Y) (assocInvHom X Y x) = x

name: StringDiagrams.BoxProd.assocInvHom_assocHom
statement:
theorem assocInvHom_assocHom {X Y : BoxProd k (BoxProd k C D) E} (x : X ⟶ Y) :
    assocInvHom (assocObj C D E X) (assocObj C D E Y) (assocHom X Y x) = x

name: StringDiagrams.BoxProd.assocInvHom_assocHom'
StringDiagrams.BoxProd.tmul_tmul_mem_parity
proof:
:=
  tmul_mem_parity (tmul_mem_parity (X := X.fst) (Y := Y.fst) hf hg) hh

name: StringDiagrams.BoxProd.tmul_tmul_mem_parity'
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_assoc]; exact tmul_mem_parity hf (tmul_mem_parity (X := X.snd) (Y := Y.snd) hg hh)

name: StringDiagrams.BoxProd.assocHom_comp
statement:
theorem assocHom_comp {X Y Z : BoxProd k (BoxProd k C D) E} (x : X ⟶ Y) (y : Y ⟶ Z) :
    assocHom X Z (x ≫ y) = assocHom X Y x ≫ assocHom Y Z y
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_on_homogeneous₃ with
  | zero => rw [Limits.zero_comp, map_zero, map_zero, Limits.zero_comp]
  | add x x' hx hx' => rw [Preadditive.add_comp, map_add, map_add, Preadditive.add_comp, hx, hx']
  | tmul a b c f g h hf hg hh =>
    induction y using induction_on_homogeneous₃ with
    | zero => rw [Limits.comp_zero, map_zero, map_zero, Limits.comp_zero]
    | add y y' hy hy' => rw [Preadditive.comp_add, map_add, map_add, Preadditive.comp_add, hy, hy']
    | tmul a' b' c' f' g' h' hf' hg' hh' =>
      rw [tmulHom_comp_tmulHom (tmulHom_mem_parity (X := X.fst) (Y := Y.fst) hf hg) _ _ hh',
        tmulHom_comp_tmulHom hf _ _ hg', assocHom_tmul, assocHom_tmul,
        tmulHom_comp_tmulHom (X := assocObj C D E X) (Y := assocObj C D E Y)
          (Z := assocObj C D E Z) hf _ _ (tmulHom_mem_parity (X := (assocObj C D E Y).snd) (Y := (assocObj C D E Z).snd) hg' hh'),
        tmulHom_comp_tmulHom (X := (assocObj C D E X).snd) (Y := (assocObj C D E Y).snd)
          (Z := (assocObj C D E Z).snd) hg _ _ hh']
      rw [tmulHom_zsmul_left, map_zsmul, map_zsmul, assocHom_tmul, tmulHom_zsmul_right, smul_smul,
        smul_smul, koszulSign_add_left, koszulSign_add_right]
      congr 1
      ring

name: StringDiagrams.BoxProd.assocHom_proj
statement:
theorem assocHom_proj {X Y : BoxProd k (BoxProd k C D) E} (p : ZMod 2) (x : X ⟶ Y) :
    assocHom X Y (proj k p x) = proj k p (assocHom X Y x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_on_homogeneous₃ with
  | zero => simp only [map_zero]
  | add x x' hx hx' => simp only [map_add, hx, hx']
  | tmul a b c f g h hf hg hh =>
    refine Superfunctor.map_proj_of_mem _ (tmul_tmul_mem_parity hf hg hh) ?_ p
    rw [assocHom_tmul]
    exact tmul_tmul_mem_parity' hf hg hh

name: StringDiagrams.BoxProd.assocInvHom_comp
statement:
theorem assocInvHom_comp {X Y Z : BoxProd k C (BoxProd k D E)} (x : X ⟶ Y) (y : Y ⟶ Z) :
    assocInvHom X Z (x ≫ y) = assocInvHom X Y x ≫ assocInvHom Y Z y
proof:
:= by
  have h := assocHom_comp (assocInvHom X Y x) (assocInvHom Y Z y)
  rw [assocHom_assocInvHom, assocHom_assocInvHom] at h
  rw [← h, assocInvHom_assocHom']

name: StringDiagrams.BoxProd.assocInvHom_proj
statement:
theorem assocInvHom_proj {X Y : BoxProd k C (BoxProd k D E)} (p : ZMod 2) (x : X ⟶ Y) :
    assocInvHom X Y (proj k p x) = proj k p (assocInvHom X Y x)
proof:
:= by
  have h := assocHom_proj p (assocInvHom X Y x)
  rw [assocHom_assocInvHom] at h
  rw [← h, assocInvHom_assocHom']

name: StringDiagrams.BoxProd.assoc_obj
statement:
@[simp] theorem assoc_obj (X : BoxProd k (BoxProd k C D) E) :
    (assoc C D E).obj X = ⟨X.fst.fst, ⟨X.fst.snd, X.snd⟩⟩

name: StringDiagrams.BoxProd.assocInv_obj
statement:
@[simp] theorem assocInv_obj (X : BoxProd k C (BoxProd k D E)) :
    (assocInv C D E).obj X = ⟨⟨X.fst, X.snd.fst⟩, X.snd.snd⟩

name: StringDiagrams.BoxProd.assoc_map_tmulHom
statement:
@[simp] theorem assoc_map_tmulHom {X Y : BoxProd k (BoxProd k C D) E}
    (f : X.fst.fst ⟶ Y.fst.fst) (g : X.fst.snd ⟶ Y.fst.snd) (h : X.snd ⟶ Y.snd) :
    (assoc C D E).map (tmulHom (tmulHom (X := X.fst) (Y := Y.fst) f g) h) =
      tmulHom (X := assocObj C D E X) (Y := assocObj C D E Y) f
        (tmulHom (X := (assocObj C D E X).snd) (Y := (assocObj C D E Y).snd) g h)

name: StringDiagrams.BoxProd.assocInv_map_tmulHom
statement:
@[simp] theorem assocInv_map_tmulHom {X Y : BoxProd k C (BoxProd k D E)}
    (f : X.fst ⟶ Y.fst) (g : X.snd.fst ⟶ Y.snd.fst) (h : X.snd.snd ⟶ Y.snd.snd) :
    (assocInv C D E).map (tmulHom (X := X) (Y := Y) f (tmulHom (X := X.snd) (Y := Y.snd) g h)) =
      tmulHom (tmulHom (X := (assocInvObj C D E X).fst) (Y := (assocInvObj C D E Y).fst) f g) h

name: StringDiagrams.BoxProd.assoc_comp_assocInv
statement: theorem assoc_comp_assocInv : (assoc C D E).comp (assocInv C D E) = Superfunctor.id k _
proof:
:=
  Superfunctor.ext (CategoryTheory.Functor.hext (fun _ => rfl) fun _ _ x =>
    heq_of_eq (assocInvHom_assocHom x))

name: StringDiagrams.BoxProd.assocInv_comp_assoc
statement: theorem assocInv_comp_assoc : (assocInv C D E).comp (assoc C D E) = Superfunctor.id k _

:=
  Superfunctor.ext (CategoryTheory.Functor.hext (fun _ => rfl) fun _ _ x =>
    heq_of_eq (assocHom_assocInvHom x))

name: StringDiagrams.BoxProd.map_map_comp_assoc
statement:
theorem map_map_comp_assoc (F : Superfunctor k C C') (G : Superfunctor k D D')
    (H : Superfunctor k E E') :
    (map (map F G) H).comp (assoc C' D' E') = (assoc C D E).comp (map F (map G H))
proof:
:= by
  refine Superfunctor.ext (CategoryTheory.Functor.hext (fun _ => rfl) fun X Y x => heq_of_eq ?_)
  change assocHom _ _ (mapHom (map F G) H X Y x) = mapHom F (map G H) _ _ (assocHom X Y x)
  induction x using induction_on_homogeneous₃ with
  | zero => rw [map_zero, map_zero, map_zero, map_zero]; rfl
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, map_add, map_add, hx, hy]; rfl
  | tmul a b c f g h _ _ _ => rfl

name: StringDiagrams.BoxProd.lunitHom_tmul
statement:
theorem lunitHom_tmul {X Y : BoxProd k (BoxUnit.{w, u} k) C} (r : X.fst ⟶ Y.fst)

statement:
theorem lunitInvHom_apply {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) :

name: StringDiagrams.BoxProd.runitHom_tmul
statement:
theorem runitHom_tmul {X Y : BoxProd k C (BoxUnit.{w, u} k)} (f : X.fst ⟶ Y.fst)
    (r : X.snd ⟶ Y.snd) : runitHom X Y (tmulHom f r) = (r : k) • f

name: StringDiagrams.BoxProd.runitInvHom_apply
statement:
theorem runitInvHom_apply {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    runitInvHom.{w} (k := k) X Y f = tmulHom (X := ⟨X, BoxUnit.star⟩) (Y := ⟨Y, BoxUnit.star⟩) f (1 : k)

name: StringDiagrams.BoxProd.lunitHom_lunitInvHom
statement: theorem lunitHom_lunitInvHom {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) : lunitHom _ _ (lunitInvHom.{w} (k := k) X Y f) = f

statement: theorem runitHom_runitInvHom {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) : runitHom _ _ (runitInvHom.{w} (k := k) X Y f) = f

StringDiagrams.BoxProd.runitInvHom_runitHom
statement:
theorem runitInvHom_runitHom {X Y : BoxProd k C (BoxUnit.{w, u} k)} (x : X ⟶ Y) :
    runitInvHom X.fst Y.fst (runitHom X Y x) = x

name: StringDiagrams.BoxProd.lunitHom_comp
statement:
theorem lunitHom_comp {X Y Z : BoxProd k (BoxUnit.{w, u} k) C} (x : X ⟶ Y) (y : Y ⟶ Z) :
    lunitHom X Z (x ≫ y) = lunitHom X Y x ≫ lunitHom Y Z y
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_on_tmulHom with
  | zero => rw [Limits.zero_comp, map_zero, map_zero, Limits.zero_comp]
  | add x x' hx hx' => rw [Preadditive.add_comp, map_add, map_add, Preadditive.add_comp, hx, hx']
  | tmul a b r f _ _ =>
    induction y using induction_on_tmulHom with
    | zero => rw [Limits.comp_zero, map_zero, map_zero, Limits.comp_zero]
    | add y y' hy hy' => rw [Preadditive.comp_add, map_add, map_add, Preadditive.comp_add, hy, hy']
    | tmul c d s g _ hg =>
      rw [tmulHom_comp_tmulHom (BoxUnit.mem_parity_zero r) f s hg,
        koszulSign_zero_left, one_smul, lunitHom_tmul, lunitHom_tmul, lunitHom_tmul,
        Linear.smul_comp, Linear.comp_smul, smul_smul, BoxUnit.comp_eq, mul_comm]

name: StringDiagrams.BoxProd.runitHom_comp
statement:
theorem runitHom_comp {X Y Z : BoxProd k C (BoxUnit.{w, u} k)} (x : X ⟶ Y) (y : Y ⟶ Z) :
    runitHom X Z (x ≫ y) = runitHom X Y x ≫ runitHom Y Z y
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_on_tmulHom with
  | zero => rw [Limits.zero_comp, map_zero, map_zero, Limits.zero_comp]
  | add x x' hx hx' => rw [Preadditive.add_comp, map_add, map_add, Preadditive.add_comp, hx, hx']
  | tmul a b f r hf _ =>
    induction y using induction_on_tmulHom with
    | zero => rw [Limits.comp_zero, map_zero, map_zero, Limits.comp_zero]
    | add y y' hy hy' => rw [Preadditive.comp_add, map_add, map_add, Preadditive.comp_add, hy, hy']
    | tmul c d g s _ _ =>
      rw [tmulHom_comp_tmulHom hf r g (BoxUnit.mem_parity_zero s),
        koszulSign_zero_right, one_smul, runitHom_tmul, runitHom_tmul, runitHom_tmul,
        Linear.smul_comp, Linear.comp_smul, smul_smul, BoxUnit.comp_eq, mul_comm]

name: StringDiagrams.BoxProd.lunitHom_proj
statement:
theorem lunitHom_proj {X Y : BoxProd k (BoxUnit.{w, u} k) C} (p : ZMod 2) (x : X ⟶ Y) :
    lunitHom X Y (proj k p x) = proj k p (lunitHom X Y x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_on_tmulHom with
  | zero => simp only [map_zero]
  | add x x' hx hx' => simp only [map_add, hx, hx']
  | tmul a b r f _ hf =>
    have h := tmulHom_mem_parity (X := X) (Y := Y) (BoxUnit.mem_parity_zero r) hf
    rw [zero_add] at h
    refine Superfunctor.map_proj_of_mem _ h ?_ p
    rw [lunitHom_tmul]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hf

name: StringDiagrams.BoxProd.runitHom_proj
statement:
theorem runitHom_proj {X Y : BoxProd k C (BoxUnit.{w, u} k)} (p : ZMod 2) (x : X ⟶ Y) :
    runitHom X Y (proj k p x) = proj k p (runitHom X Y x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_on_tmulHom with
  | zero => simp only [map_zero]
  | add x x' hx hx' => simp only [map_add, hx, hx']
  | tmul a b f r hf _ =>
    have h := tmulHom_mem_parity (X := X) (Y := Y) hf (BoxUnit.mem_parity_zero r)
    rw [add_zero] at h
    refine Superfunctor.map_proj_of_mem _ h ?_ p
    rw [runitHom_tmul]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hf

name: StringDiagrams.BoxProd.lunitInvHom_comp
statement:
theorem lunitInvHom_comp {X Y Z : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) :
    lunitInvHom.{w} (k := k) X Z (f ≫ g) = lunitInvHom X Y f ≫ lunitInvHom Y Z g
proof:
:= by
  have h := lunitHom_comp (lunitInvHom.{w} (k := k) X Y f) (lunitInvHom Y Z g)
  rw [lunitHom_lunitInvHom, lunitHom_lunitInvHom] at h
  rw [← h, lunitInvHom_lunitHom']

name: StringDiagrams.BoxProd.runitInvHom_comp
statement:
theorem runitInvHom_comp {X Y Z : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) :
    runitInvHom.{w} (k := k) X Z (f ≫ g) = runitInvHom X Y f ≫ runitInvHom Y Z g
proof:
:= by
  have h := runitHom_comp (runitInvHom.{w} (k := k) X Y f) (runitInvHom Y Z g)
  rw [runitHom_runitInvHom, runitHom_runitInvHom] at h
  rw [← h, runitInvHom_runitHom']

name: StringDiagrams.BoxProd.lunitInvHom_proj
statement:
theorem lunitInvHom_proj {X Y : C} (p : ZMod 2) (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    lunitInvHom.{w} (k := k) X Y (proj k p f) = proj k p (lunitInvHom X Y f)
proof:
:= by
  have h := lunitHom_proj p (lunitInvHom.{w} (k := k) X Y f)
  rw [lunitHom_lunitInvHom] at h
  rw [← h, lunitInvHom_lunitHom']

name: StringDiagrams.BoxProd.runitInvHom_proj
statement:
theorem runitInvHom_proj {X Y : C} (p : ZMod 2) (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    runitInvHom.{w} (k := k) X Y (proj k p f) = proj k p (runitInvHom X Y f)
proof:
:= by
  have h := runitHom_proj p (runitInvHom.{w} (k := k) X Y f)
  rw [runitHom_runitInvHom] at h
  rw [← h, runitInvHom_runitHom']

name: StringDiagrams.BoxProd.map_comp_lunit
statement:
theorem map_comp_lunit (F : Superfunctor k C C') :
    (map (Superfunctor.id k (BoxUnit.{w, u} k)) F).comp (lunit C') = (lunit C).comp F
proof:
:= by
  refine Superfunctor.ext (CategoryTheory.Functor.hext (fun _ => rfl) fun X Y x => heq_of_eq ?_)
  change lunitHom _ _ (mapHom _ F X Y x) = F.map (lunitHom X Y x)
  induction x using induction_on_tmulHom with
  | zero => rw [map_zero, map_zero, map_zero]; exact (F.toFunctor.map_zero _ _).symm
  | add x y hx hy =>
    rw [map_add, map_add, map_add, hx, hy]; exact (F.toFunctor.map_add).symm
  | tmul a b r f _ _ =>
    rw [mapHom_tmul, lunitHom_tmul, lunitHom_tmul]
    exact (F.toFunctor.map_smul _ _).symm

name: StringDiagrams.BoxProd.map_comp_runit
statement:
theorem map_comp_runit (F : Superfunctor k C C') :
    (map F (Superfunctor.id k (BoxUnit.{w, u} k))).comp (runit C') = (runit C).comp F
proof:
:= by
  refine Superfunctor.ext (CategoryTheory.Functor.hext (fun _ => rfl) fun X Y x => heq_of_eq ?_)
  change runitHom _ _ (mapHom F _ X Y x) = F.map (runitHom X Y x)
  induction x using induction_on_tmulHom with
  | zero => rw [map_zero, map_zero, map_zero]; exact (F.toFunctor.map_zero _ _).symm
  | add x y hx hy =>
    rw [map_add, map_add, map_add, hx, hy]; exact (F.toFunctor.map_add).symm
  | tmul a b f r _ _ =>
    rw [mapHom_tmul, runitHom_tmul, runitHom_tmul]
    exact (F.toFunctor.map_smul _ _).symm

name: StringDiagrams.BoxProd.pentagon
statement:
theorem pentagon :
    (map (assoc C D E) (Superfunctor.id k E')).comp
        ((assoc C (BoxProd k D E) E').comp (map (Superfunctor.id k C) (assoc D E E'))) =
      (assoc (BoxProd k C D) E E').comp (assoc C D (BoxProd k E E'))
proof:
:= by
  refine Superfunctor.ext (CategoryTheory.Functor.hext (fun _ => rfl) fun X Y x => heq_of_eq ?_)
  induction x using induction_on_homogeneous₃ with
  | zero => rw [Functor.map_zero, Functor.map_zero]; rfl
  | add x y hx hy => rw [Functor.map_add, Functor.map_add, hx, hy]; rfl
  | tmul a b c f g h hf _ _ =>
    clear hf
    induction f using induction_on_tmulHom with
    | zero =>
      have h0 : tmulHom (tmulHom (X := X.fst) (Y := Y.fst) (0 : X.fst.fst ⟶ Y.fst.fst) g) h = 0 := by
        rw [tmulHom_zero_left, tmulHom_zero_left]
      rw [h0, Functor.map_zero, Functor.map_zero]; rfl
    | add f f' h₁ h₂ =>
      rw [tmulHom_add_left, tmulHom_add_left, Functor.map_add, Functor.map_add, h₁, h₂]; rfl
    | tmul _ _ _ _ _ _ => rfl

name: StringDiagrams.BoxProd.triangle
statement:
theorem triangle :
    (assoc C (BoxUnit.{w, u} k) D).comp (map (Superfunctor.id k C) (lunit D)) =
      map (runit C) (Superfunctor.id k D)
proof:
:= by
  refine Superfunctor.ext (CategoryTheory.Functor.hext (fun _ => rfl) fun X Y x => heq_of_eq ?_)
  induction x using induction_on_homogeneous₃ with
  | zero => rw [Functor.map_zero, Functor.map_zero]; rfl
  | add x y hx hy => rw [Functor.map_add, Functor.map_add, hx, hy]; rfl
  | tmul a b c f r g _ _ _ =>
    change tmulHom (X := ⟨X.fst.fst, X.snd⟩) (Y := ⟨Y.fst.fst, Y.snd⟩) f
        (lunitHom (⟨X.fst.snd, X.snd⟩ : BoxProd k (BoxUnit.{w, u} k) D) ⟨Y.fst.snd, Y.snd⟩
          (tmulHom (X := ⟨X.fst.snd, X.snd⟩) (Y := ⟨Y.fst.snd, Y.snd⟩) r g)) =
      tmulHom (X := ⟨X.fst.fst, X.snd⟩) (Y := ⟨Y.fst.fst, Y.snd⟩)
        (runitHom X.fst Y.fst (tmulHom (X := X.fst) (Y := Y.fst) f r)) g
    rw [lunitHom_tmul, runitHom_tmul, tmulHom_smul_left, tmulHom_smul_right]
