name: StringDiagrams.SCat.pentagon'
statement:
theorem pentagon' (W X Y Z : SCat.{u, u, w} k) :
    (α_ W X Y).hom ▷ Z ≫ (α_ W (X ⊗ Y) Z).hom ≫ W ◁ (α_ X Y Z).hom =
      (α_ (W ⊗ X) Y Z).hom ≫ (α_ W X (Y ⊗ Z)).hom
proof:
:= by
  refine Superfunctor.ext (CategoryTheory.Functor.hext (fun _ => rfl) fun A B x => heq_of_eq ?_)
  induction x using BoxProd.induction_on_homogeneous₃ with
  | zero => rw [Functor.map_zero, Functor.map_zero]; rfl
  | add x y hx hy => rw [Functor.map_add, Functor.map_add, hx, hy]; rfl
  | tmul a b c f g h hf _ _ =>
    clear hf
    induction f using BoxProd.induction_on_tmulHom with
    | zero =>
      have h0 : BoxProd.tmulHom (BoxProd.tmulHom (X := A.fst) (Y := B.fst)
          (0 : A.fst.fst ⟶ B.fst.fst) g) h = 0 := by
        rw [BoxProd.tmulHom_zero_left, BoxProd.tmulHom_zero_left]
      rw [h0, Functor.map_zero, Functor.map_zero]; rfl
    | add f f' h₁ h₂ =>
      rw [BoxProd.tmulHom_add_left, BoxProd.tmulHom_add_left, Functor.map_add, Functor.map_add,
        h₁, h₂]; rfl
    | tmul _ _ _ _ _ _ => rfl

name: StringDiagrams.SCat.triangle'
statement:
theorem triangle' (X Y : SCat.{u, u, w} k) :
    (α_ X (𝟙_ _) Y).hom ≫ X ◁ (λ_ Y).hom = (ρ_ X).hom ▷ Y
proof:
:= by
  refine Superfunctor.ext (CategoryTheory.Functor.hext (fun _ => rfl) fun A B x => heq_of_eq ?_)
  induction x using BoxProd.induction_on_homogeneous₃ with
  | zero => rw [Functor.map_zero, Functor.map_zero]; rfl
  | add x y hx hy => rw [Functor.map_add, Functor.map_add, hx, hy]; rfl
  | tmul a b c f r g _ _ _ =>
    change BoxProd.tmulHom (X := ⟨A.fst.fst, A.snd⟩) (Y := ⟨B.fst.fst, B.snd⟩) f
        (BoxProd.lunitHom (⟨A.fst.snd, A.snd⟩ : BoxProd k (BoxUnit.{w, u} k) Y)
          ⟨B.fst.snd, B.snd⟩
          (BoxProd.tmulHom (X := ⟨A.fst.snd, A.snd⟩) (Y := ⟨B.fst.snd, B.snd⟩) r g)) =
      BoxProd.tmulHom (X := ⟨A.fst.fst, A.snd⟩) (Y := ⟨B.fst.fst, B.snd⟩)
        (BoxProd.runitHom A.fst B.fst (BoxProd.tmulHom (X := A.fst) (Y := B.fst) f r)) g
    rw [BoxProd.lunitHom_tmul, BoxProd.runitHom_tmul, BoxProd.tmulHom_smul_left,
      BoxProd.tmulHom_smul_right]

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiCategory.whiskerLeft_neg'
statement: theorem whiskerLeft_neg' (X : D) {Y Z : D} (f : Y ⟶ Z) : X ◁ (-f) = -(X ◁ f)

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiCategory.neg_whiskerRight'
statement: theorem neg_whiskerRight' {X Y : D} (f : X ⟶ Y) (Z : D) : (-f) ▷ Z = -(f ▷ Z)

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiCategory.ξ_whiskerRight_pi
statement:
theorem ξ_whiskerRight_pi :
    (𝛏).hom ▷ 𝛑 ≫ (λ_ 𝛑).hom = (α_ 𝛑 𝛑 𝛑).hom ≫ 𝛑 ◁ (𝛏).hom ≫ (ρ_ 𝛑).hom
proof:
:= by
  have h := ξ_comm (R := R) (D := D) 𝛑
  rw [β_pi (R := R), whiskerLeft_neg', neg_whiskerRight']
    at h
  simp only [MonoidalCategory.whiskerLeft_id, MonoidalCategory.id_whiskerRight,
    Preadditive.neg_comp, Preadditive.comp_neg, neg_neg, Category.id_comp,
    Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc] at h
  rw [← h]
  simp [← MonoidalCategory.whiskerLeft_comp_assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiCategory.ξL_hom
statement: theorem ξL_hom (X : D) : (ξL (R := R) X).hom = (α_ 𝛑 𝛑 X).inv ≫ (𝛏).hom ▷ X ≫ (λ_ X).hom

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiCategory.ξL_inv
statement: theorem ξL_inv (X : D) : (ξL (R := R) X).inv = (λ_ X).inv ≫ (𝛏).inv ▷ X ≫ (α_ 𝛑 𝛑 X).hom

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiCategory.ξL_naturality
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem ξL_naturality {X Y : D} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    𝛑 ◁ 𝛑 ◁ f ≫ (ξL (R := R) Y).hom = (ξL (R := R) X).hom ≫ f
proof:
:= by
  rw [ξL_hom, ξL_hom, associator_inv_naturality_right_assoc, whisker_exchange_assoc,
    leftUnitor_naturality]
  simp only [Category.assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiCategory.ξL_pi
statement: theorem ξL_pi (X : D) : (ξL (R := R) (𝛑 ⊗ X)).hom = 𝛑 ◁ (ξL (R := R) X).hom
proof:
:= by
  have key : (𝛏).hom ▷ (𝛑 ⊗ X) ≫ (λ_ (𝛑 ⊗ X)).hom =
      (α_ (𝛑 ⊗ 𝛑) 𝛑 X).inv ≫ ((𝛏).hom ▷ 𝛑 ≫ (λ_ 𝛑).hom) ▷ X := by monoidal
  rw [ξL_hom, ξL_hom, key, ξ_whiskerRight_pi]
  monoidal

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiCategory.pi_obj
statement: @[simp] theorem pi_obj (X : D) : (PiCategory.pi (R := R)).obj X = 𝛑 ⊗ X

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiCategory.pi_map
statement: @[simp] theorem pi_map {X Y : D} (f : X ⟶ Y) : (PiCategory.pi (R := R)).map f = 𝛑 ◁ f

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiCategory.ξApp_hom
statement: @[simp] theorem ξApp_hom (X : D) : (PiCategory.ξApp (R := R) X).hom = (ξL (R := R) X).hom

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiCategory.ξApp_inv
statement: @[simp] theorem ξApp_inv (X : D) : (PiCategory.ξApp (R := R) X).inv = (ξL (R := R) X).inv

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiCategory.ξ_hom_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem ξ_hom_app (X : D) :
    (PiCategory.ξ (R := R) (C := D)).hom.app X = (ξL (R := R) X).hom

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiCategory.ξ_inv_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem ξ_inv_app (X : D) :
    (PiCategory.ξ (R := R) (C := D)).inv.app X = (ξL (R := R) X).inv

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiCategory.β_inv_naturality
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem β_inv_naturality {X Y : D} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    f ▷ 𝛑 ≫ ((𝛃).β Y).inv = ((𝛃).β X).inv ≫ 𝛑 ◁ f

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiCategory.β_pi_tensor_hom
statement:
theorem β_pi_tensor_hom (X : D) :
    ((𝛃).β (𝛑 ⊗ X)).hom = -(𝛑 ◁ ((𝛃).β X).hom ≫ (α_ 𝛑 X 𝛑).inv)
proof:
:= by
  rw [HalfBraiding.monoidal, β_pi (R := R), neg_whiskerRight', MonoidalCategory.id_whiskerRight]
  simp

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiCategory.β_pi_tensor_inv
statement:
theorem β_pi_tensor_inv (X : D) :
    ((𝛃).β (𝛑 ⊗ X)).inv = -((α_ 𝛑 X 𝛑).hom ≫ 𝛑 ◁ ((𝛃).β X).inv)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cancel_epi ((𝛃).β (𝛑 ⊗ X)).hom, Iso.hom_inv_id, β_pi_tensor_hom]
  simp [← MonoidalCategory.whiskerLeft_comp]

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiCategory.β_pi_inv
statement: theorem β_pi_inv : ((𝛃).β 𝛑).inv = -𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cancel_epi ((𝛃).β 𝛑).hom, Iso.hom_inv_id, β_pi (R := R)]
  simp

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiCategory.βL_hom
statement:
theorem βL_hom (X Z : D) :
    (βL (R := R) X Z).hom = (α_ 𝛑 X Z).inv ≫ ((𝛃).β X).hom ▷ Z ≫ (α_ X 𝛑 Z).hom

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiCategory.βL_inv
statement:
theorem βL_inv (X Z : D) :
    (βL (R := R) X Z).inv = (α_ X 𝛑 Z).inv ≫ ((𝛃).β X).inv ▷ Z ≫ (α_ 𝛑 X Z).hom

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiCategory.βL_naturality
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem βL_naturality (X : D) {Z Z' : D} (f : Z ⟶ Z') :
    𝛑 ◁ X ◁ f ≫ (βL (R := R) X Z').hom = (βL (R := R) X Z).hom ≫ X ◁ 𝛑 ◁ f
proof:
:= by
  simp only [βL_hom, Category.assoc]
  rw [associator_inv_naturality_right_assoc, whisker_exchange_assoc,
    associator_naturality_right]

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiCategory.βL_comm
statement:
theorem βL_comm (X Z : D) :
    (ξL (R := R) (X ⊗ Z)).hom ≫ X ◁ (ξL (R := R) Z).inv =
      𝛑 ◁ (βL (R := R) X Z).hom ≫ (βL (R := R) X (𝛑 ⊗ Z)).hom
proof:
:= by
  have h := ξ_comm (R := R) (D := D) X
  have key : (ξL (R := R) (X ⊗ Z)).hom ≫ X ◁ (ξL (R := R) Z).inv =
      ((α_ 𝛑 𝛑 (X ⊗ Z)).inv ≫ (α_ (𝛑 ⊗ 𝛑) X Z).inv) ≫
        ((𝛏).hom ▷ X ≫ (λ_ X).hom ≫ (ρ_ X).inv ≫ X ◁ (𝛏).inv) ▷ Z ≫
          ((α_ X (𝛑 ⊗ 𝛑) Z).hom ≫ X ◁ (α_ 𝛑 𝛑 Z).hom) := by
    rw [ξL_hom, ξL_inv]; monoidal
  rw [key, h, βL_hom, βL_hom]
  monoidal

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiCategory.tensorLeftPi_β_hom_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem tensorLeftPi_β_hom_app (X Z : D) :
    (tensorLeftPi R X).β.hom.app Z = (βL (R := R) X Z).hom

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiCategory.tensorLeftPi_β_inv_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem tensorLeftPi_β_inv_app (X Z : D) :
    (tensorLeftPi R X).β.inv.app Z = (βL (R := R) X Z).inv

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiCategory.αR_comm
statement:
theorem αR_comm (X Y : D) :
    (ξL (R := R) (X ⊗ Y)).hom ≫ (ξL (R := R) X).inv ▷ Y =
      𝛑 ◁ (α_ 𝛑 X Y).inv ≫ (α_ 𝛑 (𝛑 ⊗ X) Y).inv
proof:
:= by
  have key : (ξL (R := R) (X ⊗ Y)).hom ≫ (ξL (R := R) X).inv ▷ Y =
      (α_ 𝛑 𝛑 (X ⊗ Y)).inv ≫ ((𝛏).hom ▷ (X ⊗ Y) ≫ (𝛏).inv ▷ (X ⊗ Y)) ≫
        (α_ (𝛑 ⊗ 𝛑) X Y).inv ≫ (α_ 𝛑 𝛑 X).hom ▷ Y := by
    rw [ξL_hom, ξL_inv]; monoidal
  rw [key, ← MonoidalCategory.comp_whiskerRight, Iso.hom_inv_id,
    MonoidalCategory.id_whiskerRight]
  monoidal

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiCategory.tensorRightPi_β_hom_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem tensorRightPi_β_hom_app (X Y : D) :
    (tensorRightPi R Y).β.hom.app X = (α_ 𝛑 X Y).inv

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiCategory.tensorRightPi_β_inv_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem tensorRightPi_β_inv_app (X Y : D) :
    (tensorRightPi R Y).β.inv.app X = (α_ 𝛑 X Y).hom

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiCategory.βL_inv_naturality_left
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem βL_inv_naturality_left {X X' : D} (f : X ⟶ X') (Z : D) :
    f ▷ (𝛑 ⊗ Z) ≫ (βL (R := R) X' Z).inv = (βL (R := R) X Z).inv ≫ 𝛑 ◁ f ▷ Z
proof:
:= by
  simp only [βL_inv, Category.assoc]
  rw [associator_inv_naturality_left_assoc, ← MonoidalCategory.comp_whiskerRight_assoc,
    β_inv_naturality, MonoidalCategory.comp_whiskerRight_assoc, associator_naturality_middle]

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiCategory.β_unit
statement: theorem β_unit : ((𝛃).β (𝟙_ D)).hom ≫ (λ_ 𝛑).hom = (ρ_ 𝛑).hom
proof:
:= by
  set b := ((𝛃).β (𝟙_ D)).hom with hbdef
  set e := (ρ_ 𝛑).inv ≫ b ≫ (λ_ 𝛑).hom with he
  have hb : b = (ρ_ 𝛑).hom ≫ e ≫ (λ_ 𝛑).inv := by simp [he]
  have H := (𝛃).naturality (λ_ (𝟙_ D)).hom
  rw [HalfBraiding.monoidal, ← hbdef, hb] at H
  have H2 : ((𝛑 ◁ (λ_ (𝟙_ D)).hom ≫ (ρ_ 𝛑).hom) ≫ e) ≫ (λ_ 𝛑).inv =
      ((𝛑 ◁ (λ_ (𝟙_ D)).hom ≫ (ρ_ 𝛑).hom) ≫ (e ≫ e)) ≫ (λ_ 𝛑).inv := by
    calc _ = 𝛑 ◁ (λ_ (𝟙_ D)).hom ≫ (ρ_ 𝛑).hom ≫ e ≫ (λ_ 𝛑).inv := by simp
      _ = _ := H
      _ = _ := by monoidal
  have H3 : e = e ≫ e := by
    have := (cancel_mono _).1 H2
    exact (cancel_epi _).1 this
  have hiso : IsIso e := by rw [he]; infer_instance
  have he1 : e = 𝟙 _ := by
    rw [← cancel_mono e, Category.id_comp]; exact H3.symm
  rw [hb, he1]; simp

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiFunctor.βF_hom
statement: theorem βF_hom (X : D) : (hF.βF X).hom = hF.j.hom ▷ F.obj X ≫ μ F 𝛑D X

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiFunctor.βF_inv
statement: theorem βF_inv (X : D) : (hF.βF X).inv = δ F 𝛑D X ≫ hF.j.inv ▷ F.obj X

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiFunctor.βF_naturality
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem βF_naturality {X Y : D} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    𝛑E ◁ F.map f ≫ (hF.βF Y).hom = (hF.βF X).hom ≫ F.map (𝛑D ◁ f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [βF_hom, βF_hom, whisker_exchange_assoc, μ_natural_right, Category.assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiFunctor.βF_comm
statement:
theorem βF_comm (X : D) :
    (ξL (R := R) (F.obj X)).hom ≫ F.map (ξL (R := R) X).inv =
      𝛑E ◁ (hF.βF X).hom ≫ (hF.βF (𝛑D ⊗ X)).hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cancel_mono (F.map (ξL (R := R) X).hom), Category.assoc, ← F.map_comp, Iso.inv_hom_id,
    F.map_id, Category.comp_id]
  have hξ := hF.ξ_comm
  have e1 : (ξL (R := R) (F.obj X)).hom =
      (α_ 𝛑E 𝛑E (F.obj X)).inv ≫ ((𝛏E).hom ≫ ε F) ▷ F.obj X ≫ μ F (𝟙_ D) X ≫
        F.map (λ_ X).hom := by
    rw [ξL_hom, Functor.LaxMonoidal.left_unitality F X, MonoidalCategory.comp_whiskerRight_assoc]
  rw [e1, hξ, tensorHom_def', MonoidalCategory.comp_whiskerRight,
    MonoidalCategory.comp_whiskerRight, MonoidalCategory.comp_whiskerRight]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [μ_natural_left_assoc, βF_hom, βF_hom, ξL_hom, F.map_comp, F.map_comp,
    MonoidalCategory.whiskerLeft_comp_assoc]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [whisker_exchange_assoc, Functor.LaxMonoidal.associativity_inv_assoc]
  have e2 : (α_ 𝛑E 𝛑E (F.obj X)).inv ≫ (𝛑E ◁ hF.j.hom) ▷ F.obj X ≫
      hF.j.hom ▷ F.obj 𝛑D ▷ F.obj X =
      𝛑E ◁ hF.j.hom ▷ F.obj X ≫ hF.j.hom ▷ (F.obj 𝛑D ⊗ F.obj X) ≫
        (α_ (F.obj 𝛑D) (F.obj 𝛑D) (F.obj X)).inv := by monoidal
  rw [reassoc_of% e2]

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiFunctor.toPiFunctor_β_hom_app
statement: @[simp] theorem toPiFunctor_β_hom_app (X : D) : (hF.toPiFunctor R).β.hom.app X = (hF.βF X).hom

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiFunctor.toPiFunctor_β_inv_app
statement: @[simp] theorem toPiFunctor_β_inv_app (X : D) : (hF.toPiFunctor R).β.inv.app X = (hF.βF X).inv

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiFunctor.βL_βF
statement:
theorem βL_βF (X Y : D) :
    𝛑E ◁ μ F X Y ≫ (hF.βF (X ⊗ Y)).hom ≫ F.map (βL (R := R) X Y).hom =
      (βL (R := R) (F.obj X) (F.obj Y)).hom ≫ F.obj X ◁ (hF.βF Y).hom ≫ μ F X (𝛑D ⊗ Y)
proof:
:= by
  have hβ := hF.β_comm X
  rw [βF_hom, βL_hom, F.map_comp, F.map_comp]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [whisker_exchange_assoc, Functor.LaxMonoidal.associativity_inv_assoc,
    ← μ_natural_left_assoc]
  have e1 : hF.j.hom ▷ (F.obj X ⊗ F.obj Y) ≫ (α_ (F.obj 𝛑D) (F.obj X) (F.obj Y)).inv =
      (α_ 𝛑E (F.obj X) (F.obj Y)).inv ≫ (hF.j.hom ▷ F.obj X) ▷ F.obj Y := by monoidal
  rw [reassoc_of% e1, ← MonoidalCategory.comp_whiskerRight_assoc,
    ← MonoidalCategory.comp_whiskerRight_assoc]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [hβ]
  simp only [MonoidalCategory.comp_whiskerRight, Category.assoc]
  rw [Functor.LaxMonoidal.associativity, βF_hom, βL_hom]
  simp only [Category.assoc, MonoidalCategory.whiskerLeft_comp]
  have e2 : (F.obj X ◁ hF.j.hom) ▷ F.obj Y ≫ (α_ (F.obj X) (F.obj 𝛑D) (F.obj Y)).hom =
      (α_ (F.obj X) 𝛑E (F.obj Y)).hom ≫ F.obj X ◁ hF.j.hom ▷ F.obj Y := by monoidal
  rw [reassoc_of% e2]

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiFunctor.βL_βF_inv
statement:
theorem βL_βF_inv (X Y : D) :
    F.obj X ◁ (hF.βF Y).inv ≫ (βL (R := R) (F.obj X) (F.obj Y)).inv ≫ 𝛑E ◁ μ F X Y =
      μ F X (𝛑D ⊗ Y) ≫ F.map (βL (R := R) X Y).inv ≫ (hF.βF (X ⊗ Y)).inv
proof:
:= by
  have h := hF.βL_βF X Y
  rw [← cancel_epi (F.obj X ◁ (hF.βF Y).hom), ← MonoidalCategory.whiskerLeft_comp_assoc,
    Iso.hom_inv_id, MonoidalCategory.whiskerLeft_id, Category.id_comp,
    ← cancel_epi (βL (R := R) (F.obj X) (F.obj Y)).hom, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc,
    ← reassoc_of% h]
  simp [← F.map_comp_assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiFunctor.βF_inv_whiskerRight
statement:
theorem βF_inv_whiskerRight (Y X' : D) :
    μ F (𝛑D ⊗ Y) X' ≫ F.map (α_ 𝛑D Y X').hom ≫ (hF.βF (Y ⊗ X')).inv =
      (hF.βF Y).inv ▷ F.obj X' ≫ (α_ 𝛑E (F.obj Y) (F.obj X')).hom ≫ 𝛑E ◁ μ F Y X'
proof:
:= by
  rw [βF_inv, βF_inv, Functor.Monoidal.map_associator]
  simp only [Category.assoc, Functor.Monoidal.μ_δ_assoc,
    MonoidalCategory.comp_whiskerRight]
  rw [whisker_exchange]
  monoidal

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.homMk_comp_homMk_even
statement:
theorem homMk_comp_homMk_even {X Y Z : Associated R C} (f : X.obj ⟶ Y.obj) (g : Y.obj ⟶ Z.obj) :
    (homMk f 0 : X ⟶ Y) ≫ (homMk g 0 : Y ⟶ Z) = homMk (f ≫ g) 0

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.homMk_even_mem
statement:
theorem homMk_even_mem {X Y : Associated R C} (f : X.obj ⟶ Y.obj) :
    (homMk f 0 : X ⟶ Y) ∈ parity (R := R) X Y 0

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.map_naturality
statement:
theorem map_naturality {F G : C ⥤ E} [F.Additive] [F.Linear R] [G.Additive] [G.Linear R]
    {hF : PiFunctor R F} {hG : PiFunctor R G} {y : F ⟶ G} (hy : PiFunctor.IsPiNatural R hF hG y)
    {X Y : Associated R C} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    (map hF).map f ≫ homMk (Y := (map hG).obj Y) (y.app Y.obj) 0 =
      homMk (X := (map hF).obj X) (y.app X.obj) 0 ≫ (map hG).map f

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.map_map_map
statement:
theorem map_map_map {F G : D ⥤ D} [F.Additive] [G.Additive] (hF : PiFunctor R F)
    (hG : PiFunctor R G) {X Y : Associated R D} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    (map hG).map ((map hF).map f) = (map (hF.comp hG)).map f

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.map_id_map
statement: theorem map_id_map {X Y : Associated R D} (f : X ⟶ Y) : (map (PiFunctor.id R D)).map f = f

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.tensorObj_obj
statement: @[simp] theorem tensorObj_obj (X Y : Associated R D) : (X ⊗ Y).obj = X.obj ⊗ Y.obj

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.tensorUnit_obj
statement: @[simp] theorem tensorUnit_obj : (𝟙_ (Associated R D)).obj = 𝟙_ D

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.whiskerLeft_fst
statement:
@[simp] theorem whiskerLeft_fst (X : Associated R D) {Y Z : Associated R D} (g : Y ⟶ Z) :
    (X ◁ g).1 = X.obj ◁ g.1

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.whiskerLeft_snd
statement:
@[simp] theorem whiskerLeft_snd (X : Associated R D) {Y Z : Associated R D} (g : Y ⟶ Z) :
    (X ◁ g).2 = X.obj ◁ g.2 ≫ (βL (R := R) X.obj Z.obj).inv

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.whiskerRight_fst
statement:
@[simp] theorem whiskerRight_fst {X Y : Associated R D} (f : X ⟶ Y) (Z : Associated R D) :
    (f ▷ Z).1 = f.1 ▷ Z.obj

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.whiskerRight_snd
statement:
@[simp] theorem whiskerRight_snd {X Y : Associated R D} (f : X ⟶ Y) (Z : Associated R D) :
    (f ▷ Z).2 = f.2 ▷ Z.obj ≫ (α_ 𝛑 Y.obj Z.obj).hom

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.associator_hom_fst
statement:
@[simp] theorem associator_hom_fst (X Y Z : Associated R D) :
    (α_ X Y Z).hom.1 = (α_ X.obj Y.obj Z.obj).hom

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.associator_hom_snd
statement: @[simp] theorem associator_hom_snd (X Y Z : Associated R D) : (α_ X Y Z).hom.2 = 0

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.associator_inv_fst
statement:
@[simp] theorem associator_inv_fst (X Y Z : Associated R D) :
    (α_ X Y Z).inv.1 = (α_ X.obj Y.obj Z.obj).inv

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.associator_inv_snd
statement: @[simp] theorem associator_inv_snd (X Y Z : Associated R D) : (α_ X Y Z).inv.2 = 0

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.leftUnitor_hom_fst
statement: @[simp] theorem leftUnitor_hom_fst (X : Associated R D) : (λ_ X).hom.1 = (λ_ X.obj).hom

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.leftUnitor_hom_snd
statement: @[simp] theorem leftUnitor_hom_snd (X : Associated R D) : (λ_ X).hom.2 = 0

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.leftUnitor_inv_fst
statement: @[simp] theorem leftUnitor_inv_fst (X : Associated R D) : (λ_ X).inv.1 = (λ_ X.obj).inv

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.leftUnitor_inv_snd
statement: @[simp] theorem leftUnitor_inv_snd (X : Associated R D) : (λ_ X).inv.2 = 0

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.rightUnitor_hom_fst
statement: @[simp] theorem rightUnitor_hom_fst (X : Associated R D) : (ρ_ X).hom.1 = (ρ_ X.obj).hom

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.rightUnitor_hom_snd
statement: @[simp] theorem rightUnitor_hom_snd (X : Associated R D) : (ρ_ X).hom.2 = 0

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.rightUnitor_inv_fst
statement: @[simp] theorem rightUnitor_inv_fst (X : Associated R D) : (ρ_ X).inv.1 = (ρ_ X.obj).inv

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.rightUnitor_inv_snd
statement: @[simp] theorem rightUnitor_inv_snd (X : Associated R D) : (ρ_ X).inv.2 = 0

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.odd_odd_key
statement:
theorem odd_odd_key {X X' Y Y' : D} (f : X ⟶ 𝛑 ⊗ X') (g : Y ⟶ 𝛑 ⊗ Y') :
    X ◁ g ≫ (βL (R := R) X Y').inv ≫ 𝛑 ◁ f ▷ Y' ≫ 𝛑 ◁ (α_ 𝛑 X' Y').hom =
      -(f ▷ Y ≫ (α_ 𝛑 X' Y).hom ≫ 𝛑 ◁ X' ◁ g ≫ 𝛑 ◁ (βL (R := R) X' Y').inv)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← βL_inv_naturality_left_assoc, whisker_exchange_assoc, βL_inv, β_pi_tensor_inv,
    neg_whiskerRight', βL_inv]
  simp only [Preadditive.neg_comp, Preadditive.comp_neg]
  congr 1
  monoidal

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.super_interchange_assoc
proof:
:= by
  rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one p with rfl | rfl <;>
    rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one q with rfl | rfl
  · rw [mem_parity_zero] at hf hg
    rw [koszulSign_zero_left, one_smul]
    ext
    · simp [hf, hg, whisker_exchange]
    · simp [hf, hg]
  · rw [mem_parity_zero] at hf; rw [mem_parity_one] at hg
    rw [koszulSign_zero_left, one_smul]
    ext
    · simp [hf, hg]
    · simp only [comp_snd, whiskerRight_fst, whiskerLeft_snd, whiskerRight_snd, hf, hg,
        whiskerLeft_fst, MonoidalPreadditive.zero_whiskerRight, Limits.zero_comp, add_zero,
        zero_add, MonoidalPreadditive.whiskerLeft_zero, Limits.comp_zero,
        Category.assoc, MonoidalPiCategory.pi_obj, MonoidalPiCategory.pi_map]
      rw [← whisker_exchange_assoc, βL_inv_naturality_left]
  · rw [mem_parity_one] at hf; rw [mem_parity_zero] at hg
    rw [koszulSign_zero_right, one_smul]
    ext
    · simp [hf, hg]
    · simp only [comp_snd, whiskerRight_fst, whiskerLeft_snd, whiskerRight_snd, hf, hg,
        whiskerLeft_fst, MonoidalPreadditive.zero_whiskerRight, Limits.zero_comp, add_zero,
        zero_add, MonoidalPreadditive.whiskerLeft_zero, Limits.comp_zero, Category.assoc]
      rw [whisker_exchange_assoc]
      simp
  · rw [mem_parity_one] at hf hg
    rw [koszulSign_one_one, neg_one_smul]
    ext
    · simp only [comp_fst, whiskerRight_fst, whiskerLeft_snd, whiskerRight_snd, hf, hg,
        whiskerLeft_fst, neg_fst, MonoidalPreadditive.zero_whiskerRight,
        MonoidalPreadditive.whiskerLeft_zero, Limits.zero_comp, zero_sub, neg_neg,
        Category.assoc, PiCategory.pi, curriedTensor_obj_map, MonoidalCategory.whiskerLeft_comp,
        ξApp_hom, tensorObj_obj]
      rw [reassoc_of% (odd_odd_key (R := R) f.2 g.2)]
      simp
    · simp [hf, hg]

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.associator_naturality_left_assoc'
statement:
theorem associator_naturality_left_assoc' {X X' : Associated R D} (f : X ⟶ X')
    (Y Z : Associated R D) :
    (f ▷ Y) ▷ Z ≫ (α_ X' Y Z).hom = (α_ X Y Z).hom ≫ f ▷ (Y ⊗ Z)
proof:
:= by
  have h := map_naturality (αLeft_isPiNatural R Y.obj Z.obj) f
  rw [← map_map_map] at h
  exact h

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.associator_naturality_middle_assoc'
proof:
:= by

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.superTensorHom_odd_odd
statement:
theorem superTensorHom_odd_odd {X₁ Y₁ X₂ Y₂ : Associated R D} {f : X₁ ⟶ Y₁} {g : X₂ ⟶ Y₂}
    (hf : f.1 = 0) (hg : g.1 = 0) :
    MonoidalSupercategory.superTensorHom f g =
      homMk ((f.2 ⊗ₘ g.2) ≫ (α_ 𝛑 Y₁.obj (𝛑 ⊗ Y₂.obj)).hom ≫ 𝛑 ◁ (βL (R := R) Y₁.obj Y₂.obj).inv ≫
        (ξL (R := R) (Y₁.obj ⊗ Y₂.obj)).hom) 0
proof:
:= by
  ext
  · simp only [MonoidalSupercategory.superTensorHom, comp_fst, whiskerLeft_fst, whiskerRight_fst,
      whiskerLeft_snd, whiskerRight_snd, hf, hg, homMk_fst, MonoidalPreadditive.whiskerLeft_zero,
      MonoidalPreadditive.zero_whiskerRight, Limits.zero_comp, zero_sub, ξApp_hom,
      MonoidalPiCategory.pi_map, MonoidalCategory.whiskerLeft_comp,
      Category.assoc, tensorObj_obj]
    rw [reassoc_of% (odd_odd_key (R := R) f.2 g.2)]
    simp only [Preadditive.neg_comp, neg_neg, tensorHom_def, Category.assoc,
      MonoidalPiCategory.pi_obj, associator_naturality_right_assoc]
  · simp [MonoidalSupercategory.superTensorHom, hf, hg]

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.ξ_hom_eq
statement:
theorem ξ_hom_eq :
    (MonoidalPiSupercategory.ξ (R := R) (C := Associated R D)).hom =
      homMk (X := ⟨𝛑 ⊗ 𝛑⟩) (Y := 𝟙_ _) (𝛏).hom 0
proof:
:= by
  have hβ : (βL (R := R) 𝛑 (𝟙_ D)).inv = -𝟙 _ := by
    rw [βL_inv, β_pi_inv, neg_whiskerRight']; simp
  ext
  · simp [MonoidalPiSupercategory.ξ_hom, MonoidalPiSupercategory.ζR, ζ_eq, hβ]
    rw [ξL_hom]
    monoidal
  · simp [MonoidalPiSupercategory.ξ_hom, MonoidalPiSupercategory.ζR, ζ_eq]

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.β_hom_eq
statement:
theorem β_hom_eq (X : Associated R D) :
    (MonoidalPiSupercategory.β (R := R) X).hom =
      homMk (X := ⟨𝛑 ⊗ X.obj⟩) (Y := ⟨X.obj ⊗ 𝛑⟩) ((𝛃).β X.obj).hom 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cancel_mono (MonoidalPiSupercategory.ζR (R := R) X).hom]
  simp only [MonoidalPiSupercategory.β, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Category.assoc,
    Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]
  ext
  · simp [MonoidalPiSupercategory.ζL, MonoidalPiSupercategory.ζR, ζ_eq]
  · simp [MonoidalPiSupercategory.ζL, MonoidalPiSupercategory.ζR, ζ_eq]
    have e : ((𝛃).β X.obj).hom ≫ (ρ_ (X.obj ⊗ 𝛑)).inv ≫ (α_ X.obj 𝛑 (𝟙_ D)).hom ≫
        (βL (R := R) X.obj (𝟙_ D)).inv ≫ (α_ 𝛑 X.obj (𝟙_ D)).inv ≫ (ρ_ (𝛑 ⊗ X.obj)).hom =
        ((𝛃).β X.obj).hom ≫ (ρ_ (X.obj ⊗ 𝛑)).inv ≫ ((𝛃).β X.obj).inv ▷ 𝟙_ D ≫
          (ρ_ (𝛑 ⊗ X.obj)).hom := by
      rw [βL_inv]; monoidal
    rw [e, ← rightUnitor_inv_naturality_assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id]

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.jIso_mapMonoidal_hom
statement:
theorem jIso_mapMonoidal_hom :
    (MonoidalSuperfunctor.jIso (mapMonoidal hF)).hom =
      homMk (X := (⟨MonoidalPiCategory.pi (R := R) (D := E)⟩ : Associated R E))
        (Y := ⟨F.obj (MonoidalPiCategory.pi (R := R) (D := D))⟩) hF.j.hom 0
proof:
:= by
  ext
  · simp [MonoidalSuperfunctor.jIso, ζ_eq, mapMonoidal]
    simp only [MonoidalPiCategory.whiskerLeft_neg', Preadditive.neg_comp, Preadditive.comp_neg,
      neg_neg]
    have hin : ε F ≫ F.map (ξL (R := R) (𝟙_ D)).inv ≫
        F.map (α_ (MonoidalPiCategory.pi (R := R) (D := D)) (MonoidalPiCategory.pi (R := R))
          (𝟙_ D)).inv ≫ F.map (ρ_ (MonoidalPiCategory.pi (R := R) (D := D) ⊗
            MonoidalPiCategory.pi (R := R))).hom ≫
          (hF.βF (MonoidalPiCategory.pi (R := R) (D := D))).inv =
        (MonoidalPiCategory.ξ (R := R) (D := E)).inv ≫
          MonoidalPiCategory.pi (R := R) (D := E) ◁ hF.j.hom := by
      have e : F.map (ξL (R := R) (𝟙_ D)).inv ≫
          F.map (α_ (MonoidalPiCategory.pi (R := R) (D := D)) (MonoidalPiCategory.pi (R := R))
            (𝟙_ D)).inv ≫ F.map (ρ_ (MonoidalPiCategory.pi (R := R) (D := D) ⊗
              MonoidalPiCategory.pi (R := R))).hom =
          F.map (MonoidalPiCategory.ξ (R := R) (D := D)).inv := by
        rw [← F.map_comp, ← F.map_comp, MonoidalPiCategory.ξL_inv]
        congr 1
        monoidal
      rw [reassoc_of% e, ← cancel_epi (MonoidalPiCategory.ξ (R := R) (D := E)).hom,
        reassoc_of% hF.ξ_comm, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc, MonoidalPiFunctor.βF_inv]
      simp [tensorHom_def']
    rw [hin, MonoidalCategory.whiskerLeft_comp_assoc, MonoidalPiCategory.ξL_naturality,
      MonoidalPiCategory.ξL_hom]
    have h8 := MonoidalPiCategory.ξ_whiskerRight_pi R (D := E)
    simp only [Category.assoc]
    rw [reassoc_of% h8]
    simp
  · simp [MonoidalSuperfunctor.jIso, ζ_eq, mapMonoidal]

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.ξL_und_val
statement:
theorem ξL_und_val (X : Underlying R A) :
    (MonoidalPiCategory.ξL (R := R) X).hom.1 =
      -((ζL (R := R) (𝛑 ⊗ X.obj)).hom ≫ (ζL (R := R) X.obj).hom)
proof:
:= by
  rw [MonoidalPiCategory.ξL_hom]
  change (α_ 𝛑 𝛑 X.obj).inv ≫ (MonoidalPiSupercategory.ξ (R := R) (C := A)).hom ▷ X.obj ≫
    (λ_ X.obj).hom = _
  rw [ξ_whiskerRight_leftUnitor, ← associator_ζL]
  simp

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.Tmon_map_injective
statement:
theorem Tmon_map_injective {X Y : Associated R (Underlying R A)} {f g : X ⟶ Y}
    (h : (Tmon R A).map f = (Tmon R A).map g) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  have hζ := ζL_hom_mem (R := R) Y.obj.obj
  have hf1 : f.2.1 ≫ (ζL (R := R) Y.obj.obj).hom ∈ parity (R := R) X.obj.obj Y.obj.obj 1 := by
    simpa using comp_mem f.2.2 hζ
  have hg1 : g.2.1 ≫ (ζL (R := R) Y.obj.obj).hom ∈ parity (R := R) X.obj.obj Y.obj.obj 1 := by
    simpa using comp_mem g.2.2 hζ
  have hf0 : f.1.1 ∈ parity (R := R) X.obj.obj Y.obj.obj (1 + 1) := f.1.2
  have hg0 : g.1.1 ∈ parity (R := R) X.obj.obj Y.obj.obj (1 + 1) := g.1.2
  have e0 : f.1.1 = g.1.1 := by
    rw [← proj_eq_of_add (R := R) (p := 0) rfl f.1.2 hf1,
      ← proj_eq_of_add (R := R) (p := 0) rfl g.1.2 hg1]
    exact congrArg (proj R 0) h
  have e1 : f.2.1 ≫ (ζL (R := R) Y.obj.obj).hom = g.2.1 ≫ (ζL (R := R) Y.obj.obj).hom := by
    rw [← proj_eq_of_add (R := R) (p := 1) (add_comm _ _) hf1 hf0,
      ← proj_eq_of_add (R := R) (p := 1) (add_comm _ _) hg1 hg0]
    exact congrArg (proj R 1) h
  exact hom_ext (Subtype.ext e0) (Subtype.ext ((cancel_mono _).1 e1))

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.Tmon_map_TmonInv_map

statement: theorem TmonInv_comp_Tmon : TmonInv R A ⋙ Tmon R A = 𝟭 A

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.Tmon_map_ζ
statement:
theorem Tmon_map_ζ :
    (Tmon R A).map (MonoidalPiSupercategory.ζ (R := R) (C := Associated R (Underlying R A))).hom =
      (MonoidalPiSupercategory.ζ (R := R) (C := A)).hom
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Tmon_map, ζ_eq, ζUnit_hom_fst, ζUnit_hom_snd, Underlying.zero_val, zero_add]
  change (ρ_ 𝛑).inv ≫ (MonoidalPiSupercategory.ζ (R := R) (C := A)).hom ▷ 𝟙_ A ≫ (λ_ (𝟙_ A)).hom = _
  rw [MonoidalSupercategory.rightUnitor_inv_naturality_assoc R,
    MonoidalSupercategory.unitors_equal R, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.Tmon_map_whiskerRight
statement:
theorem Tmon_map_whiskerRight {X Y : Associated R (Underlying R A)} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (Z : Associated R (Underlying R A)) :
    (Tmon R A).map (f ▷ Z) = (Tmon R A).map f ▷ Z.obj.obj
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Tmon_map, whiskerRight_fst, whiskerRight_snd, Underlying.whiskerRight_val,
    Underlying.comp_val, Underlying.associator_hom_val, Category.assoc,
    MonoidalSupercategory.add_whiskerRight (R := R), MonoidalSupercategory.comp_whiskerRight (R := R)]
  erw [associator_ζL]

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.Tmon_map_whiskerLeft
statement:
theorem Tmon_map_whiskerLeft (X : Associated R (Underlying R A))
    {Y Z : Associated R (Underlying R A)} (g : Y ⟶ Z) :
    (Tmon R A).map (X ◁ g) = X.obj.obj ◁ (Tmon R A).map g
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Tmon_map, whiskerLeft_fst, whiskerLeft_snd, Underlying.whiskerLeft_val,
    Underlying.comp_val, Category.assoc, MonoidalSupercategory.whiskerLeft_add (R := R),
    MonoidalSupercategory.whiskerLeft_comp (R := R)]
  congr 2
  have e : (MonoidalPiCategory.βL (R := R) X.obj Z.obj).inv.1 =
      (α_ X.obj.obj 𝛑 Z.obj.obj).inv ≫
        ((ζR (R := R) X.obj.obj).hom ≫ (ζL (R := R) X.obj.obj).inv) ▷ Z.obj.obj ≫
          (α_ 𝛑 X.obj.obj Z.obj.obj).hom := by
    simp [MonoidalPiCategory.βL_inv]
    rfl
  erw [e]
  simp only [Category.assoc, MonoidalSupercategory.comp_whiskerRight (R := R)]
  erw [associator_ζL]
  rw [← MonoidalSupercategory.comp_whiskerRight (R := R), Iso.inv_hom_id,
    MonoidalSupercategory.id_whiskerRight (R := R), Category.comp_id,
    ← cancel_epi (α_ X.obj.obj 𝛑 Z.obj.obj).hom, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
  simp only [ζR, ζL, MonoidalSupercategory.comp_whiskerRight (R := R),
    MonoidalSupercategory.whiskerLeft_comp (R := R)]
  rw [← reassoc_of% (MonoidalSupercategory.associator_naturality_middle R X.obj.obj
    (MonoidalPiSupercategory.ζ (R := R) (C := A)).hom Z.obj.obj),
    MonoidalSupercategory.triangle (R := R)]

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.Tmon_map_homMk
statement:
@[simp] theorem Tmon_map_homMk {X Y : Associated R (Underlying R A)} (f : X.obj ⟶ Y.obj) :
    (Tmon R A).map (homMk f 0) = f.1

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.βF_comp_map_ζL
statement:
theorem βF_comp_map_ζL (Y : Underlying R A) :
    letI := (MonoidalSuperfunctor.underlyingCoreMonoidal hG).toMonoidal
    ((hG.toMonoidalPiFunctor).βF Y).hom.1 ≫ G.map (ζL (R := R) Y.obj).hom =
      (ζL (R := R) (G.obj Y.obj)).hom
proof:
:= by
  let := (MonoidalSuperfunctor.underlyingCoreMonoidal hG).toMonoidal
  have e : ((hG.toMonoidalPiFunctor).βF Y).hom.1 = (MonoidalSuperfunctor.jIso hG).hom ▷ G.obj Y.obj ≫
      (hG.μIso (MonoidalPiSupercategory.pi (R := R) (C := A)) Y.obj).hom := rfl
  rw [e, ζL, G.map_comp]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [← reassoc_of% (hG.μ_natural_left _ Y.obj), ← Category.assoc,
    ← MonoidalSupercategory.comp_whiskerRight (R := R),
    MonoidalSuperfunctor.jIso_hom_comp_map_ζ, MonoidalSupercategory.comp_whiskerRight (R := R),
    Category.assoc, ← hG.left_unitality]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.Tmon_naturality
statement:
theorem Tmon_naturality :
    letI := (MonoidalSuperfunctor.underlyingCoreMonoidal hG).toMonoidal
    map ((hG.toMonoidalPiFunctor).toPiFunctor R) ⋙ Tmon R B = Tmon R A ⋙ G
proof:
:= by
  let := (MonoidalSuperfunctor.underlyingCoreMonoidal hG).toMonoidal
  have h2 : ∀ Y : Underlying R A, ((hG.toMonoidalPiFunctor).βF Y).inv.1 ≫ (ζL (R := R) (G.obj Y.obj)).hom =
      G.map (ζL (R := R) Y.obj).hom := fun Y => by
    rw [← βF_comp_map_ζL hG Y, ← Category.assoc, ← Underlying.comp_val, Iso.inv_hom_id]
    exact Category.id_comp _
  refine CategoryTheory.Functor.ext (fun _ => rfl) fun X Y f => ?_
  simp only [Functor.comp_map, eqToHom_refl, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]
  change G.map f.1.1 + (G.map f.2.1 ≫ ((hG.toMonoidalPiFunctor).βF Y.obj).inv.1) ≫
    (ζL (R := R) (G.obj Y.obj.obj)).hom = G.map (f.1.1 + f.2.1 ≫ (ζL (R := R) Y.obj.obj).hom)
  rw [G.map_add, G.map_comp, Category.assoc, h2 Y.obj]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.compositor_associator
statement:
private theorem compositor_associator {a b c d : B} (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c)
    (h : c ⟶ d) :
    (BicategoryStruct.associator (H.map f) (H.map g) (H.map h)).hom ≫
      H.map f ◁ (H.mapComp g h).hom ≫ (H.mapComp f (g ≫ h)).hom =
    (H.mapComp f g).hom ▷ H.map h ≫ (H.mapComp (f ≫ g) h).hom ≫
      H.map₂ (BicategoryStruct.associator f g h).hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cancel_mono (H.map₂Iso (BicategoryStruct.associator f g h)).inv]
  simp only [Category.assoc, TwoSuperfunctor.map₂Iso_inv, ← H.map₂_comp,
    Iso.hom_inv_id, H.map₂_id, Category.comp_id]
  rw [H.map₂_associator, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.postcomposeVcomp_hom_naturality
statement:
theorem postcomposeVcomp_hom_naturality {a b : A} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (vcomp (postcompose H θ) (postcompose H ψ)).x f ≫
        (H.mapComp (θ.X a) (ψ.X a)).hom ▷ H.map (K.map f) =
      H.map (F.map f) ◁ (H.mapComp (θ.X b) (ψ.X b)).hom ≫
        (postcompose H (vcomp θ ψ)).x f
proof:
:= by
  simp only [vcomp_x, postcompose_x, postcompose_X, vcomp_X,
    comp_whiskerRight (R := R), whiskerLeft_comp (R := R), H.map₂_comp, Category.assoc]
  dsimp only [TwoSuperfunctor.comp]
  rw [← cancel_mono (H.mapComp (θ.X a ≫ ψ.X a) (K.map f)).hom]
  simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]
  rw [H.map₂_associator_assoc]
  rw [← H.map₂_associator (θ.X a) (ψ.X a) (K.map f)]
  rw [whiskerLeft_inv_hom_assoc R, H.mapComp_naturality_right_assoc,
    reassoc_of% (compositor_associator H (θ.X a) (G.map f) (ψ.X b)),
    inv_hom_whiskerRight_assoc R, H.mapComp_naturality_left_assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.postcomposeVcomp_inv_naturality
statement:
theorem postcomposeVcomp_inv_naturality {a b : A} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (postcompose H (vcomp θ ψ)).x f ≫
        (H.mapComp (θ.X a) (ψ.X a)).inv ▷ H.map (K.map f) =
      H.map (F.map f) ◁ (H.mapComp (θ.X b) (ψ.X b)).inv ≫
        (vcomp (postcompose H θ) (postcompose H ψ)).x f
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cancel_epi (whiskerLeftIso (R := R) (H.map (F.map f))
    (H.mapComp (θ.X b) (ψ.X b))).hom]
  change H.map (F.map f) ◁ (H.mapComp (θ.X b) (ψ.X b)).hom ≫ _ = _
  dsimp only [whiskerLeftIso]
  erw [← Category.assoc, ← postcomposeVcomp_hom_naturality H θ ψ f,
    Category.assoc, hom_inv_whiskerRight R, Category.comp_id,
    ← Category.assoc, whiskerLeft_hom_inv R, Category.id_comp]

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSuperspace.proj_mem
statement:
theorem proj_mem (p : ZMod 2) {n : ℤ} {v : V.toSVec} (hv : v ∈ V.deg n) :
    V.toSVec.proj p v ∈ V.deg n
proof:
:= by
  rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one p with rfl | rfl
  · rw [SVec.proj_zero, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.id_apply]
    exact Submodule.sub_mem _ hv (V.odd_mem hv)
  · rw [SVec.proj_one]; exact V.odd_mem hv

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSuperspace.induction_on_deg
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
theorem induction_on_deg {P : V.toSVec → Prop} (v : V.toSVec) (zero : P 0)
    (hom : ∀ (n : ℤ) (w : V.toSVec), w ∈ V.deg n → P w) (add : ∀ w w', P w → P w' → P (w + w')) :
    P v
proof:
:=
  letI := V.degreeDecomposition
  DirectSum.Decomposition.inductionOn V.deg zero (fun w => hom _ _ w.2) add v

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSuperspace.isInternal_bideg
statement: theorem isInternal_bideg : DirectSum.IsInternal V.bideg
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine (DirectSum.isInternal_submodule_iff_iSupIndep_and_iSup_eq_top _).2 ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [iSupIndep_def]
    intro i
    rw [Submodule.disjoint_def]
    intro x hx hx'
    have hpi : ∀ j : ℤ × ZMod 2, j ≠ i → ∀ y ∈ V.bideg j,
        V.toSVec.proj i.2 (V.dproj i.1 y) = 0 := by
      intro j hj y hy
      by_cases h1 : j.1 = i.1
      · have h2 : j.2 ≠ i.2 := fun h2 => hj (Prod.ext h1 h2)
        rw [V.dproj_of_mem (h1 ▸ hy.1), SVec.proj_apply_of_mem_part _ hy.2,
          ite_eq_right (Ne.symm h2)]
      · rw [V.dproj_of_mem_ne hy.1 h1, map_zero]
    have h0 : V.toSVec.proj i.2 (V.dproj i.1 x) = 0 := by
      refine Submodule.iSup_induction (fun j : {j // j ≠ i} => V.bideg j)
        (motive := fun y => V.toSVec.proj i.2 (V.dproj i.1 y) = 0) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
      · simpa [iSup_subtype'] using hx'
      · intro j y hy; exact hpi j j.2 y hy
      · simp
      · intro y z hy hz; rw [map_add, map_add, hy, hz, add_zero]
    rwa [V.dproj_of_mem hx.1, (SVec.mem_part_iff _).1 hx.2] at h0
  · rw [eq_top_iff]
    intro v _
    refine V.induction_on_deg v (Submodule.zero_mem _) (fun n w hw => ?_)
      (fun w w' hw hw' => Submodule.add_mem _ hw hw')
    rw [← SVec.proj_apply_add V.toSVec w]
    refine Submodule.add_mem _ ?_ ?_
    · exact Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem (n, (0 : ZMod 2)) ⟨V.proj_mem 0 hw, SVec.proj_mem_part _ 0 _⟩
    · exact Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem (n, (1 : ZMod 2)) ⟨V.proj_mem 1 hw, SVec.proj_mem_part _ 1 _⟩

statement:
theorem mem_degHom_iff {n : ℤ} {f : V.toSVec ⟶ W.toSVec} :
    f ∈ degHom V W n ↔ ∀ (m : ℤ) (v : V.toSVec), v ∈ V.deg m → f v ∈ W.deg (m + n)

statement:
theorem apply_mem_deg {n : ℤ} {f : V.toSVec ⟶ W.toSVec} (hf : f ∈ degHom V W n) {m : ℤ}
    {v : V.toSVec} (hv : v ∈ V.deg m) : f v ∈ W.deg (m + n)

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSuperspace.homProj_mem_degHom
statement:
theorem homProj_mem_degHom (p : ZMod 2) {n : ℤ} {f : V.toSVec ⟶ W.toSVec}
    (hf : f ∈ degHom V W n) : SVec.homProj p f ∈ degHom V W n
proof:
:= fun m v hv => by
  rw [SVec.homProj_apply]
  exact Submodule.add_mem _ (W.proj_mem _ (hf m _ (V.proj_mem 0 hv)))
    (W.proj_mem _ (hf m _ (V.proj_mem 1 hv)))

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSuperspace.proj_mem_degHom
statement:
theorem proj_mem_degHom (p : ZMod 2) {n : ℤ} {f : V.toSVec ⟶ W.toSVec}
    (hf : f ∈ degHom V W n) : proj k p f ∈ degHom V W n
proof:
:= by
  rw [SVec.proj_eq_homProj]; exact homProj_mem_degHom p hf

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSuperspace.iSupIndep_degHom
statement: theorem iSupIndep_degHom : iSupIndep (degHom V W)
proof:
:= by
  refine iSupIndep_of_eval (degHom V W) (A := Σ m : ℤ, V.deg m) (N := fun _ => W.toSVec)
    (fun x => evalHom (x.2 : V.toSVec)) (fun x n => W.deg (x.1 + n))
    (fun x => W.isInternal_deg.submodule_iSupIndep.comp (add_right_injective x.1)) ?_ ?_
  · rintro ⟨m, v⟩ n f ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩
    exact hg m v v.2
  · intro f hf
    ext v
    rw [SVec.zero_apply]
    refine V.induction_on_deg v (map_zero f) (fun n w hw => hf ⟨n, ⟨w, hw⟩⟩)
      (fun w w' hw hw' => by rw [map_add, hw, hw', add_zero])

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.postcomposeCell_naturality
statement:
theorem postcomposeCell_naturality (θ : TwoNatTrans F G) {a b : A}
    {f g : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ g) :
    H.map₂ (F.map₂ η) ▷ H.map (θ.X b) ≫ postcomposeCell H θ g =
      postcomposeCell H θ f ≫ H.map (θ.X a) ◁ H.map₂ (G.map₂ η)
proof:
:= by
  unfold postcomposeCell
  rw [← cancel_mono (H.mapComp (θ.X a) (G.map g)).hom]
  simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]
  rw [H.mapComp_naturality_left_assoc, ← H.map₂_comp, θ.naturality,
    H.map₂_comp, H.mapComp_naturality_right, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.map_associator_hom
statement:
private theorem map_associator_hom {a b c d : B} (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c)
    (h : c ⟶ d) :
    (BicategoryStruct.associator (H.map f) (H.map g) (H.map h)).hom ≫
      H.map f ◁ (H.mapComp g h).hom ≫ (H.mapComp f (g ≫ h)).hom =
    (H.mapComp f g).hom ▷ H.map h ≫ (H.mapComp (f ≫ g) h).hom ≫
      H.map₂ (BicategoryStruct.associator f g h).hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cancel_mono (H.map₂Iso (BicategoryStruct.associator f g h)).inv]
  simp only [Category.assoc, TwoSuperfunctor.map₂Iso_inv, ← H.map₂_comp,
    Iso.hom_inv_id, H.map₂_id, Category.comp_id]
  rw [H.map₂_associator, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.map_leftUnitor_inv
statement:
private theorem map_leftUnitor_inv {a b : B} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (BicategoryStruct.leftUnitor (H.map f)).inv ≫
      (H.mapId a).hom ▷ H.map f ≫ (H.mapComp (𝟙 a) f).hom =
    H.map₂ (BicategoryStruct.leftUnitor f).inv
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cancel_mono (H.map₂Iso (BicategoryStruct.leftUnitor f)).hom]
  simp only [Category.assoc, TwoSuperfunctor.map₂Iso_hom, ← H.map₂_comp,
    Iso.inv_hom_id, H.map₂_id]
  rw [H.map₂_leftUnitor, Iso.inv_hom_id]

    (postcompose H θ).x f = (H.mapComp (F.map f) (θ.X b)).hom ≫
      H.map₂ (θ.x f) ≫ (H.mapComp (θ.X a) (G.map f)).inv

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.postcompose_isStrong
statement:
theorem postcompose_isStrong {θ : TwoNatTrans F G} (hθ : θ.IsStrong) :
    (postcompose H θ).IsStrong
proof:
:= by
  intro a b f
  let := hθ f
  have : IsIso (H.map₂ (θ.x f)) :=
    (H.mapFunctor _ _).map_isIso (θ.x f)
  change IsIso ((H.mapComp (F.map f) (θ.X b)).hom ≫
    H.map₂ (θ.x f) ≫ (H.mapComp (θ.X a) (G.map f)).inv)
  infer_instance

StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.postcompose_isGraded
statement:
theorem postcompose_isGraded (hH : H.IsGraded) {θ : TwoNatTrans F G}
    (hθ : θ.IsGraded) : (postcompose H θ).IsGraded
proof:
:= by
  intro a b f
  change postcomposeCell H θ f ∈ GradedSupercategory.degree (R := R) _ _ 0
  simpa only [postcomposeCell, add_zero, neg_zero] using
    GradedSupercategory.comp_mem_degree (hH.mapComp_hom_mem_degree (F.map f) (θ.X b))
      (GradedSupercategory.comp_mem_degree (hH.map₂_mem_degree (hθ f))
        (GradedSupercategory.inv_mem_degree _ (hH.mapComp_hom_mem_degree (θ.X a) (G.map f))))

StringDiagrams.MonoidalSupercategory.whiskerLeft_zero
statement: theorem whiskerLeft_zero (X : C) {Y Z : C} : X ◁ (0 : Y ⟶ Z) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := whiskerLeft_add (R := R) X (0 : Y ⟶ Z) 0
  rw [add_zero] at h
  exact left_eq_add.mp h

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalSupercategory.zero_whiskerRight
statement: theorem zero_whiskerRight {X Y : C} (Z : C) : (0 : X ⟶ Y) ▷ Z = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := add_whiskerRight (R := R) (0 : X ⟶ Y) 0 Z
  rw [add_zero] at h
  exact left_eq_add.mp h

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalSupercategory.whiskerLeft_neg
statement: theorem whiskerLeft_neg (X : C) {Y Z : C} (f : Y ⟶ Z) : X ◁ (-f) = -(X ◁ f)
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left ?_
  rw [← whiskerLeft_add (R := R), neg_add_cancel, whiskerLeft_zero R]

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalSupercategory.neg_whiskerRight
statement: theorem neg_whiskerRight {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (Z : C) : (-f) ▷ Z = -(f ▷ Z)
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left ?_
  rw [← add_whiskerRight (R := R), neg_add_cancel, zero_whiskerRight R]

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalSupercategory.whiskerLeft_zsmul
statement: theorem whiskerLeft_zsmul (X : C) {Y Z : C} (n : ℤ) (f : Y ⟶ Z) : X ◁ (n • f) = n • (X ◁ f)
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Int.induction_on with
  | zero => simp [whiskerLeft_zero R]
  | succ n ih => simp only [add_smul, one_smul, whiskerLeft_add (R := R), ih]
  | pred n ih =>
    rw [sub_smul, sub_smul, sub_eq_add_neg, sub_eq_add_neg, one_smul, one_smul,
      whiskerLeft_add (R := R), ih, whiskerLeft_neg R]

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalSupercategory.zsmul_whiskerRight
statement: theorem zsmul_whiskerRight {X Y : C} (n : ℤ) (f : X ⟶ Y) (Z : C) : (n • f) ▷ Z = n • (f ▷ Z)
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Int.induction_on with
  | zero => simp [zero_whiskerRight R]
  | succ n ih => simp only [add_smul, one_smul, add_whiskerRight (R := R), ih]
  | pred n ih =>
    rw [sub_smul, sub_smul, sub_eq_add_neg, sub_eq_add_neg, one_smul, one_smul,
      add_whiskerRight (R := R), ih, neg_whiskerRight R]

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalSupercategory.tensor_id
statement: theorem tensor_id (X Y : C) : 𝟙 X ⊗ₘ 𝟙 Y = 𝟙 (X ⊗ Y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensorHom_def (R := R), id_whiskerRight (R := R), whiskerLeft_id (R := R),
    Category.comp_id]

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalSupercategory.superTensorHom_mem
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_comm]
  exact comp_mem (whiskerLeft_mem X₁ hg) (whiskerRight_mem Y₂ hf)

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalSupercategory.tensorHom_mem
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensorHom_def (R := R)]
  exact comp_mem (whiskerRight_mem X₂ hf) (whiskerLeft_mem Y₁ hg)

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalSupercategory.tensorHom_eq_superTensorHom
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensorHom_def (R := R), super_interchange hf hg, superTensorHom]

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalSupercategory.superTensorHom_comp_superTensorHom
statement:
theorem superTensorHom_comp_superTensorHom {X₁ Y₁ Z₁ X₂ Y₂ Z₂ : C} {pg ph : ZMod 2}
    (h : X₁ ⟶ Y₁) (k : X₂ ⟶ Y₂) (f : Y₁ ⟶ Z₁) (g : Y₂ ⟶ Z₂)
    (hh : h ∈ parity (R := R) X₁ Y₁ ph) (hg : g ∈ parity (R := R) Y₂ Z₂ pg) :
    superTensorHom h k ≫ superTensorHom f g =
      koszulSign pg ph • superTensorHom (h ≫ f) (k ≫ g)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [superTensorHom, Category.assoc]
  rw [← Category.assoc (h ▷ Y₂), super_interchange hh hg, Linear.smul_comp,
    Linear.comp_smul, koszulSign_comm, whiskerLeft_comp (R := R), comp_whiskerRight (R := R)]
  simp only [Category.assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalSupercategory.tensorHom_comp_tensorHom
statement:
theorem tensorHom_comp_tensorHom {X₁ Y₁ Z₁ X₂ Y₂ Z₂ : C} {pf pk : ZMod 2}
    (h : X₁ ⟶ Y₁) (k : X₂ ⟶ Y₂) (f : Y₁ ⟶ Z₁) (g : Y₂ ⟶ Z₂)
    (hf : f ∈ parity (R := R) Y₁ Z₁ pf) (hk : k ∈ parity (R := R) X₂ Y₂ pk) :
    (h ⊗ₘ k) ≫ (f ⊗ₘ g) = koszulSign pf pk • ((h ≫ f) ⊗ₘ (k ≫ g))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [tensorHom_def (R := R), Category.assoc]
  rw [← Category.assoc (Y₁ ◁ k), ← koszulSign_smul_smul pf pk (Y₁ ◁ k ≫ f ▷ Y₂),
    ← super_interchange hf hk, Linear.smul_comp, Linear.comp_smul, whiskerLeft_comp (R := R),
    comp_whiskerRight (R := R)]
  simp only [Category.assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalSupercategory.interchange_of_even_left
proof:
:= by
  rw [super_interchange hf hg, koszulSign_zero_left, one_smul]

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalSupercategory.interchange_of_even_right
proof:
:= by
  rw [super_interchange hf hg, koszulSign_zero_right, one_smul]

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalSupercategory.interchange_of_odd
proof:
:= by
  rw [super_interchange hf hg, koszulSign_one_one, neg_one_smul]

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalSupercategory.mem_parity_zero_of_noOdd
statement:
theorem mem_parity_zero_of_noOdd (h : NoOdd R C) {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    f ∈ parity (R := R) X Y 0
proof:
:= by
  have hf : f ∈ ⨆ q, parity (R := R) X Y q := by
    rw [(isInternal (R := R) X Y).submodule_iSup_eq_top]; exact Submodule.mem_top
  refine (iSup_le fun q => ?_ : ⨆ q, parity (R := R) X Y q ≤ parity (R := R) X Y 0) hf
  rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one q with rfl | rfl
  · exact le_rfl
  · rw [h X Y]; exact bot_le

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalSupercategory.eq_zero_of_noOdd
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_noOdd (h : NoOdd R C) {X Y : C} {f : X ⟶ Y}
    (hf : f ∈ parity (R := R) X Y 1) : f = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [h X Y] at hf; exact (Submodule.mem_bot R).mp hf

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalSupercategory.whisker_exchange_of_noOdd
statement:
theorem whisker_exchange_of_noOdd (h : NoOdd R C) {X X' Y Y' : C} (f : X ⟶ X') (g : Y ⟶ Y') :
    X ◁ g ≫ f ▷ Y' = f ▷ Y ≫ X' ◁ g

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalSupercategory.toMonoidalPreadditive
statement:
theorem toMonoidalPreadditive (h : NoOdd R C) :
    letI := toMonoidalCategory R h
    MonoidalPreadditive C
proof:
:=
  letI := toMonoidalCategory R h
  { whiskerLeft_zero := whiskerLeft_zero R _
    zero_whiskerRight := zero_whiskerRight R _
    whiskerLeft_add := whiskerLeft_add (R := R) _
    add_whiskerRight f g := add_whiskerRight (R := R) f g _ }

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalSupercategory.toMonoidalLinear
statement:
theorem toMonoidalLinear (h : NoOdd R C) :
    letI := toMonoidalCategory R h
    letI := toMonoidalPreadditive h
    MonoidalLinear R C
proof:
:=
  letI := toMonoidalCategory R h
  letI := toMonoidalPreadditive h
  { whiskerLeft_smul := whiskerLeft_smul
    smul_whiskerRight r _ _ f X := smul_whiskerRight r f X }

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalSupercategory.ofMonoidalCategory
statement:
theorem MonoidalSupercategory.ofMonoidalCategory [MonoidalCategory C] [MonoidalPreadditive C]
    [MonoidalLinear R C] (h : MonoidalSupercategory.NoOdd R C) : MonoidalSupercategory R C where
  tensorHom_def
proof:
:= MonoidalCategory.tensorHom_def
  whiskerLeft_id := MonoidalCategory.whiskerLeft_id
  id_whiskerRight := MonoidalCategory.id_whiskerRight
  whiskerLeft_comp := MonoidalCategory.whiskerLeft_comp
  comp_whiskerRight := MonoidalCategory.comp_whiskerRight
  whiskerLeft_add _ _ _ f g := MonoidalPreadditive.whiskerLeft_add f g
  add_whiskerRight f g _ := MonoidalPreadditive.add_whiskerRight f g
  whiskerLeft_smul := MonoidalLinear.whiskerLeft_smul
  smul_whiskerRight r f Z := MonoidalLinear.smul_whiskerRight r f Z
  whiskerLeft_mem X Y Z p f hf := by
    rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one p with rfl | rfl
    · exact MonoidalSupercategory.mem_parity_zero_of_noOdd h _
    · rw [MonoidalSupercategory.eq_zero_of_noOdd h hf, MonoidalPreadditive.whiskerLeft_zero]
      exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  whiskerRight_mem {X Y p f} Z hf := by
    rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one p with rfl | rfl
    · exact MonoidalSupercategory.mem_parity_zero_of_noOdd h _
    · rw [MonoidalSupercategory.eq_zero_of_noOdd h hf, MonoidalPreadditive.zero_whiskerRight]
      exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  super_interchange {X X' Y Y' p q f g} hf hg := by
    rcases koszulSign_eq_one_or p q with hs | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    · rw [hs, one_smul, whisker_exchange]
    · rw [MonoidalSupercategory.eq_zero_of_noOdd h hf]
      simp
  associator_naturality := MonoidalCategory.associator_naturality
  leftUnitor_naturality := MonoidalCategory.leftUnitor_naturality
  rightUnitor_naturality := MonoidalCategory.rightUnitor_naturality
  pentagon := MonoidalCategory.pentagon
  triangle := MonoidalCategory.triangle
  associator_hom_mem _ _ _ := MonoidalSupercategory.mem_parity_zero_of_noOdd h _
  leftUnitor_hom_mem _ := MonoidalSupercategory.mem_parity_zero_of_noOdd h _
  rightUnitor_hom_mem _ := MonoidalSupercategory.mem_parity_zero_of_noOdd h _

name: StringDiagrams.KrullSchmidt.covering_pi_smul_indec
statement:
theorem covering_pi_smul_indec (i : IndecClass C) :
    letI := K₀.moduleLaurent k C
    CoveringLaurent.pi • indecBasis k i = indecBasis k (indecParity k i)
proof:
:= by
  let := K₀.moduleLaurent k C
  simp only [indecBasis_apply]
  rw [CoveringLaurent.pi, K₀.C_π_smul_mk]
  exact K₀.mk_eq_mk_of_iso (indecParity_rep_iso k i).some

name: StringDiagrams.KrullSchmidt.covering_T_smul_indec
statement:
theorem covering_T_smul_indec (n : ℤ) (i : IndecClass C) :
    letI := K₀.moduleLaurent k C
    (T n : LaurentPolynomial Zπ) • indecBasis k i = indecBasis k (indecShift k n i)
proof:
:= by
  let := K₀.moduleLaurent k C
  have h := int_T_smul_indec k n i
  change CoveringLaurent.inclusion (T n : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) • K₀.mk i.rep =
    K₀.mk (indecShift k n i).rep at h
  simpa only [CoveringLaurent.inclusion, T, AddMonoidAlgebra.mapRingHom_single,
    map_one, indecBasis_apply] using h

name: StringDiagrams.KrullSchmidt.indecParity_shift
statement:
theorem indecParity_shift (n : ℤ) (i : IndecClass C) :
    indecParity k (indecShift k n i) = indecShift k n (indecParity k i)
proof:
:= by
  let := K₀.moduleLaurent k C
  apply (indecBasis k).injective
  rw [← covering_pi_smul_indec, ← covering_T_smul_indec,
    ← covering_T_smul_indec, ← covering_pi_smul_indec]
  rw [← mul_smul, mul_comm CoveringLaurent.pi (T n : LaurentPolynomial Zπ), mul_smul]

name: StringDiagrams.KrullSchmidt.laurentParity_involutive
statement: theorem laurentParity_involutive : Function.Involutive (laurentParity k (C := C))

name: StringDiagrams.KrullSchmidt.parityLaurentBasis_pi
statement:
theorem parityLaurentBasis_pi (h : ShiftHomBoundedBelow k (C := C))
    (o : ShiftOrbit k (C := C)) :
    letI := K₀.moduleLaurent k C
    CoveringLaurent.pi • parityLaurentBasis k h o =
      parityLaurentBasis k h (laurentParity k o)
proof:
:= by
  let := K₀.moduleLaurent k C
  let := K₀.moduleLaurentInt k C
  let := indecShiftAction k (C := C)
  let := laurentOrbitOrder k (C := C)
  exact LaurentBasis.parityCompatibleBasis_parity (indecParity k) (indecParity_involutive k)
    (indecParity_shift k) (indec_shift_free k h) (indecBasis k)
    (fun n i => by
      simp only [indecBasis_apply]
      exact int_T_smul_indec k n i)
    (fun x => CoveringLaurent.pi • x) (covering_pi_smul_indec k) o

name: StringDiagrams.KrullSchmidt.laurentParity_fixed_iff
statement:
theorem laurentParity_fixed_iff (h : ShiftHomBoundedBelow k (C := C)) (i : IndecClass C) :
    laurentParity k (Quotient.mk _ i) = Quotient.mk _ i ↔
      Nonempty ((PiCategory.pi (R := k)).obj i.rep ≅ i.rep)
proof:
:= by
  let := indecShiftAction k (C := C)
  exact (LaurentBasis.orbitParity_fixed_iff (indecParity k) (indecParity_involutive k)
    (indecParity_shift k) (indec_shift_free k h) i).trans (indecParity_eq_iff k i)

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.map₂_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem map₂_zero {a b : B} (f g : a ⟶ b) : F.map₂ (0 : f ⟶ g) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← zero_smul R (0 : f ⟶ g), F.map₂_smul, zero_smul]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.map₂_neg
statement: @[simp] theorem map₂_neg {a b : B} {f g : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ g) : F.map₂ (-η) = -F.map₂ η
proof:
:= by
  rw [← neg_one_smul R η, F.map₂_smul, neg_one_smul]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.mapComp_naturality
statement:
theorem mapComp_naturality {a b c : B} {f f' : a ⟶ b} {g g' : b ⟶ c} (η : f ⟶ f')
    (θ : g ⟶ g') :
    hcomp (F.map₂ η) (F.map₂ θ) ≫ (F.mapComp f' g').hom =
      (F.mapComp f g).hom ≫ F.map₂ (hcomp η θ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hcomp, hcomp, Category.assoc, F.mapComp_naturality_right, ← Category.assoc,
    F.mapComp_naturality_left, Category.assoc, ← F.map₂_comp]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.hom_ext
statement:
@[ext]
theorem hom_ext {α β : θ ⟶ θ'} (h : ∀ a, α.app a = β.app a) : α = β

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.id_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem id_app (θ : TwoNatTrans F G) (a : B) :
    (𝟙 θ : θ ⟶ θ).app a = 𝟙 (θ.X a)

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.comp_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem comp_app (α : θ ⟶ θ') (β : θ' ⟶ θ'') (a : B) :

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.zero_app

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.add_app
statement: @[simp] theorem add_app (α β : θ ⟶ θ') (a : B) : (α + β).app a = α.app a + β.app a

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.neg_app
statement: @[simp] theorem neg_app (α : θ ⟶ θ') (a : B) : (-α).app a = -α.app a

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.sub_app

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.smul_app
statement: @[simp] theorem smul_app (r : R) (α : θ ⟶ θ') (a : B) : (r • α).app a = r • α.app a

statement: @[simp] theorem nsmul_app (n : ℕ) (α : θ ⟶ θ') (a : B) : (n • α).app a = n • α.app a

statement: theorem app_injective : Function.Injective (fun (α : θ ⟶ θ') (a : B) => α.app a)

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.mem_parityHom
statement:
theorem mem_parityHom {p : ZMod 2} {α : θ ⟶ θ'} :
    α ∈ parityHom θ θ' p ↔ ∀ a, α.app a ∈ parity (R := R) (θ.X a) (θ'.X a) p

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.projHom_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem projHom_app (p : ZMod 2) (α : θ ⟶ θ') (a : B) :
