name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.mem_parity_iff
statement:
theorem mem_parity_iff {p : ZMod 2} {α : θ ⟶ θ'} :
    α ∈ parity (R := R) θ θ' p ↔ ∀ a, α.app a ∈ parity (R := R) (θ.X a) (θ'.X a) p

name: StringDiagrams.SCat.isSuperequivalence_iff
statement:
theorem isSuperequivalence_iff {C D : SCat.{w, v₁, u₁} R} (F : C ⟶ D) :
    TwoSupercategory.IsSuperequivalence R F ↔ Nonempty (Superequivalence R F.toFunctor)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨G, e₁, e₂, h₁, h₂⟩
    exact ⟨{ inverse := G.toFunctor
             unitIso := (natIsoOfEvenIso e₁ h₁).symm
             counitIso := natIsoOfEvenIso e₂ h₂
             unitIso_mem := fun X => e₁.inv.app_mem 0 X
             counitIso_mem := fun X => e₂.hom.app_mem 0 X }⟩
  · rintro ⟨s⟩
    let G : D ⟶ C := ⟨s.inverse⟩
    refine ⟨G, isoOfEvenNatIso (G := 𝟙 C) s.unitIso.symm
      (fun X => inv_mem (s.unitIso.app X) (s.unitIso_mem X)),
      isoOfEvenNatIso (F := G ≫ F) (G := 𝟙 D) s.counitIso s.counitIso_mem, ?_, ?_⟩ <;>
    · rw [Superfunctor.mem_parity_iff]
      funext X
      simp [isoOfEvenNatIso, SuperNatTrans.ofNatTrans]

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated.Qhat_evenlyDense
statement: theorem Qhat_evenlyDense : EvenlyDense R (Qhat R A)
proof:
:= fun Y =>
  ⟨⟨(QPiCategory.Qinv (R := R)).obj Y.obj⟩,
    (Underlying.ι R (Associated R A)).mapIso ((Associated.unit R A).mapIso
      ((QPiCategory.jj (R := R) (C := A)).app Y.obj)),
    ((Associated.unit R A).map ((QPiCategory.jj (R := R) (C := A)).hom.app Y.obj)).2⟩

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated.equivalence_mk_unit_app
statement:
theorem equivalence_mk_unit_app {C D : Type*} [Category C] [Category D] (F : C ⥤ D) (G : D ⥤ C)
    (η : 𝟭 C ≅ F ⋙ G) (ε : G ⋙ F ≅ 𝟭 D) (X : C) :
    (CategoryTheory.Equivalence.mk F G η ε).unitIso.hom.app X =
      η.hom.app X ≫ G.map (ε.inv.app (F.obj X)) ≫ G.map (F.map (η.inv.app X))

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated.unit_obj
statement: @[simp] theorem unit_obj (X : A) : (unit R A).obj X = ⟨⟨⟨⟨X⟩⟩⟩⟩

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated.unit_map_val
statement:
theorem unit_map_val {X Y : A} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    ((unit R A).map f).1.1 = (ι (shiftData R A)).map (homMk (X := ⟨X⟩) (Y := ⟨Y⟩) f 0)

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated.unit_comp_counit
statement: theorem unit_comp_counit : unit R A ⋙ counit R A = 𝟭 A
proof:
:=
  CategoryTheory.Functor.ext (fun _ => rfl) fun X Y f => by
    simp only [Functor.comp_obj, Functor.comp_map, Functor.id_obj, Functor.id_map, eqToHom_refl,
      Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]
    show ((π₀ (shiftData R A)).map ((ιZ (shiftData R A)).map (homMk (X := ⟨X⟩) (Y := ⟨Y⟩) f 0))).1 = f
    rw [ιZ_comp_π₀_map]; rfl

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated.counit_comp_unit
statement: theorem counit_comp_unit : counit R A ⋙ unit R A = 𝟭 _
proof:
:=
  CategoryTheory.Functor.ext (fun _ => rfl) fun X Y x => by
    simp only [Functor.comp_obj, Functor.comp_map, Functor.id_obj, Functor.id_map, eqToHom_refl,
      Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]
    apply Underlying.hom_ext
    show (ιZ (shiftData R A)).map (homMk ((π₀ (shiftData R A)).map x.1).1 0) = x.1
    have h0 : ((π₀ (shiftData R A)).map x.1).2 = 0 :=
      Associated.mem_parity_zero.1 (map_mem (π₀ (shiftData R A)) x.2)
    rw [show homMk ((π₀ (shiftData R A)).map x.1).1 0 = (π₀ (shiftData R A)).map x.1 from
      hom_ext rfl h0.symm, π₀_comp_ιZ_map]

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated.unit_map_pi
statement:
theorem unit_map_pi {X Y : A} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    (PiCategory.pi (R := R)).map ((unit R A).map f) = (unit R A).map ((PiCategory.pi (R := R)).map f)
proof:
:= by
  apply Underlying.hom_ext; apply DegreeZero.hom_ext
  show (PiSupercategory.pi (R := R)).map ((ι (shiftData R A)).map (homMk f 0)) =
    (ι (shiftData R A)).map (homMk ((PiCategory.pi (R := R)).map f) 0)
  rw [pi_map_ι]
  congr 1
  exact congrArg Subtype.val (Associated.unit_map_pi (R := R) (C := A) f)

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated.unit_map_Q
statement:
theorem unit_map_Q {X Y : A} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    (QPiCategory.Q (R := R)).map ((unit R A).map f) = (unit R A).map ((QPiCategory.Q (R := R)).map f)
proof:
:= by
  apply Underlying.hom_ext; apply DegreeZero.hom_ext
  show (QPiSupercategory.Q (R := R)).map ((ι (shiftData R A)).map (homMk f 0)) =
    (ι (shiftData R A)).map (homMk ((QPiCategory.Q (R := R)).map f) 0)
  rw [Q_map_ι]
  congr 1
  refine hom_ext rfl ?_
  show ((Qhat R A).map (homMk f 0)).2 = 0
  simp

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated.ξ_unit
statement:
theorem ξ_unit (X : A) :
    (PiCategory.ξApp (R := R) ((unit R A).obj X)).hom = (unit R A).map (PiCategory.ξApp (R := R) X).hom
proof:
:= by
  apply Underlying.hom_ext
  rw [Underlying.ξApp_hom_val]
  apply DegreeZero.hom_ext
  rw [DegreeZero.ξ_hom_val]
  exact (ξ_hom_eq (d := shiftData R A) (⟨X⟩ : Associated R A)).trans
    (congrArg (ι (shiftData R A)).map (Associated.ξ_hom (R := R) (C := A) ⟨X⟩))

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated.β_Q_unit
statement:
theorem β_Q_unit (X : A) :
    (QPiCategory.Q_pi (R := R) (C := GUnderlying R (QAssociated R A))).β.hom.app ((unit R A).obj X) =
      (unit R A).map ((QPiCategory.Q_pi (R := R) (C := A)).β.hom.app X)
proof:
:= by
  apply Underlying.hom_ext; apply DegreeZero.hom_ext
  rw [GUnderlying.β_Q_hom_app_val, unit_map_val, PiSupercategory.β_hom]
  simp only [Orbit.ζ_eq, Orbit.ζIso, Functor.mapIso_hom, Functor.mapIso_inv]
  erw [Q_map_ι]
  rw [← Functor.map_comp]
  congr 1
  exact Associated.β_map (hF := QPiCategory.Q_pi (R := R) (C := A)) (⟨X⟩ : Associated R A)

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated.unitQPiFunctor_β_hom_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem unitQPiFunctor_β_hom_app (X : A) :
    (unitQPiFunctor R A).β.hom.app X = 𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated.unitQPiFunctor_γ_hom_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem unitQPiFunctor_γ_hom_app (X : A) :
    (unitQPiFunctor R A).γ.hom.app X = 𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated.compat_inv
statement:
theorem compat_inv {F : A ⥤ A'} [F.Additive] (hF : QPiFunctor R F) (Y : A) :
    (QPiCategory.Q (R := R)).map (hF.β.inv.app Y) ≫
        (QPiCategory.Q_pi (R := R) (C := A')).β.inv.app (F.obj Y) ≫
          (PiCategory.pi (R := R)).map (hF.γ.hom.app Y) =
      hF.γ.hom.app ((PiCategory.pi (R := R)).obj Y) ≫
        F.map ((QPiCategory.Q_pi (R := R) (C := A)).β.inv.app Y) ≫
          hF.β.inv.app ((QPiCategory.Q (R := R)).obj Y)
proof:
:= by
  have h := (QPiFunctorData.IsCompatible.iff hF.toQPiFunctorData).1 hF.isCompatible Y
  rw [← cancel_epi ((QPiCategory.Q_pi (R := R) (C := A')).β.hom.app (F.obj Y) ≫
    (QPiCategory.Q (R := R)).map (hF.β.hom.app Y))]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [reassoc_of% h]
  simp only [Functor.comp_obj, ← Functor.map_comp_assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_app]
  simp

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated.unit_comp_map
statement:
theorem unit_comp_map {F : A ⥤ A'} [F.Additive] [F.Linear R] (hF : QPiFunctor R F) :
    unit R A ⋙ GUnderlying.map R (map hF) = F ⋙ unit R A'
proof:
:=
  CategoryTheory.Functor.ext (fun _ => rfl) fun X Y f => by
    simp only [Functor.comp_map, eqToHom_refl, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]
    apply Underlying.hom_ext; apply DegreeZero.hom_ext
    show (Orbit.map (shiftFunctor R hF)).map ((ι (shiftData R A)).map (homMk f 0)) =
      (ι (shiftData R A')).map (homMk (F.map f) 0)
    have := CategoryTheory.Functor.congr_hom (Orbit.ι_comp_map (shiftFunctor R hF))
      (homMk (X := ⟨X⟩) (Y := ⟨Y⟩) f 0)
    simp only [Functor.comp_map, eqToHom_refl, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp] at this
    rw [this]
    congr 1
    exact hom_ext rfl (by simp [shiftFunctor])

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated.mapNat_app
statement:
theorem mapNat_app {F G : A ⥤ A'} [F.Additive] [F.Linear R] [G.Additive] [G.Linear R]
    {hF : QPiFunctor R F} {hG : QPiFunctor R G} {x : F ⟶ G}
    (hx : QPiFunctor.IsQPiNatural R hF hG x) (X : QAssociated R A) :
    (mapNat hx).app X =
      (ι (shiftData R A')).map (homMk (X := ⟨F.obj X.obj.obj⟩) (Y := ⟨G.obj X.obj.obj⟩)
        (x.app X.obj.obj) 0)

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated.isGradedSupernatural_mapNat
statement:
theorem isGradedSupernatural_mapNat {F G : A ⥤ A'} [F.Additive] [F.Linear R] [G.Additive]
    [G.Linear R] {hF : QPiFunctor R F} {hG : QPiFunctor R G} {x : F ⟶ G}
    (hx : QPiFunctor.IsQPiNatural R hF hG x) :
    IsGradedSupernatural R 0 0 (F := map hF) (G := map hG) (mapNat hx).app

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated.mapNat_id
statement:
theorem mapNat_id {F : A ⥤ A'} [F.Additive] [F.Linear R] (hF : QPiFunctor R F) :
    mapNat (QPiFunctor.isQPiNatural_id hF) = 𝟙 (map hF)
proof:
:= by
  ext X
  rw [mapNat_app, NatTrans.id_app]
  refine Eq.trans ?_ ((ι (shiftData R A')).map_id (⟨F.obj X.obj.obj⟩ : Associated R A'))
  congr 1

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated.mapNat_comp
statement:
theorem mapNat_comp {F G H : A ⥤ A'} [F.Additive] [F.Linear R] [G.Additive] [G.Linear R]
    [H.Additive] [H.Linear R] {hF : QPiFunctor R F} {hG : QPiFunctor R G} {hH : QPiFunctor R H}
    {x : F ⟶ G} {y : G ⟶ H} (hx : QPiFunctor.IsQPiNatural R hF hG x)
    (hy : QPiFunctor.IsQPiNatural R hG hH y) :
    mapNat (hx.comp hy) = mapNat hx ≫ mapNat hy
proof:
:= by
  ext X
  simp only [mapNat_app, NatTrans.comp_app]
  erw [← (ι (shiftData R A')).map_comp]
  congr 1
  exact hom_ext (by simp) (by simp)

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated.unit_map_app_mapNat
statement:
theorem unit_map_app_mapNat {F G : A ⥤ A'} [F.Additive] [F.Linear R] [G.Additive] [G.Linear R]
    {hF : QPiFunctor R F} {hG : QPiFunctor R G} {x : F ⟶ G}
    (hx : QPiFunctor.IsQPiNatural R hF hG x) (X : A) :
    ((unit R A').map (x.app X)).1.1 = (mapNat hx).app ((unit R A).obj X).obj.obj

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated.shiftFunctor_F
statement:
@[simp] theorem shiftFunctor_F {F : A ⥤ A'} [F.Additive] [F.Linear R] (hF : QPiFunctor R F) :
    (shiftFunctor R hF).F = Associated.map hF.toPiFunctor

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated.shiftFunctor_γ_hom_app
statement:
theorem shiftFunctor_γ_hom_app {F : A ⥤ A'} [F.Additive] [F.Linear R] (hF : QPiFunctor R F)
    (X : Associated R A) :
    (shiftFunctor R hF).γ.hom.app X =
      homMk (X := ⟨(QPiCategory.Q (R := R)).obj (F.obj X.obj)⟩)
        (Y := ⟨F.obj ((QPiCategory.Q (R := R)).obj X.obj)⟩) (hF.γ.hom.app X.obj) 0

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated.map_id
statement: theorem map_id : map (QPiFunctor.id R A) = 𝟭 (QAssociated R A)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Orbit.map_id]
  refine Orbit.map_congr' (fun _ => rfl) (fun g => ?_) fun X => ?_
  · simp only [eqToHom_refl, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp, ShiftFunctor.id_F,
      Functor.id_map, shiftFunctor_F]
    apply hom_ext <;> simp
  · simp only [shiftFunctor_γ_hom_app, ShiftFunctor.id_γ_hom_app, QPiFunctor.id_γ_hom_app,
      eqToHom_refl, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]
    exact hom_ext rfl rfl

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated.map_comp
statement:
theorem map_comp {F : A ⥤ A'} [F.Additive] [F.Linear R] {G : A' ⥤ A''} [G.Additive] [G.Linear R]
    (hF : QPiFunctor R F) (hG : QPiFunctor R G) : map (hF.comp hG) = map hF ⋙ map hG
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Orbit.map_comp]
  refine Orbit.map_congr' (fun _ => rfl) (fun g => ?_) fun X => ?_
  · simp only [eqToHom_refl, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp, ShiftFunctor.comp_F,
      Functor.comp_map, shiftFunctor_F]
    apply hom_ext <;> simp
    rfl
  · simp only [shiftFunctor_γ_hom_app, ShiftFunctor.comp_γ_hom_app, QPiFunctor.comp_γ_hom_app,
      eqToHom_refl, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]
    change _ = homMk _ 0 ≫ (Associated.map hG.toPiFunctor).map (homMk _ 0)
    apply hom_ext <;> simp
    rfl

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated.isQPiNatural_whiskerLeft
statement:
theorem isQPiNatural_whiskerLeft {E : Type w₅} [Category.{w₆} E] [Preadditive E] [Linear R E]
    [QPiCategory R E] {K : E ⥤ A} [K.Additive] [K.Linear R] (hK : QPiFunctor R K)
    (hx : QPiFunctor.IsQPiNatural R hF hG x) :
    QPiFunctor.IsQPiNatural R (hK.comp hF) (hK.comp hG) (Functor.whiskerLeft K x)
proof:
:=
  ⟨Associated.isPiNatural_whiskerLeft hK.toPiFunctor hx.1, fun X => by
    simp only [QPiFunctor.comp_γ_hom_app, Functor.whiskerLeft_app, Functor.comp_obj, Category.assoc]
    rw [x.naturality, reassoc_of% (hx.2 (K.obj X))]⟩

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated.isQPiNatural_whiskerRight
statement:
theorem isQPiNatural_whiskerRight {K : A' ⥤ A''} [K.Additive] [K.Linear R] (hK : QPiFunctor R K)
    (hx : QPiFunctor.IsQPiNatural R hF hG x) :
    QPiFunctor.IsQPiNatural R (hF.comp hK) (hG.comp hK) (Functor.whiskerRight x K)
proof:
:=
  ⟨Associated.isPiNatural_whiskerRight hK.toPiFunctor hx.1, fun X => by
    simp only [QPiFunctor.comp_γ_hom_app, Functor.whiskerRight_app, Functor.comp_obj,
      Category.assoc, ← K.map_comp, hx.2 X]
    rw [K.map_comp, reassoc_of% (hK.γ.hom.naturality (x.app X))]⟩

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated.mapNat_whiskerLeft_app
statement:
theorem mapNat_whiskerLeft_app {E : Type w₅} [Category.{w₆} E] [Preadditive E] [Linear R E]
    [QPiCategory R E] {K : E ⥤ A} [K.Additive] [K.Linear R] (hK : QPiFunctor R K)
    (hx : QPiFunctor.IsQPiNatural R hF hG x) (X : QAssociated R E) :
    (mapNat (isQPiNatural_whiskerLeft hK hx)).app X = (mapNat hx).app ((map hK).obj X)

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated.mapNat_whiskerRight_app
statement:
theorem mapNat_whiskerRight_app {K : A' ⥤ A''} [K.Additive] [K.Linear R] (hK : QPiFunctor R K)
    (hx : QPiFunctor.IsQPiNatural R hF hG x) (X : QAssociated R A) :
    (mapNat (isQPiNatural_whiskerRight hK hx)).app X = (map hK).map ((mapNat hx).app X)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mapNat_app, mapNat_app, Orbit.map_ι_map]
  congr 1
  apply hom_ext <;> simp [shiftFunctor]

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated.TbF_map_mem_degree
statement:
theorem TbF_map_mem_degree {X Y : Associated R (GUnderlying R B)} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    (TbF R B).map f ∈ degree (R := R) ((TbF R B).obj X) ((TbF R B).obj Y) 0

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated.TbF_map_injective
statement:
theorem TbF_map_injective {X Y : Associated R (GUnderlying R B)} {f g : X ⟶ Y}
    (h : (TbF R B).map f = (TbF R B).map g) : f = g

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated.TbF_map_Qhat
statement:
theorem TbF_map_Qhat {X Y : Associated R (GUnderlying R B)} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    (TbF R B).map ((Qhat R (GUnderlying R B)).map f) =
      (QPiSupercategory.Q (R := R)).map ((TbF R B).map f)
proof:
:= by
  have h := CategoryTheory.Functor.congr_hom (Associated.T_naturality (R := R)
    (A := DegreeZero R B) (B := DegreeZero R B) (DegreeZero.map (R := R)
      (QPiSupercategory.Q (R := R) (C := B)))) f
  simp only [Functor.comp_map, eqToHom_refl, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp] at h
  exact congrArg Subtype.val h

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated.TbF_map_dQ
statement:
theorem TbF_map_dQ {X Y : Associated R (GUnderlying R B)} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    (TbF R B).map ((shiftData R (GUnderlying R B)).Q.map f) =
      (QPiSupercategory.Q (R := R)).map ((TbF R B).map f)

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated.τ_zero
statement: theorem τ_zero (X : Associated R (GUnderlying R B)) : τ R B 0 X = Iso.refl _

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated.τ_succ
statement:
theorem τ_succ (i : ℤ) (X : Associated R (GUnderlying R B)) :
    (τ R B (i + 1) X).hom = (TbF R B).map (((dB R B).succ i).inv.app X) ≫
      (σ (R := R) (bobj (((dB R B).pow i).obj X))).hom ≫ (τ R B i X).hom
proof:
:= by
  rcases i with n | (_ | n)
  · show (τNat R B (n + 1) X).hom = (TbF R B).map (𝟙 _) ≫ _ ≫ _
    rw [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id, Category.id_comp]; rfl
  · show 𝟙 _ = (TbF R B).map ((dB R B).e.counitIso.inv.app X) ≫ _ ≫
      ((σ (R := R) (bobj ((dB R B).Qi.obj X))).inv ≫ (TbF R B).map ((dB R B).e.counitIso.hom.app X))
    erw [Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc, ← Functor.map_comp, Iso.inv_hom_id_app]
    exact ((TbF R B).map_id _).symm
  · show (τ R B (Int.negSucc n) X).hom = (TbF R B).map (((dB R B).succ (Int.negSucc (n + 1))).inv.app X) ≫
      _ ≫ ((σ (R := R) _).inv ≫ (TbF R B).map ((dB R B).e.counitIso.hom.app _) ≫ (τNeg R B n X).hom)
    rw [succ_negSucc_succ_inv_app]
    erw [Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc, ← Functor.map_comp_assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_app]
    erw [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id, Category.id_comp]
    rcases n with _ | n <;> rfl

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated.τNat_hom_mem
statement:
theorem τNat_hom_mem (n : ℕ) (X : Associated R (GUnderlying R B)) :
    (τNat R B n X).hom ∈ parity (R := R) _ _ 0 ∧ (τNat R B n X).hom ∈ degree (R := R) _ _ (-n)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact ⟨id_mem _, id_mem_degree _⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    refine ⟨by simpa using! comp_mem (σ_hom_mem (R := R) _) ih.1, ?_⟩
    have := comp_mem_degree (σ_hom_mem_degree (R := R) _) ih.2
    rwa [show (-1 + -(n : ℤ)) = -((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) by push_cast; ring] at this

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated.τNeg_hom_mem
statement:
theorem τNeg_hom_mem (n : ℕ) (X : Associated R (GUnderlying R B)) :
    (τNeg R B n X).hom ∈ parity (R := R) _ _ 0 ∧
      (τNeg R B n X).hom ∈ degree (R := R) _ _ ((n : ℤ) + 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    show (σ (R := R) _).inv ≫ (TbF R B).map ((dB R B).e.counitIso.hom.app X) ∈ _ ∧
      (σ (R := R) _).inv ≫ (TbF R B).map ((dB R B).e.counitIso.hom.app X) ∈ _
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · have := comp_mem (σ_inv_mem (R := R) (bobj ((dB R B).Qi.obj X)))
        (map_mem (TbF R B) ((dB R B).counit_mem X))
      simpa using! this
    · have := comp_mem_degree (σ_inv_mem_degree (R := R) (bobj ((dB R B).Qi.obj X)))
        (TbF_map_mem_degree (R := R) (B := B) ((dB R B).e.counitIso.hom.app X))
      simpa using! this
  | succ n ih =>
    show (σ (R := R) _).inv ≫ (TbF R B).map ((dB R B).e.counitIso.hom.app _) ≫ (τNeg R B n X).hom ∈ _ ∧
      (σ (R := R) _).inv ≫ (TbF R B).map ((dB R B).e.counitIso.hom.app _) ≫ (τNeg R B n X).hom ∈ _
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · have := comp_mem (σ_inv_mem (R := R) (bobj ((dB R B).Qi.obj (((dB R B).powNeg (n + 1)).obj X))))
        (comp_mem (map_mem (TbF R B) ((dB R B).counit_mem (((dB R B).powNeg (n + 1)).obj X))) ih.1)
      simpa using! this
    · have := comp_mem_degree
        (σ_inv_mem_degree (R := R) (bobj ((dB R B).Qi.obj (((dB R B).powNeg (n + 1)).obj X))))
        (comp_mem_degree (TbF_map_mem_degree (R := R) (B := B)
          ((dB R B).e.counitIso.hom.app (((dB R B).powNeg (n + 1)).obj X))) ih.2)
      rwa [show (1 + (0 + ((n : ℤ) + 1))) = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) + 1 by push_cast; ring] at this

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated.τ_hom_mem
statement:
theorem τ_hom_mem (i : ℤ) (X : Associated R (GUnderlying R B)) :
    (τ R B i X).hom ∈ parity (R := R) _ _ 0 ∧ (τ R B i X).hom ∈ degree (R := R) _ _ (-i)
proof:
:= by
  rcases i with n | n
  · exact τNat_hom_mem n X
  · refine ⟨(τNeg_hom_mem n X).1, ?_⟩
    have := (τNeg_hom_mem n X).2
    rwa [show ((n : ℤ) + 1) = -Int.negSucc n by rw [Int.neg_negSucc]; push_cast; ring] at this

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated.τ_inv_mem
statement:
theorem τ_inv_mem (i : ℤ) (X : Associated R (GUnderlying R B)) :
    (τ R B i X).inv ∈ parity (R := R) _ _ 0 ∧ (τ R B i X).inv ∈ degree (R := R) _ _ i
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨inv_mem _ (τ_hom_mem i X).1, ?_⟩
  simpa using inv_mem_degree _ (τ_hom_mem i X).2

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated.τ_succ_inv
statement:
theorem τ_succ_inv (i : ℤ) (X : Associated R (GUnderlying R B)) :
    (τ R B (i + 1) X).inv = (τ R B i X).inv ≫ (σ (R := R) (bobj (((dB R B).pow i).obj X))).inv ≫
      (TbF R B).map (((dB R B).succ i).hom.app X)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cancel_epi (τ R B (i + 1) X).hom, Iso.hom_inv_id, τ_succ]
  simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
  rw [← Functor.map_comp, Iso.inv_hom_id_app]
  exact ((TbF R B).map_id _).symm

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated.val_succ
statement:
theorem val_succ {m : ℤ} {f : (dB R B).FamAll X Y} (hf : f ∈ (dB R B).Fam R m X Y) (i j : ℤ) :
    val f (i + 1) (j + 1) = val f i j
proof:
:= by
  rw [val, val, τ_succ_inv, τ_succ, Fam.compat hf]
  simp only [Category.assoc, Functor.map_comp]
  rw [← Functor.map_comp_assoc (TbF R B) (((dB R B).succ i).hom.app X), Iso.hom_inv_id_app]
  erw [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id, Category.id_comp]
  rw [← Functor.map_comp_assoc (TbF R B) (((dB R B).succ j).hom.app Y), Iso.hom_inv_id_app]
  erw [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id, Category.id_comp]
  erw [TbF_map_Qhat]
  rw [QPiSupercategory.Q_map_eq]
  simp

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated.val_eq
statement:
theorem val_eq {m : ℤ} {f : (dB R B).FamAll X Y} (hf : f ∈ (dB R B).Fam R m X Y) {i j : ℤ}
    (h : i - j = m) : val f i j = val f 0 (-m)
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ k : ℤ, val f (0 + k) (-m + k) = val f 0 (-m) := by
    intro k
    induction k using Int.induction_on with
    | zero => simp
    | succ k ih => rw [← ih, ← add_assoc, ← add_assoc, val_succ hf]
    | pred k ih =>
      rw [← ih, show (0 : ℤ) + -(k : ℤ) = 0 + (-(k : ℤ) - 1) + 1 by ring,
        show -m + -(k : ℤ) = -m + (-(k : ℤ) - 1) + 1 by ring, val_succ hf]
  rw [← key i, show 0 + i = i by ring, show -m + i = j by omega]

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated.val_zero
statement:
theorem val_zero {m : ℤ} (f : (dB R B).FamAll X Y) :
    val f 0 (-m) = (TbF R B).map (f 0 (-m)) ≫ (τ R B (-m) Y).hom

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated.val_famComp
statement:
theorem val_famComp (m : ℤ) {Z : Associated R (GUnderlying R B)} (f : (dB R B).FamAll X Y)
    (g : (dB R B).FamAll Y Z) (i k : ℤ) :
    val ((dB R B).famComp m f g) i k = val f i (i - m) ≫ val g (i - m) k
proof:
:= by
  rw [val, val, val, famComp, Functor.map_comp]
  simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated.TL_lof
statement:
theorem TL_lof {m : ℤ} (f : (dB R B).Fam R m X Y) :
    TL R B X Y ((dB R B).lof m X Y f) = val f.1 0 (-m)

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated.T_map_lof
statement:
theorem T_map_lof {X Y : QAssociated R (GUnderlying R B)} {m : ℤ} (f : (dB R B).Fam R m X.obj Y.obj) :
    (T R B).map ((dB R B).lof m X.obj Y.obj f : X ⟶ Y) = val f.1 0 (-m)

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated.val_mem
statement:
theorem val_mem {p : ZMod 2} {f : (dB R B).FamAll X Y} (i j : ℤ)
    (hf : f i j ∈ parity (R := R) _ _ p) : val f i j ∈ parity (R := R) _ _ p
proof:
:= by
  have := comp_mem (comp_mem (τ_inv_mem i X).1 (map_mem (TbF R B) hf)) (τ_hom_mem j Y).1
  rw [zero_add, add_zero, Category.assoc] at this
  exact this

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated.val_mem_degree
statement:
theorem val_mem_degree {f : (dB R B).FamAll X Y} (i j : ℤ) :
    val f i j ∈ degree (R := R) (bobj X) (bobj Y) (i - j)
proof:
:= by
  have := comp_mem_degree (comp_mem_degree (τ_inv_mem i X).2 (TbF_map_mem_degree (f i j)))
    (τ_hom_mem j Y).2
  rw [show i + 0 + -j = i - j by ring, Category.assoc] at this
  exact this

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated.dproj_TL
statement:
theorem dproj_TL (n : ℤ) (x : (dB R B).Hom X Y) :
    dproj R n (TL R B X Y x) = val ((dB R B).component n X Y x).1 0 (-n)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using Hom.induction_on with
  | zero =>
    simp [val]
    exact (congrArg _ (map_zero _)).trans (map_zero _)
  | add x y hx hy =>
    rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy, map_add]
    simp only [val, Submodule.coe_add, FamAll.add_apply, Functor.map_add, Preadditive.add_comp,
      Preadditive.comp_add]
  | lof m f =>
    rw [TL_lof]
    by_cases h : m = n
    · subst h
      rw [component_lof_self, dproj_of_mem]
      simpa using val_mem_degree (f := f.1) 0 (-m)
    · rw [(dB R B).component_lof_of_ne _ h, dproj_of_mem_ne (by simpa using val_mem_degree (f := f.1) 0 (-m)) h]
      simp [val]

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated.TL_injective
statement: theorem TL_injective : Function.Injective (TL R B X Y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LinearMap.ker_eq_bot, Submodule.eq_bot_iff]
  intro x hx
  refine Hom.ext fun n => ?_
  rw [map_zero]
  have h0 : val ((dB R B).component n X Y x).1 0 (-n) = 0 := by
    rw [← dproj_TL, LinearMap.mem_ker.1 hx, map_zero]
  rw [val_zero] at h0
  have h1 : (TbF R B).map (((dB R B).component n X Y x).1 0 (-n)) = (TbF R B).map 0 := by
    rw [Functor.map_zero]
    exact (cancel_mono (τ R B (-n) Y).hom).1 (by rw [h0, Limits.zero_comp])
  exact Subtype.ext (Fam.eq_of_entry ((dB R B).component n X Y x).2 (Submodule.zero_mem _)
    (i₀ := 0) (j₀ := -n) (by ring) (TbF_map_injective h1))

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated.TbF_map_TbPre
statement:
theorem TbF_map_TbPre {Z W : Associated R (GUnderlying R B)} (h : bobj Z ⟶ bobj W)
    (hh : h ∈ degree (R := R) (bobj Z) (bobj W) 0) : (TbF R B).map (TbPre h hh) = h
proof:
:=
  congrArg Subtype.val (Associated.T_map_Tinv_map (R := R) (A := DegreeZero R B)
    (⟨h, hh⟩ : (⟨bobj Z⟩ : DegreeZero R B) ⟶ ⟨bobj W⟩))

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated.conj_mem_degree
statement:
theorem conj_mem_degree {n : ℤ} {g : bobj X ⟶ bobj Y} (hg : g ∈ degree (R := R) _ _ n) {i j : ℤ}
    (h : i - j = n) :
    (τ R B i X).hom ≫ g ≫ (τ R B j Y).inv ∈ degree (R := R) (bobj (((dB R B).pow i).obj X))
      (bobj (((dB R B).pow j).obj Y)) 0
proof:
:= by
  have := comp_mem_degree (comp_mem_degree (τ_hom_mem i X).2 hg) (τ_inv_mem j Y).2
  rw [show -i + n + j = 0 by omega, Category.assoc] at this
  exact this

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated.TbF_famOf
statement:
theorem TbF_famOf {n : ℤ} (g : bobj X ⟶ bobj Y) (hg : g ∈ degree (R := R) _ _ n) {i j : ℤ}
    (h : i - j = n) : (TbF R B).map (famOf g hg i j) = (τ R B i X).hom ≫ g ≫ (τ R B j Y).inv

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated.famOf_mem
statement:
theorem famOf_mem {n : ℤ} (g : bobj X ⟶ bobj Y) (hg : g ∈ degree (R := R) _ _ n) :
    famOf g hg ∈ (dB R B).Fam R n X Y
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun i j h => by rw [famOf, dite_eq_right h], fun i j => ?_⟩
  by_cases h : i - j = n
  · apply TbF_map_injective
    rw [TbF_famOf g hg (by omega), Functor.map_comp, Functor.map_comp]
    erw [TbF_map_Qhat]
    rw [TbF_famOf g hg h, τ_succ, τ_succ_inv, QPiSupercategory.Q_map_eq]
    simp only [Category.assoc]
  · rw [famOf, famOf, dite_eq_right (by omega), dite_eq_right h]; simp

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated.TL_famOf
statement:
theorem TL_famOf {n : ℤ} (g : bobj X ⟶ bobj Y) (hg : g ∈ degree (R := R) _ _ n) :
    TL R B X Y ((dB R B).lof n X Y ⟨famOf g hg, famOf_mem g hg⟩) = g
proof:
:= by
  rw [TL_lof, val, TbF_famOf g hg (by ring), τ_zero]
  simp

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated.TL_surjective
statement: theorem TL_surjective : Function.Surjective (TL R B X Y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LinearMap.range_eq_top, eq_top_iff]
  rintro g -
  refine induction_on_degree (R := R) g (Submodule.zero_mem _) (fun n g hg => ⟨_, TL_famOf g hg⟩)
    (fun g h hg hh => Submodule.add_mem _ hg hh)

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated.T_map_Tinv_map
statement: theorem T_map_Tinv_map {b b' : B} (g : b ⟶ b') : (T R B).map ((Tinv R B).map g) = g
proof:
:=
  (T R B).map_preimage (show (T R B).obj ⟨⟨⟨⟨b⟩⟩⟩⟩ ⟶ (T R B).obj ⟨⟨⟨⟨b'⟩⟩⟩⟩ from g)

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated.Tinv_comp_T
statement: theorem Tinv_comp_T : Tinv R B ⋙ T R B = 𝟭 B

:=
  CategoryTheory.Functor.ext (fun _ => rfl) fun b b' g => by simpa using T_map_Tinv_map g

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated.T_comp_Tinv

proof:

    (T R B).map_injective (by simpa using T_map_Tinv_map ((T R B).map x))

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated.T_map_ι
statement:
theorem T_map_ι {Z W : Associated R (GUnderlying R B)} (f : Z ⟶ W) :
    (T R B).map ((ι (dB R B)).map f) = (TbF R B).map f
proof:
:= by
  rw [ι_map]
  refine (T_map_lof (X := (⟨Z⟩ : QAssociated R _)) (Y := ⟨W⟩) _).trans ?_
  rw [neg_zero, val, τ_zero, τ_zero]
  simp [mapFam, diagFam_self]

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated.T_map_ζ
statement:
theorem T_map_ζ (X : QAssociated R (GUnderlying R B)) :
    (T R B).map (PiSupercategory.ζ (R := R) X).hom = (PiSupercategory.ζ (R := R) ((T R B).obj X)).hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [ζ_eq, ζIso, Functor.mapIso_hom]
  erw [T_map_ι]
  exact congrArg Subtype.val (Associated.T_map_ζ (R := R) (A := DegreeZero R B) X.obj)

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated.T_map_σ
statement:
theorem T_map_σ (X : QAssociated R (GUnderlying R B)) :
    (T R B).map (QPiSupercategory.σ (R := R) X).hom = (σ (R := R) ((T R B).obj X)).hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [σ_eq]
  show (T R B).map ((dB R B).lof (-1) _ _ _) = _
  rw [T_map_lof, neg_neg, val, τ_zero]
  show 𝟙 _ ≫ (TbF R B).map ((dB R B).famσ X.obj 0 (0 + 1)) ≫ (τ R B 1 X.obj).hom = _
  rw [famσ_succ, comm_zero_hom_app]
  erw [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id, Category.id_comp, Category.id_comp]
  show (σ (R := R) _).hom ≫ 𝟙 _ = _
  rw [Category.comp_id]; rfl

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated.TbF_map_F
statement:
theorem TbF_map_F {Z W : Associated R (GUnderlying R B)} (f : Z ⟶ W) :

proof:
:= by
  have h := CategoryTheory.Functor.congr_hom (Associated.T_naturality (R := R)
    (A := DegreeZero R B) (B := DegreeZero R B') (DegreeZero.map (R := R) F)) f
  simp only [Functor.comp_map, eqToHom_refl, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp] at h
  exact congrArg Subtype.val h

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated.TbF_γhat_inv

proof:
:= by
  show ((Associated.T R (DegreeZero R B')).map (Associated.homMk _ 0)).1 = _
  rw [Associated.T_map]
  simp only [Associated.homMk_fst, Associated.homMk_snd, Underlying.zero_val, Limits.zero_comp,
    add_zero]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated.TbF_Γ_zero
statement:
theorem TbF_Γ_zero (Z : Associated R (GUnderlying R B)) :
    (TbF R B').map (((DEΦ F).Γ 0).hom.app Z) = 𝟙 _
proof:

  show (TbF R B').map (𝟙 _ ≫ 𝟙 _) = _
  simp
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated.TbF_Γ_inv_τ_succ
statement:
theorem TbF_Γ_inv_τ_succ (i : ℤ) (Z : Associated R (GUnderlying R B)) :
    (TbF R B').map (((DEΦ F).Γ (i + 1)).inv.app Z) ≫ (τ R B' (i + 1) ((DEΦ F).F.obj Z)).hom =
      F.map ((TbF R B).map (((dB R B).succ i).inv.app Z) ≫ (σ (R := R) (bobj (((dB R B).pow i).obj Z))).hom) ≫
        (TbF R B').map (((DEΦ F).Γ i).inv.app Z) ≫ (τ R B' i ((DEΦ F).F.obj Z)).hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [ShiftFunctor.Γ_succ_inv_app]
  rw [τ_succ]
  rw [(TbF R B').map_comp, (TbF R B').map_comp, (TbF R B').map_comp]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [← (TbF R B').map_comp_assoc (((dB R B').succ i).hom.app _), Iso.hom_inv_id_app]
  erw [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id, Category.id_comp]
  rw [TbF_map_dQ, TbF_map_F, TbF_γhat_inv]
  erw [QPiSupercategory.σ_naturality_assoc (R := R) (C := B')
    ((TbF R B').map (((DEΦ F).Γ i).inv.app Z))]
  rw [γ_inv, F.map_comp]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  erw [Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated.TbF_Γ_inv_τ
statement:
theorem TbF_Γ_inv_τ (i : ℤ) (Z : Associated R (GUnderlying R B)) :
    (TbF R B').map (((DEΦ F).Γ i).inv.app Z) ≫ (τ R B' i ((DEΦ F).F.obj Z)).hom =
      F.map (τ R B i Z).hom
proof:
:= by
  have step : ∀ i : ℤ, ((TbF R B').map (((DEΦ F).Γ (i + 1)).inv.app Z) ≫
      (τ R B' (i + 1) ((DEΦ F).F.obj Z)).hom = F.map (τ R B (i + 1) Z).hom) ↔
      ((TbF R B').map (((DEΦ F).Γ i).inv.app Z) ≫ (τ R B' i ((DEΦ F).F.obj Z)).hom =
        F.map (τ R B i Z).hom) := by
    intro i
    let K := F.mapIso (((TbF R B).mapIso (((dB R B).succ i).app Z)).symm ≪≫
      σ (R := R) (bobj (((dB R B).pow i).obj Z)))
    have h1 := TbF_Γ_inv_τ_succ F i Z
    have h2 : F.map (τ R B (i + 1) Z).hom = K.hom ≫ F.map (τ R B i Z).hom := by
      rw [τ_succ]; simp [K]
    rw [h1, h2]
    exact ⟨fun h => (cancel_epi K.hom).1 h, fun h => by rw [h]; rfl⟩
  induction i using Int.induction_on with
  | zero =>
    rw [τ_zero, τ_zero]
    simp only [Iso.refl_hom, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id]
    erw [Category.comp_id]
    show (TbF R B').map (𝟙 _ ≫ 𝟙 _) = 𝟙 _
    simp
    rfl
  | succ k ih => exact (step k).2 ih
  | pred k ih =>
    have := (step (-(k : ℤ) - 1)).1
    rw [show -(k : ℤ) - 1 + 1 = -(k : ℤ) by ring] at this
    exact this ih

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated.T_naturality
statement: theorem T_naturality : DEmap F ⋙ T R B' = T R B ⋙ F
proof:
:=
  CategoryTheory.Functor.ext (fun _ => rfl) fun X Y x => by
    simp only [Functor.comp_map, eqToHom_refl, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]
    induction x using Hom.induction_on with
    | zero => simp
    | add x y hx hy =>
      rw [(DEmap F).map_add, (T R B').map_add, hx, hy, (T R B).map_add, F.map_add]
    | lof m f =>
      have e1 : (DEmap F).map ((dB R B).lof m X.obj Y.obj f : X ⟶ Y) =
          (dB R B').lof m _ _ ((DEΦ F).famMapₗ m X.obj Y.obj f) :=
        Orbit.map_map_lof (DEΦ F) f
      rw [e1]
      refine (T_map_lof (X := (DEmap F).obj X) (Y := (DEmap F).obj Y)
        ((DEΦ F).famMapₗ m X.obj Y.obj f)).trans ?_
      rw [T_map_lof, val, val, τ_zero, τ_zero]
      simp only [Iso.refl_inv, F.map_comp]
      erw [Category.id_comp, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id, Category.id_comp]
      show (TbF R B').map (((DEΦ F).Γ 0).hom.app _ ≫ (DEΦ F).F.map (f.1 0 (-m)) ≫
          ((DEΦ F).Γ (-m)).inv.app _) ≫ _ = _
      rw [(TbF R B').map_comp, (TbF R B').map_comp, TbF_Γ_zero, Category.id_comp, TbF_map_F,
        Category.assoc]
      congr 1
      exact TbF_Γ_inv_τ F (-m) Y.obj

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated.T_map_mapNat_app
statement:
theorem T_map_mapNat_app {G : B ⥤ B'} [G.Additive] [G.Linear R] [IsGradedSuperfunctor R G]
    {x : ∀ X, F.obj X ⟶ G.obj X} (hx : IsGradedSupernatural R 0 0 x)
    (X : QAssociated R (GUnderlying R B)) :
    (T R B').map ((mapNat (GUnderlying.isQPiNatural hx)).app X) =
      x ((T R B).obj X)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mapNat_app, T_map_ι]
  show ((Associated.T R (DegreeZero R B')).map (Associated.homMk _ 0)).1 = _
  simp only [Associated.T_map, Associated.homMk_fst, Associated.homMk_snd]
  simp
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.KrullSchmidtParityExamples.qEnd_single
statement:
private theorem qEnd_single (e : qPoint ⟶ qPoint) :
    ∃ a : ℚ, (e.val : QAlgebra) = AddMonoidAlgebra.single 0 a
proof:
:= by
  have h : (e.val : QAlgebra) ∈ qGrading 0 := e.property
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := (AddMonoidAlgebra.mem_grade_iff' ℚ 0 e.val).1 h
  exact ⟨a, ha.symm⟩

name: StringDiagrams.KrullSchmidtParityExamples.typeQ_indec
statement: theorem typeQ_indec : IsIndec typeQObj
proof:
:= by
  apply (isIndec_obj_iff (SKar.of ℚ QCat) qPoint).2
  constructor
  · intro hz
    have h := congrArg (fun e : qPoint ⟶ qPoint => (e.val : QAlgebra).coeff 0)
      ((IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero _).1 hz)
    change (1 : QAlgebra).coeff 0 = (0 : QAlgebra).coeff 0 at h
    simp at h
  · intro e he
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := qEnd_single e
    let f : QAlgebra := e.val
    have hmul : f * f = f := congrArg Subtype.val he
    change f = AddMonoidAlgebra.single 0 a at ha
    rw [ha, AddMonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single, zero_add] at hmul
    have h : a * a = a := by
      simpa using congrArg (fun x : QAlgebra => x.coeff 0) hmul
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp (show a * (a - 1) = 0 by rw [mul_sub, mul_one, h, sub_self]) with h | h
    · left
      apply Subtype.ext
      change f = (0 : QAlgebra)
      simpa only [h, AddMonoidAlgebra.single_zero] using ha
    · right
      apply Subtype.ext
      change f = (1 : QAlgebra)
      simpa only [sub_eq_zero.mp h, ← AddMonoidAlgebra.one_def] using ha

name: StringDiagrams.KrullSchmidtParityExamples.typeQ_tate_ne_zero
statement:
theorem typeQ_tate_ne_zero :
    letI := K₀.moduleZπ ℚ (SKar ℚ QCat)
    ∃ x : ParityBasis.fixedSubmodule (M := K₀ (SKar ℚ QCat)),
      Submodule.Quotient.mk x ≠ (0 : ParityBasis.TateZero (M := K₀ (SKar ℚ QCat)))
proof:
:= by
  let := K₀.moduleZπ ℚ (SKar ℚ QCat)
  have hx : Zπ.π • K₀.mk typeQObj = K₀.mk typeQObj := by
    rw [K₀.π_smul_mk]
    exact K₀.mk_eq_mk_of_iso typeQParityIso
  refine ⟨⟨K₀.mk typeQObj, hx⟩, ?_⟩
  intro h
  exact KrullSchmidt.indec_not_norm ℚ typeQ_indec typeQParityIso
    ((ParityBasis.tate_eq_zero_iff (K₀.mk typeQObj) hx).1 h)

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.twoJ_eq_comp
statement:
theorem twoJ_eq_comp :
    twoJ R B = (QTwoEnvelope.twoJ R B).comp (TwoEnvelope.twoJ R (QTwoEnvelope R B))
proof:
:= by
  refine TwoEnvelope.twoSuperfunctor_ext rfl HEq.rfl HEq.rfl (heq_of_eq ?_) (heq_of_eq ?_)
  · funext a b c f g
    apply Iso.ext
    exact (Category.id_comp _).symm
  · funext a
    apply Iso.ext
    exact (Category.id_comp _).symm

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.twoJ_mapFunctor
statement:
theorem twoJ_mapFunctor (a b : B) :
    (twoJ R B).mapFunctor a b = QPiEnvelope.J R (a ⟶ b)

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.twoJ_isGraded
statement:
theorem twoJ_isGraded [∀ a b : B, GradedSupercategory R (a ⟶ b)] [GradedTwoSupercategory R B] :
    (twoJ R B).IsGraded where
  map₂_mem_degree {a b f g n η} hη
proof:
:= by
    show η ∈ degree (R := R) f g (n + (0 - 0))
    simpa using hη
  mapComp_hom_mem_degree f g := by
    show 𝟙 (f ≫ g) ∈ degree (R := R) _ _ (0 + (0 + 0 - 0))
    simpa using! id_mem_degree (R := R) (f ≫ g)
  mapId_hom_mem_degree a := by
    show 𝟙 (𝟙 a) ∈ degree (R := R) _ _ (0 + (0 - 0))
    simpa using! id_mem_degree (R := R) (𝟙 a)

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.restrict_obj
statement:
@[simp] theorem restrict_obj (T : TwoSuperfunctor R (QPiTwoEnvelope R B) C) (a : B) :
    (restrict T).obj a = T.obj ⟨⟨a⟩⟩

statement:
theorem restrict_map (T : TwoSuperfunctor R (QPiTwoEnvelope R B) C) {a b : B} (f : a ⟶ b) :

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.restrict_map₂
statement:
theorem restrict_map₂ (T : TwoSuperfunctor R (QPiTwoEnvelope R B) C) {a b : B} {f g : a ⟶ b}
    (η : f ⟶ g) : (restrict T).map₂ η = T.map₂ (J2 η)

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.restrict_mapComp
statement:
theorem restrict_mapComp (T : TwoSuperfunctor R (QPiTwoEnvelope R B) C) {a b c : B} (f : a ⟶ b)
    (g : b ⟶ c) : (restrict T).mapComp f g = T.mapComp (Jm (R := R) f) (Jm g)

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.restrict_eq_comp
statement:
theorem restrict_eq_comp (T : TwoSuperfunctor R (QPiTwoEnvelope R B) C) :
    restrict T = (twoJ R B).comp T
proof:
:= by
  refine TwoEnvelope.twoSuperfunctor_ext rfl HEq.rfl HEq.rfl (heq_of_eq ?_) (heq_of_eq ?_)
  · funext a b c f g
    apply Iso.ext
    show (T.mapComp (Jm (R := R) f) (Jm g)).hom = (T.mapComp (Jm f) (Jm g)).hom ≫
      T.map₂ (𝟙 (Jm (R := R) f ≫ Jm g))
    rw [T.map₂_id]
    erw [Category.comp_id]
  · funext a
    apply Iso.ext
    show (T.mapId ⟨⟨a⟩⟩).hom = (T.mapId ⟨⟨a⟩⟩).hom ≫ T.map₂ (𝟙 (𝟙 (⟨⟨a⟩⟩ : QPiTwoEnvelope R B)))
    rw [T.map₂_id]
    erw [Category.comp_id]

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.restrict_isGraded
statement:
theorem restrict_isGraded [∀ a b : B, GradedSupercategory R (a ⟶ b)] [GradedTwoSupercategory R B]
    [∀ a b : C, GradedSupercategory R (a ⟶ b)] {T : TwoSuperfunctor R (QPiTwoEnvelope R B) C}
    (hT : T.IsGraded) : (restrict T).IsGraded where
  map₂_mem_degree {a b f g n η} hη
proof:
:=
    hT.map₂_mem_degree (f := Jm f) (g := Jm g) (η := J2 η) (by
      show η ∈ degree (R := R) f g (n + (0 - 0))
      simpa using hη)
  mapComp_hom_mem_degree f g := hT.mapComp_hom_mem_degree (Jm f) (Jm g)
  mapId_hom_mem_degree a := hT.mapId_hom_mem_degree ⟨⟨a⟩⟩

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.extend_obj
statement: @[simp] theorem extend_obj (a : QPiTwoEnvelope R B) : (extend F).obj a = F.obj a.as.as

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.extend_map
statement:
theorem extend_map (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (extend F).map f = piPow R f.par (qPow R f.obj.shift (F.map f.obj.obj))

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.extend_map₂
statement:
theorem extend_map₂ {f g : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ g) :
    (extend F).map₂ η = (ζPow R f.par _).hom ≫ ((σPow R f.obj.shift (F.map f.obj.obj)).hom ≫
      F.map₂ (toHom η) ≫ (σPow R g.obj.shift (F.map g.obj.obj)).inv) ≫ (ζPow R g.par _).inv

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.extendComp_hom
statement:
theorem extendComp_hom (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) :
    ((extend F).mapComp f g).hom = sign R (f.par * g.par) •
      ((ζPow R f.par _).hom ▷ (extend F).map g ≫
        (QTwoEnvelope.extend F).map f.obj ◁ (ζPow R g.par _).hom ≫
        ((σPow R f.obj.shift (F.map f.obj.obj)).hom ▷ (QTwoEnvelope.extend F).map g.obj ≫
          F.map f.obj.obj ◁ (σPow R g.obj.shift (F.map g.obj.obj)).hom ≫
          (F.mapComp f.obj.obj g.obj.obj).hom ≫
          (σPow R (f.obj.shift + g.obj.shift) (F.map (f.obj.obj ≫ g.obj.obj))).inv) ≫
        (ζPow R (f.par + g.par) _).inv)

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.extend_mapId
statement: theorem extend_mapId (a : QPiTwoEnvelope R B) : (extend F).mapId a = F.mapId a.as.as

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.extend_map_J
statement: theorem extend_map_J {a b : B} (f : a ⟶ b) : (extend F).map (Jm (R := R) f) = F.map f

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.extend_map₂_J
statement:
theorem extend_map₂_J {a b : B} {f g : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ g) :
    (extend F).map₂ (J2 (R := R) η) = F.map₂ η

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.extendComp_J
statement:
theorem extendComp_J {a b c : B} (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) :
    ((extend F).mapComp (Jm (R := R) f) (Jm g)).hom = (F.mapComp f g).hom
proof:
:=
  (TwoEnvelope.extendComp_J (QTwoEnvelope.extend F) (a := ⟨⟨a⟩⟩) (b := ⟨⟨b⟩⟩) (c := ⟨⟨c⟩⟩)
    (QTwoEnvelope.Jm f) (QTwoEnvelope.Jm g)).trans
    (QTwoEnvelope.extendComp_J F (a := ⟨a⟩) (b := ⟨b⟩) (c := ⟨c⟩) f g)

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.twoJ_comp_extend
statement: theorem twoJ_comp_extend : (twoJ R B).comp (extend F) = F
proof:
:= by
  refine TwoEnvelope.twoSuperfunctor_ext rfl HEq.rfl (heq_of_eq ?_) (heq_of_eq ?_)
    (heq_of_eq ?_)
  · funext a b f g η
    exact extend_map₂_J F η
  · funext a b c f g
    apply Iso.ext
    show ((extend F).mapComp (Jm (R := R) f) (Jm g)).hom ≫
      (extend F).map₂ (𝟙 (Jm (R := R) f ≫ Jm g)) = _
    rw [(extend F).map₂_id]
    erw [Category.comp_id]
    exact extendComp_J F f g
  · funext a
    apply Iso.ext
    show (F.mapId a).hom ≫ (extend F).map₂ (𝟙 (𝟙 (⟨⟨a⟩⟩ : QPiTwoEnvelope R B))) = _
    rw [(extend F).map₂_id]
    erw [Category.comp_id]

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.restrict_extend
statement: theorem restrict_extend : restrict (extend F) = F

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.extend_isGraded
statement:
theorem extend_isGraded [∀ a b : B, GradedSupercategory R (a ⟶ b)] [GradedTwoSupercategory R C]
    (hF : F.IsGraded) : (extend F).IsGraded where
  map₂_mem_degree {a b f g n η} hη
proof:
:= by
    have hη' : toHom η ∈ degree (R := R) f.obj.obj g.obj.obj (n + (f.obj.shift - g.obj.shift)) :=
      hη
    have := comp_mem_degree (ζPow_hom_mem_degree (R := R) f.par _)
      (comp_mem_degree (σPow_hom_mem_degree (R := R) f.obj.shift _)
        (comp_mem_degree (hF.map₂_mem_degree hη')
          (comp_mem_degree (σPow_inv_mem_degree (R := R) g.obj.shift _)
            (ζPow_inv_mem_degree (R := R) g.par _))))
    rw [extend_map₂]
    simp only [Category.assoc] at this ⊢
    convert this using 2 <;> first | rfl | ring
  mapComp_hom_mem_degree f g := by
    rw [extendComp_hom]
    refine Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ?_
    have := comp_mem_degree
      (GradedTwoSupercategory.whiskerRight_mem_degree _ (ζPow_hom_mem_degree (R := R) f.par _))
      (comp_mem_degree
        (GradedTwoSupercategory.whiskerLeft_mem_degree _ (ζPow_hom_mem_degree (R := R) g.par _))
        (comp_mem_degree (GradedTwoSupercategory.whiskerRight_mem_degree _
            (σPow_hom_mem_degree (R := R) f.obj.shift _))
          (comp_mem_degree (GradedTwoSupercategory.whiskerLeft_mem_degree _
              (σPow_hom_mem_degree (R := R) g.obj.shift _))
            (comp_mem_degree (hF.mapComp_hom_mem_degree f.obj.obj g.obj.obj)
              (comp_mem_degree
                (σPow_inv_mem_degree (R := R) (f.obj.shift + g.obj.shift) _)
                (ζPow_inv_mem_degree (R := R) (f.par + g.par) _))))))
    simp only [Category.assoc] at this ⊢
    convert this using 2 <;> first | rfl | ring
  mapId_hom_mem_degree a := hF.mapId_hom_mem_degree a.as.as

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.extendTwoNatTrans_X
statement:
@[simp] theorem extendTwoNatTrans_X (θ : TwoNatTrans F G) (a : QPiTwoEnvelope R B) :

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.extendTwoNatTrans_x
statement:
theorem extendTwoNatTrans_x (θ : TwoNatTrans F G) (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (extendTwoNatTrans θ).x f =
      (ζPow R f.par _).hom ▷ θ.X b.as.as ≫
        ((σPow R f.obj.shift (F.map f.obj.obj)).hom ▷ θ.X b.as.as ≫ θ.x f.obj.obj ≫
          θ.X a.as.as ◁ (σPow R f.obj.shift (G.map f.obj.obj)).inv) ≫
        θ.X a.as.as ◁ (ζPow R f.par _).inv

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.extendTwoNatTrans_x_J
statement:
theorem extendTwoNatTrans_x_J (θ : TwoNatTrans F G) {a b : B} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (extendTwoNatTrans θ).x (Jm (R := R) f) = θ.x f
proof:
:=
  (TwoEnvelope.extendX_J (a := (⟨⟨a⟩⟩ : QPiTwoEnvelope R B)) (b := ⟨⟨b⟩⟩) _
    (QTwoEnvelope.Jm f)).trans
    (QTwoEnvelope.extendX_J (a := ⟨a⟩) (b := ⟨b⟩) θ f)

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.extendTwoNatTrans_unique
statement:
theorem extendTwoNatTrans_unique (θ : TwoNatTrans F G) (ψ : TwoNatTrans (extend F) (extend G))
    (h : restrictTwoNatTrans ψ = θ) : ψ = extendTwoNatTrans θ

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.twoNatTrans_ext_of_J
statement:
theorem twoNatTrans_ext_of_J (ψ ψ' : TwoNatTrans (extend F) (extend G))
    (hX : ∀ a : B, ψ.X (⟨⟨a⟩⟩ : QPiTwoEnvelope R B) = ψ'.X ⟨⟨a⟩⟩)
    (hx : ∀ {a b : B} (f : a ⟶ b), HEq (ψ.x (Jm (R := R) f)) (ψ'.x (Jm f))) : ψ = ψ'
proof:
:= by
  rw [← extendTwoNatTrans_restrictTwoNatTrans ψ, ← extendTwoNatTrans_restrictTwoNatTrans ψ']
  congr 1
  exact TwoEnvelope.twoNatTrans_ext (funext hX) fun f => hx f

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.extendTwoNatTrans_id
statement:
theorem extendTwoNatTrans_id :
    extendTwoNatTrans (TwoNatTrans.id F) = TwoNatTrans.id (extend F)

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.extendTwoNatTrans_vcomp
statement:
theorem extendTwoNatTrans_vcomp (θ : TwoNatTrans F G) (θ' : TwoNatTrans G H) :

      TwoNatTrans.vcomp (extendTwoNatTrans θ) (extendTwoNatTrans θ')

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.extendTwoNatTrans_isGraded
statement:
theorem extendTwoNatTrans_isGraded {θ : TwoNatTrans F G} (hθ : θ.IsGraded) :
    (extendTwoNatTrans θ).IsGraded
proof:
:= fun {a b} f => by
  have := comp_mem_degree
    (GradedTwoSupercategory.whiskerRight_mem_degree _ (ζPow_hom_mem_degree (R := R) f.par _))
    (comp_mem_degree
      (GradedTwoSupercategory.whiskerRight_mem_degree _
        (σPow_hom_mem_degree (R := R) f.obj.shift (F.map f.obj.obj)))
      (comp_mem_degree (hθ f.obj.obj)
        (comp_mem_degree (GradedTwoSupercategory.whiskerLeft_mem_degree _
            (σPow_inv_mem_degree (R := R) f.obj.shift (G.map f.obj.obj)))
          (GradedTwoSupercategory.whiskerLeft_mem_degree _
            (ζPow_inv_mem_degree (R := R) f.par _)))))
  rw [extendTwoNatTrans_x]
  simp only [Category.assoc] at this ⊢
  convert this using 2 <;> first | rfl | ring

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.restrictTwoNatTrans_isGraded
statement:
theorem restrictTwoNatTrans_isGraded {ψ : TwoNatTrans (extend F) (extend G)} (hψ : ψ.IsGraded) :
    (restrictTwoNatTrans ψ).IsGraded

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.extendTwoNatTrans_isGraded_iff
statement:
theorem extendTwoNatTrans_isGraded_iff (θ : TwoNatTrans F G) :
    (extendTwoNatTrans θ).IsGraded ↔ θ.IsGraded
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => by
    have h' : (restrictTwoNatTrans (extendTwoNatTrans θ)).IsGraded :=
      restrictTwoNatTrans_isGraded h
    rwa [restrictTwoNatTrans_extendTwoNatTrans] at h', extendTwoNatTrans_isGraded⟩

    (extendSupermodification α).IsHomogeneous p n ↔ α.IsHomogeneous p n
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h a => h ⟨⟨a⟩⟩, fun h a => h a.as.as⟩

statement: theorem extendHom_evenlyDense : EvenlyDense R (extendHom F G)
proof:
:= fun ψ =>
  ⟨restrictTwoNatTrans ψ, eqToIso (extendTwoNatTrans_restrictTwoNatTrans ψ),
    TwoEnvelope.eqToHom_mem (extendTwoNatTrans_restrictTwoNatTrans ψ)⟩

statement: @[simp] theorem extendQPi_obj (a : QPiTwoEnvelope R B) : (extendQPi F).obj a = F.obj a.as.as

statement: theorem extendQPi_map_J {a b : B} (f : a ⟶ b) : (extendQPi F).map (Jm (R := R) f) = F.map f

statement:
theorem extendQPi_map_one_one {a b : B} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (extendQPi F).map (⟨1, ⟨1, f⟩⟩ : (⟨⟨a⟩⟩ : QPiTwoEnvelope R B) ⟶ ⟨⟨b⟩⟩) =
      (F.map f ≫ QPiTwoSupercategory.q (R := R) (B := C) (F.obj b)) ≫

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.extendQPi_map₂_J

theorem extendQPi_map₂_J {a b : B} {f g : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ g) :
    (extendQPi F).map₂ (J2 (R := R) η) = F.map₂ η
proof:
:=
  letI : ∀ a b : C, QPiSupercategory R (a ⟶ b) := fun a b => homQPiLeft a b
  extend_map₂_J F η

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.twoJ_comp_extendQPi
statement: theorem twoJ_comp_extendQPi : (twoJ R B).comp (extendQPi F) = F
proof:
:=
  letI : ∀ a b : C, QPiSupercategory R (a ⟶ b) := fun a b => homQPiLeft a b
  twoJ_comp_extend F

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.extendQPi_isGraded
statement:
theorem extendQPi_isGraded [∀ a b : B, GradedSupercategory R (a ⟶ b)] (hF : F.IsGraded) :
    (extendQPi F).IsGraded
proof:
:=
  letI : ∀ a b : C, QPiSupercategory R (a ⟶ b) := fun a b => homQPiLeft a b
  extend_isGraded F hF

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.extendComp_Q_one_zero
statement:
theorem extendComp_Q_one_zero {a b c : B} (f₀ : a ⟶ b) (g₀ : b ⟶ c) :
    letI : ∀ a b : C, QPiSupercategory R (a ⟶ b) := fun a b => homQPiLeft a b
    (QTwoEnvelope.extendComp F (QTwoEnvelope.Qm (R := R) f₀) (QTwoEnvelope.Jm g₀)).hom =
      (associator (F.map f₀) (QPiTwoSupercategory.q (R := R) (B := C) (F.obj b))
          (F.map g₀)).hom ≫
        F.map f₀ ◁ (γ (R := R) (F.map g₀)).inv ≫
        (associator (F.map f₀) (F.map g₀) (QPiTwoSupercategory.q (R := R) (B := C) (F.obj c))).inv ≫
        (F.mapComp f₀ g₀).hom ▷ QPiTwoSupercategory.q (R := R) (B := C) (F.obj c)
proof:
:= by
  let : ∀ a b : C, QPiSupercategory R (a ⟶ b) := fun a b => homQPiLeft a b
  show (((F.map f₀ ◁ (QPiTwoSupercategory.σ (R := R) (F.obj b)).hom ≫
      (rightUnitor (F.map f₀)).hom) ≫ 𝟙 _) ▷ F.map g₀ ≫ F.map f₀ ◁ 𝟙 (F.map g₀) ≫
      (F.mapComp f₀ g₀).hom ≫ (𝟙 _ ≫ ((rightUnitor (F.map (f₀ ≫ g₀))).inv ≫
        F.map (f₀ ≫ g₀) ◁ (QPiTwoSupercategory.σ (R := R) (F.obj c)).inv))) = _
  rw [whiskerLeft_id (R := R), Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp, Category.id_comp,
    comp_whiskerRight (R := R), whisker_assoc (R := R), ← TwoSupercategory.triangle (R := R),
    QPiTwoSupercategory.γ_inv]
  simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc, whiskerLeft_comp (R := R)]
  congr 3
  rw [associator_inv_naturality_right_assoc R,
    ← TwoEnvelope.interchange_even_left R (F.mapComp_hom_mem f₀ g₀),
    rightUnitor_inv_naturality_assoc R, rightUnitor_comp_inv R, Category.assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.extendTwoNatTransQPiEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem extendTwoNatTransQPiEquiv_apply (θ : TwoNatTrans F G) :

statement:
theorem extendTwoNatTransQPi_isGraded [∀ a b : B, GradedSupercategory R (a ⟶ b)]

:=

name: StringDiagrams.QPiEnvelope.extendRestrictIso_hom_app_J
statement:
theorem extendRestrictIso_hom_app_J (X : A) :
    (extendRestrictIso H).hom.app ((J R A).obj X) = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  simp only [extendRestrictIso, Iso.trans_hom, NatTrans.comp_app, Envelope.extendIso_hom_app]
  erw [Envelope.extendNat_zero_par (X := (QEnvelope.J R A).obj X)]
  simp only [Envelope.extendRestrictIso, NatIso.ofComponents_hom_app]
  simp only [QEnvelope.extendRestrictIso, NatIso.ofComponents_hom_app]
  show (𝟙 _ ≫ H.map (𝟙 _)) ≫ (𝟙 _ ≫ H.map (𝟙 _)) = 𝟙 _
  simp

name: StringDiagrams.QPiEnvelope.extendRestrictIso_inv_app_J
statement:
theorem extendRestrictIso_inv_app_J (X : A) :
    (extendRestrictIso H).inv.app ((J R A).obj X) = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  have := (extendRestrictIso H).hom_inv_id_app ((J R A).obj X)
  rw [extendRestrictIso_hom_app_J, Category.id_comp] at this
  exact this

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.xcompL_nat₁
statement:
theorem xcompL_nat₁ {a b c : QPiTwoEnvelope R B} {f f' : a ⟶ b} (u : f ⟶ f') (g : b ⟶ c) :
    (F'.map₂ u ▷ F'.map g) ▷ X c ≫ xcompL X x f' g = xcompL X x f g ≫ X a ◁ G'.map₂ (u ▷ g)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [xcompL]
  rw [TwoEnvelope.comp_whiskerRight_comp R, F'.mapComp_naturality_left,
    ← TwoEnvelope.comp_whiskerRight_comp R, nat]
  simp only [Category.assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.xcompR_nat₁
statement:
theorem xcompR_nat₁ {a b c : QPiTwoEnvelope R B} {f f' : a ⟶ b} (u : f ⟶ f') (g : b ⟶ c) :
    (F'.map₂ u ▷ F'.map g) ▷ X c ≫ xcompR X x f' g = xcompR X x f g ≫ X a ◁ G'.map₂ (u ▷ g)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [xcompR]
  rw [associator_naturality_left_assoc R,
    reassoc_of% (TwoEnvelope.interchange_even_right R (F'.map₂ u) (x_mem g)),
    associator_inv_naturality_left_assoc R, TwoEnvelope.comp_whiskerRight_comp R, nat,
    ← TwoEnvelope.comp_whiskerRight_comp R, associator_naturality_middle_assoc R,
    ← whiskerLeft_comp (R := R), G'.mapComp_naturality_left, whiskerLeft_comp (R := R)]
  simp only [Category.assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.xcompL_nat₂
statement:
theorem xcompL_nat₂ {a b c : QPiTwoEnvelope R B} (f : a ⟶ b) {g g' : b ⟶ c} (v : g ⟶ g') :
    (F'.map f ◁ F'.map₂ v) ▷ X c ≫ xcompL X x f g' = xcompL X x f g ≫ X a ◁ G'.map₂ (f ◁ v)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [xcompL]
  rw [TwoEnvelope.comp_whiskerRight_comp R, F'.mapComp_naturality_right,
    ← TwoEnvelope.comp_whiskerRight_comp R, nat]
  simp only [Category.assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.xcompR_nat₂
statement:
theorem xcompR_nat₂ {a b c : QPiTwoEnvelope R B} (f : a ⟶ b) {g g' : b ⟶ c} (v : g ⟶ g') :
    (F'.map f ◁ F'.map₂ v) ▷ X c ≫ xcompR X x f g' = xcompR X x f g ≫ X a ◁ G'.map₂ (f ◁ v)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [xcompR]
  rw [associator_naturality_middle_assoc R, TwoEnvelope.whiskerLeft_comp_comp R, nat,
    ← TwoEnvelope.whiskerLeft_comp_comp R, associator_inv_naturality_right_assoc R,
    ← reassoc_of% (TwoEnvelope.interchange_even_left R (x_mem f) (G'.map₂ v)),
    associator_naturality_right_assoc R, ← whiskerLeft_comp (R := R),
    G'.mapComp_naturality_right, whiskerLeft_comp (R := R)]
  simp only [Category.assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.xcomp_of_J
statement:
theorem xcomp_of_J
    (h : ∀ {a b c : B} (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c), xcompL X x (Jm (R := R) f) (Jm g) =
      xcompR X x (Jm (R := R) f) (Jm g))
    {a b c : QPiTwoEnvelope R B} (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) : xcompL X x f g = xcompR X x f g
proof:
:= by
  have e₁ : Epi ((F'.map₂ (shiftIso f).hom ▷ F'.map g) ▷ X c) :=
    (inferInstance : Epi (whiskerRightIso (R := R) (whiskerRightIso (R := R)
      (F'.map₂Iso (shiftIso f)) _) _).hom)
  refine TwoEnvelope.eq_of_conj_hom _ e₁ _ (xcompL_nat₁ X x nat (shiftIso f).hom g)
    (xcompR_nat₁ X x x_mem nat (shiftIso f).hom g) ?_
  have e₂ : Epi ((F'.map (Jm (R := R) f.obj.obj) ◁ F'.map₂ (shiftIso g).hom) ▷ X c) :=
    (inferInstance : Epi (whiskerRightIso (R := R) (whiskerLeftIso (R := R) _
      (F'.map₂Iso (shiftIso g))) _).hom)
  refine TwoEnvelope.eq_of_conj_hom _ e₂ _ (xcompL_nat₂ X x nat _ (shiftIso g).hom)
    (xcompR_nat₂ X x x_mem nat _ (shiftIso g).hom) ?_
  exact h f.obj.obj g.obj.obj

proof:

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.extendRestrictX_naturality
statement:
theorem extendRestrictX_naturality {a b : QPiTwoEnvelope R B} {f g : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ g) :

      extendRestrictX T hT f ≫ 𝟙 (T.obj a) ◁ T.map₂ η
proof:
:= by
  simp only [extendRestrictX]
  rw [rightUnitor_naturality_assoc R, reassoc_of% (extendRestrictApp_naturality T hT η),
    leftUnitor_inv_naturality R]
  simp only [Category.assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.extendRestrictNatTrans_isStrong

    haveI := hT.isGradedSuperfunctor a b
    inferInstanceAs (IsIso ((QPiEnvelope.extendRestrictIso (homFunctor T a b)).app f).hom)

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.gradedSuperequivalenceJ_iff
statement:
theorem gradedSuperequivalenceJ_iff :
    (∀ a b : B, Nonempty (GradedSuperequivalence R ((twoJ R B).mapFunctor a b))) ↔
      QPiComplete2 (R := R) (B := B)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← J_gradedEvenlyDense_iff]
  exact forall_congr' fun a => forall_congr' fun b =>
    ⟨fun ⟨e⟩ => e.gradedEvenlyDense,

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoFunctor.βHom_hom
statement:
theorem βHom_hom {a b : B} (g : a ⟶ b) :
    (hF.βHom g).hom = F.map g ◁ (hF.j b).hom ≫ (F.mapComp g (𝛑 b)).inv

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoFunctor.βHom_inv
statement:
theorem βHom_inv {a b : B} (g : a ⟶ b) :
    (hF.βHom g).inv = (F.mapComp g (𝛑 b)).hom ≫ F.map g ◁ (hF.j b).inv

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoFunctor.βHom_naturality
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem βHom_naturality {a b : B} {g g' : a ⟶ b} (η : g ⟶ g') :
    F.map₂ η ▷ 𝛑 (F.obj b) ≫ (hF.βHom g').hom = (hF.βHom g).hom ≫ F.map₂ (η ▷ 𝛑 b)

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoFunctor.βHom_comm
statement:
theorem βHom_comm {a b : B} (g : a ⟶ b) :
    (ξHom (R := R) (F.map g)).hom ≫ F.map₂ (ξHom (R := R) g).inv =
      (hF.βHom g).hom ▷ 𝛑 (F.obj b) ≫ (hF.βHom (g ≫ 𝛑 b)).hom
proof:
:= by
  have hξ := hF.ξ_comm b
  have key : (ξHom (R := R) (F.map g)).hom = (hF.βHom g).hom ▷ 𝛑 (F.obj b) ≫
      (hF.βHom (g ≫ 𝛑 b)).hom ≫ F.map₂ (ξHom (R := R) g).hom := by
    rw [ξHom_hom, ξHom_hom, F.map₂_comp, F.map₂_comp, Pseudofunctor.map₂_associator,
      Pseudofunctor.map₂_whisker_left, Pseudofunctor.map₂_right_unitor, βHom_hom, βHom_hom]
    simp only [Bicategory.comp_whiskerRight, Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
    rw [← whisker_exchange_assoc, Bicategory.inv_hom_whiskerRight_assoc]
    have c1 : (F.map g ◁ (hF.j b).hom) ▷ 𝛑 (F.obj b) ≫
        (F.map g ≫ F.map (𝛑 b)) ◁ (hF.j b).hom ≫
          (α_ (F.map g) (F.map (𝛑 b)) (F.map (𝛑 b))).hom =
        (α_ (F.map g) (𝛑 (F.obj b)) (𝛑 (F.obj b))).hom ≫
          F.map g ◁ ((hF.j b).hom ▷ 𝛑 (F.obj b)) ≫ F.map g ◁ (F.map (𝛑 b) ◁ (hF.j b).hom) := by
      bicategory
    rw [reassoc_of% c1]
    simp only [← Bicategory.whiskerLeft_comp_assoc]
    rw [reassoc_of% hξ]
    simp
  rw [key]
  simp [← F.map₂_comp]

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoFunctor.map₂_zero
statement: theorem map₂_zero {a b : B} {f g : a ⟶ b} : F.map₂ (0 : f ⟶ g) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := hF.map₂_add (0 : f ⟶ g) 0
  rw [add_zero] at h
  exact left_eq_add.mp h
