name: StringDiagrams.QPiEnvelope.restrictSuperNatTrans_app
StringDiagrams.QPiEnvelope.restrictSuperNatTrans_mem_hom
proof:
:= by
  refine (family R (QPiEnvelope R A) B).hom_induction hy
    (fun n z hz => (family R A B).mem_hom_of_mem (n := n) fun p X => hz p ((J R A).obj X)) ?_ ?_
  · rw [show restrictSuperNatTrans (0 : (extendGS R F).toSuperfunctor ⟶
      (extendGS R G).toSuperfunctor) = 0 from Superfunctor.hom_ext fun _ _ => rfl]
    exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  · intro z z' hz hz'
    rw [show restrictSuperNatTrans (z + z') = restrictSuperNatTrans z + restrictSuperNatTrans z'
      from Superfunctor.hom_ext fun _ _ => rfl]
    exact Submodule.add_mem _ hz hz'

name: StringDiagrams.QPiEnvelope.extendSuperNatTrans_restrictSuperNatTrans
proof:
:=
  Superfunctor.hom_ext fun p X => congrFun (eq_of_restrict_eq (R := R) (p := p)
    (isSupernatural_extendNat (SuperNatTrans.isSupernatural (restrictSuperNatTrans y) p))
    (SuperNatTrans.isSupernatural y p) fun Y => by
      rw [J_obj, extendNat_J]; rfl) X

name: StringDiagrams.QPiEnvelope.isGradedSupernatural_extendRestrictIso_hom
statement:
theorem isGradedSupernatural_extendRestrictIso_hom (H : QPiEnvelope R A ⥤ B) [H.Additive]
    [H.Linear R] [IsGradedSuperfunctor R H] :
    IsGradedSupernatural R 0 0 fun X => ((extendRestrictIso H).app X).hom

name: StringDiagrams.QPiEnvelope.isGradedSupernatural_extendRestrictIso_inv
statement:
theorem isGradedSupernatural_extendRestrictIso_inv (H : QPiEnvelope R A ⥤ B) [H.Additive]
    [H.Linear R] [IsGradedSuperfunctor R H] :
    IsGradedSupernatural R 0 (-0) fun X => ((extendRestrictIso H).app X).inv
proof:
:=
  ⟨isSupernatural_of_natTrans (extendRestrictIso H).inv
      (fun X => inv_mem ((extendRestrictIso H).app X) (extendRestrictIso_hom_mem H X)),
    fun X => inv_mem_degree ((extendRestrictIso H).app X) (extendRestrictIso_hom_mem_degree H X)⟩

name: StringDiagrams.QPiEnvelope.extendHom_gradedEvenlyDense
statement: theorem extendHom_gradedEvenlyDense : GradedEvenlyDense R (extendHom R A B)
proof:
:= fun H =>
  ⟨⟨(JGS R A).comp H.as⟩, extendRestrictGradedIso H,
    GradedHom.ofHomogeneous_mem (isGradedSupernatural_extendRestrictIso_hom H.as.toFunctor),
    GradedHom.ofHomogeneous_mem_degree
      (isGradedSupernatural_extendRestrictIso_hom H.as.toFunctor)⟩

name: StringDiagrams.QPiEnvelope.exists_ne_of_J_comp_eq
statement:
theorem exists_ne_of_J_comp_eq (X : A) :
    ∃ H H' : QPiEnvelope R A ⥤ QPiEnvelope R (QPiEnvelope R A),
      J R A ⋙ H = J R A ⋙ H' ∧ H ≠ H'
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨J R (QPiEnvelope R A), extend R (J R A ⋙ J R (QPiEnvelope R A)),
    (J_comp_extend R _).symm, fun h => ?_⟩
  have := congrArg (fun K : QPiEnvelope R A ⥤ QPiEnvelope R (QPiEnvelope R A) =>
    (K.obj (mk 0 1 X)).par) h
  change (0 : ZMod 2) = 0 + 1 at this
  exact absurd this (by decide)

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSuperfunctor.ext_toFunctor
statement:
theorem GradedSuperfunctor.ext_toFunctor {R : Type w} [CommRing R] {C : Type w₁} [Category.{w₂} C]
    [Preadditive C] [Linear R C] [Supercategory R C] [GradedSupercategory R C] {D : Type w₃}
    [Category.{w₄} D] [Preadditive D] [Linear R D] [Supercategory R D] [GradedSupercategory R D]
    {F G : GradedSuperfunctor R C D} (h : F.toFunctor = G.toFunctor) : F = G
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨F, _, _, _⟩, _⟩ := F
  obtain ⟨⟨G, _, _, _⟩, _⟩ := G
  change F = G at h
  subst h
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.QPiGSCat.unitJ_naturality
statement:
theorem unitJ_naturality {A A' : GSCat.{w, v, u} R} (F : A ⟶ A') :
    F ≫ unitJ A' = unitJ A ≫ (forget R).map ((envelope R).map F)

name: StringDiagrams.QPiGSCat.not_exists_adjunction_unit_J
statement:
theorem not_exists_adjunction_unit_J (A : GSCat.{w, v, u} R) [Nonempty A] :
    ¬ ∃ adj : envelope R ⊣ forget R, adj.unit.app A = unitJ A
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨adj, h⟩
  obtain ⟨X⟩ := ‹Nonempty A›
  let B := (envelope R).obj ((forget R).obj ((envelope R).obj A))
  let H : (envelope R).obj A ⟶ B := ⟨QPiEnvelope.JGS R (QPiEnvelope R A)⟩
  let H' : (envelope R).obj A ⟶ B :=
    ⟨QPiEnvelope.extendGS R ((QPiEnvelope.JGS R A).comp (QPiEnvelope.JGS R (QPiEnvelope R A)))⟩
  have e : adj.homEquiv _ _ H = adj.homEquiv _ _ H' := by
    rw [adj.homEquiv_unit, adj.homEquiv_unit, h]
    change (⟨(QPiEnvelope.JGS R A).comp (QPiEnvelope.JGS R (QPiEnvelope R A))⟩ :
        GradedHom R A (QPiEnvelope R (QPiEnvelope R A))) =
      ⟨(QPiEnvelope.JGS R A).comp (QPiEnvelope.extendGS R
        ((QPiEnvelope.JGS R A).comp (QPiEnvelope.JGS R (QPiEnvelope R A))))⟩
    congr 1
    exact GradedSuperfunctor.ext_toFunctor (QPiEnvelope.J_comp_extend R _).symm
  have e' := congrArg (fun K : (envelope R).obj A ⟶ B =>
    Envelope.par (K.as.toFunctor.obj (QPiEnvelope.mk 0 1 X))) ((adj.homEquiv _ _).injective e)
  change (0 : ZMod 2) = 0 + 1 at e'
  exact absurd e' (by decide)

name: StringDiagrams.LaurentBasis.regroup_single
statement:
theorem regroup_single (b : Basis (ι × ℤ) ℤ M) (i : ι) (n : ℤ) (a : ℤ) :
    regroup b (Finsupp.single i (AddMonoidAlgebra.single n a)) = a • b (i, n)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h : Finsupp.mapRange.linearEquiv (AddMonoidAlgebra.coeffLinearEquiv ℤ)
      (Finsupp.single i (AddMonoidAlgebra.single n a)) =
      Finsupp.single i (Finsupp.single n a) :=
        Finsupp.mapRange_single (hf := map_zero _)
  change b.repr.symm (Finsupp.uncurry _) = _
  simp only [LinearEquiv.coe_coe]
  rw [h, Finsupp.uncurry_single, b.repr_symm_single]

name: StringDiagrams.LaurentBasis.ofProduct_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem ofProduct_apply (b : Basis (ι × ℤ) ℤ M)
    (hb : ∀ i n, (T n : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) • b (i, 0) = b (i, n)) (i : ι) :
    ofProduct b hb i = b (i, 0)

name: StringDiagrams.LaurentBasis.free_of_boundedBelow
statement:
theorem free_of_boundedBelow
    (h : ∀ i : ι, ∃ N : ℤ, ∀ n : ℤ, n +ᵥ i = i → N ≤ n) :
    ∀ (i : ι) (n : ℤ), n +ᵥ i = i → n = 0
proof:
:= by
  intro i m hm
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := h i
  have nonneg : ∀ n : ℤ, n ∈ AddAction.stabilizer ℤ i → 0 ≤ n := by
    intro n hn
    by_contra hneg
    have hn' : n ≤ -1 := by omega
    let a : ℕ := N.natAbs + 1
    have ha : -(a : ℤ) < N := by
      have := Int.le_natAbs (a := -N)
      rw [Int.natAbs_neg] at this
      dsimp [a]
      omega
    have hmem := (AddAction.stabilizer ℤ i).nsmul_mem hn a
    have hbound := hN ((a : ℤ) * n) (by
      simpa only [nsmul_eq_mul, AddAction.mem_stabilizer_iff] using hmem)
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hn' (Int.natCast_nonneg a)
    omega
  have hp := nonneg m hm
  have hn := nonneg (-m) ((AddAction.stabilizer ℤ i).neg_mem hm)
  omega

name: StringDiagrams.LaurentBasis.ofOrbits_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem ofOrbits_apply (b : Basis ι ℤ M)
    (hb : ∀ n i, (T n : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) • b i = b (n +ᵥ i))
    (hfree : ∀ (i : ι) (n : ℤ), n +ᵥ i = i → n = 0)
    (o : Orbit (ι := ι)) : ofOrbits b hb hfree o = b o.out
proof:
:= by
  rw [ofOrbits, ofProduct_apply]
  simp only [Basis.reindex_apply, Equiv.symm_symm]
  change b ((0 : ℤ) +ᵥ o.out) = b o.out
  rw [zero_vadd]

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoFunctor.natHom_γ
statement:
theorem natHom_γ (hη : hF.IsQPiTwoNatural hG η) {a b : B} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (α_ (F.map f) (η.app b) (𝐪 (G.obj b))).hom ≫ F.map f ◁ (𝛄 (η.app b)).hom ≫
        (α_ (F.map f) (𝐪 (F.obj b)) (η.app b)).inv ≫ (hF.γHom f).hom ▷ η.app b ≫
          η.naturality (f ≫ 𝐪 b) =
      η.naturality f ▷ 𝐪 (G.obj b) ≫ (α_ (η.app a) (G.map f) (𝐪 (G.obj b))).hom ≫
        η.app a ◁ (hG.γHom f).hom
proof:
:= by
  have hc : (F.mapComp f (𝐪 b)).inv ▷ η.app b ≫ η.naturality (f ≫ 𝐪 b) =
      (α_ (F.map f) (F.map (𝐪 b)) (η.app b)).hom ≫ F.map f ◁ η.naturality (𝐪 b) ≫
        (α_ (F.map f) (η.app b) (G.map (𝐪 b))).inv ≫ η.naturality f ▷ G.map (𝐪 b) ≫
          (α_ (η.app a) (G.map f) (G.map (𝐪 b))).hom ≫ η.app a ◁ (G.mapComp f (𝐪 b)).inv := by
    have e := η.naturality_comp f (𝐪 b)
    simp only [Pseudofunctor.toOplax_mapComp, Pseudofunctor.toOplax_toPrelaxFunctor] at e
    rw [← cancel_mono (η.app a ◁ (G.mapComp f (𝐪 b)).hom)]
    simp only [Category.assoc, Bicategory.whiskerLeft_inv_hom, Category.comp_id]
    rw [e, Bicategory.inv_hom_whiskerRight_assoc]
  rw [γHom_hom, Bicategory.comp_whiskerRight, Category.assoc, hc]
  simp only [Pseudofunctor.toOplax_toPrelaxFunctor]
  calc _ = (α_ (F.map f) (η.app b) (𝐪 (G.obj b))).hom ≫
        F.map f ◁ ((𝛄 (η.app b)).hom ≫ (hF.k b).hom ▷ η.app b ≫ η.naturality (𝐪 b)) ≫
          (α_ (F.map f) (η.app b) (G.map (𝐪 b))).inv ≫ η.naturality f ▷ G.map (𝐪 b) ≫
            (α_ (η.app a) (G.map f) (G.map (𝐪 b))).hom ≫
              η.app a ◁ (G.mapComp f (𝐪 b)).inv := by
        bicategory
    _ = (α_ (F.map f) (η.app b) (𝐪 (G.obj b))).hom ≫ F.map f ◁ (η.app b ◁ (hG.k b).hom) ≫
          (α_ (F.map f) (η.app b) (G.map (𝐪 b))).inv ≫ η.naturality f ▷ G.map (𝐪 b) ≫
            (α_ (η.app a) (G.map f) (G.map (𝐪 b))).hom ≫
              η.app a ◁ (G.mapComp f (𝐪 b)).inv := by
        rw [hη.2 b]
    _ = ((F.map f ≫ η.app b) ◁ (hG.k b).hom ≫ η.naturality f ▷ G.map (𝐪 b)) ≫
          (α_ (η.app a) (G.map f) (G.map (𝐪 b))).hom ≫
            η.app a ◁ (G.mapComp f (𝐪 b)).inv := by
        bicategory
    _ = (η.naturality f ▷ 𝐪 (G.obj b) ≫ (η.app a ≫ G.map f) ◁ (hG.k b).hom) ≫
          (α_ (η.app a) (G.map f) (G.map (𝐪 b))).hom ≫
            η.app a ◁ (G.mapComp f (𝐪 b)).inv := by
        rw [whisker_exchange]
        rfl
    _ = _ := by
        rw [γHom_hom]
        bicategory

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoFunctor.natHomQ_compat
statement:
theorem natHomQ_compat (a b : Associated2 R B) (f : a ⟶ b) :
    ((hF.homShiftFunctor R a b).comp (postShift R _
        ((PiTwoFunctor.mapTwoNat hF.toPiTwoFunctor hG.toPiTwoFunctor hη.1).X b))).γ.hom.app f ≫
      (natHomQ hη a b).app ((homShift R a b).Q.obj f) =
    (homShift R _ _).Q.map ((natHomQ hη a b).app f) ≫
      ((hG.homShiftFunctor R a b).comp (preShift R _
        ((PiTwoFunctor.mapTwoNat hF.toPiTwoFunctor hG.toPiTwoFunctor hη.1).X a))).γ.hom.app f
proof:
:= by
  apply Associated2.hom₂_ext
  · simp only [natHomQ, ShiftFunctor.comp_γ_hom_app, preShift_γ_hom_app, postShift_γ_hom_app,
      QPiTwoFunctor.homShiftFunctor_γ_hom_app, QPiTwoFunctor.homShiftFunctor_F, preShift_F,
      postShift_F,
      TwoSupercategory.postcomp_map, TwoSupercategory.precomp_map,
      homShift_Q,
      Functor.comp_obj, γR_hom, Associated2.comp₂_fst, Associated2.comp₂_snd,
      Associated2.whiskerLeft_fst, Associated2.whiskerLeft_snd, Associated2.whiskerRight_fst,
      Associated2.whiskerRight_snd, Associated2.associator_hom_fst, Associated2.associator_hom_snd,
      Associated2.associator_inv_fst, Associated2.associator_inv_snd,
      Associated2.centralShift_γ_eq, Associated2.γhat_hom_fst, Associated2.γhat_hom_snd,
      QPiTwoFunctor.γhat_hom_app_fst, QPiTwoFunctor.γhat_hom_app_snd,
      PiTwoFunctor.mapTwoNat_x,
      Associated.homMk_fst, Associated.homMk_snd, Limits.zero_comp, Limits.comp_zero,
      PreadditiveBicategory.whiskerLeft_zero, PreadditiveBicategory.zero_whiskerRight, sub_zero,
      add_zero, Category.assoc]
    exact natHom_γ hη f.obj
  · simp only [natHomQ, ShiftFunctor.comp_γ_hom_app, preShift_γ_hom_app, postShift_γ_hom_app,
      QPiTwoFunctor.homShiftFunctor_γ_hom_app, QPiTwoFunctor.homShiftFunctor_F, preShift_F,
      postShift_F,
      TwoSupercategory.postcomp_map, TwoSupercategory.precomp_map,
      homShift_Q,
      Functor.comp_obj, γR_hom, Associated2.comp₂_fst, Associated2.comp₂_snd,
      Associated2.whiskerLeft_fst, Associated2.whiskerLeft_snd, Associated2.whiskerRight_fst,
      Associated2.whiskerRight_snd, Associated2.associator_hom_fst, Associated2.associator_hom_snd,
      Associated2.associator_inv_fst, Associated2.associator_inv_snd,
      Associated2.centralShift_γ_eq, Associated2.γhat_hom_fst, Associated2.γhat_hom_snd,
      QPiTwoFunctor.γhat_hom_app_fst, QPiTwoFunctor.γhat_hom_app_snd,
      PiTwoFunctor.mapTwoNat_x,
      Associated.homMk_fst, Associated.homMk_snd, Limits.zero_comp, Limits.comp_zero,
      PreadditiveBicategory.whiskerLeft_zero, PreadditiveBicategory.zero_whiskerRight, sub_zero,
      add_zero, Category.assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoFunctor.mapQNat_id
statement:
theorem mapQNat_id (hF : QPiTwoFunctor R F) :
    mapQNat (isQPiTwoNatural_id hF) = TwoNatTrans.id hF.mapQ
proof:
:= by
  refine TwoNatTrans.ext_of_eq rfl fun {a b} f => ?_
  simp only [eqToHom_refl, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]
  rw [mapQNat_x, TwoNatTrans.id_x, Orbit2.rightUnitor_hom_def, Orbit2.leftUnitor_inv_def,
    ← Functor.map_comp]
  refine congrArg (Orbit.ι (homShift R (hF.mapQ.obj a).obj (hF.mapQ.obj b).obj)).map ?_
  simp only [PiTwoFunctor.mapTwoNat_x, Oplax.OplaxTrans.id]
  apply Associated2.hom₂_ext
  · simp
    rfl
  · simp

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoFunctor.mapQNat_vcomp
statement:
theorem mapQNat_vcomp {η : Oplax.OplaxTrans F.toOplax G.toOplax}
    {θ : Oplax.OplaxTrans G.toOplax H.toOplax} (hη : hF.IsQPiTwoNatural hG η)
    (hθ : hG.IsQPiTwoNatural hH θ) :
    mapQNat (hη.vcomp hθ) = (mapQNat hη).vcomp (mapQNat hθ)
proof:
:= by
  refine TwoNatTrans.ext_of_eq rfl fun {a b} f => ?_
  simp only [eqToHom_refl, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]
  rw [TwoNatTrans.vcomp_x, mapQNat_x, mapQNat_x, mapQNat_x, Orbit2.whiskerRight_ι,
    Orbit2.whiskerLeft_ι, Orbit2.associator_inv_def, Orbit2.associator_hom_def,
    Orbit2.associator_inv_def]
  simp only [← Functor.map_comp]
  refine congrArg (Orbit.ι (homShift R (hF.mapQ.obj a).obj (hH.mapQ.obj b).obj)).map ?_
  simp only [PiTwoFunctor.mapTwoNat_x, Oplax.OplaxTrans.vcomp]
  apply Associated2.hom₂_ext
  · simp only [Associated2.comp₂_fst, Associated2.whiskerLeft_fst, Associated2.whiskerLeft_snd,
      Associated2.whiskerRight_fst, Associated2.whiskerRight_snd, Associated2.associator_hom_fst,
      Associated2.associator_hom_snd, Associated2.associator_inv_fst,
      Associated2.associator_inv_snd, Associated.homMk_fst, Associated.homMk_snd,
      PreadditiveBicategory.zero_whiskerRight, PreadditiveBicategory.whiskerLeft_zero,
      Limits.zero_comp, Limits.comp_zero, sub_zero,
      Pseudofunctor.toOplax_toPrelaxFunctor]
    rfl
  · simp only [Associated2.comp₂_snd, Associated2.whiskerLeft_fst, Associated2.whiskerLeft_snd,
      Associated2.whiskerRight_fst, Associated2.whiskerRight_snd, Associated2.associator_hom_fst,
      Associated2.associator_hom_snd, Associated2.associator_inv_fst,
      Associated2.associator_inv_snd, Associated.homMk_fst, Associated.homMk_snd,
      PreadditiveBicategory.zero_whiskerRight, PreadditiveBicategory.whiskerLeft_zero,
      Limits.zero_comp, Limits.comp_zero, add_zero, PiTwoCategory.pi_map]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.homShiftFunctor_γ_hom_app
statement:
theorem homShiftFunctor_γ_hom_app {a b : A} (X : a ⟶ b) :
    (G.homShiftFunctor a b).γ.hom.app X = G.map X ◁ (G.kIso b).hom ≫ (G.mapComp X (𝐪 b)).hom

statement:
theorem homShiftFunctor_F_map {a b : A} {X Y : a ⟶ b} (x : X ⟶ Y) :

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.homShiftFunctor_trivCompat
statement:
theorem homShiftFunctor_trivCompat (a b : A) :
    Orbit.IsTrivCompatible (QPiTwoSupercategory.homTriv R a b)
      (QPiTwoSupercategory.homTriv R (G.obj a) (G.obj b)) (G.homShiftFunctor a b)
proof:
:= fun X => by
  have h1 : (G.kIso b).inv ≫ (𝛔 (G.obj b)).hom = G.map₂ (𝛔 b).hom ≫ (G.mapId b).inv := by
    rw [Iso.inv_comp_eq, ← Category.assoc, kIso_hom_comp_map₂_σ, Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id,
      Category.comp_id]
  have h2 : (G.mapComp X (𝟙 b)).hom ≫ G.map₂ (rightUnitor X).hom =
      G.map X ◁ (G.mapId b).inv ≫ (rightUnitor (G.map X)).hom := by
    rw [← G.map₂_rightUnitor X, TwoSupercategory.whiskerLeft_inv_hom_assoc R]
  change ((G.mapComp X (𝐪 b)).inv ≫ G.map X ◁ (G.kIso b).inv) ≫ G.map X ◁ (𝛔 (G.obj b)).hom ≫
      (rightUnitor (G.map X)).hom = G.map₂ (X ◁ (𝛔 b).hom ≫ (rightUnitor X).hom)
  rw [G.map₂_comp, Category.assoc, ← whiskerLeft_comp'_assoc R, h1, whiskerLeft_comp'_assoc R,
    ← h2, G.mapComp_naturality_right_assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated2.TΦ_comp_γ_hom_app
statement:
theorem TΦ_comp_γ_hom_app {a b : Associated2 R (GUnderlying2 R B)} {S : Type*} [Category S]
    [Preadditive S] [Linear R S] [Supercategory R S] {d : ShiftData R S}
    (Ψ : ShiftFunctor R (homShift R (bo a) (bo b)) d) (X : a ⟶ b) :
    ((TΦ R B a b).comp Ψ).γ.hom.app X = Ψ.γ.hom.app ((TF R B a b).obj X)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ShiftFunctor.comp_γ_hom_app, TΦ_γ_hom_app]
  exact (congrArg (Ψ.γ.hom.app ((TΦ R B a b).F.obj X) ≫ ·) (Ψ.F.map_id _)).trans
    (Category.comp_id _)

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated2.map_DE_comp_TΦ
statement:
theorem map_DE_comp_TΦ (a b : Associated2 R (GUnderlying2 R B)) :
    Orbit.map (((G.toQPiTwoFunctor hG).homShiftFunctor R a b).comp
      (TΦ R B' ((G.toQPiTwoFunctor hG).mapTwo.obj a) ((G.toQPiTwoFunctor hG).mapTwo.obj b))) =
    Orbit.map ((TΦ R B a b).comp (G.homShiftFunctor (bo a) (bo b)))
proof:
:= by
  refine Orbit.map_congr' (fun _ => rfl) (fun y => ?_) fun X => ?_
  · simp only [eqToHom_refl, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]
    exact congrArg Subtype.val (Associated2.T_map₂_mapTwo (G.toDegreeZero2 hG) y)
  · simp only [eqToHom_refl, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]
    rw [TΦ_comp_γ_hom_app, ShiftFunctor.comp_γ_hom_app, TΦ_γ_hom_app, Category.id_comp]
    erw [TF_map]
    simp only [Associated2.T_map₂, QPiTwoFunctor.homShiftFunctor_γ_hom_app,
      QPiTwoFunctor.γhat_hom_app_fst, QPiTwoFunctor.γhat_hom_app_snd, Underlying2.zero₂_val,
      Limits.zero_comp, add_zero]
    rfl

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated2.T_map₂_mapQ
statement:
theorem T_map₂_mapQ {a b : QAssociated2 R (GUnderlying2 R B)} {f g : a ⟶ b} (x : f ⟶ g) :
    (T R B').map₂ ((G.toQPiTwoFunctor hG).mapQ.map₂ x) = G.map₂ ((T R B).map₂ x)
proof:
:= by
  change (Orbit.eval (QPiTwoSupercategory.homTriv R (G.obj (bo a.obj)) (G.obj (bo b.obj)))).map
      ((Orbit.map (TΦ R B' ((G.toQPiTwoFunctor hG).mapTwo.obj a.obj)
        ((G.toQPiTwoFunctor hG).mapTwo.obj b.obj))).map
        ((Orbit.map ((G.toQPiTwoFunctor hG).homShiftFunctor R a.obj b.obj)).map x)) =
    (G.homShiftFunctor (bo a.obj) (bo b.obj)).F.map
      ((Orbit.eval (QPiTwoSupercategory.homTriv R (bo a.obj) (bo b.obj))).map
        ((Orbit.map (TΦ R B a.obj b.obj)).map x))
  rw [← eval_map_map (G.homShiftFunctor_trivCompat (bo a.obj) (bo b.obj))]
  rw [map_map_comp]
  rw [map_map_comp (TΦ R B a.obj b.obj) (G.homShiftFunctor (bo a.obj) (bo b.obj)) x]
  have key := CategoryTheory.Functor.congr_hom (map_DE_comp_TΦ G hG a.obj b.obj) x
  rw [key]
  simp

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated2.T_map₂_mapQ_mapComp
statement:
theorem T_map₂_mapQ_mapComp {a b c : QAssociated2 R (GUnderlying2 R B)} (f : a ⟶ b)

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated2.T_map₂_mapQNat
statement:
theorem T_map₂_mapQNat {G' : TwoSuperfunctor R B B'} (hG' : G'.IsGraded) (θ : TwoNatTrans G G')

name: StringDiagrams.UnitSupercat.tensorHom_eq
statement:
theorem tensorHom_eq {X₁ Y₁ X₂ Y₂ : UnitSupercat k} (f : X₁ ⟶ Y₁) (g : X₂ ⟶ Y₂) :
    toElem (f ⊗ₘ g) = toElem f * toElem g
proof:
:= by
  change toElem g * toElem f = _
  exact mul_comm _ _

name: StringDiagrams.UnitSupercat.monoidalStruct_eq
statement:
theorem monoidalStruct_eq (S : MonoidalCategoryStruct (UnitSupercat k))
    (hS : @MonoidalSupercategory k _ (UnitSupercat k) _ _ _ _ S)
    (hS' : @MonoidalSupercategory.IsStrict (UnitSupercat k) _ S) :
    S = instMonoidalCategoryStruct
proof:
:= by
  have hL : ∀ (X : UnitSupercat k) {Y Z : UnitSupercat k} (f : Y ⟶ Z),
      @MonoidalCategoryStruct.whiskerLeft _ _ S X Y Z f = f := by
    intro X Y Z f
    have h1 := @MonoidalSupercategory.whiskerLeft_smul k _ _ _ _ _ _ S hS X Y Z (toElem f)
      (𝟙 Y)
    have h2 := @MonoidalSupercategory.whiskerLeft_id k _ _ _ _ _ _ S hS X Y
    rw [h2] at h1
    have : (toElem f • 𝟙 Y : Y ⟶ Y) = f := hom_ext (by change toElem f * 1 = toElem f; simp)
    rw [this] at h1
    rw [h1]; exact hom_ext (by change toElem f * 1 = toElem f; simp)
  have hR : ∀ {X Y : UnitSupercat k} (f : X ⟶ Y) (Z : UnitSupercat k),
      @MonoidalCategoryStruct.whiskerRight _ _ S X Y f Z = f := by
    intro X Y f Z
    have h1 := @MonoidalSupercategory.smul_whiskerRight k _ _ _ _ _ _ S hS X X (toElem f) (𝟙 X) Z
    have h2 := @MonoidalSupercategory.id_whiskerRight k _ _ _ _ _ _ S hS X Z
    rw [h2] at h1
    have : (toElem f • 𝟙 X : X ⟶ X) = f := hom_ext (by change toElem f * 1 = toElem f; simp)
    rw [this] at h1
    rw [h1]; exact hom_ext (by change toElem f * 1 = toElem f; simp)
  obtain ⟨tensorObj, whiskerLeft, whiskerRight, tensorHom, tensorUnit, associator, leftUnitor,
    rightUnitor⟩ := S
  obtain rfl : tensorObj = fun _ _ => () := rfl
  obtain rfl : tensorUnit = () := rfl
  have hα := hS'.associator_eq
  have hlu := hS'.leftUnitor_eq
  have hru := hS'.rightUnitor_eq
  have htH := @MonoidalSupercategory.tensorHom_def k _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hS
  simp only at hL hR hα hlu hru htH
  have e1 : whiskerLeft = fun _ _ _ f => f := by funext X Y Z f; exact hL X f
  have e2 : @whiskerRight = fun _ _ f _ => f := by
    funext X Y f Z; exact hR f Z
  subst e1 e2
  have e3 : @tensorHom = fun _ _ _ _ f g => f ≫ g := by
    funext X₁ Y₁ X₂ Y₂ f g; exact htH f g
  subst e3
  have e4 : associator = (instMonoidalCategoryStruct (k := k)).associator := by
    funext X Y Z; rw [hα X Y Z]; rfl
  have e5 : leftUnitor = (instMonoidalCategoryStruct (k := k)).leftUnitor := by
    funext X; rw [hlu X]; rfl
  have e6 : rightUnitor = (instMonoidalCategoryStruct (k := k)).rightUnitor := by
    funext X; rw [hru X]; rfl
  subst e4 e5 e6
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.UnitSupercat.toSVec_map_apply

theorem toSVec_map_apply {X Y : UnitSupercat k} (f : X ⟶ Y) (r : k) :

name: StringDiagrams.SuperOpposite.mulBilin_apply
statement:
theorem mulBilin_apply (a b : B) :
    mulBilin ℬ a b = b * algProj ℬ 0 a + (algProj ℬ 0 b - algProj ℬ 1 b) * algProj ℬ 1 a

name: StringDiagrams.SuperOpposite.mulBilin_of_mem
statement:
theorem mulBilin_of_mem {p q : ZMod 2} {a b : B} (ha : a ∈ ℬ p) (hb : b ∈ ℬ q) :
    mulBilin ℬ a b = sign k (p * q) • (b * a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mulBilin_apply]
  rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one p with rfl | rfl <;> rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one q with rfl | rfl <;>
    simp [algProj_of_mem ℬ ha, algProj_of_mem ℬ hb, algProj_of_mem_ne ℬ ha, algProj_of_mem_ne ℬ hb]

name: StringDiagrams.SuperOpposite.mulBilin_mem
statement:
theorem mulBilin_mem {p q : ZMod 2} {a b : B} (ha : a ∈ ℬ p) (hb : b ∈ ℬ q) :
    mulBilin ℬ a b ∈ ℬ (p + q)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mulBilin_of_mem ℬ ha hb, add_comm]
  exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (SetLike.GradedMul.mul_mem hb ha)

name: StringDiagrams.SuperOpposite.mulBilin_assoc
statement:
theorem mulBilin_assoc (a b c : B) :
    mulBilin ℬ (mulBilin ℬ a b) c = mulBilin ℬ a (mulBilin ℬ b c)
proof:
:= by
  induction a using alg_induction_on ℬ with
  | zero => simp
  | add a a' ha ha' => simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, ha, ha']
  | hom p a ha =>
    induction b using alg_induction_on ℬ with
    | zero => simp
    | add b b' hb hb' => simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hb, hb']
    | hom q b hb =>
      induction c using alg_induction_on ℬ with
      | zero => simp
      | add c c' hc hc' => simp only [map_add, hc, hc']
      | hom r c hc =>
        rw [mulBilin_of_mem ℬ ha hb, mulBilin_of_mem ℬ hb hc, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply,
          map_smul, mulBilin_of_mem ℬ (SetLike.GradedMul.mul_mem hb ha) hc,
          mulBilin_of_mem ℬ ha (SetLike.GradedMul.mul_mem hc hb), smul_smul, smul_smul,
          ← sign_add, ← sign_add, mul_assoc]
        congr 2
        ring

name: StringDiagrams.SuperOpposite.mul_def
statement: theorem mul_def (a b : SuperOpposite ℬ) : a * b = mulBilin ℬ a b

name: StringDiagrams.SuperOpposite.one_def
statement: theorem one_def : (1 : SuperOpposite ℬ) = (1 : B)

name: StringDiagrams.SuperOpposite.mul_of_mem
statement:
theorem mul_of_mem {p q : ZMod 2} {a b : B} (ha : a ∈ ℬ p) (hb : b ∈ ℬ q) :
    op ℬ a * op ℬ b = op ℬ (sign k (p * q) • (b * a))
proof:
:=
  (mul_def ℬ a b).trans (mulBilin_of_mem ℬ ha hb)

name: StringDiagrams.SuperOpposite.mem_grading_iff
statement: theorem mem_grading_iff {p : ZMod 2} {b : B} : (b : SuperOpposite ℬ) ∈ grading ℬ p ↔ b ∈ ℬ p

name: StringDiagrams.SuperOppositeCat.comp_of_mem
statement:
theorem SuperOppositeCat.comp_of_mem (ℬ : ZMod 2 → Submodule k B) [GradedAlgebra ℬ]
    {X Y Z : SuperOppositeCat ℬ} {p q : ZMod 2} {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : Y ⟶ Z}
    (hf : f ∈ parity (R := k) X Y p) (hg : g ∈ parity (R := k) Y Z q) :
    SuperOpposite.unop ℬ (SuperalgebraCat.toElem (f ≫ g)) =
      sign k (p * q) • (SuperOpposite.unop ℬ (SuperalgebraCat.toElem f) *
        SuperOpposite.unop ℬ (SuperalgebraCat.toElem g))
proof:
:= by
  have hf' : SuperOpposite.unop ℬ (SuperalgebraCat.toElem f) ∈ ℬ p := hf
  have hg' : SuperOpposite.unop ℬ (SuperalgebraCat.toElem g) ∈ ℬ q := hg
  change SuperOpposite.mulBilin ℬ (SuperOpposite.unop ℬ (SuperalgebraCat.toElem g))
    (SuperOpposite.unop ℬ (SuperalgebraCat.toElem f)) = _
  rw [SuperOpposite.mulBilin_of_mem ℬ hg' hf', mul_comm q p]

name: StringDiagrams.ParityBasis.tate_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem tate_eq_zero_iff (x : M) (hx : Zπ.π • x = x) :
    Submodule.Quotient.mk (⟨x, hx⟩ : fixedSubmodule (M := M)) =
      (0 : TateZero (M := M)) ↔ ∃ y : M, y + Zπ.π • y = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
    exact ⟨y, congrArg Subtype.val hy⟩
  · rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
    exact ⟨y, Subtype.ext hy⟩

name: StringDiagrams.ParityBasis.repr_pi
statement: theorem repr_pi (x : M) (i : ι) : b.repr (Zπ.π • x) i = b.repr x (σ i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h : (b.coord i).comp piLinear = b.coord (σ i) := by
    apply b.ext
    intro j
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, piLinear, LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk,
      hb, Basis.coord_apply, Basis.repr_self, Finsupp.single_apply]
    have he : σ j = i ↔ j = σ i := ⟨fun h => by rw [← h, hσ], fun h => by rw [h, hσ]⟩
    simp only [he]
  exact congrArg (fun f : M →ₗ[ℤ] ℤ => f x) h

name: StringDiagrams.ParityBasis.fixed_not_norm
statement:
theorem fixed_not_norm (i : ι) (hi : σ i = i) :
    ¬ ∃ x : M, x + Zπ.π • x = b i
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
  have h := congrArg (fun y => b.repr y i) hx
  simp only [map_add, Finsupp.add_apply, repr_pi b σ hσ hb, hi,
    Basis.repr_self, Finsupp.single_eq_same] at h
  omega

name: StringDiagrams.ParityBasis.fixed_tate_ne_zero
statement:
theorem fixed_tate_ne_zero (i : ι) (hi : σ i = i) :
    Submodule.Quotient.mk
      (⟨b i, by change Zπ.π • b i = b i; rw [hb, hi]⟩ : fixedSubmodule (M := M)) ≠
        (0 : TateZero (M := M))
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  exact fixed_not_norm b σ hσ hb i hi
    ((tate_eq_zero_iff (b i) (by rw [hb, hi])).1 h)

name: StringDiagrams.ParityBasis.norm_surjective_of_free
statement:
theorem norm_surjective_of_free [Module.Free Zπ M] (x : M) (hx : Zπ.π • x = x) :
    ∃ y : M, y + Zπ.π • y = x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let c := Module.Free.chooseBasis Zπ M
  have hz (i) : ∃ a : ℤ, c.repr x i = (a : Zπ) + a * Zπ.π := by
    obtain ⟨a, d, hd⟩ := Zπ.exists_eq_add_mul_π (c.repr x i)
    have h := congrArg (fun y => c.repr y i) hx
    simp only [map_smul, Finsupp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hd] at h
    have he : (d : Zπ) + a * Zπ.π = a + d * Zπ.π := by
      calc
        (d : Zπ) + a * Zπ.π = Zπ.π * (a + d * Zπ.π) := by
          rw [mul_add, ← mul_assoc Zπ.π, mul_comm Zπ.π (d : Zπ), mul_assoc,
            Zπ.π_mul_π, mul_one, mul_comm Zπ.π (a : Zπ), add_comm]
        _ = _ := h
    have had := (Zπ.add_mul_π_injective he).1
    exact ⟨a, by simpa only [had] using hd⟩
  choose a ha using hz
  refine ⟨∑ i ∈ (c.repr x).support, (a i : Zπ) • c i, ?_⟩
  rw [Finset.smul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  calc
    _ = ∑ i ∈ (c.repr x).support, c.repr x i • c i := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      rw [smul_smul, mul_comm Zπ.π, ← add_smul, ← ha]
    _ = x := c.linearCombination_repr x

name: StringDiagrams.ParityBasis.no_fixed_of_free
statement: theorem no_fixed_of_free [Module.Free Zπ M] : ∀ i, σ i ≠ i
proof:
:= by
  intro i hi
  exact fixed_not_norm b σ hσ hb i hi
    (norm_surjective_of_free (b i) (by rw [hb, hi]))

name: StringDiagrams.ParityBasis.pair_ne
statement: private theorem pair_ne (i j : PairRep σ) : σ j.val ≠ i.val
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h' : σ i.val = j.val := by rw [← h, hσ]
  exact lt_asymm i.property (by simpa only [h', h] using j.property)

name: StringDiagrams.ParityBasis.repr_scalar_pair
statement:
theorem repr_scalar_pair (z : Zπ) (j : PairRep σ) (a d : ℤ)
    (hz : z = (a : Zπ) + d * Zπ.π) (i : PairRep σ) :
    b.repr (z • b j.val) i.val = if j = i then a else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [hz, add_smul, mul_smul, hb]
  simp only [Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul, map_add, map_smul, Finsupp.add_apply,
    Finsupp.smul_apply, Basis.repr_self, Finsupp.single_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  simp [pair_ne σ hσ i j, Subtype.ext_iff]

name: StringDiagrams.ParityBasis.repr_scalar_pair_pi
statement:
theorem repr_scalar_pair_pi (z : Zπ) (j : PairRep σ) (a d : ℤ)
    (hz : z = (a : Zπ) + d * Zπ.π) (i : PairRep σ) :
    b.repr (z • b j.val) (σ i.val) = if j = i then d else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [hz, add_smul, mul_smul, hb]
  simp only [Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul, map_add, map_smul, Finsupp.add_apply,
    Finsupp.smul_apply, Basis.repr_self, Finsupp.single_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  have hne : j.val ≠ σ i.val := (pair_ne σ hσ j i).symm
  simp [hne, hσ.injective.eq_iff, Subtype.ext_iff]

name: StringDiagrams.ParityBasis.paired_independent
statement: theorem paired_independent : LinearIndependent Zπ (fun i : PairRep σ => b i.val)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [linearIndependent_iff']
  intro s g hg i hi
  choose a d hd using fun j => Zπ.exists_eq_add_mul_π (g j)
  have h₁ := congrArg (fun x => b.repr x i.val) hg
  have h₂ := congrArg (fun x => b.repr x (σ i.val)) hg
  simp only [map_sum, Finsupp.finsetSum_apply, map_zero, Finsupp.zero_apply,
    repr_scalar_pair b σ hσ hb _ _ _ _ (hd _) i] at h₁
  simp only [map_sum, Finsupp.finsetSum_apply, map_zero, Finsupp.zero_apply,
    repr_scalar_pair_pi b σ hσ hb _ _ _ _ (hd _) i] at h₂
  simp only [Finset.sum_ite_eq', hi, ite_true] at h₁ h₂
  rw [hd, h₁, h₂]
  simp

name: StringDiagrams.ParityBasis.pairedBasis_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem pairedBasis_apply (hn : ∀ i, σ i ≠ i) (i : PairRep σ) :
    pairedBasis b σ hσ hb hn i = b i.val

name: StringDiagrams.ParityBasis.free_iff
statement: theorem free_iff : Module.Free Zπ M ↔ ∀ i, σ i ≠ i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro h
    let := h
    exact no_fixed_of_free b σ hσ hb
  · intro h
    let := linearOrderOfSTO (WellOrderingRel : ι → ι → Prop)
    exact Module.Free.of_basis (pairedBasis b σ hσ hb h)

name: StringDiagrams.ParityBasis.free_iff_norm_surjective
statement:
theorem free_iff_norm_surjective : Module.Free Zπ M ↔
    ∀ x : M, Zπ.π • x = x → ∃ y : M, y + Zπ.π • y = x
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    let := h
    exact norm_surjective_of_free
  · intro h
    apply (free_iff b σ hσ hb).2
    intro i hi
    exact fixed_not_norm b σ hσ hb i hi (h (b i) (by rw [hb, hi]))

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.cancelComparison_hom_isHomogeneous
statement:
theorem cancelComparison_hom_isHomogeneous (a : TwoNatTrans S E) (b : TwoNatTrans E S)
    (c : TwoNatTrans T E) (d : TwoNatTrans E T)
    (eS : vcomp a b ≅ id S) (eE : vcomp d c ≅ id E)
    (hS : eS.hom.IsHomogeneous 0 0) (hE : eE.hom.IsHomogeneous 0 0) :
    (cancelComparison a b c d eS eE).hom.IsHomogeneous 0 0
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  constructor
  · simpa only [zero_add] using! comp_mem
      (associator_hom_mem (R := R) (a.X x) (d.X x) ((vcomp c b).X x))
      (comp_mem (whiskerLeft_mem (a.X x)
        (inv_mem _ (associator_hom_mem (R := R) (d.X x) (c.X x) (b.X x))))
        (comp_mem (whiskerLeft_mem (a.X x) (whiskerRight_mem (b.X x) (hE x).1))
          (comp_mem (whiskerLeft_mem (a.X x) (leftUnitor_hom_mem (R := R) (b.X x)))
            (hS x).1)))
  · simpa only [zero_add] using! comp_mem_degree
      (GradedTwoSupercategory.associator_hom_mem_degree (R := R)
        (a.X x) (d.X x) ((vcomp c b).X x))
      (comp_mem_degree (GradedTwoSupercategory.whiskerLeft_mem_degree (a.X x)
        (GradedTwoSupercategory.associator_inv_mem_degree (R := R) (d.X x) (c.X x) (b.X x)))
        (comp_mem_degree (GradedTwoSupercategory.whiskerLeft_mem_degree (a.X x)
          (GradedTwoSupercategory.whiskerRight_mem_degree (b.X x) (hE x).2))
          (comp_mem_degree (GradedTwoSupercategory.whiskerLeft_mem_degree (a.X x)
            (GradedTwoSupercategory.leftUnitor_hom_mem_degree (R := R) (b.X x))) (hS x).2)))

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.iso_inv_isHomogeneous
statement:
theorem iso_inv_isHomogeneous {θ ψ : TwoNatTrans S T} (e : θ ≅ ψ)
    (he : e.hom.IsHomogeneous 0 0) : e.inv.IsHomogeneous 0 0
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  let ex : θ.X x ≅ ψ.X x :=
    { hom := e.hom.app x
      inv := e.inv.app x
      hom_inv_id := congrArg (fun α : θ ⟶ θ => α.app x) e.hom_inv_id
      inv_hom_id := congrArg (fun α : ψ ⟶ ψ => α.app x) e.inv_hom_id }
  exact ⟨inv_mem ex (he x).1, by simpa using inv_mem_degree ex (he x).2⟩

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.cancelComparisonTransport_hom_isHomogeneous
statement:
theorem cancelComparisonTransport_hom_isHomogeneous (h : E' = E)
    (a : TwoNatTrans S E) (b : TwoNatTrans E S)
    (c : TwoNatTrans T E') (d : TwoNatTrans E' T)
    (eS : vcomp a b ≅ id S) (eE : vcomp d c ≅ id E')
    (hS : eS.hom.IsHomogeneous 0 0) (hE : eE.hom.IsHomogeneous 0 0) :
    (cancelComparisonTransport h a b c d eS eE).hom.IsHomogeneous 0 0
proof:
:= by
  cases h
  exact cancelComparison_hom_isHomogeneous a b c d eS eE hS hE

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.comparisonCompInvIso_hom_isHomogeneous
statement:
theorem comparisonCompInvIso_hom_isHomogeneous :
    (comparisonCompInvIso S T hS hT h).hom.IsHomogeneous 0 0
proof:
:= by
  let : ∀ a b : C, QPiSupercategory R (a ⟶ b) :=
    fun a b => QPiTwoSupercategory.homQPiLeft a b
  exact TwoNatTrans.cancelComparisonTransport_hom_isHomogeneous _ _ _ _ _ _ _
    (extendRestrictUnitIso_hom_isHomogeneous S hS)
    (extendRestrictCounitIso_hom_isHomogeneous T hT)

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.comparisonCompInvIso_inv_isHomogeneous
statement:
theorem comparisonCompInvIso_inv_isHomogeneous :
    (comparisonCompInvIso S T hS hT h).inv.IsHomogeneous 0 0
proof:
:=
  TwoNatTrans.iso_inv_isHomogeneous _ (comparisonCompInvIso_hom_isHomogeneous S T hS hT h)

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.comparisonInvCompIso_hom_isHomogeneous
statement:
theorem comparisonInvCompIso_hom_isHomogeneous :
    (comparisonInvCompIso S T hS hT h).hom.IsHomogeneous 0 0
proof:
:=
  comparisonCompInvIso_hom_isHomogeneous T S hT hS h.symm

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.comparisonInvCompIso_inv_isHomogeneous
statement:
theorem comparisonInvCompIso_inv_isHomogeneous :

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoFunctor.j_comm
statement:
theorem j_comm (a : B) :
    (𝛃 (𝐪 (F.obj a))).hom ≫ (hF.j a).hom ▷ 𝐪 (F.obj a) ≫ F.map (𝛑 a) ◁ (hF.k a).hom ≫
        (F.mapComp (𝛑 a) (𝐪 a)).inv =
      (hF.k a).hom ▷ 𝛑 (F.obj a) ≫ F.map (𝐪 a) ◁ (hF.j a).hom ≫
        (F.mapComp (𝐪 a) (𝛑 a)).inv ≫ F.map₂ (𝛃 (𝐪 a)).hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [hF.β_comm (𝐪 a), ← reassoc_of% (β_naturality (R := R) (hF.k a).hom), whisker_exchange_assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoFunctor.γHom_hom
statement:
theorem γHom_hom {a b : B} (g : a ⟶ b) :
    (hF.γHom g).hom = F.map g ◁ (hF.k b).hom ≫ (F.mapComp g (𝐪 b)).inv

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoFunctor.γHom_inv
statement:
theorem γHom_inv {a b : B} (g : a ⟶ b) :
    (hF.γHom g).inv = (F.mapComp g (𝐪 b)).hom ≫ F.map g ◁ (hF.k b).inv

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoFunctor.γHom_naturality
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem γHom_naturality {a b : B} {g g' : a ⟶ b} (η : g ⟶ g') :
    F.map₂ η ▷ 𝐪 (F.obj b) ≫ (hF.γHom g').hom = (hF.γHom g).hom ≫ F.map₂ (η ▷ 𝐪 b)

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoFunctor.γHom_comm
statement:
theorem γHom_comm {a b : B} (g : a ⟶ b) :
    (QPiTwoCategory.βQHom (R := R) (F.map g)).hom ≫ (hF.βHom g).hom ▷ 𝐪 (F.obj b) ≫
        (hF.γHom (g ≫ 𝛑 b)).hom =
      (hF.γHom g).hom ▷ 𝛑 (F.obj b) ≫ (hF.βHom (g ≫ 𝐪 b)).hom ≫
        F.map₂ (QPiTwoCategory.βQHom (R := R) g).hom
proof:
:= by
  have hj := hF.j_comm b
  rw [QPiTwoCategory.βQHom_hom, QPiTwoCategory.βQHom_hom, PiTwoFunctor.βHom_hom, PiTwoFunctor.βHom_hom, γHom_hom,
    γHom_hom, F.map₂_comp, F.map₂_comp, Pseudofunctor.map₂_associator,
    Pseudofunctor.map₂_whisker_left, Pseudofunctor.map₂_associator_inv']
  simp only [Bicategory.comp_whiskerRight, Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
  have hj' : (hF.k b).hom ▷ 𝛑 (F.obj b) ≫ F.map (𝐪 b) ◁ (hF.j b).hom ≫
      (F.mapComp (𝐪 b) (𝛑 b)).inv ≫ F.map₂ (𝛃 (𝐪 b)).hom ≫ (F.mapComp (𝛑 b) (𝐪 b)).hom =
      (𝛃 (𝐪 (F.obj b))).hom ≫ (hF.j b).hom ▷ 𝐪 (F.obj b) ≫ F.map (𝛑 b) ◁ (hF.k b).hom := by
    rw [← cancel_mono (F.mapComp (𝛑 b) (𝐪 b)).inv]
    simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]
    exact hj.symm
  rw [← whisker_exchange_assoc (F.mapComp g (𝛑 b)).inv (hF.k b).hom,
    ← whisker_exchange_assoc (F.mapComp g (𝐪 b)).inv (hF.j b).hom,
    Bicategory.inv_hom_whiskerRight_assoc]
  calc _ = (α_ (F.map g) (𝐪 (F.obj b)) (𝛑 (F.obj b))).hom ≫
        F.map g ◁ ((𝛃 (𝐪 (F.obj b))).hom ≫ (hF.j b).hom ▷ 𝐪 (F.obj b) ≫
          F.map (𝛑 b) ◁ (hF.k b).hom) ≫ (α_ (F.map g) (F.map (𝛑 b)) (F.map (𝐪 b))).inv ≫
        (F.mapComp g (𝛑 b)).inv ▷ F.map (𝐪 b) ≫ (F.mapComp (g ≫ 𝛑 b) (𝐪 b)).inv := by
        bicategory
    _ = (α_ (F.map g) (𝐪 (F.obj b)) (𝛑 (F.obj b))).hom ≫
        F.map g ◁ ((hF.k b).hom ▷ 𝛑 (F.obj b) ≫ F.map (𝐪 b) ◁ (hF.j b).hom ≫
          (F.mapComp (𝐪 b) (𝛑 b)).inv ≫ F.map₂ (𝛃 (𝐪 b)).hom ≫ (F.mapComp (𝛑 b) (𝐪 b)).hom) ≫
        (α_ (F.map g) (F.map (𝛑 b)) (F.map (𝐪 b))).inv ≫
        (F.mapComp g (𝛑 b)).inv ▷ F.map (𝐪 b) ≫ (F.mapComp (g ≫ 𝛑 b) (𝐪 b)).inv := by
        rw [hj']
    _ = _ := by bicategory

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoFunctor.isQPiTwoNatural_id
statement:
theorem isQPiTwoNatural_id (hF : QPiTwoFunctor R F) :
    hF.IsQPiTwoNatural hF (Oplax.OplaxTrans.id F.toOplax)
proof:
:=
  ⟨PiTwoFunctor.isPiTwoNatural_id hF.toPiTwoFunctor, fun a => by
    simp only [Oplax.OplaxTrans.id, γ_id, Pseudofunctor.toOplax_toPrelaxFunctor]
    bicategory⟩

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoFunctor.IsQPiTwoNatural.vcomp
proof:
:=
  ⟨hη.1.vcomp hθ.1, fun a => by
    simp only [Oplax.OplaxTrans.vcomp, γ_comp, Pseudofunctor.toOplax_toPrelaxFunctor,
      Category.assoc]
    have c1 : (α_ (η.app a) (θ.app a) (𝐪 (H.obj a))).hom ≫ η.app a ◁ (𝛄 (θ.app a)).hom ≫
        (α_ (η.app a) (𝐪 (G.obj a)) (θ.app a)).inv ≫ (𝛄 (η.app a)).hom ▷ θ.app a ≫
          (α_ (𝐪 (F.obj a)) (η.app a) (θ.app a)).hom ≫ (hF.k a).hom ▷ (η.app a ≫ θ.app a) ≫
            (α_ (F.map (𝐪 a)) (η.app a) (θ.app a)).inv ≫ η.naturality (𝐪 a) ▷ θ.app a ≫
              (α_ (η.app a) (G.map (𝐪 a)) (θ.app a)).hom ≫ η.app a ◁ θ.naturality (𝐪 a) ≫
                (α_ (η.app a) (θ.app a) (H.map (𝐪 a))).inv =
        (α_ (η.app a) (θ.app a) (𝐪 (H.obj a))).hom ≫ η.app a ◁ (𝛄 (θ.app a)).hom ≫
          (α_ (η.app a) (𝐪 (G.obj a)) (θ.app a)).inv ≫
            ((𝛄 (η.app a)).hom ≫ (hF.k a).hom ▷ η.app a ≫ η.naturality (𝐪 a)) ▷ θ.app a ≫
              (α_ (η.app a) (G.map (𝐪 a)) (θ.app a)).hom ≫ η.app a ◁ θ.naturality (𝐪 a) ≫
                (α_ (η.app a) (θ.app a) (H.map (𝐪 a))).inv := by
      bicategory
    rw [c1, hη.2 a]
    have c2 : (α_ (η.app a) (θ.app a) (𝐪 (H.obj a))).hom ≫ η.app a ◁ (𝛄 (θ.app a)).hom ≫
        (α_ (η.app a) (𝐪 (G.obj a)) (θ.app a)).inv ≫ (η.app a ◁ (hG.k a).hom) ▷ θ.app a ≫
          (α_ (η.app a) (G.map (𝐪 a)) (θ.app a)).hom ≫ η.app a ◁ θ.naturality (𝐪 a) ≫
            (α_ (η.app a) (θ.app a) (H.map (𝐪 a))).inv =
        (α_ (η.app a) (θ.app a) (𝐪 (H.obj a))).hom ≫
          η.app a ◁ ((𝛄 (θ.app a)).hom ≫ (hG.k a).hom ▷ θ.app a ≫ θ.naturality (𝐪 a)) ≫
            (α_ (η.app a) (θ.app a) (H.map (𝐪 a))).inv := by
      bicategory
    rw [c2, hθ.2 a]
    bicategory⟩

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.kIso_hom

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.kIso_hom_mem
statement:
theorem kIso_hom_mem (a : A) :
    (F.kIso a).hom ∈ parity (R := R) (𝐪 (F.obj a)) (F.map (𝐪 a)) 0
proof:
:= by
  have := comp_mem (comp_mem (QPiTwoSupercategory.σ_hom_mem (R := R) (F.obj a))
    (F.mapId_hom_mem a)) (F.map₂_mem (QPiTwoSupercategory.σ_inv_mem (R := R) a))

proof:
:= by

    (QPiTwoSupercategory.σ_hom_mem_degree (R := R) (F.obj a)) (hF.mapId_hom_mem_degree a))
    (hF.map₂_mem_degree (QPiTwoSupercategory.σ_inv_mem_degree (R := R) a))

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.kIso_hom_comp_map₂_σ
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem kIso_hom_comp_map₂_σ (a : A) :
    (F.kIso a).hom ≫ F.map₂ (𝛔 a).hom = (𝛔 (F.obj a)).hom ≫ (F.mapId a).hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [kIso_hom, Category.assoc, Category.assoc, ← F.map₂_comp, Iso.inv_hom_id, F.map₂_id,
    Category.comp_id]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.mapId_hom_comp_map₂_σ_inv
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem mapId_hom_comp_map₂_σ_inv (a : A) :
    (F.mapId a).hom ≫ F.map₂ (𝛔 a).inv = (𝛔 (F.obj a)).inv ≫ (F.kIso a).hom

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.kγ_comm
statement:
theorem kγ_comm {a b : A} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    F.map f ◁ (F.kIso b).hom ≫ (F.mapComp f (𝐪 b)).hom ≫ F.map₂ (𝛄 f).hom =
      (𝛄 (F.map f)).hom ≫ (F.kIso a).hom ▷ F.map f ≫ (F.mapComp (𝐪 a) f).hom
proof:
:= by
  have hl := F.map₂_leftUnitor f
  have hr := F.map₂_rightUnitor f
  rw [QPiTwoSupercategory.γ_hom, QPiTwoSupercategory.γ_hom, F.map₂_comp, F.map₂_comp,
    F.map₂_comp]
  rw [← reassoc_of% (F.mapComp_naturality_right f (𝛔 b).hom), ← whiskerLeft_comp'_assoc R,
    kIso_hom_comp_map₂_σ, whiskerLeft_comp'_assoc R]
  have e1 : F.map f ◁ (F.mapId b).hom ≫ (F.mapComp f (𝟙 b)).hom ≫
      F.map₂ (rightUnitor f).hom = (rightUnitor (F.map f)).hom := hr
  have e2' : (leftUnitor (F.map f)).hom ≫ F.map₂ (leftUnitor f).inv =
      (F.mapId a).hom ▷ F.map f ≫ (F.mapComp (𝟙 a) f).hom := by
    rw [← hl]
    simp only [Category.assoc]
    rw [← F.map₂_comp, Iso.hom_inv_id, F.map₂_id, Category.comp_id]
  have e2 : F.map₂ (leftUnitor f).inv = (leftUnitor (F.map f)).inv ≫
      (F.mapId a).hom ▷ F.map f ≫ (F.mapComp (𝟙 a) f).hom := by
    rw [← e2', Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
  rw [reassoc_of% e1, e2]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [← F.mapComp_naturality_left, ← comp_whiskerRight'_assoc R, mapId_hom_comp_map₂_σ_inv,
    comp_whiskerRight'_assoc R]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.kNat
statement:
theorem kNat (a : A) :
    (𝛄 (θ.X a)).hom ≫ (F.kIso a).hom ▷ θ.X a ≫ θ.x (𝐪 a) = θ.X a ◁ (G.kIso a).hom
proof:
:= by
  have hn := θ.naturality (𝛔 a).inv
  have hid := θ.x_id a
  rw [TwoSuperfunctor.kIso_hom, comp_whiskerRight'_assoc R, comp_whiskerRight'_assoc R, hn,
    QPiTwoSupercategory.γ_hom_comp_σ_assoc]
  rw [reassoc_of% hid, TwoSuperfunctor.kIso_hom, whiskerLeft_comp' R, whiskerLeft_comp' R]

statement: theorem iSupIndep_degNat (F G : GradedSuperfunctor R A B) : iSupIndep (degNat F G)
proof:
:= by
  refine iSupIndep_of_eval (degNat F G) (A := ZMod 2 × A) (N := fun pX => F.obj pX.2 ⟶ G.obj pX.2)
    (fun pX => evalNat F G pX.1 pX.2) (fun pX n => degree (R := R) (F.obj pX.2) (G.obj pX.2) n)
    (fun pX => (isInternal_degree (R := R) _ _).submodule_iSupIndep) ?_ ?_
  · rintro ⟨p, X⟩ n x ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    exact hy p X
  · intro x hx

    (G : GradedSuperfunctor R B C) :
    Superfunctor.whiskerRight x G.toSuperfunctor ∈ degNat (F.comp G) (H.comp G) n
proof:
:=
  fun p X => map_mem_degree G.toFunctor (hx p X)

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSuperfunctor.whiskerLeft_mem_hom
proof:
:= by
  refine (family R B C).hom_induction hy
    (fun n y hy => (family R A C).mem_hom_of_mem (whiskerLeft_mem_degNat F hy)) ?_ ?_
  · rw [show Superfunctor.whiskerLeft F.toSuperfunctor (0 : G.toSuperfunctor ⟶ K.toSuperfunctor) = 0
      from Superfunctor.hom_ext fun _ _ => rfl]
    exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  · intro y z hy hz
    rw [Superfunctor.whiskerLeft_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hy hz

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSuperfunctor.whiskerRight_mem_hom
statement:
theorem whiskerRight_mem_hom {F H : GradedSuperfunctor R A B}
    {x : F.toSuperfunctor ⟶ H.toSuperfunctor} (hx : x ∈ (family R A B).hom F H)
    (G : GradedSuperfunctor R B C) :
    Superfunctor.whiskerRight x G.toSuperfunctor ∈ (family R A C).hom (F.comp G) (H.comp G)
proof:
:= by
  refine (family R A B).hom_induction hx
    (fun n x hx => (family R A C).mem_hom_of_mem (whiskerRight_mem_degNat hx G)) ?_ ?_
  · rw [show Superfunctor.whiskerRight (0 : F.toSuperfunctor ⟶ H.toSuperfunctor) G.toSuperfunctor = 0
      from Superfunctor.hom_ext fun _ _ => G.toFunctor.map_zero _ _]
    exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  · intro x z hx hz
    rw [Superfunctor.add_whiskerRight]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hx hz

name: StringDiagrams.QPiFunctor.ext
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨hF', γF⟩, cF⟩ := hF
  obtain ⟨⟨hG', γG⟩, cG⟩ := hG
  have e1 : hF' = hG' := PiFunctor.ext hβ
  subst e1
  have e2 : γF = γG := Iso.ext (NatTrans.ext (funext hγ))
  subst e2
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.QPiCat.Hom.ext
statement:
theorem Hom.ext {A B : QPiCat.{w, v, u} R} {F G : Hom A B} (h : F.toFunctor = G.toFunctor)
    (hβ : ∀ X, HEq (F.qpiFunctor.β.hom.app X) (G.qpiFunctor.β.hom.app X))
    (hγ : ∀ X, HEq (F.qpiFunctor.γ.hom.app X) (G.qpiFunctor.γ.hom.app X)) : F = G
proof:
:= by
  cases F
  cases G
  dsimp only at h hβ hγ
  subst h
  congr
  exact QPiFunctor.ext (fun X => eq_of_heq (hβ X)) fun X => eq_of_heq (hγ X)

name: StringDiagrams.PiSOp.correction_of_mem
proof:
:= by

name: StringDiagrams.PiSOp.correction_mem
StringDiagrams.PiSOp.exponent_comp
statement:
theorem exponent_comp (a b c p q : ZMod 2) :
    exponent a c (p + q) + p * q =
      (p + (a + b)) * (q + (b + c)) + exponent a b p + exponent b c q
proof:
:= by
  rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one a with rfl | rfl <;>
    rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one b with rfl | rfl <;>
    rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one c with rfl | rfl <;>
    rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one p with rfl | rfl <;>
    rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one q with rfl | rfl <;> decide

name: StringDiagrams.PiSOp.correction_comp
statement:
theorem correction_comp (a b c : ZMod 2) {X Y Z : C} (f : Y ⟶ X) (g : Z ⟶ Y) :
    correction (R := R) a c (SOp.compC (R := R) f g) =
      Envelope.toHom (SOp.compC (R := R) (C := Envelope R C)
        (Envelope.ofHom (X := ⟨b, Y⟩) (Y := ⟨a, X⟩) (correction (R := R) a b f))
        (Envelope.ofHom (X := ⟨c, Z⟩) (Y := ⟨b, Y⟩) (correction (R := R) b c g)))
proof:
:= by
  refine induction_on (R := R) f ?_ (fun p f hf => ?_) ?_
  · simp only [map_zero, Envelope.ofHom, SOp.zero_compC, Envelope.toHom_zero]
  · refine induction_on (R := R) g ?_ (fun q g hg => ?_) ?_
    · simp only [map_zero, Envelope.ofHom, SOp.compC_zero, Envelope.toHom_zero]
    · rw [SOp.compC_of_mem hf hg, map_smul,
        correction_of_mem a c (comp_mem hg hf)]
      have hcf := Envelope.ofHom_mem (X := (⟨b, Y⟩ : Envelope R C))
        (Y := ⟨a, X⟩) (correction_mem a b hf)
      have hcg := Envelope.ofHom_mem (X := (⟨c, Z⟩ : Envelope R C))
        (Y := ⟨b, Y⟩) (correction_mem b c hg)
      rw [SOp.compC_of_mem hcf hcg]
      change sign R (p * q) • (sign R (exponent a c (q + p)) • (g ≫ f)) =
        sign R ((p + (b + a)) * (q + (c + b))) •
          (correction (R := R) b c g ≫ correction (R := R) a b f)
      rw [correction_of_mem b c hg, correction_of_mem a b hf,
        Linear.smul_comp, Linear.comp_smul, smul_smul, smul_smul, smul_smul]
      congr 1
      simp only [← sign_add]
      congr 1
      have e := exponent_comp a b c p q
      convert e using 1 <;> unfold exponent <;> ring
    · intro g h hg hh
      simp only [map_add, Envelope.ofHom, SOp.compC_add, Envelope.toHom_add, hg, hh]
  · intro f h hf hh
    simp only [map_add, Envelope.ofHom, SOp.add_compC, Envelope.toHom_add, hf, hh]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.inv_hom_whiskerRight'
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem inv_hom_whiskerRight' {a b c : C} {f g : a ⟶ b} (e : f ≅ g) (h : b ⟶ c) :
    e.inv ▷ h ≫ e.hom ▷ h = 𝟙 (g ≫ h)

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.hom_inv_whiskerRight'
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem hom_inv_whiskerRight' {a b c : C} {f g : a ⟶ b} (e : f ≅ g) (h : b ⟶ c) :
    e.hom ▷ h ≫ e.inv ▷ h = 𝟙 (f ≫ h)

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.whiskerLeft_inv_hom'
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem whiskerLeft_inv_hom' {a b c : C} (f : a ⟶ b) {g h : b ⟶ c} (e : g ≅ h) :
    f ◁ e.inv ≫ f ◁ e.hom = 𝟙 (f ≫ h)

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.whiskerLeft_hom_inv'
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem whiskerLeft_hom_inv' {a b c : C} (f : a ⟶ b) {g h : b ⟶ c} (e : g ≅ h) :
    f ◁ e.hom ≫ f ◁ e.inv = 𝟙 (f ≫ g)

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.whiskerLeft_comp_comp
statement:
theorem whiskerLeft_comp_comp {a b c : C} (f : a ⟶ b) {g h i : b ⟶ c} {j : a ⟶ c} (η : g ⟶ h)
    (θ : h ⟶ i) (κ : f ≫ i ⟶ j) : f ◁ η ≫ f ◁ θ ≫ κ = f ◁ (η ≫ θ) ≫ κ

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.comp_whiskerRight_comp
statement:
theorem comp_whiskerRight_comp {a b c : C} {f g h : a ⟶ b} (i : b ⟶ c) {j : a ⟶ c} (η : f ⟶ g)
    (θ : g ⟶ h) (κ : h ≫ i ⟶ j) : η ▷ i ≫ θ ▷ i ≫ κ = (η ≫ θ) ▷ i ≫ κ

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.interchange_even_left
statement:
theorem interchange_even_left {a b c : C} {f g : a ⟶ b} {h i : b ⟶ c} {η : f ⟶ g}
    (hη : η ∈ parity (R := R) f g 0) (θ : h ⟶ i) : η ▷ h ≫ g ◁ θ = f ◁ θ ≫ η ▷ i
proof:
:= by
  refine Supercategory.induction_on (R := R) θ ?_ (fun q θ hθ => ?_) (fun θ κ hθ hκ => ?_)
  · rw [whiskerLeft_zero R, whiskerLeft_zero R, Limits.comp_zero, Limits.zero_comp]
  · rw [super_interchange hη hθ, koszulSign_zero_left, one_smul]
  · rw [whiskerLeft_add (R := R), whiskerLeft_add (R := R), Preadditive.comp_add,
      Preadditive.add_comp, hθ, hκ]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.interchange_even_right
statement:
theorem interchange_even_right {a b c : C} {f g : a ⟶ b} {h i : b ⟶ c} (η : f ⟶ g) {θ : h ⟶ i}
    (hθ : θ ∈ parity (R := R) h i 0) : η ▷ h ≫ g ◁ θ = f ◁ θ ≫ η ▷ i
proof:
:= by
  refine Supercategory.induction_on (R := R) η ?_ (fun q η hη => ?_) (fun η κ hη hκ => ?_)
  · rw [zero_whiskerRight R, zero_whiskerRight R, Limits.comp_zero, Limits.zero_comp]
  · rw [super_interchange hη hθ, koszulSign_zero_right, one_smul]
  · rw [add_whiskerRight (R := R), add_whiskerRight (R := R), Preadditive.comp_add,
      Preadditive.add_comp, hη, hκ]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.ζF_hom_mem

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.ζF_inv_mem

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.extendFunctor_map
statement:
theorem extendFunctor_map {f g : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ g) :
    (extendFunctor F a b).map η = (ζF F f).hom ≫ F.map₂ (toHom η) ≫ (ζF F g).inv

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.extendCompAux_inv
statement:
theorem extendCompAux_inv (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) :
    extendCompAux F f g ≫ extendCompAuxInv F f g = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  simp only [extendCompAux, extendCompAuxInv, Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc,
    Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc, whiskerLeft_hom_inv'_assoc R, hom_inv_whiskerRight' R]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.extendCompAuxInv_aux
statement:
theorem extendCompAuxInv_aux (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) :
    extendCompAuxInv F f g ≫ extendCompAux F f g = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  simp only [extendCompAux, extendCompAuxInv, Category.assoc, inv_hom_whiskerRight'_assoc R,
    whiskerLeft_inv_hom'_assoc R, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.extendComp_hom
statement:
theorem extendComp_hom (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) :
    (extendComp F f g).hom = sign R (f.par * g.par) • extendCompAux F f g

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.extendCompAux_mem
statement:
theorem extendCompAux_mem (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) :
    extendCompAux F f g ∈ parity (R := R) _ _ 0
proof:
:= by
  have := comp_mem (whiskerRight_mem ((extendFunctor F b c).obj g) (ζF_hom_mem F f))
    (comp_mem (whiskerLeft_mem (F.map f.obj) (ζF_hom_mem F g))
      (comp_mem (F.mapComp_hom_mem f.obj g.obj) (ζF_inv_mem F (f ≫ g))))
  have e : f.par + (g.par + (0 + (f ≫ g).par)) = 0 := by
    simp only [comp_par]
    generalize f.par = x; generalize g.par = y; revert x y; decide
  rw [e] at this
  exact this

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.extendComp_hom_mem
statement:
theorem extendComp_hom_mem (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) :
    (extendComp F f g).hom ∈ parity (R := R) _ _ 0

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.extendComp_naturality_left
statement:
theorem extendComp_naturality_left {f f' : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ f') (g : b ⟶ c) :
    (extendFunctor F a b).map η ▷ (extendFunctor F b c).obj g ≫ (extendComp F f' g).hom =
      (extendComp F f g).hom ≫ (extendFunctor F a c).map (η ▷ g)
proof:
:= by
  refine induction_on' (R := R) η ?_ (fun r η hη => ?_) (fun η θ hη hθ => ?_)
  · rw [Functor.map_zero, zero_whiskerRight R, TwoEnvelope.zero_whiskerRight', Functor.map_zero,
      Limits.zero_comp, Limits.comp_zero]
  · have hi := super_interchange (R := R) (F.map₂_mem hη) (ζF_hom_mem F g)
    rw [extendComp_hom, extendComp_hom, extendFunctor_map, extendFunctor_map,
      toHom_whiskerRight_of_mem hη g, F.map₂_smul]
    simp only [extendCompAux, comp_whiskerRight (R := R), Category.assoc,
      inv_hom_whiskerRight'_assoc R, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc, Linear.smul_comp, Linear.comp_smul]
    rw [reassoc_of% hi, Linear.smul_comp, Linear.comp_smul, Category.assoc,
      reassoc_of% (F.mapComp_naturality_left _ _), koszulSign_smul (R := R), smul_smul,
      smul_smul, ← sign_add, ← sign_add]
    congr 2
    generalize f.par = x; generalize f'.par = y; generalize g.par = z
    clear hη hi; revert x y z r; decide
  · rw [Functor.map_add, add_whiskerRight (R := R), TwoEnvelope.add_whiskerRight',
      Functor.map_add, Preadditive.add_comp, Preadditive.comp_add, hη, hθ]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.extendComp_naturality_right
statement:
theorem extendComp_naturality_right (f : a ⟶ b) {g g' : b ⟶ c} (θ : g ⟶ g') :
    (extendFunctor F a b).obj f ◁ (extendFunctor F b c).map θ ≫ (extendComp F f g').hom =
      (extendComp F f g).hom ≫ (extendFunctor F a c).map (f ◁ θ)
proof:
:= by
  refine induction_on' (R := R) θ ?_ (fun r θ hθ => ?_) (fun η θ hη hθ => ?_)
  · rw [Functor.map_zero, whiskerLeft_zero R, TwoEnvelope.whiskerLeft_zero', Functor.map_zero,
      Limits.zero_comp, Limits.comp_zero]
  · have hw : (ζF F g).hom ≫ F.map₂ (toHom θ) ≫ (ζF F g').inv ∈
        parity (R := R) _ _ (g.par + r + g'.par) := by
      simpa only [Category.assoc] using comp_mem (comp_mem (ζF_hom_mem F g) (F.map₂_mem hθ))
        (ζF_inv_mem F g')
    have hi := super_interchange (R := R) (ζF_hom_mem F f) hw
    have hi' := congrArg (fun t => koszulSign f.par (g.par + r + g'.par) • t) hi
    simp only [koszulSign_smul_smul] at hi'
    rw [extendComp_hom, extendComp_hom, extendFunctor_map, extendFunctor_map,
      toHom_whiskerLeft_of_mem f hθ, F.map₂_smul]
    simp only [extendCompAux, Linear.comp_smul, Linear.smul_comp]
    rw [reassoc_of% hi'.symm]
    simp only [whiskerLeft_comp (R := R), Category.assoc, whiskerLeft_inv_hom'_assoc R,
      Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc, Linear.smul_comp]
    rw [reassoc_of% (F.mapComp_naturality_right _ _), koszulSign_smul (R := R), smul_smul,
      smul_smul, ← sign_add, ← sign_add]
    congr 2
    generalize f.par = x; generalize g.par = y; generalize g'.par = z
    clear hθ hi hi' hw; revert x y z r; decide
  · rw [Functor.map_add, whiskerLeft_add (R := R), TwoEnvelope.whiskerLeft_add',
      Functor.map_add, Preadditive.add_comp, Preadditive.comp_add, hη, hθ]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.extendComp_J
statement:
theorem extendComp_J (f : a.as ⟶ b.as) (g : b.as ⟶ c.as) :
    (extendComp F (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) ((J R _).obj f) ((J R _).obj g)).hom =
      (F.mapComp f g).hom
proof:
:= by
  show sign R (0 * 0) • (𝟙 (F.map f) ▷ F.map g ≫ F.map f ◁ 𝟙 (F.map g) ≫ (F.mapComp f g).hom ≫
    𝟙 _) = _
  rw [id_whiskerRight (R := R), whiskerLeft_id (R := R), mul_zero, sign_zero, one_smul,
    Category.id_comp, Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.extendComp_J_comp_left
statement:
theorem extendComp_J_comp_left (f : a.as ⟶ b.as) (g : b.as ⟶ c.as) (h : c.as ⟶ d.as) :
    (extendComp F (a := a) (b := c) (c := d)
      (((J R _).obj f : a ⟶ b) ≫ ((J R _).obj g : b ⟶ c)) ((J R _).obj h)).hom =
      (F.mapComp (f ≫ g) h).hom
proof:
:= by
  show sign R (0 * 0) • (𝟙 (F.map (f ≫ g)) ▷ F.map h ≫ F.map (f ≫ g) ◁ 𝟙 (F.map h) ≫
    (F.mapComp (f ≫ g) h).hom ≫ 𝟙 _) = _
  rw [id_whiskerRight (R := R), whiskerLeft_id (R := R), mul_zero, sign_zero, one_smul,
    Category.id_comp, Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.extendComp_J_comp_right
statement:
theorem extendComp_J_comp_right (f : a.as ⟶ b.as) (g : b.as ⟶ c.as) (h : c.as ⟶ d.as) :
    (extendComp F (a := a) (b := b) (c := d) ((J R _).obj f)
      (((J R _).obj g : b ⟶ c) ≫ ((J R _).obj h : c ⟶ d))).hom =
      (F.mapComp f (g ≫ h)).hom
proof:
:= by
  show sign R (0 * 0) • (𝟙 (F.map f) ▷ F.map (g ≫ h) ≫ F.map f ◁ 𝟙 (F.map (g ≫ h)) ≫
    (F.mapComp f (g ≫ h)).hom ≫ 𝟙 _) = _
  rw [id_whiskerRight (R := R), whiskerLeft_id (R := R), mul_zero, sign_zero, one_smul,
    Category.id_comp, Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.extendFunctor_map_J
StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.assocL_nat₁
statement:
theorem assocL_nat₁ {f f' : a ⟶ b} (u : f ⟶ f') (g : b ⟶ c) (h : c ⟶ d) :
    (F̃ a b).map u ▷ ((F̃ b c).obj g ≫ (F̃ c d).obj h) ≫ assocL F f' g h =
      assocL F f g h ≫ (F̃ a d).map ((u ▷ g) ▷ h)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [assocL]
  rw [← Category.assoc, interchange_even_right R _ (extendComp_hom_mem F g h), Category.assoc,
    reassoc_of% (extendComp_naturality_left F u (g ≫ h)), ← Functor.map_comp,
    associator_inv_naturality_left R, Functor.map_comp]
  simp only [Category.assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.assocR_nat₁
statement:
theorem assocR_nat₁ {f f' : a ⟶ b} (u : f ⟶ f') (g : b ⟶ c) (h : c ⟶ d) :
    (F̃ a b).map u ▷ ((F̃ b c).obj g ≫ (F̃ c d).obj h) ≫ assocR F f' g h =
      assocR F f g h ≫ (F̃ a d).map ((u ▷ g) ▷ h)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [assocR]
  rw [associator_inv_naturality_left_assoc R, comp_whiskerRight_comp R,
    extendComp_naturality_left, ← comp_whiskerRight_comp R, extendComp_naturality_left]
  simp only [Category.assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.assocL_nat₂
statement:
theorem assocL_nat₂ (f : a ⟶ b) {g g' : b ⟶ c} (v : g ⟶ g') (h : c ⟶ d) :
    (F̃ a b).obj f ◁ ((F̃ b c).map v ▷ (F̃ c d).obj h) ≫ assocL F f g' h =
      assocL F f g h ≫ (F̃ a d).map ((f ◁ v) ▷ h)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [assocL]
  rw [whiskerLeft_comp_comp R, extendComp_naturality_left, ← whiskerLeft_comp_comp R,
    reassoc_of% (extendComp_naturality_right F f (v ▷ h)),
    ← Functor.map_comp, associator_inv_naturality_middle R, Functor.map_comp]
  simp only [Category.assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.assocR_nat₂
statement:
theorem assocR_nat₂ (f : a ⟶ b) {g g' : b ⟶ c} (v : g ⟶ g') (h : c ⟶ d) :
    (F̃ a b).obj f ◁ ((F̃ b c).map v ▷ (F̃ c d).obj h) ≫ assocR F f g' h =
      assocR F f g h ≫ (F̃ a d).map ((f ◁ v) ▷ h)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [assocR]
  rw [associator_inv_naturality_middle_assoc R, comp_whiskerRight_comp R,
    extendComp_naturality_right, ← comp_whiskerRight_comp R, extendComp_naturality_left]
  simp only [Category.assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.assocL_nat₃
statement:
theorem assocL_nat₃ (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) {h h' : c ⟶ d} (w : h ⟶ h') :
    (F̃ a b).obj f ◁ (F̃ b c).obj g ◁ (F̃ c d).map w ≫ assocL F f g h' =
      assocL F f g h ≫ (F̃ a d).map ((f ≫ g) ◁ w)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [assocL]
  rw [whiskerLeft_comp_comp R, extendComp_naturality_right, ← whiskerLeft_comp_comp R,
    reassoc_of% (extendComp_naturality_right F f (g ◁ w)), ← Functor.map_comp,
    associator_inv_naturality_right R, Functor.map_comp]
  simp only [Category.assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.assocR_nat₃
statement:
theorem assocR_nat₃ (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) {h h' : c ⟶ d} (w : h ⟶ h') :
    (F̃ a b).obj f ◁ (F̃ b c).obj g ◁ (F̃ c d).map w ≫ assocR F f g h' =
      assocR F f g h ≫ (F̃ a d).map ((f ≫ g) ◁ w)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [assocR]
  rw [associator_inv_naturality_right_assoc R,
    ← reassoc_of% (interchange_even_left R (extendComp_hom_mem F f g) ((F̃ c d).map w)),
    extendComp_naturality_right]
  simp only [Category.assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.eq_of_conj_hom
statement:
theorem eq_of_conj_hom {D : Type*} [Category D] {X X' Y Y' : D} (e : X ⟶ X') (he : Epi e)
    (g : Y ⟶ Y') {φ ψ : X' ⟶ Y'} {φ₀ ψ₀ : X ⟶ Y} (hφ : e ≫ φ = φ₀ ≫ g)
    (hψ : e ≫ ψ = ψ₀ ≫ g) (h : φ₀ = ψ₀) : φ = ψ
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cancel_epi e, hφ, hψ, h]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.assocL_eq_assocR
statement:
theorem assocL_eq_assocR (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) (h : c ⟶ d) :
    assocL F f g h = assocR F f g h
proof:
:= by
  have e₁ : Epi ((F̃ a b).map (shiftIso f).hom ▷ ((F̃ b c).obj g ≫ (F̃ c d).obj h)) :=
    (inferInstance : Epi (whiskerRightIso (R := R) ((F̃ a b).mapIso (shiftIso f)) _).hom)
  refine eq_of_conj_hom _ e₁ _ (assocL_nat₁ F (shiftIso f).hom g h)
    (assocR_nat₁ F (shiftIso f).hom g h) ?_
  have e₂ : Epi ((F̃ a b).obj ((J R _).obj f.obj) ◁
      ((F̃ b c).map (shiftIso g).hom ▷ (F̃ c d).obj h)) :=
    (inferInstance : Epi (whiskerLeftIso (R := R) _ (whiskerRightIso (R := R)
      ((F̃ b c).mapIso (shiftIso g)) ((F̃ c d).obj h))).hom)
  refine eq_of_conj_hom _ e₂ _ (assocL_nat₂ F _ (shiftIso g).hom h)
    (assocR_nat₂ F _ (shiftIso g).hom h) ?_
  have e₃ : Epi ((F̃ a b).obj ((J R _).obj f.obj) ◁ (F̃ b c).obj ((J R _).obj g.obj) ◁
      (F̃ c d).map (shiftIso h).hom) :=
    (inferInstance : Epi (whiskerLeftIso (R := R) _ (whiskerLeftIso (R := R) _
      ((F̃ c d).mapIso (shiftIso h)))).hom)
  refine eq_of_conj_hom _ e₃ _ (assocL_nat₃ F _ _ (shiftIso h).hom)
    (assocR_nat₃ F _ _ (shiftIso h).hom) ?_
  simp only [assocL, assocR]
  rw [extendComp_J, extendComp_J, extendComp_J_comp_left, extendComp_J_comp_right]
  have e : (F̃ a d).map (associator ((J R _).obj f.obj : a ⟶ b) ((J R _).obj g.obj : b ⟶ c)
      ((J R _).obj h.obj : c ⟶ d)).inv = F.map₂ (associator f.obj g.obj h.obj).inv := by
    show 𝟙 _ ≫ F.map₂ _ ≫ 𝟙 _ = _
    rw [Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id]; rfl
  rw [e]
  exact F.map₂_associator f.obj g.obj h.obj

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.extendComp_id_J
statement:
theorem extendComp_id_J (f : a.as ⟶ b.as) :
    (extendComp F (𝟙 a) ((J R _).obj f : a ⟶ b)).hom = (F.mapComp (𝟙 a.as) f).hom
proof:
:= by
  show sign R (0 * 0) • (𝟙 (F.map (𝟙 a.as)) ▷ F.map f ≫ F.map (𝟙 a.as) ◁ 𝟙 (F.map f) ≫
    (F.mapComp (𝟙 a.as) f).hom ≫ 𝟙 _) = _
  rw [id_whiskerRight (R := R), whiskerLeft_id (R := R), mul_zero, sign_zero, one_smul,
    Category.id_comp, Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.extendComp_J_id
statement:
theorem extendComp_J_id (f : a.as ⟶ b.as) :
    (extendComp F ((J R _).obj f : a ⟶ b) (𝟙 b)).hom = (F.mapComp f (𝟙 b.as)).hom
proof:
:= by
  show sign R (0 * 0) • (𝟙 (F.map f) ▷ F.map (𝟙 b.as) ≫ F.map f ◁ 𝟙 (F.map (𝟙 b.as)) ≫
    (F.mapComp f (𝟙 b.as)).hom ≫ 𝟙 _) = _
  rw [id_whiskerRight (R := R), whiskerLeft_id (R := R), mul_zero, sign_zero, one_smul,
    Category.id_comp, Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.extend_leftUnitor
statement:
theorem extend_leftUnitor (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (F.mapId a.as).hom ▷ (F̃ a b).obj f ≫ (extendComp F (𝟙 a) f).hom ≫
        (F̃ a b).map (leftUnitor f).hom = (leftUnitor ((F̃ a b).obj f)).hom
proof:
:= by
  have nat : ∀ {f f' : a ⟶ b} (u : f ⟶ f'), 𝟙 _ ◁ (F̃ a b).map u ≫
      ((F.mapId a.as).hom ▷ (F̃ a b).obj f' ≫ (extendComp F (𝟙 a) f').hom ≫
        (F̃ a b).map (leftUnitor f').hom) =
      ((F.mapId a.as).hom ▷ (F̃ a b).obj f ≫ (extendComp F (𝟙 a) f).hom ≫
        (F̃ a b).map (leftUnitor f).hom) ≫ (F̃ a b).map u := by
    intro f f' u
    rw [← reassoc_of% (interchange_even_left R (F.mapId_hom_mem a.as) ((F̃ a b).map u))]
    erw [reassoc_of% (extendComp_naturality_right F (𝟙 a) u)]
    rw [← Functor.map_comp, leftUnitor_naturality R, Functor.map_comp]
    simp only [Category.assoc]
  have e₁ : Epi (𝟙 (F.obj a.as) ◁ (F̃ a b).map (shiftIso f).hom) :=
    (inferInstance : Epi (whiskerLeftIso (R := R) _ ((F̃ a b).mapIso (shiftIso f))).hom)
  refine eq_of_conj_hom _ e₁ _ (nat (shiftIso f).hom) (leftUnitor_naturality R _) ?_
  rw [extendComp_id_J]
  have e : (F̃ a b).map (leftUnitor ((J R _).obj f.obj : a ⟶ b)).hom =
      F.map₂ (leftUnitor f.obj).hom := by
    show 𝟙 _ ≫ F.map₂ _ ≫ 𝟙 _ = _
    rw [Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id]; rfl
  rw [e]
  exact F.map₂_leftUnitor f.obj

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.extend_rightUnitor
statement:
theorem extend_rightUnitor (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (F̃ a b).obj f ◁ (F.mapId b.as).hom ≫ (extendComp F f (𝟙 b)).hom ≫
        (F̃ a b).map (rightUnitor f).hom = (rightUnitor ((F̃ a b).obj f)).hom
proof:
:= by
  have nat : ∀ {f f' : a ⟶ b} (u : f ⟶ f'), (F̃ a b).map u ▷ 𝟙 _ ≫
      ((F̃ a b).obj f' ◁ (F.mapId b.as).hom ≫ (extendComp F f' (𝟙 b)).hom ≫
        (F̃ a b).map (rightUnitor f').hom) =
      ((F̃ a b).obj f ◁ (F.mapId b.as).hom ≫ (extendComp F f (𝟙 b)).hom ≫
        (F̃ a b).map (rightUnitor f).hom) ≫ (F̃ a b).map u := by
    intro f f' u
    rw [reassoc_of% (interchange_even_right R ((F̃ a b).map u) (F.mapId_hom_mem b.as))]
    erw [reassoc_of% (extendComp_naturality_left F u (𝟙 b))]
    rw [← Functor.map_comp, rightUnitor_naturality R, Functor.map_comp]
    simp only [Category.assoc]
  have e₁ : Epi ((F̃ a b).map (shiftIso f).hom ▷ 𝟙 (F.obj b.as)) :=
    (inferInstance : Epi (whiskerRightIso (R := R) ((F̃ a b).mapIso (shiftIso f)) _).hom)
  refine eq_of_conj_hom _ e₁ _ (nat (shiftIso f).hom) (rightUnitor_naturality R _) ?_
  rw [extendComp_J_id]
  have e : (F̃ a b).map (rightUnitor ((J R _).obj f.obj : a ⟶ b)).hom =
      F.map₂ (rightUnitor f.obj).hom := by
    show 𝟙 _ ≫ F.map₂ _ ≫ 𝟙 _ = _
    rw [Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id]; rfl
  rw [e]
  exact F.map₂_rightUnitor f.obj

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.extend_obj
statement: @[simp] theorem extend_obj (a : TwoEnvelope R B) : (extend F).obj a = F.obj a.as

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.extend_map
statement: theorem extend_map (f : a ⟶ b) : (extend F).map f = (F̃ a b).obj f

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.extend_map₂
statement: theorem extend_map₂ {f g : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ g) : (extend F).map₂ η = (F̃ a b).map η

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.extend_map_J
statement:
theorem extend_map_J (f : a.as ⟶ b.as) :
    (extend F).map ((J R _).obj f : a ⟶ b) = F.map f

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.extend_map₂_J
statement:
theorem extend_map₂_J {f g : a.as ⟶ b.as} (η : f ⟶ g) :
    (extend F).map₂ ((J R (a.as ⟶ b.as)).map η : ((J R _).obj f : a ⟶ b) ⟶ (J R _).obj g) =
      F.map₂ η

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.extend_mapId
statement: theorem extend_mapId (a : TwoEnvelope R B) : (extend F).mapId a = F.mapId a.as

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.extendX_mem
statement:
theorem extendX_mem (θ : TwoNatTrans F G) (f : a ⟶ b) :
    extendX θ f ∈ parity (R := R) _ _ 0
proof:
:= by
  have := comp_mem (whiskerRight_mem (θ.X b.as) (ζF_hom_mem F f))
    (comp_mem (θ.x_mem f.obj) (whiskerLeft_mem (θ.X a.as) (ζF_inv_mem G f)))
  rwa [zero_add, zmod2_add_self] at this

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.extendX_naturality
statement:
theorem extendX_naturality (θ : TwoNatTrans F G) {f g : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ g) :
    (F̃ a b).map η ▷ θ.X b.as ≫ extendX θ g = extendX θ f ≫ θ.X a.as ◁ (G̃ a b).map η
proof:
:= by
  simp only [extendX, extendFunctor_map, comp_whiskerRight (R := R), whiskerLeft_comp (R := R),
    Category.assoc, inv_hom_whiskerRight'_assoc R, whiskerLeft_inv_hom'_assoc R]
  rw [reassoc_of% (θ.naturality (toHom η))]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.extendX_J
statement:
theorem extendX_J (θ : TwoNatTrans F G) (f : a.as ⟶ b.as) :
    extendX θ ((J R _).obj f : a ⟶ b) = θ.x f
proof:
:= by
  show 𝟙 (F.map f) ▷ θ.X b.as ≫ θ.x f ≫ θ.X a.as ◁ 𝟙 (G.map f) = _
  rw [id_whiskerRight (R := R), whiskerLeft_id (R := R), Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.extendX_J_comp
statement:
theorem extendX_J_comp (θ : TwoNatTrans F G) (f : a.as ⟶ b.as) (g : b.as ⟶ c.as) :
    extendX θ (((J R _).obj f : a ⟶ b) ≫ ((J R _).obj g : b ⟶ c)) = θ.x (f ≫ g)
proof:
:= by
  show 𝟙 (F.map (f ≫ g)) ▷ θ.X c.as ≫ θ.x (f ≫ g) ≫ θ.X a.as ◁ 𝟙 (G.map (f ≫ g)) = _
  rw [id_whiskerRight (R := R), whiskerLeft_id (R := R), Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.compL_nat₁
statement:
theorem compL_nat₁ {f f' : a ⟶ b} (u : f ⟶ f') (g : b ⟶ c) :
    ((F̃ a b).map u ▷ (F̃ b c).obj g) ▷ θ.X c.as ≫ compL θ f' g =
      compL θ f g ≫ θ.X a.as ◁ (G̃ a c).map (u ▷ g)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [compL]
  rw [comp_whiskerRight_comp R, extendComp_naturality_left, ← comp_whiskerRight_comp R,
    extendX_naturality]
  simp only [Category.assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.compR_nat₁
statement:
theorem compR_nat₁ {f f' : a ⟶ b} (u : f ⟶ f') (g : b ⟶ c) :
    ((F̃ a b).map u ▷ (F̃ b c).obj g) ▷ θ.X c.as ≫ compR θ f' g =
      compR θ f g ≫ θ.X a.as ◁ (G̃ a c).map (u ▷ g)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [compR]
  rw [associator_naturality_left_assoc R,
    reassoc_of% (interchange_even_right R ((F̃ a b).map u) (extendX_mem θ g)),
    associator_inv_naturality_left_assoc R, comp_whiskerRight_comp R, extendX_naturality,
    ← comp_whiskerRight_comp R, associator_naturality_middle_assoc R,
    ← whiskerLeft_comp (R := R), extendComp_naturality_left, whiskerLeft_comp (R := R)]
  simp only [Category.assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.compL_nat₂
statement:
theorem compL_nat₂ (f : a ⟶ b) {g g' : b ⟶ c} (v : g ⟶ g') :
    ((F̃ a b).obj f ◁ (F̃ b c).map v) ▷ θ.X c.as ≫ compL θ f g' =
      compL θ f g ≫ θ.X a.as ◁ (G̃ a c).map (f ◁ v)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [compL]
  rw [comp_whiskerRight_comp R, extendComp_naturality_right, ← comp_whiskerRight_comp R,
    extendX_naturality]
  simp only [Category.assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.compR_nat₂
statement:
theorem compR_nat₂ (f : a ⟶ b) {g g' : b ⟶ c} (v : g ⟶ g') :
    ((F̃ a b).obj f ◁ (F̃ b c).map v) ▷ θ.X c.as ≫ compR θ f g' =
      compR θ f g ≫ θ.X a.as ◁ (G̃ a c).map (f ◁ v)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [compR]
  rw [associator_naturality_middle_assoc R, whiskerLeft_comp_comp R, extendX_naturality,
    ← whiskerLeft_comp_comp R, associator_inv_naturality_right_assoc R,
    ← reassoc_of% (interchange_even_left R (extendX_mem θ f) ((G̃ b c).map v)),
    associator_naturality_right_assoc R, ← whiskerLeft_comp (R := R),
    extendComp_naturality_right, whiskerLeft_comp (R := R)]
  simp only [Category.assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.compL_eq_compR
statement: theorem compL_eq_compR (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) : compL θ f g = compR θ f g
proof:
:= by
  have e₁ : Epi (((F̃ a b).map (shiftIso f).hom ▷ (F̃ b c).obj g) ▷ θ.X c.as) :=
    (inferInstance : Epi (whiskerRightIso (R := R) (whiskerRightIso (R := R)
      ((F̃ a b).mapIso (shiftIso f)) _) _).hom)
  refine eq_of_conj_hom _ e₁ _ (compL_nat₁ θ (shiftIso f).hom g)
    (compR_nat₁ θ (shiftIso f).hom g) ?_
  have e₂ : Epi (((F̃ a b).obj ((J R _).obj f.obj) ◁ (F̃ b c).map (shiftIso g).hom) ▷
      θ.X c.as) :=
    (inferInstance : Epi (whiskerRightIso (R := R) (whiskerLeftIso (R := R) _
      ((F̃ b c).mapIso (shiftIso g))) _).hom)
  refine eq_of_conj_hom _ e₂ _ (compL_nat₂ θ _ (shiftIso g).hom)
    (compR_nat₂ θ _ (shiftIso g).hom) ?_
  simp only [compL, compR]
  rw [extendComp_J, extendComp_J, extendX_J, extendX_J, extendX_J_comp]
  exact θ.x_comp f.obj g.obj

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.extendTwoNatTrans_X
statement:
@[simp] theorem extendTwoNatTrans_X (θ : TwoNatTrans F G) (a : TwoEnvelope R B) :
    (extendTwoNatTrans θ).X a = θ.X a.as

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.extendTwoNatTrans_x

theorem extendTwoNatTrans_x (θ : TwoNatTrans F G) (f : a ⟶ b) :
