statement:
theorem extendTwoNatTrans_x_J (θ : TwoNatTrans F G) (f : a.as ⟶ b.as) :
    (extendTwoNatTrans θ).x ((J R _).obj f : a ⟶ b) = θ.x f

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.twoNatTrans_ext
statement:
theorem twoNatTrans_ext {F' G' : TwoSuperfunctor R B C} {θ θ' : TwoNatTrans F' G'}
    (hX : θ.X = θ'.X) (hx : ∀ {a b : B} (f : a ⟶ b), HEq (θ.x f) (θ'.x f)) : θ = θ'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨X, x, _, _, _, _⟩ := θ
  obtain ⟨X', x', _, _, _, _⟩ := θ'
  dsimp only at hX hx
  subst hX
  have : @x = @x' := by
    funext a b f
    exact eq_of_heq (hx f)
  subst this
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.restrictTwoNatTrans_X
statement:
@[simp] theorem restrictTwoNatTrans_X (ψ : TwoNatTrans (extend F) (extend G)) (a : B) :
    (restrictTwoNatTrans ψ).X a = ψ.X ⟨a⟩

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.restrictTwoNatTrans_x
statement:
theorem restrictTwoNatTrans_x (ψ : TwoNatTrans (extend F) (extend G)) {a b : B} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (restrictTwoNatTrans ψ).x f =
      ψ.x ((J R (a ⟶ b)).obj f : (⟨a⟩ : TwoEnvelope R B) ⟶ ⟨b⟩)

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.restrictTwoNatTrans_extendTwoNatTrans
statement:
theorem restrictTwoNatTrans_extendTwoNatTrans (θ : TwoNatTrans F G) :
    restrictTwoNatTrans (extendTwoNatTrans θ) = θ
proof:
:=
  twoNatTrans_ext rfl fun {a b} f =>
    heq_of_eq (extendX_J (a := (⟨a⟩ : TwoEnvelope R B)) (b := ⟨b⟩) θ f)

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.extendTwoNatTrans_restrictTwoNatTrans
statement:
theorem extendTwoNatTrans_restrictTwoNatTrans (ψ : TwoNatTrans (extend F) (extend G)) :
    extendTwoNatTrans (restrictTwoNatTrans ψ) = ψ
proof:
:= by
  refine twoNatTrans_ext rfl fun {a b} f => heq_of_eq ?_
  have h := ψ.naturality (shiftIso f).inv
  have e₁ : (extend F).map₂ (shiftIso f).inv = (ζF F f).hom := by
    show (ζF F f).hom ≫ F.map₂ (𝟙 f.obj) ≫ 𝟙 _ = _
    rw [F.map₂_id, Category.comp_id, Category.comp_id]
  have e₂ : (extend G).map₂ (shiftIso f).inv = (ζF G f).hom := by
    show (ζF G f).hom ≫ G.map₂ (𝟙 f.obj) ≫ 𝟙 _ = _
    rw [G.map₂_id, Category.comp_id, Category.comp_id]
  rw [e₁, e₂] at h
  show (ζF F f).hom ▷ ψ.X b ≫ ψ.x ((J R _).obj f.obj) ≫ ψ.X a ◁ (ζF G f).inv = ψ.x f
  rw [reassoc_of% h, whiskerLeft_hom_inv' R, Category.comp_id]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.extendTwoNatTrans_unique
statement:
theorem extendTwoNatTrans_unique (θ : TwoNatTrans F G) (ψ : TwoNatTrans (extend F) (extend G))
    (h : restrictTwoNatTrans ψ = θ) : ψ = extendTwoNatTrans θ

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.extend_naturality_of_mem
statement:
theorem extend_naturality_of_mem {θ θ' : TwoNatTrans F G} {p : ZMod 2}
    (α : ∀ a : B, θ.X a ⟶ θ'.X a) (hα : ∀ a, α a ∈ parity (R := R) _ _ p)
    (nat : ∀ {a b : B} (f : a ⟶ b), θ.x f ≫ α a ▷ G.map f = F.map f ◁ α b ≫ θ'.x f)
    {a b : TwoEnvelope R B} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (extendTwoNatTrans θ).x f ≫ α a.as ▷ (extend G).map f =
      (extend F).map f ◁ α b.as ≫ (extendTwoNatTrans θ').x f
proof:
:= by
  simp only [extendTwoNatTrans_x, extendX, extend_map, Category.assoc]
  have h₁ := super_interchange (R := R) (hα a.as) (ζF_inv_mem G f)
  have h₂ := super_interchange (R := R) (ζF_hom_mem F f) (hα b.as)
  rw [← koszulSign_smul_smul p f.par (θ.X a.as ◁ _ ≫ _), ← h₁, Linear.comp_smul,
    Linear.comp_smul, reassoc_of% (nat f.obj), ← Category.assoc ((ζF F f).hom ▷ _),
    h₂, Linear.smul_comp, smul_smul, koszulSign_comm, koszulSign_mul_self, one_smul]
  simp only [Category.assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.extend_naturality
statement:
theorem extend_naturality {θ θ' : TwoNatTrans F G} (α : θ ⟶ θ') {a b : TwoEnvelope R B}
    (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (extendTwoNatTrans θ).x f ≫ α.app a.as ▷ (extend G).map f =
      (extend F).map f ◁ α.app b.as ≫ (extendTwoNatTrans θ').x f
proof:
:= by
  have h := fun p => extend_naturality_of_mem (TwoNatTrans.projHom p α).app
    (fun a => proj_mem (R := R) p (α.app a)) (TwoNatTrans.projHom p α).naturality f
  have e : ∀ a : B, α.app a = (TwoNatTrans.projHom 0 α).app a + (TwoNatTrans.projHom 1 α).app a :=
    fun a => (proj_add_proj (R := R) (α.app a)).symm
  rw [e, e, add_whiskerRight (R := R), whiskerLeft_add (R := R), Preadditive.comp_add,
    Preadditive.add_comp, h 0, h 1]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.extendSupermodification_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem extendSupermodification_app {θ θ' : TwoNatTrans F G} (α : θ ⟶ θ')
    (a : TwoEnvelope R B) : (extendSupermodification α).app a = α.app a.as

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.eqToHom_mem
statement:
theorem eqToHom_mem {F' G' : TwoSuperfunctor R (TwoEnvelope R B) C} {θ θ' : TwoNatTrans F' G'}
    (h : θ = θ') : (eqToIso h).hom ∈ parity (R := R) θ θ' 0

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.extendHom_evenlyDense
statement: theorem extendHom_evenlyDense : EvenlyDense R (extendHom F G)
proof:
:= fun ψ =>
  ⟨restrictTwoNatTrans ψ, eqToIso (extendTwoNatTrans_restrictTwoNatTrans ψ),
    eqToHom_mem (extendTwoNatTrans_restrictTwoNatTrans ψ)⟩

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.Jm_eq
statement: theorem Jm_eq {a b : B} (f : a ⟶ b) : Jm (R := R) f = (J R (a ⟶ b)).obj f

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.J2_eq
statement: theorem J2_eq {a b : B} {f g : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ g) : J2 (R := R) η = (J R (a ⟶ b)).map η

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.J2_whiskerRight
statement:
theorem J2_whiskerRight {a b c : B} {f g : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ g) (h : b ⟶ c) :
    J2 (R := R) η ▷ Jm h = J2 (η ▷ h)

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.J2_whiskerLeft
statement:
theorem J2_whiskerLeft {a b c : B} (f : a ⟶ b) {g h : b ⟶ c} (η : g ⟶ h) :
    Jm (R := R) f ◁ J2 η = J2 (f ◁ η)

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.xcompL_nat₁
statement:
theorem xcompL_nat₁ {a b c : TwoEnvelope R B} {f f' : a ⟶ b} (u : f ⟶ f') (g : b ⟶ c) :
    (F'.map₂ u ▷ F'.map g) ▷ X c ≫ xcompL X x f' g = xcompL X x f g ≫ X a ◁ G'.map₂ (u ▷ g)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [xcompL]
  rw [comp_whiskerRight_comp R, F'.mapComp_naturality_left, ← comp_whiskerRight_comp R, nat]
  simp only [Category.assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.xcompR_nat₁
statement:
theorem xcompR_nat₁ {a b c : TwoEnvelope R B} {f f' : a ⟶ b} (u : f ⟶ f') (g : b ⟶ c) :
    (F'.map₂ u ▷ F'.map g) ▷ X c ≫ xcompR X x f' g = xcompR X x f g ≫ X a ◁ G'.map₂ (u ▷ g)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [xcompR]
  rw [associator_naturality_left_assoc R,
    reassoc_of% (interchange_even_right R (F'.map₂ u) (x_mem g)),
    associator_inv_naturality_left_assoc R, comp_whiskerRight_comp R, nat,
    ← comp_whiskerRight_comp R, associator_naturality_middle_assoc R,
    ← whiskerLeft_comp (R := R), G'.mapComp_naturality_left, whiskerLeft_comp (R := R)]
  simp only [Category.assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.xcompL_nat₂
statement:
theorem xcompL_nat₂ {a b c : TwoEnvelope R B} (f : a ⟶ b) {g g' : b ⟶ c} (v : g ⟶ g') :
    (F'.map f ◁ F'.map₂ v) ▷ X c ≫ xcompL X x f g' = xcompL X x f g ≫ X a ◁ G'.map₂ (f ◁ v)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [xcompL]
  rw [comp_whiskerRight_comp R, F'.mapComp_naturality_right, ← comp_whiskerRight_comp R, nat]
  simp only [Category.assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.xcompR_nat₂
statement:
theorem xcompR_nat₂ {a b c : TwoEnvelope R B} (f : a ⟶ b) {g g' : b ⟶ c} (v : g ⟶ g') :
    (F'.map f ◁ F'.map₂ v) ▷ X c ≫ xcompR X x f g' = xcompR X x f g ≫ X a ◁ G'.map₂ (f ◁ v)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [xcompR]
  rw [associator_naturality_middle_assoc R, whiskerLeft_comp_comp R, nat,
    ← whiskerLeft_comp_comp R, associator_inv_naturality_right_assoc R,
    ← reassoc_of% (interchange_even_left R (x_mem f) (G'.map₂ v)),
    associator_naturality_right_assoc R, ← whiskerLeft_comp (R := R),
    G'.mapComp_naturality_right, whiskerLeft_comp (R := R)]
  simp only [Category.assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.xcomp_of_J
statement:
theorem xcomp_of_J
    (h : ∀ {a b c : B} (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c), xcompL X x (Jm (R := R) f) (Jm g) =
      xcompR X x (Jm (R := R) f) (Jm g))
    {a b c : TwoEnvelope R B} (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) : xcompL X x f g = xcompR X x f g
proof:
:= by
  have e₁ : Epi ((F'.map₂ (shiftIso f).hom ▷ F'.map g) ▷ X c) :=
    (inferInstance : Epi (whiskerRightIso (R := R) (whiskerRightIso (R := R)
      (F'.map₂Iso (shiftIso f)) _) _).hom)
  refine eq_of_conj_hom _ e₁ _ (xcompL_nat₁ X x nat (shiftIso f).hom g)
    (xcompR_nat₁ X x x_mem nat (shiftIso f).hom g) ?_
  have e₂ : Epi ((F'.map ((J R _).obj f.obj) ◁ F'.map₂ (shiftIso g).hom) ▷ X c) :=
    (inferInstance : Epi (whiskerRightIso (R := R) (whiskerLeftIso (R := R) _
      (F'.map₂Iso (shiftIso g))) _).hom)
  refine eq_of_conj_hom _ e₂ _ (xcompL_nat₂ X x nat _ (shiftIso g).hom)
    (xcompR_nat₂ X x x_mem nat _ (shiftIso g).hom) ?_
  exact h f.obj g.obj

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.unit_coherence
statement:
theorem unit_coherence {a b c : C} (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) {h : a ⟶ c} (φ : f ≫ g ⟶ h) :
    φ ▷ 𝟙 c ≫ (rightUnitor h).hom ≫ (leftUnitor h).inv =
      (associator f g (𝟙 c)).hom ≫ f ◁ ((rightUnitor g).hom ≫ (leftUnitor g).inv) ≫
        (associator f (𝟙 b) g).inv ≫ ((rightUnitor f).hom ≫ (leftUnitor f).inv) ▷ g ≫
          (associator (𝟙 a) f g).hom ≫ 𝟙 a ◁ φ
proof:
:= by
  have tri : (associator f (𝟙 b) g).inv ≫ (rightUnitor f).hom ▷ g = f ◁ (leftUnitor g).hom := by
    rw [← TwoSupercategory.triangle (R := R), Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
  rw [rightUnitor_naturality_assoc R, leftUnitor_inv_naturality R, whiskerLeft_comp (R := R),
    comp_whiskerRight (R := R)]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [reassoc_of% tri, whiskerLeft_inv_hom'_assoc R, ← Category.assoc ((leftUnitor f).inv ▷ g),
    ← leftUnitor_comp_inv R f g, ← Category.assoc (associator f g (𝟙 c)).hom,
    ← rightUnitor_comp R f g]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.extendRestrict_obj
statement: theorem extendRestrict_obj (a : TwoEnvelope R B) : (extend (restrict T)).obj a = T.obj a

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.extendRestrictApp_mem
statement:
theorem extendRestrictApp_mem {a b : TwoEnvelope R B} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    extendRestrictApp T f ∈ parity (R := R) _ _ 0

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.extendRestrictApp_naturality
statement:
theorem extendRestrictApp_naturality {a b : TwoEnvelope R B} {f g : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ g) :
    (extend (restrict T)).map₂ η ≫ extendRestrictApp T g = extendRestrictApp T f ≫ T.map₂ η

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.extendRestrictApp_J
statement:
theorem extendRestrictApp_J {a b : TwoEnvelope R B} (f : a.as ⟶ b.as) :
    extendRestrictApp T ((J R (a.as ⟶ b.as)).obj f : a ⟶ b) = 𝟙 _
proof:
:=
  extendRestrictIso_hom_app_J (H := homFunctor T a b) f

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.extendRestrictX_mem
statement:
theorem extendRestrictX_mem {a b : TwoEnvelope R B} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    extendRestrictX T f ∈ parity (R := R) _ _ 0
proof:
:= by
  have := comp_mem (rightUnitor_hom_mem (R := R) _)
    (comp_mem (extendRestrictApp_mem T f) (inv_mem _ (leftUnitor_hom_mem (R := R) _)))
  simpa using! this

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.extendRestrictX_naturality
statement:
theorem extendRestrictX_naturality {a b : TwoEnvelope R B} {f g : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ g) :
    (extend (restrict T)).map₂ η ▷ 𝟙 (T.obj b) ≫ extendRestrictX T g =
      extendRestrictX T f ≫ 𝟙 (T.obj a) ◁ T.map₂ η
proof:
:= by
  simp only [extendRestrictX]
  rw [rightUnitor_naturality_assoc R, reassoc_of% (extendRestrictApp_naturality T η),
    leftUnitor_inv_naturality R]
  simp only [Category.assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.extendRestrictNatTrans_isStrong
statement: theorem extendRestrictNatTrans_isStrong : (extendRestrictNatTrans T).IsStrong
proof:
:= fun f => by
  show IsIso ((rightUnitor _).hom ≫ extendRestrictApp T f ≫ (leftUnitor _).inv)
  have : IsIso (extendRestrictApp T f) :=
    inferInstanceAs (IsIso ((extendRestrictIso (homFunctor T _ _)).app f).hom)
  infer_instance

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.extendRestrictAppInv_J
statement:
theorem extendRestrictAppInv_J {a b : TwoEnvelope R B} (f : a.as ⟶ b.as) :
    extendRestrictAppInv T ((J R (a.as ⟶ b.as)).obj f : a ⟶ b) = 𝟙 _
proof:
:=
  extendRestrictIso_inv_app_J (H := homFunctor T a b) f

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.extendRestrictInvX_mem
statement:
theorem extendRestrictInvX_mem {a b : TwoEnvelope R B} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    extendRestrictInvX T f ∈ parity (R := R) _ _ 0
proof:
:= by
  have := comp_mem (rightUnitor_hom_mem (R := R) _)
    (comp_mem (extendRestrictIso_inv_mem (H := homFunctor T a b) f)
      (inv_mem _ (leftUnitor_hom_mem (R := R) _)))
  simpa using! this

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.extendRestrictInvX_naturality
statement:
theorem extendRestrictInvX_naturality {a b : TwoEnvelope R B} {f g : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ g) :
    T.map₂ η ▷ 𝟙 (T.obj b) ≫ extendRestrictInvX T g =
      extendRestrictInvX T f ≫ 𝟙 (T.obj a) ◁ (extend (restrict T)).map₂ η
proof:
:= by
  simp only [extendRestrictInvX, extendRestrictAppInv]
  rw [rightUnitor_naturality_assoc R]
  erw [reassoc_of% ((extendRestrictIso (homFunctor T a b)).inv.naturality η)]
  erw [leftUnitor_inv_naturality R]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.extendRestrictNatTransInv_isStrong
statement: theorem extendRestrictNatTransInv_isStrong : (extendRestrictNatTransInv T).IsStrong
proof:
:= fun f => by
  show IsIso ((rightUnitor _).hom ≫ extendRestrictAppInv T f ≫ (leftUnitor _).inv)
  have : IsIso (extendRestrictAppInv T f) :=
    inferInstanceAs (IsIso ((extendRestrictIso (homFunctor T _ _)).app f).inv)
  infer_instance

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.extendRestrictX_comp_inv
statement:
theorem extendRestrictX_comp_inv {a b : TwoEnvelope R B} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    extendRestrictX T f ≫ (leftUnitor _).hom ≫ (rightUnitor _).inv ≫ extendRestrictInvX T f =
      (rightUnitor _).hom ≫ (leftUnitor _).inv
proof:
:= by
  simp only [extendRestrictX, extendRestrictInvX, extendRestrictApp, extendRestrictAppInv,
    Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
  rw [← NatTrans.comp_app_assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id, NatTrans.id_app, Category.id_comp]

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoSupercategory.ζ_ζ_eq_β_ξ
statement:
theorem ζ_ζ_eq_β_ξ {b c : C} (g : b ⟶ c) :
    (ζ (R := R) b).hom ▷ (g ≫ pi (R := R) c) ≫ (leftUnitor _).hom ≫ g ◁ (ζ (R := R) c).hom ≫
        (rightUnitor g).hom =
      (associator _ g _).inv ≫ (β (R := R) g).inv ▷ pi (R := R) c ≫ (associator g _ _).hom ≫
        g ◁ (ξ (R := R) c).hom ≫ (rightUnitor g).hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [β_inv, ξ_hom]
  simp only [comp_whiskerRight (R := R), whiskerLeft_comp (R := R), Category.assoc]
  rw [associator_naturality_middle_assoc R, TwoEnvelope.whiskerLeft_comp_comp R,
    TwoEnvelope.inv_hom_whiskerRight' R, whiskerLeft_id (R := R), Category.id_comp,
    reassoc_of% (TwoSupercategory.triangle (R := R) g (pi (R := R) c)),
    TwoEnvelope.inv_hom_whiskerRight'_assoc R, ← associator_inv_naturality_left_assoc R,
    ← leftUnitor_comp_assoc R]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.extendComp_one_one
statement:
theorem extendComp_one_one (F : TwoSuperfunctor R B C) {a b c : B} (f₀ : a ⟶ b)
    (g₀ : b ⟶ c) :
    letI : ∀ a b : C, PiSupercategory R (a ⟶ b) := fun a b => PiTwoSupercategory.homPiLeft a b
    (extendComp F (Pm (R := R) f₀) (Pm g₀)).hom =
      (associator (F.map f₀) (pi (R := R) (F.obj b)) (F.map g₀ ≫ pi (R := R) (F.obj c))).hom ≫
        F.map f₀ ◁ (associator (pi (R := R) (F.obj b)) (F.map g₀) (pi (R := R) (F.obj c))).inv ≫
        F.map f₀ ◁ ((β (R := R) (F.map g₀)).inv ▷ pi (R := R) (F.obj c)) ≫
        F.map f₀ ◁ (associator (F.map g₀) (pi (R := R) (F.obj c)) (pi (R := R) (F.obj c))).hom ≫
        (associator (F.map f₀) (F.map g₀) (pi (R := R) (F.obj c) ≫ pi (R := R) (F.obj c))).inv ≫
        (F.mapComp f₀ g₀).hom ▷ (pi (R := R) (F.obj c) ≫ pi (R := R) (F.obj c)) ≫
        F.map (f₀ ≫ g₀) ◁ (-(ξ (R := R) (F.obj c)).hom) ≫ (rightUnitor (F.map (f₀ ≫ g₀))).hom
proof:
:= by
  let : ∀ a b : C, PiSupercategory R (a ⟶ b) := fun a b => PiTwoSupercategory.homPiLeft a b
  show sign R (1 * 1) • ((F.map f₀ ◁ (PiTwoSupercategory.ζ (R := R) (F.obj b)).hom ≫ (rightUnitor (F.map f₀)).hom) ▷ (F.map g₀ ≫ pi (R := R) (F.obj c)) ≫
    F.map f₀ ◁ (F.map g₀ ◁ (PiTwoSupercategory.ζ (R := R) (F.obj c)).hom ≫ (rightUnitor (F.map g₀)).hom) ≫ (F.mapComp f₀ g₀).hom ≫ 𝟙 _) = _
  have key := ζ_ζ_eq_β_ξ (R := R) (F.map g₀)
  rw [mul_one, sign_one, neg_one_smul, Category.comp_id, 
    comp_whiskerRight (R := R), whisker_assoc (R := R),
    ← TwoSupercategory.triangle (R := R), whiskerLeft_neg R, Preadditive.neg_comp,
    Preadditive.comp_neg, Preadditive.comp_neg, Preadditive.comp_neg, Preadditive.comp_neg,
    Preadditive.comp_neg, Preadditive.comp_neg]
  congr 1
  have key' := congrArg (fun t => F.map f₀ ◁ t) key
  simp only [whiskerLeft_comp (R := R)] at key'
  simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc, whiskerLeft_comp (R := R)]
  rw [reassoc_of% key']
  rw [reassoc_of% (TwoEnvelope.interchange_even_left R (F.mapComp_hom_mem f₀ g₀) _),
    rightUnitor_naturality R, ← associator_inv_naturality_right_assoc R,
    ← whiskerLeft_rightUnitor_assoc R]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.extendComp_one_zero
statement:
theorem extendComp_one_zero (F : TwoSuperfunctor R B C) {a b c : B} (f₀ : a ⟶ b)
    (g₀ : b ⟶ c) :
    letI : ∀ a b : C, PiSupercategory R (a ⟶ b) := fun a b => PiTwoSupercategory.homPiLeft a b
    (extendComp F (Pm (R := R) f₀) (Jm g₀)).hom =
      (associator (F.map f₀) (pi (R := R) (F.obj b)) (F.map g₀)).hom ≫
        F.map f₀ ◁ (β (R := R) (F.map g₀)).inv ≫
        (associator (F.map f₀) (F.map g₀) (pi (R := R) (F.obj c))).inv ≫
        (F.mapComp f₀ g₀).hom ▷ pi (R := R) (F.obj c)
proof:
:= by
  let : ∀ a b : C, PiSupercategory R (a ⟶ b) := fun a b => PiTwoSupercategory.homPiLeft a b
  show sign R (1 * 0) • ((F.map f₀ ◁ (PiTwoSupercategory.ζ (R := R) (F.obj b)).hom ≫ (rightUnitor (F.map f₀)).hom) ▷ F.map g₀ ≫
    F.map f₀ ◁ 𝟙 (F.map g₀) ≫ (F.mapComp f₀ g₀).hom ≫ ((rightUnitor (F.map (f₀ ≫ g₀))).inv ≫ F.map (f₀ ≫ g₀) ◁ (PiTwoSupercategory.ζ (R := R) (F.obj c)).inv)) = _
  rw [mul_zero, sign_zero, one_smul, whiskerLeft_id (R := R), Category.id_comp,  comp_whiskerRight (R := R), whisker_assoc (R := R),
    ← TwoSupercategory.triangle (R := R), β_inv]
  simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc, whiskerLeft_comp (R := R)]
  congr 3
  rw [associator_inv_naturality_right_assoc R,
    ← TwoEnvelope.interchange_even_left R (F.mapComp_hom_mem f₀ g₀),
    rightUnitor_inv_naturality_assoc R, rightUnitor_comp_inv R, Category.assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.extendComp_zero_one
statement:
theorem extendComp_zero_one (F : TwoSuperfunctor R B C) {a b c : B} (f₀ : a ⟶ b)
    (g₀ : b ⟶ c) :
    letI : ∀ a b : C, PiSupercategory R (a ⟶ b) := fun a b => PiTwoSupercategory.homPiLeft a b
    (extendComp F (Jm (R := R) f₀) (Pm g₀)).hom =
      (associator (F.map f₀) (F.map g₀) (pi (R := R) (F.obj c))).inv ≫
        (F.mapComp f₀ g₀).hom ▷ pi (R := R) (F.obj c)
proof:
:= by
  let : ∀ a b : C, PiSupercategory R (a ⟶ b) := fun a b => PiTwoSupercategory.homPiLeft a b
  show sign R (0 * 1) • (𝟙 (F.map f₀) ▷ (F.map g₀ ≫ pi (R := R) (F.obj c)) ≫
    F.map f₀ ◁ (F.map g₀ ◁ (PiTwoSupercategory.ζ (R := R) (F.obj c)).hom ≫ (rightUnitor (F.map g₀)).hom) ≫ (F.mapComp f₀ g₀).hom ≫
      ((rightUnitor (F.map (f₀ ≫ g₀))).inv ≫ F.map (f₀ ≫ g₀) ◁ (PiTwoSupercategory.ζ (R := R) (F.obj c)).inv)) = _
  rw [zero_mul, sign_zero, one_smul, id_whiskerRight (R := R), Category.id_comp,  whiskerLeft_comp (R := R), whiskerLeft_rightUnitor R]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [associator_inv_naturality_right_assoc R, ← rightUnitor_naturality_assoc R,
    Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc,
    ← reassoc_of% (TwoEnvelope.interchange_even_left R (F.mapComp_hom_mem f₀ g₀) _),
    whiskerLeft_hom_inv' R, Category.comp_id]

name: StringDiagrams.Envelope.isInternal_shift
statement:
theorem isInternal_shift (X Y : C) (s : ZMod 2) :
    DirectSum.IsInternal fun p => parity (R := R) X Y (p + s)
proof:
:= by
  have h := (DirectSum.isInternal_submodule_iff_iSupIndep_and_iSup_eq_top _).1
    (isInternal (R := R) X Y)
  rw [DirectSum.isInternal_submodule_iff_iSupIndep_and_iSup_eq_top]
  exact ⟨h.1.comp (add_left_injective s), by
    rw [← h.2]; exact (Equiv.addRight s).iSup_comp (g := fun p => parity (R := R) X Y p)⟩

name: StringDiagrams.Envelope.mem_parity_iff
statement:
theorem mem_parity_iff {X Y : Envelope R C} {f : X ⟶ Y} {p : ZMod 2} :
    f ∈ parity (R := R) X Y p ↔ toHom f ∈ parity (R := R) X.obj Y.obj (p + (X.par + Y.par))

name: StringDiagrams.Envelope.ofHom_mem
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_parity_iff, toHom_ofHom, add_assoc, zmod2_add_self, add_zero]
  exact hf

name: StringDiagrams.Envelope.toHom_proj
statement:
theorem toHom_proj (p : ZMod 2) {X Y : Envelope R C} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    toHom (proj R p f) = proj R (p + (X.par + Y.par)) (toHom f)
proof:
:= by
  set s := X.par + Y.par
  let g : X ⟶ Y := ofHom (proj R (p + s) (toHom f))
  let h : X ⟶ Y := ofHom (proj R (p + s + 1) (toHom f))
  have e : f = g + h := (proj_add_proj_add_one (R := R) (p + s) (toHom f)).symm
  have hg : g ∈ parity (R := R) X Y p := proj_mem (R := R) (p + s) (toHom f)
  have hh : h ∈ parity (R := R) X Y (p + 1) := by
    show proj R (p + s + 1) (toHom f) ∈ parity (R := R) X.obj Y.obj (p + 1 + s)
    rw [add_right_comm]; exact proj_mem _ _
  rw [proj_eq_of_add e hg hh]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.Envelope.toHom_twist
statement:
theorem toHom_twist (p : ZMod 2) {X Y : Envelope R C} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    toHom (twist R p f) = sign R (p * (X.par + Y.par)) • twist R p (toHom f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [twist_apply, twist_apply, toHom_add, toHom_smul, toHom_proj, toHom_proj]
  rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one (X.par + Y.par) with h | h <;> rw [h]
  · simp
  · rw [show (0 : ZMod 2) + 1 = 1 from rfl, show (1 : ZMod 2) + 1 = 0 from rfl, mul_one,
      smul_add, sign_smul_sign_smul, add_comm]

name: StringDiagrams.Envelope.ζIso_mem
statement:
theorem ζIso_mem (X : Envelope R C) :
    (ζIso X).hom ∈ parity (R := R) (⟨X.par + 1, X.obj⟩ : Envelope R C) X 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_parity_iff]
  show 𝟙 X.obj ∈ parity (R := R) X.obj X.obj (1 + (X.par + 1 + X.par))
  rw [show (1 : ZMod 2) + (X.par + 1 + X.par) = (1 + 1) + (X.par + X.par) by ring,
    zmod2_add_self, zmod2_add_self, add_zero]
  exact id_mem X.obj

theorem toHom_pi_map {X Y : Envelope R C} (f : X ⟶ Y) :

      sign R (X.par + Y.par) • twist R 1 (toHom f)
proof:
:= by
  show toHom (ζIso X).hom ≫ toHom (twist R 1 f) ≫ toHom (ζIso Y).inv = _
  rw [toHom_twist, one_mul]
  simp [ζIso]

proof:

name: StringDiagrams.Envelope.J_evenlyDense_iff
statement: theorem J_evenlyDense_iff : EvenlyDense R (J R C) ↔ PiComplete R C
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h X
    obtain ⟨Y, e, he⟩ := h ⟨1, X⟩
    refine ⟨Y, isoToIso e, ?_⟩
    rw [mem_parity_iff] at he
    exact he
  · intro h X
    obtain ⟨a, X⟩ := X
    rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one a with rfl | rfl
    · exact ⟨X, Iso.refl _, id_mem _⟩
    · obtain ⟨Y, e, he⟩ := h X
      refine ⟨Y, isoOfIso e, ?_⟩
      rw [mem_parity_iff]
      exact he

statement: theorem extend_map_J_map {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) : (extend R F).map ((J R C).map f) = F.map f
proof:
:=
  show (ζPow R 0 (F.obj X)).hom ≫ F.map f ≫ (ζPow R 0 (F.obj Y)).inv = F.map f by simp

name: StringDiagrams.Envelope.J_comp_extend
statement: theorem J_comp_extend : J R C ⋙ extend R F = F
proof:
:=
  CategoryTheory.Functor.ext (fun _ => rfl) (fun X Y f => by
    simp only [Functor.comp_map, eqToHom_refl, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]
    exact extend_map_J_map R F f)

name: StringDiagrams.Envelope.isSupernatural_extendNat
statement:
theorem isSupernatural_extendNat {p : ZMod 2} {x : ∀ X, F.obj X ⟶ G.obj X}
    (hx : IsSupernatural R p x) :
    IsSupernatural R p (F := extend R F) (G := extend R G) (extendNat R F G p x) where
  mem X
proof:
:= by
    have := comp_mem (comp_mem (ζPow_hom_mem X.par (F.obj X.obj)) (hx.mem X.obj))
      (ζPow_inv_mem X.par (G.obj X.obj))
    rw [show X.par + p + X.par = p by
      rw [add_right_comm, zmod2_add_self, zero_add], Category.assoc] at this
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ this
  naturality {X Y q f} hf := by
    rw [mem_parity_iff] at hf
    simp only [extend_map, extendNat, Linear.comp_smul, Linear.smul_comp,
      Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc, smul_smul]
    rw [reassoc_of% (hx.naturality hf), Linear.smul_comp, Linear.comp_smul, smul_smul,
      ← sign_add, ← sign_add]
    rw [show Y.par * p + p * (q + (X.par + Y.par)) = p * q + X.par * p + (Y.par * p + Y.par * p)
      by ring, zmod2_add_self, add_zero]
    simp only [Category.assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.Envelope.extendNat_zero_par
statement:
@[simp] theorem extendNat_zero_par (p : ZMod 2) (x : ∀ X, F.obj X ⟶ G.obj X) (X : C) :
    extendNat R F G p x ((J R C).obj X) = x X
proof:
:= by
  show sign R (0 * p) • ((ζPow R 0 (F.obj X)).hom ≫ x X ≫ (ζPow R 0 (G.obj X)).inv) = x X
  simp

name: StringDiagrams.Envelope.eq_of_restrict_eq
statement:
theorem eq_of_restrict_eq {H K : Envelope R C ⥤ B} [H.Additive] [H.Linear R] [IsSuperfunctor R H]
    [K.Additive] [K.Linear R] [IsSuperfunctor R K] {p : ZMod 2}
    {y y' : ∀ X, H.obj X ⟶ K.obj X} (hy : IsSupernatural R p y) (hy' : IsSupernatural R p y')
    (h : ∀ X : C, y ((J R C).obj X) = y' ((J R C).obj X)) : y = y'
proof:
:= by
  funext X
  obtain ⟨a, X⟩ := X
  rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one a with rfl | rfl
  · exact h X
  · have hu := ζIso_mem (R := R) (⟨0, X⟩ : Envelope R C)
    have e1 := hy.naturality hu
    have e2 := hy'.naturality hu
    have h0 : y ⟨0, X⟩ = y' ⟨0, X⟩ := h X
    change H.map _ ≫ y ⟨0, X⟩ = sign R (p * 1) • (y ⟨1, X⟩ ≫ K.map _) at e1
    change H.map _ ≫ y' ⟨0, X⟩ = sign R (p * 1) • (y' ⟨1, X⟩ ≫ K.map _) at e2
    rw [h0, e2] at e1
    have e3 := congrArg (fun t => sign R (p * 1) • t) e1
    simp only [sign_smul_sign_smul] at e3
    exact ((cancel_mono _).1 e3).symm

name: StringDiagrams.Envelope.eq_extendNat
statement:
theorem eq_extendNat {p : ZMod 2} {x : ∀ X, F.obj X ⟶ G.obj X} (hx : IsSupernatural R p x)
    {y : ∀ X, (extend R F).obj X ⟶ (extend R G).obj X}
    (hy : IsSupernatural R p (F := extend R F) (G := extend R G) y)
    (h : ∀ X : C, y ((J R C).obj X) = x X) : y = extendNat R F G p x
proof:
:=
  eq_of_restrict_eq hy (isSupernatural_extendNat hx) fun X => by rw [h, extendNat_zero_par]

name: StringDiagrams.Envelope.restrict_bijective
statement:
theorem restrict_bijective (p : ZMod 2) :
    Function.Bijective (fun y : {y : ∀ X, (extend R F).obj X ⟶ (extend R G).obj X //
        IsSupernatural R p (F := extend R F) (G := extend R G) y} =>
      (⟨fun X => y.1 ((J R C).obj X), ⟨fun X => y.2.mem ((J R C).obj X), fun {X Y q f} hf => by
        have h := y.2.naturality (map_mem (J R C) hf)
        rw [extend_map_J_map, extend_map_J_map] at h
        exact h⟩⟩ :
        {x : ∀ X, F.obj X ⟶ G.obj X // IsSupernatural R p x}))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro y y' hyy
    exact Subtype.ext (eq_of_restrict_eq y.2 y'.2 fun X => congrFun (congrArg Subtype.val hyy) X)
  · intro x
    exact ⟨⟨extendNat R F G p x.1, isSupernatural_extendNat x.2⟩,
      Subtype.ext (funext fun X => extendNat_zero_par p x.1 X)⟩

name: StringDiagrams.Envelope.extendNat_id
statement:
theorem extendNat_id :
    extendNat R F F 0 (fun X => 𝟙 (F.obj X)) = fun X => 𝟙 ((extend R F).obj X)
proof:
:=
  (eq_of_restrict_eq (isSupernatural_extendNat isSupernatural_id) isSupernatural_id
    fun X => by simp; rfl).trans rfl

name: StringDiagrams.Envelope.extendNat_comp
statement:
theorem extendNat_comp {H : C ⥤ B} [H.Additive] [H.Linear R] [IsSuperfunctor R H]
    {p q : ZMod 2} {x : ∀ X, F.obj X ⟶ G.obj X} {y : ∀ X, G.obj X ⟶ H.obj X}
    (hx : IsSupernatural R p x) (hy : IsSupernatural R q y) :
    extendNat R F H (p + q) (fun X => x X ≫ y X) =
      fun X => extendNat R F G p x X ≫ extendNat R G H q y X
proof:
:=
  (eq_of_restrict_eq (isSupernatural_extendNat (hx.comp hy))
    ((isSupernatural_extendNat hx).comp (isSupernatural_extendNat hy))
    fun X => by simp).trans rfl

name: StringDiagrams.Envelope.extendNat_add
statement:
theorem extendNat_add {p : ZMod 2} (x y : ∀ X, F.obj X ⟶ G.obj X) :
    extendNat R F G p (x + y) = extendNat R F G p x + extendNat R F G p y
proof:
:= by
  funext X; simp [extendNat, Preadditive.add_comp, Preadditive.comp_add, smul_add]

name: StringDiagrams.Envelope.extendNat_smul
statement:
theorem extendNat_smul {p : ZMod 2} (r : R) (x : ∀ X, F.obj X ⟶ G.obj X) :
    extendNat R F G p (r • x) = r • extendNat R F G p x
proof:
:= by
  funext X; simp [extendNat, smul_comm r]

name: StringDiagrams.Envelope.extendRestrictIso_hom_mem
statement:
theorem extendRestrictIso_hom_mem (H : Envelope R C ⥤ B) [H.Additive] [H.Linear R]
    [IsSuperfunctor R H] (X : Envelope R C) :
    (extendRestrictIso H).hom.app X ∈
      parity (R := R) ((extend R (J R C ⋙ H)).obj X) (H.obj X) 0
proof:
:= by
  have := comp_mem (ζPow_hom_mem X.par (H.obj ((J R C).obj X.obj)))
    (map_mem H (shiftIso_hom_mem (R := R) X))
  rw [zmod2_add_self] at this
  exact this

name: StringDiagrams.SOp.unsop_proj
statement:
theorem unsop_proj (p : ZMod 2) {X Y : SOp R C} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    unsop (proj R p f) = proj R p (unsop f)
proof:
:= by
  refine Supercategory.induction_on (R := R) f ?_ (fun q g hg => ?_) ?_
  · simp
  · by_cases h : q = p
    · subst h
      rw [proj_of_mem hg, proj_of_mem (mem_parity_iff.mp hg)]
    · rw [proj_of_mem_ne hg h, unsop_zero, proj_of_mem_ne (mem_parity_iff.mp hg) h]
  · intro g h hg hh
    rw [map_add, unsop_add, unsop_add, map_add, hg, hh]

name: StringDiagrams.LaurentBasis.parity_shift_rigid
statement: theorem parity_shift_rigid (i : ι) (n : ℤ) (h : σ i = n +ᵥ i) : n = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hn : (n + n) +ᵥ i = i := by
    rw [add_vadd, ← h, ← hc, ← h, hσ]
  have := hf i (n + n) hn
  omega

name: StringDiagrams.LaurentBasis.orbitParity_involutive
statement: theorem orbitParity_involutive : Function.Involutive (orbitParity σ hc)
proof:
:= by
  intro o
  induction o using Quotient.inductionOn with
  | h i => change Quotient.mk _ (σ (σ i)) = Quotient.mk _ i; rw [hσ]

name: StringDiagrams.LaurentBasis.orbitParity_fixed_iff
statement:
theorem orbitParity_fixed_iff (i : ι) :
    orbitParity σ hc (Quotient.mk _ i) = Quotient.mk _ i ↔ σ i = i
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := Quotient.exact h
    have hz := parity_shift_rigid σ hσ hc hf i n hn.symm
    simpa only [hz, zero_vadd] using hn.symm
  · intro h
    change Quotient.mk _ (σ i) = Quotient.mk _ i
    rw [h]

name: StringDiagrams.LaurentBasis.paritySection_spec
statement:
theorem paritySection_spec (o : Orbit (ι := ι)) :
    Quotient.mk (AddAction.orbitRel ℤ ι) (paritySection σ hc o) = o
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold paritySection
  split_ifs
  · change orbitParity σ hc (Quotient.mk _ (orbitParity σ hc o).out) = o
    rw [Quotient.out_eq, orbitParity_involutive σ hσ hc]
  · exact Quotient.out_eq o

name: StringDiagrams.LaurentBasis.paritySection_parity
statement:
theorem paritySection_parity (o : Orbit (ι := ι)) :
    paritySection σ hc (orbitParity σ hc o) = σ (paritySection σ hc o)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hs := orbitParity_involutive σ hσ hc
  rcases lt_trichotomy o (orbitParity σ hc o) with h | h | h
  · simp only [paritySection, hs o]
    rw [ite_eq_left h, ite_eq_right (not_lt_of_gt h)]
  · have hfix : σ o.out = o.out := by
      apply (orbitParity_fixed_iff σ hσ hc hf o.out).1
      rw [Quotient.out_eq, ← h]
    simp only [paritySection, ← h, lt_self_iff_false, ↓reduceIte, hfix]
  · simp only [paritySection, hs o]
    rw [ite_eq_right (not_lt_of_gt h), ite_eq_left h, hσ]

name: StringDiagrams.LaurentBasis.ofSection_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem ofSection_apply (b : Basis ι ℤ M)
    (hb : ∀ n i, (T n : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) • b i = b (n +ᵥ i))
    (r : Orbit (ι := ι) → ι)
    (hr : ∀ o, Quotient.mk (AddAction.orbitRel ℤ ι) (r o) = o)
    (o : Orbit (ι := ι)) : ofSection hf b hb r hr o = b (r o)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ofSection, ofProduct_apply]
  simp only [Basis.reindex_apply, Equiv.symm_symm]
  change b ((0 : ℤ) +ᵥ r o) = b (r o)
  rw [zero_vadd]

name: StringDiagrams.LaurentBasis.parityCompatibleBasis_parity
statement:
theorem parityCompatibleBasis_parity (b : Basis ι ℤ M)
    (hb : ∀ n i, (T n : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) • b i = b (n +ᵥ i))
    (p : M → M) (hp : ∀ i, p (b i) = b (σ i)) (o : Orbit (ι := ι)) :
    p (parityCompatibleBasis σ hσ hc hf b hb o) =
      parityCompatibleBasis σ hσ hc hf b hb (orbitParity σ hc o)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [parityCompatibleBasis, ofSection_apply, hp,
    paritySection_parity σ hσ hc hf]

name: StringDiagrams.Mat_.mapMat_diag
statement:
theorem mapMat_diag {D : Type*} [Category D] [Preadditive D] (F : C ⥤ D) [F.Additive]
    {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] {X Y : ι → C} (φ : ∀ i, X i ⟶ Y i) :
    F.mapMat_.map (diag (X := X) (Y := Y) φ) = diag (X := fun i => F.obj (X i))
      (Y := fun i => F.obj (Y i)) (fun i => F.map (φ i))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext i j
  by_cases h : i = j
  · subst h; simp [diag_apply_self]
  · simp only [Functor.mapMat__map]
    rw [diag_apply_of_ne _ h, diag_apply_of_ne _ h, F.map_zero]

name: StringDiagrams.Mat_.diag_congr

name: StringDiagrams.Mat_.mapMatIso_hom_app

    (mapMatIso α).inv.app M = diag (X := fun i => G.obj (M.X i)) (Y := fun i => F.obj (M.X i))

name: StringDiagrams.Mat_.ξ_hom_app_eq

name: StringDiagrams.K₀.qEnd_mul_qinvEnd
statement: theorem qEnd_mul_qinvEnd : qEnd R A * qinvEnd R A = 1
proof:

  rw [← map_comp, map_eq_of_iso (QPiCategory.jj (R := R) (C := A)), map_id]

name: StringDiagrams.K₀.piInvolution_commute
statement:
theorem piInvolution_commute :
    Commute (show AddMonoid.End (K₀ A) from piInvolution R A) (qEnd R A)
proof:
:= by
  show (map _).comp (map _) = (map _).comp (map _)
  rw [← map_comp, ← map_comp, map_eq_of_iso (QPiCategory.Q_pi (R := R) (C := A)).β]

name: StringDiagrams.K₀.toEnd_commute
statement:
theorem toEnd_commute (r : Zπ) :
    Commute (Zπ.toEnd (piInvolution R A) (piInvolution_piInvolution R A) r) (qEnd R A)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective r
  show Commute (Polynomial.eval₂ (Int.castRingHom _)
    (show AddMonoid.End (K₀ A) from piInvolution R A) p) _
  induction p using Polynomial.induction_on' with
  | add p q hp hq => rw [Polynomial.eval₂_add]; exact hp.add_left hq
  | monomial n a =>
    rw [Polynomial.eval₂_monomial]
    exact (Int.cast_commute a _).mul_left ((piInvolution_commute R A).pow_left n)

theorem C_π_smul_mk (V : A) :
    letI := moduleLaurent R A
    (C Zπ.π : LaurentPolynomial Zπ) • mk V = mk ((PiCategory.pi (R := R)).obj V)
proof:
:= by
  show laurentEnd R A (C Zπ.π) (mk V) = _
  rw [laurentEnd_C, Zπ.toEnd_π, piInvolution_mk]

name: StringDiagrams.K₀.T_smul_mk
statement:

proof:

name: StringDiagrams.K₀.T_neg_one_smul_mk

theorem T_neg_one_smul_mk (V : A) :

proof:

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.comp_assoc
statement:
theorem comp_assoc (F : TwoSuperfunctor R B C) (G : TwoSuperfunctor R C D)
    (H : TwoSuperfunctor R D E) : (F.comp G).comp H = F.comp (G.comp H)
proof:
:= by
  refine TwoEnvelope.twoSuperfunctor_ext rfl HEq.rfl HEq.rfl (heq_of_eq ?_) (heq_of_eq ?_)
  · funext a b c f g
    apply Iso.ext
    simp only [comp_mapComp, Iso.trans_hom, map₂Iso_hom, comp_map₂,
      map₂_comp, Category.assoc]
    rfl
  · funext a
    apply Iso.ext
    simp only [comp_mapId, Iso.trans_hom, map₂Iso_hom, comp_map₂,
      map₂_comp, Category.assoc]
    rfl

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.id_comp
statement: theorem id_comp (F : TwoSuperfunctor R B C) : (TwoSuperfunctor.id R B).comp F = F
proof:
:= by

  · funext a b c f g
    apply Iso.ext
    simp only [comp_mapComp, Iso.trans_hom, map₂Iso_hom, Iso.refl_hom, map₂_id,
      Category.comp_id]
  · funext a

    simp only [comp_mapId, Iso.trans_hom, map₂Iso_hom, Iso.refl_hom, map₂_id,

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.comp_id

proof:
:= by
  refine TwoEnvelope.twoSuperfunctor_ext rfl HEq.rfl HEq.rfl (heq_of_eq ?_) (heq_of_eq ?_)
  · funext a b c f g
    apply Iso.ext
    simp only [comp_mapComp, Iso.trans_hom, map₂Iso_hom, Iso.refl_hom]
    exact Category.id_comp _
  · funext a

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.pasteComparison_hom_isHomogeneous
statement:
theorem pasteComparison_hom_isHomogeneous (a : TwoNatTrans S E) (b : TwoNatTrans E T)
    (c : TwoNatTrans T E) (d : TwoNatTrans E U)
    (e : vcomp b c ≅ id E) (he : e.hom.IsHomogeneous 0 0) :
    (pasteComparison a b c d e).hom.IsHomogeneous 0 0
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  constructor
  · simpa only [zero_add] using! comp_mem
      (associator_hom_mem (R := R) (a.X x) (b.X x) ((vcomp c d).X x))
      (comp_mem (whiskerLeft_mem (a.X x)
        (inv_mem _ (associator_hom_mem (R := R) (b.X x) (c.X x) (d.X x))))
        (comp_mem (whiskerLeft_mem (a.X x) (whiskerRight_mem (d.X x) (he x).1))
          (whiskerLeft_mem (a.X x) (leftUnitor_hom_mem (R := R) (d.X x)))))
  · simpa only [zero_add] using! comp_mem_degree
      (GradedTwoSupercategory.associator_hom_mem_degree (R := R)
        (a.X x) (b.X x) ((vcomp c d).X x))
      (comp_mem_degree (GradedTwoSupercategory.whiskerLeft_mem_degree (a.X x)
        (GradedTwoSupercategory.associator_inv_mem_degree (R := R) (b.X x) (c.X x) (d.X x)))
        (comp_mem_degree (GradedTwoSupercategory.whiskerLeft_mem_degree (a.X x)
          (GradedTwoSupercategory.whiskerRight_mem_degree (d.X x) (he x).2))
          (GradedTwoSupercategory.whiskerLeft_mem_degree (a.X x)
            (GradedTwoSupercategory.leftUnitor_hom_mem_degree (R := R) (d.X x)))))

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.pasteComparisonTransport_hom_isHomogeneous
statement:
theorem pasteComparisonTransport_hom_isHomogeneous (h : E' = E) (k : E'' = E')
    (a : TwoNatTrans S E) (b : TwoNatTrans E' T)
    (c : TwoNatTrans T E') (d : TwoNatTrans E'' U)
    (e : vcomp b c ≅ id E') (he : e.hom.IsHomogeneous 0 0) :
    (pasteComparisonTransport h k a b c d e).hom.IsHomogeneous 0 0
proof:
:= by
  cases h
  cases k
  exact pasteComparison_hom_isHomogeneous a b c d e he

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.transportIso_hom_isHomogeneous
proof:
:= by
  cases h
  cases k
  intro x
  simpa only [transportIso, Iso.trans_hom, eqToIso_refl, Iso.refl_hom,
    TwoNatTrans.comp_app, TwoNatTrans.id_app, Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id] using he x

    (comparisonCompIso S T U hS hT hU h k).hom.IsHomogeneous 0 0
proof:
:= by
  let : ∀ a b : C, QPiSupercategory R (a ⟶ b) :=
    fun a b => QPiTwoSupercategory.homQPiLeft a b
  exact TwoNatTrans.pasteComparisonTransport_hom_isHomogeneous _ _ _ _ _ _ _
    (extendRestrictCounitIso_hom_isHomogeneous T hT)

proof:
:=
  TwoNatTrans.iso_inv_isHomogeneous _
    (comparisonCompIso_hom_isHomogeneous S T U hS hT hU h k)

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.counitNaturality_id_source

theorem counitNaturality_id_source (B : QPiTwoGSCat.{w, w₁, v₁, u₁} R) :

statement:

    (counitNaturalityIdCompIso B).hom.IsHomogeneous 0 0

:=
  TwoNatTrans.transportIso_hom_isHomogeneous _ _ _
    (comparisonCompIso_hom_isHomogeneous (B := B.toGTwoSCat)
      (counit B) (counit B) (counit B)
      (counit_isGraded B) (counit_isGraded B) (counit_isGraded B) rfl rfl)

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.counitNaturalityIdCompIso_inv_isHomogeneous
statement:
theorem counitNaturalityIdCompIso_inv_isHomogeneous (B : QPiTwoGSCat.{w, w₁, v₁, u₁} R) :
    (counitNaturalityIdCompIso B).inv.IsHomogeneous 0 0

name: StringDiagrams.PiSupercategory.ofIsoFunctor_preservesParity
statement:
theorem ofIsoFunctor_preservesParity (he : ∀ X, (e X).hom ∈ parity (R := R) (obj X) X 1) :
    IsSuperfunctor R (ofIsoFunctor (R := R) obj e) where
  map_mem {X Y p f} hf
proof:
:= by
    have := comp_mem (comp_mem (he X) (twist_mem 1 hf)) (inv_mem _ (he Y))
    rw [show (1 : ZMod 2) + p + 1 = p by rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one p with rfl | rfl <;> rfl,
      Category.assoc] at this
    exact this

name: StringDiagrams.PiSupercategory.ζ_hom_mem
statement:
theorem ζ_hom_mem (X : C) :
    (ζ (R := R) X).hom ∈ parity (R := R) ((pi (R := R)).obj X) X 1

name: StringDiagrams.PiSupercategory.ζ_inv_mem
statement:
theorem ζ_inv_mem (X : C) :
    (ζ (R := R) X).inv ∈ parity (R := R) X ((pi (R := R)).obj X) 1

name: StringDiagrams.PiSupercategory.ζ_naturality
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem ζ_naturality {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    (pi (R := R)).map f ≫ (ζ (R := R) Y).hom = (ζ (R := R) X).hom ≫ twist R 1 f

name: StringDiagrams.PiSupercategory.ζ_naturality_of_mem
StringDiagrams.PiSupercategory.pi_map_eq
statement:
theorem pi_map_eq {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    (pi (R := R)).map f = (ζ (R := R) X).hom ≫ twist R 1 f ≫ (ζ (R := R) Y).inv

name: StringDiagrams.PiSupercategory.pi_map_ζ
statement:
theorem pi_map_ζ (X : C) :
    (pi (R := R)).map (ζ (R := R) X).hom = -(ζ (R := R) ((pi (R := R)).obj X)).hom
proof:
:= by
  have h := ζ_naturality_of_mem (R := R) (ζ_hom_mem (R := R) X)
  rw [sign_one, neg_smul, one_smul, ← Preadditive.neg_comp] at h
  exact (cancel_mono _).1 h

name: StringDiagrams.PiSupercategory.ξ_hom
statement:
theorem ξ_hom (X : C) :
    (ξ (R := R) X).hom = (pi (R := R)).map (ζ (R := R) X).hom ≫ (ζ (R := R) X).hom

name: StringDiagrams.PiSupercategory.ξ_hom_eq_neg
statement:
theorem ξ_hom_eq_neg (X : C) :
    (ξ (R := R) X).hom = -((ζ (R := R) ((pi (R := R)).obj X)).hom ≫ (ζ (R := R) X).hom)

name: StringDiagrams.PiSupercategory.ξ_inv_eq_neg
statement:
theorem ξ_inv_eq_neg (X : C) :
    (ξ (R := R) X).inv = -((ζ (R := R) X).inv ≫ (ζ (R := R) ((pi (R := R)).obj X)).inv)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cancel_mono (ξ (R := R) X).hom, Iso.inv_hom_id, ξ_hom_eq_neg]
  simp

name: StringDiagrams.PiSupercategory.ξ_hom_mem
statement:
theorem ξ_hom_mem (X : C) :
    (ξ (R := R) X).hom ∈ parity (R := R) ((pi (R := R)).obj ((pi (R := R)).obj X)) X 0
proof:
:= by
  have := comp_mem (map_mem (R := R) (pi (R := R)) (ζ_hom_mem (R := R) X))
    (ζ_hom_mem (R := R) X)
  exact this

name: StringDiagrams.PiSupercategory.ξ_naturality
statement:
theorem ξ_naturality {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    (pi (R := R)).map ((pi (R := R)).map f) ≫ (ξ (R := R) Y).hom = (ξ (R := R) X).hom ≫ f
proof:
:= by
  rw [ξ_hom, ξ_hom, ← Functor.map_comp_assoc, ζ_naturality (R := R) f, Functor.map_comp,
    Category.assoc, ζ_naturality (R := R) (twist R 1 f), twist_twist, Category.assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.PiSupercategory.ξ_pi
statement:
theorem ξ_pi (X : C) :
    (ξ (R := R) ((pi (R := R)).obj X)).hom = (pi (R := R)).map (ξ (R := R) X).hom
proof:
:= by
  have h : (ζ (R := R) ((pi (R := R)).obj X)).hom = -(pi (R := R)).map (ζ (R := R) X).hom := by
    rw [pi_map_ζ, neg_neg]
  rw [ξ_hom, ξ_hom, h, Functor.map_neg, Preadditive.neg_comp, Preadditive.comp_neg, neg_neg,
    Functor.map_comp]

name: StringDiagrams.PiSupercategory.ξIso_hom_app
statement: @[simp] theorem ξIso_hom_app (X : C) : (ξIso (R := R) (C := C)).hom.app X = (ξ (R := R) X).hom

name: StringDiagrams.PiSupercategory.ξIso_inv_app
statement: @[simp] theorem ξIso_inv_app (X : C) : (ξIso (R := R) (C := C)).inv.app X = (ξ (R := R) X).inv

name: StringDiagrams.PiSupercategory.β_hom
statement:
theorem β_hom (F : C ⥤ D) (X : C) :
    (β R F X).hom = (ζ (R := R) (F.obj X)).hom ≫ F.map (ζ (R := R) X).inv

name: StringDiagrams.PiSupercategory.β_inv
statement:
theorem β_inv (F : C ⥤ D) (X : C) :
    (β R F X).inv = F.map (ζ (R := R) X).hom ≫ (ζ (R := R) (F.obj X)).inv

name: StringDiagrams.PiSupercategory.β_hom_eq_neg
statement:
theorem β_hom_eq_neg [F.Additive] [F.Linear R] [IsSuperfunctor R F] (X : C) :
    (β R F X).hom = -((pi (R := R)).map (F.map (ζ (R := R) X).inv) ≫
      (ζ (R := R) (F.obj ((pi (R := R)).obj X))).hom)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ζ_naturality_of_mem (map_mem F (ζ_inv_mem (R := R) X)), sign_one, neg_smul, one_smul,
    neg_neg, β_hom]

name: StringDiagrams.PiSupercategory.β_hom_mem
statement:
theorem β_hom_mem [F.Additive] [F.Linear R] [IsSuperfunctor R F] (X : C) :
    (β R F X).hom ∈ parity (R := R) ((pi (R := R)).obj (F.obj X)) (F.obj ((pi (R := R)).obj X)) 0

name: StringDiagrams.PiSupercategory.β_naturality
statement:
theorem β_naturality [F.Additive] [F.Linear R] [IsSuperfunctor R F] {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    (pi (R := R)).map (F.map f) ≫ (β R F Y).hom = (β R F X).hom ≫ F.map ((pi (R := R)).map f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [β_hom, β_hom, ζ_naturality_assoc, Category.assoc, pi_map_eq, ← F.map_comp,
    Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc, F.map_comp, map_twist]

name: StringDiagrams.PiSupercategory.βIso_hom_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem βIso_hom_app [F.Additive] [F.Linear R] [IsSuperfunctor R F] (X : C) :
    (βIso (R := R) F).hom.app X = (β R F X).hom

name: StringDiagrams.PiSupercategory.β_comm
statement:
theorem β_comm [F.Additive] [F.Linear R] [IsSuperfunctor R F] (X : C) :
    (ξ (R := R) (F.obj X)).hom ≫ F.map (ξ (R := R) X).inv =
      (pi (R := R)).map (β R F X).hom ≫ (β R F ((pi (R := R)).obj X)).hom
proof:
:= by
  have h := ζ_naturality_of_mem (R := R) (map_mem F (ζ_inv_mem (R := R) X))
  rw [sign_one, neg_smul, one_smul] at h
  rw [β_hom, β_hom, Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc, reassoc_of% h, ξ_hom, ξ_inv_eq_neg,
    F.map_neg, F.map_comp]
  simp

name: StringDiagrams.PiSupercategory.β_naturality_supernatural
statement:
theorem β_naturality_supernatural [F.Additive] (G : C ⥤ D) [G.Additive] [G.Linear R]
    {p : ZMod 2} {x : ∀ X, F.obj X ⟶ G.obj X} (hx : IsSupernatural R p x) (X : C) :
    (pi (R := R)).map (x X) ≫ (β R G X).hom = (β R F X).hom ≫ x ((pi (R := R)).obj X)
proof:
:= by
  rw [β_hom, β_hom, ζ_naturality_assoc, Category.assoc, hx.naturality (ζ_inv_mem (R := R) X),
    twist_one_of_mem (hx.mem X), Linear.comp_smul, Linear.smul_comp, Linear.comp_smul,
    mul_one]

name: StringDiagrams.PiSupercategory.β_comp
statement:
theorem β_comp (G : D ⥤ E) (X : C) :
    (β R (F ⋙ G) X).hom = (β R G (F.obj X)).hom ≫ G.map (β R F X).hom

name: StringDiagrams.PiSupercategory.β_id
statement: theorem β_id (X : C) : (β R (𝟭 C) X).hom = 𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.PiSupercategory.β_pi
statement: theorem β_pi (X : C) : (β R (pi (R := R)) X).hom = -𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  have h : (ζ (R := R) ((pi (R := R)).obj X)).hom = -(pi (R := R)).map (ζ (R := R) X).hom := by
    rw [pi_map_ζ, neg_neg]
  rw [β_hom, h, Preadditive.neg_comp, ← Functor.map_comp, Iso.hom_inv_id,
      CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id]

name: StringDiagrams.iSupIndep_comap_of_injective
statement:
theorem iSupIndep_comap_of_injective {ι : Type*} {M N : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] {p : ι → Submodule R N} (hp : iSupIndep p) (f : M →ₗ[R] N)
    (hf : Function.Injective f) : iSupIndep fun i => (p i).comap f
proof:
:= by
  rw [iSupIndep_def] at hp ⊢
  intro i
  refine Disjoint.mono_right (iSup₂_le fun j hj => Submodule.comap_mono
    (le_iSup₂ (f := fun j _ => p j) j hj)) ?_
  rw [Submodule.disjoint_def]
  intro x hx hx'
  have h := Submodule.disjoint_def.1 (hp i) (f x) hx hx'
  exact hf (h.trans (map_zero f).symm)

name: StringDiagrams.iSupIndep_of_eval
statement:
theorem iSupIndep_of_eval {ι : Type*} {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    (deg : ι → Submodule R M) {A : Type*} {N : A → Type*} [∀ a, AddCommGroup (N a)]
    [∀ a, Module R (N a)] (ev : ∀ a, M →ₗ[R] N a) (E : ∀ a, ι → Submodule R (N a))
    (hE : ∀ a, iSupIndep (E a)) (hdeg : ∀ a n, (deg n).map (ev a) ≤ E a n)
    (hinj : ∀ x : M, (∀ a, ev a x = 0) → x = 0) : iSupIndep deg
proof:
:= by
  rw [iSupIndep_def]
  intro i
  rw [Submodule.disjoint_def]
  intro x hx hx'
  refine hinj x fun a => ?_
  have h1 : ev a x ∈ E a i := hdeg a i ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  have h2 : ev a x ∈ ⨆ (j) (_ : j ≠ i), E a j := by
    have : (⨆ (j) (_ : j ≠ i), deg j).map (ev a) ≤ ⨆ (j) (_ : j ≠ i), E a j := by
      rw [Submodule.map_iSup]
      refine iSup_mono fun j => ?_
      rw [Submodule.map_iSup]
      exact iSup_mono fun hj => hdeg a j
    exact this ⟨x, hx', rfl⟩
  exact Submodule.disjoint_def.1 (iSupIndep_def.1 (hE a) i) _ h1 h2

name: StringDiagrams.iSupIndep_of_projections
statement:
theorem iSupIndep_of_projections {ι M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    (P : ι → Submodule R M) (π : ι → M →ₗ[R] M)
    (h_same : ∀ i, P i ≤ LinearMap.eqLocus (π i) LinearMap.id)
    (h_ne : ∀ i j, j ≠ i → P j ≤ LinearMap.ker (π i)) : iSupIndep P
proof:
:= by
  rw [iSupIndep_def]
  intro i
  rw [Submodule.disjoint_def]
  intro x hx hx'
  have h1 : π i x = x := LinearMap.mem_eqLocus.1 (h_same i hx)
  have h2 : π i x = 0 :=
    LinearMap.mem_ker.1 ((iSup₂_le fun j hj => h_ne i j hj : (⨆ (j) (_ : j ≠ i), P j) ≤ _) hx')
  rw [← h1, h2]

name: StringDiagrams.isInternal_inf_of_decompose_mem
statement:
theorem isInternal_inf_of_decompose_mem {ι κ M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ] (𝒜 : ι → Submodule R M) (ℬ : κ → Submodule R M)
    [DirectSum.Decomposition 𝒜] [DirectSum.Decomposition ℬ]
    (h : ∀ (i : ι) (j : κ) {m : M}, m ∈ 𝒜 i → (DirectSum.decompose ℬ m j : M) ∈ 𝒜 i) :
    DirectSum.IsInternal fun ij : ι × κ => 𝒜 ij.1 ⊓ ℬ ij.2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine (DirectSum.isInternal_submodule_iff_iSupIndep_and_iSup_eq_top _).2 ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [iSupIndep_def]
    intro i
    rw [Submodule.disjoint_def]
    intro x hx hx'
    let φ : M →ₗ[R] M := (ℬ i.2).subtype ∘ₗ (DirectSum.component R κ (fun j => ℬ j) i.2) ∘ₗ
      (DirectSum.decomposeLinearEquiv ℬ).toLinearMap ∘ₗ (𝒜 i.1).subtype ∘ₗ
        (DirectSum.component R ι (fun i => 𝒜 i) i.1) ∘ₗ (DirectSum.decomposeLinearEquiv 𝒜).toLinearMap
    have hφ : ∀ y, φ y = (DirectSum.decompose ℬ (DirectSum.decompose 𝒜 y i.1 : M) i.2 : M) :=
      fun y => rfl
    have hpi : ∀ j : ι × κ, j ≠ i → ∀ y ∈ 𝒜 j.1 ⊓ ℬ j.2, φ y = 0 := by
      intro j hj y hy
      rw [hφ]
      by_cases h1 : j.1 = i.1
      · have h2 : j.2 ≠ i.2 := fun h2 => hj (Prod.ext h1 h2)
        rw [DirectSum.decompose_of_mem_same 𝒜 (h1 ▸ hy.1), DirectSum.decompose_of_mem_ne ℬ hy.2 h2]
      · rw [DirectSum.decompose_of_mem_ne 𝒜 hy.1 h1]
        simp
    have h0 : φ x = 0 := by
      refine Submodule.iSup_induction (fun j : {j // j ≠ i} => 𝒜 j.1.1 ⊓ ℬ j.1.2)
        (motive := fun y => φ y = 0) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
      · simpa [iSup_subtype'] using hx'
      · intro j y hy; exact hpi j j.2 y hy
      · simp
      · intro y z hy hz; rw [map_add, hy, hz, add_zero]
    rwa [hφ, DirectSum.decompose_of_mem_same 𝒜 hx.1, DirectSum.decompose_of_mem_same ℬ hx.2] at h0
  · rw [eq_top_iff]
    intro v _
    refine DirectSum.Decomposition.inductionOn 𝒜
      (motive := fun v => v ∈ ⨆ ij : ι × κ, 𝒜 ij.1 ⊓ ℬ ij.2) (Submodule.zero_mem _)
      (fun {i} w => ?_) (fun w w' hw hw' => Submodule.add_mem _ hw hw') v
    rw [← DirectSum.sum_support_decompose ℬ (w : M)]
    exact Submodule.sum_mem _ fun j _ =>
      Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem (i, j) ⟨h i j w.2, Submodule.coe_mem _⟩

name: StringDiagrams.GradedHomFamily.mem_hom_of_mem
statement:
theorem mem_hom_of_mem {i j : J} {n : ℤ} {f : 𝒟.obj i ⟶ 𝒟.obj j} (hf : f ∈ 𝒟.deg i j n) :
    f ∈ 𝒟.hom i j

name: StringDiagrams.GradedHomFamily.hom_induction
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
theorem hom_induction {i j : J} {motive : (𝒟.obj i ⟶ 𝒟.obj j) → Prop} {f : 𝒟.obj i ⟶ 𝒟.obj j}
    (hf : f ∈ 𝒟.hom i j) (mem : ∀ (n : ℤ) (g : 𝒟.obj i ⟶ 𝒟.obj j), g ∈ 𝒟.deg i j n → motive g)
    (zero : motive 0) (add : ∀ g h, motive g → motive h → motive (g + h)) : motive f
proof:
:=
  Submodule.iSup_induction (𝒟.deg i j) (motive := motive) hf mem zero add

name: StringDiagrams.GradedHomFamily.id_mem_hom
statement: theorem id_mem_hom (i : J) : 𝟙 (𝒟.obj i) ∈ 𝒟.hom i i

name: StringDiagrams.GradedHomFamily.comp_mem_hom
statement:
theorem comp_mem_hom {i j k : J} {f : 𝒟.obj i ⟶ 𝒟.obj j} {g : 𝒟.obj j ⟶ 𝒟.obj k}
    (hf : f ∈ 𝒟.hom i j) (hg : g ∈ 𝒟.hom j k) : f ≫ g ∈ 𝒟.hom i k
proof:
:= by
  refine 𝒟.hom_induction hf (fun m f hf => ?_) (by simp) (fun f f' h h' => ?_)
  · refine 𝒟.hom_induction hg (fun n g hg => 𝒟.mem_hom_of_mem (𝒟.comp_mem hf hg)) (by simp)
      (fun g g' h h' => ?_)
    rw [Preadditive.comp_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ h h'
  · rw [Preadditive.add_comp]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ h h'

name: StringDiagrams.GradedHomFamily.proj_mem_hom
statement:
theorem proj_mem_hom (p : ZMod 2) {i j : J} {f : 𝒟.obj i ⟶ 𝒟.obj j} (hf : f ∈ 𝒟.hom i j) :
    proj R p f ∈ 𝒟.hom i j
proof:
:= by
  refine 𝒟.hom_induction hf (fun n g hg => 𝒟.mem_hom_of_mem (𝒟.proj_mem p hg)) (by simp)
    (fun g g' h h' => ?_)
  rw [map_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ h h'

name: StringDiagrams.GradedHomFamily.twist_mem
statement:
theorem twist_mem (p : ZMod 2) {i j : J} {n : ℤ} {f : 𝒟.obj i ⟶ 𝒟.obj j}
    (hf : f ∈ 𝒟.deg i j n) : twist R p f ∈ 𝒟.deg i j n
proof:
:= by
  rw [twist_apply]
  exact Submodule.add_mem _ (𝒟.proj_mem 0 hf) (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (𝒟.proj_mem 1 hf))

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSubcategory.mem_parityHom
statement:
theorem mem_parityHom {X Y : GradedSubcategory 𝒟} {p : ZMod 2} {f : X ⟶ Y} :
    f ∈ parityHom X Y p ↔ f.1 ∈ parity (R := R) (𝒟.obj X.as) (𝒟.obj Y.as) p

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSubcategory.mem_parity_iff
statement:
theorem mem_parity_iff {X Y : GradedSubcategory 𝒟} {p : ZMod 2} {f : X ⟶ Y} :
    f ∈ parity (R := R) X Y p ↔ f.1 ∈ parity (R := R) (𝒟.obj X.as) (𝒟.obj Y.as) p

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSubcategory.proj_val
statement:
theorem proj_val (p : ZMod 2) {X Y : GradedSubcategory 𝒟} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    (proj R p f).1 = proj R p f.1
proof:
:= by
  have e : f = ⟨proj R p f.1, 𝒟.proj_mem_hom p f.2⟩ +
      ⟨proj R (p + 1) f.1, 𝒟.proj_mem_hom (p + 1) f.2⟩ :=
    Subtype.ext (proj_add_proj_add_one (R := R) p f.1).symm
  rw [proj_eq_of_add e (mem_parity_iff.2 (proj_mem p _)) (mem_parity_iff.2 (proj_mem _ _))]

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSubcategory.twist_val
statement:
theorem twist_val (p : ZMod 2) {X Y : GradedSubcategory 𝒟} (f : X ⟶ Y) :

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSubcategory.homMk_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem homMk_val {X Y : GradedSubcategory 𝒟} {n : ℤ} (f : 𝒟.obj X.as ⟶ 𝒟.obj Y.as)
    (hf : f ∈ 𝒟.deg X.as Y.as n) : (homMk f hf).1 = f

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSupercategory.dproj_apply
statement:
theorem dproj_apply (n : ℤ) {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    letI := degreeDecomposition R X Y
    dproj R n f = (DirectSum.decompose (degree (R := R) X Y) f n : X ⟶ Y)

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSupercategory.dproj_mem
statement: theorem dproj_mem (n : ℤ) {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) : dproj R n f ∈ degree (R := R) X Y n
proof:
:=
  letI := degreeDecomposition R X Y
  (DirectSum.decompose (degree (R := R) X Y) f n).2

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSupercategory.dproj_of_mem
statement:
theorem dproj_of_mem {n : ℤ} {X Y : C} {f : X ⟶ Y} (hf : f ∈ degree (R := R) X Y n) :
    dproj R n f = f
proof:
:=
  letI := degreeDecomposition R X Y
  DirectSum.decompose_of_mem_same _ hf

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSupercategory.dproj_of_mem_ne
statement:
theorem dproj_of_mem_ne {m n : ℤ} {X Y : C} {f : X ⟶ Y} (hf : f ∈ degree (R := R) X Y m)
    (h : m ≠ n) : dproj R n f = 0
proof:
:=
  letI := degreeDecomposition R X Y
  DirectSum.decompose_of_mem_ne _ hf h

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSupercategory.induction_on_degree
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
theorem induction_on_degree {X Y : C} {P : (X ⟶ Y) → Prop} (f : X ⟶ Y) (zero : P 0)
    (hom : ∀ (n : ℤ) (g : X ⟶ Y), g ∈ degree (R := R) X Y n → P g)
    (add : ∀ g h, P g → P h → P (g + h)) : P f
proof:
:=
  letI := degreeDecomposition R X Y
  DirectSum.Decomposition.inductionOn (degree (R := R) X Y) zero (fun g => hom _ _ g.2) add f

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSupercategory.mem_degree_of_dproj
statement:
theorem mem_degree_of_dproj {n : ℤ} {X Y : C} {f : X ⟶ Y}
    (h : ∀ m, m ≠ n → dproj R m f = 0) : f ∈ degree (R := R) X Y n
proof:
:= by
  let := degreeDecomposition R X Y
  have e : DirectSum.decompose (degree (R := R) X Y) f =
      DirectSum.of (fun m => degree (R := R) X Y m) n
        (DirectSum.decompose (degree (R := R) X Y) f n) := by
    ext m : 1
    by_cases hm : m = n
    · subst hm; simp
    · rw [DirectSum.of_eq_of_ne _ _ _ hm]
      exact Subtype.ext (h m hm)
  have := congrArg (DirectSum.decompose (degree (R := R) X Y)).symm e
  rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply, DirectSum.decompose_symm_of] at this
  rw [this]; exact Submodule.coe_mem _

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSupercategory.proj_dproj
statement:
theorem proj_dproj (p : ZMod 2) (n : ℤ) {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    proj R p (dproj R n f) = dproj R n (proj R p f)
proof:
:= by
  refine induction_on_degree (R := R) f (by simp) (fun m g hg => ?_) (fun g h hg hh => ?_)
  · by_cases h : m = n
    · subst h
      rw [dproj_of_mem hg, dproj_of_mem (proj_mem_degree p hg)]
    · rw [dproj_of_mem_ne hg h, dproj_of_mem_ne (proj_mem_degree p hg) h, map_zero]
  · rw [map_add, map_add, hg, hh, map_add, map_add]

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSupercategory.twist_mem_degree
statement:
theorem twist_mem_degree (p : ZMod 2) {n : ℤ} {X Y : C} {f : X ⟶ Y}
    (hf : f ∈ degree (R := R) X Y n) : twist R p f ∈ degree (R := R) X Y n
proof:
:= by
  rw [twist_apply]
  exact Submodule.add_mem _ (proj_mem_degree 0 hf)
    (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (proj_mem_degree 1 hf))

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSupercategory.zero_mem_degree
statement: theorem zero_mem_degree {X Y : C} (n : ℤ) : (0 : X ⟶ Y) ∈ degree (R := R) X Y n

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSupercategory.inv_mem_degree
statement:
theorem inv_mem_degree {n : ℤ} {X Y : C} (e : X ≅ Y) (he : e.hom ∈ degree (R := R) X Y n) :
    e.inv ∈ degree (R := R) Y X (-n)
proof:
:= by
  apply mem_degree_of_dproj
  intro m hm
  have key : ∀ g : Y ⟶ X, ∀ k, dproj R (n + k) (e.hom ≫ g) = e.hom ≫ dproj R k g := by
    intro g k
    refine induction_on_degree (R := R) g (by simp) (fun j g hg => ?_) (fun g h hg hh => ?_)
    · by_cases hj : j = k
      · subst hj; rw [dproj_of_mem (comp_mem_degree he hg), dproj_of_mem hg]
      · rw [dproj_of_mem_ne (comp_mem_degree he hg) (fun h => hj (add_left_cancel h)),
          dproj_of_mem_ne hg hj, Limits.comp_zero]
    · rw [Preadditive.comp_add, map_add, hg, hh, map_add, Preadditive.comp_add]
  have h1 : e.hom ≫ dproj R m e.inv = 0 := by
    rw [← key, e.hom_inv_id, dproj_of_mem_ne (id_mem_degree X)]
    omega
  calc dproj R m e.inv = e.inv ≫ e.hom ≫ dproj R m e.inv := by
        rw [← Category.assoc, e.inv_hom_id, Category.id_comp]
    _ = 0 := by rw [h1, Limits.comp_zero]

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSupercategory.isInternal_bigrading
statement: theorem isInternal_bigrading (X Y : C) : DirectSum.IsInternal (bidegree (R := R) X Y)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let := degreeDecomposition R X Y
  let := decomposition R X Y
  refine (DirectSum.isInternal_submodule_iff_iSupIndep_and_iSup_eq_top _).2 ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    rw [iSupIndep_def]
    intro i
    rw [Submodule.disjoint_def]
    intro x hx hx'
    have hpi : ∀ j : ℤ × ZMod 2, j ≠ i → ∀ y ∈ bidegree (R := R) X Y j,
        proj R i.2 (dproj R i.1 y) = 0 := by
      intro j hj y hy
      by_cases h1 : j.1 = i.1
      · have h2 : j.2 ≠ i.2 := fun h2 => hj (Prod.ext h1 h2)
        rw [dproj_of_mem (h1 ▸ hy.1), proj_of_mem_ne hy.2 h2]
      · rw [dproj_of_mem_ne hy.1 h1, map_zero]
    have h0 : proj R i.2 (dproj R i.1 x) = 0 := by
      refine Submodule.iSup_induction (fun j : {j // j ≠ i} => bidegree (R := R) X Y j)
        (motive := fun y => proj R i.2 (dproj R i.1 y) = 0) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
      · simpa [iSup_subtype'] using hx'
      · intro j y hy; exact hpi j j.2 y hy
      · simp
      · intro y z hy hz; rw [map_add, map_add, hy, hz, add_zero]
    rwa [dproj_of_mem hx.1, proj_of_mem hx.2] at h0
  · rw [eq_top_iff]
    intro f _
    refine induction_on_degree (R := R) f (Submodule.zero_mem _) (fun n g hg => ?_)
      (fun g h hg hh => Submodule.add_mem _ hg hh)
    rw [← proj_add_proj (R := R) g]
    refine Submodule.add_mem _ ?_ ?_
    · exact Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem (n, (0 : ZMod 2)) ⟨proj_mem_degree 0 hg, proj_mem 0 g⟩
    · exact Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem (n, (1 : ZMod 2)) ⟨proj_mem_degree 1 hg, proj_mem 1 g⟩

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSupercategory.map_mem_degree
statement:
theorem map_mem_degree (F : C ⥤ D) [F.Additive] [F.Linear R] [IsGradedSuperfunctor R F]
    {X Y : C} {n : ℤ} {f : X ⟶ Y} (hf : f ∈ degree (R := R) X Y n) :
    F.map f ∈ degree (R := R) (F.obj X) (F.obj Y) n

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSupercategory.map_dproj
statement:
theorem map_dproj (F : C ⥤ D) [F.Additive] [F.Linear R] [IsGradedSuperfunctor R F] (n : ℤ)
    {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) : F.map (dproj R n f) = dproj R n (F.map f)
proof:
:= by
  refine induction_on_degree (R := R) f (by simp) (fun m g hg => ?_) (fun g h hg hh => ?_)
  · by_cases h : m = n
    · subst h; rw [dproj_of_mem hg, dproj_of_mem (map_mem_degree F hg)]
    · rw [dproj_of_mem_ne hg h, dproj_of_mem_ne (map_mem_degree F hg) h, F.map_zero]
  · rw [map_add, F.map_add, hg, hh, F.map_add, map_add]

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSupercategory.mem_degree_of_map_mem
proof:
:=
  mem_degree_of_dproj fun m hm => F.map_injective (by
    rw [map_dproj, F.map_zero, dproj_of_mem_ne hf (Ne.symm hm)])

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSupercategory.isGradedSupernatural_id
statement:
theorem isGradedSupernatural_id [F.Linear R] :
    IsGradedSupernatural R 0 0 fun X => 𝟙 (F.obj X)

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSupercategory.IsGradedSupernatural.comp
statement:
theorem IsGradedSupernatural.comp [F.Additive] [G.Additive] [G.Linear R] [H.Additive]
    [H.Linear R] {p q : ZMod 2} {m n : ℤ} {x : ∀ X, F.obj X ⟶ G.obj X}
    {y : ∀ X, G.obj X ⟶ H.obj X} (hx : IsGradedSupernatural R p m x)
    (hy : IsGradedSupernatural R q n y) :
    IsGradedSupernatural R (p + q) (m + n) fun X => x X ≫ y X
proof:
:=
  ⟨hx.toIsSupernatural.comp hy.toIsSupernatural,
    fun X => comp_mem_degree (hx.mem_degree X) (hy.mem_degree X)⟩

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSupercategory.IsGradedSupernatural.whiskerRight
statement:
theorem IsGradedSupernatural.whiskerRight [F.Additive] [G.Additive] [G.Linear R] {p : ZMod 2}
    {n : ℤ} {x : ∀ X, F.obj X ⟶ G.obj X} (hx : IsGradedSupernatural R p n x) (K : D ⥤ E)
    [K.Additive] [K.Linear R] [IsGradedSuperfunctor R K] :
    IsGradedSupernatural R p n (F := F ⋙ K) (G := G ⋙ K) fun X => K.map (x X)
proof:
:=
  ⟨hx.toIsSupernatural.whiskerRight K, fun X => map_mem_degree K (hx.mem_degree X)⟩

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSupercategory.IsGradedSupernatural.whiskerLeft
statement:
theorem IsGradedSupernatural.whiskerLeft {B : Type*} [Category B] [Preadditive B] [Linear R B]
    [Supercategory R B] [GradedSupercategory R B] {p : ZMod 2} {n : ℤ}
    {x : ∀ X, F.obj X ⟶ G.obj X} (hx : IsGradedSupernatural R p n x)
    (K : B ⥤ C) [K.Additive] [K.Linear R] [IsGradedSuperfunctor R K] :
    IsGradedSupernatural R p n (F := K ⋙ F) (G := K ⋙ G) fun X => x (K.obj X)

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSupercategory.IsGradedSupernatural.neg
statement:
theorem IsGradedSupernatural.neg {p : ZMod 2} {n : ℤ} {x : ∀ X, F.obj X ⟶ G.obj X}
    (hx : IsGradedSupernatural R p n x) : IsGradedSupernatural R p n fun X => -x X
proof:
:=
  ⟨⟨fun X => Submodule.neg_mem _ (hx.mem X), fun hf => by
      rw [Preadditive.comp_neg, hx.naturality hf, Preadditive.neg_comp, smul_neg]⟩,
    fun X => Submodule.neg_mem _ (hx.mem_degree X)⟩

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSupercategory.IsGradedSupernatural.toGraded_total
proof:
:= by
  rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one p with rfl | rfl <;>
    simp [GradedSuperNatTrans.total, IsGradedSupernatural.toGraded]

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSupercategory.GradedSuperequivalence.gradedEvenlyDense
statement:
theorem GradedSuperequivalence.gradedEvenlyDense {F : C ⥤ D} (e : GradedSuperequivalence R F) :
    GradedEvenlyDense R F
proof:
:= fun Y =>
  ⟨e.inverse.obj Y, e.counitIso.app Y, e.counitIso_mem Y, e.counitIso_mem_degree Y⟩

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSupercategory.GradedEvenlyDense.iso_mem
statement:
theorem GradedEvenlyDense.iso_mem (Y : D) :
    (hF.iso F Y).hom ∈ parity (R := R) (F.obj (hF.obj F Y)) Y 0

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSupercategory.GradedEvenlyDense.iso_mem_degree
statement:
theorem GradedEvenlyDense.iso_mem_degree (Y : D) :
    (hF.iso F Y).hom ∈ degree (R := R) (F.obj (hF.obj F Y)) Y 0

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSupercategory.DegreeZero.hom_ext
statement: @[ext] theorem hom_ext {X Y : DegreeZero R C} {f g : X ⟶ Y} (h : f.1 = g.1) : f = g

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSupercategory.DegreeZero.id_val
statement: @[simp] theorem id_val (X : DegreeZero R C) : (𝟙 X : X ⟶ X).1 = 𝟙 X.obj

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSupercategory.DegreeZero.comp_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem comp_val {X Y Z : DegreeZero R C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) :
    (f ≫ g).1 = f.1 ≫ g.1

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSupercategory.DegreeZero.add_val
statement: @[simp] theorem add_val {X Y : DegreeZero R C} (f g : X ⟶ Y) : (f + g).1 = f.1 + g.1

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSupercategory.DegreeZero.neg_val
statement: @[simp] theorem neg_val {X Y : DegreeZero R C} (f : X ⟶ Y) : (-f).1 = -f.1

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSupercategory.DegreeZero.zero_val
statement: @[simp] theorem zero_val {X Y : DegreeZero R C} : (0 : X ⟶ Y).1 = 0

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSupercategory.DegreeZero.sub_val
statement: @[simp] theorem sub_val {X Y : DegreeZero R C} (f g : X ⟶ Y) : (f - g).1 = f.1 - g.1

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSupercategory.DegreeZero.smul_val
statement: @[simp] theorem smul_val {X Y : DegreeZero R C} (r : R) (f : X ⟶ Y) : (r • f).1 = r • f.1

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSupercategory.DegreeZero.mem_parityZ
statement:
theorem mem_parityZ {X Y : DegreeZero R C} {p : ZMod 2} {f : X ⟶ Y} :
    f ∈ parityZ X Y p ↔ f.1 ∈ parity (R := R) X.obj Y.obj p

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSupercategory.DegreeZero.mem_parity_iff
statement:
theorem mem_parity_iff {X Y : DegreeZero R C} {p : ZMod 2} {f : X ⟶ Y} :
    f ∈ parity (R := R) X Y p ↔ f.1 ∈ parity (R := R) X.obj Y.obj p

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSupercategory.DegreeZero.proj_val
statement:
theorem proj_val (p : ZMod 2) {X Y : DegreeZero R C} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    (proj R p f).1 = proj R p f.1
proof:
:= by
  have e : f = ⟨proj R p f.1, proj_mem_degree p f.2⟩ +
      ⟨proj R (p + 1) f.1, proj_mem_degree (p + 1) f.2⟩ :=
    Subtype.ext (proj_add_proj_add_one (R := R) p f.1).symm
  rw [proj_eq_of_add e (mem_parity_iff.2 (proj_mem p _)) (mem_parity_iff.2 (proj_mem _ _))]

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSupercategory.DegreeZero.twist_val
statement:
theorem twist_val (p : ZMod 2) {X Y : DegreeZero R C} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    (twist R p f).1 = twist R p f.1

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSupercategory.DegreeZero.isSupernatural_map
statement:
theorem isSupernatural_map {F G : C ⥤ D} [F.Additive] [F.Linear R] [IsGradedSuperfunctor R F]
    [G.Additive] [G.Linear R] [IsGradedSuperfunctor R G] {p : ZMod 2}
    {x : ∀ X, F.obj X ⟶ G.obj X} (hx : IsGradedSupernatural R p 0 x) :
    IsSupernatural R p (F := map (R := R) F) (G := map (R := R) G)
      fun X => (⟨x X.obj, hx.mem_degree X.obj⟩ : (map (R := R) F).obj X ⟶ (map (R := R) G).obj X) where
  mem X
proof:
:= hx.mem X.obj
  naturality hf := Subtype.ext (hx.naturality hf)

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.Superequivalent.nonempty_equivalence
statement:
theorem Superequivalent.nonempty_equivalence {a b : C} (h : Superequivalent R a b) :
    Nonempty ((⟨a⟩ : Underlying2 R C) ≌ ⟨b⟩)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, g, e₁, e₂, h₁, h₂⟩ := h
  exact ⟨Equivalence.mkOfAdjointifyCounit (f := Underlying2.hom1 f) (g := Underlying2.hom1 g)
    (Underlying.isoMk e₁ h₁).symm (Underlying.isoMk e₂ h₂)⟩

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.toPseudo_obj
statement: @[simp] theorem toPseudo_obj (a : Underlying2 R B) : F.toPseudo.obj a = ⟨F.obj a.obj⟩

statement:
@[simp] theorem toPseudo_map_obj {a b : Underlying2 R B} (f : a ⟶ b) :

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.toPseudo_map₂_val

    (F.toPseudo.mapComp f g).hom.1 = (F.mapComp f.obj g.obj).inv

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.toPseudo_mapComp_inv_val

@[simp] theorem toPseudo_mapComp_inv_val {a b c : Underlying2 R B} (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) :

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.toPseudo_mapId_hom_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem toPseudo_mapId_hom_val (a : Underlying2 R B) :
    (F.toPseudo.mapId a).hom.1 = (F.mapId a.obj).inv

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.toPseudo_mapId_inv_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem toPseudo_mapId_inv_val (a : Underlying2 R B) :
    (F.toPseudo.mapId a).inv.1 = (F.mapId a.obj).hom

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.IsLocalTwoSuperequivalence.map₂_pre
statement:
@[simp] theorem map₂_pre {a b : B} {f g : a ⟶ b} (x : F.map f ⟶ F.map g) :
    F.map₂ (hF.pre x) = x

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.IsLocalTwoSuperequivalence.map₂_injective
statement:
theorem map₂_injective {a b : B} {f g : a ⟶ b} :
    Function.Injective (F.map₂ : (f ⟶ g) → (F.map f ⟶ F.map g))

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.IsLocalTwoSuperequivalence.pre_mem
statement:
theorem pre_mem {a b : B} {f g : a ⟶ b} {p : ZMod 2} {x : F.map f ⟶ F.map g}
    (hx : x ∈ parity (R := R) (F.map f) (F.map g) p) : hF.pre x ∈ parity (R := R) f g p
proof:
:= by
  have := (hF.se a b).fullyFaithful.faithful
  refine mem_of_map_mem (F.mapFunctor a b) ?_
  change F.map₂ (hF.pre x) ∈ _
  rw [map₂_pre]
  exact hx

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.IsLocalTwoSuperequivalence.liftIso_hom_mem
statement:
theorem liftIso_hom_mem {a b : B} (k : F.obj a ⟶ F.obj b) :
    (hF.liftIso k).hom ∈ parity (R := R) _ _ 0

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.IsLocalTwoSuperequivalence.map₂_preU
statement:
@[simp] theorem map₂_preU {a b : Underlying2 R B} {f g : a ⟶ b}

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.IsLocalTwoSuperequivalence.map₂U_injective

theorem map₂U_injective {a b : Underlying2 R B} {f g : a ⟶ b} :
