    Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalSupercategory.coherence_pentagon_inv
statement:
theorem coherence_pentagon_inv (X Y Z W : A) :
    (α_ X (Y ⊗ Z) W).hom ≫ X ◁ (α_ Y Z W).hom ≫ (α_ X Y (Z ⊗ W)).inv =
      (α_ X Y Z).inv ▷ W ≫ (α_ (X ⊗ Y) Z W).hom
proof:
:= by
  have hU : ∀ X Y Z W : Underlying R A,
    (α_ X (Y ⊗ Z) W).hom ≫ X ◁ (α_ Y Z W).hom ≫ (α_ X Y (Z ⊗ W)).inv =
      (α_ X Y Z).inv ▷ W ≫ (α_ (X ⊗ Y) Z W).hom := by
    intros; monoidal
  have h := congrArg Subtype.val (hU ⟨X⟩ ⟨Y⟩ ⟨Z⟩ ⟨W⟩)
  underlying_val h

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalSupercategory.coherence_pentagon_inv'
statement:
theorem coherence_pentagon_inv' (X Y Z W : A) :
    (α_ X Y (Z ⊗ W)).inv ≫ (α_ (X ⊗ Y) Z W).inv ≫ (α_ X Y Z).hom ▷ W =
      X ◁ (α_ Y Z W).inv ≫ (α_ X (Y ⊗ Z) W).inv
proof:
:= by
  have hU : ∀ X Y Z W : Underlying R A,
    (α_ X Y (Z ⊗ W)).inv ≫ (α_ (X ⊗ Y) Z W).inv ≫ (α_ X Y Z).hom ▷ W =
      X ◁ (α_ Y Z W).inv ≫ (α_ X (Y ⊗ Z) W).inv := by
    intros; monoidal
  have h := congrArg Subtype.val (hU ⟨X⟩ ⟨Y⟩ ⟨Z⟩ ⟨W⟩)
  underlying_val h

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalSupercategory.coherence_leftUnitor_inv_tensor
statement:
theorem coherence_leftUnitor_inv_tensor (Z W : A) :
    (λ_ (Z ⊗ W)).inv = (λ_ Z).inv ▷ W ≫ (α_ (𝟙_ A) Z W).hom
proof:
:= by
  have hU : ∀ Z W : Underlying R A,
    (λ_ (Z ⊗ W)).inv = (λ_ Z).inv ▷ W ≫ (α_ (𝟙_ _) Z W).hom := by
    intros; monoidal
  have h := congrArg Subtype.val (hU ⟨Z⟩ ⟨W⟩)
  underlying_val h

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalSupercategory.coherence_left_unitality
statement:
theorem coherence_left_unitality (X Y : A) :
    (λ_ (X ⊗ Y)).inv ≫ (α_ (𝟙_ A) X Y).inv ≫ (λ_ X).hom ▷ Y = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  have hU : ∀ X Y : Underlying R A,
    (λ_ (X ⊗ Y)).inv ≫ (α_ (𝟙_ _) X Y).inv ≫ (λ_ X).hom ▷ Y = 𝟙 _ := by
    intros; monoidal
  have h := congrArg Subtype.val (hU ⟨X⟩ ⟨Y⟩)
  underlying_val h

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalSupercategory.coherence_right_unitality
statement:
theorem coherence_right_unitality (X Y : A) :
    X ◁ (λ_ Y).inv ≫ (α_ X (𝟙_ A) Y).inv ≫ (ρ_ X).hom ▷ Y = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  have hU : ∀ X Y : Underlying R A,
    X ◁ (λ_ Y).inv ≫ (α_ X (𝟙_ _) Y).inv ≫ (ρ_ X).hom ▷ Y = 𝟙 _ := by
    intros; monoidal
  have h := congrArg Subtype.val (hU ⟨X⟩ ⟨Y⟩)
  underlying_val h

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalSupercategory.coherence_rightUnitor_inv_tensor
statement:
theorem coherence_rightUnitor_inv_tensor (X Y : A) :
    (ρ_ (X ⊗ Y)).inv = ((ρ_ X).inv ⊗ₘ (ρ_ Y).inv) ≫ (α_ X (𝟙_ A) (Y ⊗ 𝟙_ A)).hom ≫
      X ◁ (λ_ (Y ⊗ 𝟙_ A)).hom ≫ (α_ X Y (𝟙_ A)).inv
proof:
:= by
  have hU : ∀ X Y : Underlying R A,
    (ρ_ (X ⊗ Y)).inv = ((ρ_ X).inv ⊗ₘ (ρ_ Y).inv) ≫ (α_ X (𝟙_ _) (Y ⊗ 𝟙_ _)).hom ≫
      X ◁ (λ_ (Y ⊗ 𝟙_ _)).hom ≫ (α_ X Y (𝟙_ _)).inv := by
    intros; monoidal
  have h := congrArg Subtype.val (hU ⟨X⟩ ⟨Y⟩)
  underlying_val h

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalSupercategory.coherence_leftUnitor_inv_unit
statement: theorem coherence_leftUnitor_inv_unit : (λ_ (𝟙_ A)).inv = (ρ_ (𝟙_ A)).inv
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg Subtype.val
    (show (λ_ (𝟙_ (Underlying R A))).inv = (ρ_ (𝟙_ (Underlying R A))).inv by monoidal)
  underlying_val h

name: StringDiagrams.Strictification.ext_of_heq
statement:
theorem ext_of_heq {M N : Strictification R A} (h : M.toFunctor = N.toFunctor)
    (hγ : ∀ X Y, HEq (M.γ X Y).hom (N.γ X Y).hom) : M = N
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨F, γ, _, _, _, _⟩ := M
  obtain ⟨G, γ', _, _, _, _⟩ := N
  obtain rfl : F = G := h
  obtain rfl : γ = γ' := funext fun X => funext fun Y => Iso.ext (eq_of_heq (hγ X Y))
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.Strictification.γ_unit
statement:
theorem γ_unit (M : Strictification R A) (X : A) :
    (M.γ X (𝟙_ A)).hom ≫ M.toFunctor.map (ρ_ X).hom = (ρ_ (M.toFunctor.obj X)).hom
proof:
:= by
  
  have key : ∀ Z : A, ((M.γ X (𝟙_ A)).hom ≫ M.toFunctor.map (ρ_ X).hom) ▷ Z ≫ (M.γ X Z).hom =
      (ρ_ (M.toFunctor.obj X)).hom ▷ Z ≫ (M.γ X Z).hom := by
    intro Z
    rw [MonoidalSupercategory.comp_whiskerRight (R := R), Category.assoc,
      M.γ_naturality_left, ← MonoidalSupercategory.triangle (R := R) (M.toFunctor.obj X) Z,
      Category.assoc, M.γ_naturality_right, M.γ_assoc_assoc, ← Functor.map_comp,
      MonoidalSupercategory.triangle (R := R) X Z]
  have h := key (𝟙_ A)
  rw [cancel_mono] at h
  rw [← cancel_mono (ρ_ (M.toFunctor.obj X)).inv, ← cancel_epi (ρ_ (M.toFunctor.obj X ⊗ 𝟙_ A)).hom]
  have e := MonoidalSupercategory.rightUnitor_naturality (R := R)
    ((M.γ X (𝟙_ A)).hom ≫ M.toFunctor.map (ρ_ X).hom)
  have e' := MonoidalSupercategory.rightUnitor_naturality (R := R) (ρ_ (M.toFunctor.obj X)).hom
  rw [h] at e
  rw [← Category.assoc, ← e, ← Category.assoc, ← e']

name: StringDiagrams.Strictification.mem_homSubmodule
statement:
theorem mem_homSubmodule {M N : Strictification R A} {x : M.toSuperfunctor ⟶ N.toSuperfunctor} :
    x ∈ homSubmodule M N ↔ ∀ (p : ZMod 2) (X Y : A),
      (M.γ X Y).hom ≫ x.app p (X ⊗ Y) = x.app p X ▷ Y ≫ (N.γ X Y).hom

name: StringDiagrams.Strictification.id_mem_homSubmodule
statement:
theorem id_mem_homSubmodule (M : Strictification R A) :
    𝟙 M.toSuperfunctor ∈ homSubmodule M M
proof:
:= by
  intro p X Y
  rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one p with rfl | rfl
  · simp [MonoidalSupercategory.id_whiskerRight (R := R)]
  · simp [MonoidalSupercategory.zero_whiskerRight R]

name: StringDiagrams.Strictification.comp_mem_homSubmodule
proof:
:= by
  intro r X Y
  simp only [comp_app, Preadditive.comp_add, Preadditive.add_comp,
    MonoidalSupercategory.add_whiskerRight (R := R),
    MonoidalSupercategory.comp_whiskerRight (R := R), Category.assoc]
  rw [reassoc_of% (hx 0 X Y), reassoc_of% (hx 1 X Y), hy r X Y, hy (r + 1) X Y]

name: StringDiagrams.Strictification.proj_mem_homSubmodule
statement:
theorem proj_mem_homSubmodule {M N : Strictification R A} (p : ZMod 2)
    {x : M.toSuperfunctor ⟶ N.toSuperfunctor} (hx : x ∈ homSubmodule M N) :
    proj R p x ∈ homSubmodule M N
proof:
:= by
  intro q X Y
  simp only [proj_app]
  split_ifs with h
  · subst h; exact hx q X Y
  · simp [MonoidalSupercategory.zero_whiskerRight R]

name: StringDiagrams.Strictification.hom_ext
statement: @[ext] theorem hom_ext {M N : Strictification R A} {x y : M ⟶ N} (h : x.1 = y.1) : x = y

name: StringDiagrams.Strictification.id_val
statement: @[simp] theorem id_val (M : Strictification R A) : (𝟙 M : M ⟶ M).1 = 𝟙 M.toSuperfunctor

name: StringDiagrams.Strictification.comp_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem comp_val {M N P : Strictification R A} (x : M ⟶ N) (y : N ⟶ P) :
    (x ≫ y).1 = x.1 ≫ y.1

name: StringDiagrams.Strictification.hom_compat
statement:
theorem hom_compat {M N : Strictification R A} (x : M ⟶ N) (p : ZMod 2) (X Y : A) :
    (M.γ X Y).hom ≫ x.1.app p (X ⊗ Y) = x.1.app p X ▷ Y ≫ (N.γ X Y).hom

name: StringDiagrams.Strictification.add_val
statement: @[simp] theorem add_val {M N : Strictification R A} (x y : M ⟶ N) : (x + y).1 = x.1 + y.1

name: StringDiagrams.Strictification.zero_val
statement: @[simp] theorem zero_val {M N : Strictification R A} : (0 : M ⟶ N).1 = 0

name: StringDiagrams.Strictification.smul_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem smul_val {M N : Strictification R A} (r : R) (x : M ⟶ N) :
    (r • x).1 = r • x.1

name: StringDiagrams.Strictification.zsmul_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem zsmul_val {M N : Strictification R A} (n : ℤ) (x : M ⟶ N) :
    (n • x).1 = n • x.1

name: StringDiagrams.Strictification.mem_parityHom
statement:
theorem mem_parityHom {M N : Strictification R A} {p : ZMod 2} {x : M ⟶ N} :
    x ∈ parityHom M N p ↔ x.1 ∈ parity (R := R) M.toSuperfunctor N.toSuperfunctor p

name: StringDiagrams.Strictification.mem_parity_iff
statement:
theorem mem_parity_iff {M N : Strictification R A} {p : ZMod 2} {x : M ⟶ N} :
    x ∈ parity (R := R) M N p ↔ x.1 ∈ parity (R := R) M.toSuperfunctor N.toSuperfunctor p

name: StringDiagrams.Strictification.tensorObj_assoc
statement:
theorem tensorObj_assoc (M N P : Strictification R A) :
    tensorObj (tensorObj M N) P = tensorObj M (tensorObj N P)
proof:
:=
  ext_of_heq rfl fun X Y => heq_of_eq (by simp; rfl)

name: StringDiagrams.Strictification.unit_tensorObj
statement: theorem unit_tensorObj (M : Strictification R A) : tensorObj tensorUnit M = M
proof:
:=
  ext_of_heq rfl fun X Y => heq_of_eq (by simp; exact Category.id_comp _)

name: StringDiagrams.Strictification.tensorObj_unit
statement: theorem tensorObj_unit (M : Strictification R A) : tensorObj M tensorUnit = M
proof:
:=
  ext_of_heq rfl fun X Y => heq_of_eq (by
    simp
    exact (congrArg _ (M.toFunctor.map_id _)).trans (Category.comp_id _))

name: StringDiagrams.Strictification.tensorObj_toSuperfunctor
statement:
theorem tensorObj_toSuperfunctor (M N : Strictification R A) :
    (M ⊗ N).toSuperfunctor = N.toSuperfunctor.comp M.toSuperfunctor

name: StringDiagrams.Strictification.tensorObj_toFunctor'
statement:
@[simp] theorem tensorObj_toFunctor' (M N : Strictification R A) :
    (M ⊗ N).toFunctor = N.toFunctor ⋙ M.toFunctor

name: StringDiagrams.Strictification.tensorObj_γ_hom
statement:
@[simp] theorem tensorObj_γ_hom (M N : Strictification R A) (X Y : A) :
    ((M ⊗ N).γ X Y).hom = (M.γ (N.toFunctor.obj X) Y).hom ≫ M.toFunctor.map (N.γ X Y).hom

name: StringDiagrams.Strictification.tensorUnit_toSuperfunctor
statement:
theorem tensorUnit_toSuperfunctor :
    (𝟙_ (Strictification R A)).toSuperfunctor = Superfunctor.id R A

name: StringDiagrams.Strictification.tensorUnit_toFunctor'
statement: @[simp] theorem tensorUnit_toFunctor' : (𝟙_ (Strictification R A)).toFunctor = 𝟭 A

name: StringDiagrams.Strictification.tensorUnit_γ_hom
statement: @[simp] theorem tensorUnit_γ_hom (X Y : A) : ((𝟙_ (Strictification R A)).γ X Y).hom = 𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.Strictification.whiskerLeft_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem whiskerLeft_val (M : Strictification R A) {N N' : Strictification R A}
    (y : N ⟶ N') : (M ◁ y).1 = Superfunctor.whiskerRight y.1 M.toSuperfunctor

name: StringDiagrams.Strictification.whiskerRight_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem whiskerRight_val {M M' : Strictification R A} (x : M ⟶ M')
    (N : Strictification R A) : (x ▷ N).1 = Superfunctor.whiskerLeft N.toSuperfunctor x.1

name: StringDiagrams.Strictification.tensorHom_val
statement:
theorem tensorHom_val {M M' N N' : Strictification R A} (f : M ⟶ M') (g : N ⟶ N') :
    (f ⊗ₘ g).1 = Superfunctor.whiskerLeft N.toSuperfunctor f.1 ≫
      Superfunctor.whiskerRight g.1 M'.toSuperfunctor

name: StringDiagrams.Strictification.eqToHom_val
statement:
theorem eqToHom_val {M N : Strictification R A} (h : M = N) :
    (eqToHom h).1 = eqToHom (congrArg Strictification.toSuperfunctor h)

name: StringDiagrams.Strictification.associator_hom_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem associator_hom_val (M N P : Strictification R A) :
    (α_ M N P).hom.1 = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  change (eqToHom (tensorObj_assoc M N P)).1 = _
  rw [eqToHom_val]; rfl

name: StringDiagrams.Strictification.associator_inv_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem associator_inv_val (M N P : Strictification R A) :
    (α_ M N P).inv.1 = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  change (eqToHom (tensorObj_assoc M N P).symm).1 = _
  rw [eqToHom_val]; rfl

name: StringDiagrams.Strictification.leftUnitor_hom_val
statement: @[simp] theorem leftUnitor_hom_val (M : Strictification R A) : (λ_ M).hom.1 = 𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.Strictification.leftUnitor_inv_val
statement: @[simp] theorem leftUnitor_inv_val (M : Strictification R A) : (λ_ M).inv.1 = 𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.Strictification.rightUnitor_hom_val
statement: @[simp] theorem rightUnitor_hom_val (M : Strictification R A) : (ρ_ M).hom.1 = 𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.Strictification.rightUnitor_inv_val
statement: @[simp] theorem rightUnitor_inv_val (M : Strictification R A) : (ρ_ M).inv.1 = 𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.Strictification.homMk_val_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem homMk_val_app (p : ZMod 2) (X : A) :
    (homMk x mem nat compat).1.app p X = if p = 0 then x X else 0

name: StringDiagrams.Strictification.homMk_mem
statement: theorem homMk_mem : homMk x mem nat compat ∈ parity (R := R) M N 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_parity_iff, Superfunctor.mem_parity_iff]
  funext X
  simp

name: StringDiagrams.Strictification.isoMk_hom_val_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem isoMk_hom_val_app (p : ZMod 2) (X : A) :
    (isoMk e mem nat compat).hom.1.app p X = if p = 0 then (e X).hom else 0

name: StringDiagrams.Strictification.isoMk_inv_val_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem isoMk_inv_val_app (p : ZMod 2) (X : A) :
    (isoMk e mem nat compat).inv.1.app p X = if p = 0 then (e X).inv else 0

name: StringDiagrams.Strictification.isoMk_hom_mem
statement: theorem isoMk_hom_mem : (isoMk e mem nat compat).hom ∈ parity (R := R) M N 0
proof:
:=
  homMk_mem (fun X => (e X).hom) mem nat compat

name: StringDiagrams.Strictification.proj_whiskerLeft
statement:
theorem proj_whiskerLeft (p : ZMod 2) (X : A) {Y Y' : A} (g : Y ⟶ Y') :
    proj R p (X ◁ g) = X ◁ proj R p g

name: StringDiagrams.Strictification.proj_whiskerRight
statement:
theorem proj_whiskerRight (p : ZMod 2) {X X' : A} (f : X ⟶ X') (Y : A) :
    proj R p (f ▷ Y) = proj R p f ▷ Y

name: StringDiagrams.Strictification.ι_obj
statement: @[simp] theorem ι_obj (X : A) : (ι R A).obj X = ιObj X

name: StringDiagrams.Strictification.ι_map_val_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem ι_map_val_app {X X' : A} (f : X ⟶ X') (p : ZMod 2) (Y : A) :
    ((ι R A).map f).1.app p Y = proj R p f ▷ Y

name: StringDiagrams.Strictification.ι_hom_compat
statement:
theorem ι_hom_compat (p : ZMod 2) (Y Z : A) :
    (α_ X Y Z).hom ≫ θ.1.app p (Y ⊗ Z) = θ.1.app p Y ▷ Z ≫ (α_ X' Y Z).hom

name: StringDiagrams.Strictification.ι_app_eq
statement:
theorem ι_app_eq (p : ZMod 2) (Y : A) :
    θ.1.app p Y = ((ρ_ X).inv ≫ θ.1.app p (𝟙_ A) ≫ (ρ_ X').hom) ▷ Y
proof:
:= by
  have hn : X ◁ (λ_ Y).hom ≫ θ.1.app p Y = θ.1.app p (𝟙_ A ⊗ Y) ≫ X' ◁ (λ_ Y).hom := by
    have := θ.1.naturality p (λ_ Y).hom (MonoidalSupercategory.leftUnitor_hom_mem (R := R) Y)
    rwa [koszulSign_zero_right, one_smul] at this
  have key : (ρ_ X).hom ▷ Y ≫ θ.1.app p Y = θ.1.app p (𝟙_ A) ▷ Y ≫ (ρ_ X').hom ▷ Y := by
    rw [← MonoidalSupercategory.triangle (R := R) X Y, Category.assoc, hn,
      ← Category.assoc, ι_hom_compat, Category.assoc,
      MonoidalSupercategory.triangle (R := R) X' Y]
  rw [MonoidalSupercategory.comp_whiskerRight (R := R),
    MonoidalSupercategory.comp_whiskerRight (R := R), ← key, ← Category.assoc,
    ← MonoidalSupercategory.comp_whiskerRight (R := R), Iso.inv_hom_id,
    MonoidalSupercategory.id_whiskerRight (R := R), Category.id_comp]

name: StringDiagrams.Strictification.proj_ιPreimage
statement:
theorem proj_ιPreimage (p : ZMod 2) :
    proj R p (ιPreimage θ) = (ρ_ X).inv ≫ θ.1.app p (𝟙_ A) ≫ (ρ_ X').hom
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : ∀ q, (ρ_ X).inv ≫ θ.1.app q (𝟙_ A) ≫ (ρ_ X').hom ∈ parity (R := R) X X' q := by
    intro q
    have := comp_mem (inv_mem _ (MonoidalSupercategory.rightUnitor_hom_mem (R := R) X))
      (comp_mem (θ.1.app_mem q (𝟙_ A)) (MonoidalSupercategory.rightUnitor_hom_mem (R := R) X'))
    simpa using this
  have e : ιPreimage θ = (ρ_ X).inv ≫ θ.1.app 0 (𝟙_ A) ≫ (ρ_ X').hom +
      (ρ_ X).inv ≫ θ.1.app 1 (𝟙_ A) ≫ (ρ_ X').hom := by
    simp [ιPreimage, Preadditive.add_comp, Preadditive.comp_add]
  rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one p with rfl | rfl
  · exact proj_eq_of_add e (hmem 0) (hmem 1)
  · rw [add_comm] at e
    exact proj_eq_of_add e (hmem 1) (hmem 0)

name: StringDiagrams.Strictification.ιObjIso_compat
statement:
theorem ιObjIso_compat (M : Strictification R A) (Y Z : A) :
    (α_ (M.toFunctor.obj (𝟙_ A)) Y Z).hom ≫ (M.γ (𝟙_ A) (Y ⊗ Z)).hom ≫
        M.toFunctor.map (λ_ (Y ⊗ Z)).hom =
      ((M.γ (𝟙_ A) Y).hom ≫ M.toFunctor.map (λ_ Y).hom) ▷ Z ≫ (M.γ Y Z).hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [M.γ_assoc_assoc, MonoidalSupercategory.comp_whiskerRight (R := R), Category.assoc,
    M.γ_naturality_left, ← Functor.map_comp, MonoidalSupercategory.leftUnitor_tensor R,
    Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.Strictification.ιObjIso_hom_val_app
statement:
theorem ιObjIso_hom_val_app (M : Strictification R A) (p : ZMod 2) (Y : A) :
    (ιObjIso M).hom.1.app p Y =
      if p = 0 then (M.γ (𝟙_ A) Y).hom ≫ M.toFunctor.map (λ_ Y).hom else 0

name: StringDiagrams.Strictification.ιObjIso_hom_mem
statement:
theorem ιObjIso_hom_mem (M : Strictification R A) :
    (ιObjIso M).hom ∈ parity (R := R) _ _ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_parity_iff, Superfunctor.mem_parity_iff]
  funext Y
  rw [ιObjIso_hom_val_app]
  simp

name: StringDiagrams.Strictification.ι_evenlyDense
statement: theorem ι_evenlyDense : EvenlyDense R (ι R A)
proof:
:=
  fun M => ⟨M.toFunctor.obj (𝟙_ A), ιObjIso M, ιObjIso_hom_mem M⟩

name: StringDiagrams.Strictification.comp_isoMk_hom_val_app
statement:
theorem comp_isoMk_hom_val_app (x : M ⟶ N) (e : ∀ X, N.toFunctor.obj X ≅ P.toFunctor.obj X)
    (mem : ∀ X, (e X).hom ∈ parity (R := R) _ _ 0)
    (nat : ∀ {X Y : A} (f : X ⟶ Y), N.toFunctor.map f ≫ (e Y).hom = (e X).hom ≫ P.toFunctor.map f)
    (compat : ∀ X Y, (N.γ X Y).hom ≫ (e (X ⊗ Y)).hom = (e X).hom ▷ Y ≫ (P.γ X Y).hom)
    (r : ZMod 2) (X : A) :
    (x ≫ (isoMk e mem nat compat).hom).1.app r X = x.1.app r X ≫ (e X).hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [comp_val, comp_app]
  rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one r with rfl | rfl <;>
    simp [SuperNatTrans.zmod2_one_add_one]

name: StringDiagrams.Strictification.isoMk_hom_comp_val_app
statement:
theorem isoMk_hom_comp_val_app (e : ∀ X, M.toFunctor.obj X ≅ N.toFunctor.obj X)
    (mem : ∀ X, (e X).hom ∈ parity (R := R) _ _ 0)
    (nat : ∀ {X Y : A} (f : X ⟶ Y), M.toFunctor.map f ≫ (e Y).hom = (e X).hom ≫ N.toFunctor.map f)
    (compat : ∀ X Y, (M.γ X Y).hom ≫ (e (X ⊗ Y)).hom = (e X).hom ▷ Y ≫ (N.γ X Y).hom)
    (x : N ⟶ P) (r : ZMod 2) (X : A) :
    ((isoMk e mem nat compat).hom ≫ x).1.app r X = (e X).hom ≫ x.1.app r X
proof:
:= by
  rw [comp_val, comp_app]
  rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one r with rfl | rfl <;>
    simp [SuperNatTrans.zmod2_one_add_one]

name: StringDiagrams.Strictification.proj_of_even
statement:
theorem proj_of_even {X Y : A} {f : X ⟶ Y} (hf : f ∈ parity (R := R) X Y 0) (p : ZMod 2) :
    proj R p f = if p = 0 then f else 0
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs with h
  · subst h; exact proj_of_mem hf
  · exact proj_of_mem_ne hf (Ne.symm h)

name: StringDiagrams.Strictification.ev_obj
statement: @[simp] theorem ev_obj (M : Strictification R A) : (ev R A).obj M = M.toFunctor.obj (𝟙_ A)

name: StringDiagrams.Strictification.ev_map
statement:
theorem ev_map {M N : Strictification R A} (x : M ⟶ N) :
    (ev R A).map x = x.1.app 0 (𝟙_ A) + x.1.app 1 (𝟙_ A)

name: StringDiagrams.Strictification.ev_compat
statement:
theorem ev_compat {M N : Strictification R A} (x : M ⟶ N) (p : ZMod 2) (Y : A) :
    x.1.app p (𝟙_ A) ▷ Y ≫ (N.γ (𝟙_ A) Y).hom ≫ N.toFunctor.map (λ_ Y).hom =
      (M.γ (𝟙_ A) Y).hom ≫ M.toFunctor.map (λ_ Y).hom ≫ x.1.app p Y
proof:
:= by
  have hn := x.1.naturality p (λ_ Y).hom (MonoidalSupercategory.leftUnitor_hom_mem (R := R) Y)
  rw [koszulSign_zero_right, one_smul] at hn
  rw [← reassoc_of% (hom_compat x p (𝟙_ A) Y), hn]

name: StringDiagrams.Strictification.evμIso_hom
statement:
theorem evμIso_hom (M N : Strictification R A) :
    (evμIso M N).hom = (M.γ (𝟙_ A) (N.toFunctor.obj (𝟙_ A))).hom ≫
      M.toFunctor.map (λ_ (N.toFunctor.obj (𝟙_ A))).hom

name: StringDiagrams.Strictification.ev_map_associator_hom
statement:
@[simp] theorem ev_map_associator_hom (M N P : Strictification R A) :
    (ev R A).map (α_ M N P).hom = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  rw [ev_map, associator_hom_val, Superfunctor.id_app_zero, Superfunctor.id_app_one, add_zero]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.Strictification.ev_map_leftUnitor_hom
statement:
@[simp] theorem ev_map_leftUnitor_hom (M : Strictification R A) :
    (ev R A).map (λ_ M).hom = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  rw [ev_map, leftUnitor_hom_val, Superfunctor.id_app_zero, Superfunctor.id_app_one, add_zero]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.Strictification.ev_map_rightUnitor_hom
statement:
@[simp] theorem ev_map_rightUnitor_hom (M : Strictification R A) :
    (ev R A).map (ρ_ M).hom = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  rw [ev_map, rightUnitor_hom_val, Superfunctor.id_app_zero, Superfunctor.id_app_one, add_zero]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.Strictification.app_one_eq_zero
statement:
theorem app_one_eq_zero {x : M ⟶ N} (hx : x ∈ parity (R := R) M N 0) (X : A) :
    x.1.app 1 X = 0
proof:
:= by
  have := congrFun ((Superfunctor.mem_parity_iff).1 (mem_parity_iff.1 hx)) X
  simpa using this

name: StringDiagrams.Strictification.comp_val_app_of_even_left
statement:
theorem comp_val_app_of_even_left {x : M ⟶ N} (hx : x ∈ parity (R := R) M N 0) (y : N ⟶ P)
    (r : ZMod 2) (X : A) : (x ≫ y).1.app r X = x.1.app 0 X ≫ y.1.app r X
proof:
:= by
  rw [comp_val, comp_app, app_one_eq_zero hx, Limits.zero_comp, add_zero]

name: StringDiagrams.Strictification.comp_val_app_of_even_right
statement:
theorem comp_val_app_of_even_right (x : M ⟶ N) {y : N ⟶ P} (hy : y ∈ parity (R := R) N P 0)
    (r : ZMod 2) (X : A) : (x ≫ y).1.app r X = x.1.app r X ≫ y.1.app 0 X
proof:
:= by
  rw [comp_val, comp_app]
  rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one r with rfl | rfl
  · rw [zero_add, app_one_eq_zero hy, Limits.comp_zero, add_zero]
  · rw [app_one_eq_zero hy, Limits.comp_zero, zero_add, SuperNatTrans.zmod2_one_add_one]

name: StringDiagrams.Strictification.ιμIso_hom_val_app
statement:
theorem ιμIso_hom_val_app (X Y : A) (p : ZMod 2) (Z : A) :
    (ιμIso (R := R) X Y).hom.1.app p Z = if p = 0 then (α_ X Y Z).inv else 0

name: StringDiagrams.Strictification.ιεIso_hom_val_app
statement:
theorem ιεIso_hom_val_app (p : ZMod 2) (Z : A) :
    (ιεIso (R := R) (A := A)).hom.1.app p Z = if p = 0 then (λ_ Z).inv else 0

name: StringDiagrams.Strictification.ιμIso_hom_mem
statement: theorem ιμIso_hom_mem (X Y : A) : (ιμIso (R := R) X Y).hom ∈ parity (R := R) _ _ 0

name: StringDiagrams.Strictification.ιεIso_hom_mem
statement: theorem ιεIso_hom_mem : (ιεIso (R := R) (A := A)).hom ∈ parity (R := R) _ _ 0

name: StringDiagrams.Strictification.evμIso_hom_mem
statement:
theorem evμIso_hom_mem (M N : Strictification R A) :
    (evμIso M N).hom ∈ parity (R := R) _ _ 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa [evμIso] using comp_mem (M.γ_mem (𝟙_ A) (N.toFunctor.obj (𝟙_ A)))
    (map_mem M.toFunctor (MonoidalSupercategory.leftUnitor_hom_mem (R := R) _))

name: StringDiagrams.Strictification.proj_app_add_app
statement:
theorem proj_app_add_app {M N : Strictification R A} (x : M ⟶ N) (r : ZMod 2) (X : A) :
    proj R r (x.1.app 0 X + x.1.app 1 X) = x.1.app r X
proof:
:= by
  have h0 := x.1.app_mem 0 X
  have h1 := x.1.app_mem 1 X
  rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one r with rfl | rfl
  · exact proj_eq_of_add rfl h0 (by simpa using h1)
  · rw [add_comm]; exact proj_eq_of_add rfl h1 (by simpa [SuperNatTrans.zmod2_one_add_one] using h0)

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalSupercategory.exists_strict_monoidalSuperequivalence
statement:
theorem exists_strict_monoidalSuperequivalence :
    ∃ (B : Type (max u v)) (_ : Category.{max u v} B) (_ : Preadditive B) (_ : Linear R B)
      (_ : Supercategory R B) (_ : MonoidalCategoryStruct B) (_ : MonoidalSupercategory R B),
      MonoidalSupercategory.IsStrict B ∧ Nonempty (MonoidalSuperequivalence R A B)
proof:
:=
  ⟨Strictification R A, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance,
    inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance, ⟨Strictification.monoidalSuperequivalence⟩⟩

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalSupercategory.exists_strict_monoidalSuperfunctor_superequivalence
statement:
theorem exists_strict_monoidalSuperfunctor_superequivalence :
    ∃ (B : Type (max u v)) (_ : Category.{max u v} B) (_ : Preadditive B) (_ : Linear R B)
      (_ : Supercategory R B) (_ : MonoidalCategoryStruct B) (_ : MonoidalSupercategory R B)
      (F : A ⥤ B) (_ : F.Additive) (_ : F.Linear R) (_ : IsSuperfunctor R F),
      MonoidalSupercategory.IsStrict B ∧ Nonempty (MonoidalSuperfunctor R F) ∧
        Nonempty (Superequivalence R F)
proof:
:=
  ⟨Strictification R A, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance,
    inferInstance, inferInstance, Strictification.ι R A, inferInstance, inferInstance,
    inferInstance, inferInstance, ⟨Strictification.ιMonoidal⟩,
    ⟨Strictification.ιSuperequivalence⟩⟩

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalSupercategory.coherence
statement:
theorem coherence {V : Type u'} (f : V → A) {X Y : FreeMonoidalCategory V} (g h : X ⟶ Y) :
    ((FreeMonoidalCategory.project (fun x => (⟨f x⟩ : Underlying R A))).map g).1 =
      ((FreeMonoidalCategory.project (fun x => (⟨f x⟩ : Underlying R A))).map h).1

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated2.hom2_injective
statement:
theorem hom2_injective {a b : B} {f g : a ⟶ b} :
    Function.Injective (hom2 (R := R) : (f ⟶ g) → (hom1 (R := R) f ⟶ hom1 g))
proof:
:= fun η θ h => by
  have h' : unitInv₂ (hom2U (R := R) η) = unitInv₂ (hom2U θ) :=
    congrArg unitInv₂ (Subtype.ext (Subtype.ext h))
  rwa [unitInv₂_hom2U, unitInv₂_hom2U] at h'

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated2.hom2_ofHom2
statement:
theorem hom2_ofHom2 {a b : B} {f g : a ⟶ b} (x : hom1 (R := R) f ⟶ hom1 g)
    (h0 : x ∈ GradedSupercategory.degree (R := R) _ _ 0) (he : x ∈ parity (R := R) _ _ 0) :
    hom2 (ofHom2 x h0 he) = x
proof:
:=
  congrArg (fun y => y.1.1) (hom2U_unitInv₂ (⟨⟨x, h0⟩, he⟩ : hom1U (R := R) f ⟶ hom1U g))

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated2.hom2_ofHom2'
statement:
theorem hom2_ofHom2' {a b : QAssociated2 R B} {f g : a ⟶ b} (x : f ⟶ g)
    (h0 : x ∈ GradedSupercategory.degree (R := R) _ _ 0) (he : x ∈ parity (R := R) _ _ 0) :
    hom2 (R := R) (ofHom2' x h0 he) = x
proof:
:=
  hom2_ofHom2 (a := a.obj.obj) (b := b.obj.obj) (f := f.obj.obj) (g := g.obj.obj) x h0 he

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated2.ofHom2_hom2
statement:
theorem ofHom2_hom2 {a b : B} {f g : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ g) :
    ofHom2 (hom2 (R := R) η) (hom2_mem_degree η) (hom2_mem η) = η

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated2.β_hom1
statement:
theorem β_hom1 {a b : B} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (PiTwoSupercategory.β (R := R) (hom1 (R := R) f)).hom =
      hom2 (PiTwoCategory.β (R := R) f).hom

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated2.γ_hom1
statement:
theorem γ_hom1 {a b : B} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (QPiTwoSupercategory.γ (R := R) (hom1 (R := R) f)).hom =
      hom2 (QPiTwoCategory.γ (R := R) f).hom

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoFunctor.mapQ_mapComp_inv
statement:
theorem mapQ_mapComp_inv {a b c : B} (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) :
    (hF.mapQ.mapComp (hom1 (R := R) f) (hom1 g)).inv = hom2 (F.mapComp f g).hom

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoFunctor.mapQ_mapId_inv
statement:
theorem mapQ_mapId_inv (a : B) :
    (hF.mapQ.mapId (⟨⟨a⟩⟩ : QAssociated2 R B)).inv = hom2 (F.mapId a).hom

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoFunctor.hom2_unmapQNatHom
statement:
theorem hom2_unmapQNatHom (θ : TwoNatTrans hF.mapQ hG.mapQ) (hθ : θ.IsGraded) {a b : B}
    (f : a ⟶ b) : hom2 (R := R) (unmapQNatHom hF hG θ hθ f) = θ.x (hom1 (R := R) f)

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoFunctor.x_id_mapQ
statement:
theorem x_id_mapQ (θ : TwoNatTrans hF.mapQ hG.mapQ) (a : B) :
    θ.x (𝟙 (⟨⟨a⟩⟩ : QAssociated2 R B)) ≫
        BicategoryStruct.whiskerLeft (θ.X ⟨⟨a⟩⟩) (hG.mapQ.mapId ⟨⟨a⟩⟩).inv =
      BicategoryStruct.whiskerRight (hF.mapQ.mapId ⟨⟨a⟩⟩).inv (θ.X ⟨⟨a⟩⟩) ≫
        (BicategoryStruct.leftUnitor (θ.X ⟨⟨a⟩⟩)).hom ≫
          (BicategoryStruct.rightUnitor (θ.X ⟨⟨a⟩⟩)).inv
proof:
:= by
  rw [θ.x_id_eq]
  simp only [Category.assoc, TwoSupercategory.whiskerLeft_hom_inv R, Category.comp_id]

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoFunctor.x_comp_mapQ
statement:
theorem x_comp_mapQ (θ : TwoNatTrans hF.mapQ hG.mapQ) {a b c : QAssociated2 R B} (f : a ⟶ b)
    (g : b ⟶ c) :
    θ.x (f ≫ g) ≫ BicategoryStruct.whiskerLeft (θ.X a) (hG.mapQ.mapComp f g).inv =
      BicategoryStruct.whiskerRight (hF.mapQ.mapComp f g).inv (θ.X c) ≫
        (BicategoryStruct.associator (hF.mapQ.map f) (hF.mapQ.map g) (θ.X c)).hom ≫
          BicategoryStruct.whiskerLeft (hF.mapQ.map f) (θ.x g) ≫
            (BicategoryStruct.associator (hF.mapQ.map f) (θ.X b) (hG.mapQ.map g)).inv ≫
              BicategoryStruct.whiskerRight (θ.x f) (hG.mapQ.map g) ≫
                (BicategoryStruct.associator (θ.X a) (hG.mapQ.map f) (hG.mapQ.map g)).hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [θ.x_comp_eq]
  simp only [Category.assoc, TwoSupercategory.whiskerLeft_hom_inv R, Category.comp_id]

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoFunctor.unmapQNat_naturality_eq
statement:
theorem unmapQNat_naturality_eq (θ : TwoNatTrans hF.mapQ hG.mapQ) (hθ : θ.IsGraded) {a b : B}
    (f : a ⟶ b) : (unmapQNat hF hG θ hθ).naturality f = unmapQNatHom hF hG θ hθ f

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoFunctor.isPiTwoNatural_mapQ
statement:
theorem isPiTwoNatural_mapQ (θ : TwoNatTrans hF.mapQ hG.mapQ) (a : B) :
    (PiTwoSupercategory.β (R := R) (θ.X (⟨⟨a⟩⟩ : QAssociated2 R B))).hom ≫
        BicategoryStruct.whiskerRight (hF.mapQ.jIso (⟨⟨a⟩⟩ : QAssociated2 R B)).hom
          (θ.X (⟨⟨a⟩⟩ : QAssociated2 R B)) ≫
          θ.x (PiTwoSupercategory.pi (R := R) (⟨⟨a⟩⟩ : QAssociated2 R B)) =
      BicategoryStruct.whiskerLeft (θ.X (⟨⟨a⟩⟩ : QAssociated2 R B))
        (hG.mapQ.jIso (⟨⟨a⟩⟩ : QAssociated2 R B)).hom
proof:
:=
  congrArg Subtype.val (θ.isPiTwoNatural (⟨⟨⟨a⟩⟩⟩ : Underlying2 R (QAssociated2 R B)))

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoFunctor.unmapQNat_isQPiTwoNatural
statement:
theorem unmapQNat_isQPiTwoNatural (θ : TwoNatTrans hF.mapQ hG.mapQ) (hθ : θ.IsGraded) :
    hF.IsQPiTwoNatural hG (unmapQNat hF hG θ hθ)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun a => ?_, fun a => ?_⟩
  · change (PiTwoCategory.β (R := R) (unmapQNatApp hF hG θ a)).hom ≫
        (hF.j a).hom ▷ unmapQNatApp hF hG θ a ≫ unmapQNatHom hF hG θ hθ (PiTwoCategory.pi R a) =
      unmapQNatApp hF hG θ a ◁ (hG.j a).hom
    apply hom2_injective (R := R)
    rw [hom2_comp, hom2_comp, hom2_whiskerRight, hom2_whiskerLeft,
      hom2_unmapQNatHom θ hθ, ← β_hom1,
      ← jIso_mapQ_hom, ← jIso_mapQ_hom]
    exact isPiTwoNatural_mapQ θ a
  · change (QPiTwoCategory.γ (R := R) (unmapQNatApp hF hG θ a)).hom ≫
        (hF.k a).hom ▷ unmapQNatApp hF hG θ a ≫ unmapQNatHom hF hG θ hθ (QPiTwoCategory.q R a) =
      unmapQNatApp hF hG θ a ◁ (hG.k a).hom
    apply hom2_injective (R := R)
    rw [hom2_comp, hom2_comp, hom2_whiskerRight, hom2_whiskerLeft,
      hom2_unmapQNatHom θ hθ, ← γ_hom1,
      ← kIso_mapQ_hom, ← kIso_mapQ_hom]
    exact θ.kNat (⟨⟨a⟩⟩ : QAssociated2 R B)

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoFunctor.mapQNat_unmapQNat
statement:
theorem mapQNat_unmapQNat (θ : TwoNatTrans hF.mapQ hG.mapQ) (hθ : θ.IsGraded) :
    mapQNat (unmapQNat_isQPiTwoNatural θ hθ) = θ
proof:
:= by
  refine TwoNatTrans.ext_of_eq rfl fun f => ?_
  simp only [eqToHom_refl, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]
  exact hom2_unmapQNatHom θ hθ f.obj.obj

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoFunctor.unmapQNat_mapQNat
proof:
:= by
  have h : ∀ {a b : B} (f : a ⟶ b),
      (unmapQNat hF hG (mapQNat hη) (mapQNat_isGraded hη)).naturality f = η.naturality f :=
    fun f => hom2_injective (R := R) (hom2_unmapQNatHom (mapQNat hη) (mapQNat_isGraded hη) f)
  obtain ⟨app, nat, _, _, _⟩ := η
  change Oplax.OplaxTrans.mk app _ _ _ _ = Oplax.OplaxTrans.mk app nat _ _ _
  congr
  funext a b f
  exact h f

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated2.T_map₂_mapQNat_x
statement:
theorem T_map₂_mapQNat_x {η : Oplax.OplaxTrans (F.toDegreeZero2 hF).toPseudofunctor.toOplax
      (G.toDegreeZero2 hG).toPseudofunctor.toOplax}
    (hη : (F.toQPiTwoFunctor hF).IsQPiTwoNatural (G.toQPiTwoFunctor hG) η)
    {a b : QAssociated2 R (GUnderlying2 R A)} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (T R A').map₂ ((QPiTwoFunctor.mapQNat hη).x f) = (η.naturality f.obj.obj).1.1
proof:
:= by
  rw [T_map₂, QPiTwoFunctor.mapQNat_x, Thom_ι_map, TF_map]
  simp [Associated2.T_map₂]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.ofDegreeZero2_isGraded
statement:
theorem ofDegreeZero2_isGraded (θ : TwoNatTrans (F.toDegreeZero2 hF) (G.toDegreeZero2 hG))
    (nat : ∀ {a b : A} {f g : a ⟶ b} (ε : f ⟶ g),
      F.map₂ ε ▷ (θ.X ⟨b⟩).obj ≫ (θ.x (⟨g⟩ : (⟨a⟩ : DegreeZero2 R A) ⟶ ⟨b⟩)).1 =
        (θ.x (⟨f⟩ : (⟨a⟩ : DegreeZero2 R A) ⟶ ⟨b⟩)).1 ≫ (θ.X ⟨a⟩).obj ◁ G.map₂ ε) :
    (ofDegreeZero2 θ nat).IsGraded

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.naturality_of_isQPiTwoNatural
statement:
theorem naturality_of_isQPiTwoNatural {η : Oplax.OplaxTrans
      (F.toDegreeZero2 hF).toPseudofunctor.toOplax (G.toDegreeZero2 hG).toPseudofunctor.toOplax}
    (hη : (F.toQPiTwoFunctor hF).IsQPiTwoNatural (G.toQPiTwoFunctor hG) η)
    {a b : A} {f g : a ⟶ b} (ε : f ⟶ g) :
    F.map₂ ε ▷ (η.app ⟨⟨b⟩⟩).obj.obj ≫
        (η.naturality (⟨⟨g⟩⟩ : (⟨⟨a⟩⟩ : GUnderlying2 R A) ⟶ ⟨⟨b⟩⟩)).1.1 =
      (η.naturality (⟨⟨f⟩⟩ : (⟨⟨a⟩⟩ : GUnderlying2 R A) ⟶ ⟨⟨b⟩⟩)).1.1 ≫
        (η.app ⟨⟨a⟩⟩).obj.obj ◁ G.map₂ ε
proof:
:= by
  have n := (QPiTwoFunctor.mapQNat hη).naturality (QAssociated2.tinv₂ R A ε)
  have e := congrArg (QAssociated2.T R A').map₂ n
  rw [(QAssociated2.T R A').map₂_comp, (QAssociated2.T R A').map₂_comp] at e
  rw [QAssociated2.T_map₂_whiskerRight, QAssociated2.T_map₂_whiskerLeft] at e
  rw [QAssociated2.T_map₂_mapQ, QAssociated2.T_map₂_mapQ, QAssociated2.T_map₂_tinv₂] at e
  rw [QAssociated2.T_map₂_mapQNat_x, QAssociated2.T_map₂_mapQNat_x] at e
  exact e

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.ofQPiTwoNatural_isGraded
statement:
theorem ofQPiTwoNatural_isGraded (η : Oplax.OplaxTrans
      (F.toDegreeZero2 hF).toPseudofunctor.toOplax (G.toDegreeZero2 hG).toPseudofunctor.toOplax)
    (hη : (F.toQPiTwoFunctor hF).IsQPiTwoNatural (G.toQPiTwoFunctor hG) η) :
    (ofQPiTwoNatural η hη).IsGraded

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.toOplaxTrans_ofQPiTwoNatural
statement:
theorem toOplaxTrans_ofQPiTwoNatural (η : Oplax.OplaxTrans
      (F.toDegreeZero2 hF).toPseudofunctor.toOplax (G.toDegreeZero2 hG).toPseudofunctor.toOplax)
    (hη : (F.toQPiTwoFunctor hF).IsQPiTwoNatural (G.toQPiTwoFunctor hG) η) :
    ((ofQPiTwoNatural η hη).toDegreeZero2 hF hG (ofQPiTwoNatural_isGraded η hη)).toOplaxTrans =
      η

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.ofQPiTwoNatural_toOplaxTrans
statement:
theorem ofQPiTwoNatural_toOplaxTrans (θ : TwoNatTrans F G) (hθ : θ.IsGraded) :
    ofQPiTwoNatural (θ.toDegreeZero2 hF hG hθ).toOplaxTrans (θ.isQPiTwoNatural hF hG hθ) = θ

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoCat.toQPiTwoGSCat_isTwoEquivalence
statement:
theorem toQPiTwoGSCat_isTwoEquivalence :
    (toQPiTwoGSCat : QPiTwoCat.{w, w₁, v₁, u₁} R ⥤ QPiTwoGSCat.{w, w₁, v₁, u₁} R).IsEquivalence ∧
      ∀ {B C : QPiTwoCat.{w, w₁, v₁, u₁} R} (P Q : B ⟶ C),
        Function.Bijective (fun η : { η : Oplax.OplaxTrans P.toPseudofunctor.toOplax
            Q.toPseudofunctor.toOplax // P.toQPiTwoFunctor.IsQPiTwoNatural Q.toQPiTwoFunctor η } =>
          (⟨QPiTwoFunctor.mapQNat η.2, QPiTwoFunctor.mapQNat_isGraded η.2⟩ :
            { θ : TwoNatTrans P.toQPiTwoFunctor.mapQ Q.toQPiTwoFunctor.mapQ // θ.IsGraded }))

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoGSCat.toQPiTwoCat_isTwoEquivalence
statement:
theorem toQPiTwoCat_isTwoEquivalence :
    (toQPiTwoCat : QPiTwoGSCat.{w, w₁, v₁, u₁} R ⥤ QPiTwoCat.{w, w₁, v₁, u₁} R).IsEquivalence ∧
      ∀ {A A' : QPiTwoGSCat.{w, w₁, v₁, u₁} R} (F G : A ⟶ A'),
        Function.Bijective (fun θ : { θ : TwoNatTrans F.1 G.1 // θ.IsGraded } =>
          (⟨(θ.1.toDegreeZero2 F.2 G.2 θ.2).toOplaxTrans, θ.1.isQPiTwoNatural F.2 G.2 θ.2⟩ :
            { η : Oplax.OplaxTrans (F.1.toDegreeZero2 F.2).toPseudofunctor.toOplax
                (G.1.toDegreeZero2 G.2).toPseudofunctor.toOplax //
              (F.1.toQPiTwoFunctor F.2).IsQPiTwoNatural (G.1.toQPiTwoFunctor G.2) η }))

name: StringDiagrams.LeftZigzag.unitLeg_X
statement: theorem unitLeg_X (a : A) : (unitLeg F G J).X a = F.map (J.X a)

name: StringDiagrams.LeftZigzag.counitLeg_X
statement: theorem counitLeg_X (a : A) : (counitLeg F G E).X a = E.X (F.obj a)

name: StringDiagrams.LeftZigzag.zigzag_X
statement: theorem zigzag_X (a : A) : (zigzag F G J E).X a = F.map (J.X a) ≫ E.X (F.obj a)
proof:
:= by
  change (unitLeg F G J).X a ≫ (counitLeg F G E).X a = _
  rw [unitLeg_X, counitLeg_X]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.LeftZigzag.unitLeg_x
statement:
theorem unitLeg_x {a b : A} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    HEq ((unitLeg F G J).x f) (TwoNatTrans.postcomposeCell F J f)
proof:
:=
  TwoNatTrans.rebase_x (TwoSuperfunctor.id_comp F)
    (TwoSuperfunctor.comp_assoc F G F) (TwoNatTrans.postcompose F J) f

name: StringDiagrams.LeftZigzag.counitLeg_x
statement:
theorem counitLeg_x {a b : A} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    HEq ((counitLeg F G E).x f) (E.x (F.map f))
proof:
:=
  TwoNatTrans.rebase_x rfl (TwoSuperfunctor.comp_id F) (TwoNatTrans.precompose F E) f

name: StringDiagrams.RightZigzag.unitLeg_X
statement: theorem unitLeg_X (b : B) : (unitLeg F G J).X b = J.X (G.obj b)

name: StringDiagrams.RightZigzag.counitLeg_X
statement: theorem counitLeg_X (b : B) : (counitLeg F G E).X b = G.map (E.X b)

name: StringDiagrams.RightZigzag.zigzag_X
statement: theorem zigzag_X (b : B) : (zigzag F G J E).X b = J.X (G.obj b) ≫ G.map (E.X b)
proof:
:= by
  change (unitLeg F G J).X b ≫ (counitLeg F G E).X b = _
  rw [unitLeg_X, counitLeg_X]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.isStrongOplax_id
statement: theorem isStrongOplax_id (F : C ⥤ᵒᵖᴸ C) : IsStrongOplax (𝟙 F)
proof:
:= fun f => by
  change IsIso ((Bicategory.rightUnitor (F.map f)).hom ≫ (Bicategory.leftUnitor (F.map f)).inv)
  infer_instance

name: StringDiagrams.IsStrongOplax.comp
statement:
theorem IsStrongOplax.comp {F G H : C ⥤ᵒᵖᴸ C} {η : F ⟶ G} {θ : G ⟶ H} (hη : IsStrongOplax η)
    (hθ : IsStrongOplax θ) : IsStrongOplax (η ≫ θ)
proof:
:= fun {a b} f => by
  have := hη f
  have := hθ f
  change IsIso ((Bicategory.associator (F.map f) (η.app b) (θ.app b)).inv ≫
    Bicategory.whiskerRight (η.naturality f) (θ.app b) ≫
    (Bicategory.associator (η.app a) (G.map f) (θ.app b)).hom ≫
      Bicategory.whiskerLeft (η.app a) (θ.naturality f) ≫
      (Bicategory.associator (η.app a) (θ.app a) (H.map f)).inv)
  infer_instance

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.id_toPiTwoFunctor_j_hom
statement:
theorem id_toPiTwoFunctor_j_hom (a : Underlying2 R B) :
    ((TwoSuperfunctor.id R B).toPiTwoFunctor.j a).hom = 𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.isPiTwoNatural_id_iff
statement:
theorem isPiTwoNatural_id_iff (η : idU R B ⟶ idU R B) :
    (PiTwoFunctor.id R (Underlying2 R B)).IsPiTwoNatural (PiTwoFunctor.id R _) η ↔
      (TwoSuperfunctor.id R B).toPiTwoFunctor.IsPiTwoNatural
        (TwoSuperfunctor.id R B).toPiTwoFunctor η
proof:
:= by
  refine forall_congr' fun a => ?_
  rw [id_toPiTwoFunctor_j_hom, PiTwoFunctor.id_j, Iso.refl_hom]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.isPiTwoNatural_toOplax

theorem isPiTwoNatural_toOplax (θ : EndId R B) :

name: StringDiagrams.DrinfeldCenter.toOplax_isStrong
statement: theorem toOplax_isStrong (X : DrinfeldCenter R B) : IsStrongOplax X.toTwoNatTrans.toOplax
proof:
:=
  fun {a b} f => by
    have := X.isStrong f.obj
    let Xa : a.obj ⟶ a.obj := X.toTwoNatTrans.X a.obj
    let Xb : b.obj ⟶ b.obj := X.toTwoNatTrans.X b.obj
    let e : f.obj ≫ Xb ≅ Xa ≫ f.obj := asIso (X.toTwoNatTrans.x f.obj)
    have hm : e.hom ∈ parity (R := R) (f.obj ≫ Xb) (Xa ≫ f.obj) 0 :=
      X.toTwoNatTrans.x_mem f.obj
    exact ⟨⟨⟨e.inv, Supercategory.inv_mem (R := R) (C := a.obj ⟶ b.obj) e hm⟩,
      Subtype.ext e.hom_inv_id, Subtype.ext e.inv_hom_id⟩⟩

name: StringDiagrams.PreadditiveBicategory.whiskerLeft_neg

theorem whiskerLeft_neg {a b c : B} (f : a ⟶ b) {g h : b ⟶ c} (η : g ⟶ h) :

statement:
theorem neg_whiskerRight {a b c : B} {f g : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ g) (h : b ⟶ c) :

name: StringDiagrams.PreadditiveBicategory.whiskerLeft_zero
statement:

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoCategory.β_inv_naturality
statement:
theorem β_inv_naturality {a b : B} {f g : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ g) :
    𝛑 a ◁ η ≫ (𝛃 g).inv = (𝛃 f).inv ≫ η ▷ 𝛑 b
proof:
:= by
  rw [Iso.eq_inv_comp, ← Category.assoc, β_naturality, Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id,
    Category.comp_id]

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoCategory.β_pi_inv
statement: theorem β_pi_inv (a : B) : (𝛃 (𝛑 a)).inv = -𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cancel_epi (𝛃 (𝛑 a)).hom, Iso.hom_inv_id, β_pi]
  simp

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoCategory.whiskerLeft_ξ_pi
statement:
theorem whiskerLeft_ξ_pi (a : B) :
    𝛑 a ◁ (𝛏 a).hom ≫ (ρ_ (𝛑 a)).hom =
      (α_ (𝛑 a) (𝛑 a) (𝛑 a)).inv ≫ (𝛏 a).hom ▷ 𝛑 a ≫ (λ_ (𝛑 a)).hom
proof:
:= by
  have h := ξ_comm (R := R) (𝛑 a)
  rw [β_pi, PreadditiveBicategory.neg_whiskerRight, PreadditiveBicategory.whiskerLeft_neg] at h
  simp only [Bicategory.id_whiskerRight, Bicategory.whiskerLeft_id, Preadditive.neg_comp,
    Preadditive.comp_neg, neg_neg, Category.id_comp,
    Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc] at h
  rw [← h]
  simp [← Bicategory.comp_whiskerRight_assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoCategory.ξHom_hom
statement:
theorem ξHom_hom {a b : B} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (ξHom (R := R) f).hom = (α_ f (𝛑 b) (𝛑 b)).hom ≫ f ◁ (𝛏 b).hom ≫ (ρ_ f).hom

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoCategory.ξHom_inv
statement:
theorem ξHom_inv {a b : B} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (ξHom (R := R) f).inv = (ρ_ f).inv ≫ f ◁ (𝛏 b).inv ≫ (α_ f (𝛑 b) (𝛑 b)).inv

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoCategory.ξHom_naturality
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem ξHom_naturality {a b : B} {f g : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ g) :
    η ▷ 𝛑 b ▷ 𝛑 b ≫ (ξHom (R := R) g).hom = (ξHom (R := R) f).hom ≫ η
proof:
:= by
  rw [ξHom_hom, ξHom_hom, associator_naturality_left_assoc, ← whisker_exchange_assoc,
    rightUnitor_naturality]
  simp only [Category.assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoCategory.ξHom_pi
statement:
theorem ξHom_pi {a b : B} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (ξHom (R := R) (f ≫ 𝛑 b)).hom = (ξHom (R := R) f).hom ▷ 𝛑 b
proof:
:= by
  have key : (f ≫ 𝛑 b) ◁ (𝛏 b).hom ≫ (ρ_ (f ≫ 𝛑 b)).hom =
      (α_ f (𝛑 b) (𝛑 b ≫ 𝛑 b)).hom ≫ f ◁ (𝛑 b ◁ (𝛏 b).hom ≫ (ρ_ (𝛑 b)).hom) := by bicategory
  rw [ξHom_hom, ξHom_hom, key, whiskerLeft_ξ_pi]
  bicategory

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoCategory.pi_obj
statement: @[simp] theorem pi_obj {a b : B} (f : a ⟶ b) : (PiCategory.pi (R := R)).obj f = f ≫ 𝛑 b

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.jIso_hom
statement:
theorem jIso_hom (a : A) :
    (F.jIso a).hom = (𝛇 (F.obj a)).hom ≫ (F.mapId a).hom ≫ F.map₂ (𝛇 a).inv

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.jIso_hom_mem
statement:
theorem jIso_hom_mem (a : A) :
    (F.jIso a).hom ∈ Supercategory.parity (R := R) (𝛑 (F.obj a)) (F.map (𝛑 a)) 0
proof:
:= by
  have := Supercategory.comp_mem (Supercategory.comp_mem
    (PiTwoSupercategory.ζ_hom_mem (R := R) (F.obj a)) (F.mapId_hom_mem a))
    (F.map₂_mem (PiTwoSupercategory.ζ_inv_mem (R := R) a))
  simpa [jIso_hom] using! this

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.jIso_hom_comp_map₂_ζ
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem jIso_hom_comp_map₂_ζ (a : A) :
    (F.jIso a).hom ≫ F.map₂ (𝛇 a).hom = (𝛇 (F.obj a)).hom ≫ (F.mapId a).hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [jIso_hom, Category.assoc, Category.assoc, ← F.map₂_comp, Iso.inv_hom_id, F.map₂_id,
    Category.comp_id]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.mapId_hom_comp_map₂_ζ_inv
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem mapId_hom_comp_map₂_ζ_inv (a : A) :
    (F.mapId a).hom ≫ F.map₂ (𝛇 a).inv = (𝛇 (F.obj a)).inv ≫ (F.jIso a).hom

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.jβ_comm
statement:
theorem jβ_comm {a b : A} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    F.map f ◁ (F.jIso b).hom ≫ (F.mapComp f (𝛑 b)).hom ≫
        F.map₂ (PiTwoSupercategory.β (R := R) f).hom =
      (PiTwoSupercategory.β (R := R) (F.map f)).hom ≫ (F.jIso a).hom ▷ F.map f ≫
        (F.mapComp (𝛑 a) f).hom
proof:
:= by
  have hl := F.map₂_leftUnitor f
  have hr := F.map₂_rightUnitor f
  rw [PiTwoSupercategory.β_hom, PiTwoSupercategory.β_hom, F.map₂_comp, F.map₂_comp,
    F.map₂_comp]
  rw [← reassoc_of% (F.mapComp_naturality_right f (𝛇 b).hom), ← whiskerLeft_comp'_assoc R,
    jIso_hom_comp_map₂_ζ, whiskerLeft_comp'_assoc R]
  have e1 : F.map f ◁ (F.mapId b).hom ≫ (F.mapComp f (𝟙 b)).hom ≫
      F.map₂ (rightUnitor f).hom = (rightUnitor (F.map f)).hom := hr
  have e2' : (leftUnitor (F.map f)).hom ≫ F.map₂ (leftUnitor f).inv =
      (F.mapId a).hom ▷ F.map f ≫ (F.mapComp (𝟙 a) f).hom := by
    rw [← hl]
    simp only [Category.assoc]
    rw [← F.map₂_comp, Iso.hom_inv_id, F.map₂_id, Category.comp_id]
  have e2 : F.map₂ (leftUnitor f).inv = (leftUnitor (F.map f)).inv ≫
      (F.mapId a).hom ▷ F.map f ≫ (F.mapComp (𝟙 a) f).hom := by
    rw [← e2', Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
  rw [reassoc_of% e1, e2]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [← F.mapComp_naturality_left, ← comp_whiskerRight'_assoc R, mapId_hom_comp_map₂_ζ_inv,
    comp_whiskerRight'_assoc R]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.jξ_comm
statement:
theorem jξ_comm (a : A) :
    (F.jIso a).hom ▷ 𝛑 (F.obj a) ≫ F.map (𝛑 a) ◁ (F.jIso a).hom ≫
        (F.mapComp (𝛑 a) (𝛑 a)).hom ≫ F.map₂ (PiTwoSupercategory.ξ (R := R) a).hom =
      (PiTwoSupercategory.ξ (R := R) (F.obj a)).hom ≫ (F.mapId a).hom
proof:
:= by
  have hl := F.map₂_leftUnitor (𝛑 a)
  have hj := F.jIso_hom_mem a
  rw [PiTwoSupercategory.ξ_hom, PiTwoSupercategory.ξ_hom, F.map₂_comp, F.map₂_comp]
  rw [← reassoc_of% (F.mapComp_naturality_left (𝛇 a).hom (𝛑 a))]
  have e1 : (F.mapComp (𝟙 a) (𝛑 a)).hom ≫ F.map₂ (leftUnitor (𝛑 a)).hom =
      (F.mapId a).inv ▷ F.map (𝛑 a) ≫ (leftUnitor (F.map (𝛑 a))).hom := by
    rw [← hl, ← comp_whiskerRight'_assoc R, Iso.inv_hom_id, id_whiskerRight (R := R),
      Category.id_comp]
  rw [reassoc_of% e1, ← whisker_exchange_of_even_right_assoc _ hj,
    ← comp_whiskerRight'_assoc R, jIso_hom_comp_map₂_ζ, comp_whiskerRight'_assoc R,
    whisker_exchange_of_even_left_assoc (F.mapId_hom_mem a), TwoSupercategory.hom_inv_whiskerRight_assoc R,
    TwoSupercategory.leftUnitor_naturality_assoc R, jIso_hom_comp_map₂_ζ]
  simp only [Category.assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.toPiTwoFunctor_j_hom_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem toPiTwoFunctor_j_hom_val (a : Underlying2 R A) :
    (F.toPiTwoFunctor.j a).hom.1 = (F.jIso a.obj).hom

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.isPiTwoNatural
statement:
theorem isPiTwoNatural :
    F.toPiTwoFunctor.IsPiTwoNatural G.toPiTwoFunctor θ.toOplaxTrans
proof:
:= fun a => Subtype.ext (by
  change (PiTwoSupercategory.β (R := R) (θ.X a.obj)).hom ≫ (F.jIso a.obj).hom ▷ θ.X a.obj ≫
    θ.x (𝛑 a.obj) = θ.X a.obj ◁ (G.jIso a.obj).hom
  have hn := θ.naturality (𝛇 a.obj).inv
  have hid := θ.x_id a.obj
  rw [TwoSuperfunctor.jIso_hom, comp_whiskerRight'_assoc R, comp_whiskerRight'_assoc R, hn,
    PiTwoSupercategory.β_hom_comp_ζ_assoc]
  rw [reassoc_of% hid, TwoSuperfunctor.jIso_hom, whiskerLeft_comp' R, whiskerLeft_comp' R])

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.ofOplax_X
statement:
@[simp] theorem ofOplax_X (η : idU R B ⟶ idU R B) (nat) (a : B) :

statement:

name: StringDiagrams.DrinfeldCenter.comp_app
statement: @[simp] theorem comp_app (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (a : B) : (f ≫ g).app a = f.app a ≫ g.app a

name: StringDiagrams.DrinfeldCenter.mem_parity_iff
statement:
theorem mem_parity_iff {p : ZMod 2} {f : X ⟶ Y} :
    f ∈ parity (R := R) X Y p ↔
      ∀ a, f.app a ∈ parity (R := R) (X.toTwoNatTrans.X a) (Y.toTwoNatTrans.X a) p

name: StringDiagrams.DrinfeldCenter.tensorObj_X
statement:
@[simp] theorem tensorObj_X (X Y : DrinfeldCenter R B) (a : B) :
    (tensorObj X Y).toTwoNatTrans.X a = Y.toTwoNatTrans.X a ≫ X.toTwoNatTrans.X a

name: StringDiagrams.DrinfeldCenter.tensorObj_x
statement:
theorem tensorObj_x (X Y : DrinfeldCenter R B) {a b : B} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (tensorObj X Y).toTwoNatTrans.x f =
      (associator f (Y.toTwoNatTrans.X b) (X.toTwoNatTrans.X b)).inv ≫
        Y.toTwoNatTrans.x f ▷ X.toTwoNatTrans.X b ≫
          (associator (Y.toTwoNatTrans.X a) f (X.toTwoNatTrans.X b)).hom ≫
            Y.toTwoNatTrans.X a ◁ X.toTwoNatTrans.x f ≫
              (associator (Y.toTwoNatTrans.X a) (X.toTwoNatTrans.X a) f).inv

name: StringDiagrams.DrinfeldCenter.tensorUnit_X
statement: @[simp] theorem tensorUnit_X (a : B) : (tensorUnit R B).toTwoNatTrans.X a = 𝟙 a

name: StringDiagrams.DrinfeldCenter.tensorUnit_x
statement:
theorem tensorUnit_x {a b : B} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (tensorUnit R B).toTwoNatTrans.x f = (rightUnitor f).hom ≫ (leftUnitor f).inv

name: StringDiagrams.DrinfeldCenter.whiskerLeft_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem whiskerLeft_app (X : DrinfeldCenter R B) {Y Y' : DrinfeldCenter R B}
    (β : Y ⟶ Y') (a : B) : (whiskerLeft X β).app a = β.app a ▷ X.toTwoNatTrans.X a

name: StringDiagrams.DrinfeldCenter.whiskerRight_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem whiskerRight_app {X X' : DrinfeldCenter R B} (α : X ⟶ X')
    (Y : DrinfeldCenter R B) (a : B) :
    (whiskerRight α Y).app a = Y.toTwoNatTrans.X a ◁ α.app a

name: StringDiagrams.DrinfeldCenter.associator_hom_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem associator_hom_app (X Y Z : DrinfeldCenter R B) (a : B) :
    (associator X Y Z).hom.app a =
      (BicategoryStruct.associator (Z.toTwoNatTrans.X a) (Y.toTwoNatTrans.X a)
        (X.toTwoNatTrans.X a)).inv

name: StringDiagrams.DrinfeldCenter.associator_inv_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem associator_inv_app (X Y Z : DrinfeldCenter R B) (a : B) :
    (associator X Y Z).inv.app a =
      (BicategoryStruct.associator (Z.toTwoNatTrans.X a) (Y.toTwoNatTrans.X a)
        (X.toTwoNatTrans.X a)).hom

name: StringDiagrams.DrinfeldCenter.leftUnitor_hom_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem leftUnitor_hom_app (X : DrinfeldCenter R B) (a : B) :
    (leftUnitor X).hom.app a = (BicategoryStruct.rightUnitor (X.toTwoNatTrans.X a)).hom

name: StringDiagrams.DrinfeldCenter.leftUnitor_inv_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem leftUnitor_inv_app (X : DrinfeldCenter R B) (a : B) :
    (leftUnitor X).inv.app a = (BicategoryStruct.rightUnitor (X.toTwoNatTrans.X a)).inv

name: StringDiagrams.DrinfeldCenter.rightUnitor_hom_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem rightUnitor_hom_app (X : DrinfeldCenter R B) (a : B) :
    (rightUnitor X).hom.app a = (BicategoryStruct.leftUnitor (X.toTwoNatTrans.X a)).hom

name: StringDiagrams.DrinfeldCenter.rightUnitor_inv_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem rightUnitor_inv_app (X : DrinfeldCenter R B) (a : B) :
    (rightUnitor X).inv.app a = (BicategoryStruct.leftUnitor (X.toTwoNatTrans.X a)).inv

name: StringDiagrams.DrinfeldCenter.tensor_X
statement:
@[simp] theorem tensor_X (X Y : DrinfeldCenter R B) (a : B) :
    (X ⊗ Y).toTwoNatTrans.X a = Y.toTwoNatTrans.X a ≫ X.toTwoNatTrans.X a

name: StringDiagrams.DrinfeldCenter.unit_X
statement: @[simp] theorem unit_X (a : B) : (𝟙_ (DrinfeldCenter R B)).toTwoNatTrans.X a = 𝟙 a

name: StringDiagrams.DrinfeldCenter.mwhiskerLeft_app
StringDiagrams.DrinfeldCenter.mwhiskerRight_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem mwhiskerRight_app {X X' : DrinfeldCenter R B} (α : X ⟶ X')
    (Y : DrinfeldCenter R B) (a : B) :
    (MonoidalCategoryStruct.whiskerRight α Y).app a = Y.toTwoNatTrans.X a ◁ α.app a

name: StringDiagrams.DrinfeldCenter.tensorHom_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem tensorHom_app {X₁ Y₁ X₂ Y₂ : DrinfeldCenter R B} (f : X₁ ⟶ Y₁) (g : X₂ ⟶ Y₂)
    (a : B) : (f ⊗ₘ g).app a =
      X₂.toTwoNatTrans.X a ◁ f.app a ≫ g.app a ▷ Y₁.toTwoNatTrans.X a

name: StringDiagrams.DrinfeldCenter.massociator_hom_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem massociator_hom_app (X Y Z : DrinfeldCenter R B) (a : B) :

name: StringDiagrams.DrinfeldCenter.massociator_inv_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem massociator_inv_app (X Y Z : DrinfeldCenter R B) (a : B) :
    (α_ X Y Z).inv.app a =
      (BicategoryStruct.associator (Z.toTwoNatTrans.X a) (Y.toTwoNatTrans.X a)
        (X.toTwoNatTrans.X a)).hom

name: StringDiagrams.DrinfeldCenter.mleftUnitor_hom_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem mleftUnitor_hom_app (X : DrinfeldCenter R B) (a : B) :

name: StringDiagrams.DrinfeldCenter.mrightUnitor_hom_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem mrightUnitor_hom_app (X : DrinfeldCenter R B) (a : B) :

name: StringDiagrams.DrinfeldCenter.zsmul_app
statement: @[simp] theorem zsmul_app (n : ℤ) (f : X ⟶ Y) (a : B) : (n • f).app a = n • f.app a

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoSupercategory.centerObj_X
statement: @[simp] theorem centerObj_X (a : B) : (centerObj R B).toTwoNatTrans.X a = pi (R := R) a

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoSupercategory.centerObj_x
statement:
@[simp] theorem centerObj_x {a b : B} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (centerObj R B).toTwoNatTrans.x f = (β (R := R) f).hom

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoSupercategory.centerζ_hom_mem
statement:
theorem centerζ_hom_mem :
    (centerζ R B).hom ∈ parity (R := R) (centerObj R B) (𝟙_ (DrinfeldCenter R B)) 1

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoSupercategory.centerξ_hom_mem
statement:
theorem centerξ_hom_mem :
    (centerξ R B).hom ∈
      parity (R := R) (centerObj R B ⊗ centerObj R B) (𝟙_ (DrinfeldCenter R B)) 0

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoSupercategory.centerξ_hom_eq
statement:
theorem centerξ_hom_eq :
    (centerξ R B).hom = MonoidalSupercategory.superTensorHom (centerζ R B).hom (centerζ R B).hom ≫
      (λ_ (𝟙_ (DrinfeldCenter R B))).hom
proof:
:=
  hom_ext fun a => by
    change (ξ (R := R) a).hom = ((ζ (R := R) a).hom ▷ pi (R := R) a ≫
      𝟙 a ◁ (ζ (R := R) a).hom) ≫ (BicategoryStruct.rightUnitor (𝟙 a)).hom
    rw [ξ_hom_eq_hcomp, hcomp, unitors_equal R, Category.assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.DrinfeldCenter.ext_of_eq
statement:
theorem ext_of_eq {P Q : DrinfeldCenter R B} (hX : P.toTwoNatTrans.X = Q.toTwoNatTrans.X)
    (hx : ∀ {a b : B} (f : a ⟶ b), P.toTwoNatTrans.x f =
      eqToHom (by rw [hX]) ≫ Q.toTwoNatTrans.x f ≫ eqToHom (by rw [hX])) :
    P = Q
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨X, x, _, _, _, _⟩, _⟩ := P
  obtain ⟨⟨X', x', _, _, _, _⟩, _⟩ := Q
  dsimp only at hX
  subst hX
  simp only [eqToHom_refl, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp] at hx
  congr
  funext a b f
  exact hx f

name: StringDiagrams.DrinfeldCenter.eqToHom_app
statement:
theorem eqToHom_app {P Q : DrinfeldCenter R B} (h : P = Q) (a : B) :
    (eqToHom h : P ⟶ Q).app a = eqToHom (by rw [h])

name: StringDiagrams.DrinfeldCenter.tensor_assoc
statement:
theorem tensor_assoc (X Y Z : DrinfeldCenter R B) :
    tensorObj (tensorObj X Y) Z = tensorObj X (tensorObj Y Z)
proof:
:= by
  refine ext_of_eq (funext fun a => (Strict.assoc _ _ _).symm) fun {a b} f => ?_
  simp only [tensorObj_x, tensorObj_X, whiskerLeft_comp' R, comp_whiskerRight' R,
    whiskerRight_comp (R := R), TwoSuperfunctor.id_map, TwoSuperfunctor.id_obj,
    whisker_assoc (R := R), comp_whiskerLeft (R := R), Strict.associator_eqToIso, eqToIso.hom,
    eqToIso.inv, whiskerLeft_eqToHom R, eqToHom_whiskerRight R, Category.assoc, eqToHom_trans,
    eqToHom_trans_assoc]
  erw [eqToHom_trans_assoc, eqToHom_trans]

name: StringDiagrams.DrinfeldCenter.unit_tensor
statement: theorem unit_tensor (X : DrinfeldCenter R B) : tensorObj (tensorUnit R B) X = X
proof:
:= by
  refine ext_of_eq (funext fun a => Strict.comp_id _) fun {a b} f => ?_
  simp only [tensorObj_x, tensorUnit_x, tensorUnit_X, whiskerRight_id (R := R),
    Strict.associator_eqToIso, Strict.leftUnitor_eqToIso, Strict.rightUnitor_eqToIso,
    eqToIso.hom, eqToIso.inv, whiskerLeft_eqToHom R, Category.assoc, eqToHom_trans,
    eqToHom_trans_assoc]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.DrinfeldCenter.tensor_unit
statement: theorem tensor_unit (X : DrinfeldCenter R B) : tensorObj X (tensorUnit R B) = X
proof:
:= by
  refine ext_of_eq (funext fun a => Strict.id_comp _) fun {a b} f => ?_
  simp only [tensorObj_x, tensorUnit_x, tensorUnit_X, id_whiskerLeft (R := R),
    Strict.associator_eqToIso, Strict.leftUnitor_eqToIso, Strict.rightUnitor_eqToIso,
    eqToIso.hom, eqToIso.inv, eqToHom_whiskerRight R, Category.assoc, eqToHom_trans,
    eqToHom_trans_assoc]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.Codisc.trans_X
statement: @[simp] theorem trans_X (m : M) (a : Codisc M) : ((trans (R := R) m).X a).val = m

name: StringDiagrams.Codisc.trans_isStrong
statement: theorem trans_isStrong (m : M) : (trans (R := R) m).IsStrong

name: StringDiagrams.Codisc.trans_x_mem
statement:
theorem trans_x_mem (m : M) {a b : Codisc M} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (trans (R := R) m).x f ∈ parity (R := R) _ _ 0

name: StringDiagrams.Codisc.whisker_composites_X
statement:
theorem whisker_composites_X (m n : M) (a : Codisc M) :
    (((TwoNatTrans.postcompose (TwoSuperfunctor.id R (Codisc M)) (trans (R := R) m)).vcomp
        (TwoNatTrans.precompose (TwoSuperfunctor.id R (Codisc M)) (trans (R := R) n))).X a).val =
        m * n ∧
      (((TwoNatTrans.precompose (TwoSuperfunctor.id R (Codisc M)) (trans (R := R) n)).vcomp
        (TwoNatTrans.postcompose (TwoSuperfunctor.id R (Codisc M)) (trans (R := R) m))).X a).val =
        n * m

name: StringDiagrams.Codisc.whisker_composites_ne
statement:
theorem whisker_composites_ne {m n : M} (h : m * n ≠ n * m) :
    (TwoNatTrans.postcompose (TwoSuperfunctor.id R (Codisc M)) (trans (R := R) m)).vcomp
        (TwoNatTrans.precompose (TwoSuperfunctor.id R (Codisc M)) (trans (R := R) n)) ≠
      (TwoNatTrans.precompose (TwoSuperfunctor.id R (Codisc M)) (trans (R := R) n)).vcomp
        (TwoNatTrans.postcompose (TwoSuperfunctor.id R (Codisc M)) (trans (R := R) m))
proof:
:= by
  intro e
  have h' := congrArg (fun θ => (θ.X Codisc.pt).val) e
  rw [(whisker_composites_X m n Codisc.pt).1, (whisker_composites_X m n Codisc.pt).2] at h'
  exact h h'

name: StringDiagrams.Codisc.interchange_fails
statement:
theorem interchange_fails :
    ∃ X Y : TwoNatTrans (TwoSuperfunctor.id R (Codisc (Equiv.Perm (Fin 3))))
        (TwoSuperfunctor.id R (Codisc (Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)))),
      X.IsStrong ∧ Y.IsStrong ∧
        (TwoNatTrans.postcompose (TwoSuperfunctor.id R _) X).vcomp
            (TwoNatTrans.precompose (TwoSuperfunctor.id R _) Y) ≠
          (TwoNatTrans.precompose (TwoSuperfunctor.id R _) Y).vcomp
            (TwoNatTrans.postcompose (TwoSuperfunctor.id R _) X)

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.parity_id
statement: theorem parity_id (X : C) : IsHomogeneous (R := R) (𝟙 X) 0

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.parity_comp
StringDiagrams.Supercategory.zero_isHomogeneous
statement: theorem zero_isHomogeneous {X Y : C} (p : ZMod 2) : IsHomogeneous (R := R) (0 : X ⟶ Y) p

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.IsHomogeneous.add
statement:
theorem IsHomogeneous.add {X Y : C} {p : ZMod 2} {f g : X ⟶ Y} (hf : IsHomogeneous (R := R) f p)
    (hg : IsHomogeneous (R := R) g p) : IsHomogeneous (R := R) (f + g) p

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.IsHomogeneous.smul
statement:
theorem IsHomogeneous.smul {X Y : C} {p : ZMod 2} {f : X ⟶ Y} (r : R)
    (hf : IsHomogeneous (R := R) f p) : IsHomogeneous (R := R) (r • f) p

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.IsHomogeneous.neg
statement:
theorem IsHomogeneous.neg {X Y : C} {p : ZMod 2} {f : X ⟶ Y} (hf : IsHomogeneous (R := R) f p) :
    IsHomogeneous (R := R) (-f) p

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.supercategory_parity
statement:
theorem supercategory_parity (hP : P.IsParityHomogeneous) (a b : Obj S) (p : ZMod 2) :
    letI := P.supercategory hP
    Supercategory.parity (R := R) (P.obj a) (P.obj b) p = P.homDeg (parityDeg S) a b p

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.diag_isHomogeneous
statement:
theorem diag_isHomogeneous (hP : P.IsParityHomogeneous) {a b : Obj S} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    letI := P.supercategory hP
    Supercategory.IsHomogeneous (R := R) (P.diag f) (Diagram.degree (parityDeg S) f)

name: StringDiagrams.CoveringLaurent.pi_sq
statement: @[simp] theorem pi_sq : pi * pi = 1

name: StringDiagrams.CoveringLaurent.eval_pi
statement: @[simp] theorem eval_pi (e : ℤ) (he : e * e = 1) : eval e he pi = C e
proof:
:= by
  change AddMonoidAlgebra.mapRingHom ℤ (Zπ.eval e he)
    (AddMonoidAlgebra.single 0 Zπ.π) = AddMonoidAlgebra.single 0 e
  rw [AddMonoidAlgebra.mapRingHom_single, Zπ.eval_π]

name: StringDiagrams.CoveringLaurent.eval_inclusion
statement:
@[simp] theorem eval_inclusion (e : ℤ) (he : e * e = 1) (a : R) :
    eval e he (inclusion a) = a

name: StringDiagrams.CoveringLaurent.exists_pair
statement: theorem exists_pair (z : S) : ∃ a b : R, z = inclusion a + inclusion b * pi
proof:
:= by
  induction z using AddMonoidAlgebra.induction_linear with
  | zero => exact ⟨0, 0, by simp⟩
  | add x y hx hy =>
    obtain ⟨a, b, rfl⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨c, d, rfl⟩ := hy
    exact ⟨a + c, b + d, by simp only [map_add]; ring⟩
  | single n x =>
    obtain ⟨a, b, rfl⟩ := Zπ.exists_eq_add_mul_π x
    refine ⟨C a * T n, C b * T n, ?_⟩
    simp only [← single_eq_C_mul_T, inclusion, AddMonoidAlgebra.mapRingHom_single]
    change AddMonoidAlgebra.single n ((a : Zπ) + b * Zπ.π) =
      AddMonoidAlgebra.single n (a : Zπ) +
      AddMonoidAlgebra.single n (b : Zπ) * AddMonoidAlgebra.single 0 Zπ.π
    rw [AddMonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single, add_zero, ← AddMonoidAlgebra.single_add]

name: StringDiagrams.CoveringLaurent.pair_injective
proof:
:= by
  have hp := congrArg (eval 1 (by norm_num)) h
  have hm := congrArg (eval (-1) (by norm_num)) h
  simp only [map_add, map_mul, eval_inclusion, eval_pi, map_one, mul_one] at hp
  simp only [map_add, map_mul, eval_inclusion, eval_pi, map_neg, map_one, mul_neg,
    mul_one] at hm
  constructor <;> ext n
  all_goals
    have h₁ := congrArg (fun z : R => z.coeff n) hp
    have h₂ := congrArg (fun z : R => z.coeff n) hm
    change a.coeff n + b.coeff n = c.coeff n + d.coeff n at h₁
    change a.coeff n + -(b.coeff n) = c.coeff n + -(d.coeff n) at h₂
    omega

name: StringDiagrams.CoveringLaurent.augmentation_ker
statement: theorem augmentation_ker : RingHom.ker augmentation = Ideal.span ({pi - 1} : Set S)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro z hz
    change augmentation z = 0 at hz
    obtain ⟨a, b, rfl⟩ := exists_pair z
    have hab : a + b = 0 := by simpa only [map_add, map_mul, eval_inclusion,
      eval_pi, map_one, mul_one] using hz
    have ha : a = -b := eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left hab
    apply Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.2
    refine ⟨inclusion b, ?_⟩
    rw [ha, map_neg]
    ring
  · apply Ideal.span_le.2
    intro z hz
    obtain rfl : z = pi - 1 := hz
    change augmentation (pi - 1) = 0
    simp only [map_sub, eval_pi, map_one, sub_self]

name: StringDiagrams.CoveringLaurent.quotientEval_bijective
statement: theorem quotientEval_bijective : Function.Bijective quotientEval
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro x y h
    apply sub_eq_zero.mp
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective (x - y)
    rw [← hz]
    apply Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.2
    rw [← augmentation_ker]
    change augmentation z = 0
    change quotientEval (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ z) = 0
    rw [hz, map_sub, h, sub_self]
  · intro a
    refine ⟨Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (inclusion a), ?_⟩
    exact eval_inclusion 1 (by norm_num) a

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.x_comp_eq
statement:
theorem x_comp_eq (θ : TwoNatTrans F G) {a b c : B} (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) :
    θ.x (f ≫ g) = (F.mapComp f g).inv ▷ θ.X c ≫ (associator (F.map f) (F.map g) (θ.X c)).hom ≫
      F.map f ◁ θ.x g ≫ (associator (F.map f) (θ.X b) (G.map g)).inv ≫ θ.x f ▷ G.map g ≫
        (associator (θ.X a) (G.map f) (G.map g)).hom ≫ θ.X a ◁ (G.mapComp f g).hom

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.x_id_eq
statement:
theorem x_id_eq (θ : TwoNatTrans F G) (a : B) :
    θ.x (𝟙 a) = (F.mapId a).inv ▷ θ.X a ≫ (leftUnitor (θ.X a)).hom ≫
      (rightUnitor (θ.X a)).inv ≫ θ.X a ◁ (G.mapId a).hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [← θ.x_id]
  simp only [Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc, inv_hom_whiskerRight_assoc R, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.ext_of_eq
statement:
theorem ext_of_eq {θ θ' : TwoNatTrans F G} (hX : θ.X = θ'.X)
    (hx : ∀ {a b : B} (f : a ⟶ b), θ.x f = eqToHom (by rw [hX]) ≫ θ'.x f ≫ eqToHom (by rw [hX])) :
    θ = θ'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨X, x, _, _, _, _⟩ := θ
  obtain ⟨X', x', _, _, _, _⟩ := θ'
  dsimp only at hX
  subst hX
  simp only [eqToHom_refl, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp] at hx
  congr
  funext a b f
  exact hx f

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.toOplaxTrans_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem toOplaxTrans_app (θ : TwoNatTrans F G) (a : Underlying2 R B) :
    ((toOplaxTrans θ).app a).obj = θ.X a.obj

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.toOplaxTrans_naturality
statement:
@[simp] theorem toOplaxTrans_naturality (θ : TwoNatTrans F G) {a b : Underlying2 R B}
    (f : a ⟶ b) : ((toOplaxTrans θ).naturality f).1 = θ.x f.obj

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.id_X
statement: @[simp] theorem id_X (a : B) : (id F).X a = 𝟙 (F.obj a)

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.id_x
statement:
theorem id_x {a b : B} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (id F).x f = (rightUnitor (F.map f)).hom ≫ (leftUnitor (F.map f)).inv

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.vcomp_X
statement:
@[simp] theorem vcomp_X (θ : TwoNatTrans F G) (θ' : TwoNatTrans G H) (a : B) :
    (vcomp θ θ').X a = θ.X a ≫ θ'.X a

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.vcomp_x
statement:
theorem vcomp_x (θ : TwoNatTrans F G) (θ' : TwoNatTrans G H) {a b : B} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (vcomp θ θ').x f = (associator (F.map f) (θ.X b) (θ'.X b)).inv ≫ θ.x f ▷ θ'.X b ≫
      (associator (θ.X a) (G.map f) (θ'.X b)).hom ≫ θ.X a ◁ θ'.x f ≫
        (associator (θ.X a) (θ'.X a) (H.map f)).inv

name: StringDiagrams.PiSOp.reverseHom_associator_inv
statement:
theorem reverseHom_associator_inv {a b c d : TwoSOp R (TwoEnvelope R B)}
    (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) (h : c ⟶ d) :
    (reverseHom a d).map (associator f g h).inv =
      (associator ((reverseHom a b).obj f) ((reverseHom b c).obj g)
        ((reverseHom c d).obj h)).inv
proof:
:= by
  apply Envelope.hom_ext
  apply SOp.hom_ext
  change correction (R := R)
    ((SOp.unop f).par + ((SOp.unop g).par + (SOp.unop h).par))
    (((SOp.unop f).par + (SOp.unop g).par) + (SOp.unop h).par)
    (associator (SOp.unop f).obj (SOp.unop g).obj (SOp.unop h).obj).hom = _
  rw [add_assoc]
  simp only [correction, zmod2_add_self, mul_zero, sign_zero, twist_zero, one_smul]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.PiSOp.reverseHom_leftUnitor
statement:
theorem reverseHom_leftUnitor {a b : TwoSOp R (TwoEnvelope R B)} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (reverseHom a b).map (leftUnitor f).hom =
      (leftUnitor ((reverseHom a b).obj f)).hom
proof:
:= by
  apply Envelope.hom_ext
  apply SOp.hom_ext
  change correction (R := R) (0 + (SOp.unop f).par) (SOp.unop f).par
    (leftUnitor (SOp.unop f).obj).inv = _
  simp only [zero_add, correction, zmod2_add_self, mul_zero, sign_zero, twist_zero, one_smul]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.PiSOp.reverseHom_rightUnitor
statement:
theorem reverseHom_rightUnitor {a b : TwoSOp R (TwoEnvelope R B)} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (reverseHom a b).map (rightUnitor f).hom =
      (rightUnitor ((reverseHom a b).obj f)).hom
proof:
:= by
  apply Envelope.hom_ext
  apply SOp.hom_ext
  change correction (R := R) ((SOp.unop f).par + 0) (SOp.unop f).par
    (rightUnitor (SOp.unop f).obj).inv = _
  simp only [add_zero, correction, zmod2_add_self, mul_zero, sign_zero, twist_zero, one_smul]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.PiSOp.reverseComparison_associator
statement:
theorem reverseComparison_associator {a b c d : TwoSOp R (TwoEnvelope R B)}
    (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) (h : c ⟶ d) :
    (reverseHom a b).obj f ◁ (reverseComparison g h).hom ≫
        (reverseComparison f (g ≫ h)).hom ≫ (reverseHom a d).map (associator f g h).inv =
      (associator ((reverseHom a b).obj f) ((reverseHom b c).obj g)
        ((reverseHom c d).obj h)).inv ≫
        (reverseComparison f g).hom ▷ (reverseHom c d).obj h ≫
          (reverseComparison (f ≫ g) h).hom
proof:
:= by
  change (reverseHom a b).obj f ◁ (sign R ((SOp.unop g).par * (SOp.unop h).par) • 𝟙 _) ≫
      (sign R ((SOp.unop f).par * ((SOp.unop g).par + (SOp.unop h).par)) • 𝟙 _) ≫ _ =
    _ ≫ (sign R ((SOp.unop f).par * (SOp.unop g).par) • 𝟙 _) ▷ (reverseHom c d).obj h ≫
      (sign R (((SOp.unop f).par + (SOp.unop g).par) * (SOp.unop h).par) • 𝟙 _)
  erw [whiskerLeft_smul, whiskerLeft_id (R := R), smul_whiskerRight, id_whiskerRight (R := R),
    Linear.smul_comp, Category.id_comp, Linear.smul_comp, Category.id_comp,
    Linear.comp_smul, Category.comp_id, Linear.comp_smul, Linear.comp_smul, Category.comp_id]
  erw [reverseHom_associator_inv, smul_smul, smul_smul, comparison_cocycle, mul_comm]

name: StringDiagrams.PiSOp.reverseComparison_leftUnitor
statement:
theorem reverseComparison_leftUnitor {a b : TwoSOp R (TwoEnvelope R B)} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (reverseIdentityComparison a).hom ▷ (reverseHom a b).obj f ≫
        (reverseComparison (𝟙 a) f).hom ≫ (reverseHom a b).map (leftUnitor f).hom =
      (leftUnitor ((reverseHom a b).obj f)).hom
proof:
:= by
  change 𝟙 _ ▷ (reverseHom a b).obj f ≫ (sign R (0 * (SOp.unop f).par) • 𝟙 _) ≫ _ = _
  erw [zero_mul, sign_zero, one_smul, id_whiskerRight (R := R),
    Category.id_comp, Category.id_comp]
  exact reverseHom_leftUnitor f

name: StringDiagrams.PiSOp.reverseComparison_rightUnitor
statement:
theorem reverseComparison_rightUnitor {a b : TwoSOp R (TwoEnvelope R B)} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (reverseHom a b).obj f ◁ (reverseIdentityComparison b).hom ≫
        (reverseComparison f (𝟙 b)).hom ≫ (reverseHom a b).map (rightUnitor f).hom =
      (rightUnitor ((reverseHom a b).obj f)).hom
proof:
:= by
  change (reverseHom a b).obj f ◁ 𝟙 _ ≫ (sign R ((SOp.unop f).par * 0) • 𝟙 _) ≫ _ = _
  erw [mul_zero, sign_zero, one_smul, whiskerLeft_id (R := R),
    Category.id_comp, Category.id_comp]
  exact reverseHom_rightUnitor f

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated2.T_comp_Tinv
statement: theorem T_comp_Tinv : (T R B).comp (Tinv R B) = TwoSuperfunctor.id R _
proof:
:= by
  refine TwoEnvelope.twoSuperfunctor_ext rfl HEq.rfl (heq_of_eq ?_) (heq_of_eq ?_)
    (heq_of_eq ?_)
  · funext a b f g x
    obtain ⟨⟨⟨⟨a⟩⟩⟩⟩ := a
    obtain ⟨⟨⟨⟨b⟩⟩⟩⟩ := b
    obtain ⟨⟨⟨⟨f⟩⟩⟩⟩ := f
    obtain ⟨⟨⟨⟨g⟩⟩⟩⟩ := g
    exact tinv₂_T_map₂ x
  · funext a b c f g
    obtain ⟨⟨⟨⟨a⟩⟩⟩⟩ := a
    obtain ⟨⟨⟨⟨b⟩⟩⟩⟩ := b
    obtain ⟨⟨⟨⟨c⟩⟩⟩⟩ := c
    obtain ⟨⟨⟨⟨f⟩⟩⟩⟩ := f
    obtain ⟨⟨⟨⟨g⟩⟩⟩⟩ := g
    apply Iso.ext
    exact (Category.id_comp _).trans ((Tinv R B).map₂_id _)
  · funext a
    obtain ⟨⟨⟨⟨a⟩⟩⟩⟩ := a
    apply Iso.ext
    exact (Category.id_comp _).trans ((Tinv R B).map₂_id _)

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated2.Tinv_comp_T

proof:
:= by
  refine TwoEnvelope.twoSuperfunctor_ext rfl HEq.rfl (heq_of_eq ?_) (heq_of_eq ?_)
    (heq_of_eq ?_)
  · funext a b f g x
    exact T_map₂_tinv₂ x
  · funext a b c f g
    apply Iso.ext
    exact (Category.id_comp _).trans ((T R B).map₂_id _)
  · funext a
    apply Iso.ext
    exact (Category.id_comp _).trans ((T R B).map₂_id _)

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated2.mapQ_comp_T
statement:
theorem mapQ_comp_T (G : TwoSuperfunctor R B B') (hG : G.IsGraded) :
    ((G.toQPiTwoFunctor hG).mapQ).comp (T R B') = (T R B).comp G
proof:
:= by
  refine TwoEnvelope.twoSuperfunctor_ext rfl HEq.rfl (heq_of_eq ?_) (heq_of_eq ?_)
    (heq_of_eq ?_)
  · funext a b f g x
    exact T_map₂_mapQ G hG x
  · funext a b c f g
    apply Iso.ext
    exact (Category.id_comp _).trans ((T_map₂_mapQ_mapComp G hG f g).trans
      ((Category.comp_id _).symm.trans (congrArg _ (G.map₂_id _).symm)))
  · funext a
    apply Iso.ext
    exact (Category.id_comp _).trans ((T_map₂_mapQ_mapId G hG a).trans
      ((Category.comp_id _).symm.trans (congrArg _ (G.map₂_id _).symm)))
