name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.id_comp_of_strict
statement: theorem id_comp_of_strict (θ : F ⟶ G) : 𝟙 F ≫ θ = θ
proof:
:= by
  change TwoNatTrans.vcomp (TwoNatTrans.id F) θ = θ
  refine TwoNatTrans.ext_of_eq (funext fun a => by
    rw [TwoNatTrans.vcomp_X, TwoNatTrans.id_X]; exact id_comp (θ.X a)) fun f => ?_
  simp only [TwoNatTrans.vcomp_x, TwoNatTrans.vcomp_X, TwoNatTrans.id_x, TwoNatTrans.id_X,
    associator_eqToIso, leftUnitor_eqToIso, rightUnitor_eqToIso, eqToIso.hom, eqToIso.inv,
    id_whiskerLeft (R := R), eqToHom_whiskerRight R, Category.assoc, eqToHom_trans,
    eqToHom_trans_assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.comp_id_of_strict
statement: theorem comp_id_of_strict (θ : F ⟶ G) : θ ≫ 𝟙 G = θ
proof:
:= by
  change TwoNatTrans.vcomp θ (TwoNatTrans.id G) = θ
  refine TwoNatTrans.ext_of_eq (funext fun a => by
    rw [TwoNatTrans.vcomp_X, TwoNatTrans.id_X]; exact comp_id (θ.X a)) fun f => ?_
  simp only [TwoNatTrans.vcomp_x, TwoNatTrans.vcomp_X, TwoNatTrans.id_x, TwoNatTrans.id_X,
    associator_eqToIso, leftUnitor_eqToIso, rightUnitor_eqToIso, eqToIso.hom, eqToIso.inv,
    whiskerRight_id (R := R), whiskerLeft_eqToHom R, Category.assoc, eqToHom_trans,
    eqToHom_trans_assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.assoc_of_strict
statement:
theorem assoc_of_strict (θ : F ⟶ G) (ψ : G ⟶ H) (φ : H ⟶ I) :
    (θ ≫ ψ) ≫ φ = θ ≫ ψ ≫ φ
proof:
:= by
  change TwoNatTrans.vcomp (TwoNatTrans.vcomp θ ψ) φ = TwoNatTrans.vcomp θ (TwoNatTrans.vcomp ψ φ)
  refine TwoNatTrans.ext_of_eq (funext fun a => by
    rw [TwoNatTrans.vcomp_X, TwoNatTrans.vcomp_X, TwoNatTrans.vcomp_X, TwoNatTrans.vcomp_X]
    exact assoc (θ.X a) (ψ.X a) (φ.X a)) fun f => ?_
  simp only [TwoNatTrans.vcomp_x, TwoNatTrans.vcomp_X, associator_eqToIso, eqToIso.hom,
    eqToIso.inv, whiskerLeft_comp (R := R), comp_whiskerRight (R := R),
    whiskerRight_comp (R := R), comp_whiskerLeft (R := R), whisker_assoc (R := R),
    eqToHom_whiskerRight R, whiskerLeft_eqToHom R, Category.assoc, eqToHom_trans,
    eqToHom_trans_assoc]
  erw [eqToHom_trans_assoc, eqToHom_trans]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.Superequivalent.refl
statement: theorem Superequivalent.refl (a : B) : Superequivalent R a a
proof:
:=
  ⟨𝟙 a, 𝟙 a, leftUnitor (𝟙 a), leftUnitor (𝟙 a), leftUnitor_hom_mem (R := R) _,
    leftUnitor_hom_mem (R := R) _⟩

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.Superequivalent.symm
statement: theorem Superequivalent.symm {a b : B} (h : Superequivalent R a b) : Superequivalent R b a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, g, e₁, e₂, h₁, h₂⟩ := h
  exact ⟨g, f, e₂, e₁, h₂, h₁⟩

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.IsSuperequivalence.app
statement:
theorem IsSuperequivalence.app {θ : F ⟶ G} (h : IsSuperequivalence R θ) (a : B) :
    IsSuperequivalence R (θ.X a)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ψ, e₁, e₂, h₁, h₂⟩ := h
  refine ⟨ψ.X a, ⟨e₁.hom.app a, e₁.inv.app a, ?_, ?_⟩, ⟨e₂.hom.app a, e₂.inv.app a, ?_, ?_⟩,
    h₁ a, h₂ a⟩
  · rw [← TwoNatTrans.comp_app, e₁.hom_inv_id]; rfl
  · rw [← TwoNatTrans.comp_app, e₁.inv_hom_id]; rfl
  · rw [← TwoNatTrans.comp_app, e₂.hom_inv_id]; rfl
  · rw [← TwoNatTrans.comp_app, e₂.inv_hom_id]; rfl

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.IsTwoSuperequivalence.essSurj
statement:
theorem IsTwoSuperequivalence.essSurj {F : TwoSuperfunctor R B C} (h : F.IsTwoSuperequivalence)
    (c : C) : ∃ a : B, Superequivalent R (F.obj a) c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨G, -, θ, hθ⟩ := h
  exact ⟨G.obj c, θ.X c, IsSuperequivalence.app hθ c⟩

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.eq_of_whiskerLeft
statement:
theorem eq_of_whiskerLeft {f : a ⟶ b} {g : b ⟶ a} (e : g ≫ f ≅ 𝟙 b)
    (he : e.hom ∈ parity (R := R) (g ≫ f) (𝟙 b) 0) {h h' : b ⟶ c} (η : h ⟶ h') :
    η = (leftUnitor h).inv ≫ e.inv ▷ h ≫ (associator g f h).hom ≫ g ◁ f ◁ η ≫
      (associator g f h').inv ≫ e.hom ▷ h' ≫ (leftUnitor h').hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [associator_inv_naturality_right_assoc R, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc,
    ← whisker_exchange_of_even_left_assoc he, inv_hom_whiskerRight_assoc R,
    leftUnitor_naturality R, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.eq_of_whiskerRight
statement:
theorem eq_of_whiskerRight {f : a ⟶ b} {g : b ⟶ a} (e : f ≫ g ≅ 𝟙 a)
    (he : e.hom ∈ parity (R := R) (f ≫ g) (𝟙 a) 0) {h h' : c ⟶ a} (η : h ⟶ h') :
    η = (rightUnitor h).inv ≫ h ◁ e.inv ≫ (associator h f g).inv ≫ η ▷ f ▷ g ≫
      (associator h' f g).hom ≫ h' ◁ e.hom ≫ (rightUnitor h').hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [associator_naturality_left_assoc R, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc,
    whisker_exchange_of_even_right_assoc η he, whiskerLeft_inv_hom_assoc R,
    rightUnitor_naturality R, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.whiskerLeft_injective_of_iso
statement:
theorem whiskerLeft_injective_of_iso {f : a ⟶ b} {g : b ⟶ a} (e : g ≫ f ≅ 𝟙 b)
    (he : e.hom ∈ parity (R := R) (g ≫ f) (𝟙 b) 0) {h h' : b ⟶ c} :
    Function.Injective (fun η : h ⟶ h' => f ◁ η)
proof:
:= fun η η' hη => by
  have hη : f ◁ η = f ◁ η' := hη
  rw [eq_of_whiskerLeft e he η, eq_of_whiskerLeft e he η', hη]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.whiskerRight_injective_of_iso
statement:
theorem whiskerRight_injective_of_iso {f : a ⟶ b} {g : b ⟶ a} (e : f ≫ g ≅ 𝟙 a)
    (he : e.hom ∈ parity (R := R) (f ≫ g) (𝟙 a) 0) {h h' : c ⟶ a} :
    Function.Injective (fun η : h ⟶ h' => η ▷ f)
proof:
:= fun η η' hη => by
  have hη : η ▷ f = η' ▷ f := hη
  rw [eq_of_whiskerRight e he η, eq_of_whiskerRight e he η', hη]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.IsSuperequivalence.whiskerLeft_injective
statement:
theorem IsSuperequivalence.whiskerLeft_injective {f : a ⟶ b} (hf : IsSuperequivalence R f)
    {h h' : b ⟶ c} : Function.Injective (fun η : h ⟶ h' => f ◁ η)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, -, e₂, -, h₂⟩ := hf
  exact whiskerLeft_injective_of_iso e₂ h₂

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.IsSuperequivalence.whiskerRight_injective
statement:
theorem IsSuperequivalence.whiskerRight_injective {f : a ⟶ b} (hf : IsSuperequivalence R f)
    {h h' : c ⟶ a} : Function.Injective (fun η : h ⟶ h' => η ▷ f)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, e₁, -, h₁, -⟩ := hf
  exact whiskerRight_injective_of_iso e₁ h₁

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.IsSuperequivalence.whiskerLeft_surjective
statement:
theorem IsSuperequivalence.whiskerLeft_surjective {f : a ⟶ b} (hf : IsSuperequivalence R f)
    {h h' : b ⟶ c} : Function.Surjective (fun η : h ⟶ h' => f ◁ η)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, e₁, e₂, h₁, h₂⟩ := hf
  intro ζ
  set η := (leftUnitor h).inv ≫ e₂.inv ▷ h ≫ (associator g f h).hom ≫ g ◁ ζ ≫
    (associator g f h').inv ≫ e₂.hom ▷ h' ≫ (leftUnitor h').hom with hη
  refine ⟨η, whiskerLeft_injective_of_iso (f := g) e₁ h₁ ?_⟩
  have key := (eq_of_whiskerLeft e₂ h₂ η).symm.trans hη
  have key' := congrArg (fun t => (associator g f h).inv ≫ e₂.hom ▷ h ≫ (leftUnitor h).hom ≫ t ≫
    (leftUnitor h').inv ≫ e₂.inv ▷ h' ≫ (associator g f h').hom) key
  simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id,
    Category.comp_id, hom_inv_whiskerRight_assoc R] at key'
  exact key'

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.IsSuperequivalence.whiskerRight_surjective
statement:
theorem IsSuperequivalence.whiskerRight_surjective {f : a ⟶ b} (hf : IsSuperequivalence R f)
    {h h' : c ⟶ a} : Function.Surjective (fun η : h ⟶ h' => η ▷ f)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, e₁, e₂, h₁, h₂⟩ := hf
  intro ζ
  set η := (rightUnitor h).inv ≫ h ◁ e₁.inv ≫ (associator h f g).inv ≫ ζ ▷ g ≫
    (associator h' f g).hom ≫ h' ◁ e₁.hom ≫ (rightUnitor h').hom with hη
  refine ⟨η, whiskerRight_injective_of_iso (f := g) e₂ h₂ ?_⟩
  have key := (eq_of_whiskerRight e₁ h₁ η).symm.trans hη
  have key' := congrArg (fun t => (associator h f g).hom ≫ h ◁ e₁.hom ≫ (rightUnitor h).hom ≫
    t ≫ (rightUnitor h').inv ≫ h' ◁ e₁.inv ≫ (associator h' f g).inv) key
  simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id,
    whiskerLeft_hom_inv_assoc R] at key'
  exact key'

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.EvenIso.trans
statement:
private theorem EvenIso.trans {f g h : a ⟶ b} (h₁ : EvenIso R f g) (h₂ : EvenIso R g h) :
    EvenIso R f h
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := h₁
  obtain ⟨e', he'⟩ := h₂
  exact ⟨e ≪≫ e', by simpa using comp_mem he he'⟩

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.EvenIso.symm
statement: private theorem EvenIso.symm {f g : a ⟶ b} (h : EvenIso R f g) : EvenIso R g f
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := h
  exact ⟨e.symm, inv_mem e he⟩

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.EvenIso.whiskerLeft
statement:
private theorem EvenIso.whiskerLeft (f : a ⟶ b) {g h : b ⟶ c} (hgh : EvenIso R g h) :
    EvenIso R (f ≫ g) (f ≫ h)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := hgh
  exact ⟨whiskerLeftIso (R := R) f e, whiskerLeft_mem f he⟩

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.EvenIso.whiskerRight
statement:
private theorem EvenIso.whiskerRight {f g : a ⟶ b} (hfg : EvenIso R f g) (h : b ⟶ c) :
    EvenIso R (f ≫ h) (g ≫ h)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := hfg
  exact ⟨whiskerRightIso (R := R) e h, whiskerRight_mem h he⟩

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.EvenIso.associator
statement:
private theorem EvenIso.associator (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) (h : c ⟶ d) :
    EvenIso R ((f ≫ g) ≫ h) (f ≫ g ≫ h)
proof:
:=
  ⟨BicategoryStruct.associator f g h, associator_hom_mem (R := R) f g h⟩

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.EvenIso.leftUnitor
statement: private theorem EvenIso.leftUnitor (f : a ⟶ b) : EvenIso R (𝟙 a ≫ f) f

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.EvenIso.rightUnitor
statement: private theorem EvenIso.rightUnitor (f : a ⟶ b) : EvenIso R (f ≫ 𝟙 b) f

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.x_eq_of_iso
statement:
theorem x_eq_of_iso {θ₁ θ₂ : F' ⟶ G'} (e : θ₁ ≅ θ₂) {a b : B} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    θ₁.x f = F'.map f ◁ e.hom.app b ≫ θ₂.x f ≫ e.inv.app a ▷ G'.map f
proof:
:= by
  have h : e.hom.app a ≫ e.inv.app a = 𝟙 _ := by
    rw [← TwoNatTrans.comp_app, e.hom_inv_id]; rfl
  rw [← Category.assoc, ← e.hom.naturality f, Category.assoc, ← comp_whiskerRight' R, h,
    id_whiskerRight (R := R), Category.comp_id]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.isIso_x_of_iso
statement:
theorem isIso_x_of_iso {θ₁ θ₂ : F' ⟶ G'} (e : θ₁ ≅ θ₂) {a b : B} (f : a ⟶ b)
    [IsIso (θ₂.x f)] : IsIso (θ₁.x f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [x_eq_of_iso e f]
  have : IsIso (F'.map f ◁ e.hom.app b) :=
    (whiskerLeftIso (R := R) (F'.map f) (appIso e b)).isIso_hom
  have : IsIso (e.inv.app a ▷ G'.map f) :=
    (whiskerRightIso (R := R) (appIso e a).symm (G'.map f)).isIso_hom
  infer_instance

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.isIso_id_x
statement:
theorem isIso_id_x (F' : TwoSuperfunctor R B C) {a b : B} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    IsIso (TwoNatTrans.x (𝟙 F') f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [id_def, TwoNatTrans.id_x]
  exact (rightUnitor (F'.map f) ≪≫ (leftUnitor (F'.map f)).symm).isIso_hom

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.IsSuperequivalence.isIso_x
statement:
theorem IsSuperequivalence.isIso_x {θ : F' ⟶ G'} (hθ : IsSuperequivalence R θ) {a b : B}
    (f : a ⟶ b) : IsIso (θ.x f)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨θ', e₁, e₂, h₁, h₂⟩ := hθ
  have hθ' : IsSuperequivalence R θ' := ⟨θ, e₂, e₁, h₂, h₁⟩
  obtain ⟨T₁, hT₁⟩ : ∃ T₁ : (θ.X a ≫ θ'.X a) ≫ F'.map f ⟶ F'.map f ≫ θ.X b ≫ θ'.X b,
      (θ ≫ θ').x f ≫ T₁ = 𝟙 _ := by
    obtain ⟨T, hT, -⟩ := (have := isIso_id_x F' f; isIso_x_of_iso e₁ f).out
    exact ⟨T, hT⟩
  obtain ⟨T₂, hT₂⟩ : ∃ T₂ : (θ'.X a ≫ θ.X a) ≫ G'.map f ⟶ G'.map f ≫ θ'.X b ≫ θ.X b,
      T₂ ≫ (θ' ≫ θ).x f = 𝟙 _ := by
    obtain ⟨T, -, hT⟩ := (have := isIso_id_x G' f; isIso_x_of_iso e₂ f).out
    exact ⟨T, hT⟩
  
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ : ∃ r, θ.x f ≫ r = 𝟙 _ := by
    have h : ((associator (F'.map f) (θ.X b) (θ'.X b)).inv ≫ θ.x f ▷ θ'.X b ≫
        (associator (θ.X a) (G'.map f) (θ'.X b)).hom ≫ θ.X a ◁ θ'.x f ≫
          (associator (θ.X a) (θ'.X a) (F'.map f)).inv) ≫ T₁ = 𝟙 _ :=
      hT₁
    simp only [Category.assoc] at h
    obtain ⟨r', hr'⟩ := (IsSuperequivalence.app hθ' b).whiskerRight_surjective
      ((associator (θ.X a) (G'.map f) (θ'.X b)).hom ≫ θ.X a ◁ θ'.x f ≫
        (associator (θ.X a) (θ'.X a) (F'.map f)).inv ≫ T₁ ≫
          (associator (F'.map f) (θ.X b) (θ'.X b)).inv)
    refine ⟨r', (IsSuperequivalence.app hθ' b).whiskerRight_injective ?_⟩
    change (θ.x f ≫ r') ▷ θ'.X b = 𝟙 (F'.map f ≫ θ.X b) ▷ θ'.X b
    have hr' : r' ▷ θ'.X b = _ := hr'
    rw [comp_whiskerRight' R, hr', id_whiskerRight (R := R),
      ← cancel_epi (associator (F'.map f) (θ.X b) (θ'.X b)).inv, reassoc_of% h, Category.comp_id]
  
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ : ∃ l, l ≫ θ.x f = 𝟙 _ := by
    have h : T₂ ≫ (associator (G'.map f) (θ'.X b) (θ.X b)).inv ≫
        θ'.x f ▷ θ.X b ≫ (associator (θ'.X a) (F'.map f) (θ.X b)).hom ≫
          θ'.X a ◁ θ.x f ≫ (associator (θ'.X a) (θ.X a) (G'.map f)).inv = 𝟙 _ :=
      hT₂
    obtain ⟨l', hl'⟩ := (IsSuperequivalence.app hθ' a).whiskerLeft_surjective
      ((associator (θ'.X a) (θ.X a) (G'.map f)).inv ≫ T₂ ≫
        (associator (G'.map f) (θ'.X b) (θ.X b)).inv ≫ θ'.x f ▷ θ.X b ≫
          (associator (θ'.X a) (F'.map f) (θ.X b)).hom)
    refine ⟨l', (IsSuperequivalence.app hθ' a).whiskerLeft_injective ?_⟩
    change θ'.X a ◁ (l' ≫ θ.x f) = θ'.X a ◁ 𝟙 (θ.X a ≫ G'.map f)
    have hl' : θ'.X a ◁ l' = _ := hl'
    rw [whiskerLeft_comp' R, hl', whiskerLeft_id (R := R),
      ← cancel_mono (associator (θ'.X a) (θ.X a) (G'.map f)).inv]
    simp only [Category.assoc]
    rw [h, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]
  have hlr : l = r := calc
    l = l ≫ θ.x f ≫ r := by rw [hr, Category.comp_id]
    _ = r := by rw [reassoc_of% hl]
  exact ⟨r, hr, hlr ▸ hl⟩

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.IsSuperequivalence.isStrong
statement:
theorem IsSuperequivalence.isStrong {θ : F' ⟶ G'} (hθ : IsSuperequivalence R θ) :
    TwoNatTrans.IsStrong θ

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.map₂_injective_of_superequivalent
statement:
theorem map₂_injective_of_superequivalent
    (h : Superequivalent R (F.comp G) (TwoSuperfunctor.id R B)) {a b : B} {f g : a ⟶ b} :
    Function.Injective (F.map₂ : (f ⟶ g) → (F.map f ⟶ F.map g))
proof:
:= by
  intro η η' hη
  obtain ⟨θ, hθ⟩ := h
  have := IsSuperequivalence.isIso_x hθ f
  apply (IsSuperequivalence.app hθ a).whiskerLeft_injective
  change θ.X a ◁ η = θ.X a ◁ η'
  rw [← cancel_epi (θ.x f)]
  have n := θ.naturality η
  have n' := θ.naturality η'
  change G.map₂ (F.map₂ η) ▷ θ.X b ≫ θ.x g = θ.x f ≫ θ.X a ◁ η at n
  change G.map₂ (F.map₂ η') ▷ θ.X b ≫ θ.x g = θ.x f ≫ θ.X a ◁ η' at n'
  rw [← n, ← n', hη]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.map₂_surjective_of_superequivalent
statement:
theorem map₂_surjective_of_superequivalent
    (h : Superequivalent R (F.comp G) (TwoSuperfunctor.id R B)) {a b : B}
    (hG : ∀ {f g : F.obj a ⟶ F.obj b},
      Function.Injective (G.map₂ : (f ⟶ g) → (G.map f ⟶ G.map g)))
    {f g : a ⟶ b} : Function.Surjective (F.map₂ : (f ⟶ g) → (F.map f ⟶ F.map g))
proof:
:= by
  intro ζ
  obtain ⟨θ, hθ⟩ := h
  have := IsSuperequivalence.isIso_x hθ f
  obtain ⟨η, hη⟩ := (IsSuperequivalence.app hθ a).whiskerLeft_surjective
    (inv (θ.x f) ≫ G.map₂ ζ ▷ θ.X b ≫ θ.x g)
  have hη : θ.X a ◁ η = inv (θ.x f) ≫ G.map₂ ζ ▷ θ.X b ≫ θ.x g := hη
  have := IsSuperequivalence.isIso_x hθ g
  have key : (F.comp G).map₂ η ▷ θ.X b ≫ θ.x g = G.map₂ ζ ▷ θ.X b ≫ θ.x g := calc
    _ = θ.x f ≫ θ.X a ◁ η := θ.naturality η
    _ = _ := by rw [hη, IsIso.hom_inv_id_assoc]; rfl
  exact ⟨η, hG ((IsSuperequivalence.app hθ b).whiskerRight_injective
    ((cancel_mono (θ.x g)).1 key))⟩

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.evenlyDense_of_superequivalent
statement:
theorem evenlyDense_of_superequivalent
    (h : Superequivalent R (F.comp G) (TwoSuperfunctor.id R B)) (a b : B)
    [(G.mapFunctor (F.obj a) (F.obj b)).Full] [(G.mapFunctor (F.obj a) (F.obj b)).Faithful] :
    EvenlyDense R (F.mapFunctor a b)
proof:
:= by
  intro k
  obtain ⟨θ, hθ⟩ := h
  have hθ₀ := hθ
  obtain ⟨θ', e₁, -, h₁, -⟩ := hθ₀
  let f : a ⟶ b := θ'.X a ≫ G.map k ≫ θ.X b
  have := IsSuperequivalence.isIso_x hθ f
  have E : ∀ c : B, EvenIso R (θ.X c ≫ θ'.X c) (𝟙 (G.obj (F.obj c))) := fun c =>
    ⟨appIso e₁ c, h₁ c⟩
  have hx : EvenIso R (G.map (F.map f) ≫ θ.X b) (θ.X a ≫ f) :=
    ⟨@asIso _ _ _ _ (θ.x f) this, θ.x_mem f⟩
  have h6 : EvenIso R (f ≫ θ'.X b) (θ'.X a ≫ G.map k) :=
    (EvenIso.associator R _ _ _).trans (EvenIso.whiskerLeft _
      ((EvenIso.associator R _ _ _).trans
        ((EvenIso.whiskerLeft _ (E b)).trans (EvenIso.rightUnitor R _))))
  have hGk : EvenIso R (G.map (F.map f)) (G.map k) :=
    (EvenIso.rightUnitor R _).symm.trans <|
      (EvenIso.whiskerLeft _ (E b).symm).trans <|
        (EvenIso.associator R _ _ _).symm.trans <|
          (EvenIso.whiskerRight hx _).trans <|
            (EvenIso.associator R _ _ _).trans <|
              (EvenIso.whiskerLeft _ h6).trans <|
                (EvenIso.associator R _ _ _).symm.trans <|
                  (EvenIso.whiskerRight (E a) _).trans (EvenIso.leftUnitor R _)
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ : EvenIso R ((G.mapFunctor (F.obj a) (F.obj b)).obj ((F.mapFunctor a b).obj f))
      ((G.mapFunctor (F.obj a) (F.obj b)).obj k) := hGk
  exact ⟨f, (G.mapFunctor (F.obj a) (F.obj b)).preimageIso e,
    mem_of_map_mem (G.mapFunctor (F.obj a) (F.obj b))
      (by rw [Functor.preimageIso_hom, Functor.map_preimage]; exact he)⟩

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.IsTwoSuperequivalence.isLocalTwoSuperequivalence
statement:
theorem IsTwoSuperequivalence.isLocalTwoSuperequivalence {F : TwoSuperfunctor R B C}
    (h : F.IsTwoSuperequivalence) : F.IsLocalTwoSuperequivalence
proof:
:= by
  have h₀ := h
  obtain ⟨G, hFG, hGF⟩ := h₀
  have injF : ∀ {a b : B} {f g : a ⟶ b},
      Function.Injective (F.map₂ : (f ⟶ g) → (F.map f ⟶ F.map g)) :=
    @fun _ _ _ _ => map₂_injective_of_superequivalent hFG
  have injG : ∀ {c d : C} {f g : c ⟶ d},
      Function.Injective (G.map₂ : (f ⟶ g) → (G.map f ⟶ G.map g)) :=
    @fun _ _ _ _ => map₂_injective_of_superequivalent hGF
  refine ⟨fun a b => ?_, h.essSurj⟩
  have : (F.mapFunctor a b).Faithful := ⟨fun h => injF h⟩
  have : (F.mapFunctor a b).Full :=
    ⟨map₂_surjective_of_superequivalent hFG fun h => injG h⟩
  have : (G.mapFunctor (F.obj a) (F.obj b)).Faithful := ⟨fun h => injG h⟩
  have : (G.mapFunctor (F.obj a) (F.obj b)).Full :=
    ⟨map₂_surjective_of_superequivalent hGF fun h => injF h⟩
  exact ⟨Superequivalence.ofFullyFaithful _ (evenlyDense_of_superequivalent hFG a b)⟩

proof:
:= by
  intro a b f
  rw [vcomp_x]
  have := hθ f
  have := hψ f
  have : IsIso (θ.x f ▷ ψ.X b) :=
    (whiskerRightIso (R := R) (asIso (θ.x f)) (ψ.X b)).isIso_hom
  have : IsIso (θ.X a ◁ ψ.x f) :=
    (whiskerLeftIso (R := R) (θ.X a) (asIso (ψ.x f))).isIso_hom

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSuperspace.braidingMap_mem_degHom
statement:
theorem braidingMap_mem_degHom (V W : GradedSuperspace k) :
    SVec.braidingMap V.toSVec W.toSVec ∈ degHom (V.tensorObj W) (W.tensorObj V) 0
proof:
:= by
  intro m x hx
  refine (tensorDeg_le_iff V W
    (S := (W.tensorDeg V (m + 0)).comap
      (SVec.toLinearMap (SVec.braidingMap V.toSVec W.toSVec)))).2
    (fun r s hrs v hv w hw => ?_) hx
  rw [Submodule.mem_comap]
  change TensorProduct.comm k V.toSVec W.toSVec
    ((map (V.toSVec.proj 0) LinearMap.id + map (V.toSVec.proj 1) (W.toSVec.sgn 1) :
      V.toSVec ⊗[k] W.toSVec →ₗ[k] V.toSVec ⊗[k] W.toSVec) (v ⊗ₜ w)) ∈ _
  rw [LinearMap.add_apply, map_tmul, map_tmul, LinearMap.id_apply, map_add, comm_tmul,
    comm_tmul]
  subst hrs
  rw [add_zero, add_comm r s]
  exact Submodule.add_mem _ (tmul_mem_tensorDeg W V hw (V.proj_mem 0 hv))
    (tmul_mem_tensorDeg W V (W.sgn_mem hw) (V.proj_mem 1 hv))

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSupercategory.end_pow_mem_degree
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simpa using id_mem_degree (R := k) X
  | succ n ih =>
    simpa [pow_succ, End.mul_def, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, add_mul, add_comm]
      using comp_mem_degree hf ih

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSupercategory.iso_degree_nonneg
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hB
  by_contra hm
  have hm' : m ≤ -1 := by omega
  let n : ℕ := N.natAbs + 1
  have hneg : -(n : ℤ) < N := by
    dsimp [n]
    have := Int.le_natAbs (a := -N)
    rw [Int.natAbs_neg] at this
    omega
  have hdeg : (n : ℤ) * m < N := by
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hm' (Int.natCast_nonneg n)
    nlinarith
  let f : End X := e.hom
  have hz : f ^ n = 0 := by
    have hp := end_pow_mem_degree (f := f) he n
    rw [hN _ hdeg] at hp
    exact hp
  have hu : IsUnit (f ^ n) :=
    ((isUnit_iff_isIso f).2 inferInstance).pow n
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hu
  have hid : (𝟙 X : X ⟶ X) = 0 := by
    have h := u.val_inv
    rw [hu, hz, zero_mul] at h
    exact h.symm
  exact hX ((Limits.IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero X).2 hid)

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSupercategory.iso_degree_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  have h := iso_degree_nonneg hX hB e he
  have h' := iso_degree_nonneg hX hB e.symm (inv_mem_degree e he)
  omega

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSupercategory.qPow_iso_degree_zero
statement:
theorem qPow_iso_degree_zero {X : C} [QPiSupercategory k C]
    (hX : ¬ Limits.IsZero X) (hB : EndBoundedBelow (k := k) X)
    (m : ℤ) (e : QPiSupercategory.qPow k m X ≅ X)
    (he : e.hom ∈ degree (R := k) _ X 0) : m = 0
proof:
:= by
  let f := (QPiSupercategory.σPow k m X).symm ≪≫ e
  apply iso_degree_eq_zero hX hB f
  simpa only [f, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, add_zero] using comp_mem_degree
    (QPiSupercategory.σPow_inv_mem_degree (R := k) m X) he

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoFunctor.mapCompLeft_γ
statement:
theorem mapCompLeft_γ {a b c : B} (f : a ⟶ b) (h : b ⟶ c) :
    (α_ (F.map f) (F.map h) (𝐪 (F.obj c))).hom ≫ F.map f ◁ (𝛄 (F.map h)).hom ≫
        (α_ (F.map f) (𝐪 (F.obj b)) (F.map h)).inv ≫ (hF.γHom f).hom ▷ F.map h ≫
          (F.mapComp (f ≫ 𝐪 b) h).inv =
      (F.mapComp f h).inv ▷ 𝐪 (F.obj c) ≫ (hF.γHom (f ≫ h)).hom ≫
        F.map₂ ((α_ f h (𝐪 c)).hom ≫ f ◁ (𝛄 h).hom ≫ (α_ f (𝐪 b) h).inv)
proof:
:= by
  have hγ : F.map h ◁ (hF.k c).hom ≫ (F.mapComp h (𝐪 c)).inv ≫ F.map₂ (𝛄 h).hom ≫
      (F.mapComp (𝐪 b) h).hom = (𝛄 (F.map h)).hom ≫ (hF.k b).hom ▷ F.map h := by
    rw [reassoc_of% (hF.γ_comm h)]
    simp
  rw [γHom_hom, γHom_hom, F.map₂_comp, F.map₂_comp, Pseudofunctor.map₂_associator,
    Pseudofunctor.map₂_whisker_left, Pseudofunctor.map₂_associator_inv']
  simp only [Bicategory.comp_whiskerRight, Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
  rw [← whisker_exchange_assoc (F.mapComp f h).inv (hF.k c).hom,
    Bicategory.inv_hom_whiskerRight_assoc]
  calc _ = (α_ (F.map f) (F.map h) (𝐪 (F.obj c))).hom ≫
        F.map f ◁ ((𝛄 (F.map h)).hom ≫ (hF.k b).hom ▷ F.map h) ≫
          (α_ (F.map f) (F.map (𝐪 b)) (F.map h)).inv ≫ (F.mapComp f (𝐪 b)).inv ▷ F.map h ≫
            (F.mapComp (f ≫ 𝐪 b) h).inv := by
        bicategory
    _ = (α_ (F.map f) (F.map h) (𝐪 (F.obj c))).hom ≫
        F.map f ◁ (F.map h ◁ (hF.k c).hom ≫ (F.mapComp h (𝐪 c)).inv ≫ F.map₂ (𝛄 h).hom ≫
          (F.mapComp (𝐪 b) h).hom) ≫
          (α_ (F.map f) (F.map (𝐪 b)) (F.map h)).inv ≫ (F.mapComp f (𝐪 b)).inv ▷ F.map h ≫
            (F.mapComp (f ≫ 𝐪 b) h).inv := by
        rw [hγ]
    _ = _ := by bicategory

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoFunctor.mapCompRight_γ

      (F.mapComp f g).inv ▷ 𝐪 (F.obj c) ≫ (hF.γHom (f ≫ g)).hom ≫ F.map₂ (α_ f g (𝐪 c)).hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [γHom_hom, γHom_hom, Pseudofunctor.map₂_associator]
  simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
  rw [← whisker_exchange_assoc (F.mapComp f g).inv (hF.k c).hom,
    Bicategory.inv_hom_whiskerRight_assoc]
  bicategory

proof:
:= by
  apply hom₂_ext
  · simp only [ShiftFunctor.comp_γ_hom_app, postShift_γ_hom_app, homShiftFunctor_γ_hom_app,
      homShiftFunctor_F, postShift_F, TwoSuperfunctor.mapFunctor_map,

      homShift_Q, mapCompLeftNat, Iso.symm_hom, PiTwoFunctor.homFunctor_map, Functor.comp_obj,

      Category.assoc]
    exact hF.mapCompLeft_γ f.obj h.obj
  · simp only [ShiftFunctor.comp_γ_hom_app, postShift_γ_hom_app, homShiftFunctor_γ_hom_app,
      homShiftFunctor_F, postShift_F, TwoSuperfunctor.mapFunctor_map,
      TwoSupercategory.postcomp_map,
      homShift_Q, mapCompLeftNat, Iso.symm_hom, PiTwoFunctor.homFunctor_map, Functor.comp_obj,
      γR_hom, comp₂_fst, comp₂_snd, whiskerLeft_fst, whiskerLeft_snd, whiskerRight_fst,
      whiskerRight_snd, associator_hom_fst, associator_hom_snd, associator_inv_fst,
      associator_inv_snd, centralShift_γ_eq, Associated2.γhat_hom_fst, Associated2.γhat_hom_snd,
      γhat_hom_app_fst, γhat_hom_app_snd, PiTwoFunctor.mapTwo_mapComp, Associated.evenIso_hom,
      Associated.homMk_fst, Associated.homMk_snd, PiTwoFunctor.mapTwo_map₂, Associated.map_map,
      Limits.zero_comp, Limits.comp_zero, PreadditiveBicategory.whiskerLeft_zero,

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoFunctor.kIso_mapQ_hom
statement:
theorem kIso_mapQ_hom (a : B) :
    (hF.mapQ.kIso (⟨⟨a⟩⟩ : QAssociated2 R B)).hom = hom2 (hF.k a).hom
proof:
:= by
  have e : (QPiTwoSupercategory.σ (R := R) (⟨⟨a⟩⟩ : QAssociated2 R B)).inv =
      (Orbit.σIso (⟨𝟙 (⟨a⟩ : Associated2 R B)⟩ : (⟨⟨a⟩⟩ : QAssociated2 R B) ⟶ ⟨⟨a⟩⟩)).inv ≫
        (Orbit.ι (homShift R (⟨a⟩ : Associated2 R B) ⟨a⟩)).map
          (BicategoryStruct.leftUnitor (CentralShift.q (R := R) (⟨a⟩ : Associated2 R B))).hom := by
    simp [Orbit2.σ_eq, Orbit2.σ]
  rw [TwoSuperfunctor.kIso_hom]
  change (QPiTwoSupercategory.σ (R := R) (⟨hF.mapTwo.obj ⟨a⟩⟩ : QAssociated2 R C)).hom ≫
    (Orbit.ι (homShift R (hF.mapTwo.obj (⟨a⟩ : Associated2 R B))
      (hF.mapTwo.obj (⟨a⟩ : Associated2 R B)))).map (hF.mapTwo.mapId ⟨a⟩).hom ≫
    (Orbit.map (hF.homShiftFunctor R ⟨a⟩ ⟨a⟩)).map
      (QPiTwoSupercategory.σ (R := R) (⟨⟨a⟩⟩ : QAssociated2 R B)).inv = _
  rw [e, Orbit2.σ_eq, Orbit2.σ_hom, Functor.map_comp, Orbit.map_σIso_inv, Orbit.map_ι_map]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  have hn : (Orbit.σIso (⟨𝟙 (hF.mapTwo.obj (⟨a⟩ : Associated2 R B))⟩ :
      Orbit (homShift R (hF.mapTwo.obj (⟨a⟩ : Associated2 R B))
        (hF.mapTwo.obj (⟨a⟩ : Associated2 R B))))).hom ≫
      (Orbit.ι (homShift R (hF.mapTwo.obj (⟨a⟩ : Associated2 R B))
        (hF.mapTwo.obj (⟨a⟩ : Associated2 R B)))).map (hF.mapTwo.mapId ⟨a⟩).hom =
      (Orbit.ι (homShift R (hF.mapTwo.obj (⟨a⟩ : Associated2 R B))
        (hF.mapTwo.obj (⟨a⟩ : Associated2 R B)))).map
          ((homShift R _ _).Q.map (hF.mapTwo.mapId ⟨a⟩).hom) ≫
        (Orbit.σIso (⟨hF.mapTwo.map (𝟙 (⟨a⟩ : Associated2 R B))⟩ :
          Orbit (homShift R (hF.mapTwo.obj (⟨a⟩ : Associated2 R B))
            (hF.mapTwo.obj (⟨a⟩ : Associated2 R B))))).hom :=
    Orbit.σIso_hom_naturality _
  rw [reassoc_of% hn]
  simp only [homShiftFunctor_F]
  erw [Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
  rw [← Functor.map_comp, ← Functor.map_comp, ← Functor.map_comp]
  refine congrArg (Orbit.ι (homShift R (hF.mapTwo.obj (⟨a⟩ : Associated2 R B))
    (hF.mapTwo.obj (⟨a⟩ : Associated2 R B)))).map ?_
  apply Associated2.hom₂_ext
  · simp only [comp₂_fst, comp₂_snd, Associated2.leftUnitor_inv_fst,
      Associated2.leftUnitor_inv_snd, Associated2.leftUnitor_hom_fst, Associated2.leftUnitor_hom_snd,
      homShift_Q, TwoSupercategory.postcomp_map, whiskerRight_fst, whiskerRight_snd,
      homShiftFunctor_γ_hom_app, γhat_hom_app_fst, γhat_hom_app_snd, PiTwoFunctor.mapTwo_mapId,
      Associated.evenIso_hom, Associated.homMk_fst, Associated.homMk_snd, Iso.symm_hom,
      TwoSuperfunctor.mapFunctor_map, PiTwoFunctor.mapTwo_map₂, Associated.map_map,
      PiTwoFunctor.homFunctor_map, Limits.zero_comp,
      PreadditiveBicategory.zero_whiskerRight, sub_zero, add_zero]
    exact hF.k_eq_γHom_id a
  · simp only [comp₂_fst, comp₂_snd, Associated2.leftUnitor_inv_fst,
      Associated2.leftUnitor_inv_snd, Associated2.leftUnitor_hom_fst, Associated2.leftUnitor_hom_snd,
      homShift_Q, TwoSupercategory.postcomp_map, whiskerRight_fst, whiskerRight_snd,
      homShiftFunctor_γ_hom_app, γhat_hom_app_fst, γhat_hom_app_snd, PiTwoFunctor.mapTwo_mapId,
      Associated.evenIso_hom, Associated.homMk_fst, Associated.homMk_snd, Iso.symm_hom,
      TwoSuperfunctor.mapFunctor_map, PiTwoFunctor.mapTwo_map₂, Associated.map_map,
      PiTwoFunctor.homFunctor_map, Limits.zero_comp,
      PreadditiveBicategory.zero_whiskerRight, sub_zero, add_zero]
    rw [hF.toPiTwoFunctor.map₂_zero]
    simp

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.EndId.x_comp'

    θ.x (f ≫ g) = (BicategoryStruct.associator f g (θ.X c)).hom ≫ f ◁ θ.x g ≫
      (BicategoryStruct.associator f (θ.X b) g).inv ≫ θ.x f ▷ g ≫ (BicategoryStruct.associator (θ.X a) f g).hom

:= by

name: StringDiagrams.DrinfeldCenter.braidingApp_naturality
statement:
theorem braidingApp_naturality {a b : B} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (X ⊗ Y).toTwoNatTrans.x f ≫ braidingApp X Y a ▷ (TwoSuperfunctor.id R B).map f =
      (TwoSuperfunctor.id R B).map f ◁ braidingApp X Y b ≫ (Y ⊗ X).toTwoNatTrans.x f
proof:
:= by
  have h := X.toTwoNatTrans.naturality (Y.toTwoNatTrans.x f)
  simp only [TwoSuperfunctor.id_map] at h
  rw [TwoNatTrans.EndId.x_comp', TwoNatTrans.EndId.x_comp'] at h
  change ((BicategoryStruct.associator f (Y.toTwoNatTrans.X b) (X.toTwoNatTrans.X b)).inv ≫
      Y.toTwoNatTrans.x f ▷ X.toTwoNatTrans.X b ≫
        (BicategoryStruct.associator (Y.toTwoNatTrans.X a) f (X.toTwoNatTrans.X b)).hom ≫
          Y.toTwoNatTrans.X a ◁ X.toTwoNatTrans.x f ≫
            (BicategoryStruct.associator (Y.toTwoNatTrans.X a) (X.toTwoNatTrans.X a) f).inv) ≫
              X.toTwoNatTrans.x (Y.toTwoNatTrans.X a) ▷ f =
    f ◁ X.toTwoNatTrans.x (Y.toTwoNatTrans.X b) ≫
      ((BicategoryStruct.associator f (X.toTwoNatTrans.X b) (Y.toTwoNatTrans.X b)).inv ≫
        X.toTwoNatTrans.x f ▷ Y.toTwoNatTrans.X b ≫
          (BicategoryStruct.associator (X.toTwoNatTrans.X a) f (Y.toTwoNatTrans.X b)).hom ≫
            X.toTwoNatTrans.X a ◁ Y.toTwoNatTrans.x f ≫
              (BicategoryStruct.associator (X.toTwoNatTrans.X a) (Y.toTwoNatTrans.X a) f).inv)
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [← cancel_mono (BicategoryStruct.associator (X.toTwoNatTrans.X a) (Y.toTwoNatTrans.X a) f).hom,
    ← cancel_epi (BicategoryStruct.associator f (Y.toTwoNatTrans.X b) (X.toTwoNatTrans.X b)).hom]
  simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
  simpa only [Category.assoc] using h

name: StringDiagrams.DrinfeldCenter.braiding_hom_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem braiding_hom_app (a : B) :
    (braiding X Y).hom.app a = X.toTwoNatTrans.x (Y.toTwoNatTrans.X a)

name: StringDiagrams.PiSOp.unsop_twist
statement:
theorem unsop_twist {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {C : Type*} [Category C]
    [Preadditive C] [Linear R C] [Supercategory R C]
    {X Y : SOp R C} (p : ZMod 2) (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    SOp.unsop (twist R p f) = twist R p (SOp.unsop f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [twist_apply, SOp.unsop_add, SOp.unsop_smul, SOp.unsop_proj, SOp.unsop_proj]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.PiSOp.comparison_even
statement:
theorem comparison_even {a b c : TwoEnvelope R (TwoSOp R B)} (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) :
    (comparison f g).hom ∈ parity (R := R)
      ((hom a b).obj f ≫ (hom b c).obj g) ((hom a c).obj (f ≫ g)) 0

name: StringDiagrams.PiSOp.comparison_degree
statement:
theorem comparison_degree {a b c : TwoEnvelope R (TwoSOp R B)} (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) :
    (comparison f g).hom ∈ degree (R := R)
      ((hom a b).obj f ≫ (hom b c).obj g) ((hom a c).obj (f ≫ g)) 0

name: StringDiagrams.Underlying.tensorObj_obj
statement: @[simp] theorem tensorObj_obj (X Y : Underlying R C) : (X ⊗ Y).obj = X.obj ⊗ Y.obj

name: StringDiagrams.Underlying.tensorUnit_obj
statement: @[simp] theorem tensorUnit_obj : (𝟙_ (Underlying R C)).obj = 𝟙_ C

name: StringDiagrams.Underlying.whiskerLeft_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem whiskerLeft_val (X : Underlying R C) {Y Y' : Underlying R C} (f : Y ⟶ Y') :

name: StringDiagrams.Underlying.whiskerRight_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem whiskerRight_val {X X' : Underlying R C} (f : X ⟶ X') (Y : Underlying R C) :

name: StringDiagrams.Underlying.tensorHom_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem tensorHom_val {X X' Y Y' : Underlying R C} (f : X ⟶ X') (g : Y ⟶ Y') :
    (f ⊗ₘ g).1 = f.1 ⊗ₘ g.1

name: StringDiagrams.Underlying.associator_hom_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem associator_hom_val (X Y Z : Underlying R C) :
    (α_ X Y Z).hom.1 = (α_ X.obj Y.obj Z.obj).hom

name: StringDiagrams.Underlying.associator_inv_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem associator_inv_val (X Y Z : Underlying R C) :
    (α_ X Y Z).inv.1 = (α_ X.obj Y.obj Z.obj).inv

name: StringDiagrams.Underlying.leftUnitor_hom_val
statement: @[simp] theorem leftUnitor_hom_val (X : Underlying R C) : (λ_ X).hom.1 = (λ_ X.obj).hom

name: StringDiagrams.Underlying.leftUnitor_inv_val
statement: @[simp] theorem leftUnitor_inv_val (X : Underlying R C) : (λ_ X).inv.1 = (λ_ X.obj).inv

name: StringDiagrams.Underlying.rightUnitor_hom_val
statement: @[simp] theorem rightUnitor_hom_val (X : Underlying R C) : (ρ_ X).hom.1 = (ρ_ X.obj).hom

name: StringDiagrams.Underlying.rightUnitor_inv_val
statement: @[simp] theorem rightUnitor_inv_val (X : Underlying R C) : (ρ_ X).inv.1 = (ρ_ X.obj).inv

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalSupercategory.unitors_equal
statement: theorem unitors_equal : (λ_ (𝟙_ C)).hom = (ρ_ (𝟙_ C)).hom

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalSupercategory.leftUnitor_tensor
statement:
theorem leftUnitor_tensor (X Y : C) :
    (λ_ (X ⊗ Y)).hom = (α_ (𝟙_ C) X Y).inv ≫ (λ_ X).hom ▷ Y

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalSupercategory.rightUnitor_tensor_inv
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem rightUnitor_tensor_inv (X Y : C) :
    (ρ_ (X ⊗ Y)).inv = X ◁ (ρ_ Y).inv ≫ (α_ X Y (𝟙_ C)).inv

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalSupercategory.rightUnitor_inv_naturality
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem rightUnitor_inv_naturality {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    (ρ_ X).inv ≫ f ▷ 𝟙_ C = f ≫ (ρ_ Y).inv
proof:
:= by
  rw [Iso.inv_comp_eq, ← Category.assoc, ← rightUnitor_naturality (R := R), Category.assoc,
    Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalSupercategory.associator_inv_naturality_right
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem associator_inv_naturality_right (X Y : C) {Z Z' : C} (h : Z ⟶ Z') :
    X ◁ (Y ◁ h) ≫ (α_ X Y Z').inv = (α_ X Y Z).inv ≫ (X ⊗ Y) ◁ h
proof:
:= by
  rw [Iso.eq_inv_comp, ← Category.assoc, ← associator_naturality_right R, Category.assoc,
    Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiSupercategory.ζ_inv_mem
statement: theorem ζ_inv_mem : (𝛇).inv ∈ parity (R := R) (𝟙_ C) 𝛑 1

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiSupercategory.ζL_hom_mem
statement: theorem ζL_hom_mem (X : C) : (ζL (R := R) X).hom ∈ parity (R := R) (𝛑 ⊗ X) X 1
proof:
:= by
  simpa using! comp_mem (MonoidalSupercategory.whiskerRight_mem X (ζ_hom_mem (R := R) (C := C)))
    (MonoidalSupercategory.leftUnitor_hom_mem (R := R) X)

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiSupercategory.ζR_hom_mem
statement: theorem ζR_hom_mem (X : C) : (ζR (R := R) X).hom ∈ parity (R := R) (X ⊗ 𝛑) X 1
proof:
:= by
  simpa using! comp_mem (MonoidalSupercategory.whiskerLeft_mem X (ζ_hom_mem (R := R) (C := C)))
    (MonoidalSupercategory.rightUnitor_hom_mem (R := R) X)

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiSupercategory.ζL_naturality
statement:
theorem ζL_naturality {X Y : C} {q : ZMod 2} {f : X ⟶ Y} (hf : f ∈ parity (R := R) X Y q) :
    𝛑 ◁ f ≫ (ζL (R := R) Y).hom = sign R q • ((ζL (R := R) X).hom ≫ f)
proof:
:= by
  have h := MonoidalSupercategory.super_interchange (ζ_hom_mem (R := R) (C := C)) hf
  rw [koszulSign_smul (R := R), one_mul] at h
  have h' : 𝛑 ◁ f ≫ (𝛇).hom ▷ Y = sign R q • ((𝛇).hom ▷ X ≫ 𝟙_ C ◁ f) := by
    rw [h, sign_smul_sign_smul]
  simp only [ζL, ← Category.assoc, h', Linear.smul_comp]
  rw [Category.assoc, MonoidalSupercategory.leftUnitor_naturality (R := R), Category.assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiSupercategory.ζR_naturality
statement:
theorem ζR_naturality {X Y : C} {q : ZMod 2} {f : X ⟶ Y} (hf : f ∈ parity (R := R) X Y q) :
    f ▷ 𝛑 ≫ (ζR (R := R) Y).hom = sign R q • ((ζR (R := R) X).hom ≫ f)
proof:
:= by
  have h := MonoidalSupercategory.super_interchange hf (ζ_hom_mem (R := R) (C := C))
  rw [koszulSign_smul (R := R), mul_one] at h
  simp only [ζR, ← Category.assoc, h, Linear.smul_comp]
  rw [Category.assoc, MonoidalSupercategory.rightUnitor_naturality (R := R), Category.assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiSupercategory.β_hom
statement:
theorem β_hom (X : C) :
    (β (R := R) X).hom = (𝛇).hom ▷ X ≫ (λ_ X).hom ≫ (ρ_ X).inv ≫ X ◁ (𝛇).inv

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiSupercategory.β_hom_mem
statement: theorem β_hom_mem (X : C) : (β (R := R) X).hom ∈ parity (R := R) (𝛑 ⊗ X) (X ⊗ 𝛑) 0
proof:
:= by
  have := comp_mem (ζL_hom_mem (R := R) X) (inv_mem _ (ζR_hom_mem (R := R) X))
  simpa [β] using! this

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiSupercategory.β_naturality
statement:
theorem β_naturality {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    𝛑 ◁ f ≫ (β (R := R) Y).hom = (β (R := R) X).hom ≫ f ▷ 𝛑
proof:
:= by
  refine induction_on (R := R) f ?_ (fun q f hf => ?_) (fun f g hf hg => ?_)
  · rw [MonoidalSupercategory.whiskerLeft_zero R, MonoidalSupercategory.zero_whiskerRight R,
      Limits.zero_comp, Limits.comp_zero]
  · have h2 : (ζR (R := R) X).inv ≫ f ▷ 𝛑 = sign R q • (f ≫ (ζR (R := R) Y).inv) := by
      rw [← cancel_mono (ζR (R := R) Y).hom, Category.assoc, ζR_naturality hf,
        Linear.comp_smul, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc, Linear.smul_comp, Category.assoc,
        Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]
    simp only [β, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom]
    rw [← Category.assoc, ζL_naturality hf, Linear.smul_comp, Category.assoc, Category.assoc,
      h2, Linear.comp_smul]
  · rw [MonoidalSupercategory.whiskerLeft_add (R := R),
      MonoidalSupercategory.add_whiskerRight (R := R),
      Preadditive.add_comp, Preadditive.comp_add, hf, hg]

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiSupercategory.β_unit
statement: theorem β_unit : (β (R := R) (𝟙_ C)).hom ≫ (λ_ 𝛑).hom = (ρ_ 𝛑).hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [β_hom, Category.assoc, Category.assoc, Category.assoc,
    MonoidalSupercategory.leftUnitor_naturality (R := R),
    MonoidalSupercategory.unitors_equal R, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc, ← Category.assoc,
    MonoidalSupercategory.rightUnitor_naturality (R := R), Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id,
    Category.comp_id]

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiSupercategory.associator_ζL
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem associator_ζL (X Y : C) :
    (α_ 𝛑 X Y).hom ≫ (ζL (R := R) (X ⊗ Y)).hom = (ζL (R := R) X).hom ▷ Y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ζL]
  rw [← Category.assoc, ← MonoidalSupercategory.associator_naturality_left R,
    MonoidalSupercategory.leftUnitor_tensor R, Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc,
    MonoidalSupercategory.comp_whiskerRight (R := R)]

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiSupercategory.ζR_inv_associator
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem ζR_inv_associator (X Y : C) :
    (ζR (R := R) (X ⊗ Y)).inv ≫ (α_ X Y 𝛑).hom = X ◁ (ζR (R := R) Y).inv
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ζR]
  rw [Category.assoc, MonoidalSupercategory.associator_naturality_right R,
    MonoidalSupercategory.rightUnitor_tensor_inv R, Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc,
    MonoidalSupercategory.whiskerLeft_comp (R := R)]

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiSupercategory.ζR_inv_whiskerRight_associator_ζL
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem ζR_inv_whiskerRight_associator_ζL (X Y : C) :
    (ζR (R := R) X).inv ▷ Y ≫ (α_ X 𝛑 Y).hom ≫ X ◁ (ζL (R := R) Y).hom = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ζR, ζL]
  rw [MonoidalSupercategory.comp_whiskerRight (R := R),
    MonoidalSupercategory.whiskerLeft_comp (R := R),
    Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc ((X ◁ (𝛇).inv) ▷ Y),
    MonoidalSupercategory.associator_naturality_middle R, Category.assoc,
    ← Category.assoc (X ◁ (𝛇).inv ▷ Y), ← MonoidalSupercategory.whiskerLeft_comp (R := R),
    ← MonoidalSupercategory.comp_whiskerRight (R := R), Iso.inv_hom_id,
    MonoidalSupercategory.id_whiskerRight (R := R), MonoidalSupercategory.whiskerLeft_id (R := R),
    Category.id_comp, MonoidalSupercategory.triangle (R := R),
    ← MonoidalSupercategory.comp_whiskerRight (R := R), Iso.inv_hom_id,
    MonoidalSupercategory.id_whiskerRight (R := R)]

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiSupercategory.β_tensor
statement:
theorem β_tensor (X Y : C) :
    (α_ 𝛑 X Y).hom ≫ (β (R := R) (X ⊗ Y)).hom ≫ (α_ X Y 𝛑).hom =
      (β (R := R) X).hom ▷ Y ≫ (α_ X 𝛑 Y).hom ≫ X ◁ (β (R := R) Y).hom
proof:
:= by
  simp only [β, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Category.assoc]
  rw [associator_ζL_assoc, ζR_inv_associator, MonoidalSupercategory.comp_whiskerRight (R := R),
    MonoidalSupercategory.whiskerLeft_comp (R := R), Category.assoc,
    ζR_inv_whiskerRight_associator_ζL_assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiSupercategory.ζL_pi
statement: theorem ζL_pi : (ζL (R := R) 𝛑).hom = -(ζR (R := R) 𝛑).hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cancel_mono (𝛇).hom]
  have h := MonoidalSupercategory.super_interchange (ζ_hom_mem (R := R) (C := C))
    (ζ_hom_mem (R := R) (C := C))
  rw [koszulSign_one_one, neg_one_smul] at h
  simp only [ζL, ζR, Category.assoc, Preadditive.neg_comp]
  rw [← MonoidalSupercategory.leftUnitor_naturality (R := R), ← Category.assoc, h,
    Preadditive.neg_comp, Category.assoc, MonoidalSupercategory.unitors_equal R,
    MonoidalSupercategory.rightUnitor_naturality (R := R)]

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiSupercategory.β_pi
statement: theorem β_pi : (β (R := R) 𝛑).hom = -𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  simp only [β, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom]
  rw [ζL_pi, Preadditive.neg_comp, Iso.hom_inv_id]

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiSupercategory.ξ_hom
statement: theorem ξ_hom : (ξ (R := R) (C := C)).hom = (ζR (R := R) 𝛑).hom ≫ (𝛇).hom

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiSupercategory.ξ_inv
statement: theorem ξ_inv : (ξ (R := R) (C := C)).inv = (𝛇).inv ≫ (ζR (R := R) 𝛑).inv

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiSupercategory.ξ_hom_eq
statement:
theorem ξ_hom_eq : (ξ (R := R) (C := C)).hom =
    MonoidalSupercategory.superTensorHom (𝛇).hom (𝛇).hom ≫ (λ_ (𝟙_ C)).hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [ξ_hom, MonoidalSupercategory.superTensorHom, MonoidalSupercategory.unitors_equal R]
  simp only [ζR, Category.assoc]
  rw [← MonoidalSupercategory.rightUnitor_naturality (R := R)]

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiSupercategory.ξ_hom_mem
statement: theorem ξ_hom_mem : (ξ (R := R) (C := C)).hom ∈ parity (R := R) (𝛑 ⊗ 𝛑) (𝟙_ C) 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa using! comp_mem (ζR_hom_mem (R := R) 𝛑) (ζ_hom_mem (R := R) (C := C))

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiSupercategory.ξ_hom_eq_neg
statement: theorem ξ_hom_eq_neg : (ξ (R := R) (C := C)).hom = -((ζL (R := R) 𝛑).hom ≫ (𝛇).hom)

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiSupercategory.ξ_whiskerRight_leftUnitor
statement:
theorem ξ_whiskerRight_leftUnitor (X : C) :
    (ξ (R := R) (C := C)).hom ▷ X ≫ (λ_ X).hom =
      -((ζL (R := R) 𝛑).hom ▷ X ≫ (ζL (R := R) X).hom)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ξ_hom_eq_neg, MonoidalSupercategory.neg_whiskerRight R,
    MonoidalSupercategory.comp_whiskerRight (R := R), Preadditive.neg_comp]
  simp [ζL]

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiSupercategory.rightUnitor_inv_whiskerLeft_ξ_inv
statement:
theorem rightUnitor_inv_whiskerLeft_ξ_inv (X : C) :
    (ρ_ X).inv ≫ X ◁ (ξ (R := R) (C := C)).inv =
      (ζR (R := R) X).inv ≫ X ◁ (ζR (R := R) 𝛑).inv

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiSupercategory.whiskerLeft_ζR_inv_associator_inv_ζL
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem whiskerLeft_ζR_inv_associator_inv_ζL (X : C) :
    𝛑 ◁ (ζR (R := R) X).inv ≫ (α_ 𝛑 X 𝛑).inv ≫ (ζL (R := R) X).hom ▷ 𝛑 =
      -((ζL (R := R) X).hom ≫ (ζR (R := R) X).inv)
proof:
:= by
  have hf : (𝛇).hom ▷ X ∈ parity (R := R) (𝛑 ⊗ X) (𝟙_ C ⊗ X) 1 :=
    MonoidalSupercategory.whiskerRight_mem X (ζ_hom_mem (R := R) (C := C))
  have hi := MonoidalSupercategory.super_interchange hf (ζ_inv_mem (R := R) (C := C))
  rw [koszulSign_one_one, neg_one_smul] at hi
  have hi' : (𝛑 ⊗ X) ◁ (𝛇).inv ≫ ((𝛇).hom ▷ X) ▷ 𝛑 =
      -(((𝛇).hom ▷ X) ▷ 𝟙_ C ≫ (𝟙_ C ⊗ X) ◁ (𝛇).inv) := by rw [hi, neg_neg]
  have he := MonoidalSupercategory.interchange_of_even_left
    (MonoidalSupercategory.leftUnitor_hom_mem (R := R) X) (ζ_inv_mem (R := R) (C := C))
  simp only [ζR, ζL, MonoidalSupercategory.whiskerLeft_comp (R := R),
    MonoidalSupercategory.comp_whiskerRight (R := R), Category.assoc]
  rw [MonoidalSupercategory.associator_inv_naturality_right_assoc R, reassoc_of% hi']
  simp only [Preadditive.neg_comp, Preadditive.comp_neg, Category.assoc]
  rw [← he, ← MonoidalSupercategory.rightUnitor_tensor_inv_assoc R,
    ← Category.assoc ((𝛇).hom ▷ X ▷ 𝟙_ C), ← MonoidalSupercategory.comp_whiskerRight (R := R),
    MonoidalSupercategory.rightUnitor_inv_naturality_assoc R, Category.assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiSupercategory.associator_whiskerLeft_ζL_ζL
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem associator_whiskerLeft_ζL_ζL (X : C) :
    (α_ 𝛑 𝛑 X).hom ≫ 𝛑 ◁ (ζL (R := R) X).hom ≫ (ζL (R := R) X).hom =
      -((ζL (R := R) 𝛑).hom ▷ X ≫ (ζL (R := R) X).hom)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ζL_naturality (ζL_hom_mem (R := R) X), sign_one, neg_one_smul, Preadditive.comp_neg,
    associator_ζL_assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiSupercategory.ζR_inv_whiskerRight_associator
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem ζR_inv_whiskerRight_associator (X : C) :
    (ζR (R := R) X).inv ▷ 𝛑 ≫ (α_ X 𝛑 𝛑).hom = -(X ◁ (ζR (R := R) 𝛑).inv)
proof:
:= by
  have h := ζR_naturality (inv_mem _ (ζR_hom_mem (R := R) X))
  rw [sign_one, neg_one_smul, Iso.hom_inv_id] at h
  have h' : (ζR (R := R) X).inv ▷ 𝛑 = -(ζR (R := R) (X ⊗ 𝛑)).inv := by
    rw [← cancel_mono (ζR (R := R) (X ⊗ 𝛑)).hom, h, Preadditive.neg_comp, Iso.inv_hom_id]
  rw [h', Preadditive.neg_comp, ζR_inv_associator]

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiSupercategory.ξ_comm
statement:
theorem ξ_comm (X : C) :
    (ξ (R := R) (C := C)).hom ▷ X ≫ (λ_ X).hom ≫ (ρ_ X).inv ≫ X ◁ (ξ (R := R) (C := C)).inv =
      (α_ 𝛑 𝛑 X).hom ≫ 𝛑 ◁ (β (R := R) X).hom ≫ (α_ 𝛑 X 𝛑).inv ≫
        (β (R := R) X).hom ▷ 𝛑 ≫ (α_ X 𝛑 𝛑).hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Category.assoc, ξ_whiskerRight_leftUnitor, rightUnitor_inv_whiskerLeft_ξ_inv]
  simp only [β, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, MonoidalSupercategory.whiskerLeft_comp (R := R),
    MonoidalSupercategory.comp_whiskerRight (R := R), Category.assoc]
  rw [whiskerLeft_ζR_inv_associator_inv_ζL_assoc, ζR_inv_whiskerRight_associator]
  simp only [Preadditive.neg_comp, Preadditive.comp_neg, neg_neg, Category.assoc]
  rw [associator_whiskerLeft_ζL_ζL_assoc]
  simp only [Preadditive.neg_comp, Category.assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalSuperfunctor.jIso_hom
statement: theorem jIso_hom : (jIso hF).hom = (𝛇D).hom ≫ hF.εIso.hom ≫ F.map (𝛇C).inv

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalSuperfunctor.jIso_hom_mem
statement: theorem jIso_hom_mem : (jIso hF).hom ∈ parity (R := R) 𝛑D (F.obj 𝛑C) 0
proof:
:= by
  have := comp_mem (comp_mem (MonoidalPiSupercategory.ζ_hom_mem (R := R) (C := D)) hF.ε_mem)
    (Supercategory.map_mem F (MonoidalPiSupercategory.ζ_inv_mem (R := R) (C := C)))
  simpa using! this

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalSuperfunctor.jIso_hom_comp_map_ζ
statement: theorem jIso_hom_comp_map_ζ : (jIso hF).hom ≫ F.map (𝛇C).hom = (𝛇D).hom ≫ hF.εIso.hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [jIso_hom, Category.assoc, Category.assoc, ← F.map_comp, Iso.inv_hom_id, F.map_id,
    Category.comp_id]

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalSuperfunctor.β_comm_left
statement:
theorem β_comm_left (X : C) :
    (jIso hF).hom ▷ F.obj X ≫ (hF.μIso 𝛑C X).hom ≫
        F.map (MonoidalPiSupercategory.β (R := R) X).hom =
      (𝛇D).hom ▷ F.obj X ≫ (λ_ (F.obj X)).hom ≫ F.map (ρ_ X).inv ≫ F.map (X ◁ (𝛇C).inv)
proof:
:= by
  rw [MonoidalPiSupercategory.β_hom, F.map_comp, F.map_comp, F.map_comp,
    ← reassoc_of% (hF.μ_natural_left (𝛇C).hom X), ← Category.assoc,
    ← MonoidalSupercategory.comp_whiskerRight (R := R), jIso_hom_comp_map_ζ,
    MonoidalSupercategory.comp_whiskerRight (R := R), Category.assoc,
    reassoc_of% (hF.left_unitality X).symm]

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalSuperfunctor.β_comm_right
statement:
theorem β_comm_right (X : C) :
    (MonoidalPiSupercategory.β (R := R) (F.obj X)).hom ≫ F.obj X ◁ (jIso hF).hom ≫
        (hF.μIso X 𝛑C).hom =
      (𝛇D).hom ▷ F.obj X ≫ (λ_ (F.obj X)).hom ≫ F.map (ρ_ X).inv ≫ F.map (X ◁ (𝛇C).inv)
proof:
:= by
  rw [MonoidalPiSupercategory.β_hom]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  congr 2
  rw [jIso_hom, MonoidalSupercategory.whiskerLeft_comp (R := R),
    MonoidalSupercategory.whiskerLeft_comp (R := R), Category.assoc,
    ← reassoc_of% (MonoidalSupercategory.whiskerLeft_comp (R := R) (F.obj X) (𝛇D).inv (𝛇D).hom),
    Iso.inv_hom_id, MonoidalSupercategory.whiskerLeft_id (R := R), Category.id_comp]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [hF.μ_natural_right, ← Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc]
  congr 1
  rw [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_comp_eq, hF.right_unitality X, Category.assoc, Category.assoc,
    ← F.map_comp, Iso.hom_inv_id, F.map_id, Category.comp_id]

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalSuperfunctor.ξ_comm_aux
statement:
theorem ξ_comm_aux :
    (MonoidalPiSupercategory.ξ (R := R) (C := D)).hom ≫ hF.εIso.hom =
      ((jIso hF).hom ▷ 𝛑D ≫ F.obj 𝛑C ◁ (jIso hF).hom) ≫ (hF.μIso 𝛑C 𝛑C).hom ≫
        F.map (MonoidalPiSupercategory.ξ (R := R) (C := C)).hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [MonoidalPiSupercategory.ξ_hom, MonoidalPiSupercategory.ξ_hom]
  simp only [MonoidalPiSupercategory.ζR, F.map_comp, Category.assoc]
  rw [← reassoc_of% (hF.μ_natural_right 𝛑C (𝛇C).hom), ← reassoc_of%
    (MonoidalSupercategory.whiskerLeft_comp (R := R) (F.obj 𝛑C) (jIso hF).hom (F.map (𝛇C).hom)),
    jIso_hom_comp_map_ζ, MonoidalSupercategory.whiskerLeft_comp (R := R), Category.assoc,
    ← reassoc_of% (hF.right_unitality 𝛑C),
    reassoc_of% (MonoidalSupercategory.interchange_of_even_left (jIso_hom_mem hF)
      (MonoidalPiSupercategory.ζ_hom_mem (R := R) (C := D))),
    reassoc_of% (MonoidalSupercategory.rightUnitor_naturality (R := R) (jIso hF).hom),
    jIso_hom_comp_map_ζ hF]

name: StringDiagrams.Associated2.T_map₂_whiskerRight

name: StringDiagrams.Associated2.T_map₂_associator_inv
statement:
theorem T_map₂_associator_inv {a b c d : Associated2 R (Underlying2 R A)} (f : a ⟶ b)
    (g : b ⟶ c) (h : c ⟶ d) :
    (T R A).map₂ (associator f g h).inv =
      (associator ((T R A).map f) ((T R A).map g) ((T R A).map h)).inv
proof:
:= by
  have := (T R A).map₂_associator f g h
  erw [whiskerLeft_id (R := R), id_whiskerRight (R := R), Category.id_comp, Category.id_comp,
    Category.comp_id] at this
  erw [Category.comp_id] at this
  exact this

name: StringDiagrams.Associated2.T_map₂_associator_hom
statement:
theorem T_map₂_associator_hom {a b c d : Associated2 R (Underlying2 R A)} (f : a ⟶ b)
    (g : b ⟶ c) (h : c ⟶ d) :
    (T R A).map₂ (associator f g h).hom =
      (associator ((T R A).map f) ((T R A).map g) ((T R A).map h)).hom
proof:
:= by
  have e : (T R A).map₂ (associator f g h).hom ≫ (T R A).map₂ (associator f g h).inv = 𝟙 _ := by
    rw [← (T R A).map₂_comp, Iso.hom_inv_id, (T R A).map₂_id]
  rw [T_map₂_associator_inv] at e
  exact (Iso.comp_inv_eq_id _).1 e

name: StringDiagrams.Associated2.T_map₂_leftUnitor_hom
statement:
theorem T_map₂_leftUnitor_hom {a b : Associated2 R (Underlying2 R A)} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (T R A).map₂ (leftUnitor f).hom = (leftUnitor ((T R A).map f)).hom
proof:
:= by
  have := (T R A).map₂_leftUnitor f
  erw [id_whiskerRight (R := R), Category.id_comp, Category.id_comp] at this
  exact this

name: StringDiagrams.Associated2.T_map₂_rightUnitor_hom
statement:
theorem T_map₂_rightUnitor_hom {a b : Associated2 R (Underlying2 R A)} (f : a ⟶ b) :

name: StringDiagrams.Associated2.Tinv₂_mem
proof:

name: StringDiagrams.Associated2.T_comp_Tinv
statement: theorem T_comp_Tinv : (T R A).comp (Tinv R A) = TwoSuperfunctor.id R _
proof:
:= by
  refine TwoEnvelope.twoSuperfunctor_ext rfl HEq.rfl (heq_of_eq ?_) (heq_of_eq ?_)
    (heq_of_eq ?_)
  · funext a b f g x
    exact Tinv₂_T_map₂ x
  · funext a b c f g
    apply Iso.ext
    change 𝟙 _ ≫ Tinv₂ R A (𝟙 _) = 𝟙 _
    rw [Category.id_comp]
    exact (Tinv R A).map₂_id _
  · funext a
    apply Iso.ext
    change 𝟙 _ ≫ Tinv₂ R A (𝟙 _) = 𝟙 _
    rw [Category.id_comp]
    exact (Tinv R A).map₂_id _

name: StringDiagrams.Associated2.Tinv_comp_T
statement: theorem Tinv_comp_T : (Tinv R A).comp (T R A) = TwoSuperfunctor.id R A
proof:
:= by
  refine TwoEnvelope.twoSuperfunctor_ext rfl HEq.rfl (heq_of_eq ?_) (heq_of_eq ?_)
    (heq_of_eq ?_)
  · funext a b f g x
    exact T_map₂_Tinv₂ (f := (Tinv R A).map f) (g := (Tinv R A).map g) x
  · funext a b c f g
    apply Iso.ext
    exact (Category.id_comp _).trans ((T R A).map₂_id _)
  · funext a
    apply Iso.ext
    exact (Category.id_comp _).trans ((T R A).map₂_id _)

name: StringDiagrams.Associated2.mapTwo_comp_T
statement:
theorem mapTwo_comp_T (G : TwoSuperfunctor R A A') :
    (G.toPiTwoFunctor.mapTwo).comp (T R A') = (T R A).comp G
proof:
:= by
  refine TwoEnvelope.twoSuperfunctor_ext rfl HEq.rfl (heq_of_eq ?_) (heq_of_eq ?_)
    (heq_of_eq ?_)
  · funext a b f g x
    exact T_map₂_mapTwo G x
  · funext a b c f g
    apply Iso.ext
    change 𝟙 _ ≫ (T R A').map₂ ((G.toPiTwoFunctor.mapTwo).mapComp f g).hom =
      (G.mapComp f.obj.obj g.obj.obj).hom ≫ G.map₂ (𝟙 _)
    rw [Category.id_comp, T_map₂_mapTwo_mapComp, G.map₂_id, Category.comp_id]
  · funext a
    apply Iso.ext
    change 𝟙 _ ≫ (T R A').map₂ ((G.toPiTwoFunctor.mapTwo).mapId a).hom =
      (G.mapId a.obj.obj).hom ≫ G.map₂ (𝟙 _)
    rw [Category.id_comp, T_map₂_mapTwo_mapId, G.map₂_id, Category.comp_id]

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.extendRestrictApp_precompose
statement:
theorem extendRestrictApp_precompose {a b : QPiTwoEnvelope R B} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    extendRestrictApp ((mapQPi F).comp T) ((mapQPi_isGraded hF).comp hT) f =
      extendRestrictApp T hT ((mapQPi F).map f)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [extendRestrictApp, QPiEnvelope.extendRestrictIso, Iso.trans_hom,
    NatTrans.comp_app, Envelope.extendIso_hom_app,
    QEnvelope.extendRestrictIso, Envelope.extendRestrictIso,
    NatIso.ofComponents_hom_app, Envelope.extendNat,
    Functor.mapIso_hom, Functor.comp_map, Functor.comp_obj]
  dsimp [homFunctor, TwoSuperfunctor.mapFunctor, TwoSuperfunctor.comp,
    mapQPi, TwoEnvelope.mapPi, TwoEnvelope.mapPiMap, TwoEnvelope.mapPiMap₂,
    QTwoEnvelope.mapQ, Envelope.shiftIso, QEnvelope.shiftIso,
    Envelope.isoOfIso, QEnvelope.isoOfIso, Envelope.J, QEnvelope.J,
    QEnvelope.extend, Envelope.toHom, QEnvelope.toHom, Envelope.ofHom, QEnvelope.ofHom]
  simp! only [F.map₂_id]
  congr 1
  congr 1
  exact congrArg (fun η : F.map f.obj.obj ⟶ F.map f.obj.obj =>
    T.map₂ (a := (mapQPi F).obj a) (b := (mapQPi F).obj b)
      (f := ⟨0, ⟨f.obj.shift, F.map f.obj.obj⟩⟩) (g := (mapQPi F).map f)
      (QPiEnvelope.ofHom
      (X := ⟨0, ⟨f.obj.shift, F.map f.obj.obj⟩⟩)
      (Y := (mapQPi F).map f) η)) (F.map₂_id f.obj.obj)

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.extendRestrictAppInv_precompose
statement:
theorem extendRestrictAppInv_precompose {a b : QPiTwoEnvelope R B} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    extendRestrictAppInv ((mapQPi F).comp T) ((mapQPi_isGraded hF).comp hT) f =
      extendRestrictAppInv T hT ((mapQPi F).map f)
proof:
:= by
  let U := (mapQPi F).comp T
  let hU := (mapQPi_isGraded hF).comp hT
  calc
    extendRestrictAppInv U hU f = extendRestrictAppInv U hU f ≫
        (extendRestrictApp T hT ((mapQPi F).map f) ≫
          extendRestrictAppInv T hT ((mapQPi F).map f)) := by
      rw [extendRestrictApp_comp_inv]
      exact (Category.comp_id _).symm
    _ = (extendRestrictAppInv U hU f ≫ extendRestrictApp U hU f) ≫
        extendRestrictAppInv T hT ((mapQPi F).map f) := by
      rw [extendRestrictApp_precompose F hF T hT, Category.assoc]
    _ = extendRestrictAppInv T hT ((mapQPi F).map f) := by
      rw [extendRestrictAppInv_comp, Category.id_comp]

name: StringDiagrams.BraidedMonoidalSupercategory.braiding_naturality
statement:
theorem braiding_naturality {X X' Y Y' : C} {p q : ZMod 2} {f : X ⟶ X'} {g : Y ⟶ Y'}
    (hf : f ∈ parity (R := R) X X' p) (hg : g ∈ parity (R := R) Y Y' q) :
    MonoidalSupercategory.superTensorHom f g ≫ (braiding (R := R) X' Y').hom =
      koszulSign p q • ((braiding (R := R) X Y).hom ≫ MonoidalSupercategory.superTensorHom g f)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [MonoidalSupercategory.superTensorHom, Category.assoc]
  rw [braiding_naturality_left, braiding_naturality_right_assoc,
    MonoidalSupercategory.super_interchange hg hf, koszulSign_comm, Linear.comp_smul]

name: StringDiagrams.Mat_.smul_apply

name: StringDiagrams.Mat_.diag_apply_self

name: StringDiagrams.Mat_.diag_apply_of_ne
statement:
theorem diag_apply_of_ne {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] {X Y : ι → C} (φ : ∀ i, X i ⟶ Y i) {i j : ι}
    (h : i ≠ j) : diag φ i j = 0

name: StringDiagrams.Mat_.diag_comp_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem diag_comp_apply {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] {X Y : ι → C} (φ : ∀ i, X i ⟶ Y i)
    {N : Mat_ C} (f : (⟨ι, Y⟩ : Mat_ C) ⟶ N) (i : ι) (k : N.ι) :
    (diag φ ≫ f) i k = φ i ≫ f i k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [CategoryTheory.Mat_.comp_apply, Finset.sum_eq_single i]
  · rw [diag_apply_self]
  · intro j _ hj; rw [diag_apply_of_ne φ (Ne.symm hj), zero_comp]
  · intro h; exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ i) h

name: StringDiagrams.Mat_.comp_diag_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem comp_diag_apply {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] {X Y : ι → C} (φ : ∀ i, X i ⟶ Y i)
    {M : Mat_ C} (f : M ⟶ (⟨ι, X⟩ : Mat_ C)) (i : M.ι) (k : ι) :
    (f ≫ diag φ) i k = f i k ≫ φ k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [CategoryTheory.Mat_.comp_apply, Finset.sum_eq_single k]
  · rw [diag_apply_self]
  · intro j _ hj; rw [diag_apply_of_ne φ hj, comp_zero]
  · intro h; exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ k) h

name: StringDiagrams.Mat_.diag_comp_diag
statement:
theorem diag_comp_diag {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] {X Y Z : ι → C} (φ : ∀ i, X i ⟶ Y i)
    (ψ : ∀ i, Y i ⟶ Z i) : diag φ ≫ diag ψ = diag (fun i => φ i ≫ ψ i)
proof:
:= by
  ext i k
  rw [diag_comp_apply]
  by_cases h : i = k
  · subst h; rw [diag_apply_self, diag_apply_self]
  · rw [diag_apply_of_ne _ h, diag_apply_of_ne _ h, comp_zero]

name: StringDiagrams.Mat_.diag_id
statement:
theorem diag_id {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] (X : ι → C) :
    diag (fun i => 𝟙 (X i)) = 𝟙 (⟨ι, X⟩ : Mat_ C)
proof:
:= by
  ext i k
  by_cases h : i = k
  · subst h; rw [diag_apply_self, CategoryTheory.Mat_.id_apply_self]
  · rw [diag_apply_of_ne _ h, CategoryTheory.Mat_.id_apply_of_ne _ _ _ h]

name: StringDiagrams.PiSOp.comparison_naturality_right
statement:
theorem comparison_naturality_right {a b c : TwoEnvelope R (TwoSOp R B)}
    (f : a ⟶ b) {g h : b ⟶ c} (η : g ⟶ h) :
    (hom a b).obj f ◁ (hom b c).map η ≫ (comparison f h).hom =
      (comparison f g).hom ≫ (hom a c).map (f ◁ η)
proof:
:= by
  change _ ≫ (sign R (f.par * h.par) • 𝟙 _) =
    (sign R (f.par * g.par) • 𝟙 _) ≫ _
  erw [Linear.comp_smul, Category.comp_id, Linear.smul_comp, Category.id_comp]
  apply SOp.hom_ext
  apply Envelope.hom_ext
  change sign R (f.par * h.par) •
      (SOp.unop f.obj ◁ twist R f.par
        (correction (R := R) g.par h.par
          (SOp.unsop (Envelope.toHom (C := SOp R (b.as.unop ⟶ c.as.unop)) η)))) =
    sign R (f.par * g.par) • correction (R := R) (f.par + g.par) (f.par + h.par)
      (SOp.unsop (f.obj ◁ twist R f.par
        (Envelope.toHom (C := SOp R (b.as.unop ⟶ c.as.unop)) η)))
  rw [TwoSOp.unsop_whiskerLeft, unsop_twist, correction_whiskerLeft,
    smul_smul, ← sign_add]
  have e : f.par * g.par + f.par * (g.par + h.par) = f.par * h.par := by
    calc
      _ = (f.par * g.par + f.par * g.par) + f.par * h.par := by ring
      _ = _ := by rw [zmod2_add_self, zero_add]
  rw [e]

name: StringDiagrams.PiSOp.comparison_naturality_left
statement:
theorem comparison_naturality_left {a b c : TwoEnvelope R (TwoSOp R B)}
    {f g : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ g) (h : b ⟶ c) :
    (hom a b).map η ▷ (hom b c).obj h ≫ (comparison g h).hom =
      (comparison f h).hom ≫ (hom a c).map (η ▷ h)
proof:
:= by
  change _ ≫ (sign R (g.par * h.par) • 𝟙 _) =
    (sign R (f.par * h.par) • 𝟙 _) ≫ _
  erw [Linear.comp_smul, Category.comp_id, Linear.smul_comp, Category.id_comp]
  apply SOp.hom_ext
  apply Envelope.hom_ext
  change sign R (g.par * h.par) •
      (Envelope.toHom (twist R h.par
        (Envelope.ofHom (correction (R := R) f.par g.par
          (SOp.unsop (Envelope.toHom (C := SOp R (a.as.unop ⟶ b.as.unop)) η))) :
            (⟨g.par, SOp.unop g.obj⟩ : Envelope R (a.as.unop ⟶ b.as.unop)) ⟶
            ⟨f.par, SOp.unop f.obj⟩)) ▷ SOp.unop h.obj) =
    sign R (f.par * h.par) • correction (R := R) (f.par + h.par) (g.par + h.par)
      (SOp.unsop (Envelope.toHom (C := SOp R (a.as.unop ⟶ b.as.unop))
        (twist R h.par η) ▷ h.obj))
  rw [Envelope.toHom_twist, Envelope.toHom_twist, TwoSOp.unsop_whiskerRight,
    SOp.unsop_smul, unsop_twist, smul_whiskerRight, smul_whiskerRight,
    map_smul, correction_whiskerRight]
  change sign R (g.par * h.par) •
      (sign R (h.par * (g.par + f.par)) •
        (twist R h.par (correction (R := R) f.par g.par
          (SOp.unsop (Envelope.toHom (C := SOp R (a.as.unop ⟶ b.as.unop)) η))) ▷
          SOp.unop h.obj)) =
    sign R (f.par * h.par) • (sign R (h.par * (f.par + g.par)) •
      (sign R (h.par * (f.par + g.par)) •
        (twist R h.par (correction (R := R) f.par g.par
          (SOp.unsop (Envelope.toHom (C := SOp R (a.as.unop ⟶ b.as.unop)) η))) ▷
          SOp.unop h.obj)))
  rw [sign_smul_sign_smul, smul_smul, ← sign_add]
  have e : g.par * h.par + h.par * (g.par + f.par) = f.par * h.par := by
    calc
      _ = (g.par * h.par + g.par * h.par) + f.par * h.par := by ring
      _ = _ := by rw [zmod2_add_self, zero_add]
  rw [e]

name: StringDiagrams.Underlying.natTrans_id

name: StringDiagrams.Underlying.natTrans_comp

statement:
theorem natTrans_whiskerLeft (K : E ⥤ C) [K.Additive] [K.Linear R] [IsSuperfunctor R K]

theorem natTrans_whiskerRight (K : D ⥤ E) [K.Additive] [K.Linear R] [IsSuperfunctor R K]

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.mapNatTrans_isSupernatural
statement:
theorem mapNatTrans_isSupernatural {y : F ⟶ G} (hy : PiFunctor.IsPiNatural R hF hG y) :

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.mapNatTrans_id
statement: theorem mapNatTrans_id : mapNatTrans (PiFunctor.isPiNatural_id hF) = 𝟙 (map hF)

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.mapNatTrans_comp
statement:
theorem mapNatTrans_comp {x : F ⟶ G} {y : G ⟶ H} (hx : PiFunctor.IsPiNatural R hF hG x)
    (hy : PiFunctor.IsPiNatural R hG hH y) :
    mapNatTrans (hx.comp hy) = mapNatTrans hx ≫ mapNatTrans hy

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.isPiNatural_whiskerLeft
proof:
:= fun X => by
  simp only [PiFunctor.comp_β, NatIso.ofComponents_hom_app, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.app_hom,
    Functor.mapIso_hom, Functor.whiskerLeft_app, Functor.comp_obj, Category.assoc]
  rw [y.naturality, reassoc_of% (hy (K.obj X))]

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.isPiNatural_whiskerRight
proof:
:= fun X => by
  simp only [PiFunctor.comp_β, NatIso.ofComponents_hom_app, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.app_hom,
    Functor.mapIso_hom, Functor.whiskerRight_app, Functor.comp_obj, Category.assoc]
  rw [← K.map_comp, hy X, K.map_comp, reassoc_of% (hK.β.hom.naturality (y.app X))]

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.mapNatTrans_whiskerLeft
statement:
theorem mapNatTrans_whiskerLeft {K : E ⥤ C} [K.Additive] [K.Linear R] (hK : PiFunctor R K)
    {y : F ⟶ G} (hy : PiFunctor.IsPiNatural R hF hG y) (X : Associated R E) :
    (mapNatTrans (isPiNatural_whiskerLeft hK hy)).app X =
      (mapNatTrans hy).app ((map hK).obj X)

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.mapNatTrans_whiskerRight
statement:
theorem mapNatTrans_whiskerRight {K : D ⥤ E} [K.Additive] [K.Linear R] (hK : PiFunctor R K)
    {y : F ⟶ G} (hy : PiFunctor.IsPiNatural R hF hG y) (X : Associated R C) :
    (mapNatTrans (isPiNatural_whiskerRight hK hy)).app X =
      (map hK).map ((mapNatTrans hy).app X)

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.natTrans_mapNatTrans
statement:
theorem natTrans_mapNatTrans {y : F ⟶ G} (hy : PiFunctor.IsPiNatural R hF hG y) (X : C) :
    (Underlying.natTrans (F := map hF) (G := map hG) (mapNatTrans_isSupernatural hy)).app
      ⟨⟨X⟩⟩ = (unit R D).map (y.app X)

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.pi_eq_map_pi
statement:
theorem pi_eq_map_pi :
    PiSupercategory.pi (R := R) (C := Associated R C) = map (PiFunctor.pi (R := R) (C := C))
proof:
:=
  CategoryTheory.Functor.ext (fun _ => rfl) fun X Y f => by
    simp only [eqToHom_refl, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]
    ext
    · simp [pi_map_fst]
    · simp [pi_map_snd]

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.ζ_inv
statement:
theorem ζ_inv (X : Associated R C) :
    (PiSupercategory.ζ (R := R) X).inv =
      homMk (X := X) (Y := ⟨(PiCategory.pi (R := R)).obj X.obj⟩) 0
        (-(PiCategory.ξApp (R := R) X.obj).inv)

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.β_map
statement:
theorem β_map (X : Associated R C) :
    (PiSupercategory.β R (map hF) X).hom =
      homMk (X := ⟨(PiCategory.pi (R := R)).obj (F.obj X.obj)⟩)
        (Y := ⟨F.obj ((PiCategory.pi (R := R)).obj X.obj)⟩) (hF.β.hom.app X.obj) 0
proof:
:= by
  have hc := hF.comm X.obj
  have n := (PiCategory.ξ (R := R) (C := D)).hom.naturality (hF.β.hom.app X.obj)
  simp only [Functor.comp_obj, Functor.id_obj, Functor.comp_map, Functor.id_map] at n
  rw [PiSupercategory.β_hom]
  ext
  · simp only [comp_fst, map_map, homMk_fst, homMk_snd, ζ_hom, ζ_inv, Limits.zero_comp,
      Functor.map_neg, Preadditive.neg_comp, zero_sub, neg_neg, Category.id_comp, pi_obj,
      Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc]
    have h1 : F.map ((PiCategory.ξ (R := R)).inv.app X.obj) ≫
        hF.β.inv.app ((PiCategory.pi (R := R)).obj X.obj) =
        (PiCategory.ξ (R := R)).inv.app (F.obj X.obj) ≫
          (PiCategory.pi (R := R)).map (hF.β.hom.app X.obj) := by
      rw [← cancel_epi ((PiCategory.ξ (R := R)).hom.app (F.obj X.obj)), reassoc_of% hc]
      simp
    rw [PiCategory.ξApp_inv, ← Functor.map_comp_assoc, h1, Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc,
      PiCategory.ξApp_hom]
    erw [n]
    rw [← Category.assoc, PiCategory.ξ_pi, ← Functor.map_comp, Iso.inv_hom_id_app]
    erw [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id, Category.id_comp]
  · simp [ζ_hom, ζ_inv]

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.T_map_homMk
statement:
@[simp] theorem T_map_homMk {X Y : Associated R (Underlying R A)} (f : X.obj ⟶ Y.obj) :

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.T_map_mapNatTrans
statement:
theorem T_map_mapNatTrans {F G : A ⥤ B} [F.Additive] [F.Linear R] [IsSuperfunctor R F]
    [G.Additive] [G.Linear R] [IsSuperfunctor R G] {x : ∀ X, F.obj X ⟶ G.obj X}
    (hx : IsSupernatural R 0 x) (X : Associated R (Underlying R A)) :
    (T R B).map ((mapNatTrans (Underlying.isPiNatural hx)).app X) = x X.obj.obj

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.β_T
statement:
theorem β_T (X : Associated R (Underlying R A)) :
    (PiSupercategory.β R (T R A) X).hom = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  have h : (T R A).map (PiSupercategory.ζ (R := R) X).inv =
      (PiSupercategory.ζ (R := R) X.obj.obj).inv := by
    rw [← cancel_epi (PiSupercategory.ζ (R := R) X.obj.obj).hom, Iso.hom_inv_id, ← T_map_ζ,
      ← Functor.map_comp, Iso.hom_inv_id, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id]
    rfl
  rw [PiSupercategory.β_hom, h]
  exact Iso.hom_inv_id _

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftData.unit_inv_mem
statement:
theorem unit_inv_mem (X : S) :
    d.e.unitIso.inv.app X ∈ parity (R := R) (d.Qi.obj (d.Q.obj X)) X 0

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftData.counit_inv_mem
statement:
theorem counit_inv_mem (X : S) :
    d.e.counitIso.inv.app X ∈ parity (R := R) X (d.Q.obj (d.Qi.obj X)) 0

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftData.pow_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem pow_zero : d.pow 0 = 𝟭 S

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftData.succ_hom_mem
statement:
theorem succ_hom_mem (i : ℤ) (X : S) :
    (d.succ i).hom.app X ∈ parity (R := R) (d.Q.obj ((d.pow i).obj X)) ((d.pow (i + 1)).obj X) 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases i with n | (_ | n)
  · exact id_mem _
  · exact d.counit_mem X
  · have h : (d.succ (Int.negSucc (n + 1))).hom.app X =
        d.e.counitIso.hom.app ((d.powNeg (n + 1)).obj X) := by
      show 𝟙 _ ≫ _ ≫ 𝟙 _ = _
      rw [Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id]; rfl
    rw [h]; exact d.counit_mem _

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftData.succ_inv_mem
statement:
theorem succ_inv_mem (i : ℤ) (X : S) :
    (d.succ i).inv.app X ∈ parity (R := R) ((d.pow (i + 1)).obj X) (d.Q.obj ((d.pow i).obj X)) 0

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftData.comm_zero_hom_app
statement: theorem comm_zero_hom_app (X : S) : (d.comm 0).hom.app X = 𝟙 (d.Q.obj X)

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftData.commNat_hom_mem
statement:
theorem commNat_hom_mem (n : ℕ) (X : S) :
    (d.commNat n).hom.app X ∈ parity (R := R) ((d.powNat n).obj (d.Q.obj X)) ((d.powNat (n + 1)).obj X) 0
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simpa [commNat] using! id_mem (R := R) (d.Q.obj X)
  | succ n ih =>
    have h : (d.commNat (n + 1)).hom.app X = d.Q.map ((d.commNat n).hom.app X) :=
      Category.id_comp _
    rw [h]; exact map_mem d.Q ih

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftData.commNeg_hom_mem
statement:
theorem commNeg_hom_mem (n : ℕ) (X : S) :
    (d.commNeg n).hom.app X ∈ parity (R := R) ((d.powNeg (n + 1)).obj (d.Q.obj X)) ((d.powNeg n).obj X) 0
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    have h : (d.commNeg 0).hom.app X = d.e.unitIso.inv.app X := Category.id_comp _
    rw [h]; exact d.unit_inv_mem X
  | succ n ih =>
    have h : (d.commNeg (n + 1)).hom.app X = d.Qi.map ((d.commNeg n).hom.app X) :=
      Category.id_comp _
    rw [h]; exact map_mem d.Qi ih

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftData.comm_hom_mem
statement:
theorem comm_hom_mem (i : ℤ) (X : S) :
    (d.comm i).hom.app X ∈ parity (R := R) ((d.pow i).obj (d.Q.obj X)) ((d.pow (i + 1)).obj X) 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases i with n | (_ | n)
  · exact d.commNat_hom_mem n X
  · exact d.commNeg_hom_mem 0 X
  · exact d.commNeg_hom_mem (n + 1) X

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftData.comm_inv_mem
statement:
theorem comm_inv_mem (i : ℤ) (X : S) :
    (d.comm i).inv.app X ∈ parity (R := R) ((d.pow (i + 1)).obj X) ((d.pow i).obj (d.Q.obj X)) 0

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftData.succ_negSucc_succ_hom_app
statement:
theorem succ_negSucc_succ_hom_app (n : ℕ) (X : S) :
    (d.succ (Int.negSucc (n + 1))).hom.app X = d.e.counitIso.hom.app ((d.powNeg (n + 1)).obj X)

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftData.succ_negSucc_succ_inv_app
statement:
theorem succ_negSucc_succ_inv_app (n : ℕ) (X : S) :
    (d.succ (Int.negSucc (n + 1))).inv.app X = d.e.counitIso.inv.app ((d.powNeg (n + 1)).obj X)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cancel_mono ((d.succ (Int.negSucc (n + 1))).hom.app X), Iso.inv_hom_id_app,
    succ_negSucc_succ_hom_app]
  exact (Iso.inv_hom_id_app d.e.counitIso _).symm

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftData.commNeg_succ_hom_app
statement:
theorem commNeg_succ_hom_app (n : ℕ) (X : S) :
    (d.commNeg (n + 1)).hom.app X = d.Qi.map ((d.commNeg n).hom.app X)

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftData.comm_succ
statement:
theorem comm_succ (i : ℤ) (X : S) :
    (d.comm (i + 1)).hom.app X =
      (d.succ i).inv.app (d.Q.obj X) ≫ d.Q.map ((d.comm i).hom.app X) ≫ (d.succ (i + 1)).hom.app X
proof:
:= by
  rcases i with n | (_ | n)
  · show (d.commNat (n + 1)).hom.app X = 𝟙 _ ≫ d.Q.map ((d.commNat n).hom.app X) ≫ 𝟙 _
    rw [Category.comp_id]; rfl
  · show 𝟙 _ ≫ 𝟙 _ = (d.e.counitIso.inv.app (d.Q.obj X)) ≫
      d.Q.map (𝟙 _ ≫ d.e.unitIso.inv.app X) ≫ 𝟙 _
    simp only [Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id]
    exact (d.e.counitInv_functor_comp X).symm
  · rcases n with _ | n
    · show (d.commNeg 0).hom.app X = (d.succ (Int.negSucc 1)).inv.app (d.Q.obj X) ≫
        d.Q.map ((d.commNeg 1).hom.app X) ≫ d.e.counitIso.hom.app X
      rw [succ_negSucc_succ_inv_app, commNeg_succ_hom_app]
      symm
      exact (Iso.inv_comp_eq (d.e.counitIso.app _)).2 (d.e.counitIso.hom.naturality _)
    · show (d.commNeg (n + 1)).hom.app X = (d.succ (Int.negSucc (n + 2))).inv.app (d.Q.obj X) ≫
        d.Q.map ((d.commNeg (n + 2)).hom.app X) ≫ (d.succ (Int.negSucc (n + 1))).hom.app X
      rw [succ_negSucc_succ_inv_app, succ_negSucc_succ_hom_app, commNeg_succ_hom_app d (n + 1)]
      symm
      exact (Iso.inv_comp_eq (d.e.counitIso.app _)).2 (d.e.counitIso.hom.naturality _)

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftData.FamAll.add_apply
statement:

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftData.FamAll.smul_apply

@[simp] theorem FamAll.smul_apply {X Y : S} (r : R) (f : d.FamAll X Y) (i j : ℤ) :
