name: StringDiagrams.ShiftData.FamAll.zero_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem FamAll.zero_apply {X Y : S} (i j : ℤ) : (0 : d.FamAll X Y) i j = 0

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftData.FamAll.neg_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem FamAll.neg_apply {X Y : S} (f : d.FamAll X Y) (i j : ℤ) : (-f) i j = -f i j

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftData.FamAll.ext
statement: @[ext] theorem FamAll.ext {X Y : S} {f g : d.FamAll X Y} (h : ∀ i j, f i j = g i j) : f = g
proof:
:=
  funext fun i => funext fun j => h i j

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftData.Fam.eq_zero
statement:
theorem Fam.eq_zero {m : ℤ} {X Y : S} {f : d.FamAll X Y} (hf : f ∈ d.Fam R m X Y) {i j : ℤ}
    (h : i - j ≠ m) : f i j = 0

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftData.Fam.compat
statement:
theorem Fam.compat {m : ℤ} {X Y : S} {f : d.FamAll X Y} (hf : f ∈ d.Fam R m X Y) (i j : ℤ) :
    f (i + 1) (j + 1) = (d.succ i).inv.app X ≫ d.Q.map (f i j) ≫ (d.succ j).hom.app Y

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftData.famComp_mem
statement:
theorem famComp_mem {m n : ℤ} {X Y Z : S} {f : d.FamAll X Y} {g : d.FamAll Y Z}
    (hf : f ∈ d.Fam R m X Y) (hg : g ∈ d.Fam R n Y Z) : d.famComp m f g ∈ d.Fam R (m + n) X Z
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun i k h => ?_, fun i k => ?_⟩
  · rw [famComp, Fam.eq_zero hg (by omega), Limits.comp_zero]
  · simp only [famComp]
    rw [show i + 1 - m = i - m + 1 by ring, Fam.compat hf, Fam.compat hg]
    simp [Category.assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftData.idFam_self
statement: theorem idFam_self (X : S) (i : ℤ) : d.idFam X i i = 𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftData.idFam_mem
statement: theorem idFam_mem (X : S) : d.idFam X ∈ d.Fam R 0 X X
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun i j h => ?_, fun i j => ?_⟩
  · rw [idFam, dite_eq_right (by omega)]
  · by_cases h : i = j
    · subst h; simp [idFam_self]
    · rw [idFam, idFam, dite_eq_right h, dite_eq_right (by omega)]; simp

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftData.famComp_idFam_left
statement: theorem famComp_idFam_left {X Y : S} (f : d.FamAll X Y) : d.famComp 0 (d.idFam X) f = f
proof:
:= by
  ext i k
  simp only [famComp]
  rw [show i - 0 = i by ring, idFam_self, Category.id_comp]

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftData.famComp_idFam_right
statement:
theorem famComp_idFam_right {m : ℤ} {X Y : S} {f : d.FamAll X Y} (hf : f ∈ d.Fam R m X Y) :
    d.famComp m f (d.idFam Y) = f
proof:
:= by
  ext i k
  simp only [famComp, idFam]
  by_cases h : i - m = k
  · subst h; simp
  · rw [dite_eq_right h, Limits.comp_zero, Fam.eq_zero hf (by omega)]

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftData.famComp_assoc
statement:
theorem famComp_assoc (m n : ℤ) {W X Y Z : S} (f : d.FamAll W X) (g : d.FamAll X Y)
    (h : d.FamAll Y Z) :
    d.famComp (m + n) (d.famComp m f g) h = d.famComp m f (d.famComp n g h)
proof:
:= by
  ext i l
  simp only [famComp]
  rw [show i - (m + n) = i - m - n by ring, Category.assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftData.famCompₗ_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem famCompₗ_apply (m n : ℤ) {X Y Z : S} (f : d.Fam R m X Y) (g : d.Fam R n Y Z) :
    ((d.famCompₗ m n X Y Z f g : d.Fam R (m + n) X Z) : d.FamAll X Z) = d.famComp m f.1 g.1

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftData.component_lof_self
statement:
@[simp] theorem component_lof_self (m : ℤ) {X Y : S} (f : d.Fam R m X Y) :
    d.component m X Y (d.lof m X Y f) = f
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.component.lof_self (M := fun m => d.Fam R m X Y) R m f

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftData.component_lof_of_ne
statement:
theorem component_lof_of_ne {m n : ℤ} {X Y : S} (f : d.Fam R m X Y) (h : m ≠ n) :
    d.component n X Y (d.lof m X Y f) = 0
proof:
:=
  (DirectSum.component.of (M := fun m => d.Fam R m X Y) R n m f).trans (dite_eq_right h)

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftData.Hom.ext
statement:
@[ext] theorem Hom.ext {X Y : S} {x y : d.Hom X Y}
    (h : ∀ m, d.component m X Y x = d.component m X Y y) : x = y
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.ext (β := fun m => d.Fam R m X Y) h

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftData.Hom.induction_on
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
theorem Hom.induction_on {X Y : S} {motive : d.Hom X Y → Prop} (x : d.Hom X Y) (zero : motive 0)
    (lof : ∀ m f, motive (d.lof m X Y f)) (add : ∀ x y, motive x → motive y → motive (x + y)) :
    motive x
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.induction_on (β := fun m => d.Fam R m X Y) x zero
    (fun m f => by
      have h := lof m f
      rw [ShiftData.lof] at h
      exact h) add

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftData.Hom.linearMap_ext
statement:
theorem Hom.linearMap_ext {X Y : S} {N : Type*} [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N]
    {φ ψ : d.Hom X Y →ₗ[R] N} (h : ∀ m f, φ (d.lof m X Y f) = ψ (d.lof m X Y f)) : φ = ψ
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.linearMap_ext R fun m => LinearMap.ext fun f => h m f

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftData.lof_congr
statement:
theorem lof_congr {X Y : S} {i j : ℤ} (h : i = j) {a : d.Fam R i X Y} {b : d.Fam R j X Y}
    (hab : (a : d.FamAll X Y) = b) : d.lof i X Y a = d.lof j X Y b
proof:
:= by
  subst h; congr 1; exact Subtype.ext hab

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftData.compL_lof_lof
statement:
theorem compL_lof_lof {m n : ℤ} {X Y Z : S} (f : d.Fam R m X Y) (g : d.Fam R n Y Z) :
    d.compL X Y Z (d.lof m X Y f) (d.lof n Y Z g) = d.lof (m + n) X Z (d.famCompₗ m n X Y Z f g)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [compL, lof]
  erw [DirectSum.toModule_lof, LinearMap.flip_apply, DirectSum.toModule_lof]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftData.id_compL
statement: theorem id_compL {X Y : S} (x : d.Hom X Y) : d.compL X X Y (d.idHom X) x = x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using Hom.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | lof m f =>
    rw [idHom, compL_lof_lof]
    exact d.lof_congr (zero_add m) (by simp [famComp_idFam_left])
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, hx, hy]

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftData.compL_id
statement: theorem compL_id {X Y : S} (x : d.Hom X Y) : d.compL X Y Y x (d.idHom Y) = x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using Hom.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | lof m f =>
    rw [idHom, compL_lof_lof]
    exact d.lof_congr (add_zero m) (by simp [famComp_idFam_right d f.2])
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hx, hy]

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftData.compL_assoc
statement:
theorem compL_assoc {W X Y Z : S} (x : d.Hom W X) (y : d.Hom X Y) (z : d.Hom Y Z) :
    d.compL W Y Z (d.compL W X Y x y) z = d.compL W X Z x (d.compL X Y Z y z)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using Hom.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | add x x' hx hx' => simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hx, hx']
  | lof m f =>
    induction y using Hom.induction_on with
    | zero => simp
    | add y y' hy hy' => simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hy, hy']
    | lof n g =>
      induction z using Hom.induction_on with
      | zero => simp
      | add z z' hz hz' => simp only [map_add, hz, hz']
      | lof p h =>
        simp only [compL_lof_lof]
        exact d.lof_congr (add_assoc m n p) (by simp [famComp_assoc])

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftData.compL_lof_lof'
statement:
theorem compL_lof_lof' {m n : ℤ} {X Y Z : S} (f : d.Fam R m X Y) (g : d.Fam R n Y Z) :
    d.compL X Y Z (d.lof m X Y f) (d.lof n Y Z g) =
      d.lof (m + n) X Z ⟨d.famComp m f.1 g.1, famComp_mem f.2 g.2⟩

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftData.famProj_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem famProj_apply (p : ZMod 2) {m : ℤ} {X Y : S} (f : d.Fam R m X Y) (i j : ℤ) :
    (d.famProj R p m X Y f).1 i j = proj R p (f.1 i j)

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftData.projHom_lof
statement:
theorem projHom_lof (p : ZMod 2) {m : ℤ} {X Y : S} (f : d.Fam R m X Y) :
    d.projHom R p X Y (d.lof m X Y f) = d.lof m X Y (d.famProj R p m X Y f)

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftData.component_projHom
statement:
theorem component_projHom (p : ZMod 2) (m : ℤ) {X Y : S} (x : d.Hom X Y) :
    d.component m X Y (d.projHom R p X Y x) = d.famProj R p m X Y (d.component m X Y x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using Hom.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | lof n f =>
    rw [projHom_lof]
    by_cases h : n = m
    · subst h; simp
    · rw [d.component_lof_of_ne _ h, d.component_lof_of_ne _ h, map_zero]
  | add x y hx hy => simp [hx, hy]

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftData.projHom_mem
statement: theorem projHom_mem (p : ZMod 2) {X Y : S} (x : d.Hom X Y) : d.projHom R p X Y x ∈ d.parityHom R X Y p
proof:
:=
  fun m i j => by rw [component_projHom, famProj_apply]; exact proj_mem _ _

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftData.projHom_of_mem
statement:
theorem projHom_of_mem {p : ZMod 2} {X Y : S} {x : d.Hom X Y} (hx : x ∈ d.parityHom R X Y p) :
    d.projHom R p X Y x = x
proof:
:=
  Hom.ext fun m => Subtype.ext (FamAll.ext fun i j => by
    rw [component_projHom, famProj_apply, proj_of_mem (hx m i j)])

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftData.projHom_add_projHom
statement:
theorem projHom_add_projHom {X Y : S} (x : d.Hom X Y) :
    d.projHom R 0 X Y x + d.projHom R 1 X Y x = x
proof:
:=
  Hom.ext fun m => Subtype.ext (FamAll.ext fun i j => by
    rw [map_add, component_projHom, component_projHom]
    exact proj_add_proj _)

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftData.compL_projHom_mem
statement:
theorem compL_projHom_mem (p q : ZMod 2) {X Y Z : S} (x : d.Hom X Y) (y : d.Hom Y Z) :
    d.compL X Y Z (d.projHom R p X Y x) (d.projHom R q Y Z y) ∈ d.parityHom R X Z (p + q)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using Hom.induction_on with
  | zero => simp only [map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  | add x x' hx hx' => simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hx hx'
  | lof m f =>
    induction y using Hom.induction_on with
    | zero => simp only [map_zero]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _
    | add y y' hy hy' => simp only [map_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hy hy'
    | lof n g =>
      rw [projHom_lof, projHom_lof, compL_lof_lof']
      intro k i l
      by_cases h : m + n = k
      · subst h
        simp only [component_lof_self, famComp]
        exact comp_mem (proj_mem _ _) (proj_mem _ _)
      · rw [d.component_lof_of_ne _ h]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftData.compL_mem
proof:
:= by
  rw [← d.projHom_of_mem hx, ← d.projHom_of_mem hy]
  exact d.compL_projHom_mem p q x y

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftData.isInternal_degreeHom
statement: theorem isInternal_degreeHom (X Y : S) : DirectSum.IsInternal (d.degreeHom R X Y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [DirectSum.isInternal_submodule_iff_iSupIndep_and_iSup_eq_top]
  constructor
  · rw [iSupIndep_def]
    intro n
    rw [Submodule.disjoint_def]
    intro x hx hx'
    obtain ⟨f, rfl⟩ := hx
    have h0 : d.component n X Y (d.lof n X Y f) = 0 := by
      have hle : (⨆ j, ⨆ (_ : j ≠ n), d.degreeHom R X Y j) ≤ LinearMap.ker (d.component n X Y) := by
        refine iSup_le fun j => iSup_le fun hj => ?_
        rintro _ ⟨g, rfl⟩
        exact d.component_lof_of_ne _ hj
      exact hle hx'
    rw [component_lof_self] at h0
    rw [h0, map_zero]
  · rw [eq_top_iff]
    rintro x -
    induction x using Hom.induction_on with
    | zero => exact Submodule.zero_mem _
    | lof m f => exact Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem m ⟨f, rfl⟩
    | add x y hx hy => exact Submodule.add_mem _ hx hy

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftData.diagFam_self
statement:
theorem diagFam_self {X Y : S} (φ : ∀ i : ℤ, (d.pow i).obj X ⟶ (d.pow i).obj Y) (i : ℤ) :
    d.diagFam φ i i = φ i

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftData.diagFam_mem
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun i j h => ?_, fun i j => ?_⟩
  · rw [diagFam, dite_eq_right (by omega)]
  · by_cases h : i = j
    · subst h; rw [diagFam_self, diagFam_self, hφ]
    · rw [diagFam, diagFam, dite_eq_right h, dite_eq_right (by omega)]; simp

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftData.famComp_diagFam
statement:
theorem famComp_diagFam {X Y Z : S} (φ : ∀ i : ℤ, (d.pow i).obj X ⟶ (d.pow i).obj Y)
    (ψ : ∀ i : ℤ, (d.pow i).obj Y ⟶ (d.pow i).obj Z) :
    d.famComp 0 (d.diagFam φ) (d.diagFam ψ) = d.diagFam fun i => φ i ≫ ψ i
proof:
:= by
  ext i k
  simp only [famComp]
  rw [show i - 0 = i by ring, diagFam_self]
  by_cases h : i = k
  · subst h; simp [diagFam_self]
  · simp [diagFam, h]

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftData.FamAll.congr_entry
statement:
theorem FamAll.congr_entry {X Y : S} {f g : d.FamAll X Y} {i j i' j' : ℤ} (hi : i = i')
    (hj : j = j') (h : f i j = g i j) : f i' j' = g i' j'
proof:
:= by
  subst hi hj; exact h

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftData.Fam.eq_of_entry
statement:
theorem Fam.eq_of_entry {m : ℤ} {X Y : S} {f g : d.FamAll X Y} (hf : f ∈ d.Fam R m X Y)
    (hg : g ∈ d.Fam R m X Y) {i₀ j₀ : ℤ} (h₀ : i₀ - j₀ = m) (h : f i₀ j₀ = g i₀ j₀) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ k : ℤ, f (i₀ + k) (j₀ + k) = g (i₀ + k) (j₀ + k) := by
    intro k
    induction k using Int.induction_on with
    | zero => exact FamAll.congr_entry (by ring) (by ring) h
    | succ k ih =>
      have e := FamAll.congr_entry (f := f) (g := g) (i' := i₀ + (k + 1)) (j' := j₀ + (k + 1))
        (by ring) (by ring) (show f (i₀ + k + 1) (j₀ + k + 1) = g (i₀ + k + 1) (j₀ + k + 1) by
          rw [Fam.compat hf, Fam.compat hg, ih])
      exact e
    | pred k ih =>
      have e := FamAll.congr_entry (f := f) (g := g)
        (i' := i₀ + (-(k : ℤ) - 1) + 1) (j' := j₀ + (-(k : ℤ) - 1) + 1) (by ring) (by ring) ih
      rw [Fam.compat hf, Fam.compat hg] at e
      have e3 := (cancel_mono _).1 ((cancel_epi _).1 e)
      exact d.Q.map_injective e3
  ext i j
  by_cases hij : i - j = m
  · exact FamAll.congr_entry (by ring) (by omega) (key (i - i₀))
  · rw [Fam.eq_zero hf hij, Fam.eq_zero hg hij]

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftData.famσ_succ
statement: theorem famσ_succ (X : S) (i : ℤ) : d.famσ X i (i + 1) = (d.comm i).hom.app X

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftData.famσinv_succ
statement: theorem famσinv_succ (X : S) (j : ℤ) : d.famσinv X (j + 1) j = (d.comm j).inv.app X

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftData.famσ_mem
statement: theorem famσ_mem (X : S) : d.famσ X ∈ d.Fam R (-1) (d.Q.obj X) X
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun i j h => ?_, fun i j => ?_⟩
  · rw [famσ, dite_eq_right (by omega)]
  · by_cases h : j = i + 1
    · subst h
      rw [famσ_succ, famσ_succ, d.comm_succ]
    · rw [famσ, famσ, dite_eq_right h, dite_eq_right (by omega)]; simp

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftData.famσinv_mem
statement: theorem famσinv_mem (X : S) : d.famσinv X ∈ d.Fam R 1 X (d.Q.obj X)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun i j h => ?_, fun i j => ?_⟩
  · rw [famσinv, dite_eq_right (by omega)]
  · by_cases h : i = j + 1
    · subst h
      rw [famσinv_succ, famσinv_succ, ← cancel_epi ((d.comm (j + 1)).hom.app X),
        Iso.hom_inv_id_app, d.comm_succ]
      simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_app_assoc]
      rw [← Functor.map_comp_assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_app]
      erw [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id, Category.id_comp, Iso.inv_hom_id_app]
      rfl
    · rw [famσinv, famσinv, dite_eq_right h, dite_eq_right (by omega)]; simp

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftData.famComp_famσ_famσinv
statement:
theorem famComp_famσ_famσinv (X : S) :
    d.famComp (-1) (d.famσ X) (d.famσinv X) = d.idFam (d.Q.obj X)
proof:
:= by
  ext i k
  simp only [famComp]
  rw [show i - -1 = i + 1 by ring, famσ_succ]
  by_cases h : i = k
  · subst h; rw [famσinv_succ, Iso.hom_inv_id_app, idFam_self]; rfl
  · rw [famσinv, dite_eq_right (by omega), Limits.comp_zero, idFam, dite_eq_right h]

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftData.famComp_famσinv_famσ
statement:
theorem famComp_famσinv_famσ (X : S) :
    d.famComp 1 (d.famσinv X) (d.famσ X) = d.idFam X
proof:
:= by
  ext i k
  obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ : ∃ j, i = j + 1 := ⟨i - 1, by ring⟩
  simp only [famComp]
  rw [show j + 1 - 1 = j by ring, famσinv_succ]
  by_cases h : k = j + 1
  · subst h; rw [famσ_succ, Iso.inv_hom_id_app, idFam_self]
  · rw [famσ, dite_eq_right h, Limits.comp_zero, idFam, dite_eq_right (Ne.symm h)]

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.comp_def
statement:
theorem comp_def {X Y Z : Orbit d} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) :
    f ≫ g = d.compL X.obj Y.obj Z.obj f g

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.id_def
statement: theorem id_def (X : Orbit d) : 𝟙 X = d.idHom X.obj

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.mem_parity_iff
statement:
theorem mem_parity_iff {X Y : Orbit d} {p : ZMod 2} {f : X ⟶ Y} :
    f ∈ parity (R := R) X Y p ↔ f ∈ d.parityHom R X.obj Y.obj p

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.proj_eq
statement:
theorem proj_eq {X Y : Orbit d} (p : ZMod 2) (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    proj R p f = d.projHom R p X.obj Y.obj f
proof:
:=
  proj_eq_of_add (h := d.projHom R (p + 1) X.obj Y.obj f)
    (by
      rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one p with rfl | rfl
      · exact (d.projHom_add_projHom f).symm
      · rw [add_comm]; exact (d.projHom_add_projHom f).symm)
    (d.projHom_mem p f) (d.projHom_mem (p + 1) f)

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.mem_degree_iff
statement:
theorem mem_degree_iff {X Y : Orbit d} {n : ℤ} {f : X ⟶ Y} :
    f ∈ GradedSupercategory.degree (R := R) X Y n ↔ ∃ g, d.lof n X.obj Y.obj g = f

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.lof_mem_degree
statement:
theorem lof_mem_degree {X Y : Orbit d} {n : ℤ} (g : d.Fam R n X.obj Y.obj) :
    (d.lof n X.obj Y.obj g : X ⟶ Y) ∈ GradedSupercategory.degree (R := R) X Y n

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.ι_map
statement:
theorem ι_map (d : ShiftData R S) {X Y : S} (g : X ⟶ Y) :
    ((ι d).map g : (⟨X⟩ : Orbit d) ⟶ ⟨Y⟩) = d.lof 0 X Y (d.mapFam g)

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.ι_map_mem_degree
statement:
theorem ι_map_mem_degree {X Y : S} (g : X ⟶ Y) :
    (ι d).map g ∈ GradedSupercategory.degree (R := R) ((ι d).obj X) ((ι d).obj Y) 0

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftData.component_zero_compL
statement:
theorem _root_.StringDiagrams.ShiftData.component_zero_compL {X Y Z : S} {x : d.Hom X Y}
    {y : d.Hom Y Z} (hx : x ∈ d.degreeHom R X Y 0) (hy : y ∈ d.degreeHom R Y Z 0) :
    d.component 0 X Z (d.compL X Y Z x y) =
      ⟨d.famComp 0 (d.component 0 X Y x).1 (d.component 0 Y Z y).1,
        by simpa using famComp_mem (d.component 0 X Y x).2 (d.component 0 Y Z y).2⟩
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hx
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := hy
  rw [compL_lof_lof, show d.lof (0 + 0) X Z (d.famCompₗ 0 0 X Y Z a b) =
    d.lof 0 X Z ⟨d.famComp 0 a.1 b.1, by simpa using famComp_mem a.2 b.2⟩ from
      d.lof_congr (add_zero 0) rfl]
  simp only [component_lof_self]

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.degreeZero_eq_lof
statement:
theorem degreeZero_eq_lof {X Y : Orbit d} (x : (⟨X⟩ : DegreeZero R (Orbit d)) ⟶ ⟨Y⟩) :
    x.1 = d.lof 0 X.obj Y.obj (d.component 0 X.obj Y.obj x.1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := x.2
  rw [← hf, component_lof_self]

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.π₀_comp_ιZ_map
statement:
theorem π₀_comp_ιZ_map {X Y : Orbit d} (x : (⟨X⟩ : DegreeZero R (Orbit d)) ⟶ ⟨Y⟩) :
    (ιZ d).map ((π₀ d).map x) = x
proof:
:= by
  apply DegreeZero.hom_ext
  show d.lof 0 _ _ (d.mapFam _) = x.1
  rw [degreeZero_eq_lof x]
  congr 1
  refine Subtype.ext (Fam.eq_of_entry (d.mapFam _).2 (d.component 0 _ _ x.1).2
    (i₀ := 0) (j₀ := 0) rfl ?_)
  simp [mapFam, diagFam_self]; rfl

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.ιZ_comp_π₀_map
statement: theorem ιZ_comp_π₀_map {X Y : S} (g : X ⟶ Y) : (π₀ d).map ((ιZ d).map g) = g
proof:
:= by
  show (d.component 0 _ _ (d.lof 0 _ _ (d.mapFam g))).1 0 0 = g
  rw [component_lof_self]
  simp [mapFam, diagFam_self]

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.ιZ_comp_π₀
statement: theorem ιZ_comp_π₀ : ιZ d ⋙ π₀ d = 𝟭 S
proof:
:=
  CategoryTheory.Functor.ext (fun _ => rfl) fun X Y g => by simpa using ιZ_comp_π₀_map g

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.π₀_comp_ιZ
statement: theorem π₀_comp_ιZ : π₀ d ⋙ ιZ d = 𝟭 _
proof:
:=
  CategoryTheory.Functor.ext (fun _ => rfl) fun X Y x => by simpa using! π₀_comp_ιZ_map x

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.ζIso_hom_mem
statement:
theorem ζIso_hom_mem (X : Orbit d) :
    (ζIso X).hom ∈ parity (R := R) (⟨(PiSupercategory.pi (R := R)).obj X.obj⟩ : Orbit d) X 1

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.ζ_eq
statement: theorem ζ_eq (X : Orbit d) : PiSupercategory.ζ (R := R) X = ζIso X

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.pi_obj
statement:
@[simp] theorem pi_obj (X : Orbit d) :
    (PiSupercategory.pi (R := R)).obj X = ⟨(PiSupercategory.pi (R := R)).obj X.obj⟩

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.pi_map_ι
statement:
theorem pi_map_ι {X Y : S} (g : X ⟶ Y) :
    (PiSupercategory.pi (R := R)).map ((ι d).map g) =
      (ι d).map ((PiSupercategory.pi (R := R)).map g)
proof:
:= by
  show (ζIso _).hom ≫ twist R 1 ((ι d).map g) ≫ (ζIso _).inv = _
  rw [← map_twist (ι d), ζIso, ζIso, Functor.mapIso_hom, Functor.mapIso_inv, ← Functor.map_comp,
    ← Functor.map_comp, PiSupercategory.pi_map_eq (R := R) g]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.ξ_hom_eq
statement:
theorem ξ_hom_eq (X : S) :
    (PiSupercategory.ξ (R := R) (⟨X⟩ : Orbit d)).hom = (ι d).map (PiSupercategory.ξ (R := R) X).hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [PiSupercategory.ξ_hom, PiSupercategory.ξ_hom, ζ_eq, ζIso, Functor.mapIso_hom]
  erw [pi_map_ι]
  rw [← Functor.map_comp]

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.σIso_hom_mem
statement:
theorem σIso_hom_mem (X : Orbit d) :
    (σIso X).hom ∈ parity (R := R) (⟨d.Q.obj X.obj⟩ : Orbit d) X 0
proof:
:= by
  intro m i j
  show (d.component m _ _ (d.lof (-1) _ _ _)).1 i j ∈ _
  by_cases h : m = -1
  · subst h
    simp only [component_lof_self, famσ]
    split_ifs with hij
    · subst hij; simpa using d.comm_hom_mem i X.obj
    · exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  · rw [d.component_lof_of_ne _ (Ne.symm h)]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.σIso_hom_mem_degree
statement:
theorem σIso_hom_mem_degree (X : Orbit d) :
    (σIso X).hom ∈ GradedSupercategory.degree (R := R) (⟨d.Q.obj X.obj⟩ : Orbit d) X (-1)

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.σIso_hom_naturality
statement:
theorem σIso_hom_naturality {X Y : S} (g : X ⟶ Y) :
    (σIso ((ι d).obj X)).hom ≫ (ι d).map g = (ι d).map (d.Q.map g) ≫ (σIso ((ι d).obj Y)).hom
proof:
:= by
  show d.compL _ _ _ (d.lof (-1) _ _ _) (d.lof 0 _ _ _) = d.compL _ _ _ (d.lof 0 _ _ _) (d.lof (-1) _ _ _)
  rw [compL_lof_lof, compL_lof_lof]
  refine d.lof_congr (by norm_num) ?_
  rw [famCompₗ_apply, famCompₗ_apply]
  ext i k
  simp only [famComp, mapFam]
  rw [show i - -1 = i + 1 by ring, show i - 0 = i by ring, diagFam_self]
  by_cases h : k = i + 1
  · subst h
    rw [famσ_succ, famσ_succ, diagFam_self]
    exact ((d.comm i).hom.naturality g).symm
  · rw [famσ_succ, diagFam, dite_eq_right (Ne.symm h), Limits.comp_zero, famσ, dite_eq_right h,
      Limits.comp_zero]

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.σbarIso_hom_mem
statement:
theorem σbarIso_hom_mem (X : Orbit d) :
    (σbarIso X).hom ∈ parity (R := R) (⟨d.Qi.obj X.obj⟩ : Orbit d) X 0
proof:
:= by
  have := comp_mem (inv_mem _ (σIso_hom_mem (⟨d.Qi.obj X.obj⟩ : Orbit d)))
    (map_mem (ι d) (d.counit_mem X.obj))
  simpa [σbarIso] using! this

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.σbarIso_hom_mem_degree
statement:
theorem σbarIso_hom_mem_degree (X : Orbit d) :
    (σbarIso X).hom ∈ GradedSupercategory.degree (R := R) (⟨d.Qi.obj X.obj⟩ : Orbit d) X 1
proof:
:= by
  have := GradedSupercategory.comp_mem_degree
    (GradedSupercategory.inv_mem_degree _ (σIso_hom_mem_degree (⟨d.Qi.obj X.obj⟩ : Orbit d)))
    (ι_map_mem_degree (d := d) (d.e.counitIso.hom.app X.obj))
  simpa [σbarIso] using! this

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.Q_map_ι
statement:
theorem Q_map_ι [PiSupercategory R S] {X Y : S} (g : X ⟶ Y) :
    (QPiSupercategory.Q (R := R) (C := Orbit d)).map ((ι d).map g) = (ι d).map (d.Q.map g)
proof:
:= by
  show (σIso _).hom ≫ (ι d).map g ≫ (σIso _).inv = _
  rw [reassoc_of% (σIso_hom_naturality g), Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.Q_obj
statement:
@[simp] theorem Q_obj [PiSupercategory R S] (X : Orbit d) :
    (QPiSupercategory.Q (R := R) (C := Orbit d)).obj X = ⟨d.Q.obj X.obj⟩

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.σ_eq
statement: theorem σ_eq [PiSupercategory R S] (X : Orbit d) : QPiSupercategory.σ (R := R) X = σIso X

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftFunctor.ΓNat_succ_hom_app
statement:
theorem ΓNat_succ_hom_app (n : ℕ) (X : S) :
    (Φ.ΓNat (n + 1)).hom.app X = d'.Q.map ((Φ.ΓNat n).hom.app X) ≫ Φ.γ.hom.app ((d.powNat n).obj X)

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftFunctor.Γ_negSucc
statement: theorem Γ_negSucc (n : ℕ) : Φ.Γ (Int.negSucc n) = Φ.ΓNegAux n (Φ.Γ (Int.negSucc n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  rcases n with _ | n <;> rfl

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftFunctor.Γ_succ_hom_app
statement:
theorem Γ_succ_hom_app (i : ℤ) (X : S) :
    (Φ.Γ (i + 1)).hom.app X = (d'.succ i).inv.app (Φ.F.obj X) ≫ d'.Q.map ((Φ.Γ i).hom.app X) ≫
      Φ.γ.hom.app ((d.pow i).obj X) ≫ Φ.F.map ((d.succ i).hom.app X)
proof:
:= by
  rcases i with n | n
  · show (Φ.ΓNat (n + 1)).hom.app X = 𝟙 _ ≫ d'.Q.map ((Φ.ΓNat n).hom.app X) ≫ _ ≫ Φ.F.map (𝟙 _)
    rw [ΓNat_succ_hom_app, Category.id_comp, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id, Category.comp_id]
    rfl
  · rw [Γ_negSucc]
    simp only [ΓNegAux, NatIso.ofComponents_hom_app, Functor.preimageIso_hom, Functor.map_preimage,
      Iso.trans_hom, Iso.app_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Iso.app_inv, Category.assoc,
      Iso.inv_hom_id_app_assoc]
    rw [← Φ.F.map_comp, Iso.inv_hom_id_app]
    erw [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id, Category.comp_id]

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftFunctor.Γ_succ_inv_app
statement:
theorem Γ_succ_inv_app (i : ℤ) (X : S) :
    (Φ.Γ (i + 1)).inv.app X = Φ.F.map ((d.succ i).inv.app X) ≫ Φ.γ.inv.app ((d.pow i).obj X) ≫
      d'.Q.map ((Φ.Γ i).inv.app X) ≫ (d'.succ i).hom.app (Φ.F.obj X)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cancel_epi ((Φ.Γ (i + 1)).hom.app X), Iso.hom_inv_id_app, Γ_succ_hom_app]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [← Φ.F.map_comp_assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_app]
  erw [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id, Category.id_comp]
  rw [Iso.hom_inv_id_app_assoc, ← d'.Q.map_comp_assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_app]
  erw [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id, Category.id_comp, Iso.inv_hom_id_app]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftFunctor.ΓNat_hom_mem
statement: theorem ΓNat_hom_mem (n : ℕ) (X : S) : (Φ.ΓNat n).hom.app X ∈ parity (R := R) _ _ 0
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => show 𝟙 _ ≫ 𝟙 _ ∈ _; simpa using! id_mem (R := R) (Φ.F.obj X)
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [ΓNat_succ_hom_app]
    simpa using! comp_mem (map_mem d'.Q ih) (Φ.γ_mem _)

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftFunctor.Γ_hom_mem
statement: theorem Γ_hom_mem (i : ℤ) (X : S) : (Φ.Γ i).hom.app X ∈ parity (R := R) _ _ 0
proof:
:= by
  have step : ∀ (n : ℕ), (Φ.Γ (Int.negSucc n + 1)).hom.app X ∈ parity (R := R) _ _ 0 →
      (Φ.Γ (Int.negSucc n)).hom.app X ∈ parity (R := R) _ _ 0 := by
    intro n h
    rw [Γ_negSucc]
    apply mem_of_map_mem d'.Q
    simp only [ΓNegAux, NatIso.ofComponents_hom_app, Functor.preimageIso_hom, Functor.map_preimage,
      Iso.trans_hom, Iso.app_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Iso.app_inv]
    have := comp_mem (d'.succ_hom_mem (Int.negSucc n) (Φ.F.obj X)) (comp_mem h
      (comp_mem (map_mem Φ.F (d.succ_inv_mem (Int.negSucc n) X))
        (inv_mem (Φ.γ.app _) (Φ.γ_mem ((d.pow (Int.negSucc n)).obj X)))))
    simpa using! this
  rcases i with n | n
  · exact Φ.ΓNat_hom_mem n X
  · induction n with
    | zero => exact step 0 (Φ.ΓNat_hom_mem 0 X)
    | succ n ih => exact step (n + 1) ih

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftFunctor.Γ_inv_mem
statement: theorem Γ_inv_mem (i : ℤ) (X : S) : (Φ.Γ i).inv.app X ∈ parity (R := R) _ _ 0

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftFunctor.famMap_mem
statement:
theorem famMap_mem {m : ℤ} {X Y : S} {f : d.FamAll X Y} (hf : f ∈ d.Fam R m X Y) :
    Φ.famMap f ∈ d'.Fam R m (Φ.F.obj X) (Φ.F.obj Y)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun i j h => by rw [famMap, Fam.eq_zero hf h]; simp, fun i j => ?_⟩
  simp only [famMap]
  rw [Γ_succ_hom_app, Γ_succ_inv_app, Fam.compat hf]
  simp only [Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc]
  rw [← Φ.F.map_comp_assoc ((d.succ i).hom.app X), Iso.hom_inv_id_app]
  erw [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id, Category.id_comp]
  rw [← Φ.F.map_comp_assoc ((d.succ j).hom.app Y), Iso.hom_inv_id_app]
  erw [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id, Category.id_comp]
  have hγ := Φ.γ.hom.naturality (f i j)
  simp only [Functor.comp_obj, Functor.comp_map] at hγ
  rw [← reassoc_of% hγ, Iso.hom_inv_id_app_assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftFunctor.famMap_famComp
statement:
theorem famMap_famComp (m : ℤ) {X Y Z : S} (f : d.FamAll X Y) (g : d.FamAll Y Z) :
    Φ.famMap (d.famComp m f g) = d'.famComp m (Φ.famMap f) (Φ.famMap g)
proof:
:= by
  ext i k
  simp [famMap, famComp]

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftFunctor.famMap_idFam
statement: theorem famMap_idFam (X : S) : Φ.famMap (d.idFam X) = d'.idFam (Φ.F.obj X)
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  by_cases h : i = j
  · subst h; simp [famMap, idFam_self]
  · simp [famMap, idFam, h]

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftFunctor.famMap_mapFam
statement:
theorem famMap_mapFam {X Y : S} (g : X ⟶ Y) :
    Φ.famMap (d.mapFam g).1 = (d'.mapFam (Φ.F.map g)).1
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  by_cases h : i = j
  · subst h
    simp only [famMap, mapFam, diagFam_self]
    have := (Φ.Γ i).hom.naturality g
    simp only [Functor.comp_obj, Functor.comp_map] at this
    rw [← Category.assoc, ← this, Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_app]
    exact Category.comp_id _
  · simp [famMap, mapFam, diagFam, h]

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftFunctor.mapL_lof
statement:
theorem mapL_lof {m : ℤ} {X Y : S} (f : d.Fam R m X Y) :
    Φ.mapL X Y (d.lof m X Y f) = d'.lof m (Φ.F.obj X) (Φ.F.obj Y) (Φ.famMapₗ m X Y f)

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftFunctor.Γ_hom_app_comp_app
statement:
theorem Γ_hom_app_comp_app {Ψ : ShiftFunctor R d d'} (x : Φ.F ⟶ Ψ.F)
    (hx : ∀ X, Φ.γ.hom.app X ≫ x.app (d.Q.obj X) = d'.Q.map (x.app X) ≫ Ψ.γ.hom.app X)
    (i : ℤ) (X : S) :
    (Φ.Γ i).hom.app X ≫ x.app ((d.pow i).obj X) = (d'.pow i).map (x.app X) ≫ (Ψ.Γ i).hom.app X
proof:
:= by
  let P : ℤ → Prop := fun i =>
    (Φ.Γ i).hom.app X ≫ x.app ((d.pow i).obj X) = (d'.pow i).map (x.app X) ≫ (Ψ.Γ i).hom.app X
  have step : ∀ i : ℤ, P (i + 1) ↔ P i := by
    intro i
    have e1 : (Φ.Γ (i + 1)).hom.app X ≫ x.app ((d.pow (i + 1)).obj X) =
        (d'.succ i).inv.app (Φ.F.obj X) ≫
          d'.Q.map ((Φ.Γ i).hom.app X ≫ x.app ((d.pow i).obj X)) ≫
            Ψ.γ.hom.app ((d.pow i).obj X) ≫ Ψ.F.map ((d.succ i).hom.app X) := by
      rw [Γ_succ_hom_app]
      simp only [Category.assoc, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp]
      have n := x.naturality ((d.succ i).hom.app X)
      rw [n]
      erw [reassoc_of% (hx ((d.pow i).obj X))]
    have e2 : (d'.pow (i + 1)).map (x.app X) ≫ (Ψ.Γ (i + 1)).hom.app X =
        (d'.succ i).inv.app (Φ.F.obj X) ≫
          d'.Q.map ((d'.pow i).map (x.app X) ≫ (Ψ.Γ i).hom.app X) ≫
            Ψ.γ.hom.app ((d.pow i).obj X) ≫ Ψ.F.map ((d.succ i).hom.app X) := by
      rw [Γ_succ_hom_app, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc]
      have n := (d'.succ i).inv.naturality (x.app X)
      simp only [Functor.comp_obj, Functor.comp_map] at n
      rw [reassoc_of% n]
    show _ = _ ↔ _ = _
    rw [e1, e2, cancel_epi, cancel_mono]
    exact ⟨fun h => d'.Q.map_injective h, fun h => by rw [h]⟩
  have h0 : P 0 := by
    show (Φ.Γ 0).hom.app X ≫ x.app X = x.app X ≫ (Ψ.Γ 0).hom.app X
    show (𝟙 _ ≫ 𝟙 _) ≫ x.app X = x.app X ≫ (𝟙 _ ≫ 𝟙 _)
    simp
  have key : P i := by
    induction i using Int.induction_on with
    | zero => exact h0
    | succ k ih => exact (step k).2 ih
    | pred k ih =>
      exact (step (-(k : ℤ) - 1)).1 (by rw [show -(k : ℤ) - 1 + 1 = -k by ring]; exact ih)
  exact key

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.map_map_lof
statement:
theorem map_map_lof (Φ : ShiftFunctor R d d') {X Y : Orbit d} {m : ℤ} (f : d.Fam R m X.obj Y.obj) :
    (map Φ).map (d.lof m X.obj Y.obj f : X ⟶ Y) = d'.lof m _ _ (Φ.famMapₗ m X.obj Y.obj f)

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.ι_comp_map
statement: theorem ι_comp_map (Φ : ShiftFunctor R d d') : ι d ⋙ map Φ = Φ.F ⋙ ι d'
proof:
:=
  CategoryTheory.Functor.ext (fun _ => rfl) fun X Y g => by
    simp only [Functor.comp_map, eqToHom_refl, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]
    show Φ.mapL X Y (d.lof 0 X Y _) = d'.lof 0 _ _ _
    rw [mapL_lof]
    congr 1
    exact Subtype.ext (Φ.famMap_mapFam g)

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.isGradedSupernatural_mapNat
statement:
theorem isGradedSupernatural_mapNat {Φ Ψ : ShiftFunctor R d d'} (x : Φ.F ⟶ Ψ.F)
    (hx : ∀ X, Φ.γ.hom.app X ≫ x.app (d.Q.obj X) = d'.Q.map (x.app X) ≫ Ψ.γ.hom.app X)
    (hp : ∀ X, x.app X ∈ parity (R := R) (Φ.F.obj X) (Ψ.F.obj X) 0) :
    IsGradedSupernatural R 0 0 (F := map Φ) (G := map Ψ) (mapNat x hx).app where
  toIsSupernatural
proof:
:= isSupernatural_of_natTrans (mapNat x hx) fun X => map_mem (ι d') (hp X.obj)
  mem_degree X := ι_map_mem_degree (x.app X.obj)

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.CoherenceExamples.oddShift_homogeneous
statement:
theorem oddShift_homogeneous :
    oddShift ∈ parity (R := ℚ) _ _ 1 ∧ oddShift ∈ degree (R := ℚ) _ _ (-3)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · change 𝟙 (𝟙 A) ∈ parity (R := ℚ) _ _ (1 + (0 + 1))
    simpa only [show (1 + (0 + 1) : ZMod 2) = 0 by decide] using id_mem (R := ℚ) (𝟙 A)
  · change 𝟙 (𝟙 A) ∈ degree (R := ℚ) _ _ (-3 + (0 - -3))
    simpa only [show (-3 + (0 - -3) : ℤ) = 0 by decide] using id_mem_degree (R := ℚ) (𝟙 A)

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.CoherenceExamples.oddShift_ne_zero
statement: theorem oddShift_ne_zero : oddShift ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h' : (1 : ℚ) = 0 := congrArg
    (fun η : Jm (𝟙 A) ⟶ shifted =>
      SuperalgebraCat.toElem ((toHom η).1.app 0
        (SuperalgebraCat.star _ : UnitSupercat ℚ))) h
  exact one_ne_zero h'

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.CoherenceExamples.oddShift_horizontal_sign
statement:
theorem oddShift_horizontal_sign :
    toHom (hcomp oddShift (shiftIso shifted).inv) =
      -hcomp (𝟙 (𝟙 A)) (𝟙 (𝟙 A))
proof:
:= by
  have h := toHom_hcomp (x := oddShift) (y := (shiftIso shifted).inv)
    (id_mem (R := ℚ) (𝟙 A)) (id_mem (R := ℚ) (𝟙 A))
  change toHom (hcomp oddShift (shiftIso shifted).inv) =
    sign ℚ (1 * 0 + 0 * 1 + 1 * 1 + 0 * 1) • hcomp (𝟙 (𝟙 A)) (𝟙 (𝟙 A)) at h
  simpa using h

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.CoherenceExamples.oddShift_naturality
statement:
theorem oddShift_naturality :
    (mapQPi identityFunctor).map₂ oddShift ▷ (mapQPiNatTrans identityTransformation).X a ≫
      (mapQPiNatTrans identityTransformation).x shifted =
    (mapQPiNatTrans identityTransformation).x (Jm (𝟙 A)) ≫
      (mapQPiNatTrans identityTransformation).X a ◁ (mapQPi identityFunctor).map₂ oddShift

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.CoherenceExamples.shifted_coherence_degree
statement:
theorem shifted_coherence_degree :
    (mapQPiNatTrans identityTransformation).x shifted ∈ degree (R := ℚ) _ _ 0

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.CoherenceExamples.identity_whisker
statement:
theorem identity_whisker :
    mapQPiSupermodification (TwoNatTrans.whiskerLeft identityTransformation
      (𝟙 identityTransformation)) =
    eqToHom (mapQPiNatTrans_vcomp identityTransformation identityTransformation) ≫
      TwoNatTrans.whiskerLeft (mapQPiNatTrans identityTransformation)
        (mapQPiSupermodification (𝟙 identityTransformation)) ≫
      eqToHom (mapQPiNatTrans_vcomp identityTransformation identityTransformation).symm

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.CoherenceExamples.inclusion_square
statement:
theorem inclusion_square :
    cast (congrArg₂ (fun S T => TwoNatTrans S T)
      (twoJ_naturality identityFunctor) (twoJ_naturality identityFunctor))
      (precomposeTwoJ (mapGradedTwoNatTrans
        ⟨identityTransformation, TwoNatTrans.id_isGraded⟩).1) =
      postcomposeTwoJ identityTransformation

name: StringDiagrams.GradedHom.precompose_obj
statement:
@[simp] theorem precompose_obj (K : GradedSuperfunctor R A' A) (F : GradedHom R A B) :
    (precompose B K).obj F = ⟨K.comp F.as⟩

name: StringDiagrams.GradedHom.precompose_map_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem precompose_map_val (K : GradedSuperfunctor R A' A) {F G : GradedHom R A B}
    (x : F ⟶ G) : ((precompose B K).map x).1 = Superfunctor.whiskerLeft K.toSuperfunctor x.1

name: StringDiagrams.GradedHom.postcompose_obj
statement:
@[simp] theorem postcompose_obj (L : GradedSuperfunctor R B B') (F : GradedHom R A B) :
    (postcompose A L).obj F = ⟨F.as.comp L⟩

name: StringDiagrams.GradedHom.postcompose_map_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem postcompose_map_val (L : GradedSuperfunctor R B B') {F G : GradedHom R A B}
    (x : F ⟶ G) : ((postcompose A L).map x).1 = Superfunctor.whiskerRight x.1 L.toSuperfunctor

name: StringDiagrams.QPiEnvelope.extend_comp_left
statement:
theorem extend_comp_left (K : A' ⥤ A) (F : A ⥤ B) :
    extend R (K ⋙ F) = map R K ⋙ extend R F

name: StringDiagrams.QPiEnvelope.extendSuperNatTrans_whiskerLeft
statement:
theorem extendSuperNatTrans_whiskerLeft (K : GradedSuperfunctor R A' A)
    {F G : GradedSuperfunctor R A B} (x : F.toSuperfunctor ⟶ G.toSuperfunctor) :
    extendSuperNatTrans (F := K.comp F) (G := K.comp G)
        (Superfunctor.whiskerLeft K.toSuperfunctor x) =
      Superfunctor.whiskerLeft (mapGS R K).toSuperfunctor (extendSuperNatTrans x)

name: StringDiagrams.QPiEnvelope.extendHom_precompose
statement:
theorem extendHom_precompose (K : GradedSuperfunctor R A' A) :
    extendHom R A B ⋙ GradedHom.precompose B (mapGS R K) =
      GradedHom.precompose B K ⋙ extendHom R A' B
proof:
:=
  CategoryTheory.Functor.ext (fun _ => rfl) fun _ _ _ => by
    simp only [Functor.comp_map, eqToHom_refl, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]
    rfl

name: StringDiagrams.QEnvelope.γPow_hom_mem
statement:
theorem γPow_hom_mem (L : B ⥤ B') [L.Additive] [L.Linear R] [IsSuperfunctor R L] (m : ℤ)
    (Y : B) : (γPow R L m Y).hom ∈ parity (R := R) _ _ 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa [γPow] using comp_mem (σPow_hom_mem (R := R) m (L.obj Y))
    (map_mem L (σPow_inv_mem (R := R) m Y))

name: StringDiagrams.QEnvelope.γPow_hom_mem_degree
statement:
theorem γPow_hom_mem_degree (L : B ⥤ B') [L.Additive] [L.Linear R] [IsGradedSuperfunctor R L]
    (m : ℤ) (Y : B) : (γPow R L m Y).hom ∈ degree (R := R) _ _ 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa [γPow] using comp_mem_degree (σPow_hom_mem_degree (R := R) m (L.obj Y))
    (map_mem_degree L (σPow_inv_mem_degree (R := R) m Y))

name: StringDiagrams.QEnvelope.extendCompIso_hom_app
statement:
theorem extendCompIso_hom_app (F : C ⥤ B) (L : B ⥤ B') (X : QEnvelope R C) :
    (extendCompIso R F L).hom.app X = (γPow R L X.shift (F.obj X.obj)).hom

name: StringDiagrams.Envelope.βPow_hom_mem_degree
statement:
theorem βPow_hom_mem_degree (L : B ⥤ B') [L.Additive] [L.Linear R] [IsGradedSuperfunctor R L]
    (a : ZMod 2) (Y : B) : (βPow R L a Y).hom ∈ degree (R := R) _ _ 0
proof:
:= by
  have e : (βPow R L a Y).hom = (ζPow R a (L.obj Y)).hom ≫ L.map (ζPow R a Y).inv := by
    rw [ζPow_map, Category.assoc, ← L.map_comp, Iso.hom_inv_id, L.map_id, Category.comp_id]
  rw [e]
  have := comp_mem_degree (ζPow_hom_mem_degree (R := R) a (L.obj Y))
    (map_mem_degree L (ζPow_inv_mem_degree (R := R) a Y))
  rwa [add_zero] at this

name: StringDiagrams.QPiEnvelope.extendCompIso_hom_mem
statement:
theorem extendCompIso_hom_mem (X : QPiEnvelope R A) :
    (extendCompIso R F L).hom.app X ∈ parity (R := R) _ _ 0
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := (Envelope.isSupernatural_extendNat (isSupernatural_of_natTrans
    (QEnvelope.extendCompIso R F L).hom
    (fun X => QEnvelope.γPow_hom_mem L X.shift (F.obj X.obj)))).mem X
  have h2 := Envelope.extendCompIso_hom_mem (QEnvelope.extend R F) L X
  simpa using! comp_mem h1 h2

name: StringDiagrams.QPiEnvelope.extendCompIso_hom_mem_degree
statement:
theorem extendCompIso_hom_mem_degree (X : QPiEnvelope R A) :
    (extendCompIso R F L).hom.app X ∈ degree (R := R) _ _ 0
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := Envelope.extendNat_mem_degree (p := 0)
    (x := fun X => (QEnvelope.extendCompIso R F L).hom.app X)
    (fun X => QEnvelope.γPow_hom_mem_degree L X.shift (F.obj X.obj)) X
  have h2 : (Envelope.extendCompIso R (QEnvelope.extend R F) L).hom.app X ∈
      degree (R := R) _ _ 0 :=
    Envelope.βPow_hom_mem_degree L X.par _
  simpa using! comp_mem_degree h1 h2

name: StringDiagrams.QPiEnvelope.extendCompIso_hom_app_J
statement:
theorem extendCompIso_hom_app_J (X : A) :
    (extendCompIso R F L).hom.app ⟨0, ⟨0, X⟩⟩ = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  show Envelope.extendNat R (QEnvelope.extend R (F ⋙ L)) (QEnvelope.extend R F ⋙ L) 0
      (fun X => (QEnvelope.extendCompIso R F L).hom.app X)
      ((Envelope.J R (QEnvelope R A)).obj ((QEnvelope.J R A).obj X)) ≫
    (Envelope.extendCompIso R (QEnvelope.extend R F) L).hom.app
      ((Envelope.J R (QEnvelope R A)).obj ((QEnvelope.J R A).obj X)) = 𝟙 (L.obj (F.obj X))
  rw [Envelope.extendNat_zero_par, Envelope.extendCompIso_hom_app_J, Category.comp_id,
    QEnvelope.extendCompIso_hom_app]
  change (QPiSupercategory.σPow R 0 (L.obj (F.obj X))).hom ≫
    L.map (QPiSupercategory.σPow R 0 (F.obj X)).inv = _
  simp

name: StringDiagrams.QPiEnvelope.isGradedSupernatural_extendCompIso_hom
statement:

proof:
:=
  ⟨isSupernatural_of_natTrans (extendCompIso R F L).hom (extendCompIso_hom_mem F L),

      (fun X => inv_mem ((extendCompIso R F L).app X) (extendCompIso_hom_mem F L X)),

name: StringDiagrams.QPiEnvelope.extendCompIso_naturality
statement:
theorem extendCompIso_naturality {F G : A ⥤ B} [F.Additive] [F.Linear R]
    [IsGradedSuperfunctor R F] [G.Additive] [G.Linear R] [IsGradedSuperfunctor R G]
    (L : B ⥤ B') [L.Additive] [L.Linear R] [IsGradedSuperfunctor R L] {p : ZMod 2}
    {x : ∀ X, F.obj X ⟶ G.obj X} (hx : IsSupernatural R p x) (X : QPiEnvelope R A) :
    extendNat R (F ⋙ L) (G ⋙ L) p (fun X => L.map (x X)) X ≫
        (extendCompIso R G L).hom.app X =
      (extendCompIso R F L).hom.app X ≫ L.map (extendNat R F G p x X)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : IsSupernatural R p (F := extend R (F ⋙ L)) (G := extend R G ⋙ L) fun X =>
      extendNat R (F ⋙ L) (G ⋙ L) p (fun X => L.map (x X)) X ≫
        (extendCompIso R G L).hom.app X := by
    simpa using (isSupernatural_extendNat (hx.whiskerRight L)).comp
      (isSupernatural_of_natTrans (extendCompIso R G L).hom (extendCompIso_hom_mem G L))
  have h2 : IsSupernatural R p (F := extend R (F ⋙ L)) (G := extend R G ⋙ L) fun X =>
      (extendCompIso R F L).hom.app X ≫ L.map (extendNat R F G p x X) := by
    simpa using (isSupernatural_of_natTrans (extendCompIso R F L).hom
      (extendCompIso_hom_mem F L)).comp ((isSupernatural_extendNat hx).whiskerRight L)
  refine congrFun (eq_of_restrict_eq (R := R) h1 h2 fun Y => ?_) X
  simp only [J_obj, extendNat_J]
  rw [extendCompIso_hom_app_J, extendCompIso_hom_app_J, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated2.unit_γ_comm

theorem unit_γ_comm {a b : B} (f : a ⟶ b) :

          ((unit R B).mapComp (QPiTwoCategory.q (R := R) a) f).inv

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated2.unit_comp_counit
statement: theorem unit_comp_counit : (unit R B).comp (counit R B) = Pseudofunctor.id B
proof:
:= by
  refine pseudofunctor_ext rfl HEq.rfl (heq_of_eq ?_) (heq_of_eq ?_) (heq_of_eq ?_)
  · funext a b f g η
    exact unitInv₂_hom2U η
  · funext a b c f g
    apply Iso.ext
    change (counit R B).map₂ (𝟙 (hom1U (R := R) f ≫ hom1U g)) ≫ 𝟙 (f ≫ g) = 𝟙 (f ≫ g)
    erw [PrelaxFunctor.map₂_id, Category.comp_id]
    rfl
  · funext a
    apply Iso.ext
    change (counit R B).map₂ (𝟙 (𝟙 ((unit R B).obj a))) ≫ 𝟙 (𝟙 a) = 𝟙 (𝟙 a)
    erw [PrelaxFunctor.map₂_id, Category.comp_id]
    rfl

proof:
:= by
  refine pseudofunctor_ext rfl HEq.rfl (heq_of_eq ?_) (heq_of_eq ?_) (heq_of_eq ?_)
  · funext a b f g x
    exact unit_map₂_unitInv₂ x
  · funext a b c f g
    apply Iso.ext
    change (unit R B).map₂ (𝟙 (f.obj.obj.obj.obj ≫ g.obj.obj.obj.obj)) ≫ 𝟙 (f ≫ g) = 𝟙 (f ≫ g)
    erw [PrelaxFunctor.map₂_id, Category.comp_id]
    rfl
  · funext a
    apply Iso.ext
    change (unit R B).map₂ (𝟙 (𝟙 a.obj.as.obj.obj)) ≫ 𝟙 (𝟙 a) = 𝟙 (𝟙 a)
    erw [PrelaxFunctor.map₂_id, Category.comp_id]
    rfl

statement:
theorem comp_unit :
    F.comp (unit R C) = (unit R B).comp (hF.mapQ.toDegreeZero2 hF.mapQ_isGraded).toPseudofunctor
proof:
:= by
  refine pseudofunctor_ext rfl HEq.rfl (heq_of_eq ?_) (heq_of_eq ?_) (heq_of_eq ?_)
  · funext a b f g η
    exact (hF.toQPiTwoFunctor_mapQ_map₂ η).symm
  · funext a b c f g
    apply Iso.ext
    change (unit R C).map₂ (F.mapComp f g).hom ≫ 𝟙 _ =
      (hF.mapQ.toDegreeZero2 hF.mapQ_isGraded).toPseudofunctor.map₂ (𝟙 _) ≫
        ((hF.mapQ.toDegreeZero2 hF.mapQ_isGraded).toPseudofunctor.mapComp
          ((unit R B).map f) ((unit R B).map g)).hom
    rw [PrelaxFunctor.map₂_id, hF.toQPiTwoFunctor_mapQ_mapComp]
    erw [Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]
  · funext a
    apply Iso.ext
    rw [Pseudofunctor.comp_mapId, Pseudofunctor.comp_mapId, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.trans_hom,
      PrelaxFunctor.map₂Iso_hom, PrelaxFunctor.map₂Iso_hom, unit_mapId, unit_mapId, Iso.refl_hom,
      Iso.refl_hom]
    erw [PrelaxFunctor.map₂_id, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]
    exact (hF.toQPiTwoFunctor_mapQ_mapId a).symm

name: StringDiagrams.UnitIso.swap
statement:
theorem swap (q : a ⟶ a) (s : q ≅ 𝟙 a) :
    s.hom ▷ q ≫ (λ_ q).hom = q ◁ s.hom ≫ (ρ_ q).hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cancel_mono s.hom]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [← leftUnitor_naturality, ← rightUnitor_naturality, unitors_equal]
