name: StringDiagrams.UnitIso.halfBraid_id
statement:
theorem halfBraid_id (a : 𝔅) :
    (halfBraid q s (𝟙 a)).hom = (λ_ (q a)).hom ≫ (ρ_ (q a)).inv
proof:
:= by
  rw [halfBraid_hom, ← cancel_mono ((ρ_ (q a)).hom), ← cancel_mono (s a).hom]
  simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]
  rw [rightUnitor_naturality_assoc, ← unitors_equal, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id,
    Category.comp_id, leftUnitor_naturality]

name: StringDiagrams.UnitIso.halfBraid_comp
statement:
theorem halfBraid_comp (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) :
    (halfBraid q s (f ≫ g)).hom = (α_ f g (q c)).hom ≫ f ◁ (halfBraid q s g).hom ≫
      (α_ f (q b) g).inv ≫ (halfBraid q s f).hom ▷ g ≫ (α_ (q a) f g).hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [halfBraid_hom, halfBraid_hom, halfBraid_hom]
  simp only [Bicategory.whiskerLeft_comp, Bicategory.comp_whiskerRight, Category.assoc]
  rw [associator_inv_naturality_middle_assoc, ← comp_whiskerRight_assoc, ← Bicategory.whiskerLeft_comp]
  simp only [Iso.inv_hom_id, Bicategory.whiskerLeft_id, Bicategory.id_whiskerRight, Category.id_comp]
  bicategory

name: StringDiagrams.UnitIso.q_ii
statement:
theorem q_ii : (ii s' t).hom ▷ q' ≫ (λ_ q').hom =
    (α_ q' qi q').hom ≫ q' ◁ (jj s' t).hom ≫ (ρ_ q').hom
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ii, jj, Iso.trans_hom, whiskerRightIso_hom, Bicategory.whiskerLeft_comp, Bicategory.comp_whiskerRight,
    Category.assoc]
  rw [← swap q' s', whisker_exchange_assoc, whisker_exchange_assoc]
  bicategory

name: StringDiagrams.UnitIso.ii_qinv
statement:
theorem ii_qinv : qi ◁ (ii s' t).hom ≫ (ρ_ qi).hom =
    (α_ qi q' qi).inv ≫ (jj s' t).hom ▷ qi ≫ (λ_ qi).hom
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ii, jj, Iso.trans_hom, whiskerRightIso_hom, Bicategory.whiskerLeft_comp, Bicategory.comp_whiskerRight,
    Category.assoc]
  rw [← swap qi t, whisker_exchange_assoc, whisker_exchange_assoc]
  bicategory

name: StringDiagrams.GradedTwoSupercategory.hcomp_mem_degree
StringDiagrams.GradedTwoSupercategory.associator_inv_mem_degree
statement:
theorem associator_inv_mem_degree {a b c d : B} (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) (h : c ⟶ d) :
    (associator f g h).inv ∈ degree (R := R) (f ≫ g ≫ h) ((f ≫ g) ≫ h) 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa using inv_mem_degree _ (associator_hom_mem_degree (R := R) f g h)

name: StringDiagrams.GradedTwoSupercategory.leftUnitor_inv_mem_degree
statement:
theorem leftUnitor_inv_mem_degree {a b : B} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (leftUnitor f).inv ∈ degree (R := R) f (𝟙 a ≫ f) 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa using inv_mem_degree _ (leftUnitor_hom_mem_degree (R := R) f)

name: StringDiagrams.GradedTwoSupercategory.rightUnitor_inv_mem_degree
statement:
theorem rightUnitor_inv_mem_degree {a b : B} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (rightUnitor f).inv ∈ degree (R := R) f (f ≫ 𝟙 b) 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa using inv_mem_degree _ (rightUnitor_hom_mem_degree (R := R) f)

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.IsGraded.isGradedSuperfunctor
StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.id_isGraded
statement:
theorem TwoSuperfunctor.id_isGraded [TwoSupercategory R B] : (TwoSuperfunctor.id R B).IsGraded where
  map₂_mem_degree h

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoSupercategory.σ_inv_mem
statement: theorem σ_inv_mem (a : B) : (σ (R := R) a).inv ∈ parity (R := R) (𝟙 a) (q (R := R) a) 0

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoSupercategory.σ_inv_mem_degree
statement:
theorem σ_inv_mem_degree (a : B) :
    (σ (R := R) a).inv ∈ degree (R := R) (𝟙 a) (q (R := R) a) 1
proof:
:= by
  simpa using inv_mem_degree _ (σ_hom_mem_degree (R := R) a)

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoSupercategory.σbar_inv_mem
statement:
theorem σbar_inv_mem (a : B) :
    (σbar (R := R) a).inv ∈ parity (R := R) (𝟙 a) (qinv (R := R) a) 0

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoSupercategory.σbar_inv_mem_degree
statement:
theorem σbar_inv_mem_degree (a : B) :
    (σbar (R := R) a).inv ∈ degree (R := R) (𝟙 a) (qinv (R := R) a) (-1)

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoSupercategory.ζ_inv_mem_degree'
statement:
theorem ζ_inv_mem_degree' (a : B) :
    (ζ (R := R) a).inv ∈ degree (R := R) (𝟙 a) (pi (R := R) a) 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa using inv_mem_degree _ (ζ_hom_mem_degree (R := R) a)

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoSupercategory.β_hom_mem_degree
statement:
theorem β_hom_mem_degree (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (β (R := R) f).hom ∈ degree (R := R) (f ≫ pi (R := R) b) (pi (R := R) a ≫ f) 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [β_hom]
  have h := comp_mem_degree (comp_mem_degree (comp_mem_degree
    (whiskerLeft_mem_degree f (ζ_hom_mem_degree (R := R) b))
    (rightUnitor_hom_mem_degree (R := R) f)) (leftUnitor_inv_mem_degree (R := R) f))
    (whiskerRight_mem_degree f (ζ_inv_mem_degree' (R := R) a))
  simpa [Category.assoc] using h

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoSupercategory.ξ_hom_mem_degree
statement:
theorem ξ_hom_mem_degree (a : B) :
    (ξ (R := R) a).hom ∈ degree (R := R) (pi (R := R) a ≫ pi (R := R) a) (𝟙 a) 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [ξ_hom]
  have h := comp_mem_degree (comp_mem_degree
    (whiskerRight_mem_degree (pi (R := R) a) (ζ_hom_mem_degree (R := R) a))
    (leftUnitor_hom_mem_degree (R := R) (pi (R := R) a))) (ζ_hom_mem_degree (R := R) a)
  simpa [Category.assoc] using h

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoSupercategory.γ_hom
statement:
theorem γ_hom (f : a ⟶ b) : (γ (R := R) f).hom =
    f ◁ (σ (R := R) b).hom ≫ (rightUnitor f).hom ≫ (leftUnitor f).inv ≫
      (σ (R := R) a).inv ▷ f

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoSupercategory.γ_hom_mem
statement:
theorem γ_hom_mem (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (γ (R := R) f).hom ∈ parity (R := R) (f ≫ q (R := R) b) (q (R := R) a ≫ f) 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [γ_hom]
  have h := comp_mem (comp_mem (comp_mem (whiskerLeft_mem f (σ_hom_mem (R := R) b))
    (rightUnitor_hom_mem (R := R) f)) (inv_mem _ (leftUnitor_hom_mem (R := R) f)))
    (whiskerRight_mem f (σ_inv_mem (R := R) a))
  simpa [Category.assoc] using h

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoSupercategory.γ_hom_mem_degree
statement:
theorem γ_hom_mem_degree (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (γ (R := R) f).hom ∈ degree (R := R) (f ≫ q (R := R) b) (q (R := R) a ≫ f) 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [γ_hom]
  have h := comp_mem_degree (comp_mem_degree (comp_mem_degree
    (whiskerLeft_mem_degree f (σ_hom_mem_degree (R := R) b))
    (rightUnitor_hom_mem_degree (R := R) f)) (leftUnitor_inv_mem_degree (R := R) f))
    (whiskerRight_mem_degree f (σ_inv_mem_degree (R := R) a))
  simpa [Category.assoc] using h

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoSupercategory.γ_naturality
statement:
theorem γ_naturality {f g : a ⟶ b} (x : f ⟶ g) :
    (γ (R := R) f).hom ≫ q (R := R) a ◁ x = x ▷ q (R := R) b ≫ (γ (R := R) g).hom
proof:
:= by
  refine induction_on (R := R) x (by simp [zero_whiskerRight R, whiskerLeft_zero R])
    (fun p x hx => ?_) (fun x y hx hy => ?_)
  · rw [γ_hom, γ_hom]
    simp only [Category.assoc]
    have h1 := super_interchange (R := R) (σ_inv_mem (R := R) a) hx
    have h2 := super_interchange (R := R) hx (σ_hom_mem (R := R) b)
    rw [koszulSign_zero_left, one_smul] at h1
    rw [koszulSign_zero_right, one_smul] at h2
    rw [h1, ← leftUnitor_inv_naturality_assoc R, ← rightUnitor_naturality_assoc R,
      ← reassoc_of% h2]
  · rw [whiskerLeft_add (R := R), add_whiskerRight (R := R), Preadditive.comp_add,
      Preadditive.add_comp, hx, hy]

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoSupercategory.σU_hom_val
statement: @[simp] theorem σU_hom_val (a : Underlying2 R B) : (σU a).hom.1 = (σ (R := R) a.obj).hom

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoSupercategory.σU_inv_val
statement: @[simp] theorem σU_inv_val (a : Underlying2 R B) : (σU a).inv.1 = (σ (R := R) a.obj).inv

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoSupercategory.σbarU_hom_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem σbarU_hom_val (a : Underlying2 R B) :
    (σbarU a).hom.1 = (σbar (R := R) a.obj).hom

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoSupercategory.halfBraid_val
statement:
theorem halfBraid_val (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (UnitIso.halfBraid (qU (R := R) (B := B)) σU (Underlying2.hom1 (a := a) (b := b) f)).hom.1 =
      (γ (R := R) f).hom

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoSupercategory.γ_comp
statement:
theorem γ_comp (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) :
    (γ (R := R) (f ≫ g)).hom = (associator f g (q (R := R) c)).hom ≫ f ◁ (γ (R := R) g).hom ≫
      (associator f (q (R := R) b) g).inv ≫ (γ (R := R) f).hom ▷ g ≫
        (associator (q (R := R) a) f g).hom
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg Subtype.val (UnitIso.halfBraid_comp (qU (R := R) (B := B)) σU
    (Underlying2.hom1 (a := a) (b := b) f) (Underlying2.hom1 (a := b) (b := c) g))
  rw [← halfBraid_val, ← halfBraid_val, ← halfBraid_val]
  exact h

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoSupercategory.γ_id
statement:
theorem γ_id (a : B) :
    (γ (R := R) (𝟙 a)).hom = (leftUnitor (q (R := R) a)).hom ≫ (rightUnitor (q (R := R) a)).inv
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg Subtype.val (UnitIso.halfBraid_id (qU (R := R) (B := B)) σU ⟨a⟩)
  rw [← halfBraid_val]
  exact h

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoSupercategory.γ_q
statement: theorem γ_q (a : B) : (γ (R := R) (q (R := R) a)).hom = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg Subtype.val (UnitIso.halfBraid_self (qU (R := R) (B := B)) σU ⟨a⟩)
  rw [← halfBraid_val]
  exact h

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoSupercategory.γ_pi
statement: theorem γ_pi (a : B) : (γ (R := R) (pi (R := R) a)).hom = (β (R := R) (q (R := R) a)).inv
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cancel_mono (β (R := R) (q (R := R) a)).hom, Iso.inv_hom_id, γ_hom, β_hom]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  have h1 := super_interchange (R := R) (σ_inv_mem (R := R) a) (ζ_hom_mem (R := R) a)
  rw [koszulSign_zero_left, one_smul] at h1
  have h2 := super_interchange (R := R) (ζ_hom_mem (R := R) a) (σ_hom_mem (R := R) a)
  rw [koszulSign_zero_right, one_smul] at h2
  rw [reassoc_of% h1, ← leftUnitor_inv_naturality_assoc R, rightUnitor_naturality_assoc R,
    ← unitors_equal R, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc, ← rightUnitor_naturality_assoc R,
    ← reassoc_of% h2, ← unitors_equal R, leftUnitor_naturality_assoc R, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc,
    Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc, hom_inv_whiskerRight R]

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoSupercategory.ii_hom
statement:
theorem ii_hom (a : B) : (ii (R := R) a).hom = (σ (R := R) a).hom ▷ qinv (R := R) a ≫
    (leftUnitor (qinv (R := R) a)).hom ≫ (σbar (R := R) a).hom

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoSupercategory.jj_hom
statement:
theorem jj_hom (a : B) : (jj (R := R) a).hom = (σbar (R := R) a).hom ▷ q (R := R) a ≫
    (leftUnitor (q (R := R) a)).hom ≫ (σ (R := R) a).hom

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoSupercategory.ii_hom_mem
statement: theorem ii_hom_mem (a : B) : (ii (R := R) a).hom ∈ parity (R := R) _ (𝟙 a) 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [ii_hom]
  simpa [Category.assoc] using comp_mem (comp_mem (whiskerRight_mem _ (σ_hom_mem (R := R) a))
    (leftUnitor_hom_mem (R := R) _)) (σbar_hom_mem (R := R) a)

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoSupercategory.ii_hom_mem_degree
statement: theorem ii_hom_mem_degree (a : B) : (ii (R := R) a).hom ∈ degree (R := R) _ (𝟙 a) 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [ii_hom]
  have h := comp_mem_degree (comp_mem_degree
    (whiskerRight_mem_degree _ (σ_hom_mem_degree (R := R) a))
    (leftUnitor_hom_mem_degree (R := R) _)) (σbar_hom_mem_degree (R := R) a)
  simpa [Category.assoc] using h

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoSupercategory.jj_hom_mem
statement: theorem jj_hom_mem (a : B) : (jj (R := R) a).hom ∈ parity (R := R) _ (𝟙 a) 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [jj_hom]
  simpa [Category.assoc] using comp_mem (comp_mem (whiskerRight_mem _ (σbar_hom_mem (R := R) a))
    (leftUnitor_hom_mem (R := R) _)) (σ_hom_mem (R := R) a)

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoSupercategory.jj_hom_mem_degree
statement: theorem jj_hom_mem_degree (a : B) : (jj (R := R) a).hom ∈ degree (R := R) _ (𝟙 a) 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [jj_hom]
  have h := comp_mem_degree (comp_mem_degree
    (whiskerRight_mem_degree _ (σbar_hom_mem_degree (R := R) a))
    (leftUnitor_hom_mem_degree (R := R) _)) (σ_hom_mem_degree (R := R) a)
  simpa [Category.assoc] using h

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoSupercategory.q_ii
statement:
theorem q_ii (a : B) : (ii (R := R) a).hom ▷ q (R := R) a ≫ (leftUnitor (q (R := R) a)).hom =
    (associator (q (R := R) a) (qinv (R := R) a) (q (R := R) a)).hom ≫
      q (R := R) a ◁ (jj (R := R) a).hom ≫ (rightUnitor (q (R := R) a)).hom
proof:
:= by
  exact congrArg Subtype.val (UnitIso.q_ii (σU (R := R) (B := B) ⟨a⟩) (σbarU ⟨a⟩))

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoSupercategory.ii_qinv
statement:
theorem ii_qinv (a : B) : qinv (R := R) a ◁ (ii (R := R) a).hom ≫
    (rightUnitor (qinv (R := R) a)).hom =
      (associator (qinv (R := R) a) (q (R := R) a) (qinv (R := R) a)).inv ≫
        (jj (R := R) a).hom ▷ qinv (R := R) a ≫ (leftUnitor (qinv (R := R) a)).hom
proof:
:= by
  exact congrArg Subtype.val (UnitIso.ii_qinv (σU (R := R) (B := B) ⟨a⟩) (σbarU ⟨a⟩))

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoSupercategory.γ_hom_comp_σ
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem γ_hom_comp_σ (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (γ (R := R) f).hom ≫ (σ (R := R) a).hom ▷ f =
      f ◁ (σ (R := R) b).hom ≫ (rightUnitor f).hom ≫ (leftUnitor f).inv
proof:
:= by
  rw [γ_hom]; simp only [Category.assoc, inv_hom_whiskerRight R, Category.comp_id]

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoSupercategory.qCenterObj_X
statement: @[simp] theorem qCenterObj_X (a : B) : (qCenterObj R B).toTwoNatTrans.X a = q (R := R) a

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoSupercategory.qCenterObj_x
statement:
@[simp] theorem qCenterObj_x {a b : B} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (qCenterObj R B).toTwoNatTrans.x f = (γ (R := R) f).hom

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoSupercategory.centerσ_hom_mem
statement:
theorem centerσ_hom_mem :
    (centerσ R B).hom ∈ parity (R := R) (qCenterObj R B) (𝟙_ (DrinfeldCenter R B)) 0

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoSupercategory.centralShift_q
statement: theorem centralShift_q (a : B) : CentralShift.q (R := R) a = QPiTwoSupercategory.q (R := R) a

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoSupercategory.homTriv_σ_hom
statement:
theorem homTriv_σ_hom {a b : B} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    ((homTriv R a b).σ f).hom = f ◁ (σ (R := R) b).hom ≫ (rightUnitor f).hom

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoSupercategory.preShift_trivCompat
statement:
theorem preShift_trivCompat {a b : B} (c : B) (f : a ⟶ b) :
    Orbit.IsTrivCompatible (homTriv R b c) (homTriv R a c) (preShift R c f)
proof:
:= fun X => by
  simp only [preShift_γ_inv_app, homTriv_σ_hom, preShift_F, precomp_map,
    whiskerLeft_comp' R]
  change (associator f X (q (R := R) c)).inv ≫ (f ≫ X) ◁ (σ (R := R) c).hom ≫ _ = _
  rw [← associator_inv_naturality_right_assoc R, whiskerLeft_rightUnitor R]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoSupercategory.postShift_trivCompat
statement:
theorem postShift_trivCompat (a : B) {b c : B} (h : b ⟶ c) :
    Orbit.IsTrivCompatible (homTriv R a b) (homTriv R a c) (postShift R a h)
proof:
:= fun X => by
  have key : (γ (R := R) h).inv ≫ h ◁ (σ (R := R) c).hom ≫ (rightUnitor h).hom =
      (σ (R := R) b).hom ▷ h ≫ (leftUnitor h).hom := by
    rw [Iso.inv_comp_eq, reassoc_of% (γ_hom_comp_σ (R := R) h)]
    simp
  simp only [postShift_γ_inv_app, homTriv_σ_hom, postShift_F, postcomp_map,
    γR_inv, Category.assoc]
  change _ ≫ X ◁ (γ (R := R) h).inv ≫ (associator X h (q (R := R) c)).inv ≫
    (X ≫ h) ◁ (σ (R := R) c).hom ≫ (rightUnitor (X ≫ h)).hom = _
  rw [← associator_inv_naturality_right_assoc R, ← whiskerLeft_rightUnitor R,
    ← whiskerLeft_comp' R, ← whiskerLeft_comp' R, key, whiskerLeft_comp' R,
    comp_whiskerRight' R, whisker_assoc (R := R), ← TwoSupercategory.triangle (R := R)]
  simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated2.TF_obj
statement: theorem TF_obj {a b : 𝔄} (f : a ⟶ b) : (TF R B a b).obj f = f.obj.obj.obj

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated2.TF_map
statement:
theorem TF_map {a b : 𝔄} {f g : a ⟶ b} (x : f ⟶ g) :
    (TF R B a b).map x = ((Associated2.T R (DegreeZero2 R B)).map₂ x).1

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated2.TF_map_mem_degree
statement:
theorem TF_map_mem_degree {a b : 𝔄} {f g : a ⟶ b} (x : f ⟶ g) :
    (TF R B a b).map x ∈ degree (R := R) _ _ 0

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated2.TF_map_injective
statement:
theorem TF_map_injective {a b : 𝔄} {f g : a ⟶ b} {x y : f ⟶ g}
    (h : (TF R B a b).map x = (TF R B a b).map y) : x = y

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated2.TF_map_surjective
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := (Associated2.T_map₂_bijective (R := R) (A := DegreeZero2 R B) f g).2
    (⟨h, hh⟩ : (⟨(TF R B a b).obj f⟩ : DegreeZero R (bo a ⟶ bo b)) ⟶ ⟨(TF R B a b).obj g⟩)
  exact ⟨x, congrArg Subtype.val hx⟩

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated2.TF_whiskerRight
statement:
theorem TF_whiskerRight {a b c : 𝔄} {f g : a ⟶ b} (x : f ⟶ g) (h : b ⟶ c) :
    (TF R B a c).map (x ▷ h) = (TF R B a b).map x ▷ (TF R B b c).obj h
proof:
:= by
  have e := (Associated2.T R (DegreeZero2 R B)).mapComp_naturality_left x h
  simp only [Associated2.T_mapComp, Iso.refl_hom] at e
  erw [Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id] at e
  exact (congrArg Subtype.val e).symm

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated2.TF_whiskerLeft
statement:
theorem TF_whiskerLeft {a b c : 𝔄} (f : a ⟶ b) {g h : b ⟶ c} (x : g ⟶ h) :
    (TF R B a c).map (f ◁ x) = (TF R B a b).obj f ◁ (TF R B b c).map x
proof:
:= by
  have e := (Associated2.T R (DegreeZero2 R B)).mapComp_naturality_right f x
  simp only [Associated2.T_mapComp, Iso.refl_hom] at e
  erw [Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id] at e
  exact (congrArg Subtype.val e).symm

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated2.TF_associator_hom
statement:
theorem TF_associator_hom {a b c d : 𝔄} (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) (h : c ⟶ d) :
    (TF R B a d).map (associator f g h).hom =
      (associator ((TF R B a b).obj f) ((TF R B b c).obj g) ((TF R B c d).obj h)).hom

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated2.TF_associator_inv
statement:
theorem TF_associator_inv {a b c d : 𝔄} (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) (h : c ⟶ d) :
    (TF R B a d).map (associator f g h).inv =
      (associator ((TF R B a b).obj f) ((TF R B b c).obj g) ((TF R B c d).obj h)).inv

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated2.TF_leftUnitor_hom
statement:
theorem TF_leftUnitor_hom {a b : 𝔄} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (TF R B a b).map (leftUnitor f).hom = (leftUnitor ((TF R B a b).obj f)).hom

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated2.TF_leftUnitor_inv
statement:
theorem TF_leftUnitor_inv {a b : 𝔄} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (TF R B a b).map (leftUnitor f).inv = (leftUnitor ((TF R B a b).obj f)).inv

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated2.TF_rightUnitor_hom
statement:
theorem TF_rightUnitor_hom {a b : 𝔄} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (TF R B a b).map (rightUnitor f).hom = (rightUnitor ((TF R B a b).obj f)).hom

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated2.TF_γ
statement:
theorem TF_γ {a b : 𝔄} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (TF R B a b).map (CentralShift.γ (R := R) f).hom =
      (QPiTwoSupercategory.γ (R := R) ((TF R B a b).obj f)).hom

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated2.TΦ_F
statement: @[simp] theorem TΦ_F (a b : 𝔄) : (TΦ R B a b).F = TF R B a b

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated2.TΦ_γ_hom_app
statement: @[simp] theorem TΦ_γ_hom_app {a b : 𝔄} (f : a ⟶ b) : (TΦ R B a b).γ.hom.app f = 𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated2.TΦ_γ_inv_app
statement: @[simp] theorem TΦ_γ_inv_app {a b : 𝔄} (f : a ⟶ b) : (TΦ R B a b).γ.inv.app f = 𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated2.TF_γR
statement:
theorem TF_γR {a b c : 𝔄} (g : a ⟶ b) (h : b ⟶ c) :
    (TF R B a c).map (CentralShift.γR (R := R) g h).hom =
      (CentralShift.γR (R := R) ((TF R B a b).obj g) ((TF R B b c).obj h)).hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [γR_hom, γR_hom, Functor.map_comp, Functor.map_comp, TF_associator_hom, TF_whiskerLeft,
    TF_associator_inv, TF_γ]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated2.map_post_comp
statement:
theorem map_post_comp {a : 𝔄} {b c : 𝔄} (h : b ⟶ c) :
    Orbit.map ((postShift R a h).comp (TΦ R B a c)) =
      Orbit.map ((TΦ R B a b).comp (postShift R (bo a) ((TF R B b c).obj h)))
proof:
:= by
  refine Orbit.map_congr' (fun _ => rfl) (fun y => ?_) fun X => ?_
  · simp only [ShiftFunctor.comp_F, Functor.comp_map, postShift_F, postcomp_map, TΦ_F,
      eqToHom_refl, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]
    exact TF_whiskerRight y h
  · simp only [ShiftFunctor.comp_γ_hom_app, TΦ_γ_hom_app, postShift_γ_hom_app, TΦ_F,
      postShift_F, eqToHom_refl, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]
    rw [TF_γR, postcomp_map]
    erw [id_whiskerRight (R := R), Category.comp_id]

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated2.map_pre_comp
statement:
theorem map_pre_comp {a b : 𝔄} (c : 𝔄) (f : a ⟶ b) :
    Orbit.map ((preShift R c f).comp (TΦ R B a c)) =
      Orbit.map ((TΦ R B b c).comp (preShift R (bo c) ((TF R B a b).obj f)))
proof:
:= by
  refine Orbit.map_congr' (fun _ => rfl) (fun y => ?_) fun X => ?_
  · simp only [ShiftFunctor.comp_F, Functor.comp_map, preShift_F, precomp_map, TΦ_F,
      eqToHom_refl, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]
    exact TF_whiskerLeft f y
  · simp only [ShiftFunctor.comp_γ_hom_app, TΦ_γ_hom_app, preShift_γ_hom_app, TΦ_F,
      preShift_F, eqToHom_refl, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]
    rw [TF_associator_hom, precomp_map]
    erw [whiskerLeft_id (R := R), Category.comp_id]
    rfl

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated2.Thom_whiskerRight
statement:
theorem Thom_whiskerRight {f g : a ⟶ b} (x : f ⟶ g) (h : b ⟶ c) :
    (Thom R B a.obj c.obj).map (x ▷ h) =
      (Thom R B a.obj b.obj).map x ▷ (TF R B b.obj c.obj).obj h.obj
proof:
:= by
  rw [Orbit2.whiskerRight_def]
  unfold Thom
  have e := CategoryTheory.Functor.congr_hom (map_post_comp (a := a.obj) h.obj) x
  erw [eqToHom_refl, eqToHom_refl, Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id] at e
  rw [lift_map, lift_map, map_map_comp]
  erw [e]
  rw [← map_map_comp, eval_map_map (postShift_trivCompat (R := R) _ _)]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated2.Thom_whiskerLeft
statement:
theorem Thom_whiskerLeft (f : a ⟶ b) {g h : b ⟶ c} (x : g ⟶ h) :
    (Thom R B a.obj c.obj).map (f ◁ x) =
      (TF R B a.obj b.obj).obj f.obj ◁ (Thom R B b.obj c.obj).map x
proof:
:= by
  rw [Orbit2.whiskerLeft_def]
  unfold Thom
  have e := CategoryTheory.Functor.congr_hom (map_pre_comp c.obj f.obj) x
  erw [eqToHom_refl, eqToHom_refl, Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id] at e
  rw [lift_map, lift_map, map_map_comp]
  erw [e]
  rw [← map_map_comp, eval_map_map (preShift_trivCompat (R := R) _ _)]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated2.Thom_eq
statement:
theorem Thom_eq (a b : 𝔄) :
    Thom R B a b = Orbit.lift (homTriv R (bo a) (bo b)) (TΦ R B a b)

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated2.Thom_ι_map
statement:
theorem Thom_ι_map {a b : 𝔄} {f g : a ⟶ b} (x : f ⟶ g) :
    (Thom R B a b).map ((Orbit.ι (homShift R a b)).map x) = (TF R B a b).map x

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated2.TΦ_γ_hom_mem_degree
statement:
theorem TΦ_γ_hom_mem_degree {a b : 𝔄} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (TΦ R B a b).γ.hom.app f ∈ degree (R := R) _ _ 0

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated2.Thom_map_mem_degree
proof:
:=
  lift_map_mem_degree (homTriv R (bo a) (bo b)) (Φ := TΦ R B a b)
    (fun y => TF_map_mem_degree y) (fun y => TΦ_γ_hom_mem_degree y) hx

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated2.Thom_map_injective
statement:
theorem Thom_map_injective {a b : 𝔄} {f g : Orbit (homShift R a b)} {x y : f ⟶ g}
    (h : (Thom R B a b).map x = (Thom R B a b).map y) : x = y
proof:
:=
  lift_map_injective (homTriv R (bo a) (bo b)) (Φ := TΦ R B a b)
    (fun y => TF_map_mem_degree y) (fun y => TΦ_γ_hom_mem_degree y) h

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated2.Thom_map_surjective
statement:
theorem Thom_map_surjective {a b : 𝔄} {f g : Orbit (homShift R a b)}
    (h : (Thom R B a b).obj f ⟶ (Thom R B a b).obj g) : ∃ x : f ⟶ g, (Thom R B a b).map x = h
proof:
:=
  lift_map_surjective (homTriv R (bo a) (bo b)) (Φ := TΦ R B a b)
    (fun y => TF_map_mem_degree y) (fun y => TΦ_γ_hom_mem_degree y)
    (fun h hh => TF_map_surjective h hh) h

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated2.T_map₂_mem_degree
statement:
theorem T_map₂_mem_degree {f g : a ⟶ b} {n : ℤ} {x : f ⟶ g}
    (hx : x ∈ degree (R := R) f g n) : (T R B).map₂ x ∈ degree (R := R) _ _ n

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated2.T_map₂_bijective
statement:
theorem T_map₂_bijective (f g : a ⟶ b) :
    Function.Bijective ((T R B).map₂ : (f ⟶ g) → ((T R B).map f ⟶ (T R B).map g))
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun _ _ h => Thom_map_injective (a := a.obj) (b := b.obj) h,
    fun h => Thom_map_surjective (a := a.obj) (b := b.obj) h⟩

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated2.T_map₂_ζ
statement:
theorem T_map₂_ζ (a : QAssociated2 R (GUnderlying2 R B)) :
    (T R B).map₂ (PiTwoSupercategory.ζ (R := R) a).hom =
      (PiTwoSupercategory.ζ (R := R) ((T R B).obj a)).hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [T_map₂, Orbit2.ζ_hom_def, Thom_ι_map, TF_map]
  exact congrArg Subtype.val (Associated2.T_map₂_ζ (R := R) (A := DegreeZero2 R B) a.obj)

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated2.T_map₂_σ
statement:
theorem T_map₂_σ (a : QAssociated2 R (GUnderlying2 R B)) :
    (T R B).map₂ (QPiTwoSupercategory.σ (R := R) a).hom =
      (QPiTwoSupercategory.σ (R := R) ((T R B).obj a)).hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [T_map₂, Orbit2.σ_eq, Orbit2.σ_hom, Functor.map_comp, Thom_ι_map]
  unfold Thom
  erw [lift_σIso_hom]
  simp only [TΦ_γ_inv_app, homTriv_σ_hom, TΦ_F]
  erw [Category.id_comp]
  rw [TF_leftUnitor_inv]
  change (leftUnitor (QPiTwoSupercategory.q (R := R) (bo a.obj))).inv ≫
    𝟙 _ ◁ (QPiTwoSupercategory.σ (R := R) (bo a.obj)).hom ≫
    (rightUnitor (𝟙 (bo a.obj))).hom = _
  rw [← leftUnitor_inv_naturality_assoc R, ← unitors_equal R, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.Superequivalence.isEquivalence
statement:
theorem Superequivalence.isEquivalence {F : C ⥤ D} (e : Superequivalence R F) :
    F.IsEquivalence

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.EvenlyIsomorphic.trans
statement:
theorem trans {f g h : a ⟶ b} (h₁ : EvenlyIsomorphic R f g) (h₂ : EvenlyIsomorphic R g h) :
    EvenlyIsomorphic R f h
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := h₁
  obtain ⟨e', he'⟩ := h₂
  exact ⟨e ≪≫ e', by simpa using comp_mem he he'⟩

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.EvenlyIsomorphic.symm
statement: theorem symm {f g : a ⟶ b} (h : EvenlyIsomorphic R f g) : EvenlyIsomorphic R g f
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := h
  exact ⟨e.symm, inv_mem e he⟩

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.EvenlyIsomorphic.whiskerLeft
statement:
theorem whiskerLeft (f : a ⟶ b) {g h : b ⟶ c} (hgh : EvenlyIsomorphic R g h) :
    EvenlyIsomorphic R (f ≫ g) (f ≫ h)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := hgh
  exact ⟨whiskerLeftIso (R := R) f e, whiskerLeft_mem f he⟩

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.EvenlyIsomorphic.whiskerRight
statement:
theorem whiskerRight {f g : a ⟶ b} (hfg : EvenlyIsomorphic R f g) (h : b ⟶ c) :
    EvenlyIsomorphic R (f ≫ h) (g ≫ h)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := hfg
  exact ⟨whiskerRightIso (R := R) e h, whiskerRight_mem h he⟩

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.EvenlyIsomorphic.associator
statement:
theorem associator {d : B} (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) (h : c ⟶ d) :
    EvenlyIsomorphic R ((f ≫ g) ≫ h) (f ≫ g ≫ h)
proof:
:=
  ⟨BicategoryStruct.associator f g h, associator_hom_mem (R := R) f g h⟩

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.EvenlyIsomorphic.leftUnitor
statement: theorem leftUnitor (f : a ⟶ b) : EvenlyIsomorphic R (𝟙 a ≫ f) f

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.IsSuperequivalence.comp
statement:
theorem IsSuperequivalence.comp {f : a ⟶ b} {g : b ⟶ c} (hf : IsSuperequivalence R f)
    (hg : IsSuperequivalence R g) : IsSuperequivalence R (f ≫ g)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f', e₁, e₂, h₁, h₂⟩ := hf
  obtain ⟨g', e₃, e₄, h₃, h₄⟩ := hg
  obtain ⟨E₁, hE₁⟩ : EvenlyIsomorphic R ((f ≫ g) ≫ g' ≫ f') (𝟙 a) :=
    (EvenlyIsomorphic.associator R _ _ _).trans <|
      (EvenlyIsomorphic.whiskerLeft f <| (EvenlyIsomorphic.associator R _ _ _).symm.trans <|
        (EvenlyIsomorphic.whiskerRight ⟨e₃, h₃⟩ f').trans (EvenlyIsomorphic.leftUnitor R f')).trans
        ⟨e₁, h₁⟩
  obtain ⟨E₂, hE₂⟩ : EvenlyIsomorphic R ((g' ≫ f') ≫ f ≫ g) (𝟙 c) :=
    (EvenlyIsomorphic.associator R _ _ _).trans <|
      (EvenlyIsomorphic.whiskerLeft g' <| (EvenlyIsomorphic.associator R _ _ _).symm.trans <|
        (EvenlyIsomorphic.whiskerRight ⟨e₂, h₂⟩ g).trans (EvenlyIsomorphic.leftUnitor R g)).trans
        ⟨e₄, h₄⟩
  exact ⟨g' ≫ f', E₁, E₂, hE₁, hE₂⟩

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.Superequivalent.trans
statement:
theorem Superequivalent.trans (h₁ : Superequivalent R a b) (h₂ : Superequivalent R b c) :
    Superequivalent R a c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := h₁
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := h₂
  exact ⟨f ≫ g, hf.comp hg⟩

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.isSuperequivalence_map
statement:
theorem isSuperequivalence_map (F : TwoSuperfunctor R B C) {a b : B} {f : a ⟶ b}
    (hf : IsSuperequivalence R f) : IsSuperequivalence R (F.map f)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, e₁, e₂, h₁, h₂⟩ := hf
  refine ⟨F.map g, F.mapComp f g ≪≫ F.map₂Iso e₁ ≪≫ (F.mapId a).symm,
    F.mapComp g f ≪≫ F.map₂Iso e₂ ≪≫ (F.mapId b).symm, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa using comp_mem (comp_mem (F.mapComp_hom_mem f g) (F.map₂_mem h₁))
      (inv_mem _ (F.mapId_hom_mem a))
  · simpa using comp_mem (comp_mem (F.mapComp_hom_mem g f) (F.map₂_mem h₂))
      (inv_mem _ (F.mapId_hom_mem b))

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.superequivalent_obj
statement:
theorem superequivalent_obj (F : TwoSuperfunctor R B C) {a b : B} (h : Superequivalent R a b) :
    Superequivalent R (F.obj a) (F.obj b)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := h
  exact ⟨F.map f, F.isSuperequivalence_map hf⟩

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.IsLocalTwoSuperequivalence.comp
statement:
theorem IsLocalTwoSuperequivalence.comp {F : TwoSuperfunctor R B C} {G : TwoSuperfunctor R C D}
    (hF : F.IsLocalTwoSuperequivalence) (hG : G.IsLocalTwoSuperequivalence) :
    (F.comp G).IsLocalTwoSuperequivalence where
  hom a b
proof:
:= ⟨(hF.hom a b).some.comp (hG.hom (F.obj a) (F.obj b)).some⟩
  essSurj d := by
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hG.essSurj d
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hF.essSurj c
    exact ⟨a, (G.superequivalent_obj ha).trans hc⟩

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.TwoSuperequivalent.symm
statement: theorem TwoSuperequivalent.symm (h : TwoSuperequivalent R B C) : TwoSuperequivalent R C B
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨F, G, h₁, h₂⟩ := h
  exact ⟨G, F, h₂, h₁⟩

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSuperfunctor.TwoSuperequivalent.trans
statement:
theorem TwoSuperequivalent.trans (h₁ : TwoSuperequivalent R B C) (h₂ : TwoSuperequivalent R C D) :
    TwoSuperequivalent R B D
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ := h₁.localTwoSuperequivalent
  obtain ⟨G, hG⟩ := h₂.localTwoSuperequivalent
  exact LocalTwoSuperequivalent.twoSuperequivalent ⟨F.comp G, hF.comp hG⟩

name: StringDiagrams.PiSOp.exponent_whiskerLeft
statement:
theorem exponent_whiskerLeft (a b c p : ZMod 2) :
    exponent (a + b) (a + c) p = a * (b + c) + exponent b c p
proof:
:= by
  have e : (a + b) + (a + c) = b + c := by
    calc
      _ = (a + a) + (b + c) := by ac_rfl
      _ = b + c := by rw [zmod2_add_self, zero_add]
  unfold exponent
  rw [e]
  ring

name: StringDiagrams.PiSOp.exponent_whiskerRight
statement:
theorem exponent_whiskerRight (a b c p : ZMod 2) :
    exponent (a + b) (c + b) p = b * (a + c) + exponent a c p
proof:
:= by
  have e : (a + b) + (c + b) = a + c := by
    calc
      _ = (b + b) + (a + c) := by ac_rfl
      _ = a + c := by rw [zmod2_add_self, zero_add]
  unfold exponent
  rw [e]
  ring

name: StringDiagrams.PiSOp.correction_whiskerLeft
statement:
theorem correction_whiskerLeft (a b c : ZMod 2) {x y z : B}
    (f : x ⟶ y) {g h : y ⟶ z} (η : g ⟶ h) :
    correction (R := R) (a + b) (a + c) (f ◁ twist R a η) =
      sign R (a * (b + c)) • (f ◁ twist R a (correction (R := R) b c η))
proof:
:= by
  refine induction_on (R := R) η ?_ (fun p η hη => ?_) ?_
  · have hz : f ◁ (0 : g ⟶ h) = 0 := by
      simpa only [zero_smul] using whiskerLeft_smul f (0 : R) (0 : g ⟶ h)
    simp only [map_zero, hz, smul_zero]
  · rw [twist_of_mem a hη, whiskerLeft_smul, map_smul,
      correction_of_mem (a + b) (a + c) (whiskerLeft_mem f hη),
      correction_of_mem b c hη, map_smul, twist_of_mem a hη,
      whiskerLeft_smul, whiskerLeft_smul, exponent_whiskerLeft, sign_add]
    simp only [smul_smul]
    congr 1
    ring
  · intro η θ hη hθ
    simp only [map_add, whiskerLeft_add R, hη, hθ, smul_add]

name: StringDiagrams.PiSOp.correction_whiskerRight
statement:
theorem correction_whiskerRight (a b c : ZMod 2) {x y z : B}
    {f g : x ⟶ y} (η : f ⟶ g) (h : y ⟶ z) :
    correction (R := R) (a + b) (c + b) (twist R b η ▷ h) =
      sign R (b * (a + c)) • (twist R b (correction (R := R) a c η) ▷ h)
proof:
:= by
  refine induction_on (R := R) η ?_ (fun p η hη => ?_) ?_
  · have hz : (0 : f ⟶ g) ▷ h = 0 := by
      simpa only [zero_smul] using smul_whiskerRight (0 : R) (0 : f ⟶ g) h
    simp only [map_zero, hz, smul_zero]
  · rw [twist_of_mem b hη, smul_whiskerRight, map_smul,
      correction_of_mem (a + b) (c + b) (whiskerRight_mem h hη),
      correction_of_mem a c hη, map_smul, twist_of_mem b hη,
      smul_whiskerRight, smul_whiskerRight, exponent_whiskerRight, sign_add]
    simp only [smul_smul]
    congr 1
    ring
  · intro η θ hη hθ
    simp only [map_add, add_whiskerRight R, hη, hθ, smul_add]

name: StringDiagrams.PiSOp.comparison_cocycle
statement:
theorem comparison_cocycle (a b c : ZMod 2) :
    sign R (b * c) * sign R (a * (b + c)) =
      sign R (a * b) * sign R ((a + b) * c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sign_add, ← sign_add]
  congr 1
  ring

name: StringDiagrams.PiSOp.comparison_units
statement: theorem comparison_units (a : ZMod 2) : sign R (0 * a) = 1 ∧ sign R (a * 0) = 1

name: StringDiagrams.Underlying2.eqToHom_val
statement:
theorem eqToHom_val {a b : Underlying2 R B} {f g : a ⟶ b} (h : f = g) :
    (eqToHom h).1 = eqToHom (congrArg Underlying.obj h)

name: StringDiagrams.Underlying2.hom1_eq
statement: theorem hom1_eq {a b : Underlying2 R B} {f g : a ⟶ b} (h : f.obj = g.obj) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  cases f
  cases g
  cases h
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.Superfunctor.eqToHom_app_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem eqToHom_app_zero {F G : Superfunctor R C D} (h : F = G) (X : C) :
    (eqToHom h : F ⟶ G).app 0 X = eqToHom (by rw [h])

name: StringDiagrams.Superfunctor.eqToHom_app_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem eqToHom_app_one {F G : Superfunctor R C D} (h : F = G) (X : C) :
    (eqToHom h : F ⟶ G).app 1 X = 0

name: StringDiagrams.PiSCat.eqToHom_app_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem eqToHom_app_zero {F G : A ⟶ B} (h : F = G) (X : A.carrier) :
    (eqToHom h : F ⟶ G).app 0 X = eqToHom (by rw [h])

name: StringDiagrams.PiSCat.eqToHom_app_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem eqToHom_app_one {F G : A ⟶ B} (h : F = G) (X : A.carrier) :
    (eqToHom h : F ⟶ G).app 1 X = 0

name: StringDiagrams.PiSCat.app_one_eq_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem app_one_eq_zero {F G : A ⟶ B} (x : F ⟶ G) (X : A.obj.carrier) : x.1.app 1 X = 0

name: StringDiagrams.PiSCat.hom₂_ext
statement:
theorem hom₂_ext {F G : A ⟶ B} {x y : F ⟶ G} (h : ∀ X : A.obj.carrier, x.1.app 0 X = y.1.app 0 X) :
    x = y
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext (Superfunctor.hom_ext_parity h fun X => by
    rw [app_one_eq_zero x X, app_one_eq_zero y X])

name: StringDiagrams.PiSCat.comp₂_app_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem comp₂_app_zero {F G H : A ⟶ B} (x : F ⟶ G) (y : G ⟶ H) (X : A.obj.carrier) :
    (x ≫ y).1.app 0 X = x.1.app 0 X ≫ y.1.app 0 X
proof:
:= by
  change x.1.app 0 X ≫ y.1.app 0 X + x.1.app 1 X ≫ y.1.app 1 X = _
  rw [app_one_eq_zero x X, Limits.zero_comp, add_zero]

name: StringDiagrams.PiSCat.id₂_app_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem id₂_app_zero (F : A ⟶ B) (X : A.obj.carrier) :
    (𝟙 F : F ⟶ F).1.app 0 X = 𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.PiSCat.whiskerLeft₂_app_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem whiskerLeft₂_app_zero (F : A ⟶ B) {G H : B ⟶ C} (y : G ⟶ H)
    (X : A.obj.carrier) : (F ◁ y).1.app 0 X = y.1.app 0 (F.obj.obj X)

name: StringDiagrams.PiSCat.whiskerRight₂_app_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem whiskerRight₂_app_zero {F G : A ⟶ B} (x : F ⟶ G) (H : B ⟶ C)
    (X : A.obj.carrier) : (x ▷ H).1.app 0 X = H.obj.map (x.1.app 0 X)

name: StringDiagrams.PiSCat.leftUnitor₂_hom_app_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem leftUnitor₂_hom_app_zero (F : A ⟶ B) (X : A.obj.carrier) :
    (λ_ F).hom.1.app 0 X = 𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.PiSCat.leftUnitor₂_inv_app_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem leftUnitor₂_inv_app_zero (F : A ⟶ B) (X : A.obj.carrier) :
    (λ_ F).inv.1.app 0 X = 𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.PiSCat.rightUnitor₂_hom_app_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem rightUnitor₂_hom_app_zero (F : A ⟶ B) (X : A.obj.carrier) :
    (ρ_ F).hom.1.app 0 X = 𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.PiSCat.rightUnitor₂_inv_app_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem rightUnitor₂_inv_app_zero (F : A ⟶ B) (X : A.obj.carrier) :
    (ρ_ F).inv.1.app 0 X = 𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.PiSCat.associator₂_hom_app_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem associator₂_hom_app_zero {D : Underlying2 R (PiSCat.{w, v, u} R)} (F : A ⟶ B)
    (G : B ⟶ C) (H : C ⟶ D) (X : A.obj.carrier) : (α_ F G H).hom.1.app 0 X = 𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.PiSCat.associator₂_inv_app_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem associator₂_inv_app_zero {D : Underlying2 R (PiSCat.{w, v, u} R)} (F : A ⟶ B)
    (G : B ⟶ C) (H : C ⟶ D) (X : A.obj.carrier) : (α_ F G H).inv.1.app 0 X = 𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.PiSCat.eqToHom₂_app_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem eqToHom₂_app_zero {F G : A ⟶ B} (h : F = G) (X : A.obj.carrier) :
    (eqToHom h : F ⟶ G).1.app 0 X = eqToHom (by rw [h])

name: StringDiagrams.PiCat.D₁map₂_app_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem D₁map₂_app_zero {F G : A ⟶ B} (y : F ⟶ G) (X : Associated R A) :
    (D₁map₂ y).1.app 0 X = Associated.homMk ((Hom₂.natTrans y).app X.obj) 0
proof:
:= by
  change (if (0 : ZMod 2) = 0 then _ else 0) = _
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.PiCat.D₁map₂_app_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem D₁map₂_app_one {F G : A ⟶ B} (y : F ⟶ G) (X : Associated R A) :
    (D₁map₂ y).1.app 1 X = 0
proof:
:= by
  change (if (1 : ZMod 2) = 0 then Associated.homMk ((Hom₂.natTrans y).app X.obj) 0 else 0) = _
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.PiCat.D₁Strict_obj
statement: @[simp] theorem D₁Strict_obj (A : PiCat.{w, v, u} R) : (D₁Strict R).obj A = D₁obj A

name: StringDiagrams.PiCat.D₁Strict_map
statement:
@[simp] theorem D₁Strict_map {A B : PiCat.{w, v, u} R} (F : A ⟶ B) :
    (D₁Strict R).map F = D₁hom F

name: StringDiagrams.PiCat.D₁Strict_map₂
statement:
@[simp] theorem D₁Strict_map₂ {A B : PiCat.{w, v, u} R} {F G : A ⟶ B} (y : F ⟶ G) :
    (D₁Strict R).map₂ y = D₁map₂ y

name: StringDiagrams.PiCat.D₁Pseudo_mapComp_inv
statement:
theorem D₁Pseudo_mapComp_inv {A B C : PiCat.{w, v, u} R} (F : A ⟶ B) (G : B ⟶ C) :
    ((D₁Pseudo R).mapComp F G).inv = eqToHom (Underlying2.hom1_eq (D₁.map_comp F G)).symm

name: StringDiagrams.PiCat.D₁Pseudo_mapComp_hom
statement:
theorem D₁Pseudo_mapComp_hom {A B C : PiCat.{w, v, u} R} (F : A ⟶ B) (G : B ⟶ C) :
    ((D₁Pseudo R).mapComp F G).hom = eqToHom (Underlying2.hom1_eq (D₁.map_comp F G))

name: StringDiagrams.PiCat.D₁Pseudo_mapId_hom
statement:
theorem D₁Pseudo_mapId_hom (A : PiCat.{w, v, u} R) :
    ((D₁Pseudo R).mapId A).hom = eqToHom (Underlying2.hom1_eq (D₁.map_id A))

name: StringDiagrams.PiCat.D₁Pseudo_mapId_inv
statement:
theorem D₁Pseudo_mapId_inv (A : PiCat.{w, v, u} R) :
    ((D₁Pseudo R).mapId A).inv = eqToHom (Underlying2.hom1_eq (D₁.map_id A)).symm

name: StringDiagrams.PiCat.D₁_pi_eq
statement:
theorem D₁_pi_eq (A : PiCat.{w, v, u} R) :
    PiTwoCategory.pi (R := R) ((D₁Pseudo R).obj A) = (D₁Pseudo R).map (PiTwoCategory.pi (R := R) A)

name: StringDiagrams.PiCat.comp₂_natTrans_app'
statement:
@[simp] theorem comp₂_natTrans_app' {A B : PiCat.{w, v, u} R} {F G H : A ⟶ B} (x : F ⟶ G)
    (y : G ⟶ H) (X : A) :
    (Hom₂.natTrans (x ≫ y)).app X = (Hom₂.natTrans x).app X ≫ (Hom₂.natTrans y).app X

name: StringDiagrams.PiCat.id₂_natTrans_app'
statement:
@[simp] theorem id₂_natTrans_app' {A B : PiCat.{w, v, u} R} (F : A ⟶ B) (X : A) :
    (Hom₂.natTrans (𝟙 F)).app X = 𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.PiCat.E₁D₁_mapId_app
statement:
theorem E₁D₁_mapId_app (A : PiCat.{w, v, u} R) (X : A) :
    (Hom₂.natTrans (((D₁Pseudo R).comp (PiSCat.E₁Pseudo R)).mapId A).hom).app
      ((unitHom R A).toFunctor.obj X) = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  apply Underlying.hom_ext
  change (eqToHom (Underlying2.hom1_eq (D₁.map_id A)) : D₁hom (𝟙 A) ⟶ 𝟙 (D₁obj A)).1.app 0
    (⟨X⟩ : Associated R A) ≫ 𝟙 _ = 𝟙 _
  rw [PiSCat.eqToHom₂_app_zero, Category.comp_id]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.PiCat.E₁D₁_mapComp_app
statement:
theorem E₁D₁_mapComp_app {A B C : PiCat.{w, v, u} R} (F : A ⟶ B) (G : B ⟶ C) (X : A) :
    (Hom₂.natTrans (((D₁Pseudo R).comp (PiSCat.E₁Pseudo R)).mapComp F G).hom).app
      ((unitHom R A).toFunctor.obj X) = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  apply Underlying.hom_ext
  change (eqToHom (Underlying2.hom1_eq (D₁.map_comp F G)) : D₁hom (F ≫ G) ⟶ D₁hom F ≫ D₁hom G).1.app 0
    (⟨X⟩ : Associated R A) ≫ 𝟙 _ = 𝟙 _
  rw [PiSCat.eqToHom₂_app_zero, Category.comp_id]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.PiCat.unit_naturality_eq
statement:
theorem unit_naturality_eq {A B : PiCat.{w, v, u} R} (F : A ⟶ B) :
    (Pseudofunctor.id (PiCat.{w, v, u} R)).map F ≫ unitHom R B =
      unitHom R A ≫ ((D₁Pseudo R).comp (PiSCat.E₁Pseudo R)).map F

name: StringDiagrams.PiCat.unitStrong_app
statement: @[simp] theorem unitStrong_app (A : PiCat.{w, v, u} R) : (unitStrong R).app A = unitHom R A

name: StringDiagrams.PiCat.unitStrong_naturality
statement:
theorem unitStrong_naturality {A B : PiCat.{w, v, u} R} (F : A ⟶ B) :
    (unitStrong R).naturality F = eqToIso (unit_naturality_eq F)

name: StringDiagrams.PiCat.E₁D₁_j_app
statement:
theorem E₁D₁_j_app (A : PiCat.{w, v, u} R)
    (Y : (((D₁Pseudo R).comp (PiSCat.E₁Pseudo R)).obj A).carrier) :
    (Hom₂.natTrans (((D₁PiTwoFunctor R).comp (PiSCat.E₁PiTwoFunctor R)).j A).hom).app Y =
      𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  apply Underlying.hom_ext
  change 𝟙 _ ≫ (eqToHom (D₁_pi_eq A)).1.app 0 Y.obj = 𝟙 _
  rw [PiSCat.eqToHom₂_app_zero, Category.id_comp]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.PiCat.unitHom_β_app
statement:
theorem unitHom_β_app (A : PiCat.{w, v, u} R) (X : A) :
    (Hom₂.natTrans (PiTwoCategory.β (R := R) (unitHom R A)).hom).app X = 𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.PiCat.unitStrong_isPiTwoNatural
statement:
theorem unitStrong_isPiTwoNatural :
    (PiTwoFunctor.id R (PiCat.{w, v, u} R)).IsPiTwoNatural
      ((D₁PiTwoFunctor R).comp (PiSCat.E₁PiTwoFunctor R)) (unitStrong R).toOplax.toOplax
proof:
:=
  fun A => by
    ext X
    erw [E₁D₁_j_app]
    simp only [comp₂_natTrans_app', PiTwoFunctor.id_j, Iso.refl_hom]
    erw [unitHom_β_app]
    repeat erw [Category.id_comp]
    erw [show (unitStrong R).toOplax.toOplax.naturality (PiTwoCategory.pi (R := R) A) =
      eqToHom (unit_naturality_eq _) from rfl, eqToHom_natTrans_app, eqToHom_refl]
    rfl

name: StringDiagrams.PiSCat.id_mapComp_hom'
statement:
theorem id_mapComp_hom' {a b c : Underlying2 R (PiSCat.{w, v, u} R)} (F : a ⟶ b) (G : b ⟶ c) :
    ((Pseudofunctor.id (Underlying2 R (PiSCat.{w, v, u} R))).mapComp F G).hom = 𝟙 (F ≫ G)

name: StringDiagrams.PiSCat.counit_naturality_eq
statement:
theorem counit_naturality_eq {A B : Underlying2 R (PiSCat.{w, v, u} R)} (F : A ⟶ B) :
    ((E₁Pseudo R).comp (D₁Pseudo R)).map F ≫ counitHom R B =
      counitHom R A ≫ (Pseudofunctor.id _).map F

name: StringDiagrams.PiSCat.counitHom_obj
statement:
theorem counitHom_obj (A : Underlying2 R (PiSCat.{w, v, u} R)) :
    (counitHom R A).obj = (counitIsoApp A.obj).hom

name: StringDiagrams.PiSCat.E₁D₁_mapId_app'
statement:
theorem E₁D₁_mapId_app' (A : Underlying2 R (PiSCat.{w, v, u} R))
    (X : (((E₁Pseudo R).comp (D₁Pseudo R)).obj A).obj.carrier) :
    (((E₁Pseudo R).comp (D₁Pseudo R)).mapId A).hom.1.app 0 X = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  erw [Pseudofunctor.comp_mapId, Iso.trans_hom, PiSCat.comp₂_app_zero, D₁Pseudo_mapId_hom,
    PiSCat.eqToHom₂_app_zero, PrelaxFunctor.map₂Iso_hom, D₁Strict_map₂, D₁map₂_app_zero,
    eqToHom_refl, Category.comp_id]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.PiSCat.E₁D₁_mapComp_app'
statement:
theorem E₁D₁_mapComp_app' {A B C : Underlying2 R (PiSCat.{w, v, u} R)} (F : A ⟶ B) (G : B ⟶ C)
    (X : (((E₁Pseudo R).comp (D₁Pseudo R)).obj A).obj.carrier) :
    (((E₁Pseudo R).comp (D₁Pseudo R)).mapComp F G).hom.1.app 0 X = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  erw [Pseudofunctor.comp_mapComp, Iso.trans_hom, PiSCat.comp₂_app_zero, D₁Pseudo_mapComp_hom,
    PiSCat.eqToHom₂_app_zero, PrelaxFunctor.map₂Iso_hom, D₁Strict_map₂, D₁map₂_app_zero,
    eqToHom_refl, Category.comp_id]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.PiSCat.counitStrong_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem counitStrong_app (A : Underlying2 R (PiSCat.{w, v, u} R)) :
    (counitStrong R).app A = counitHom R A

name: StringDiagrams.PiSCat.counitStrong_naturality
statement:
theorem counitStrong_naturality {A B : Underlying2 R (PiSCat.{w, v, u} R)} (F : A ⟶ B) :
    (counitStrong R).naturality F = eqToIso (counit_naturality_eq F)

name: StringDiagrams.PiSCat.counitHom_β_app
statement:
theorem counitHom_β_app (A : Underlying2 R (PiSCat.{w, v, u} R))
    (X : (((E₁Pseudo R).comp (D₁Pseudo R)).obj A).obj.carrier) :
    (PiTwoCategory.β (R := R) (counitHom R A)).hom.1.app 0 X = 𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.PiSCat.E₁D₁_j_app'
statement:
theorem E₁D₁_j_app' (A : Underlying2 R (PiSCat.{w, v, u} R))
    (X : (((E₁Pseudo R).comp (D₁Pseudo R)).obj A).obj.carrier) :
    (((PiSCat.E₁PiTwoFunctor R).comp (D₁PiTwoFunctor R)).j A).hom.1.app 0 X = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  erw [Iso.trans_hom, PiSCat.comp₂_app_zero, PiSCat.eqToHom₂_app_zero (D₁_pi_eq _),
    PrelaxFunctor.map₂Iso_hom,
    D₁Strict_map₂, D₁map₂_app_zero, eqToHom_refl, Category.id_comp]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.PiSCat.counitStrong_isPiTwoNatural
statement:
theorem counitStrong_isPiTwoNatural :
    ((PiSCat.E₁PiTwoFunctor R).comp (D₁PiTwoFunctor R)).IsPiTwoNatural
      (PiTwoFunctor.id R (Underlying2 R (PiSCat.{w, v, u} R))) (counitStrong R).toOplax.toOplax
proof:
:=
  fun A => by
    apply hom₂_ext
    intro X
    erw [comp₂_app_zero, counitHom_β_app, comp₂_app_zero, whiskerRight₂_app_zero, E₁D₁_j_app',
      show (counitStrong R).toOplax.toOplax.naturality (PiTwoCategory.pi (R := R) A) =
        eqToHom (counit_naturality_eq _) from rfl,
      eqToHom₂_app_zero (counit_naturality_eq _), whiskerLeft₂_app_zero, PiTwoFunctor.id_j,
      Iso.refl_hom, id₂_app_zero]
    repeat erw [eqToHom_refl]
    obtain ⟨⟨X⟩⟩ := X
    change 𝟙 ((PiSupercategory.pi (R := R)).obj X) ≫ (Associated.T R A.obj.carrier).map
        (𝟙 (⟨⟨(PiSupercategory.pi (R := R)).obj X⟩⟩ : Associated R (Underlying R A.obj.carrier))) ≫
          𝟙 ((PiSupercategory.pi (R := R)).obj X) = 𝟙 ((PiSupercategory.pi (R := R)).obj X)
    rw [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id]
    simp only [Category.id_comp]
    exact Category.id_comp _

name: StringDiagrams.PiSCat.counitHom_inv
statement:
theorem counitHom_inv (A : Underlying2 R (PiSCat.{w, v, u} R)) :
    counitHom R A ≫ (Underlying2.hom1 (R := R) (counitIsoApp A.obj).inv :
      (Pseudofunctor.id _).obj A ⟶ ((E₁Pseudo R).comp (D₁Pseudo R)).obj A) = 𝟙 _ ∧
    (Underlying2.hom1 (R := R) (counitIsoApp A.obj).inv :
      (Pseudofunctor.id _).obj A ⟶ ((E₁Pseudo R).comp (D₁Pseudo R)).obj A) ≫ counitHom R A = 𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.PiCat.theorem53
statement:
theorem theorem53 :
    (PiTwoFunctor.id R (PiCat.{w, v, u} R)).IsPiTwoNatural
        ((D₁PiTwoFunctor R).comp (PiSCat.E₁PiTwoFunctor R)) (unitStrong R).toOplax.toOplax ∧
      (∀ {A B : PiCat.{w, v, u} R} (F : A ⟶ B),
        (unitStrong R).naturality F = eqToIso (unit_naturality_eq F)) ∧
      (∀ A : PiCat.{w, v, u} R, ∃ g : ((D₁Pseudo R).comp (PiSCat.E₁Pseudo R)).obj A ⟶ A,
        (unitStrong R).app A ≫ g = 𝟙 _ ∧ g ≫ (unitStrong R).app A = 𝟙 _) ∧
      ((PiSCat.E₁PiTwoFunctor R).comp (D₁PiTwoFunctor R)).IsPiTwoNatural
        (PiTwoFunctor.id R (Underlying2 R (PiSCat.{w, v, u} R))) (counitStrong R).toOplax.toOplax ∧
      (∀ {A B : Underlying2 R (PiSCat.{w, v, u} R)} (F : A ⟶ B),
        (counitStrong R).naturality F = eqToIso (counit_naturality_eq F)) ∧
      (∀ A : Underlying2 R (PiSCat.{w, v, u} R),
        ∃ g : A ⟶ ((PiSCat.E₁Pseudo R).comp (D₁Pseudo R)).obj A,
          (counitStrong R).app A ≫ g = 𝟙 _ ∧ g ≫ (counitStrong R).app A = 𝟙 _)
proof:
:=
  ⟨unitStrong_isPiTwoNatural, fun _ => rfl,
    fun A => ⟨(unitIsoApp A).inv, (unitIsoApp A).hom_inv_id, (unitIsoApp A).inv_hom_id⟩,
    counitStrong_isPiTwoNatural, fun _ => rfl,
    fun A => ⟨_, (counitHom_inv A).1, (counitHom_inv A).2⟩⟩

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSOp.mem_degree_iff
statement:
theorem mem_degree_iff {a b : TwoSOp R B} {f g : a ⟶ b} {n : ℤ} {η : f ⟶ g} :
    η ∈ degree (R := R) f g n ↔
      SOp.unsop η ∈ degree (R := R) (SOp.unop g) (SOp.unop f) n

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalPiFunctor.ext
statement:
theorem ext {F : C ⥤ D} [F.Monoidal] {hF hG : MonoidalPiFunctor R F}
    (h : hF.j.hom = hG.j.hom) : hF = hG
proof:
:= by
  have hj : hF.j = hG.j := Iso.ext h
  cases hF
  cases hG
  dsimp only at hj
  subst hj
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalSuperfunctor.ext
statement:
theorem ext {F : C ⥤ D} [F.Additive] [F.Linear R] [IsSuperfunctor R F]
    {cF cG : MonoidalSuperfunctor R F} (hμ : ∀ X Y, (cF.μIso X Y).hom = (cG.μIso X Y).hom)
    (hε : cF.εIso.hom = cG.εIso.hom) : cF = cG
proof:
:= by
  have hμ' : cF.μIso = cG.μIso := funext₂ fun X Y => Iso.ext (hμ X Y)
  have hε' : cF.εIso = cG.εIso := Iso.ext hε
  cases cF
  cases cG
  dsimp only at hμ' hε'
  subst hμ' hε'
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.PiMon.Hom.ext
statement:
theorem Hom.ext {A B : PiMon.{w, v, u} R} {F G : Hom A B} (h : F.toFunctor = G.toFunctor)
    (hε : HEq (ε F.toFunctor) (ε G.toFunctor))
    (hμ : ∀ X Y, HEq (μ F.toFunctor X Y) (μ G.toFunctor X Y))
    (hj : HEq F.piFunctor.j.hom G.piFunctor.j.hom) : F = G
proof:
:= by
  cases F with | mk F pF =>
  cases G with | mk G pG =>
  dsimp only at h hε hμ hj
  subst h
  rename_i _ _ mF _ _ mG
  obtain rfl : mF = mG := Functor.Monoidal.toLaxMonoidal_injective _
    (Functor.LaxMonoidal.ext (eq_of_heq hε) (funext₂ fun X Y => eq_of_heq (hμ X Y)))
  obtain rfl : pF = pG := MonoidalPiFunctor.ext (eq_of_heq hj)
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.PiMon.hom_def
statement: theorem hom_def : (A ⟶ B) = Hom A B

name: StringDiagrams.PiMon.id_toFunctor
statement: @[simp] theorem id_toFunctor : (𝟙 A : A ⟶ A).toFunctor = 𝟭 A

name: StringDiagrams.PiMon.comp_toFunctor
statement:
@[simp] theorem comp_toFunctor (F : A ⟶ B) (G : B ⟶ E) :
    (F ≫ G).toFunctor = F.toFunctor ⋙ G.toFunctor

name: StringDiagrams.PiMon.id_piFunctor
statement: @[simp] theorem id_piFunctor : (𝟙 A : A ⟶ A).piFunctor = MonoidalPiFunctor.id R A

name: StringDiagrams.PiMon.comp_piFunctor
statement:
@[simp] theorem comp_piFunctor (F : A ⟶ B) (G : B ⟶ E) :
    (F ≫ G).piFunctor = F.piFunctor.comp G.piFunctor

name: StringDiagrams.PiSMon.Hom.ext
statement:
theorem Hom.ext {A B : PiSMon.{w, v, u} R} {F G : Hom A B} (h : F.toFunctor = G.toFunctor)
    (hμ : ∀ X Y, HEq (F.monoidal.μIso X Y).hom (G.monoidal.μIso X Y).hom)
    (hε : HEq F.monoidal.εIso.hom G.monoidal.εIso.hom) : F = G
proof:
:= by
  cases F with | mk F cF =>
  cases G with | mk G cG =>
  dsimp only at h hμ hε
  subst h
  obtain rfl : cF = cG :=
    MonoidalSuperfunctor.ext (fun X Y => eq_of_heq (hμ X Y)) (eq_of_heq hε)
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.PiSMon.hom_def
statement: theorem hom_def : (A ⟶ B) = Hom A B

name: StringDiagrams.PiSMon.id_toFunctor
statement: @[simp] theorem id_toFunctor : (𝟙 A : A ⟶ A).toFunctor = 𝟭 A

name: StringDiagrams.PiSMon.comp_toFunctor
statement:
@[simp] theorem comp_toFunctor (F : A ⟶ B) (G : B ⟶ E) :
    (F ≫ G).toFunctor = F.toFunctor ⋙ G.toFunctor

name: StringDiagrams.PiSMon.id_monoidal
statement: @[simp] theorem id_monoidal : (𝟙 A : A ⟶ A).monoidal = MonoidalSuperfunctor.id (R := R)

name: StringDiagrams.PiSMon.comp_monoidal
statement:

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.mapMonoidal_comp_μIso_hom
statement:
theorem mapMonoidal_comp_μIso_hom (X Y : Associated R C) :
    ((mapMonoidal (hF.comp hG)).μIso X Y).hom =
      ((mapMonoidal hG).μIso ((map (hF.toPiFunctor R)).obj X)
        ((map (hF.toPiFunctor R)).obj Y)).hom ≫
        (map (hG.toPiFunctor R)).map ((mapMonoidal hF).μIso X Y).hom

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.mapMonoidal_comp_εIso_hom

name: StringDiagrams.PiMon.toPiFunctor_comp
statement:
theorem toPiFunctor_comp {E : PiMon.{w, v, u} R} (F : A ⟶ B) (G : B ⟶ E) :
    (F ≫ G).piFunctor.toPiFunctor R =
      (F.piFunctor.toPiFunctor R).comp (G.piFunctor.toPiFunctor R)
proof:
:=
  PiFunctor.ext fun X => by
    simp only [comp_piFunctor, MonoidalPiFunctor.toPiFunctor_β_hom_app,
      MonoidalPiFunctor.βF_hom, PiFunctor.comp_β, NatIso.ofComponents_hom_app, Iso.trans_hom,
      Iso.app_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom, MonoidalPiFunctor.comp_j, comp_toFunctor,
      Functor.comp_obj, comp_μ, comp_whiskerRight, Category.assoc, Functor.map_comp]
    rw [μ_natural_left_assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoSupercategory.ζ_inv_mem
statement: theorem ζ_inv_mem (a : B) : (ζ (R := R) a).inv ∈ parity (R := R) (𝟙 a) (pi (R := R) a) 1

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoSupercategory.β_hom
statement:
theorem β_hom (f : a ⟶ b) : (β (R := R) f).hom =
    f ◁ (ζ (R := R) b).hom ≫ (rightUnitor f).hom ≫ (leftUnitor f).inv ≫
      (ζ (R := R) a).inv ▷ f

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoSupercategory.β_inv
statement:
theorem β_inv (f : a ⟶ b) : (β (R := R) f).inv =
    (ζ (R := R) a).hom ▷ f ≫ (leftUnitor f).hom ≫ (rightUnitor f).inv ≫
      f ◁ (ζ (R := R) b).inv

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoSupercategory.β_hom_mem
statement:
theorem β_hom_mem (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (β (R := R) f).hom ∈ parity (R := R) (f ≫ pi (R := R) b) (pi (R := R) a ≫ f) 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [β_hom]
  have h := comp_mem (comp_mem (comp_mem (whiskerLeft_mem f (ζ_hom_mem (R := R) b))
    (rightUnitor_hom_mem (R := R) f)) (inv_mem _ (leftUnitor_hom_mem (R := R) f)))
    (whiskerRight_mem f (ζ_inv_mem (R := R) a))
  simpa [Category.assoc] using! h

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoSupercategory.β_hom_comp_ζ
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem β_hom_comp_ζ (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (β (R := R) f).hom ≫ (ζ (R := R) a).hom ▷ f =
      f ◁ (ζ (R := R) b).hom ≫ (rightUnitor f).hom ≫ (leftUnitor f).inv
proof:
:= by
  rw [β_hom]; simp only [Category.assoc, inv_hom_whiskerRight R, Category.comp_id]

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoSupercategory.β_hom_eq_neg_hcomp
statement:
theorem β_hom_eq_neg_hcomp (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (β (R := R) f).hom = -((leftUnitor (f ≫ pi (R := R) b)).inv ≫
      hcomp (ζ (R := R) a).inv (f ◁ (ζ (R := R) b).hom) ≫ pi (R := R) a ◁ (rightUnitor f).hom)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hcomp_eq (R := R) (ζ_inv_mem a) (whiskerLeft_mem f (ζ_hom_mem b)), koszulSign_one_one,
    neg_smul, one_smul, Preadditive.neg_comp, Preadditive.comp_neg, neg_neg, Category.assoc,
    ← leftUnitor_inv_naturality_assoc R]
  have h := super_interchange (R := R) (ζ_inv_mem (R := R) a)
    (rightUnitor_hom_mem (R := R) f)
  rw [koszulSign_zero_right, one_smul] at h
  rw [h, ← leftUnitor_inv_naturality_assoc R, β_hom]

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoSupercategory.β_naturality
statement:
theorem β_naturality {f g : a ⟶ b} (x : f ⟶ g) :
    (β (R := R) f).hom ≫ pi (R := R) a ◁ x = x ▷ pi (R := R) b ≫ (β (R := R) g).hom
proof:
:= by
  refine induction_on (R := R) x (by simp [zero_whiskerRight R, whiskerLeft_zero R])
    (fun p x hx => ?_) (fun x y hx hy => ?_)
  · rw [β_hom, β_hom]
    simp only [Category.assoc]
    have h1 := super_interchange (R := R) (ζ_inv_mem (R := R) a) hx
    have h2 := super_interchange (R := R) hx (ζ_hom_mem (R := R) b)
    rw [h1, Linear.comp_smul, Linear.comp_smul, Linear.comp_smul,
      ← leftUnitor_inv_naturality_assoc R, ← rightUnitor_naturality_assoc R,
      ← Category.assoc (f ◁ _), ← koszulSign_smul_smul p 1 (f ◁ _ ≫ x ▷ 𝟙 b), ← h2,
      Linear.smul_comp, smul_smul, koszulSign_comm 1 p, koszulSign_mul_self, one_smul]
    simp only [Category.assoc]
  · rw [whiskerLeft_add (R := R), add_whiskerRight (R := R), Preadditive.comp_add,
      Preadditive.add_comp, hx, hy]

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoSupercategory.ξ_hom
statement:
theorem ξ_hom (a : B) : (ξ (R := R) a).hom =
    (ζ (R := R) a).hom ▷ pi (R := R) a ≫ (leftUnitor (pi (R := R) a)).hom ≫ (ζ (R := R) a).hom

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoSupercategory.ξ_inv
statement:
theorem ξ_inv (a : B) : (ξ (R := R) a).inv =
    (ζ (R := R) a).inv ≫ (leftUnitor (pi (R := R) a)).inv ≫ (ζ (R := R) a).inv ▷ pi (R := R) a

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoSupercategory.ξ_hom_eq_hcomp
statement:
theorem ξ_hom_eq_hcomp (a : B) : (ξ (R := R) a).hom =
    hcomp (ζ (R := R) a).hom (ζ (R := R) a).hom ≫ (leftUnitor (𝟙 a)).hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [ξ_hom, hcomp, Category.assoc, leftUnitor_naturality R]

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoSupercategory.ξ_hom_mem
statement:
theorem ξ_hom_mem (a : B) :
    (ξ (R := R) a).hom ∈ parity (R := R) (pi (R := R) a ≫ pi (R := R) a) (𝟙 a) 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [ξ_hom]
  have h := comp_mem (comp_mem (whiskerRight_mem (pi (R := R) a) (ζ_hom_mem (R := R) a))
    (leftUnitor_hom_mem (R := R) (pi (R := R) a))) (ζ_hom_mem (R := R) a)
  simpa [Category.assoc] using! h

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoSupercategory.β_isSupernatural
statement:
theorem β_isSupernatural :
    IsSupernatural R 0 (F := postcomp R (a := a) (pi (R := R) b))
      (G := precomp R (c := b) (pi (R := R) a)) fun f => (β (R := R) f).hom where
  mem f
proof:
:= β_hom_mem f
  naturality {f g q x} _ := by
    simp only [postcomp_map, precomp_map, zero_mul, sign_zero,
      one_smul]
    exact (β_naturality x).symm

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoSupercategory.β_comp
statement:
theorem β_comp (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) :
    (β (R := R) (f ≫ g)).hom =
      (associator f g (pi (R := R) c)).hom ≫ f ◁ (β (R := R) g).hom ≫
        (associator f (pi (R := R) b) g).inv ≫ (β (R := R) f).hom ▷ g ≫
          (associator (pi (R := R) a) f g).hom
proof:
:= by
  symm
  simp only [β_hom, whiskerLeft_comp' R, comp_whiskerRight' R, Category.assoc]
  rw [associator_inv_naturality_middle_assoc R, ← comp_whiskerRight'_assoc R,
    ← whiskerLeft_comp' R, Iso.inv_hom_id, whiskerLeft_id (R := R), id_whiskerRight (R := R),
    Category.id_comp, ← triangle (R := R), Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc,
    whiskerLeft_inv_hom_assoc R, associator_naturality_left R, ← leftUnitor_comp_inv_assoc R,
    ← associator_naturality_right_assoc R, ← rightUnitor_comp_assoc R]

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoSupercategory.β_id
statement:
theorem β_id (a : B) :
    (β (R := R) (𝟙 a)).hom = (leftUnitor (pi (R := R) a)).hom ≫ (rightUnitor (pi (R := R) a)).inv
proof:
:= by
  rw [β_hom, ← unitors_equal R, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc, id_whiskerLeft (R := R),
    whiskerRight_id (R := R), Category.assoc, Category.assoc, ← unitors_equal R,
    Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoSupercategory.pi_whisker_ζ
statement:
theorem pi_whisker_ζ (a : B) :
    (ζ (R := R) a).hom ▷ pi (R := R) a ≫ (leftUnitor (pi (R := R) a)).hom =
      -(pi (R := R) a ◁ (ζ (R := R) a).hom ≫ (rightUnitor (pi (R := R) a)).hom)
proof:
:= by
  have h := super_interchange (R := R) (ζ_hom_mem (R := R) a) (ζ_hom_mem (R := R) a)
  rw [koszulSign_one_one, neg_smul, one_smul, id_whiskerLeft (R := R),
    whiskerRight_id (R := R), ← unitors_inv_equal R] at h
  apply (cancel_mono ((ζ (R := R) a).hom ≫ (leftUnitor (𝟙 a)).inv)).1
  simpa only [Category.assoc, Preadditive.neg_comp] using h

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoSupercategory.β_pi
statement: theorem β_pi (a : B) : (β (R := R) (pi (R := R) a)).hom = -𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  have h : pi (R := R) a ◁ (ζ (R := R) a).hom ≫ (rightUnitor (pi (R := R) a)).hom =
      -((ζ (R := R) a).hom ▷ pi (R := R) a ≫ (leftUnitor (pi (R := R) a)).hom) := by
    rw [pi_whisker_ζ, neg_neg]
  rw [β_hom, ← Category.assoc, h]
  simp only [Preadditive.neg_comp, Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
  rw [hom_inv_whiskerRight R]

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoSupercategory.ξ_comm
statement:
theorem ξ_comm (f : a ⟶ b) :
    f ◁ (ξ (R := R) b).hom ≫ (rightUnitor f).hom ≫ (leftUnitor f).inv ≫ (ξ (R := R) a).inv ▷ f =
      (associator f (pi (R := R) b) (pi (R := R) b)).inv ≫ (β (R := R) f).hom ▷ pi (R := R) b ≫
        (associator (pi (R := R) a) f (pi (R := R) b)).hom ≫ pi (R := R) a ◁ (β (R := R) f).hom ≫
          (associator (pi (R := R) a) (pi (R := R) a) f).inv
proof:
:= by
  
  have hz := ζ_hom_mem (R := R) a
  have hy := ζ_hom_mem (R := R) b
  have hβ := β_hom_mem (R := R) f
  
  have key : (associator f (pi (R := R) b) (pi (R := R) b)).inv ≫ (β (R := R) f).hom ▷ (pi (R := R) b) ≫ (associator (pi (R := R) a) f (pi (R := R) b)).hom ≫
      (pi (R := R) a) ◁ (β (R := R) f).hom ≫ (associator (pi (R := R) a) (pi (R := R) a) f).inv ≫ (ξ (R := R) a).hom ▷ f =
        f ◁ (ξ (R := R) b).hom ≫ (rightUnitor f).hom ≫ (leftUnitor f).inv := by
    rw [ξ_hom, comp_whiskerRight' R, comp_whiskerRight' R,
      ← associator_inv_naturality_left_assoc R]
    have h2 : (pi (R := R) a) ◁ (β (R := R) f).hom ≫ (ζ (R := R) a).hom ▷ ((pi (R := R) a) ≫ f) =
        (ζ (R := R) a).hom ▷ (f ≫ (pi (R := R) b)) ≫ 𝟙 a ◁ (β (R := R) f).hom :=
      (whisker_exchange_of_even_right (ζ (R := R) a).hom hβ).symm
    rw [reassoc_of% h2, ← leftUnitor_comp_assoc R, leftUnitor_naturality_assoc R,
      β_hom_comp_ζ, ← associator_naturality_left_assoc R,
      ← leftUnitor_whiskerRight_assoc R, ← comp_whiskerRight'_assoc R,
      ← comp_whiskerRight'_assoc R, Category.assoc, β_hom_comp_ζ_assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id,
      Category.comp_id, comp_whiskerRight'_assoc R,
      whisker_exchange_of_even_left_assoc (rightUnitor_hom_mem (R := R) f),
      super_interchange_assoc (whiskerLeft_mem f hy) hy, koszulSign_one_one, neg_smul, one_smul,
      Preadditive.comp_neg, rightUnitor_naturality_assoc R, rightUnitor_naturality_assoc R,
      ← associator_inv_naturality_right_assoc R, ← whiskerLeft_rightUnitor_assoc R,
      ξ_hom, ← Category.assoc ((ζ (R := R) b).hom ▷ (pi (R := R) b)), pi_whisker_ζ, Preadditive.neg_comp,
      whiskerLeft_neg R, whiskerLeft_comp' R, whiskerLeft_comp' R]
    simp only [Preadditive.neg_comp, Category.assoc]
  rw [← reassoc_of% key]
  simp only [hom_inv_whiskerRight R, Category.comp_id]

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoSupercategory.PiSCat.ζ_inv_isSupernatural
statement:
theorem ζ_inv_isSupernatural (A : PiSCat.{w₁, v, u} R) :
    IsSupernatural R 1 (F := 𝟭 A) (G := PiSupercategory.pi (R := R) (C := A))
      fun X => (PiSupercategory.ζ (R := R) X).inv
proof:
:=
  IsSupernatural.of_twist (fun X => PiSupercategory.ζ_inv_mem X) fun {X Y} f => by
    rw [pi_map_eq, twist_twist, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]; rfl

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoSupercategory.PiSCat.pi_map_ζ
statement:
theorem pi_map_ζ (A : PiSCat.{w₁, v, u} R) (X : A.carrier) :
    (PiSupercategory.pi (R := R)).map (PiSupercategory.ζ (R := R) X).hom =
      -(PiSupercategory.ζ (R := R) ((PiSupercategory.pi (R := R)).obj X)).hom
proof:
:= by
  simpa using! congrArg (fun t => t.app 1 X) (PiTwoSupercategory.pi_whisker_ζ (R := R) A)

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoSupercategory.PiSCat.ξ_pi
statement:
theorem ξ_pi (A : PiSCat.{w₁, v, u} R) (X : A.carrier) :
    (PiSupercategory.ξ (R := R) ((PiSupercategory.pi (R := R)).obj X)).hom =
      (PiSupercategory.pi (R := R)).map (PiSupercategory.ξ (R := R) X).hom
proof:
:= by
  have h : (PiSupercategory.ζ (R := R) ((PiSupercategory.pi (R := R)).obj X)).hom =
      -(PiSupercategory.pi (R := R)).map (PiSupercategory.ζ (R := R) X).hom := by
    rw [pi_map_ζ A, neg_neg]
  rw [PiSupercategory.ξ_hom, PiSupercategory.ξ_hom, h, Functor.map_neg, Preadditive.neg_comp,
    Preadditive.comp_neg, neg_neg, Functor.map_comp]

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoSupercategory.PiSCat.β_comm
statement:
theorem β_comm (F : A ⟶ B) (X : A.carrier) :
    (PiSupercategory.ξ (R := R) (F.obj X)).hom ≫ F.map (PiSupercategory.ξ (R := R) X).inv =
      (PiSupercategory.pi (R := R)).map (PiSupercategory.β R F.toFunctor X).hom ≫
        (PiSupercategory.β R F.toFunctor ((PiSupercategory.pi (R := R)).obj X)).hom
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun t => t.app 0 X) (PiTwoSupercategory.ξ_comm (R := R) F)
  simp [PiTwoSupercategory.ξ_hom, PiTwoSupercategory.ξ_inv, PiTwoSupercategory.β_hom] at h
  simpa [PiSupercategory.ξ_hom, PiSupercategory.β_hom, PiSupercategory.ξ] using! h

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoSupercategory.PiSCat.β_naturality_supernatural
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun t => t.app p X)
    (PiTwoSupercategory.β_naturality (R := R) (a := A) (b := B)
      (Superfunctor.homMk hx.toSuperNatTrans : F ⟶ G))
  rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one p with rfl | rfl <;>
    simpa [comp_app, ← β_app_zero, β_app_one, IsSupernatural.toSuperNatTrans,
      SuperNatTrans.zmod2_one_add_one] using! h.symm

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoSupercategory.PiSCat.β_comp
statement:
theorem β_comp (F : A ⟶ B) (G : B ⟶ C) (X : A.carrier) :
    (PiSupercategory.β R (F.toFunctor ⋙ G.toFunctor) X).hom =
      (PiSupercategory.β R G.toFunctor (F.obj X)).hom ≫
        G.map (PiSupercategory.β R F.toFunctor X).hom
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun t => t.app 0 X) (PiTwoSupercategory.β_comp (R := R) F G)
  simp only [comp_app_zero, associator_hom, associator_inv, id_app_zero, id_app_one,
    whiskerLeft_app, whiskerRight_app, β_app_zero, β_app_one] at h
  simpa using! h

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoSupercategory.PiSCat.β_id
statement:
theorem β_id (A : PiSCat.{w₁, v, u} R) (X : A.carrier) :
    (PiSupercategory.β R (𝟭 A.carrier) X).hom = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun t => t.app 0 X) (PiTwoSupercategory.β_id (R := R) A)
  simp only [β_app_zero] at h
  simpa using! h

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoSupercategory.PiSCat.β_pi
statement:
theorem β_pi (A : PiSCat.{w₁, v, u} R) (X : A.carrier) :
    (PiSupercategory.β R (PiSupercategory.pi (R := R) (C := A.carrier)) X).hom = -𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun t => t.app 0 X) (PiTwoSupercategory.β_pi (R := R) A)
  simp only [β_app_zero] at h
  simpa using! h

name: StringDiagrams.K₀.homRank_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem homRank_mk (Z : C) (hfin : ∀ X : C, FiniteDimensional K (Z ⟶ X)) (X : C) :
    homRank K Z hfin (mk X) = finrank K (Z ⟶ X)

name: StringDiagrams.K₀.homRank_congr
statement:
theorem homRank_congr {Z Z' : C} (e : Z ≅ Z') (hfin : ∀ X : C, FiniteDimensional K (Z ⟶ X))
    (hfin' : ∀ X : C, FiniteDimensional K (Z' ⟶ X)) :
    homRank K Z hfin = homRank K Z' hfin'
proof:
:=
  hom_ext fun X => by
    rw [homRank_mk, homRank_mk, (Linear.homCongr K e (Iso.refl X)).finrank_eq]

name: StringDiagrams.Mat_.finiteDimensional_hom
statement:
theorem Mat_.finiteDimensional_hom (h : ∀ X Y : D, FiniteDimensional K (X ⟶ Y))
    (M N : Mat_ D) : FiniteDimensional K (M ⟶ N)
proof:
:= by
  change FiniteDimensional K (∀ i j, M.X i ⟶ N.X j)
  infer_instance

name: StringDiagrams.Karoubi.finiteDimensional_hom_mat
statement:
theorem Karoubi.finiteDimensional_hom_mat (h : ∀ X Y : D, FiniteDimensional K (X ⟶ Y))
    (P Q : Karoubi (Mat_ D)) : FiniteDimensional K (P ⟶ Q)
proof:
:= by
  have := Mat_.finiteDimensional_hom h P.X Q.X
  let φ : (P ⟶ Q) →ₗ[K] (P.X ⟶ Q.X) :=
    { toFun := fun f => f.f
      map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl
      map_smul' := fun _ _ => rfl }
  exact FiniteDimensional.of_injective φ fun f g e => Karoubi.hom_ext f g e

name: StringDiagrams.GSKar.finiteDimensional_hom
statement:
theorem GSKar.finiteDimensional_hom
    (hfd : ∀ (X Y : C) (n : ℤ), FiniteDimensional K (degree (R := K) X Y n))
    (P Q : GSKar K C) : FiniteDimensional K (P ⟶ Q)
proof:
:= by
  refine Karoubi.finiteDimensional_hom_mat (fun X Y => ?_) P Q
  have := hfd X.obj.obj.obj.obj Y.obj.obj.obj.obj
    (0 + (X.obj.obj.obj.shift - Y.obj.obj.obj.shift))
  exact FiniteDimensional.finiteDimensional_submodule _

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSOp.horizontal_compC
proof:
:= by
  refine induction_on (R := R) η ?_ (fun p η hη => ?_) ?_
  · simp only [zero_whiskerRight R, SOp.zero_compC, Limits.zero_comp]
  · refine induction_on (R := R) θ ?_ (fun q θ hθ => ?_) ?_
    · simp only [whiskerLeft_zero R, SOp.compC_zero, Limits.comp_zero]
    · rw [SOp.compC_of_mem (whiskerRight_mem h hη) (whiskerLeft_mem g hθ)]
      exact ((super_interchange hη hθ).trans (koszulSign_smul p q _)).symm
    · intro θ θ' hθ hθ'
      rw [whiskerLeft_add (R := R), SOp.compC_add, whiskerLeft_add (R := R),
        Preadditive.comp_add, hθ, hθ']
  · intro η η' hη hη'
    rw [add_whiskerRight (R := R), SOp.add_compC, add_whiskerRight (R := R),
      Preadditive.add_comp, hη, hη']

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSOp.unsop_hcomp
proof:
:= by
  change SOp.compC (R := R) (SOp.unsop η ▷ SOp.unop h) (SOp.unop g ◁ SOp.unsop θ) =
    SOp.unsop η ▷ SOp.unop i ≫ SOp.unop f ◁ SOp.unsop θ
  exact horizontal_compC _ _

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSOp.unsop_comp_odd
proof:
:= by
  change SOp.unsop η ∈ parity (R := R) (SOp.unop g) (SOp.unop f) 1 at hη
  change SOp.unsop θ ∈ parity (R := R) (SOp.unop h) (SOp.unop g) 1 at hθ
  change SOp.compC (R := R) (SOp.unsop η) (SOp.unsop θ) = _
  rw [SOp.compC_of_mem hη hθ, mul_one, sign_one, neg_one_smul]

name: StringDiagrams.K₀.mk_eq_mk_of_iso
statement: theorem mk_eq_mk_of_iso {X Y : C} (e : X ≅ Y) : mk X = mk Y
proof:
:= by
  rw [mk, mk, QuotientAddGroup.eq_iff_sub_mem]
  exact AddSubgroup.subset_closure (Or.inl ⟨X, Y, e, rfl⟩)

name: StringDiagrams.K₀.mk_biprod
statement: theorem mk_biprod (X Y : C) : mk (X ⊞ Y) = mk X + mk Y
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sub_eq_zero, sub_add_eq_sub_sub, mk, mk, mk, ← QuotientAddGroup.mk_sub,
    ← QuotientAddGroup.mk_sub, QuotientAddGroup.eq_zero_iff]
  exact AddSubgroup.subset_closure (Or.inr ⟨X, Y, rfl⟩)

name: StringDiagrams.K₀.mk_of_isBilimit
statement:
theorem mk_of_isBilimit {X Y : C} (b : BinaryBicone X Y) (hb : b.IsBilimit) :
    mk b.pt = mk X + mk Y
proof:
:= by
  rw [mk_eq_mk_of_iso (biprod.uniqueUpToIso X Y hb), mk_biprod]

name: StringDiagrams.K₀.lift_mk
statement: @[simp] theorem lift_mk (X : C) : lift f hiso hbiprod (mk X) = f X

name: StringDiagrams.K₀.hom_ext
statement:
theorem hom_ext {G : Type w} [AddCommGroup G] {φ ψ : K₀ C →+ G} (h : ∀ X : C, φ (mk X) = ψ (mk X)) :
    φ = ψ
proof:
:= by
  apply QuotientAddGroup.addMonoidHom_ext
  apply FreeAbelianGroup.lift_ext
  exact h

name: StringDiagrams.K₀.induction_on
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
theorem induction_on {P : K₀ C → Prop} (x : K₀ C) (mk : ∀ X, P (mk X)) (zero : P 0)
    (add : ∀ x y, P x → P y → P (x + y)) (neg : ∀ x, P x → P (-x)) : P x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using QuotientAddGroup.induction_on with
  | H z =>
    induction z using FreeAbelianGroup.induction_on with
    | zero => exact zero
    | of X => exact mk X
    | neg X h => exact neg _ h
    | add a b ha hb => exact add _ _ ha hb

name: StringDiagrams.K₀.mk_zero
statement: theorem mk_zero [HasZeroObject C] : mk (0 : C) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := mk_biprod (0 : C) 0
  have hz : IsZero ((0 : C) ⊞ 0) := by
    rw [IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero]
    apply biprod.hom_ext <;> exact (isZero_zero C).eq_of_tgt _ _
  rw [mk_eq_mk_of_iso (hz.iso (isZero_zero C))] at h
  exact left_eq_add.mp h

name: StringDiagrams.K₀.exists_eq_mk_sub_mk
statement: theorem exists_eq_mk_sub_mk [HasZeroObject C] (x : K₀ C) : ∃ X Y : C, x = mk X - mk Y
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_on with
  | mk X => exact ⟨X, 0, by rw [mk_zero, sub_zero]⟩
  | zero => exact ⟨0, 0, by rw [sub_self]⟩
  | add x y hx hy =>
    obtain ⟨X, Y, rfl⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨X', Y', rfl⟩ := hy
    exact ⟨X ⊞ X', Y ⊞ Y', by rw [mk_biprod, mk_biprod]; abel⟩
  | neg x hx =>
    obtain ⟨X, Y, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact ⟨Y, X, by abel⟩

name: StringDiagrams.K₀.map_mk
statement: @[simp] theorem map_mk (F : C ⥤ D) [F.Additive] (X : C) : map F (mk X) = mk (F.obj X)

name: StringDiagrams.K₀.map_id
statement: theorem map_id : map (𝟭 C) = AddMonoidHom.id (K₀ C)

name: StringDiagrams.K₀.map_comp
statement:
theorem map_comp (F : C ⥤ D) [F.Additive] (G : D ⥤ E) [G.Additive] :
    map (F ⋙ G) = (map G).comp (map F)

name: StringDiagrams.K₀.map_eq_of_iso
statement: theorem map_eq_of_iso {F G : C ⥤ D} [F.Additive] [G.Additive] (e : F ≅ G) : map F = map G
proof:
:=
  hom_ext fun X => by rw [map_mk, map_mk, mk_eq_mk_of_iso (e.app X)]

name: StringDiagrams.K₀.mapEquiv_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem mapEquiv_mk (e : C ≌ D) [e.functor.Additive] (X : C) :
    mapEquiv e (mk X) = mk (e.functor.obj X)

name: StringDiagrams.K₀.mul_def
statement: theorem mul_def (x y : K₀ C) : x * y = mulHom x y

name: StringDiagrams.K₀.mk_mul_mk
statement: @[simp] theorem mk_mul_mk (X Y : C) : mk X * mk Y = mk (X ⊗ Y)

name: StringDiagrams.K₀.one_def
statement: theorem one_def : (1 : K₀ C) = mk (𝟙_ C)

name: StringDiagrams.K₀.mul_add
statement: protected theorem mul_add (x y z : K₀ C) : x * (y + z) = x * y + x * z

name: StringDiagrams.K₀.add_mul
statement: protected theorem add_mul (x y z : K₀ C) : (x + y) * z = x * z + y * z

name: StringDiagrams.K₀.mul_zero
statement: protected theorem mul_zero (x : K₀ C) : x * 0 = 0

name: StringDiagrams.K₀.zero_mul
statement: protected theorem zero_mul (x : K₀ C) : 0 * x = 0

name: StringDiagrams.K₀.mul_neg
statement: protected theorem mul_neg (x y : K₀ C) : x * -y = -(x * y)

name: StringDiagrams.K₀.neg_mul
statement: protected theorem neg_mul (x y : K₀ C) : -x * y = -(x * y)

name: StringDiagrams.K₀.mul_assoc
statement: protected theorem mul_assoc (x y z : K₀ C) : x * y * z = x * (y * z)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_on with
  | mk X =>
    induction y using induction_on with
    | mk Y =>
      induction z using induction_on with
      | mk Z => simp only [mk_mul_mk]; exact mk_eq_mk_of_iso (α_ X Y Z)
      | zero => simp only [K₀.mul_zero]
      | add z z' h h' => simp only [K₀.mul_add, h, h']
      | neg z h => simp only [K₀.mul_neg, h]
    | zero => simp only [K₀.mul_zero, K₀.zero_mul]
    | add y y' h h' => simp only [K₀.mul_add, K₀.add_mul, h, h']
    | neg y h => simp only [K₀.mul_neg, K₀.neg_mul, h]
  | zero => simp only [K₀.zero_mul]
  | add x x' h h' => simp only [K₀.add_mul, h, h']
  | neg x h => simp only [K₀.neg_mul, h]

name: StringDiagrams.K₀.one_mul
statement: protected theorem one_mul (x : K₀ C) : 1 * x = x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_on with
  | mk X => rw [one_def, mk_mul_mk]; exact mk_eq_mk_of_iso (λ_ X)
  | zero => exact K₀.mul_zero 1
  | add x x' h h' => rw [K₀.mul_add, h, h']
  | neg x h => rw [K₀.mul_neg, h]

name: StringDiagrams.K₀.mul_one
statement: protected theorem mul_one (x : K₀ C) : x * 1 = x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_on with
  | mk X => rw [one_def, mk_mul_mk]; exact mk_eq_mk_of_iso (ρ_ X)
  | zero => exact K₀.zero_mul 1
  | add x x' h h' => rw [K₀.add_mul, h, h']
  | neg x h => rw [K₀.neg_mul, h]

name: StringDiagrams.Zπ.π_mul_π
statement: theorem π_mul_π : π * π = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [π, ← map_mul, ← sub_eq_zero, ← map_one (Ideal.Quotient.mk _), ← map_sub,
    Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, ← pow_two]
  exact Ideal.subset_span rfl

name: StringDiagrams.Zπ.π_pow_two
statement: theorem π_pow_two : π ^ 2 = 1

name: StringDiagrams.Zπ.exists_eq_add_mul_π
statement: theorem exists_eq_add_mul_π (z : Zπ) : ∃ a b : ℤ, z = a + b * π
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective z
  induction q using Polynomial.induction_on with
  | C a => exact ⟨a, 0, by simp⟩
  | add p q hp hq =>
    obtain ⟨a, b, hab⟩ := hp
    obtain ⟨c, d, hcd⟩ := hq
    exact ⟨a + c, b + d, by rw [map_add, hab, hcd]; push_cast; ring⟩
  | monomial n a h =>
    obtain ⟨c, d, hcd⟩ := h
    refine ⟨d, c, ?_⟩
    have e : (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (C a * X ^ (n + 1)) : Zπ) =
        Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (C a * X ^ n) * π := by
      rw [π, ← map_mul, mul_assoc, ← pow_succ]
    rw [e, hcd, add_mul, mul_assoc, π_mul_π, mul_one]
    ring

name: StringDiagrams.Zπ.eval_π
statement: theorem eval_π (ε : ℤ) (hε : ε * ε = 1) : eval ε hε π = ε

name: StringDiagrams.Zπ.eval_add_mul_π
statement:
theorem eval_add_mul_π (ε : ℤ) (hε : ε * ε = 1) (a b : ℤ) :
    eval ε hε (a + b * π) = a + b * ε

name: StringDiagrams.Zπ.add_mul_π_injective
statement: theorem add_mul_π_injective {a b c d : ℤ} (h : (a : Zπ) + b * π = c + d * π) : a = c ∧ b = d
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := congrArg (eval 1 (by norm_num)) h
  have h2 := congrArg (eval (-1) (by norm_num)) h
  rw [eval_add_mul_π, eval_add_mul_π] at h1 h2
  constructor <;> omega

name: StringDiagrams.Zπ.toEnd_π
statement: theorem toEnd_π (σ : AddMonoid.End G) (hσ : ∀ x, σ (σ x) = x) : toEnd σ hσ π = σ

name: StringDiagrams.Zπ.π_smul
statement:
theorem π_smul (σ : AddMonoid.End G) (hσ : ∀ x, σ (σ x) = x) (x : G) :
    letI := moduleOfInvolution σ hσ
    π • x = σ x
proof:
:= by
  change toEnd σ hσ π x = σ x
  rw [toEnd_π]

name: StringDiagrams.K₀.piInvolution_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem piInvolution_mk (X : A) :
    piInvolution R A (mk X) = mk ((PiCategory.pi (R := R)).obj X)

name: StringDiagrams.K₀.piInvolution_piInvolution
statement: theorem piInvolution_piInvolution (x : K₀ A) : piInvolution R A (piInvolution R A x) = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, piInvolution, ← map_comp,
    map_eq_of_iso (PiCategory.ξ (R := R) (C := A)), map_id, AddMonoidHom.id_apply]

name: StringDiagrams.K₀.π_smul_mk
statement:
theorem π_smul_mk (X : A) :
    letI := moduleZπ R A
    Zπ.π • mk X = mk ((PiCategory.pi (R := R)).obj X)

name: StringDiagrams.KrullSchmidtLaurentExamples.rational_bound
statement: theorem rational_bound : GSKar.HomBoundedBelow (k := ℚ) (C := UnitSupercat ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  intro X Y
  exact ⟨0, fun n hn => UnitSupercat.trivialDegree_of_ne ℚ (by omega)⟩

name: StringDiagrams.KrullSchmidtLaurentExamples.rational_k0_free
statement:
theorem rational_k0_free :
    letI := K₀.moduleLaurentInt ℚ (GSKar ℚ (UnitSupercat ℚ))
    Module.Free (LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (K₀ (GSKar ℚ (UnitSupercat ℚ)))

name: StringDiagrams.KrullSchmidtLaurentExamples.line_indec
statement: theorem line_indec : IsIndec line
proof:
:= by
  apply (isIndec_obj_iff embed point).2
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hz := congrArg (fun f : point ⟶ point => (f.val.val : ℚ))
      ((IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero point).1 h)
    exact (one_ne_zero : (1 : ℚ) ≠ 0) hz
  · intro f hf
    let a : ℚ := f.val.val
    have ha : a * a = a := congrArg (fun f : point ⟶ point => (f.val.val : ℚ)) hf
    have h := mul_eq_zero.mp (show a * (a - 1) = 0 by rw [mul_sub, mul_one, ha, sub_self])
    rcases h with h | h
    · left; apply Subtype.ext; apply Subtype.ext; exact h
    · right; apply Subtype.ext; apply Subtype.ext; exact sub_eq_zero.mp h

name: StringDiagrams.KrullSchmidtLaurentExamples.line_class_ne_zero
statement: theorem line_class_ne_zero : K₀.mk line ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hp := multK_self_pos ℚ line_indec
  rw [h, map_zero] at hp
  exact (lt_irrefl 0) hp

name: StringDiagrams.KrullSchmidtLaurentExamples.line_shift_rigid
statement:
theorem line_shift_rigid (n : ℤ)
    (h : indecShift ℚ n (Quotient.mk (indecSetoid _) ⟨line, line_indec⟩) =
      Quotient.mk (indecSetoid _) ⟨line, line_indec⟩) : n = 0

name: StringDiagrams.PiFunctor.IsPiNatural.inv
statement:
theorem IsPiNatural.inv {F G : C ⥤ D} {hF : PiFunctor R F} {hG : PiFunctor R G} {e : F ≅ G}
    (he : IsPiNatural R hF hG e.hom) : IsPiNatural R hG hF e.inv
proof:
:= fun X => by
  have h := he X
  rw [← cancel_epi ((PiCategory.pi (R := R)).map (e.hom.app X)), ← reassoc_of% h,
    ← Functor.map_comp_assoc]
  simp

name: StringDiagrams.PiCat.Hom₂.isPiNatural
statement:
theorem Hom₂.isPiNatural (x : F ⟶ G) :
    PiFunctor.IsPiNatural R F.piFunctor G.piFunctor (Hom₂.natTrans x)
proof:
:=
  Subtype.property (p := fun y => y ∈ piNat F G) x

name: StringDiagrams.PiCat.hom₂Mk_natTrans
statement:
@[simp] theorem hom₂Mk_natTrans (x : F.toFunctor ⟶ G.toFunctor)
    (hx : PiFunctor.IsPiNatural R F.piFunctor G.piFunctor x) :
    Hom₂.natTrans (hom₂Mk x hx) = x

name: StringDiagrams.PiCat.hom₂_ext
statement:
@[ext] theorem hom₂_ext {x y : F ⟶ G} (h : ∀ X, (Hom₂.natTrans x).app X = (Hom₂.natTrans y).app X) :
    x = y

name: StringDiagrams.PiCat.id₂_natTrans
statement: @[simp] theorem id₂_natTrans (F : A ⟶ B) : Hom₂.natTrans (𝟙 F) = 𝟙 F.toFunctor

name: StringDiagrams.PiCat.comp₂_natTrans
statement:
@[simp] theorem comp₂_natTrans (x : F ⟶ G) (y : G ⟶ H) :
    Hom₂.natTrans (x ≫ y) = Hom₂.natTrans x ≫ Hom₂.natTrans y

name: StringDiagrams.PiCat.add₂_natTrans
statement:
@[simp] theorem add₂_natTrans (x y : F ⟶ G) :
    Hom₂.natTrans (x + y) = Hom₂.natTrans x + Hom₂.natTrans y

name: StringDiagrams.PiCat.neg₂_natTrans
statement: @[simp] theorem neg₂_natTrans (x : F ⟶ G) : Hom₂.natTrans (-x) = -Hom₂.natTrans x

name: StringDiagrams.PiCat.zero₂_natTrans
statement: @[simp] theorem zero₂_natTrans : Hom₂.natTrans (0 : F ⟶ G) = 0

name: StringDiagrams.PiCat.smul₂_natTrans
statement:
@[simp] theorem smul₂_natTrans (r : R) (x : F ⟶ G) :
    Hom₂.natTrans (r • x) = r • Hom₂.natTrans x

name: StringDiagrams.PiCat.associator_isPiNatural
statement:
theorem associator_isPiNatural {A B E E' : PiCat.{w, v, u} R} (F : A ⟶ B) (G : B ⟶ E)
    (H : E ⟶ E') :
    PiFunctor.IsPiNatural R ((F ≫ G) ≫ H).piFunctor (F ≫ G ≫ H).piFunctor
      (Functor.associator F.toFunctor G.toFunctor H.toFunctor).hom

name: StringDiagrams.PiCat.leftUnitor_isPiNatural
statement:
theorem leftUnitor_isPiNatural (F : A ⟶ B) :
    PiFunctor.IsPiNatural R (𝟙 A ≫ F).piFunctor F.piFunctor
