name: StringDiagrams.PiCat.rightUnitor_isPiNatural
statement:
theorem rightUnitor_isPiNatural (F : A ⟶ B) :
    PiFunctor.IsPiNatural R (F ≫ 𝟙 B).piFunctor F.piFunctor
      (Functor.rightUnitor F.toFunctor).hom

name: StringDiagrams.PiCat.whiskerLeft_natTrans_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem whiskerLeft_natTrans_app (F : A ⟶ B) {G H : B ⟶ E} (y : G ⟶ H) (X : A) :
    (Hom₂.natTrans (F ◁ y)).app X = (Hom₂.natTrans y).app (F.toFunctor.obj X)

name: StringDiagrams.PiCat.whiskerRight_natTrans_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem whiskerRight_natTrans_app {F G : A ⟶ B} (x : F ⟶ G) (H : B ⟶ E) (X : A) :
    (Hom₂.natTrans (x ▷ H)).app X = H.toFunctor.map ((Hom₂.natTrans x).app X)

name: StringDiagrams.PiCat.associator_hom_natTrans_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem associator_hom_natTrans_app {E' : PiCat.{w, v, u} R} (F : A ⟶ B) (G : B ⟶ E)
    (H : E ⟶ E') (X : A) :
    (Hom₂.natTrans (Bicategory.associator F G H).hom).app X = 𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.PiCat.associator_inv_natTrans_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem associator_inv_natTrans_app {E' : PiCat.{w, v, u} R} (F : A ⟶ B) (G : B ⟶ E)
    (H : E ⟶ E') (X : A) :
    (Hom₂.natTrans (Bicategory.associator F G H).inv).app X = 𝟙 _

@[simp] theorem leftUnitor_hom_natTrans_app (F : A ⟶ B) (X : A) :

name: StringDiagrams.PiCat.leftUnitor_inv_natTrans_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem leftUnitor_inv_natTrans_app (F : A ⟶ B) (X : A) :

name: StringDiagrams.PiCat.rightUnitor_hom_natTrans_app

@[simp] theorem rightUnitor_hom_natTrans_app (F : A ⟶ B) (X : A) :

name: StringDiagrams.PiCat.rightUnitor_inv_natTrans_app

@[simp] theorem rightUnitor_inv_natTrans_app (F : A ⟶ B) (X : A) :

name: StringDiagrams.PiCat.eqToHom_natTrans_app
statement:
theorem eqToHom_natTrans_app {F G : A ⟶ B} (h : F = G) (X : A) :
    (Hom₂.natTrans (eqToHom h)).app X = eqToHom (by rw [h])

name: StringDiagrams.PiCat.β_isPiNatural
statement:
theorem β_isPiNatural (F : A ⟶ B) :
    PiFunctor.IsPiNatural R (F ≫ piHom B).piFunctor (piHom A ≫ F).piFunctor
      F.piFunctor.β.hom

name: StringDiagrams.PiCat.ξ_isPiNatural
statement:
theorem ξ_isPiNatural (A : PiCat.{w, v, u} R) :
    PiFunctor.IsPiNatural R (piHom A ≫ piHom A).piFunctor (𝟙 A : A ⟶ A).piFunctor
      (PiCategory.ξ (R := R) (C := A)).hom
proof:
:= fun X => by
  simp [PiFunctor.comp, PiFunctor.pi, PiFunctor.id, PiCategory.ξ_pi]

name: StringDiagrams.PiCat.pi_eq
statement: @[simp] theorem pi_eq (A : PiCat.{w, v, u} R) : PiTwoCategory.pi (R := R) A = piHom A

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.Superequivalence.map_inverse_map
statement:
theorem map_inverse_map {X Y : D} (g : X ⟶ Y) :
    F.map (e.inverse.map g) = e.counitIso.hom.app X ≫ g ≫ e.counitIso.inv.app Y
proof:
:= by
  have h := e.counitIso.hom.naturality g
  simp only [Functor.comp_obj, Functor.comp_map, Functor.id_obj, Functor.id_map] at h
  rw [← reassoc_of% h]
  simp

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.Superequivalence.map_adjointUnitIso_hom_app
statement:
theorem map_adjointUnitIso_hom_app (X : C) :
    F.map ((adjointUnitIso e).hom.app X) = e.counitIso.inv.app (F.obj X)

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.Superequivalence.adjointUnitIso_eq
statement:
theorem adjointUnitIso_eq
    (h : ∀ X, F.map (e.unitIso.hom.app X) ≫ e.counitIso.hom.app (F.obj X) = 𝟙 (F.obj X)) :
    e.adjointUnitIso = e.unitIso
proof:
:= by
  ext X
  apply e.fullyFaithful.map_injective
  rw [map_adjointUnitIso_hom_app, ← cancel_mono (e.counitIso.hom.app (F.obj X)), h X,
    Iso.inv_hom_id_app]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.Superequivalence.adjointUnitIso_hom_app_mem
statement:
theorem adjointUnitIso_hom_app_mem (X : C) :
    (adjointUnitIso e).hom.app X ∈ parity (R := R) X (e.inverse.obj (F.obj X)) 0
proof:
:= by
  have := e.fullyFaithful.faithful
  refine mem_of_map_mem F ?_
  rw [map_adjointUnitIso_hom_app]
  exact inv_mem (e.counitIso.app (F.obj X)) (e.counitIso_mem _)

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalSupercategory.whiskerLeft_comp_eq_id
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem whiskerLeft_comp_eq_id (Z : D) {X Y : D} {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : Y ⟶ X} (h : f ≫ g = 𝟙 X) :
    Z ◁ f ≫ Z ◁ g = 𝟙 (Z ⊗ X)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← whiskerLeft_comp (R := R), h, whiskerLeft_id (R := R)]

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalSupercategory.whiskerRight_comp_eq_id
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem whiskerRight_comp_eq_id {X Y : D} {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : Y ⟶ X} (h : f ≫ g = 𝟙 X) (Z : D) :
    f ▷ Z ≫ g ▷ Z = 𝟙 (X ⊗ Z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← comp_whiskerRight (R := R), h, id_whiskerRight (R := R)]

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalSupercategory.interchange_even_left
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem interchange_even_left {X X' Y Y' : D} {f : X ⟶ X'} (hf : f ∈ parity (R := R) X X' 0)
    (g : Y ⟶ Y') : f ▷ Y ≫ X' ◁ g = X ◁ g ≫ f ▷ Y'
proof:
:= by
  refine Supercategory.induction_on (R := R) g ?_ (fun q g hg => ?_) (fun g h hg hh => ?_)
  · rw [whiskerLeft_zero R, whiskerLeft_zero R, Limits.comp_zero, Limits.zero_comp]
  · exact interchange_of_even_left hf hg
  · rw [whiskerLeft_add (R := R), whiskerLeft_add (R := R), Preadditive.comp_add,
      Preadditive.add_comp, hg, hh]

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalSupercategory.interchange_even_right
proof:
:= by
  refine Supercategory.induction_on (R := R) f ?_ (fun q f hf => ?_) (fun f h hf hh => ?_)
  · rw [zero_whiskerRight R, zero_whiskerRight R, Limits.comp_zero, Limits.zero_comp]
  · exact interchange_of_even_right hf hg
  · rw [add_whiskerRight (R := R), add_whiskerRight (R := R), Preadditive.comp_add,
      Preadditive.add_comp, hf, hh]

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.Superequivalence.counit_interchange
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem counit_interchange (A : D) {Y Y' : D} (g : Y ⟶ Y') :
    F.obj (e.inverse.obj A) ◁ g ≫ (e.counitIso.hom.app A : F.obj (e.inverse.obj A) ⟶ A) ▷ Y' =
      (e.counitIso.hom.app A : F.obj (e.inverse.obj A) ⟶ A) ▷ Y ≫ A ◁ g

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.Superequivalence.counit_interchange_hom
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem counit_interchange_hom (A B : D) :
    F.obj (e.inverse.obj A) ◁ (e.counitIso.hom.app B : F.obj (e.inverse.obj B) ⟶ B) ≫
      (e.counitIso.hom.app A : F.obj (e.inverse.obj A) ⟶ A) ▷ B =
      (e.counitIso.hom.app A : F.obj (e.inverse.obj A) ⟶ A) ▷ F.obj (e.inverse.obj B) ≫
        A ◁ (e.counitIso.hom.app B : F.obj (e.inverse.obj B) ⟶ B)

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.Superequivalence.counit_interchange_inv
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem counit_interchange_inv (A B : D) :
    F.obj (e.inverse.obj A) ◁ (e.counitIso.inv.app B : B ⟶ F.obj (e.inverse.obj B)) ≫
      (e.counitIso.hom.app A : F.obj (e.inverse.obj A) ⟶ A) ▷ F.obj (e.inverse.obj B) =
      (e.counitIso.hom.app A : F.obj (e.inverse.obj A) ⟶ A) ▷ B ≫
        A ◁ (e.counitIso.inv.app B : B ⟶ F.obj (e.inverse.obj B))

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.Superequivalence.whiskerLeft_counit_inv_hom
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem whiskerLeft_counit_inv_hom (A B : D) :
    A ◁ (e.counitIso.inv.app B : B ⟶ F.obj (e.inverse.obj B)) ≫
      A ◁ (e.counitIso.hom.app B : F.obj (e.inverse.obj B) ⟶ B) = 𝟙 (A ⊗ B)

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.Superequivalence.counit_inv_hom_whiskerRight
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem counit_inv_hom_whiskerRight (A B : D) :
    (e.counitIso.inv.app A : A ⟶ F.obj (e.inverse.obj A)) ▷ B ≫
      (e.counitIso.hom.app A : F.obj (e.inverse.obj A) ⟶ A) ▷ B = 𝟙 (A ⊗ B)

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalSuperfunctor.map_whiskerRight
statement:
theorem map_whiskerRight {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (Z : C) :
    F.map (f ▷ Z) = (cF.μIso X Z).inv ≫ F.map f ▷ F.obj Z ≫ (cF.μIso Y Z).hom

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalSuperfunctor.map_whiskerLeft
statement:
theorem map_whiskerLeft (Z : C) {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    F.map (Z ◁ f) = (cF.μIso Z X).inv ≫ F.obj Z ◁ F.map f ≫ (cF.μIso Z Y).hom

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalSuperfunctor.map_associator_hom
statement:
theorem map_associator_hom (X Y Z : C) :
    F.map (α_ X Y Z).hom = (cF.μIso (X ⊗ Y) Z).inv ≫ (cF.μIso X Y).inv ▷ F.obj Z ≫
      (α_ (F.obj X) (F.obj Y) (F.obj Z)).hom ≫ F.obj X ◁ (cF.μIso Y Z).hom ≫
        (cF.μIso X (Y ⊗ Z)).hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cF.associativity, ← Category.assoc ((cF.μIso X Y).inv ▷ F.obj Z),
    ← MonoidalSupercategory.comp_whiskerRight (R := R), Iso.inv_hom_id,
    MonoidalSupercategory.id_whiskerRight (R := R), Category.id_comp, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalSuperfunctor.map_leftUnitor_hom
statement:
theorem map_leftUnitor_hom (X : C) :
    F.map (λ_ X).hom =
      (cF.μIso (𝟙_ C) X).inv ≫ cF.εIso.inv ▷ F.obj X ≫ (λ_ (F.obj X)).hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [cF.left_unitality, ← Category.assoc (cF.εIso.inv ▷ F.obj X),
    ← MonoidalSupercategory.comp_whiskerRight (R := R), Iso.inv_hom_id,
    MonoidalSupercategory.id_whiskerRight (R := R), Category.id_comp, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalSuperfunctor.map_rightUnitor_hom
statement:
theorem map_rightUnitor_hom (X : C) :
    F.map (ρ_ X).hom =
      (cF.μIso X (𝟙_ C)).inv ≫ F.obj X ◁ cF.εIso.inv ≫ (ρ_ (F.obj X)).hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [cF.right_unitality, ← Category.assoc (F.obj X ◁ cF.εIso.inv),
    ← MonoidalSupercategory.whiskerLeft_comp (R := R), Iso.inv_hom_id,
    MonoidalSupercategory.whiskerLeft_id (R := R), Category.id_comp, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.Superequivalence.inverseε_hom_mem
statement: theorem inverseε_hom_mem : (inverseε cF e).hom ∈ parity (R := R) _ _ 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := comp_mem (inv_mem _ cF.ε_mem) (inv_mem (e.counitIso.app (𝟙_ D)) (e.counitIso_mem _))
  simpa using h

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.Superequivalence.inverseμ_hom_mem
statement:
theorem inverseμ_hom_mem (X Y : D) :
    (inverseμ cF e X Y).hom ∈ parity (R := R) _ _ 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := comp_mem (inv_mem _ (cF.μ_mem _ _)) (comp_mem
    (MonoidalSupercategory.whiskerRight_mem (F.obj (e.inverse.obj Y)) (e.counitIso_mem X))
    (comp_mem (MonoidalSupercategory.whiskerLeft_mem X (e.counitIso_mem Y))
      (inv_mem (e.counitIso.app (X ⊗ Y)) (e.counitIso_mem (X ⊗ Y)))))
  simpa using h

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.Superequivalence.map_inverseMonoidal_μIso_hom
statement:
theorem map_inverseMonoidal_μIso_hom (X Y : D) :
    F.map ((inverseMonoidal cF e).μIso X Y).hom = (inverseμ cF e X Y).hom

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.Superequivalence.map_inverseMonoidal_εIso_hom
statement:
theorem map_inverseMonoidal_εIso_hom :
    F.map (inverseMonoidal cF e).εIso.hom = (inverseε cF e).hom

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalSuperequivalence.ofSuperequivalence_functor
statement: @[simp] theorem ofSuperequivalence_functor : (ofSuperequivalence cF e).functor = F

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalSuperequivalence.ofSuperequivalence_inverse
statement: @[simp] theorem ofSuperequivalence_inverse : (ofSuperequivalence cF e).inverse = e.inverse

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalSuperequivalence.ofSuperequivalence_functorMonoidal
statement:
theorem ofSuperequivalence_functorMonoidal :
    (ofSuperequivalence cF e).functorMonoidal = cF

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalSuperequivalence.ofSuperequivalence_inverseMonoidal
statement:
theorem ofSuperequivalence_inverseMonoidal :
    (ofSuperequivalence cF e).inverseMonoidal = e.inverseMonoidal cF

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalSuperequivalence.ofSuperequivalence_unitIso_toNatIso
statement:
theorem ofSuperequivalence_unitIso_toNatIso :
    (ofSuperequivalence cF e).unitIso.toNatIso = e.adjointUnitIso

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalSuperequivalence.ofSuperequivalence_counitIso_toNatIso
statement:
theorem ofSuperequivalence_counitIso_toNatIso :
    (ofSuperequivalence cF e).counitIso.toNatIso = e.counitIso

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalSuperequivalence.nonempty_iff_exists_superequivalence
statement:
theorem nonempty_iff_exists_superequivalence :
    Nonempty (MonoidalSuperequivalence R C D) ↔
      ∃ (F : C ⥤ D) (_ : F.Additive) (_ : F.Linear R) (_ : IsSuperfunctor R F),
        Nonempty (MonoidalSuperfunctor R F) ∧ Nonempty (Superequivalence R F)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨e⟩
    exact ⟨e.functor, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance, ⟨e.functorMonoidal⟩,
      ⟨e.superequivalence⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨F, _, _, _, ⟨cF⟩, ⟨e⟩⟩
    exact ⟨ofSuperequivalence cF e⟩

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.scal_comp
statement:
@[simp] theorem scal_comp {X Y Z : D k} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) :
    scal (f ≫ g) = scal g * scal f

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.scal_id
statement: @[simp] theorem scal_id (X : D k) : scal (𝟙 X) = 1

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.scal_add
statement: @[simp] theorem scal_add {X Y : D k} (f g : X ⟶ Y) : scal (f + g) = scal f + scal g

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.scal_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem scal_zero {X Y : D k} : scal (0 : X ⟶ Y) = 0

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.scal_sum
statement:
theorem scal_sum {X Y : D k} {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → (X ⟶ Y)) :
    scal (∑ i ∈ s, f i) = ∑ i ∈ s, scal (f i)

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.scal_eq_zero_of_ne
statement: theorem scal_eq_zero_of_ne {X Y : D k} (f : X ⟶ Y) (h : par X ≠ par Y) : scal f = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hf := f.2
  rw [Envelope.mem_parity_iff, zero_add,
    show X.obj.par + Y.obj.par = 1 by
      rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one X.obj.par with h1 | h1 <;>
        rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one Y.obj.par with h2 | h2 <;> simp_all] at hf
  exact UnitSupercat.eq_zero_of_mem_parity_one hf

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.hom_ext
statement: theorem hom_ext {X Y : D k} {f g : X ⟶ Y} (h : scal f = scal g) : f = g

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.scal_ofScal
statement: @[simp] theorem scal_ofScal {X Y : D k} (h : par X = par Y) (r : k) : scal (ofScal h r) = r

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.scal_eqToHom
statement: theorem scal_eqToHom {X Y : D k} (h : X = Y) : scal (eqToHom h) = 1

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.freeObj_odd_apply
statement:
theorem freeObj_odd_apply (M : Mat_ (D k)) (v : M.ι → k) (i : M.ι) :
    (freeObj M).odd v i = if par (M.X i) = 1 then v i else 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [freeObj, LinearMap.pi_apply]
  split_ifs <;> rfl

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.freeObj_proj_apply
statement:
theorem freeObj_proj_apply (M : Mat_ (D k)) (q : ZMod 2) (v : M.ι → k) (i : M.ι) :
    (freeObj M).proj q v i = if par (M.X i) = q then v i else 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one q with rfl | rfl
  · rw [SVec.proj_zero, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.id_apply]
    change v i - (freeObj M).odd v i = _
    rw [freeObj_odd_apply]
    rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one (par (M.X i)) with h | h <;> simp [h]
  · rw [SVec.proj_one]; exact freeObj_odd_apply M v i

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.mem_freeObj_part_iff
statement:
theorem mem_freeObj_part_iff (M : Mat_ (D k)) {q : ZMod 2} {v : M.ι → k} :
    v ∈ (freeObj M).part q ↔ ∀ i, par (M.X i) ≠ q → v i = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [SVec.mem_part_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h i hi
    rw [← h, freeObj_proj_apply, ite_eq_right hi]
  · intro h
    funext i
    rw [freeObj_proj_apply]
    split_ifs with hi
    · rfl
    · exact (h i hi).symm

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.scalMat_comp
statement:
theorem scalMat_comp {M N P : Mat_ (D k)} (f : M ⟶ N) (g : N ⟶ P) :
    scalMat (f ≫ g) = scalMat f * scalMat g
proof:
:= by
  ext i l
  simp only [scalMat, CategoryTheory.Mat_.comp_apply, scal_sum, scal_comp, Matrix.mul_apply]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => mul_comm _ _

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.scalMat_id
statement: theorem scalMat_id (M : Mat_ (D k)) : scalMat (𝟙 M) = 1
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  by_cases h : i = j
  · subst h; simp [scalMat, CategoryTheory.Mat_.id_apply_self]
  · rw [Matrix.one_apply_ne h, scalMat, CategoryTheory.Mat_.id_apply_of_ne _ _ _ h, scal_zero]

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.scalMat_add
statement: theorem scalMat_add {M N : Mat_ (D k)} (f g : M ⟶ N) : scalMat (f + g) = scalMat f + scalMat g

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.scalMat_injective
statement: theorem scalMat_injective {M N : Mat_ (D k)} : Function.Injective (scalMat (M := M) (N := N))
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ h => CategoryTheory.Mat_.hom_ext _ _ fun i j => hom_ext (congrFun (congrFun h i) j)

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.scalMat_eq_zero_of_ne
statement:
theorem scalMat_eq_zero_of_ne {M N : Mat_ (D k)} (f : M ⟶ N) {i : M.ι} {j : N.ι}
    (h : par (M.X i) ≠ par (N.X j)) : scalMat f i j = 0

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.matHom_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem matHom_apply {M N : Mat_ (D k)} (f : M ⟶ N) (v : M.ι → k) :
    matHom f v = v ᵥ* scalMat f

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.matHom_comp
statement:
theorem matHom_comp {M N P : Mat_ (D k)} (f : M ⟶ N) (g : N ⟶ P) :
    matHom (f ≫ g) = matHom f ≫ matHom g
proof:
:= by
  ext v j
  show (v ᵥ* scalMat (f ≫ g)) j = ((v ᵥ* scalMat f) ᵥ* scalMat g) j
  rw [scalMat_comp, Matrix.vecMul_vecMul]

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.matHom_id
statement: theorem matHom_id (M : Mat_ (D k)) : matHom (𝟙 M) = 𝟙 (freeObj M)
proof:
:= by
  ext v j
  show (v ᵥ* scalMat (𝟙 M)) j = v j
  rw [scalMat_id, Matrix.vecMul_one]

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.matHom_mem
statement:
theorem matHom_mem {M N : Mat_ (D k)} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    matHom f ∈ SVec.parityHom (freeObj M) (freeObj N) 0
proof:
:= by
  refine SVec.mem_parityHom_of_apply_mem fun q v hv => ?_
  simp only [add_zero]
  rw [mem_freeObj_part_iff] at hv ⊢
  intro j hj
  rw [matHom_apply, Matrix.vecMul, dotProduct]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i _ => ?_
  by_cases hi : par (M.X i) = q
  · rw [scalMat_eq_zero_of_ne f (by rw [hi]; exact Ne.symm hj), mul_zero]
  · rw [hv i hi, zero_mul]

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.matHom_injective
statement: theorem matHom_injective {M N : Mat_ (D k)} {f g : M ⟶ N} (h : matHom f = matHom g) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply scalMat_injective
  ext i j
  have := congrArg (fun φ : freeObj M ⟶ freeObj N => φ (Pi.single i 1) j) h
  change (Pi.single i 1 ᵥ* scalMat f) j = (Pi.single i 1 ᵥ* scalMat g) j at this
  simpa [Matrix.single_vecMul] using this

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.matHom_odd
statement:
theorem matHom_odd {M N : Mat_ (D k)} (f : M ⟶ N) (v : M.ι → k) :
    matHom f ((freeObj M).odd v) = (freeObj N).odd (matHom f v)
proof:
:= by
  have h := SVec.apply_proj_of_mem (matHom_mem f) 1 v
  simp only [add_zero] at h
  rwa [SVec.proj_one, SVec.proj_one] at h

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.mem_imgSubmodule
statement:
theorem mem_imgSubmodule {P : SKar k (UnitSupercat k)} {v : P.X.ι → k} :
    v ∈ imgSubmodule P ↔ matHom P.p v = v
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨w, rfl⟩
    change matHom P.p (matHom P.p w) = matHom P.p w
    rw [← SVec.comp_apply, ← matHom_comp, P.idem]
  · intro h; exact ⟨v, h⟩

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.odd_mem_imgSubmodule
statement:
theorem odd_mem_imgSubmodule (P : SKar k (UnitSupercat k)) :
    ∀ v ∈ imgSubmodule P, (freeObj P.X).odd v ∈ imgSubmodule P
proof:
:= by
  intro v hv
  rw [mem_imgSubmodule] at hv ⊢
  rw [matHom_odd, hv]

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.matHom_mem_imgSubmodule
statement:
theorem matHom_mem_imgSubmodule {P Q : SKar k (UnitSupercat k)} (f : P ⟶ Q) :
    ∀ v ∈ imgSubmodule P, matHom f.f v ∈ imgSubmodule Q
proof:
:= by
  intro v _
  rw [mem_imgSubmodule, ← SVec.comp_apply, ← matHom_comp, Idempotents.Karoubi.comp_p]

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.imgHom_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem imgHom_apply {P Q : SKar k (UnitSupercat k)} (f : P ⟶ Q) (v : imgSubmodule P) :
    ((imgHom f v : imgSubmodule Q) : Q.X.ι → k) = matHom f.f v

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.imgHom_mem
statement:
theorem imgHom_mem {P Q : SKar k (UnitSupercat k)} (f : P ⟶ Q) :
    imgHom f ∈ SVec.parityHom (imgObj P) (imgObj Q) 0

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.toSVec_obj
statement: @[simp] theorem toSVec_obj (P : SKar k (UnitSupercat k)) : ((toSVec k).obj P).obj = imgObj P

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.toSVec_map_apply
statement:
theorem toSVec_map_apply {P Q : SKar k (UnitSupercat k)} (f : P ⟶ Q) (v : imgSubmodule P) :
    (((toSVec k).map f).1 v).1 = matHom f.f v.1

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.matHom_p_mem
statement:
theorem matHom_p_mem (P : SKar k (UnitSupercat k)) (v : P.X.ι → k) :
    matHom P.p v ∈ imgSubmodule P

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.fullMap_apply
statement:
theorem fullMap_apply (v : P.X.ι → k) :
    fullMap g v = (g.1 ⟨matHom P.p v, matHom_p_mem P v⟩).1

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.fullMap_eq_zero_of_ne
statement:
theorem fullMap_eq_zero_of_ne {i : P.X.ι} {j : Q.X.ι} (h : par (P.X.X i) ≠ par (Q.X.X j)) :
    fullMap g (Pi.single i 1) j = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (Pi.single i 1 : P.X.ι → k) ∈ (freeObj P.X).part (par (P.X.X i)) := by
    rw [mem_freeObj_part_iff]
    intro i' hi'
    rw [Pi.single_apply, ite_eq_right]
    rintro rfl; exact hi' rfl
  have h2 := SVec.apply_mem_part (matHom_mem P.p) h1
  simp only [add_zero] at h2
  have h3 : (⟨matHom P.p (Pi.single i 1), matHom_p_mem P _⟩ : imgSubmodule P) ∈
      (imgObj P).part (par (P.X.X i)) := (SVec.mem_sub_part_iff _ _ _).2 h2
  have h4 := SVec.apply_mem_part g.2 h3
  simp only [add_zero] at h4
  have h5 := (SVec.mem_sub_part_iff _ _ _).1 h4
  rw [mem_freeObj_part_iff] at h5
  exact h5 j (Ne.symm h)

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.scalMat_fullMatrix
statement: theorem scalMat_fullMatrix : scalMat (fullMatrix g) = fun i j => fullMap g (Pi.single i 1) j
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp only [scalMat, fullMatrix]
  split_ifs with h
  · rfl
  · rw [scal_zero, fullMap_eq_zero_of_ne g h]

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.matHom_fullMatrix
statement: theorem matHom_fullMatrix (v : P.X.ι → k) : matHom (fullMatrix g) v = fullMap g v
proof:
:= by
  change v ᵥ* scalMat (fullMatrix g) = _
  rw [scalMat_fullMatrix]
  conv_rhs => rw [pi_eq_sum_univ v]
  ext j
  simp only [Matrix.vecMul, dotProduct, map_sum, map_smul, Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply,
    smul_eq_mul]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => ?_
  have : (Pi.single x 1 : P.X.ι → k) = fun j => if x = j then 1 else 0 := by
    funext j'; rw [Pi.single_apply]; simp [eq_comm]
  rw [this]

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.fullMap_p
statement: theorem fullMap_p (v : P.X.ι → k) : fullMap g (matHom P.p v) = fullMap g v
proof:
:= by
  rw [fullMap_apply, fullMap_apply]
  congr 3
  exact mem_imgSubmodule.1 (matHom_p_mem P v)

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.q_fullMap
statement: theorem q_fullMap (v : P.X.ι → k) : matHom Q.p (fullMap g v) = fullMap g v
proof:
:=
  mem_imgSubmodule.1 (g.1 ⟨matHom P.p v, matHom_p_mem P v⟩).2

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.toSVec_map_fullHom
statement: theorem toSVec_map_fullHom : (toSVec k).map (fullHom g) = g
proof:
:= by
  refine Underlying.hom_ext (SVec.hom_ext fun w => Subtype.ext ?_)
  change matHom (fullMatrix g) w.1 = (g.1 w).1
  rw [matHom_fullMatrix, fullMap_apply]
  congr 2
  exact Subtype.ext (mem_imgSubmodule.1 w.2)

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.toSVec_map_comp_val
statement:
theorem toSVec_map_comp_val {P Q R : SKar k (UnitSupercat k)} (f : P ⟶ Q) (g : Q ⟶ R) :
    ((toSVec k).map (f ≫ g)).1 = ((toSVec k).map f).1 ≫ ((toSVec k).map g).1

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.toSVec_map_id_val
statement:
theorem toSVec_map_id_val (P : SKar k (UnitSupercat k)) :
    ((toSVec k).map (𝟙 P)).1 = 𝟙 (imgObj P)

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.toSVec_map_add_val
statement:
theorem toSVec_map_add_val {P Q : SKar k (UnitSupercat k)} (f g : P ⟶ Q) :
    ((toSVec k).map (f + g)).1 = ((toSVec k).map f).1 + ((toSVec k).map g).1

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.scal_pi
statement: theorem scal_pi {X Y : D k} (f : X ⟶ Y) : scal ((PiCategory.pi (R := k)).map f) = scal f
proof:
:= by
  change SuperalgebraCat.toElem (Envelope.toHom ((PiSupercategory.pi (R := k)).map f.1)) = scal f
  rw [Envelope.toHom_pi_map, twist_of_mem 1 (UnitSupercat.mem_parity_zero _), mul_zero,
    sign_zero, one_smul]
  by_cases h : par X = par Y
  · change SuperalgebraCat.toElem (sign k (X.obj.par + Y.obj.par) • Envelope.toHom f.1) = scal f
    rw [show X.obj.par = Y.obj.par from h, zmod2_add_self, sign_zero, one_smul]; rfl
  · change sign k (X.obj.par + Y.obj.par) * scal f = scal f
    rw [scal_eq_zero_of_ne f h, mul_zero]

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.scalMat_pi
statement:
theorem scalMat_pi {M N : Mat_ (D k)} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    scalMat ((PiCategory.pi (R := k)).map f) = scalMat f
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  exact scal_pi (f i j)

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.imgSubmodule_eq
statement:
theorem imgSubmodule_eq (P : SKar k (UnitSupercat k)) :
    imgSubmodule P = LinearMap.range (scalMat P.p).vecMulLinear

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.pi_obj_p
statement:
theorem pi_obj_p (P : SKar k (UnitSupercat k)) :
    ((PiCategory.pi (R := k)).obj P).p = (PiCategory.pi (R := k)).map P.p

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.imgSubmodule_pi
statement:
theorem imgSubmodule_pi (P : SKar k (UnitSupercat k)) :
    imgSubmodule ((PiCategory.pi (R := k)).obj P) = imgSubmodule P
proof:
:= by
  rw [imgSubmodule_eq, imgSubmodule_eq, pi_obj_p, scalMat_pi]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.pi_obj_mat
statement: theorem pi_obj_mat (M : Mat_ (D k)) : (PiCategory.pi (R := k)).obj M = shiftMat M

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.mem_freeObj_shiftMat_part_iff
statement:
theorem mem_freeObj_shiftMat_part_iff (M : Mat_ (D k)) {q : ZMod 2} {v : M.ι → k} :
    v ∈ (freeObj (shiftMat M)).part q ↔ v ∈ (freeObj M).part (q + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_freeObj_part_iff, mem_freeObj_part_iff]
  refine forall_congr' fun i => imp_congr_left ?_
  change par (M.X i) + 1 ≠ q ↔ _
  rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one (par (M.X i)) with h | h <;>
    rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one q with rfl | rfl <;> simp [h]

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.dim_eq_of_iso
statement:
theorem dim_eq_of_iso {P Q : SKar K (UnitSupercat K)} (e : P ≅ Q) (q : ZMod 2) :
    dim P q = dim Q q

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.dim_biprod
statement:
theorem dim_biprod (P Q : SKar K (UnitSupercat K)) (q : ZMod 2) :
    dim (P ⊞ Q) q = dim P q + dim Q q
proof:
:= by
  have hmap : ∀ {A B C : SKar K (UnitSupercat K)} (f : A ⟶ B) (g : B ⟶ C) (h : A ⟶ C),
      f ≫ g = h → ((toSVec K).map f).1 ≫ ((toSVec K).map g).1 = ((toSVec K).map h).1 := by
    intro A B C f g h e; rw [← toSVec_map_comp_val, e]
  exact SVec.finrank_part_of_biprod ((toSVec K).map biprod.inl).1 ((toSVec K).map biprod.inr).1
    ((toSVec K).map biprod.fst).1 ((toSVec K).map biprod.snd).1
    ((toSVec K).map _).2 ((toSVec K).map _).2 ((toSVec K).map _).2 ((toSVec K).map _).2
    (by rw [hmap _ _ _ biprod.inl_fst, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id]; rfl)
    (by rw [hmap _ _ _ biprod.inr_snd, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id]; rfl)
    (by rw [hmap _ _ _ biprod.inl_snd, Functor.map_zero]; rfl)
    (by rw [hmap _ _ _ biprod.inr_fst, Functor.map_zero]; rfl)
    (by
      rw [← toSVec_map_comp_val, ← toSVec_map_comp_val, ← toSVec_map_add_val, biprod.total,
        toSVec_map_id_val]
      rfl)
    q

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.dim_eq_finrank
statement:
theorem dim_eq_finrank (P : SKar K (UnitSupercat K)) (q : ZMod 2) :
    dim P q = Module.finrank K ↥(imgSubmodule P ⊓ (freeObj P.X).part q)
proof:
:= by
  refine LinearEquiv.finrank_eq
    { toFun := fun w => ⟨w.1.1, w.1.2, (SVec.mem_sub_part_iff (freeObj P.X) (imgSubmodule P)
        (odd_mem_imgSubmodule P)).1 w.2⟩
      invFun := fun w => ⟨⟨w.1, w.2.1⟩, (SVec.mem_sub_part_iff (freeObj P.X) (imgSubmodule P)
        (odd_mem_imgSubmodule P)).2 w.2.2⟩
      map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl
      map_smul' := fun _ _ => rfl
      left_inv := fun _ => rfl
      right_inv := fun _ => rfl }

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.freeObj_part_pi
statement:
theorem freeObj_part_pi (P : SKar K (UnitSupercat K)) (q : ZMod 2) :
    (freeObj ((PiCategory.pi (R := K)).obj P).X).part q = (freeObj P.X).part (q + 1)
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  exact mem_freeObj_shiftMat_part_iff P.X

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.dim_pi
statement:
theorem dim_pi (P : SKar K (UnitSupercat K)) (q : ZMod 2) :
    dim ((PiCategory.pi (R := K)).obj P) q = dim P (q + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [dim_eq_finrank, dim_eq_finrank]
  have h : imgSubmodule ((PiCategory.pi (R := K)).obj P) ⊓
      (freeObj ((PiCategory.pi (R := K)).obj P).X).part q =
        imgSubmodule P ⊓ (freeObj P.X).part (q + 1) := by
    rw [imgSubmodule_pi, freeObj_part_pi]
  exact congrArg (fun S : Submodule K (P.X.ι → K) => Module.finrank K S) h

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.dim_toKaroubi
statement:
theorem dim_toKaroubi (M : Mat_ (D K)) (q : ZMod 2) :
    dim ((toKaroubi _).obj M) q = Fintype.card {i // par (M.X i) = q}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [← Module.finrank_fintype_fun_eq_card (R := K)]
  have hall : ∀ v : M.ι → K, v ∈ imgSubmodule ((toKaroubi _).obj M) := fun v =>
    mem_imgSubmodule.2 (by
      change matHom (𝟙 M) v = v
      rw [matHom_id]; rfl)
  refine LinearEquiv.finrank_eq
    { toFun := fun w i => w.1.1 i.1
      invFun := fun u => ⟨⟨fun i => if h : par (M.X i) = q then u ⟨i, h⟩ else 0, hall _⟩,
        (SVec.mem_sub_part_iff _ _ _).2 ((mem_freeObj_part_iff M).2 fun i hi => dite_eq_right hi)⟩
      map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl
      map_smul' := fun _ _ => rfl
      left_inv := fun w => ?_
      right_inv := fun u => ?_ }
  · apply Subtype.ext; apply Subtype.ext
    funext i
    dsimp only
    split_ifs with h
    · rfl
    · exact ((mem_freeObj_part_iff M).1 ((SVec.mem_sub_part_iff _ _ _).1 w.2) i h).symm
  · funext i
    exact dite_eq_left i.2

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.dim_obj
statement: theorem dim_obj (a q : ZMod 2) : dim (obj K a) q = if a = q then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [obj, dim_toKaroubi]
  split_ifs with h
  · subst h
    rw [Fintype.card_eq_one_iff]
    exact ⟨⟨PUnit.unit, rfl⟩, fun _ => Subtype.ext rfl⟩
  · rw [Fintype.card_eq_zero_iff]; exact ⟨fun i => h i.2⟩

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.K₀Dim_mk
statement: @[simp] theorem K₀Dim_mk (P : SKar K (UnitSupercat K)) : K₀Dim K (K₀.mk P) = dimZπ P

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.K₀Dim_obj_zero
statement: theorem K₀Dim_obj_zero : K₀Dim K (K₀.mk (obj K 0)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [K₀Dim_mk, dimZπ, dim_obj, dim_obj]
  simp

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.K₀Dim_obj_one
statement: theorem K₀Dim_obj_one : K₀Dim K (K₀.mk (obj K 1)) = Zπ.π
proof:
:= by
  rw [K₀Dim_mk, dimZπ, dim_obj, dim_obj]
  simp

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.K₀Dim_surjective
statement: theorem K₀Dim_surjective : Function.Surjective (K₀Dim K)
proof:
:= by
  intro z
  obtain ⟨a, b, rfl⟩ := Zπ.exists_eq_add_mul_π z
  refine ⟨a • K₀.mk (obj K 0) + b • K₀.mk (obj K 1), ?_⟩
  rw [map_add, map_zsmul, map_zsmul, K₀Dim_obj_zero, K₀Dim_obj_one, zsmul_eq_mul, zsmul_eq_mul,
    mul_one]

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.nonempty_iso_of_dim_eq
statement:
theorem nonempty_iso_of_dim_eq {P Q : SKar K (UnitSupercat K)} (h₀ : dim P 0 = dim Q 0)
    (h₁ : dim P 1 = dim Q 1) : Nonempty (P ≅ Q)
proof:
:= by
  let e := SVec.isoOfPartEquiv (V := ((toSVec K).obj P).obj) (W := ((toSVec K).obj Q).obj)
    (LinearEquiv.ofFinrankEq _ _ h₀) (LinearEquiv.ofFinrankEq _ _ h₁)
  exact ⟨(toSVec K).preimageIso (Underlying.isoMk e (SVec.isoOfPartEquiv_hom_mem _ _))⟩

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.K₀Dim_injective
statement: theorem K₀Dim_injective : Function.Injective (K₀Dim K)
proof:
:= by
  rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨P, Q, rfl⟩ := K₀.exists_eq_mk_sub_mk x
  rw [map_sub, K₀Dim_mk, K₀Dim_mk, sub_eq_zero, dimZπ, dimZπ] at hx
  have hx' : ((dim P 0 : ℤ) : Zπ) + ((dim P 1 : ℤ) : Zπ) * Zπ.π =
      ((dim Q 0 : ℤ) : Zπ) + ((dim Q 1 : ℤ) : Zπ) * Zπ.π := by
    simpa only [Int.cast_natCast] using hx
  obtain ⟨h₀, h₁⟩ := Zπ.add_mul_π_injective hx'
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := nonempty_iso_of_dim_eq (Int.ofNat_inj.1 h₀) (Int.ofNat_inj.1 h₁)
  rw [K₀.mk_eq_mk_of_iso e, sub_self]

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.K₀Dim_piInvolution
statement:
theorem K₀Dim_piInvolution (x : K₀ (SKar K (UnitSupercat K))) :
    K₀Dim K (K₀.piInvolution K _ x) = Zπ.π * K₀Dim K x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using K₀.induction_on with
  | mk P =>
    rw [K₀.piInvolution_mk, K₀Dim_mk, K₀Dim_mk, dimZπ, dimZπ, dim_pi, dim_pi]
    rw [show (0 : ZMod 2) + 1 = 1 from rfl, show (1 : ZMod 2) + 1 = 0 from rfl]
    rw [mul_add, ← mul_assoc, mul_comm Zπ.π (dim P 1 : Zπ), mul_assoc, Zπ.π_mul_π]
    ring
  | zero => simp
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy, map_add, mul_add]
  | neg x hx => rw [map_neg, map_neg, hx, map_neg]; ring

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.one_eq_mk_obj_zero
statement: theorem one_eq_mk_obj_zero : (1 : K₀ (SKar K (UnitSupercat K))) = K₀.mk (obj K 0)

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.K₀Dim_one
statement: theorem K₀Dim_one : K₀Dim K 1 = 1

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.K₀Dim_smul
statement:
theorem K₀Dim_smul (c : Zπ) (x : K₀ (SKar K (UnitSupercat K))) :
    K₀Dim K (c • x) = c * K₀Dim K x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, rfl⟩ := Zπ.exists_eq_add_mul_π c
  rw [add_smul (a : Zπ) ((b : Zπ) * Zπ.π) x, mul_smul (b : Zπ) Zπ.π x, SKar.π_smul_eq,
    Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul, Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul,
    map_add, map_zsmul, map_zsmul, K₀Dim_piInvolution, zsmul_eq_mul, zsmul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.K₀Dim_algebraMap
statement: theorem K₀Dim_algebraMap (c : Zπ) : K₀Dim K (algebraMap Zπ _ c) = c

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.K₀AlgEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
theorem K₀AlgEquiv_symm_apply (x : K₀ (SKar K (UnitSupercat K))) :
    (K₀AlgEquiv (K := K)).symm x = K₀Dim K x
proof:
:= by
  rw [AlgEquiv.symm_apply_eq]
  exact K₀Dim_injective (by
    change K₀Dim K x = K₀Dim K (algebraMap Zπ _ (K₀Dim K x))
    rw [K₀Dim_algebraMap])

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.K₀AlgEquiv_symm_mk
statement:
theorem K₀AlgEquiv_symm_mk (P : SKar K (UnitSupercat K)) :
    (K₀AlgEquiv (K := K)).symm (K₀.mk P) =
      (dim P 0 : Zπ) + (dim P 1 : Zπ) * Zπ.π

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.card_sumMat_zero
statement:
theorem card_sumMat_zero (m n : ℕ) :
    Fintype.card {i // par ((sumMat (K := K) m n).X i) = 0} = m
proof:
:= by
  refine (Fintype.card_congr
    { toFun := fun i => match i with
        | ⟨.inl a, _⟩ => a
        | ⟨.inr _, h⟩ => (fun h' : (1 : ZMod 2) = 0 => absurd h' (by decide)) h
      invFun := fun a => ⟨.inl a, rfl⟩
      left_inv := fun i => ?_
      right_inv := fun _ => rfl }).trans (Fintype.card_fin m)
  rcases i with ⟨i | i, h⟩
  · rfl
  · exact (fun h' : (1 : ZMod 2) = 0 => absurd h' (by decide)) h

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.card_sumMat_one
statement:
theorem card_sumMat_one (m n : ℕ) :
    Fintype.card {i // par ((sumMat (K := K) m n).X i) = 1} = n
proof:
:= by
  refine (Fintype.card_congr
    { toFun := fun i => match i with
        | ⟨.inr a, _⟩ => a
        | ⟨.inl _, h⟩ => (fun h' : (0 : ZMod 2) = 1 => absurd h' (by decide)) h
      invFun := fun a => ⟨.inr a, rfl⟩
      left_inv := fun i => ?_
      right_inv := fun _ => rfl }).trans (Fintype.card_fin n)
  rcases i with ⟨i | i, h⟩
  · exact (fun h' : (0 : ZMod 2) = 1 => absurd h' (by decide)) h
  · rfl

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.exists_iso_toSVec_obj
statement:
theorem exists_iso_toSVec_obj (V : SVec K) [FiniteDimensional K V] :
    ∃ P : SKar K (UnitSupercat K), Nonempty ((toSVec K).obj P ≅ ⟨V⟩)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(toKaroubi _).obj (sumMat (Module.finrank K (V.part 0)) (Module.finrank K (V.part 1))),
    ⟨Underlying.isoMk (SVec.isoOfPartEquiv (LinearEquiv.ofFinrankEq _ _ ?_)
      (LinearEquiv.ofFinrankEq _ _ ?_)) (SVec.isoOfPartEquiv_hom_mem _ _)⟩⟩
  · exact (dim_toKaroubi _ 0).trans (card_sumMat_zero _ _)
  · exact (dim_toKaroubi _ 1).trans (card_sumMat_one _ _)

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.postcomposeDensityX_mem
statement:
theorem postcomposeDensityX_mem {a b : QPiTwoEnvelope R B} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    postcomposeDensityX T hT G f ∈ parity (R := R) _ _ 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [postcomposeDensityX, zero_add] using! comp_mem
    (rightUnitor_hom_mem (R := R) _)
    (comp_mem (G.1.map₂_mem (extendRestrictApp_mem T hT f))
      (inv_mem _ (leftUnitor_hom_mem (R := R) _)))

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.postcomposeDensityX_naturality
statement:
theorem postcomposeDensityX_naturality {a b : QPiTwoEnvelope R B}
    {f g : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ g) :
    G.1.map₂ ((extend (restrict T)).map₂ η) ▷ 𝟙 (G.1.obj (T.obj b)) ≫
        postcomposeDensityX T hT G g =
      postcomposeDensityX T hT G f ≫ 𝟙 (G.1.obj (T.obj a)) ◁ G.1.map₂ (T.map₂ η)
proof:
:= by
  unfold postcomposeDensityX
  erw [rightUnitor_naturality_assoc R, ← reassoc_of% G.1.map₂_comp,
    extendRestrictApp_naturality, G.1.map₂_comp]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  erw [leftUnitor_inv_naturality R (G.1.map₂ (T.map₂ η))]

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.postcomposeDensity_isGraded
statement: theorem postcomposeDensity_isGraded : (postcomposeDensity T hT G).IsGraded
proof:
:= by
  intro a b f
  simpa only [postcomposeDensity, postcomposeDensityX, zero_add] using! comp_mem_degree
    (GradedTwoSupercategory.rightUnitor_hom_mem_degree (R := R) _)
    (comp_mem_degree (G.2.map₂_mem_degree (extendRestrictApp_mem_degree T hT f))
      (GradedTwoSupercategory.leftUnitor_inv_mem_degree (R := R) _))

statement:
theorem postcomposeDensityIso_hom_isHomogeneous :
    (postcomposeDensityIso T hT G).hom.IsHomogeneous 0 0
proof:
:= by
  intro a
  exact ⟨inv_mem _ (G.1.mapId_hom_mem (T.obj a)), by
    simpa using! inv_mem_degree _ (G.2.mapId_hom_mem_degree (T.obj a))⟩

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.postcomposeDensity_isStrong
statement: theorem postcomposeDensity_isStrong : (postcomposeDensity T hT G).IsStrong
proof:
:= by
  intro a b f
  change IsIso ((rightUnitor _).hom ≫ G.1.map₂ (extendRestrictApp T hT f) ≫
    (leftUnitor _).inv)
  have := hT.isGradedSuperfunctor a b
  have : IsIso (extendRestrictApp T hT f) :=
    inferInstanceAs (IsIso ((QPiEnvelope.extendRestrictIso (homFunctor T a b)).app f).hom)
  have : IsIso (G.1.map₂ (extendRestrictApp T hT f)) :=
    (G.1.mapFunctor _ _).map_isIso _
  infer_instance

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.postcomposeDensityBridgeCollapseIso_hom_isHomogeneous
statement:
theorem postcomposeDensityBridgeCollapseIso_hom_isHomogeneous :
    (postcomposeDensityBridgeCollapseIso T hT G).hom.IsHomogeneous 0 0
proof:
:= by
  intro a
  constructor
  · simpa only [zero_add] using! comp_mem
      (associator_hom_mem (R := R) ((postcomposeDensity T hT G).X a) _ _)
      (comp_mem (whiskerLeft_mem _
        (extendRestrictUnitIso_hom_isHomogeneous (T.comp G.1) (hT.comp G.2) a).1)
        (rightUnitor_hom_mem (R := R) _))
  · simpa only [zero_add] using! comp_mem_degree
      (GradedTwoSupercategory.associator_hom_mem_degree (R := R)
        ((postcomposeDensity T hT G).X a) _ _)
      (comp_mem_degree (GradedTwoSupercategory.whiskerLeft_mem_degree _
        (extendRestrictUnitIso_hom_isHomogeneous (T.comp G.1) (hT.comp G.2) a).2)
        (GradedTwoSupercategory.rightUnitor_hom_mem_degree (R := R) _))

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.postcomposeDensityFactorizationIso_hom_isHomogeneous
statement:
theorem postcomposeDensityFactorizationIso_hom_isHomogeneous :
    (postcomposeDensityFactorizationIso T hT G).hom.IsHomogeneous 0 0
proof:
:= by
  intro a
  have h := TwoNatTrans.iso_inv_isHomogeneous _
    (postcomposeDensityBridgeCollapseIso_hom_isHomogeneous T hT G) a
  exact ⟨by simpa only [zero_add] using!
      comp_mem (postcomposeDensityIso_hom_isHomogeneous T hT G a).1 h.1,
    by simpa only [zero_add] using!
      comp_mem_degree (postcomposeDensityIso_hom_isHomogeneous T hT G a).2 h.2⟩

statement:
theorem postcomposeDensityFactorizationIso_naturality
    {a b : QPiTwoEnvelope R B} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (TwoNatTrans.postcompose G.1 (extendRestrictNatTrans T hT)).x f ≫
        (postcomposeDensityFactorizationIso T hT G).hom.app a ▷ (T.comp G.1).map f =
      ((extend (restrict T)).comp G.1).map f ◁
        (postcomposeDensityFactorizationIso T hT G).hom.app b ≫
          (TwoNatTrans.vcomp (postcomposeDensityBridge T hT G)
            (extendRestrictNatTrans (T.comp G.1) (hT.comp G.2))).x f

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.counitPasteRight_restrict
statement:
theorem counitPasteRight_restrict (F : A ⟶ C) (G : C ⟶ D) :
    restrict ((mapQPi F.1).comp ((counit C).comp G.1)) =
      restrict ((counit A).comp (F ≫ G).1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← counitPaste_middle F G, ← counitPaste_target F G]
  simpa only [restrict_eq_comp, TwoSuperfunctor.comp_assoc] using
    congrArg (fun H => H.comp G.1) (counit_naturality_restrict F)

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSuperspace.tmul_mem_tensorDeg
statement:
theorem tmul_mem_tensorDeg {r s : ℤ} {v : V.toSVec} {w : W.toSVec} (hv : v ∈ V.deg r)
    (hw : w ∈ W.deg s) : v ⊗ₜ w ∈ V.tensorDeg W (r + s)

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSuperspace.tensorDeg_le_iff
statement:
theorem tensorDeg_le_iff {n : ℤ} {S : Submodule k (V.toSVec ⊗[k] W.toSVec)} :
    V.tensorDeg W n ≤ S ↔
      ∀ (r s : ℤ), r + s = n → ∀ v ∈ V.deg r, ∀ w ∈ W.deg s, v ⊗ₜ w ∈ S
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h _ _ hrs _ hv _ hw => h (hrs ▸ tmul_mem_tensorDeg V W hv hw),
    fun h => iSup₂_le fun rs hrs => Submodule.map₂_le.2 fun v hv w hw => h rs.1 rs.2 hrs v hv w hw⟩

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSuperspace.tensorProj_tmul
statement:
theorem tensorProj_tmul (n r s : ℤ) {v : V.toSVec} {w : W.toSVec} (hv : v ∈ V.deg r)
    (hw : w ∈ W.deg s) : V.tensorProj W n (v ⊗ₜ w) = if r + s = n then v ⊗ₜ w else 0
proof:
:= by
  let := V.degreeDecomposition
  let := W.degreeDecomposition
  have hv' : DirectSum.decompose V.deg v = DirectSum.lof k ℤ (fun r => V.deg r) r ⟨v, hv⟩ :=
    DirectSum.decompose_of_mem V.deg hv
  have hw' : DirectSum.decompose W.deg w = DirectSum.lof k ℤ (fun s => W.deg s) s ⟨w, hw⟩ :=
    DirectSum.decompose_of_mem W.deg hw
  simp only [tensorProj, LinearMap.comp_apply, TensorProduct.map_tmul, LinearEquiv.coe_coe,
    DirectSum.decomposeLinearEquiv_apply, hv', hw', TensorProduct.directSum_lof_tmul_lof,
    DirectSum.toModule_lof]
  split_ifs
  · simp
  · rfl

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSuperspace.tensorPiece_le_eqLocus
statement:
theorem tensorPiece_le_eqLocus (n : ℤ) (rs : ℤ × ℤ) (h : rs.1 + rs.2 = n) :
    V.tensorPiece W rs ≤ LinearMap.eqLocus (V.tensorProj W n) LinearMap.id
proof:
:=
  Submodule.map₂_le.2 fun v hv w hw => LinearMap.mem_eqLocus.2 (by
    rw [TensorProduct.mk_apply, tensorProj_tmul V W n rs.1 rs.2 hv hw, ite_eq_left h]; rfl)

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSuperspace.tensorPiece_le_ker
statement:
theorem tensorPiece_le_ker (n : ℤ) (rs : ℤ × ℤ) (h : rs.1 + rs.2 ≠ n) :
    V.tensorPiece W rs ≤ LinearMap.ker (V.tensorProj W n)
proof:
:=
  Submodule.map₂_le.2 fun v hv w hw => LinearMap.mem_ker.2 (by
    rw [TensorProduct.mk_apply, tensorProj_tmul V W n rs.1 rs.2 hv hw, ite_eq_right h])

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSuperspace.tensorProj_of_mem
statement:
theorem tensorProj_of_mem {n : ℤ} {x : V.toSVec ⊗[k] W.toSVec} (hx : x ∈ V.tensorDeg W n) :
    V.tensorProj W n x = x
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.mem_eqLocus.1
    ((iSup₂_le fun rs hrs => tensorPiece_le_eqLocus V W n rs hrs : V.tensorDeg W n ≤ _) hx)

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSuperspace.tensorProj_of_mem_ne
statement:
theorem tensorProj_of_mem_ne {m n : ℤ} (h : m ≠ n) {x : V.toSVec ⊗[k] W.toSVec}
    (hx : x ∈ V.tensorDeg W m) : V.tensorProj W n x = 0
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.mem_ker.1 ((iSup₂_le fun rs hrs =>
    tensorPiece_le_ker V W n rs fun e => h (hrs.symm.trans e) : V.tensorDeg W m ≤ _) hx)

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSuperspace.iSupIndep_tensorDeg
statement: theorem iSupIndep_tensorDeg : iSupIndep (V.tensorDeg W)
proof:
:=
  iSupIndep_of_projections _ (V.tensorProj W)
    (fun n => iSup₂_le fun rs hrs => tensorPiece_le_eqLocus V W n rs hrs)
    (fun n _ hmn => iSup₂_le fun rs hrs =>
      tensorPiece_le_ker V W n rs fun h => hmn (hrs.symm.trans h))

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSuperspace.iSup_tensorDeg_eq_top
statement: theorem iSup_tensorDeg_eq_top : ⨆ n, V.tensorDeg W n = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_top_iff]
  intro x _
  refine TensorProduct.inductionOn x (fun v w => ?_)
    (fun x y hx hy => Submodule.add_mem _ hx hy)
  refine V.induction_on_deg v (by rw [zero_tmul]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _) (fun r v hv => ?_)
    (fun v v' hv hv' => by rw [add_tmul]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hv hv')
  refine W.induction_on_deg w (by rw [tmul_zero]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _) (fun s w hw => ?_)
    (fun w w' hw hw' => by rw [tmul_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hw hw')
  exact Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem (r + s) (tmul_mem_tensorDeg V W hv hw)

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSuperspace.isInternal_tensorDeg
statement: theorem isInternal_tensorDeg : DirectSum.IsInternal (V.tensorDeg W)

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSuperspace.sgn_mem
statement: theorem sgn_mem {b : ZMod 2} {n : ℤ} {v : V.toSVec} (hv : v ∈ V.deg n) : V.toSVec.sgn b v ∈ V.deg n
proof:
:= by
  rw [SVec.sgn_apply]
  exact Submodule.add_mem _ (V.proj_mem 0 hv) (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (V.proj_mem 1 hv))

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSuperspace.tensorObj_toSVec
statement: @[simp] theorem tensorObj_toSVec : (V.tensorObj W).toSVec = SVec.tensorObj V.toSVec W.toSVec

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSuperspace.tensorObj_deg
statement: @[simp] theorem tensorObj_deg (n : ℤ) : (V.tensorObj W).deg n = V.tensorDeg W n

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSuperspace.unit_toSVec
statement: @[simp] theorem unit_toSVec : (unit : GradedSuperspace k).toSVec = SVec.unit

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSuperspace.unit_deg
statement: theorem unit_deg (n : ℤ) : (unit : GradedSuperspace k).deg n = if n = 0 then ⊤ else ⊥

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSuperspace.mem_unit_deg_zero
statement:
theorem mem_unit_deg_zero (r : (unit : GradedSuperspace k).toSVec) :
    r ∈ (unit : GradedSuperspace k).deg 0

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSuperspace.eq_zero_of_mem_unit_deg
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_mem_unit_deg {n : ℤ} (hn : n ≠ 0) {r : (unit : GradedSuperspace k).toSVec}
    (hr : r ∈ (unit : GradedSuperspace k).deg n) : r = 0
proof:
:= by
  rwa [unit_deg, ite_eq_right hn, Submodule.mem_bot] at hr

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSuperspace.whiskerLeft_mem_degHom
proof:
:= by
  intro m x hx
  refine (tensorDeg_le_iff V W
    (S := (V.tensorDeg W' (m + n)).comap (SVec.toLinearMap (SVec.whiskerLeft V.toSVec g)))).2
    (fun r s hrs v hv w hw => ?_) hx
  rw [Submodule.mem_comap]
  change (TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id (SVec.toLinearMap (SVec.homProj 0 g)) +
    TensorProduct.map (V.toSVec.sgn 1) (SVec.toLinearMap (SVec.homProj 1 g)) :
      V.toSVec ⊗[k] W.toSVec →ₗ[k] V.toSVec ⊗[k] W'.toSVec) (v ⊗ₜ w) ∈ _
  rw [LinearMap.add_apply, TensorProduct.map_tmul, TensorProduct.map_tmul, LinearMap.id_apply]
  subst hrs
  rw [add_assoc]
  exact Submodule.add_mem _ (tmul_mem_tensorDeg V W' hv (homProj_mem_degHom 0 hg s w hw))
    (tmul_mem_tensorDeg V W' (V.sgn_mem hv) (homProj_mem_degHom 1 hg s w hw))

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSuperspace.whiskerRight_mem_degHom
proof:
:= by
  intro m x hx
  refine (tensorDeg_le_iff V W
    (S := (V'.tensorDeg W (m + n)).comap (SVec.toLinearMap (SVec.whiskerRight f W.toSVec)))).2
    (fun r s hrs v hv w hw => ?_) hx
  rw [Submodule.mem_comap]
  change f v ⊗ₜ w ∈ _
  subst hrs
  rw [add_right_comm]
  exact tmul_mem_tensorDeg V' W (hf r v hv) hw

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSuperspace.whiskerLeft_mem_hom
proof:
:= by
  refine (family k).hom_induction hg
    (fun n g hg => (family k).mem_hom_of_mem (whiskerLeft_mem_degHom V hg)) ?_ ?_
  · rw [SVec.whiskerLeft_zero]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  · intro g g' hg hg'
    rw [SVec.whiskerLeft_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hg hg'

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSuperspace.whiskerRight_mem_hom
proof:
:= by
  refine (family k).hom_induction hf
    (fun n f hf => (family k).mem_hom_of_mem (whiskerRight_mem_degHom hf W)) ?_ ?_
  · rw [SVec.whiskerRight_zero]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  · intro f f' hf hf'
    rw [SVec.whiskerRight_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hf hf'

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSuperspace.associator_hom_mem_degHom
statement:
theorem associator_hom_mem_degHom (U V W : GradedSuperspace k) :
    (SVec.associator U.toSVec V.toSVec W.toSVec).hom ∈
      degHom ((U.tensorObj V).tensorObj W) (U.tensorObj (V.tensorObj W)) 0
proof:
:= by
  intro m x hx
  refine (tensorDeg_le_iff (U.tensorObj V) W
    (S := (U.tensorDeg (V.tensorObj W) (m + 0)).comap
      (SVec.toLinearMap (SVec.associator U.toSVec V.toSVec W.toSVec).hom))).2
    (fun r s hrs y hy w hw => ?_) hx
  refine (tensorDeg_le_iff U V
    (S := (U.tensorDeg (V.tensorObj W) (m + 0)).comap
      ((SVec.toLinearMap (SVec.associator U.toSVec V.toSVec W.toSVec).hom) ∘ₗ
        (TensorProduct.mk k _ W.toSVec).flip w))).2
    (fun a b hab u hu v hv => ?_) hy
  change (SVec.associator U.toSVec V.toSVec W.toSVec).hom ((u ⊗ₜ v) ⊗ₜ w) ∈
    U.tensorDeg (V.tensorObj W) (m + 0)
  change u ⊗ₜ (v ⊗ₜ w) ∈ _
  subst hrs hab
  rw [add_zero, add_assoc]
  exact tmul_mem_tensorDeg U (V.tensorObj W) hu (tmul_mem_tensorDeg V W hv hw)

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSuperspace.associator_inv_mem_degHom
statement:
theorem associator_inv_mem_degHom (U V W : GradedSuperspace k) :
    (SVec.associator U.toSVec V.toSVec W.toSVec).inv ∈
      degHom (U.tensorObj (V.tensorObj W)) ((U.tensorObj V).tensorObj W) 0
proof:
:= by
  intro m x hx
  refine (tensorDeg_le_iff U (V.tensorObj W)
    (S := ((U.tensorObj V).tensorDeg W (m + 0)).comap
      (SVec.toLinearMap (SVec.associator U.toSVec V.toSVec W.toSVec).inv))).2
    (fun r s hrs u hu y hy => ?_) hx
  refine (tensorDeg_le_iff V W
    (S := ((U.tensorObj V).tensorDeg W (m + 0)).comap
      ((SVec.toLinearMap (SVec.associator U.toSVec V.toSVec W.toSVec).inv) ∘ₗ
        TensorProduct.mk k U.toSVec _ u))).2
    (fun a b hab v hv w hw => ?_) hy
  change (SVec.associator U.toSVec V.toSVec W.toSVec).inv (u ⊗ₜ (v ⊗ₜ w)) ∈
    (U.tensorObj V).tensorDeg W (m + 0)
  change (u ⊗ₜ v) ⊗ₜ w ∈ _
  subst hrs hab
  rw [add_zero, ← add_assoc]
  exact tmul_mem_tensorDeg (U.tensorObj V) W (tmul_mem_tensorDeg U V hu hv) hw

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSuperspace.leftUnitor_hom_mem_degHom
statement:
theorem leftUnitor_hom_mem_degHom (V : GradedSuperspace k) :
    (SVec.leftUnitor V.toSVec).hom ∈ degHom (unit.tensorObj V) V 0
proof:
:= by
  intro m x hx
  refine (tensorDeg_le_iff unit V
    (S := (V.deg (m + 0)).comap (SVec.toLinearMap (SVec.leftUnitor V.toSVec).hom))).2
    (fun r s hrs c hc v hv => ?_) hx
  rw [Submodule.mem_comap]
  change TensorProduct.lid k V.toSVec (c ⊗ₜ v) ∈ _
  rw [TensorProduct.lid_tmul, add_zero]
  by_cases hr : r = 0
  · subst hr; rw [zero_add] at hrs; subst hrs; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hv
  · rw [show (c • v : V.toSVec) = 0 by rw [eq_zero_of_mem_unit_deg hr hc]; exact zero_smul k v]
    exact Submodule.zero_mem _

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSuperspace.leftUnitor_inv_mem_degHom
statement:
theorem leftUnitor_inv_mem_degHom (V : GradedSuperspace k) :
    (SVec.leftUnitor V.toSVec).inv ∈ degHom V (unit.tensorObj V) 0
proof:
:= fun m v hv => by
  change (TensorProduct.lid k V.toSVec).symm v ∈ _
  rw [TensorProduct.lid_symm_apply, add_zero]
  have := tmul_mem_tensorDeg unit V (mem_unit_deg_zero (1 : k)) hv
  rwa [zero_add] at this

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSuperspace.rightUnitor_hom_mem_degHom
statement:
theorem rightUnitor_hom_mem_degHom (V : GradedSuperspace k) :
    (SVec.rightUnitor V.toSVec).hom ∈ degHom (V.tensorObj unit) V 0
proof:
:= by
  intro m x hx
  refine (tensorDeg_le_iff V unit
    (S := (V.deg (m + 0)).comap (SVec.toLinearMap (SVec.rightUnitor V.toSVec).hom))).2
    (fun r s hrs v hv c hc => ?_) hx
  rw [Submodule.mem_comap]
  change TensorProduct.rid k V.toSVec (v ⊗ₜ c) ∈ _
  rw [TensorProduct.rid_tmul, add_zero]
  by_cases hs : s = 0
  · subst hs; rw [add_zero] at hrs; subst hrs; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hv
  · rw [show (c • v : V.toSVec) = 0 by rw [eq_zero_of_mem_unit_deg hs hc]; exact zero_smul k v]
    exact Submodule.zero_mem _

name: StringDiagrams.GradedSuperspace.rightUnitor_inv_mem_degHom
statement:

proof:
:= fun m v hv => by
  change (TensorProduct.rid k V.toSVec).symm v ∈ _
  rw [TensorProduct.rid_symm_apply, add_zero]
  have := tmul_mem_tensorDeg V unit hv (mem_unit_deg_zero (1 : k))
  rwa [add_zero] at this

proof:
:= by
  intro a

    (counitPaste_middle F G) (counitPaste_target F G)
    (counitNaturalityPostcomposeAssemblyIso G F)
    (counitNaturalityPostcomposeAssemblyIso_hom_isHomogeneous G F) a
  have h₂ := TwoNatTrans.eqToIso_hom_isHomogeneous
    (comparison_transportBoundary _ _
      (((mapQPi_isGraded F.2).comp (counit_isGraded C)).comp G.2)
      (((counit_isGraded A).comp F.2).comp G.2)
      (postcompose_restrict_congr _ _ (counit_naturality_restrict F) G)
      (counitPaste_middle F G) (counitPaste_target F G)
      ((mapQPi_isGraded F.2).comp ((counit_isGraded C).comp G.2))
      ((counit_isGraded A).comp (F.2.comp G.2)) (counitPasteRight_restrict F G)) a

name: StringDiagrams.SOpMap.proj_whisk
statement:
theorem proj_whisk (p : ZMod 2) {a b : Obj S'} (f : Q.obj a ⟶ Q.obj b) (u : Obj S')
    (v : List S'.Colour) :
    proj R p (Q.whisk f u v) = Q.whisk (proj R p f) u v
proof:
:= by
  have hm : ∀ q, Q.whisk (proj R q f) u v ∈ parity (R := R) (Q.obj (a.whisker u v))
      (Q.obj (b.whisker u v)) q := fun q => by
    rw [hpar]
    exact Presentation.whisk_mem_homDeg (by rw [← hpar]; exact proj_mem q f) u v
  conv_lhs => rw [← proj_add_proj (R := R) f, Q.whisk_add]
  rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one p with rfl | rfl
  · rw [map_add, proj_of_mem (hm 0), proj_of_mem_ne (hm 1) (by decide), add_zero]
  · rw [map_add, proj_of_mem (hm 1), proj_of_mem_ne (hm 0) (by decide), zero_add]

name: StringDiagrams.SOpMap.twist_whisk
statement:
theorem twist_whisk (p : ZMod 2) {a b : Obj S'} (f : Q.obj a ⟶ Q.obj b) (u : Obj S')
    (v : List S'.Colour) :
    twist R p (Q.whisk f u v) = Q.whisk (twist R p f) u v
proof:
:= by
  rw [twist_apply, twist_apply, proj_whisk hpar, proj_whisk hpar, Q.whisk_add, Q.whisk_smul]

name: StringDiagrams.SOpMap.whisk_compC
statement:
theorem whisk_compC {a b c : Obj S'} (f : Q.obj b ⟶ Q.obj a) (g : Q.obj c ⟶ Q.obj b)
    (u : Obj S') (v : List S'.Colour) :
    Q.whisk (SOp.compC (R := R) f g) u v =
      SOp.compC (R := R) (Q.whisk f u v) (Q.whisk g u v)
proof:
:= by
  unfold SOp.compC
  rw [Q.whisk_add, Q.whisk_comp, Q.whisk_comp, proj_whisk hpar, proj_whisk hpar, twist_whisk hpar]

name: StringDiagrams.SOpMap.whisk_congr'
StringDiagrams.SOpMap.whisk_nil_eq_wRAt
statement:
private theorem whisk_nil_eq_wRAt {a a' : Obj S'} (f : Q.obj a ⟶ Q.obj a') {r : S'.Region}
    (b : Obj S') (ha : a.start = r) (ha' : a'.start = r) :
    Q.whisk f (Obj.nil r) b.word =
      eqToHom (congrArg Q.obj (Obj.tensor_eq_whisker_nil_of_start b ha)).symm ≫
        Q.wRAt r f b ha ha' ≫

statement:
theorem functor_map_ofLayer (L : Layer S) (hv : L.Valid) :
