name: StringDiagrams.SOpMap.layerImg_mem
statement:
theorem layerImg_mem
    (himg : ∀ g, img g ∈ Q.homDeg (Presentation.parityDeg S') (genCod κ g) (genDom κ g)
      (Presentation.parityDeg S g)) (L : Layer S) :
    layerImg κ img L ∈ parity (R := R) (Q.obj (κ.obj L.cod)) (Q.obj (κ.obj L.dom))
      (Presentation.parityDeg S L.gen)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hpar]
  have := Presentation.comp_mem_homDeg (Presentation.eqToHom_mem_homDeg (P := Q)
    (Presentation.parityDeg S') (congrArg Q.obj (whisker_genCod κ L)).symm)
    (Presentation.comp_mem_homDeg
      (Presentation.whisk_mem_homDeg (himg L.gen) (κ.obj ⟨L.start, L.left⟩) (κ.word L.right))
      (Presentation.eqToHom_mem_homDeg (P := Q) (Presentation.parityDeg S')
        (congrArg Q.obj (whisker_genDom κ L))))
  rwa [zero_add, add_zero] at this

name: StringDiagrams.SOpMap.compC_eqToHom
statement:
theorem compC_eqToHom {X X' Y Y' Z Z' : C} (hY : Y = Y') (A : Y' ⟶ X') (hX : X' = X)
    (hZ : Z = Z') (B : Z' ⟶ Y') :
    SOp.compC (R := R) (eqToHom hY ≫ A ≫ eqToHom hX) (eqToHom hZ ≫ B ≫ eqToHom hY.symm) =
      eqToHom hZ ≫ SOp.compC (R := R) A B ≫ eqToHom hX
proof:
:= by
  subst hX hY hZ; simp

name: StringDiagrams.SOpMap.genCod_whiskerOK
statement:
theorem genCod_whiskerOK {L : Layer S} (hv : L.Valid) :
    (genCod κ L.gen).WhiskerOK (κ.obj ⟨L.start, L.left⟩) (κ.word L.right)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨κ.ok_map hv.left_ok, ?_, ?_⟩
  · show S'.endR (κ.region L.start) (κ.word L.left) = κ.region (S.left L.gen)
    rw [κ.endR_map, hv.left_end]
  · show S'.ok (S'.endR (κ.region (S.left L.gen)) (κ.word (S.cod L.gen))) _
    rw [κ.endR_map, hv.cod_end]; exact κ.ok_map hv.right_ok

name: StringDiagrams.SOpMap.layerImg_whisker
statement:
theorem layerImg_whisker {u : Obj S} {v : List S.Colour} {L : Layer S} (hv : L.Valid)
    (hwL : L.dom.WhiskerOK u v) :
    layerImg κ img (L.whisker u v) =
      eqToHom (by rw [L.whisker_cod, κ.obj_whisker]) ≫
        Q.whisk (layerImg κ img L) (κ.obj u) (κ.word v) ≫
          eqToHom (by rw [L.whisker_dom, κ.obj_whisker])
proof:
:= by
  have hwc : L.cod.WhiskerOK u v := Chain.whiskerOK (ls := [L]) ⟨hv, rfl, rfl⟩ hwL
  have hw₀ := genCod_whiskerOK (κ := κ) hv
  have hw₁ : ((genCod κ L.gen).whisker (κ.obj ⟨L.start, L.left⟩)
      (κ.word L.right)).WhiskerOK (κ.obj u) (κ.word v) := by
    rw [whisker_genCod]; exact κ.whiskerOK hwc
  rw [layerImg, layerImg, Q.whisk_comp, Q.whisk_comp,
    Q.whisk_eqToHom (whisker_genCod κ L).symm _ _ (κ.whiskerOK hwc),
    Q.whisk_eqToHom (whisker_genDom κ L) _ _ (by rw [whisker_genDom]; exact κ.whiskerOK hwL),
    Q.whisk_whisk _ _ _ _ _ hw₀ hw₁,
    whisk_congr' (img L.gen) (u := (κ.obj u).tensor (κ.obj ⟨L.start, L.left⟩))
      (v := κ.word L.right ++ κ.word v) (u' := κ.obj ⟨(L.whisker u v).start,
      (L.whisker u v).left⟩) (v' := κ.word (L.whisker u v).right)
      (by simp [ColourMap.obj, Obj.tensor, Layer.whisker]) (by simp [Layer.whisker])]
  simp only [Category.assoc, eqToHom_trans, eqToHom_trans_assoc]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.SOpMap.layerImg_whisker'
statement:
theorem layerImg_whisker' {u : Obj S} {v : List S.Colour} {L : Layer S} (hv : L.Valid)
    (hwL : L.dom.WhiskerOK u v) {X Y : Obj S'} (hX : κ.obj (L.whisker u v).cod = X)
    (hY : κ.obj (L.whisker u v).dom = Y) :
    eqToHom (congrArg Q.obj hX).symm ≫ layerImg κ img (L.whisker u v) ≫ eqToHom (congrArg Q.obj hY) =
      eqToHom (by rw [← hX, L.whisker_cod, κ.obj_whisker]) ≫
        Q.whisk (layerImg κ img L) (κ.obj u) (κ.word v) ≫
          eqToHom (by rw [← hY, L.whisker_dom, κ.obj_whisker])
proof:
:= by
  subst hX hY
  rw [layerImg_whisker hv hwL]
  simp

name: StringDiagrams.SOpMap.unsop_eqToHom_comp
statement:
theorem unsop_eqToHom_comp {X Y Z : SOp R C} (h : X = Y) (f : Y ⟶ Z) :
    SOp.unsop (eqToHom h ≫ f) = SOp.unsop f ≫ eqToHom (congrArg SOp.unop h).symm

name: StringDiagrams.SOpMap.unsop_comp_eqToHom
statement:
theorem unsop_comp_eqToHom {X Y Z : SOp R C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (h : Y = Z) :
    SOp.unsop (f ≫ eqToHom h) = eqToHom (congrArg SOp.unop h).symm ≫ SOp.unsop f

name: StringDiagrams.SOpMap.functor_map_whisker_aux
statement:
theorem functor_map_whisker_aux (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour) :
    ∀ (ls : List (Layer S)) {c b : Obj S} (hc : Chain c ls b) (hwc : c.WhiskerOK u v),
      SOp.unsop ((functor κ img).map (Diagram.whisker (Diagram.mk ls hc) u v hwc)) =
        eqToHom (congrArg Q.obj (κ.obj_whisker b u v)) ≫
          Q.whisk (SOp.unsop ((functor κ img).map (Diagram.mk ls hc))) (κ.obj u) (κ.word v) ≫
            eqToHom (congrArg Q.obj (κ.obj_whisker c u v)).symm
proof:
:= by
  intro ls
  induction ls with
  | nil =>
    intro c b hc hwc
    cases hc
    rw [show Diagram.mk [] (rfl : Chain c [] c) = 𝟙 c from rfl, Diagram.whisker_id,
      CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id]
    change (𝟙 (Q.obj (κ.obj (c.whisker u v)))) = eqToHom _ ≫
      Q.whisk (𝟙 (Q.obj (κ.obj c))) (κ.obj u) (κ.word v) ≫ eqToHom _
    rw [Q.whisk_id _ _ _ (κ.whiskerOK hwc), Category.id_comp, eqToHom_trans, eqToHom_refl]
  | cons L ls ih =>
    intro c b hc hwc
    obtain ⟨hv, rfl, hc'⟩ := hc
    have e : Diagram.mk (L :: ls) (show Chain L.dom (L :: ls) b from ⟨hv, rfl, hc'⟩) =
        Diagram.ofLayer L hv ≫ Diagram.mk ls hc' := Diagram.ext rfl
    have hwc' : L.cod.WhiskerOK u v := Chain.whiskerOK (ls := [L]) ⟨hv, rfl, rfl⟩ hwc
    have hv' : (L.whisker u v).Valid := hv.whisker hwc
    have el : Diagram.whisker (Diagram.ofLayer L hv) u v hwc =
        Diagram.layer (L.whisker u v) hv' (L.whisker_dom u v) (L.whisker_cod u v) :=
      Diagram.ext rfl
    rw [e, Diagram.whisker_comp, Functor.map_comp, el, SOp.unsop_comp, ih hc' hwc',
      Functor.map_comp, SOp.unsop_comp, functor_map_ofLayer, whisk_compC hpar]
    have hl : SOp.unsop ((functor κ img).map (Diagram.layer (L.whisker u v) hv'
        (L.whisker_dom u v) (L.whisker_cod u v))) =
        eqToHom (congrArg Q.obj (congrArg κ.obj (L.whisker_cod u v)).symm) ≫
          layerImg κ img (L.whisker u v) ≫
            eqToHom (congrArg Q.obj (congrArg κ.obj (L.whisker_dom u v))) := by
      show SOp.unsop ((interp κ img).functor.map _) = _
      rw [Interpretation.functor_map_layer, unsop_eqToHom_comp, unsop_comp_eqToHom]
      simp only [Category.assoc]
      rfl
    rw [hl, layerImg_whisker' (img := img) hv hwc (congrArg κ.obj (L.whisker_cod u v))
      (congrArg κ.obj (L.whisker_dom u v))]
    exact compC_eqToHom _ _ _ _ _

name: StringDiagrams.SOpMap.functor_map_two
statement:
theorem functor_map_two
    (himg : ∀ g, img g ∈ Q.homDeg (Presentation.parityDeg S') (LocalMap.genCod κ g)
      (LocalMap.genDom κ g) (Presentation.parityDeg S g))
    {a b : Obj S} (L₁ L₂ : Layer S) (h : Chain a [L₁, L₂] b) :
    SOp.unsop ((functor κ img).map (Diagram.mk [L₁, L₂] h)) =
      ((Supercategory.koszulSign (Presentation.parityDeg S L₁.gen)
          (Presentation.parityDeg S L₂.gen) : ℤ) : R) •
        (eqToHom (congrArg (fun x => Q.obj (κ.obj x)) h.2.2.2.2.symm) ≫ layerImg κ img L₂ ≫
          eqToHom (congrArg (fun x => Q.obj (κ.obj x)) h.2.2.2.1) ≫ layerImg κ img L₁ ≫
            eqToHom (congrArg (fun x => Q.obj (κ.obj x)) h.2.1))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hv₁, rfl, hv₂, e₁₂, rfl⟩ := h
  have m₁ := layerImg_mem hpar himg L₁
  have m₂ : layerImg κ img L₂ ≫ eqToHom (congrArg (fun x => Q.obj (κ.obj x)) e₁₂) ∈
        parity (R := R) (Q.obj (κ.obj L₂.cod)) (Q.obj (κ.obj L₁.cod))
          (Presentation.parityDeg S L₂.gen) := by
    have he : eqToHom (congrArg (fun x => Q.obj (κ.obj x)) e₁₂) ∈
        parity (R := R) (Q.obj (κ.obj L₂.dom)) (Q.obj (κ.obj L₁.cod)) 0 := by
      rw [hpar]; exact Presentation.eqToHom_mem_homDeg _ _
    simpa using comp_mem (layerImg_mem hpar himg L₂) he
  show SOp.unsop ((interp κ img).functor.map _) = _
  erw [Interpretation.functor_map_mk_cons, Interpretation.functor_map_mk_cons,
    Interpretation.functor_map_mk_nil]
  simp only [eqToHom_refl, Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id]
  erw [Category.comp_id, SOp.unsop_comp, unsop_eqToHom_comp]
  change SOp.compC (R := R) (layerImg κ img L₁) (layerImg κ img L₂ ≫ _) = _
  refine (SOp.compC_of_mem m₁ m₂).trans ?_
  rw [Supercategory.sign_mul, Category.assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.SOpMap.ofGen_interchange
statement:
theorem ofGen_interchange
    (himg : ∀ g, img g ∈ Q.homDeg (Presentation.parityDeg S') (genCod κ g) (genDom κ g)
      (Presentation.parityDeg S g))
    {x : InterchangeData S} (hx : x.Valid) :
    (freeLift R (functor κ img)).map (InterchangeData.rel R hx) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hs : x.start = S.left x.g := hx.gh₁.left_end
  have e₀ : S.endR (S.right x.g) x.mid = S.left x.h := by
    have h₀ := hx.gh₁.left_end
    have h₁ := hx.hg₁.left_end
    have h₂ := hx.gh₁.dom_end
    simp only [InterchangeData.hg₁, InterchangeData.gh₁, Signature.endR_append,
      Signature.endR_nil] at h₀ h₁ h₂
    rwa [h₀, h₂] at h₁
  have hmok : S.ok (S.right x.g) x.mid := ((Signature.ok_append _ _ _).1 hx.gh₁.right_ok).1
  set r := κ.region (S.left x.g) with hr
  let A := genDom κ x.g
  let A' := genCod κ x.g
  let M : Obj S' := κ.obj ⟨S.right x.g, x.mid⟩
  let Dh := genDom κ x.h
  let Ch := genCod κ x.h
  have hMend : M.endR = κ.region (S.left x.h) := by
    show S'.endR (κ.region (S.right x.g)) (κ.word x.mid) = _
    rw [κ.endR_map, e₀]
  have hMD : M.Composable Dh := ⟨κ.ok_map hmok, hMend, κ.ok_map hx.hg₁.dom_ok⟩
  have hMC : M.Composable Ch := ⟨κ.ok_map hmok, hMend, κ.ok_map hx.hg₁.cod_ok⟩
  have hgd : S.endR (S.left x.g) (S.dom x.g) = S.right x.g := hx.gh₁.dom_end
  have hgc : S.endR (S.left x.g) (S.cod x.g) = S.right x.g := hx.gh₁.cod_end
  have hAM : A.Composable M := ⟨κ.ok_map hx.gh₁.dom_ok, by
    show S'.endR (κ.region (S.left x.g)) (κ.word (S.dom x.g)) = _
    rw [κ.endR_map, hgd]; rfl, κ.ok_map hmok⟩
  have hA'M : A'.Composable M := ⟨κ.ok_map hx.gh₁.cod_ok, by
    show S'.endR (κ.region (S.left x.g)) (κ.word (S.cod x.g)) = _
    rw [κ.endR_map, hgc]; rfl, κ.ok_map hmok⟩
  have hA : A.start = r := rfl
  have hA' : A'.start = r := rfl
  let G := Q.wL M (img x.h)
  have hG := Q.wL_mem (Presentation.parityDeg S') M (himg x.h)
  have key := Q.wRAt_comp_wL_super (hA'M.tensor_right hMC) (himg x.g) hG hA' hA
  have hk : ((Supercategory.koszulSign (Presentation.parityDeg S x.g)
      (Presentation.parityDeg S x.h) : ℤ) : R) = ((x.sign : ℤ) : R) := by
    congr 1
    unfold InterchangeData.sign Presentation.parityDeg
    cases S.odd x.g <;> cases S.odd x.h <;> simp
  have hk' : ((Supercategory.koszulSign (Presentation.parityDeg S x.hg₁.gen)
      (Presentation.parityDeg S x.hg₂.gen) : ℤ) : R) = ((x.sign : ℤ) : R) := by
    show ((Supercategory.koszulSign (Presentation.parityDeg S x.h)
      (Presentation.parityDeg S x.g) : ℤ) : R) = _
    rw [Supercategory.koszulSign_comm]; exact hk
  have hk₂ : ((Supercategory.koszulSign (Presentation.parityDeg S x.gh₁.gen)
      (Presentation.parityDeg S x.gh₂.gen) : ℤ) : R) = ((x.sign : ℤ) : R) := hk
  have oD : A.tensor (M.tensor Dh) = κ.obj x.dom := by
    refine Obj.ext (by simp [A, InterchangeData.dom, genDom, ColourMap.obj, Obj.tensor, hs]) ?_
    simp [A, M, Dh, InterchangeData.dom, genDom, ColourMap.obj, Obj.tensor]
  have oC : κ.obj x.cod = A'.tensor (M.tensor Ch) := by
    refine Obj.ext (by simp [A', InterchangeData.cod, genCod, ColourMap.obj, Obj.tensor, hs]) ?_
    simp [A', M, Ch, InterchangeData.cod, genCod, ColourMap.obj, Obj.tensor]
  have hgh : SOp.unsop ((functor κ img).map (InterchangeData.ghDiagram hx)) =
      ((x.sign : ℤ) : R) • (eqToHom (congrArg Q.obj oC) ≫
        (Q.wL A' G ≫ Q.wRAt r (img x.g) (M.tensor Dh) hA' hA) ≫ eqToHom (congrArg Q.obj oD)) := by
    unfold InterchangeData.ghDiagram
    rw [functor_map_two hpar himg, hk₂]
    congr 1
    rw [layerImg, layerImg,
      whisk_congr' (img x.gh₁.gen) (u' := Obj.nil r) (v' := (M.tensor Dh).word)
        (by simp [ColourMap.obj, InterchangeData.gh₁, Obj.nil, hs, r])
        (by simp [InterchangeData.gh₁, M, Dh, genDom, ColourMap.obj, Obj.tensor]),
      whisk_nil_eq_wRAt (img x.gh₁.gen) (M.tensor Dh) hA' hA,
      whisk_congr' (img x.gh₂.gen) (u' := A'.tensor M) (v' := [])
        (by simp [ColourMap.obj, InterchangeData.gh₂, A', M, genCod, Obj.tensor, hs])
        (by simp [InterchangeData.gh₂]),
      whisk_eq_wL (img x.gh₂.gen) (A'.tensor M), Q.wL_tensor hA'M hMC]
    simp only [Category.assoc, eqToHom_trans_assoc, eqToHom_trans, eqToHom_refl,
      Category.id_comp]
    rfl
  have hhg : SOp.unsop ((functor κ img).map (InterchangeData.hgDiagram hx)) =
      ((x.sign : ℤ) : R) • (eqToHom (congrArg Q.obj oC) ≫
        (Q.wRAt r (img x.g) (M.tensor Ch) hA' hA ≫ Q.wL A G) ≫ eqToHom (congrArg Q.obj oD)) := by
    unfold InterchangeData.hgDiagram
    rw [functor_map_two hpar himg, hk']
    congr 1
    rw [layerImg, layerImg,
      whisk_congr' (img x.hg₁.gen) (u' := A.tensor M) (v' := [])
        (by simp [ColourMap.obj, InterchangeData.hg₁, A, M, genDom, Obj.tensor, hs])
        (by simp [InterchangeData.hg₁]),
      whisk_eq_wL (img x.hg₁.gen) (A.tensor M), Q.wL_tensor hAM hMC,
      whisk_congr' (img x.hg₂.gen) (u' := Obj.nil r) (v' := (M.tensor Ch).word)
        (by simp [ColourMap.obj, InterchangeData.hg₂, Obj.nil, hs, r])
        (by simp [InterchangeData.hg₂, M, Ch, genCod, ColourMap.obj, Obj.tensor]),
      whisk_nil_eq_wRAt (img x.hg₂.gen) (M.tensor Ch) hA' hA]
    simp only [Category.assoc, eqToHom_trans_assoc, eqToHom_trans, eqToHom_refl,
      Category.id_comp]
    rfl
  have key' : Q.wRAt r (img x.g) (M.tensor Ch) hA' hA ≫ Q.wL A G =
      ((x.sign : ℤ) : R) • (Q.wL A' G ≫ Q.wRAt r (img x.g) (M.tensor Dh) hA' hA) := by
    rw [← hk, Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul]; exact key
  apply SOp.hom_ext
  rw [InterchangeData.rel, Functor.map_sub, Functor.map_smul, freeLift_map_of, freeLift_map_of,
    SOp.unsop_sub, SOp.unsop_smul, hgh, hhg, key', Linear.smul_comp, Linear.comp_smul, smul_smul,
    show ((x.sign : ℤ) : R) * ((x.sign : ℤ) : R) = 1 by
      unfold InterchangeData.sign; split_ifs <;> simp,
    one_smul, sub_self, SOp.unsop_zero]

name: StringDiagrams.SOpMap.functor_map_whisker
statement:
theorem functor_map_whisker {a b : Obj S} (d : a ⟶ b) (u : Obj S) (v : List S.Colour)
    (hw : a.WhiskerOK u v) :
    SOp.unsop ((functor κ img).map (Diagram.whisker d u v hw)) =
      eqToHom (congrArg Q.obj (κ.obj_whisker b u v)) ≫
        Q.whisk (SOp.unsop ((functor κ img).map d)) (κ.obj u) (κ.word v) ≫
          eqToHom (congrArg Q.obj (κ.obj_whisker a u v)).symm
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ls, hc⟩ := d
  exact functor_map_whisker_aux hpar u v ls hc hw

name: StringDiagrams.SOpMap.freeLift_whisker_eq_zero
statement:
theorem freeLift_whisker_eq_zero {a b : Obj S} (f : LinDiagram R a b) (u : Obj S)
    (v : List S.Colour) (hw : a.WhiskerOK u v) (hf : (freeLift R (functor κ img)).map f = 0) :
    (freeLift R (functor κ img)).map (LinDiagram.whisker f u v hw) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have := freeLift_map_mapDomain (F := functor κ img) (G := functor κ img)
    (fun d => Diagram.whisker d u v hw) (whiskT κ a b u v)
    (fun d => SOp.hom_ext (functor_map_whisker hpar d u v hw)) f
  exact this.trans (by rw [hf, map_zero])

name: StringDiagrams.SOpMap.respects
statement:
theorem respects
    (himg : ∀ g, img g ∈ Q.homDeg (Presentation.parityDeg S') (LocalMap.genCod κ g)
      (LocalMap.genDom κ g) (Presentation.parityDeg S g))
    (hrel : ∀ r, (freeLift R (functor κ img)).map (P.rel r) = 0) :
    P.Respects (functor κ img)
proof:
:=
  P.respects_of_whisker_on (fun _ : Unit => functor κ img) (fun _ => True) (fun _ => trivial)
    (fun _ _ => trivial)
    (fun _ _ _ f u v _ hw hf => freeLift_whisker_eq_zero hpar f u v hw (hf ()))
    (fun _ r => hrel r) (fun _ _ hx => ofGen_interchange hpar himg hx) ()

name: StringDiagrams.SOpMap.liftGen_obj
statement:
@[simp] theorem liftGen_obj (a : Obj S) :
    (liftGen hpar κ img P himg hrel).obj (P.obj a) = ⟨Q.obj (κ.obj a)⟩

name: StringDiagrams.SOpMap.liftGen_diag
statement:
theorem liftGen_diag {a b : Obj S} (d : a ⟶ b) :
    (liftGen hpar κ img P himg hrel).map (P.diag d) = (functor κ img).map d

name: StringDiagrams.SOpMap.liftGen_lin
statement:
theorem liftGen_lin {a b : Obj S} (f : LinDiagram R a b) :
    (liftGen hpar κ img P himg hrel).map (P.lin f) = (freeLift R (functor κ img)).map f

name: StringDiagrams.SOpMap.liftGen_layer
statement:
theorem liftGen_layer (L : Layer S) (hv : L.Valid) :
    SOp.unsop ((liftGen hpar κ img P himg hrel).map (P.diag (Diagram.ofLayer L hv))) =
      layerImg κ img L
proof:
:= by
  rw [liftGen_diag]; exact functor_map_ofLayer κ img L hv

name: StringDiagrams.SOpMap.liftGen_whisk
statement:
theorem liftGen_whisk {a b : Obj S} (f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b) {u : Obj S} {v : List S.Colour}
    (hw : a.WhiskerOK u v) :
    SOp.unsop ((liftGen hpar κ img P himg hrel).map (P.whisk f u v)) =
      eqToHom (congrArg Q.obj (κ.obj_whisker b u v)) ≫
        Q.whisk (SOp.unsop ((liftGen hpar κ img P himg hrel).map f)) (κ.obj u) (κ.word v) ≫
          eqToHom (congrArg Q.obj (κ.obj_whisker a u v)).symm
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, rfl⟩ := P.lin_surjective f
  rw [Presentation.whisk_lin, LinDiagram.whisk_of_ok _ hw, liftGen_lin, liftGen_lin]
  have := freeLift_map_mapDomain (F := functor κ img) (G := functor κ img)
    (fun d => Diagram.whisker d u v hw) (whiskT κ a b u v)
    (fun d => SOp.hom_ext (functor_map_whisker hpar d u v hw)) f
  exact congrArg SOp.unsop this

name: StringDiagrams.SOpMap.functor_map_mem
statement:
theorem functor_map_mem {a b : Obj S} (d : a ⟶ b) :
    (functor κ img).map d ∈ parity (R := R) ((functor κ img).obj a) ((functor κ img).obj b)
      (Diagram.degree (Presentation.parityDeg S) d)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ls, hc⟩ := d
  induction ls generalizing a with
  | nil =>
    cases hc
    change (functor κ img).map (𝟙 _) ∈ _
    rw [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id]
    exact Supercategory.id_mem _
  | cons L ls ih =>
    obtain ⟨hv, rfl, hc'⟩ := hc
    have e : (⟨L :: ls, hv, rfl, hc'⟩ : L.dom ⟶ b) = Diagram.ofLayer L hv ≫ ⟨ls, hc'⟩ :=
      Diagram.ext rfl
    rw [e, Functor.map_comp, Diagram.degree_comp, Diagram.degree_ofLayer]
    refine Supercategory.comp_mem ?_ (ih hc')
    rw [SOp.mem_parity_iff, functor_map_ofLayer]
    exact layerImg_mem hpar himg L

name: StringDiagrams.SOpMap.liftGen_mem
statement:
theorem liftGen_mem {a b : Obj S} {x : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b} {p : ZMod 2}
    (hx : x ∈ P.homDeg (Presentation.parityDeg S) a b p) :
    (liftGen hpar κ img P himg hrel).map x ∈
      parity (R := R) ((functor κ img).obj a) ((functor κ img).obj b) p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩ := Presentation.mem_homDeg_iff.mp hx
  clear hx
  rw [liftGen_lin]
  rw [LinDiagram.homDeg, Finsupp.supported_eq_span_single] at hf
  induction hf using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨d, hd, rfl⟩ := hy
    rw [freeLift_map_single]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (hd ▸ functor_map_mem hpar himg d)
  | zero => rw [Functor.map_zero]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  | add y z _ _ hy hz => rw [Functor.map_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hy hz
  | smul r y _ hy => rw [Functor.map_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ r hy

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.degree_parityDeg
statement:
theorem Diagram.degree_parityDeg {a b : Obj S} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    Diagram.degree (Presentation.parityDeg S) f = (Diagram.oddCount f : ZMod 2)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ls, h⟩ := f
  simp only [Diagram.degree, Diagram.oddCount, Diagram.layers]
  clear h
  induction ls with
  | nil => simp
  | cons L ls ih =>
    rw [Diagram.oddCountList_cons, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, ih, Nat.cast_add]
    congr 1
    by_cases hL : S.odd L.gen <;>
      simp [Presentation.parityDeg, Diagram.oddCountList, hL]

name: StringDiagrams.Diagram.neg_one_pow_oddCount
statement:
theorem Diagram.neg_one_pow_oddCount {a b a' b' : Obj S} (f : a ⟶ b) (g : a' ⟶ b')
    {p q : ZMod 2} (hf : Diagram.degree (Presentation.parityDeg S) f = p)
    (hg : Diagram.degree (Presentation.parityDeg S) g = q) :
    (-1 : ℤ) ^ (Diagram.oddCount f * Diagram.oddCount g) = koszulSign p q
proof:
:= by
  rw [← koszulSign_natCast, ← Diagram.degree_parityDeg, ← Diagram.degree_parityDeg, hf, hg]

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.isParityHomogeneous_of_isEven
statement:
theorem Presentation.isParityHomogeneous_of_isEven [S.IsEven] {R : Type w} [CommRing R]
    (P : Presentation.{w, v} S R) : P.IsParityHomogeneous
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  refine ⟨0, LinDiagram.mem_homDeg_iff.mpr fun g _ => ?_⟩
  rw [Diagram.degree_parityDeg, Diagram.oddCount_eq_zero, Nat.cast_zero]

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.homDeg_induction
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨F, hF, rfl⟩ := mem_homDeg_iff.mp hx
  clear hx
  rw [LinDiagram.homDeg, Finsupp.supported_eq_span_single] at hF
  induction hF using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩ := hy
    exact diag f hf
  | zero => rw [lin_zero]; exact zero
  | add y z _ _ hy hz => rw [lin_add]; exact add _ _ hy hz
  | smul r y _ hy => rw [lin_smul]; exact smul r _ hy

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.eqToHom_mem_homDeg
statement:
theorem eqToHom_mem_homDeg {A : Type*} [AddCommMonoid A] (deg : S.Gen → A) {a b : Obj S}
    (h : P.obj a = P.obj b) : eqToHom h ∈ P.homDeg deg a b 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [P.eqToHom_obj h]
  exact diag_mem_homDeg' (Diagram.degree_eqToHom deg _)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.wL_mem
proof:
:= by
  have := comp_mem_homDeg (eqToHom_mem_homDeg (P := P) deg (congrArg P.obj
    (Obj.tensor_eq_whisker_nil a b))) (comp_mem_homDeg (whisk_mem_homDeg hg a [])
      (eqToHom_mem_homDeg (P := P) deg (congrArg P.obj (Obj.tensor_eq_whisker_nil a b').symm)))
  rwa [zero_add, add_zero] at this

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.wRAt_mem
statement:
theorem wRAt_mem {A : Type*} [AddCommMonoid A] (deg : S.Gen → A) (r : S.Region) {a a' : Obj S}
    {d : A} {f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj a'} (hf : f ∈ P.homDeg deg a a' d) (b : Obj S)
    (ha : a.start = r) (ha' : a'.start = r) :
    P.wRAt r f b ha ha' ∈ P.homDeg deg (a.tensor b) (a'.tensor b) d
proof:
:= by
  have := comp_mem_homDeg (eqToHom_mem_homDeg (P := P) deg (congrArg P.obj
    (Obj.tensor_eq_whisker_nil_of_start b ha))) (comp_mem_homDeg
      (whisk_mem_homDeg hf (Obj.nil r) b.word) (eqToHom_mem_homDeg (P := P) deg
        (congrArg P.obj (Obj.tensor_eq_whisker_nil_of_start b ha').symm)))
  rwa [zero_add, add_zero] at this

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.wRAt_comp_wL_super
statement:
theorem wRAt_comp_wL_super {a a' b b' : Obj S} {r : S.Region} (h : a.Composable b)
    {p q : ZMod 2} {f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj a'} {g : P.obj b ⟶ P.obj b'}
    (hf : f ∈ P.homDeg (parityDeg S) a a' p) (hg : g ∈ P.homDeg (parityDeg S) b b' q)
    (ha : a.start = r) (ha' : a'.start = r) :
    P.wRAt r f b ha ha' ≫ P.wL a' g = koszulSign p q • (P.wL a g ≫ P.wRAt r f b' ha ha')
proof:
:= by
  refine homDeg_induction (motive := fun f =>
    P.wRAt r f b ha ha' ≫ P.wL a' g = koszulSign p q • (P.wL a g ≫ P.wRAt r f b' ha ha'))
    (fun d hd => ?_) (by simp [wRAt_zero]) (fun f f' hf hf' => ?_) (fun x f hf => ?_) hf
  · refine homDeg_induction (motive := fun g => P.wRAt r (P.diag d) b ha ha' ≫ P.wL a' g =
      koszulSign p q • (P.wL a g ≫ P.wRAt r (P.diag d) b' ha ha'))
      (fun e he => ?_) (by simp [wL_zero]) (fun g g' hg hg' => ?_) (fun x g hg => ?_) hg
    · rw [P.wRAt_diag_comp_wL_diag h d e, Diagram.neg_one_pow_oddCount d e hd he]
    · simp only [wL_add, Preadditive.add_comp, Preadditive.comp_add, hg, hg', smul_add]
    · simp only [wL_smul, Linear.smul_comp, Linear.comp_smul, hg, smul_comm x]
  · simp only [wRAt_add, Preadditive.add_comp, Preadditive.comp_add, hf, hf', smul_add]
  · simp only [wRAt_smul, Linear.smul_comp, Linear.comp_smul, hf, smul_comm x]

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.wR_mem
proof:
:= by
  have := comp_mem_homDeg (eqToHom_mem_homDeg (P := P) deg (congrArg P.obj
    (Obj.tensor_eq_whisker_unit a b))) (comp_mem_homDeg (whisk_mem_homDeg hf Obj.unit b.word)
      (eqToHom_mem_homDeg (P := P) deg (congrArg P.obj (Obj.tensor_eq_whisker_unit a' b).symm)))
  rwa [zero_add, add_zero] at this

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.wR_comp_wL_super
statement:
theorem wR_comp_wL_super {a a' b b' : Obj S} {p q : ZMod 2} {f : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj a'}
    {g : P.obj b ⟶ P.obj b'} (hf : f ∈ P.homDeg (parityDeg S) a a' p)
    (hg : g ∈ P.homDeg (parityDeg S) b b' q) :
    P.wR f b ≫ P.wL a' g = koszulSign p q • (P.wL a g ≫ P.wR f b')
proof:
:= by
  refine homDeg_induction (motive := fun f =>
    P.wR f b ≫ P.wL a' g = koszulSign p q • (P.wL a g ≫ P.wR f b'))
    (fun d hd => ?_) (by simp [wR_zero]) (fun f f' hf hf' => ?_) (fun x f hf => ?_) hf
  · refine homDeg_induction (motive := fun g => P.wR (P.diag d) b ≫ P.wL a' g =
      koszulSign p q • (P.wL a g ≫ P.wR (P.diag d) b'))
      (fun e he => ?_) (by simp [wL_zero]) (fun g g' hg hg' => ?_) (fun x g hg => ?_) hg
    · rw [wR_diag, wR_diag, wL_diag, wL_diag, ← diag_comp, ← diag_comp,
        P.diag_interchange_diagrams, Diagram.neg_one_pow_oddCount d e hd he]
    · simp only [wL_add, Preadditive.add_comp, Preadditive.comp_add, hg, hg', smul_add]
    · simp only [wL_smul, Linear.smul_comp, Linear.comp_smul, hg, smul_comm x]
  · simp only [wR_add, Preadditive.add_comp, Preadditive.comp_add, hf, hf', smul_add]
  · simp only [wR_smul, Linear.smul_comp, Linear.comp_smul, hf, smul_comm x]

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.monoidalSupercategory
statement:
theorem monoidalSupercategory (hP : P.IsParityHomogeneous) :
    letI := P.supercategory hP
    MonoidalSupercategory R P.Presented
proof:
:=
  letI := P.supercategory hP
  { tensorHom_def := fun _ _ => rfl
    whiskerLeft_id := fun X Y => P.wL_id (P.toObj X) (P.toObj Y)
    id_whiskerRight := fun X Y => P.wR_id (P.toObj X) (P.toObj Y)
    whiskerLeft_comp := fun X _ _ _ f g => P.wL_comp (P.toObj X) f g
    comp_whiskerRight := fun f g W => P.wR_comp f g (P.toObj W)
    whiskerLeft_add := fun X _ _ f g => P.wL_add (P.toObj X) f g
    add_whiskerRight := fun f g Z => P.wR_add f g (P.toObj Z)
    whiskerLeft_smul := fun X _ _ r f => P.wL_smul (P.toObj X) r f
    smul_whiskerRight := fun r f Z => P.wR_smul r f (P.toObj Z)
    whiskerLeft_mem := fun X _ _ _ _ hf => P.wL_mem (parityDeg S) (P.toObj X) hf
    whiskerRight_mem := fun Z hf => P.wR_mem (parityDeg S) hf (P.toObj Z)
    super_interchange := fun hf hg => P.wR_comp_wL_super hf hg
    associator_naturality := fun {X₁ X₂ X₃ Y₁ Y₂ Y₃} f₁ f₂ f₃ =>
      P.associator_naturality_aux (a₁ := P.toObj X₁) (a₂ := P.toObj X₂) (a₃ := P.toObj X₃)
        (b₁ := P.toObj Y₁) (b₂ := P.toObj Y₂) (b₃ := P.toObj Y₃) f₁ f₂ f₃
    leftUnitor_naturality := fun {X Y} f => P.unit_wL (b := P.toObj X) (b' := P.toObj Y) f
    rightUnitor_naturality := fun {X Y} f => P.wR_unit (a := P.toObj X) (a' := P.toObj Y) f
    pentagon := fun W X Y Z => P.pentagon_aux (P.toObj W) (P.toObj X) (P.toObj Y) (P.toObj Z)
    triangle := fun X Y => P.triangle_aux (P.toObj X) (P.toObj Y)
    associator_hom_mem := fun _ _ _ =>
      eqToHom_mem_homDeg (P := P) _ (congrArg P.obj (Obj.tensor_assoc _ _ _))
    leftUnitor_hom_mem := fun _ =>
      eqToHom_mem_homDeg (P := P) _ (congrArg P.obj (Obj.unit_tensor _))
    rightUnitor_hom_mem := fun _ =>
      eqToHom_mem_homDeg (P := P) _ (congrArg P.obj (Obj.tensor_unit _)) }

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.noOdd_of_isEven
statement:
theorem noOdd_of_isEven [S.IsEven] :
    letI := P.supercategory P.isParityHomogeneous_of_isEven
    MonoidalSupercategory.NoOdd R P.Presented
proof:
:= by
  intro X Y
  rw [eq_bot_iff]
  intro x hx
  rw [Submodule.mem_bot]
  refine homDeg_induction (motive := fun x => x = 0) (fun f hf => ?_) rfl
    (fun x y hx hy => by rw [hx, hy, add_zero]) (fun r x hx => by rw [hx, smul_zero]) hx
  rw [Diagram.degree_parityDeg, Diagram.oddCount_eq_zero] at hf
  exact absurd hf (by decide)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.toMonoidalCategory_eq
statement:
theorem toMonoidalCategory_eq [S.IsEven] :
    letI := P.supercategory P.isParityHomogeneous_of_isEven
    letI := P.monoidalSupercategory P.isParityHomogeneous_of_isEven
    MonoidalSupercategory.toMonoidalCategory R P.noOdd_of_isEven = P.instMonoidalCategory

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.Bicat.isoOfEq_hom_mem
statement:
theorem Bicat.isoOfEq_hom_mem {l m : P.Bicat} (hP : P.IsParityHomogeneous) {a b : l ⟶ m}
    (e : Bicat.Hom.obj a = Bicat.Hom.obj b) :
    letI := Bicat.supercategory hP l m
    ((Bicat.isoOfEq e).hom : a ⟶ b) ∈ parity (R := R) a b 0

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.twoSupercategory
statement:
theorem twoSupercategory (hP : P.IsParityHomogeneous) :
    letI := Bicat.supercategory hP
    TwoSupercategory R P.Bicat
proof:
:=
  letI := Bicat.supercategory hP
  { whiskerLeft_id := fun a b => P.wL_id_of_composable (Bicat.Hom.composable a b)
    whiskerLeft_comp := fun a _ _ _ η θ => P.wL_comp (Bicat.Hom.obj a) η θ
    id_whiskerLeft := fun {_ _} {a b} η =>
      P.wL_nil η (Bicat.Hom.wf a) (Bicat.Hom.start_eq a) (Bicat.Hom.start_eq b)
    comp_whiskerLeft := fun a b _ _ η =>
      P.wL_tensor (Bicat.Hom.composable a b) (Bicat.Hom.composable b _) η
    id_whiskerRight := fun a b =>
      P.wRAt_id (Bicat.Hom.start_eq a) (Bicat.Hom.obj b) (Bicat.Hom.composable a b).ok_endR
    comp_whiskerRight := fun η θ c => P.wRAt_comp _ _ _ η θ (Bicat.Hom.obj c)
    whiskerRight_id := fun {_ _} {a a'} η =>
      P.wRAt_nil η (Bicat.Hom.wf a) (Bicat.Hom.endR_eq a) (Bicat.Hom.start_eq a)
        (Bicat.Hom.start_eq a')
    whiskerRight_comp := fun {_ _ _ _} {a _} η b c =>
      P.wRAt_tensor (Bicat.Hom.composable a b) (Bicat.Hom.composable b c) η _ _
    whisker_assoc := fun {_ _ _ _} a {b b'} η c =>
      P.wRAt_wL (Bicat.Hom.composable a b) (Bicat.Hom.composable b c) η (Bicat.Hom.start_eq a)
        (Bicat.Hom.start_eq b) (Bicat.Hom.start_eq b')
    pentagon := fun a b c d => Bicat.pentagon_aux a b c d
    triangle := fun a b => Bicat.triangle_aux a b
    whiskerLeft_add := fun a _ _ η θ => P.wL_add (Bicat.Hom.obj a) η θ
    add_whiskerRight := fun η θ c => P.wRAt_add _ _ η θ (Bicat.Hom.obj c)
    whiskerLeft_smul := fun a _ _ r η => P.wL_smul (Bicat.Hom.obj a) r η
    smul_whiskerRight := fun r η c => P.wRAt_smul _ _ r η (Bicat.Hom.obj c)
    whiskerLeft_mem := fun a _ _ _ _ hη => P.wL_mem (parityDeg S) (Bicat.Hom.obj a) hη
    whiskerRight_mem := fun {l _ _} {a a'} _ _ c hη =>
      P.wRAt_mem (parityDeg S) l.region hη (Bicat.Hom.obj c) (Bicat.Hom.start_eq a)
        (Bicat.Hom.start_eq a')
    super_interchange := fun {_ _ _} {a a'} {b _} _ _ _ _ hη hθ =>
      P.wRAt_comp_wL_super (Bicat.Hom.composable a b) hη hθ (Bicat.Hom.start_eq a)
        (Bicat.Hom.start_eq a')
    associator_hom_mem := fun _ _ _ => Bicat.isoOfEq_hom_mem hP _
    leftUnitor_hom_mem := fun _ => Bicat.isoOfEq_hom_mem hP _
    rightUnitor_hom_mem := fun _ => Bicat.isoOfEq_hom_mem hP _ }

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.Bicat.noOdd_of_isEven
statement:
theorem Bicat.noOdd_of_isEven [S.IsEven] :
    letI := Bicat.supercategory P.isParityHomogeneous_of_isEven
    TwoSupercategory.NoOdd R P.Bicat
proof:
:= by
  intro l m a b
  rw [eq_bot_iff]
  intro x hx
  rw [Submodule.mem_bot]
  refine homDeg_induction (motive := fun x => x = 0) (fun f hf => ?_) rfl
    (fun x y hx hy => by rw [hx, hy, add_zero]) (fun r x hx => by rw [hx, smul_zero]) hx
  rw [Diagram.degree_parityDeg, Diagram.oddCount_eq_zero] at hf
  exact absurd hf (by decide)

name: StringDiagrams.Presentation.toBicategory_eq
statement:
theorem toBicategory_eq [S.IsEven] :
    letI := Bicat.supercategory P.isParityHomogeneous_of_isEven
    letI := P.twoSupercategory P.isParityHomogeneous_of_isEven
    TwoSupercategory.toBicategory R Bicat.noOdd_of_isEven = P.instBicategory

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.parity_eq_zero_or_one
statement: theorem parity_eq_zero_or_one (p : ZMod 2) : p = 0 ∨ p = 1

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.koszulSign_zero_left
statement: @[simp] theorem koszulSign_zero_left (q : ZMod 2) : koszulSign 0 q = 1

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.koszulSign_zero_right
statement: @[simp] theorem koszulSign_zero_right (p : ZMod 2) : koszulSign p 0 = 1

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.koszulSign_one_one
statement: @[simp] theorem koszulSign_one_one : koszulSign 1 1 = -1

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.koszulSign_comm
statement: theorem koszulSign_comm (p q : ZMod 2) : koszulSign p q = koszulSign q p

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.koszulSign_add_left
statement:
theorem koszulSign_add_left (p p' q : ZMod 2) :
    koszulSign (p + p') q = koszulSign p q * koszulSign p' q
proof:
:= by
  revert p p' q; decide

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.koszulSign_add_right
statement:
theorem koszulSign_add_right (p q q' : ZMod 2) :
    koszulSign p (q + q') = koszulSign p q * koszulSign p q'
proof:
:= by
  revert p q q'; decide

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.koszulSign_mul_self
statement: theorem koszulSign_mul_self (p q : ZMod 2) : koszulSign p q * koszulSign p q = 1

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.koszulSign_eq_one_or
statement: theorem koszulSign_eq_one_or (p q : ZMod 2) : koszulSign p q = 1 ∨ (p = 1 ∧ q = 1)

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.koszulSign_natCast
statement: theorem koszulSign_natCast (n m : ℕ) : koszulSign (n : ZMod 2) (m : ZMod 2) = (-1) ^ (n * m)
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.even_or_odd n with hn | hn <;> rcases Nat.even_or_odd m with hm | hm
  · rw [(ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff_even.mpr hn), koszulSign_zero_left, (hn.mul_right m).neg_one_pow]
  · rw [(ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff_even.mpr hn), koszulSign_zero_left, (hn.mul_right m).neg_one_pow]
  · rw [(ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff_even.mpr hm), koszulSign_zero_right, (hm.mul_left n).neg_one_pow]
  · rw [(ZMod.natCast_eq_one_iff_odd.mpr hn), (ZMod.natCast_eq_one_iff_odd.mpr hm), koszulSign_one_one,
      (hn.mul hm).neg_one_pow]

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.koszulSign_smul_smul
statement:
theorem koszulSign_smul_smul {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] (p q : ZMod 2) (x : M) :
    koszulSign p q • koszulSign p q • x = x

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.IsSuperfunctor.map_isHomogeneous
StringDiagrams.Supercategory.SuperNatTrans.id_app_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem id_app_zero (F : C ⥤ D) (X : C) : (id (R := R) F).app 0 X = 𝟙 (F.obj X)

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.SuperNatTrans.id_app_one
statement: @[simp] theorem id_app_one (F : C ⥤ D) (X : C) : (id (R := R) F).app 1 X = 0

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.SuperNatTrans.id_total
statement: theorem id_total (F : C ⥤ D) (X : C) : (id (R := R) F).total X = 𝟙 (F.obj X)

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.SuperNatTrans.vcomp_total
statement:
theorem vcomp_total (x : SuperNatTrans R F G) (y : SuperNatTrans R G H) (X : C) :
    (x.vcomp y).total X = x.total X ≫ y.total X
proof:
:= by
  simp only [total, vcomp, Preadditive.add_comp, Preadditive.comp_add]
  rw [(by decide : (0 : ZMod 2) + 1 = 1), (by decide : (1 : ZMod 2) + 1 = 0)]
  abel

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.SuperNatTrans.toNatTrans_app
statement: @[simp] theorem toNatTrans_app [F.Additive] [G.Additive] (x : SuperNatTrans R F G) (X : C) : x.toNatTrans.app X = x.app 0 X

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.SuperNatTrans.ofNatTrans_isHomogeneous
statement:
theorem ofNatTrans_isHomogeneous [F.Additive] [F.Linear R] [G.Additive] [G.Linear R]
    (α : F ⟶ G) (h : ∀ X, α.app X ∈ parity (R := R) (F.obj X) (G.obj X) 0) :
    (ofNatTrans α h).IsHomogeneous 0
proof:
:= by
  intro q hq
  funext X
  simp [ofNatTrans, hq]

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.SuperNatTrans.ofNatTrans_toNatTrans
statement:
@[simp] theorem ofNatTrans_toNatTrans [F.Additive] [F.Linear R] [G.Additive] [G.Linear R]
    (α : F ⟶ G) (h : ∀ X, α.app X ∈ parity (R := R) (F.obj X) (G.obj X) 0) :
    (ofNatTrans α h).toNatTrans = α

name: StringDiagrams.PiSOp.correction_twice
statement:
theorem correction_twice (a b : ZMod 2) {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    correction (R := R) a b (correction (R := R) a b f) = f
proof:
:= by
  change sign R (a * (a + b)) • twist R (a + b)
    (sign R (a * (a + b)) • twist R (a + b) f) = f
  rw [map_smul, twist_twist, sign_smul_sign_smul]

name: StringDiagrams.PiSOp.bridge_obj_surjective
statement: theorem bridge_obj_surjective : Function.Surjective (bridge (R := R) (C := C)).obj

name: StringDiagrams.PiSOp.bridge_gradedEvenlyDense
statement: theorem bridge_gradedEvenlyDense : GradedEvenlyDense R (bridge (R := R) (C := C))
proof:
:= by
  intro Y
  obtain ⟨X, hX⟩ := bridge_obj_surjective Y
  subst Y
  exact ⟨X, Iso.refl _, id_mem _, id_mem_degree _⟩

name: StringDiagrams.laurentToSeries_C
statement:
@[simp] theorem laurentToSeries_C (a : Zπ) :
    laurentToSeries (LaurentPolynomial.C a) = HahnSeries.C a

name: StringDiagrams.laurentToSeries_T_one
statement:
theorem laurentToSeries_T_one :
    laurentToSeries (LaurentPolynomial.T 1) = HahnSeries.single 1 1

name: StringDiagrams.laurentToSeries_T_neg_one
statement:
theorem laurentToSeries_T_neg_one :
    laurentToSeries (LaurentPolynomial.T (-1)) = HahnSeries.single (-1) 1

name: StringDiagrams.K₀.piInvolution_eq_laurentEnd
statement:
theorem piInvolution_eq_laurentEnd (x : K₀ A) :
    piInvolution R A x = laurentEnd R A (LaurentPolynomial.C Zπ.π) x

name: StringDiagrams.K₀.piInvolution_laurentEnd
statement:
theorem piInvolution_laurentEnd (r : LaurentPolynomial Zπ) (x : K₀ A) :
    piInvolution R A (laurentEnd R A r x) = laurentEnd R A r (piInvolution R A x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [piInvolution_eq_laurentEnd, piInvolution_eq_laurentEnd]
  have h : laurentEnd R A (LaurentPolynomial.C Zπ.π) * laurentEnd R A r =
      laurentEnd R A r * laurentEnd R A (LaurentPolynomial.C Zπ.π) := by
    rw [← map_mul, ← map_mul, mul_comm (LaurentPolynomial.C Zπ.π) r]
  exact congrArg (fun φ : AddMonoid.End (K₀ A) => φ x) h

name: StringDiagrams.GSKar.homCoeff_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem homCoeff_mk (P X : GSKar k C) (n : ℤ) :
    homCoeff k P n (K₀.mk X) = finrank k ((shiftFunctor n).obj P ⟶ X)

name: StringDiagrams.GSKar.homCoeff_mk_Q
statement:
theorem homCoeff_mk_Q (P X : GSKar k C) (n : ℤ) :
    homCoeff k P n (K₀.mk ((QPiCategory.Q (R := k)).obj X)) = homCoeff k P (n - 1) (K₀.mk X)
proof:
:= by
  rw [homCoeff_mk, homCoeff_mk, (homQEquiv _ X).finrank_eq,
    (Linear.homCongr k (qinvShiftIso P n) (Iso.refl X)).finrank_eq]

name: StringDiagrams.GSKar.homCoeff_T_one_smul
statement:
theorem homCoeff_T_one_smul (P : GSKar k C) (n : ℤ) (x : K₀ (GSKar k C)) :
    letI := moduleLaurent k C
    homCoeff k P n ((LaurentPolynomial.T 1 : LaurentPolynomial Zπ) • x) =
      homCoeff k P (n - 1) x
proof:
:= by
  let := moduleLaurent k C
  have : (homCoeff k P n).comp (K₀.laurentEnd k (GSKar k C) (LaurentPolynomial.T 1)) =
      homCoeff k P (n - 1) := K₀.hom_ext fun X => by
    change homCoeff k P n ((LaurentPolynomial.T 1 : LaurentPolynomial Zπ) • K₀.mk X) = _
    rw [K₀.T_smul_mk, homCoeff_mk_Q]
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun this x

name: StringDiagrams.GSKar.homCoeff_T_neg_one_smul
statement:
theorem homCoeff_T_neg_one_smul (P : GSKar k C) (n : ℤ) (x : K₀ (GSKar k C)) :
    letI := moduleLaurent k C
    homCoeff k P n ((LaurentPolynomial.T (-1) : LaurentPolynomial Zπ) • x) =
      homCoeff k P (n + 1) x
proof:
:= by
  let := moduleLaurent k C
  conv_rhs => rw [← one_smul (LaurentPolynomial Zπ) x, ← LaurentPolynomial.T_zero,
    show (0 : ℤ) = 1 + -1 by norm_num, LaurentPolynomial.T_add, mul_smul,
    homCoeff_T_one_smul, add_sub_cancel_right]

name: StringDiagrams.GSKar.homCoeff_eventually_zero
statement:
theorem homCoeff_eventually_zero (h : HomBoundedBelow (k := k) (C := C)) (P : GSKar k C)
    (x : K₀ (GSKar k C)) : ∃ N : ℤ, ∀ n < N, homCoeff k P n x = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨X, Y, rfl⟩ := K₀.exists_eq_mk_sub_mk x
  obtain ⟨N₁, h₁⟩ := shift_hom_boundedBelow h P X
  obtain ⟨N₂, h₂⟩ := shift_hom_boundedBelow h P Y
  refine ⟨min N₁ N₂, fun n hn => ?_⟩
  have := h₁ n (lt_of_lt_of_le hn (min_le_left _ _))
  have := h₂ n (lt_of_lt_of_le hn (min_le_right _ _))
  rw [map_sub, homCoeff_mk, homCoeff_mk, Module.finrank_zero_of_subsingleton,
    Module.finrank_zero_of_subsingleton, sub_self]

name: StringDiagrams.GSKar.superCoeff_apply
statement:
theorem superCoeff_apply (P : GSKar k C) (n : ℤ) (x : K₀ (GSKar k C)) :
    superCoeff k P n x = (homCoeff k P n x : Zπ) +
      (homCoeff k P n (K₀.piInvolution k (GSKar k C) x) : Zπ) * Zπ.π

name: StringDiagrams.GSKar.coeff_pairing
statement:
@[simp] theorem coeff_pairing (h : HomBoundedBelow (k := k) (C := C)) (P : GSKar k C)
    (x : K₀ (GSKar k C)) (n : ℤ) :
    (pairing k h P x).coeff n = superCoeff k P n x

name: StringDiagrams.GSKar.pairing_T_one_smul
statement:
theorem pairing_T_one_smul (h : HomBoundedBelow (k := k) (C := C)) (P : GSKar k C)
    (x : K₀ (GSKar k C)) :
    letI := moduleLaurent k C
    pairing k h P ((LaurentPolynomial.T 1 : LaurentPolynomial Zπ) • x) =
      HahnSeries.single 1 1 * pairing k h P x
proof:
:= by
  let := moduleLaurent k C
  ext n
  have hc : (HahnSeries.single (1 : ℤ) (1 : Zπ) * pairing k h P x).coeff n =
      (pairing k h P x).coeff (n - 1) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [show n = (n - 1) + 1 by ring]
    rw [HahnSeries.coeff_single_mul_add, one_mul]
  rw [hc, coeff_pairing, coeff_pairing, superCoeff_apply, superCoeff_apply,
    homCoeff_T_one_smul]
  congr 3
  change homCoeff k P n (K₀.piInvolution k (GSKar k C)
    (K₀.laurentEnd k (GSKar k C) (LaurentPolynomial.T 1) x)) = _
  rw [← homCoeff_T_one_smul]
  exact congrArg _ (K₀.piInvolution_laurentEnd k (GSKar k C) _ x)

name: StringDiagrams.GSKar.pairing_T_neg_one_smul
statement:
theorem pairing_T_neg_one_smul (h : HomBoundedBelow (k := k) (C := C)) (P : GSKar k C)
    (x : K₀ (GSKar k C)) :
    letI := moduleLaurent k C
    pairing k h P ((LaurentPolynomial.T (-1) : LaurentPolynomial Zπ) • x) =
      HahnSeries.single (-1) 1 * pairing k h P x
proof:
:= by
  let := moduleLaurent k C
  ext n
  have hc : (HahnSeries.single (-1 : ℤ) (1 : Zπ) * pairing k h P x).coeff n =
      (pairing k h P x).coeff (n + 1) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [show n = (n + 1) + -1 by ring]
    rw [HahnSeries.coeff_single_mul_add, one_mul]
  rw [hc, coeff_pairing, coeff_pairing, superCoeff_apply, superCoeff_apply,
    homCoeff_T_neg_one_smul]
  congr 3
  change homCoeff k P n (K₀.piInvolution k (GSKar k C)
    (K₀.laurentEnd k (GSKar k C) (LaurentPolynomial.T (-1)) x)) = _
  rw [← homCoeff_T_neg_one_smul]
  exact congrArg _ (K₀.piInvolution_laurentEnd k (GSKar k C) _ x)

name: StringDiagrams.GSKar.pairing_π_smul
statement:
theorem pairing_π_smul (h : HomBoundedBelow (k := k) (C := C)) (P : GSKar k C)
    (x : K₀ (GSKar k C)) :
    letI := moduleLaurent k C
    pairing k h P ((LaurentPolynomial.C Zπ.π : LaurentPolynomial Zπ) • x) =
      HahnSeries.C Zπ.π * pairing k h P x
proof:
:= by
  let := moduleLaurent k C
  have hx : (LaurentPolynomial.C Zπ.π : LaurentPolynomial Zπ) • x =
      K₀.piInvolution k (GSKar k C) x :=
    (K₀.piInvolution_eq_laurentEnd k (GSKar k C) x).symm
  ext n
  rw [hx, HahnSeries.C_mul_eq_smul, HahnSeries.coeff_smul, coeff_pairing, coeff_pairing,
    superCoeff_apply, superCoeff_apply, K₀.piInvolution_piInvolution, smul_eq_mul]
  linear_combination (-((homCoeff k P n (K₀.piInvolution k (GSKar k C) x) : ℤ) : Zπ)) *
    Zπ.π_mul_π

name: StringDiagrams.GSKar.pairing_smul
statement:
theorem pairing_smul (h : HomBoundedBelow (k := k) (C := C)) (P : GSKar k C)
    (r : LaurentPolynomial Zπ) (x : K₀ (GSKar k C)) :
    letI := moduleLaurent k C
    pairing k h P (r • x) = laurentToSeries r * pairing k h P x
proof:
:= by
  let := moduleLaurent k C
  let M : LaurentPolynomial Zπ → Prop := fun r =>
    ∀ x, pairing k h P (r • x) = laurentToSeries r * pairing k h P x
  have hmul : ∀ {r s}, M r → M s → M (r * s) := fun hr hs x => by
    rw [mul_smul, hr, hs, map_mul]
    exact (mul_assoc (laurentToSeries _) (laurentToSeries _) (pairing k h P x)).symm
  have hadd : ∀ {r s}, M r → M s → M (r + s) := fun hr hs x => by
    rw [add_smul, map_add, hr, hs, map_add]
    ring
  have hint : ∀ m : ℤ, M (m : LaurentPolynomial Zπ) := fun m x => by
    rw [Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul, map_zsmul, map_intCast]
    exact zsmul_eq_mul (pairing k h P x) m
  have hC : ∀ a : Zπ, M (LaurentPolynomial.C a) := by
    intro a
    obtain ⟨m, b, rfl⟩ := Zπ.exists_eq_add_mul_π a
    rw [map_add, map_mul, map_intCast, map_intCast]
    exact hadd (hint m) (hmul (hint b) fun x => by rw [pairing_π_smul, laurentToSeries_C])
  have hT1 : M (LaurentPolynomial.T 1) := fun x => by
    rw [pairing_T_one_smul, laurentToSeries_T_one]
  have hTm1 : M (LaurentPolynomial.T (-1)) := fun x => by
    rw [pairing_T_neg_one_smul, laurentToSeries_T_neg_one]
  revert x
  induction r using LaurentPolynomial.induction_on with
  | h_C a => exact hC a
  | h_add hp hq => exact hadd hp hq
  | h_C_mul_T n a ih =>
    rw [LaurentPolynomial.T_add, ← mul_assoc]
    exact hmul ih hT1
  | h_C_mul_T_Z n a ih =>
    have e : (LaurentPolynomial.T (-(n : ℤ) - 1) : LaurentPolynomial Zπ) =
        LaurentPolynomial.T (-(n : ℤ)) * LaurentPolynomial.T (-1) := by
      rw [← LaurentPolynomial.T_add]
      congr 1
    rw [e, ← mul_assoc]
    exact hmul ih hTm1

name: StringDiagrams.GSKar.homCoeff_of
statement:
theorem homCoeff_of (X Y : C) (n : ℤ) (p : ZMod 2) :
    homCoeff k (of k X 0 0) n (K₀.mk (of k Y 0 p)) =
      finrank k ↥(degree (R := k) X Y n ⊓ Supercategory.parity (R := k) X Y p)
proof:
:= by
  rw [homCoeff_mk, (Linear.homCongr k (shiftOfIso X 0 n 0) (Iso.refl _)).finrank_eq]
  refine congrArg _ ((((homOfEquiv (⟨⟨⟨0, ⟨0 + n, X⟩⟩⟩⟩ : ShiftBase k C) ⟨⟨⟨p, ⟨0, Y⟩⟩⟩⟩).trans
    (baseHomEquiv X Y (0 + n) 0 0 p)).finrank_eq).trans ?_)
  rw [zero_add, sub_zero, zero_add]

name: StringDiagrams.GSKar.superCoeff_of
statement:
theorem superCoeff_of (X Y : C) (n : ℤ) :
    superCoeff k (of k X 0 0) n (K₀.mk (of k Y 0 0)) =
      (finrank k ↥(degree (R := k) X Y n ⊓ Supercategory.parity (R := k) X Y 0) : Zπ) +
        (finrank k ↥(degree (R := k) X Y n ⊓ Supercategory.parity (R := k) X Y 1) : Zπ) * Zπ.π
proof:
:= by
  rw [superCoeff_apply, K₀.piInvolution_mk, K₀.mk_eq_mk_of_iso (piOfIso Y 0 0), zero_add,
    homCoeff_of, homCoeff_of]
  rfl

StringDiagrams.BoxProd.homDeg_le_iff
statement:
theorem homDeg_le_iff {X Y : BoxProd k C D} {n : ℤ} {S : Submodule k (X ⟶ Y)} :
    homDeg X Y n ≤ S ↔ ∀ (r s : ℤ), r + s = n → ∀ f ∈ degree (R := k) X.fst Y.fst r,
      ∀ g ∈ degree (R := k) X.snd Y.snd s, tmulHom f g ∈ S

    [Module k M] (φ : (X ⟶ Y) →ₗ[k] M) (S : Submodule k M)
    (h : ∀ (r s : ℤ), r + s = n → ∀ f ∈ degree (R := k) X.fst Y.fst r,
      ∀ g ∈ degree (R := k) X.snd Y.snd s, φ (tmulHom f g) ∈ S)
    {x : X ⟶ Y} (hx : x ∈ homDeg X Y n) : φ x ∈ S

name: StringDiagrams.BoxProd.proj_eq_homObj_proj
statement:
theorem proj_eq_homObj_proj {X Y : BoxProd k C D} (p : ZMod 2) (x : X ⟶ Y) :
    proj k p x = (homObj k X Y).proj p x
proof:
:= by
  refine proj_eq_of_add ?_ (mem_parity_iff.2 (SVec.proj_mem_part (homObj k X Y) p x))
    (mem_parity_iff.2 (SVec.proj_mem_part (homObj k X Y) (p + 1) x))
  rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one p with rfl | rfl
  · exact (LinearMap.congr_fun (SVec.proj_add_proj (homObj k X Y)) x).symm
  · rw [SVec.zmod2_one_add_one]
    exact (LinearMap.congr_fun (SVec.proj_add_proj (homObj k X Y)) x).symm.trans (add_comm _ _)

name: StringDiagrams.BoxProd.proj_mem_homDeg
statement:
theorem proj_mem_homDeg {X Y : BoxProd k C D} {n : ℤ} {x : X ⟶ Y} (p : ZMod 2)
    (hx : x ∈ homDeg X Y n) : proj k p x ∈ homDeg X Y n
proof:
:= by
  rw [proj_eq_homObj_proj]
  exact ((homGSpace k C X.fst Y.fst).tensorObj (homGSpace k D X.snd Y.snd)).proj_mem p hx

name: StringDiagrams.BoxProd.tmulHom_comp_tmulHom_eq
statement:
theorem tmulHom_comp_tmulHom_eq {X Y Z : BoxProd k C D} (f : X.fst ⟶ Y.fst) (g : X.snd ⟶ Y.snd)
    (h : Y.fst ⟶ Z.fst) (l : Y.snd ⟶ Z.snd) :
    tmulHom f g ≫ tmulHom h l =
      tmulHom (proj k 0 f ≫ h) (g ≫ l) + tmulHom (proj k 1 f ≫ h) (g ≫ twist k 1 l)
proof:
:=
  compMap_tmul_tmul X Y Z f g h l

name: StringDiagrams.BoxProd.comp_mem_homDeg
statement:
theorem comp_mem_homDeg {X Y Z : BoxProd k C D} {m n : ℤ} {x : X ⟶ Y} {y : Y ⟶ Z}
    (hx : x ∈ homDeg X Y m) (hy : y ∈ homDeg Y Z n) : x ≫ y ∈ homDeg X Z (m + n)
proof:
:= by
  refine map_mem_of_homDeg ((compMap X Y Z).flip y) _ (fun r s hrs f hf g hg => ?_) hx
  change compMap X Y Z (tmulHom f g) y ∈ _
  refine map_mem_of_homDeg (compMap X Y Z (tmulHom f g)) _
    (fun r' s' hrs' h hh l hl => ?_) hy
  change tmulHom f g ≫ tmulHom h l ∈ _
  rw [tmulHom_comp_tmulHom_eq, show m + n = (r + r') + (s + s') by omega]
  exact Submodule.add_mem _
    (tmulHom_mem_homDeg (X := X) (Y := Z) (comp_mem_degree (proj_mem_degree 0 hf) hh)
      (comp_mem_degree hg hl))
    (tmulHom_mem_homDeg (X := X) (Y := Z) (comp_mem_degree (proj_mem_degree 1 hf) hh)
      (comp_mem_degree hg (twist_mem_degree 1 hl)))

name: StringDiagrams.BoxProd.map_mem_of_degree₃
statement:
theorem map_mem_of_degree₃ {X Y : BoxProd k (BoxProd k C D) E} {n : ℤ} {M : Type*}
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module k M] (φ : (X ⟶ Y) →ₗ[k] M) (S : Submodule k M)
    (h : ∀ (a b c : ℤ), a + b + c = n → ∀ f ∈ degree (R := k) X.fst.fst Y.fst.fst a,
      ∀ g ∈ degree (R := k) X.fst.snd Y.fst.snd b, ∀ l ∈ degree (R := k) X.snd Y.snd c,
      φ (tmulHom (tmulHom (X := X.fst) (Y := Y.fst) f g) l) ∈ S)
    {x : X ⟶ Y} (hx : x ∈ degree (R := k) X Y n) : φ x ∈ S
proof:
:=
  map_mem_of_homDeg φ S (fun r c hrc v hv l hl =>
    map_mem_of_homDeg (X := X.fst) (Y := Y.fst)
      (φ ∘ₗ (TensorProduct.mk k (X.fst ⟶ Y.fst) (X.snd ⟶ Y.snd)).flip l) S
      (fun a b hab f hf g hg => h a b c (by rw [hab, hrc]) f hf g hg l hl) hv) hx

name: StringDiagrams.BoxProd.map_mem_of_degree₃'
statement:
theorem map_mem_of_degree₃' {X Y : BoxProd k C (BoxProd k D E)} {n : ℤ} {M : Type*}
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module k M] (φ : (X ⟶ Y) →ₗ[k] M) (S : Submodule k M)
    (h : ∀ (a b c : ℤ), a + b + c = n → ∀ f ∈ degree (R := k) X.fst Y.fst a,
      ∀ g ∈ degree (R := k) X.snd.fst Y.snd.fst b, ∀ l ∈ degree (R := k) X.snd.snd Y.snd.snd c,
      φ (tmulHom (X := X) (Y := Y) f (tmulHom (X := X.snd) (Y := Y.snd) g l)) ∈ S)
    {x : X ⟶ Y} (hx : x ∈ degree (R := k) X Y n) : φ x ∈ S
proof:
:=
  map_mem_of_homDeg φ S (fun a r har f hf v hv =>
    map_mem_of_homDeg (X := X.snd) (Y := Y.snd)
      (φ ∘ₗ TensorProduct.mk k (X.fst ⟶ Y.fst) (X.snd ⟶ Y.snd) f) S
      (fun b c hbc g hg l hl => h a b c (by rw [add_assoc, hbc, har]) f hf g hg l hl) hv) hx

name: StringDiagrams.CoveringLaurent.pair_ne
statement: private theorem pair_ne (i j : PairRep σ) : σ j.val ≠ i.val
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h' : σ i.val = j.val := by rw [← h, hσ]
  exact lt_asymm i.property (by simpa only [h', h] using j.property)

name: StringDiagrams.CoveringLaurent.pair_ne_fixed
statement: private theorem pair_ne_fixed (i : PairRep σ) (j : FixedRep σ) : i.val ≠ j.val
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hi := i.property
  rw [h, j.property] at hi
  exact lt_irrefl _ hi

name: StringDiagrams.CoveringLaurent.pair_pi_ne_fixed
statement: private theorem pair_pi_ne_fixed (i : PairRep σ) (j : FixedRep σ) : σ i.val ≠ j.val
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  apply pair_ne_fixed σ i j
  have := congrArg σ h
  simpa only [hσ i.val, j.property] using this

name: StringDiagrams.CoveringLaurent.repr_pair
statement:
theorem repr_pair (z : S) (j : PairRep σ) (a d : R)
    (hz : z = inclusion a + inclusion d * pi) (i : PairRep σ) :
    b.repr (z • b j.val) i.val = if j = i then a else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [hz, add_smul, mul_smul, hb]
  change b.repr (a • b j.val + d • b (σ j.val)) i.val = _
  simp only [map_add, map_smul, Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.smul_apply,
    Basis.repr_self, Finsupp.single_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  simp [pair_ne σ hσ i j, Subtype.ext_iff]

name: StringDiagrams.CoveringLaurent.repr_pair_pi
statement:
theorem repr_pair_pi (z : S) (j : PairRep σ) (a d : R)
    (hz : z = inclusion a + inclusion d * pi) (i : PairRep σ) :
    b.repr (z • b j.val) (σ i.val) = if j = i then d else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [hz, add_smul, mul_smul, hb]
  change b.repr (a • b j.val + d • b (σ j.val)) (σ i.val) = _
  simp only [map_add, map_smul, Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.smul_apply,
    Basis.repr_self, Finsupp.single_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  have hne : j.val ≠ σ i.val := (pair_ne σ hσ j i).symm
  simp [hne, hσ.injective.eq_iff, Subtype.ext_iff]

name: StringDiagrams.CoveringLaurent.repr_pair_fixed
statement:
theorem repr_pair_fixed (z : S) (j : PairRep σ) (i : FixedRep σ) :
    b.repr (z • b j.val) i.val = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, d, rfl⟩ := exists_pair z
  rw [add_smul, mul_smul, hb]
  change b.repr (a • b j.val + d • b (σ j.val)) i.val = 0
  simp [pair_ne_fixed σ j i, pair_pi_ne_fixed σ hσ j i]

name: StringDiagrams.CoveringLaurent.fixed_smul
statement:
theorem fixed_smul (z : S) (i : FixedRep σ) :
    z • b i.val = (augmentation z : R) • b i.val
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, d, rfl⟩ := exists_pair z
  rw [add_smul, mul_smul, hb, i.property]
  change a • b i.val + d • b i.val = augmentation (inclusion a + inclusion d * pi) • b i.val
  simp only [map_add, map_mul, eval_inclusion, eval_pi, map_one, mul_one, add_smul]

name: StringDiagrams.CoveringLaurent.decompositionMap_pair_single
statement:
@[simp] theorem decompositionMap_pair_single (i : PairRep σ) (z : S) :
    decompositionMap b σ hb (Finsupp.single i z, 0) = z • b i.val

name: StringDiagrams.CoveringLaurent.decompositionMap_fixed_single
statement:
@[simp] theorem decompositionMap_fixed_single (i : FixedRep σ) (r : R) :
    decompositionMap b σ hb (0, Finsupp.single i r) = (r : R) • b i.val

name: StringDiagrams.CoveringLaurent.decompositionMap_apply
statement:
theorem decompositionMap_apply (p : PairRep σ →₀ S) (q : FixedRep σ →₀ R) :
    decompositionMap b σ hb (p, q) =
      p.sum (fun i z => z • b i.val) + q.sum (fun i r => (r : R) • b i.val)

name: StringDiagrams.CoveringLaurent.repr_fixed_pair
statement:
private theorem repr_fixed_pair (r : R) (j : FixedRep σ) (i : PairRep σ) :
    b.repr (r • b j.val) i.val = 0

name: StringDiagrams.CoveringLaurent.repr_fixed_pair_pi
statement:
private theorem repr_fixed_pair_pi (r : R) (j : FixedRep σ) (i : PairRep σ) :
    b.repr (r • b j.val) (σ i.val) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [(pair_pi_ne_fixed σ hσ i j).symm]

name: StringDiagrams.CoveringLaurent.repr_fixed_fixed
statement:
private theorem repr_fixed_fixed (r : R) (j i : FixedRep σ) :
    b.repr (r • b j.val) i.val = if j = i then r else 0

name: StringDiagrams.CoveringLaurent.decompositionMap_ker
statement:
theorem decompositionMap_ker (p : PairRep σ →₀ S) (q : FixedRep σ →₀ R)
    (h : decompositionMap b σ hb (p, q) = 0) : p = 0 ∧ q = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  choose a d hd using fun j => exists_pair (p j)
  constructor
  · apply Finsupp.ext
    intro i
    by_cases hi : i ∈ p.support
    · have h₁ := congrArg (fun x => b.repr x i.val) h
      have h₂ := congrArg (fun x => b.repr x (σ i.val)) h
      simp only [decompositionMap_apply, Finsupp.sum, map_add, map_sum,
        Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.finsetSum_apply, map_zero, Finsupp.zero_apply,
        repr_pair b σ hσ hb _ _ _ _ (hd _) i, repr_fixed_pair b σ] at h₁
      simp only [decompositionMap_apply, Finsupp.sum, map_add, map_sum,
        Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.finsetSum_apply, map_zero, Finsupp.zero_apply,
        repr_pair_pi b σ hσ hb _ _ _ _ (hd _) i, repr_fixed_pair_pi b σ hσ] at h₂
      simp only [Finset.sum_const_zero, add_zero, Finset.sum_ite_eq', hi, ite_true] at h₁ h₂
      rw [hd, h₁, h₂]
      simp
    · simpa only [Finsupp.zero_apply] using Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.1 hi
  · apply Finsupp.ext
    intro i
    by_cases hi : i ∈ q.support
    · have hq := congrArg (fun x => b.repr x i.val) h
      simp only [decompositionMap_apply, Finsupp.sum, map_add, map_sum,
        Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.finsetSum_apply, map_zero, Finsupp.zero_apply,
        repr_pair_fixed b σ hσ hb, repr_fixed_fixed b σ] at hq
      simpa only [Finset.sum_const_zero, zero_add, Finset.sum_ite_eq', hi, ite_true,
        Finsupp.zero_apply] using hq
    · simpa only [Finsupp.zero_apply] using Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.1 hi

name: StringDiagrams.CoveringLaurent.decompositionMap_surjective
statement: theorem decompositionMap_surjective : Function.Surjective (decompositionMap b σ hb)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let L := decompositionMap b σ hb
  have hi (i : ι) : b i ∈ LinearMap.range L := by
    rcases lt_trichotomy i (σ i) with h | h | h
    · refine ⟨(Finsupp.single ⟨i, h⟩ 1, 0), ?_⟩
      simp [L]
    · refine ⟨(0, Finsupp.single ⟨i, h.symm⟩ 1), ?_⟩
      simp [L]
    · refine ⟨(Finsupp.single ⟨σ i, by simpa only [hσ i] using h⟩ pi, 0), ?_⟩
      simp only [L, decompositionMap_pair_single, hb, hσ i]
  intro x
  change x ∈ LinearMap.range L
  rw [← b.linearCombination_repr x]
  change (b.repr x).sum (fun i r => (r : R) • b i) ∈ LinearMap.range L
  exact Submodule.sum_mem _ (fun i _ =>
    (LinearMap.range L).smul_mem (inclusion (b.repr x i)) (hi i))

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoFunctor.IsPiTwoNatural.precomp
statement:
theorem IsPiTwoNatural.precomp {P : Pseudofunctor B C} (hP : PiTwoFunctor R P)
    {F G : Pseudofunctor C D} {hF : PiTwoFunctor R F} {hG : PiTwoFunctor R G}
    {η : Oplax.OplaxTrans F.toOplax G.toOplax} (hη : hF.IsPiTwoNatural hG η) :
    (hP.comp hF).IsPiTwoNatural (hP.comp hG) (Oplax.OplaxTrans.precomp P η)
proof:
:= fun a =>
  Oplax.OplaxTrans.precomp_central (fun f => (PiTwoCategory.β (R := R) f).hom) P hP.j hF.j
    hG.j η hη a

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoFunctor.IsPiTwoNatural.postcomp
proof:
:= fun a =>
  Oplax.OplaxTrans.postcomp_central (fun f => (PiTwoCategory.β (R := R) f).hom)
    (fun f => (PiTwoCategory.β (R := R) f).hom) H hF.j hG.j hH.j hH.β_comm η hη a

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoFunctor.IsQPiTwoNatural.precomp
statement:
theorem IsQPiTwoNatural.precomp {P : Pseudofunctor B C} (hP : QPiTwoFunctor R P)
    {F G : Pseudofunctor C D} {hF : QPiTwoFunctor R F} {hG : QPiTwoFunctor R G}
    {η : Oplax.OplaxTrans F.toOplax G.toOplax} (hη : hF.IsQPiTwoNatural hG η) :
    (hP.comp hF).IsQPiTwoNatural (hP.comp hG) (Oplax.OplaxTrans.precomp P η)
proof:
:=
  ⟨hη.1.precomp hP.toPiTwoFunctor, fun a =>
    Oplax.OplaxTrans.precomp_central (fun f => (QPiTwoCategory.γ (R := R) f).hom) P hP.k hF.k
      hG.k η hη.2 a⟩

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoFunctor.IsQPiTwoNatural.postcomp
proof:
:=
  ⟨hη.1.postcomp hH.toPiTwoFunctor, fun a =>
    Oplax.OplaxTrans.postcomp_central (fun f => (QPiTwoCategory.γ (R := R) f).hom)
      (fun f => (QPiTwoCategory.γ (R := R) f).hom) H hF.k hG.k hH.k hH.γ_comm η hη.2 a⟩

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.toOplaxTrans_precompose
statement:
theorem toOplaxTrans_precompose (P : TwoSuperfunctor R A A') {F G : TwoSuperfunctor R A' A''}
    (θ : TwoNatTrans F G) :
    (θ.precompose P).toOplaxTrans = (Oplax.OplaxTrans.precomp P.toPseudofunctor
      (F := F.toPseudofunctor) (G := G.toPseudofunctor) θ.toOplaxTrans :
        (P.comp F).toOplax ⟶ (P.comp G).toOplax)

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.toOplaxTrans_postcompose
statement:
theorem toOplaxTrans_postcompose {F G : TwoSuperfunctor R A A'} (θ : TwoNatTrans F G)
    (H : TwoSuperfunctor R A' A'') :
    (θ.postcompose H).toOplaxTrans = (Oplax.OplaxTrans.postcomp (F := F.toPseudofunctor)
      (G := G.toPseudofunctor) θ.toOplaxTrans H.toPseudofunctor :
        (F.comp H).toOplax ⟶ (G.comp H).toOplax)

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.toOplaxTrans_toDegreeZero2_precompose
statement:
theorem toOplaxTrans_toDegreeZero2_precompose {P : TwoSuperfunctor R A A'}
    {F G : TwoSuperfunctor R A' A''} (hP : P.IsGraded) (hF : F.IsGraded) (hG : G.IsGraded)
    (θ : TwoNatTrans F G) (hθ : θ.IsGraded) :
    ((θ.precompose P).toDegreeZero2 (hP.comp hF) (hP.comp hG)
        (precompose_isGraded P hθ)).toOplaxTrans =
      (Oplax.OplaxTrans.precomp (P.toDegreeZero2 hP).toPseudofunctor
        (F := (F.toDegreeZero2 hF).toPseudofunctor) (G := (G.toDegreeZero2 hG).toPseudofunctor)
        (θ.toDegreeZero2 hF hG hθ).toOplaxTrans :
          ((P.comp F).toDegreeZero2 (hP.comp hF)).toOplax ⟶
            ((P.comp G).toDegreeZero2 (hP.comp hG)).toOplax)

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.toOplaxTrans_toDegreeZero2_postcompose
statement:
theorem toOplaxTrans_toDegreeZero2_postcompose {F G : TwoSuperfunctor R A A'}
    {H : TwoSuperfunctor R A' A''} (hF : F.IsGraded) (hG : G.IsGraded) (hH : H.IsGraded)
    (θ : TwoNatTrans F G) (hθ : θ.IsGraded) :
    ((θ.postcompose H).toDegreeZero2 (hF.comp hH) (hG.comp hH)
        (postcompose_isGraded H hH hθ)).toOplaxTrans =
      (Oplax.OplaxTrans.postcomp (F := (F.toDegreeZero2 hF).toPseudofunctor)
        (G := (G.toDegreeZero2 hG).toPseudofunctor) (θ.toDegreeZero2 hF hG hθ).toOplaxTrans
        (H.toDegreeZero2 hH).toPseudofunctor :
          ((F.comp H).toDegreeZero2 (hF.comp hH)).toOplax ⟶
            ((G.comp H).toDegreeZero2 (hG.comp hH)).toOplax)

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoSCat.toPiTwoCat_isSesquiEquivalence
statement:
theorem toPiTwoCat_isSesquiEquivalence :
    (toPiTwoCat : PiTwoSCat.{w, w₁, v₁, u₁} R ⥤ PiTwoCat.{w, w₁, v₁, u₁} R).IsEquivalence ∧
      (∀ {A A' : PiTwoSCat.{w, w₁, v₁, u₁} R} (F G : TwoSuperfunctor R A A'),
        Function.Bijective (fun θ : TwoNatTrans F G =>
          (⟨θ.toOplaxTrans, θ.isPiTwoNatural⟩ : { η : F.toOplax ⟶ G.toOplax //
            F.toPiTwoFunctor.IsPiTwoNatural G.toPiTwoFunctor η }))) ∧
      (∀ {A A' A'' : PiTwoSCat.{w, w₁, v₁, u₁} R} (P : TwoSuperfunctor R A A')
        {F G : TwoSuperfunctor R A' A''} (θ : TwoNatTrans F G),
        (θ.precompose P).toOplaxTrans = (Oplax.OplaxTrans.precomp P.toPseudofunctor
          (F := F.toPseudofunctor) (G := G.toPseudofunctor) θ.toOplaxTrans :
            (P.comp F).toOplax ⟶ (P.comp G).toOplax)) ∧
      (∀ {A A' A'' : PiTwoSCat.{w, w₁, v₁, u₁} R} {F G : TwoSuperfunctor R A A'}
        (θ : TwoNatTrans F G) (H : TwoSuperfunctor R A' A''),
        (θ.postcompose H).toOplaxTrans = (Oplax.OplaxTrans.postcomp (F := F.toPseudofunctor)
          (G := G.toPseudofunctor) θ.toOplaxTrans H.toPseudofunctor :
            (F.comp H).toOplax ⟶ (G.comp H).toOplax))
proof:
:=
  ⟨toPiTwoCat_isTwoEquivalence.1, toPiTwoCat_isTwoEquivalence.2,
    fun P _ _ θ => TwoNatTrans.toOplaxTrans_precompose P θ,
    fun θ H => TwoNatTrans.toOplaxTrans_postcompose θ H⟩

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoGSCat.toQPiTwoCat_isSesquiEquivalence
statement:
theorem toQPiTwoCat_isSesquiEquivalence :
    (toQPiTwoCat : QPiTwoGSCat.{w, w₁, v₁, u₁} R ⥤ QPiTwoCat.{w, w₁, v₁, u₁} R).IsEquivalence ∧
      (∀ {A A' : QPiTwoGSCat.{w, w₁, v₁, u₁} R} (F G : A ⟶ A'),
        Function.Bijective (fun θ : { θ : TwoNatTrans F.1 G.1 // θ.IsGraded } =>
          (⟨(θ.1.toDegreeZero2 F.2 G.2 θ.2).toOplaxTrans, θ.1.isQPiTwoNatural F.2 G.2 θ.2⟩ :
            { η : Oplax.OplaxTrans (F.1.toDegreeZero2 F.2).toPseudofunctor.toOplax
                (G.1.toDegreeZero2 G.2).toPseudofunctor.toOplax //
              (F.1.toQPiTwoFunctor F.2).IsQPiTwoNatural (G.1.toQPiTwoFunctor G.2) η }))) ∧
      (∀ {A A' A'' : QPiTwoGSCat.{w, w₁, v₁, u₁} R} (P : A ⟶ A') (F G : A' ⟶ A'')
        (θ : TwoNatTrans F.1 G.1) (hθ : θ.IsGraded),
        ((θ.precompose P.1).toDegreeZero2 (P.2.comp F.2) (P.2.comp G.2)
            (TwoNatTrans.precompose_isGraded P.1 hθ)).toOplaxTrans =
          (Oplax.OplaxTrans.precomp (P.1.toDegreeZero2 P.2).toPseudofunctor
            (F := (F.1.toDegreeZero2 F.2).toPseudofunctor)
            (G := (G.1.toDegreeZero2 G.2).toPseudofunctor)
            (θ.toDegreeZero2 F.2 G.2 hθ).toOplaxTrans :
              ((P.1.comp F.1).toDegreeZero2 (P.2.comp F.2)).toOplax ⟶
                ((P.1.comp G.1).toDegreeZero2 (P.2.comp G.2)).toOplax)) ∧
      (∀ {A A' A'' : QPiTwoGSCat.{w, w₁, v₁, u₁} R} (F G : A ⟶ A') (H : A' ⟶ A'')
        (θ : TwoNatTrans F.1 G.1) (hθ : θ.IsGraded),
        ((θ.postcompose H.1).toDegreeZero2 (F.2.comp H.2) (G.2.comp H.2)
            (TwoNatTrans.postcompose_isGraded H.1 H.2 hθ)).toOplaxTrans =
          (Oplax.OplaxTrans.postcomp (F := (F.1.toDegreeZero2 F.2).toPseudofunctor)
            (G := (G.1.toDegreeZero2 G.2).toPseudofunctor)
            (θ.toDegreeZero2 F.2 G.2 hθ).toOplaxTrans (H.1.toDegreeZero2 H.2).toPseudofunctor :
              ((F.1.comp H.1).toDegreeZero2 (F.2.comp H.2)).toOplax ⟶
                ((G.1.comp H.1).toDegreeZero2 (G.2.comp H.2)).toOplax))
proof:
:=
  ⟨toQPiTwoCat_isTwoEquivalence.1, toQPiTwoCat_isTwoEquivalence.2,
    fun P F G θ hθ => TwoNatTrans.toOplaxTrans_toDegreeZero2_precompose P.2 F.2 G.2 θ hθ,
    fun F G H θ hθ => TwoNatTrans.toOplaxTrans_toDegreeZero2_postcompose F.2 G.2 H.2 θ hθ⟩

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.postcomposeInverseDensityX_mem
statement:
theorem postcomposeInverseDensityX_mem {a b : QPiTwoEnvelope R B} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    postcomposeInverseDensityX T hT G f ∈ parity (R := R) _ _ 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [postcomposeInverseDensityX, zero_add] using! comp_mem
    (rightUnitor_hom_mem (R := R) _)
    (comp_mem (G.1.map₂_mem (extendRestrictAppInv_mem T hT f))
      (inv_mem _ (leftUnitor_hom_mem (R := R) _)))

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.postcomposeInverseDensityX_naturality
statement:
theorem postcomposeInverseDensityX_naturality {a b : QPiTwoEnvelope R B}
    {f g : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ g) :
    G.1.map₂ (T.map₂ η) ▷ 𝟙 (G.1.obj (T.obj b)) ≫
        postcomposeInverseDensityX T hT G g =
      postcomposeInverseDensityX T hT G f ≫ 𝟙 (G.1.obj (T.obj a)) ◁ G.1.map₂ ((extend (restrict T)).map₂ η)
proof:
:= by
  unfold postcomposeInverseDensityX
  erw [rightUnitor_naturality_assoc R, ← reassoc_of% G.1.map₂_comp,
    extendRestrictAppInv_naturality, G.1.map₂_comp]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  erw [leftUnitor_inv_naturality R (G.1.map₂ ((extend (restrict T)).map₂ η))]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.postcomposeInverseDensity_isGraded
statement: theorem postcomposeInverseDensity_isGraded : (postcomposeInverseDensity T hT G).IsGraded
proof:
:= by
  intro a b f
  simpa only [postcomposeInverseDensity, postcomposeInverseDensityX, zero_add] using! comp_mem_degree
    (GradedTwoSupercategory.rightUnitor_hom_mem_degree (R := R) _)
    (comp_mem_degree (G.2.map₂_mem_degree (extendRestrictAppInv_mem_degree T hT f))
      (GradedTwoSupercategory.leftUnitor_inv_mem_degree (R := R) _))

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.postcomposeInverseDensity_isStrong
statement: theorem postcomposeInverseDensity_isStrong : (postcomposeInverseDensity T hT G).IsStrong
proof:
:= by
  intro a b f
  change IsIso ((rightUnitor _).hom ≫ G.1.map₂ (extendRestrictAppInv T hT f) ≫

name: StringDiagrams.Mat_.permMat_apply_self
statement:
@[simp] theorem permMat_apply_self (e : ι ≃ κ) (φ : ∀ i, X i ⟶ Y (e i)) (i : ι) :
    permMat e φ i (e i) = φ i

name: StringDiagrams.Mat_.permMat_apply_of_ne
statement:
theorem permMat_apply_of_ne (e : ι ≃ κ) (φ : ∀ i, X i ⟶ Y (e i)) {i : ι} {j : κ} (h : e i ≠ j) :
    permMat e φ i j = 0

name: StringDiagrams.Mat_.permMat_comp_apply
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [CategoryTheory.Mat_.comp_apply, Finset.sum_eq_single (e i)]
  · rw [permMat_apply_self]
  · intro j _ hj; rw [permMat_apply_of_ne e φ (Ne.symm hj), zero_comp]
  · intro h; exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ _) h

name: StringDiagrams.Mat_.comp_permMat_apply
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [CategoryTheory.Mat_.comp_apply, Finset.sum_eq_single i]
  · rw [permMat_apply_self]
  · intro j _ hj; rw [permMat_apply_of_ne e φ (fun h => hj (e.injective h)), comp_zero]
  · intro h; exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ _) h

name: StringDiagrams.Mat_.hom_ext_equiv
statement:
theorem hom_ext_equiv (e : ι ≃ κ) {M : Mat_ D} {f g : M ⟶ (⟨κ, Y⟩ : Mat_ D)}
    (h : ∀ m i, f m (e i) = g m (e i)) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  ext m j
  have := h m (e.symm j)
  rwa [e.apply_symm_apply] at this

name: StringDiagrams.Mat_.permMat_congr
statement:
theorem permMat_congr {e e' : ι ≃ κ} (he : ∀ i, e i = e' i) (φ : ∀ i, X i ⟶ Y (e i))
    (φ' : ∀ i, X i ⟶ Y (e' i)) (hφ : ∀ i, φ i ≫ eqToHom (congrArg Y (he i)) = φ' i) :
    permMat e φ = permMat e' φ'
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  by_cases h : e i = j
  · subst h
    rw [permMat_apply_self]
    unfold permMat
    rw [dite_eq_left (he i).symm, ← hφ i, Category.assoc, eqToHom_trans]
    simp
  · rw [permMat_apply_of_ne e φ h, permMat_apply_of_ne e' φ' (by rwa [← he i])]

name: StringDiagrams.Mat_.permMat_eq_id
statement:
theorem permMat_eq_id (e : ι ≃ ι) (he : ∀ i, e i = i) (φ : ∀ i, X i ⟶ X (e i))
    (hφ : ∀ i, φ i ≫ eqToHom (congrArg X (he i)) = 𝟙 (X i)) :
    permMat e φ = 𝟙 (⟨ι, X⟩ : Mat_ D)
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  by_cases h : i = j
  · subst h
    rw [CategoryTheory.Mat_.id_apply_self]
    unfold permMat
    rw [dite_eq_left (he i), hφ i]
  · rw [CategoryTheory.Mat_.id_apply_of_ne _ _ _ h, permMat_apply_of_ne e φ (by rwa [he i])]

name: StringDiagrams.Mat_.id_eq_permMat
statement:
theorem id_eq_permMat (ι : Type) [Fintype ι] (X : ι → D) :
    𝟙 (⟨ι, X⟩ : Mat_ D) = permMat (Equiv.refl ι) (fun i => 𝟙 (X i))
proof:
:=
  (permMat_eq_id (Equiv.refl ι) (fun _ => rfl) (fun i => 𝟙 (X i)) (fun _ => by simp)).symm

name: StringDiagrams.Mat_.permMat_comp_permMat
statement:
theorem permMat_comp_permMat (e : ι ≃ κ) (φ : ∀ i, X i ⟶ Y (e i)) (e' : κ ≃ μ)
    (ψ : ∀ j, Y j ⟶ Z (e' j)) :
    permMat e φ ≫ permMat e' ψ = permMat (e.trans e') (fun i => φ i ≫ ψ (e i))
proof:
:= by
  refine hom_ext_equiv (e.trans e') fun m i => ?_
  rw [permMat_comp_apply]
  by_cases h : m = i
  · subst h
    rw [Equiv.trans_apply, permMat_apply_self]
    exact (permMat_apply_self (e.trans e') (fun i => φ i ≫ ψ (e i)) m).symm
  · have h' : e m ≠ e i := fun h'' => h (e.injective h'')
    rw [Equiv.trans_apply, permMat_apply_of_ne e' ψ (fun h'' => h' (e'.injective h'')), comp_zero]
    exact (permMat_apply_of_ne (e.trans e') (fun i => φ i ≫ ψ (e i))
      (fun h'' => h ((e.trans e').injective h''))).symm

name: StringDiagrams.Mat_.id_eq_permMat'
statement: theorem id_eq_permMat' (M : Mat_ D) : 𝟙 M = permMat (Equiv.refl M.ι) (fun i => 𝟙 (M.X i))

name: StringDiagrams.Mat_.tensorHom_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem tensorHom_apply {M M' N N' : Mat_ D} (f : M ⟶ M') (g : N ⟶ N')
    (x : M.ι × N.ι) (y : M'.ι × N'.ι) : tensorHom f g x y = f x.1 y.1 ⊗ₘ g x.2 y.2

name: StringDiagrams.Mat_.tensorHom_permMat
statement:
theorem tensorHom_permMat {ι κ ι' κ' : Type} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] [Fintype ι'] [Fintype κ']
    {X : ι → D} {Y : κ → D} {X' : ι' → D} {Y' : κ' → D} (e : ι ≃ κ) (φ : ∀ i, X i ⟶ Y (e i))
    (e' : ι' ≃ κ') (ψ : ∀ i, X' i ⟶ Y' (e' i)) :
    tensorHom (permMat e φ) (permMat e' ψ) =
      permMat (X := fun x => X x.1 ⊗ X' x.2) (Y := fun y => Y y.1 ⊗ Y' y.2)
        (e.prodCongr e')
        (fun x => (φ x.1 ⊗ₘ ψ x.2 : X x.1 ⊗ X' x.2 ⟶ Y (e x.1) ⊗ Y' (e' x.2)))
proof:
:= by
  ext ⟨x₁, x₂⟩ ⟨y₁, y₂⟩
  rw [tensorHom_apply]
  by_cases h₁ : e x₁ = y₁
  · by_cases h₂ : e' x₂ = y₂
    · subst h₁ h₂
      rw [permMat_apply_self, permMat_apply_self]
      exact (permMat_apply_self (X := fun x => X x.1 ⊗ X' x.2) (Y := fun y => Y y.1 ⊗ Y' y.2)
        (e.prodCongr e') (fun x => (φ x.1 ⊗ₘ ψ x.2 : X x.1 ⊗ X' x.2 ⟶ Y (e x.1) ⊗ Y' (e' x.2)))
        (x₁, x₂)).symm
    · rw [permMat_apply_of_ne e' ψ h₂, MonoidalPreadditive.tensor_zero]
      exact (permMat_apply_of_ne (X := fun x => X x.1 ⊗ X' x.2) (Y := fun y => Y y.1 ⊗ Y' y.2)
        (e.prodCongr e') (fun x => (φ x.1 ⊗ₘ ψ x.2 : X x.1 ⊗ X' x.2 ⟶ Y (e x.1) ⊗ Y' (e' x.2)))
        (i := (x₁, x₂)) (j := (y₁, y₂)) (fun h => h₂ (congrArg Prod.snd h))).symm
  · rw [permMat_apply_of_ne e φ h₁, MonoidalPreadditive.zero_tensor]
    exact (permMat_apply_of_ne (X := fun x => X x.1 ⊗ X' x.2) (Y := fun y => Y y.1 ⊗ Y' y.2)
      (e.prodCongr e') (fun x => (φ x.1 ⊗ₘ ψ x.2 : X x.1 ⊗ X' x.2 ⟶ Y (e x.1) ⊗ Y' (e' x.2)))
      (i := (x₁, x₂)) (j := (y₁, y₂)) (fun h => h₁ (congrArg Prod.fst h))).symm

name: StringDiagrams.Mat_.tensorHom_id_id
statement: theorem tensorHom_id_id (M N : Mat_ D) : tensorHom (𝟙 M) (𝟙 N) = 𝟙 (tensorObj M N)
proof:
:= by
  rw [id_eq_permMat' M, id_eq_permMat' N, tensorHom_permMat]
  exact permMat_eq_id _ (fun _ => rfl) _ fun _ => by simp

name: StringDiagrams.Mat_.tensorHom_comp
statement:
theorem tensorHom_comp {M₁ M₂ M₃ N₁ N₂ N₃ : Mat_ D} (f₁ : M₁ ⟶ M₂) (f₂ : N₁ ⟶ N₂)
    (g₁ : M₂ ⟶ M₃) (g₂ : N₂ ⟶ N₃) :
    tensorHom (f₁ ≫ g₁) (f₂ ≫ g₂) = tensorHom f₁ f₂ ≫ tensorHom g₁ g₂
proof:
:= by
  ext x z
  simp only [tensorHom_apply, CategoryTheory.Mat_.comp_apply, sum_tensor, tensor_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  refine Eq.trans ?_ (Fintype.sum_prod_type (f := fun y : M₂.ι × N₂.ι =>
    (f₁ x.1 y.1 ⊗ₘ f₂ x.2 y.2) ≫ (g₁ y.1 z.1 ⊗ₘ g₂ y.2 z.2))).symm
  simp only [tensorHom_comp_tensorHom]

name: StringDiagrams.Karoubi.sandwich
statement:
theorem sandwich {X Y Z W : C} (φ : X ⟶ Y) (E : Y ⟶ Y) (ψ : Y ⟶ Z) (E' : Z ⟶ Z)
    (h : E ≫ ψ = ψ ≫ E') (hE' : E' ≫ E' = E') (W' : Z ⟶ W) :
    (φ ≫ E) ≫ (ψ ≫ E') ≫ W' = (φ ≫ ψ) ≫ E' ≫ W'
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [reassoc_of% h, reassoc_of% hE']

name: StringDiagrams.Karoubi.sandwich'
statement:
theorem sandwich' {X Y Z : C} (φ : X ⟶ Y) (E : Y ⟶ Y) (ψ : Y ⟶ Z) (E' : Z ⟶ Z)
    (h : E ≫ ψ = ψ ≫ E') (hE' : E' ≫ E' = E') :
    (φ ≫ E) ≫ (ψ ≫ E') = (φ ≫ ψ) ≫ E'
proof:
:= by
  simpa using sandwich φ E ψ E' h hE' (𝟙 _)
