name: StringDiagrams.QPiGSCatU.hom₂_ext
statement:
theorem hom₂_ext {F G : A ⟶ B} {x y : F ⟶ G}
    (h : ∀ X : A.obj.as.carrier, x.1.1.1.app 0 X = y.1.1.1.app 0 X) : x = y
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext (DegreeZero.hom_ext (Subtype.ext (Superfunctor.hom_ext_parity h fun X => by
    rw [app_one_eq_zero x X, app_one_eq_zero y X])))

name: StringDiagrams.QPiGSCatU.comp₂_app_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem comp₂_app_zero {F G H : A ⟶ B} (x : F ⟶ G) (y : G ⟶ H) (X : A.obj.as.carrier) :
    (x ≫ y).1.1.1.app 0 X = x.1.1.1.app 0 X ≫ y.1.1.1.app 0 X
proof:
:= by
  change x.1.1.1.app 0 X ≫ y.1.1.1.app 0 X + x.1.1.1.app 1 X ≫ y.1.1.1.app 1 X = _
  rw [app_one_eq_zero x X, Limits.zero_comp, add_zero]

name: StringDiagrams.QPiGSCatU.id₂_app_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem id₂_app_zero (F : A ⟶ B) (X : A.obj.as.carrier) :
    (𝟙 F : F ⟶ F).1.1.1.app 0 X = 𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.QPiGSCatU.whiskerLeft₂_app_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem whiskerLeft₂_app_zero (F : A ⟶ B) {G H : B ⟶ C} (y : G ⟶ H)
    (X : A.obj.as.carrier) : (F ◁ y).1.1.1.app 0 X = y.1.1.1.app 0 ((fun1 F).obj X)

name: StringDiagrams.QPiGSCatU.whiskerRight₂_app_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem whiskerRight₂_app_zero {F G : A ⟶ B} (x : F ⟶ G) (H : B ⟶ C)
    (X : A.obj.as.carrier) : (x ▷ H).1.1.1.app 0 X = (fun1 H).map (x.1.1.1.app 0 X)

name: StringDiagrams.QPiGSCatU.associator₂_hom_app_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem associator₂_hom_app_zero {D : GUnderlying2 R (QPiGSCat.{w, v, u} R)} (F : A ⟶ B)
    (G : B ⟶ C) (H : C ⟶ D) (X : A.obj.as.carrier) : (α_ F G H).hom.1.1.1.app 0 X = 𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.QPiGSCatU.associator₂_inv_app_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem associator₂_inv_app_zero {D : GUnderlying2 R (QPiGSCat.{w, v, u} R)} (F : A ⟶ B)
    (G : B ⟶ C) (H : C ⟶ D) (X : A.obj.as.carrier) : (α_ F G H).inv.1.1.1.app 0 X = 𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.QPiGSCatU.leftUnitor₂_hom_app_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem leftUnitor₂_hom_app_zero (F : A ⟶ B) (X : A.obj.as.carrier) :
    (λ_ F).hom.1.1.1.app 0 X = 𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.QPiGSCatU.rightUnitor₂_hom_app_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem rightUnitor₂_hom_app_zero (F : A ⟶ B) (X : A.obj.as.carrier) :
    (ρ_ F).hom.1.1.1.app 0 X = 𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.QPiGSCatU.Emap₂_app_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem Emap₂_app_val {F G : A ⟶ B} (η : F ⟶ G) (X : GUnderlying R A.obj.as.carrier) :
    ((QPiCat.Hom₂.natTrans (Emap₂ η)).app X).1.1 = η.1.1.1.app 0 X.obj.obj

name: StringDiagrams.QPiFunctor.isQPiNatural_id_of
statement:
theorem _root_.StringDiagrams.QPiFunctor.isQPiNatural_id_of {R : Type w} [CommRing R]
    {C : Type*} [Category C] [Preadditive C] [Linear R C] [QPiCategory R C]
    {D : Type*} [Category D] [Preadditive D] [Linear R D] [QPiCategory R D]
    {F : C ⥤ D} {hF hG : QPiFunctor R F}
    (hβ : ∀ X, hF.β.hom.app X = hG.β.hom.app X) (hγ : ∀ X, hF.γ.hom.app X = hG.γ.hom.app X) :
    QPiFunctor.IsQPiNatural R hF hG (𝟙 F)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun X => by simp [hβ X], fun X => by simp [hγ X]⟩

name: StringDiagrams.QPiGSCatU.id_isQPiNatural
statement:
theorem id_isQPiNatural (A : GUnderlying2 R (QPiGSCat.{w, v, u} R)) :
    QPiFunctor.IsQPiNatural R (Emap R (𝟙 A)).qpiFunctor
      (QPiFunctor.id R (GUnderlying R A.obj.as.carrier)) (Iso.refl (𝟭 _)).hom
proof:
:=
  QPiFunctor.isQPiNatural_id_of
    (fun X => Underlying.hom_ext (DegreeZero.hom_ext (by
      rw [GUnderlying.qpiFunctor_β_hom_app_val]
      exact PiSupercategory.β_id (R := R) X.obj.obj)))
    (fun X => Underlying.hom_ext (DegreeZero.hom_ext (by
      rw [GUnderlying.qpiFunctor_γ_hom_app_val]
      exact QPiSupercategory.γ_id (R := R) X.obj.obj)))

name: StringDiagrams.QPiGSCatU.comp_isQPiNatural
statement:
theorem comp_isQPiNatural (F : A ⟶ B) (G : B ⟶ C) :
    QPiFunctor.IsQPiNatural R (Emap R (F ≫ G)).qpiFunctor (Emap R F ≫ Emap R G).qpiFunctor
      (Iso.refl _).hom

name: StringDiagrams.QPiGSCatU.EPseudo_map₂
statement: theorem EPseudo_map₂ {F G : A ⟶ B} (η : F ⟶ G) : (EPseudo R).map₂ η = Emap₂ η

name: StringDiagrams.QPiGSCatU.Emap_id
statement:
theorem Emap_id (A : GUnderlying2 R (QPiGSCat.{w, v, u} R)) :
    Emap R (𝟙 A) = 𝟙 (QPiCat.of R (GUnderlying R A.obj.as.carrier))
proof:
:=
  QPiCat.Hom.ext rfl
    (fun X => heq_of_eq (Underlying.hom_ext (DegreeZero.hom_ext (by
      rw [GUnderlying.qpiFunctor_β_hom_app_val]
      exact PiSupercategory.β_id (R := R) X.obj.obj))))
    (fun X => heq_of_eq (Underlying.hom_ext (DegreeZero.hom_ext (by
      rw [GUnderlying.qpiFunctor_γ_hom_app_val]
      exact QPiSupercategory.γ_id (R := R) X.obj.obj))))

name: StringDiagrams.QPiGSCatU.Emap_comp
statement: theorem Emap_comp (F : A ⟶ B) (G : B ⟶ C) : Emap R (F ≫ G) = Emap R F ≫ Emap R G
proof:
:=
  QPiCat.Hom.ext rfl (fun X => heq_of_eq (GUnderlying.qpiFunctor_comp_β (fun1 F) (fun1 G) X))
    (fun X => heq_of_eq (GUnderlying.qpiFunctor_comp_γ (fun1 F) (fun1 G) X))

name: StringDiagrams.QPiGSCatU.EPseudo_mapId
statement:
theorem EPseudo_mapId (A : GUnderlying2 R (QPiGSCat.{w, v, u} R)) :
    (EPseudo R).mapId A = eqToIso (Emap_id A)
proof:
:=
  Iso.ext (QPiCat.hom₂_ext fun X => by
    erw [eqToIso.hom, QPiCat.eqToHom_natTrans_app, eqToHom_refl]
    rfl)

name: StringDiagrams.QPiGSCatU.EPseudo_mapComp
statement:
theorem EPseudo_mapComp (F : A ⟶ B) (G : B ⟶ C) :
    (EPseudo R).mapComp F G = eqToIso (Emap_comp F G)
proof:
:=
  Iso.ext (QPiCat.hom₂_ext fun X => by
    erw [eqToIso.hom, QPiCat.eqToHom_natTrans_app, eqToHom_refl]
    rfl)

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated.β_map_unit
statement:
theorem β_map_unit {F : A ⥤ A'} [F.Additive] [F.Linear R] (hF : QPiFunctor R F) (X : A) :
    (PiSupercategory.β R (map hF) ((unit R A).obj X).obj.obj).hom =
      ((unit R A').map (hF.β.hom.app X)).1.1
proof:
:= by
  rw [unit_map_val, PiSupercategory.β_hom]
  simp only [Orbit.ζ_eq, Orbit.ζIso, Functor.mapIso_hom, Functor.mapIso_inv]
  erw [Orbit.map_ι_map]
  rw [← Functor.map_comp]
  congr 1
  exact Associated.β_map (hF := hF.toPiFunctor) (⟨X⟩ : Associated R A)

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated.γ_map_unit
statement:
theorem γ_map_unit {F : A ⥤ A'} [F.Additive] [F.Linear R] (hF : QPiFunctor R F) (X : A) :
    (QPiSupercategory.γ R (map hF) ((unit R A).obj X).obj.obj).hom =
      ((unit R A').map (hF.γ.hom.app X)).1.1
proof:
:= by
  rw [unit_map_val, QPiSupercategory.γ_hom, Orbit.σ_eq, Orbit.σ_eq]
  erw [Orbit.map_σIso_inv, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc, shiftFunctor_γ_hom_app]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated.counit_map_eq
statement:
theorem counit_map_eq {X Y : GUnderlying R (QAssociated R A)} (g : X ⟶ Y) :
    (unit R A).map ((counit R A).map g) = g
proof:
:= by
  have h := CategoryTheory.Functor.congr_hom (counit_comp_unit (R := R) (A := A)) g
  erw [eqToHom_refl, eqToHom_refl, Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id] at h
  exact h

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated.counit_map_unit
statement: theorem counit_map_unit {X Y : A} (f : X ⟶ Y) : (counit R A).map ((unit R A).map f) = f
proof:
:= by
  have h := CategoryTheory.Functor.congr_hom (unit_comp_counit (R := R) (A := A)) f
  erw [eqToHom_refl, eqToHom_refl, Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id] at h
  exact h

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated.unit_map_injective
statement:
theorem unit_map_injective {X Y : A} {f f' : X ⟶ Y}
    (h : (unit R A).map f = (unit R A).map f') : f = f'
proof:
:= by
  rw [← counit_map_unit (R := R) f, h, counit_map_unit]

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated.counit_map_pi
statement:
theorem counit_map_pi {X Y : GUnderlying R (QAssociated R A)} (g : X ⟶ Y) :
    (counit R A).map ((PiCategory.pi (R := R)).map g) =
      (PiCategory.pi (R := R)).map ((counit R A).map g)
proof:
:= by
  apply unit_map_injective (R := R)
  erw [counit_map_eq, ← unit_map_pi, counit_map_eq]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated.counit_map_Q
statement:
theorem counit_map_Q {X Y : GUnderlying R (QAssociated R A)} (g : X ⟶ Y) :
    (counit R A).map ((QPiCategory.Q (R := R)).map g) =
      (QPiCategory.Q (R := R)).map ((counit R A).map g)
proof:
:= by
  apply unit_map_injective (R := R)
  erw [counit_map_eq, ← unit_map_Q, counit_map_eq]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated.counitQPiFunctor_β_hom_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem counitQPiFunctor_β_hom_app (X : GUnderlying R (QAssociated R A)) :
    (counitQPiFunctor R A).β.hom.app X = 𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.QAssociated.counitQPiFunctor_γ_hom_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem counitQPiFunctor_γ_hom_app (X : GUnderlying R (QAssociated R A)) :
    (counitQPiFunctor R A).γ.hom.app X = 𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.DegreeZero2.hom_eq
statement: theorem hom_eq {a b : DegreeZero2 R B} {f g : a ⟶ b} (h : f.obj = g.obj) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  cases f
  cases g
  cases h
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.DegreeZero2.eqToHom_val
statement:
theorem eqToHom_val {a b : DegreeZero2 R B} {f g : a ⟶ b} (h : f = g) :
    (eqToHom h).1 = eqToHom (congrArg DegreeZero.obj h)

name: StringDiagrams.QPiGSCatU.hom1_eq_of_toFunctor_eq
statement: theorem hom1_eq_of_toFunctor_eq {F G : A ⟶ B} (h : fun1 F = fun1 G) : F = G

name: StringDiagrams.QPiGSCatU.eqToHom₂_app_zero
statement:
theorem eqToHom₂_app_zero {F G : A ⟶ B} (h : F = G) (X : A.obj.as.carrier) :
    (eqToHom h : F ⟶ G).1.1.1.app 0 X = eqToHom (by rw [h])

name: StringDiagrams.QPiCat.Dmap₂_app_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem Dmap₂_app_zero {F G : A ⟶ B} (x : F ⟶ G) (X : QAssociated R A) :
    (Dmap₂ x).1.1.1.app 0 X = (QAssociated.mapNat (Hom₂.isQPiNatural x)).app X
proof:
:= by
  change (if (0 : ZMod 2) = 0 then (QAssociated.mapNat (Hom₂.isQPiNatural x)).app X else 0) = _
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.QPiCat.unitHom'_inv
statement:
theorem unitHom'_inv (A : QPiCat.{w, v, u} R) :
    unitHom' A ≫ unitInvHom' A = 𝟙 A ∧ unitInvHom' A ≫ unitHom' A = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨Hom.ext QAssociated.unit_comp_counit (fun X => ?_) (fun X => ?_),
    Hom.ext QAssociated.counit_comp_unit (fun X => ?_) (fun X => ?_)⟩
  all_goals refine heq_of_eq ?_
  all_goals simp only [unitHom', unitInvHom', comp_qpiFunctor, id_qpiFunctor,
    QPiFunctor.comp_β_hom_app, QPiFunctor.comp_γ_hom_app, QPiFunctor.id_β_hom_app,
    QPiFunctor.id_γ_hom_app, QAssociated.unitQPiFunctor_β_hom_app,
    QAssociated.unitQPiFunctor_γ_hom_app, QAssociated.counitQPiFunctor_β_hom_app,
    QAssociated.counitQPiFunctor_γ_hom_app]
  all_goals repeat erw [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id]
  all_goals repeat erw [Category.id_comp]
  all_goals rfl

name: StringDiagrams.QPiCat.unitHom_inv
statement:
theorem unitHom_inv (A : QPiCat.{w, v, u} R) :
    unitHom R A ≫ unitInvHom R A = 𝟙 _ ∧ unitInvHom R A ≫ unitHom R A = 𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.QPiCat.unit_naturality_eq'
statement:
theorem unit_naturality_eq' {A B : QPiCat.{w, v, u} R} (F : A ⟶ B) :
    F ≫ unitHom' B = unitHom' A ≫ EDhom F
proof:
:=
  Hom.ext (QAssociated.unit_comp_map F.qpiFunctor).symm
    (fun X => heq_of_eq (by
      simp [unitHom']
      erw [Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id]
      apply Underlying.hom_ext; apply DegreeZero.hom_ext
      exact (QAssociated.β_map_unit F.qpiFunctor X).symm))
    (fun X => heq_of_eq (by
      simp [unitHom']
      erw [Category.id_comp, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id, Category.comp_id]
      apply Underlying.hom_ext; apply DegreeZero.hom_ext
      exact (QAssociated.γ_map_unit F.qpiFunctor X).symm))

name: StringDiagrams.QPiCat.unit_naturality_eq
statement:
theorem unit_naturality_eq {A B : QPiCat.{w, v, u} R} (F : A ⟶ B) :
    (Pseudofunctor.id (QPiCat.{w, v, u} R)).map F ≫ unitHom R B =
      unitHom R A ≫ ((DPseudo R).comp (QPiGSCatU.EPseudo R)).map F

name: StringDiagrams.QPiCat.DPseudo_mapComp_hom
statement:
theorem DPseudo_mapComp_hom {A B C : QPiCat.{w, v, u} R} (F : A ⟶ B) (G : B ⟶ C) :
    ((DPseudo R).mapComp F G).hom =
      eqToHom (QPiGSCatU.hom1_eq_of_toFunctor_eq (QAssociated.map_comp F.qpiFunctor G.qpiFunctor))

name: StringDiagrams.QPiCat.DPseudo_mapId_hom
statement:
theorem DPseudo_mapId_hom (A : QPiCat.{w, v, u} R) :
    ((DPseudo R).mapId A).hom =
      eqToHom (QPiGSCatU.hom1_eq_of_toFunctor_eq (QAssociated.map_id (R := R) (A := A)))

name: StringDiagrams.QPiCat.ED_mapId_app
statement:
theorem ED_mapId_app (A : QPiCat.{w, v, u} R)
    (Y : (((DPseudo R).comp (QPiGSCatU.EPseudo R)).obj A).carrier) :
    (Hom₂.natTrans (((DPseudo R).comp (QPiGSCatU.EPseudo R)).mapId A).hom).app Y = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  apply Underlying.hom_ext; apply DegreeZero.hom_ext
  refine Eq.trans (?_ : _ = (eqToHom (QPiGSCatU.hom1_eq_of_toFunctor_eq (F := Dhom (𝟙 A))
    (G := 𝟙 (Dobj R A)) (QAssociated.map_id (R := R) (A := A))) :
      Dhom (𝟙 A) ⟶ 𝟙 (Dobj R A)).1.1.1.app 0 _ ≫ 𝟙 _) ?_
  · rfl
  · exact ((congrArg (fun z => z ≫ 𝟙 _) (QPiGSCatU.eqToHom₂_app_zero _ _)).trans
      (Category.comp_id _)).trans rfl

name: StringDiagrams.QPiCat.ED_mapComp_app
statement:
theorem ED_mapComp_app {A B C : QPiCat.{w, v, u} R} (F : A ⟶ B) (G : B ⟶ C)
    (Y : (((DPseudo R).comp (QPiGSCatU.EPseudo R)).obj A).carrier) :
    (Hom₂.natTrans (((DPseudo R).comp (QPiGSCatU.EPseudo R)).mapComp F G).hom).app Y =
      𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  apply Underlying.hom_ext; apply DegreeZero.hom_ext
  refine Eq.trans (?_ : _ = (eqToHom (QPiGSCatU.hom1_eq_of_toFunctor_eq (F := Dhom (F ≫ G))
    (G := Dhom F ≫ Dhom G) (QAssociated.map_comp F.qpiFunctor G.qpiFunctor)) :
      Dhom (F ≫ G) ⟶ Dhom F ≫ Dhom G).1.1.1.app 0 _ ≫ 𝟙 _) ?_
  · rfl
  · exact ((congrArg (fun z => z ≫ 𝟙 _) (QPiGSCatU.eqToHom₂_app_zero _ _)).trans
      (Category.comp_id _)).trans rfl

name: StringDiagrams.QPiCat.ED_map_id
statement:
theorem ED_map_id (A : QPiCat.{w, v, u} R) :
    ((DPseudo R).comp (QPiGSCatU.EPseudo R)).map (𝟙 A) =
      𝟙 (((DPseudo R).comp (QPiGSCatU.EPseudo R)).obj A)

name: StringDiagrams.QPiCat.ED_map_comp
statement:
theorem ED_map_comp {A B C : QPiCat.{w, v, u} R} (F : A ⟶ B) (G : B ⟶ C) :
    ((DPseudo R).comp (QPiGSCatU.EPseudo R)).map (F ≫ G) =
      ((DPseudo R).comp (QPiGSCatU.EPseudo R)).map F ≫
        ((DPseudo R).comp (QPiGSCatU.EPseudo R)).map G

name: StringDiagrams.QPiCat.ED_mapId
statement:
theorem ED_mapId (A : QPiCat.{w, v, u} R) :
    ((DPseudo R).comp (QPiGSCatU.EPseudo R)).mapId A = eqToIso (ED_map_id A)
proof:
:=
  Iso.ext (hom₂_ext fun Y => (ED_mapId_app A Y).trans (by
    erw [eqToIso.hom, eqToHom_natTrans_app, eqToHom_refl]))

name: StringDiagrams.QPiCat.ED_mapComp
statement:
theorem ED_mapComp {A B C : QPiCat.{w, v, u} R} (F : A ⟶ B) (G : B ⟶ C) :
    ((DPseudo R).comp (QPiGSCatU.EPseudo R)).mapComp F G = eqToIso (ED_map_comp F G)
proof:
:= by
  ext1
  simp only [Pseudofunctor.comp_mapComp, (DStrict R).mapComp_eq_eqToIso,
    QPiGSCatU.EPseudo_mapComp, eqToIso.hom]
  erw [Iso.trans_hom, PrelaxFunctor.map₂Iso_hom, eqToIso.hom, eqToIso.hom,
    PrelaxFunctor.map₂_eqToHom, eqToHom_trans]

name: StringDiagrams.QPiGSCatU.counitHom_inv
statement:
theorem counitHom_inv (B : GUnderlying2 R (QPiGSCat.{w, v, u} R)) :
    counitHom R B ≫ counitInvHom R B = 𝟙 _ ∧ counitInvHom R B ≫ counitHom R B = 𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.QPiGSCatU.counit_naturality_eq
statement:
theorem counit_naturality_eq {A B : GUnderlying2 R (QPiGSCat.{w, v, u} R)} (F : A ⟶ B) :

name: StringDiagrams.QPiGSCatU.DE_map_id
statement:
theorem DE_map_id (B : GUnderlying2 R (QPiGSCat.{w, v, u} R)) :
    ((EPseudo R).comp (DPseudo R)).map (𝟙 B) = 𝟙 (((EPseudo R).comp (DPseudo R)).obj B)

name: StringDiagrams.QPiGSCatU.DE_map_comp
statement:
theorem DE_map_comp {A B C : GUnderlying2 R (QPiGSCat.{w, v, u} R)} (F : A ⟶ B) (G : B ⟶ C) :

name: StringDiagrams.QPiGSCatU.DE_mapId
statement:
theorem DE_mapId (B : GUnderlying2 R (QPiGSCat.{w, v, u} R)) :
    ((EPseudo R).comp (DPseudo R)).mapId B = eqToIso (DE_map_id B)
proof:
:= by
  ext1
  simp only [Pseudofunctor.comp_mapId, EPseudo_mapId, (DStrict R).mapId_eq_eqToIso,
    eqToIso.hom]
  erw [Iso.trans_hom, PrelaxFunctor.map₂Iso_hom, eqToIso.hom, eqToIso.hom,

name: StringDiagrams.QPiGSCatU.DE_mapComp
statement:
theorem DE_mapComp {A B C : GUnderlying2 R (QPiGSCat.{w, v, u} R)} (F : A ⟶ B) (G : B ⟶ C) :
    ((EPseudo R).comp (DPseudo R)).mapComp F G = eqToIso (DE_map_comp F G)
proof:
:= by
  ext1
  simp only [Pseudofunctor.comp_mapComp, EPseudo_mapComp, (DStrict R).mapComp_eq_eqToIso,
    eqToIso.hom]
  erw [Iso.trans_hom, PrelaxFunctor.map₂Iso_hom, eqToIso.hom, eqToIso.hom,
    PrelaxFunctor.map₂_eqToHom, eqToHom_trans]

name: StringDiagrams.QPiCat.theorem613
statement:
theorem theorem613 :
    (∀ {A B : QPiCat.{w, v, u} R} (F : A ⟶ B),
        (unitStrong R).naturality F = eqToIso (unit_naturality_eq F)) ∧
      (∀ A : QPiCat.{w, v, u} R, ∃ g : ((DPseudo R).comp (QPiGSCatU.EPseudo R)).obj A ⟶ A,
        (unitStrong R).app A ≫ g = 𝟙 _ ∧ g ≫ (unitStrong R).app A = 𝟙 _) ∧
      (∀ {A B : GUnderlying2 R (QPiGSCat.{w, v, u} R)} (F : A ⟶ B),
        (QPiGSCatU.counitStrong R).naturality F = eqToIso (QPiGSCatU.counit_naturality_eq F)) ∧
      (∀ B : GUnderlying2 R (QPiGSCat.{w, v, u} R),
        ∃ g : B ⟶ ((QPiGSCatU.EPseudo R).comp (DPseudo R)).obj B,
          (QPiGSCatU.counitStrong R).app B ≫ g = 𝟙 _ ∧ g ≫ (QPiGSCatU.counitStrong R).app B = 𝟙 _)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun _ => rfl, fun A => ⟨_, (unitHom_inv A).1, (unitHom_inv A).2⟩, fun _ => rfl,
    fun B => ⟨_, (QPiGSCatU.counitHom_inv B).1, (QPiGSCatU.counitHom_inv B).2⟩⟩

name: CategoryTheory.Oplax.OplaxTrans.map₂_associator_inv'
statement:
theorem map₂_associator_inv' {B : Type u₁} [Bicategory.{w₁, v₁} B] {C : Type u₂}
    [Bicategory.{w₂, v₂} C] (H : Pseudofunctor B C) {a b c d : B} (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c)
    (h : c ⟶ d) :
    H.map₂ (α_ f g h).inv = (H.mapComp f (g ≫ h)).hom ≫ H.map f ◁ (H.mapComp g h).hom ≫
      (α_ (H.map f) (H.map g) (H.map h)).inv ≫ (H.mapComp f g).inv ▷ H.map h ≫
        (H.mapComp (f ≫ g) h).inv
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cancel_mono (H.map₂ (α_ f g h).hom), ← H.map₂_comp, Iso.inv_hom_id, H.map₂_id,
    Pseudofunctor.map₂_associator]
  simp

name: CategoryTheory.Oplax.OplaxTrans.precomp_central
statement:
theorem precomp_central {pB : ∀ a : B, a ⟶ a} {pC : ∀ a : C, a ⟶ a} {pD : ∀ a : D, a ⟶ a}
    (eD : ∀ {a b : D} (f : a ⟶ b), f ≫ pD b ⟶ pD a ≫ f)
    (P : Pseudofunctor B C) {F G : Pseudofunctor C D}
    (jP : ∀ a, pC (P.obj a) ≅ P.map (pB a)) (jF : ∀ a, pD (F.obj a) ≅ F.map (pC a))
    (jG : ∀ a, pD (G.obj a) ≅ G.map (pC a))
    (η : Oplax.OplaxTrans F.toOplax G.toOplax)
    (hη : ∀ a, eD (η.app a) ≫ (jF a).hom ▷ η.app a ≫ η.naturality (pC a) =
      η.app a ◁ (jG a).hom) (a : B) :
    eD ((precomp P η).app a) ≫ (jF (P.obj a) ≪≫ F.map₂Iso (jP a)).hom ▷ (precomp P η).app a ≫
        (precomp P η).naturality (pB a) =
      (precomp P η).app a ◁ (jG (P.obj a) ≪≫ G.map₂Iso (jP a)).hom
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := η.naturality_naturality (jP a).hom
  simp only [Pseudofunctor.toOplax_toPrelaxFunctor] at h1
  change eD (η.app (P.obj a)) ≫ ((jF (P.obj a)).hom ≫ F.map₂ (jP a).hom) ▷ η.app (P.obj a) ≫
      η.naturality (P.map (pB a)) = η.app (P.obj a) ◁ ((jG (P.obj a)).hom ≫ G.map₂ (jP a).hom)
  rw [comp_whiskerRight, Category.assoc, h1, reassoc_of% (hη (P.obj a)),
    whiskerLeft_comp]

name: CategoryTheory.Oplax.OplaxTrans.postcomp_central
statement:
theorem postcomp_central {pC : ∀ a : C, a ⟶ a} {pD : ∀ a : D, a ⟶ a} {pE : ∀ a : E, a ⟶ a}
    (eD : ∀ {a b : D} (f : a ⟶ b), f ≫ pD b ⟶ pD a ≫ f)
    (eE : ∀ {a b : E} (f : a ⟶ b), f ≫ pE b ⟶ pE a ≫ f)
    {F G : Pseudofunctor C D} (H : Pseudofunctor D E)
    (jF : ∀ a, pD (F.obj a) ≅ F.map (pC a)) (jG : ∀ a, pD (G.obj a) ≅ G.map (pC a))
    (jH : ∀ a, pE (H.obj a) ≅ H.map (pD a))
    (hH : ∀ {a b : D} (f : a ⟶ b), H.map f ◁ (jH b).hom ≫ (H.mapComp f (pD b)).inv ≫
      H.map₂ (eD f) = eE (H.map f) ≫ (jH a).hom ▷ H.map f ≫ (H.mapComp (pD a) f).inv)
    (η : Oplax.OplaxTrans F.toOplax G.toOplax)
    (hη : ∀ a, eD (η.app a) ≫ (jF a).hom ▷ η.app a ≫ η.naturality (pC a) =
      η.app a ◁ (jG a).hom) (a : C) :
    eE ((postcomp η H).app a) ≫ (jH (F.obj a) ≪≫ H.map₂Iso (jF a)).hom ▷ (postcomp η H).app a ≫
        (postcomp η H).naturality (pC a) =
      (postcomp η H).app a ◁ (jH (G.obj a) ≪≫ H.map₂Iso (jG a)).hom
proof:
:= by
  have e1 : eE (H.map (η.app a)) ≫ (jH (F.obj a)).hom ▷ H.map (η.app a) =
      H.map (η.app a) ◁ (jH (G.obj a)).hom ≫ (H.mapComp (η.app a) (pD (G.obj a))).inv ≫
        H.map₂ (eD (η.app a)) ≫ (H.mapComp (pD (F.obj a)) (η.app a)).hom := by
    have h : H.map (η.app a) ◁ (jH (G.obj a)).hom ≫ (H.mapComp (η.app a) (pD (G.obj a))).inv ≫
        H.map₂ (eD (η.app a)) = eE (H.map (η.app a)) ≫ (jH (F.obj a)).hom ▷ H.map (η.app a) ≫
          (H.mapComp (pD (F.obj a)) (η.app a)).inv := hH (η.app a)
    rw [reassoc_of% h]
    simp
  have e2 := congrArg H.map₂ (hη a)
  simp only [PrelaxFunctor.map₂_comp, Pseudofunctor.map₂_whisker_left,
    Pseudofunctor.map₂_whisker_right, Category.assoc] at e2
  change eE (H.map (η.app a)) ≫ ((jH (F.obj a)).hom ≫ H.map₂ (jF a).hom) ▷ H.map (η.app a) ≫
      (H.mapComp (F.map (pC a)) (η.app a)).inv ≫ H.map₂ (η.naturality (pC a)) ≫
        (H.mapComp (η.app a) (G.map (pC a))).hom =
    H.map (η.app a) ◁ ((jH (G.obj a)).hom ≫ H.map₂ (jG a).hom)
  rw [comp_whiskerRight]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [reassoc_of% e1, reassoc_of% e2]
  simp [whiskerLeft_comp]

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.par_tensorObj
statement: theorem par_tensorObj (X Y : D k) : par (X ⊗ Y) = par X + par Y

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.scal_tensorHom
statement:
theorem scal_tensorHom {X X' Y Y' : D k} (f : X ⟶ X') (g : Y ⟶ Y') :
    scal (f ⊗ₘ g) = scal f * scal g
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hY : par Y = par Y'
  · change SuperalgebraCat.toElem (Envelope.toHom (f.1 ⊗ₘ g.1)) = _
    rw [Envelope.tensorHom_def', Envelope.toHom_comp,
      Envelope.toHom_whiskerRight_of_mem (UnitSupercat.mem_parity_zero _),
      Envelope.toHom_whiskerLeft_of_mem _ (UnitSupercat.mem_parity_zero _), mul_zero, sign_zero,
      one_smul, zero_add, show Y.obj.par + Y'.obj.par = 0 by
        rw [show Y.obj.par = Y'.obj.par from hY, zmod2_add_self],
      mul_zero, sign_zero, one_smul]
    exact mul_comm _ _
  · rw [hom_ext (f := g) (g := 0) (by rw [scal_eq_zero_of_ne g hY, scal_zero]),
      MonoidalPreadditive.tensor_zero, scal_zero, scal_zero, mul_zero]

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.scalMat_tensorHom
statement:
theorem scalMat_tensorHom {M M' N N' : Mat_ (D k)} (f : M ⟶ M') (g : N ⟶ N') :
    scalMat (f ⊗ₘ g) = kroneckerMap (· * ·) (scalMat f) (scalMat g)
proof:
:= by
  ext x y
  exact scal_tensorHom (f x.1 y.1) (g x.2 y.2)

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.scal_associator_hom
statement: theorem scal_associator_hom (X Y Z : D k) : scal (α_ X Y Z).hom = 1

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.scal_leftUnitor_hom
statement: theorem scal_leftUnitor_hom (X : D k) : scal (λ_ X).hom = 1

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.scal_rightUnitor_hom
statement: theorem scal_rightUnitor_hom (X : D k) : scal (ρ_ X).hom = 1

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.scalMat_permMat
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : e i = j
  · subst h
    rw [ite_eq_left rfl, scalMat, Mat_.permMat_apply_self, hφ]
  · rw [ite_eq_right h, scalMat, Mat_.permMat_apply_of_ne _ _ h, scal_zero]

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.vecMul_perm
statement:
theorem vecMul_perm {ι κ : Type} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ] (e : ι ≃ κ)
    (u : ι → k) (j : κ) : (u ᵥ* fun i j => if e i = j then (1 : k) else 0) j = u (e.symm j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [vecMul, dotProduct, Finset.sum_eq_single (e.symm j)]
  · rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply, ite_eq_left rfl, mul_one]
  · intro i _ hi
    rw [ite_eq_right, mul_zero]
    intro h; exact hi (by rw [← h, Equiv.symm_apply_apply])
  · intro h; exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ _) h

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.tmulFun_tmul
statement:
@[simp] theorem tmulFun_tmul {ι κ : Type} (v : ι → k) (w : κ → k) :
    tmulFun ι κ (v ⊗ₜ w) = fun x => v x.1 * w x.2

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.tmulFun_single
statement:
theorem tmulFun_single {ι κ : Type} [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ] (i : ι) (j : κ) :
    tmulFun ι κ (Pi.single i (1 : k) ⊗ₜ Pi.single j (1 : k)) = Pi.single (i, j) 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [tmulFun_tmul]
  funext x
  obtain ⟨x₁, x₂⟩ := x
  simp only [Pi.single_apply, Prod.mk.injEq]
  by_cases h₁ : x₁ = i <;> by_cases h₂ : x₂ = j <;> simp [h₁, h₂]

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.tmulFun_vecMul
statement:
theorem tmulFun_vecMul {ι κ ι' κ' : Type} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] (A : Matrix ι ι' k)
    (B : Matrix κ κ' k) (v : ι → k) (w : κ → k) :
    tmulFun ι' κ' ((v ᵥ* A) ⊗ₜ (w ᵥ* B)) = tmulFun ι κ (v ⊗ₜ w) ᵥ* kroneckerMap (· * ·) A B
proof:
:= by
  funext x
  simp only [tmulFun_tmul, vecMul, dotProduct, kroneckerMap_apply, Finset.sum_mul_sum,
    Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
  ring

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.tmulFun_vecMul'
statement:
theorem tmulFun_vecMul' {ι κ ι' κ' : Type} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] (A : Matrix ι ι' k)
    (B : Matrix κ κ' k) (t : (ι → k) ⊗[k] (κ → k)) :
    tmulFun ι' κ' (TensorProduct.map A.vecMulLinear B.vecMulLinear t) =
      tmulFun ι κ t ᵥ* kroneckerMap (· * ·) A B
proof:
:= by
  induction t using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul v w => exact tmulFun_vecMul A B v w
  | add t t' ht ht' => rw [map_add, map_add, ht, ht', map_add, add_vecMul]

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.tmulFun_surjective
statement:
theorem tmulFun_surjective (ι κ : Type) [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] :
    Function.Surjective (tmulFun (k := K) ι κ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [← LinearMap.range_eq_top, eq_top_iff, ← (Pi.basisFun K (ι × κ)).span_eq, Submodule.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨⟨i, j⟩, rfl⟩
  rw [Pi.basisFun_apply]
  exact ⟨_, tmulFun_single (k := K) i j⟩

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.tmulFun_injective
statement:
theorem tmulFun_injective (ι κ : Type) [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] :
    Function.Injective (tmulFun (k := K) ι κ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine (LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective_of_finrank_eq_finrank ?_).2 (tmulFun_surjective ι κ)
  rw [Module.finrank_tensorProduct, Module.finrank_fintype_fun_eq_card,
    Module.finrank_fintype_fun_eq_card, Module.finrank_fintype_fun_eq_card, Fintype.card_prod]

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.tmulFun_bijective
statement:
theorem tmulFun_bijective (ι κ : Type) [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] :
    Function.Bijective (tmulFun (k := K) ι κ)

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.freeTensor_tmul
statement:
theorem freeTensor_tmul (M N : Mat_ (D k)) (v : M.ι → k) (w : N.ι → k) :
    freeTensor M N (v ⊗ₜ w) = fun x => v x.1 * w x.2

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.freeTensor_apply
statement:
theorem freeTensor_apply (M N : Mat_ (D k)) (t : (M.ι → k) ⊗[k] (N.ι → k)) :
    freeTensor M N t = tmulFun M.ι N.ι t

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.par_tensor_X
statement:
theorem par_tensor_X (M N : Mat_ (D k)) (x : M.ι × N.ι) :
    par ((M ⊗ N).X x) = par (M.X x.1) + par (N.X x.2)

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.freeTensor_mem
statement:
theorem freeTensor_mem (M N : Mat_ (D k)) :
    freeTensor M N ∈ SVec.parityHom (freeObj M ⊗ freeObj N) (freeObj (M ⊗ N)) 0
proof:
:= by
  intro q
  apply TensorProduct.ext'
  intro v w
  change freeTensor M N ((SVec.tensorObj (freeObj M) (freeObj N)).proj q (v ⊗ₜ w)) =
    (freeObj (M ⊗ N)).proj (q + 0) (freeTensor M N (v ⊗ₜ w))
  rw [add_zero, SVec.tensorObj_proj_tmul, map_add, freeTensor_tmul, freeTensor_tmul,
    freeTensor_tmul]
  funext x
  rw [Pi.add_apply, freeObj_proj_apply, freeObj_proj_apply, freeObj_proj_apply,
    freeObj_proj_apply, freeObj_proj_apply, par_tensor_X]
  rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one (par (M.X x.1)) with h1 | h1 <;>
    rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one (par (N.X x.2)) with h2 | h2 <;>
    rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one q with rfl | rfl <;> simp [h1, h2]

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.matHom_tensor_apply
statement:
theorem matHom_tensor_apply {M M' N N' : Mat_ (D k)} (f : M ⟶ M') (g : N ⟶ N')
    (t : (M.ι → k) ⊗[k] (N.ι → k)) :
    matHom (f ⊗ₘ g) (tmulFun M.ι N.ι t) = tmulFun M'.ι N'.ι
      (TensorProduct.map (SVec.toLinearMap (matHom f)) (SVec.toLinearMap (matHom g)) t)

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.tensorObj_p
statement: theorem tensorObj_p (P Q : SKar k (UnitSupercat k)) : (P ⊗ Q).p = P.p ⊗ₘ Q.p

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.μLin_tmul
statement:
theorem μLin_tmul (P Q : SKar k (UnitSupercat k)) (v : imgSubmodule P) (w : imgSubmodule Q) :
    μLin P Q (v ⊗ₜ w) = fun x => v.1 x.1 * w.1 x.2

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.μLin_mem
statement:
theorem μLin_mem (P Q : SKar k (UnitSupercat k)) (t : imgSubmodule P ⊗[k] imgSubmodule Q) :
    μLin P Q t ∈ imgSubmodule (P ⊗ Q)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_imgSubmodule, tensorObj_p]
  induction t using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul v w =>
    change matHom (P.p ⊗ₘ Q.p) (tmulFun _ _ (v.1 ⊗ₜ w.1)) = tmulFun _ _ (v.1 ⊗ₜ w.1)
    rw [matHom_tensor_apply, TensorProduct.map_tmul]
    change tmulFun _ _ (matHom P.p v.1 ⊗ₜ matHom Q.p w.1) = _
    rw [mem_imgSubmodule.1 v.2, mem_imgSubmodule.1 w.2]
  | add t t' h h' =>
    rw [LinearMap.map_add]
    erw [LinearMap.map_add (matHom (P.p ⊗ₘ Q.p))]
    exact congrArg₂ (· + ·) h h'

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.μLin_apply_mem_imgSubmodule
statement:
theorem μLin_apply_mem_imgSubmodule (P Q : SKar k (UnitSupercat k)) (u : P.X.ι × Q.X.ι → k)
    (hu : u ∈ imgSubmodule (P ⊗ Q)) (t : (P.X.ι → k) ⊗[k] (Q.X.ι → k)) (ht : tmulFun _ _ t = u) :
    μLin P Q (TensorProduct.map
      (LinearMap.codRestrict (imgSubmodule P) (SVec.toLinearMap (matHom P.p)) (matHom_p_mem P))
      (LinearMap.codRestrict (imgSubmodule Q) (SVec.toLinearMap (matHom Q.p)) (matHom_p_mem Q)) t)
      = u
proof:
:= by
  rw [μLin, LinearMap.comp_apply,
    ← LinearMap.comp_apply (TensorProduct.map (imgSubmodule P).subtype (imgSubmodule Q).subtype),
    ← TensorProduct.map_comp, LinearMap.subtype_comp_codRestrict,
    LinearMap.subtype_comp_codRestrict, ← matHom_tensor_apply, ← tensorObj_p, ht]
  exact mem_imgSubmodule.1 hu

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.inclT_mem
statement:
theorem inclT_mem (P Q : SKar k (UnitSupercat k)) :
    SVec.ofHom (TensorProduct.map (imgSubmodule P).subtype (imgSubmodule Q).subtype) ∈
      SVec.parityHom (imgObj P ⊗ imgObj Q) (freeObj P.X ⊗ freeObj Q.X) 0
proof:
:= by
  intro q
  apply TensorProduct.ext'
  intro v w
  change TensorProduct.map _ _ ((SVec.tensorObj (imgObj P) (imgObj Q)).proj q (v ⊗ₜ w)) =
    (SVec.tensorObj (freeObj P.X) (freeObj Q.X)).proj (q + 0) (v.1 ⊗ₜ w.1)
  rw [add_zero, SVec.tensorObj_proj_tmul, SVec.tensorObj_proj_tmul, map_add,
    TensorProduct.map_tmul, TensorProduct.map_tmul]
  simp only [Submodule.subtype_apply]
  rw [SVec.sub_proj_apply, SVec.sub_proj_apply, SVec.sub_proj_apply, SVec.sub_proj_apply]

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.range_μLin
statement:
theorem range_μLin (P Q : SKar K (UnitSupercat K)) :
    LinearMap.range (μLin P Q) = imgSubmodule (P ⊗ Q)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rintro _ ⟨t, rfl⟩
    exact μLin_mem P Q t
  · intro u hu
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := tmulFun_surjective P.X.ι Q.X.ι u
    exact ⟨_, μLin_apply_mem_imgSubmodule P Q u hu t ht⟩

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.μLin_injective
statement: theorem μLin_injective (P Q : SKar K (UnitSupercat K)) : Function.Injective (μLin P Q)
proof:
:= by
  refine (tmulFun_injective _ _).comp ?_
  change Function.Injective
    (TensorProduct.map (imgSubmodule P).subtype (imgSubmodule Q).subtype)
  rw [← LinearMap.lTensor_comp_rTensor]
  exact (Module.Flat.lTensor_preserves_injective_linearMap _ (Submodule.injective_subtype _)).comp
    (Module.Flat.rTensor_preserves_injective_linearMap _ (Submodule.injective_subtype _))

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.μEquiv_apply_coe
statement:
theorem μEquiv_apply_coe (P Q : SKar K (UnitSupercat K)) (t : imgSubmodule P ⊗[K] imgSubmodule Q) :
    (μEquiv P Q t).1 = μLin P Q t

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.μEquiv_tmul_coe
statement:
theorem μEquiv_tmul_coe (P Q : SKar K (UnitSupercat K)) (v : imgSubmodule P)
    (w : imgSubmodule Q) : (μEquiv P Q (v ⊗ₜ w)).1 = fun x => v.1 x.1 * w.1 x.2

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.μEquiv_hom_mem
statement:
theorem μEquiv_hom_mem (P Q : SKar K (UnitSupercat K)) :
    (SVec.isoOfLinearEquiv (μEquiv P Q)).hom ∈
      SVec.parityHom (imgObj P ⊗ imgObj Q) (imgObj (P ⊗ Q)) 0
proof:
:= by
  refine SVec.mem_parityHom_of_apply_mem fun q t ht => ?_
  rw [add_zero, SVec.mem_sub_part_iff]
  have h1 := SVec.apply_mem_part (inclT_mem P Q) ht
  have h2 := SVec.apply_mem_part (freeTensor_mem P.X Q.X) h1
  rw [add_zero, add_zero] at h2
  exact h2

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.μIso_hom_apply_coe
statement:
theorem μIso_hom_apply_coe (P Q : SKar K (UnitSupercat K))
    (t : imgSubmodule P ⊗[K] imgSubmodule Q) :
    ((μIso P Q).hom.1 t).1 = μLin P Q t

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.unit_p
statement: theorem unit_p : (𝟙_ (SKar K (UnitSupercat K))).p = 𝟙 (𝟙_ (Mat_ (D K)))

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.par_unit_X
statement: theorem par_unit_X (i : (𝟙_ (Mat_ (D K))).ι) : par ((𝟙_ (Mat_ (D K))).X i) = 0

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.εEquiv_apply_coe
statement: theorem εEquiv_apply_coe (c : K) : (εEquiv c).1 = fun _ => c

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.εEquiv_hom_mem
statement:
theorem εEquiv_hom_mem :
    (SVec.isoOfLinearEquiv (εEquiv (K := K))).hom ∈
      SVec.parityHom SVec.unit (imgObj (𝟙_ (SKar K (UnitSupercat K)))) 0
proof:
:= by
  refine SVec.mem_parityHom_of_apply_mem fun q c hc => ?_
  rw [add_zero, SVec.mem_sub_part_iff, mem_freeObj_part_iff]
  intro i hi
  change (0 : ZMod 2) ≠ q at hi
  rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one q with rfl | rfl
  · exact absurd rfl hi
  · rw [SVec.mem_part_iff, SVec.unit_proj_one_apply] at hc
    change c = 0
    exact hc.symm

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.vecMul_scalMat_permMat

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.matHom_associator_hom
statement:
theorem matHom_associator_hom (M N P : Mat_ (D K)) (y : ((M ⊗ N) ⊗ P).ι → K)

proof:
:= by

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.tensor_p_apply_tmul
statement:
theorem tensor_p_apply_tmul (P Q : SKar K (UnitSupercat K)) (v : imgSubmodule P)
    (w : imgSubmodule Q) :
    matHom (P.p ⊗ₘ Q.p) (tmulFun P.X.ι Q.X.ι (v.1 ⊗ₜ w.1)) = tmulFun P.X.ι Q.X.ι (v.1 ⊗ₜ w.1)

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.μIso_natural
statement:
theorem μIso_natural {P P' Q Q' : SKar K (UnitSupercat K)} (φ : P ⟶ P') (ψ : Q ⟶ Q')
    (t : imgSubmodule P ⊗[K] imgSubmodule Q) :
    (μIso P' Q').hom.1 (TensorProduct.map (SVec.toLinearMap ((toSVec K).map φ).1)
      (SVec.toLinearMap ((toSVec K).map ψ).1) t) =
      ((toSVec K).map (φ ⊗ₘ ψ)).1 ((μIso P Q).hom.1 t)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [μIso_hom_apply_coe, toSVec_map_apply, μIso_hom_apply_coe]
  induction t using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul v w =>
    rw [TensorProduct.map_tmul]
    change tmulFun _ _ (matHom φ.f v.1 ⊗ₜ matHom ψ.f w.1) =
      matHom (φ.f ⊗ₘ ψ.f) (tmulFun _ _ (v.1 ⊗ₜ w.1))
    rw [matHom_tensor_apply, TensorProduct.map_tmul]
    rfl
  | add t t' h h' =>
    rw [LinearMap.map_add, LinearMap.map_add, LinearMap.map_add]
    erw [LinearMap.map_add (matHom (φ ⊗ₘ ψ).f)]
    exact congrArg₂ (· + ·) h h'

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.toSVec_map_id_toLinearMap
statement:
theorem toSVec_map_id_toLinearMap (P : SKar K (UnitSupercat K)) :

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.μIso_associativity
statement:
theorem μIso_associativity (P Q R : SKar K (UnitSupercat K)) :
    (μIso P Q).hom ▷ (toSVec K).obj R ≫ (μIso (P ⊗ Q) R).hom ≫ (toSVec K).map (α_ P Q R).hom =
        (α_ ((toSVec K).obj P) ((toSVec K).obj Q) ((toSVec K).obj R)).hom ≫
          (toSVec K).obj P ◁ (μIso Q R).hom ≫ (μIso P (Q ⊗ R)).hom
proof:
:= by
  apply Underlying.hom_ext
  apply SVec.hom_ext
  intro t
  induction t using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | add t t' h h' => rw [map_add, map_add, h, h']
  | tmul t u =>
    induction t using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
    | add t t' h h' => rw [TensorProduct.add_tmul, map_add, map_add, h, h']
    | tmul v w =>
      simp only [Underlying.comp_val, Underlying.whiskerRight_val, Underlying.whiskerLeft_val,
        Underlying.associator_hom_val]
      erw [SVec.comp_apply, SVec.comp_apply, SVec.comp_apply, SVec.comp_apply]
      change ((toSVec K).map (α_ P Q R).hom).1 ((μIso (P ⊗ Q) R).hom.1
        ((μIso P Q).hom.1 (v ⊗ₜ w) ⊗ₜ u)) = (μIso P (Q ⊗ R)).hom.1
          ((SVec.whiskerLeft (imgObj P) (μIso Q R).hom.1) (v ⊗ₜ (w ⊗ₜ u)))
      rw [SVec.whiskerLeft_of_mem _ (μIso Q R).hom.2, SVec.sgn_zero]
      apply Subtype.ext
      rw [toSVec_map_apply, μIso_hom_apply_coe]
      refine (matHom_associator_hom_f P Q R _).trans ?_
      have e1 : matHom (α_ P.X Q.X R.X).hom (μLin (P ⊗ Q) R ((μIso P Q).hom.1 (v ⊗ₜ w) ⊗ₜ u)) =
          tmulFun P.X.ι (Q.X.ι × R.X.ι) (v.1 ⊗ₜ tmulFun Q.X.ι R.X.ι (w.1 ⊗ₜ u.1)) := by
        funext x
        refine (matHom_associator_hom P.X Q.X R.X _ x).trans ?_
        change (v.1 x.1 * w.1 x.2.1) * u.1 x.2.2 = v.1 x.1 * (w.1 x.2.1 * u.1 x.2.2)
        rw [mul_assoc]
      rw [e1]
      refine (matHom_tensor_apply P.p (Q.p ⊗ₘ R.p) _).trans ?_
      rw [TensorProduct.map_tmul]
      refine (congrArg (tmulFun P.X.ι (Q.X.ι × R.X.ι)) (congrArg₂ (fun a b => a ⊗ₜ[K] b)
        (mem_imgSubmodule.1 v.2) (tensor_p_apply_tmul Q R w u))).trans ?_
      rfl

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.μIso_left_unitality
statement:
theorem μIso_left_unitality (P : SKar K (UnitSupercat K)) :
    (λ_ ((toSVec K).obj P)).hom = εIso.hom ▷ (toSVec K).obj P ≫
      (μIso (𝟙_ (SKar K (UnitSupercat K))) P).hom ≫ (toSVec K).map (λ_ P).hom
proof:
:= by
  apply Underlying.hom_ext
  apply SVec.hom_ext
  intro t
  induction t using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | add t t' h h' => rw [map_add, map_add, h, h']
  | tmul c v =>
    simp only [Underlying.comp_val, Underlying.whiskerRight_val, Underlying.leftUnitor_hom_val]
    erw [SVec.comp_apply, SVec.comp_apply, SVec.leftUnitor_hom_tmul]
    change c • v = ((toSVec K).map (λ_ P).hom).1
      ((μIso (𝟙_ (SKar K (UnitSupercat K))) P).hom.1 (εIso.hom.1 c ⊗ₜ v))
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [toSVec_map_apply, μIso_hom_apply_coe]
    change (c • v).1 = matHom ((λ_ P.X).hom ≫ P.p)
      (μLin (𝟙_ (SKar K (UnitSupercat K))) P (εIso.hom.1 c ⊗ₜ v))
    rw [matHom_comp, SVec.comp_apply]
    have e1 : matHom (λ_ P.X).hom (μLin (𝟙_ (SKar K (UnitSupercat K))) P (εIso.hom.1 c ⊗ₜ v)) =
        c • v.1 := by
      funext i
      exact matHom_leftUnitor_hom P.X _ i
    rw [e1, LinearMap.map_smul, mem_imgSubmodule.1 v.2]
    rfl

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.μIso_right_unitality
statement:
theorem μIso_right_unitality (P : SKar K (UnitSupercat K)) :
    (ρ_ ((toSVec K).obj P)).hom = (toSVec K).obj P ◁ εIso.hom ≫
      (μIso P (𝟙_ (SKar K (UnitSupercat K)))).hom ≫ (toSVec K).map (ρ_ P).hom
proof:
:= by
  apply Underlying.hom_ext
  apply SVec.hom_ext
  intro t
  induction t using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | add t t' h h' => rw [map_add, map_add, h, h']
  | tmul v c =>
    simp only [Underlying.comp_val, Underlying.whiskerLeft_val, Underlying.rightUnitor_hom_val]
    erw [SVec.comp_apply, SVec.comp_apply, SVec.rightUnitor_hom_tmul]
    change c • v = ((toSVec K).map (ρ_ P).hom).1 ((μIso P (𝟙_ (SKar K (UnitSupercat K)))).hom.1
      ((SVec.whiskerLeft (imgObj P) εIso.hom.1) (v ⊗ₜ c)))
    rw [SVec.whiskerLeft_of_mem _ εIso.hom.2, SVec.sgn_zero]
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [toSVec_map_apply, μIso_hom_apply_coe]
    change (c • v).1 = matHom ((ρ_ P.X).hom ≫ P.p)
      (μLin P (𝟙_ (SKar K (UnitSupercat K))) (v ⊗ₜ εIso.hom.1 c))
    rw [matHom_comp, SVec.comp_apply]
    have e1 : matHom (ρ_ P.X).hom (μLin P (𝟙_ (SKar K (UnitSupercat K))) (v ⊗ₜ εIso.hom.1 c)) =
        c • v.1 := by
      funext i
      refine (matHom_rightUnitor_hom P.X _ i).trans ?_
      change v.1 i * c = c * v.1 i
      rw [mul_comm]
    rw [e1, LinearMap.map_smul, mem_imgSubmodule.1 v.2]
    rfl

name: StringDiagrams.PiSOp.hom_associator_inv
statement:
theorem hom_associator_inv {a b c d : TwoEnvelope R (TwoSOp R B)}
    (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) (h : c ⟶ d) :
    (hom a d).map (associator f g h).inv =
      (associator ((hom a b).obj f) ((hom b c).obj g) ((hom c d).obj h)).inv
proof:
:= by
  apply SOp.hom_ext
  apply Envelope.hom_ext
  change correction (R := R) (f.par + (g.par + h.par)) ((f.par + g.par) + h.par)
      (associator (SOp.unop f.obj) (SOp.unop g.obj) (SOp.unop h.obj)).hom = _
  rw [add_assoc]
  simp only [correction, zmod2_add_self, mul_zero, sign_zero, twist_zero, one_smul]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.PiSOp.hom_leftUnitor
statement:
theorem hom_leftUnitor {a b : TwoEnvelope R (TwoSOp R B)} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (hom a b).map (leftUnitor f).hom = (leftUnitor ((hom a b).obj f)).hom
proof:
:= by
  apply SOp.hom_ext
  apply Envelope.hom_ext
  change correction (R := R) (0 + f.par) f.par (leftUnitor (SOp.unop f.obj)).inv = _
  simp only [zero_add, correction, zmod2_add_self, mul_zero, sign_zero, twist_zero, one_smul]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.PiSOp.hom_rightUnitor
statement:
theorem hom_rightUnitor {a b : TwoEnvelope R (TwoSOp R B)} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (hom a b).map (rightUnitor f).hom = (rightUnitor ((hom a b).obj f)).hom
proof:
:= by
  apply SOp.hom_ext
  apply Envelope.hom_ext
  change correction (R := R) (f.par + 0) f.par (rightUnitor (SOp.unop f.obj)).inv = _
  simp only [add_zero, correction, zmod2_add_self, mul_zero, sign_zero, twist_zero, one_smul]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.PiSOp.comparison_associator
statement:
theorem comparison_associator {a b c d : TwoEnvelope R (TwoSOp R B)}
    (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) (h : c ⟶ d) :
    (hom a b).obj f ◁ (comparison g h).hom ≫ (comparison f (g ≫ h)).hom ≫
        (hom a d).map (associator f g h).inv =
      (associator ((hom a b).obj f) ((hom b c).obj g) ((hom c d).obj h)).inv ≫
        (comparison f g).hom ▷ (hom c d).obj h ≫ (comparison (f ≫ g) h).hom
proof:
:= by
  change (hom a b).obj f ◁ (sign R (g.par * h.par) • 𝟙 _) ≫
      (sign R (f.par * (g.par + h.par)) • 𝟙 _) ≫ _ =
    _ ≫ (sign R (f.par * g.par) • 𝟙 _) ▷ (hom c d).obj h ≫
      (sign R ((f.par + g.par) * h.par) • 𝟙 _)
  erw [whiskerLeft_smul, whiskerLeft_id (R := R), smul_whiskerRight, id_whiskerRight (R := R),
    Linear.smul_comp, Category.id_comp, Linear.smul_comp, Category.id_comp,
    Linear.comp_smul, Category.comp_id, Linear.comp_smul, Linear.comp_smul, Category.comp_id]
  erw [hom_associator_inv, smul_smul, smul_smul, comparison_cocycle, mul_comm]

name: StringDiagrams.PiSOp.comparison_leftUnitor
statement:
theorem comparison_leftUnitor {a b : TwoEnvelope R (TwoSOp R B)} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (identityComparison a).hom ▷ (hom a b).obj f ≫ (comparison (𝟙 a) f).hom ≫
        (hom a b).map (leftUnitor f).hom = (leftUnitor ((hom a b).obj f)).hom
proof:
:= by
  change 𝟙 _ ▷ (hom a b).obj f ≫ (sign R (0 * f.par) • 𝟙 _) ≫ _ = _
  erw [zero_mul, sign_zero, one_smul, id_whiskerRight (R := R),
    Category.id_comp, Category.id_comp]
  exact hom_leftUnitor f

name: StringDiagrams.PiSOp.comparison_rightUnitor
statement:
theorem comparison_rightUnitor {a b : TwoEnvelope R (TwoSOp R B)} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (hom a b).obj f ◁ (identityComparison b).hom ≫ (comparison f (𝟙 b)).hom ≫
        (hom a b).map (rightUnitor f).hom = (rightUnitor ((hom a b).obj f)).hom
proof:
:= by
  change (hom a b).obj f ◁ 𝟙 _ ≫ (sign R (f.par * 0) • 𝟙 _) ≫ _ = _
  erw [mul_zero, sign_zero, one_smul, whiskerLeft_id (R := R),
    Category.id_comp, Category.id_comp]
  exact hom_rightUnitor f

name: StringDiagrams.QPiSupercategory.conjFunctor_isSuperfunctor
statement:
theorem conjFunctor_isSuperfunctor (obj : C → C) (e : ∀ X, obj X ≅ X)
    (he : ∀ X, (e X).hom ∈ parity (R := R) (obj X) X 0) :
    IsSuperfunctor R (conjFunctor obj e) where
  map_mem {X Y p f} hf
proof:
:= by
    have := comp_mem (comp_mem (he X) hf) (inv_mem _ (he Y))
    simp only [zero_add, add_zero, Category.assoc] at this
    exact this

name: StringDiagrams.QPiSupercategory.conjFunctor_isSupernatural

    IsSupernatural R 0 (F := conjFunctor obj e) (G := 𝟭 C) fun X => (e X).hom
proof:
:=
  IsSupernatural.of_twist he fun f => by simp

:= by
  have h := comp_mem_degree (σbar_hom_mem_degree (R := R) (𝐐.obj X))
    (σ_hom_mem_degree (R := R) X)
  rw [add_neg_cancel] at h
  exact h

name: StringDiagrams.QPiSupercategory.jj_hom_mem
statement: theorem jj_hom_mem (X : C) : (jj (R := R) X).hom ∈ parity (R := R) _ X 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := comp_mem (σ_hom_mem (R := R) (𝐐⁻.obj X)) (σbar_hom_mem (R := R) X)
  rw [add_zero] at h
  exact h

name: StringDiagrams.QPiSupercategory.jj_hom_mem_degree
statement: theorem jj_hom_mem_degree (X : C) : (jj (R := R) X).hom ∈ degree (R := R) _ X 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := comp_mem_degree (σ_hom_mem_degree (R := R) (𝐐⁻.obj X))
    (σbar_hom_mem_degree (R := R) X)
  rw [neg_add_cancel] at h
  exact h

name: StringDiagrams.QPiSupercategory.ii_naturality
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem ii_naturality {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    𝐐⁻.map (𝐐.map f) ≫ (ii (R := R) Y).hom = (ii (R := R) X).hom ≫ f
proof:
:= by
  rw [ii_hom, ii_hom, σbar_naturality_assoc, σ_naturality, Category.assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.QPiSupercategory.jj_naturality
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem jj_naturality {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    𝐐.map (𝐐⁻.map f) ≫ (jj (R := R) Y).hom = (jj (R := R) X).hom ≫ f
proof:
:= by
  rw [jj_hom, jj_hom, σ_naturality_assoc, σbar_naturality, Category.assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.QPiSupercategory.Q_map_ii
statement: theorem Q_map_ii (X : C) : 𝐐.map (ii (R := R) X).hom = (jj (R := R) (𝐐.obj X)).hom

name: StringDiagrams.QPiSupercategory.ii_Qinv
statement: theorem ii_Qinv (X : C) : (ii (R := R) (𝐐⁻.obj X)).hom = 𝐐⁻.map (jj (R := R) X).hom

name: StringDiagrams.QPiSupercategory.qEquivalence_functor
statement: @[simp] theorem qEquivalence_functor : (qEquivalence (R := R) (C := C)).functor = 𝐐

name: StringDiagrams.QPiSupercategory.qEquivalence_inverse
statement: @[simp] theorem qEquivalence_inverse : (qEquivalence (R := R) (C := C)).inverse = 𝐐⁻

name: StringDiagrams.QPiSupercategory.β_hom_mem_degree
statement:
theorem β_hom_mem_degree (F : C ⥤ D) [F.Additive] [F.Linear R] [IsGradedSuperfunctor R F]
    (X : C) :
    (PiSupercategory.β R F X).hom ∈ degree (R := R) _ _ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [PiSupercategory.β_hom]
  simpa using comp_mem_degree (ζ_hom_mem_degree (R := R) (F.obj X))
    (map_mem_degree F (ζ_inv_mem_degree (R := R) X))

name: StringDiagrams.QPiSupercategory.γ_hom
statement:
theorem γ_hom (F : C ⥤ D) (X : C) :
    (γ R F X).hom = (σ (R := R) (F.obj X)).hom ≫ F.map (σ (R := R) X).inv

name: StringDiagrams.QPiSupercategory.γ_inv
statement:
theorem γ_inv (F : C ⥤ D) (X : C) :
    (γ R F X).inv = F.map (σ (R := R) X).hom ≫ (σ (R := R) (F.obj X)).inv

name: StringDiagrams.QPiSupercategory.γ_hom_eq
statement:
theorem γ_hom_eq (F : C ⥤ D) (X : C) :
    (γ R F X).hom = (Q (R := R)).map (F.map (σ (R := R) X).inv) ≫
      (σ (R := R) (F.obj ((Q (R := R)).obj X))).hom

name: StringDiagrams.QPiSupercategory.γ_hom_mem
statement:
theorem γ_hom_mem (F : C ⥤ D) [F.Additive] [F.Linear R] [IsSuperfunctor R F] (X : C) :
    (γ R F X).hom ∈ parity (R := R) _ _ 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := comp_mem (σ_hom_mem (R := R) (F.obj X)) (map_mem F (σ_inv_mem (R := R) X))
  rw [add_zero] at h
  exact h

name: StringDiagrams.QPiSupercategory.γ_hom_mem_degree
statement:
theorem γ_hom_mem_degree (F : C ⥤ D) [F.Additive] [F.Linear R] [IsGradedSuperfunctor R F]
    (X : C) : (γ R F X).hom ∈ degree (R := R) _ _ 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := comp_mem_degree (σ_hom_mem_degree (R := R) (F.obj X))
    (map_mem_degree F (σ_inv_mem_degree (R := R) X))
  rw [neg_add_cancel] at h
  exact h

name: StringDiagrams.QPiSupercategory.γ_naturality
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem γ_naturality (F : C ⥤ D) {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    (Q (R := R)).map (F.map f) ≫ (γ R F Y).hom = (γ R F X).hom ≫ F.map ((Q (R := R)).map f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [γ_hom, γ_hom, σ_naturality_assoc, Category.assoc, Q_map_eq (R := R) f, ← F.map_comp,
    ← F.map_comp, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.QPiSupercategory.γ_pi
statement:
theorem γ_pi (X : C) :
    (γ R (PiSupercategory.pi (R := R)) X).hom = (PiSupercategory.β R 𝐐 X).inv
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cancel_mono (PiSupercategory.β R 𝐐 X).hom, Iso.inv_hom_id, γ_hom,
    PiSupercategory.β_hom, Category.assoc, PiSupercategory.ζ_naturality_assoc,
    twist_one_of_mem (σ_inv_mem (R := R) X), sign_zero, one_smul, Q_map_eq]
  simp

name: StringDiagrams.QPiSupercategory.γ_naturality_supernatural
statement:
theorem γ_naturality_supernatural (F G : C ⥤ D) [F.Additive] [G.Additive] [G.Linear R]
    {p : ZMod 2} {x : ∀ X, F.obj X ⟶ G.obj X} (hx : IsSupernatural R p x) (X : C) :
    (Q (R := R)).map (x X) ≫ (γ R G X).hom = (γ R F X).hom ≫ x ((Q (R := R)).obj X)
proof:
:= by
  rw [γ_hom, γ_hom, σ_naturality_assoc, Category.assoc, hx.naturality (σ_inv_mem (R := R) X),
    mul_zero, sign_zero, one_smul]

name: StringDiagrams.QPiSupercategory.γ_comp
statement:
theorem γ_comp (F : C ⥤ D) (G : D ⥤ E) (X : C) :
    (γ R (F ⋙ G) X).hom = (γ R G (F.obj X)).hom ≫ G.map (γ R F X).hom

name: StringDiagrams.QPiSupercategory.γ_id
statement: theorem γ_id (X : C) : (γ R (𝟭 C) X).hom = 𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.QPiSupercategory.γ_Q
statement: theorem γ_Q (X : C) : (γ R 𝐐 X).hom = 𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.QPiSupercategory.β_γ_compat
statement:
theorem β_γ_compat (F : C ⥤ D) [F.Additive] [F.Linear R] [IsSuperfunctor R F] (X : C) :
    (PiSupercategory.β R (Q (R := R) (C := D)) (F.obj X)).hom ≫
        (Q (R := R)).map (PiSupercategory.β R F X).hom ≫ (γ R F ((PiSupercategory.pi (R := R)).obj X)).hom =
      (PiSupercategory.pi (R := R)).map (γ R F X).hom ≫ (PiSupercategory.β R F ((Q (R := R)).obj X)).hom ≫
        F.map (PiSupercategory.β R 𝐐 X).hom
proof:
:= by
  simp only [PiSupercategory.β_hom, γ_hom, Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc]
  rw [← (Q (R := R)).map_comp_assoc (PiSupercategory.ζ (R := R) (F.obj X)).inv, Iso.inv_hom_id]
  erw [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id, Category.id_comp]
  rw [σ_naturality_assoc, ← Functor.map_comp_assoc (PiSupercategory.pi (R := R)),
    PiSupercategory.ζ_naturality_assoc,
    twist_one_of_mem (comp_mem (σ_hom_mem (R := R) (F.obj X)) (map_mem F (σ_inv_mem (R := R) X))),
    add_zero, sign_zero, one_smul]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [← F.map_comp_assoc (PiSupercategory.ζ (R := R) ((Q (R := R)).obj X)).inv, Iso.inv_hom_id]
  erw [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id, Category.id_comp]
  simp only [← F.map_comp]
  congr 3
  rw [Q_map_eq (R := R) (PiSupercategory.ζ (R := R) X).inv]
  simp

name: StringDiagrams.QPiSupercategory.σPowNat_hom_mem
statement:
theorem σPowNat_hom_mem (n : ℕ) (X : C) :
    (σPowNat R n X).hom ∈ parity (R := R) _ X 0
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact id_mem X
  | succ n ih =>
    have h := comp_mem (σ_hom_mem (R := R) _) ih
    rw [add_zero] at h
    exact h

name: StringDiagrams.QPiSupercategory.σPowNat_hom_mem_degree
statement:
theorem σPowNat_hom_mem_degree (n : ℕ) (X : C) :
    (σPowNat R n X).hom ∈ degree (R := R) _ X (-n)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact id_mem_degree X
  | succ n ih =>
    have := comp_mem_degree (σ_hom_mem_degree (R := R) (qPowNat R n X)) ih
    rwa [show (-1 + -(n : ℤ)) = -((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) by push_cast; ring] at this

name: StringDiagrams.QPiSupercategory.σbarPowNat_hom_mem
statement:
theorem σbarPowNat_hom_mem (n : ℕ) (X : C) :
    (σbarPowNat R n X).hom ∈ parity (R := R) _ X 0
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact id_mem X
  | succ n ih =>
    have h := comp_mem (σbar_hom_mem (R := R) _) ih
    rw [add_zero] at h
    exact h

name: StringDiagrams.QPiSupercategory.σbarPowNat_hom_mem_degree
statement:
theorem σbarPowNat_hom_mem_degree (n : ℕ) (X : C) :
    (σbarPowNat R n X).hom ∈ degree (R := R) _ X n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact id_mem_degree X
  | succ n ih =>
    have := comp_mem_degree (σbar_hom_mem_degree (R := R) (qinvPowNat R n X)) ih
    rwa [show (1 + (n : ℤ)) = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) by push_cast; ring] at this

name: StringDiagrams.QPiSupercategory.σPow_hom_mem
statement: theorem σPow_hom_mem (m : ℤ) (X : C) : (σPow R m X).hom ∈ parity (R := R) _ X 0
proof:
:= by
  cases m with
  | ofNat n => exact σPowNat_hom_mem n X
  | negSucc n => exact σbarPowNat_hom_mem (n + 1) X

name: StringDiagrams.QPiSupercategory.σPow_inv_mem
statement: theorem σPow_inv_mem (m : ℤ) (X : C) : (σPow R m X).inv ∈ parity (R := R) X _ 0

name: StringDiagrams.QPiSupercategory.σPow_hom_mem_degree
statement: theorem σPow_hom_mem_degree (m : ℤ) (X : C) : (σPow R m X).hom ∈ degree (R := R) _ X (-m)
proof:
:= by
  cases m with
  | ofNat n => exact σPowNat_hom_mem_degree n X
  | negSucc n =>
    have := σbarPowNat_hom_mem_degree (R := R) (n + 1) X
    rwa [show ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = -Int.negSucc n by rw [Int.neg_negSucc]] at this

name: StringDiagrams.QPiSupercategory.σPow_inv_mem_degree
statement: theorem σPow_inv_mem_degree (m : ℤ) (X : C) : (σPow R m X).inv ∈ degree (R := R) X _ m
proof:
:= by
  simpa using inv_mem_degree _ (σPow_hom_mem_degree (R := R) m X)

name: StringDiagrams.QPiSupercategory.qPow_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem qPow_zero (X : C) : qPow R 0 X = X

name: StringDiagrams.QPiSupercategory.σPow_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem σPow_zero (X : C) : σPow R 0 X = Iso.refl X

name: StringDiagrams.Underlying.ζ_comp_ζL_inv_mem
statement:
theorem ζ_comp_ζL_inv_mem (X : C) :
    ((PiSupercategory.ζ (R := R) X).hom ≫ (MonoidalPiSupercategory.ζL (R := R) X).inv) ∈
      parity (R := R) _ _ 0
proof:
:= by
  have := comp_mem (PiSupercategory.ζ_hom_mem (R := R) X)
    (inv_mem _ (MonoidalPiSupercategory.ζL_hom_mem (R := R) X))
  simpa using! this

name: StringDiagrams.Underlying.ζ_comp_ζR_inv_mem
statement:
theorem ζ_comp_ζR_inv_mem (X : C) :
    ((PiSupercategory.ζ (R := R) X).hom ≫ (MonoidalPiSupercategory.ζR (R := R) X).inv) ∈
      parity (R := R) _ _ 0
proof:
:= by
  have := comp_mem (PiSupercategory.ζ_hom_mem (R := R) X)
    (inv_mem _ (MonoidalPiSupercategory.ζR_hom_mem (R := R) X))
  simpa using! this

name: StringDiagrams.SKar.mk_pi_eq_piObj_mul
statement:
theorem mk_pi_eq_piObj_mul (P : SKar R C) :
    K₀.mk ((PiCategory.pi (R := R)).obj P) = K₀.mk (piObj R C) * K₀.mk P

name: StringDiagrams.SKar.mk_pi_eq_mul_piObj
statement:
theorem mk_pi_eq_mul_piObj (P : SKar R C) :
    K₀.mk ((PiCategory.pi (R := R)).obj P) = K₀.mk P * K₀.mk (piObj R C)

name: StringDiagrams.SKar.piObj_mul
statement:
theorem piObj_mul (x : K₀ (SKar R C)) :
    K₀.mk (piObj R C) * x = K₀.piInvolution R (SKar R C) x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using K₀.induction_on with
  | mk P => rw [K₀.piInvolution_mk, mk_pi_eq_piObj_mul]
  | zero => rw [K₀.mul_zero, map_zero]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [K₀.mul_add, hx, hy, map_add]
  | neg x hx => rw [K₀.mul_neg, hx, map_neg]

name: StringDiagrams.SKar.mul_piObj
statement:
theorem mul_piObj (x : K₀ (SKar R C)) :
    x * K₀.mk (piObj R C) = K₀.piInvolution R (SKar R C) x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using K₀.induction_on with
  | mk P => rw [K₀.piInvolution_mk, mk_pi_eq_mul_piObj]
  | zero => rw [K₀.zero_mul, map_zero]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [K₀.add_mul, hx, hy, map_add]
  | neg x hx => rw [K₀.neg_mul, hx, map_neg]

name: StringDiagrams.SKar.piObj_commute
statement: theorem piObj_commute (x : K₀ (SKar R C)) : Commute (K₀.mk (piObj R C)) x

name: StringDiagrams.SKar.piObj_mul_piObj
statement: theorem piObj_mul_piObj : K₀.mk (piObj R C) * K₀.mk (piObj R C) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h : K₀.mk (piObj R C) = K₀.piInvolution R (SKar R C) 1 := by
    rw [← piObj_mul, mul_one]
  rw [piObj_mul, h, K₀.piInvolution_piInvolution]

name: StringDiagrams.SKar.toK₀_π
statement: theorem toK₀_π : toK₀ (R := R) (C := C) Zπ.π = K₀.mk (piObj R C)

name: StringDiagrams.SKar.toK₀_commute
statement: theorem toK₀_commute (c : Zπ) (x : K₀ (SKar R C)) : Commute (toK₀ c) x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective c
  change Commute (eval₂RingHom' (Int.castRingHom _) (K₀.mk (piObj R C))
    (fun n => Int.cast_commute n _) q) x
  induction q using Polynomial.induction_on with
  | C a =>
    rw [eval₂RingHom', RingHom.coe_mk, MonoidHom.coe_mk, OneHom.coe_mk, eval₂_C]
    exact Int.cast_commute a x
  | add p q hp hq => rw [map_add]; exact hp.add_left hq
  | monomial n a _ =>
    rw [map_mul, map_pow]
    refine Commute.mul_left ?_ (Commute.pow_left ?_ _)
    · rw [eval₂RingHom', RingHom.coe_mk, MonoidHom.coe_mk, OneHom.coe_mk, eval₂_C]
      exact Int.cast_commute a x
    · rw [eval₂RingHom', RingHom.coe_mk, MonoidHom.coe_mk, OneHom.coe_mk, eval₂_X]
      exact piObj_commute x

name: StringDiagrams.SKar.algebraMap_π
statement: theorem algebraMap_π : algebraMap Zπ (K₀ (SKar R C)) Zπ.π = K₀.mk (piObj R C)

name: StringDiagrams.SKar.π_smul_eq
statement: theorem π_smul_eq (x : K₀ (SKar R C)) : Zπ.π • x = K₀.piInvolution R (SKar R C) x

name: StringDiagrams.SKar.π_smul_mk_algebra
statement:
theorem π_smul_mk_algebra (V : SKar R C) :
    Zπ.π • K₀.mk V = K₀.mk ((PiCategory.pi (R := R)).obj V)

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.mapPiNatTrans_isStrong
statement:
theorem mapPiNatTrans_isStrong {F G : TwoSuperfunctor R A B}
    {θ : TwoNatTrans F G} (hθ : θ.IsStrong) : (mapPiNatTrans θ).IsStrong
proof:
:= by
  intro a b f
  let e : F.map f.obj ≫ θ.X b.as ≅ θ.X a.as ≫ G.map f.obj :=
    @asIso _ _ _ _ (θ.x f.obj) (hθ f.obj)
  let eπ : (mapPi F).map f ≫ (mapPiNatTrans θ).X b ≅
      (mapPiNatTrans θ).X a ≫ (mapPi G).map f :=
    Envelope.isoOfIso e
  exact eπ.isIso_hom

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.mapPiSupermodification_isHomogeneous
proof:
:= by
  intro a
  constructor
  · change α.app a.as ∈ parity (R := R) (C := F.obj a.as ⟶ G.obj a.as)
      (θ.X a.as) (ψ.X a.as) (0 + (0 + 0))
    simpa only [add_zero] using (h a.as).1
  · exact (h a.as).2

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.mapPiNatTrans_heq
proof:
:= by
  subst F' G'
  cases eq_of_heq h
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.mapPiNatTrans_postcompose_heq
statement:
theorem mapPiNatTrans_postcompose_heq {F G : TwoSuperfunctor R A B}
    (H : TwoSuperfunctor R B C) (θ : TwoNatTrans F G) :
    HEq (mapPiNatTrans (TwoNatTrans.postcompose H θ))
      (TwoNatTrans.postcompose (mapPi H) (mapPiNatTrans θ))
proof:
:= by
  apply TwoNatTrans.hext (mapPi_comp F H) (mapPi_comp G H)
  · intro a
    rfl
  · intro a b f
    rfl

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.mapPiNatTrans_precompose_heq
statement:
theorem mapPiNatTrans_precompose_heq (P : TwoSuperfunctor R A B)
    {F G : TwoSuperfunctor R B C} (θ : TwoNatTrans F G) :
    HEq (mapPiNatTrans (TwoNatTrans.precompose P θ))
      (TwoNatTrans.precompose (mapPi P) (mapPiNatTrans θ))
proof:
:= by
  apply TwoNatTrans.hext (mapPi_comp P F) (mapPi_comp P G)
  · intro a
    rfl
  · intro a b f
    rfl

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.obj_p
statement:
theorem obj_p (a : ZMod 2) :
    (obj K a).p = 𝟙 ((CategoryTheory.Mat_.embedding _).obj (⟨⟨a, ()⟩⟩ : D K))

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.isSchur_obj
statement: theorem isSchur_obj (a : ZMod 2) : IsSchur (k := K) (obj K a)
proof:
:= by
  intro f
  refine ⟨scal (f.f PUnit.unit PUnit.unit), ?_⟩
  apply Karoubi.hom_ext
  apply CategoryTheory.Mat_.hom_ext
  rintro ⟨⟩ ⟨⟩
  apply hom_ext
  rw [Karoubi.smul_f, Karoubi.id_f, obj_p, Mat_.smul_apply, CategoryTheory.Mat_.id_apply_self]
  change _ = scal (f.f PUnit.unit PUnit.unit) * scal (𝟙 _)
  rw [scal_id, mul_one]

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.id_obj_ne_zero
statement: theorem id_obj_ne_zero (a : ZMod 2) : 𝟙 (obj K a) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have := congrArg (fun φ : obj K a ⟶ obj K a => scal (φ.f PUnit.unit PUnit.unit)) h
  simp only [Karoubi.id_f, obj_p, CategoryTheory.Mat_.id_apply_self] at this
  exact one_ne_zero (this.trans rfl)

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.hom_obj_eq_zero
statement: theorem hom_obj_eq_zero {a b : ZMod 2} (h : a ≠ b) (f : obj K a ⟶ obj K b) : f = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Karoubi.hom_ext
  apply CategoryTheory.Mat_.hom_ext
  rintro ⟨⟩ ⟨⟩
  apply hom_ext
  rw [scal_eq_zero_of_ne _ h]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.dim_of_isZero
statement: theorem dim_of_isZero {P : SKar K (UnitSupercat K)} (hP : IsZero P) (q : ZMod 2) : dim P q = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hz : IsZero ((0 : SKar K (UnitSupercat K)) ⊞ 0) := by
    rw [IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero]
    apply biprod.hom_ext <;> exact (isZero_zero _).eq_of_tgt _ _
  have h1 := dim_biprod (0 : SKar K (UnitSupercat K)) 0 q
  rw [dim_eq_of_iso (hz.iso (isZero_zero _)) q] at h1
  rw [dim_eq_of_iso (hP.iso (isZero_zero _)) q]
  omega

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.dim_bsum
statement:
theorem dim_bsum (L : List (SKar K (UnitSupercat K))) (q : ZMod 2) :
    dim (bsum L) q = (L.map fun P => dim P q).sum
proof:
:= by
  induction L with
  | nil => exact dim_of_isZero (isZero_zero _) q
  | cons P L ih => rw [bsum_cons, dim_biprod, ih, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.dim_bsum_sumList
statement:
theorem dim_bsum_sumList (m n : ℕ) (q : ZMod 2) :
    dim (bsum (sumList (K := K) m n)) q = if q = 0 then m else n
proof:
:= by
  rw [dim_bsum, sumList, List.map_append, List.sum_append, List.map_replicate, List.map_replicate,
    List.sum_replicate, List.sum_replicate, dim_obj, dim_obj]
  rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one q with rfl | rfl <;> simp

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.exists_iso_bsum_obj
statement:
theorem exists_iso_bsum_obj (P : SKar K (UnitSupercat K)) :
    Nonempty (P ≅ bsum (sumList (dim P 0) (dim P 1)))

name: StringDiagrams.SKarUnit.orthogonalSchurGenerators_obj
statement:
theorem orthogonalSchurGenerators_obj : OrthogonalSchurGenerators K (obj K) where
  schur
proof:
:= isSchur_obj
  id_ne_zero := id_obj_ne_zero
  hom_eq_zero h := hom_obj_eq_zero h
  exists_iso_bsum P :=
    ⟨sumList (dim P 0) (dim P 1), fun Q hQ => by
      rcases List.mem_append.mp hQ with h | h
      · exact ⟨0, (List.eq_of_mem_replicate h)⟩
      · exact ⟨1, (List.eq_of_mem_replicate h)⟩,
      exists_iso_bsum_obj P⟩

name: StringDiagrams.PiSupercategory.naturality_of_isPiNatural
statement:
theorem naturality_of_isPiNatural (y : ∀ X, F.obj X ⟶ G.obj X)
    (hmem : ∀ X, y X ∈ parity (R := R) (F.obj X) (G.obj X) 0)
    (hnat : ∀ {X Y : A} (f : X ⟶ Y), f ∈ parity (R := R) X Y 0 → F.map f ≫ y Y = y X ≫ G.map f)
    (hpi : ∀ X, (β R F X).hom ≫ y ((pi (R := R)).obj X) =
      (pi (R := R)).map (y X) ≫ (β R G X).hom)
    {X Y : A} (f : X ⟶ Y) : F.map f ≫ y Y = y X ≫ G.map f
proof:
:= by
  
  have hζ : ∀ Y : A, F.map (ζ (R := R) Y).hom ≫ y Y = y ((pi (R := R)).obj Y) ≫
      G.map (ζ (R := R) Y).hom := by
    intro Y
    have h1 := hpi Y
    have h2 := ζ_naturality_of_mem (R := R) (hmem Y)
    rw [sign_zero, one_smul] at h2
    rw [β_hom, β_hom, Category.assoc, reassoc_of% h2] at h1
    have h3 := (cancel_epi _).1 h1
    rw [← cancel_epi (F.map (ζ (R := R) Y).inv), ← F.map_comp_assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id,
      F.map_id, Category.id_comp, reassoc_of% h3, ← G.map_comp, Iso.inv_hom_id, G.map_id,
      Category.comp_id]
  have hodd : ∀ {X Y : A} (f : X ⟶ Y), f ∈ parity (R := R) X Y 1 →
      F.map f ≫ y Y = y X ≫ G.map f := by
    intro X Y f hf
    have hg : f ≫ (ζ (R := R) Y).inv ∈ parity (R := R) X ((pi (R := R)).obj Y) 0 := by
      have h := comp_mem hf (ζ_inv_mem (R := R) Y)
      rwa [show (1 : ZMod 2) + 1 = 0 from rfl] at h
    have e : f = (f ≫ (ζ (R := R) Y).inv) ≫ (ζ (R := R) Y).hom := by simp
    rw [e, F.map_comp, G.map_comp, Category.assoc, hζ, ← Category.assoc, hnat _ hg,
      Category.assoc]
  rw [← proj_add_proj (R := R) f, F.map_add, G.map_add, Preadditive.add_comp,
    Preadditive.comp_add, hnat _ (proj_mem 0 f), hodd _ (proj_mem 1 f)]

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.Tinv_map_ζ_inv

proof:
:= by
  apply T_map_injective
  rw [T_map_Tinv_map]
  have h : (T R A).mapIso (PiSupercategory.ζ (R := R) ((Tinv R A).obj X)) =
      PiSupercategory.ζ (R := R) X := Iso.ext (T_map_ζ _)
  exact (congrArg Iso.inv h).symm

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.liftFunctor_β

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.mapPi_naturality_left
statement:
theorem mapPi_naturality_left {a b c : TwoEnvelope R B} {f f' : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ f')
    (g : b ⟶ c) :
    mapPiMap₂ F η ▷ mapPiMap F g ≫
      (ofHom (F.mapComp f'.obj g.obj).hom : mapPiMap F f' ≫ mapPiMap F g ⟶ mapPiMap F (f' ≫ g)) =
      (ofHom (F.mapComp f.obj g.obj).hom : mapPiMap F f ≫ mapPiMap F g ⟶ mapPiMap F (f ≫ g)) ≫
        mapPiMap₂ F (η ▷ g)
proof:
:= by
  refine induction_on' (R := R) η ?_ (fun r η hη => ?_) (fun η θ hη hθ => ?_)
  · rw [mapPiMap₂_zero, TwoEnvelope.zero_whiskerRight', TwoEnvelope.zero_whiskerRight',
      mapPiMap₂_zero, Limits.zero_comp, Limits.comp_zero]
  · apply hom_ext
    rw [toHom_comp, toHom_comp, TwoEnvelope.toHom_whiskerRight_of_mem (F.map₂_mem hη),
      toHom_mapPiMap₂, toHom_mapPiMap₂, TwoEnvelope.toHom_whiskerRight_of_mem hη, F.map₂_smul,
      Linear.smul_comp, Linear.comp_smul]
    erw [F.mapComp_naturality_left]
    rfl
  · rw [mapPiMap₂_add, TwoEnvelope.add_whiskerRight', TwoEnvelope.add_whiskerRight',
      mapPiMap₂_add, Preadditive.add_comp, Preadditive.comp_add, hη, hθ]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.mapPi_naturality_right
statement:
theorem mapPi_naturality_right {a b c : TwoEnvelope R B} (f : a ⟶ b) {g g' : b ⟶ c}
    (η : g ⟶ g') :
    mapPiMap F f ◁ mapPiMap₂ F η ≫
      (ofHom (F.mapComp f.obj g'.obj).hom : mapPiMap F f ≫ mapPiMap F g' ⟶ mapPiMap F (f ≫ g')) =
      (ofHom (F.mapComp f.obj g.obj).hom : mapPiMap F f ≫ mapPiMap F g ⟶ mapPiMap F (f ≫ g)) ≫
        mapPiMap₂ F (f ◁ η)
proof:
:= by
  refine induction_on' (R := R) η ?_ (fun r η hη => ?_) (fun η θ hη hθ => ?_)
  · rw [mapPiMap₂_zero, TwoEnvelope.whiskerLeft_zero', TwoEnvelope.whiskerLeft_zero',
      mapPiMap₂_zero, Limits.zero_comp, Limits.comp_zero]
  · apply hom_ext
    rw [toHom_comp, toHom_comp, TwoEnvelope.toHom_whiskerLeft_of_mem _ (F.map₂_mem hη),
      toHom_mapPiMap₂, toHom_mapPiMap₂, TwoEnvelope.toHom_whiskerLeft_of_mem _ hη, F.map₂_smul,
      Linear.smul_comp, Linear.comp_smul]
    erw [F.mapComp_naturality_right]
    rfl
  · rw [mapPiMap₂_add, TwoEnvelope.whiskerLeft_add', TwoEnvelope.whiskerLeft_add',
      mapPiMap₂_add, Preadditive.add_comp, Preadditive.comp_add, hη, hθ]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.mapPi_supermodification_naturality_of_mem
statement:
theorem mapPi_supermodification_naturality_of_mem {θ θ' : TwoNatTrans F G} {p : ZMod 2}
    (α : ∀ a : B, θ.X a ⟶ θ'.X a) (hα : ∀ a, α a ∈ parity (R := R) _ _ p)
    (nat : ∀ {a b : B} (f : a ⟶ b), θ.x f ≫ α a ▷ G.map f = F.map f ◁ α b ≫ θ'.x f)
    {a b : TwoEnvelope R B} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (mapPiNatTrans θ).x f ≫ (J2 (α a.as) : Jm (R := R) (θ.X a.as) ⟶ Jm (θ'.X a.as)) ▷
        (mapPi G).map f =
      (mapPi F).map f ◁ (J2 (α b.as) : Jm (R := R) (θ.X b.as) ⟶ Jm (θ'.X b.as)) ≫
        (mapPiNatTrans θ').x f
proof:
:= by
  apply hom_ext
  rw [toHom_comp, toHom_comp, TwoEnvelope.toHom_whiskerRight_of_mem (η := J2 (α a.as)) (hα a.as),
    TwoEnvelope.toHom_whiskerLeft_of_mem _ (η := J2 (α b.as)) (hα b.as), Linear.comp_smul,
    Linear.smul_comp]
  show sign R (f.par * (p + (0 + 0))) • (θ.x f.obj ≫ α a.as ▷ G.map f.obj) =
    sign R (f.par * p) • (F.map f.obj ◁ α b.as ≫ θ'.x f.obj)
  rw [nat, add_zero, add_zero]

name: StringDiagrams.UnitQPiEnvelope.one_superTensorHom_one
statement:
theorem one_superTensorHom_one (n : ℤ) (b : ZMod 2) (l : ℤ) (d : ZMod 2) (m : ℤ) (a : ZMod 2)
    (j : ℤ) (c : ZMod 2) :
    MonoidalSupercategory.superTensorHom (one (k := k) n b l d) (one m a j c) =
      sign k ((a + c) * b) • one (n + m) (b + a) (l + j) (d + c)
proof:
:= by
  refine (QPiEnvelope.ofHom_superTensorHom_ofHom (R := k) (X := P k n b) (X' := P k l d)
    (Y := P k m a) (Y' := P k j c) (y := ofElem (1 : k)) (x := ofElem (1 : k))
    (UnitSupercat.mem_parity_zero _) (UnitSupercat.mem_parity_zero _)).trans ?_
  show sign k (b * 0 + 0 * c + b * c + a * b) • _ = _
  congr 1
  · congr 1; ring
  · exact Envelope.hom_ext (QEnvelope.hom_ext (SuperalgebraCat.hom_ext (𝒜 := trivialGrading k)
      (mul_one (1 : k))))

name: StringDiagrams.UnitQPiEnvelope.one_tensorHom_one
statement:
theorem one_tensorHom_one (n : ℤ) (b : ZMod 2) (l : ℤ) (d : ZMod 2) (m : ℤ) (a : ZMod 2)
    (j : ℤ) (c : ZMod 2) :
    one (k := k) n b l d ⊗ₘ one m a j c =
      sign k ((a + c) * d) • one (n + m) (b + a) (l + j) (d + c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [MonoidalSupercategory.tensorHom_eq_superTensorHom (R := k) (one_mem n b l d)
    (one_mem m a j c), koszulSign_smul (R := k), one_superTensorHom_one, smul_smul,
    ← sign_add]
  congr 2
  revert a b c d; decide
