name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.proj_of_mem_ne
statement:
theorem proj_of_mem_ne {p q : ZMod 2} {X Y : C} {f : X ⟶ Y} (hf : f ∈ parity (R := R) X Y q)
    (h : q ≠ p) : proj R p f = 0
proof:
:=
  letI := decomposition R X Y
  DirectSum.decompose_of_mem_ne _ hf h

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.induction_on
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
theorem induction_on {X Y : C} {P : (X ⟶ Y) → Prop} (f : X ⟶ Y) (zero : P 0)
    (hom : ∀ (p : ZMod 2) (g : X ⟶ Y), g ∈ parity (R := R) X Y p → P g)
    (add : ∀ g h, P g → P h → P (g + h)) : P f
proof:
:=
  letI := decomposition R X Y
  DirectSum.Decomposition.inductionOn (parity (R := R) X Y) zero (fun g => hom _ _ g.2) add f

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.mem_iff_proj
statement:
theorem mem_iff_proj {p : ZMod 2} {X Y : C} {f : X ⟶ Y} :
    f ∈ parity (R := R) X Y p ↔ proj R p f = f
proof:
:=
  ⟨proj_of_mem, fun h => h ▸ proj_mem p f⟩

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.proj_proj
statement: theorem proj_proj (p : ZMod 2) {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) : proj R p (proj R p f) = proj R p f

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.proj_proj_of_ne
statement:
theorem proj_proj_of_ne {p q : ZMod 2} (h : q ≠ p) {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    proj R p (proj R q f) = 0

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.proj_add_proj
statement: theorem proj_add_proj {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) : proj R 0 f + proj R 1 f = f
proof:
:= by
  refine induction_on (R := R) f (by simp) (fun p g hg => ?_) (fun g h hg hh => ?_)
  · rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one p with rfl | rfl
    · rw [proj_of_mem hg, proj_of_mem_ne hg (by decide), add_zero]
    · rw [proj_of_mem hg, proj_of_mem_ne hg (by decide), zero_add]
  · rw [map_add, map_add, add_add_add_comm, hg, hh]

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.proj_add_proj_add_one
statement:
theorem proj_add_proj_add_one (s : ZMod 2) {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    proj R s f + proj R (s + 1) f = f
proof:
:= by
  rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one s with rfl | rfl
  · exact proj_add_proj f
  · rw [show (1 : ZMod 2) + 1 = 0 from rfl, add_comm]; exact proj_add_proj f

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.proj_eq_of_add
statement:
theorem proj_eq_of_add {p : ZMod 2} {X Y : C} {f g h : X ⟶ Y} (e : f = g + h)
    (hg : g ∈ parity (R := R) X Y p) (hh : h ∈ parity (R := R) X Y (p + 1)) : proj R p f = g
proof:
:= by
  rw [e, map_add, proj_of_mem hg, proj_of_mem_ne hh (zmod2_add_one_ne p), add_zero]

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.ext_proj
statement: theorem ext_proj {X Y : C} {f g : X ⟶ Y} (h : ∀ p, proj R p f = proj R p g) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  rw [← proj_add_proj (R := R) f, ← proj_add_proj (R := R) g, h, h]

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.proj_comp_of_mem_left
proof:
:= by
  refine induction_on (R := R) g (by simp) (fun r g hg => ?_) (fun g h hg hh => ?_)
  · by_cases h : r = q
    · subst h; rw [proj_of_mem (comp_mem hf hg), proj_of_mem hg]
    · rw [proj_of_mem_ne (comp_mem hf hg) (fun e => h (add_left_cancel e)),
        proj_of_mem_ne hg h, Limits.comp_zero]
  · rw [Preadditive.comp_add, map_add, hg, hh, map_add, Preadditive.comp_add]

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.proj_comp_of_mem_right
proof:
:= by
  refine induction_on (R := R) f (by simp) (fun r f hf => ?_) (fun f h hf hh => ?_)
  · by_cases h : r = p
    · subst h; rw [proj_of_mem (comp_mem hf hg), proj_of_mem hf]
    · rw [proj_of_mem_ne (comp_mem hf hg) (fun e => h (add_right_cancel e)),
        proj_of_mem_ne hf h, Limits.zero_comp]
  · rw [Preadditive.add_comp, map_add, hf, hh, map_add, Preadditive.add_comp]

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.proj_id
statement: theorem proj_id (X : C) (p : ZMod 2) : proj R p (𝟙 X) = if p = 0 then 𝟙 X else 0
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs with h
  · subst h; exact proj_of_mem (id_mem X)
  · exact proj_of_mem_ne (id_mem X) (Ne.symm h)

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.inv_mem
statement:
theorem inv_mem {p : ZMod 2} {X Y : C} (e : X ≅ Y) (he : e.hom ∈ parity (R := R) X Y p) :
    e.inv ∈ parity (R := R) Y X p
proof:
:= by
  have key : proj R (p + 1) e.inv = 0 := by
    have h1 : e.hom ≫ proj R (p + 1) e.inv = 0 := by
      rw [← proj_comp_of_mem_left _ he, e.hom_inv_id, proj_id,
        ite_eq_right (by rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one p with rfl | rfl <;> decide)]
    calc proj R (p + 1) e.inv = e.inv ≫ e.hom ≫ proj R (p + 1) e.inv := by
          rw [← Category.assoc, e.inv_hom_id, Category.id_comp]
      _ = 0 := by rw [h1, Limits.comp_zero]
  have h := proj_add_proj (R := R) e.inv
  rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one p with rfl | rfl
  · have : proj R 1 e.inv = 0 := key
    rw [this, add_zero] at h
    exact h ▸ proj_mem _ _
  · have : proj R 0 e.inv = 0 := key
    rw [this, zero_add] at h
    exact h ▸ proj_mem _ _

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.twist_apply
statement:
theorem twist_apply (p : ZMod 2) {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    twist R p f = proj R 0 f + sign R p • proj R 1 f

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.twist_of_mem
statement:
theorem twist_of_mem (p : ZMod 2) {q : ZMod 2} {X Y : C} {f : X ⟶ Y}
    (hf : f ∈ parity (R := R) X Y q) : twist R p f = sign R (p * q) • f
proof:
:= by
  rw [twist_apply]
  rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one q with rfl | rfl
  · rw [proj_of_mem hf, proj_of_mem_ne hf (by decide)]; simp
  · rw [proj_of_mem hf, proj_of_mem_ne hf (by decide)]; simp

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.twist_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem twist_zero {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) : twist R 0 f = f

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.twist_mem
statement:
theorem twist_mem (p : ZMod 2) {q : ZMod 2} {X Y : C} {f : X ⟶ Y}
    (hf : f ∈ parity (R := R) X Y q) : twist R p f ∈ parity (R := R) X Y q
proof:
:= by
  rw [twist_of_mem p hf]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hf

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.twist_twist
statement: theorem twist_twist (p : ZMod 2) {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) : twist R p (twist R p f) = f
proof:
:= by
  refine induction_on (R := R) f (by simp) (fun q g hg => ?_) (fun g h hg hh => ?_)
  · rw [twist_of_mem p hg, map_smul, twist_of_mem p hg, sign_smul_sign_smul]
  · rw [map_add, map_add, hg, hh]

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.twist_add
statement:
theorem twist_add (p q : ZMod 2) {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    twist R (p + q) f = twist R p (twist R q f)
proof:
:= by
  refine induction_on (R := R) f (by simp) (fun r g hg => ?_) (fun g h hg hh => ?_)
  · rw [twist_of_mem _ hg, twist_of_mem q hg, map_smul, twist_of_mem p hg, smul_smul, add_mul,
      sign_add, mul_comm]
  · rw [map_add, map_add, map_add, hg, hh]

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.twist_comp
statement:
theorem twist_comp (p : ZMod 2) {X Y Z : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) :
    twist R p (f ≫ g) = twist R p f ≫ twist R p g
proof:
:= by
  refine induction_on (R := R) f (by simp) (fun q f hf => ?_) (fun f h hf hh => ?_)
  · refine induction_on (R := R) g (by simp) (fun r g hg => ?_) (fun g h hg hh => ?_)
    · rw [twist_of_mem p (comp_mem hf hg), twist_of_mem p hf, twist_of_mem p hg,
        Linear.smul_comp, Linear.comp_smul, smul_smul, mul_add, sign_add, mul_comm]
    · rw [Preadditive.comp_add, map_add, hg, hh, map_add, Preadditive.comp_add]
  · rw [Preadditive.add_comp, map_add, hf, hh, map_add, Preadditive.add_comp]

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.twist_id
statement: @[simp] theorem twist_id (p : ZMod 2) (X : C) : twist R p (𝟙 X) = 𝟙 X
proof:
:= by
  rw [twist_of_mem p (id_mem X), mul_zero, sign_zero, one_smul]

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.twist_one_of_mem
statement:
theorem twist_one_of_mem {q : ZMod 2} {X Y : C} {f : X ⟶ Y} (hf : f ∈ parity (R := R) X Y q) :
    twist R 1 f = sign R q • f

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.proj_twist
statement:
theorem proj_twist (p q : ZMod 2) {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    proj R q (twist R p f) = sign R (p * q) • proj R q f
proof:
:= by
  refine induction_on (R := R) f (by simp) (fun r g hg => ?_) (fun g h hg hh => ?_)
  · rw [twist_of_mem p hg, map_smul]
    by_cases h : r = q
    · subst h; rfl
    · rw [proj_of_mem_ne hg h, smul_zero, smul_zero]
  · rw [map_add, map_add, hg, hh, map_add, smul_add]

name: StringDiagrams.KarBicat.of_comp_comm
statement:
theorem of_comp_comm (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) :
    (of f ≫ of g).p ≫ 𝟙 (f ≫ g) = 𝟙 (f ≫ g) ≫ (of (f ≫ g)).p
proof:
:= by
  change hcomp₂ (𝟙 f) (𝟙 g) ≫ _ = _
  rw [hcomp₂_id_id]

name: StringDiagrams.K₀Ring.mk_of_mul_mk_of
statement:
theorem mk_of_mul_mk_of {f : a ⟶ b} {g : b ⟶ c} {h : a ⟶ c} (e : f ≫ g ≅ h) :
    mk (Kar.of g) * mk (Kar.of f) = mk (Kar.of h)

name: StringDiagrams.GSKAR.mk_of_mul_mk_of
statement:
theorem mk_of_mul_mk_of (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) :
    K₀Ring.mk (of R g) * K₀Ring.mk (of R f) = K₀Ring.mk (of R (f ≫ g))

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.comp_par
statement: @[simp] theorem comp_par (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) : (f ≫ g).par = f.par + g.par

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.comp_obj
statement: @[simp] theorem comp_obj (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) : (f ≫ g).obj = f.obj ≫ g.obj

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.id_par
statement: @[simp] theorem id_par (a : TwoEnvelope R B) : (𝟙 a : a ⟶ a).par = 0

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.id_obj
statement: @[simp] theorem id_obj (a : TwoEnvelope R B) : (𝟙 a : a ⟶ a).obj = 𝟙 a.as

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.toHom_whiskerLeft
statement:
theorem toHom_whiskerLeft (f : a ⟶ b) {g h : b ⟶ c} (η : g ⟶ h) :
    toHom (f ◁ η) = f.obj ◁ twist R f.par (toHom η)

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.toHom_whiskerRight
statement:
theorem toHom_whiskerRight {f g : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ g) (h : b ⟶ c) :
    toHom (η ▷ h) = toHom (twist R h.par η) ▷ h.obj

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.toHom_associator_hom
statement:
@[simp] theorem toHom_associator_hom (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) (h : c ⟶ d) :
    toHom (associator f g h).hom = (associator f.obj g.obj h.obj).hom

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.toHom_associator_inv
statement:
@[simp] theorem toHom_associator_inv (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) (h : c ⟶ d) :
    toHom (associator f g h).inv = (associator f.obj g.obj h.obj).inv

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.toHom_leftUnitor_hom
statement:
@[simp] theorem toHom_leftUnitor_hom (f : a ⟶ b) :
    toHom (leftUnitor f).hom = (leftUnitor f.obj).hom

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.toHom_leftUnitor_inv
statement:
@[simp] theorem toHom_leftUnitor_inv (f : a ⟶ b) :
    toHom (leftUnitor f).inv = (leftUnitor f.obj).inv

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.toHom_rightUnitor_hom
statement:
@[simp] theorem toHom_rightUnitor_hom (f : a ⟶ b) :
    toHom (rightUnitor f).hom = (rightUnitor f.obj).hom

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.toHom_rightUnitor_inv
statement:
@[simp] theorem toHom_rightUnitor_inv (f : a ⟶ b) :
    toHom (rightUnitor f).inv = (rightUnitor f.obj).inv

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.toHom_whiskerLeft_of_mem
StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.toHom_whiskerRight_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  rw [toHom_whiskerRight, toHom_twist, twist_of_mem _ hη, smul_smul, ← sign_add,
    TwoSupercategory.smul_whiskerRight]
  congr 2
  ring

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.toHom_whiskerLeft_mem
proof:
:= by
  rw [toHom_whiskerLeft_of_mem f hη]
  exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (TwoSupercategory.whiskerLeft_mem _ hη)

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.toHom_whiskerRight_mem
proof:
:= by
  rw [toHom_whiskerRight_of_mem hη]
  exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (TwoSupercategory.whiskerRight_mem _ hη)

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.toHom_whiskerLeft_of_par_zero
statement:
theorem toHom_whiskerLeft_of_par_zero (f : a ⟶ b) (hf : f.par = 0) {g h : b ⟶ c}
    (η : g ⟶ h) : toHom (f ◁ η) = f.obj ◁ toHom η

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.toHom_whiskerRight_of_par_zero
statement:
theorem toHom_whiskerRight_of_par_zero {f g : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ g) (h : b ⟶ c) (hh : h.par = 0) :
    toHom (η ▷ h) = toHom η ▷ h.obj

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.toHom_whiskerLeft_of_even
statement:
theorem toHom_whiskerLeft_of_even (f : a ⟶ b) {g h : b ⟶ c} {η : g ⟶ h}
    (hη : toHom η ∈ parity (R := R) g.obj h.obj 0) : toHom (f ◁ η) = f.obj ◁ toHom η
proof:
:= by
  rw [toHom_whiskerLeft_of_mem f hη, mul_zero, sign_zero, one_smul]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.toHom_whiskerRight_of_even
proof:
:= by
  rw [toHom_whiskerRight_of_mem hη, hfg, zmod2_add_self, add_zero, mul_zero, sign_zero,
    one_smul]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.whiskerLeft_add'
statement:
theorem whiskerLeft_add' (f : a ⟶ b) {g h : b ⟶ c} (η θ : g ⟶ h) :
    f ◁ (η + θ) = f ◁ η + f ◁ θ
proof:
:= by
  apply hom_ext
  rw [toHom_add, toHom_whiskerLeft, toHom_whiskerLeft, toHom_whiskerLeft, toHom_add, map_add,
    TwoSupercategory.whiskerLeft_add (R := R)]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.add_whiskerRight'
statement:
theorem add_whiskerRight' {f g : a ⟶ b} (η θ : f ⟶ g) (h : b ⟶ c) :
    (η + θ) ▷ h = η ▷ h + θ ▷ h
proof:
:= by
  apply hom_ext
  rw [toHom_add, toHom_whiskerRight, toHom_whiskerRight, toHom_whiskerRight, map_add, toHom_add,
    TwoSupercategory.add_whiskerRight (R := R)]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.whiskerLeft_zero'
statement: theorem whiskerLeft_zero' (f : a ⟶ b) {g h : b ⟶ c} : f ◁ (0 : g ⟶ h) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have := whiskerLeft_add' f (0 : g ⟶ h) 0
  rw [add_zero] at this
  exact (add_eq_left.1 this.symm)

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.zero_whiskerRight'
statement: theorem zero_whiskerRight' {f g : a ⟶ b} (h : b ⟶ c) : (0 : f ⟶ g) ▷ h = 0
proof:
:= by
  have := add_whiskerRight' (0 : f ⟶ g) 0 h
  rw [add_zero] at this
  exact (add_eq_left.1 this.symm)

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.zmod2_cases
statement: private theorem zmod2_cases (P : ZMod 2 → Prop) (h0 : P 0) (h1 : P 1) (p : ZMod 2) : P p
proof:
:= by
  rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one p with rfl | rfl <;> assumption

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.toHom_hcomp
statement:
theorem toHom_hcomp {f h : a ⟶ b} {g k : b ⟶ c} {x : f ⟶ h} {y : g ⟶ k} {px py : ZMod 2}
    (hx : toHom x ∈ parity (R := R) f.obj h.obj px)
    (hy : toHom y ∈ parity (R := R) g.obj k.obj py) :
    toHom (hcomp x y) =
      sign R (g.par * px + py * h.par + g.par * h.par + f.par * g.par) •
        hcomp (toHom x) (toHom y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hcomp, hcomp, toHom_comp, toHom_whiskerRight_of_mem hx, toHom_whiskerLeft_of_mem _ hy,
    Linear.smul_comp, Linear.comp_smul, smul_smul, ← sign_add]
  congr 2
  ring

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.toHom_super_interchange
statement:
theorem toHom_super_interchange {f g k : a ⟶ b} {h i l : b ⟶ c} {pu py : ZMod 2}
    (x : f ⟶ g) (u : g ⟶ k) (y : h ⟶ i) (v : i ⟶ l)
    (hu : toHom u ∈ parity (R := R) g.obj k.obj pu)
    (hy : toHom y ∈ parity (R := R) h.obj i.obj py) :
    hcomp x y ≫ hcomp u v =
      koszulSign (pu + (g.par + k.par)) (py + (h.par + i.par)) • hcomp (x ≫ u) (y ≫ v)
proof:
:=
  hcomp_comp_hcomp (R := R) x u y v (ofHom_mem hu) (ofHom_mem hy)

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.associator_sign_eq
statement:
theorem associator_sign_eq (a b c d e x y z : ZMod 2) :
    c * y + z * e + c * e + b * c + (b + c) * x + (y + z) * d + (b + c) * d + a * (b + c) =
      b * x + y * d + b * d + a * b + c * (x + y) + z * (d + e) + c * (d + e) + (a + b) * c

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.ζ_hom_mem
statement: theorem ζ_hom_mem (a : TwoEnvelope R B) : (ζ R a).hom ∈ parity (R := R) (π R a) (𝟙 a) 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_parity_iff]
  show 𝟙 (𝟙 a.as) ∈ parity (R := R) (𝟙 a.as) (𝟙 a.as) (1 + (1 + 0))
  exact id_mem _

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.toHom_ζ_hom
statement: @[simp] theorem toHom_ζ_hom (a : TwoEnvelope R B) : toHom (ζ R a).hom = 𝟙 (𝟙 a.as)

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.toHom_ξ
statement:
theorem toHom_ξ (a : TwoEnvelope R B) :
    toHom (hcomp (ζ R a).hom (ζ R a).hom) = -𝟙 (𝟙 a.as ≫ 𝟙 a.as)
proof:
:= by
  rw [toHom_hcomp (x := (ζ R a).hom) (y := (ζ R a).hom) (px := 0) (py := 0) (id_mem (𝟙 a.as))
    (id_mem (𝟙 a.as)), hcomp, toHom_ζ_hom]
  show sign R ((1 : ZMod 2) * 0 + 0 * 0 + 1 * 0 + 1 * 1) •
    (𝟙 (𝟙 a.as) ▷ 𝟙 a.as ≫ 𝟙 a.as ◁ 𝟙 (𝟙 a.as)) = _
  rw [TwoSupercategory.id_whiskerRight (R := R), TwoSupercategory.whiskerLeft_id (R := R),
    Category.comp_id]
  simp

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.piComplete_hom
statement: theorem piComplete_hom (h : PiComplete R B) (x y : B) : Envelope.PiComplete R (x ⟶ y)
proof:
:= by
  intro f
  obtain ⟨p, e, he⟩ := h x
  let w : p ≫ f ≅ 𝟙 x ≫ f :=
    { hom := e.hom ▷ f
      inv := e.inv ▷ f
      hom_inv_id := by
        rw [← TwoSupercategory.comp_whiskerRight (R := R), e.hom_inv_id,
          TwoSupercategory.id_whiskerRight (R := R)]
      inv_hom_id := by
        rw [← TwoSupercategory.comp_whiskerRight (R := R), e.inv_hom_id,
          TwoSupercategory.id_whiskerRight (R := R)] }
  refine ⟨p ≫ f, w.trans (leftUnitor f), ?_⟩
  have := comp_mem (TwoSupercategory.whiskerRight_mem (R := R) f he)
    (TwoSupercategory.leftUnitor_hom_mem (R := R) f)
  simpa using this

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.superequivalenceJ_iff
statement:
theorem superequivalenceJ_iff :
    (∀ x y : B, Nonempty (Superequivalence R (Envelope.J R (x ⟶ y)))) ↔ PiComplete R B
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h x
    exact Envelope.piComplete_of_superequivalence (h x x).some (𝟙 x)
  · intro h x y
    exact ⟨Envelope.superequivalenceJ (piComplete_hom h x y)⟩

name: StringDiagrams.SOp.compC_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  unfold compC
  rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one q with rfl | rfl
  · rw [proj_of_mem hg, proj_of_mem_ne hg (by decide), Limits.zero_comp, add_zero, mul_zero,
      sign_zero, one_smul]
  · rw [proj_of_mem hg, proj_of_mem_ne hg (by decide), Limits.zero_comp, zero_add,
      twist_one_of_mem hf, Linear.comp_smul, mul_one]

name: StringDiagrams.SOp.compC_add
statement:
theorem compC_add {X Y Z : C} (f : Y ⟶ X) (g g' : Z ⟶ Y) :
    compC (R := R) f (g + g') = compC (R := R) f g + compC (R := R) f g'
proof:
:= by
  unfold compC
  rw [map_add, map_add, Preadditive.add_comp, Preadditive.add_comp]
  abel

name: StringDiagrams.SOp.add_compC
statement:
theorem add_compC {X Y Z : C} (f f' : Y ⟶ X) (g : Z ⟶ Y) :
    compC (R := R) (f + f') g = compC (R := R) f g + compC (R := R) f' g
proof:
:= by
  unfold compC
  rw [map_add, Preadditive.comp_add, Preadditive.comp_add]
  abel

name: StringDiagrams.SOp.compC_smul
statement:
theorem compC_smul {X Y Z : C} (f : Y ⟶ X) (r : R) (g : Z ⟶ Y) :
    compC (R := R) f (r • g) = r • compC (R := R) f g
proof:
:= by
  unfold compC
  rw [map_smul, map_smul, Linear.smul_comp, Linear.smul_comp, smul_add]

name: StringDiagrams.SOp.smul_compC
statement:
theorem smul_compC {X Y Z : C} (r : R) (f : Y ⟶ X) (g : Z ⟶ Y) :
    compC (R := R) (r • f) g = r • compC (R := R) f g
proof:
:= by
  unfold compC
  rw [map_smul, Linear.comp_smul, Linear.comp_smul, smul_add]

name: StringDiagrams.SOp.compC_zero
statement: theorem compC_zero {X Y Z : C} (f : Y ⟶ X) : compC (R := R) f (0 : Z ⟶ Y) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← zero_smul R (0 : Z ⟶ Y), compC_smul, zero_smul]

name: StringDiagrams.SOp.zero_compC
statement: theorem zero_compC {X Y Z : C} (g : Z ⟶ Y) : compC (R := R) (0 : Y ⟶ X) g = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← zero_smul R (0 : Y ⟶ X), smul_compC, zero_smul]

name: StringDiagrams.SOp.compC_assoc
statement:
theorem compC_assoc {W X Y Z : C} (f : X ⟶ W) (g : Y ⟶ X) (h : Z ⟶ Y) :
    compC (R := R) (compC (R := R) f g) h = compC (R := R) f (compC (R := R) g h)
proof:
:= by
  refine induction_on (R := R) f (by simp only [zero_compC]) (fun p f hf => ?_)
    (fun f f' hf hf' => by rw [add_compC, add_compC, add_compC, hf, hf'])
  refine induction_on (R := R) g (by simp only [zero_compC, compC_zero])
    (fun q g hg => ?_) (fun g g' hg hg' => by rw [compC_add, add_compC, add_compC, compC_add, hg, hg'])
  refine induction_on (R := R) h (by simp only [compC_zero])
    (fun r h hh => ?_) (fun h h' hh hh' => by rw [compC_add, compC_add, compC_add, hh, hh'])
  have m₁ : compC (R := R) f g ∈ parity (R := R) Y W (q + p) := by
    rw [compC_of_mem hf hg]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (comp_mem hg hf)
  have m₂ : compC (R := R) g h ∈ parity (R := R) Z X (r + q) := by
    rw [compC_of_mem hg hh]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (comp_mem hh hg)
  rw [compC_of_mem m₁ hh, compC_of_mem hf m₂, compC_of_mem hf hg, compC_of_mem hg hh,
    Linear.comp_smul, Linear.smul_comp, smul_smul, smul_smul, Category.assoc, ← sign_add,
    ← sign_add]
  congr 2
  ring

name: StringDiagrams.SOp.unsop_sop
statement: @[simp] theorem unsop_sop {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) : unsop (sop (R := R) f) = f

name: StringDiagrams.SOp.sop_unsop
statement: @[simp] theorem sop_unsop {X Y : C} (f : (⟨Y⟩ : SOp R C) ⟶ ⟨X⟩) : sop (unsop f) = f

name: StringDiagrams.SOp.hom_ext
statement:
@[ext]
theorem hom_ext {X Y : SOp R C} {f g : X ⟶ Y} (h : unsop f = unsop g) : f = g

name: StringDiagrams.SOp.unsop_comp
statement:
theorem unsop_comp {X Y Z : SOp R C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) :
    unsop (f ≫ g) = compC (R := R) (unsop f) (unsop g)

name: StringDiagrams.SOp.unsop_id
statement: @[simp] theorem unsop_id (X : SOp R C) : unsop (𝟙 X) = 𝟙 X.unop

name: StringDiagrams.SOp.comp_of_mem
statement:
theorem comp_of_mem {X Y Z : SOp R C} {p q : ZMod 2} {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : Y ⟶ Z}
    (hf : unsop f ∈ parity (R := R) Y.unop X.unop p)
    (hg : unsop g ∈ parity (R := R) Z.unop Y.unop q) :
    unsop (f ≫ g) = sign R (p * q) • (unsop g ≫ unsop f)

name: StringDiagrams.SOp.unsop_mk'
statement: @[simp] theorem unsop_mk' {X Y : SOp R C} (f : Y.unop ⟶ X.unop) : unsop (mk' (X := X) (Y := Y) f) = f

name: StringDiagrams.SOp.unsop_injective
statement: theorem unsop_injective {X Y : SOp R C} : Function.Injective (unsop (X := X) (Y := Y))

name: StringDiagrams.SOp.unsop_add
statement: @[simp] theorem unsop_add {X Y : SOp R C} (f g : X ⟶ Y) : unsop (f + g) = unsop f + unsop g

name: StringDiagrams.SOp.unsop_smul
statement: @[simp] theorem unsop_smul {X Y : SOp R C} (r : R) (f : X ⟶ Y) : unsop (r • f) = r • unsop f

name: StringDiagrams.SOp.unsop_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem unsop_zero {X Y : SOp R C} : unsop (0 : X ⟶ Y) = 0

name: StringDiagrams.SOp.unsop_neg
statement: @[simp] theorem unsop_neg {X Y : SOp R C} (f : X ⟶ Y) : unsop (-f) = -unsop f

name: StringDiagrams.SOp.unsop_sub
statement: @[simp] theorem unsop_sub {X Y : SOp R C} (f g : X ⟶ Y) : unsop (f - g) = unsop f - unsop g

name: StringDiagrams.SOp.unsop_eqToHom
statement:
theorem unsop_eqToHom {X Y : SOp R C} (h : X = Y) :
    unsop (eqToHom h) = eqToHom (congrArg SOp.unop h).symm

name: StringDiagrams.SOp.mem_parity_iff
statement:
theorem mem_parity_iff {X Y : SOp R C} {p : ZMod 2} {f : X ⟶ Y} :
    f ∈ parity (R := R) X Y p ↔ unsop f ∈ parity (R := R) Y.unop X.unop p

name: StringDiagrams.SOp.unsopUnsop_map
statement:
@[simp] theorem unsopUnsop_map {X Y : SOp R (SOp R C)} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    unsopUnsop.map f = unsop (unsop f)

name: StringDiagrams.SOp.proj_map
statement:
theorem proj_map (F : C ⥤ D) [F.Additive] [F.Linear R]
    (hF : ∀ {X Y : C} {p : ZMod 2} {f : X ⟶ Y}, f ∈ parity (R := R) X Y p →
      F.map f ∈ parity (R := R) (F.obj X) (F.obj Y) p)
    (p : ZMod 2) {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) : proj R p (F.map f) = F.map (proj R p f)
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← proj_add_proj (R := R) f, F.map_add]
  rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one p with rfl | rfl
  · rw [map_add, proj_of_mem (hF (proj_mem 0 f)), proj_of_mem_ne (hF (proj_mem 1 f)) (by decide),
      add_zero]
  · rw [map_add, proj_of_mem (hF (proj_mem 1 f)), proj_of_mem_ne (hF (proj_mem 0 f)) (by decide),
      zero_add]

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftData.Trivialization.σ_inv_mem
statement: theorem σ_inv_mem (X : C) : (t.σ X).inv ∈ parity (R := R) X (d.Q.obj X) 0

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftData.Trivialization.σ_inv_mem_degree
statement: theorem σ_inv_mem_degree (X : C) : (t.σ X).inv ∈ degree (R := R) X (d.Q.obj X) 1

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftData.Trivialization.Q_map_eq
statement: theorem Q_map_eq {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) : d.Q.map f = (t.σ X).hom ≫ f ≫ (t.σ Y).inv
proof:
:= by
  rw [← reassoc_of% (t.σ_naturality f), Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftData.Trivialization.succ_hom_mem_degree
statement:
theorem succ_hom_mem_degree (i : ℤ) (X : C) :
    (d.succ i).hom.app X ∈ degree (R := R) _ _ 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases i with n | (_ | n)
  · exact id_mem_degree _
  · exact t.counit_mem_degree X
  · rw [succ_negSucc_succ_hom_app]
    exact t.counit_mem_degree _

name: StringDiagrams.ShiftData.Trivialization.succ_inv_mem_degree
statement:
theorem succ_inv_mem_degree (i : ℤ) (X : C) :
    (d.succ i).inv.app X ∈ degree (R := R) _ _ 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa using inv_mem_degree ((d.succ i).app X) (t.succ_hom_mem_degree i X)

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.Eval.τ_zero
statement: theorem τ_zero (X : C) : τ t 0 X = Iso.refl _

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.Eval.τ_succ
statement:
theorem τ_succ (i : ℤ) (X : C) :
    (τ t (i + 1) X).hom = (d.succ i).inv.app X ≫ (t.σ ((d.pow i).obj X)).hom ≫ (τ t i X).hom
proof:
:= by
  rcases i with n | (_ | n)
  · show (τNat t (n + 1) X).hom = 𝟙 _ ≫ _ ≫ _
    rw [Category.id_comp]; rfl
  · show 𝟙 _ = d.e.counitIso.inv.app X ≫ (t.σ (d.Qi.obj X)).hom ≫
      ((t.σ (d.Qi.obj X)).inv ≫ d.e.counitIso.hom.app X)
    rw [Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_app]
  · rw [succ_negSucc_succ_inv_app]
    show (τ t (Int.negSucc n) X).hom = d.e.counitIso.inv.app ((d.powNeg (n + 1)).obj X) ≫
      (t.σ (d.Qi.obj ((d.powNeg (n + 1)).obj X))).hom ≫
        ((t.σ (d.Qi.obj ((d.powNeg (n + 1)).obj X))).inv ≫
          d.e.counitIso.hom.app ((d.powNeg (n + 1)).obj X) ≫ (τNeg t n X).hom)
    rw [Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_app_assoc]
    rcases n with _ | n <;> rfl

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.Eval.τNat_hom_mem
statement:
theorem τNat_hom_mem (n : ℕ) (X : C) :
    (τNat t n X).hom ∈ parity (R := R) _ _ 0 ∧ (τNat t n X).hom ∈ degree (R := R) _ _ (-n)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact ⟨id_mem _, id_mem_degree _⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    refine ⟨by simpa using! comp_mem (t.σ_mem _) ih.1, ?_⟩
    have := comp_mem_degree (t.σ_mem_degree _) ih.2
    rwa [show (-1 + -(n : ℤ)) = -((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) by push_cast; ring] at this

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.Eval.τNeg_hom_mem
statement:
theorem τNeg_hom_mem (n : ℕ) (X : C) :
    (τNeg t n X).hom ∈ parity (R := R) _ _ 0 ∧
      (τNeg t n X).hom ∈ degree (R := R) _ _ ((n : ℤ) + 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    show (t.σ _).inv ≫ d.e.counitIso.hom.app X ∈ _ ∧ (t.σ _).inv ≫ d.e.counitIso.hom.app X ∈ _
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa using! comp_mem (t.σ_inv_mem (d.Qi.obj X)) (d.counit_mem X)
    · simpa using! comp_mem_degree (t.σ_inv_mem_degree (d.Qi.obj X)) (t.counit_mem_degree X)
  | succ n ih =>
    show (t.σ _).inv ≫ d.e.counitIso.hom.app _ ≫ (τNeg t n X).hom ∈ _ ∧
      (t.σ _).inv ≫ d.e.counitIso.hom.app _ ≫ (τNeg t n X).hom ∈ _
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa using! comp_mem (t.σ_inv_mem (d.Qi.obj ((d.powNeg (n + 1)).obj X)))
        (comp_mem (d.counit_mem ((d.powNeg (n + 1)).obj X)) ih.1)
    · have := comp_mem_degree (t.σ_inv_mem_degree (d.Qi.obj ((d.powNeg (n + 1)).obj X)))
        (comp_mem_degree (t.counit_mem_degree ((d.powNeg (n + 1)).obj X)) ih.2)
      rwa [show (1 + (0 + ((n : ℤ) + 1))) = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) + 1 by push_cast; ring] at this

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.Eval.τ_hom_mem
statement:
theorem τ_hom_mem (i : ℤ) (X : C) :
    (τ t i X).hom ∈ parity (R := R) _ _ 0 ∧ (τ t i X).hom ∈ degree (R := R) _ _ (-i)
proof:
:= by
  rcases i with n | n
  · exact τNat_hom_mem t n X
  · refine ⟨(τNeg_hom_mem t n X).1, ?_⟩
    have := (τNeg_hom_mem t n X).2
    rwa [show ((n : ℤ) + 1) = -Int.negSucc n by rw [Int.neg_negSucc]; push_cast; ring] at this

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.Eval.τ_inv_mem
statement:
theorem τ_inv_mem (i : ℤ) (X : C) :
    (τ t i X).inv ∈ parity (R := R) _ _ 0 ∧ (τ t i X).inv ∈ degree (R := R) _ _ i
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨inv_mem _ (τ_hom_mem t i X).1, ?_⟩
  simpa using inv_mem_degree (R := R) _ (τ_hom_mem t i X).2

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.Eval.τ_succ_inv
statement:
theorem τ_succ_inv (i : ℤ) (X : C) :
    (τ t (i + 1) X).inv = (τ t i X).inv ≫ (t.σ ((d.pow i).obj X)).inv ≫ (d.succ i).hom.app X
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cancel_epi (τ t (i + 1) X).hom, Iso.hom_inv_id, τ_succ]
  simp

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.Eval.val_succ
statement:
theorem val_succ {m : ℤ} {f : d.FamAll X Y} (hf : f ∈ d.Fam R m X Y) (i j : ℤ) :
    val t f (i + 1) (j + 1) = val t f i j
proof:
:= by
  rw [val, val, τ_succ_inv, τ_succ, Fam.compat hf, t.Q_map_eq]
  simp

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.Eval.val_eq
statement:
theorem val_eq {m : ℤ} {f : d.FamAll X Y} (hf : f ∈ d.Fam R m X Y) {i j : ℤ}
    (h : i - j = m) : val t f i j = val t f 0 (-m)
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ k : ℤ, val t f (0 + k) (-m + k) = val t f 0 (-m) := by
    intro k
    induction k using Int.induction_on with
    | zero => simp
    | succ k ih => rw [← ih, ← add_assoc, ← add_assoc, val_succ hf]
    | pred k ih =>
      rw [← ih, show (0 : ℤ) + -(k : ℤ) = 0 + (-(k : ℤ) - 1) + 1 by ring,
        show -m + -(k : ℤ) = -m + (-(k : ℤ) - 1) + 1 by ring, val_succ hf]
  rw [← key i, show 0 + i = i by ring, show -m + i = j by omega]

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.Eval.val_zero
statement: theorem val_zero (f : d.FamAll X Y) (j : ℤ) : val t f 0 j = f 0 j ≫ (τ t j Y).hom

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.Eval.val_famComp
statement:
theorem val_famComp (m : ℤ) {Z : C} (f : d.FamAll X Y) (g : d.FamAll Y Z) (i k : ℤ) :
    val t (d.famComp m f g) i k = val t f i (i - m) ≫ val t g (i - m) k
proof:
:= by
  rw [val, val, val, famComp]
  simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.Eval.evalL_lof
statement:
theorem evalL_lof {m : ℤ} (f : d.Fam R m X Y) :
    evalL t X Y (d.lof m X Y f) = val t f.1 0 (-m)

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.Eval.val_mem
statement:
theorem val_mem {p : ZMod 2} {f : d.FamAll X Y} (i j : ℤ)
    (hf : f i j ∈ parity (R := R) _ _ p) : val t f i j ∈ parity (R := R) _ _ p
proof:
:= by
  have := comp_mem (comp_mem (τ_inv_mem t i X).1 hf) (τ_hom_mem t j Y).1
  rw [zero_add, add_zero, Category.assoc] at this
  exact this

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.Eval.val_mem_degree
statement:
theorem val_mem_degree {f : d.FamAll X Y} {n : ℤ} (i j : ℤ) (hf : f i j ∈ degree (R := R) _ _ n) :
    val t f i j ∈ degree (R := R) X Y (i + n - j)
proof:
:= by
  have := comp_mem_degree (comp_mem_degree (τ_inv_mem t i X).2 hf) (τ_hom_mem t j Y).2
  rw [show i + n + -j = i + n - j by ring, Category.assoc] at this
  exact this

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.eval_obj
statement: @[simp] theorem eval_obj (X : Orbit d) : (eval t).obj X = X.obj

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.eval_map_lof
statement:
theorem eval_map_lof {X Y : Orbit d} {m : ℤ} (f : d.Fam R m X.obj Y.obj) :
    (eval t).map (d.lof m X.obj Y.obj f : X ⟶ Y) = val t f.1 0 (-m)

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.eval_ι_map
statement: theorem eval_ι_map {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) : (eval t).map ((ι d).map f) = f
proof:
:= by
  rw [ι_map]
  refine (eval_map_lof t (X := (⟨X⟩ : Orbit _)) (Y := ⟨Y⟩) _).trans ?_
  rw [neg_zero, val, τ_zero, τ_zero]
  simp [mapFam, diagFam_self]

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.eval_σIso_hom
statement: theorem eval_σIso_hom (X : Orbit d) : (eval t).map (σIso X).hom = (t.σ X.obj).hom
proof:
:= by
  show (eval t).map (d.lof (-1) _ _ _) = _
  rw [eval_map_lof, neg_neg, val_zero]
  show d.famσ X.obj 0 (0 + 1) ≫ (τ t (0 + 1) X.obj).hom = _
  rw [famσ_succ, comm_zero_hom_app, τ_succ, τ_zero]
  simp only [succ_zero_inv_app, Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id]
  erw [Category.id_comp, Category.id_comp]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.Γ_inv_τ
statement:
theorem Γ_inv_τ (h : IsTrivCompatible t t' Ψ) (i : ℤ) (Z : C) :
    (Ψ.Γ i).inv.app Z ≫ (τ t' i (Ψ.F.obj Z)).hom = Ψ.F.map (τ t i Z).hom
proof:
:= by
  refine Int.forall_of_step (P := fun i => (Ψ.Γ i).inv.app Z ≫ (τ t' i (Ψ.F.obj Z)).hom =
    Ψ.F.map (τ t i Z).hom) ?_ (fun i => ?_) i
  · rw [Γ_zero_inv_app, τ_zero, τ_zero]; simp
  · have h1 : (Ψ.Γ (i + 1)).inv.app Z ≫ (τ t' (i + 1) (Ψ.F.obj Z)).hom =
        Ψ.F.map ((d.succ i).inv.app Z ≫ (t.σ ((d.pow i).obj Z)).hom) ≫
          (Ψ.Γ i).inv.app Z ≫ (τ t' i (Ψ.F.obj Z)).hom := by
      rw [ShiftFunctor.Γ_succ_inv_app, τ_succ]
      simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_app_assoc, Functor.map_comp]
      rw [reassoc_of% (t'.σ_naturality ((Ψ.Γ i).inv.app Z)), ← h]
      simp only [Category.assoc]
    have h2 : Ψ.F.map (τ t (i + 1) Z).hom = Ψ.F.map ((d.succ i).inv.app Z ≫
        (t.σ ((d.pow i).obj Z)).hom) ≫ Ψ.F.map (τ t i Z).hom := by
      rw [τ_succ, ← Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc]
    have hK : IsIso (Ψ.F.map ((d.succ i).inv.app Z ≫ (t.σ ((d.pow i).obj Z)).hom)) :=
      inferInstance
    show _ = _ ↔ _ = _
    rw [h1, h2]
    exact ⟨fun e => (cancel_epi _).1 e, fun e => by rw [e]⟩

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.eval_map_map
statement:
theorem eval_map_map (h : IsTrivCompatible t t' Ψ) {X Y : Orbit d} (x : X ⟶ Y) :
    (eval t').map ((map Ψ).map x) = Ψ.F.map ((eval t).map x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using Hom.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | add x y hx hy => rw [(map _).map_add, (eval t').map_add, hx, hy, (eval t).map_add, Ψ.F.map_add]
  | lof m f =>
    rw [map_map_lof]
    erw [eval_map_lof, eval_map_lof]
    rw [val_zero, val_zero]
    simp only [famMapₗ_apply, famMap, Γ_zero_hom_app, Category.assoc,
      Functor.map_comp]
    erw [Category.id_comp, Γ_inv_τ h]

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.lift_obj
statement: @[simp] theorem lift_obj (X : Orbit d') : (lift t Φ).obj X = Φ.F.obj X.obj

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.lift_map
statement:
theorem lift_map {X Y : Orbit d'} (x : X ⟶ Y) :
    (lift t Φ).map x = (eval t).map ((map Φ).map x)

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.lift_ι_map
statement: theorem lift_ι_map {X Y : S} (f : X ⟶ Y) : (lift t Φ).map ((ι d').map f) = Φ.F.map f

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.lift_σIso_hom
statement:
theorem lift_σIso_hom (X : Orbit d') :
    (lift t Φ).map (σIso X).hom = Φ.γ.inv.app X.obj ≫ (t.σ (Φ.F.obj X.obj)).hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [lift_map, map_σIso_hom, Functor.map_comp, eval_ι_map]
  erw [eval_σIso_hom]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.lift_map_lof
statement:
theorem lift_map_lof {X Y : Orbit d'} {m : ℤ} (f : d'.Fam R m X.obj Y.obj) :
    (lift t Φ).map (d'.lof m X.obj Y.obj f : X ⟶ Y) =
      Φ.F.map (f.1 0 (-m)) ≫ (Φ.Γ (-m)).inv.app Y.obj ≫ (τ t (-m) (Φ.F.obj Y.obj)).hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [lift_map, map_map_lof]
  erw [eval_map_lof]
  rw [val_zero]
  simp only [famMapₗ_apply, famMap, Γ_zero_hom_app, Category.assoc]
  erw [Category.id_comp]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.Γ_hom_mem_degree
statement:
theorem Γ_hom_mem_degree (hP : ∀ {X Y : S} (f : X ⟶ Y), Φ.F.map f ∈ degree (R := R) _ _ 0)
    (hγ : ∀ X : S, Φ.γ.hom.app X ∈ degree (R := R) _ _ 0) (i : ℤ) (X : S) :
    (Φ.Γ i).hom.app X ∈ degree (R := R) _ _ 0
proof:
:= by
  refine Int.forall_of_step (P := fun i => (Φ.Γ i).hom.app X ∈ degree (R := R) _ _ 0) ?_
    (fun i => ?_) i
  · rw [Γ_zero_hom_app]; exact id_mem_degree _
  · show _ ∈ _ ↔ _ ∈ _
    rw [Γ_succ_hom_app]
    constructor
    · intro h
      have h1 := comp_mem_degree (comp_mem_degree (t.succ_hom_mem_degree i _) h)
        (comp_mem_degree (hP ((d'.succ i).inv.app X))
          (inv_mem_degree (Φ.γ.app ((d'.pow i).obj X)) (hγ ((d'.pow i).obj X))))
      simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_app_assoc, zero_add, add_zero,
        Iso.app_inv] at h1
      rw [← Φ.F.map_comp_assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_app] at h1
      erw [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id, Category.id_comp] at h1
      rw [Iso.hom_inv_id_app] at h1
      erw [Category.comp_id] at h1
      rw [t.Q_map_eq] at h1
      have h2 := comp_mem_degree (comp_mem_degree (t.σ_inv_mem_degree _) h1)
        (t.σ_mem_degree _)
      simpa using h2
    · intro h
      have hQ : d.Q.map ((Φ.Γ i).hom.app X) ∈ degree (R := R) _ _ 0 := by
        rw [t.Q_map_eq]
        simpa using comp_mem_degree (comp_mem_degree (t.σ_mem_degree _) h)
          (t.σ_inv_mem_degree _)
      have := comp_mem_degree (comp_mem_degree (comp_mem_degree
        (t.succ_inv_mem_degree i _) hQ) (hγ ((d'.pow i).obj X))) (hP ((d'.succ i).hom.app X))
      simpa using this

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.Γ_inv_mem_degree
statement:
theorem Γ_inv_mem_degree (hP : ∀ {X Y : S} (f : X ⟶ Y), Φ.F.map f ∈ degree (R := R) _ _ 0)
    (hγ : ∀ X : S, Φ.γ.hom.app X ∈ degree (R := R) _ _ 0) (i : ℤ) (X : S) :
    (Φ.Γ i).inv.app X ∈ degree (R := R) _ _ 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa using inv_mem_degree ((Φ.Γ i).app X) (Γ_hom_mem_degree t hP hγ i X)

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.lift_map_lof_mem_degree
statement:
theorem lift_map_lof_mem_degree (hP : ∀ {X Y : S} (f : X ⟶ Y), Φ.F.map f ∈ degree (R := R) _ _ 0)
    (hγ : ∀ X : S, Φ.γ.hom.app X ∈ degree (R := R) _ _ 0) {X Y : Orbit d'} {m : ℤ}
    (f : d'.Fam R m X.obj Y.obj) :
    (lift t Φ).map (d'.lof m X.obj Y.obj f : X ⟶ Y) ∈ degree (R := R) _ _ m
proof:
:= by
  rw [lift_map_lof]
  have := comp_mem_degree (hP (f.1 0 (-m))) (comp_mem_degree
    (Γ_inv_mem_degree t hP hγ (-m) Y.obj) (τ_hom_mem t (-m) (Φ.F.obj Y.obj)).2)
  simpa using! this

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.lift_map_mem_degree
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, rfl⟩ := hx
  exact lift_map_lof_mem_degree t hP hγ f

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.dproj_lift_map
statement:
theorem dproj_lift_map (hP : ∀ {X Y : S} (f : X ⟶ Y), Φ.F.map f ∈ degree (R := R) _ _ 0)
    (hγ : ∀ X : S, Φ.γ.hom.app X ∈ degree (R := R) _ _ 0) {X Y : Orbit d'} (n : ℤ)
    (x : X ⟶ Y) :
    dproj R n ((lift t Φ).map x) =
      (lift t Φ).map (d'.lof n X.obj Y.obj (d'.component n X.obj Y.obj x) : X ⟶ Y)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using Hom.induction_on with
  | zero =>
    rw [Functor.map_zero, map_zero, map_zero, map_zero]
    exact ((lift t Φ).map_zero _ _).symm
  | add x y hx hy =>
    rw [Functor.map_add, map_add, hx, hy, map_add, map_add]
    exact ((lift t Φ).map_add).symm
  | lof m f =>
    by_cases h : m = n
    · subst h
      rw [component_lof_self, dproj_of_mem (lift_map_lof_mem_degree t hP hγ f)]
    · rw [d'.component_lof_of_ne _ h, dproj_of_mem_ne (lift_map_lof_mem_degree t hP hγ f) h,
        map_zero]
      exact ((lift t Φ).map_zero _ _).symm

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.lift_map_injective
statement:
theorem lift_map_injective [Φ.F.Faithful]
    (hP : ∀ {X Y : S} (f : X ⟶ Y), Φ.F.map f ∈ degree (R := R) _ _ 0)
    (hγ : ∀ X : S, Φ.γ.hom.app X ∈ degree (R := R) _ _ 0) {X Y : Orbit d'} {x y : X ⟶ Y}
    (h : (lift t Φ).map x = (lift t Φ).map y) : x = y
proof:
:= by
  refine Hom.ext fun n => ?_
  have h1 := dproj_lift_map t hP hγ n x
  rw [h, dproj_lift_map t hP hγ n y, lift_map_lof, lift_map_lof] at h1
  have h2 := (cancel_mono ((Φ.Γ (-n)).inv.app Y.obj ≫ (τ t (-n) (Φ.F.obj Y.obj)).hom)).1
    (by simpa only [Category.assoc] using! h1)
  exact Subtype.ext (Fam.eq_of_entry (d'.component n X.obj Y.obj x).2
    (d'.component n X.obj Y.obj y).2 (i₀ := 0) (j₀ := -n) (by ring) (Φ.F.map_injective h2.symm))

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.F_map_Q_map
statement:
theorem F_map_Q_map {X Y : S} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    Φ.F.map (d'.Q.map f) = Φ.γ.inv.app X ≫ d.Q.map (Φ.F.map f) ≫ Φ.γ.hom.app Y
proof:
:= by
  have n := Φ.γ.hom.naturality f
  simp only [Functor.comp_obj, Functor.comp_map] at n
  rw [← cancel_epi (Φ.γ.hom.app X), Iso.hom_inv_id_app_assoc, n]

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.conj_mem_degree
proof:
:= by
  have := comp_mem_degree (Γ_inv_mem_degree t hP hγ i X) (comp_mem_degree
    (τ_hom_mem t i (Φ.F.obj X)).2 (comp_mem_degree hg (comp_mem_degree
      (τ_inv_mem t j (Φ.F.obj Y)).2 (Γ_hom_mem_degree t hP hγ j Y))))
  rwa [show 0 + (-i + (n + (j + 0))) = 0 by omega] at this

name: StringDiagrams.Orbit.lift_map_surjective
statement:
theorem lift_map_surjective [Φ.F.Faithful] {X Y : Orbit d'}
    (g : Φ.F.obj X.obj ⟶ Φ.F.obj Y.obj) : ∃ x : X ⟶ Y, (lift t Φ).map x = g
proof:
:= by
  refine induction_on_degree (R := R) g ⟨0, Functor.map_zero _ _ _⟩ (fun n g hg => ?_)
    (fun g h ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨y, hy⟩ => ⟨x + y, by rw [Functor.map_add, hx, hy]⟩)
  classical
  let fam : d'.FamAll X.obj Y.obj := fun i j =>
    if h : i - j = n then (hsurj _ (conj_mem_degree t Φ hP hγ hg h)).choose else 0
  have hfam : ∀ i j (h : i - j = n), Φ.F.map (fam i j) = conj t Φ g i j := fun i j h => by
    simp only [fam, dite_eq_left h]
    exact (hsurj _ (conj_mem_degree t Φ hP hγ hg h)).choose_spec
  have hmem : fam ∈ d'.Fam R n X.obj Y.obj := by
    refine ⟨fun i j h => by simp only [fam, dite_eq_right h], fun i j => ?_⟩
    by_cases h : i - j = n
    · apply Φ.F.map_injective
      rw [hfam _ _ (by omega), Functor.map_comp, Functor.map_comp, F_map_Q_map, hfam i j h]
      simp only [conj, Γ_succ_inv_app, Γ_succ_hom_app, τ_succ, τ_succ_inv, t.Q_map_eq,
        Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_app_assoc,
        Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc,
        Functor.comp_obj]
    · simp only [fam, dite_eq_right h, dite_eq_right (show ¬(i + 1 - (j + 1) = n) by omega),
        Functor.map_zero, Limits.zero_comp, Limits.comp_zero]
  refine ⟨d'.lof n X.obj Y.obj ⟨fam, hmem⟩, ?_⟩
  rw [lift_map_lof]
  change Φ.F.map (fam 0 (-n)) ≫ _ ≫ _ = g
  rw [hfam 0 (-n) (by ring), conj, Γ_zero_inv_app, τ_zero]
  simp

name: StringDiagrams.UnitTwo.noOdd
statement: theorem noOdd : TwoSupercategory.NoOdd R (UnitTwo R)

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.solve_aux
statement:
private theorem solve_aux {c d : A} (h : c ⟶ d) {Xc Yc : c ⟶ c} {Xd Yd : d ⟶ d}
    (Γc : Xc ⟶ Yc) (Γd : Xd ⟶ Yd) (Δd : Yd ⟶ Xd) (hΔΓ : Δd ≫ Γd = 𝟙 Yd)
    (yh : h ≫ Yd ⟶ Yc ≫ h) (xh : h ≫ Xd ⟶ Xc ≫ h) (hm : h ◁ Γd ≫ yh = xh ≫ Γc ▷ h) :
    yh = h ◁ Δd ≫ xh ≫ Γc ▷ h
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hm, ← Category.assoc, ← whiskerLeft_comp (R := R), hΔΓ, whiskerLeft_id (R := R),
    Category.id_comp]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.exchange_aux
statement:
private theorem exchange_aux {a b : A} {f g : a ⟶ b} (ε : f ⟶ g) {Xa Ya : a ⟶ a}
    {Xb Yb : b ⟶ b} (Γa : Xa ⟶ Ya) (Δb : Yb ⟶ Xb) (hΓa : Γa ∈ parity (R := R) Xa Ya 0)
    (hΔb : Δb ∈ parity (R := R) Yb Xb 0) (xf : f ≫ Xb ⟶ Xa ≫ f) (xg : g ≫ Xb ⟶ Xa ≫ g)
    (hθ : ε ▷ Xb ≫ xg = xf ≫ Xa ◁ ε) :
    ε ▷ Yb ≫ g ◁ Δb ≫ xg ≫ Γa ▷ g = (f ◁ Δb ≫ xf ≫ Γa ▷ f) ≫ Ya ◁ ε
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Category.assoc, whisker_exchange_of_even_right (R := R) ε hΔb, Category.assoc,
    ← Category.assoc (ε ▷ Xb), hθ, Category.assoc, ← whisker_exchange_of_even_left (R := R) hΓa ε]
  simp only [Category.assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.naturality_of_iso
statement:
theorem naturality_of_iso (θ : EndId R A) (η : idU R A ⟶ idU R A) (e : θ.toOplax ≅ η)
    {a b : A} {f g : a ⟶ b} (ε : f ⟶ g) :
    ε ▷ (η.app ⟨b⟩).obj ≫ (η.naturality (Underlying2.hom1 (R := R) g)).1 =
      (η.naturality (Underlying2.hom1 (R := R) f)).1 ≫ (η.app ⟨a⟩).obj ◁ ε
proof:
:= by
  have hΔΓ : ∀ c : A, (e.inv.as.app ⟨c⟩).1 ≫ (e.hom.as.app ⟨c⟩).1 = 𝟙 _ := fun c =>
    congrArg (fun k => (k.as.app ⟨c⟩).1) e.inv_hom_id
  have key : ∀ {c d : A} (h : c ⟶ d), (η.naturality (Underlying2.hom1 (R := R) h)).1 =
      h ◁ (e.inv.as.app ⟨d⟩).1 ≫ θ.x h ≫ (e.hom.as.app ⟨c⟩).1 ▷ h := fun {c d} h =>
    solve_aux (R := R) h (e.hom.as.app ⟨c⟩).1 (e.hom.as.app ⟨d⟩).1 (e.inv.as.app ⟨d⟩).1 (hΔΓ d)
      _ (θ.x h) (congrArg Subtype.val (e.hom.as.naturality (Underlying2.hom1 (R := R) h)))
  rw [key, key]
  exact exchange_aux (R := R) ε (e.hom.as.app ⟨a⟩).1 (e.inv.as.app ⟨b⟩).1
    (e.hom.as.app ⟨a⟩).2 (e.inv.as.app ⟨b⟩).2 (θ.x f) (θ.x g) (θ.naturality ε)

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.eq_zero_of_par_ne
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_par_ne (hB : TwoSupercategory.NoOdd R B) {a b : Underlying2 R (TwoEnvelope R B)}
    {f g : a ⟶ b} (ε : f ⟶ g) (h : f.obj.par ≠ g.obj.par) : ε = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hm : Envelope.toHom ε.1 ∈ parity (R := R) f.obj.obj g.obj.obj (0 + (f.obj.par + g.obj.par)) :=
    Envelope.mem_parity_iff.1 ε.2
  have h1 : (0 : ZMod 2) + (f.obj.par + g.obj.par) = 1 := by
    rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one f.obj.par with h0 | h0 <;>
      rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one g.obj.par with h0' | h0' <;> simp_all
  rw [h1, hB] at hm
  exact Subtype.ext ((Submodule.mem_bot R).1 hm)

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.parityTwist_app
statement:
theorem parityTwist_app (hB : TwoSupercategory.NoOdd R B) (a : Underlying2 R (TwoEnvelope R B)) :
    ((parityTwist R B hB).app a).obj = 𝟙 a.obj

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.parityTwist_naturality
statement:
theorem parityTwist_naturality (hB : TwoSupercategory.NoOdd R B)
    {a b : Underlying2 R (TwoEnvelope R B)} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    ((parityTwist R B hB).naturality f).1 =
      sign R f.obj.par • ((BicategoryStruct.rightUnitor f.obj).hom ≫
        (BicategoryStruct.leftUnitor f.obj).inv)

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.parityTwist_isStrong
statement:
theorem parityTwist_isStrong (hB : TwoSupercategory.NoOdd R B) :
    IsStrongOplax (parityTwist R B hB)
proof:
:= fun {a b} f => by
  let n := (Oplax.OplaxTrans.id (OplaxFunctor.id (Underlying2 R (TwoEnvelope R B)))).naturality f
  have : IsIso n := by
    change IsIso ((Bicategory.rightUnitor f).hom ≫ (Bicategory.leftUnitor f).inv)
    infer_instance
  refine ⟨⟨sign R f.obj.par • inv n, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · change (sign R f.obj.par • n) ≫ (sign R f.obj.par • inv n) = 𝟙 _
    rw [Linear.smul_comp, Linear.comp_smul, smul_smul, sign_mul_self, one_smul, IsIso.hom_inv_id]
  · change (sign R f.obj.par • inv n) ≫ (sign R f.obj.par • n) = 𝟙 _
    rw [Linear.smul_comp, Linear.comp_smul, smul_smul, sign_mul_self, one_smul, IsIso.inv_hom_id]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.parityTwist_not_iso
statement:
theorem parityTwist_not_iso (hB : TwoSupercategory.NoOdd R B) (a : B)
    (h2 : (2 : R) • 𝟙 (𝟙 a) ≠ 0) (θ : TwoNatTrans.EndId R (TwoEnvelope R B)) :
    IsEmpty (θ.toOplax ≅ parityTwist R B hB)
proof:
:= ⟨fun e => by
  let A : TwoEnvelope R B := ⟨a⟩
  have h := TwoNatTrans.naturality_of_iso θ _ e (a := A) (b := A)
    (f := PiTwoSupercategory.pi (R := R) A) (g := 𝟙 A) (PiTwoSupercategory.ζ (R := R) A).hom
  change BicategoryStruct.whiskerRight (PiTwoSupercategory.ζ (R := R) A).hom (𝟙 A) ≫
      (sign R 0 • ((BicategoryStruct.rightUnitor (𝟙 A)).hom ≫
        (BicategoryStruct.leftUnitor (𝟙 A)).inv)) =
    (sign R 1 • ((BicategoryStruct.rightUnitor (PiTwoSupercategory.pi (R := R) A)).hom ≫
        (BicategoryStruct.leftUnitor (PiTwoSupercategory.pi (R := R) A)).inv)) ≫
      BicategoryStruct.whiskerLeft (𝟙 A) (PiTwoSupercategory.ζ (R := R) A).hom at h
  rw [sign_zero, sign_one, one_smul, neg_one_smul, Preadditive.neg_comp, ← Category.assoc,
    rightUnitor_naturality (R := R), Category.assoc, Category.assoc,
    ← leftUnitor_inv_naturality (R := R)] at h
  set z := (BicategoryStruct.rightUnitor (PiTwoSupercategory.pi (R := R) A)).hom ≫
    (PiTwoSupercategory.ζ (R := R) A).hom ≫ (BicategoryStruct.leftUnitor (𝟙 A)).inv with hz
  have hz2 : (2 : R) • z = 0 := by
    rw [two_smul]
    nth_rewrite 2 [h]
    exact add_neg_cancel z
  have hone : (2 : R) • 𝟙 (PiTwoSupercategory.pi (R := R) A) = 0 := by
    have : 𝟙 (PiTwoSupercategory.pi (R := R) A) =
        (BicategoryStruct.rightUnitor (PiTwoSupercategory.pi (R := R) A)).inv ≫ z ≫
          (BicategoryStruct.leftUnitor (𝟙 A)).hom ≫ (PiTwoSupercategory.ζ (R := R) A).inv := by
      simp [hz]
    rw [this, ← Linear.comp_smul, ← Linear.smul_comp, hz2, Limits.zero_comp, Limits.comp_zero]
  apply h2
  have := congrArg Envelope.toHom hone
  rw [Envelope.toHom_smul, Envelope.toHom_id] at this
  exact this⟩

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.parityTwistObj_not_mem_essImage
statement:
theorem parityTwistObj_not_mem_essImage (hB : TwoSupercategory.NoOdd R B) (a : B)
    (h2 : (2 : R) • 𝟙 (𝟙 a) ≠ 0) :
    ¬ (DrinfeldCenter.toCenter2 R (TwoEnvelope R B)).essImage (parityTwistObj R B hB)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨X, ⟨e⟩⟩
  exact (parityTwist_not_iso hB a h2 X.obj.toTwoNatTrans).false
    ((centerProp (Underlying2 R (TwoEnvelope R B))).ι.mapIso e).unmop

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.parityTwist_not_isPiTwoNatural
statement:
theorem parityTwist_not_isPiTwoNatural (hB : TwoSupercategory.NoOdd R B) (a : B)
    (h2 : (2 : R) • 𝟙 (𝟙 a) ≠ 0) :
    ¬ (PiTwoFunctor.id R (Underlying2 R (TwoEnvelope R B))).IsPiTwoNatural
      (PiTwoFunctor.id R _) (parityTwist R B hB)
proof:
:= fun hπ =>
  (parityTwist_not_iso hB a h2 (DrinfeldCenter.ofPiCenter
    (⟨MonoidalOpposite.mop (parityTwist R B hB), parityTwist_isStrong hB, hπ⟩ :
      PiCenter R (Underlying2 R (TwoEnvelope R B)))).toTwoNatTrans).false (Iso.refl _)

name: StringDiagrams.remark57_toCenter2_not_essSurj
statement:
theorem remark57_toCenter2_not_essSurj :
    ¬ (DrinfeldCenter.toCenter2 ℤ (TwoEnvelope ℤ (UnitTwo ℤ))).EssSurj
proof:
:= fun h =>
  TwoEnvelope.parityTwistObj_not_mem_essImage (UnitTwo.noOdd ℤ) UnitTwo.pt
    (show (2 : ℤ) • (1 : ℤ) ≠ 0 by norm_num) (h.mem_essImage _)

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.id_isGraded
statement:
theorem id_isGraded [∀ a b : B, GradedSupercategory R (a ⟶ b)]
    [∀ a b : C, GradedSupercategory R (a ⟶ b)] [GradedTwoSupercategory R C] :
    (id F).IsGraded
proof:
:= by
  intro a b f
  rw [id_x]
  simpa only [add_zero, id_X] using comp_mem_degree
    (GradedTwoSupercategory.rightUnitor_hom_mem_degree (R := R) (F.map f))
    (GradedTwoSupercategory.leftUnitor_inv_mem_degree (R := R) (F.map f))

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.IsGraded.vcomp
statement:
theorem IsGraded.vcomp [∀ a b : B, GradedSupercategory R (a ⟶ b)]
    [∀ a b : C, GradedSupercategory R (a ⟶ b)] [GradedTwoSupercategory R C]
    {θ : TwoNatTrans F G} {ψ : TwoNatTrans G H} (hθ : θ.IsGraded) (hψ : ψ.IsGraded) :
    (vcomp θ ψ).IsGraded
proof:
:= by
  intro a b f
  rw [vcomp_x]
  simpa only [add_zero, vcomp_X] using comp_mem_degree
    (GradedTwoSupercategory.associator_inv_mem_degree (R := R) _ _ _)
    (comp_mem_degree (GradedTwoSupercategory.whiskerRight_mem_degree _ (hθ f))
      (comp_mem_degree (GradedTwoSupercategory.associator_hom_mem_degree (R := R) _ _ _)
        (comp_mem_degree (GradedTwoSupercategory.whiskerLeft_mem_degree _ (hψ f))
          (GradedTwoSupercategory.associator_inv_mem_degree (R := R) _ _ _))))

name: StringDiagrams.QTwoEnvelope.mapQNatTrans_id
statement: theorem mapQNatTrans_id : mapQNatTrans (TwoNatTrans.id F) = TwoNatTrans.id (mapQ F)

:= by
  apply TwoNatTrans.ext_of_eq rfl

name: StringDiagrams.QTwoEnvelope.mapQNatTrans_vcomp
statement:
theorem mapQNatTrans_vcomp (θ : TwoNatTrans F G) (ψ : TwoNatTrans G H) :
    mapQNatTrans (TwoNatTrans.vcomp θ ψ) = TwoNatTrans.vcomp (mapQNatTrans θ) (mapQNatTrans ψ)
proof:
:= by
  apply TwoNatTrans.ext_of_eq rfl
  intro a b f
  simp only [eqToHom_refl, Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id]

name: StringDiagrams.QTwoEnvelope.mapQNatTrans_isGraded
statement:
theorem mapQNatTrans_isGraded [∀ a b : B, GradedSupercategory R (a ⟶ b)]
    [∀ a b : C, GradedSupercategory R (a ⟶ b)] {θ : TwoNatTrans F G} (hθ : θ.IsGraded) :
    (mapQNatTrans θ).IsGraded
proof:
:= by
  intro a b f
  change θ.x f.obj ∈ degree (R := R) (F.map f.obj ≫ θ.X b.as) (θ.X a.as ≫ G.map f.obj)
    (0 + ((f.shift + 0) - (0 + f.shift)))
  simpa only [add_zero, zero_add, sub_self] using hθ f.obj

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.mapPiNatTrans_id
statement: theorem mapPiNatTrans_id : mapPiNatTrans (TwoNatTrans.id F) = TwoNatTrans.id (mapPi F)

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.mapPiNatTrans_vcomp
statement:
theorem mapPiNatTrans_vcomp (θ : TwoNatTrans F G) (ψ : TwoNatTrans G H) :
    mapPiNatTrans (TwoNatTrans.vcomp θ ψ) = TwoNatTrans.vcomp (mapPiNatTrans θ) (mapPiNatTrans ψ)
proof:
:= by
  apply TwoNatTrans.ext_of_eq (by
    funext a
    change Envelope.mk 0 _ = Envelope.mk (0 + 0) _
    simp only [add_zero]
    rfl)
  intro a b f
  simp only [eqToHom_refl, Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id]
  apply Envelope.hom_ext
  rw [toHom_mapPiNatTrans_x, TwoNatTrans.vcomp_x, TwoNatTrans.vcomp_x]
  repeat rw [Envelope.toHom_comp]
  rw [toHom_whiskerRight_of_par_zero _ _ rfl, toHom_whiskerLeft_of_par_zero _ rfl]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.toHom_mapQPiSupermodification_app

@[simp] theorem toHom_mapQPiSupermodification_app {θ θ' : TwoNatTrans F G} (α : θ ⟶ θ')

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.mapQPiSupermodification_isHomogeneous_iff
statement:
theorem mapQPiSupermodification_isHomogeneous_iff
    [∀ a b : B, GradedSupercategory R (a ⟶ b)]
    [∀ a b : C, GradedSupercategory R (a ⟶ b)]
    {θ θ' : TwoNatTrans F G} (α : θ ⟶ θ') (p : ZMod 2) (n : ℤ) :
    (mapQPiSupermodification α).IsHomogeneous p n ↔ α.IsHomogeneous p n
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h a
    have ha := h ⟨⟨a⟩⟩
    change α.app a ∈ parity (R := R) (θ.X a) (θ'.X a) (p + (0 + 0)) ∧
      α.app a ∈ degree (R := R) (θ.X a) (θ'.X a) (n + (0 - 0)) at ha
    simpa only [add_zero, sub_self] using ha
  · intro h a
    change α.app a.as.as ∈ parity (R := R) (θ.X a.as.as) (θ'.X a.as.as) (p + (0 + 0)) ∧
      α.app a.as.as ∈ degree (R := R) (θ.X a.as.as) (θ'.X a.as.as) (n + (0 - 0))
    simpa only [add_zero, sub_self] using h a.as.as

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.mapQPiSupermodification_whiskerLeft_app

theorem mapQPiSupermodification_whiskerLeft_app (θ : TwoNatTrans F G)

    toHom ((mapQPiSupermodification (TwoNatTrans.whiskerLeft θ α)).app a) =
      toHom ((TwoNatTrans.whiskerLeft (mapQPiNatTrans θ) (mapQPiSupermodification α)).app a)
proof:
:= by
  change _ = QEnvelope.toHom (Envelope.toHom ((mapQPiNatTrans θ).X a ◁
    (mapQPiSupermodification α).app a))
  rw [TwoEnvelope.toHom_whiskerLeft_of_par_zero _ rfl]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.mapQPiSupermodification_whiskerRight_app
statement:
theorem mapQPiSupermodification_whiskerRight_app {θ θ' : TwoNatTrans F G}
    (α : θ ⟶ θ') (ψ : TwoNatTrans G H) (a : QPiTwoEnvelope R B) :
    toHom ((mapQPiSupermodification (TwoNatTrans.whiskerRight α ψ)).app a) =
      toHom ((TwoNatTrans.whiskerRight (mapQPiSupermodification α) (mapQPiNatTrans ψ)).app a)
proof:
:= by
  change _ = QEnvelope.toHom (Envelope.toHom ((mapQPiSupermodification α).app a ▷
    (mapQPiNatTrans ψ).X a))
  rw [TwoEnvelope.toHom_whiskerRight_of_par_zero _ _ rfl]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalSupercategory.associator_naturality_left
statement:
theorem associator_naturality_left {X X' : C} (f : X ⟶ X') (Y Z : C) :
    (f ▷ Y) ▷ Z ≫ (α_ X' Y Z).hom = (α_ X Y Z).hom ≫ f ▷ (Y ⊗ Z)
proof:
:= by
  have h := associator_naturality (R := R) f (𝟙 Y) (𝟙 Z)
  rwa [tensor_id R, tensorHom_def (R := R) (f ⊗ₘ 𝟙 Y), tensorHom_def (R := R) f,
    tensorHom_def (R := R) f, whiskerLeft_id (R := R), whiskerLeft_id (R := R),
    whiskerLeft_id (R := R), Category.comp_id, Category.comp_id, Category.comp_id] at h

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalSupercategory.associator_naturality_middle
statement:
theorem associator_naturality_middle (X : C) {Y Y' : C} (g : Y ⟶ Y') (Z : C) :
    (X ◁ g) ▷ Z ≫ (α_ X Y' Z).hom = (α_ X Y Z).hom ≫ X ◁ (g ▷ Z)
proof:
:= by
  have h := associator_naturality (R := R) (𝟙 X) g (𝟙 Z)
  rwa [tensorHom_def (R := R) (𝟙 X ⊗ₘ g), tensorHom_def (R := R) (𝟙 X) g,
    tensorHom_def (R := R) (𝟙 X), tensorHom_def (R := R) g, id_whiskerRight (R := R),
    id_whiskerRight (R := R), whiskerLeft_id (R := R), whiskerLeft_id (R := R),
    Category.id_comp, Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id, Category.comp_id] at h

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalSupercategory.associator_naturality_right
statement:
theorem associator_naturality_right (X Y : C) {Z Z' : C} (h : Z ⟶ Z') :
    (X ⊗ Y) ◁ h ≫ (α_ X Y Z').hom = (α_ X Y Z).hom ≫ X ◁ (Y ◁ h)
proof:
:= by
  have e := associator_naturality (R := R) (𝟙 X) (𝟙 Y) h
  rwa [tensor_id R, tensorHom_def (R := R) (𝟙 (X ⊗ Y)), tensorHom_def (R := R) (𝟙 X),
    tensorHom_def (R := R) (𝟙 Y), id_whiskerRight (R := R), id_whiskerRight (R := R),
    id_whiskerRight (R := R), Category.id_comp, Category.id_comp, Category.id_comp] at e

name: StringDiagrams.MonoidalSupercategory.associator_naturality_of_whiskers
statement:
theorem MonoidalSupercategory.associator_naturality_of_whiskers {C : Type w₁} [Category.{w₂} C]
    [MonoidalCategoryStruct C]
    (tensorHom_def : ∀ {X₁ Y₁ X₂ Y₂ : C} (f : X₁ ⟶ Y₁) (g : X₂ ⟶ Y₂),
      f ⊗ₘ g = f ▷ X₂ ≫ Y₁ ◁ g)
    (whiskerLeft_comp : ∀ (X : C) {Y Z W : C} (f : Y ⟶ Z) (g : Z ⟶ W),
      X ◁ (f ≫ g) = X ◁ f ≫ X ◁ g)
    (comp_whiskerRight : ∀ {X Y Z : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (W : C),
      (f ≫ g) ▷ W = f ▷ W ≫ g ▷ W)
    (left : ∀ {X X' : C} (f : X ⟶ X') (Y Z : C),
      (f ▷ Y) ▷ Z ≫ (α_ X' Y Z).hom = (α_ X Y Z).hom ≫ f ▷ (Y ⊗ Z))
    (middle : ∀ (X : C) {Y Y' : C} (g : Y ⟶ Y') (Z : C),
      (X ◁ g) ▷ Z ≫ (α_ X Y' Z).hom = (α_ X Y Z).hom ≫ X ◁ (g ▷ Z))
    (right : ∀ (X Y : C) {Z Z' : C} (h : Z ⟶ Z'),
      (X ⊗ Y) ◁ h ≫ (α_ X Y Z').hom = (α_ X Y Z).hom ≫ X ◁ (Y ◁ h))
    {X₁ X₂ X₃ Y₁ Y₂ Y₃ : C} (f₁ : X₁ ⟶ Y₁) (f₂ : X₂ ⟶ Y₂) (f₃ : X₃ ⟶ Y₃) :
    ((f₁ ⊗ₘ f₂) ⊗ₘ f₃) ≫ (α_ Y₁ Y₂ Y₃).hom = (α_ X₁ X₂ X₃).hom ≫ (f₁ ⊗ₘ (f₂ ⊗ₘ f₃))
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensorHom_def (f₁ ⊗ₘ f₂), tensorHom_def f₁ f₂, tensorHom_def f₁, tensorHom_def f₂,
    comp_whiskerRight, whiskerLeft_comp, Category.assoc, Category.assoc, right,
    ← Category.assoc ((Y₁ ◁ f₂) ▷ X₃), middle, Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc ((f₁ ▷ X₂) ▷ X₃),
    left, Category.assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.Envelope.induction_on'
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
theorem induction_on' [CommRing R] [Linear R C] [Supercategory R C] {X Y : Envelope R C}
    {P : (X ⟶ Y) → Prop} (f : X ⟶ Y) (zero : P 0)
    (hom : ∀ (r : ZMod 2) (g : X ⟶ Y), toHom g ∈ parity (R := R) X.obj Y.obj r → P g)
    (add : ∀ g h, P g → P h → P (g + h)) : P f
proof:
:=
  induction_on (R := R) (P := fun g : X.obj ⟶ Y.obj => P (ofHom g)) (toHom f) zero
    (fun r g hg => hom r (ofHom g) hg) (fun g h => add (ofHom g) (ofHom h))

proof:

name: StringDiagrams.Envelope.associator_naturality_left'
statement:
theorem associator_naturality_left' {X X' : Envelope R C} (f : X ⟶ X') (Y Z : Envelope R C) :
    (f ▷ Y) ▷ Z ≫ (α_ X' Y Z).hom = (α_ X Y Z).hom ≫ f ▷ (Y ⊗ Z)
proof:
:= by
  refine induction_on' (R := R) f ?_ (fun r f hf => ?_) (fun f g hf hg => ?_)
  · rw [zero_whiskerRight', zero_whiskerRight', zero_whiskerRight', Limits.zero_comp,
      Limits.comp_zero]
  · apply hom_ext
    rw [toHom_comp, toHom_comp, toHom_whiskerRight_of_mem (toHom_whiskerRight_mem hf Y),
      toHom_whiskerRight_of_mem hf, toHom_whiskerRight_of_mem hf,
      MonoidalSupercategory.smul_whiskerRight, smul_smul, Linear.smul_comp, Linear.comp_smul,
      toHom_associator_hom, toHom_associator_hom,
      MonoidalSupercategory.associator_naturality_left R, ← sign_add]
    congr 2
    simp only [tensorObj_par]
    ring
  · rw [add_whiskerRight', add_whiskerRight', add_whiskerRight', Preadditive.add_comp,
      Preadditive.comp_add, hf, hg]

name: StringDiagrams.Envelope.associator_naturality_middle'
statement:
theorem associator_naturality_middle' (X : Envelope R C) {Y Y' : Envelope R C} (g : Y ⟶ Y')
    (Z : Envelope R C) :
    (X ◁ g) ▷ Z ≫ (α_ X Y' Z).hom = (α_ X Y Z).hom ≫ X ◁ (g ▷ Z)
proof:
:= by
  refine induction_on' (R := R) g ?_ (fun r g hg => ?_) (fun f g hf hg => ?_)
  · rw [whiskerLeft_zero', zero_whiskerRight', zero_whiskerRight', whiskerLeft_zero',
      Limits.zero_comp, Limits.comp_zero]
  · apply hom_ext
    rw [toHom_comp, toHom_comp, toHom_whiskerRight_of_mem (toHom_whiskerLeft_mem X hg),
      toHom_whiskerLeft_of_mem X hg, toHom_whiskerLeft_of_mem X (toHom_whiskerRight_mem hg Z),
      toHom_whiskerRight_of_mem hg, MonoidalSupercategory.smul_whiskerRight,
      MonoidalSupercategory.whiskerLeft_smul, smul_smul, smul_smul, Linear.smul_comp,
      Linear.comp_smul, toHom_associator_hom, toHom_associator_hom,
      ← sign_add, ← sign_add]
    erw [MonoidalSupercategory.associator_naturality_middle R]
    congr 2
    simp only [tensorObj_par]
    clear hg
    generalize X.par = a; generalize Y.par = b; generalize Y'.par = c; generalize Z.par = d
    revert a b c d r; decide
  · rw [whiskerLeft_add', add_whiskerRight', add_whiskerRight', whiskerLeft_add',
      Preadditive.add_comp, Preadditive.comp_add, hf, hg]

name: StringDiagrams.Envelope.associator_naturality_right'
statement:
theorem associator_naturality_right' (X Y : Envelope R C) {Z Z' : Envelope R C} (h : Z ⟶ Z') :
    (X ⊗ Y) ◁ h ≫ (α_ X Y Z').hom = (α_ X Y Z).hom ≫ X ◁ (Y ◁ h)
proof:
:= by
  refine induction_on' (R := R) h ?_ (fun r h hh => ?_) (fun f g hf hg => ?_)
  · rw [whiskerLeft_zero', whiskerLeft_zero', whiskerLeft_zero', Limits.zero_comp,
      Limits.comp_zero]
  · apply hom_ext
    rw [toHom_comp, toHom_comp, toHom_whiskerLeft_of_mem _ hh,
      toHom_whiskerLeft_of_mem X (toHom_whiskerLeft_mem Y hh), toHom_whiskerLeft_of_mem Y hh,
      MonoidalSupercategory.whiskerLeft_smul, smul_smul, Linear.smul_comp, Linear.comp_smul,
      toHom_associator_hom, toHom_associator_hom, ← sign_add]
    erw [MonoidalSupercategory.associator_naturality_right R]
    congr 2
    simp only [tensorObj_par]
    clear hh
    generalize X.par = a; generalize Y.par = b; generalize Z.par = c; generalize Z'.par = d
    revert a b c d r; decide
  · rw [whiskerLeft_add', whiskerLeft_add', whiskerLeft_add', Preadditive.add_comp,
      Preadditive.comp_add, hf, hg]

name: StringDiagrams.Envelope.toHom_superTensorHom
statement:
theorem toHom_superTensorHom {X X' Y Y' : Envelope R C} {f : X ⟶ X'} {g : Y ⟶ Y'}
    {pf pg : ZMod 2} (hf : toHom f ∈ parity (R := R) X.obj X'.obj pf)
    (hg : toHom g ∈ parity (R := R) Y.obj Y'.obj pg) :
    toHom (MonoidalSupercategory.superTensorHom f g) =
      sign R (X.par * pg + pf * Y'.par + X.par * Y'.par + X.par * Y.par) •
        MonoidalSupercategory.superTensorHom (toHom f) (toHom g)
proof:
:= by
  rw [MonoidalSupercategory.superTensorHom, MonoidalSupercategory.superTensorHom, toHom_comp,
    toHom_whiskerLeft_of_mem X hg, toHom_whiskerRight_of_mem hf, Linear.smul_comp,
    Linear.comp_smul, smul_smul, ← sign_add]
  congr 2
  ring

name: StringDiagrams.Envelope.ζUnit_hom_mem
statement: theorem ζUnit_hom_mem : (ζUnit (R := R) (C := C)).hom ∈ parity (R := R) _ _ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_parity_iff]
  show 𝟙 (𝟙_ C) ∈ parity (R := R) (𝟙_ C) (𝟙_ C) (1 + (1 + 0))
  exact id_mem _

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.shiftIso_hom_mem

theorem shiftIso_hom_mem (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (shiftIso (R := R) f).hom ∈ parity (R := R) (Jm f.obj.obj : a ⟶ b) f f.par
proof:
:= by
  show 𝟙 f.obj.obj ∈ parity (R := R) f.obj.obj f.obj.obj (f.par + (0 + f.par))
  rw [zero_add, zmod2_add_self]
  exact id_mem _

statement:
theorem shiftIso_hom_mem_degree [∀ a b : B, GradedSupercategory R (a ⟶ b)] (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (shiftIso (R := R) f).hom ∈ degree (R := R) (Jm f.obj.obj : a ⟶ b) f f.obj.shift
proof:
:= by
  have h : (Envelope.ofHom (QEnvelope.ofHom (𝟙 f.obj.obj)) : (Jm f.obj.obj : a ⟶ b) ⟶ f) ∈
      degree (R := R) _ _ (0 + f.obj.shift - 0) :=
    ofHom_mem_degree (R := R) (id_mem_degree (R := R) f.obj.obj)
  rw [zero_add, sub_zero] at h
  exact h

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.shiftIso_conj
statement:
theorem shiftIso_conj {f g : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ g) :

proof:
:= by
  apply Envelope.hom_ext

  show 𝟙 _ ≫ toHom η ≫ 𝟙 _ = toHom η
  rw [Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id]

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.x_eq_shift
statement:
theorem x_eq_shift (θ : TwoNatTrans T T') {a b : QPiTwoEnvelope R B} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    θ.x f = T.map₂ (shiftIso f).inv ▷ θ.X b ≫ θ.x (Jm f.obj.obj) ≫
      θ.X a ◁ T'.map₂ (shiftIso f).hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [← θ.naturality (shiftIso f).hom, ← Category.assoc, ← comp_whiskerRight (R := R),
    ← T.map₂_comp, Iso.inv_hom_id, T.map₂_id, id_whiskerRight (R := R), Category.id_comp]

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.naturality_of_Jm_of_mem
statement:
theorem naturality_of_Jm_of_mem {θ θ' : TwoNatTrans T T'} {p : ZMod 2}
    (α : ∀ a, θ.X a ⟶ θ'.X a) (hα : ∀ a, α a ∈ parity (R := R) _ _ p)
    {a b : QPiTwoEnvelope R B} (f : a ⟶ b)
    (h : θ.x (Jm f.obj.obj : a ⟶ b) ≫ α a ▷ T'.map (Jm f.obj.obj) =
      T.map (Jm f.obj.obj) ◁ α b ≫ θ'.x (Jm f.obj.obj)) :
    θ.x f ≫ α a ▷ T'.map f = T.map f ◁ α b ≫ θ'.x f
proof:
:= by
  rw [x_eq_shift θ f, x_eq_shift θ' f]
  have h₁ := super_interchange (R := R) (hα a) (T'.map₂_mem (shiftIso_hom_mem (R := R) f))
  have h₂ := super_interchange (R := R) (T.map₂_mem (shiftIso_inv_mem (R := R) f)) (hα b)
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [← koszulSign_smul_smul p f.par (θ.X a ◁ _ ≫ _), ← h₁, Linear.comp_smul,
    Linear.comp_smul, reassoc_of% h, ← Category.assoc (T.map₂ (shiftIso f).inv ▷ _),
    h₂, Linear.smul_comp, smul_smul, koszulSign_comm, koszulSign_mul_self, one_smul]
  simp only [Category.assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.naturality_of_Jm
statement:
theorem naturality_of_Jm {θ θ' : TwoNatTrans T T'} (β : restrictNatTrans θ ⟶ restrictNatTrans θ')
    {a b : QPiTwoEnvelope R B} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    θ.x f ≫ β.app a.as.as ▷ T'.map f = T.map f ◁ β.app b.as.as ≫ θ'.x f
proof:
:= by
  have h := fun p => naturality_of_Jm_of_mem (fun a => (TwoNatTrans.projHom p β).app a.as.as)
    (fun a => proj_mem (R := R) p (β.app a.as.as)) f
    ((TwoNatTrans.projHom p β).naturality f.obj.obj)
  have e : ∀ a : B, β.app a = (TwoNatTrans.projHom 0 β).app a + (TwoNatTrans.projHom 1 β).app a :=
    fun a => (proj_add_proj (R := R) (β.app a)).symm
  rw [e, e, add_whiskerRight (R := R), whiskerLeft_add (R := R), Preadditive.comp_add,
    Preadditive.add_comp, h 0, h 1]

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.liftX_Jm
statement:
theorem liftX_Jm {a b : QPiTwoEnvelope R B} (f : a.as.as ⟶ b.as.as) :
    liftX ψ (Jm f : a ⟶ b) = liftXJ ψ (Jm f : a ⟶ b)
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ : T.map₂ (shiftIso (R := R) (Jm f : a ⟶ b)).inv = 𝟙 _ := T.map₂_id _
  have h₂ : T'.map₂ (shiftIso (R := R) (Jm f : a ⟶ b)).hom = 𝟙 _ := T'.map₂_id _
  rw [liftX, h₁, h₂]
  erw [id_whiskerRight (R := R), whiskerLeft_id (R := R), Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id]

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.liftX_mem
statement:
theorem liftX_mem {a b : QPiTwoEnvelope R B} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    liftX ψ f ∈ parity (R := R) _ _ 0
proof:
:= by
  have := comp_mem (whiskerRight_mem (R := R) (liftObj ψ b)
    (T.map₂_mem (shiftIso_inv_mem (R := R) f)))
    (comp_mem (ψ.x_mem f.obj.obj) (whiskerLeft_mem (R := R) (liftObj ψ a)
      (T'.map₂_mem (shiftIso_hom_mem (R := R) f))))
  rwa [zero_add, zmod2_add_self] at this

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.liftX_naturality
statement:
theorem liftX_naturality {a b : QPiTwoEnvelope R B} {f g : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ g) :
    T.map₂ η ▷ liftObj ψ b ≫ liftX ψ g = liftX ψ f ≫ liftObj ψ a ◁ T'.map₂ η
proof:
:= by
  have k₁ : η ≫ (shiftIso g).inv = (shiftIso f).inv ≫ J2 (toHom η) := by
    rw [← shiftIso_conj, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
  have k₂ : J2 (toHom η) ≫ (shiftIso g).hom = (shiftIso f).hom ≫ η := by
    rw [← shiftIso_conj]
    simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]
  have hn : T.map₂ (J2 (toHom η)) ▷ liftObj ψ b ≫ liftXJ ψ g =
      liftXJ ψ f ≫ liftObj ψ a ◁ T'.map₂ (J2 (toHom η)) :=
    ψ.naturality (toHom η)
  simp only [liftX]
  rw [← Category.assoc (T.map₂ η ▷ _), ← comp_whiskerRight (R := R), ← T.map₂_comp, k₁,
    T.map₂_comp, comp_whiskerRight (R := R), Category.assoc, reassoc_of% hn,
    ← whiskerLeft_comp (R := R), ← T'.map₂_comp, k₂, T'.map₂_comp, whiskerLeft_comp (R := R)]
  simp only [Category.assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.liftNatTrans_isGraded
statement:
theorem liftNatTrans_isGraded [GradedTwoSupercategory R C] (hT : T.IsGraded) (hT' : T'.IsGraded)
    {ψ : TwoNatTrans (restrict T) (restrict T')} (hψ : ψ.IsGraded) :
    (liftNatTrans ψ).IsGraded
proof:
:= fun {a b} f => by
  have := comp_mem_degree
    (GradedTwoSupercategory.whiskerRight_mem_degree (R := R) (liftObj ψ b)
      (hT.map₂_mem_degree (shiftIso_inv_mem_degree (R := R) f)))
    (comp_mem_degree (hψ f.obj.obj) (GradedTwoSupercategory.whiskerLeft_mem_degree (R := R)
      (liftObj ψ a) (hT'.map₂_mem_degree (shiftIso_hom_mem_degree (R := R) f))))
  rw [zero_add, neg_add_cancel] at this
  exact this
