name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.coherence_yoneda_assoc
statement:
theorem coherence_yoneda_assoc {a b c d e : B} (k : e ⟶ d) (h : d ⟶ c) (u : c ⟶ a)
    (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (associator k h (u ≫ f)).hom ≫ k ◁ (associator h u f).inv ≫ (associator k (h ≫ u) f).inv =
      (associator (k ≫ h) u f).inv ≫ (associator k h u).hom ▷ f
proof:
:= by
  have hU : ∀ {a b c d e : Underlying2 R B} (k : e ⟶ d) (h : d ⟶ c) (u : c ⟶ a) (f : a ⟶ b),
      (Bicategory.associator k h (u ≫ f)).hom ≫
          Bicategory.whiskerLeft k (Bicategory.associator h u f).inv ≫
            (Bicategory.associator k (h ≫ u) f).inv =
        (Bicategory.associator (k ≫ h) u f).inv ≫
          Bicategory.whiskerRight (Bicategory.associator k h u).hom f := by
    intros; bicategory
  have h' := congrArg Subtype.val (hU (Underlying2.hom1 k) (Underlying2.hom1 h)
    (Underlying2.hom1 u) (Underlying2.hom1 f))
  underlying2_val h'

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.coherence_yoneda_mapComp
statement:
theorem coherence_yoneda_mapComp {a b c d e : B} (h : e ⟶ d) (u : d ⟶ a) (f : a ⟶ b)
    (g : b ⟶ c) :
    (associator h (u ≫ f) g).inv ≫ (associator h u f).inv ▷ g ≫ (associator (h ≫ u) f g).hom =
      h ◁ (associator u f g).hom ≫ (associator h u (f ≫ g)).inv
proof:
:= by
  have hU : ∀ {a b c d e : Underlying2 R B} (h : e ⟶ d) (u : d ⟶ a) (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c),
      (Bicategory.associator h (u ≫ f) g).inv ≫
          Bicategory.whiskerRight (Bicategory.associator h u f).inv g ≫
            (Bicategory.associator (h ≫ u) f g).hom =
        Bicategory.whiskerLeft h (Bicategory.associator u f g).hom ≫
          (Bicategory.associator h u (f ≫ g)).inv := by
    intros; bicategory
  have h' := congrArg Subtype.val (hU (Underlying2.hom1 h) (Underlying2.hom1 u)
    (Underlying2.hom1 f) (Underlying2.hom1 g))
  underlying2_val h'

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.coherence_yoneda_associator
statement:
theorem coherence_yoneda_associator {a b c d e : B} (u : e ⟶ a) (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c)
    (h : c ⟶ d) :
    (associator (u ≫ f) g h).hom ≫ (associator u f (g ≫ h)).hom ≫ u ◁ (associator f g h).inv =
      (associator u f g).hom ▷ h ≫ (associator u (f ≫ g) h).hom
proof:
:= by
  have hU : ∀ {a b c d e : Underlying2 R B} (u : e ⟶ a) (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) (h : c ⟶ d),
      (Bicategory.associator (u ≫ f) g h).hom ≫ (Bicategory.associator u f (g ≫ h)).hom ≫
          Bicategory.whiskerLeft u (Bicategory.associator f g h).inv =
        Bicategory.whiskerRight (Bicategory.associator u f g).hom h ≫
          (Bicategory.associator u (f ≫ g) h).hom := by
    intros; bicategory
  have h' := congrArg Subtype.val (hU (Underlying2.hom1 u) (Underlying2.hom1 f)
    (Underlying2.hom1 g) (Underlying2.hom1 h))
  underlying2_val h'

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.coherence_yoneda_leftUnitor
statement:
theorem coherence_yoneda_leftUnitor {a b e : B} (u : e ⟶ a) (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (rightUnitor u).inv ▷ f ≫ (associator u (𝟙 a) f).hom ≫ u ◁ (leftUnitor f).hom = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  have hU : ∀ {a b e : Underlying2 R B} (u : e ⟶ a) (f : a ⟶ b),
      Bicategory.whiskerRight (Bicategory.rightUnitor u).inv f ≫
          (Bicategory.associator u (𝟙 a) f).hom ≫
            Bicategory.whiskerLeft u (Bicategory.leftUnitor f).hom = 𝟙 _ := by
    intros; bicategory
  have h' := congrArg Subtype.val (hU (Underlying2.hom1 u) (Underlying2.hom1 f))
  underlying2_val h'

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.coherence_yoneda_rightUnitor
statement:
theorem coherence_yoneda_rightUnitor {a b e : B} (u : e ⟶ a) (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (rightUnitor (u ≫ f)).inv ≫ (associator u f (𝟙 b)).hom ≫ u ◁ (rightUnitor f).hom =
      𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  have hU : ∀ {a b e : Underlying2 R B} (u : e ⟶ a) (f : a ⟶ b),
      (Bicategory.rightUnitor (u ≫ f)).inv ≫ (Bicategory.associator u f (𝟙 b)).hom ≫
          Bicategory.whiskerLeft u (Bicategory.rightUnitor f).hom = 𝟙 _ := by
    intros; bicategory
  have h' := congrArg Subtype.val (hU (Underlying2.hom1 u) (Underlying2.hom1 f))
  underlying2_val h'

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.coherence_rightUnitor_comp
statement:
theorem coherence_rightUnitor_comp {a b c : B} (h : c ⟶ b) (u : b ⟶ a) :
    (associator h u (𝟙 a)).hom ≫ h ◁ (rightUnitor u).hom = (rightUnitor (h ≫ u)).hom

name: StringDiagrams.TwoStrictification.Hom1.ext_of_heq
statement:
theorem ext_of_heq {F G : Hom1 a b} (h : F.F = G.F)
    (hγ : ∀ {c d : B} (k : d ⟶ c) (u : c ⟶ a.as), HEq (F.γ k u).hom (G.γ k u).hom) : F = G
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨F, γ, _, _, _, _⟩ := F
  obtain ⟨G, γ', _, _, _, _⟩ := G
  obtain rfl : F = G := h
  have : @γ = @γ' := by
    funext c d k u
    exact Iso.ext (eq_of_heq (hγ k u))
  subst this
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.TwoStrictification.Hom1.id_mem_homSubmodule
statement: theorem id_mem_homSubmodule (F : Hom1 a b) : (fun c => 𝟙 (F.sf c)) ∈ homSubmodule F F
proof:
:= by
  intro p c d h u
  rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one p with rfl | rfl
  · simp [TwoSupercategory.whiskerLeft_id (R := R)]
  · simp [TwoSupercategory.whiskerLeft_zero R]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoStrictification.Hom1.comp_mem_homSubmodule
proof:
:= by
  intro r c d h u
  simp only [Superfunctor.comp_app, Preadditive.comp_add, Preadditive.add_comp,
    TwoSupercategory.whiskerLeft_add (R := R), TwoSupercategory.whiskerLeft_comp (R := R),
    Category.assoc]
  rw [reassoc_of% (hθ 0 h u), reassoc_of% (hθ 1 h u), hθ' r h u, hθ' (r + 1) h u]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoStrictification.Hom1.proj_mem_homSubmodule
statement:
theorem proj_mem_homSubmodule {F G : Hom1 a b} (p : ZMod 2) {θ : ∀ c, F.sf c ⟶ G.sf c}
    (hθ : θ ∈ homSubmodule F G) : (fun c => proj R p (θ c)) ∈ homSubmodule F G
proof:
:= by
  intro q c d h u
  simp only [Superfunctor.proj_app]
  split_ifs with hq
  · subst hq; exact hθ q h u
  · simp [TwoSupercategory.whiskerLeft_zero R]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoStrictification.Hom1.hom2_ext
statement: theorem hom2_ext {F G : Hom1 a b} {θ θ' : F ⟶ G} (h : ∀ c, θ.1 c = θ'.1 c) : θ = θ'

name: StringDiagrams.TwoStrictification.Hom1.id2_val
statement: @[simp] theorem id2_val (F : Hom1 a b) (c : B) : (𝟙 F : F ⟶ F).1 c = 𝟙 (F.sf c)

name: StringDiagrams.TwoStrictification.Hom1.comp2_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem comp2_val {F G H : Hom1 a b} (θ : F ⟶ G) (θ' : G ⟶ H) (c : B) :
    (θ ≫ θ').1 c = θ.1 c ≫ θ'.1 c

name: StringDiagrams.TwoStrictification.Hom1.hom2_compat
statement:
theorem hom2_compat {F G : Hom1 a b} (θ : F ⟶ G) (p : ZMod 2) {c d : B} (h : d ⟶ c)
    (u : c ⟶ a.as) :
    (F.γ h u).hom ≫ (θ.1 d).app p (h ≫ u) = h ◁ (θ.1 c).app p u ≫ (G.γ h u).hom

name: StringDiagrams.TwoStrictification.Hom1.add2_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem add2_val {F G : Hom1 a b} (θ θ' : F ⟶ G) (c : B) :
    (θ + θ').1 c = θ.1 c + θ'.1 c

name: StringDiagrams.TwoStrictification.Hom1.zero2_val
statement: @[simp] theorem zero2_val {F G : Hom1 a b} (c : B) : (0 : F ⟶ G).1 c = 0

name: StringDiagrams.TwoStrictification.Hom1.smul2_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem smul2_val {F G : Hom1 a b} (r : R) (θ : F ⟶ G) (c : B) :
    (r • θ).1 c = r • θ.1 c

name: StringDiagrams.TwoStrictification.Hom1.zsmul2_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem zsmul2_val {F G : Hom1 a b} (n : ℤ) (θ : F ⟶ G) (c : B) :
    (n • θ).1 c = n • θ.1 c

name: StringDiagrams.TwoStrictification.Hom1.mem_parity_iff
statement:
theorem mem_parity_iff {F G : Hom1 a b} {p : ZMod 2} {θ : F ⟶ G} :
    θ ∈ parity (R := R) F G p ↔ ∀ c, θ.1 c ∈ parity (R := R) (F.sf c) (G.sf c) p

name: StringDiagrams.TwoStrictification.comp1_assoc
statement:
theorem comp1_assoc {a b c d : TwoStrictification R B} (F : Hom1 a b) (G : Hom1 b c)
    (H : Hom1 c d) : comp1 (comp1 F G) H = comp1 F (comp1 G H)
proof:
:=
  Hom1.ext_of_heq rfl fun k u => heq_of_eq (by simp; rfl)

name: StringDiagrams.TwoStrictification.id1_comp
statement: theorem id1_comp {a b : TwoStrictification R B} (F : Hom1 a b) : comp1 (id1 a) F = F
proof:
:=
  Hom1.ext_of_heq rfl fun k u => heq_of_eq (by
    simp; erw [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id, Category.comp_id]; rfl)

name: StringDiagrams.TwoStrictification.comp1_id
statement: theorem comp1_id {a b : TwoStrictification R B} (F : Hom1 a b) : comp1 F (id1 b) = F
proof:
:=
  Hom1.ext_of_heq rfl fun k u => heq_of_eq (by simp; erw [Category.id_comp]; rfl)

name: StringDiagrams.TwoStrictification.comp2_val'
statement:
@[simp] theorem comp2_val' {F G H : a ⟶ b} (θ : F ⟶ G) (θ' : G ⟶ H) (e : B) :
    (θ ≫ θ').1 e = θ.1 e ≫ θ'.1 e

name: StringDiagrams.TwoStrictification.id2_val'
statement: @[simp] theorem id2_val' (F : a ⟶ b) (e : B) : (𝟙 F : F ⟶ F).1 e = 𝟙 (Hom1.sf F e)

name: StringDiagrams.TwoStrictification.comp_F
statement:
@[simp] theorem comp_F (F : a ⟶ b) (G : b ⟶ c) (e : B) :
    Hom1.F (F ≫ G) e = Hom1.F F e ⋙ Hom1.F G e

name: StringDiagrams.TwoStrictification.id_F
statement: @[simp] theorem id_F (e : B) : Hom1.F (𝟙 a) e = 𝟭 _

name: StringDiagrams.TwoStrictification.comp_γ_hom
statement:
@[simp] theorem comp_γ_hom (F : a ⟶ b) (G : b ⟶ c) {d e : B} (h : e ⟶ d) (u : d ⟶ a.as) :
    (Hom1.γ (F ≫ G) h u).hom =
      (Hom1.γ G h ((Hom1.F F d).obj u)).hom ≫ (Hom1.F G e).map (Hom1.γ F h u).hom

name: StringDiagrams.TwoStrictification.id_γ_hom
statement:
@[simp] theorem id_γ_hom {d e : B} (h : e ⟶ d) (u : d ⟶ a.as) :
    (Hom1.γ (𝟙 a) h u).hom = 𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.TwoStrictification.whiskerLeft_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem whiskerLeft_val (F : a ⟶ b) {G H : b ⟶ c} (η : G ⟶ H) (e : B) :
    (F ◁ η).1 e = Superfunctor.whiskerLeft (Hom1.sf F e) (η.1 e)

name: StringDiagrams.TwoStrictification.whiskerRight_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem whiskerRight_val {F G : a ⟶ b} (η : F ⟶ G) (H : b ⟶ c) (e : B) :
    (η ▷ H).1 e = Superfunctor.whiskerRight (η.1 e) (Hom1.sf H e)

name: StringDiagrams.TwoStrictification.eqToHom_val
statement:
theorem eqToHom_val {F G : Hom1 a b} (h : F = G) (e : B) :
    (eqToHom h).1 e = eqToHom (congrArg (fun F => Hom1.sf F e) h)

name: StringDiagrams.TwoStrictification.associator_hom_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem associator_hom_val {d : TwoStrictification R B} (F : a ⟶ b) (G : b ⟶ c)
    (H : c ⟶ d) (e : B) : (BicategoryStruct.associator F G H).hom.1 e = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  change (eqToHom (comp1_assoc F G H)).1 e = _
  rw [eqToHom_val]; rfl

name: StringDiagrams.TwoStrictification.associator_inv_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem associator_inv_val {d : TwoStrictification R B} (F : a ⟶ b) (G : b ⟶ c)
    (H : c ⟶ d) (e : B) : (BicategoryStruct.associator F G H).inv.1 e = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  change (eqToHom (comp1_assoc F G H).symm).1 e = _
  rw [eqToHom_val]; rfl

name: StringDiagrams.TwoStrictification.leftUnitor_hom_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem leftUnitor_hom_val (F : a ⟶ b) (e : B) :
    (BicategoryStruct.leftUnitor F).hom.1 e = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  change (eqToHom (id1_comp F)).1 e = _
  rw [eqToHom_val]; rfl

name: StringDiagrams.TwoStrictification.leftUnitor_inv_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem leftUnitor_inv_val (F : a ⟶ b) (e : B) :
    (BicategoryStruct.leftUnitor F).inv.1 e = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  change (eqToHom (id1_comp F).symm).1 e = _
  rw [eqToHom_val]; rfl

name: StringDiagrams.TwoStrictification.rightUnitor_hom_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem rightUnitor_hom_val (F : a ⟶ b) (e : B) :
    (BicategoryStruct.rightUnitor F).hom.1 e = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  change (eqToHom (comp1_id F)).1 e = _
  rw [eqToHom_val]; rfl

name: StringDiagrams.TwoStrictification.rightUnitor_inv_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem rightUnitor_inv_val (F : a ⟶ b) (e : B) :
    (BicategoryStruct.rightUnitor F).inv.1 e = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  change (eqToHom (comp1_id F).symm).1 e = _
  rw [eqToHom_val]; rfl

name: StringDiagrams.TwoStrictification.hom2_ext'
proof:
:=
  Hom1.hom2_ext fun e => Superfunctor.hom_ext fun p u => h e p u

name: StringDiagrams.TwoStrictification.homMk2_val_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem homMk2_val_app (c : B) (p : ZMod 2) (u : c ⟶ a.as) :
    ((homMk2 x mem nat compat).1 c).app p u = if p = 0 then x c u else 0

name: StringDiagrams.TwoStrictification.homMk2_mem
statement: theorem homMk2_mem : homMk2 x mem nat compat ∈ parity (R := R) F G 0
proof:
:= fun c => by
  rw [Superfunctor.mem_parity_iff]
  funext u
  simp

name: StringDiagrams.TwoStrictification.isoMk2_hom_val_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem isoMk2_hom_val_app (c : B) (p : ZMod 2) (u : c ⟶ a.as) :
    (((isoMk2 e mem nat compat).hom).1 c).app p u = if p = 0 then (e c u).hom else 0

name: StringDiagrams.TwoStrictification.isoMk2_hom_mem
statement: theorem isoMk2_hom_mem : (isoMk2 e mem nat compat).hom ∈ parity (R := R) F G 0
proof:
:=
  homMk2_mem (fun c u => (e c u).hom) mem nat compat

name: StringDiagrams.TwoStrictification.proj_whiskerRight'
statement:
theorem proj_whiskerRight' (p : ZMod 2) {c a b : B} {u u' : c ⟶ a} (θ : u ⟶ u') (f : a ⟶ b) :
    proj R p (θ ▷ f) = proj R p θ ▷ f

name: StringDiagrams.TwoStrictification.proj_whiskerLeft'
statement:
theorem proj_whiskerLeft' (p : ZMod 2) {c a b : B} (u : c ⟶ a) {f f' : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ f') :
    proj R p (u ◁ η) = u ◁ proj R p η

name: StringDiagrams.TwoStrictification.yonedaMap₂_val_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem yonedaMap₂_val_app {a b : B} {f f' : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ f') (c : B) (p : ZMod 2)
    (u : c ⟶ a) : ((yonedaMap₂ (R := R) η).1 c).app p u = u ◁ proj R p η

name: StringDiagrams.TwoStrictification.yonedaMapComp_hom_val_app
statement:
theorem yonedaMapComp_hom_val_app {a b c : B} (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) (e : B) (p : ZMod 2)
    (u : e ⟶ a) :
    (((yonedaMapComp (R := R) f g).hom).1 e).app p u =
      if p = 0 then (associator u f g).hom else 0

name: StringDiagrams.TwoStrictification.yonedaMapId_hom_val_app
statement:
theorem yonedaMapId_hom_val_app (a e : B) (p : ZMod 2) (u : e ⟶ a) :
    (((yonedaMapId (R := R) a).hom).1 e).app p u =
      if p = 0 then (rightUnitor u).inv else 0

name: StringDiagrams.TwoStrictification.yoneda_obj
statement: @[simp] theorem yoneda_obj (a : B) : (yoneda R B).obj a = ⟨a⟩

name: StringDiagrams.TwoStrictification.yoneda_map
statement: @[simp] theorem yoneda_map {a b : B} (f : a ⟶ b) : (yoneda R B).map f = yonedaMap f

name: StringDiagrams.TwoStrictification.yoneda_map₂
statement:
@[simp] theorem yoneda_map₂ {a b : B} {f f' : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ f') :
    (yoneda R B).map₂ η = yonedaMap₂ η

name: StringDiagrams.TwoStrictification.yoneda_app_eq
statement:
theorem yoneda_app_eq (θ : (yonedaMap (R := R) f : (⟨a⟩ : TwoStrictification R B) ⟶ ⟨b⟩) ⟶
    yonedaMap f') (p : ZMod 2) {c : B} (u : c ⟶ a) :
    (θ.1 c).app p u =
      u ◁ ((leftUnitor f).inv ≫ (θ.1 a).app p (𝟙 a) ≫ (leftUnitor f').hom)
proof:
:= by
  have tri : ∀ g : a ⟶ b,
      u ◁ (leftUnitor g).hom = (associator u (𝟙 a) g).inv ≫ (rightUnitor u).hom ▷ g := by
    intro g
    rw [← TwoSupercategory.triangle (R := R), Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
  have hn : (rightUnitor u).hom ▷ f ≫ (θ.1 c).app p u =
      (θ.1 c).app p (u ≫ 𝟙 a) ≫ (rightUnitor u).hom ▷ f' := by
    have := (θ.1 c).naturality p (rightUnitor u).hom
      (TwoSupercategory.rightUnitor_hom_mem (R := R) u)
    rwa [koszulSign_zero_right, one_smul] at this
  have hc : (associator u (𝟙 a) f).inv ≫ (θ.1 c).app p (u ≫ 𝟙 a) =
      u ◁ (θ.1 a).app p (𝟙 a) ≫ (associator u (𝟙 a) f').inv := θ.2 p u (𝟙 a)
  have key : u ◁ (leftUnitor f).hom ≫ (θ.1 c).app p u =
      u ◁ (θ.1 a).app p (𝟙 a) ≫ u ◁ (leftUnitor f').hom := by
    rw [tri f, Category.assoc, hn, ← Category.assoc, hc, Category.assoc, ← tri f']
  rw [TwoSupercategory.whiskerLeft_comp (R := R), TwoSupercategory.whiskerLeft_comp (R := R),
    ← key, ← Category.assoc, TwoSupercategory.whiskerLeft_inv_hom (R := R), Category.id_comp]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoStrictification.proj_yonedaPreimage
statement:
theorem proj_yonedaPreimage
    (θ : (yonedaMap (R := R) f : (⟨a⟩ : TwoStrictification R B) ⟶ ⟨b⟩) ⟶ yonedaMap f')
    (p : ZMod 2) :
    proj R p (yonedaPreimage θ) =
      (leftUnitor f).inv ≫ (θ.1 a).app p (𝟙 a) ≫ (leftUnitor f').hom
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : ∀ q, (leftUnitor f).inv ≫ (θ.1 a).app q (𝟙 a) ≫ (leftUnitor f').hom ∈
      parity (R := R) f f' q := by
    intro q
    have := comp_mem (inv_mem _ (TwoSupercategory.leftUnitor_hom_mem (R := R) f))
      (comp_mem ((θ.1 a).app_mem q (𝟙 a)) (TwoSupercategory.leftUnitor_hom_mem (R := R) f'))
    simpa using this
  have e : yonedaPreimage θ = (leftUnitor f).inv ≫ (θ.1 a).app 0 (𝟙 a) ≫ (leftUnitor f').hom +
      (leftUnitor f).inv ≫ (θ.1 a).app 1 (𝟙 a) ≫ (leftUnitor f').hom := by
    simp [yonedaPreimage, Preadditive.add_comp, Preadditive.comp_add]
  rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one p with rfl | rfl
  · exact proj_eq_of_add e (hmem 0) (hmem 1)
  · rw [add_comm] at e
    exact proj_eq_of_add e (hmem 1) (hmem 0)

name: StringDiagrams.TwoStrictification.yonedaObjIso_hom_val_app
statement:
theorem yonedaObjIso_hom_val_app {a b : B} (F : Hom1 (⟨a⟩ : TwoStrictification R B) ⟨b⟩)
    (c : B) (p : ZMod 2) (u : c ⟶ a) :
    (((yonedaObjIso F).hom).1 c).app p u =
      if p = 0 then (Hom1.γ F u (𝟙 a)).hom ≫ (Hom1.F F c).map (rightUnitor u).hom else 0

name: StringDiagrams.TwoStrictification.yonedaObjIso_hom_mem
statement:
theorem yonedaObjIso_hom_mem {a b : B} (F : Hom1 (⟨a⟩ : TwoStrictification R B) ⟨b⟩) :
    (yonedaObjIso F).hom ∈ parity (R := R) _ _ 0
proof:
:= fun c => by
  rw [Superfunctor.mem_parity_iff]
  funext u
  rw [zero_add, yonedaObjIso_hom_val_app, ite_eq_right zmod2_one_ne_zero]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.TwoStrictification.yoneda_evenlyDense
statement: theorem yoneda_evenlyDense (a b : B) : EvenlyDense R ((yoneda R B).mapFunctor a b)
proof:
:=
  fun F => ⟨(Hom1.F F a).obj (𝟙 a), yonedaObjIso F, yonedaObjIso_hom_mem F⟩

name: StringDiagrams.TwoStrictification.yoneda_isLocalTwoSuperequivalence
statement:
theorem yoneda_isLocalTwoSuperequivalence : (yoneda R B).IsLocalTwoSuperequivalence where
  hom a b
proof:
:= ⟨yonedaSuperequivalence a b⟩
  essSurj c := ⟨c.as, TwoSupercategory.Superequivalent.refl (R := R) c⟩

name: StringDiagrams.TwoSupercategory.exists_strict_localTwoSuperequivalent
statement:
theorem exists_strict_localTwoSuperequivalent :
    ∃ (C : Type u₁) (_ : BicategoryStruct.{max u₁ v₁ w₁, max u₁ v₁ w₁} C)

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.precompose_counitNaturality_eq_comparison
statement:
private theorem precompose_counitNaturality_eq_comparison :
    TwoNatTrans.precompose (mapQPi F.1) (counitNaturality G) =
      comparison (B := B.toGTwoSCat) _ _
        ((mapQPi_isGraded F.2).comp ((mapQPi_isGraded G.2).comp (counit_isGraded D)))
        ((mapQPi_isGraded F.2).comp ((counit_isGraded C).comp G.2))
        (left_pre_restrict F G)
proof:
:= by
  unfold counitNaturality comparison
  have hX₁ (a : QPiTwoEnvelope R C) :
      (TwoNatTrans.transportSource
        (congrArg extend (counit_naturality_restrict G).symm)
        (extendRestrictNatTrans ((counit C).comp G.1) ((counit_isGraded C).comp G.2))).X a =
      𝟙 (G.1.obj a.as.as) :=
    eq_of_heq (TwoNatTrans.transportSource_X_heq _ _ a)
  have hX₂ (a : QPiTwoEnvelope R B) :
      (TwoNatTrans.transportSource
        (congrArg extend (left_pre_restrict F G).symm)
        (extendRestrictNatTrans ((mapQPi F.1).comp ((counit C).comp G.1))
          ((mapQPi_isGraded F.2).comp ((counit_isGraded C).comp G.2)))).X a =
      𝟙 (G.1.obj (F.1.obj a.as.as)) :=
    eq_of_heq (TwoNatTrans.transportSource_X_heq _ _ a)
  have hX (a : QPiTwoEnvelope R B) :
      (TwoNatTrans.transportSource
        (congrArg extend (counit_naturality_restrict G).symm)
        (extendRestrictNatTrans ((counit C).comp G.1) ((counit_isGraded C).comp G.2))).X
          ((mapQPi F.1).obj a) =
      (TwoNatTrans.transportSource
        (congrArg extend (left_pre_restrict F G).symm)
        (extendRestrictNatTrans ((mapQPi F.1).comp ((counit C).comp G.1))
          ((mapQPi_isGraded F.2).comp ((counit_isGraded C).comp G.2)))).X a := by
    rw [hX₁, hX₂]
    rfl
  have hx {a b : QPiTwoEnvelope R B} (f : a ⟶ b) :
      HEq ((TwoNatTrans.transportSource
        (congrArg extend (counit_naturality_restrict G).symm)
        (extendRestrictNatTrans ((counit C).comp G.1) ((counit_isGraded C).comp G.2))).x
          ((mapQPi F.1).map f))
      ((TwoNatTrans.transportSource
        (congrArg extend (left_pre_restrict F G).symm)
        (extendRestrictNatTrans ((mapQPi F.1).comp ((counit C).comp G.1))
          ((mapQPi_isGraded F.2).comp ((counit_isGraded C).comp G.2)))).x f) := by
    exact (TwoNatTrans.transportSource_x_heq
      (congrArg extend (counit_naturality_restrict G).symm)
      (extendRestrictNatTrans ((counit C).comp G.1) ((counit_isGraded C).comp G.2))
      ((mapQPi F.1).map f)).trans
      ((heq_of_eq (extendRestrictX_precompose F.1 F.2
        ((counit C).comp G.1) ((counit_isGraded C).comp G.2) f).symm).trans
        (TwoNatTrans.transportSource_x_heq
          (congrArg extend (left_pre_restrict F G).symm)
          (extendRestrictNatTrans ((mapQPi F.1).comp ((counit C).comp G.1))
            ((mapQPi_isGraded F.2).comp ((counit_isGraded C).comp G.2))) f).symm)
  apply TwoEnvelope.twoNatTrans_ext
  · funext a
    simp only [TwoNatTrans.precompose_X, TwoNatTrans.vcomp_X, hX₁, hX₂]
    rfl
  · intro a b f
    have hi := (extendRestrictInvX_precompose F.1 F.2
      ((mapQPi G.1).comp (counit D))
      ((mapQPi_isGraded G.2).comp (counit_isGraded D)) f).symm
    simp only [TwoNatTrans.precompose_x, TwoNatTrans.vcomp_x]
    exact densityPasteCell_heq hi (hX a) (hX b) (hx f)

name: StringDiagrams.IsVNRegular.idem_left

proof:

name: StringDiagrams.LinearMap.exists_comp_comp_eq_self
statement:
theorem LinearMap.exists_comp_comp_eq_self {k : Type w} [Field k] {V W : Type*} [AddCommGroup V]
    [Module k V] [AddCommGroup W] [Module k W] (φ : V →ₗ[k] W) :
    ∃ ψ : W →ₗ[k] V, φ ∘ₗ ψ ∘ₗ φ = φ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := LinearMap.exists_rightInverse_of_surjective φ.rangeRestrict
    (LinearMap.range_rangeRestrict φ)
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := LinearMap.exists_leftInverse_of_injective (LinearMap.range φ).subtype
    (Submodule.ker_subtype _)
  refine ⟨s ∘ₗ r, ?_⟩
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro v
  have h1 : ∀ x : LinearMap.range φ, φ (s x) = x := fun x =>
    congrArg Subtype.val (congrArg (fun F => F x) hs)
  have h2 : ∀ x : LinearMap.range φ, r (x : W) = x := fun x => congrArg (fun F => F x) hr
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply]
  rw [h1]
  change ((r ((φ.rangeRestrict v : LinearMap.range φ) : W)) : W) =
    ((φ.rangeRestrict v : LinearMap.range φ) : W)
  rw [h2]

name: StringDiagrams.OrthogonalSchurGenerators.comp_apply_eq
statement:
theorem comp_apply_eq {X Y : 𝒞} (φ : ∀ i, (S i ⟶ X) →ₗ[k] (S i ⟶ Y)) {i j : ι}
    (u : S i ⟶ S j) (v : S j ⟶ X) : u ≫ φ j v = φ i (u ≫ v)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst hij
    obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := hS.schur i u
    rw [Linear.smul_comp, Category.id_comp, Linear.smul_comp, Category.id_comp, map_smul]
  · rw [hS.hom_eq_zero hij u, zero_comp, zero_comp, map_zero]

name: StringDiagrams.OrthogonalSchurGenerators.hom_ext_bsum
statement:
theorem hom_ext_bsum {Y : 𝒞} (L : List 𝒞) (hL : ∀ P ∈ L, ∃ i, P = S i) {f f' : bsum L ⟶ Y}
    (h : ∀ i (u : S i ⟶ bsum L), u ≫ f = u ≫ f') : f = f'
proof:
:= by
  induction L with
  | nil => exact (isZero_zero 𝒞).eq_of_src f f'
  | cons P L ih =>
    obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := hL P (by simp)
    apply biprod.hom_ext'
    · exact h j biprod.inl
    · exact ih (fun Q hQ => hL Q (by simp [hQ])) fun i u => by
        rw [← Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc]; exact h i (u ≫ biprod.inr)

name: StringDiagrams.OrthogonalSchurGenerators.hom_ext_of_gen
statement:
theorem hom_ext_of_gen {X Y : 𝒞} {f f' : X ⟶ Y}
    (h : ∀ i (u : S i ⟶ X), u ≫ f = u ≫ f') : f = f'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨L, hL, ⟨e⟩⟩ := hS.exists_iso_bsum X
  rw [← cancel_epi e.inv]
  exact hom_ext_bsum L hL fun i u => by
    rw [← Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc]; exact h i (u ≫ e.inv)

name: StringDiagrams.OrthogonalSchurGenerators.exists_hom_bsum
statement:
theorem exists_hom_bsum {Y : 𝒞} (L : List 𝒞) (hL : ∀ P ∈ L, ∃ i, P = S i)
    (φ : ∀ i, (S i ⟶ bsum L) →ₗ[k] (S i ⟶ Y)) :
    ∃ f : bsum L ⟶ Y, ∀ i (u : S i ⟶ bsum L), u ≫ f = φ i u
proof:
:= by
  induction L with
  | nil =>
    refine ⟨0, fun i u => ?_⟩
    rw [(isZero_zero 𝒞).eq_of_tgt u 0, zero_comp, map_zero]
  | cons P L ih =>
    obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := hL P (by simp)
    obtain ⟨f₂, hf₂⟩ := ih (fun Q hQ => hL Q (by simp [hQ]))
      (fun i => (φ i) ∘ₗ Linear.rightComp k (S i) biprod.inr)
    refine ⟨biprod.desc (φ j biprod.inl) f₂, fun i u => ?_⟩
    have hu : u ≫ biprod.fst ≫ biprod.inl + u ≫ biprod.snd ≫ biprod.inr = u := by
      rw [← Preadditive.comp_add, biprod.total]; exact Category.comp_id u
    have h1 : (u ≫ biprod.fst ≫ biprod.inl) ≫ biprod.desc (φ j biprod.inl) f₂ =
        φ i (u ≫ biprod.fst ≫ biprod.inl) := by
      rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc, biprod.inl_desc, ← Category.assoc, hS.comp_apply_eq φ,
        Category.assoc]
    have h2 : (u ≫ biprod.snd ≫ biprod.inr) ≫ biprod.desc (φ j biprod.inl) f₂ =
        φ i (u ≫ biprod.snd ≫ biprod.inr) := by
      rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc, biprod.inr_desc, ← Category.assoc, hf₂ i]
      change φ i ((u ≫ biprod.snd) ≫ biprod.inr) = _
      rw [Category.assoc]
    rw [← hu, map_add, Preadditive.add_comp, h1, h2]

name: StringDiagrams.OrthogonalSchurGenerators.exists_hom_of_gen
statement:
theorem exists_hom_of_gen {X Y : 𝒞} (φ : ∀ i, (S i ⟶ X) →ₗ[k] (S i ⟶ Y)) :
    ∃ f : X ⟶ Y, ∀ i (u : S i ⟶ X), u ≫ f = φ i u
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨L, hL, ⟨e⟩⟩ := hS.exists_iso_bsum X
  obtain ⟨f₀, hf₀⟩ := hS.exists_hom_bsum L hL fun i => (φ i) ∘ₗ Linear.rightComp k (S i) e.inv
  refine ⟨e.hom ≫ f₀, fun i u => ?_⟩
  rw [← Category.assoc, hf₀]
  change φ i ((u ≫ e.hom) ≫ e.inv) = φ i u
  rw [Category.assoc, e.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]

name: StringDiagrams.OrthogonalSchurGenerators.isVNRegular_of_gen
statement: theorem isVNRegular_of_gen {X Y : 𝒞} (f : X ⟶ Y) : IsVNRegular f
proof:
:= by
  choose ψ hψ using fun i => LinearMap.exists_comp_comp_eq_self (Linear.rightComp k (S i) f)
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := hS.exists_hom_of_gen ψ
  refine ⟨g, hS.hom_ext_of_gen fun i u => ?_⟩
  have h := congrArg (fun F => F u) (hψ i)
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, Linear.rightComp_apply] at h
  rw [← Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc, hg]
  exact h

name: StringDiagrams.OrthogonalSchurGenerators.simple
statement:
theorem simple (i : ι) : Simple (S i) where
  mono_isIso_iff_nonzero {Y} f _
proof:
:= by
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨g, -, hgf⟩ h0
      rw [h0, comp_zero] at hgf
      exact hS.id_ne_zero i hgf.symm
    · intro hf
      obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := hS.isVNRegular_of_gen f
      have hfg : f ≫ g = 𝟙 Y := IsVNRegular.comp_eq_id_of_mono hg
      obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hS.schur i (g ≫ f)
      have hidem : (g ≫ f) ≫ (g ≫ f) = g ≫ f := by
        rw [Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc f, hfg, Category.id_comp]
      rw [hc, Linear.smul_comp, Linear.comp_smul, Category.id_comp, smul_smul] at hidem
      have hcc : c * c = c := by
        by_contra hne
        have : (c * c - c) • 𝟙 (S i) = 0 := by rw [sub_smul, hidem, sub_self]
        exact hS.id_ne_zero i ((smul_eq_zero.mp this).resolve_left (sub_ne_zero.mpr hne))
      have hc1 : c = 1 := by
        have : c * (c - 1) = 0 := by rw [mul_sub, hcc, mul_one, sub_self]
        rcases mul_eq_zero.mp this with h0 | h1
        · exfalso
          apply hf
          rw [← hg, hc, h0, zero_smul, comp_zero]
        · exact sub_eq_zero.mp h1
      exact ⟨g, hfg, by rw [hc, hc1, one_smul]⟩

name: StringDiagrams.OrthogonalSchurGenerators.exists_iso_bsum_simple
statement:
theorem exists_iso_bsum_simple (X : 𝒞) :
    ∃ L : List 𝒞, (∀ P ∈ L, Simple P) ∧ Nonempty (X ≅ bsum L)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨L, hL, e⟩ := hS.exists_iso_bsum X
  refine ⟨L, fun P hP => ?_, e⟩
  obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hL P hP
  exact hS.simple i

name: StringDiagrams.OrthogonalSchurGenerators.exists_iso_of_simple
statement: theorem exists_iso_of_simple (X : 𝒞) [Simple X] : ∃ i, Nonempty (X ≅ S i)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨L, hL, ⟨e⟩⟩ := hS.exists_iso_bsum X
  cases L with
  | nil => exact absurd (IsZero.of_iso (isZero_zero 𝒞) e) (Simple.not_isZero X)
  | cons P L =>
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hL P (by simp)
    refine ⟨i, ?_⟩
    rcases (indecomposable_of_simple X).2 _ _ e with h | h
    · exfalso
      exact hS.id_ne_zero i (h.eq_of_src _ _)
    · exact ⟨e ≪≫ (isoBiprodZero h).symm⟩

name: StringDiagrams.OrthogonalSchurGenerators.isEmpty_iso_of_ne
statement: theorem isEmpty_iso_of_ne {i j : ι} (h : i ≠ j) : IsEmpty (S i ≅ S j)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun e => hS.id_ne_zero i (by rw [← e.hom_inv_id, hS.hom_eq_zero h e.hom, zero_comp])⟩

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.proj_comp_proj_add_one
statement: theorem proj_comp_proj_add_one (p : ZMod 2) : V.proj p ∘ₗ V.proj (p + 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one p with rfl | rfl
  · ext v; simp [proj_zero, proj_one, odd_apply_odd]
  · ext v; simp [proj_zero, proj_one, odd_apply_odd]

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.proj_comp_proj_of_ne
statement: theorem proj_comp_proj_of_ne {p q : ZMod 2} (h : p ≠ q) : V.proj p ∘ₗ V.proj q = 0
proof:
:= by
  have : q = p + 1 := by
    rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one p with rfl | rfl <;>
      rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one q with rfl | rfl <;> simp_all
  subst this; exact proj_comp_proj_add_one V p

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.proj_proj_apply
statement: theorem proj_proj_apply (p : ZMod 2) (v : V) : V.proj p (V.proj p v) = V.proj p v

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.proj_proj_apply_of_ne
statement:
theorem proj_proj_apply_of_ne {p q : ZMod 2} (h : p ≠ q) (v : V) :
    V.proj p (V.proj q v) = 0

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.proj_zero_proj_one
statement: @[simp] theorem proj_zero_proj_one (v : V) : V.proj 0 (V.proj 1 v) = 0

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.proj_one_proj_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem proj_one_proj_zero (v : V) : V.proj 1 (V.proj 0 v) = 0

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.proj_apply_add'
statement: theorem proj_apply_add' (q : ZMod 2) (v : V) : V.proj q v + V.proj (q + 1) v = v
proof:
:= by
  rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one q with rfl | rfl
  · exact proj_apply_add V v
  · rw [add_comm]; exact proj_apply_add V v

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.mem_part_iff
statement: theorem mem_part_iff {p : ZMod 2} {v : V} : v ∈ V.part p ↔ V.proj p v = v
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨w, rfl⟩; exact proj_proj_apply V p w
  · intro h; exact ⟨v, h⟩

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.proj_mem_part
statement: theorem proj_mem_part (p : ZMod 2) (v : V) : V.proj p v ∈ V.part p

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.proj_apply_of_mem_part
statement:
theorem proj_apply_of_mem_part {p q : ZMod 2} {v : V} (hv : v ∈ V.part q) :
    V.proj p v = if p = q then v else 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := hv
  split_ifs with h
  · subst h; exact proj_proj_apply V p w
  · exact proj_proj_apply_of_ne V h w

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.mem_part_zero_iff
statement: theorem mem_part_zero_iff {v : V} : v ∈ V.part 0 ↔ V.odd v = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_part_iff, proj_zero, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.id_apply, sub_eq_self]

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.mem_part_one_iff
statement: theorem mem_part_one_iff {v : V} : v ∈ V.part 1 ↔ V.odd v = v

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.isInternal_part
statement: theorem isInternal_part : DirectSum.IsInternal V.part
proof:
:= by
  rw [DirectSum.isInternal_submodule_iff_isCompl V.part (i := 0) (j := 1) (by decide)
    (by ext p; rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one p with rfl | rfl <;> simp)]
  constructor
  · rw [Submodule.disjoint_def]
    intro v h0 h1
    rw [mem_part_iff] at h0 h1
    rw [← h0, ← h1, proj_proj_apply_of_ne V (by decide)]
  · rw [codisjoint_iff, eq_top_iff]
    intro v _
    rw [← proj_apply_add V v]
    exact Submodule.add_mem_sup (proj_mem_part V 0 v) (proj_mem_part V 1 v)

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.ofProd_mem_part_zero
statement:
theorem ofProd_mem_part_zero {V₀ V₁ : Type u} [AddCommGroup V₀] [Module k V₀] [AddCommGroup V₁]
    [Module k V₁] (v : V₀) : ((v, 0) : ofProd (k := k) V₀ V₁) ∈ (ofProd (k := k) V₀ V₁).part 0

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.ofProd_mem_part_one
statement:
theorem ofProd_mem_part_one {V₀ V₁ : Type u} [AddCommGroup V₀] [Module k V₀] [AddCommGroup V₁]
    [Module k V₁] (v : V₁) : ((0, v) : ofProd (k := k) V₀ V₁) ∈ (ofProd (k := k) V₀ V₁).part 1

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.ofIsCompl_part_one
statement:
theorem ofIsCompl_part_one (M : Type u) [AddCommGroup M] [Module k M] (M₀ M₁ : Submodule k M)
    (h : IsCompl M₀ M₁) : (ofIsCompl M M₀ M₁ h).part 1 = M₁
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  rw [mem_part_one_iff]
  simp only [ofIsCompl, LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, Submodule.coe_subtype]
  constructor
  · intro hv; rw [← hv]; exact Submodule.coe_mem _
  · intro hv; rw [Submodule.projectionOnto_apply_left h.symm ⟨v, hv⟩]

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.ofIsCompl_part_zero
statement:
theorem ofIsCompl_part_zero (M : Type u) [AddCommGroup M] [Module k M] (M₀ M₁ : Submodule k M)
    (h : IsCompl M₀ M₁) : (ofIsCompl M M₀ M₁ h).part 0 = M₀
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  rw [mem_part_zero_iff]
  simp only [ofIsCompl, LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, Submodule.coe_subtype,
    ZeroMemClass.coe_eq_zero]
  exact Submodule.projectionOnto_apply_eq_zero_iff h.symm

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.toLinearMap_ofHom
statement: @[simp] theorem toLinearMap_ofHom {V W : SVec k} (f : V →ₗ[k] W) : toLinearMap (ofHom f) = f

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.ofHom_toLinearMap
statement: @[simp] theorem ofHom_toLinearMap {V W : SVec k} (f : V ⟶ W) : ofHom (toLinearMap f) = f

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.coe_toLinearMap
statement: @[simp] theorem coe_toLinearMap {V W : SVec k} (f : V ⟶ W) : ⇑(toLinearMap f) = ⇑f

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.ofHom_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem ofHom_apply {V W : SVec k} (f : V →ₗ[k] W) (v : V) : ofHom f v = f v

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.hom_ext
statement: @[ext] theorem hom_ext {V W : SVec k} {f g : V ⟶ W} (h : ∀ v, f v = g v) : f = g

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.id_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem id_apply (V : SVec k) (v : V) : (𝟙 V : V ⟶ V) v = v

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.comp_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem comp_apply {U V W : SVec k} (f : U ⟶ V) (g : V ⟶ W) (u : U) :
    (f ≫ g) u = g (f u)

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.toLinearMap_comp
statement:
theorem toLinearMap_comp {U V W : SVec k} (f : U ⟶ V) (g : V ⟶ W) :
    toLinearMap (f ≫ g) = toLinearMap g ∘ₗ toLinearMap f

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.toLinearMap_id
statement: @[simp] theorem toLinearMap_id (V : SVec k) : toLinearMap (𝟙 V) = LinearMap.id

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.add_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem add_apply {V W : SVec k} (f g : V ⟶ W) (v : V) : (f + g) v = f v + g v

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.sub_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem sub_apply {V W : SVec k} (f g : V ⟶ W) (v : V) : (f - g) v = f v - g v

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.neg_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem neg_apply {V W : SVec k} (f : V ⟶ W) (v : V) : (-f) v = -f v

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.zero_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem zero_apply {V W : SVec k} (v : V) : (0 : V ⟶ W) v = 0

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.smul_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem smul_apply {V W : SVec k} (r : k) (f : V ⟶ W) (v : V) : (r • f) v = r • f v

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.zsmul_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem zsmul_apply {V W : SVec k} (n : ℤ) (f : V ⟶ W) (v : V) : (n • f) v = n • f v

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.toLinearMap_add
statement:
@[simp] theorem toLinearMap_add {V W : SVec k} (f g : V ⟶ W) :
    toLinearMap (f + g) = toLinearMap f + toLinearMap g

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.toLinearMap_smul
statement:
@[simp] theorem toLinearMap_smul {V W : SVec k} (r : k) (f : V ⟶ W) :
    toLinearMap (r • f) = r • toLinearMap f

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.mem_parityHom_iff
statement:
theorem mem_parityHom_iff {V W : SVec k} {p : ZMod 2} {f : V ⟶ W} :
    f ∈ parityHom V W p ↔ ∀ q, toLinearMap f ∘ₗ V.proj q = W.proj (q + p) ∘ₗ toLinearMap f

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.apply_proj_of_mem
statement:
theorem apply_proj_of_mem {V W : SVec k} {p : ZMod 2} {f : V ⟶ W} (hf : f ∈ parityHom V W p)
    (q : ZMod 2) (v : V) : f (V.proj q v) = W.proj (q + p) (f v)

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.apply_mem_part
statement:
theorem apply_mem_part {V W : SVec k} {p q : ZMod 2} {f : V ⟶ W} (hf : f ∈ parityHom V W p)
    {v : V} (hv : v ∈ V.part q) : f v ∈ W.part (q + p)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_part_iff] at hv ⊢
  rw [← hv, apply_proj_of_mem hf, proj_proj_apply]

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.mem_parityHom_of_apply_mem
statement:
theorem mem_parityHom_of_apply_mem {V W : SVec k} {p : ZMod 2} {f : V ⟶ W}
    (h : ∀ q (v : V), v ∈ V.part q → f v ∈ W.part (q + p)) : f ∈ parityHom V W p
proof:
:= by
  intro q
  ext v
  simp only [LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, coe_toLinearMap]
  have hv := h q _ (proj_mem_part V q v)
  have hv' := h (q + 1) _ (proj_mem_part V (q + 1) v)
  have hne : q + p ≠ q + 1 + p := by
    rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one p with rfl | rfl <;>
      rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one q with rfl | rfl <;> decide
  conv_rhs => rw [← proj_apply_add' V q v]
  rw [map_add, map_add, (mem_part_iff _).1 hv, proj_apply_of_mem_part _ hv', ite_eq_right hne,
    add_zero]

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.homProj_apply
statement:
theorem homProj_apply (p : ZMod 2) {V W : SVec k} (f : V ⟶ W) (v : V) :
    homProj p f v = W.proj p (f (V.proj 0 v)) + W.proj (1 + p) (f (V.proj 1 v))

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.homProj_mem
statement: theorem homProj_mem (p : ZMod 2) {V W : SVec k} (f : V ⟶ W) : homProj p f ∈ parityHom V W p
proof:
:= by
  refine mem_parityHom_of_apply_mem fun q v hv => ?_
  rw [homProj_apply, proj_apply_of_mem_part _ hv, proj_apply_of_mem_part _ hv]
  rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one q with rfl | rfl
  · simpa using proj_mem_part W p (f v)
  · simpa using proj_mem_part W (1 + p) (f v)

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.homProj_add_homProj
statement: theorem homProj_add_homProj {V W : SVec k} (f : V ⟶ W) : homProj 0 f + homProj 1 f = f
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  simp only [add_apply, homProj_apply, show (1 : ZMod 2) + 0 = 1 from rfl,
    show (1 : ZMod 2) + 1 = 0 from rfl]
  conv_rhs => rw [← proj_apply_add V v, map_add, ← proj_apply_add W (f (V.proj 0 v)),
    ← proj_apply_add W (f (V.proj 1 v))]
  abel

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.homProj_of_mem
statement:
theorem homProj_of_mem {p : ZMod 2} {V W : SVec k} {f : V ⟶ W} (hf : f ∈ parityHom V W p) :
    homProj p f = f
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  rw [homProj_apply, apply_proj_of_mem hf, apply_proj_of_mem hf, zero_add, proj_proj_apply,
    proj_proj_apply, add_comm 1 p, proj_apply_add']

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.homProj_of_mem_ne
statement:
theorem homProj_of_mem_ne {p q : ZMod 2} (h : p ≠ q) {V W : SVec k} {f : V ⟶ W}
    (hf : f ∈ parityHom V W q) : homProj p f = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  rw [homProj_apply, apply_proj_of_mem hf, apply_proj_of_mem hf, zero_apply]
  rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one p with rfl | rfl <;>
    rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one q with rfl | rfl <;> simp_all

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.parity_eq
statement: theorem parity_eq (V W : SVec k) (p : ZMod 2) : parity (R := k) V W p = parityHom V W p

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.proj_eq_homProj
statement:
theorem proj_eq_homProj (p : ZMod 2) {V W : SVec k} (f : V ⟶ W) :
    Supercategory.proj k p f = homProj p f
proof:
:= by
  rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one p with rfl | rfl
  · exact proj_eq_of_add (homProj_add_homProj f).symm (homProj_mem 0 f) (homProj_mem 1 f)
  · exact proj_eq_of_add ((add_comm _ _).trans (homProj_add_homProj f)).symm
      (homProj_mem 1 f) (by simpa using! homProj_mem 0 f)

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.homProj_eq_of_add
statement:
theorem homProj_eq_of_add {p : ZMod 2} {V W : SVec k} {f g h : V ⟶ W} (e : f = g + h)
    (hg : g ∈ parityHom V W p) (hh : h ∈ parityHom V W (p + 1)) : homProj p f = g
proof:
:= by
  rw [← proj_eq_homProj]; exact proj_eq_of_add e hg hh

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.ext_part
statement:
theorem ext_part {V : SVec k} {M : Type u} [AddCommGroup M] [Module k M] {f g : V →ₗ[k] M}
    (h : ∀ q (v : V), v ∈ V.part q → f v = g v) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  rw [← proj_apply_add V v, map_add, map_add, h 0 _ (proj_mem_part V 0 v),
    h 1 _ (proj_mem_part V 1 v)]

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.sgn_apply
statement:
theorem sgn_apply (V : SVec k) (b : ZMod 2) (v : V) :
    V.sgn b v = V.proj 0 v + sign k b • V.proj 1 v

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.sgn_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem sgn_zero (V : SVec k) : V.sgn 0 = LinearMap.id

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.sgn_apply_of_mem
statement:
theorem sgn_apply_of_mem {V : SVec k} (b : ZMod 2) {q : ZMod 2} {v : V} (hv : v ∈ V.part q) :
    V.sgn b v = sign k (q * b) • v
proof:
:= by
  rw [sgn_apply, proj_apply_of_mem_part _ hv, proj_apply_of_mem_part _ hv]
  rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one q with rfl | rfl <;> simp

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.sgn_comp_sgn
statement: theorem sgn_comp_sgn (V : SVec k) (a b : ZMod 2) : V.sgn a ∘ₗ V.sgn b = V.sgn (a + b)
proof:
:= by
  refine ext_part fun q v hv => ?_
  rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, sgn_apply_of_mem _ hv, map_smul, sgn_apply_of_mem _ hv,
    sgn_apply_of_mem _ hv, smul_smul, ← sign_add, mul_add, add_comm]

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.sgn_sgn_apply
statement: theorem sgn_sgn_apply (V : SVec k) (b : ZMod 2) (v : V) : V.sgn b (V.sgn b v) = v
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LinearMap.comp_apply, sgn_comp_sgn, zmod2_add_self, sgn_zero, LinearMap.id_apply]

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.sgn_mem
statement: theorem sgn_mem (V : SVec k) (b : ZMod 2) : ofHom (V.sgn b) ∈ parityHom V V 0
proof:
:= by
  intro q
  refine ext_part fun r v hv => ?_
  simp only [add_zero, LinearMap.comp_apply, toLinearMap_ofHom, proj_apply_of_mem_part _ hv]
  split_ifs <;> simp [sgn_apply_of_mem _ hv, proj_apply_of_mem_part _ hv, *]

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.sgn_comp_of_mem
statement:
theorem sgn_comp_of_mem {V W : SVec k} {p : ZMod 2} {f : V ⟶ W} (hf : f ∈ parityHom V W p)
    (b : ZMod 2) : W.sgn b ∘ₗ toLinearMap f = sign k (p * b) • (toLinearMap f ∘ₗ V.sgn b)
proof:
:= by
  refine ext_part fun q v hv => ?_
  rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, sgn_apply_of_mem _ hv,
    coe_toLinearMap, map_smul, sgn_apply_of_mem _ (apply_mem_part hf hv), smul_smul, ← sign_add,
    add_mul, add_comm]

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.tensorObj_odd_tmul
statement:
theorem tensorObj_odd_tmul (V W : SVec k) (v : V) (w : W) :
    (tensorObj V W).odd (v ⊗ₜ w) = V.proj 1 v ⊗ₜ W.proj 0 w + V.proj 0 v ⊗ₜ W.proj 1 w

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.tensorObj_proj_tmul
statement:
@[simp] theorem tensorObj_proj_tmul (V W : SVec k) (q : ZMod 2) (v : V) (w : W) :
    (tensorObj V W).proj q (v ⊗ₜ w) =
      V.proj 0 v ⊗ₜ W.proj q w + V.proj 1 v ⊗ₜ W.proj (1 + q) w
proof:
:= by
  rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one q with rfl | rfl
  · rw [proj_zero, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.id_apply, tensorObj_odd_tmul, add_zero]
    have e : v ⊗ₜ[k] w = (V.proj 0 v + V.proj 1 v) ⊗ₜ (W.proj 0 w + W.proj 1 w) := by
      rw [proj_apply_add, proj_apply_add]
    rw [e]
    simp only [add_tmul, tmul_add]
    abel
  · rw [proj_one, tensorObj_odd_tmul, zmod2_one_add_one, add_comm]

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.tmul_mem_part
statement:
theorem tmul_mem_part {V W : SVec k} {p q : ZMod 2} {v : V} {w : W} (hv : v ∈ V.part p)
    (hw : w ∈ W.part q) : v ⊗ₜ[k] w ∈ (tensorObj V W).part (p + q)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_part_iff, tensorObj_proj_tmul, proj_apply_of_mem_part _ hv, proj_apply_of_mem_part _ hv,
    proj_apply_of_mem_part _ hw, proj_apply_of_mem_part _ hw]
  rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one p with rfl | rfl <;>
    rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one q with rfl | rfl <;> simp

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.ext_tensor
statement:
theorem ext_tensor {V W : SVec k} {M : Type u} [AddCommGroup M] [Module k M]
    {f g : V ⊗[k] W →ₗ[k] M}
    (h : ∀ p q (v : V) (w : W), v ∈ V.part p → w ∈ W.part q → f (v ⊗ₜ w) = g (v ⊗ₜ w)) :
    f = g
proof:
:= by
  apply TensorProduct.ext'
  intro v w
  rw [← proj_apply_add V v, ← proj_apply_add W w]
  simp only [add_tmul, tmul_add, map_add]
  rw [h _ _ _ _ (proj_mem_part V 0 v) (proj_mem_part W 0 w),
    h _ _ _ _ (proj_mem_part V 0 v) (proj_mem_part W 1 w),
    h _ _ _ _ (proj_mem_part V 1 v) (proj_mem_part W 0 w),
    h _ _ _ _ (proj_mem_part V 1 v) (proj_mem_part W 1 w)]

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.tensorObj_sgn
statement:
theorem tensorObj_sgn (V W : SVec k) (b : ZMod 2) :
    (tensorObj V W).sgn b = map (V.sgn b) (W.sgn b)
proof:
:= by
  refine ext_tensor fun p q v w hv hw => ?_
  rw [sgn_apply_of_mem _ (tmul_mem_part hv hw), map_tmul, sgn_apply_of_mem _ hv,
    sgn_apply_of_mem _ hw, smul_tmul_smul, ← sign_add, add_mul]

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.map_mem
statement:
theorem map_mem {V V' W W' : SVec k} {a b : ZMod 2} {f : V ⟶ V'} {g : W ⟶ W'}
    (hf : f ∈ parityHom V V' a) (hg : g ∈ parityHom W W' b) :
    (ofHom (map (toLinearMap f) (toLinearMap g)) : tensorObj V W ⟶ tensorObj V' W') ∈
      parityHom (tensorObj V W) (tensorObj V' W') (a + b)
proof:
:= by
  intro q
  refine ext_tensor fun p r v w hv hw => ?_
  have hfg : f v ⊗ₜ[k] g w ∈ (tensorObj V' W').part (p + a + (r + b)) :=
    tmul_mem_part (apply_mem_part hf hv) (apply_mem_part hg hw)
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, toLinearMap_ofHom]
  rw [proj_apply_of_mem_part _ (tmul_mem_part hv hw), map_tmul, coe_toLinearMap,
    coe_toLinearMap, proj_apply_of_mem_part _ hfg]
  split_ifs with h1 h2 h2
  · rw [map_tmul]; rfl
  · exact absurd (by rw [h1]; abel) h2
  · refine absurd (add_right_cancel (b := a + b) ?_) h1
    rw [h2]; abel
  · exact map_zero _

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.unit_proj_zero_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem unit_proj_zero_apply (r : k) : (unit : SVec k).proj 0 r = r

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.unit_proj_one_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem unit_proj_one_apply (r : k) : (unit : SVec k).proj 1 r = 0

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.unit_sgn
statement: theorem unit_sgn (b : ZMod 2) : (unit : SVec k).sgn b = LinearMap.id
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.ext fun r => by
    rw [sgn_apply, unit_proj_zero_apply, unit_proj_one_apply, smul_zero, add_zero]; rfl

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.whiskerRight_tmul
statement:
theorem whiskerRight_tmul {V V' : SVec k} (f : V ⟶ V') (W : SVec k) (v : V) (w : W) :
    whiskerRight f W (v ⊗ₜ w) = f v ⊗ₜ w

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.whiskerLeft_of_mem
statement:
theorem whiskerLeft_of_mem (V : SVec k) {W W' : SVec k} {b : ZMod 2} {g : W ⟶ W'}
    (hg : g ∈ parityHom W W' b) : whiskerLeft V g = ofHom (map (V.sgn b) (toLinearMap g))
proof:
:= by
  rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one b with rfl | rfl
  · rw [whiskerLeft, homProj_of_mem hg, homProj_of_mem_ne (by decide) hg, sgn_zero]
    simp [toLinearMap, ofHom]
  · rw [whiskerLeft, homProj_of_mem hg, homProj_of_mem_ne (by decide) hg]
    simp [toLinearMap, ofHom]

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.whiskerLeft_tmul
proof:
:= by
  rw [whiskerLeft_of_mem V hg, ofHom_apply, map_tmul, sgn_apply_of_mem _ hv, smul_tmul']
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.whiskerLeft_add
statement:
theorem whiskerLeft_add (V : SVec k) {W W' : SVec k} (g g' : W ⟶ W') :
    whiskerLeft V (g + g') = whiskerLeft V g + whiskerLeft V g'
proof:
:= by
  simp only [whiskerLeft, map_add, toLinearMap_add, map_add_right]
  ext x
  rw [add_apply, ofHom_apply, ofHom_apply, ofHom_apply]
  simp only [LinearMap.add_apply]
  abel

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.whiskerLeft_smul
statement:
theorem whiskerLeft_smul (V : SVec k) {W W' : SVec k} (r : k) (g : W ⟶ W') :
    whiskerLeft V (r • g) = r • whiskerLeft V g
proof:
:= by
  simp only [whiskerLeft, map_smul, toLinearMap_smul, map_smul_right]
  ext x
  rw [smul_apply, ofHom_apply, ofHom_apply]
  simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_add]

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.whiskerLeft_zero
statement: theorem whiskerLeft_zero (V : SVec k) {W W' : SVec k} : whiskerLeft V (0 : W ⟶ W') = 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa using whiskerLeft_smul V (0 : k) (0 : W ⟶ W')

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.whiskerLeft_mem
proof:
:= by
  rw [whiskerLeft_of_mem V hg]
  simpa using map_mem (sgn_mem V b) hg

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.whiskerRight_mem
statement:
theorem whiskerRight_mem {V V' : SVec k} {a : ZMod 2} {f : V ⟶ V'} (hf : f ∈ parityHom V V' a)
    (W : SVec k) : whiskerRight f W ∈ parityHom (tensorObj V W) (tensorObj V' W) a
proof:
:= by
  simpa using! map_mem hf (instSupercategory.id_mem W)

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.whiskerLeft_comp
statement:
theorem whiskerLeft_comp (V : SVec k) {W W' W'' : SVec k} (f : W ⟶ W') (g : W' ⟶ W'') :
    whiskerLeft V (f ≫ g) = whiskerLeft V f ≫ whiskerLeft V g
proof:
:= by
  refine Supercategory.induction_on (R := k) f ?_ ?_ ?_
  · simp only [Limits.zero_comp, whiskerLeft_zero]
  · intro a f hfa
    refine Supercategory.induction_on (R := k) g ?_ ?_ ?_
    · simp only [Limits.comp_zero, whiskerLeft_zero]
    · intro b g hgb
      rw [whiskerLeft_of_mem V (Supercategory.comp_mem hfa hgb), whiskerLeft_of_mem V hfa,
        whiskerLeft_of_mem V hgb, add_comm, ← sgn_comp_sgn]
      exact map_comp _ _ _ _
    · intro g g' hg hg'
      rw [Preadditive.comp_add, whiskerLeft_add, whiskerLeft_add, hg, hg', Preadditive.comp_add]
  · intro f f' hf hf'
    rw [Preadditive.add_comp, whiskerLeft_add, whiskerLeft_add, hf, hf', Preadditive.add_comp]

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.whiskerLeft_id
statement: theorem whiskerLeft_id (V W : SVec k) : whiskerLeft V (𝟙 W) = 𝟙 (tensorObj V W)
proof:
:= by
  rw [whiskerLeft_of_mem V (instSupercategory.id_mem W), sgn_zero]
  exact TensorProduct.map_id

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.whiskerRight_id
statement: theorem whiskerRight_id (V W : SVec k) : whiskerRight (𝟙 V) W = 𝟙 (tensorObj V W)

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.comp_whiskerRight
statement:
theorem comp_whiskerRight {U V W : SVec k} (f : U ⟶ V) (g : V ⟶ W) (X : SVec k) :
    whiskerRight (f ≫ g) X = whiskerRight f X ≫ whiskerRight g X

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.super_interchange
statement:
theorem super_interchange {V V' W W' : SVec k} {p q : ZMod 2} {f : V ⟶ V'} {g : W ⟶ W'}
    (hf : f ∈ parityHom V V' p) (hg : g ∈ parityHom W W' q) :
    whiskerRight f W ≫ whiskerLeft V' g =
      koszulSign p q • (whiskerLeft V g ≫ whiskerRight f W')
proof:
:= by
  rw [whiskerLeft_of_mem V' hg, whiskerLeft_of_mem V hg, koszulSign_smul (R := k)]
  change map _ _ ∘ₗ map _ _ = sign k (p * q) • (map _ _ ∘ₗ map _ _)
  rw [← map_comp, ← map_comp, sgn_comp_of_mem hf, LinearMap.id_comp, LinearMap.comp_id,
    map_smul_left]

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.tensorObj_def
statement: theorem tensorObj_def (V W : SVec k) : V ⊗ W = tensorObj V W

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.tensorUnit_def
statement: theorem tensorUnit_def : 𝟙_ (SVec k) = unit

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.whiskerLeft_def
statement: theorem whiskerLeft_def (V : SVec k) {W W' : SVec k} (g : W ⟶ W') : V ◁ g = whiskerLeft V g

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.whiskerRight_def
statement: theorem whiskerRight_def {V V' : SVec k} (f : V ⟶ V') (W : SVec k) : f ▷ W = whiskerRight f W

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.associator_hom_tmul
statement:
@[simp] theorem associator_hom_tmul (U V W : SVec k) (u : U) (v : V) (w : W) :
    (α_ U V W).hom ((u ⊗ₜ v) ⊗ₜ w) = u ⊗ₜ (v ⊗ₜ w)

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.associator_inv_tmul
statement:
@[simp] theorem associator_inv_tmul (U V W : SVec k) (u : U) (v : V) (w : W) :
    (α_ U V W).inv (u ⊗ₜ (v ⊗ₜ w)) = (u ⊗ₜ v) ⊗ₜ w

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.leftUnitor_hom_tmul
statement:
@[simp] theorem leftUnitor_hom_tmul (V : SVec k) (r : k) (v : V) :
    (λ_ V).hom (r ⊗ₜ v) = r • v
proof:
:= by
  change TensorProduct.lid k V (r ⊗ₜ v) = r • v; simp

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.rightUnitor_hom_tmul
statement:
@[simp] theorem rightUnitor_hom_tmul (V : SVec k) (r : k) (v : V) :
    (ρ_ V).hom (v ⊗ₜ r) = r • v
proof:
:= by
  change TensorProduct.rid k V (v ⊗ₜ r) = r • v; simp

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.whiskerRight_tmul'
statement:
@[simp] theorem whiskerRight_tmul' {V V' : SVec k} (f : V ⟶ V') (W : SVec k) (v : V) (w : W) :
    (f ▷ W) (v ⊗ₜ w) = f v ⊗ₜ w

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.whiskerLeft_tmul'
StringDiagrams.SVec.associator_mem
statement:
theorem associator_mem (U V W : SVec k) :
    (associator U V W).hom ∈ parityHom (tensorObj (tensorObj U V) W) (tensorObj U (tensorObj V W)) 0
proof:
:= by
  intro q
  apply TensorProduct.ext_threefold
  intro u v w
  simp only [add_zero, LinearMap.comp_apply, associator, isoOfLinearEquiv_hom, toLinearMap_ofHom,
    LinearEquiv.coe_coe, assoc_tmul]
  repeat rw [tensorObj_proj_tmul]
  simp only [add_tmul, tmul_add, map_add, assoc_tmul]
  rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one q with rfl | rfl
  · simp only [add_zero, zmod2_one_add_one]; abel
  · simp only [add_zero, zmod2_one_add_one, ← add_assoc]; abel

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.leftUnitor_mem
statement: theorem leftUnitor_mem (V : SVec k) : (leftUnitor V).hom ∈ parityHom (tensorObj unit V) V 0
proof:
:= by
  intro q
  apply TensorProduct.ext'
  intro r v
  change TensorProduct.lid k V ((tensorObj unit V).proj q (r ⊗ₜ v)) =
    V.proj (q + 0) (TensorProduct.lid k V (r ⊗ₜ v))
  rw [tensorObj_proj_tmul, unit_proj_zero_apply, unit_proj_one_apply, zero_tmul, add_zero,
    add_zero]
  simp

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.rightUnitor_mem
statement: theorem rightUnitor_mem (V : SVec k) : (rightUnitor V).hom ∈ parityHom (tensorObj V unit) V 0
proof:
:= by
  intro q
  apply TensorProduct.ext'
  intro v r
  change TensorProduct.rid k V ((tensorObj V unit).proj q (v ⊗ₜ r)) =
    V.proj (q + 0) (TensorProduct.rid k V (v ⊗ₜ r))
  rw [tensorObj_proj_tmul, add_zero]
  rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one q with rfl | rfl
  · rw [unit_proj_zero_apply, add_zero, unit_proj_one_apply, tmul_zero, add_zero]
    simp
  · rw [unit_proj_one_apply, zmod2_one_add_one, unit_proj_zero_apply, tmul_zero, zero_add]
    simp

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.whiskerLeft_even
statement:
theorem whiskerLeft_even (V : SVec k) {W W' : SVec k} {g : W ⟶ W'} (hg : g ∈ parityHom W W' 0) :
    whiskerLeft V g = ofHom (map LinearMap.id (toLinearMap g))

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.homProj_whiskerLeft
statement:
theorem homProj_whiskerLeft (p : ZMod 2) (V : SVec k) {W W' : SVec k} (g : W ⟶ W') :
    homProj p (whiskerLeft V g) = whiskerLeft V (homProj p g)
proof:
:= by
  have e : whiskerLeft V g = whiskerLeft V (homProj p g) + whiskerLeft V (homProj (p + 1) g) := by
    rw [← whiskerLeft_add]
    rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one p with rfl | rfl
    · rw [zero_add, homProj_add_homProj]
    · rw [zmod2_one_add_one, add_comm, homProj_add_homProj]
  exact homProj_eq_of_add e (whiskerLeft_mem V (homProj_mem p g))
    (whiskerLeft_mem V (homProj_mem (p + 1) g))

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.homProj_whiskerRight
statement:
theorem homProj_whiskerRight (p : ZMod 2) {V V' : SVec k} (f : V ⟶ V') (W : SVec k) :
    homProj p (whiskerRight f W) = whiskerRight (homProj p f) W
proof:
:= by
  have e : whiskerRight f W = whiskerRight (homProj p f) W + whiskerRight (homProj (p + 1) f) W := by
    have : f = homProj p f + homProj (p + 1) f := by
      rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one p with rfl | rfl
      · rw [zero_add, homProj_add_homProj]
      · rw [zmod2_one_add_one, add_comm, homProj_add_homProj]
    conv_lhs => rw [this]
    exact map_add_left _ _ _
  exact homProj_eq_of_add e (whiskerRight_mem (homProj_mem p f) W)
    (whiskerRight_mem (homProj_mem (p + 1) f) W)

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.associator_naturality_left
statement:
theorem associator_naturality_left {U U' : SVec k} (f : U ⟶ U') (V W : SVec k) :
    whiskerRight (whiskerRight f V) W ≫ (associator U' V W).hom =
      (associator U V W).hom ≫ whiskerRight f (tensorObj V W)

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.whiskerRight_add
statement:
theorem whiskerRight_add {V V' : SVec k} (f f' : V ⟶ V') (W : SVec k) :
    whiskerRight (f + f') W = whiskerRight f W + whiskerRight f' W

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.whiskerRight_zero
statement:
theorem whiskerRight_zero {V V' : SVec k} (W : SVec k) :
    whiskerRight (0 : V ⟶ V') W = 0

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.associator_naturality_middle
statement:
theorem associator_naturality_middle (U : SVec k) {V V' : SVec k} (g : V ⟶ V') (W : SVec k) :
    whiskerRight (whiskerLeft U g) W ≫ (associator U V' W).hom =
      (associator U V W).hom ≫ whiskerLeft U (whiskerRight g W)
proof:
:= by
  refine Supercategory.induction_on (R := k) g ?_ ?_ ?_
  · rw [whiskerLeft_zero, whiskerRight_zero, whiskerRight_zero, whiskerLeft_zero,
      Limits.zero_comp, Limits.comp_zero]
  · intro b g hg
    rw [whiskerLeft_of_mem U hg, whiskerLeft_of_mem U (whiskerRight_mem hg W)]
    exact TensorProduct.ext_threefold fun _ _ _ => rfl
  · intro g g' hg hg'
    rw [whiskerLeft_add, whiskerRight_add, Preadditive.add_comp, hg, hg', whiskerRight_add,
      whiskerLeft_add, Preadditive.comp_add]

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.associator_naturality_right
statement:
theorem associator_naturality_right (U V : SVec k) {W W' : SVec k} (h : W ⟶ W') :
    whiskerLeft (tensorObj U V) h ≫ (associator U V W').hom =
      (associator U V W).hom ≫ whiskerLeft U (whiskerLeft V h)
proof:
:= by
  refine Supercategory.induction_on (R := k) h ?_ ?_ ?_
  · rw [whiskerLeft_zero, whiskerLeft_zero, whiskerLeft_zero, Limits.zero_comp, Limits.comp_zero]
  · intro c h hh
    rw [whiskerLeft_of_mem _ hh, whiskerLeft_of_mem U (whiskerLeft_mem V hh),
      whiskerLeft_of_mem V hh, tensorObj_sgn]
    exact TensorProduct.ext_threefold fun _ _ _ => rfl
  · intro h h' hh hh'
    rw [whiskerLeft_add, Preadditive.add_comp, hh, hh', whiskerLeft_add, whiskerLeft_add,
      Preadditive.comp_add]

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.superTensorHom_tmul
proof:
:= by
  change (f ▷ W') ((V ◁ g) (v ⊗ₜ w)) = _
  rw [whiskerLeft_tmul' hg hv, map_smul, whiskerRight_tmul', mul_comm]

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.tensorHom_tmul
proof:
:= by
  change (V' ◁ g) ((f ▷ W) (v ⊗ₜ w)) = _
  rw [whiskerRight_tmul', whiskerLeft_tmul' hg (apply_mem_part hf hv)]

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.piObj_proj
statement: theorem piObj_proj (V : SVec k) (p : ZMod 2) : (piObj V).proj p = V.proj (p + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one p with rfl | rfl
  · rw [proj_zero, zero_add, proj_one]
    ext v; simp [piObj]
  · rw [proj_one, zmod2_one_add_one, proj_zero]; rfl

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.piObj_part
statement: theorem piObj_part (V : SVec k) (p : ZMod 2) : (piObj V).part p = V.part (p + 1)

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.ζIso_hom_mem
statement: theorem ζIso_hom_mem (V : SVec k) : (ζIso V).hom ∈ parityHom (piObj V) V 1

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.pi_obj
statement: theorem pi_obj (V : SVec k) : (PiSupercategory.pi (R := k)).obj V = piObj V

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.piHom_comp
statement:
@[simp] theorem piHom_comp {U V W : SVec k} (f : U ⟶ V) (g : V ⟶ W) :
    piHom (f ≫ g) = piHom f ≫ piHom g

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.piHom_id
statement: @[simp] theorem piHom_id (V : SVec k) : piHom (𝟙 V) = 𝟙 (piObj V)

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.piHom_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem piHom_apply {V W : SVec k} (f : V ⟶ W) (v : V) : piHom f v = f v

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.piHom_mem_iff
statement:
theorem piHom_mem_iff {V W : SVec k} {p : ZMod 2} {f : V ⟶ W} :
    piHom f ∈ parityHom (piObj V) (piObj W) p ↔ f ∈ parityHom V W p
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h q
    have := h (q + 1)
    rw [piObj_proj, piObj_proj] at this
    have e1 : q + 1 + 1 = q := by rw [add_assoc, zmod2_one_add_one, add_zero]
    have e2 : q + 1 + p + 1 = q + p := by rw [add_right_comm, e1]
    rw [e1, e2] at this
    exact this
  · intro h q
    rw [piObj_proj, piObj_proj, show q + p + 1 = q + 1 + p by rw [add_right_comm]]
    exact h (q + 1)

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.ζ_eq
statement: theorem ζ_eq (V : SVec k) : PiSupercategory.ζ (R := k) V = ζIso V

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.pi_map_of_mem
statement:
theorem pi_map_of_mem {V W : SVec k} {p : ZMod 2} {f : V ⟶ W} (hf : f ∈ parity (R := k) V W p) :
    toLinearMap ((PiSupercategory.pi (R := k)).map f) = sign k p • toLinearMap f
proof:
:= by
  change toLinearMap (twist k 1 f) = _
  rw [twist_of_mem 1 hf, one_mul]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.ξ_hom
statement:
theorem ξ_hom (V : SVec k) :
    toLinearMap (PiSupercategory.ξ (R := k) V).hom = -LinearMap.id

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.sub_odd_apply
statement: theorem sub_odd_apply (v : U) : ((sub V U hU).odd v : V) = V.odd v

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.sub_proj_apply
statement: theorem sub_proj_apply (q : ZMod 2) (v : U) : ((sub V U hU).proj q v : V) = V.proj q v
proof:
:= by
  rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one q with rfl | rfl
  · simp [proj_zero]
  · simp [proj_one]

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.mem_sub_part_iff
statement: theorem mem_sub_part_iff {q : ZMod 2} {v : U} : v ∈ (sub V U hU).part q ↔ (v : V) ∈ V.part q
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_part_iff, mem_part_iff, ← sub_proj_apply V U hU, Subtype.ext_iff]

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.restrictHom_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem restrictHom_apply (f : V ⟶ W) (hf : ∀ v ∈ U, f v ∈ U') (v : U) :
    (restrictHom (hU := hU) (hU' := hU') f hf v : W) = f v

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.restrictHom_mem
statement:
theorem restrictHom_mem {p : ZMod 2} {f : V ⟶ W} (hfp : f ∈ parityHom V W p)
    (hf : ∀ v ∈ U, f v ∈ U') : restrictHom (hU := hU) (hU' := hU') f hf ∈
      parityHom (sub V U hU) (sub W U' hU') p
proof:
:= by
  intro q
  ext v
  show f ((sub V U hU).proj q v : V) = ((sub W U' hU').proj (q + p) ⟨f v, hf v v.2⟩ : W)
  rw [sub_proj_apply, sub_proj_apply]
  exact apply_proj_of_mem hfp q v

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.partMap_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem partMap_apply {V W : SVec k} (f : V ⟶ W) (hf : f ∈ parityHom V W 0) (q : ZMod 2)
    (v : V.part q) : (partMap f hf q v : W) = f v

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.isoOfPartEquiv_hom_mem
statement:
theorem isoOfPartEquiv_hom_mem {V W : SVec k} (e₀ : V.part 0 ≃ₗ[k] W.part 0)
    (e₁ : V.part 1 ≃ₗ[k] W.part 1) : (isoOfPartEquiv e₀ e₁).hom ∈ parityHom V W 0
proof:
:= by
  refine mem_parityHom_of_apply_mem fun q v hv => ?_
  rw [add_zero]
  change ((e₀ (⟨V.proj 0 v, _⟩) : W) + e₁ ⟨V.proj 1 v, _⟩) ∈ W.part q
  rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one q with rfl | rfl
  · have : V.proj 1 v = 0 := by rw [proj_apply_of_mem_part _ hv]; rfl
    simp only [this]
    rw [show (⟨0, _⟩ : V.part 1) = 0 from rfl, map_zero, Submodule.coe_zero, add_zero]
    exact (e₀ _).2
  · have : V.proj 0 v = 0 := by rw [proj_apply_of_mem_part _ hv]; rfl
    simp only [this]
    rw [show (⟨0, _⟩ : V.part 0) = 0 from rfl, map_zero, Submodule.coe_zero, zero_add]
    exact (e₁ _).2

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.finrank_part_of_biprod
statement:
theorem finrank_part_of_biprod {V X Y : SVec K} (i₁ : X ⟶ V) (i₂ : Y ⟶ V) (p₁ : V ⟶ X)
    (p₂ : V ⟶ Y) (hi₁ : i₁ ∈ parityHom X V 0) (hi₂ : i₂ ∈ parityHom Y V 0)
    (hp₁ : p₁ ∈ parityHom V X 0) (hp₂ : p₂ ∈ parityHom V Y 0) (h₁ : i₁ ≫ p₁ = 𝟙 X)
    (h₂ : i₂ ≫ p₂ = 𝟙 Y) (h₁₂ : i₁ ≫ p₂ = 0) (h₂₁ : i₂ ≫ p₁ = 0)
    (htot : p₁ ≫ i₁ + p₂ ≫ i₂ = 𝟙 V) (q : ZMod 2) [Module.Finite K (X.part q)]
    [Module.Finite K (Y.part q)] :
    Module.finrank K (V.part q) = Module.finrank K (X.part q) + Module.finrank K (Y.part q)
proof:
:= by
  rw [(partEquivOfBiprod i₁ i₂ p₁ p₂ hi₁ hi₂ hp₁ hp₂ h₁ h₂ h₁₂ h₂₁ htot q).finrank_eq,
    Module.finrank_prod]

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.counitPaste_restrict_trans
statement:
theorem counitPaste_restrict_trans :
    (counitPasteLeft_restrict F G).trans (counitPasteRight_restrict F G) =
      counit_naturality_restrict (F ≫ G)

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.counitPasteComparisonsIso_hom_isHomogeneous
statement:
theorem counitPasteComparisonsIso_hom_isHomogeneous :
    (counitPasteComparisonsIso F G).hom.IsHomogeneous 0 0

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.counitNaturalityPasteIso_hom_isHomogeneous
statement:
theorem counitNaturalityPasteIso_hom_isHomogeneous :
    (counitNaturalityPasteIso F G).hom.IsHomogeneous 0 0
proof:
:= by
  intro a
  have hl := counitPasteLeftIso_hom_isHomogeneous F G a
  have hr := counitPasteRightIso_hom_isHomogeneous F G a
  have hc := counitPasteComparisonsIso_hom_isHomogeneous F G a
  constructor
  · simpa only [zero_add] using! comp_mem
      (whiskerRight_mem ((counitPasteRight F G).X a) hl.1)
      (comp_mem (whiskerLeft_mem ((counitPasteLeftComparison F G).X a) hr.1) hc.1)
  · simpa only [zero_add] using! comp_mem_degree
      (GradedTwoSupercategory.whiskerRight_mem_degree ((counitPasteRight F G).X a) hl.2)
      (comp_mem_degree
        (GradedTwoSupercategory.whiskerLeft_mem_degree ((counitPasteLeftComparison F G).X a) hr.2)
        hc.2)

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.counitNaturalityPasteIso_inv_isHomogeneous
statement:
theorem counitNaturalityPasteIso_inv_isHomogeneous :
    (counitNaturalityPasteIso F G).inv.IsHomogeneous 0 0

name: StringDiagrams.PiSOp.twoFunctor_comp_inverse_map₂
StringDiagrams.PiSOp.inverse_comp_twoFunctor_map₂
StringDiagrams.PiSOp.twoFunctor_comp_inverse_comparison
proof:
:= by
  change (sign R (f.par * g.par) • 𝟙 _) ≫
    reverseBridge.map (sign R (f.par * g.par) • 𝟙 (bridge.obj (f ≫ g))) = _
  rw [Functor.map_smul, reverseBridge.map_id]
  erw [Linear.smul_comp, Linear.comp_smul, Category.id_comp,
    smul_smul, sign_mul_self, one_smul]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.PiSOp.inverse_comp_twoFunctor_comparison
proof:
:= by
  change (sign R ((SOp.unop f).par * (SOp.unop g).par) • 𝟙 _) ≫
    bridge.map (sign R ((SOp.unop f).par * (SOp.unop g).par) •
      𝟙 (reverseBridge.obj (f ≫ g))) = _
  rw [Functor.map_smul, bridge.map_id]
  change (sign R ((SOp.unop f).par * (SOp.unop g).par) • 𝟙 (f ≫ g)) ≫
    (sign R ((SOp.unop f).par * (SOp.unop g).par) • 𝟙 (f ≫ g)) = _
  rw [Linear.smul_comp, Linear.comp_smul, Category.id_comp,
    smul_smul, sign_mul_self, one_smul]

name: StringDiagrams.PiSOp.twoFunctor_comp_inverse_identity
statement:
theorem twoFunctor_comp_inverse_identity (a : TwoEnvelope R (TwoSOp R B)) :
    (((twoFunctor (R := R) (B := B)).comp inverseTwoFunctor).mapId a).hom = 𝟙 (𝟙 a)
proof:
:= by
  change 𝟙 _ ≫ reverseBridge.map (𝟙 _) = _
  erw [reverseBridge.map_id, Category.id_comp]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.PiSOp.inverse_comp_twoFunctor_identity
statement:
theorem inverse_comp_twoFunctor_identity (a : TwoSOp R (TwoEnvelope R B)) :
    (((inverseTwoFunctor (R := R) (B := B)).comp twoFunctor).mapId a).hom = 𝟙 (𝟙 a)
proof:
:= by
  change 𝟙 _ ≫ bridge.map (𝟙 _) = _
  erw [bridge.map_id, Category.id_comp]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.PiSOp.twoFunctor_comp_inverseTwoFunctor
statement:
theorem twoFunctor_comp_inverseTwoFunctor :
    (twoFunctor (R := R) (B := B)).comp inverseTwoFunctor = TwoSuperfunctor.id R _
proof:
:= by
  unfold TwoSuperfunctor.comp
  congr 1
  · funext a b f g η
    exact twoFunctor_comp_inverse_map₂ η
  · funext a b c f g
    exact Iso.ext (twoFunctor_comp_inverse_comparison f g)
  · funext a
    exact Iso.ext (twoFunctor_comp_inverse_identity a)

name: StringDiagrams.PiSOp.inverseTwoFunctor_comp_twoFunctor
statement:
theorem inverseTwoFunctor_comp_twoFunctor :
    (inverseTwoFunctor (R := R) (B := B)).comp twoFunctor = TwoSuperfunctor.id R _
proof:
:= by
  unfold TwoSuperfunctor.comp
  congr 1
  · funext a b f g η
    exact inverse_comp_twoFunctor_map₂ η
  · funext a b c f g
    exact Iso.ext (inverse_comp_twoFunctor_comparison f g)
  · funext a
    exact Iso.ext (inverse_comp_twoFunctor_identity a)

name: StringDiagrams.SKarAlg.elem_comp
statement:
@[simp] theorem elem_comp {X Y Z : D 𝒜} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) :
    elem (f ≫ g) = elem g * elem f

name: StringDiagrams.SKarAlg.elem_id
statement: @[simp] theorem elem_id (X : D 𝒜) : elem (𝟙 X) = 1

name: StringDiagrams.SKarAlg.elem_add
statement: @[simp] theorem elem_add {X Y : D 𝒜} (f g : X ⟶ Y) : elem (f + g) = elem f + elem g

name: StringDiagrams.SKarAlg.elem_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem elem_zero {X Y : D 𝒜} : elem (0 : X ⟶ Y) = 0

name: StringDiagrams.SKarAlg.elem_sum
statement:
theorem elem_sum {X Y : D 𝒜} {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → (X ⟶ Y)) :
    elem (∑ i ∈ s, f i) = ∑ i ∈ s, elem (f i)
proof:
:=
  map_sum (elemHom 𝒜 X Y) f s

name: StringDiagrams.SKarAlg.elem_mem
statement: theorem elem_mem {X Y : D 𝒜} (f : X ⟶ Y) : elem f ∈ 𝒜 (par X + par Y)
proof:
:= by
  have hf := f.2
  rw [Envelope.mem_parity_iff, zero_add] at hf
  exact hf

name: StringDiagrams.SKarAlg.hom_ext
statement: theorem hom_ext {X Y : D 𝒜} {f g : X ⟶ Y} (h : elem f = elem g) : f = g

name: StringDiagrams.SKarAlg.elem_ofElem
statement:
@[simp] theorem elem_ofElem {X Y : D 𝒜} {r : A} (h : r ∈ 𝒜 (par X + par Y)) :
    elem (ofElem h) = r

name: StringDiagrams.SKarAlg.elem_eqToHom
statement: theorem elem_eqToHom {X Y : D 𝒜} (h : X = Y) : elem (eqToHom h) = 1

name: StringDiagrams.SKarAlg.aproj_mem
statement: theorem aproj_mem (p : ZMod 2) (r : A) : aproj 𝒜 p r ∈ 𝒜 p
proof:
:=
  proj_mem (R := k) p (C := SuperalgebraCat 𝒜) (X := SuperalgebraCat.star 𝒜)
    (Y := SuperalgebraCat.star 𝒜) r

name: StringDiagrams.SKarAlg.aproj_of_mem
statement: theorem aproj_of_mem {p : ZMod 2} {r : A} (h : r ∈ 𝒜 p) : aproj 𝒜 p r = r
proof:
:=
  proj_of_mem (R := k) (C := SuperalgebraCat 𝒜) (X := SuperalgebraCat.star 𝒜)
    (Y := SuperalgebraCat.star 𝒜) h

name: StringDiagrams.SKarAlg.aproj_of_mem_ne
statement: theorem aproj_of_mem_ne {p q : ZMod 2} {r : A} (h : r ∈ 𝒜 q) (hpq : q ≠ p) : aproj 𝒜 p r = 0
proof:
:=
  proj_of_mem_ne (R := k) (C := SuperalgebraCat 𝒜) (X := SuperalgebraCat.star 𝒜)
    (Y := SuperalgebraCat.star 𝒜) h hpq

name: StringDiagrams.SKarAlg.aproj_add_aproj
statement: theorem aproj_add_aproj (r : A) : aproj 𝒜 0 r + aproj 𝒜 1 r = r
proof:
:=
  proj_add_proj (R := k) (C := SuperalgebraCat 𝒜) (X := SuperalgebraCat.star 𝒜)
    (Y := SuperalgebraCat.star 𝒜) r

name: StringDiagrams.SKarAlg.aproj_aproj
statement: theorem aproj_aproj (p : ZMod 2) (r : A) : aproj 𝒜 p (aproj 𝒜 p r) = aproj 𝒜 p r

name: StringDiagrams.SKarAlg.aproj_aproj_of_ne
statement: theorem aproj_aproj_of_ne {p q : ZMod 2} (h : q ≠ p) (r : A) : aproj 𝒜 p (aproj 𝒜 q r) = 0

name: StringDiagrams.SKarAlg.aproj_add_aproj'
statement: theorem aproj_add_aproj' (q : ZMod 2) (r : A) : aproj 𝒜 q r + aproj 𝒜 (1 + q) r = r
proof:
:= by
  rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one q with rfl | rfl
  · exact aproj_add_aproj r
  · rw [add_comm, show (1 : ZMod 2) + 1 = 0 from rfl]; exact aproj_add_aproj r

name: StringDiagrams.SKarAlg.freeObj_proj_apply
statement:
theorem freeObj_proj_apply (M : Mat_ (D 𝒜)) (q : ZMod 2) (v : M.ι → A) (i : M.ι) :
    (freeObj 𝒜 M).proj q v i = aproj 𝒜 (q + par (M.X i)) (v i)
proof:
:= by
  rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one q with rfl | rfl
  · rw [SVec.proj_zero, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.id_apply, zero_add]
    change v i - aproj 𝒜 (1 + par (M.X i)) (v i) = _
    rw [sub_eq_iff_eq_add]
    exact (aproj_add_aproj' (par (M.X i)) (v i)).symm
  · rw [SVec.proj_one]; rfl

name: StringDiagrams.SKarAlg.mem_freeObj_part_iff
statement:
theorem mem_freeObj_part_iff (M : Mat_ (D 𝒜)) {q : ZMod 2} {v : M.ι → A} :
    v ∈ (freeObj 𝒜 M).part q ↔ ∀ i, v i ∈ 𝒜 (q + par (M.X i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [SVec.mem_part_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h i
    rw [← h, freeObj_proj_apply]; exact aproj_mem _ _
  · intro h
    funext i
    rw [freeObj_proj_apply, aproj_of_mem (h i)]

name: StringDiagrams.SKarAlg.rmul_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem rmul_apply (M : Mat_ (D 𝒜)) (a : A) (v : M.ι → A) (i : M.ι) :
    rmul M a v i = v i * a

name: StringDiagrams.SKarAlg.rmul_mem
statement:
theorem rmul_mem (M : Mat_ (D 𝒜)) {p : ZMod 2} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ 𝒜 p) :
    rmul M a ∈ SVec.parityHom (freeObj 𝒜 M) (freeObj 𝒜 M) p
proof:
:= by
  refine SVec.mem_parityHom_of_apply_mem fun q v hv => ?_
  rw [mem_freeObj_part_iff] at hv ⊢
  intro i
  rw [show q + p + par (M.X i) = q + par (M.X i) + p by abel]
  exact SetLike.GradedMul.mul_mem (hv i) ha

name: StringDiagrams.SKarAlg.matHom_apply
statement:
theorem matHom_apply {M N : Mat_ (D 𝒜)} (f : M ⟶ N) (v : M.ι → A) (j : N.ι) :
    matHom f v j = ∑ i, elem (f i j) * v i

name: StringDiagrams.SKarAlg.matHom_comp
statement:
theorem matHom_comp {M N P : Mat_ (D 𝒜)} (f : M ⟶ N) (g : N ⟶ P) :
    matHom (f ≫ g) = matHom f ≫ matHom g
proof:
:= by
  refine SVec.hom_ext fun v => funext fun l => ?_
  change ∑ i, elem ((f ≫ g) i l) * v i = ∑ j, elem (g j l) * ∑ i, elem (f i j) * v i
  simp only [CategoryTheory.Mat_.comp_apply, elem_sum, elem_comp, Finset.sum_mul,
    Finset.mul_sum, mul_assoc]
  exact Finset.sum_comm

name: StringDiagrams.SKarAlg.matHom_id
statement: theorem matHom_id (M : Mat_ (D 𝒜)) : matHom (𝟙 M) = 𝟙 (freeObj 𝒜 M)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine SVec.hom_ext fun v => funext fun j => ?_
  change ∑ i, elem ((𝟙 M : M ⟶ M) i j) * v i = v j
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single j]
  · rw [CategoryTheory.Mat_.id_apply_self, elem_id, one_mul]
  · intro i _ hij; rw [CategoryTheory.Mat_.id_apply_of_ne _ _ _ hij, elem_zero, zero_mul]
  · intro h; exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ _) h

name: StringDiagrams.SKarAlg.matHom_add
statement: theorem matHom_add {M N : Mat_ (D 𝒜)} (f g : M ⟶ N) : matHom (f + g) = matHom f + matHom g
proof:
:= by
  refine SVec.hom_ext fun v => funext fun j => ?_
  change ∑ i, elem ((f + g) i j) * v i = ∑ i, elem (f i j) * v i + ∑ i, elem (g i j) * v i
  simp [add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]

name: StringDiagrams.SKarAlg.matHom_mem
statement:
theorem matHom_mem {M N : Mat_ (D 𝒜)} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    matHom f ∈ SVec.parityHom (freeObj 𝒜 M) (freeObj 𝒜 N) 0
proof:
:= by
  refine SVec.mem_parityHom_of_apply_mem fun q v hv => ?_
  simp only [add_zero]
  rw [mem_freeObj_part_iff] at hv ⊢
  intro j
  refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun i _ => ?_
  have := SetLike.GradedMul.mul_mem (elem_mem (f i j)) (hv i)
  have key : ∀ a b q : ZMod 2, a + b + (q + a) = q + b := by decide
  rwa [key] at this

name: StringDiagrams.SKarAlg.matHom_rmul
statement:
theorem matHom_rmul {M N : Mat_ (D 𝒜)} (f : M ⟶ N) (a : A) (v : M.ι → A) :
    matHom f (rmul M a v) = rmul N a (matHom f v)
proof:
:= by
  funext j
  change ∑ i, elem (f i j) * (v i * a) = (∑ i, elem (f i j) * v i) * a
  rw [Finset.sum_mul]
  simp only [mul_assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.SKarAlg.matHom_injective
statement: theorem matHom_injective {M N : Mat_ (D 𝒜)} {f g : M ⟶ N} (h : matHom f = matHom g) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine CategoryTheory.Mat_.hom_ext _ _ fun i j => hom_ext ?_
  have := congrArg (fun φ : freeObj 𝒜 M ⟶ freeObj 𝒜 N => φ (Pi.single i 1) j) h
  change ∑ i', elem (f i' j) * (Pi.single i (1 : A) : M.ι → A) i' =
    ∑ i', elem (g i' j) * (Pi.single i (1 : A) : M.ι → A) i' at this
  simpa [Pi.single_apply] using this

name: StringDiagrams.SKarAlg.matHom_odd
statement:
theorem matHom_odd {M N : Mat_ (D 𝒜)} (f : M ⟶ N) (v : M.ι → A) :
    matHom f ((freeObj 𝒜 M).odd v) = (freeObj 𝒜 N).odd (matHom f v)
proof:
:= by
  have h := SVec.apply_proj_of_mem (matHom_mem f) 1 v
  simp only [add_zero] at h
  rwa [SVec.proj_one, SVec.proj_one] at h

name: StringDiagrams.SKarAlg.mem_imgSubmodule
statement:
theorem mem_imgSubmodule {P : SKar k (SuperalgebraCat 𝒜)} {v : P.X.ι → A} :
    v ∈ imgSubmodule P ↔ matHom P.p v = v
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨w, rfl⟩
    change matHom P.p (matHom P.p w) = matHom P.p w
    rw [← SVec.comp_apply, ← matHom_comp, P.idem]
  · intro h; exact ⟨v, h⟩

name: StringDiagrams.SKarAlg.matHom_p_mem
statement:
theorem matHom_p_mem (P : SKar k (SuperalgebraCat 𝒜)) (v : P.X.ι → A) :
    matHom P.p v ∈ imgSubmodule P

name: StringDiagrams.SKarAlg.odd_mem_imgSubmodule
statement:
theorem odd_mem_imgSubmodule (P : SKar k (SuperalgebraCat 𝒜)) :
    ∀ v ∈ imgSubmodule P, (freeObj 𝒜 P.X).odd v ∈ imgSubmodule P
proof:
:= by
  intro v hv
  rw [mem_imgSubmodule] at hv ⊢
  rw [matHom_odd, hv]

name: StringDiagrams.SKarAlg.rmul_mem_imgSubmodule
statement:
theorem rmul_mem_imgSubmodule (P : SKar k (SuperalgebraCat 𝒜)) (a : A) :
    ∀ v ∈ imgSubmodule P, rmul P.X a v ∈ imgSubmodule P
proof:
:= by
  intro v hv
  rw [mem_imgSubmodule] at hv ⊢
  rw [matHom_rmul, hv]

name: StringDiagrams.SKarAlg.ractHom_apply
statement:
theorem ractHom_apply (P : SKar k (SuperalgebraCat 𝒜)) (a : A) (v : imgSubmodule P) (i : P.X.ι) :
    (ractHom P a v).1 i = v.1 i * a

name: StringDiagrams.SKarAlg.matHom_mem_imgSubmodule
statement:
theorem matHom_mem_imgSubmodule {P Q : SKar k (SuperalgebraCat 𝒜)} (f : P ⟶ Q) :
    ∀ v ∈ imgSubmodule P, matHom f.f v ∈ imgSubmodule Q
proof:
:= fun v _ => by
  rw [mem_imgSubmodule, ← SVec.comp_apply, ← matHom_comp, Idempotents.Karoubi.comp_p]

name: StringDiagrams.SKarAlg.isHom_matHom
statement:
theorem isHom_matHom {P Q : SKar k (SuperalgebraCat 𝒜)} (f : P ⟶ Q) :
    SuperBimodule.IsHom (toModObj P) (toModObj Q)
      (SVec.restrictHom (matHom f.f) (matHom_mem_imgSubmodule f))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun p r _ => ?_, fun b => ?_⟩
  · rw [twist_of_mem p (SVec.restrictHom_mem (matHom_mem f.f) (matHom_mem_imgSubmodule f)),
      mul_zero, sign_zero, one_smul]
    simp only [LinearMap.toSpanSingleton_apply, Linear.smul_comp, Linear.comp_smul,
      Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id]
  · exact SVec.hom_ext fun v => Subtype.ext (by
      change matHom f.f (rmul P.X b v.1) = rmul Q.X b (matHom f.f v.1)
      exact matHom_rmul f.f b v.1)

name: StringDiagrams.SKarAlg.toModHom_mem
statement:
theorem toModHom_mem {P Q : SKar k (SuperalgebraCat 𝒜)} (f : P ⟶ Q) :
    toModHom f ∈ parity (R := k) (toModObj P) (toModObj Q) 0

name: StringDiagrams.SKarAlg.toMod_map_apply
statement:
theorem toMod_map_apply {P Q : SKar k (SuperalgebraCat 𝒜)} (f : P ⟶ Q) (v : imgSubmodule P) :
    (((toMod 𝒜).map f).1.1 v).1 = matHom f.f v.1

name: StringDiagrams.SKarAlg.fullMap_add
statement: theorem fullMap_add (v w : P.X.ι → A) : fullMap g (v + w) = fullMap g v + fullMap g w
proof:
:= by
  have e : (⟨matHom P.p (v + w), matHom_p_mem P _⟩ : imgSubmodule P) =
      ⟨matHom P.p v, matHom_p_mem P _⟩ + ⟨matHom P.p w, matHom_p_mem P _⟩ :=
    Subtype.ext (map_add (SVec.toLinearMap (matHom P.p)) v w)
  simp only [fullMap]
  rw [e, map_add]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.SKarAlg.fullMap_zero
statement: theorem fullMap_zero : fullMap g 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  have e : (⟨matHom P.p 0, matHom_p_mem P 0⟩ : imgSubmodule P) = 0 :=
    Subtype.ext (map_zero (SVec.toLinearMap (matHom P.p)))
  simp only [fullMap]
  rw [e, map_zero]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.SKarAlg.fullMap_sum
statement:
theorem fullMap_sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (v : ι → P.X.ι → A) :
    fullMap g (∑ i ∈ s, v i) = ∑ i ∈ s, fullMap g (v i)
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp [fullMap_zero]
  | insert i s hi ih => rw [Finset.sum_insert hi, Finset.sum_insert hi, fullMap_add, ih]

name: StringDiagrams.SKarAlg.fullMap_rmul
statement:
theorem fullMap_rmul (a : A) (v : P.X.ι → A) :
    fullMap g (rmul P.X a v) = rmul Q.X a (fullMap g v)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun φ => (φ ⟨matHom P.p v, matHom_p_mem P v⟩).1) (g.1.2.2 a)
  change (g.1.1 ⟨rmul P.X a (matHom P.p v), _⟩).1 = rmul Q.X a (fullMap g v) at h
  rw [fullMap, ← h]
  congr 2
  exact Subtype.ext (matHom_rmul P.p a v)

name: StringDiagrams.SKarAlg.single_mem_part
statement:
theorem single_mem_part (i : P.X.ι) :
    (Pi.single i 1 : P.X.ι → A) ∈ (freeObj 𝒜 P.X).part (par (P.X.X i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_freeObj_part_iff]
  intro i'
  rw [Pi.single_apply]
  split_ifs with h
  · subst h; rw [zmod2_add_self]; exact SetLike.GradedOne.one_mem
  · exact Submodule.zero_mem _

name: StringDiagrams.SKarAlg.fullMap_single_mem
statement:
theorem fullMap_single_mem (i : P.X.ι) (j : Q.X.ι) :
    fullMap g (Pi.single i 1) j ∈ 𝒜 (par (P.X.X i) + par (Q.X.X j))
proof:
:= by
  have h2 := SVec.apply_mem_part (matHom_mem P.p) (single_mem_part i)
  simp only [add_zero] at h2
  have h3 : (⟨matHom P.p (Pi.single i 1), matHom_p_mem P _⟩ : imgSubmodule P) ∈
      (imgObj P).part (par (P.X.X i)) := (SVec.mem_sub_part_iff _ _ _).2 h2
  have h4 := SVec.apply_mem_part (SuperBimodule.mem_parity_iff.1 g.2) h3
  simp only [add_zero] at h4
  have h5 := (SVec.mem_sub_part_iff _ _ _).1 h4
  rw [mem_freeObj_part_iff] at h5
  exact h5 j

name: StringDiagrams.SKarAlg.matHom_fullMatrix
statement: theorem matHom_fullMatrix (v : P.X.ι → A) : matHom (fullMatrix g) v = fullMap g v
proof:
:= by
  have hv : v = ∑ i, rmul P.X (v i) (Pi.single i 1) := by
    funext i'
    rw [Finset.sum_apply]
    change v i' = ∑ c, (Pi.single c (1 : A) : P.X.ι → A) i' * v c
    simp [Pi.single_apply]
  conv_rhs => rw [hv, fullMap_sum]
  funext j
  rw [Finset.sum_apply]
  change ∑ i, elem (fullMatrix g i j) * v i = _
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  rw [fullMap_rmul]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.SKarAlg.fullMap_p
statement: theorem fullMap_p (v : P.X.ι → A) : fullMap g (matHom P.p v) = fullMap g v
proof:
:= by
  simp only [fullMap]
  congr 3
  exact mem_imgSubmodule.1 (matHom_p_mem P v)

name: StringDiagrams.SKarAlg.q_fullMap
statement: theorem q_fullMap (v : P.X.ι → A) : matHom Q.p (fullMap g v) = fullMap g v
proof:
:=
  mem_imgSubmodule.1 (g.1.1 ⟨matHom P.p v, matHom_p_mem P v⟩).2

name: StringDiagrams.SKarAlg.toMod_map_fullHom
statement: theorem toMod_map_fullHom : (toMod 𝒜).map (fullHom g) = g
proof:
:= by
  refine Underlying.hom_ext (SuperBimodule.hom_ext (SVec.hom_ext fun w => Subtype.ext ?_))
  change matHom (fullMatrix g) w.1 = (g.1.1 w).1
  rw [matHom_fullMatrix, fullMap]
  congr 2
  exact Subtype.ext (mem_imgSubmodule.1 w.2)
