name: StringDiagrams.SKarAlg.imgSubmodule_toKaroubi
statement: theorem imgSubmodule_toKaroubi (M : Mat_ (D 𝒜)) : imgSubmodule ((toKaroubi _).obj M) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_top_iff]
  intro v _
  rw [mem_imgSubmodule]
  change matHom (𝟙 M) v = v
  rw [matHom_id]; rfl

name: StringDiagrams.SKarAlg.isFGProjective_toMod_obj
statement:
theorem isFGProjective_toMod_obj (P : SKar k (SuperalgebraCat 𝒜)) :
    IsFGProjective ((toMod 𝒜).obj P).obj
proof:
:=
  ⟨P.X, (toMod 𝒜).map (Karoubi.decompId_i P), (toMod 𝒜).map (Karoubi.decompId_p P), by
    rw [← Functor.map_comp, ← Karoubi.decompId, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id]⟩

name: StringDiagrams.SKarAlg.exists_iso_toMod_obj
statement:
theorem exists_iso_toMod_obj {V : SuperBimodule (trivialGrading k) 𝒜} (hV : IsFGProjective V) :
    ∃ P : SKar k (SuperalgebraCat 𝒜), Nonempty ((toMod 𝒜).obj P ≅ ⟨V⟩)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M, i, r, h⟩ := hV
  let ε : (toKaroubi _).obj M ⟶ (toKaroubi _).obj M := (toMod 𝒜).preimage (r ≫ i)
  have hε : (toMod 𝒜).map ε = r ≫ i := (toMod 𝒜).map_preimage _
  have hεε : ε ≫ ε = ε := (toMod 𝒜).map_injective (by
    rw [Functor.map_comp, hε, Category.assoc, reassoc_of% h])
  have idem : ε.f ≫ ε.f = ε.f := congrArg Idempotents.Karoubi.Hom.f hεε
  let P : SKar k (SuperalgebraCat 𝒜) := ⟨M, ε.f, idem⟩
  let a : P ⟶ (toKaroubi _).obj M := ⟨ε.f, by
    rw [Idempotents.Karoubi.comp_p]; exact idem⟩
  let b : (toKaroubi _).obj M ⟶ P := ⟨ε.f, by
    rw [← Category.assoc, Idempotents.Karoubi.p_comp]; exact idem⟩
  have hab : a ≫ ε ≫ b = 𝟙 P := Idempotents.Karoubi.hom_ext _ _ (by
    change ε.f ≫ ε.f ≫ ε.f = ε.f; rw [idem, idem])
  have hba : b ≫ a = ε := Idempotents.Karoubi.hom_ext _ _ idem
  refine ⟨P, ⟨Iso.mk ((toMod 𝒜).map a ≫ r) (i ≫ (toMod 𝒜).map b) ?_ ?_⟩⟩
  · rw [Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc r, ← hε, ← Functor.map_comp, ← Functor.map_comp, hab,
      CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id]
  · rw [Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc ((toMod 𝒜).map b), ← Functor.map_comp, hba, hε,
      ← Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc, h, Category.id_comp, h]

name: StringDiagrams.K₀.hcompK_mk_mk
statement: @[simp] theorem hcompK_mk_mk (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) : hcompK a b c (mk f) (mk g) = mk (f ≫ g)

name: StringDiagrams.K₀Ring.of_injective
statement: theorem of_injective : Function.Injective (of a b)

name: StringDiagrams.K₀Ring.mk_eq_mk_of_iso
statement: theorem mk_eq_mk_of_iso {f f' : a ⟶ b} (e : f ≅ f') : mk f = mk f'

name: StringDiagrams.K₀Ring.mk_biprod
statement: theorem mk_biprod (f f' : a ⟶ b) : mk (f ⊞ f') = mk f + mk f'
proof:
:= by
  rw [mk, mk, mk, K₀.mk_biprod, map_add]

name: StringDiagrams.K₀Ring.addHom_ext
statement:
theorem addHom_ext {G : Type w₁} [AddCommGroup G] {φ ψ : K₀Ring B →+ G}
    (h : ∀ (a b : B) (x : K₀ (a ⟶ b)), φ (of a b x) = ψ (of a b x)) : φ = ψ
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.addHom_ext fun p x => h p.1 p.2 x

name: StringDiagrams.K₀Ring.induction_on
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
theorem induction_on {P : K₀Ring B → Prop} (x : K₀Ring B) (zero : P 0)
    (of : ∀ (a b : B) (x : K₀ (a ⟶ b)), P (of a b x)) (add : ∀ x y, P x → P y → P (x + y)) :
    P x
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.induction_on x zero (fun p x => of p.1 p.2 x) add

name: StringDiagrams.K₀Ring.castHom_rfl
statement: theorem castHom_rfl (c d : B) : castHom (c := c) (rfl : d = d) = AddMonoidHom.id _

name: StringDiagrams.K₀Ring.mulOf_of_ne
statement:
theorem mulOf_of_ne {a b c d : B} (h : d ≠ a) (x : K₀ (a ⟶ b)) (y : K₀ (c ⟶ d)) :
    mulOf B (a, b) (c, d) x y = 0

name: StringDiagrams.K₀Ring.mulOf_self
statement:
theorem mulOf_self (a b c : B) (x : K₀ (a ⟶ b)) (y : K₀ (c ⟶ a)) :
    mulOf B (a, b) (c, a) x y = of c b (K₀.hcompK c a b y x)

name: StringDiagrams.K₀Ring.mul_def
statement: theorem mul_def (x y : K₀Ring B) : x * y = mulHom B x y

name: StringDiagrams.K₀Ring.of_mul_of
statement:
theorem of_mul_of {a b c d : B} (x : K₀ (a ⟶ b)) (y : K₀ (c ⟶ d)) :
    of a b x * of c d y = mulOf B (a, b) (c, d) x y
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_def, mulHom, of, of, DirectSum.toAddMonoid_of, AddMonoidHom.flip_apply,
    DirectSum.toAddMonoid_of, AddMonoidHom.flip_apply]

name: StringDiagrams.K₀Ring.mk_mul_mk
statement: theorem mk_mul_mk (f : a ⟶ b) {c : B} (g : c ⟶ a) : mk f * mk g = mk (g ≫ f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mk, mk, of_mul_of, mulOf_self, K₀.hcompK_mk_mk]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.K₀Ring.mk_mul_mk_of_ne
statement: theorem mk_mul_mk_of_ne (f : a ⟶ b) {c d : B} (g : c ⟶ d) (h : d ≠ a) : mk f * mk g = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [mk, mk, of_mul_of, mulOf_of_ne h]

name: StringDiagrams.K₀Ring.mul_add
statement: protected theorem mul_add (x y z : K₀Ring B) : x * (y + z) = x * y + x * z

name: StringDiagrams.K₀Ring.add_mul
statement: protected theorem add_mul (x y z : K₀Ring B) : (x + y) * z = x * z + y * z

name: StringDiagrams.K₀Ring.mul_zero
statement: protected theorem mul_zero (x : K₀Ring B) : x * 0 = 0

name: StringDiagrams.K₀Ring.zero_mul
statement: protected theorem zero_mul (x : K₀Ring B) : 0 * x = 0

name: StringDiagrams.K₀Ring.mul_neg
statement: protected theorem mul_neg (x y : K₀Ring B) : x * -y = -(x * y)

name: StringDiagrams.K₀Ring.neg_mul
statement: protected theorem neg_mul (x y : K₀Ring B) : -x * y = -(x * y)

name: StringDiagrams.K₀Ring.mul_assoc_mk
statement:
theorem mul_assoc_mk {a b c d e e' : B} (f : a ⟶ b) (g : c ⟶ d) (h : e ⟶ e') :
    mk f * mk g * mk h = mk f * (mk g * mk h)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h1 : d = a
  · subst h1
    rw [mk_mul_mk]
    by_cases h2 : e' = c
    · subst h2
      rw [mk_mul_mk, mk_mul_mk, mk_mul_mk]
      exact mk_eq_mk_of_iso (α_ h g f).symm
    · rw [mk_mul_mk_of_ne _ _ h2, mk_mul_mk_of_ne _ _ h2, K₀Ring.mul_zero]
  · rw [mk_mul_mk_of_ne _ _ h1, K₀Ring.zero_mul]
    by_cases h2 : e' = c
    · subst h2
      rw [mk_mul_mk, mk_mul_mk_of_ne _ _ h1]
    · rw [mk_mul_mk_of_ne _ _ h2, K₀Ring.mul_zero]

name: StringDiagrams.K₀Ring.mul_assoc_of
statement:
theorem mul_assoc_of {a b c d e e' : B} (x : K₀ (a ⟶ b)) (y : K₀ (c ⟶ d)) (z : K₀ (e ⟶ e')) :
    of a b x * of c d y * of e e' z = of a b x * (of c d y * of e e' z)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using K₀.induction_on with
  | mk f =>
    induction y using K₀.induction_on with
    | mk g =>
      induction z using K₀.induction_on with
      | mk h => exact mul_assoc_mk f g h
      | zero => simp only [map_zero, K₀Ring.mul_zero]
      | add z z' hz hz' => simp only [map_add, K₀Ring.mul_add, hz, hz']
      | neg z hz => simp only [map_neg, K₀Ring.mul_neg, hz]
    | zero => simp only [map_zero, K₀Ring.mul_zero, K₀Ring.zero_mul]
    | add y y' hy hy' => simp only [map_add, K₀Ring.mul_add, K₀Ring.add_mul, hy, hy']
    | neg y hy => simp only [map_neg, K₀Ring.mul_neg, K₀Ring.neg_mul, hy]
  | zero => simp only [map_zero, K₀Ring.zero_mul]
  | add x x' hx hx' => simp only [map_add, K₀Ring.add_mul, hx, hx']
  | neg x hx => simp only [map_neg, K₀Ring.neg_mul, hx]

name: StringDiagrams.K₀Ring.mul_assoc
statement: protected theorem mul_assoc (x y z : K₀Ring B) : x * y * z = x * (y * z)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_on with
  | zero => simp only [K₀Ring.zero_mul]
  | of a b x =>
    induction y using induction_on with
    | zero => simp only [K₀Ring.zero_mul, K₀Ring.mul_zero]
    | of c d y =>
      induction z using induction_on with
      | zero => simp only [K₀Ring.mul_zero]
      | of e e' z => exact mul_assoc_of x y z
      | add z z' hz hz' => simp only [K₀Ring.mul_add, hz, hz']
    | add y y' hy hy' => simp only [K₀Ring.mul_add, K₀Ring.add_mul, hy, hy']
  | add x x' hx hx' => simp only [K₀Ring.add_mul, hx, hx']

name: StringDiagrams.K₀Ring.one_mul_of
statement: theorem one_mul_of (x : K₀ (a ⟶ b)) : one b * of a b x = of a b x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using K₀.induction_on with
  | mk f =>
    change mk (𝟙 b) * mk f = mk f
    rw [mk_mul_mk]
    exact mk_eq_mk_of_iso (ρ_ f)
  | zero => simp only [map_zero, K₀Ring.mul_zero]
  | add x x' hx hx' => simp only [map_add, K₀Ring.mul_add, hx, hx']
  | neg x hx => simp only [map_neg, K₀Ring.mul_neg, hx]

name: StringDiagrams.K₀Ring.of_mul_one
statement: theorem of_mul_one (x : K₀ (a ⟶ b)) : of a b x * one a = of a b x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using K₀.induction_on with
  | mk f =>
    change mk f * mk (𝟙 a) = mk f
    rw [mk_mul_mk]
    exact mk_eq_mk_of_iso (λ_ f)
  | zero => simp only [map_zero, K₀Ring.zero_mul]
  | add x x' hx hx' => simp only [map_add, K₀Ring.add_mul, hx, hx']
  | neg x hx => simp only [map_neg, K₀Ring.neg_mul, hx]

name: StringDiagrams.K₀Ring.one_mul_of_of_ne
statement: theorem one_mul_of_of_ne {c : B} (h : c ≠ b) (x : K₀ (a ⟶ b)) : one c * of a b x = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [one, mk, of_mul_of, mulOf_of_ne (Ne.symm h)]

name: StringDiagrams.K₀Ring.of_mul_one_of_ne
statement: theorem of_mul_one_of_ne {c : B} (h : c ≠ a) (x : K₀ (a ⟶ b)) : of a b x * one c = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [one, mk, of_mul_of, mulOf_of_ne h]

name: StringDiagrams.K₀Ring.one_mul_one_self
statement: theorem one_mul_one_self (a : B) : one a * one a = one a

name: StringDiagrams.K₀Ring.one_mul_one_of_ne
statement: theorem one_mul_one_of_ne {a b : B} (h : a ≠ b) : one a * one b = 0

name: StringDiagrams.K₀Ring.finset_sum_one_mul_of
statement:
theorem finset_sum_one_mul_of (s : Finset B) (hb : b ∈ s) (x : K₀ (a ⟶ b)) :
    (∑ c ∈ s, one c) * of a b x = of a b x
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.sum_mul, Finset.sum_eq_single b (fun c _ hc => one_mul_of_of_ne hc x)
    (fun h => absurd hb h), one_mul_of]

name: StringDiagrams.K₀Ring.of_mul_finset_sum_one
statement:
theorem of_mul_finset_sum_one (s : Finset B) (ha : a ∈ s) (x : K₀ (a ⟶ b)) :
    of a b x * ∑ c ∈ s, one c = of a b x
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_eq_single a (fun c _ hc => of_mul_one_of_ne hc x)
    (fun h => absurd ha h), of_mul_one]

name: StringDiagrams.K₀Ring.exists_finset_one_mul
statement:
theorem exists_finset_one_mul (x : K₀Ring B) :
    ∃ s : Finset B, ∀ t : Finset B, s ⊆ t →
      (∑ c ∈ t, one c) * x = x ∧ x * ∑ c ∈ t, one c = x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_on with
  | zero => exact ⟨∅, fun _ _ => by simp⟩
  | of a b x =>
    exact ⟨{a, b}, fun t ht => ⟨finset_sum_one_mul_of t (ht (by simp)) x,
      of_mul_finset_sum_one t (ht (by simp)) x⟩⟩
  | add x y hx hy =>
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨s', hs'⟩ := hy
    refine ⟨s ∪ s', fun t ht => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hs t (Finset.union_subset_left ht)
    obtain ⟨h1', h2'⟩ := hs' t (Finset.union_subset_right ht)
    exact ⟨by rw [mul_add, h1, h1'], by rw [add_mul, h2, h2']⟩

name: StringDiagrams.K₀Ring.tEnd_of
statement:
theorem tEnd_of (t : ∀ b : B, b ⟶ b) (x : K₀ (a ⟶ b)) :
    tEnd t (of a b x) = of a b (K₀.map (postcomp a (t b)) x)

name: StringDiagrams.K₀Ring.tEnd_mk
statement: theorem tEnd_mk (t : ∀ b : B, b ⟶ b) (f : a ⟶ b) : tEnd t (mk f) = mk (f ≫ t b)

name: StringDiagrams.K₀Ring.tEnd_mul
statement: theorem tEnd_mul (t : ∀ b : B, b ⟶ b) (x y : K₀Ring B) : tEnd t (x * y) = tEnd t x * y
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_on with
  | zero => simp only [K₀Ring.zero_mul, map_zero]
  | of a b x =>
    induction y using induction_on with
    | zero => simp only [K₀Ring.mul_zero, map_zero]
    | of c d y =>
      induction x using K₀.induction_on with
      | mk f =>
        induction y using K₀.induction_on with
        | mk g =>
          change tEnd t (mk f * mk g) = tEnd t (mk f) * mk g
          by_cases h : d = a
          · subst h
            rw [mk_mul_mk, tEnd_mk, tEnd_mk, mk_mul_mk]
            exact mk_eq_mk_of_iso (α_ g f (t b))
          · rw [mk_mul_mk_of_ne _ _ h, tEnd_mk, mk_mul_mk_of_ne _ _ h, map_zero]
        | zero => simp only [map_zero, K₀Ring.mul_zero]
        | add y y' hy hy' => simp only [map_add, K₀Ring.mul_add, hy, hy']
        | neg y hy => simp only [map_neg, K₀Ring.mul_neg, hy]
      | zero => simp only [map_zero, K₀Ring.zero_mul]
      | add x x' hx hx' => simp only [map_add, K₀Ring.add_mul, hx, hx']
      | neg x hx => simp only [map_neg, K₀Ring.neg_mul, hx]
    | add y y' hy hy' => simp only [K₀Ring.mul_add, map_add, hy, hy']
  | add x x' hx hx' => simp only [K₀Ring.add_mul, map_add, hx, hx']

name: StringDiagrams.K₀Ring.mul_tEnd
statement:
theorem mul_tEnd (t : ∀ b : B, b ⟶ b) (τ : ∀ {a b : B} (f : a ⟶ b), f ≫ t b ≅ t a ≫ f)
    (x y : K₀Ring B) : tEnd t (x * y) = x * tEnd t y
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_on with
  | zero => simp only [K₀Ring.zero_mul, map_zero]
  | of a b x =>
    induction y using induction_on with
    | zero => simp only [K₀Ring.mul_zero, map_zero]
    | of c d y =>
      induction x using K₀.induction_on with
      | mk f =>
        induction y using K₀.induction_on with
        | mk g =>
          change tEnd t (mk f * mk g) = mk f * tEnd t (mk g)
          by_cases h : d = a
          · subst h
            rw [mk_mul_mk, tEnd_mk, tEnd_mk, mk_mul_mk]
            exact mk_eq_mk_of_iso (α_ g f _ ≪≫ whiskerLeftIso g (τ f) ≪≫ (α_ g _ f).symm)
          · rw [mk_mul_mk_of_ne _ _ h, tEnd_mk, mk_mul_mk_of_ne _ _ h, map_zero]
        | zero => simp only [map_zero, K₀Ring.mul_zero]
        | add y y' hy hy' => simp only [map_add, K₀Ring.mul_add, hy, hy']
        | neg y hy => simp only [map_neg, K₀Ring.mul_neg, hy]
      | zero => simp only [map_zero, K₀Ring.zero_mul]
      | add x x' hx hx' => simp only [map_add, K₀Ring.add_mul, hx, hx']
      | neg x hx => simp only [map_neg, K₀Ring.neg_mul, hx]
    | add y y' hy hy' => simp only [K₀Ring.mul_add, map_add, hy, hy']
  | add x x' hx hx' => simp only [K₀Ring.add_mul, map_add, hx, hx']

name: StringDiagrams.K₀Ring.tEnd_of_eq_mk_mul
statement:
theorem tEnd_of_eq_mk_mul (t : ∀ b : B, b ⟶ b) (x : K₀ (a ⟶ b)) :
    tEnd t (of a b x) = mk (t b) * of a b x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using K₀.induction_on with
  | mk f =>
    change tEnd t (mk f) = mk (t b) * mk f
    rw [tEnd_mk, mk_mul_mk]
  | zero => simp only [map_zero, K₀Ring.mul_zero]
  | add x x' hx hx' => simp only [map_add, K₀Ring.mul_add, hx, hx']
  | neg x hx => simp only [map_neg, K₀Ring.mul_neg, hx]

name: StringDiagrams.K₀Ring.tEnd_of_eq_mul_mk
statement:
theorem tEnd_of_eq_mul_mk (t : ∀ b : B, b ⟶ b) (τ : ∀ {a b : B} (f : a ⟶ b), f ≫ t b ≅ t a ≫ f)
    (x : K₀ (a ⟶ b)) : tEnd t (of a b x) = of a b x * mk (t a)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using K₀.induction_on with
  | mk f =>
    change tEnd t (mk f) = mk f * mk (t a)
    rw [tEnd_mk, mk_mul_mk]
    exact mk_eq_mk_of_iso (τ f)
  | zero => simp only [map_zero, K₀Ring.zero_mul]
  | add x x' hx hx' => simp only [map_add, K₀Ring.add_mul, hx, hx']
  | neg x hx => simp only [map_neg, K₀Ring.neg_mul, hx]

name: StringDiagrams.K₀Ring.laurentEnd_apply
statement:
theorem laurentEnd_apply (r : LaurentPolynomial Zπ) (x : K₀Ring B) (p : B × B) :
    laurentEnd R r x p = K₀.laurentEnd R (p.1 ⟶ p.2) r (x p)

name: StringDiagrams.K₀Ring.laurentEnd_of
statement:
theorem laurentEnd_of (r : LaurentPolynomial Zπ) (x : K₀ (a ⟶ b)) :
    laurentEnd R r (of a b x) = of a b (K₀.laurentEnd R (a ⟶ b) r x)

name: StringDiagrams.K₀Ring.laurentEnd_C_π
statement: theorem laurentEnd_C_π : laurentEnd R (B := B) (C Zπ.π) = tEnd 𝛑
proof:
:=
  AddMonoidHom.ext fun x => DirectSum.ext fun p => by
    rw [laurentEnd_apply, K₀.laurentEnd_C, Zπ.toEnd_π, tEnd, DirectSum.map_apply]
    rfl

name: StringDiagrams.K₀Ring.laurentEnd_T_one
statement: theorem laurentEnd_T_one : laurentEnd R (B := B) (T 1) = tEnd 𝐪
proof:
:=
  AddMonoidHom.ext fun x => DirectSum.ext fun p => by
    rw [laurentEnd_apply, K₀.laurentEnd_T, zpow_one, tEnd, DirectSum.map_apply]
    rfl

name: StringDiagrams.K₀Ring.laurentEnd_T_neg_one
statement: theorem laurentEnd_T_neg_one : laurentEnd R (B := B) (T (-1)) = tEnd 𝐪⁻¹
proof:
:=
  AddMonoidHom.ext fun x => DirectSum.ext fun p => by
    rw [laurentEnd_apply, K₀.laurentEnd_T, zpow_neg_one, tEnd, DirectSum.map_apply]
    rfl

name: StringDiagrams.K₀Ring.smul_def
statement:
theorem smul_def (r : LaurentPolynomial Zπ) (x : K₀Ring B) :
    letI := moduleLaurent R (B := B)
    r • x = laurentEnd R r x

name: StringDiagrams.K₀Ring.smul_of
statement:
theorem smul_of (r : LaurentPolynomial Zπ) (x : K₀ (a ⟶ b)) :
    letI := moduleLaurent R (B := B)
    letI := K₀.moduleLaurent R (a ⟶ b)
    r • of a b x = of a b (r • x)

name: StringDiagrams.K₀Ring.C_π_smul_of
statement:
theorem C_π_smul_of (x : K₀ (a ⟶ b)) :
    letI := moduleLaurent R (B := B)
    (C Zπ.π : LaurentPolynomial Zπ) • of a b x = mk (𝛑 b) * of a b x
proof:
:= by
  show laurentEnd R (C Zπ.π) (of a b x) = _
  rw [laurentEnd_C_π, tEnd_of_eq_mk_mul]

name: StringDiagrams.K₀Ring.C_π_smul_of'
statement:
theorem C_π_smul_of' (x : K₀ (a ⟶ b)) :
    letI := moduleLaurent R (B := B)
    (C Zπ.π : LaurentPolynomial Zπ) • of a b x = of a b x * mk (𝛑 a)
proof:
:= by
  show laurentEnd R (C Zπ.π) (of a b x) = _
  rw [laurentEnd_C_π, tEnd_of_eq_mul_mk 𝛑 (fun f => 𝛃 f)]

name: StringDiagrams.K₀Ring.T_smul_of
statement:
theorem T_smul_of (x : K₀ (a ⟶ b)) :
    letI := moduleLaurent R (B := B)
    (T 1 : LaurentPolynomial Zπ) • of a b x = mk (𝐪 b) * of a b x
proof:
:= by
  show laurentEnd R (T 1) (of a b x) = _
  rw [laurentEnd_T_one, tEnd_of_eq_mk_mul]

name: StringDiagrams.K₀Ring.T_smul_of'
statement:
theorem T_smul_of' (x : K₀ (a ⟶ b)) :
    letI := moduleLaurent R (B := B)
    (T 1 : LaurentPolynomial Zπ) • of a b x = of a b x * mk (𝐪 a)
proof:
:= by
  show laurentEnd R (T 1) (of a b x) = _
  rw [laurentEnd_T_one, tEnd_of_eq_mul_mk 𝐪 (fun f => 𝛄 f)]

name: StringDiagrams.K₀Ring.T_neg_one_smul_of
statement:
theorem T_neg_one_smul_of (x : K₀ (a ⟶ b)) :
    letI := moduleLaurent R (B := B)
    (T (-1) : LaurentPolynomial Zπ) • of a b x = mk (𝐪⁻¹ b) * of a b x
proof:
:= by
  show laurentEnd R (T (-1)) (of a b x) = _
  rw [laurentEnd_T_neg_one, tEnd_of_eq_mk_mul]

name: StringDiagrams.K₀Ring.T_neg_one_smul_of'
statement:
theorem T_neg_one_smul_of' (x : K₀ (a ⟶ b)) :
    letI := moduleLaurent R (B := B)
    (T (-1) : LaurentPolynomial Zπ) • of a b x = of a b x * mk (𝐪⁻¹ a)
proof:
:= by
  show laurentEnd R (T (-1)) (of a b x) = _
  rw [laurentEnd_T_neg_one, tEnd_of_eq_mul_mk 𝐪⁻¹ (fun f => γinvIso f)]

name: StringDiagrams.K₀Ring.isCentral_one
statement: theorem isCentral_one : IsCentral (1 : AddMonoid.End (K₀Ring B))

name: StringDiagrams.K₀Ring.isCentral_zero
statement: theorem isCentral_zero : IsCentral (0 : AddMonoid.End (K₀Ring B))
proof:
:= fun x y =>
  ⟨by rw [AddMonoid.End.zero_apply, AddMonoid.End.zero_apply, zero_mul],
    by rw [AddMonoid.End.zero_apply, AddMonoid.End.zero_apply, mul_zero]⟩

name: StringDiagrams.K₀Ring.IsCentral.add
statement:
theorem IsCentral.add {φ ψ : AddMonoid.End (K₀Ring B)} (hφ : IsCentral φ) (hψ : IsCentral ψ) :
    IsCentral (φ + ψ)
proof:
:= fun x y => by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hφ x y
  obtain ⟨h3, h4⟩ := hψ x y
  exact ⟨by change φ (x * y) + ψ (x * y) = (φ x + ψ x) * y; rw [h1, h3, add_mul],
    by change φ (x * y) + ψ (x * y) = x * (φ y + ψ y); rw [h2, h4, mul_add]⟩

name: StringDiagrams.K₀Ring.IsCentral.neg
statement: theorem IsCentral.neg {φ : AddMonoid.End (K₀Ring B)} (hφ : IsCentral φ) : IsCentral (-φ)
proof:
:=
  fun x y => by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hφ x y
  exact ⟨by change -φ (x * y) = -φ x * y; rw [h1, neg_mul],
    by change -φ (x * y) = x * -φ y; rw [h2, mul_neg]⟩

name: StringDiagrams.K₀Ring.IsCentral.mul
statement:
theorem IsCentral.mul {φ ψ : AddMonoid.End (K₀Ring B)} (hφ : IsCentral φ) (hψ : IsCentral ψ) :
    IsCentral (φ * ψ)
proof:
:= fun x y => by
  obtain ⟨h3, h4⟩ := hψ x y
  obtain ⟨h1, _⟩ := hφ (ψ x) y
  obtain ⟨_, h2⟩ := hφ x (ψ y)
  exact ⟨by change φ (ψ (x * y)) = φ (ψ x) * y; rw [h3, h1],
    by change φ (ψ (x * y)) = x * φ (ψ y); rw [h4, h2]⟩

name: StringDiagrams.K₀Ring.isCentral_intCast
statement: theorem isCentral_intCast (n : ℤ) : IsCentral ((n : ℤ) : AddMonoid.End (K₀Ring B))
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Int.induction_on with
  | zero => rw [Int.cast_zero]; exact isCentral_zero
  | succ n ih => rw [Int.cast_add, Int.cast_one]; exact ih.add isCentral_one
  | pred n ih => rw [Int.cast_sub, Int.cast_one, sub_eq_add_neg]; exact ih.add isCentral_one.neg

name: StringDiagrams.K₀Ring.isCentral_tEnd_π
statement: theorem isCentral_tEnd_π : IsCentral (tEnd (B := B) 𝛑)
proof:
:= fun x y =>
  ⟨tEnd_mul 𝛑 x y, mul_tEnd 𝛑 (fun f => 𝛃 f) x y⟩

name: StringDiagrams.K₀Ring.isCentral_tEnd_q
statement: theorem isCentral_tEnd_q : IsCentral (tEnd (B := B) 𝐪)
proof:
:= fun x y =>
  ⟨tEnd_mul 𝐪 x y, mul_tEnd 𝐪 (fun f => 𝛄 f) x y⟩

name: StringDiagrams.K₀Ring.isCentral_tEnd_qinv
statement: theorem isCentral_tEnd_qinv : IsCentral (tEnd (B := B) 𝐪⁻¹)
proof:
:= fun x y =>
  ⟨tEnd_mul 𝐪⁻¹ x y, mul_tEnd 𝐪⁻¹ (fun f => γinvIso f) x y⟩

name: StringDiagrams.K₀Ring.isCentral_laurentEnd_T
statement: theorem isCentral_laurentEnd_T (n : ℤ) : IsCentral (laurentEnd R (B := B) (T n))
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Int.induction_on with
  | zero => rw [T_zero, map_one]; exact isCentral_one
  | succ n ih => rw [T_add, map_mul, laurentEnd_T_one]; exact ih.mul (isCentral_tEnd_q (R := R))
  | pred n ih =>
    rw [T_sub, map_mul, laurentEnd_T_neg_one]; exact ih.mul (isCentral_tEnd_qinv (R := R))

name: StringDiagrams.K₀Ring.isCentral_laurentEnd_C
statement: theorem isCentral_laurentEnd_C (r : Zπ) : IsCentral (laurentEnd R (B := B) (C r))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, j, rfl⟩ := Zπ.exists_eq_add_mul_π r
  rw [map_add, map_mul, map_intCast, map_intCast, map_add, map_mul, map_intCast, map_intCast,
    laurentEnd_C_π]
  exact (isCentral_intCast i).add ((isCentral_intCast j).mul (isCentral_tEnd_π (R := R)))

name: StringDiagrams.K₀Ring.isCentral_laurentEnd
statement: theorem isCentral_laurentEnd (r : LaurentPolynomial Zπ) : IsCentral (laurentEnd R (B := B) r)
proof:
:= by
  induction r using LaurentPolynomial.induction_on' with
  | add p q hp hq => rw [map_add]; exact hp.add hq
  | C_mul_T n a => rw [map_mul]; exact (isCentral_laurentEnd_C a).mul (isCentral_laurentEnd_T n)

name: StringDiagrams.K₀Ring.smul_mul
statement:
theorem smul_mul (r : LaurentPolynomial Zπ) (x y : K₀Ring B) :
    letI := moduleLaurent R (B := B)
    (r • x) * y = r • (x * y)

name: StringDiagrams.K₀Ring.mul_smul
statement:
theorem mul_smul (r : LaurentPolynomial Zπ) (x y : K₀Ring B) :
    letI := moduleLaurent R (B := B)
    x * (r • y) = r • (x * y)

name: StringDiagrams.GSKAR.K₀_hom_eq
statement: theorem K₀_hom_eq (a b : B) : K₀ (mkObj R B a ⟶ mkObj R B b) = K₀ (GSKar R (a ⟶ b))

name: StringDiagrams.GSKAR.smul_mul
statement:
theorem smul_mul (r : LaurentPolynomial Zπ) (x y : K₀Ring (GSKAR R B)) :
    letI := moduleLaurent R B
    (r • x) * y = r • (x * y)

name: StringDiagrams.GSKAR.mul_smul
statement:
theorem mul_smul (r : LaurentPolynomial Zπ) (x y : K₀Ring (GSKAR R B)) :
    letI := moduleLaurent R B
    x * (r • y) = r • (x * y)

name: StringDiagrams.GSKAR.C_π_smul_of
statement:
theorem C_π_smul_of {a b : B} (x : K₀ (mkObj R B a ⟶ mkObj R B b)) :
    letI := moduleLaurent R B
    (C Zπ.π : LaurentPolynomial Zπ) • K₀Ring.of _ _ x =
        K₀Ring.mk (PiTwoCategory.pi (R := R) (mkObj R B b)) * K₀Ring.of _ _ x ∧
      (C Zπ.π : LaurentPolynomial Zπ) • K₀Ring.of _ _ x =
        K₀Ring.of _ _ x * K₀Ring.mk (PiTwoCategory.pi (R := R) (mkObj R B a))

name: StringDiagrams.GSKAR.T_smul_of
statement:
theorem T_smul_of {a b : B} (x : K₀ (mkObj R B a ⟶ mkObj R B b)) :
    letI := moduleLaurent R B
    (T 1 : LaurentPolynomial Zπ) • K₀Ring.of _ _ x =
        K₀Ring.mk (QPiTwoCategory.q (R := R) (mkObj R B b)) * K₀Ring.of _ _ x ∧
      (T 1 : LaurentPolynomial Zπ) • K₀Ring.of _ _ x =
        K₀Ring.of _ _ x * K₀Ring.mk (QPiTwoCategory.q (R := R) (mkObj R B a))

name: StringDiagrams.GSCat.forget_obj
statement: @[simp] theorem forget_obj (A : GSCat.{w, v, u} R) : (forget R).obj A = A.toSCat

name: StringDiagrams.GSCat.forget_map
statement:
@[simp] theorem forget_map {A B : GSCat.{w, v, u} R} (F : A ⟶ B) :
    (forget R).map F = F.as.toSuperfunctor

name: StringDiagrams.GSCat.hom_ext
statement:
theorem hom_ext {A B : GSCat.{w, v, u} R} {F G : A ⟶ B}
    (h : (forget R).map F = (forget R).map G) : F = G
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨F, _⟩⟩ := F
  obtain ⟨⟨G, _⟩⟩ := G
  change F = G at h
  subst h
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.GSCat.tensorObj_def
statement: theorem tensorObj_def (A B : GSCat.{u, u, w} k) : A ⊗ B = GSCat.of k (BoxProd k A B)

name: StringDiagrams.GSCat.tensorUnit_def
statement: theorem tensorUnit_def : 𝟙_ (GSCat.{u, u, w} k) = GSCat.of k (BoxUnit.{w, u} k)

name: StringDiagrams.GSCat.forget_obj_tensorObj
statement:
@[simp] theorem forget_obj_tensorObj (A B : GSCat.{u, u, w} k) :
    (forget k).obj (A ⊗ B) = (forget k).obj A ⊗ (forget k).obj B

name: StringDiagrams.GSCat.forget_obj_tensorUnit
statement: @[simp] theorem forget_obj_tensorUnit : (forget k).obj (𝟙_ (GSCat.{u, u, w} k)) = 𝟙_ _

name: StringDiagrams.GSCat.forget_map_tensorHom
statement:
@[simp] theorem forget_map_tensorHom {A B A' B' : GSCat.{u, u, w} k} (F : A ⟶ A') (G : B ⟶ B') :
    (forget k).map (F ⊗ₘ G) = (forget k).map F ⊗ₘ (forget k).map G

name: StringDiagrams.GSCat.forget_map_whiskerLeft
statement:
@[simp] theorem forget_map_whiskerLeft (A : GSCat.{u, u, w} k) {B B' : GSCat.{u, u, w} k}
    (G : B ⟶ B') : (forget k).map (A ◁ G) = (forget k).obj A ◁ (forget k).map G

name: StringDiagrams.GSCat.forget_map_whiskerRight
statement:
@[simp] theorem forget_map_whiskerRight {A A' : GSCat.{u, u, w} k} (F : A ⟶ A')
    (B : GSCat.{u, u, w} k) : (forget k).map (F ▷ B) = (forget k).map F ▷ (forget k).obj B

name: StringDiagrams.GSCat.forget_map_associator_hom
statement:
@[simp] theorem forget_map_associator_hom (A B C : GSCat.{u, u, w} k) :
    (forget k).map (α_ A B C).hom =
      (α_ ((forget k).obj A) ((forget k).obj B) ((forget k).obj C)).hom

name: StringDiagrams.GSCat.forget_map_associator_inv
statement:
@[simp] theorem forget_map_associator_inv (A B C : GSCat.{u, u, w} k) :
    (forget k).map (α_ A B C).inv =
      (α_ ((forget k).obj A) ((forget k).obj B) ((forget k).obj C)).inv

name: StringDiagrams.GSCat.forget_map_leftUnitor_hom
statement:
@[simp] theorem forget_map_leftUnitor_hom (A : GSCat.{u, u, w} k) :
    (forget k).map (λ_ A).hom = (λ_ ((forget k).obj A)).hom

name: StringDiagrams.GSCat.forget_map_leftUnitor_inv
statement:
@[simp] theorem forget_map_leftUnitor_inv (A : GSCat.{u, u, w} k) :
    (forget k).map (λ_ A).inv = (λ_ ((forget k).obj A)).inv

name: StringDiagrams.GSCat.forget_map_rightUnitor_hom
statement:
@[simp] theorem forget_map_rightUnitor_hom (A : GSCat.{u, u, w} k) :
    (forget k).map (ρ_ A).hom = (ρ_ ((forget k).obj A)).hom

name: StringDiagrams.GSCat.forget_map_rightUnitor_inv
statement:
@[simp] theorem forget_map_rightUnitor_inv (A : GSCat.{u, u, w} k) :
    (forget k).map (ρ_ A).inv = (ρ_ ((forget k).obj A)).inv

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.GradedSubmodule.toSubmodule_injective
statement:
theorem toSubmodule_injective :
    Function.Injective (toSubmodule : GradedSubmodule V → Submodule k V)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨U, _⟩ ⟨U', _⟩ h
  cases h; rfl

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.GradedSubmodule.mem_toSubmodule
statement: theorem mem_toSubmodule {U : GradedSubmodule V} {v : V} : v ∈ U.toSubmodule ↔ v ∈ U

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.GradedSubmodule.zero_mem
statement: theorem zero_mem (U : GradedSubmodule V) : (0 : V) ∈ U

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.GradedSubmodule.add_mem
statement: theorem add_mem (U : GradedSubmodule V) {v w : V} (hv : v ∈ U) (hw : w ∈ U) : v + w ∈ U

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.GradedSubmodule.sub_mem
statement: theorem sub_mem (U : GradedSubmodule V) {v w : V} (hv : v ∈ U) (hw : w ∈ U) : v - w ∈ U

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.GradedSubmodule.smul_mem
statement: theorem smul_mem (U : GradedSubmodule V) (r : k) {v : V} (hv : v ∈ U) : r • v ∈ U

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.GradedSubmodule.zsmul_mem
statement: theorem zsmul_mem (U : GradedSubmodule V) (n : ℤ) {v : V} (hv : v ∈ U) : n • v ∈ U

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.GradedSubmodule.proj_mem
statement: theorem proj_mem (U : GradedSubmodule V) (q : ZMod 2) {v : V} (hv : v ∈ U) : V.proj q v ∈ U
proof:
:= by
  rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one q with rfl | rfl
  · rw [proj_zero, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.id_apply]; exact U.sub_mem hv (U.odd_mem v hv)
  · rw [proj_one]; exact U.odd_mem v hv

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.quotMk_apply
statement: theorem quotMk_apply (v : V) : quotMk V U v = quotMkFun V U v

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.quotMkFun_surjective
statement: theorem quotMkFun_surjective : Function.Surjective (quotMkFun V U)

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.quotMkFun_add
statement: theorem quotMkFun_add (v w : V) : quotMkFun V U (v + w) = quotMkFun V U v + quotMkFun V U w

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.quotMkFun_sub
statement: theorem quotMkFun_sub (v w : V) : quotMkFun V U (v - w) = quotMkFun V U v - quotMkFun V U w

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.quotMkFun_smul
statement: theorem quotMkFun_smul (r : k) (v : V) : quotMkFun V U (r • v) = r • quotMkFun V U v

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.quotMkFun_zsmul
statement: theorem quotMkFun_zsmul (n : ℤ) (v : V) : quotMkFun V U (n • v) = n • quotMkFun V U v

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.quotMkFun_zero
statement: theorem quotMkFun_zero : quotMkFun V U 0 = 0

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.quotMkFun_eq_quotMkFun
statement: theorem quotMkFun_eq_quotMkFun {v w : V} : quotMkFun V U v = quotMkFun V U w ↔ v - w ∈ U

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.quotMkFun_eq_zero
statement: theorem quotMkFun_eq_zero {v : V} : quotMkFun V U v = 0 ↔ v ∈ U

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.quot_odd_mk
statement: theorem quot_odd_mk (v : V) : (quot V U).odd (quotMkFun V U v) = quotMkFun V U (V.odd v)

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.quot_proj_mk
statement:
theorem quot_proj_mk (p : ZMod 2) (v : V) :
    (quot V U).proj p (quotMkFun V U v) = quotMkFun V U (V.proj p v)
proof:
:= by
  rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one p with rfl | rfl
  · rw [proj_zero, proj_zero, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.id_apply,
      LinearMap.id_apply, quot_odd_mk, quotMkFun_sub]
  · rw [proj_one, proj_one, quot_odd_mk]

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.quotMk_mem
statement: theorem quotMk_mem : quotMk V U ∈ parityHom V (quot V U) 0
proof:
:= by
  intro q
  ext v
  rw [add_zero, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply]
  exact (quot_proj_mk V U q v).symm

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.quotMkFun_mem_part
statement:
theorem quotMkFun_mem_part {p : ZMod 2} {v : V} (hv : v ∈ V.part p) :
    quotMkFun V U v ∈ (quot V U).part p
proof:
:= by
  simpa using! apply_mem_part (quotMk_mem V U) (v := v) hv

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.quot_induction_on
statement:
theorem quot_induction_on {P : quot V U → Prop} (x : quot V U) (h : ∀ v : V, P (quotMkFun V U v)) :
    P x

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.quot_hom_ext
statement:
theorem quot_hom_ext {W : SVec k} {f g : quot V U ⟶ W}
    (h : ∀ v : V, f (quotMkFun V U v) = g (quotMkFun V U v)) : f = g
proof:
:=
  hom_ext fun x => quot_induction_on (P := fun x => f x = g x) x h

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.quotMap_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem quotMap_mk (f : V ⟶ W) (hf : ∀ v ∈ U, f v ∈ U') (v : V) :
    quotMap f hf (quotMkFun V U v) = quotMkFun W U' (f v)

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.quotMk_comp_quotMap
statement:
theorem quotMk_comp_quotMap (f : V ⟶ W) (hf : ∀ v ∈ U, f v ∈ U') :
    quotMk V U ≫ quotMap f hf = f ≫ quotMk W U'

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.quotMap_id
statement: theorem quotMap_id : quotMap (U := U) (U' := U) (𝟙 V) (fun _ hv => hv) = 𝟙 (quot V U)

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.quotMap_comp
statement:
theorem quotMap_comp (f : V ⟶ W) (hf : ∀ v ∈ U, f v ∈ U') (g : W ⟶ X)
    (hg : ∀ w ∈ U', g w ∈ U'') :
    quotMap (U := U) (U' := U'') (f ≫ g) (fun v hv => hg _ (hf v hv)) =
      quotMap f hf ≫ quotMap g hg

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.quotMap_add
statement:
theorem quotMap_add (f g : V ⟶ W) (hf : ∀ v ∈ U, f v ∈ U') (hg : ∀ v ∈ U, g v ∈ U') :
    quotMap (f + g) (fun v hv => U'.add_mem (hf v hv) (hg v hv)) = quotMap f hf + quotMap g hg

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.quotMap_smul
statement:
theorem quotMap_smul (r : k) (f : V ⟶ W) (hf : ∀ v ∈ U, f v ∈ U') :
    quotMap (r • f) (fun v hv => U'.smul_mem r (hf v hv)) = r • quotMap f hf

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.quotMap_zsmul
statement:
theorem quotMap_zsmul (n : ℤ) (f : V ⟶ W) (hf : ∀ v ∈ U, f v ∈ U') :
    quotMap (n • f) (fun v hv => U'.zsmul_mem n (hf v hv)) = n • quotMap f hf

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.quotMap_zero
statement: theorem quotMap_zero : quotMap (U := U) (U' := U') (0 : V ⟶ W) (fun _ _ => U'.zero_mem) = 0

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.quotMap_congr
statement:
theorem quotMap_congr {f g : V ⟶ W} (h : f = g) (hf : ∀ v ∈ U, f v ∈ U') :
    quotMap f hf = quotMap g (h ▸ hf)

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.homProj_mem_of_mem
statement:
theorem homProj_mem_of_mem (p : ZMod 2) {f : V ⟶ W} (hf : ∀ v ∈ U, f v ∈ U') :
    ∀ v ∈ U, homProj p f v ∈ U'
proof:
:= fun v hv => by
  rw [homProj_apply]
  exact U'.add_mem (U'.proj_mem _ (hf _ (U.proj_mem 0 hv))) (U'.proj_mem _ (hf _ (U.proj_mem 1 hv)))

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.quotMap_mem
statement:
theorem quotMap_mem {p : ZMod 2} {f : V ⟶ W} (hfp : f ∈ parityHom V W p)
    (hf : ∀ v ∈ U, f v ∈ U') : quotMap f hf ∈ parityHom (quot V U) (quot W U') p
proof:
:= by
  intro q
  refine quot_hom_ext V U fun v => ?_
  change quotMap f hf ((quot V U).proj q (quotMkFun V U v)) =
    (quot W U').proj (q + p) (quotMap f hf (quotMkFun V U v))
  rw [quot_proj_mk, quotMap_mk, quotMap_mk, quot_proj_mk, apply_proj_of_mem hfp]

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.homProj_quotMap
statement:
theorem homProj_quotMap (p : ZMod 2) (f : V ⟶ W) (hf : ∀ v ∈ U, f v ∈ U') :
    homProj p (quotMap f hf) = quotMap (homProj p f) (homProj_mem_of_mem p hf)
proof:
:= by
  have e : f = homProj p f + homProj (p + 1) f := by
    rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one p with rfl | rfl
    · rw [zero_add, homProj_add_homProj]
    · rw [zmod2_one_add_one, add_comm, homProj_add_homProj]
  refine homProj_eq_of_add ?_ (quotMap_mem (homProj_mem p f) _)
    (quotMap_mem (homProj_mem (p + 1) f) (homProj_mem_of_mem _ hf))
  rw [← quotMap_add]
  exact quotMap_congr e hf

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.twist_mem_of_mem
statement:
theorem twist_mem_of_mem (p : ZMod 2) {f : V ⟶ W} (hf : ∀ v ∈ U, f v ∈ U') :
    ∀ v ∈ U, twist k p f v ∈ U'
proof:
:= fun v hv => by
  rw [twist_apply, proj_eq_homProj, proj_eq_homProj]
  exact U'.add_mem (homProj_mem_of_mem 0 hf v hv) (U'.smul_mem _ (homProj_mem_of_mem 1 hf v hv))

name: StringDiagrams.SVec.twist_quotMap
statement:
theorem twist_quotMap (p : ZMod 2) (f : V ⟶ W) (hf : ∀ v ∈ U, f v ∈ U') :
    twist k p (quotMap f hf) = quotMap (twist k p f) (twist_mem_of_mem p hf)
proof:
:= by
  rw [twist_apply, proj_eq_homProj, proj_eq_homProj, homProj_quotMap, homProj_quotMap,
    ← quotMap_smul, ← quotMap_add]
  exact (quotMap_congr (by rw [twist_apply, proj_eq_homProj, proj_eq_homProj]) _).symm

name: StringDiagrams.QTwoEnvelope.comp_shift
statement: @[simp] theorem comp_shift (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) : (f ≫ g).shift = f.shift + g.shift

name: StringDiagrams.QTwoEnvelope.comp_obj
statement: @[simp] theorem comp_obj (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) : (f ≫ g).obj = f.obj ≫ g.obj

name: StringDiagrams.QTwoEnvelope.id_shift
statement: @[simp] theorem id_shift (a : QTwoEnvelope R B) : (𝟙 a : a ⟶ a).shift = 0

name: StringDiagrams.QTwoEnvelope.id_obj
statement: @[simp] theorem id_obj (a : QTwoEnvelope R B) : (𝟙 a : a ⟶ a).obj = 𝟙 a.as

name: StringDiagrams.QTwoEnvelope.toHom_whiskerLeft
statement:
theorem toHom_whiskerLeft (f : a ⟶ b) {g h : b ⟶ c} (η : g ⟶ h) :
    toHom (f ◁ η) = f.obj ◁ toHom η

name: StringDiagrams.QTwoEnvelope.toHom_whiskerRight
statement:
theorem toHom_whiskerRight {f g : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ g) (h : b ⟶ c) :
    toHom (η ▷ h) = toHom η ▷ h.obj

name: StringDiagrams.QTwoEnvelope.toHom_associator_hom
statement:
@[simp] theorem toHom_associator_hom (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) (h : c ⟶ d) :
    toHom (associator f g h).hom = (associator f.obj g.obj h.obj).hom

name: StringDiagrams.QTwoEnvelope.toHom_associator_inv
statement:
@[simp] theorem toHom_associator_inv (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) (h : c ⟶ d) :
    toHom (associator f g h).inv = (associator f.obj g.obj h.obj).inv

name: StringDiagrams.QTwoEnvelope.toHom_leftUnitor_hom
statement:
@[simp] theorem toHom_leftUnitor_hom (f : a ⟶ b) :
    toHom (leftUnitor f).hom = (leftUnitor f.obj).hom

name: StringDiagrams.QTwoEnvelope.toHom_leftUnitor_inv
statement:
@[simp] theorem toHom_leftUnitor_inv (f : a ⟶ b) :
    toHom (leftUnitor f).inv = (leftUnitor f.obj).inv

name: StringDiagrams.QTwoEnvelope.toHom_rightUnitor_hom
statement:
@[simp] theorem toHom_rightUnitor_hom (f : a ⟶ b) :
    toHom (rightUnitor f).hom = (rightUnitor f.obj).hom

name: StringDiagrams.QTwoEnvelope.toHom_rightUnitor_inv
statement:
@[simp] theorem toHom_rightUnitor_inv (f : a ⟶ b) :
    toHom (rightUnitor f).inv = (rightUnitor f.obj).inv

name: StringDiagrams.QTwoEnvelope.Jm_eq
statement: theorem Jm_eq {a b : B} (f : a ⟶ b) : Jm (R := R) f = (J R (a ⟶ b)).obj f

name: StringDiagrams.QTwoEnvelope.J2_eq
statement: theorem J2_eq {a b : B} {f g : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ g) : J2 (R := R) η = (J R (a ⟶ b)).map η

name: StringDiagrams.QTwoEnvelope.J2_whiskerRight
statement:
theorem J2_whiskerRight {a b c : B} {f g : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ g) (h : b ⟶ c) :
    J2 (R := R) η ▷ Jm h = J2 (η ▷ h)

name: StringDiagrams.QTwoEnvelope.J2_whiskerLeft
statement:
theorem J2_whiskerLeft {a b c : B} (f : a ⟶ b) {g h : b ⟶ c} (η : g ⟶ h) :
    Jm (R := R) f ◁ J2 η = J2 (f ◁ η)

name: StringDiagrams.QTwoEnvelope.twoJ_isStrict
statement:
theorem twoJ_isStrict : (twoJ R B).IsStrict where
  map_comp _ _
proof:
:= rfl
  map_id _ := rfl
  mapComp_eq _ _ := Iso.ext rfl
  mapId_eq _ := Iso.ext rfl

name: StringDiagrams.QTwoEnvelope.restrict_eq_comp
statement:
theorem restrict_eq_comp (T : TwoSuperfunctor R (QTwoEnvelope R B) C) :
    restrict T = (twoJ R B).comp T
proof:
:= by
  refine TwoEnvelope.twoSuperfunctor_ext rfl HEq.rfl HEq.rfl (heq_of_eq ?_) (heq_of_eq ?_)
  · funext a b c f g
    apply Iso.ext
    show (T.mapComp (Jm (R := R) f) (Jm g)).hom = (T.mapComp (Jm f) (Jm g)).hom ≫
      T.map₂ (𝟙 (Jm (R := R) f ≫ Jm g))
    rw [T.map₂_id]
    erw [Category.comp_id]
  · funext a
    apply Iso.ext
    show (T.mapId ⟨a⟩).hom = (T.mapId ⟨a⟩).hom ≫ T.map₂ (𝟙 (𝟙 (⟨a⟩ : QTwoEnvelope R B)))
    rw [T.map₂_id]
    erw [Category.comp_id]

name: StringDiagrams.QTwoEnvelope.σF_hom_mem
statement: theorem σF_hom_mem (f : a ⟶ b) : (σF F f).hom ∈ parity (R := R) _ _ 0

name: StringDiagrams.QTwoEnvelope.σF_inv_mem
statement: theorem σF_inv_mem (f : a ⟶ b) : (σF F f).inv ∈ parity (R := R) _ _ 0

name: StringDiagrams.QTwoEnvelope.extendFunctor_map
statement:
theorem extendFunctor_map {f g : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ g) :
    (extendFunctor F a b).map η = (σF F f).hom ≫ F.map₂ (toHom η) ≫ (σF F g).inv

name: StringDiagrams.QTwoEnvelope.extendCompAux_inv
statement:
theorem extendCompAux_inv (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) :
    extendCompAux F f g ≫ extendCompAuxInv F f g = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  simp only [extendCompAux, extendCompAuxInv, Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc,
    Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc, TwoEnvelope.whiskerLeft_hom_inv'_assoc R,
    TwoEnvelope.hom_inv_whiskerRight' R]

name: StringDiagrams.QTwoEnvelope.extendCompAuxInv_aux
statement:
theorem extendCompAuxInv_aux (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) :
    extendCompAuxInv F f g ≫ extendCompAux F f g = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  simp only [extendCompAux, extendCompAuxInv, Category.assoc,
    TwoEnvelope.inv_hom_whiskerRight'_assoc R, TwoEnvelope.whiskerLeft_inv_hom'_assoc R,
    Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id]

name: StringDiagrams.QTwoEnvelope.extendComp_hom
statement:
theorem extendComp_hom (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) :
    (extendComp F f g).hom = (σF F f).hom ▷ (extendFunctor F b c).obj g ≫
      F.map f.obj ◁ (σF F g).hom ≫ (F.mapComp f.obj g.obj).hom ≫ (σF F (f ≫ g)).inv

name: StringDiagrams.QTwoEnvelope.extendComp_hom_mem
statement:
theorem extendComp_hom_mem (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) :
    (extendComp F f g).hom ∈ parity (R := R) _ _ 0
proof:
:= by
  have := comp_mem (whiskerRight_mem ((extendFunctor F b c).obj g) (σF_hom_mem F f))
    (comp_mem (whiskerLeft_mem (F.map f.obj) (σF_hom_mem F g))
      (comp_mem (F.mapComp_hom_mem f.obj g.obj) (σF_inv_mem F (f ≫ g))))
  rw [extendComp_hom]
  simpa using this

name: StringDiagrams.QTwoEnvelope.extendComp_naturality_left
statement:
theorem extendComp_naturality_left {f f' : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ f') (g : b ⟶ c) :
    (extendFunctor F a b).map η ▷ (extendFunctor F b c).obj g ≫ (extendComp F f' g).hom =
      (extendComp F f g).hom ≫ (extendFunctor F a c).map (η ▷ g)
proof:
:= by
  rw [extendComp_hom, extendComp_hom, extendFunctor_map, extendFunctor_map, toHom_whiskerRight]
  simp only [comp_whiskerRight (R := R), Category.assoc,
    TwoEnvelope.inv_hom_whiskerRight'_assoc R, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
  rw [reassoc_of% (TwoEnvelope.interchange_even_right R (F.map₂ (toHom η)) (σF_hom_mem F g)),
    F.mapComp_naturality_left_assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.QTwoEnvelope.extendComp_naturality_right
statement:
theorem extendComp_naturality_right (f : a ⟶ b) {g g' : b ⟶ c} (θ : g ⟶ g') :
    (extendFunctor F a b).obj f ◁ (extendFunctor F b c).map θ ≫ (extendComp F f g').hom =
      (extendComp F f g).hom ≫ (extendFunctor F a c).map (f ◁ θ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [extendComp_hom, extendComp_hom, extendFunctor_map, extendFunctor_map, toHom_whiskerLeft,
    ← reassoc_of% (TwoEnvelope.interchange_even_left R (σF_hom_mem F f)
      ((σF F g).hom ≫ F.map₂ (toHom θ) ≫ (σF F g').inv))]
  simp only [whiskerLeft_comp (R := R), Category.assoc,
    TwoEnvelope.whiskerLeft_inv_hom'_assoc R, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
  rw [F.mapComp_naturality_right_assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.QTwoEnvelope.extendComp_J
statement:
theorem extendComp_J (f : a.as ⟶ b.as) (g : b.as ⟶ c.as) :
    (extendComp F (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) ((J R _).obj f) ((J R _).obj g)).hom =
      (F.mapComp f g).hom
proof:
:= by
  show 𝟙 (F.map f) ▷ F.map g ≫ F.map f ◁ 𝟙 (F.map g) ≫ (F.mapComp f g).hom ≫ 𝟙 _ = _
  rw [id_whiskerRight (R := R), whiskerLeft_id (R := R), Category.id_comp, Category.id_comp,
    Category.comp_id]

name: StringDiagrams.QTwoEnvelope.extendComp_J_comp_left
statement:
theorem extendComp_J_comp_left (f : a.as ⟶ b.as) (g : b.as ⟶ c.as) (h : c.as ⟶ d.as) :
    (extendComp F (a := a) (b := c) (c := d)
      (((J R _).obj f : a ⟶ b) ≫ ((J R _).obj g : b ⟶ c)) ((J R _).obj h)).hom =
      (F.mapComp (f ≫ g) h).hom
proof:
:= by
  show 𝟙 (F.map (f ≫ g)) ▷ F.map h ≫ F.map (f ≫ g) ◁ 𝟙 (F.map h) ≫
    (F.mapComp (f ≫ g) h).hom ≫ 𝟙 _ = _
  rw [id_whiskerRight (R := R), whiskerLeft_id (R := R), Category.id_comp, Category.id_comp,
    Category.comp_id]

name: StringDiagrams.QTwoEnvelope.extendComp_J_comp_right
statement:
theorem extendComp_J_comp_right (f : a.as ⟶ b.as) (g : b.as ⟶ c.as) (h : c.as ⟶ d.as) :
    (extendComp F (a := a) (b := b) (c := d) ((J R _).obj f)
      (((J R _).obj g : b ⟶ c) ≫ ((J R _).obj h : c ⟶ d))).hom =
      (F.mapComp f (g ≫ h)).hom
proof:
:= by
  show 𝟙 (F.map f) ▷ F.map (g ≫ h) ≫ F.map f ◁ 𝟙 (F.map (g ≫ h)) ≫
    (F.mapComp f (g ≫ h)).hom ≫ 𝟙 _ = _
  rw [id_whiskerRight (R := R), whiskerLeft_id (R := R), Category.id_comp, Category.id_comp,
    Category.comp_id]

name: StringDiagrams.QTwoEnvelope.extendFunctor_map_J
StringDiagrams.QTwoEnvelope.assocL_nat₁
statement:
theorem assocL_nat₁ {f f' : a ⟶ b} (u : f ⟶ f') (g : b ⟶ c) (h : c ⟶ d) :
    (F̃ a b).map u ▷ ((F̃ b c).obj g ≫ (F̃ c d).obj h) ≫ assocL F f' g h =
      assocL F f g h ≫ (F̃ a d).map ((u ▷ g) ▷ h)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [assocL]
  rw [← Category.assoc, TwoEnvelope.interchange_even_right R _ (extendComp_hom_mem F g h),
    Category.assoc, reassoc_of% (extendComp_naturality_left F u (g ≫ h)), ← Functor.map_comp,
    associator_inv_naturality_left R, Functor.map_comp]
  simp only [Category.assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.QTwoEnvelope.assocR_nat₁
statement:
theorem assocR_nat₁ {f f' : a ⟶ b} (u : f ⟶ f') (g : b ⟶ c) (h : c ⟶ d) :
    (F̃ a b).map u ▷ ((F̃ b c).obj g ≫ (F̃ c d).obj h) ≫ assocR F f' g h =
      assocR F f g h ≫ (F̃ a d).map ((u ▷ g) ▷ h)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [assocR]
  rw [associator_inv_naturality_left_assoc R, TwoEnvelope.comp_whiskerRight_comp R,
    extendComp_naturality_left, ← TwoEnvelope.comp_whiskerRight_comp R,
    extendComp_naturality_left]
  simp only [Category.assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.QTwoEnvelope.assocL_nat₂
statement:
theorem assocL_nat₂ (f : a ⟶ b) {g g' : b ⟶ c} (v : g ⟶ g') (h : c ⟶ d) :
    (F̃ a b).obj f ◁ ((F̃ b c).map v ▷ (F̃ c d).obj h) ≫ assocL F f g' h =
      assocL F f g h ≫ (F̃ a d).map ((f ◁ v) ▷ h)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [assocL]
  rw [TwoEnvelope.whiskerLeft_comp_comp R, extendComp_naturality_left,
    ← TwoEnvelope.whiskerLeft_comp_comp R, reassoc_of% (extendComp_naturality_right F f (v ▷ h)),
    ← Functor.map_comp, associator_inv_naturality_middle R, Functor.map_comp]
  simp only [Category.assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.QTwoEnvelope.assocR_nat₂
statement:
theorem assocR_nat₂ (f : a ⟶ b) {g g' : b ⟶ c} (v : g ⟶ g') (h : c ⟶ d) :
    (F̃ a b).obj f ◁ ((F̃ b c).map v ▷ (F̃ c d).obj h) ≫ assocR F f g' h =
      assocR F f g h ≫ (F̃ a d).map ((f ◁ v) ▷ h)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [assocR]
  rw [associator_inv_naturality_middle_assoc R, TwoEnvelope.comp_whiskerRight_comp R,
    extendComp_naturality_right, ← TwoEnvelope.comp_whiskerRight_comp R,
    extendComp_naturality_left]
  simp only [Category.assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.QTwoEnvelope.assocL_nat₃
statement:
theorem assocL_nat₃ (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) {h h' : c ⟶ d} (w : h ⟶ h') :
    (F̃ a b).obj f ◁ (F̃ b c).obj g ◁ (F̃ c d).map w ≫ assocL F f g h' =
      assocL F f g h ≫ (F̃ a d).map ((f ≫ g) ◁ w)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [assocL]
  rw [TwoEnvelope.whiskerLeft_comp_comp R, extendComp_naturality_right,
    ← TwoEnvelope.whiskerLeft_comp_comp R,
    reassoc_of% (extendComp_naturality_right F f (g ◁ w)), ← Functor.map_comp,
    associator_inv_naturality_right R, Functor.map_comp]
  simp only [Category.assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.QTwoEnvelope.assocR_nat₃
statement:
theorem assocR_nat₃ (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) {h h' : c ⟶ d} (w : h ⟶ h') :
    (F̃ a b).obj f ◁ (F̃ b c).obj g ◁ (F̃ c d).map w ≫ assocR F f g h' =
      assocR F f g h ≫ (F̃ a d).map ((f ≫ g) ◁ w)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [assocR]
  rw [associator_inv_naturality_right_assoc R,
    ← reassoc_of% (TwoEnvelope.interchange_even_left R (extendComp_hom_mem F f g)
      ((F̃ c d).map w)),
    extendComp_naturality_right]
  simp only [Category.assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.QTwoEnvelope.assocL_eq_assocR
statement:
theorem assocL_eq_assocR (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) (h : c ⟶ d) :
    assocL F f g h = assocR F f g h
proof:
:= by
  have e₁ : Epi ((F̃ a b).map (shiftIso f).hom ▷ ((F̃ b c).obj g ≫ (F̃ c d).obj h)) :=
    (inferInstance : Epi (whiskerRightIso (R := R) ((F̃ a b).mapIso (shiftIso f)) _).hom)
  refine TwoEnvelope.eq_of_conj_hom _ e₁ _ (assocL_nat₁ F (shiftIso f).hom g h)
    (assocR_nat₁ F (shiftIso f).hom g h) ?_
  have e₂ : Epi ((F̃ a b).obj ((J R _).obj f.obj) ◁
      ((F̃ b c).map (shiftIso g).hom ▷ (F̃ c d).obj h)) :=
    (inferInstance : Epi (whiskerLeftIso (R := R) _ (whiskerRightIso (R := R)
      ((F̃ b c).mapIso (shiftIso g)) ((F̃ c d).obj h))).hom)
  refine TwoEnvelope.eq_of_conj_hom _ e₂ _ (assocL_nat₂ F _ (shiftIso g).hom h)
    (assocR_nat₂ F _ (shiftIso g).hom h) ?_
  have e₃ : Epi ((F̃ a b).obj ((J R _).obj f.obj) ◁ (F̃ b c).obj ((J R _).obj g.obj) ◁
      (F̃ c d).map (shiftIso h).hom) :=
    (inferInstance : Epi (whiskerLeftIso (R := R) _ (whiskerLeftIso (R := R) _
      ((F̃ c d).mapIso (shiftIso h)))).hom)
  refine TwoEnvelope.eq_of_conj_hom _ e₃ _ (assocL_nat₃ F _ _ (shiftIso h).hom)
    (assocR_nat₃ F _ _ (shiftIso h).hom) ?_
  simp only [assocL, assocR]
  rw [extendComp_J, extendComp_J, extendComp_J_comp_left, extendComp_J_comp_right]
  have e : (F̃ a d).map (associator ((J R _).obj f.obj : a ⟶ b) ((J R _).obj g.obj : b ⟶ c)
      ((J R _).obj h.obj : c ⟶ d)).inv = F.map₂ (associator f.obj g.obj h.obj).inv := by
    show 𝟙 _ ≫ F.map₂ _ ≫ 𝟙 _ = _
    rw [Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id]; rfl
  rw [e]
  exact F.map₂_associator f.obj g.obj h.obj

name: StringDiagrams.QTwoEnvelope.extendComp_id_J
statement:
theorem extendComp_id_J (f : a.as ⟶ b.as) :
    (extendComp F (𝟙 a) ((J R _).obj f : a ⟶ b)).hom = (F.mapComp (𝟙 a.as) f).hom
proof:
:= by
  show 𝟙 (F.map (𝟙 a.as)) ▷ F.map f ≫ F.map (𝟙 a.as) ◁ 𝟙 (F.map f) ≫
    (F.mapComp (𝟙 a.as) f).hom ≫ 𝟙 _ = _
  rw [id_whiskerRight (R := R), whiskerLeft_id (R := R), Category.id_comp, Category.id_comp,
    Category.comp_id]

name: StringDiagrams.QTwoEnvelope.extendComp_J_id
statement:
theorem extendComp_J_id (f : a.as ⟶ b.as) :
    (extendComp F ((J R _).obj f : a ⟶ b) (𝟙 b)).hom = (F.mapComp f (𝟙 b.as)).hom
proof:
:= by
  show 𝟙 (F.map f) ▷ F.map (𝟙 b.as) ≫ F.map f ◁ 𝟙 (F.map (𝟙 b.as)) ≫
    (F.mapComp f (𝟙 b.as)).hom ≫ 𝟙 _ = _
  rw [id_whiskerRight (R := R), whiskerLeft_id (R := R), Category.id_comp, Category.id_comp,
    Category.comp_id]

name: StringDiagrams.QTwoEnvelope.extend_leftUnitor
statement:
theorem extend_leftUnitor (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (F.mapId a.as).hom ▷ (F̃ a b).obj f ≫ (extendComp F (𝟙 a) f).hom ≫
        (F̃ a b).map (leftUnitor f).hom = (leftUnitor ((F̃ a b).obj f)).hom
proof:
:= by
  have nat : ∀ {f f' : a ⟶ b} (u : f ⟶ f'), 𝟙 _ ◁ (F̃ a b).map u ≫
      ((F.mapId a.as).hom ▷ (F̃ a b).obj f' ≫ (extendComp F (𝟙 a) f').hom ≫
        (F̃ a b).map (leftUnitor f').hom) =
      ((F.mapId a.as).hom ▷ (F̃ a b).obj f ≫ (extendComp F (𝟙 a) f).hom ≫
        (F̃ a b).map (leftUnitor f).hom) ≫ (F̃ a b).map u := by
    intro f f' u
    rw [← reassoc_of% (TwoEnvelope.interchange_even_left R (F.mapId_hom_mem a.as)
      ((F̃ a b).map u))]
    erw [reassoc_of% (extendComp_naturality_right F (𝟙 a) u)]
    rw [← Functor.map_comp, leftUnitor_naturality R, Functor.map_comp]
    simp only [Category.assoc]
  have e₁ : Epi (𝟙 (F.obj a.as) ◁ (F̃ a b).map (shiftIso f).hom) :=
    (inferInstance : Epi (whiskerLeftIso (R := R) _ ((F̃ a b).mapIso (shiftIso f))).hom)
  refine TwoEnvelope.eq_of_conj_hom _ e₁ _ (nat (shiftIso f).hom) (leftUnitor_naturality R _) ?_
  rw [extendComp_id_J]
  have e : (F̃ a b).map (leftUnitor ((J R _).obj f.obj : a ⟶ b)).hom =
      F.map₂ (leftUnitor f.obj).hom := by
    show 𝟙 _ ≫ F.map₂ _ ≫ 𝟙 _ = _
    rw [Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id]; rfl
  rw [e]
  exact F.map₂_leftUnitor f.obj

name: StringDiagrams.QTwoEnvelope.extend_rightUnitor
statement:
theorem extend_rightUnitor (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (F̃ a b).obj f ◁ (F.mapId b.as).hom ≫ (extendComp F f (𝟙 b)).hom ≫
        (F̃ a b).map (rightUnitor f).hom = (rightUnitor ((F̃ a b).obj f)).hom
proof:
:= by
  have nat : ∀ {f f' : a ⟶ b} (u : f ⟶ f'), (F̃ a b).map u ▷ 𝟙 _ ≫
      ((F̃ a b).obj f' ◁ (F.mapId b.as).hom ≫ (extendComp F f' (𝟙 b)).hom ≫
        (F̃ a b).map (rightUnitor f').hom) =
      ((F̃ a b).obj f ◁ (F.mapId b.as).hom ≫ (extendComp F f (𝟙 b)).hom ≫
        (F̃ a b).map (rightUnitor f).hom) ≫ (F̃ a b).map u := by
    intro f f' u
    rw [reassoc_of% (TwoEnvelope.interchange_even_right R ((F̃ a b).map u)
      (F.mapId_hom_mem b.as))]
    erw [reassoc_of% (extendComp_naturality_left F u (𝟙 b))]
    rw [← Functor.map_comp, rightUnitor_naturality R, Functor.map_comp]
    simp only [Category.assoc]
  have e₁ : Epi ((F̃ a b).map (shiftIso f).hom ▷ 𝟙 (F.obj b.as)) :=
    (inferInstance : Epi (whiskerRightIso (R := R) ((F̃ a b).mapIso (shiftIso f)) _).hom)
  refine TwoEnvelope.eq_of_conj_hom _ e₁ _ (nat (shiftIso f).hom) (rightUnitor_naturality R _) ?_
  rw [extendComp_J_id]
  have e : (F̃ a b).map (rightUnitor ((J R _).obj f.obj : a ⟶ b)).hom =
      F.map₂ (rightUnitor f.obj).hom := by
    show 𝟙 _ ≫ F.map₂ _ ≫ 𝟙 _ = _
    rw [Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id]; rfl
  rw [e]
  exact F.map₂_rightUnitor f.obj

name: StringDiagrams.QTwoEnvelope.extend_obj
statement: @[simp] theorem extend_obj (a : QTwoEnvelope R B) : (extend F).obj a = F.obj a.as

name: StringDiagrams.QTwoEnvelope.extend_map
statement: theorem extend_map (f : a ⟶ b) : (extend F).map f = (F̃ a b).obj f

name: StringDiagrams.QTwoEnvelope.extend_map₂
statement: theorem extend_map₂ {f g : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ g) : (extend F).map₂ η = (F̃ a b).map η

name: StringDiagrams.QTwoEnvelope.extend_map_J
statement:
theorem extend_map_J (f : a.as ⟶ b.as) :
    (extend F).map ((J R _).obj f : a ⟶ b) = F.map f

name: StringDiagrams.QTwoEnvelope.extend_map₂_J
statement:
theorem extend_map₂_J {f g : a.as ⟶ b.as} (η : f ⟶ g) :
    (extend F).map₂ ((J R (a.as ⟶ b.as)).map η : ((J R _).obj f : a ⟶ b) ⟶ (J R _).obj g) =
      F.map₂ η

name: StringDiagrams.QTwoEnvelope.extend_mapId
statement: theorem extend_mapId (a : QTwoEnvelope R B) : (extend F).mapId a = F.mapId a.as

name: StringDiagrams.QTwoEnvelope.twoJ_comp_extend
statement: theorem twoJ_comp_extend : (twoJ R B).comp (extend F) = F
proof:
:= by
  refine TwoEnvelope.twoSuperfunctor_ext rfl HEq.rfl (heq_of_eq ?_) (heq_of_eq ?_)
    (heq_of_eq ?_)
  · funext a b f g η
    show 𝟙 _ ≫ F.map₂ η ≫ 𝟙 _ = _
    rw [Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id]
  · funext a b c f g
    apply Iso.ext
    show (extendComp F (Jm (R := R) f) (Jm g)).hom ≫
      (extend F).map₂ (𝟙 (Jm (R := R) f ≫ Jm g)) = _
    rw [(extend F).map₂_id]
    erw [Category.comp_id]
    exact extendComp_J F (a := ⟨a⟩) (b := ⟨b⟩) (c := ⟨c⟩) f g
  · funext a
    apply Iso.ext
    show (F.mapId a).hom ≫ (extend F).map₂ (𝟙 (𝟙 (⟨a⟩ : QTwoEnvelope R B))) = _
    rw [(extend F).map₂_id]
    erw [Category.comp_id]

name: StringDiagrams.QTwoEnvelope.restrict_extend
statement: theorem restrict_extend : restrict (extend F) = F

name: StringDiagrams.QTwoEnvelope.extendX_mem
statement:
theorem extendX_mem (θ : TwoNatTrans F G) (f : a ⟶ b) :
    extendX θ f ∈ parity (R := R) _ _ 0
proof:
:= by
  have := comp_mem (whiskerRight_mem (θ.X b.as) (σF_hom_mem F f))
    (comp_mem (θ.x_mem f.obj) (whiskerLeft_mem (θ.X a.as) (σF_inv_mem G f)))
  simpa using! this

name: StringDiagrams.QTwoEnvelope.extendX_naturality
statement:
theorem extendX_naturality (θ : TwoNatTrans F G) {f g : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ g) :
    (F̃ a b).map η ▷ θ.X b.as ≫ extendX θ g = extendX θ f ≫ θ.X a.as ◁ (G̃ a b).map η
proof:
:= by
  simp only [extendX, extendFunctor_map, comp_whiskerRight (R := R), whiskerLeft_comp (R := R),
    Category.assoc, TwoEnvelope.inv_hom_whiskerRight'_assoc R,
    TwoEnvelope.whiskerLeft_inv_hom'_assoc R]
  rw [reassoc_of% (θ.naturality (toHom η))]

name: StringDiagrams.QTwoEnvelope.extendX_J
statement:
theorem extendX_J (θ : TwoNatTrans F G) (f : a.as ⟶ b.as) :
    extendX θ ((J R _).obj f : a ⟶ b) = θ.x f
proof:
:= by
  show 𝟙 (F.map f) ▷ θ.X b.as ≫ θ.x f ≫ θ.X a.as ◁ 𝟙 (G.map f) = _
  rw [id_whiskerRight (R := R), whiskerLeft_id (R := R), Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id]

name: StringDiagrams.QTwoEnvelope.extendX_J_comp
statement:
theorem extendX_J_comp (θ : TwoNatTrans F G) (f : a.as ⟶ b.as) (g : b.as ⟶ c.as) :
    extendX θ (((J R _).obj f : a ⟶ b) ≫ ((J R _).obj g : b ⟶ c)) = θ.x (f ≫ g)
proof:
:= by
  show 𝟙 (F.map (f ≫ g)) ▷ θ.X c.as ≫ θ.x (f ≫ g) ≫ θ.X a.as ◁ 𝟙 (G.map (f ≫ g)) = _
  rw [id_whiskerRight (R := R), whiskerLeft_id (R := R), Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id]

name: StringDiagrams.QTwoEnvelope.compL_nat₁
statement:
theorem compL_nat₁ {f f' : a ⟶ b} (u : f ⟶ f') (g : b ⟶ c) :
    ((F̃ a b).map u ▷ (F̃ b c).obj g) ▷ θ.X c.as ≫ compL θ f' g =
      compL θ f g ≫ θ.X a.as ◁ (G̃ a c).map (u ▷ g)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [compL]
  rw [TwoEnvelope.comp_whiskerRight_comp R, extendComp_naturality_left,
    ← TwoEnvelope.comp_whiskerRight_comp R, extendX_naturality]
  simp only [Category.assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.QTwoEnvelope.compR_nat₁
statement:
theorem compR_nat₁ {f f' : a ⟶ b} (u : f ⟶ f') (g : b ⟶ c) :
    ((F̃ a b).map u ▷ (F̃ b c).obj g) ▷ θ.X c.as ≫ compR θ f' g =
      compR θ f g ≫ θ.X a.as ◁ (G̃ a c).map (u ▷ g)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [compR]
  rw [associator_naturality_left_assoc R,
    reassoc_of% (TwoEnvelope.interchange_even_right R ((F̃ a b).map u) (extendX_mem θ g)),
    associator_inv_naturality_left_assoc R, TwoEnvelope.comp_whiskerRight_comp R,
    extendX_naturality, ← TwoEnvelope.comp_whiskerRight_comp R,
    associator_naturality_middle_assoc R, ← whiskerLeft_comp (R := R),
    extendComp_naturality_left, whiskerLeft_comp (R := R)]
  simp only [Category.assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.QTwoEnvelope.compL_nat₂
statement:
theorem compL_nat₂ (f : a ⟶ b) {g g' : b ⟶ c} (v : g ⟶ g') :
    ((F̃ a b).obj f ◁ (F̃ b c).map v) ▷ θ.X c.as ≫ compL θ f g' =
      compL θ f g ≫ θ.X a.as ◁ (G̃ a c).map (f ◁ v)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [compL]
  rw [TwoEnvelope.comp_whiskerRight_comp R, extendComp_naturality_right,
    ← TwoEnvelope.comp_whiskerRight_comp R, extendX_naturality]
  simp only [Category.assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.QTwoEnvelope.compR_nat₂
statement:
theorem compR_nat₂ (f : a ⟶ b) {g g' : b ⟶ c} (v : g ⟶ g') :
    ((F̃ a b).obj f ◁ (F̃ b c).map v) ▷ θ.X c.as ≫ compR θ f g' =
      compR θ f g ≫ θ.X a.as ◁ (G̃ a c).map (f ◁ v)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [compR]
  rw [associator_naturality_middle_assoc R, TwoEnvelope.whiskerLeft_comp_comp R,
    extendX_naturality, ← TwoEnvelope.whiskerLeft_comp_comp R,
    associator_inv_naturality_right_assoc R,
    ← reassoc_of% (TwoEnvelope.interchange_even_left R (extendX_mem θ f) ((G̃ b c).map v)),
    associator_naturality_right_assoc R, ← whiskerLeft_comp (R := R),
    extendComp_naturality_right, whiskerLeft_comp (R := R)]
  simp only [Category.assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.QTwoEnvelope.compL_eq_compR
statement: theorem compL_eq_compR (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) : compL θ f g = compR θ f g
proof:
:= by
  have e₁ : Epi (((F̃ a b).map (shiftIso f).hom ▷ (F̃ b c).obj g) ▷ θ.X c.as) :=
    (inferInstance : Epi (whiskerRightIso (R := R) (whiskerRightIso (R := R)
      ((F̃ a b).mapIso (shiftIso f)) _) _).hom)
  refine TwoEnvelope.eq_of_conj_hom _ e₁ _ (compL_nat₁ θ (shiftIso f).hom g)
    (compR_nat₁ θ (shiftIso f).hom g) ?_
  have e₂ : Epi (((F̃ a b).obj ((J R _).obj f.obj) ◁ (F̃ b c).map (shiftIso g).hom) ▷
      θ.X c.as) :=
    (inferInstance : Epi (whiskerRightIso (R := R) (whiskerLeftIso (R := R) _
      ((F̃ b c).mapIso (shiftIso g))) _).hom)
  refine TwoEnvelope.eq_of_conj_hom _ e₂ _ (compL_nat₂ θ _ (shiftIso g).hom)
    (compR_nat₂ θ _ (shiftIso g).hom) ?_
  simp only [compL, compR]
  rw [extendComp_J, extendComp_J, extendX_J, extendX_J, extendX_J_comp]
  exact θ.x_comp f.obj g.obj

name: StringDiagrams.QTwoEnvelope.extendTwoNatTrans_X
statement:
@[simp] theorem extendTwoNatTrans_X (θ : TwoNatTrans F G) (a : QTwoEnvelope R B) :
    (extendTwoNatTrans θ).X a = θ.X a.as

name: StringDiagrams.QTwoEnvelope.extendTwoNatTrans_x
statement:
theorem extendTwoNatTrans_x (θ : TwoNatTrans F G) (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (extendTwoNatTrans θ).x f = extendX θ f

name: StringDiagrams.QTwoEnvelope.extendTwoNatTrans_x_J
statement:
theorem extendTwoNatTrans_x_J (θ : TwoNatTrans F G) (f : a.as ⟶ b.as) :
    (extendTwoNatTrans θ).x ((J R _).obj f : a ⟶ b) = θ.x f

name: StringDiagrams.QTwoEnvelope.restrictTwoNatTrans_X
statement:
@[simp] theorem restrictTwoNatTrans_X (ψ : TwoNatTrans (extend F) (extend G)) (a : B) :
    (restrictTwoNatTrans ψ).X a = ψ.X ⟨a⟩

name: StringDiagrams.QTwoEnvelope.restrictTwoNatTrans_x
statement:
theorem restrictTwoNatTrans_x (ψ : TwoNatTrans (extend F) (extend G)) {a b : B} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (restrictTwoNatTrans ψ).x f =
      ψ.x ((J R (a ⟶ b)).obj f : (⟨a⟩ : QTwoEnvelope R B) ⟶ ⟨b⟩)

name: StringDiagrams.QTwoEnvelope.restrictTwoNatTrans_extendTwoNatTrans
statement:
theorem restrictTwoNatTrans_extendTwoNatTrans (θ : TwoNatTrans F G) :
    restrictTwoNatTrans (extendTwoNatTrans θ) = θ
proof:
:=
  TwoEnvelope.twoNatTrans_ext rfl fun {a b} f =>
    heq_of_eq (extendX_J (a := (⟨a⟩ : QTwoEnvelope R B)) (b := ⟨b⟩) θ f)

name: StringDiagrams.QTwoEnvelope.extendTwoNatTrans_restrictTwoNatTrans
statement:
theorem extendTwoNatTrans_restrictTwoNatTrans (ψ : TwoNatTrans (extend F) (extend G)) :
    extendTwoNatTrans (restrictTwoNatTrans ψ) = ψ
proof:
:= by
  refine TwoEnvelope.twoNatTrans_ext rfl fun {a b} f => heq_of_eq ?_
  have h := ψ.naturality (shiftIso f).inv
  have e₁ : (extend F).map₂ (shiftIso f).inv = (σF F f).hom := by
    show (σF F f).hom ≫ F.map₂ (𝟙 f.obj) ≫ 𝟙 _ = _
    rw [F.map₂_id, Category.comp_id, Category.comp_id]
  have e₂ : (extend G).map₂ (shiftIso f).inv = (σF G f).hom := by
    show (σF G f).hom ≫ G.map₂ (𝟙 f.obj) ≫ 𝟙 _ = _
    rw [G.map₂_id, Category.comp_id, Category.comp_id]
  rw [e₁, e₂] at h
  show (σF F f).hom ▷ ψ.X b ≫ ψ.x ((J R _).obj f.obj) ≫ ψ.X a ◁ (σF G f).inv = ψ.x f
  rw [reassoc_of% h, TwoEnvelope.whiskerLeft_hom_inv' R, Category.comp_id]

name: StringDiagrams.QTwoEnvelope.extendTwoNatTrans_unique
statement:
theorem extendTwoNatTrans_unique (θ : TwoNatTrans F G) (ψ : TwoNatTrans (extend F) (extend G))
    (h : restrictTwoNatTrans ψ = θ) : ψ = extendTwoNatTrans θ

name: StringDiagrams.QTwoEnvelope.extendTwoNatTrans_id
statement:
theorem extendTwoNatTrans_id :
    extendTwoNatTrans (TwoNatTrans.id F) = TwoNatTrans.id (extend F)

name: StringDiagrams.QTwoEnvelope.extendTwoNatTrans_vcomp
statement:
theorem extendTwoNatTrans_vcomp {H : TwoSuperfunctor R B C} (θ : TwoNatTrans F G)
    (θ' : TwoNatTrans G H) :
    extendTwoNatTrans (TwoNatTrans.vcomp θ θ') =
      TwoNatTrans.vcomp (extendTwoNatTrans θ) (extendTwoNatTrans θ')
proof:
:= by
  rw [← extendTwoNatTrans_restrictTwoNatTrans
    (TwoNatTrans.vcomp (extendTwoNatTrans θ) (extendTwoNatTrans θ'))]
  congr 1
  refine TwoEnvelope.twoNatTrans_ext rfl fun {a b} f => heq_of_eq ?_
  rw [restrictTwoNatTrans_x, TwoNatTrans.vcomp_x, TwoNatTrans.vcomp_x]
  have h₁ : (extendTwoNatTrans θ).x
      ((J R (a ⟶ b)).obj f : (⟨a⟩ : QTwoEnvelope R B) ⟶ ⟨b⟩) = θ.x f :=
    extendX_J (a := (⟨a⟩ : QTwoEnvelope R B)) (b := ⟨b⟩) θ f
  have h₂ : (extendTwoNatTrans θ').x
      ((J R (a ⟶ b)).obj f : (⟨a⟩ : QTwoEnvelope R B) ⟶ ⟨b⟩) = θ'.x f :=
    extendX_J (a := (⟨a⟩ : QTwoEnvelope R B)) (b := ⟨b⟩) θ' f
  rw [h₁, h₂]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.QTwoEnvelope.extend_naturality
statement:
theorem extend_naturality {θ θ' : TwoNatTrans F G} (α : θ ⟶ θ') (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (extendTwoNatTrans θ).x f ≫ α.app a.as ▷ (extend G).map f =
      (extend F).map f ◁ α.app b.as ≫ (extendTwoNatTrans θ').x f
proof:
:= by
  simp only [extendTwoNatTrans_x, extendX, extend_map, Category.assoc]
  rw [← TwoEnvelope.interchange_even_right R (α.app a.as) (σF_inv_mem G f),
    reassoc_of% (α.naturality f.obj), ← Category.assoc ((σF F f).hom ▷ _),
    TwoEnvelope.interchange_even_left R (σF_hom_mem F f) (α.app b.as)]
  simp only [Category.assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.QTwoEnvelope.extendSupermodification_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem extendSupermodification_app {θ θ' : TwoNatTrans F G} (α : θ ⟶ θ')
    (a : QTwoEnvelope R B) : (extendSupermodification α).app a = α.app a.as

name: StringDiagrams.QTwoEnvelope.eqToHom_mem
statement:
theorem eqToHom_mem {F' G' : TwoSuperfunctor R (QTwoEnvelope R B) C} {θ θ' : TwoNatTrans F' G'}
    (h : θ = θ') : (eqToIso h).hom ∈ parity (R := R) θ θ' 0

name: StringDiagrams.QTwoEnvelope.extendHom_evenlyDense
statement: theorem extendHom_evenlyDense : EvenlyDense R (extendHom F G)
proof:
:= fun ψ =>
  ⟨restrictTwoNatTrans ψ, eqToIso (extendTwoNatTrans_restrictTwoNatTrans ψ),
    eqToHom_mem (extendTwoNatTrans_restrictTwoNatTrans ψ)⟩

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.rebase_X
statement:
theorem rebase_X (h : F = F') (j : G = G') (θ : TwoNatTrans F G) (a : A) :
    HEq ((rebase h j θ).X a) (θ.X a)

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.rebase_x
statement:
theorem rebase_x (h : F = F') (j : G = G') (θ : TwoNatTrans F G)
    {a b : A} (f : a ⟶ b) : HEq ((rebase h j θ).x f) (θ.x f)

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.rebase_heq
statement:
theorem rebase_heq (h : F = F') (j : G = G') (θ : TwoNatTrans F G) :
    HEq (rebase h j θ) θ

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.rebase_isStrong
statement:
theorem rebase_isStrong (h : F = F') (j : G = G') (θ : TwoNatTrans F G)
    (hθ : θ.IsStrong) : (rebase h j θ).IsStrong
proof:
:= by
  subst h j
  exact hθ

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.rebase_isGraded
statement:
theorem rebase_isGraded [∀ a b : B, GradedSupercategory R (a ⟶ b)]
    (h : F = F') (j : G = G') (θ : TwoNatTrans F G)
    (hθ : θ.IsGraded) : (rebase h j θ).IsGraded
proof:
:= by
  subst h j
  exact hθ

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.hext
statement:
theorem hext (hF : F = F') (hG : G = G') (θ : TwoNatTrans F G) (ψ : TwoNatTrans F' G')
    (hX : ∀ a, HEq (θ.X a) (ψ.X a))
    (hx : ∀ {a b : A} (f : a ⟶ b), HEq (θ.x f) (ψ.x f)) : HEq θ ψ
proof:
:= by
  subst F' G'
  obtain ⟨X, x, _, _, _, _⟩ := θ
  obtain ⟨Y, y, _, _, _, _⟩ := ψ
  have h : X = Y := funext fun a => eq_of_heq (hX a)
  subst Y
  have h : @x = @y := by
    funext a b f
    exact eq_of_heq (hx f)
  subst y
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.postcompose_heq
statement:
theorem postcompose_heq [TwoSupercategory R C] (hF : F = F') (hG : G = G')
    (H : TwoSuperfunctor R B C)
    {θ : TwoNatTrans F G} {ψ : TwoNatTrans F' G'} (h : HEq θ ψ) :
    HEq (postcompose H θ) (postcompose H ψ)
proof:
:= by
  subst F' G'
  cases eq_of_heq h
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.precompose_heq
statement:
theorem precompose_heq [TwoSupercategory R C] (P : TwoSuperfunctor R A B)
    {F G F' G' : TwoSuperfunctor R B C} (hF : F = F') (hG : G = G')
    {θ : TwoNatTrans F G} {ψ : TwoNatTrans F' G'} (h : HEq θ ψ) :
    HEq (precompose P θ) (precompose P ψ)
proof:
:= by
  subst F' G'
  cases eq_of_heq h
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.postcompose_comp_heq
proof:
:= by
  apply hext (TwoSuperfunctor.comp_assoc F H K).symm
    (TwoSuperfunctor.comp_assoc G H K).symm
  · intro a
    rfl
  · intro a b f
    apply heq_of_eq
    change ((K.mapComp _ _).hom ≫ K.map₂ (H.mapComp _ _).hom) ≫
      K.map₂ (H.map₂ (θ.x f)) ≫
      (K.map₂ (H.mapComp _ _).inv ≫ (K.mapComp _ _).inv) =
      (K.mapComp _ _).hom ≫
      K.map₂ ((H.mapComp _ _).hom ≫ H.map₂ (θ.x f) ≫ (H.mapComp _ _).inv) ≫
      (K.mapComp _ _).inv
    simp only [K.map₂_comp, Category.assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.precompose_postcompose_heq
statement:
theorem precompose_postcompose_heq [TwoSupercategory R C] (P : TwoSuperfunctor R A B)
    {F G : TwoSuperfunctor R B C} (H : TwoSuperfunctor R C D) (θ : TwoNatTrans F G) :
    HEq (precompose P (postcompose H θ)) (postcompose H (precompose P θ))
proof:
:= by
  apply hext (TwoSuperfunctor.comp_assoc P F H).symm
    (TwoSuperfunctor.comp_assoc P G H).symm
  · intro a
    rfl
  · intro a b f
    rfl

name: StringDiagrams.TwoNatTrans.precompose_precompose_heq
statement:
theorem precompose_precompose_heq [TwoSupercategory R C] (P : TwoSuperfunctor R A B) (Q : TwoSuperfunctor R B C)
    {F G : TwoSuperfunctor R C D} (θ : TwoNatTrans F G) :
    HEq (precompose P (precompose Q θ)) (precompose (P.comp Q) θ)
proof:
:= by
  apply hext (TwoSuperfunctor.comp_assoc P Q F).symm
    (TwoSuperfunctor.comp_assoc P Q G).symm
  · intro a
    rfl
  · intro a b f
    rfl

name: StringDiagrams.SuperEnd.tensorObj_def
statement:
theorem tensorObj_def (F G : SuperEnd R A) :
    toSuperfunctor (F ⊗ G) = (toSuperfunctor G).comp (toSuperfunctor F)

name: StringDiagrams.SuperEnd.whiskerLeft_app
statement:
theorem whiskerLeft_app (F : SuperEnd R A) {G K : SuperEnd R A} (y : G ⟶ K) (p : ZMod 2)
    (X : A) : (F ◁ y).app p X = (toSuperfunctor F).map (y.app p X)

name: StringDiagrams.SuperEnd.whiskerRight_app
statement:
theorem whiskerRight_app {F H : SuperEnd R A} (x : F ⟶ H) (G : SuperEnd R A) (p : ZMod 2)
    (X : A) : (x ▷ G).app p X = x.app p ((toSuperfunctor G).obj X)

name: StringDiagrams.SuperEnd.whiskerLeft_whiskerLeft
statement:
theorem whiskerLeft_whiskerLeft (F G : Superfunctor R A A) {H K : Superfunctor R A A}
    (y : H ⟶ K) :
    Superfunctor.whiskerLeft G (Superfunctor.whiskerLeft F y) =
      Superfunctor.whiskerLeft (G.comp F) y

name: StringDiagrams.SuperEnd.whiskerLeft_whiskerRight

theorem whiskerLeft_whiskerRight (F : Superfunctor R A A) {G K : Superfunctor R A A}

name: StringDiagrams.SuperEnd.whiskerRight_id'

name: StringDiagrams.UnitSupercat.trivialDegree_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem trivialDegree_zero : trivialDegree k 0 = ⊤

name: StringDiagrams.UnitSupercat.trivialDegree_of_ne
statement: theorem trivialDegree_of_ne {n : ℤ} (h : n ≠ 0) : trivialDegree k n = ⊥

name: StringDiagrams.UnitSupercat.isInternal_trivialDegree
statement: theorem isInternal_trivialDegree : DirectSum.IsInternal (trivialDegree k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [DirectSum.isInternal_submodule_iff_iSupIndep_and_iSup_eq_top]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [iSupIndep_def]
    intro n
    by_cases h : n = 0
    · subst h
      refine Disjoint.mono_right ?_ disjoint_bot_right
      refine iSup_le fun m => iSup_le fun hm => ?_
      rw [trivialDegree_of_ne k hm]
    · rw [trivialDegree_of_ne k h]
      exact disjoint_bot_left
  · exact eq_top_iff.2 ((trivialDegree_zero k).symm.le.trans (le_iSup (trivialDegree k) 0))

name: StringDiagrams.UnitSupercat.mem_trivialDegree_iff
statement: theorem mem_trivialDegree_iff {n : ℤ} {r : k} : r ∈ trivialDegree k n ↔ n = 0 ∨ r = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : n = 0
  · simp [h]
  · simp [trivialDegree_of_ne k h, h]

name: StringDiagrams.UnitSupercat.mem_degree_iff

name: StringDiagrams.UnitQPiEnvelope.one_mem
statement:
theorem one_mem (m : ℤ) (a : ZMod 2) (n : ℤ) (b : ZMod 2) :
    one (k := k) m a n b ∈ parity (R := k) (P k m a) (P k n b) (a + b)
proof:
:= by
  have := QPiEnvelope.ofHom_mem (R := k) (X := P k m a) (Y := P k n b)
    (UnitSupercat.mem_parity_zero (SuperalgebraCat.ofElem (1 : k)))
  rwa [zero_add] at this

name: StringDiagrams.UnitQPiEnvelope.one_mem_degree
statement:
theorem one_mem_degree (m : ℤ) (a : ZMod 2) (n : ℤ) (b : ZMod 2) :
    one (k := k) m a n b ∈ degree (R := k) (P k m a) (P k n b) (n - m)
proof:
:= by
  have := QPiEnvelope.ofHom_mem_degree (R := k) (X := P k m a) (Y := P k n b)
    (f := SuperalgebraCat.ofElem (1 : k)) (UnitSupercat.mem_degree_iff.2 (Or.inl rfl))
  rwa [zero_add] at this

proof:

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.Superfunctor.mem_parityHom
statement: theorem mem_parityHom {p : ZMod 2} {x : F ⟶ G} : x ∈ parityHom F G p ↔ x.app (p + 1) = 0

statement:
theorem component_app (p : ZMod 2) (x : F ⟶ G) (q : ZMod 2) (X : C) :
    (component p x).app q X = if q = p then x.app p X else 0

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.Superfunctor.component_mem
statement: theorem component_mem (p : ZMod 2) (x : F ⟶ G) : component p x ∈ parityHom F G p
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_parityHom]; funext X
  simp [component_app, zmod2_add_one_ne p]

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.Superfunctor.component_add_component
statement: theorem component_add_component (x : F ⟶ G) : component 0 x + component 1 x = x
proof:
:=
  hom_ext_parity (fun X => by simp [component_app]) (fun X => by simp [component_app])

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.Superfunctor.mem_parity_iff
statement:
theorem mem_parity_iff {p : ZMod 2} {x : F ⟶ G} :
    x ∈ parity (R := R) F G p ↔ x.app (p + 1) = 0

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.Superfunctor.mem_parity_iff_isHomogeneous
statement:
theorem mem_parity_iff_isHomogeneous {p : ZMod 2} {x : F ⟶ G} :
    x ∈ parity (R := R) F G p ↔ SuperNatTrans.IsHomogeneous (toSuperNatTrans x) p
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_parity_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h q hq
    rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one p with rfl | rfl <;>
      rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one q with rfl | rfl
    · exact absurd rfl hq
    · exact h
    · exact h
    · exact absurd rfl hq
  · intro h; exact h _ (zmod2_add_one_ne p)

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.Superfunctor.app_eq_zero_of_mem
statement:
theorem app_eq_zero_of_mem {p q : ZMod 2} {x : F ⟶ G} (hx : x ∈ parity (R := R) F G p)
    (hq : q ≠ p) (X : C) : x.app q X = 0

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.Superfunctor.proj_app
statement:
theorem proj_app (p : ZMod 2) (x : F ⟶ G) (q : ZMod 2) (X : C) :
    (proj R p x).app q X = if q = p then x.app p X else 0
proof:
:= by
  have h : proj R p x = component p x :=
    proj_eq_of_add (h := component (p + 1) x)
      (by
        rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one p with rfl | rfl
        · exact (component_add_component x).symm
        · rw [SuperNatTrans.zmod2_one_add_one, add_comm]; exact (component_add_component x).symm)
      (component_mem p x)
      (component_mem (p + 1) x)
  rw [h, component_app]

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.Superfunctor.IsSupernatural.toSuperNatTrans_mem
StringDiagrams.Supercategory.Superfunctor.hcomp_total
statement:
theorem hcomp_total (x : F ⟶ H) (y : G' ⟶ K') (X : C) :
    SuperNatTrans.total (hcomp x y) X = G'.map (x.total X) ≫ y.total (H.obj X)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hcomp, comp_total]
  simp [SuperNatTrans.total, Preadditive.add_comp, Preadditive.comp_add]

statement:
theorem whiskerLeft_smul (F : Superfunctor R C D) (r : R) (y : G' ⟶ K') :

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.Superfunctor.whiskerLeft_mem
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_parity_iff] at hy ⊢
  funext X; exact congrFun hy (F.obj X)

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.Superfunctor.whiskerRight_mem
statement:
theorem whiskerRight_mem {p : ZMod 2} {x : F ⟶ H} (hx : x ∈ parity (R := R) F H p)
    (G : Superfunctor R D E) : whiskerRight x G ∈ parity (R := R) (F.comp G) (H.comp G) p
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_parity_iff] at hx ⊢
  funext X; simp [congrFun hx X]

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.Superfunctor.whisker_exchange
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ (a b : ZMod 2) (X : C),
      G'.map (x.app a X) ≫ y.app b (H.obj X) =
        koszulSign a b • (y.app b (F.obj X) ≫ K'.map (x.app a X)) := fun a b X => by
    rw [y.naturality b (x.app a X) (x.app_mem a X), koszulSign_comm]
  have hx0 : ∀ a, a ≠ p → ∀ X, x.app a X = 0 := fun a ha X => app_eq_zero_of_mem hx ha X
  have hy0 : ∀ b, b ≠ q → ∀ X, y.app b X = 0 := fun b hb X => app_eq_zero_of_mem hy hb X
  apply hom_ext
  intro r X
  simp only [comp_app, whiskerRight_app, whiskerLeft_app, zsmul_app, key]
  rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one p with rfl | rfl <;>
    rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one q with rfl | rfl <;>
    rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one r with rfl | rfl <;>
    simp [hx0, hy0, SuperNatTrans.zmod2_one_add_one]

name: StringDiagrams.Supercategory.Superfunctor.hcomp_eq
StringDiagrams.Supercategory.Superfunctor.hcomp_comp_hcomp
statement:
theorem hcomp_comp_hcomp {L : Superfunctor R C D} {L' : Superfunctor R D E} {pu py : ZMod 2}
    (x : F ⟶ H) (u : H ⟶ L) (y : G' ⟶ K') (v : K' ⟶ L')
    (hu : u ∈ parity (R := R) H L pu) (hy : y ∈ parity (R := R) G' K' py) :
    hcomp x y ≫ hcomp u v = koszulSign pu py • hcomp (x ≫ u) (y ≫ v)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [hcomp, Category.assoc, comp_whiskerRight, whiskerLeft_comp]
  rw [← Category.assoc (whiskerLeft H y), ← koszulSign_smul_smul pu py
    (whiskerLeft H y ≫ whiskerRight u K'), ← whisker_exchange hu hy, Linear.smul_comp,
    Linear.comp_smul]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
