name: StringDiagrams.MatBicat.hcomp_permMat
statement:
theorem hcomp_permMat {ι κ ι' κ' : Type} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] [Fintype ι'] [Fintype κ']
    {X : ι → (a.obj ⟶ b.obj)} {Y : κ → (a.obj ⟶ b.obj)} {X' : ι' → (b.obj ⟶ c.obj)}
    {Y' : κ' → (b.obj ⟶ c.obj)} (e : ι ≃ κ) (φ : ∀ i, X i ⟶ Y (e i))
    (e' : ι' ≃ κ') (ψ : ∀ i, X' i ⟶ Y' (e' i)) :
    hcomp (M := ⟨ι, X⟩) (M' := ⟨κ, Y⟩) (N := ⟨ι', X'⟩) (N' := ⟨κ', Y'⟩)
        (permMat e φ) (permMat e' ψ) =
      permMat (X := fun x => X x.1 ≫ X' x.2) (Y := fun y => Y y.1 ≫ Y' y.2)
        (e.prodCongr e') (fun x => hcomp₂ (φ x.1) (ψ x.2))
proof:
:= by
  apply CategoryTheory.Mat_.hom_ext
  rintro ⟨x₁, x₂⟩ ⟨y₁, y₂⟩
  rw [hcomp_apply]
  by_cases h₁ : e x₁ = y₁
  · by_cases h₂ : e' x₂ = y₂
    · subst h₁ h₂
      rw [permMat_apply_self, permMat_apply_self]
      exact (permMat_apply_self (X := fun x => X x.1 ≫ X' x.2) (Y := fun y => Y y.1 ≫ Y' y.2)
        (e.prodCongr e') (fun x => hcomp₂ (φ x.1) (ψ x.2)) (x₁, x₂)).symm
    · rw [permMat_apply_of_ne e' ψ h₂, hcomp₂_zero_right]
      exact (permMat_apply_of_ne (X := fun x => X x.1 ≫ X' x.2) (Y := fun y => Y y.1 ≫ Y' y.2)
        (e.prodCongr e') (fun x => hcomp₂ (φ x.1) (ψ x.2))
        (i := (x₁, x₂)) (j := (y₁, y₂)) (fun h => h₂ (congrArg Prod.snd h))).symm
  · rw [permMat_apply_of_ne e φ h₁, hcomp₂_zero_left]
    exact (permMat_apply_of_ne (X := fun x => X x.1 ≫ X' x.2) (Y := fun y => Y y.1 ≫ Y' y.2)
      (e.prodCongr e') (fun x => hcomp₂ (φ x.1) (ψ x.2))
      (i := (x₁, x₂)) (j := (y₁, y₂)) (fun h => h₁ (congrArg Prod.fst h))).symm

name: StringDiagrams.MatBicat.hcomp_id_id
statement: theorem hcomp_id_id (M : a ⟶ b) (N : b ⟶ c) : hcomp (𝟙 M) (𝟙 N) = 𝟙 (M ≫ N)
proof:
:= by
  rw [id_eq_permMat' M, id_eq_permMat' N, hcomp_permMat]
  exact permMat_eq_id _ (fun _ => rfl) _ fun _ => by simp [hcomp₂]

name: StringDiagrams.MatBicat.sum_whiskerRight
statement:
theorem sum_whiskerRight {a b c : B} {f g : a ⟶ b} {α : Type*} (s : Finset α)
    (η : α → (f ⟶ g)) (h : b ⟶ c) : (∑ i ∈ s, η i) ▷ h = ∑ i ∈ s, η i ▷ h

name: StringDiagrams.MatBicat.whiskerLeft_sum
statement:
theorem whiskerLeft_sum {a b c : B} (f : a ⟶ b) {g h : b ⟶ c} {α : Type*} (s : Finset α)
    (θ : α → (g ⟶ h)) : f ◁ (∑ i ∈ s, θ i) = ∑ i ∈ s, f ◁ θ i

name: StringDiagrams.MatBicat.hcomp_comp
statement:
theorem hcomp_comp {M₁ M₂ M₃ : a ⟶ b} {N₁ N₂ N₃ : b ⟶ c} (f₁ : M₁ ⟶ M₂) (f₂ : N₁ ⟶ N₂)
    (g₁ : M₂ ⟶ M₃) (g₂ : N₂ ⟶ N₃) :
    hcomp (f₁ ≫ g₁) (f₂ ≫ g₂) = hcomp f₁ f₂ ≫ hcomp g₁ g₂
proof:
:= by
  apply CategoryTheory.Mat_.hom_ext
  intro x z
  simp only [hcomp_apply, comp_apply, hcomp₂, sum_whiskerRight,
    whiskerLeft_sum, Preadditive.sum_comp, Preadditive.comp_sum]
  refine Eq.trans ?_ (Fintype.sum_prod_type (f := fun y : M₂.ι × N₂.ι =>
    (f₁ x.1 y.1 ▷ N₁.X x.2 ≫ M₂.X y.1 ◁ f₂ x.2 y.2) ≫
      (g₁ y.1 z.1 ▷ N₂.X y.2 ≫ M₃.X z.1 ◁ g₂ y.2 z.2))).symm
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
  exact hcomp₂_comp (f₁ x.1 j) (g₁ j z.1) (f₂ x.2 k) (g₂ k z.2)

name: StringDiagrams.MatBicat.whiskerLeft_eq
statement: theorem whiskerLeft_eq (M : a ⟶ b) {N N' : b ⟶ c} (g : N ⟶ N') : M ◁ g = hcomp (𝟙 M) g

name: StringDiagrams.MatBicat.whiskerRight_eq
statement: theorem whiskerRight_eq {M M' : a ⟶ b} (f : M ⟶ M') (N : b ⟶ c) : f ▷ N = hcomp f (𝟙 N)

name: StringDiagrams.MatBicat.associator_eq
statement: theorem associator_eq (M : a ⟶ b) (N : b ⟶ c) (P : c ⟶ d) : α_ M N P = associator M N P

name: StringDiagrams.MatBicat.leftUnitor_eq
statement: theorem leftUnitor_eq (M : a ⟶ b) : λ_ M = leftUnitor M

name: StringDiagrams.MatBicat.rightUnitor_eq
statement: theorem rightUnitor_eq (M : a ⟶ b) : ρ_ M = rightUnitor M

name: StringDiagrams.MatBicat.whiskerLeft_permMat
statement:
theorem whiskerLeft_permMat (M : a ⟶ b) {ι κ : Type} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    {X : ι → (b.obj ⟶ c.obj)} {Y : κ → (b.obj ⟶ c.obj)} (e : ι ≃ κ) (φ : ∀ i, X i ⟶ Y (e i)) :
    M ◁ permMat (D := b.obj ⟶ c.obj) e φ =
      permMat (X := fun x : M.ι × ι => M.X x.1 ≫ X x.2) (Y := fun y : M.ι × κ => M.X y.1 ≫ Y y.2)
        ((Equiv.refl M.ι).prodCongr e) (fun x => M.X x.1 ◁ φ x.2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [whiskerLeft_eq, id_eq_permMat' M, hcomp_permMat]
  exact permMat_congr (fun _ => rfl) _ _ fun x => by
    rw [eqToHom_refl, Category.comp_id]; simp [hcomp₂]; rfl

name: StringDiagrams.MatBicat.permMat_whiskerRight
statement:
theorem permMat_whiskerRight {ι κ : Type} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    {X : ι → (a.obj ⟶ b.obj)} {Y : κ → (a.obj ⟶ b.obj)} (e : ι ≃ κ) (φ : ∀ i, X i ⟶ Y (e i))
    (N : b ⟶ c) :
    permMat (D := a.obj ⟶ b.obj) e φ ▷ N =
      permMat (X := fun x : ι × N.ι => X x.1 ≫ N.X x.2) (Y := fun y : κ × N.ι => Y y.1 ≫ N.X y.2)
        (e.prodCongr (Equiv.refl N.ι)) (fun x => φ x.1 ▷ N.X x.2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [whiskerRight_eq, id_eq_permMat' N, hcomp_permMat]
  exact permMat_congr (fun _ => rfl) _ _ fun x => by
    rw [eqToHom_refl, Category.comp_id]; simp [hcomp₂]

name: StringDiagrams.MatBicat.smul_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem smul_apply {a b : MatBicat B} {M N : a ⟶ b} (r : R) (f : M ⟶ N) (i j) :
    (r • f) i j = r • f i j

name: StringDiagrams.MatBicat.associator_hom_eq
statement:
theorem associator_hom_eq (M : a ⟶ b) (N : b ⟶ c) (P : c ⟶ d) :
    (α_ M N P).hom = permMat (Equiv.prodAssoc M.ι N.ι P.ι)
      fun x => (α_ (M.X x.1.1) (N.X x.1.2) (P.X x.2)).hom

name: StringDiagrams.MatBicat.associator_inv_eq
statement:
theorem associator_inv_eq (M : a ⟶ b) (N : b ⟶ c) (P : c ⟶ d) :
    (α_ M N P).inv = permMat (Equiv.prodAssoc M.ι N.ι P.ι).symm
      fun y => (α_ (M.X y.1) (N.X y.2.1) (P.X y.2.2)).inv

name: StringDiagrams.MatBicat.leftUnitor_hom_eq
statement:
theorem leftUnitor_hom_eq (M : a ⟶ b) :
    (λ_ M).hom = permMat (Equiv.punitProd M.ι) fun x => (λ_ (M.X x.2)).hom

name: StringDiagrams.MatBicat.leftUnitor_inv_eq
statement:
theorem leftUnitor_inv_eq (M : a ⟶ b) :
    (λ_ M).inv = permMat (Equiv.punitProd M.ι).symm fun i => (λ_ (M.X i)).inv

name: StringDiagrams.MatBicat.rightUnitor_hom_eq
statement:
theorem rightUnitor_hom_eq (M : a ⟶ b) :
    (ρ_ M).hom = permMat (Equiv.prodPUnit M.ι) fun x => (ρ_ (M.X x.1)).hom

name: StringDiagrams.MatBicat.rightUnitor_inv_eq
statement:
theorem rightUnitor_inv_eq (M : a ⟶ b) :
    (ρ_ M).inv = permMat (Equiv.prodPUnit M.ι).symm fun i => (ρ_ (M.X i)).inv

name: StringDiagrams.MatBicat.id₂_eq
statement: theorem id₂_eq (M : a ⟶ b) : 𝟙 M = permMat (Equiv.refl M.ι) (fun i => 𝟙 (M.X i))

name: StringDiagrams.MatBicat.neg_permMat
StringDiagrams.MatBicat.braidIso_naturality
statement:
theorem braidIso_naturality {q : b.obj ⟶ b.obj} {q' : a.obj ⟶ a.obj}
    (e : ∀ f : a.obj ⟶ b.obj, f ≫ q ≅ q' ≫ f)
    (he : ∀ {f g : a.obj ⟶ b.obj} (η : f ⟶ g), (e f).hom ≫ q' ◁ η = η ▷ q ≫ (e g).hom)
    {M N : a ⟶ b} (η : M ⟶ N) :
    (braidIso M e).hom ≫ single q' ◁ η = η ▷ single q ≫ (braidIso N e).hom
proof:
:= by
  refine hom_ext_equiv (Equiv.prodComm N.ι PUnit) fun m i => ?_
  rw [braidIso_hom, braidIso_hom]
  refine (permMat_comp_apply (X := fun x : M.ι × PUnit => M.X x.1 ≫ q)
    (Y := fun y : PUnit × M.ι => q' ≫ M.X y.2) (Equiv.prodComm M.ι PUnit)
    (fun x => (e (M.X x.1)).hom) (single q' ◁ η) m _).trans ?_
  refine Eq.trans ?_ (comp_permMat_apply (X := fun x : N.ι × PUnit => N.X x.1 ≫ q)
    (Y := fun y : PUnit × N.ι => q' ≫ N.X y.2) (Equiv.prodComm N.ι PUnit)
    (fun x => (e (N.X x.1)).hom) (η ▷ single q) m i).symm
  obtain ⟨m, ⟨⟩⟩ := m
  obtain ⟨i, ⟨⟩⟩ := i
  rw [whiskerLeft_eq, whiskerRight_eq, hcomp_apply, hcomp_apply]
  change (e (M.X m)).hom ≫ hcomp₂ ((𝟙 (single q')) PUnit.unit PUnit.unit) (η m i) =
    hcomp₂ (η m i) ((𝟙 (single q)) PUnit.unit PUnit.unit) ≫ (e (N.X i)).hom
  rw [id_apply_self, id_apply_self]
  simp only [hcomp₂, id_whiskerRight, Category.id_comp, Bicategory.whiskerLeft_id,
    Category.comp_id]
  exact he (η m i)

name: StringDiagrams.MatBicat.pi_eq
statement: @[simp] theorem pi_eq (a : MatBicat B) : 𝛑 a = single (𝛑 a.obj)

name: StringDiagrams.MatBicat.β_hom_eq
statement:
theorem β_hom_eq (M : a ⟶ b) :
    (𝛃 M).hom = permMat (Equiv.prodComm M.ι PUnit) fun x => (𝛃 (M.X x.1)).hom

name: StringDiagrams.MatBicat.β_inv_eq
statement:
theorem β_inv_eq (M : a ⟶ b) :
    (𝛃 M).inv = permMat (Equiv.prodComm PUnit M.ι) fun x => (𝛃 (M.X x.2)).inv

name: StringDiagrams.MatBicat.ξ_hom_eq
statement:
theorem ξ_hom_eq (a : MatBicat B) :
    (𝛏 a).hom = permMat (Equiv.punitProd PUnit) fun _ => (𝛏 a.obj).hom

name: StringDiagrams.MatBicat.ξ_inv_eq
statement:
theorem ξ_inv_eq (a : MatBicat B) :
    (𝛏 a).inv = permMat (Equiv.punitProd PUnit).symm fun _ => (𝛏 a.obj).inv

name: StringDiagrams.MatBicat.q_eq
statement: @[simp] theorem q_eq (a : MatBicat B) : 𝐪 a = single (𝐪 a.obj)

name: StringDiagrams.MatBicat.qinv_eq
statement: @[simp] theorem qinv_eq (a : MatBicat B) : 𝐪⁻¹ a = single (𝐪⁻¹ a.obj)

name: StringDiagrams.MatBicat.γ_hom_eq
statement:
theorem γ_hom_eq (M : a ⟶ b) :
    (𝛄 M).hom = permMat (Equiv.prodComm M.ι PUnit) fun x => (𝛄 (M.X x.1)).hom

name: StringDiagrams.MatBicat.γ_inv_eq
statement:
theorem γ_inv_eq (M : a ⟶ b) :
    (𝛄 M).inv = permMat (Equiv.prodComm PUnit M.ι) fun x => (𝛄 (M.X x.2)).inv

name: StringDiagrams.MatBicat.ii_hom_eq
statement:
theorem ii_hom_eq (a : MatBicat B) :
    (QPiTwoCategory.ii (R := R) a).hom =
      permMat (Equiv.punitProd PUnit) fun _ => (QPiTwoCategory.ii (R := R) a.obj).hom

name: StringDiagrams.MatBicat.jj_hom_eq
statement:
theorem jj_hom_eq (a : MatBicat B) :
    (QPiTwoCategory.jj (R := R) a).hom =
      permMat (Equiv.punitProd PUnit) fun _ => (QPiTwoCategory.jj (R := R) a.obj).hom

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoCategory.iiHom_hom
statement:
theorem iiHom_hom (f : a ⟶ b) : (iiHom (R := R) f).hom =
    (α_ f (𝐪 b) (𝐪⁻¹ b)).hom ≫ f ◁ (ii (R := R) b).hom ≫ (ρ_ f).hom

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoCategory.iiHom_inv
statement:
theorem iiHom_inv (f : a ⟶ b) : (iiHom (R := R) f).inv =
    (ρ_ f).inv ≫ f ◁ (ii (R := R) b).inv ≫ (α_ f (𝐪 b) (𝐪⁻¹ b)).inv

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoCategory.jjHom_hom
statement:
theorem jjHom_hom (f : a ⟶ b) : (jjHom (R := R) f).hom =
    (α_ f (𝐪⁻¹ b) (𝐪 b)).hom ≫ f ◁ (jj (R := R) b).hom ≫ (ρ_ f).hom

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoCategory.jjHom_inv
statement:
theorem jjHom_inv (f : a ⟶ b) : (jjHom (R := R) f).inv =
    (ρ_ f).inv ≫ f ◁ (jj (R := R) b).inv ≫ (α_ f (𝐪⁻¹ b) (𝐪 b)).inv

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoCategory.iiHom_naturality
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem iiHom_naturality {f g : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ g) :
    η ▷ 𝐪 b ▷ 𝐪⁻¹ b ≫ (iiHom (R := R) g).hom = (iiHom (R := R) f).hom ≫ η
proof:
:= by
  rw [iiHom_hom, iiHom_hom, associator_naturality_left_assoc, ← whisker_exchange_assoc,
    rightUnitor_naturality]
  simp only [Category.assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoCategory.jjHom_naturality
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem jjHom_naturality {f g : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ g) :
    η ▷ 𝐪⁻¹ b ▷ 𝐪 b ≫ (jjHom (R := R) g).hom = (jjHom (R := R) f).hom ≫ η
proof:
:= by
  rw [jjHom_hom, jjHom_hom, associator_naturality_left_assoc, ← whisker_exchange_assoc,
    rightUnitor_naturality]
  simp only [Category.assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoCategory.βQHom_hom
statement:
theorem βQHom_hom (f : a ⟶ b) : (βQHom (R := R) f).hom =
    (α_ f (𝐪 b) (𝛑 b)).hom ≫ f ◁ (𝛃 (𝐪 b)).hom ≫ (α_ f (𝛑 b) (𝐪 b)).inv

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoCategory.βQHom_naturality
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem βQHom_naturality {f g : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ g) :
    η ▷ 𝐪 b ▷ 𝛑 b ≫ (βQHom (R := R) g).hom = (βQHom (R := R) f).hom ≫ η ▷ 𝛑 b ▷ 𝐪 b
proof:
:= by
  rw [βQHom_hom, βQHom_hom, associator_naturality_left_assoc, ← whisker_exchange_assoc,
    associator_inv_naturality_left]
  simp only [Category.assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoCategory.whiskerLeft_jj
statement:
theorem whiskerLeft_jj (b : B) :
    𝐪 b ◁ (jj (R := R) b).hom = (α_ (𝐪 b) (𝐪⁻¹ b) (𝐪 b)).inv ≫ (ii (R := R) b).hom ▷ 𝐪 b ≫
      (λ_ (𝐪 b)).hom ≫ (ρ_ (𝐪 b)).inv
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cancel_mono (ρ_ (𝐪 b)).hom, ← cancel_epi (α_ (𝐪 b) (𝐪⁻¹ b) (𝐪 b)).hom]
  simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
  exact (q_ii (R := R) b).symm

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoCategory.whiskerLeft_ii
statement:
theorem whiskerLeft_ii (b : B) :
    𝐪⁻¹ b ◁ (ii (R := R) b).hom = (α_ (𝐪⁻¹ b) (𝐪 b) (𝐪⁻¹ b)).inv ≫ (jj (R := R) b).hom ▷ 𝐪⁻¹ b ≫
      (λ_ (𝐪⁻¹ b)).hom ≫ (ρ_ (𝐪⁻¹ b)).inv
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cancel_mono (ρ_ (𝐪⁻¹ b)).hom]
  simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]
  exact ii_qinv (R := R) b

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoCategory.left_triangle_aux
statement:
theorem left_triangle_aux (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (iiHom (R := R) f).inv ▷ 𝐪 b ≫ (jjHom (R := R) (f ≫ 𝐪 b)).hom = 𝟙 (f ≫ 𝐪 b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [iiHom_inv, jjHom_hom, comp_whiskerLeft, whiskerLeft_jj]
  calc _ = (ρ_ f).inv ▷ 𝐪 b ≫ (α_ f (𝟙 b) (𝐪 b)).hom ≫
        f ◁ (((ii (R := R) b).inv ≫ (ii (R := R) b).hom) ▷ 𝐪 b) ≫ (α_ f (𝟙 b) (𝐪 b)).inv ≫
        (ρ_ f).hom ▷ 𝐪 b := by
        simp only [comp_whiskerRight, Bicategory.whiskerLeft_comp, Category.assoc]
        bicategory
    _ = 𝟙 (f ≫ 𝐪 b) := by
        rw [Iso.inv_hom_id, id_whiskerRight, Bicategory.whiskerLeft_id, Category.id_comp,
          Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc, ← comp_whiskerRight, Iso.inv_hom_id, id_whiskerRight]

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoCategory.right_triangle_aux
statement:
theorem right_triangle_aux (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (iiHom (R := R) (f ≫ 𝐪⁻¹ b)).inv ≫ (jjHom (R := R) f).hom ▷ 𝐪⁻¹ b = 𝟙 (f ≫ 𝐪⁻¹ b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [iiHom_inv, jjHom_hom, comp_whiskerLeft]
  have h := whiskerLeft_ii (R := R) b
  rw [← cancel_mono (ρ_ (𝐪⁻¹ b)).hom] at h
  simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id] at h
  have h' : 𝐪⁻¹ b ◁ (ii (R := R) b).inv = (ρ_ (𝐪⁻¹ b)).hom ≫ (λ_ (𝐪⁻¹ b)).inv ≫
      (jj (R := R) b).inv ▷ 𝐪⁻¹ b ≫ (α_ (𝐪⁻¹ b) (𝐪 b) (𝐪⁻¹ b)).hom := by
    rw [← cancel_epi (𝐪⁻¹ b ◁ (ii (R := R) b).hom), ← Bicategory.whiskerLeft_comp, Iso.hom_inv_id,
      Bicategory.whiskerLeft_id, reassoc_of% h]
    simp
  rw [h']
  calc _ = (ρ_ f).inv ▷ 𝐪⁻¹ b ≫ (α_ f (𝟙 b) (𝐪⁻¹ b)).hom ≫
        f ◁ (((jj (R := R) b).inv ≫ (jj (R := R) b).hom) ▷ 𝐪⁻¹ b) ≫
        (α_ f (𝟙 b) (𝐪⁻¹ b)).inv ≫ (ρ_ f).hom ▷ 𝐪⁻¹ b := by
        simp only [comp_whiskerRight, Bicategory.whiskerLeft_comp, Category.assoc]
        bicategory
    _ = 𝟙 (f ≫ 𝐪⁻¹ b) := by
        rw [Iso.inv_hom_id, id_whiskerRight, Bicategory.whiskerLeft_id, Category.id_comp,
          Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc, ← comp_whiskerRight, Iso.inv_hom_id, id_whiskerRight]

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoCategory.βQHom_comm
statement:
theorem βQHom_comm (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (ξHom (R := R) (f ≫ 𝐪 b)).hom ≫ (ξHom (R := R) f).inv ▷ 𝐪 b =
      (βQHom (R := R) f).hom ▷ 𝛑 b ≫ (βQHom (R := R) (f ≫ 𝛑 b)).hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [ξHom_hom, ξHom_inv, βQHom_hom, βQHom_hom]
  calc _ = (α_ (f ≫ 𝐪 b) (𝛑 b) (𝛑 b)).hom ≫ (α_ f (𝐪 b) (𝛑 b ≫ 𝛑 b)).hom ≫
        f ◁ (𝐪 b ◁ (𝛏 b).hom ≫ (ρ_ (𝐪 b)).hom ≫ (λ_ (𝐪 b)).inv ≫ (𝛏 b).inv ▷ 𝐪 b) ≫
        (α_ f (𝛑 b ≫ 𝛑 b) (𝐪 b)).inv ≫ (α_ f (𝛑 b) (𝛑 b)).inv ▷ 𝐪 b := by
        simp only [comp_whiskerRight, Bicategory.whiskerLeft_comp, Category.assoc]
        bicategory
    _ = (α_ (f ≫ 𝐪 b) (𝛑 b) (𝛑 b)).hom ≫ (α_ f (𝐪 b) (𝛑 b ≫ 𝛑 b)).hom ≫
        f ◁ ((α_ (𝐪 b) (𝛑 b) (𝛑 b)).inv ≫ (𝛃 (𝐪 b)).hom ▷ 𝛑 b ≫ (α_ (𝛑 b) (𝐪 b) (𝛑 b)).hom ≫
          𝛑 b ◁ (𝛃 (𝐪 b)).hom ≫ (α_ (𝛑 b) (𝛑 b) (𝐪 b)).inv) ≫
        (α_ f (𝛑 b ≫ 𝛑 b) (𝐪 b)).inv ≫ (α_ f (𝛑 b) (𝛑 b)).inv ▷ 𝐪 b := by
        rw [ξ_comm (R := R) (𝐪 b)]
    _ = _ := by
        simp only [comp_whiskerRight, Bicategory.whiskerLeft_comp, Category.assoc]
        bicategory

name: StringDiagrams.QPiEnvelope.ofHom_superTensorHom_ofHom
statement:
theorem ofHom_superTensorHom_ofHom {X X' Y Y' : QPiEnvelope R C} {y : X.obj.obj ⟶ X'.obj.obj}
    {x : Y.obj.obj ⟶ Y'.obj.obj} {py px : ZMod 2}
    (hy : y ∈ parity (R := R) X.obj.obj X'.obj.obj py)
    (hx : x ∈ parity (R := R) Y.obj.obj Y'.obj.obj px) :
    MonoidalSupercategory.superTensorHom (ofHom y : X ⟶ X') (ofHom x : Y ⟶ Y') =
      sign R (X.par * px + py * Y'.par + X.par * Y'.par + Y.par * X.par) •
        (ofHom (MonoidalSupercategory.superTensorHom y x) : X ⊗ Y ⟶ X' ⊗ Y')
proof:
:= by
  apply Envelope.hom_ext
  rw [Envelope.toHom_superTensorHom (pf := py) (pg := px) hy hx, mul_comm Y.par X.par]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.mapPi_isGraded
statement:
theorem mapPi_isGraded [∀ a b : B, GradedSupercategory R (a ⟶ b)]
    [∀ a b : C, GradedSupercategory R (a ⟶ b)] {F : TwoSuperfunctor R B C} (hF : F.IsGraded) :
    (mapPi F).IsGraded where
  map₂_mem_degree hη
proof:
:= hF.map₂_mem_degree hη
  mapComp_hom_mem_degree f g := hF.mapComp_hom_mem_degree f.obj g.obj
  mapId_hom_mem_degree a := hF.mapId_hom_mem_degree a.as

name: StringDiagrams.TwoEnvelope.twoJ_comp_mapPi
statement:
theorem twoJ_comp_mapPi (F : TwoSuperfunctor R B C) :
    (twoJ R B).comp (mapPi F) = F.comp (twoJ R C)
proof:
:= by
  refine twoSuperfunctor_ext rfl HEq.rfl HEq.rfl (heq_of_eq ?_) (heq_of_eq ?_)
  · funext a b c f g
    apply Iso.ext
    apply hom_ext
    change (F.mapComp f g).hom ≫ F.map₂ (𝟙 (f ≫ g)) = 𝟙 _ ≫ (F.mapComp f g).hom
    rw [F.map₂_id, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]
  · funext a
    apply Iso.ext
    apply hom_ext
    change (F.mapId a).hom ≫ F.map₂ (𝟙 (𝟙 a)) = 𝟙 _ ≫ (F.mapId a).hom
    rw [F.map₂_id, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]

name: StringDiagrams.QTwoEnvelope.mapQ_isGraded
statement:
theorem mapQ_isGraded [∀ a b : B, GradedSupercategory R (a ⟶ b)]
    [∀ a b : C, GradedSupercategory R (a ⟶ b)] {F : TwoSuperfunctor R B C} (hF : F.IsGraded) :
    (mapQ F).IsGraded where
  map₂_mem_degree hη
proof:
:= hF.map₂_mem_degree hη
  mapComp_hom_mem_degree f g := by
    show (F.mapComp f.obj g.obj).hom ∈ degree (R := R) (F.map f.obj ≫ F.map g.obj) (F.map (f.obj ≫ g.obj))
      (0 + (f.shift + g.shift - (f.shift + g.shift)))
    rw [show (0 : ℤ) + (f.shift + g.shift - (f.shift + g.shift)) = 0 by ring]
    exact hF.mapComp_hom_mem_degree f.obj g.obj
  mapId_hom_mem_degree a := by
    show (F.mapId a.as).hom ∈ degree (R := R) (𝟙 (F.obj a.as)) (F.map (𝟙 a.as)) (0 + (0 - 0))
    rw [show (0 : ℤ) + (0 - 0) = 0 by ring]
    exact hF.mapId_hom_mem_degree a.as

name: StringDiagrams.KrullSchmidt.isIndec_pi_iff
statement:
theorem isIndec_pi_iff (X : C) :
    IsIndec ((PiCategory.pi (R := k)).obj X) ↔ IsIndec X
proof:
:= by
  let e := parityEquivalence k (C := C)
  have : e.functor.Additive := PiCategory.pi_additive
  exact isIndec_obj_iff e.functor X

name: StringDiagrams.KrullSchmidt.indecParity_rep_iso
statement:
theorem indecParity_rep_iso (i : IndecClass C) :
    Nonempty ((PiCategory.pi (R := k)).obj i.rep ≅ (indecParity k i).rep)
proof:
:= by
  have h : indecParity k i = Quotient.mk (indecSetoid C)
      ⟨(PiCategory.pi (R := k)).obj i.rep, (isIndec_pi_iff k i.rep).2 i.isIndec_rep⟩ := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← Quotient.out_eq i]
    rfl
  rw [h]
  exact IndecClass.exists_iso_rep _

name: StringDiagrams.KrullSchmidt.indecParity_involutive
statement: theorem indecParity_involutive : Function.Involutive (indecParity k (C := C))
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  apply IndecClass.eq_of_iso
  exact (indecParity_rep_iso k (indecParity k i)).some.symm ≪≫
    (PiCategory.pi (R := k)).mapIso (indecParity_rep_iso k i).some.symm ≪≫
    PiCategory.ξApp i.rep

name: StringDiagrams.KrullSchmidt.indecParity_eq_iff
statement:
theorem indecParity_eq_iff (i : IndecClass C) :
    indecParity k i = i ↔ Nonempty ((PiCategory.pi (R := k)).obj i.rep ≅ i.rep)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    simpa only [h] using indecParity_rep_iso k i
  · rintro ⟨e⟩
    exact IndecClass.eq_of_iso ((indecParity_rep_iso k i).some.symm ≪≫ e)

name: StringDiagrams.KrullSchmidt.pi_smul_indec
statement:
theorem pi_smul_indec (i : IndecClass C) :
    letI := K₀.moduleZπ k C
    Zπ.π • K₀.mk i.rep = K₀.mk (indecParity k i).rep
proof:
:= by
  let := K₀.moduleZπ k C
  rw [K₀.π_smul_mk]
  exact K₀.mk_eq_mk_of_iso (indecParity_rep_iso k i).some

name: StringDiagrams.KrullSchmidt.k0_free_zpi_iff
statement:
theorem k0_free_zpi_iff :
    letI := K₀.moduleZπ k C
    Module.Free Zπ (K₀ C) ↔
    ∀ X : C, IsIndec X → ¬ Nonempty ((PiCategory.pi (R := k)).obj X ≅ X)
proof:
:= by
  let := K₀.moduleZπ k C
  rw [ParityBasis.free_iff (indecBasis k) (indecParity k) (indecParity_involutive k)
    (fun i => by simpa only [indecBasis_apply] using pi_smul_indec k i)]
  constructor
  · intro h X hX ⟨e⟩
    let i : IndecClass C := Quotient.mk (indecSetoid C) ⟨X, hX⟩
    let f : X ≅ i.rep := (IndecClass.exists_iso_rep hX).some
    exact h i ((indecParity_eq_iff k i).2
      ⟨(PiCategory.pi (R := k)).mapIso f.symm ≪≫ e ≪≫ f⟩)
  · intro h i hi
    exact h i.rep i.isIndec_rep ((indecParity_eq_iff k i).1 hi)

name: StringDiagrams.KrullSchmidt.not_free_of_parity_iso
statement:
theorem not_free_of_parity_iso {X : C} (hX : IsIndec X)
    (e : (PiCategory.pi (R := k)).obj X ≅ X) :
    letI := K₀.moduleZπ k C
    ¬ Module.Free Zπ (K₀ C)
proof:
:=
  fun h => (k0_free_zpi_iff k).1 h X hX ⟨e⟩

name: StringDiagrams.KrullSchmidt.indec_not_norm
statement:
theorem indec_not_norm {X : C} (hX : IsIndec X)
    (e : (PiCategory.pi (R := k)).obj X ≅ X) :
    letI := K₀.moduleZπ k C
    ¬ ∃ y : K₀ C, y + Zπ.π • y = K₀.mk X
proof:
:= by
  let := K₀.moduleZπ k C
  let i : IndecClass C := Quotient.mk (indecSetoid C) ⟨X, hX⟩
  let f : X ≅ i.rep := (IndecClass.exists_iso_rep hX).some
  have hi : indecParity k i = i := (indecParity_eq_iff k i).2
    ⟨(PiCategory.pi (R := k)).mapIso f.symm ≪≫ e ≪≫ f⟩
  have h := ParityBasis.fixed_not_norm (indecBasis k) (indecParity k)
    (indecParity_involutive k)
    (fun j => by simpa only [indecBasis_apply] using pi_smul_indec k j) i hi
  simpa only [indecBasis_apply, ← K₀.mk_eq_mk_of_iso f] using h

name: StringDiagrams.KrullSchmidt.parityBasis_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem parityBasis_apply [LinearOrder (IndecClass C)]
    (h : ∀ X : C, IsIndec X → ¬ Nonempty ((PiCategory.pi (R := k)).obj X ≅ X))
    (i : ParityBasis.PairRep (indecParity k (C := C))) :
    parityBasis k h i = K₀.mk i.val.rep
proof:
:= by
  let := K₀.moduleZπ k C
  exact (ParityBasis.pairedBasis_apply _ _ _ _ _ _).trans (indecBasis_apply k i.val)

name: StringDiagrams.SKarAlg.k0_free_zpi_iff
statement:
theorem k0_free_zpi_iff : Module.Free Zπ (K₀ (SKar k (SuperalgebraCat 𝒜))) ↔
    ∀ X : SKar k (SuperalgebraCat 𝒜), KrullSchmidt.IsIndec X →
      ¬ Nonempty ((PiCategory.pi (R := k)).obj X ≅ X)

name: StringDiagrams.GSKarAlg.k0_free_zpi_iff

theorem k0_free_zpi_iff : Module.Free Zπ (K₀ (GSKar k (SuperalgebraCat 𝒢.parity))) ↔
    ∀ X : GSKar k (SuperalgebraCat 𝒢.parity), KrullSchmidt.IsIndec X →
      ¬ Nonempty ((PiCategory.pi (R := k)).obj X ≅ X)

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.twoNatTrans_ext_of_J_general
statement:
theorem twoNatTrans_ext_of_J_general
    {U V : TwoSuperfunctor R (QPiTwoEnvelope R B) D}
    (θ ψ : TwoNatTrans U V) (hX : θ.X = ψ.X)
    (hx : ∀ {a b : QPiTwoEnvelope R B} (f : a.as.as ⟶ b.as.as),
      HEq (θ.x (Jm f : a ⟶ b)) (ψ.x (Jm f))) : θ = ψ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨X, x, xm, xn, xc, xi⟩ := θ
  obtain ⟨Y, y, ym, yn, yc, yi⟩ := ψ
  dsimp only at hX hx
  subst hX
  have hxy : @x = @y := by
    funext a b f
    have e : Epi (U.map₂ (shiftIso f).hom ▷ X b) :=
      inferInstanceAs (Epi (whiskerRightIso (R := R) (U.map₂Iso (shiftIso f)) (X b)).hom)
    exact TwoEnvelope.eq_of_conj_hom _ e _ (xn (shiftIso f).hom)
      (yn (shiftIso f).hom) (eq_of_heq (hx f.obj.obj))
  cases hxy
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.twoNatTrans_hext_of_J_general
statement:
theorem twoNatTrans_hext_of_J_general
    {U V U' V' : TwoSuperfunctor R (QPiTwoEnvelope R B) D}
    (hu : U = U') (hv : V = V')
    (θ : TwoNatTrans U V) (ψ : TwoNatTrans U' V')
    (hX : HEq θ.X ψ.X)
    (hx : ∀ {a b : QPiTwoEnvelope R B} (f : a.as.as ⟶ b.as.as),
      HEq (θ.x (Jm f : a ⟶ b)) (ψ.x (Jm f))) : HEq θ ψ
proof:
:= by
  cases hu
  cases hv
  exact heq_of_eq (twoNatTrans_ext_of_J_general θ ψ (eq_of_heq hX) hx)

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.transportBoundary_heq
statement:
private theorem transportBoundary_heq
    {U V U' V' : TwoSuperfunctor R (QPiTwoEnvelope R B) D}

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.postcompose_restrict_congr
statement: theorem postcompose_restrict_congr : restrict (S.comp G.1) = restrict (T.comp G.1)
proof:

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.postcomposeBridge_source

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.postcomposeBridge_target
statement:
theorem postcomposeBridge_target :

proof:
:=

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.postcomposeDensityBridge_x_J
statement:
theorem postcomposeDensityBridge_x_J {a b : QPiTwoEnvelope R B}
    (f : a.as.as ⟶ b.as.as) :
    (postcomposeDensityBridge T hT G).x (Jm f : a ⟶ b) =
      bridgeUnitCell (G.1.map ((restrict T).map f))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [postcomposeDensityBridge, TwoNatTrans.vcomp_x,
    postcomposeDensity, postcomposeDensityX, extendRestrictNatTransInv,
    extendRestrictInvX, extendRestrictApp_J, extendRestrictAppInv_J,
    G.1.map₂_id, Category.id_comp]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.dependent_heq
statement:
private theorem dependent_heq {α : Sort*} {β : α → Sort*}
    (f : (a : α) → β a) {a b : α} (h : a = b) : HEq (f a) (f b)

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.postcomposeDensityBridge_heq
statement:
theorem postcomposeDensityBridge_heq :
    HEq (postcomposeDensityBridge S hS G) (postcomposeDensityBridge T hT G)
proof:
:= by
  apply twoNatTrans_hext_of_J_general (postcomposeBridge_source S T h G)
    (postcomposeBridge_target S T h G)
  · exact dependent_heq
      (fun H : TwoSuperfunctor R B C =>
        fun a : QPiTwoEnvelope R B =>
          𝟙 (G.1.obj (H.obj a.as.as)) ≫ 𝟙 (G.1.obj (H.obj a.as.as))) h
  · intro a b f
    rw [postcomposeDensityBridge_x_J, postcomposeDensityBridge_x_J]
    exact dependent_heq
      (fun H : TwoSuperfunctor R B C => bridgeUnitCell (G.1.map (H.map f))) h

name: StringDiagrams.QPiTwoEnvelope.postcomposeDensityBridge_transportBoundary
statement:
theorem postcomposeDensityBridge_transportBoundary :
    TwoNatTrans.transportBoundary (postcomposeBridge_source S T h G)
      (postcomposeBridge_target S T h G) (postcomposeDensityBridge S hS G) =
        postcomposeDensityBridge T hT G
proof:
:= by
  have ht : HEq
      (TwoNatTrans.transportBoundary (postcomposeBridge_source S T h G)
        (postcomposeBridge_target S T h G) (postcomposeDensityBridge S hS G))
      (postcomposeDensityBridge S hS G) := by
    exact transportBoundary_heq _ _ _
  exact eq_of_heq (ht.trans (postcomposeDensityBridge_heq S T hS hT h G))

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.id_fst
statement: @[simp] theorem id_fst : (𝟙 X : X ⟶ X).1 = 𝟙 X.obj

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.id_snd
statement: @[simp] theorem id_snd : (𝟙 X : X ⟶ X).2 = 0

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.comp_fst
statement:
@[simp] theorem comp_fst (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) :
    (f ≫ g).1 = f.1 ≫ g.1 - f.2 ≫ 𝚷.map g.2 ≫ (PiCategory.ξApp (R := R) Z.obj).hom

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.comp_snd
statement:
@[simp] theorem comp_snd (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) :

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.hom_ext
statement: @[ext] theorem hom_ext {f g : X ⟶ Y} (h₁ : f.1 = g.1) (h₂ : f.2 = g.2) : f = g

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.mem_parityAssoc_zero
statement: theorem mem_parityAssoc_zero {f : X ⟶ Y} : f ∈ parityAssoc X Y 0 ↔ f.2 = 0

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.mem_parityAssoc_one
statement: theorem mem_parityAssoc_one {f : X ⟶ Y} : f ∈ parityAssoc X Y 1 ↔ f.1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [parityAssoc, ite_eq_right (show ¬((1 : ZMod 2) = 0) by decide), LinearMap.mem_ker]; rfl

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.mem_parity_zero

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.mem_parity_one
statement: theorem mem_parity_one {f : X ⟶ Y} : f ∈ parity (R := R) X Y 1 ↔ f.1 = 0

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.proj_zero
statement: theorem proj_zero (f : X ⟶ Y) : proj R 0 f = (f.1, 0)
proof:
:=
  proj_eq_of_add (h := (0, f.2)) (by ext <;> simp) (mem_parity_zero.2 rfl) (mem_parity_one.2 rfl)

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.proj_one
statement: theorem proj_one (f : X ⟶ Y) : proj R 1 f = (0, f.2)

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.twist_one
statement: theorem twist_one (f : X ⟶ Y) : twist R 1 f = (f.1, -f.2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [twist_apply, proj_zero, proj_one]
  ext <;> simp

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.ζIso_mem
statement: theorem ζIso_mem (X : Associated R C) : (ζIso X).hom ∈ parity (R := R) _ X 1

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.pi_obj
statement:
@[simp] theorem pi_obj (X : Associated R C) :
    (PiSupercategory.pi (R := R)).obj X = ⟨𝚷.obj X.obj⟩

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.ζ_hom
statement:
theorem ζ_hom (X : Associated R C) :
    (PiSupercategory.ζ (R := R) X).hom = homMk (X := ⟨𝚷.obj X.obj⟩) 0 (𝟙 _)

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.pi_map_fst
statement:
theorem pi_map_fst (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    ((PiSupercategory.pi (R := R)).map f).1 = 𝚷.map f.1
proof:
:= by
  show ((ζIso X).hom ≫ twist R 1 f ≫ (ζIso Y).inv).1 = _
  simp only [twist_one, ζIso, comp_fst, comp_snd, homMk_fst, homMk_snd]
  simp only [Limits.zero_comp, Category.id_comp, Functor.map_neg,
    Functor.map_comp, Functor.map_zero, Preadditive.neg_comp, Preadditive.comp_neg,
    zero_sub, neg_neg, Limits.comp_zero, add_zero,
    Category.assoc]
  rw [PiCategory.ξApp_pi, ← Functor.map_comp, Iso.inv_hom_id, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id,
    Category.comp_id]
  simp

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.pi_map_snd
statement:
theorem pi_map_snd (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    ((PiSupercategory.pi (R := R)).map f).2 = -𝚷.map f.2
proof:
:= by
  show ((ζIso X).hom ≫ twist R 1 f ≫ (ζIso Y).inv).2 = _
  simp only [twist_one, ζIso, comp_fst, comp_snd, homMk_fst, homMk_snd]
  simp only [Limits.zero_comp, Category.id_comp, Functor.map_neg,
    Functor.map_comp, Functor.map_zero, Preadditive.neg_comp, Preadditive.comp_neg,
    zero_sub, neg_neg, Limits.comp_zero, add_zero]
  rw [PiCategory.ξApp_pi]
  simp only [← Functor.map_comp, Iso.inv_hom_id, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id,
    Category.comp_id, neg_zero, zero_add]

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.ξ_hom
statement:
theorem ξ_hom (X : Associated R C) :
    (PiSupercategory.ξ (R := R) X).hom = homMk (X := ⟨𝚷.obj (𝚷.obj X.obj)⟩)
      (PiCategory.ξApp (R := R) X.obj).hom 0
proof:
:= by
  ext
  · rw [PiSupercategory.ξ_hom, comp_fst, pi_map_fst, pi_map_snd]
    simp [ζ_hom]
  · rw [PiSupercategory.ξ_hom, comp_snd, pi_map_fst, pi_map_snd]
    simp [ζ_hom]

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.unit_obj
statement: @[simp] theorem unit_obj (X : C) : (unit R C).obj X = ⟨⟨X⟩⟩

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.unit_map_val

@[simp] theorem unit_map_val {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) :

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.unit_comp_counit
statement: theorem unit_comp_counit : unit R C ⋙ counit R C = 𝟭 C

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.counit_comp_unit
statement: theorem counit_comp_unit : counit R C ⋙ unit R C = 𝟭 _
proof:
:=
  CategoryTheory.Functor.ext (fun _ => rfl) fun X Y f => by
    simp only [Functor.comp_obj, Functor.comp_map, Functor.id_obj, Functor.id_map, eqToHom_refl,
      Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]
    exact Underlying.hom_ext (hom_ext rfl (mem_parity_zero.1 f.2).symm)

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.unit_map_pi

theorem unit_map_pi {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    (PiCategory.pi (R := R)).map ((unit R C).map f) =

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.unit_comp_pi
statement:
theorem unit_comp_pi :
    unit R C ⋙ PiCategory.pi (R := R) = PiCategory.pi (R := R) ⋙ unit R C
proof:
:=
  CategoryTheory.Functor.ext (fun _ => rfl) fun X Y f => by
    simp only [Functor.comp_obj, Functor.comp_map, eqToHom_refl, Category.comp_id,
      Category.id_comp]
    exact unit_map_pi f

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.ξ_unit

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.map_id
statement: theorem map_id : map (PiFunctor.id R C) = 𝟭 (Associated R C)
proof:
:=
  CategoryTheory.Functor.ext (fun _ => rfl) fun X Y f => by ext <;> simp

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.map_comp
statement:
theorem map_comp {F : C ⥤ D} [F.Additive] {G : D ⥤ E} [G.Additive] (hF : PiFunctor R F)
    (hG : PiFunctor R G) : map (hF.comp hG) = map hF ⋙ map hG
proof:
:=
  CategoryTheory.Functor.ext (fun _ => rfl) fun X Y f => by
    ext <;> simp
    rfl

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.isSupernatural_mapNatTrans
statement:
theorem isSupernatural_mapNatTrans {F G : C ⥤ D} [F.Additive] [F.Linear R] [G.Additive]
    [G.Linear R] {hF : PiFunctor R F} {hG : PiFunctor R G} {y : F ⟶ G}
    (hy : PiFunctor.IsPiNatural R hF hG y) :
    IsSupernatural R 0 (F := map hF) (G := map hG) fun X => homMk (y.app X.obj) 0
proof:
:= by
  refine isSupernatural_of_natTrans (F := map hF) (G := map hG)
    ({ app := fun X : Associated R C => homMk (Y := (map hG).obj X) (y.app X.obj) 0
       naturality := fun X Y f => ?_ } : map hF ⟶ map hG) (fun X => mem_parity_zero.2 rfl)
  have h : hF.β.inv.app Y.obj ≫ (PiCategory.pi (R := R)).map (y.app Y.obj) =
      y.app ((PiCategory.pi (R := R)).obj Y.obj) ≫ hG.β.inv.app Y.obj := by
    rw [← cancel_epi (hF.β.hom.app Y.obj), Iso.hom_inv_id_app_assoc, reassoc_of% (hy Y.obj),
      Iso.hom_inv_id_app]
    exact (Category.comp_id _).symm
  ext
  · simp [y.naturality]
  · simp only [comp_snd, map_map, homMk_fst, homMk_snd, Category.assoc,
      Limits.comp_zero, zero_add, add_zero, Limits.zero_comp]
    rw [h, ← Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc, y.naturality]

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.T_map_injective
statement:
theorem T_map_injective {X Y : Associated R (Underlying R A)} {f g : X ⟶ Y}
    (h : (T R A).map f = (T R A).map g) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  have hζ := PiSupercategory.ζ_hom_mem (R := R) Y.obj.obj
  have hf1 : f.2.1 ≫ (PiSupercategory.ζ (R := R) Y.obj.obj).hom ∈
      parity (R := R) X.obj.obj Y.obj.obj 1 := by simpa using comp_mem f.2.2 hζ
  have hg1 : g.2.1 ≫ (PiSupercategory.ζ (R := R) Y.obj.obj).hom ∈
      parity (R := R) X.obj.obj Y.obj.obj 1 := by simpa using comp_mem g.2.2 hζ
  have hf0 : f.1.1 ∈ parity (R := R) X.obj.obj Y.obj.obj (1 + 1) := f.1.2
  have hg0 : g.1.1 ∈ parity (R := R) X.obj.obj Y.obj.obj (1 + 1) := g.1.2
  have e0 : f.1.1 = g.1.1 := by
    rw [← proj_eq_of_add (R := R) (p := 0) rfl f.1.2 hf1,
      ← proj_eq_of_add (R := R) (p := 0) rfl g.1.2 hg1]
    exact congrArg (proj R 0) h
  have e1 : f.2.1 ≫ (PiSupercategory.ζ (R := R) Y.obj.obj).hom =
      g.2.1 ≫ (PiSupercategory.ζ (R := R) Y.obj.obj).hom := by
    rw [← proj_eq_of_add (R := R) (p := 1) (add_comm _ _) hf1 hf0,
      ← proj_eq_of_add (R := R) (p := 1) (add_comm _ _) hg1 hg0]
    exact congrArg (proj R 1) h
  exact hom_ext (Subtype.ext e0) (Subtype.ext ((cancel_mono _).1 e1))

name: StringDiagrams.Associated.T_naturality

theorem T_naturality (F : A ⥤ B) [F.Additive] [F.Linear R] [IsSuperfunctor R F] :
    map (Underlying.piFunctor (R := R) F) ⋙ T R B = T R A ⋙ F
proof:
:=
  CategoryTheory.Functor.ext (fun _ => rfl) fun X Y f => by
    simp only [Functor.comp_map, eqToHom_refl, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]
    change F.map f.1.1 + (F.map f.2.1 ≫ (PiSupercategory.β R F Y.obj.obj).inv) ≫
      (PiSupercategory.ζ (R := R) (F.obj Y.obj.obj)).hom =
        F.map (f.1.1 + f.2.1 ≫ (PiSupercategory.ζ (R := R) Y.obj.obj).hom)
    rw [PiSupercategory.β_inv, F.map_add, F.map_comp]
    simp

name: StringDiagrams.QPiFunctorData.IsCompatible.iff
statement:
theorem IsCompatible.iff {F : C ⥤ D} (hF : QPiFunctorData R F) :
    hF.IsCompatible R ↔ ∀ X : C,
      (QPiCategory.Q_pi (R := R) (C := D)).β.hom.app (F.obj X) ≫
        (QPiCategory.Q (R := R)).map (hF.β.hom.app X) ≫
          hF.γ.hom.app ((PiCategory.pi (R := R)).obj X) =
      (PiCategory.pi (R := R)).map (hF.γ.hom.app X) ≫ hF.β.hom.app ((QPiCategory.Q (R := R)).obj X) ≫
        F.map ((QPiCategory.Q_pi (R := R) (C := C)).β.hom.app X)
proof:
:= by
  unfold IsCompatible PiFunctor.IsPiNatural
  simp only [PiFunctor.comp_β, NatIso.ofComponents_hom_app, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.app_hom,
    Functor.mapIso_hom, Category.assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.QPiFunctorData.IsCompatible.of_iso
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsCompatible.iff] at hc ⊢
  intro X
  rw [← cancel_mono (x.hom.app ((QPiCategory.Q (R := R)).obj ((PiCategory.pi (R := R)).obj X)))]
  have h1 := hx.2 ((PiCategory.pi (R := R)).obj X)
  have h2 := hx.1 X
  have h3 := hx.1 ((QPiCategory.Q (R := R)).obj X)
  have h4 := hx.2 X
  have n1 := (QPiCategory.Q_pi (R := R) (C := D)).β.hom.naturality (x.hom.app X)
  have n2 := x.hom.naturality ((QPiCategory.Q_pi (R := R) (C := C)).β.hom.app X)
  simp only [Functor.comp_obj, Functor.comp_map] at n1 n2
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [h1, ← Functor.map_comp_assoc, h2, Functor.map_comp_assoc, ← reassoc_of% n1, hc X, n2,
    reassoc_of% h3, ← Functor.map_comp_assoc (PiCategory.pi (R := R)) (hF.γ.hom.app X), h4,
    Functor.map_comp_assoc]

theorem permMat_neg {ι κ : Type} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] {X : ι → D} {Y : κ → D} (e : ι ≃ κ)

  · subst h

name: StringDiagrams.PiTwoFunctor.unmapTwoNat_isPiTwoNatural
statement:
theorem unmapTwoNat_isPiTwoNatural (θ : TwoNatTrans hF.mapTwo hG.mapTwo) :
    hF.IsPiTwoNatural hG (unmapTwoNat hF hG θ)
proof:
:= fun a => by
  have e0 := congrArg Subtype.val (θ.isPiTwoNatural (⟨⟨a⟩⟩ : Underlying2 R (Associated2 R B)))
  change (PiTwoSupercategory.β (R := R) (θ.X (⟨a⟩ : Associated2 R B))).hom ≫
      BicategoryStruct.whiskerRight ((hF.mapTwo).jIso (⟨a⟩ : Associated2 R B)).hom
        (θ.X (⟨a⟩ : Associated2 R B)) ≫
        θ.x (PiTwoSupercategory.pi (R := R) (⟨a⟩ : Associated2 R B)) =
      BicategoryStruct.whiskerLeft (θ.X (⟨a⟩ : Associated2 R B))
        ((hG.mapTwo).jIso (⟨a⟩ : Associated2 R B)).hom at e0
  have e := congrArg Prod.fst e0
  simp only [Associated2.comp₂_fst, Associated2.comp₂_snd, Associated2.whiskerRight_fst,
    Associated2.whiskerRight_snd, Associated2.whiskerLeft_fst,
    Associated2.β_hom_eq, jIso_mapTwo_hom, Associated.homMk_fst, Associated.homMk_snd,
    mapTwo_x_snd, Limits.zero_comp, Limits.comp_zero, PreadditiveBicategory.zero_whiskerRight,
    sub_zero, add_zero] at e
  exact e

statement: theorem x_def {n i : ℕ} (h : i < n) : x R n i = (pres R).diag (dlay h)

name: StringDiagrams.Exterior.x_mul_x_self
statement: theorem x_mul_x_self (n i : ℕ) : x R n i * x R n i = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : i < n
  · have key := (pres R).lin_rel_cast () (shift i) (List.replicate (n - i - 1) ())
      (Obj.whiskerOK_of_subsingleton _ _ _) (a := strands n) (b := strands n)
      (obj_ext (by simp [pres, strands, shift, Obj.whisker]; omega))
      (obj_ext (by simp [pres, strands, shift, Obj.whisker]; omega))
    rw [show (pres R).rel () = LinDiagram.of _ from rfl, LinDiagram.whisker_of,
      LinDiagram.cast_of, Presentation.lin_of] at key
    rw [x_def R h, End.mul_def, ← Presentation.diag_comp, ← key]
    apply Presentation.diag_eq_of_layers_eq
    simp [dlay, lay, shift, Layer.whisker]
  · rw [x, dite_eq_right h, mul_zero]

name: StringDiagrams.Exterior.x_mul_x_anticomm
statement: theorem x_mul_x_anticomm {n i j : ℕ} (hij : i < j) : x R n i * x R n j = -(x R n j * x R n i)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hj : j < n
  · let d : InterchangeData sig := ⟨(), .dot, List.replicate (j - i - 1) (), .dot⟩
    have hx : d.Valid := InterchangeData.valid_of_subsingleton d
    have hd : d.dom.whisker (shift i) (List.replicate (n - j - 1) ()) = strands n :=
      obj_ext (by simp [d, InterchangeData.dom, shift, strands, sig]; omega)
    have hc : d.cod.whisker (shift i) (List.replicate (n - j - 1) ()) = strands n :=
      obj_ext (by simp [d, InterchangeData.cod, shift, strands, sig]; omega)
    have key := (pres R).diag_interchange d hx (shift i) _
      (Obj.whiskerOK_of_subsingleton _ _ _) hd hc
    have hs : ((d.sign : ℤ) : R) = -1 := by simp [d, InterchangeData.sign, sig]
    rw [hs, neg_one_smul] at key
    rw [x_def R (show i < n by omega), x_def R hj, End.mul_def, End.mul_def,
      ← Presentation.diag_comp, ← Presentation.diag_comp]
    have e₁ : (pres R).diag (dlay (show i < n by omega) ≫ dlay hj) =
        (pres R).diag (Diagram.cast (Diagram.whisker (InterchangeData.ghDiagram hx) (shift i)
          (List.replicate (n - j - 1) ()) (Obj.whiskerOK_of_subsingleton _ _ _)) hd hc) := by
      apply Presentation.diag_eq_of_layers_eq
      simp [d, dlay, lay, shift, Layer.whisker, InterchangeData.ghDiagram, InterchangeData.gh₁,
        InterchangeData.gh₂, sig]
      omega
    have e₂ : (pres R).diag (dlay hj ≫ dlay (show i < n by omega)) =
        (pres R).diag (Diagram.cast (Diagram.whisker (InterchangeData.hgDiagram hx) (shift i)
          (List.replicate (n - j - 1) ()) (Obj.whiskerOK_of_subsingleton _ _ _)) hd hc) := by
      apply Presentation.diag_eq_of_layers_eq
      simp [d, dlay, lay, shift, Layer.whisker, InterchangeData.hgDiagram, InterchangeData.hg₁,
        InterchangeData.hg₂, sig]
      omega
    rw [e₂, e₁, key, neg_neg]
  · simp only [x, dite_eq_right hj]; simp

name: StringDiagrams.SkewPolynomial.compatible
statement: theorem compatible : (D R).Compatible (pres R)

name: StringDiagrams.SkewPolynomial.x_eq_lin

theorem x_eq_lin {n i : ℕ} (h : i < n) :
    (pres R).lin (LinDiagram.of (dlay h)) = x R n i

name: StringDiagrams.SkewPolynomial.d_x
statement: theorem d_x (n i : ℕ) : d R n (x R n i) = x R n i * x R n i
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : i < n
  · rw [x, dite_eq_left h, Presentation.derivEnd_apply, dlay,
      Presentation.deriv_layer_of _ _ _ _ _ _ (ofGen Gen.dot ≫ ofGen Gen.dot) rfl, End.mul_def,
      ← Presentation.diag_comp]
    apply Presentation.diag_eq_of_layers_eq
    simp [lay, Layer.whisker, Signature.genLayer]
  · simp [x, dite_eq_right h]

name: StringDiagrams.SkewPolynomial.d_x_mul_x
statement:
theorem d_x_mul_x (n i j : ℕ) :
    d R n (x R n i * x R n j) = x R n i * x R n i * x R n j - x R n i * (x R n j * x R n j)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : i < n
  · rw [Presentation.deriv_mul _ _ _ _ (LinDiagram.hasParity_of (p := 1) rfl) (x_eq_lin R h),
      d_x, d_x, pow_one, neg_one_smul, sub_eq_add_neg]
  · simp [x, dite_eq_right h]

name: StringDiagrams.SkewPolynomial.d_ofGen_ofGen
statement:
theorem d_ofGen_ofGen :
    (pres R).deriv (compatible R) ((pres R).diag (ofGen Gen.dot)) =
      (pres R).diag (ofGen Gen.dot) ≫ (pres R).diag (ofGen Gen.dot)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Presentation.deriv_ofGen]
  show (pres R).lin (LinDiagram.of (ofGen Gen.dot ≫ ofGen Gen.dot)) = _
  rw [Presentation.lin_of, Presentation.diag_comp]

name: StringDiagrams.SkewPolynomial.d_d
statement:
theorem d_d {a b : Obj sig} (f : (pres R).obj a ⟶ (pres R).obj b) :
    (pres R).deriv (compatible R) ((pres R).deriv (compatible R) f) = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine Presentation.deriv_deriv_eq_zero _ _ (fun g => ?_) f
  cases g
  rw [d_ofGen_ofGen, Presentation.deriv_comp_diag]
  erw [d_ofGen_ofGen]
  rw [oddCount_ofGen]
  show ((-1 : R) ^ 1) • _ + _ = 0
  rw [pow_one, neg_one_smul, Category.assoc, neg_add_cancel]

name: StringDiagrams.SkewPolynomial.d_d_x
statement: theorem d_d_x (n i : ℕ) : d R n (d R n (x R n i)) = 0

name: StringDiagrams.ExteriorDeriv.derivDiag_dlay
statement:
theorem derivDiag_dlay {n i : ℕ} (h : i < n) :
    (D R).derivDiag (dlay h) = 𝟙 (Free.of R (strands n))
proof:
:= by
  rw [dlay, LocalDerivation.derivDiag_layer_of _ _ _ _ _ (𝟙 (sig.genDom Gen.dot)) rfl]
  show LinDiagram.of _ = LinDiagram.of (𝟙 (strands n))
  congr 1

name: StringDiagrams.ExteriorDeriv.compatible
statement: theorem compatible : (D R).Compatible (pres R)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun _ => ⟨2, LinDiagram.hasParity_of rfl⟩, fun _ => ?_⟩
  show (pres R).lin ((D R).derivFree (LinDiagram.of (dlay _ ≫ dlay _))) = 0
  rw [LocalDerivation.derivFree_of, LocalDerivation.derivDiag_comp, derivDiag_dlay]
  show (pres R).lin (((-1 : R) ^ 1) • _ + _) = 0
  rw [pow_one, neg_one_smul, Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id, neg_add_cancel,
    Presentation.lin_zero]

name: StringDiagrams.ExteriorDeriv.d_x
statement: theorem d_x {n i : ℕ} (h : i < n) : d R n (x R n i) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [x_def R h, Presentation.derivEnd_apply, Presentation.deriv_diag, derivDiag_dlay,
    Presentation.lin_id]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.ExteriorDeriv.d_x_mul_x
statement:
theorem d_x_mul_x {n i j : ℕ} (hi : i < n) (hj : j < n) :
    d R n (x R n i * x R n j) = x R n j - x R n i
proof:
:= by
  rw [Presentation.deriv_mul _ _ _ _ (LinDiagram.hasParity_of (p := 1) rfl)
      (x_def R hi).symm, d_x R hi, d_x R hj, pow_one, neg_one_smul, one_mul, mul_one,
    sub_eq_add_neg]

name: StringDiagrams.ExteriorDeriv.d_d
statement:
theorem d_d {a b : Obj sig} (f : (pres R).obj a ⟶ (pres R).obj b) :
    (pres R).deriv (compatible R) ((pres R).deriv (compatible R) f) = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine Presentation.deriv_deriv_eq_zero _ _ (fun g => ?_) f
  rw [Presentation.deriv_ofGen]
  show (pres R).deriv (compatible R) ((pres R).lin (𝟙 (Free.of R (sig.genDom g)))) = 0
  rw [Presentation.lin_id, Presentation.deriv_id]

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.TL.obj_tensor
statement: theorem TL.obj_tensor (m n : ℕ) : TL.obj R δ m ⊗ TL.obj R δ n = TL.obj R δ (m + n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [TL.obj, TL.obj, Presentation.obj_tensor]
  congr 1
  exact obj_ext (by simp [strands, Obj.tensor])

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.TL.obj_zero

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.strands_one_tensor_unit

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.unit_tensor_strands_one

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.coevaluation_evaluation
statement:
theorem coevaluation_evaluation :
    (pres R δ).wL (strands 1) ((pres R δ).diag cupD) ≫
        eqToHom (congrArg (pres R δ).obj
          (Obj.tensor_assoc (strands 1) (strands 1) (strands 1)).symm) ≫
          (pres R δ).wR ((pres R δ).diag capD) (strands 1) =
      eqToHom (congrArg (pres R δ).obj (Obj.tensor_unit (strands 1))) ≫
        eqToHom (congrArg (pres R δ).obj (Obj.unit_tensor (strands 1))).symm
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Presentation.wL_diag, Presentation.wR_diag, (pres R δ).eqToHom_obj,
    ← Presentation.diag_comp]
  rw [(pres R δ).diag_eq_of_layers_eq' _ (dcup (m := 1) (i := 1) le_rfl ≫
      dcap (m := 1) (i := 0) zero_le_one) strands_one_tensor_unit unit_tensor_strands_one ?_,
    Presentation.diag_comp, zigzagA_at δ le_rfl]
  · simp [Presentation.diag_eqToHom]
  · rfl

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.evaluation_coevaluation
statement:
theorem evaluation_coevaluation :
    (pres R δ).wR ((pres R δ).diag cupD) (strands 1) ≫
        eqToHom (congrArg (pres R δ).obj
          (Obj.tensor_assoc (strands 1) (strands 1) (strands 1))) ≫
          (pres R δ).wL (strands 1) ((pres R δ).diag capD) =
      eqToHom (congrArg (pres R δ).obj (Obj.unit_tensor (strands 1))) ≫
        eqToHom (congrArg (pres R δ).obj (Obj.tensor_unit (strands 1))).symm
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Presentation.wL_diag, Presentation.wR_diag, (pres R δ).eqToHom_obj,
    ← Presentation.diag_comp]
  rw [(pres R δ).diag_eq_of_layers_eq' _ (dcup (m := 1) (i := 0) zero_le_one ≫
      dcap (m := 1) (i := 1) le_rfl) unit_tensor_strands_one strands_one_tensor_unit ?_,
    Presentation.diag_comp, zigzagB_at δ le_rfl]
  · simp [Presentation.diag_eqToHom]
  · rfl

name: StringDiagrams.OddBrauer.cup_mem
statement:
theorem cup_mem (n i : ℕ) :
    cup R n i ∈
      parity (R := R) ((pres R).obj (strands n)) ((pres R).obj (strands (n + 2))) 1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : i ≤ n
  · rw [cup_def (R := R) h]
    have := Presentation.diag_isHomogeneous (isParityHomogeneous R) (dcup h)
    exact this
  · simp [cup, h]

name: StringDiagrams.OddBrauer.cap_mem
statement:
theorem cap_mem (n i : ℕ) :
    cap R n i ∈
      parity (R := R) ((pres R).obj (strands (n + 2))) ((pres R).obj (strands n)) 1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : i ≤ n
  · rw [cap_def (R := R) h]
    have := Presentation.diag_isHomogeneous (isParityHomogeneous R) (dcap h)
    exact this
  · simp [cap, h]

name: StringDiagrams.OddBrauer.cupShift_mem
statement:
theorem cupShift_mem (n i : ℕ) :
    cupShift R n i ∈ parity (R := R)
      (⟨0, (pres R).obj (strands n)⟩ : Envelope R (pres R).Presented)
      ⟨1, (pres R).obj (strands (n + 2))⟩ 0
proof:
:= by
  have := Envelope.ofHom_mem (X := (⟨0, (pres R).obj (strands n)⟩ : Envelope R (pres R).Presented))
    (Y := ⟨1, (pres R).obj (strands (n + 2))⟩) (cup_mem R n i)
  rwa [show (1 : ZMod 2) + (0 + 1) = 0 by decide] at this

name: StringDiagrams.OddBrauer.capShift_mem
statement:
theorem capShift_mem (n i : ℕ) :
    capShift R n i ∈ parity (R := R)
      (⟨1, (pres R).obj (strands (n + 2))⟩ : Envelope R (pres R).Presented)
      ⟨0, (pres R).obj (strands n)⟩ 0
proof:
:= by
  have := Envelope.ofHom_mem
    (X := (⟨1, (pres R).obj (strands (n + 2))⟩ : Envelope R (pres R).Presented))
    (Y := ⟨0, (pres R).obj (strands n)⟩) (cap_mem R n i)
  rwa [show (1 : ZMod 2) + (1 + 0) = 0 by decide] at this

statement:
theorem cupShift_comp_capShift {n i : ℕ} (h : i + 1 ≤ n) :
    cupShift R n (i + 1) ≫ capShift R n i = 𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.OddBrauer.extend_J
statement:
theorem extend_J {B : Type*} [Category B] [Preadditive B] [Linear R B] [Supercategory R B]

    [IsSuperfunctor R F] :
    Envelope.J R _ ⋙ Envelope.extend R F = F

name: StringDiagrams.WeightedBubbles.diag_whisker_bubble
statement:
theorem diag_whisker_bubble (μ : ℤ) (u : Obj sig) (v : List sig.Colour)
    (hw : (vac (μ + 2)).WhiskerOK u v) :
    (pres c).diag (Diagram.whisker (bubble μ) u v hw) = c (μ + 2) • 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  have key := (pres c).lin_rel μ u v hw
  have hrel : (pres c).rel μ = LinDiagram.of (bubble μ) - c (μ + 2) • LinDiagram.of (𝟙 _) := rfl
  rw [hrel] at key
  simp only [LinDiagram.whisker_sub, LinDiagram.whisker_smul, LinDiagram.whisker_of,
    Presentation.lin_sub, Presentation.lin_smul, Presentation.lin_of, sub_eq_zero] at key
  rw [key]
  exact congrArg (fun f => c (μ + 2) • f) ((pres c).diag_id _)

name: StringDiagrams.WeightedBubbles.diag_bubble
statement: theorem diag_bubble (μ : ℤ) : (pres c).diag (bubble μ) = c (μ + 2) • 𝟙 _

statement: theorem leftCup_valid (μ : ℤ) : (leftCup μ).Valid

name: StringDiagrams.WeightedBubbles.rightCup_valid

name: StringDiagrams.WeightedBubbles.interleaved
statement:
theorem interleaved (μ : ℤ) :
    (pres c).diag (interleavedDiagram μ) = (c (μ + 2 + 2) * c (μ + 2)) • 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  have hL := capL_valid μ
  have hM := cupR_valid μ
  have hc : (capL μ).dom.Composable (cupR μ).dom := ⟨hL.wf_dom, rfl, hM.wf_dom⟩
  have h₁ : (capL μ).cod.Composable (cupR μ).dom := hc.map_left (Diagram.ofLayer _ hL)
  have h₂ : (capL μ).dom.Composable (cupR μ).cod := hc.map_right (Diagram.ofLayer _ hM)
  have swap := (pres c).diag_swap_layers_of_composable _ _ hL hM hc h₁ h₂
  have h0 : ∀ N : Layer sig, Diagram.oddCountList [N] = 0 := fun N => by
    simp [Diagram.oddCountList, Signature.IsEven.odd_eq_false]
  rw [h0, h0, mul_zero, pow_zero, one_smul] at swap
  have hw₁ : (vac (μ + 2 + 2)).WhiskerOK (vac (μ + 2 + 2)) [.E (μ + 2)] :=
    ⟨trivial, rfl, ⟨rfl, trivial⟩⟩
  have hw₂ : (vac (μ + 2)).WhiskerOK (strandE μ) [] := ⟨⟨rfl, trivial⟩, rfl, trivial⟩
  have e₁ : (pres c).diag (interleavedDiagram μ) =
      (pres c).diag (Diagram.ofLayer _ (leftCup_valid μ)) ≫
        (pres c).diag (Diagram.lwhisker (capL μ).dom (Diagram.ofLayer _ hM) hc ≫
          Diagram.rwhisker (Diagram.ofLayer _ hL) (cupR μ).cod h₂) ≫
        (pres c).diag (Diagram.ofLayer _ (rightCap_valid μ)) := by
    rw [← Presentation.diag_comp, ← Presentation.diag_comp]; rfl
  have e₂ : (pres c).diag (Diagram.ofLayer _ (leftCup_valid μ)) ≫
        (pres c).diag (Diagram.rwhisker (Diagram.ofLayer _ hL) (cupR μ).dom hc ≫
          Diagram.lwhisker (capL μ).cod (Diagram.ofLayer _ hM) h₁) ≫
        (pres c).diag (Diagram.ofLayer _ (rightCap_valid μ)) =
      (pres c).diag (Diagram.whisker (bubble (μ + 2)) (vac (μ + 2 + 2)) [.E (μ + 2)] hw₁) ≫
        (pres c).diag (Diagram.whisker (bubble μ) (strandE μ) [] hw₂) := by
    rw [← Presentation.diag_comp, ← Presentation.diag_comp, ← Presentation.diag_comp]; rfl
  rw [e₁, ← swap, e₂, diag_whisker_bubble, diag_whisker_bubble, Linear.smul_comp,
    Linear.comp_smul, Category.id_comp, smul_smul]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.WeightedBubbles.leftBubble_eq
statement: theorem leftBubble_eq (μ : ℤ) : leftBubble c μ = c (μ + 2 + 2) • 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  have h := (pres c).wRAt_id (a := vac (μ + 2 + 2)) (r := μ + 2 + 2) rfl (strandE μ)
    ⟨rfl, trivial⟩
  rw [leftBubble, Presentation.Bicat.whiskerRight_eq, bubble₂, diag_bubble,
    Presentation.wRAt_smul]
  exact congrArg (fun f => c (μ + 2 + 2) • f) h

name: StringDiagrams.WeightedBubbles.rightBubble_eq
statement: theorem rightBubble_eq (μ : ℤ) : rightBubble c μ = c (μ + 2) • 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  have h := (pres c).wL_id_of_composable (a := strandE μ) (b := vac (μ + 2))
    ⟨⟨rfl, trivial⟩, rfl, trivial⟩
  rw [rightBubble, Presentation.Bicat.whiskerLeft_eq, bubble₂, diag_bubble,
    Presentation.wL_smul]
  exact congrArg (fun f => c (μ + 2) • f) h

name: StringDiagrams.WeightedBubbles.interp_mapChain
statement:
theorem interp_mapChain {a b : Obj sig} (ls : List (Layer sig)) (h : Chain a ls b) :
    (interp c).mapChain a ls b h = (ls.map fun L => scal c L.gen).prod • 𝟙 (ModuleCat.of R R)
proof:
:= by
  induction ls generalizing a with
  | nil =>
    simp only [Interpretation.mapChain, List.map_nil, List.prod_nil, one_smul]
    exact eqToHom_refl _ _
  | cons L ls ih =>
    simp only [Interpretation.mapChain, ih, List.map_cons, List.prod_cons]
    rw [eqToHom_refl _ _, Category.id_comp]
    simp only [interp, Linear.smul_comp, Linear.comp_smul, Category.id_comp, smul_smul,
      mul_comm]

name: StringDiagrams.WeightedBubbles.interp_map
statement:
theorem interp_map {a b : Obj sig} (d : a ⟶ b) :
    (interp c).functor.map d =
      ((Diagram.layers d).map fun L => scal c L.gen).prod • 𝟙 (ModuleCat.of R R)

name: StringDiagrams.WeightedBubbles.interp_respects
statement:
theorem interp_respects : (pres c).Respects (interp c).functor where
  rel μ u v hw
proof:
:= by
    simp only [pres, LinDiagram.whisker_sub, LinDiagram.whisker_smul, LinDiagram.whisker_of,
      Functor.map_sub, Functor.map_smul, freeLift_map_of, interp_map, Diagram.layers_whisker,
      Diagram.whisker_id, Diagram.layers_id, bubble, Diagram.layers_mk,
      Layer.whisker, List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.prod_cons,
      List.prod_nil, scal, mul_one, one_mul, smul_smul, sub_self]
  interchange x hx u v hw := by
    have hs : ((x.sign : ℤ) : R) = 1 := by
      simp [InterchangeData.sign, Signature.IsEven.odd_eq_false]
    simp only [InterchangeData.rel, hs, one_smul, LinDiagram.whisker_sub, LinDiagram.whisker_of,
      Functor.map_sub, freeLift_map_of, interp_map, Diagram.layers_whisker,
      InterchangeData.ghDiagram, InterchangeData.hgDiagram, Diagram.layers_mk,
      Layer.whisker, List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.prod_cons,
      List.prod_nil, InterchangeData.gh₁, InterchangeData.gh₂, InterchangeData.hg₁,
      InterchangeData.hg₂, mul_one]
    rw [mul_comm, sub_self]

name: StringDiagrams.WeightedBubbles.smul_id_injective
statement:
theorem smul_id_injective (a : Obj sig) {x y : R}
    (h : x • 𝟙 ((pres c).obj a) = y • 𝟙 ((pres c).obj a)) : x = y
proof:
:= by
  have h' := congrArg (fun f => ((rep c).map f).hom (1 : R)) h
  simpa [Functor.map_smul, rep] using h'

name: StringDiagrams.WeightedBubbles.leftBubble_ne_rightBubble
statement:
theorem leftBubble_ne_rightBubble (μ : ℤ) (hc : c (μ + 2 + 2) ≠ c (μ + 2)) :
    leftBubble c μ ≠ rightBubble c μ
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  rw [leftBubble_eq, rightBubble_eq] at h
  exact hc (smul_id_injective c _ h)

name: StringDiagrams.Examples.ChordDiagrams.sh_not_add
statement: @[simp] theorem sh_not_add (a : Bool) : sh (!a) + sh a = 0

name: StringDiagrams.Examples.ChordDiagrams.valid_cup
statement: theorem valid_cup (a : Bool) (ρ : ℤ) : Layer.Valid (⟨ρ, [], .cup a ρ, []⟩ : Layer sig)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨trivial, rfl, trivial, rfl, ?_, rfl, trivial⟩
  refine ⟨?_, rfl, trivial⟩
  show ρ + sh (!a) + sh a = ρ
  rw [add_assoc, sh_not_add, add_zero]

proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨trivial, rfl, ⟨rfl, rfl, trivial⟩, rfl, ⟨?_, rfl, trivial⟩, rfl, trivial⟩
  show ρ + sh a + sh b = ρ + sh b + sh a

name: StringDiagrams.Examples.ChordDiagrams.braid
statement: theorem braid (ρ : ℤ) (a b c : Bool) : (filt R ρ).Near 3 [a, b, c] braidL braidR
proof:
:= by
  apply gens.near_of_diag_eq (pres R) ρ
  intro f₁ f₂ h₁ h₂
  exact (pres R).diag_eq_of_diag_eq_of_layers f₁ f₂ (chordDiag ρ [a, b, c] braidL)
    (Diagram.cast (chordDiag ρ [a, b, c] braidR) rfl (congrArg (letters.obj ρ) (foldl_braid a b c)))
    rfl (congrArg (letters.obj ρ) (foldl_braid a b c)).symm h₁ (by rw [h₂]; rfl)
    ((pres R).diag_eq_of_rel (.braid ρ a b c) rfl)

name: StringDiagrams.Examples.ChordDiagrams.pitch
statement: theorem pitch (ρ : ℤ) (a c : Bool) : (filt R ρ).Near 1 [c] (pitchL a) (pitchR a)
proof:
:= by
  apply gens.near_of_diag_eq (pres R) ρ
  intro f₁ f₂ h₁ h₂
  exact (pres R).diag_eq_of_diag_eq_of_layers f₁ f₂ (chordDiag ρ [c] (pitchL a))
    (Diagram.cast (chordDiag ρ [c] (pitchR a)) rfl (congrArg (letters.obj ρ) (foldl_pitch a c)))
    rfl (congrArg (letters.obj ρ) (foldl_pitch a c)).symm h₁ (by rw [h₂]; rfl)
    ((pres R).diag_eq_of_rel (.pitch ρ a c) rfl)

name: StringDiagrams.Examples.ChordDiagrams.near_canon_or_reducible
statement:
theorem near_canon_or_reducible (ρ : ℤ) {D : List (Move Bool)} (hf : Fits 0 D) :
    (∃ A B : List (Move Bool), ∃ p : ℕ, (filt R ρ).Near (ncross D) [] D
        (A ++ [.cross p, .cross p] ++ B)) ∨
      (∃ A B : List (Move Bool), ∃ p : ℕ, ∃ a : Bool,
        (filt R ρ).Near (ncross D) [] D (A ++ [.cup p a, .cross p] ++ B)) ∨
      (filt R ρ).Near (ncross D) [] D (canon (run (!·) D))
proof:
:=
  gens.near_canon_or_reducible (LayerFiltration.bot (pres R) wt) (fun _ _ => rfl)
    (fun _ _ _ => rfl) (fun ρ a b c => braid R ρ a b c) (fun ρ a c => pitch R ρ a c) ρ hf

  split_ifs with h

  · exact Submodule.zero_mem _

name: StringDiagrams.FreeDots.x_pow_mem_endDeg
statement:
theorem x_pow_mem_endDeg (n i k : ℕ) :
    x R n i ^ k ∈ (pres R).endDeg deg (strands n) (2 * k)
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    simp only [pow_zero, Nat.cast_zero, mul_zero]
    exact SetLike.GradedOne.one_mem
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [pow_succ, show (2 : ℤ) * ↑(k + 1) = 2 * k + 2 by push_cast; ring]
    exact SetLike.GradedMul.mul_mem ih (x_mem_endDeg R n i)

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.pres_isHomogeneous
statement: theorem pres_isHomogeneous (t : ℤ) : (pres R δ).IsHomogeneous (S := sig) (deg t)
proof:
:= by
  intro r
  refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
  cases r with
  | loop =>
    exact Submodule.sub_mem _ (LinDiagram.of_mem_homDeg' (by simp))
      (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (LinDiagram.of_mem_homDeg' (Diagram.degree_id _ _)))
  | zigzagA =>
    exact Submodule.sub_mem _ (LinDiagram.of_mem_homDeg' (by simp))
      (LinDiagram.of_mem_homDeg' (Diagram.degree_id _ _))
  | zigzagB =>
    exact Submodule.sub_mem _ (LinDiagram.of_mem_homDeg' (by simp))
      (LinDiagram.of_mem_homDeg' (Diagram.degree_id _ _))

statement:
theorem e_mem_endDeg (t : ℤ) (m i : ℕ) :
    e δ m i ∈ (pres R δ).endDeg (deg t) (strands (m + 2)) 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold e
  split_ifs with h
  · have :=
      Presentation.comp_mem_homDeg (diag_dcap_mem_homDeg δ t h) (diag_dcup_mem_homDeg δ t h)
    rwa [neg_add_cancel] at this
  · exact Submodule.zero_mem _

name: StringDiagrams.FreeDots.list_unit_ext
statement: theorem list_unit_ext {l₁ l₂ : List Unit} (h : l₁.length = l₂.length) : l₁ = l₂
proof:
:= by
  induction l₁ generalizing l₂ with
  | nil => cases l₂ with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons _ _ => simp at h
  | cons a l ih => cases l₂ with
    | nil => simp at h
    | cons b l₂ => rw [ih (by simpa using h)]

name: StringDiagrams.FreeDots.x_mul_x_comm_of_lt
statement: theorem x_mul_x_comm_of_lt {n i j : ℕ} (hij : i < j) : x R n i * x R n j = x R n j * x R n i
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hj : j < n
  · let d : InterchangeData sig := ⟨(), .dot, List.replicate (j - i - 1) (), .dot⟩
    have hx : d.Valid := InterchangeData.valid_of_subsingleton d
    have hd : d.dom.whisker (shift i) (List.replicate (n - j - 1) ()) = strands n :=
      obj_ext (by simp [d, InterchangeData.dom, shift, strands, sig]; omega)
    have hc : d.cod.whisker (shift i) (List.replicate (n - j - 1) ()) = strands n :=
      obj_ext (by simp [d, InterchangeData.cod, shift, strands, sig]; omega)
    have key := (pres R).diag_interchange d hx (shift i) _
      (Obj.whiskerOK_of_subsingleton _ _ _) hd hc
    have hs : ((d.sign : ℤ) : R) = 1 := by simp [d, InterchangeData.sign, sig]
    rw [hs, one_smul] at key
    rw [x_def R (show i < n by omega), x_def R hj, End.mul_def, End.mul_def,
      ← Presentation.diag_comp, ← Presentation.diag_comp]
    have e₁ : (pres R).diag (dlay (show i < n by omega) ≫ dlay hj) =
        (pres R).diag (Diagram.cast (Diagram.whisker (InterchangeData.ghDiagram hx) (shift i)
          (List.replicate (n - j - 1) ()) (Obj.whiskerOK_of_subsingleton _ _ _)) hd hc) := by
      apply Presentation.diag_eq_of_layers_eq
      simp [d, dlay, lay, shift, Layer.whisker, InterchangeData.ghDiagram, InterchangeData.gh₁,
        InterchangeData.gh₂, sig]
      omega
    have e₂ : (pres R).diag (dlay hj ≫ dlay (show i < n by omega)) =
        (pres R).diag (Diagram.cast (Diagram.whisker (InterchangeData.hgDiagram hx) (shift i)
          (List.replicate (n - j - 1) ()) (Obj.whiskerOK_of_subsingleton _ _ _)) hd hc) := by
      apply Presentation.diag_eq_of_layers_eq
      simp [d, dlay, lay, shift, Layer.whisker, InterchangeData.hgDiagram, InterchangeData.hg₁,
        InterchangeData.hg₂, sig]
      omega
    rw [e₂, e₁, key]
  · simp only [x, dite_eq_right hj]; simp

name: StringDiagrams.FreeDots.x_mul_x_comm
statement: theorem x_mul_x_comm {n i j : ℕ} (hij : i ≠ j) : x R n i * x R n j = x R n j * x R n i
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.lt_or_gt_of_ne hij with h | h
  · exact x_mul_x_comm_of_lt R h
  · exact (x_mul_x_comm_of_lt R h).symm

name: StringDiagrams.FreeDots.FD.obj_tensor
statement: theorem FD.obj_tensor (m n : ℕ) : FD.obj R m ⊗ FD.obj R n = FD.obj R (m + n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [FD.obj, FD.obj, Presentation.obj_tensor]
  congr 1
  exact obj_ext (by simp [strands, Obj.tensor])

statement: theorem FD.obj_zero : 𝟙_ (FD R) = FD.obj R 0

name: StringDiagrams.FreeDots.x_whiskerRight
statement: theorem x_whiskerRight : x R 1 0 ▷ FD.obj R 1 = x R 2 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [x_def R (show 0 < 1 by omega), x_def R (show 0 < 2 by omega),
    Presentation.diag_whiskerRight]
  apply Presentation.diag_eq_of_layers_eq
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.FreeDots.whiskerLeft_x
statement: theorem whiskerLeft_x : FD.obj R 1 ◁ x R 1 0 = x R 2 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [x_def R (show 0 < 1 by omega), x_def R (show 1 < 2 by omega),
    Presentation.diag_whiskerLeft]
  apply Presentation.diag_eq_of_layers_eq
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.FreeDots.x_whiskerRight_strands
statement:
theorem x_whiskerRight_strands {n i : ℕ} (h : i < n) (m : ℕ) :
    x R n i ▷ FD.obj R m = eqToHom (FD.obj_tensor R n m) ≫ x R (n + m) i ≫
      eqToHom (FD.obj_tensor R n m).symm
proof:
:= by
  rw [x_def R h, x_def R (show i < n + m by omega), Presentation.diag_whiskerRight]
  simp only [FD.obj, (pres R).eqToHom_obj, ← Presentation.diag_comp]
  apply Presentation.diag_eq_of_layers_eq
  simp only [Diagram.layers_whiskerR, Diagram.layers_comp, Diagram.layers_eqToHom, dlay,
    Diagram.layers_layer, List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.nil_append, List.append_nil,
    List.cons.injEq, and_true]
  exact layer_ext (by simp [lay, Layer.wr]) (by simp [lay, Layer.wr, strands]; omega)

name: StringDiagrams.FreeDots.x_mul_x_comm_two
statement: theorem x_mul_x_comm_two : x R 2 0 * x R 2 1 = x R 2 1 * x R 2 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← x_whiskerRight, ← whiskerLeft_x, End.mul_def, End.mul_def]
  exact (whisker_exchange _ _).trans rfl

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.flip_rel
statement:
theorem flip_rel (r : (pres R δ).Rel) :
    (freeLift R (flip.toOpLayerMap.toPresented (pres R δ) fun _ => 1)).map
      ((pres R δ).rel r) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [OpLayerMap.freeLift_toPresented_one]
  apply Quiver.Hom.unop_inj
  rw [Quiver.Hom.unop_op, Limits.unop_zero]
  change (pres R δ).lin (flip.toOpLayerMap.lin (relation R δ r)) = 0
  cases r with
  | loop =>
    rw [relation, OpLayerMap.lin_sub, OpLayerMap.lin_smul, OpLayerMap.lin_of, OpLayerMap.lin_of,
      OpLayerMap.map_comp, flip_map_dcup, flip_map_dcap, flip_map_id, Presentation.lin_sub,
      Presentation.lin_smul, Presentation.lin_of, Presentation.lin_of, Presentation.diag_comp,
      loop_at]
    erw [Presentation.diag_id, sub_self]
  | zigzagA =>
    rw [relation, OpLayerMap.lin_sub, OpLayerMap.lin_of, OpLayerMap.lin_of, OpLayerMap.map_comp,
      flip_map_dcup, flip_map_dcap, flip_map_id, Presentation.lin_sub, Presentation.lin_of,
      Presentation.lin_of, Presentation.diag_comp, zigzagB_at δ (m := 1) (i := 0) le_rfl]
    erw [Presentation.diag_id, sub_self]
  | zigzagB =>
    rw [relation, OpLayerMap.lin_sub, OpLayerMap.lin_of, OpLayerMap.lin_of, OpLayerMap.map_comp,
      flip_map_dcup, flip_map_dcap, flip_map_id, Presentation.lin_sub, Presentation.lin_of,
      Presentation.lin_of, Presentation.diag_comp, zigzagA_at δ (m := 1) (i := 0) le_rfl]
    erw [Presentation.diag_id, sub_self]

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.flipFunctor_cup

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.flipFunctor_e

:= by
  by_cases h : i ≤ m
  · rw [e_def δ h, Functor.map_comp, unop_comp, flipFunctor_cup, flipFunctor_cap,
      Quiver.Hom.unop_op, Quiver.Hom.unop_op]
  · simp [e, h]

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.mirror_rel
statement:
theorem mirror_rel (r : (pres R δ).Rel) :
    (freeLift R (mirror.toLayerMap.toPresented (pres R δ) fun _ => 1)).map
      ((pres R δ).rel r) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [LayerMap.freeLift_toPresented_one]
  change (pres R δ).lin (mirror.toLayerMap.lin (relation R δ r)) = 0
  cases r with
  | loop =>
    rw [relation, LayerMap.lin_sub, LayerMap.lin_smul, LayerMap.lin_of, LayerMap.lin_of,
      LayerMap.map_comp, mirror_map_dcup₀, mirror_map_dcap₀, mirror_map_id₀,
      Presentation.lin_sub, Presentation.lin_smul, Presentation.lin_of, Presentation.lin_of,
      Presentation.diag_comp, loop_at δ (m := 0) (i := 0) le_rfl]
    erw [Presentation.diag_id, sub_self]
  | zigzagA =>
    rw [relation, LayerMap.lin_sub, LayerMap.lin_of, LayerMap.lin_of, LayerMap.map_comp,
      mirror_map_dcup₁, mirror_map_dcap₁, mirror_map_id₁, Presentation.lin_sub,
      Presentation.lin_of, Presentation.lin_of, Presentation.diag_comp,
      zigzagB_at δ (m := 1) (i := 0) le_rfl]
    erw [Presentation.diag_id, sub_self]
  | zigzagB =>
    rw [relation, LayerMap.lin_sub, LayerMap.lin_of, LayerMap.lin_of, LayerMap.map_comp,
      mirror_map_dcup₁, mirror_map_dcap₁, mirror_map_id₁, Presentation.lin_sub,
      Presentation.lin_of, Presentation.lin_of, Presentation.diag_comp,
      zigzagA_at δ (m := 1) (i := 0) le_rfl]
    erw [Presentation.diag_id, sub_self]

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.loopFunctor_loop
statement:
theorem loopFunctor_loop :
    (loopFunctor R δ).map ((loopPres R).diag (Diagram.ofLayer loopLayer loopLayer_valid)) =
      δ • 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  rw [loopFunctor, LocalMap.liftGen_layer, loopImg,
    (pres R δ).whisk_diag _ _ _ (Obj.whiskerOK_of_subsingleton _ _ _)]
  simp only [eqToHom_refl, Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id]
  rw [show Diagram.whisker (dcup (m := 0) (i := 0) le_rfl ≫ dcap (m := 0) (i := 0) le_rfl)
      (loopColours.obj ⟨loopLayer.start, loopLayer.left⟩) (loopColours.word loopLayer.right)
      (Obj.whiskerOK_of_subsingleton _ _ _) = dcup (m := 0) (i := 0) le_rfl ≫
        dcap (m := 0) (i := 0) le_rfl from Diagram.ext rfl,
    Presentation.diag_comp, loop_at]
  rfl

statement: theorem mirror_map_dot : mirror.toLayerMap.map dot = dot

name: StringDiagrams.Exterior.mirror_rel
statement:
theorem mirror_rel (r : (pres R).Rel) :
    (freeLift R (mirror.toLayerMap.toPresented (pres R) fun _ => 1)).map ((pres R).rel r) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [LayerMap.freeLift_toPresented_one]
  change (pres R).lin (mirror.toLayerMap.lin (LinDiagram.of (dot ≫ dot))) = 0
  rw [LayerMap.lin_of, LayerMap.map_comp, mirror_map_dot, Presentation.lin_of,
    Presentation.diag_comp]
  have := x_mul_x_self R 1 0
  rwa [x_def R (by decide), End.mul_def] at this

name: StringDiagrams.Exterior.composable_strands
statement: theorem composable_strands (m n : ℕ) : (strands m).Composable (strands n)

name: StringDiagrams.Exterior.mirror_tensor_dots
statement:
theorem mirror_tensor_dots :
    (pres R).diag (mirror.toLayerMap.map (Diagram.rwhisker dot (strands 1) (composable_strands 1 1)
      ≫ Diagram.lwhisker (strands 1) dot (composable_strands 1 1))) =
      -(pres R).diag (Diagram.rwhisker dot (strands 1) (composable_strands 1 1) ≫
        Diagram.lwhisker (strands 1) dot (composable_strands 1 1))
proof:
:= by
  rw [SigMirror.diag_map_tensor _ _ (fun _ => rfl)]
  have h₁ : Diagram.oddCount dot = 1 := rfl
  rw [h₁]
  simp only [mul_one, pow_one, neg_smul, one_smul, neg_inj]
  exact (pres R).diag_eq_of_layers_eq' _ _ rfl rfl rfl |>.symm

name: StringDiagrams.QPiCompat.mem_parity_one
statement: theorem mem_parity_one {X Y : Triv R} {f : X ⟶ Y} (hf : f ∈ parity (R := R) X Y 1) : f = 0
proof:
:= by
  have : f ∈ (⊥ : Submodule R (X ⟶ Y)) := by
    simpa [show ¬((1 : ZMod 2) = 0) by decide] using! hf
  simpa using this

name: StringDiagrams.QPiCompat.map_eq_zero_of_par_ne
statement:
theorem map_eq_zero_of_par_ne {X Y : A R} (f : X ⟶ Y) (h : X.obj.obj.par ≠ Y.obj.obj.par) :
    f = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Underlying.hom_ext; apply DegreeZero.hom_ext
  have hf : Envelope.toHom f.1.1 ∈ parity (R := R) X.obj.obj.obj Y.obj.obj.obj
      (0 + (X.obj.obj.par + Y.obj.obj.par)) := f.2
  have h1 : (0 : ZMod 2) + (X.obj.obj.par + Y.obj.obj.par) = 1 := by
    generalize X.obj.obj.par = a at h ⊢; generalize Y.obj.obj.par = b at h ⊢
    revert a b; decide
  rw [h1] at hf
  exact mem_parity_one R hf

name: StringDiagrams.QPiCompat.two_smul_id_ne_zero
statement:
theorem two_smul_id_ne_zero (h2 : (2 : R) ≠ 0) (a : ZMod 2) (m : ℤ) :
    (2 : R) • 𝟙 (⟨⟨⟨a, ⟨m, ModuleCat.of R R⟩⟩⟩⟩ : A R) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h' := congrArg (fun g : (⟨⟨⟨a, ⟨m, ModuleCat.of R R⟩⟩⟩⟩ : A R) ⟶ _ =>
    QEnvelope.toHom (Envelope.toHom g.1.1)) h
  simp only [Underlying.smul_val, DegreeZero.smul_val, Underlying.id_val, DegreeZero.id_val,
    Underlying.zero_val, DegreeZero.zero_val, Envelope.toHom_smul, Envelope.toHom_id,
    QEnvelope.toHom_smul, QEnvelope.toHom_id, Envelope.toHom_zero, QEnvelope.toHom_zero] at h'
  have h'' := congrArg (fun g : ModuleCat.of R R ⟶ ModuleCat.of R R => g.hom (1 : R)) h'
  change (2 : R) • (1 : R) = 0 at h''
  exact h2 (by simpa using h'')

name: StringDiagrams.QPiCompat.twisted_not_isCompatible
statement: theorem twisted_not_isCompatible (h2 : (2 : R) ≠ 0) : ¬ (twisted R).IsCompatible R
proof:
:= by
  intro hc
  rw [QPiFunctorData.IsCompatible.iff] at hc
  have h := hc X₀
  simp only [twisted, PiFunctor.id_β, Iso.refl_hom, NatTrans.id_app, Iso.trans_hom,
    NatTrans.comp_app, Functor.leftUnitor_hom_app, Functor.rightUnitor_inv_app,
    CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id, Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id, Iso.symm_hom,
    Functor.id_map, α, NatIso.ofComponents_hom_app, Functor.comp_obj, Functor.id_obj] at h
  have e1 : sign R (X₀ (R := R)).obj.obj.par = 1 := by show sign R 0 = 1; simp
  have e2 : sign R ((PiCategory.pi R).obj (X₀ (R := R))).obj.obj.par = -1 := by show sign R (0 + 1) = -1; simp
  rw [e1, e2, one_smul, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id, Category.id_comp,
    neg_smul, one_smul, Preadditive.comp_neg, Category.comp_id] at h
  have h3 : (2 : R) • (QPiCategory.Q_pi (R := R) (C := A R)).β.hom.app X₀ = 0 := by
    rw [two_smul]; nth_rw 1 [← h]; simp
  have h4 : (2 : R) • 𝟙 ((PiCategory.pi R).obj ((QPiCategory.Q R).obj (X₀ (R := R)))) = 0 := by
    have := congrArg (· ≫ (QPiCategory.Q_pi (R := R) (C := A R)).β.inv.app X₀) h3
    simpa using this
  exact two_smul_id_ne_zero h2 _ _ h4

name: StringDiagrams.QPiCompat.twisted_not_iso_image
statement:
theorem twisted_not_iso_image (h2 : (2 : R) ≠ 0) (F : B R ⥤ B R) [F.Additive] [F.Linear R]
    [IsGradedSuperfunctor R F] (x : 𝟭 (A R) ≅ GUnderlying.map R F) :
    ¬ QPiFunctorData.IsQPiNatural R (twisted R)
      (GUnderlying.qpiFunctor (R := R) F).toQPiFunctorData x.hom
proof:
:=
  fun hx => twisted_not_isCompatible h2
    (QPiFunctorData.IsCompatible.of_iso x hx (GUnderlying.qpiFunctor (R := R) F).isCompatible)

name: StringDiagrams.WalkingBiadjunction.zigzags
statement: theorem zigzags : (pres R).PivotalZigzags inv.toColourDuality

name: StringDiagrams.WalkingBiadjunction.dot_isCyclic
statement:
theorem dot_isCyclic (hg : psig.GenValid (.gen .dot)) :
    Biadjunction.IsCyclic (biadj (B R) ((pres R).genDom (.gen .dot) hg))
      (biadj (B R) ((pres R).genCod (.gen .dot) hg)) ((pres R).gen2 (.gen .dot) hg)
proof:
:= by
  rw [isCyclic_biadj_iff_single (B R) (c := .E) (c' := .E) rfl rfl]
  refine isCyclic_diag_of_rel (B R ((pres R).genDom (.gen .dot) hg) .E rfl)
    (B R ((pres R).genCod (.gen .dot) hg) .E rfl) _ rfl _ rfl _ rfl _ rfl
    (genDiag _ hg) (.inr ()) (r₁ := rotR) (r₂ := rotL) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · rfl

name: StringDiagrams.WalkingBiadjunction.isCyclic
statement:
theorem isCyclic {l m : (pres R).Bicat} {x x' : l ⟶ m} (θ : x ⟶ x') :
    Biadjunction.IsCyclic (biadj (B R) x) (biadj (B R) x') θ
proof:
:=
  pivotal_isCyclic inv (pres R) (zigzags R) (fun g hg => by cases g; exact dot_isCyclic R hg) θ

name: StringDiagrams.WalkingBiadjunction.bubble_comp_comm
statement:
theorem bubble_comp_comm {f : A R ⟶ Bo R} (α : strandE R ⟶ f) (β : f ⟶ strandE R) :
    StringDiagrams.Pivotal.rightTrace (α ≫ β) = StringDiagrams.Pivotal.rightTrace (β ≫ α)

name: StringDiagrams.WalkingBiadjunction.snakeUp_comp_snakeDown
statement: theorem snakeUp_comp_snakeDown : snakeUp R ≫ snakeDown R = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  have h := (biadjEF R).left.left_triangle
  rw [leftZigzag_eq] at h
  have e : snakeUp R ≫ snakeDown R = (λ_ _).inv ≫ ((biadjEF R).left.unit ▷ strandE R ≫
      (α_ _ _ _).hom ≫ strandE R ◁ (biadjEF R).left.counit) ≫ (ρ_ _).hom := by
    simp only [snakeUp, snakeDown, Category.assoc]
  rw [e, h]
  simp

name: StringDiagrams.WalkingBiadjunction.bubble_eq_trace_snakes
statement:
theorem bubble_eq_trace_snakes :
    StringDiagrams.Pivotal.rightTrace (𝟙 (strandE R)) =
      StringDiagrams.Pivotal.rightTrace (snakeDown R ≫ snakeUp R)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← snakeUp_comp_snakeDown R]
  exact bubble_comp_comm R _ _

name: StringDiagrams.OddBrauer.list_unit_ext
statement: theorem list_unit_ext {l₁ l₂ : List Unit} (h : l₁.length = l₂.length) : l₁ = l₂
proof:
:= by
  induction l₁ generalizing l₂ with
  | nil => cases l₂ with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons _ _ => simp at h
  | cons a l ih => cases l₂ with
    | nil => simp at h
    | cons b l₂ => rw [ih (by simpa using h)]

name: StringDiagrams.OddBrauer.list_unit_eq_iff
statement: @[simp] theorem list_unit_eq_iff {l₁ l₂ : List Unit} : l₁ = l₂ ↔ l₁.length = l₂.length

name: StringDiagrams.OddBrauer.isParityHomogeneous
statement: theorem isParityHomogeneous : (pres R).IsParityHomogeneous
proof:
:= by
  intro r
  cases r
  · refine ⟨0, Submodule.sub_mem _ (LinDiagram.of_mem_homDeg' ?_) (LinDiagram.of_mem_homDeg' ?_)⟩
    all_goals first | exact Diagram.degree_id _ _ | simp [dcross, Presentation.parityDeg, sig]
  · refine ⟨0, Submodule.sub_mem _ (LinDiagram.of_mem_homDeg' ?_) (LinDiagram.of_mem_homDeg' ?_)⟩
    all_goals first | exact Diagram.degree_id _ _ | simp [dcross, Presentation.parityDeg, sig]
  · refine ⟨0, Submodule.sub_mem _ (LinDiagram.of_mem_homDeg' ?_) (LinDiagram.of_mem_homDeg' ?_)⟩
    all_goals first | exact Diagram.degree_id _ _ | (simp [dcup, dcap, Presentation.parityDeg, sig]; try decide)
  · refine ⟨0, Submodule.add_mem _ (LinDiagram.of_mem_homDeg' ?_) (LinDiagram.of_mem_homDeg' ?_)⟩
    all_goals first | exact Diagram.degree_id _ _ | (simp [dcup, dcap, Presentation.parityDeg, sig]; try decide)
  · refine ⟨1, Submodule.sub_mem _ (LinDiagram.of_mem_homDeg' ?_) (LinDiagram.of_mem_homDeg' ?_)⟩
    all_goals simp [dcup, dcross, Presentation.parityDeg, sig]
  · refine ⟨1, Submodule.sub_mem _ (LinDiagram.of_mem_homDeg' ?_) (LinDiagram.of_mem_homDeg' ?_)⟩
    all_goals simp [dcup, dcross, Presentation.parityDeg, sig]

name: StringDiagrams.OddBrauer.whisk_eq
statement:

    (strands w).whisker (shift i) (List.replicate k ()) = strands n

name: StringDiagrams.OddBrauer.relation_at
statement:
theorem relation_at (r : Rel) (i k : ℕ) {a b : Obj sig}
    (ha : (strands r.dom).whisker (shift i) (List.replicate k ()) = a)
    (hb : (strands r.cod).whisker (shift i) (List.replicate k ()) = b) :
    (pres R).lin (LinDiagram.cast (LinDiagram.whisker (relation R r) (shift i)
      (List.replicate k ()) (Obj.whiskerOK_of_subsingleton _ _ _)) ha hb) = 0

name: StringDiagrams.OddBrauer.cup_def
statement: theorem cup_def {n i : ℕ} (h : i ≤ n) : cup R n i = (pres R).diag (dcup h)

name: StringDiagrams.OddBrauer.cap_def
statement: theorem cap_def {n i : ℕ} (h : i ≤ n) : cap R n i = (pres R).diag (dcap h)

name: StringDiagrams.OddBrauer.cross_def
