  simp only [insAt, List.getElem?_append, List.length_take, List.getElem?_take]
  rcases (show i < g ∨ i = g ∨ i = g + 1 ∨ g + 1 < i by omega) with h | rfl | rfl | h
  · simp [h]; omega
  · simp [Nat.min_eq_left hg]
  · simp [Nat.min_eq_left hg]
  · simp [Nat.min_eq_left hg, show ¬ i < g by omega, show i ≠ g by omega, show i ≠ g + 1 by omega]
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, i = g + 2 + m := ⟨i - g - 2, by omega⟩
    rw [show g + 2 + m - g = m + 2 by omega, show g + 2 + m - 2 = g + m by omega]
    simp [List.getElem?_drop]

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.rmIdx_lt_iff
statement: theorem rmIdx_lt_iff (r : ℕ) {i j : ℕ} : rmIdx r i < rmIdx r j ↔ i < j

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.rmIdx_inj
statement: theorem rmIdx_inj {r i j : ℕ} : rmIdx r i = rmIdx r j ↔ i = j

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.tau_lt_iff
statement:
theorem tau_lt_iff (p : ℕ) {i j : ℕ} (h : ¬ (i = p ∧ j = p + 1)) (h' : ¬ (i = p + 1 ∧ j = p)) :
    tau p i < tau p j ↔ i < j

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.swapAt_swapAt
statement: theorem swapAt_swapAt (s : List β) (p : ℕ) : swapAt (swapAt s p) p = s
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hp : p + 1 < s.length
  · apply List.ext_getElem?; intro i
    rw [getElem?_swapAt _ (by simpa using hp), getElem?_swapAt _ hp, tau_tau]
  · simp [swapAt, hp]

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.swapAt_of_le
statement: theorem swapAt_of_le (s : List β) {p : ℕ} (hp : ¬ p + 1 < s.length) : swapAt s p = s

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.rmAt_insAt
statement:
theorem rmAt_insAt (s : List β) (g : ℕ) (x y : β) (hg : g ≤ s.length) :
    rmAt (insAt s g x y) g = s
proof:
:= by
  apply List.ext_getElem?; intro i
  rw [getElem?_rmAt _ (by rw [length_insAt s hg]; omega), getElem?_insAt s hg]
  unfold rmIdx; split_ifs <;> first | rfl | omega

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.insAt_rmAt
statement:
theorem insAt_rmAt (s : List β) {r : ℕ} (hr : r + 1 < s.length) :
    insAt (rmAt s r) r s[r] s[r + 1] = s
proof:
:= by
  have hl := length_rmAt s (r := r) (by omega)
  apply List.ext_getElem?; intro i
  rw [getElem?_insAt _ (by omega)]
  simp only [getElem?_rmAt s (show r + 2 ≤ s.length by omega), rmIdx]
  rcases (show i < r ∨ i = r ∨ i = r + 1 ∨ r + 1 < i by omega) with h | rfl | rfl | h
  · simp [h]
  · simp
  · simp
  · simp [show ¬ i < r by omega, show i ≠ r by omega, show i ≠ r + 1 by omega,
      show ¬ i - 2 < r by omega, show i - 2 + 2 = i by omega]

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.idAt_ne_none_iff
statement: theorem idAt_ne_none_iff {i : ℕ} : idAt s i ≠ none ↔ i < s.length

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.Same.symm
statement: theorem Same.symm {i j : ℕ} (h : Same s i j) : Same s j i

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.same_comm
statement: theorem same_comm {i j : ℕ} : Same s i j ↔ Same s j i

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.Same.lt_left
statement: theorem Same.lt_left {i j : ℕ} (h : Same s i j) : i < s.length

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.Same.lt_right
statement: theorem Same.lt_right {i j : ℕ} (h : Same s i j) : j < s.length

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.Same.ne
statement: theorem Same.ne {i j : ℕ} (h : Same s i j) : i ≠ j

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.Valid.unique
statement: theorem Valid.unique (hv : Valid s) {i j j' : ℕ} (h : Same s i j) (h' : Same s i j') : j = j'

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.Valid.exists
statement: theorem Valid.exists (hv : Valid s) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < s.length) : ∃ j, Same s i j

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.idAt_swapAt
statement:
theorem idAt_swapAt {p : ℕ} (hp : p + 1 < s.length) (i : ℕ) :
    idAt (swapAt s p) i = idAt s (tau p i)

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.same_swapAt
statement:
theorem same_swapAt {p : ℕ} (hp : p + 1 < s.length) {i j : ℕ} :
    Same (swapAt s p) i j ↔ Same s (tau p i) (tau p j)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Same, idAt_swapAt hp, ne_eq, tau_inj]

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.idAt_rmAt
statement:
theorem idAt_rmAt {r : ℕ} (hr : r + 2 ≤ s.length) (i : ℕ) :
    idAt (rmAt s r) i = idAt s (rmIdx r i)

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.same_rmAt
statement:
theorem same_rmAt {r : ℕ} (hr : r + 2 ≤ s.length) {i j : ℕ} :
    Same (rmAt s r) i j ↔ Same s (rmIdx r i) (rmIdx r j)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Same, idAt_rmAt hr, ne_eq, rmIdx_inj]

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.Valid.swapAt
statement:
theorem Valid.swapAt (hv : Valid s) {p : ℕ} (hp : p + 1 < s.length) :
    Valid (Chord.swapAt s p)
proof:
:= by
  intro i hi
  have hi' : tau p i < s.length := by simp at hi; unfold tau; split_ifs <;> omega
  obtain ⟨j, hj, hu⟩ := hv (tau p i) hi'
  refine ⟨tau p j, ?_, fun k hk => ?_⟩
  · show Same _ _ _
    rw [same_swapAt hp, tau_tau]; exact hj
  · have hk' : Same (Chord.swapAt s p) i k := hk
    rw [same_swapAt hp] at hk'
    rw [← hu _ hk', tau_tau]

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.Valid.rmAt
statement:
theorem Valid.rmAt (hv : Valid s) {r : ℕ} (hadj : Same s r (r + 1)) :
    Valid (Chord.rmAt s r)
proof:
:= by
  have hr : r + 2 ≤ s.length := hadj.lt_right
  intro i hi
  rw [length_rmAt s hr] at hi
  have hi' : rmIdx r i < s.length := by unfold rmIdx; split_ifs <;> omega
  obtain ⟨j, hj, hu⟩ := hv (rmIdx r i) hi'
  have hjr : j ≠ r ∧ j ≠ r + 1 := by
    constructor
    · rintro rfl
      have := hv.unique hadj hj.symm
      unfold rmIdx at this; split_ifs at this <;> omega
    · rintro rfl
      have := hv.unique hadj.symm hj.symm
      unfold rmIdx at this; split_ifs at this <;> omega
  refine ⟨if j < r then j else j - 2, ?_, fun k hk => ?_⟩
  · show Same _ _ _
    rw [same_rmAt hr]
    have e : rmIdx r (if j < r then j else j - 2) = j := by
      unfold rmIdx; split_ifs <;> omega
    rw [e]; exact hj
  · have hk' : Same (Chord.rmAt s r) i k := hk
    rw [same_rmAt hr] at hk'
    have := hu _ hk'
    unfold rmIdx at this; split_ifs at this ⊢ <;> omega

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.idAt_insAt
proof:
:= by
  simp only [idAt, getElem?_insAt s hg]
  split_ifs <;> rfl

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.same_insAt_iff
statement:
theorem same_insAt_iff {g : ℕ} (hg : g ≤ s.length) {k : ℕ} (hk : ∀ x ∈ s, x.1 ≠ k) (a b : α)
    {i j : ℕ} : Same (insAt s g (k, a) (k, b)) i j ↔
      ((i = g ∧ j = g + 1) ∨ (i = g + 1 ∧ j = g) ∨
        (i ≠ g ∧ i ≠ g + 1 ∧ j ≠ g ∧ j ≠ g + 1 ∧ Same s (if i < g then i else i - 2)
          (if j < g then j else j - 2)))
proof:
:= by
  have hk' : ∀ i, idAt s i ≠ some k := by
    intro i h
    simp only [idAt, Option.map_eq_some_iff] at h
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := h
    exact hk x (List.mem_of_getElem? hx) rfl
  simp only [Same, idAt_insAt hg]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩
    split_ifs at h2 h3 <;> first
      | (left; omega) | (right; left; omega)
      | (exfalso; exact hk' _ h3) | (exfalso; exact hk' _ h3.symm)
      | (right; right; refine ⟨by omega, by omega, by omega, by omega, ?_⟩
         split_ifs; first | omega | exact ⟨by omega, h2, h3⟩)
  · rintro (⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, h7⟩)
    · simp
    · simp
    · refine ⟨fun e => ?_, ?_⟩
      · subst e; split_ifs at h5 <;> omega
      · split_ifs at h6 h7 ⊢ <;> first | omega | exact ⟨h6, h7⟩

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.Valid.insAt
statement:
theorem Valid.insAt (hv : Valid s) {g : ℕ} (hg : g ≤ s.length) {k : ℕ} (hk : ∀ x ∈ s, x.1 ≠ k)
    (a b : α) : Valid (Chord.insAt s g (k, a) (k, b))
proof:
:= by
  intro i hi
  rw [length_insAt s hg] at hi
  by_cases h1 : i = g
  · subst h1
    refine ⟨i + 1, (same_insAt_iff hg hk a b).2 (Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩), fun j hj => ?_⟩
    have hj' : Same _ _ _ := hj
    rw [same_insAt_iff hg hk] at hj'; omega
  by_cases h2 : i = g + 1
  · subst h2
    refine ⟨g, (same_insAt_iff hg hk a b).2 (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)), fun j hj => ?_⟩
    have hj' : Same _ _ _ := hj
    rw [same_insAt_iff hg hk] at hj'; omega
  obtain ⟨j, hj, hu⟩ := hv (if i < g then i else i - 2) (by split_ifs <;> omega)
  have hjl := hj.lt_right
  refine ⟨if j < g then j else j + 2, ?_, fun j' hj' => ?_⟩
  · show Same _ _ _
    rw [same_insAt_iff hg hk]
    right; right
    refine ⟨h1, h2, by split_ifs <;> omega, by split_ifs <;> omega, ?_⟩
    have e : (if (if j < g then j else j + 2) < g then (if j < g then j else j + 2)
        else (if j < g then j else j + 2) - 2) = j := by split_ifs <;> omega
    rw [e]; exact hj
  · have hj'' : Same _ _ _ := hj'
    rw [same_insAt_iff hg hk] at hj''
    rcases hj'' with h | h | ⟨-, -, h3, h4, h5⟩
    · omega
    · omega
    · have := hu _ h5
      split_ifs at this ⊢ <;> omega

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.mem_crSet
statement: theorem mem_crSet {x : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ × ℕ} : x ∈ crSet s ↔ Cr4 s x.1 x.2.1 x.2.2.1 x.2.2.2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [crSet, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_range, and_iff_right_iff_imp]
  intro h
  exact ⟨h.2.2.2.1.lt_left, h.2.2.2.2.lt_left, h.2.2.2.1.lt_right, h.2.2.2.2.lt_right⟩

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.ilv_iff
statement:
theorem ilv_iff (hv : Valid s) {q a b : ℕ} (ha : Same s q a) (hb : Same s (q + 1) b) :
    Ilv s q ↔ (q + 1 < a ∧ a < b) ∨ (b < q ∧ q + 1 < a) ∨ (a < b ∧ b < q)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, j, k, l, ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, h5⟩, h | h | h⟩ <;> obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := h
    · have := hv.unique ha h4; have := hv.unique hb h5; omega
    · have := hv.unique ha h5; have := hv.unique hb h4.symm; omega
    · have := hv.unique ha h4.symm; have := hv.unique hb h5.symm; omega
  · rintro (h | h | h)
    · exact ⟨q, q + 1, a, b, ⟨by omega, by omega, by omega, ha, hb⟩, Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩
    · exact ⟨b, q, q + 1, a, ⟨by omega, by omega, by omega, hb.symm, ha⟩,
        Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)⟩
    · exact ⟨a, b, q, q + 1, ⟨by omega, by omega, by omega, ha.symm, hb.symm⟩,
        Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)⟩

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.Ilv.lt
statement: theorem Ilv.lt (h : Ilv s q) : q + 1 < s.length
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, j, k, l, ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, h5⟩, h | h | h⟩ := h <;> obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := h
  · exact h5.lt_left
  · exact h4.lt_right
  · exact h5.lt_right

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.Ilv.not_same
statement: theorem Ilv.not_same (hv : Valid s) (h : Ilv s q) : ¬ Same s q (q + 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro hq
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hv.exists (show q < s.length by have := h.lt; omega)
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hv.exists h.lt
  have e1 := hv.unique ha hq
  have e2 := hv.unique hb hq.symm
  rw [ilv_iff hv ha hb] at h
  omega

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.swapAt_partners
statement:
theorem swapAt_partners {p : ℕ} (hp : p + 1 < s.length) {a b : ℕ} (ha : Same s p a)
    (hb : Same s (p + 1) b) (hab : ¬ Same s p (p + 1)) :
    Same (swapAt s p) p b ∧ Same (swapAt s p) (p + 1) a
proof:
:= by
  have ha1 : a ≠ p + 1 := fun e => hab (e ▸ ha)
  have hb1 : b ≠ p := fun e => hab (e ▸ hb).symm
  have ta : tau p a = a := by unfold tau; have := ha.ne; split_ifs <;> omega
  have tb : tau p b = b := by unfold tau; have := hb.ne; split_ifs <;> omega
  have t1 : tau p p = p + 1 := by simp [tau]
  have t2 : tau p (p + 1) = p := by simp [tau]
  rw [same_swapAt hp, same_swapAt hp, ta, tb, t1, t2]
  exact ⟨hb, ha⟩

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.ilv_swapAt_iff
statement:
theorem ilv_swapAt_iff (hv : Valid s) {p : ℕ} (hp : p + 1 < s.length)
    (hab : ¬ Same s p (p + 1)) : Ilv (swapAt s p) p ↔ ¬ Ilv s p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hv.exists (show p < s.length by omega)
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hv.exists hp
  obtain ⟨ha', hb'⟩ := swapAt_partners hp ha hb hab
  have hab' : a ≠ b := fun e => by subst e; have := hv.unique ha.symm hb.symm; omega
  have ha1 : a ≠ p + 1 := fun e => hab (e ▸ ha)
  have hb1 : b ≠ p := fun e => hab (e ▸ hb).symm
  rw [ilv_iff (hv.swapAt hp) ha' hb', ilv_iff hv ha hb]
  have := ha.ne; have := hb.ne
  omega

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.cr_rmAt_le
statement: theorem cr_rmAt_le {r : ℕ} (hr : r + 2 ≤ s.length) : cr (rmAt s r) ≤ cr s
proof:
:= by
  unfold cr
  refine Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn (fun x => (rmIdx r x.1, rmIdx r x.2.1, rmIdx r x.2.2.1,
    rmIdx r x.2.2.2)) (fun x hx => ?_) (fun x _ y _ h => ?_)
  · obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, h5⟩ := mem_crSet.1 hx
    apply mem_crSet.2
    exact ⟨(rmIdx_lt_iff r).2 h1, (rmIdx_lt_iff r).2 h2, (rmIdx_lt_iff r).2 h3,
      (same_rmAt hr).1 h4, (same_rmAt hr).1 h5⟩
  · simp only [Prod.mk.injEq, rmIdx_inj] at h
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := h
    exact Prod.ext h1 (Prod.ext h2 (Prod.ext h3 h4))

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.cr_swapAt_lt
statement: theorem cr_swapAt_lt (hv : Valid s) {p : ℕ} (h : Ilv s p) : cr (swapAt s p) < cr s
proof:
:= by
  have hp := h.lt
  have hn : ¬ Ilv (swapAt s p) p := by
    rw [ilv_swapAt_iff hv hp (h.not_same hv)]; exact not_not.2 h
  unfold cr
  let F : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ × ℕ → ℕ × ℕ × ℕ × ℕ := fun x => (tau p x.1, tau p x.2.1, tau p x.2.2.1,
    tau p x.2.2.2)
  have hF : Function.Injective F := by
    intro x y e
    simp only [F, Prod.mk.injEq, tau_inj] at e
    exact Prod.ext e.1 (Prod.ext e.2.1 (Prod.ext e.2.2.1 e.2.2.2))
  rw [← Finset.card_image_of_injective _ hF]
  apply Finset.card_lt_card
  rw [Finset.ssubset_iff_of_subset]
  · obtain ⟨i, j, k, l, hc, hq⟩ := h
    refine ⟨(i, j, k, l), mem_crSet.2 hc, fun hm => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨x, hx, e⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 hm
    rw [mem_crSet] at hx
    have ex : x = F (i, j, k, l) := by rw [← e]; simp [F, tau_tau]
    subst ex
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, -, -⟩ := hx
    simp only [F, tau] at h1 h2 h3
    rcases hq with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ <;>
      obtain ⟨h1', h2', h3', -, -⟩ := hc <;> split_ifs at h1 h2 h3 <;> omega
  · intro y hy
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 hy
    rw [mem_crSet] at hx ⊢
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, h5⟩ := hx
    have n1 : ¬ (x.1 = p ∧ x.2.1 = p + 1) := fun ⟨e1, e2⟩ =>
      hn ⟨_, _, _, _, ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, h5⟩, Or.inl ⟨e1, e2⟩⟩
    have n2 : ¬ (x.2.1 = p ∧ x.2.2.1 = p + 1) := fun ⟨e1, e2⟩ =>
      hn ⟨_, _, _, _, ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, h5⟩, Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨e1, e2⟩)⟩
    have n3 : ¬ (x.2.2.1 = p ∧ x.2.2.2 = p + 1) := fun ⟨e1, e2⟩ =>
      hn ⟨_, _, _, _, ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, h5⟩, Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨e1, e2⟩)⟩
    exact ⟨(tau_lt_iff p n1 (by omega)).2 h1, (tau_lt_iff p n2 (by omega)).2 h2,
      (tau_lt_iff p n3 (by omega)).2 h3, (same_swapAt hp).1 h4, (same_swapAt hp).1 h5⟩

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.Equiv.refl
statement: @[refl] theorem refl (X : List (Move α)) : Equiv X X

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.Equiv.symm
statement: theorem symm {X Y : List (Move α)} (h : Equiv X Y) : Equiv Y X

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.Equiv.trans
statement: theorem trans {X Y Z : List (Move α)} (h : Equiv X Y) (h' : Equiv Y Z) : Equiv X Z

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.Equiv.of_step
statement: theorem of_step {L R : List (Move α)} (h : Step L R) : Equiv L R
proof:
:=
  Relation.EqvGen.rel _ _ ⟨[], [], L, R, h, by simp, by simp⟩

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.Equiv.append_right
statement:
theorem append_right {X Y : List (Move α)} (h : Equiv X Y) (Z : List (Move α)) :
    Equiv (X ++ Z) (Y ++ Z)
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | rel X Y h =>
    obtain ⟨A, B, L, R, h, rfl, rfl⟩ := h
    exact Relation.EqvGen.rel _ _ ⟨A, B ++ Z, L, R, h, by simp, by simp⟩
  | refl => exact refl _
  | symm _ _ _ ih => exact ih.symm
  | trans _ _ _ _ _ ih ih' => exact ih.trans ih'

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.Equiv.append_left
statement:
theorem append_left {X Y : List (Move α)} (h : Equiv X Y) (Z : List (Move α)) :
    Equiv (Z ++ X) (Z ++ Y)
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | rel X Y h =>
    obtain ⟨A, B, L, R, h, rfl, rfl⟩ := h
    exact Relation.EqvGen.rel _ _ ⟨Z ++ A, B, L, R, h, by simp, by simp⟩
  | refl => exact refl _
  | symm _ _ _ ih => exact ih.symm
  | trans _ _ _ _ _ ih ih' => exact ih.trans ih'

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.Equiv.step_mid
statement:
theorem step_mid {L R : List (Move α)} (h : Step L R) (A B : List (Move α)) :
    Equiv (A ++ L ++ B) (A ++ R ++ B)

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.Reducible.of_equiv
statement:
theorem Reducible.of_equiv {D D' : List (Move α)} (h : Reducible D') (e : Equiv D D') :
    Reducible D
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨A, B, p, h⟩ := h
  refine ⟨A, B, p, ?_⟩
  rcases h with h | ⟨a, h⟩
  · exact Or.inl (e.trans h)
  · exact Or.inr ⟨a, e.trans h⟩

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.Reducible.append
statement:
theorem Reducible.append {D : List (Move α)} (h : Reducible D) (Z : List (Move α)) :
    Reducible (D ++ Z)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨A, B, p, h⟩ := h
  refine ⟨A, B ++ Z, p, ?_⟩
  rcases h with h | ⟨a, h⟩
  · exact Or.inl (by simpa using h.append_right Z)
  · exact Or.inr ⟨a, by simpa using h.append_right Z⟩

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.ilv_of_opn_cls
statement:
theorem ilv_of_opn_cls {s : List (ℕ × α)} (hv : Valid s) {q : ℕ} (hn : ¬ Same s q (q + 1))
    (ho : Opn s q) (hc : Cls s (q + 1)) : Ilv s q
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, hqa, ha⟩ := ho
  obtain ⟨b, hbq, hb⟩ := hc
  have h1 : a ≠ q + 1 := fun e => hn (e ▸ ha)
  have h2 : b ≠ q := fun e => hn (e ▸ hb).symm
  rw [ilv_iff hv ha hb]; omega

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.canon_adj
statement:
theorem canon_adj {s : List (ℕ × α)} (hv : Valid s) {r : ℕ} (hr : Same s r (r + 1))
    (hmin : ∀ r' < r, ¬ Same s r' (r' + 1)) :
    canon s = canon (rmAt s r) ++ [.cup r (s[r]'hr.lt_left).2]
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h : ∃ r, Same s r (r + 1) := ⟨r, hr⟩
  have e : Nat.find h = r := le_antisymm (Nat.find_min' h hr)
    (not_lt.1 fun hl => hmin _ hl (Nat.find_spec h))
  rw [canon, dite_eq_left hv, dite_eq_left h]
  subst e
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.canon_cross
statement:
theorem canon_cross {s : List (ℕ × α)} (hv : Valid s) (hno : ∀ r, ¬ Same s r (r + 1))
    (hne : s ≠ []) : ∃ q, Opn s q ∧ Cls s (q + 1) ∧ canon s = canon (swapAt s q) ++ [.cross q] ∧
      ∀ q' < q, ¬ (Opn s q' ∧ Cls s (q' + 1))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h : ¬ ∃ r, Same s r (r + 1) := fun ⟨r, hr⟩ => hno r hr
  have h' : ∃ q, Opn s q ∧ Cls s (q + 1) := by
    
    have hex : ∃ i, Cls s i := by
      obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hv.exists (show 0 < s.length from List.length_pos_of_ne_nil hne)
      exact ⟨j, 0, Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hj.ne.symm, hj.symm⟩
    have hi := Nat.find_spec hex
    have hpos : Nat.find hex ≠ 0 := by
      intro e; obtain ⟨j, hj, -⟩ := hi; omega
    refine ⟨Nat.find hex - 1, ?_, by rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel (by omega)]; exact hi⟩
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hv.exists (show Nat.find hex - 1 < s.length by
      obtain ⟨_, _, hc⟩ := hi; have := hc.lt_left; omega)
    refine ⟨j, ?_, hj⟩
    by_contra hlt
    have hj' : j < Nat.find hex - 1 := lt_of_le_of_ne (not_lt.1 hlt) hj.ne.symm
    exact Nat.find_min hex (show Nat.find hex - 1 < Nat.find hex by omega) ⟨j, hj', hj⟩
  refine ⟨Nat.find h', (Nat.find_spec h').1, (Nat.find_spec h').2, ?_,
    fun q' hq' => Nat.find_min h' hq'⟩
  rw [canon, dite_eq_left hv, dite_eq_right h, dite_eq_left h']

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.canon_nil
statement: theorem canon_nil : canon ([] : List (ℕ × α)) = []
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hv : Valid ([] : List (ℕ × α)) := fun i hi => by simp at hi
  rw [canon, dite_eq_left hv, dite_eq_right (fun ⟨r, hr⟩ => by have := hr.lt_left; simp at this),
    dite_eq_right (fun ⟨q, ⟨j, _, hj⟩, _⟩ => by have := hj.lt_left; simp at this)]

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.swapAt_append_cons_cons
statement:
theorem swapAt_append_cons_cons (u : List β) (x y : β) (t : List β) :
    swapAt (u ++ x :: y :: t) u.length = u ++ y :: x :: t
proof:
:= by
  have h : u.length + 1 < (u ++ x :: y :: t).length := by simp
  rw [swapAt, dite_eq_left h]
  simp [List.set_append_right]

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.exists_eq_append_cons_cons
statement:
theorem exists_eq_append_cons_cons {l : List β} {p : ℕ} (h : p + 1 < l.length) :
    ∃ u x y t, l = u ++ x :: y :: t ∧ u.length = p
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨l.take p, l[p], l[p + 1], l.drop (p + 2), ?_, by simp; omega⟩
  conv_lhs => rw [← List.take_append_drop p l]
  rw [List.drop_eq_getElem_cons (by omega), List.drop_eq_getElem_cons (by omega)]

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.exists_eq_append
statement:
theorem exists_eq_append {l : List β} {g : ℕ} (h : g ≤ l.length) :
    ∃ u t, l = u ++ t ∧ u.length = g
proof:
:=
  ⟨l.take g, l.drop g, (List.take_append_drop g l).symm, by simp; omega⟩

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.lstep_cup_append
statement:
theorem lstep_cup_append (u t : List α) (a : α) :
    lstep d (u ++ t) (.cup u.length a) = u ++ a :: d a :: t

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.lstep_cup_append'
statement:
theorem lstep_cup_append' (u t : List α) (a : α) {g : ℕ} (hg : u.length = g) :
    lstep d (u ++ t) (.cup g a) = u ++ a :: d a :: t
proof:
:= by
  subst hg; exact lstep_cup_append d u t a

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.lstep_cross_append'
statement:
theorem lstep_cross_append' (u : List α) (x y : α) (t : List α) {p : ℕ} (hp : u.length = p) :
    lstep d (u ++ x :: y :: t) (.cross p) = u ++ y :: x :: t
proof:
:= by
  subst hp; exact swapAt_append_cons_cons u x y t

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.lstep_cross_append
statement:
theorem lstep_cross_append (u : List α) (x y : α) (t : List α) :
    lstep d (u ++ x :: y :: t) (.cross u.length) = u ++ y :: x :: t

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.Move.ok_shift
statement: theorem Move.ok_shift {n : ℕ} (k m' : ℕ) {m : Move α} (hm : m.Ok n) : (m.shift k).Ok (k + n + m')
proof:
:= by
  cases m <;> simp only [Move.shift, Move.Ok] at hm ⊢ <;> omega

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.lstep_shift
statement:
theorem lstep_shift (u l v : List α) {m : Move α} (hm : m.Ok l.length) :
    lstep d (u ++ l ++ v) (m.shift u.length) = u ++ lstep d l m ++ v
proof:
:= by
  cases m with
  | cup g a =>
    simp only [Move.Ok] at hm
    obtain ⟨l₁, l₂, rfl, rfl⟩ := exists_eq_append hm
    have := lstep_cup_append d (u ++ l₁) (l₂ ++ v) a
    simp only [List.length_append, List.append_assoc] at this
    simp only [Move.shift, List.append_assoc, this, lstep_cup_append]
    simp
  | cross p =>
    simp only [Move.Ok] at hm
    obtain ⟨l₁, x, y, t, rfl, rfl⟩ := exists_eq_append_cons_cons hm
    have := lstep_cross_append d (u ++ l₁) x y (t ++ v)
    simp only [List.length_append, List.append_assoc] at this
    simp only [Move.shift, List.append_assoc, List.cons_append, this, lstep_cross_append]

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.foldl_shift
statement:
theorem foldl_shift (u v : List α) {l : List α} {D : List (Move α)} (hf : Fits l.length D) :
    (D.map (Move.shift u.length)).foldl (lstep d) (u ++ l ++ v) = u ++ D.foldl (lstep d) l ++ v
proof:
:= by
  induction D generalizing l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons m D ih =>
    obtain ⟨hm, hf⟩ := hf
    rw [← length_lstep (d := d)] at hf
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.foldl_cons, lstep_shift d u l v hm]
    exact ih hf

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.Move.len_shift
statement: theorem Move.len_shift (k j n : ℕ) (m : Move α) : (m.shift k).len (k + n + j) = k + m.len n + j
proof:
:= by
  cases m with
  | cup g a => simp only [Move.shift, Move.len]; omega
  | cross p => rfl

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.fits_shift
statement:
theorem fits_shift (k j : ℕ) {n : ℕ} {D : List (Move α)} (hf : Fits n D) :
    Fits (k + n + j) (D.map (Move.shift k))
proof:
:= by
  induction D generalizing n with
  | nil => trivial
  | cons m D ih =>
    obtain ⟨hm, hf⟩ := hf
    refine ⟨Move.ok_shift k j hm, ?_⟩
    rw [Move.len_shift]
    exact ih hf

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.ChordGens.moveLayers_cup'
statement:
theorem moveLayers_cup' (u t : List S.Colour) (a : S.Colour) {g : ℕ} (hg : u.length = g) :
    G.moveLayers r₀ (u ++ t) (.cup g a) = [⟨r₀, u, G.cup a, t⟩]

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.ChordGens.moveLayers_cup
statement:
theorem moveLayers_cup (u t : List S.Colour) (a : S.Colour) :
    G.moveLayers r₀ (u ++ t) (.cup u.length a) = [⟨r₀, u, G.cup a, t⟩]

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.ChordGens.moveLayers_cross
statement:
theorem moveLayers_cross (u : List S.Colour) (x y : S.Colour) (t : List S.Colour) :
    G.moveLayers r₀ (u ++ x :: y :: t) (.cross u.length) = [⟨r₀, u, G.cross x y, t⟩]
proof:
:= by
  have h : u.length + 1 < (u ++ x :: y :: t).length := by simp
  simp only [moveLayers, dite_eq_left h]
  congr 3
  · simp
  · simp [List.getElem_append_right]
  · simp [List.getElem_append_right]
  · rw [show u.length + 2 = u.length + 2 from rfl, List.drop_length_add_append]; rfl

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.ChordGens.moveLayers_cross'
statement:
theorem moveLayers_cross' (u : List S.Colour) (x y : S.Colour) (t : List S.Colour) {p : ℕ}
    (hp : u.length = p) : G.moveLayers r₀ (u ++ x :: y :: t) (.cross p) = [⟨r₀, u, G.cross x y, t⟩]
proof:
:= by
  subst hp; exact G.moveLayers_cross r₀ u x y t

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.ChordGens.chain_moveLayers
statement:
theorem chain_moveLayers (l : List S.Colour) (m : Move S.Colour) :
    Chain ⟨r₀, l⟩ (G.moveLayers r₀ l m) ⟨r₀, lstep d l m⟩
proof:
:= by
  cases m with
  | cup g a =>
    refine ⟨Layer.valid_of_subsingleton _, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp [Layer.dom, G.cup_dom]
    · simp [Layer.cod, G.cup_cod, lstep, insAt]
  | cross p =>
    by_cases h : p + 1 < l.length
    · obtain ⟨u, x, y, t, rfl, rfl⟩ := exists_eq_append_cons_cons h
      rw [moveLayers_cross, lstep_cross_append]
      refine ⟨Layer.valid_of_subsingleton _, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simp [Layer.dom, G.cross_dom]
      · simp [Layer.cod, G.cross_cod]
    · simp only [moveLayers, dite_eq_right h, chain_nil]
      simp [lstep, swapAt_of_le l h]

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.ChordGens.chain_layersOf
statement:
theorem chain_layersOf (l : List S.Colour) (D : List (Move S.Colour)) :
    Chain ⟨r₀, l⟩ (G.layersOf r₀ l D) ⟨r₀, D.foldl (lstep d) l⟩
proof:
:= by
  induction D generalizing l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons m D ih => exact (G.chain_moveLayers r₀ l m).append (ih _)

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.ChordGens.eval_interp
statement:
theorem eval_interp (l : List S.Colour) (D : List (Move S.Colour)) :
    (G.interp r₀ P).eval l D = P.diag ⟨G.layersOf r₀ l D, G.chain_layersOf r₀ l D⟩
proof:
:= by
  induction D generalizing l with
  | nil => exact (P.diag_id _).symm
  | cons m D ih =>
    rw [MoveInterp.eval_cons, ih]
    exact (P.diag_comp _ _).symm

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.ChordGens.eval_comp_eqToHom_eq
statement:
theorem eval_comp_eqToHom_eq {l : List S.Colour} {X Y : List (Move S.Colour)}
    (e : X.foldl (lstep d) l = Y.foldl (lstep d) l)
    (f : (⟨r₀, l⟩ : Obj S) ⟶ ⟨r₀, Y.foldl (lstep d) l⟩) (hf : Diagram.layers f = G.layersOf r₀ l X) :
    (G.interp r₀ P).eval l X ≫ eqToHom (congrArg (G.interp r₀ P).obj e) = P.diag f
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ (t : List S.Colour) (c : Chain ⟨r₀, l⟩ (G.layersOf r₀ l X) ⟨r₀, t⟩)
      (e : t = Y.foldl (lstep d) l),
      P.diag ⟨G.layersOf r₀ l X, c⟩ ≫ eqToHom (congrArg (G.interp r₀ P).obj e) =
        P.diag ⟨G.layersOf r₀ l X, e ▸ c⟩ := by
    intro t c e; subst e; simp
  rw [eval_interp, key _ _ e]
  obtain ⟨ls, hc⟩ := f
  simp only [Diagram.layers] at hf
  subst hf
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.ChordGens.diag_comp_eqToHom_of_layers_eq
statement:
theorem diag_comp_eqToHom_of_layers_eq {a b b' : Obj S} (f : a ⟶ b) (f' : a ⟶ b') (h : b = b')
    (hl : Diagram.layers f = Diagram.layers f') :
    P.diag f ≫ eqToHom (congrArg P.obj h) = P.diag f'
proof:
:= by
  subst h; simpa using P.diag_eq_of_layers_eq hl

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.ChordGens.diag_mk_congr
statement:
theorem diag_mk_congr {a b : Obj S} {ls ls' : List (Layer S)} (h : Chain a ls b) (e : ls = ls') :
    P.diag ⟨ls, h⟩ = P.diag ⟨ls', e ▸ h⟩

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.ChordGens.diag_mk_singleton
statement:
theorem diag_mk_singleton {a b : Obj S} (L : Layer S) (h : Chain a [L] b) :
    P.diag ⟨[L], h⟩ = eqToHom (congrArg P.obj h.2.1.symm) ≫
      P.diag (Diagram.ofLayer L h.1) ≫ eqToHom (congrArg P.obj h.2.2)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hv, rfl, rfl⟩ := h
  simp [Diagram.ofLayer]

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.LayerFiltration.eqToHom_comp_mem
statement:
theorem eqToHom_comp_mem {n : ℕ} {a a' b : Obj S} (h : a' = a) {x : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b}
    (hx : x ∈ Q.sub n a b) : eqToHom (congrArg P.obj h) ≫ x ∈ Q.sub n a' b
proof:
:= by
  subst h; simpa using hx

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.LayerFiltration.comp_eqToHom_mem
statement:
theorem comp_eqToHom_mem {n : ℕ} {a b b' : Obj S} (h : b = b') {x : P.obj a ⟶ P.obj b}
    (hx : x ∈ Q.sub n a b) : x ≫ eqToHom (congrArg P.obj h) ∈ Q.sub n a b'
proof:
:= by
  subst h; simpa using hx

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.LayerFiltration.layer_comp_mem'
statement:
theorem layer_comp_mem' {n : ℕ} {L : Layer S} (hv : L.Valid) {a b c : Obj S} (ha : L.dom = a)
    (hb : L.cod = b) {x : P.obj b ⟶ P.obj c} (hx : x ∈ Q.sub n b c) :
    (eqToHom (congrArg P.obj ha.symm) ≫ P.diag (Diagram.ofLayer L hv) ≫
      eqToHom (congrArg P.obj hb)) ≫ x ∈ Q.sub (wt L.gen + n) a c
proof:
:= by
  subst ha hb; simpa using Q.layer_comp_mem hv hx

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.LayerFiltration.comp_layer_mem'
statement:
theorem comp_layer_mem' {n : ℕ} {L : Layer S} (hv : L.Valid) {a b c : Obj S} (ha : L.dom = a)
    (hb : L.cod = b) {x : P.obj c ⟶ P.obj a} (hx : x ∈ Q.sub n c a) :
    x ≫ eqToHom (congrArg P.obj ha.symm) ≫ P.diag (Diagram.ofLayer L hv) ≫
      eqToHom (congrArg P.obj hb) ∈ Q.sub (n + wt L.gen) c b
proof:
:= by
  subst ha hb; simpa using Q.comp_layer_mem hv hx

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.ChordGens.map_interp_of_singleton
statement:
theorem map_interp_of_singleton {l : List S.Colour} {m : Move S.Colour} {L : Layer S}
    (h : G.moveLayers r₀ l m = [L]) :
    (G.interp r₀ P).map l m = eqToHom (congrArg P.obj ((h ▸ G.chain_moveLayers r₀ l m :
        Chain _ [L] _).2.1.symm)) ≫
      P.diag (Diagram.ofLayer L (h ▸ G.chain_moveLayers r₀ l m : Chain _ [L] _).1) ≫
        eqToHom (congrArg P.obj (h ▸ G.chain_moveLayers r₀ l m : Chain _ [L] _).2.2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← diag_mk_singleton]
  exact diag_mk_congr P _ h

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.ChordGens.moveLayers_eq_singleton
statement:
theorem moveLayers_eq_singleton {l : List S.Colour} {m : Move S.Colour} (hm : m.Ok l.length) :
    ∃ L, G.moveLayers r₀ l m = [L]
proof:
:= by
  cases m with
  | cup g a => exact ⟨_, rfl⟩
  | cross p =>
    simp only [Move.Ok] at hm
    exact ⟨_, dite_eq_left hm⟩

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.ChordGens.near_of_diag_eq
proof:
:= by
  intro e
  rw [G.eval_comp_eqToHom_eq r₀ P e ⟨G.layersOf r₀ l X, e ▸ G.chain_layersOf r₀ l X⟩ rfl,
    eval_interp, h _ ⟨G.layersOf r₀ l Y, G.chain_layersOf r₀ l Y⟩ rfl rfl, sub_self]
  exact zero_mem _

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.ChordGens.layersOf_pair
statement:
theorem layersOf_pair (l : List S.Colour) (m₁ m₂ : Move S.Colour) :
    G.layersOf r₀ l [m₁, m₂] = G.moveLayers r₀ l m₁ ++ G.moveLayers r₀ (lstep d l m₁) m₂

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.ChordGens.near_xx
statement:
theorem near_xx (Φ : (G.interp r₀ P).Filtration) {n p p' : ℕ} (hp : p + 2 ≤ p')
    {l : List S.Colour} (hf : Fits l.length ([.cross p, .cross p'] : List (Move S.Colour))) :
    Φ.Near n l [.cross p, .cross p'] [.cross p', .cross p]
proof:
:= by
  have hl : p' + 1 < l.length := by simp [Fits, Move.Ok, Move.len] at hf; omega
  obtain ⟨u, x, y, t, rfl, rfl⟩ := exists_eq_append_cons_cons (show p + 1 < l.length by omega)
  obtain ⟨m, z, w, v, rfl, hm⟩ :=
    exists_eq_append_cons_cons (show p' - u.length - 2 + 1 < t.length by simp at hl; omega)
  apply near_of_diag_eq G r₀ P
  intro f₁ f₂ h₁ h₂
  refine P.diag_interchange_of_layers_of_even r₀ u m v (G.cross x y) (G.cross z w)
    (Or.inl (G.cross_even _ _)) f₁ f₂ ?_ ?_
  · rw [h₁, layersOf_pair, moveLayers_cross, lstep_cross_append,
      show u ++ y :: x :: (m ++ z :: w :: v) = (u ++ y :: x :: m) ++ z :: w :: v by simp,
      moveLayers_cross' _ _ _ _ _ _ (by simp; omega)]
    simp [G.cross_dom, G.cross_cod]
  · rw [h₂, layersOf_pair,
      show u ++ x :: y :: (m ++ z :: w :: v) = (u ++ x :: y :: m) ++ z :: w :: v by simp,
      moveLayers_cross' _ _ _ _ _ _ (by simp; omega),
      lstep_cross_append' _ _ _ _ _ (by simp; omega),
      show (u ++ x :: y :: m) ++ w :: z :: v = u ++ x :: y :: (m ++ w :: z :: v) by simp,
      moveLayers_cross]
    simp [G.cross_dom, G.cross_cod]

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.ChordGens.near_xuL
statement:
theorem near_xuL (Φ : (G.interp r₀ P).Filtration) {n p g : ℕ} (a : S.Colour) (hp : p + 2 ≤ g)
    {l : List S.Colour} (hf : Fits l.length [.cross p, (.cup g a : Move S.Colour)]) :
    Φ.Near n l [.cross p, .cup g a] [.cup g a, .cross p]
proof:
:= by
  have hl : p + 1 < l.length ∧ g ≤ l.length := by simp [Fits, Move.Ok, Move.len] at hf; omega
  obtain ⟨u, x, y, t, rfl, rfl⟩ := exists_eq_append_cons_cons hl.1
  obtain ⟨m, v, rfl, hm⟩ :=
    exists_eq_append (show g - u.length - 2 ≤ t.length by have := hl.2; simp at this; omega)
  apply near_of_diag_eq G r₀ P
  intro f₁ f₂ h₁ h₂
  refine P.diag_interchange_of_layers_of_even r₀ u m v (G.cross x y) (G.cup a)
    (Or.inl (G.cross_even _ _)) f₁ f₂ ?_ ?_
  · rw [h₁, layersOf_pair, moveLayers_cross, lstep_cross_append,
      show u ++ y :: x :: (m ++ v) = (u ++ y :: x :: m) ++ v by simp,
      moveLayers_cup' _ _ _ _ _ (by simp; omega)]
    simp [G.cross_cod, G.cup_dom]
  · rw [h₂, layersOf_pair,
      show u ++ x :: y :: (m ++ v) = (u ++ x :: y :: m) ++ v by simp,
      moveLayers_cup' _ _ _ _ _ (by simp; omega),
      lstep_cup_append' _ _ _ _ (by simp; omega),
      show (u ++ x :: y :: m) ++ a :: d a :: v = u ++ x :: y :: (m ++ a :: d a :: v) by simp,
      moveLayers_cross]
    simp [G.cross_dom, G.cup_cod]

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.ChordGens.near_xuR
statement:
theorem near_xuR (Φ : (G.interp r₀ P).Filtration) {n p g : ℕ} (a : S.Colour) (hg : g ≤ p)
    {l : List S.Colour} (hf : Fits l.length [.cross p, (.cup g a : Move S.Colour)]) :
    Φ.Near n l [.cross p, .cup g a] [.cup g a, .cross (p + 2)]
proof:
:= by
  have hl : p + 1 < l.length := by simp [Fits, Move.Ok, Move.len] at hf; omega
  obtain ⟨w, x, y, v, rfl, rfl⟩ := exists_eq_append_cons_cons hl
  obtain ⟨u, m, rfl, rfl⟩ := exists_eq_append (show g ≤ w.length by omega)
  apply near_of_diag_eq G r₀ P
  intro f₁ f₂ h₁ h₂
  refine (P.diag_interchange_of_layers_of_even r₀ u m v (G.cup a) (G.cross x y)
    (Or.inl (G.cup_even _)) f₂ f₁ ?_ ?_).symm
  · rw [h₂, layersOf_pair,
      show (u ++ m) ++ x :: y :: v = u ++ (m ++ x :: y :: v) by simp,
      moveLayers_cup, lstep_cup_append,
      show u ++ a :: d a :: (m ++ x :: y :: v) = (u ++ a :: d a :: m) ++ x :: y :: v by simp,
      moveLayers_cross' _ _ _ _ _ _ (by simp; omega)]
    simp [G.cross_dom, G.cup_cod]
  · rw [h₁, layersOf_pair, moveLayers_cross' _ _ _ _ _ _ (by simp),
      lstep_cross_append' _ _ _ _ _ (by simp),
      show (u ++ m) ++ y :: x :: v = u ++ (m ++ y :: x :: v) by simp, moveLayers_cup]
    simp [G.cross_cod, G.cup_dom]

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.ChordGens.near_uu
statement:
theorem near_uu (Φ : (G.interp r₀ P).Filtration) {n g g' : ℕ} (a b : S.Colour) (hg : g' ≤ g)
    {l : List S.Colour} (hf : Fits l.length [(.cup g a : Move S.Colour), .cup g' b]) :
    Φ.Near n l [.cup g a, .cup g' b] [.cup g' b, .cup (g + 2) a]
proof:
:= by
  have hl : g ≤ l.length := by simp [Fits, Move.Ok, Move.len] at hf; omega
  obtain ⟨w, v, rfl, rfl⟩ := exists_eq_append hl
  obtain ⟨u, m, rfl, rfl⟩ := exists_eq_append hg
  apply near_of_diag_eq G r₀ P
  intro f₁ f₂ h₁ h₂
  refine (P.diag_interchange_of_layers_of_even r₀ u m v (G.cup b) (G.cup a)
    (Or.inl (G.cup_even _)) f₂ f₁ ?_ ?_).symm
  · rw [h₂, layersOf_pair, show (u ++ m) ++ v = u ++ (m ++ v) by simp, moveLayers_cup,
      lstep_cup_append,
      show u ++ b :: d b :: (m ++ v) = (u ++ b :: d b :: m) ++ v by simp,
      moveLayers_cup' _ _ _ _ _ (by simp; omega)]
    simp [G.cup_dom, G.cup_cod]
  · rw [h₁, layersOf_pair, moveLayers_cup' _ _ _ _ _ (by simp),
      lstep_cup_append' _ _ _ _ (by simp),
      show (u ++ m) ++ a :: d a :: v = u ++ (m ++ a :: d a :: v) by simp, moveLayers_cup]
    simp [G.cup_dom, G.cup_cod]

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.ChordGens.moveLayers_shift
statement:
theorem moveLayers_shift (u l v : List S.Colour) {m : Move S.Colour} (hm : m.Ok l.length) :
    G.moveLayers r₀ (u ++ l ++ v) (m.shift u.length) =
      (G.moveLayers r₀ l m).map (·.whisker ⟨r₀, u⟩ v)
proof:
:= by
  cases m with
  | cup g a =>
    simp only [Move.Ok] at hm
    obtain ⟨l₁, l₂, rfl, rfl⟩ := exists_eq_append hm
    rw [show u ++ (l₁ ++ l₂) ++ v = (u ++ l₁) ++ (l₂ ++ v) by simp, Move.shift,
      moveLayers_cup' _ _ _ _ _ (by simp), moveLayers_cup]
    simp [Layer.whisker]
  | cross p =>
    simp only [Move.Ok] at hm
    obtain ⟨l₁, x, y, t, rfl, rfl⟩ := exists_eq_append_cons_cons hm
    rw [show u ++ (l₁ ++ x :: y :: t) ++ v = (u ++ l₁) ++ x :: y :: (t ++ v) by simp, Move.shift,
      moveLayers_cross' _ _ _ _ _ _ (by simp), moveLayers_cross]
    simp [Layer.whisker]

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.ChordGens.layersOf_shift
statement:
theorem layersOf_shift (u v : List S.Colour) {l : List S.Colour} {D : List (Move S.Colour)}
    (hf : Fits l.length D) :
    G.layersOf r₀ (u ++ l ++ v) (D.map (Move.shift u.length)) =
      (G.layersOf r₀ l D).map (·.whisker ⟨r₀, u⟩ v)
proof:
:= by
  induction D generalizing l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons m D ih =>
    obtain ⟨hm, hf⟩ := hf
    rw [← length_lstep (d := d)] at hf
    simp only [List.map_cons, layersOf, List.map_append, G.moveLayers_shift r₀ u l v hm,
      lstep_shift d u l v hm, ih hf]

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.ChordGens.near_shift
statement:
theorem near_shift (Q : LayerFiltration P wt) (hcup : ∀ a, wt (G.cup a) = 0)
    (hcross : ∀ a b, wt (G.cross a b) = 1) {n : ℕ} {l : List S.Colour}
    {X Y : List (Move S.Colour)} (h : (G.toFiltration r₀ Q hcup hcross).Near n l X Y)
    (hX : Fits l.length X) (hY : Fits l.length Y) (u v : List S.Colour) :
    (G.toFiltration r₀ Q hcup hcross).Near n (u ++ l ++ v) (X.map (Move.shift u.length))
      (Y.map (Move.shift u.length))
proof:
:= by
  intro e
  have e0 : X.foldl (lstep d) l = Y.foldl (lstep d) l := by
    have e' := e
    rw [foldl_shift d u v hX, foldl_shift d u v hY] at e'
    simpa using e'
  have hw : (⟨r₀, l⟩ : Obj S).WhiskerOK ⟨r₀, u⟩ v := Obj.whiskerOK_of_subsingleton _ _ _
  have key := Q.whisk_mem ⟨r₀, u⟩ v (h e0)
  rw [G.eval_comp_eqToHom_eq r₀ P e0 ⟨G.layersOf r₀ l X, e0 ▸ G.chain_layersOf r₀ l X⟩ rfl,
    eval_interp, P.whisk_sub, P.whisk_diag _ _ _ hw, P.whisk_diag _ _ _ hw] at key
  have hb : (⟨r₀, Y.foldl (lstep d) l⟩ : Obj S).whisker ⟨r₀, u⟩ v =
      ⟨r₀, (Y.map (Move.shift u.length)).foldl (lstep d) (u ++ l ++ v)⟩ := by
    rw [foldl_shift d u v hY]; rfl
  have key' := Q.comp_eqToHom_mem hb key
  rw [Preadditive.sub_comp,
    diag_comp_eqToHom_of_layers_eq P
      (Diagram.whisker ⟨G.layersOf r₀ l X, e0 ▸ G.chain_layersOf r₀ l X⟩ ⟨r₀, u⟩ v hw)
      ⟨G.layersOf r₀ (u ++ l ++ v) (X.map (Move.shift u.length)),
        e ▸ G.chain_layersOf r₀ (u ++ l ++ v) (X.map (Move.shift u.length))⟩ hb
      (G.layersOf_shift r₀ u v hX).symm,
    diag_comp_eqToHom_of_layers_eq P
      (Diagram.whisker ⟨G.layersOf r₀ l Y, G.chain_layersOf r₀ l Y⟩ ⟨r₀, u⟩ v hw)
      ⟨G.layersOf r₀ (u ++ l ++ v) (Y.map (Move.shift u.length)),
        G.chain_layersOf r₀ (u ++ l ++ v) (Y.map (Move.shift u.length))⟩ hb
      (G.layersOf_shift r₀ u v hY).symm] at key'
  rw [G.eval_comp_eqToHom_eq r₀ P e
    ⟨G.layersOf r₀ (u ++ l ++ v) (X.map (Move.shift u.length)),
      e ▸ G.chain_layersOf r₀ (u ++ l ++ v) (X.map (Move.shift u.length))⟩ rfl, eval_interp]
  exact key'

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.ChordGens.respects
statement:
theorem respects (Q : LayerFiltration P wt) (hcup : ∀ a, wt (G.cup a) = 0)
    (hcross : ∀ a b, wt (G.cross a b) = 1)
    (hbraid : ∀ a b c : S.Colour, (G.toFiltration r₀ Q hcup hcross).Near 3 [a, b, c]
      [.cross 0, .cross 1, .cross 0] [.cross 1, .cross 0, .cross 1])
    (hpitch : ∀ a c : S.Colour, (G.toFiltration r₀ Q hcup hcross).Near 1 [c]
      [.cup 0 a, .cross 1] [.cup 1 a, .cross 0]) :
    (G.toFiltration r₀ Q hcup hcross).Respects
proof:
:= by
  intro L R hs l hf
  cases hs with
  | xx h => exact near_xx G r₀ P _ h hf
  | xuL a h => exact near_xuL G r₀ P _ a h hf
  | xuR a h => exact near_xuR G r₀ P _ a h hf
  | uu a b h => exact near_uu G r₀ P _ a b h hf
  | braid p =>
    have hl : p + 2 < l.length := by simp [Fits, Move.Ok, Move.len] at hf; omega
    obtain ⟨u, x, y, t, rfl, rfl⟩ := exists_eq_append_cons_cons (show p + 1 < l.length by omega)
    obtain ⟨z, v, rfl⟩ : ∃ z v, t = z :: v := by
      cases t with
      | nil => simp at hl
      | cons z v => exact ⟨z, v, rfl⟩
    have := G.near_shift r₀ Q hcup hcross (hbraid x y z) (by simp [Fits, Move.Ok, Move.len])
      (by simp [Fits, Move.Ok, Move.len]) u v
    have e3 : u ++ [x, y, z] ++ v = u ++ x :: y :: z :: v := by simp
    rw [e3] at this
    exact this
  | pitch g a =>
    have hl : g < l.length := by simp [Fits, Move.Ok, Move.len] at hf; omega
    obtain ⟨u, t, rfl, rfl⟩ := exists_eq_append (show g ≤ l.length by omega)
    obtain ⟨c, v, rfl⟩ : ∃ c v, t = c :: v := by
      cases t with
      | nil => simp at hl
      | cons c v => exact ⟨c, v, rfl⟩
    have := G.near_shift r₀ Q hcup hcross (hpitch a c) (by simp [Fits, Move.Ok, Move.len])
      (by simp [Fits, Move.Ok, Move.len]) u v
    have e3 : u ++ [c] ++ v = u ++ c :: v := by simp
    rw [e3] at this
    exact this

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.ChordGens.near_canon_or_reducible
statement:
theorem near_canon_or_reducible (Q : LayerFiltration P wt) (hcup : ∀ a, wt (G.cup a) = 0)
    (hcross : ∀ a b, wt (G.cross a b) = 1)
    (hbraid : ∀ a b c : S.Colour, (G.toFiltration r₀ Q hcup hcross).Near 3 [a, b, c]
      [.cross 0, .cross 1, .cross 0] [.cross 1, .cross 0, .cross 1])
    (hpitch : ∀ a c : S.Colour, (G.toFiltration r₀ Q hcup hcross).Near 1 [c]
      [.cup 0 a, .cross 1] [.cup 1 a, .cross 0])
    {D : List (Move S.Colour)} (hf : Fits 0 D) :
    (∃ A B : List (Move S.Colour), ∃ p : ℕ, (G.toFiltration r₀ Q hcup hcross).Near (ncross D) []
        D (A ++ [.cross p, .cross p] ++ B)) ∨
      (∃ A B : List (Move S.Colour), ∃ p : ℕ, ∃ a : S.Colour,
        (G.toFiltration r₀ Q hcup hcross).Near (ncross D) [] D (A ++ [.cup p a, .cross p] ++ B)) ∨
      (G.toFiltration r₀ Q hcup hcross).Near (ncross D) [] D (canon (run d D))
proof:
:=
  MoveInterp.Filtration.near_canon_or_reducible (G.respects r₀ Q hcup hcross hbraid hpitch) hf

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.ncross_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem ncross_nil : ncross ([] : List (Move α)) = 0

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.ncross_cons
statement:
@[simp] theorem ncross_cons (m : Move α) (D : List (Move α)) :
    ncross (m :: D) = m.ncross + ncross D

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.ncross_append
statement: @[simp] theorem ncross_append (D E : List (Move α)) : ncross (D ++ E) = ncross D + ncross E

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.Step.ncross_eq
statement: theorem Step.ncross_eq {L R : List (Move α)} (h : Step L R) : ncross L = ncross R

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.Rw.ncross_eq
statement: theorem Rw.ncross_eq {X Y : List (Move α)} (h : Rw X Y) : ncross X = ncross Y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨A, B, L, R, hs, rfl, rfl⟩ := h
  simp [hs.ncross_eq]

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.Equiv.ncross_eq
statement: theorem Equiv.ncross_eq {X Y : List (Move α)} (h : Equiv X Y) : ncross X = ncross Y
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | rel X Y h => exact h.ncross_eq
  | refl => rfl
  | symm _ _ _ ih => exact ih.symm
  | trans _ _ _ _ _ ih ih' => exact ih.trans ih'

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.MoveInterp.eval_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem eval_nil (l : List α) : F.eval l [] = 𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.MoveInterp.eval_cons
statement:
@[simp] theorem eval_cons (l : List α) (m : Move α) (D : List (Move α)) :
    F.eval l (m :: D) = F.map l m ≫ F.eval (lstep d l m) D

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.MoveInterp.eval_congr
statement:
theorem eval_congr {l l' : List α} (h : l = l') (D : List (Move α)) :
    F.eval l D ≫ eqToHom (congrArg F.obj (congrArg (D.foldl (lstep d)) h)) =
      eqToHom (congrArg F.obj h) ≫ F.eval l' D

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.MoveInterp.eval_append
statement:
theorem eval_append (l : List α) (D E : List (Move α)) :
    F.eval l (D ++ E) = F.eval l D ≫ F.eval (D.foldl (lstep d) l) E ≫
      eqToHom (congrArg F.obj (List.foldl_append).symm)
proof:
:= by
  induction D generalizing l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons m D ih => simp [ih]

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.MoveInterp.Filtration.comp_eqToHom_mem
statement:
theorem comp_eqToHom_mem {n : ℕ} {l l' l'' : List α} {x : F.obj l ⟶ F.obj l'} (h : l' = l'')
    (hx : x ∈ Φ.sub n l l') : x ≫ eqToHom (congrArg F.obj h) ∈ Φ.sub n l l''
proof:
:= by
  subst h; simpa using hx

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.MoveInterp.Filtration.eval_comp_mem
statement:
theorem eval_comp_mem {n : ℕ} {l₀ l : List α} {x : F.obj l₀ ⟶ F.obj l} (hx : x ∈ Φ.sub n l₀ l)
    {D : List (Move α)} (hf : Fits l.length D) :
    x ≫ F.eval l D ∈ Φ.sub (n + ncross D) l₀ (D.foldl (lstep d) l)
proof:
:= by
  induction D generalizing n l with
  | nil =>
    change x ≫ 𝟙 (F.obj l) ∈ Φ.sub (n + 0) l₀ l
    rw [Category.comp_id]; exact hx
  | cons m D ih =>
    obtain ⟨hm, hf⟩ := hf
    rw [← length_lstep (d := d)] at hf
    have := ih (Φ.comp_map_mem hm hx) hf
    rw [ncross_cons, ← Nat.add_assoc]
    change x ≫ (F.map l m ≫ F.eval (lstep d l m) D) ∈
      Φ.sub _ l₀ (D.foldl (lstep d) (lstep d l m))
    rw [← Category.assoc]
    exact this

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.MoveInterp.Filtration.mem_eval_comp
proof:
:= by
  induction D generalizing n l with
  | nil =>
    rw [ncross_nil, Nat.zero_add]
    exact Eq.mpr (congrArg (· ∈ Φ.sub n l l') (Category.id_comp x)) hx
  | cons m D ih =>
    obtain ⟨hm, hf⟩ := hf
    rw [← length_lstep (d := d)] at hf
    have := Φ.map_comp_mem hm (ih hx hf)
    rw [ncross_cons, Nat.add_assoc]
    exact Eq.mpr (congrArg (· ∈ Φ.sub _ l l') (Category.assoc _ _ x)) this

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.MoveInterp.Filtration.near_bot_iff
statement:
theorem near_bot_iff {n : ℕ} {l : List α} {X Y : List (Move α)} :
    (Filtration.bot F).Near n l X Y ↔ ∀ e : X.foldl (lstep d) l = Y.foldl (lstep d) l,
      F.eval l X ≫ eqToHom (congrArg F.obj e) = F.eval l Y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Near, Filtration.bot, AddSubgroup.mem_bot, sub_eq_zero]

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.MoveInterp.Filtration.Near.refl
statement: theorem Near.refl (n : ℕ) (l : List α) (X : List (Move α)) : Φ.Near n l X X

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.MoveInterp.Filtration.Near.symm
statement:
theorem Near.symm {n : ℕ} {l : List α} {X Y : List (Move α)} (h : Φ.Near n l X Y)
    (e : X.foldl (lstep d) l = Y.foldl (lstep d) l) : Φ.Near n l Y X
proof:
:= by
  intro e'
  have := Φ.comp_eqToHom_mem e' (neg_mem (h e))
  convert this using 1
  simp [Preadditive.sub_comp]

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.MoveInterp.Filtration.Near.trans
statement:
theorem Near.trans {n : ℕ} {l : List α} {X Y Z : List (Move α)} (h : Φ.Near n l X Y)
    (h' : Φ.Near n l Y Z) (e : X.foldl (lstep d) l = Y.foldl (lstep d) l)
    (e' : Y.foldl (lstep d) l = Z.foldl (lstep d) l) : Φ.Near n l X Z
proof:
:= by
  intro e''
  have := add_mem (Φ.comp_eqToHom_mem e' (h e)) (h' e')
  convert this using 1
  simp [Preadditive.sub_comp]

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.MoveInterp.Filtration.Near.cons
proof:
:= by
  intro e
  have := Φ.map_comp_mem hm (h e)
  rw [Preadditive.comp_sub, ← Category.assoc] at this
  exact this

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.MoveInterp.Filtration.Near.prefix
statement:
theorem Near.prefix {n : ℕ} {l : List α} {X Y : List (Move α)} (A : List (Move α))
    (h : Φ.Near n (A.foldl (lstep d) l) X Y) (hA : Fits l.length A) :
    Φ.Near (ncross A + n) l (A ++ X) (A ++ Y)
proof:
:= by
  induction A generalizing l with
  | nil => simpa using h
  | cons m A ih =>
    obtain ⟨hm, hA⟩ := hA
    rw [← length_lstep (d := d)] at hA
    have := (ih h hA).cons Φ hm
    rw [ncross_cons, Nat.add_assoc]
    exact this

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.MoveInterp.Filtration.comp_sub_comp_eq
statement:
theorem comp_sub_comp_eq {X Y Y' Z Z' : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (f' : X ⟶ Y') (g : Y ⟶ Z) (g' : Y' ⟶ Z')
    (h : Y = Y') (h' : Z = Z') (hg : g ≫ eqToHom h' = eqToHom h ≫ g') :
    (f ≫ g) ≫ eqToHom h' - f' ≫ g' = (f ≫ eqToHom h - f') ≫ g'
proof:
:= by
  subst h h'
  simp only [eqToHom_refl, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp] at hg ⊢
  rw [hg, Preadditive.sub_comp]

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.MoveInterp.Filtration.Near.append
statement:
theorem Near.append {n : ℕ} {l : List α} {X Y : List (Move α)} (h : Φ.Near n l X Y)
    (e : X.foldl (lstep d) l = Y.foldl (lstep d) l) (B : List (Move α))
    (hB : Fits (Y.foldl (lstep d) l).length B) :
    Φ.Near (n + ncross B) l (X ++ B) (Y ++ B)
proof:
:= by
  intro e'
  have hg : (F.eval (X.foldl (lstep d) l) B ≫
      eqToHom (congrArg F.obj (List.foldl_append (f := lstep d) (b := l) (l := X) (l' := B)).symm)) ≫
      eqToHom (congrArg F.obj e') = eqToHom (congrArg F.obj e) ≫
      (F.eval (Y.foldl (lstep d) l) B ≫
        eqToHom (congrArg F.obj (List.foldl_append (f := lstep d) (b := l) (l := Y) (l' := B)).symm)) := by
    rw [← Category.assoc, ← F.eval_congr e B]
    simp
  rw [eval_append, eval_append, comp_sub_comp_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ hg, ← Category.assoc]
  exact Φ.comp_eqToHom_mem List.foldl_append.symm (Φ.eval_comp_mem (h e) hB)

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.MoveInterp.Filtration.Respects.near_rw
statement:
theorem Respects.near_rw (hΦ : Φ.Respects) {l : List α} {X Y : List (Move α)} (h : Rw X Y)
    (hf : Fits l.length X) : Φ.Near (ncross X) l X Y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨A, B, L, R, hs, rfl, rfl⟩ := h
  rw [List.append_assoc] at hf ⊢
  rw [List.append_assoc]
  rw [fits_append] at hf
  obtain ⟨hA, hLB⟩ := hf
  rw [← foldl_lstep_len (d := d)] at hLB
  rw [fits_append] at hLB
  obtain ⟨hL, hB⟩ := hLB
  have hLR := hs.fits_letters (d := d) (A.foldl (lstep d) l)
  have e := hLR.2 hL
  rw [← foldl_lstep_len (d := d), e] at hB
  have := (hΦ hs _ hL).append Φ e B hB
  have := this.prefix Φ A hA
  rw [ncross_append, ncross_append]
  exact this

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.MoveInterp.Filtration.near_of_equiv
statement:
theorem near_of_equiv (hΦ : Φ.Respects) {l : List α} {X Y : List (Move α)} (h : Equiv X Y)
    (hf : Fits l.length X) : Φ.Near (ncross X) l X Y
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | rel X Y h => exact hΦ.near_rw h hf
  | refl X => exact Near.refl Φ _ _ _
  | symm X Y h ih =>
    have hfX : Fits l.length X := ((Equiv.fits_letters (d := d) h l).1).2 hf
    rw [← Equiv.ncross_eq h]
    exact (ih hfX).symm Φ ((Equiv.fits_letters (d := d) h l).2 hfX)
  | trans X Y Z h h' ih ih' =>
    have hfY : Fits l.length Y := ((Equiv.fits_letters (d := d) h l).1).1 hf
    have e := (Equiv.fits_letters (d := d) h l).2 hf
    have e' := (Equiv.fits_letters (d := d) h' l).2 hfY
    have := ih' hfY
    rw [← Equiv.ncross_eq h] at this
    exact (ih hf).trans Φ this e e'

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.MoveInterp.Filtration.near_canon_or_reducible
statement:
theorem near_canon_or_reducible (hΦ : Φ.Respects) {D : List (Move α)} (hf : Fits 0 D) :
    (∃ A B : List (Move α), ∃ p : ℕ,
        Φ.Near (ncross D) [] D (A ++ [.cross p, .cross p] ++ B)) ∨
      (∃ A B : List (Move α), ∃ p : ℕ, ∃ a : α,
        Φ.Near (ncross D) [] D (A ++ [.cup p a, .cross p] ++ B)) ∨
      Φ.Near (ncross D) [] D (canon (run d D))
proof:
:= by
  rcases equiv_canon_or_reducible (d := d) hf with ⟨A, B, p, h | ⟨a, h⟩⟩ | h
  · exact Or.inl ⟨A, B, p, near_of_equiv hΦ h hf⟩
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨A, B, p, a, near_of_equiv hΦ h hf⟩)
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (near_of_equiv hΦ h hf))

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.Iso.length_eq
statement: theorem Iso.length_eq {s s' : List (ℕ × α)} (h : Iso s s') : s.length = s'.length
proof:
:= by
  simpa using congrArg List.length h.1

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.Iso.symm
statement: theorem Iso.symm {s s' : List (ℕ × α)} (h : Iso s s') : Iso s' s

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.Iso.valid
statement: theorem Iso.valid {s s' : List (ℕ × α)} (h : Iso s s') (hv : Valid s) : Valid s'
proof:
:= by
  intro i hi
  obtain ⟨j, hj, hu⟩ := hv i (by rw [h.length_eq]; exact hi)
  exact ⟨j, (h.2 i j).1 hj, fun k hk => hu k ((h.2 i k).2 hk)⟩

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.Iso.snd_getElem
statement:
theorem Iso.snd_getElem {s s' : List (ℕ × α)} (h : Iso s s') {i : ℕ} (hi : i < s.length)
    (hi' : i < s'.length) : (s[i]).2 = (s'[i]).2
proof:
:= by
  have := congrArg (fun l => l[i]?) h.1
  simp only [List.getElem?_map, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hi, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hi'] at this
  simpa using this

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.Iso.swapAt
statement:
theorem Iso.swapAt {s s' : List (ℕ × α)} (h : Iso s s') (p : ℕ) :
    Iso (Chord.swapAt s p) (Chord.swapAt s' p)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hp : p + 1 < s.length
  · have hp' : p + 1 < s'.length := h.length_eq ▸ hp
    refine ⟨?_, fun i j => by rw [same_swapAt hp, same_swapAt hp', h.2]⟩
    apply List.ext_getElem?; intro i
    have := congrArg (fun l => l[tau p i]?) h.1
    simp only [List.getElem?_map] at this ⊢
    rw [getElem?_swapAt s hp, getElem?_swapAt s' hp']; exact this
  · rw [swapAt_of_le s hp, swapAt_of_le s' (h.length_eq ▸ hp)]; exact h

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.Iso.rmAt
statement:
theorem Iso.rmAt {s s' : List (ℕ × α)} (h : Iso s s') {r : ℕ} (hr : r + 2 ≤ s.length) :
    Iso (Chord.rmAt s r) (Chord.rmAt s' r)
proof:
:= by
  have hr' : r + 2 ≤ s'.length := h.length_eq ▸ hr
  refine ⟨?_, fun i j => by rw [same_rmAt hr, same_rmAt hr', h.2]⟩
  apply List.ext_getElem?; intro i
  have := congrArg (fun l => l[rmIdx r i]?) h.1
  simp only [List.getElem?_map] at this ⊢
  rw [getElem?_rmAt s hr, getElem?_rmAt s' hr']; exact this

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.opn_iff
statement: theorem opn_iff {s s' : List (ℕ × α)} (h : Iso s s') (q : ℕ) : Opn s q ↔ Opn s' q

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.cls_iff
statement: theorem cls_iff {s s' : List (ℕ × α)} (h : Iso s s') (q : ℕ) : Cls s q ↔ Cls s' q

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.cr_le_of_iso
statement: theorem cr_le_of_iso {s s' : List (ℕ × α)} (h : Iso s s') : cr s ≤ cr s'
proof:
:= by
  unfold cr
  refine Finset.card_le_card fun x hx => ?_
  rw [mem_crSet] at hx ⊢
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, h5⟩ := hx
  exact ⟨h1, h2, h3, (h.2 _ _).1 h4, (h.2 _ _).1 h5⟩

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.canon_congr
statement:
theorem canon_congr : ∀ (n : ℕ) {s s' : List (ℕ × α)}, s.length + cr s < n → Iso s s' →
    canon s = canon s'
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => intro s s' h; omega
  | succ n ih =>
    intro s s' hn h
    by_cases hv : Valid s
    swap
    · have hv' : ¬ Valid s' := fun hv' => hv (h.symm.valid hv')
      rw [canon, dite_eq_right hv, canon, dite_eq_right hv']
    have hv' := h.valid hv
    by_cases hadj : ∃ r, Same s r (r + 1)
    · classical
      obtain ⟨r, hr, hmin⟩ : ∃ r, Same s r (r + 1) ∧ ∀ r' < r, ¬ Same s r' (r' + 1) :=
        ⟨Nat.find hadj, Nat.find_spec hadj, fun _ => Nat.find_min hadj⟩
      have hr' : Same s' r (r + 1) := (h.2 _ _).1 hr
      have hmin' : ∀ r' < r, ¬ Same s' r' (r' + 1) := fun r' hr'' hs => hmin r' hr'' ((h.2 _ _).2 hs)
      rw [canon_adj hv hr hmin, canon_adj hv' hr' hmin', h.snd_getElem hr.lt_left hr'.lt_left]
      have hl : r + 2 ≤ s.length := hr.lt_right
      rw [ih (by rw [length_rmAt s hl]; have := cr_rmAt_le hl; omega) (h.rmAt hl)]
    · have hno : ∀ r, ¬ Same s r (r + 1) := fun r hr => hadj ⟨r, hr⟩
      have hno' : ∀ r, ¬ Same s' r (r + 1) := fun r hr => hno r ((h.2 _ _).2 hr)
      by_cases hne : s = []
      · have hne' : s' = [] := List.eq_nil_of_length_eq_zero (by rw [← h.length_eq, hne]; rfl)
        rw [hne, hne']
      have hne' : s' ≠ [] := fun e => hne (List.eq_nil_of_length_eq_zero
        (by rw [h.length_eq, e]; rfl))
      obtain ⟨q, ho, hc, hq, hmin⟩ := canon_cross hv hno hne
      obtain ⟨q', ho', hc', hq', hmin'⟩ := canon_cross hv' hno' hne'
      have e : q = q' := by
        rcases lt_trichotomy q q' with l | l | l
        · exact (hmin' q l ⟨(opn_iff h q).1 ho, (cls_iff h _).1 hc⟩).elim
        · exact l
        · exact (hmin q' l ⟨(opn_iff h q').2 ho', (cls_iff h _).2 hc'⟩).elim
      subst e
      have hilv := ilv_of_opn_cls hv (hno q) ho hc
      rw [hq, hq', ih (by rw [length_swapAt]; have := cr_swapAt_lt hv hilv; omega) (h.swapAt q)]

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.canon_eq_of_iso
statement: theorem canon_eq_of_iso {s s' : List (ℕ × α)} (h : Iso s s') : canon s = canon s'

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.map_insAt
statement:
theorem map_insAt {β γ : Type*} (f : β → γ) (s : List β) (g : ℕ) (x y : β) :
    (insAt s g x y).map f = insAt (s.map f) g (f x) (f y)

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.map_swapAt
statement:
theorem map_swapAt {β γ : Type*} (f : β → γ) (s : List β) (p : ℕ) :
    (swapAt s p).map f = swapAt (s.map f) p
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hp : p + 1 < s.length
  · apply List.ext_getElem?; intro i
    rw [List.getElem?_map, getElem?_swapAt s hp, getElem?_swapAt _ (by simpa using hp),
      List.getElem?_map]
  · rw [swapAt_of_le s hp, swapAt_of_le _ (by simpa using hp)]

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.map_rmAt
statement:
theorem map_rmAt {β γ : Type*} (f : β → γ) (s : List β) (r : ℕ) :
    (rmAt s r).map f = rmAt (s.map f) r

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.snd_step
statement:
theorem snd_step (s : List (ℕ × α)) (m : Move α) :
    (step d s m).map Prod.snd = lstep d (s.map Prod.snd) m
proof:
:= by
  cases m with
  | cup g a => simp only [step, lstep, map_insAt]
  | cross p => simp only [step, lstep, map_swapAt]

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.snd_foldl_step
statement:
theorem snd_foldl_step : ∀ (s : List (ℕ × α)) (D : List (Move α)),
    (D.foldl (step d) s).map Prod.snd = D.foldl (lstep d) (s.map Prod.snd)
proof:
| s, [] => rfl
  | s, m :: D => by simp only [List.foldl_cons, snd_foldl_step _ D, snd_step]

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.snd_run
statement: theorem snd_run (D : List (Move α)) : (run d D).map Prod.snd = D.foldl (lstep d) []

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.length_lstep
statement: theorem length_lstep (l : List α) (m : Move α) : (lstep d l m).length = m.len l.length
proof:
:= by
  cases m with
  | cup g a => simp [lstep, Move.len, insAt]; omega
  | cross p => simp [lstep, Move.len]

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.insAt_insAt
statement:
theorem insAt_insAt {β : Type*} (l : List β) {g g' : ℕ} (h : g' ≤ g) (hg : g ≤ l.length)
    (x y u v : β) : insAt (insAt l g x y) g' u v = insAt (insAt l g' u v) (g + 2) x y
proof:
:= by
  apply List.ext_getElem?; intro i
  have h1 : g' ≤ (insAt l g x y).length := by rw [length_insAt l hg]; omega
  have h2 : g + 2 ≤ (insAt l g' u v).length := by rw [length_insAt l (by omega)]; omega
  simp only [getElem?_insAt _ h1, getElem?_insAt _ h2, getElem?_insAt l hg,
    getElem?_insAt l (show g' ≤ l.length by omega)]
  rcases (show i < g' ∨ i = g' ∨ i = g' + 1 ∨ (g' + 1 < i ∧ i < g + 2) ∨ i = g + 2 ∨ i = g + 3 ∨
    g + 3 < i by omega) with hi | hi | hi | hi | hi | hi | hi <;>
  · simp (disch := omega) only [ite_eq_left, ite_eq_right]

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.insAt_swapAt_lt
statement:
theorem insAt_swapAt_lt {β : Type*} (l : List β) {p g : ℕ} (h : p + 2 ≤ g) (hg : g ≤ l.length)
    (x y : β) : insAt (swapAt l p) g x y = swapAt (insAt l g x y) p
proof:
:= by
  have hp : p + 1 < l.length := by omega
  have hg' : g ≤ (swapAt l p).length := by simpa using hg
  have hp' : p + 1 < (insAt l g x y).length := by rw [length_insAt l hg]; omega
  apply List.ext_getElem?; intro i
  simp only [getElem?_insAt _ hg', getElem?_swapAt _ hp', getElem?_insAt l hg,
    getElem?_swapAt l hp]
  rcases (show i < p ∨ i = p ∨ i = p + 1 ∨ (p + 1 < i ∧ i < g) ∨ i = g ∨ i = g + 1 ∨ g + 1 < i
    by omega) with hi | rfl | rfl | hi | rfl | rfl | hi <;>
  · simp (disch := omega) only [ite_eq_left, ite_eq_right, tau_left, tau_right, tau_of_ne, ↓reduceIte]

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.insAt_swapAt_ge
statement:
theorem insAt_swapAt_ge {β : Type*} (l : List β) {p g : ℕ} (h : g ≤ p) (hp : p + 1 < l.length)
    (x y : β) : insAt (swapAt l p) g x y = swapAt (insAt l g x y) (p + 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hg : g ≤ l.length := by omega
  have hg' : g ≤ (swapAt l p).length := by simpa using hg
  have hp' : p + 2 + 1 < (insAt l g x y).length := by rw [length_insAt l hg]; omega
  apply List.ext_getElem?; intro i
  simp only [getElem?_insAt _ hg', getElem?_swapAt _ hp', getElem?_insAt l hg,
    getElem?_swapAt l hp]
  rcases (show i < g ∨ i = g ∨ i = g + 1 ∨ (g + 1 < i ∧ i < p + 2) ∨ i = p + 2 ∨ i = p + 2 + 1 ∨
    p + 2 + 1 < i by omega) with hi | rfl | rfl | hi | rfl | rfl | hi <;>
  · simp (disch := omega) only [ite_eq_left, ite_eq_right, tau_left, tau_right, tau_of_ne, ↓reduceIte]
    try (congr 1; unfold tau; split_ifs <;> omega)

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.insAt_pitch
statement:
theorem insAt_pitch {β : Type*} (l : List β) {g : ℕ} (hg : g < l.length) (x y : β) :
    swapAt (insAt l g x y) (g + 1) = swapAt (insAt l (g + 1) x y) g
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : g + 1 + 1 < (insAt l g x y).length := by rw [length_insAt l (by omega)]; omega
  have h2 : g + 1 < (insAt l (g + 1) x y).length := by rw [length_insAt l (by omega)]; omega
  apply List.ext_getElem?; intro i
  simp only [getElem?_swapAt _ h1, getElem?_swapAt _ h2, getElem?_insAt l (show g ≤ l.length by omega),
    getElem?_insAt l (show g + 1 ≤ l.length by omega)]
  rcases (show i < g ∨ i = g ∨ i = g + 1 ∨ i = g + 1 + 1 ∨ g + 1 + 1 < i by omega) with
    hi | rfl | rfl | rfl | hi <;>
  · simp (disch := omega) only [ite_eq_left, ite_eq_right, tau_left, tau_right, tau_of_ne, ↓reduceIte,
      show ∀ n : ℕ, n + 1 + 1 - 2 = n from fun n => by omega]

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.Step.fits_letters
statement:
theorem Step.fits_letters {L R : List (Move α)} (h : Step L R) (l : List α) :
    (Fits l.length L ↔ Fits l.length R) ∧
      (Fits l.length L → L.foldl (lstep d) l = R.foldl (lstep d) l)
proof:
:= by
  cases h with
  | xx h =>
    refine ⟨by simp only [Fits, Move.Ok, Move.len, and_true]; constructor <;> intro <;> omega,
      fun hf => ?_⟩
    simp only [Fits, Move.Ok, Move.len] at hf
    simp only [List.foldl_cons, List.foldl_nil, lstep]
    exact swapAt_comm l h (by omega)
  | xuL a h =>
    refine ⟨by simp only [Fits, Move.Ok, Move.len, and_true]; constructor <;> intro <;> omega,
      fun hf => ?_⟩
    simp only [Fits, Move.Ok, Move.len] at hf
    simp only [List.foldl_cons, List.foldl_nil, lstep]
    rw [insAt_swapAt_lt l h (by simpa using hf.2.1)]
  | xuR a h =>
    refine ⟨by simp only [Fits, Move.Ok, Move.len, and_true]; constructor <;> intro <;> omega,
      fun hf => ?_⟩
    simp only [Fits, Move.Ok, Move.len] at hf
    simp only [List.foldl_cons, List.foldl_nil, lstep]
    rw [insAt_swapAt_ge l h hf.1]
  | uu a b h =>
    refine ⟨by simp only [Fits, Move.Ok, Move.len, and_true]; constructor <;> intro <;> omega,
      fun hf => ?_⟩
    simp only [Fits, Move.Ok, Move.len] at hf
    simp only [List.foldl_cons, List.foldl_nil, lstep]
    exact insAt_insAt l h hf.1 _ _ _ _
  | braid p =>
    refine ⟨by simp only [Fits, Move.Ok, Move.len, and_true]; constructor <;> intro <;> omega,
      fun hf => ?_⟩
    simp only [Fits, Move.Ok, Move.len] at hf
    simp only [List.foldl_cons, List.foldl_nil, lstep]
    exact swapAt_braid l (by omega)
  | pitch g a =>
    refine ⟨by simp only [Fits, Move.Ok, Move.len, and_true]; constructor <;> intro <;> omega,
      fun hf => ?_⟩
    simp only [Fits, Move.Ok, Move.len] at hf
    simp only [List.foldl_cons, List.foldl_nil, lstep]
    exact insAt_pitch l (by omega) _ _

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.foldl_lstep_len
statement:
theorem foldl_lstep_len : ∀ (l : List α) (D : List (Move α)),
    (D.foldl (lstep d) l).length = D.foldl Move.len l.length
proof:
| l, [] => rfl
  | l, m :: D => by simp only [List.foldl_cons, foldl_lstep_len _ D, length_lstep]

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.Rw.fits_letters
statement:
theorem Rw.fits_letters {X Y : List (Move α)} (h : Rw X Y) (l : List α) :
    (Fits l.length X ↔ Fits l.length Y) ∧
      (Fits l.length X → X.foldl (lstep d) l = Y.foldl (lstep d) l)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨A, B, L, R, hs, rfl, rfl⟩ := h
  have hA := foldl_lstep_len (d := d) l A
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hs.fits_letters (d := d) (A.foldl (lstep d) l)
  rw [hA] at h1 h2
  have hLR : ∀ hf : Fits (A.foldl Move.len l.length) L, L.foldl Move.len (A.foldl Move.len l.length) =
      R.foldl Move.len (A.foldl Move.len l.length) := fun hf => by
    rw [← hA, ← foldl_lstep_len (d := d), ← foldl_lstep_len (d := d), h2 (hA ▸ hf)]
  simp only [fits_append, List.foldl_append]
  constructor
  · constructor
    · rintro ⟨⟨hA', hL⟩, hB⟩
      exact ⟨⟨hA', h1.1 hL⟩, by rwa [← hLR hL]⟩
    · rintro ⟨⟨hA', hR⟩, hB⟩
      exact ⟨⟨hA', h1.2 hR⟩, by rwa [hLR (h1.2 hR)]⟩
  · rintro ⟨⟨-, hL⟩, -⟩
    rw [h2 (hA ▸ hL)]

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.Equiv.fits_letters
statement:
theorem Equiv.fits_letters {X Y : List (Move α)} (h : Equiv X Y) (l : List α) :
    (Fits l.length X ↔ Fits l.length Y) ∧
      (Fits l.length X → X.foldl (lstep d) l = Y.foldl (lstep d) l)
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | rel X Y h => exact h.fits_letters l
  | refl => exact ⟨Iff.rfl, fun _ => rfl⟩
  | symm X Y _ ih => exact ⟨ih.1.symm, fun hf => (ih.2 (ih.1.2 hf)).symm⟩
  | trans X Y Z _ _ ih ih' =>
    exact ⟨ih.1.trans ih'.1, fun hf => (ih.2 hf).trans (ih'.2 (ih.1.1 hf))⟩

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.Lettered.swapAt
statement:
theorem Lettered.swapAt {s : List (ℕ × α)} (h : Lettered d s) {p : ℕ}
    (hp : p + 1 < s.length) (hn : ¬ Same s p (p + 1)) : Lettered d (Chord.swapAt s p)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij hlt
  rw [same_swapAt hp] at hij
  rw [getElem?_swapAt s hp, getElem?_swapAt s hp]
  have : tau p i < tau p j := by
    rw [tau_lt_iff p]
    · exact hlt
    · rintro ⟨rfl, rfl⟩; exact hn (by simpa [tau] using hij.symm)
    · rintro ⟨rfl, rfl⟩; omega
  exact h _ _ hij this

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.Lettered.rmAt
statement:
theorem Lettered.rmAt {s : List (ℕ × α)} (h : Lettered d s) {r : ℕ} (hr : r + 2 ≤ s.length) :
    Lettered d (Chord.rmAt s r)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij hlt
  rw [same_rmAt hr] at hij
  rw [getElem?_rmAt s hr, getElem?_rmAt s hr]
  exact h _ _ hij ((rmIdx_lt_iff r).2 hlt)

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.Iso.insAt
proof:
:= by
  have hg' : g ≤ t.length := h.length_eq ▸ hg
  refine ⟨by rw [map_insAt, map_insAt, h.1], fun i j => ?_⟩
  rw [same_insAt_iff hg hk, same_insAt_iff hg' hk', h.2]

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.ne_id_of_mem_rmAt
statement:
theorem ne_id_of_mem_rmAt {s : List (ℕ × α)} (hv : Valid s) {r : ℕ} (hr : Same s r (r + 1))
    {x : ℕ × α} (hx : x ∈ Chord.rmAt s r) : x.1 ≠ (s[r]'hr.lt_left).1
proof:
:= by
  have hl : r + 2 ≤ s.length := hr.lt_right
  rw [List.mem_iff_getElem?] at hx
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hx
  rw [getElem?_rmAt s hl] at hi
  intro e
  have hs : Same s (rmIdx r i) r := by
    refine ⟨by unfold rmIdx; split_ifs <;> omega, by simp [idAt, hi], ?_⟩
    simp [idAt, hi, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hr.lt_left, e]
  have := hv.unique hs.symm hr
  unfold rmIdx at this; split_ifs at this <;> omega

name: StringDiagrams.Chord.run_canon
statement:
theorem run_canon : ∀ (n : ℕ) {s : List (ℕ × α)}, s.length + cr s < n → Valid s →
    Lettered d s → Fits 0 (canon s) ∧ Iso (run d (canon s)) s
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => intro s h; omega
  | succ n ih =>
    intro s hn hv hl
    by_cases hadj : ∃ r, Same s r (r + 1)
    · classical
      obtain ⟨r, hr, hmin⟩ : ∃ r, Same s r (r + 1) ∧ ∀ r' < r, ¬ Same s r' (r' + 1) :=
        ⟨Nat.find hadj, Nat.find_spec hadj, fun _ => Nat.find_min hadj⟩
      have hl2 : r + 2 ≤ s.length := hr.lt_right
      obtain ⟨hf, hiso⟩ := ih (s := rmAt s r)
        (by rw [length_rmAt s hl2]; have := cr_rmAt_le hl2; omega) (hv.rmAt hr) (hl.rmAt hl2)
      have hinv := inv_run (d := d) hf
      have hlen : (run d (canon (rmAt s r))).length = s.length - 2 := by
        rw [hiso.length_eq, length_rmAt s hl2]
      rw [canon_adj hv hr hmin]
      refine ⟨(fits_snoc (d := d)).2 ⟨hf, by simp only [Move.Ok]; omega⟩, ?_⟩
      rw [run_append, List.foldl_cons, List.foldl_nil]
      have e1 := insAt_rmAt s (show r + 1 < s.length by omega)
      have eid : (s[r + 1]'(by omega)).1 = (s[r]'(by omega)).1 := by
        have := hr.2.2
        simp only [idAt, List.getElem?_eq_getElem (show r < s.length by omega),
          List.getElem?_eq_getElem (show r + 1 < s.length by omega)] at this
        simpa using this.symm
      have elt : (s[r + 1]'(by omega)).2 = d (s[r]'(by omega)).2 := by
        have := hl r (r + 1) hr (by omega)
        simp only [List.getElem?_eq_getElem (show r < s.length by omega),
          List.getElem?_eq_getElem (show r + 1 < s.length by omega)] at this
        simpa using this
      have e2 : s[r + 1]'(by omega) = ((s[r]'(by omega)).1, d (s[r]'(by omega)).2) :=
        Prod.ext eid elt
      conv_rhs => rw [← e1, e2]
      exact hiso.insAt (by omega) (fun x hx => (hinv.2 x hx).ne)
        (fun x hx => ne_id_of_mem_rmAt hv hr hx) _ _
    · have hno : ∀ r, ¬ Same s r (r + 1) := fun r hr => hadj ⟨r, hr⟩
      by_cases hne : s = []
      · subst hne
        rw [canon_nil]
        exact ⟨trivial, ⟨rfl, fun i j => Iff.rfl⟩⟩
      obtain ⟨q, ho, hc, hq, -⟩ := canon_cross hv hno hne
      have hilv := ilv_of_opn_cls hv (hno q) ho hc
      have hql := hilv.lt
      obtain ⟨hf, hiso⟩ := ih (s := swapAt s q)
        (by rw [length_swapAt]; have := cr_swapAt_lt hv hilv; omega) (hv.swapAt hql)
        (hl.swapAt hql (hno q))
      rw [hq]
      refine ⟨(fits_snoc (d := d)).2 ⟨hf, by simp only [Move.Ok]; rw [hiso.length_eq]; simpa⟩, ?_⟩
      rw [run_append, List.foldl_cons, List.foldl_nil]
      have := hiso.swapAt q
      rwa [swapAt_swapAt] at this

name: StringDiagrams.DSL.isNameChar_iff
statement:
theorem isNameChar_iff {c : Char} :
    isNameChar c = true ↔ specialTok? c = none ∧ c.isWhitespace = false

name: StringDiagrams.DSL.validName_iff
statement:
theorem validName_iff {s : String} :
    validName s = true ↔ s.toList ≠ [] ∧ s.toList.all isNameChar = true

name: StringDiagrams.DSL.flush_of_ne_nil
statement:
theorem flush_of_ne_nil {l : List Char} (h : l ≠ []) (ts : List Tok) :
    flush l ts = .ident (String.ofList l) :: ts
proof:
:= by
  cases l with
  | nil => exact absurd rfl h
  | cons _ _ => rfl

name: StringDiagrams.DSL.flush_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem flush_nil (ts : List Tok) : flush [] ts = ts

name: StringDiagrams.DSL.lexAux_special
statement:
theorem lexAux_special {c : Char} {t : Tok} (h : specialTok? c = some t) (cs acc : List Char) :
    lexAux (c :: cs) acc = flush acc (t :: lexAux cs [])

name: StringDiagrams.DSL.lexAux_space
statement: theorem lexAux_space (cs acc : List Char) : lexAux (' ' :: cs) acc = flush acc (lexAux cs [])

name: StringDiagrams.DSL.lexAux_append_name
statement:
theorem lexAux_append_name : ∀ (n : List Char), n.all isNameChar = true →
    ∀ (rest acc : List Char), lexAux (n ++ rest) acc = lexAux rest (acc ++ n)
proof:
| [], _, rest, acc => by simp
  | c :: n, h, rest, acc => by
    simp only [List.all_cons, Bool.and_eq_true] at h
    obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := isNameChar_iff.1 h.1
    simp only [List.cons_append, lexAux, h₁, h₂, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]
    rw [lexAux_append_name n h.2, List.append_assoc, List.singleton_append]

name: StringDiagrams.DSL.Tok.chars_of_not_ident
statement:
theorem Tok.chars_of_not_ident {t : Tok} (ht : t.isIdent = false) :
    ∃ c, t.chars = [c] ∧ specialTok? c = some t
proof:
:= by
  cases t <;> first | exact ⟨_, rfl, rfl⟩ | simp [Tok.isIdent] at ht

name: StringDiagrams.DSL.render_cons
statement: theorem render_cons (t : Tok) (ts : List Tok) : render (t :: ts) = t.chars ++ renderTail t ts

name: StringDiagrams.DSL.lexAux_render_of_not_ident
statement:
theorem lexAux_render_of_not_ident {t : Tok} (ht : t.isIdent = false) (ts : List Tok)
    (acc : List Char) :
    lexAux (render (t :: ts)) acc = flush acc (lexAux (render (t :: ts)) [])
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hct⟩ := Tok.chars_of_not_ident ht
  rw [render_cons, hc, List.singleton_append, lexAux_special hct, lexAux_special hct, flush_nil]

name: StringDiagrams.DSL.lexAux_renderTail_nil
statement:
theorem lexAux_renderTail_nil (t : Tok) (ts : List Tok) (ih : lexAux (render ts) [] = ts) :
    lexAux (renderTail t ts) [] = ts
proof:
:= by
  cases ts with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons t' ts =>
    simp only [renderTail]
    split
    · rw [List.singleton_append, lexAux_space, flush_nil, ih]
    · rw [List.nil_append, ih]

name: StringDiagrams.DSL.lexAux_render
statement: theorem lexAux_render : ∀ ts : List Tok, ts.all Tok.wf = true → lexAux (render ts) [] = ts
proof:
| [], _ => rfl
  | t :: ts, h => by
    simp only [List.all_cons, Bool.and_eq_true] at h
    have ih := lexAux_render ts h.2
    rw [render_cons]
    cases t with
    | ident s =>
      obtain ⟨hne, hs⟩ := validName_iff.1 h.1
      rw [Tok.chars, lexAux_append_name _ hs, List.nil_append]
      have : lexAux (renderTail (.ident s) ts) s.toList = flush s.toList ts := by
        cases ts with
        | nil => rfl
        | cons t' ts =>
          simp only [renderTail]
          split
          · rw [List.singleton_append, lexAux_space, ih]
          · rename_i hsp
            have ht' : t'.isIdent = false := by
              cases t' <;> simp_all [space, Tok.isIdent]
            rw [List.nil_append, lexAux_render_of_not_ident ht', ih]
      rw [this, flush_of_ne_nil hne, String.ofList_toList]
    | _ =>
      rw [Tok.chars, List.singleton_append, lexAux_special rfl, flush_nil,
        lexAux_renderTail_nil _ _ ih]

name: StringDiagrams.DSL.lex_mk_render
statement:
theorem lex_mk_render {ts : List Tok} (h : ts.all Tok.wf = true) :
    lex (String.ofList (render ts)) = ts
proof:
:= by
  rw [lex, String.toList_ofList]; exact lexAux_render ts h

name: StringDiagrams.DSL.isNameChar_digitChar
statement: theorem isNameChar_digitChar (d : ℕ) : isNameChar (digitChar d) = true

name: StringDiagrams.DSL.charDigit_digitChar
statement: theorem charDigit_digitChar {d : ℕ} (h : d < 10) : charDigit? (digitChar d) = some d

name: StringDiagrams.DSL.readDigits_map_digitChar
statement:
theorem readDigits_map_digitChar :
    ∀ (L : List ℕ), (∀ d ∈ L, d < 10) → ∀ acc,
      readDigits acc (L.map digitChar) = some (L.foldl (fun a d => 10 * a + d) acc)
proof:
| [], _, _ => rfl
  | d :: L, h, acc => by
    simp only [List.map_cons, readDigits, charDigit_digitChar (h d (by simp)), List.foldl_cons]
    exact readDigits_map_digitChar L (fun d hd => h d (by simp [hd])) _

name: StringDiagrams.DSL.foldl_reverse_eq_ofDigits
statement:
theorem foldl_reverse_eq_ofDigits :
    ∀ (L : List ℕ) (acc : ℕ),
      L.reverse.foldl (fun a d => 10 * a + d) acc = acc * 10 ^ L.length + Nat.ofDigits 10 L
proof:
| [], acc => by simp
  | d :: L, acc => by
    rw [List.reverse_cons, List.foldl_append, foldl_reverse_eq_ofDigits L acc]
    simp only [List.foldl_cons, List.foldl_nil, List.length_cons, Nat.ofDigits_cons, pow_succ]
    ring

name: StringDiagrams.DSL.natChars_ne_nil
statement: theorem natChars_ne_nil (n : ℕ) : natChars n ≠ []
proof:
:= by
  unfold natChars
  split
  · simp
  · simpa [Nat.digits_ne_nil_iff_ne_zero]

name: StringDiagrams.DSL.parseNat_natChars
statement: theorem parseNat_natChars (n : ℕ) : parseNat? (natChars n) = some n
proof:
:= by
  have hne := natChars_ne_nil n
  have : parseNat? (natChars n) = readDigits 0 (natChars n) := by
    cases h : natChars n with
    | nil => exact absurd h hne
    | cons _ _ => rfl
  rw [this]
  unfold natChars
  split
  · subst_vars; rfl
  · rw [readDigits_map_digitChar _ (fun d hd => Nat.digits_lt_base (by norm_num)
      (List.mem_reverse.1 hd)), foldl_reverse_eq_ofDigits, Nat.ofDigits_digits]
    simp

name: StringDiagrams.DSL.validName_natChars
statement: theorem validName_natChars (n : ℕ) : validName (String.ofList (natChars n)) = true
proof:
:=
  validName_iff.2 ⟨by rw [String.toList_ofList]; exact natChars_ne_nil n, by
    rw [String.toList_ofList]; unfold natChars; split
    · decide
    · simp [List.all_map, Function.comp_def, isNameChar_digitChar]⟩

name: StringDiagrams.DSL.printToks_wf
statement: theorem printToks_wf (a : Obj S) (ls : List (Layer S)) : (printToks a ls).all Tok.wf = true
proof:
:= by
  have hobj : (objToks a).all Tok.wf = true := by
    simp only [objToks, List.all_append, Bool.and_eq_true]
    constructor
    · unfold regionToks; split
      · rfl
      · rename_i h
        simp [Tok.wf, (regionName_valid a.start).resolve_left h]
    · unfold wordToks; split
      · simp [Tok.wf, validName_natChars]
      · simp [Tok.wf, colourName_valid]
  have hls : ∀ ls : List (Layer S), (layersToks ls).all Tok.wf = true := by
    intro ls
    induction ls with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons L ls ih =>
      cases ls with
      | nil => simp [layersToks, layerToks, Tok.wf, genName_valid, validName_natChars]
      | cons L' ls =>
        simp only [layersToks] at ih ⊢
        simp [layerToks, Tok.wf, genName_valid, validName_natChars, ih]
  unfold printToks; split
  · exact hobj
  · simp [hobj, hls, Tok.wf]

name: StringDiagrams.DSL.lookupRegion_of_eq
statement:
theorem lookupRegion_of_eq {n : String} {r : S.Region} (h : regionOfName? n = some r)
    (ts : List Tok) : lookupRegion n ts = .ok (r, ts)

name: StringDiagrams.DSL.parseRegion_objToks
statement:
theorem parseRegion_objToks (a : Obj S) (rest : List Tok) :
    parseRegion (S := S) (objToks a ++ rest) = .ok (a.start, wordToks a.word ++ rest)
proof:
:= by
  have hl := regionOfName_regionName a.start
  unfold objToks regionToks
  split
  · rename_i h
    rw [h] at hl
    simp only [List.nil_append]
    unfold wordToks
    split <;> exact lookupRegion_of_eq hl _
  · exact lookupRegion_of_eq hl _

name: StringDiagrams.DSL.parseColours_map
statement:
theorem parseColours_map (w : List S.Colour) (rest : List Tok) :
    parseColours (S := S) ((w.map fun c => .ident (colourName c)) ++ .rbrack :: rest) =
      .ok (w, rest)
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons c w ih => simp [parseColours, colourOfName_colourName, ih]

name: StringDiagrams.DSL.parseWord_wordToks
statement:
theorem parseWord_wordToks (w : List S.Colour) (rest : List Tok) :
    parseWord (S := S) (wordToks w ++ rest) = .ok (w, rest)
proof:
:= by
  unfold wordToks
  split
  · rename_i c₀ hc
    simp only [List.cons_append, List.nil_append, parseWord, hc]
    rw [String.toList_ofList, parseNat_natChars]
    have : List.replicate w.length c₀ = w :=
      (List.eq_replicate_iff.2 ⟨rfl, fun c _ => soleColour_eq hc c⟩).symm
    dsimp only
    rw [this]
  · simp only [List.cons_append, List.append_assoc, parseWord]
    exact parseColours_map w rest

name: StringDiagrams.DSL.parseLayer_eq
statement:
theorem parseLayer_eq {r₀ : S.Region} {L : Layer S} (hv : L.Valid) (hs : L.start = r₀) :
    parseLayer r₀ L.dom.word (genName L.gen) (String.ofList (natChars L.left.length)) = .ok L
proof:
:= by
  have hw : L.dom.word = L.left ++ (S.dom L.gen ++ L.right) := by simp
  have hg := genOfName_genName L.gen L.right
  have hend : S.endR r₀ L.left = S.left L.gen := hs ▸ hv.left_end
  simp only [parseLayer, String.toList_ofList, parseNat_natChars, hw, List.take_left, List.drop_left,
    hend, hg, List.isPrefixOf_iff_prefix, List.prefix_append, ↓reduceIte, List.length_append]
  simp only [Nat.le_add_right, ↓reduceIte, Except.ok.injEq]
  cases L; subst hs; rfl

name: StringDiagrams.DSL.parseLayers_layersToks
statement:
theorem parseLayers_layersToks :
    ∀ (ls : List (Layer S)) (a b : Obj S), Chain a ls b → ls ≠ [] →
      parseLayers a.start a.word (layersToks ls) = .ok ls
proof:
| [], _, _, _, h => absurd rfl h
  | L :: ls, a, b, ⟨hv, hdom, hc⟩, _ => by
    have hL : parseLayer a.start a.word (genName L.gen)
        (String.ofList (natChars L.left.length)) = .ok L := by
      rw [← hdom]; exact parseLayer_eq hv rfl
    cases ls with
    | nil => simp [layersToks, layerToks, parseLayers, hL]
    | cons L' ls =>
      have ih := parseLayers_layersToks (L' :: ls) L.cod b hc (List.cons_ne_nil _ _)
      have hst : L.cod.start = a.start := by rw [← hdom]; rfl
      rw [hst] at ih
      simp only [Layer.cod_word, List.append_assoc] at ih
      simp [layersToks, layerToks, parseLayers, hL, ih]

name: StringDiagrams.DSL.parseToks_printToks
statement:
theorem parseToks_printToks {a b : Obj S} {ls : List (Layer S)} (h : Chain a ls b) :
    parseToks (printToks a ls) = .ok (a, ls)
proof:
:= by
  unfold printToks
  split
  · have := parseRegion_objToks a []
    rw [List.append_nil] at this
    have hw := parseWord_wordToks a.word []
    rw [List.append_nil] at hw
    simp only [parseToks, this, List.append_nil, hw]
  · rename_i L ls
    simp only [parseToks, parseRegion_objToks, parseWord_wordToks,
      parseLayers_layersToks _ a b h (List.cons_ne_nil _ _)]

name: StringDiagrams.DSL.parse_print
statement:
theorem parse_print {a b : Obj S} {ls : List (Layer S)} (h : Chain a ls b) :
    parse (print a ls) = .ok (a, ls)
proof:
:= by
  rw [parse, print, lex_mk_render (printToks_wf a ls), parseToks_printToks h]

name: StringDiagrams.DSL.parseHom_printHom
statement:
theorem parseHom_printHom [LawfulDSLNames S] {a b : Obj S} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    parseHom a b (printHom f) = .ok f
proof:
:= by
  simp only [parseHom, printHom, parse_print (Diagram.chain f), ↓reduceIte,
    dite_eq_left (Diagram.chain f)]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.FiniteDimensionalAlgebra.isUnit_of_mul_eq_one_left
statement: theorem isUnit_of_mul_eq_one_left {g f : E} (h : g * f = 1) : IsUnit f
proof:
:= by
  have hinj : Injective (LinearMap.mulLeft k f) := fun x y hxy => by
