    have := congrArg (g * ·) hxy
    simpa [← mul_assoc, h] using this
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := (LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective.1 hinj) 1
  have hy' : f * y = 1 := hy
  have hgy : g = y := by rw [← mul_one g, ← hy', ← mul_assoc, h, one_mul]
  exact ⟨⟨f, g, by rw [hgy, hy'], h⟩, rfl⟩

name: StringDiagrams.FiniteDimensionalAlgebra.isNilpotent_or_isUnit_of_idempotent
statement:
theorem isNilpotent_or_isUnit_of_idempotent
    (h : ∀ e : E, IsIdempotentElem e → e = 0 ∨ e = 1) (f : E) : IsNilpotent f ∨ IsUnit f
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn, hn1⟩ := ((LinearMap.mulRight k f).eventually_isCompl_ker_pow_range_pow.and
    (Filter.eventually_ge_atTop 1)).exists
  rw [LinearMap.pow_mulRight] at hn
  set K := LinearMap.ker (LinearMap.mulRight k (f ^ n))
  set I := LinearMap.range (LinearMap.mulRight k (f ^ n))
  have hK : ∀ y x, x ∈ K → y * x ∈ K := by
    intro y x hx
    simp only [K, LinearMap.mem_ker, LinearMap.mulRight_apply] at hx ⊢
    rw [mul_assoc, hx, mul_zero]
  have hI : ∀ y x, x ∈ I → y * x ∈ I := by
    rintro y _ ⟨z, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨y * z, by simp [mul_assoc]⟩
  have h1 : (1 : E) ∈ K ⊔ I := by rw [hn.sup_eq_top]; trivial
  obtain ⟨e₁, he₁, e₂, he₂, hsum⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.1 h1
  have hid : IsIdempotentElem e₁ := by
    have hdis := Submodule.disjoint_def.1 hn.disjoint
    have hK' : e₁ * e₁ - e₁ ∈ K := sub_mem (hK _ _ he₁) he₁
    have heq : e₁ * e₁ - e₁ = -(e₁ * e₂) := by
      have : e₁ * (e₁ + e₂) = e₁ := by rw [hsum, mul_one]
      rw [mul_add] at this
      rw [eq_neg_iff_add_eq_zero, sub_add_eq_add_sub, this, sub_self]
    have hI' : e₁ * e₁ - e₁ ∈ I := by rw [heq]; exact neg_mem (hI _ _ he₂)
    exact sub_eq_zero.1 (hdis _ hK' hI')
  rcases h e₁ hid with h0 | h1'
  · right
    rw [h0, zero_add] at hsum
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ : (1 : E) ∈ I := hsum ▸ he₂
    simp only [LinearMap.mulRight_apply] at hz
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le' hn1
    refine isUnit_of_mul_eq_one_left k (g := z * f ^ m) ?_
    rw [mul_assoc, ← pow_succ, hz]
  · left
    refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
    have : (1 : E) ∈ K := h1' ▸ he₁
    simpa [K] using this

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.card_word
statement: theorem card_word (n : ℕ) : Fintype.card (List.Vector (Fin 2) n) = 2 ^ n

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.length_ins
statement:
@[simp] theorem length_ins (p : ℕ) (a b : Fin 2) (w : List (Fin 2)) :
    (ins p a b w).length = w.length + 2
proof:
:= by
  induction p generalizing w with
  | zero => simp [ins]
  | succ p ih => cases w with
    | nil => simp [ins]
    | cons x w => simp [ins, ih]

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.length_del
statement:
theorem length_del {p : ℕ} {w : List (Fin 2)} (h : p + 2 ≤ w.length) :
    (del p w).length + 2 = w.length
proof:
:= by
  induction p generalizing w with
  | zero => simp [del]; omega
  | succ p ih => cases w with
    | nil => simp at h
    | cons x w => simp [del]; have := ih (w := w) (by simp at h; omega); omega

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.getD_ins_lt
statement:
theorem getD_ins_lt {p q : ℕ} (a b : Fin 2) {w : List (Fin 2)} (hq : q < p) (hp : p ≤ w.length) :
    (ins p a b w).getD q 0 = w.getD q 0
proof:
:= by
  induction p generalizing w q with
  | zero => omega
  | succ p ih => cases w with
    | nil => simp at hp
    | cons x w => cases q with
      | zero => simp [ins]
      | succ q => simp only [ins, List.getD_cons_succ]; exact ih (by omega) (by simp at hp; omega)

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.getD_ins_self
statement:
@[simp] theorem getD_ins_self (p : ℕ) (a b : Fin 2) {w : List (Fin 2)} (hp : p ≤ w.length) :
    (ins p a b w).getD p 0 = a
proof:
:= by
  induction p generalizing w with
  | zero => simp [ins]
  | succ p ih => cases w with
    | nil => simp at hp
    | cons x w => simp only [ins, List.getD_cons_succ]; exact ih (by simp at hp; omega)

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.getD_ins_succ
statement:
@[simp] theorem getD_ins_succ (p : ℕ) (a b : Fin 2) {w : List (Fin 2)} (hp : p ≤ w.length) :
    (ins p a b w).getD (p + 1) 0 = b
proof:
:= by
  induction p generalizing w with
  | zero => simp [ins]
  | succ p ih => cases w with
    | nil => simp at hp
    | cons x w => simp only [ins, List.getD_cons_succ]; exact ih (by simp at hp; omega)

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.getD_ins_ge
statement:
theorem getD_ins_ge {p q : ℕ} (a b : Fin 2) {w : List (Fin 2)} (hq : p ≤ q) (hp : p ≤ w.length) :
    (ins p a b w).getD (q + 2) 0 = w.getD q 0
proof:
:= by
  induction p generalizing w q with
  | zero => simp [ins]
  | succ p ih => cases w with
    | nil => simp at hp
    | cons x w =>
      obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ : ∃ q', q = q' + 1 := ⟨q - 1, by omega⟩
      simp only [ins, show q + 1 + 2 = (q + 2) + 1 by omega, List.getD_cons_succ]
      exact ih (by omega) (by simp at hp; omega)

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.getD_del_lt
statement:
theorem getD_del_lt {p q : ℕ} {w : List (Fin 2)} (hq : q < p) (hp : p + 2 ≤ w.length) :
    (del p w).getD q 0 = w.getD q 0
proof:
:= by
  induction p generalizing w q with
  | zero => omega
  | succ p ih => cases w with
    | nil => simp at hp
    | cons x w => cases q with
      | zero => simp [del]
      | succ q => simp only [del, List.getD_cons_succ]; exact ih (by omega) (by simp at hp; omega)

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.getD_del_ge
statement:
theorem getD_del_ge {p q : ℕ} {w : List (Fin 2)} (hq : p ≤ q) :
    (del p w).getD q 0 = w.getD (q + 2) 0
proof:
:= by
  induction p generalizing w q with
  | zero => simp [del, List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, add_comm]
  | succ p ih => cases w with
    | nil => simp [del]
    | cons x w =>
      obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ : ∃ q', q = q' + 1 := ⟨q - 1, by omega⟩
      simp only [del, show q + 1 + 2 = (q + 2) + 1 by omega, List.getD_cons_succ]
      exact ih (by omega)

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.del_ins
statement:
@[simp] theorem del_ins (p : ℕ) (a b : Fin 2) {w : List (Fin 2)} (hp : p ≤ w.length) :
    del p (ins p a b w) = w
proof:
:= by
  induction p generalizing w with
  | zero => simp [ins, del]
  | succ p ih => cases w with
    | nil => simp at hp
    | cons x w => simp only [ins, del]; rw [ih (by simp at hp; omega)]

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.del_succ_ins
statement:
theorem del_succ_ins {p : ℕ} (a b : Fin 2) {w : List (Fin 2)} (hp : p < w.length) :
    del (p + 1) (ins p a b w) = w.set p a
proof:
:= by
  induction p generalizing w with
  | zero => cases w with
    | nil => simp at hp
    | cons x w => simp [ins, del]
  | succ p ih => cases w with
    | nil => simp at hp
    | cons x w => simp only [ins, del, List.set_cons_succ]; rw [ih (by simp at hp; omega)]

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.del_ins_succ
statement:
theorem del_ins_succ {p : ℕ} (a b : Fin 2) {w : List (Fin 2)} (hp : p < w.length) :
    del p (ins (p + 1) a b w) = w.set p b
proof:
:= by
  induction p generalizing w with
  | zero => cases w with
    | nil => simp at hp
    | cons x w => simp [ins, del]
  | succ p ih => cases w with
    | nil => simp at hp
    | cons x w => simp only [ins, del, List.set_cons_succ]; rw [ih (by simp at hp; omega)]

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.set_getD_self
statement: theorem set_getD_self {p : ℕ} {w : List (Fin 2)} (hp : p < w.length) : w.set p (w.getD p 0) = w
proof:
:= by
  rw [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hp, Option.getD_some]
  exact List.set_getElem_self hp

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.ins_ins
statement:
theorem ins_ins {p k : ℕ} (a b c d : Fin 2) {w : List (Fin 2)} (h : p + k ≤ w.length) :
    ins (p + 2 + k) c d (ins p a b w) = ins p a b (ins (p + k) c d w)
proof:
:= by
  induction p generalizing w with
  | zero => simp [ins, show 2 + k = k + 1 + 1 by omega]
  | succ p ih => cases w with
    | nil => simp at h
    | cons x w =>
      simp only [show p + 1 + 2 + k = (p + 2 + k) + 1 by omega, show p + 1 + k = (p + k) + 1 by omega,
        ins]
      rw [ih (by simp at h; omega)]

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.del_del
statement:
theorem del_del {p k : ℕ} {w : List (Fin 2)} (h : p + k + 4 ≤ w.length) :
    del p (del (p + 2 + k) w) = del (p + k) (del p w)
proof:
:= by
  induction p generalizing w with
  | zero =>
    obtain ⟨x, y, w, rfl⟩ : ∃ x y w', w = x :: y :: w' := by
      rcases w with _ | ⟨x, _ | ⟨y, w'⟩⟩
      · simp at h
      · simp at h
      · exact ⟨x, y, w', rfl⟩
    simp [del, show 2 + k = k + 1 + 1 by omega]
  | succ p ih => cases w with
    | nil => simp at h
    | cons x w =>
      simp only [show p + 1 + 2 + k = (p + 2 + k) + 1 by omega, show p + 1 + k = (p + k) + 1 by omega,
        del]
      rw [ih (by simp at h; omega)]

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.del_ins_far
statement:
theorem del_ins_far {p k : ℕ} (a b : Fin 2) {w : List (Fin 2)} (h : p + k + 2 ≤ w.length) :
    del (p + 2 + k) (ins p a b w) = ins p a b (del (p + k) w)
proof:
:= by
  induction p generalizing w with
  | zero => simp [ins, del, show 2 + k = k + 1 + 1 by omega]
  | succ p ih => cases w with
    | nil => simp at h
    | cons x w =>
      simp only [show p + 1 + 2 + k = (p + 2 + k) + 1 by omega, show p + 1 + k = (p + k) + 1 by omega,
        ins, del]
      rw [ih (by simp at h; omega)]

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.del_ins_far'
statement:
theorem del_ins_far' {p k : ℕ} (c d : Fin 2) {w : List (Fin 2)} (h : p + 2 + k ≤ w.length) :
    del p (ins (p + 2 + k) c d w) = ins (p + k) c d (del p w)
proof:
:= by
  induction p generalizing w with
  | zero =>
    obtain ⟨x, y, w, rfl⟩ : ∃ x y w', w = x :: y :: w' := by
      rcases w with _ | ⟨x, _ | ⟨y, w'⟩⟩
      · simp at h
      · simp at h; omega
      · exact ⟨x, y, w', rfl⟩
    simp [ins, del, show 2 + k = k + 1 + 1 by omega]
  | succ p ih => cases w with
    | nil => simp at h
    | cons x w =>
      simp only [show p + 1 + 2 + k = (p + 2 + k) + 1 by omega, show p + 1 + k = (p + k) + 1 by omega,
        ins, del]
      rw [ih (by simp at h; omega)]

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.cupOp_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem cupOp_apply (p : ℕ) (F : Fn R) (w : List (Fin 2)) :
    cupOp R p F w = cupCoeff R (w.getD p 0) (w.getD (p + 1) 0) * F (del p w)

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.capOp_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem capOp_apply (p : ℕ) (F : Fn R) (w : List (Fin 2)) :
    capOp R p F w = ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, capCoeff R a b * F (ins p a b w)

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.evalLayers_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem evalLayers_nil : evalLayers R [] = LinearMap.id

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.evalLayers_cons
statement:
@[simp] theorem evalLayers_cons (L : Layer sig) (ls : List (Layer sig)) :
    evalLayers R (L :: ls) = evalLayers R ls ∘ₗ op R L

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.op_agree
statement:
theorem op_agree (L : Layer sig) {F F' : Fn R} (h : Agree L.dom.word.length F F') :
    Agree L.cod.word.length (op R L F) (op R L F')
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, l, g, r⟩ := L
  intro w hw
  cases g with
  | cup =>
    simp only [Layer.cod_word, List.length_append, sig, List.length_cons, List.length_nil] at hw
    have := length_del (p := l.length) (w := w) (by omega)
    simp only [op, cupOp_apply]
    rw [h _ (by simp [sig]; omega)]
  | cap =>
    simp only [Layer.cod_word, List.length_append, sig, List.length_nil] at hw
    simp only [op, capOp_apply]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
    rw [h _ (by simp [sig]; omega)]

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.evalLayers_agree
statement:
theorem evalLayers_agree {a b : Obj sig} {ls : List (Layer sig)} (hc : Chain a ls b)
    {F F' : Fn R} (h : Agree a.word.length F F') :
    Agree b.word.length (evalLayers R ls F) (evalLayers R ls F')
proof:
:= by
  induction ls generalizing a F F' with
  | nil => cases hc; exact h
  | cons L ls ih =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl, hc⟩ := hc
    exact ih hc (op_agree L h)

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.ext_apply_of_length
statement:
theorem ext_apply_of_length {n : ℕ} (f : Word n → R) {w : List (Fin 2)} (h : w.length = n) :
    ext R n f w = f ⟨w, h⟩

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.ext_apply_word
statement: @[simp] theorem ext_apply_word {n : ℕ} (f : Word n → R) (w : Word n) : ext R n f w.1 = f w

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.res_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem res_apply (n : ℕ) (F : Fn R) (w : Word n) : res R n F w = F w.1

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.restrict_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem restrict_apply (n m : ℕ) (T : Fn R →ₗ[R] Fn R) (f : Word n → R) (w : Word m) :
    restrict R n m T f w = T (ext R n f) w.1

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.loc_κ
statement: @[simp] theorem loc_κ (a : Obj sig) : (loc R).κ a = a.word.length

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.loc_ext
statement: @[simp] theorem loc_ext (n : ℕ) : (loc R).ext n = ext R n

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.loc_res
statement: @[simp] theorem loc_res (n : ℕ) : (loc R).res n = res R n

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.loc_op
statement: @[simp] theorem loc_op (L : Layer sig) : (loc R).op L = op R L

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.loc_opList
statement: theorem loc_opList (ls : List (Layer sig)) : (loc R).opList ls = evalLayers R ls
proof:
:= by
  induction ls with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons L ls ih => rw [LocalInterpretation.opList_cons, ih]; rfl

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.mapChain_apply
statement:
theorem mapChain_apply {a b : Obj sig} (ls : List (Layer sig)) (h : Chain a ls b)
    (f : Word a.word.length → R) (w : Word b.word.length) :
    ((interp R).mapChain a ls b h).hom f w = evalLayers R ls (ext R _ f) w.1
proof:
:= by
  show ((loc R).interp.mapChain a ls b h).hom f w = _
  rw [(loc R).interp_mapChain_hom, loc_opList]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.map_apply
statement:
theorem map_apply {a b : Obj sig} (d : a ⟶ b) (f : Word a.word.length → R)
    (w : Word b.word.length) :
    ((interp R).functor.map d).hom f w = evalLayers R (Diagram.layers d) (ext R _ f) w.1

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.op_cup
statement: @[simp] theorem op_cup (s : Unit) (l r : List Unit) : op R ⟨s, l, .cup, r⟩ = cupOp R l.length

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.op_cap
statement: @[simp] theorem op_cap (s : Unit) (l r : List Unit) : op R ⟨s, l, .cap, r⟩ = capOp R l.length

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.loop_op
statement:
theorem loop_op {p : ℕ} (F : Fn R) {w : List (Fin 2)} (hp : p ≤ w.length) :
    capOp R p (cupOp R p F) w = -2 * F w
proof:
:= by
  simp only [capOp_apply, cupOp_apply, getD_ins_self _ _ _ hp, getD_ins_succ _ _ _ hp,
    del_ins _ _ _ hp, Fin.sum_univ_two, cupCoeff, capCoeff]
  simp; ring

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.zigzagA_op
statement:
theorem zigzagA_op {p : ℕ} (F : Fn R) {w : List (Fin 2)} (hp : p < w.length) :
    capOp R p (cupOp R (p + 1) F) w = F w
proof:
:= by
  have e : F w = F (w.set p (w.getD p 0)) := by rw [set_getD_self hp]
  simp only [capOp_apply, cupOp_apply, getD_ins_succ _ _ _ hp.le,
    show p + 1 + 1 = p + 2 from rfl, getD_ins_ge _ _ le_rfl hp.le, del_succ_ins _ _ hp, e]
  generalize w.getD p 0 = c
  fin_cases c <;> simp [Fin.sum_univ_two, cupCoeff, capCoeff]

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.zigzagB_op
statement:
theorem zigzagB_op {p : ℕ} (F : Fn R) {w : List (Fin 2)} (hp : p < w.length) :
    capOp R (p + 1) (cupOp R p F) w = F w
proof:
:= by
  have e : F w = F (w.set p (w.getD p 0)) := by rw [set_getD_self hp]
  simp only [capOp_apply, cupOp_apply, getD_ins_lt _ _ (Nat.lt_succ_self p) hp,
    getD_ins_self _ _ _ hp, del_ins_succ _ _ hp, e]
  generalize w.getD p 0 = c
  fin_cases c <;> simp [Fin.sum_univ_two, cupCoeff, capCoeff]

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.cap_cap_op
statement:
theorem cap_cap_op {p k : ℕ} (F : Fn R) {w : List (Fin 2)} (h : p + k ≤ w.length) :
    capOp R (p + k) (capOp R p F) w = capOp R p (capOp R (p + 2 + k) F) w
proof:
:= by
  simp only [capOp_apply, ins_ins _ _ _ _ h, Fin.sum_univ_two]
  ring

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.cup_cup_op
statement:
theorem cup_cup_op {p k : ℕ} (F : Fn R) {w : List (Fin 2)} (h : p + k + 4 ≤ w.length) :
    cupOp R (p + 2 + k) (cupOp R p F) w = cupOp R p (cupOp R (p + k) F) w
proof:
:= by
  simp only [cupOp_apply]
  rw [getD_del_lt (show p < p + 2 + k by omega) (by omega),
    getD_del_lt (show p + 1 < p + 2 + k by omega) (by omega),
    getD_del_ge (show p ≤ p + k by omega), getD_del_ge (show p ≤ p + k + 1 by omega),
    show p + k + 2 = p + 2 + k by omega, show p + k + 1 + 2 = p + 2 + k + 1 by omega, del_del h]
  ring

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.cap_cup_op
statement:
theorem cap_cup_op {p k : ℕ} (F : Fn R) {w : List (Fin 2)} (h : p + k + 2 ≤ w.length) :
    cupOp R (p + k) (capOp R p F) w = capOp R p (cupOp R (p + 2 + k) F) w
proof:
:= by
  simp only [cupOp_apply, capOp_apply]
  simp only [del_ins_far _ _ h]
  simp only [show p + 2 + k = (p + k) + 2 by omega,
    getD_ins_ge _ _ (show p ≤ p + k by omega) (show p ≤ w.length by omega),
    getD_ins_ge _ _ (show p ≤ p + k + 1 by omega) (show p ≤ w.length by omega), Fin.sum_univ_two]
  ring

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.cup_cap_op
statement:
theorem cup_cap_op {p k : ℕ} (F : Fn R) {w : List (Fin 2)} (h : p + 2 + k ≤ w.length) :
    capOp R (p + 2 + k) (cupOp R p F) w = cupOp R p (capOp R (p + k) F) w
proof:
:= by
  simp only [cupOp_apply, capOp_apply, del_ins_far' _ _ h,
    getD_ins_lt _ _ (show p < p + 2 + k by omega) h,
    getD_ins_lt _ _ (show p + 1 < p + 2 + k by omega) h, Fin.sum_univ_two]
  ring

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.sig_dom_cup
statement: @[simp] theorem sig_dom_cup : sig.dom .cup = []

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.sig_cod_cup
statement: @[simp] theorem sig_cod_cup : sig.cod .cup = [(), ()]

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.sig_dom_cap
statement: @[simp] theorem sig_dom_cap : sig.dom .cap = [(), ()]

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.sig_cod_cap
statement: @[simp] theorem sig_cod_cap : sig.cod .cap = []

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.respects
statement: theorem respects : (pres R (-2)).Respects (interp R).functor
proof:
:= by
  refine (loc R).respects_of _ (fun r u v _ => ?_)
    fun x hx u v _ => (loc R).evalW_interchange_eq_zero (fun s l m r g g' => ?_) x hx u v
  · cases r <;> simp only [pres, relation, evalW_sub, evalW_smul, evalW_of, sub_eq_zero] <;>
    refine LinearMap.ext fun f => funext fun w => ?_ <;>
    have hl := w.2 <;>
    simp only [loc_κ, Obj.whisker_word, List.length_append, strands, Rel.width,
      List.length_replicate, add_zero] at hl <;>
    simp only [Diagram.layers_comp, Diagram.layers_layer, dcup, dcap, lay,
      List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.cons_append, List.nil_append, opList_cons, opList_nil,
      LinearMap.id_comp, LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply,
      Pi.smul_apply, loc_res, res_apply, loc_op, loc_ext, Layer.whisker, op_cup, op_cap,
      List.length_append, List.length_replicate, add_zero, smul_eq_mul]
    · exact loop_op _ (by omega)
    · exact zigzagA_op _ (by omega)
    · exact zigzagB_op _ (by omega)
  · have hs : (((⟨s, g, m, g'⟩ : InterchangeData sig).sign : ℤ) : R) = 1 := by
      simp [InterchangeData.sign, sig]
    rw [hs, one_smul]
    refine LinearMap.ext fun f => funext fun w => ?_
    have hl := w.2
    cases g <;> cases g' <;>
    simp only [loc_κ, List.length_append, sig_cod_cup, sig_cod_cap,
      List.length_nil, List.length_cons] at hl <;>
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, loc_res, res_apply, loc_op, loc_ext, op_cup, op_cap,
      List.length_append, sig_dom_cup, sig_cod_cup, sig_dom_cap, sig_cod_cap, List.length_nil,
      List.length_cons, List.nil_append]
    all_goals rw [show l.length + (0 + 1 + 1 + m.length) = l.length + 2 + m.length by omega]
    · exact cup_cup_op _ (by omega)
    · exact cup_cap_op _ (by omega)
    · exact cap_cup_op _ (by omega)
    · exact cap_cap_op _ (by omega)

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.rep_map_diag
statement:
@[simp] theorem rep_map_diag {a b : Obj sig} (d : a ⟶ b) :
    (rep R).map ((pres R (-2)).diag d) = (interp R).functor.map d

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.ins_inj
statement:
theorem ins_inj {p : ℕ} {a b a' b' : Fin 2} {w : List (Fin 2)} (hp : p ≤ w.length)
    (h : ins p a b w = ins p a' b' w) : a = a' ∧ b = b'
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ := congrArg (fun l => l.getD p 0) h
  have h₂ := congrArg (fun l => l.getD (p + 1) 0) h
  simp only [getD_ins_self _ _ _ hp, getD_ins_succ _ _ _ hp] at h₁ h₂
  exact ⟨h₁, h₂⟩

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.rep_e_apply
statement:
theorem rep_e_apply {m i : ℕ} (h : i ≤ m) :
    ((rep R).map (e (R := R) (-2) m i)).hom
        (fun w => if w.1 = ins i 0 1 (List.replicate m 0) then 1 else 0)
        ⟨ins i 0 1 (List.replicate m 0), by
          show _ = (List.replicate (m + 2) ()).length; simp⟩ = -1
proof:
:= by
  have hz : i ≤ (List.replicate m (0 : Fin 2)).length := by simp [h]
  rw [e_def (-2) h, ← Presentation.diag_comp, rep_map_diag]
  refine (map_apply R _ _ _).trans ?_
  simp only [Diagram.layers_comp, Diagram.layers_layer, dcup, dcap, lay, List.cons_append,
    List.nil_append, evalLayers_cons, evalLayers_nil, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.id_apply,
    op_cup, op_cap, List.length_replicate, cupOp_apply, capOp_apply, getD_ins_self _ _ _ hz,
    getD_ins_succ _ _ _ hz, del_ins _ _ _ hz]
  have hl : ∀ a b : Fin 2, (ins i a b (List.replicate m 0)).length =
      (strands (m + 2)).word.length := by simp [strands]
  simp only [ext_apply_of_length R _ (hl _ _), Fin.sum_univ_two]
  have h₁ : ins i 1 0 (List.replicate m 0) ≠ ins i 0 1 (List.replicate m 0) := fun e =>
    absurd (ins_inj hz e).1 (by decide)
  simp [h₁, cupCoeff, capCoeff]

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.Rep.e_ne_zero
statement: theorem e_ne_zero [Nontrivial R] {m i : ℕ} (h : i ≤ m) : e (R := R) (-2) m i ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro he
  have hv := rep_e_apply (R := R) h
  rw [he, Functor.map_zero] at hv
  exact neg_ne_zero.mpr one_ne_zero hv.symm

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.diag_eq_of_swap
statement:
theorem diag_eq_of_swap {a b : Obj sig} {f f' : a ⟶ b} (L M : Layer sig)
    (hf : Diagram.layers f = [L.wr M.dom.word, M.wl L.cod])
    (hf' : Diagram.layers f' = [M.wl L.dom, L.wr M.cod.word]) :
    (pres R δ).diag f = (pres R δ).diag f'
proof:
:= by
  have hc := Diagram.chain f
  rw [hf] at hc
  obtain ⟨-, ha, -, -, hb⟩ := hc
  rw [Layer.wr_dom] at ha
  rw [chain_nil, Layer.wl_cod] at hb
  subst ha hb
  have key := (pres R δ).diag_swap_layers L M
  simp only [Diagram.oddCountList, sig, Bool.false_eq_true, List.filter_cons,
    List.filter_nil, ite_false, List.length_nil, mul_zero, pow_zero, one_smul] at key
  exact (Presentation.diag_eq_of_layers_eq _ (by rw [hf]; rfl)).trans
    (key.trans (Presentation.diag_eq_of_layers_eq _ (by rw [hf']; rfl)))

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.cap_cap_interchange
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem cap_cap_interchange {n i j : ℕ} (hij : i + 2 ≤ j) (hj : j ≤ n + 2) :
    (pres R δ).diag (dcap (m := n + 2) (i := j) hj) ≫ (pres R δ).diag (dcap (m := n) (i := i) (by omega)) =
      (pres R δ).diag (dcap (m := n + 2) (i := i) (by omega)) ≫
        (pres R δ).diag (dcap (m := n) (i := j - 2) (by omega))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Presentation.diag_comp, ← Presentation.diag_comp]
  symm
  apply diag_eq_of_swap δ (gl i .cap 0) (gl (j - 2 - i) .cap (n + 2 - j)) <;>
    simp [dcap, lay, Layer.wr, Layer.wl, Layer.dom, Layer.cod, sig] <;> omega

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.cup_cup_interchange
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem cup_cup_interchange {n i j : ℕ} (hij : i + 2 ≤ j) (hj : j ≤ n + 2) :
    (pres R δ).diag (dcup (m := n) (i := j - 2) (by omega)) ≫
        (pres R δ).diag (dcup (m := n + 2) (i := i) (by omega)) =
      (pres R δ).diag (dcup (m := n) (i := i) (by omega)) ≫
        (pres R δ).diag (dcup (m := n + 2) (i := j) hj)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Presentation.diag_comp, ← Presentation.diag_comp]
  symm
  apply diag_eq_of_swap δ (gl i .cup 0) (gl (j - 2 - i) .cup (n + 2 - j)) <;>
    simp [dcup, lay, Layer.wr, Layer.wl, Layer.dom, Layer.cod, sig] <;> omega

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.cap_cup_interchange
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem cap_cup_interchange {n i j : ℕ} (hij : i + 2 ≤ j) (hj : j ≤ n + 2) :
    (pres R δ).diag (dcup (m := n + 2) (i := j) hj) ≫
        (pres R δ).diag (dcap (m := n + 2) (i := i) (by omega)) =
      (pres R δ).diag (dcap (m := n) (i := i) (by omega)) ≫
        (pres R δ).diag (dcup (m := n) (i := j - 2) (by omega))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Presentation.diag_comp, ← Presentation.diag_comp]
  symm
  apply diag_eq_of_swap δ (gl i .cap 0) (gl (j - 2 - i) .cup (n + 2 - j)) <;>
    simp [dcup, dcap, lay, Layer.wr, Layer.wl, Layer.dom, Layer.cod, sig] <;> omega

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.cup_cap_interchange
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem cup_cap_interchange {n i j : ℕ} (hij : i + 2 ≤ j) (hj : j ≤ n + 2) :
    (pres R δ).diag (dcap (m := n) (i := j - 2) (by omega)) ≫
        (pres R δ).diag (dcup (m := n) (i := i) (by omega)) =
      (pres R δ).diag (dcup (m := n + 2) (i := i) (by omega)) ≫
        (pres R δ).diag (dcap (m := n + 2) (i := j) hj)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Presentation.diag_comp, ← Presentation.diag_comp]
  symm
  apply diag_eq_of_swap δ (gl i .cup 0) (gl (j - 2 - i) .cap (n + 2 - j)) <;>
    simp [dcup, dcap, lay, Layer.wr, Layer.wl, Layer.dom, Layer.cod, sig] <;> omega

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.e_mul_e_comm
statement: theorem e_mul_e_comm {m i j : ℕ} (hij : i + 2 ≤ j) : e δ m i * e δ m j = e δ m j * e δ m i
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hj : j ≤ m
  · obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ : ∃ n, m = n + 2 := ⟨m - 2, by omega⟩
    rw [e_def δ (show i ≤ n + 2 by omega), e_def δ hj, End.mul_def, End.mul_def]
    simp only [Category.assoc]
    rw [cap_cup_interchange_assoc δ hij hj, cap_cap_interchange_assoc δ hij hj,
      cup_cup_interchange δ hij hj, cup_cap_interchange_assoc δ hij hj]
  · simp [e, hj]

name: StringDiagrams.TemperleyLieb.e_mul_e_comm_of_far
statement:
theorem e_mul_e_comm_of_far {m i j : ℕ} (h : i + 2 ≤ j ∨ j + 2 ≤ i) :
    e δ m i * e δ m j = e δ m j * e δ m i
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with h | h
  · exact e_mul_e_comm δ h
  · exact (e_mul_e_comm δ h).symm

name: StringDiagrams.FreeDots.mulX_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem mulX_apply (i : ℕ) (f : MvPolynomial ℕ R) : mulX R i f = X i * f

name: StringDiagrams.FreeDots.polyLocal_respects
statement: theorem polyLocal_respects : (pres R).Respects (polyLocal R).functor
proof:
:=
  (polyLocal R).respects_of _ (fun r => r.elim) fun x hx u v _ =>
    (polyLocal R).evalW_interchange_eq_zero_of_comm (fun s l m r g g' => by
      have hs : (((⟨s, g, m, g'⟩ : InterchangeData sig).sign : ℤ) : R) = 1 := by
        simp [InterchangeData.sign, sig]
      have hc : (sig.cod g).length = (sig.dom g).length := rfl
      rw [hs, one_smul]
      refine LinearMap.ext fun f => ?_
      simp only [polyLocal, uniform_op, layerOp, LinearMap.comp_apply, mulX_apply,
        List.length_append, hc]
      ring) x hx u v

name: StringDiagrams.FreeDots.polyRep_obj
statement:
@[simp] theorem polyRep_obj (n : ℕ) :
    (polyRep R).obj (FD.obj R n) = ModuleCat.of R (MvPolynomial ℕ R)

name: StringDiagrams.FreeDots.polyRep_map_diag
statement:
@[simp] theorem polyRep_map_diag {a b : Obj sig} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (polyRep R).map ((pres R).diag f) = (polyLocal R).functor.map f

name: StringDiagrams.FreeDots.polyRep_map_x
statement:
theorem polyRep_map_x {n i : ℕ} (h : i < n) :
    (polyRep R).map (x R n i) = ModuleCat.ofHom (mulX R i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [x_def R h, polyRep_map_diag]
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  rw [functor_map_hom]
  simp [polyLocal, layerOp, lay]

name: StringDiagrams.FreeDots.polyRep_map_x_one
statement:
theorem polyRep_map_x_one {n i : ℕ} (h : i < n) :
    ((polyRep R).map (x R n i)).hom (1 : MvPolynomial ℕ R) = X i
proof:
:= by
  rw [polyRep_map_x R h, ModuleCat.hom_ofHom]
  exact mul_one (X i : MvPolynomial ℕ R)

name: StringDiagrams.FreeDots.x_ne_zero
statement: theorem x_ne_zero [Nontrivial R] {n i : ℕ} (h : i < n) : x R n i ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h0
  have h1 := polyRep_map_x_one R h
  rw [h0, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_zero, ModuleCat.hom_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply] at h1
  exact MvPolynomial.X_ne_zero i h1.symm

name: StringDiagrams.FreeDots.x_ne_x
statement:
theorem x_ne_x [Nontrivial R] {n i j : ℕ} (hi : i < n) (hj : j < n) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    x R n i ≠ x R n j
proof:
:= by
  intro h0
  have h1 := polyRep_map_x_one R hi
  rw [h0, polyRep_map_x_one R hj] at h1
  exact hij (MvPolynomial.X_injective h1.symm)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.mat_comp_unique
statement:
theorem mat_comp_unique {D : Type*} [Category D] [Preadditive D] {M N K : Mat_ D} [Unique N.ι]
    (f : M ⟶ N) (g : N ⟶ K) (i : M.ι) (l : K.ι) : (f ≫ g) i l = f i default ≫ g default l

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.homD_one
statement:
theorem homD_one (a : ZMod 2) (n : ℕ) (h) : homD (q := q) (a := a) (b := a) (𝟙 (X k δq n)) h =
    𝟙 (genD q a n)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.jwObj_zero_p
statement:
theorem jwObj_zero_p (a : ZMod 2) :
    (jwObj q hq 0 a).p = 𝟙 ((Mat_.embedding (DD q)).obj (genD q a 0))
proof:
:= by
  show (Mat_.embedding (DD q)).map _ = _
  rw [← CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id]
  congr 1

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.unit_eq
statement: theorem unit_eq : 𝟙_ (SKar k (STL k δq)) = jwObj q hq 0 0
proof:
:= by
  refine Karoubi.ext rfl ?_
  rw [jwObj_zero_p, eqToHom_refl, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.one_eq_classJw
statement: theorem one_eq_classJw : (1 : K₀ (SKar k (STL k δq))) = classJw q hq (0, 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [K₀.one_def, classJw, unit_eq q hq]

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.pi_jwObj
statement: theorem pi_jwObj (n : ℕ) : (PiCategory.pi (R := k)).obj (jwObj q hq n 0) = jwObj q hq n 1
proof:
:= by
  refine Karoubi.ext rfl ?_
  rw [eqToHom_refl, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]
  apply Mat_.hom_ext
  rintro ⟨⟩ ⟨⟩
  apply Underlying.hom_ext
  apply Envelope.hom_ext
  erw [Envelope.toHom_pi_map, twist_of_mem (R := k) 1 (jw_mem_parity q n 0)]
  rw [zmod2_add_self, sign_zero, one_smul, show (1 : ZMod 2) * (0 + 0) = 0 from rfl, sign_zero,
    one_smul]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.classJw_one
statement: theorem classJw_one (n : ℕ) : classJw q hq (n, 1) = Zπ.π • classJw q hq (n, 0)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.X_tensor_one
statement:
theorem X_tensor_one (m : ℕ) :
    X k δq m ⊗ X k δq 1 = X k δq (m + 1)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.whiskerRight_eq_wR1
statement:
theorem whiskerRight_eq_wR1 {a b : ℕ} (x : X k δq a ⟶ X k δq b) :
    x ▷ X k δq 1 = eqToHom (X_tensor_one q a) ≫ wR1 k δq x ≫ eqToHom (X_tensor_one q b).symm
proof:
:= by
  rw [wR1]
  simp only [Category.assoc, eqToHom_trans, eqToHom_trans_assoc, eqToHom_refl, Category.comp_id,
    Category.id_comp]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.eqToHom_tensor_mem
statement:
theorem eqToHom_tensor_mem (m : ℕ) :
    (eqToHom (X_tensor_one q m) : X k δq m ⊗ X k δq 1 ⟶ X k δq (m + 1)) ∈
      (pres k δq).homDeg (Presentation.parityDeg sig) ((strands m).tensor (strands 1))
        (strands (m + 1)) 0

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.eqToHom_tensor_mem'
statement:
theorem eqToHom_tensor_mem' (m : ℕ) :
    (eqToHom (X_tensor_one q m).symm : X k δq (m + 1) ⟶ X k δq m ⊗ X k δq 1) ∈
      (pres k δq).homDeg (Presentation.parityDeg sig) (strands (m + 1))
        ((strands m).tensor (strands 1)) 0

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.tensor_p_val
statement:
theorem tensor_p_val (m : ℕ) (x y : PUnit × PUnit) :
    Envelope.toHom ((jwObj q hq m 0 ⊗ jwObj q hq 1 0).p x y).1 =
      eqToHom (X_tensor_one q m) ≫ wR1 k δq (jw q m) ≫ eqToHom (X_tensor_one q m).symm
proof:
:= by
  show Envelope.toHom ((homD (jw q m) (jw_mem_parity q m 0)).1 ⊗ₘ
    (homD (jw q 1) (jw_mem_parity q 1 0)).1) = _
  rw [Envelope.tensorHom_def', Envelope.toHom_comp, Envelope.toHom_whiskerRight_of_par_zero _ _ rfl,
    Envelope.toHom_whiskerLeft_of_par_zero _ rfl]
  simp only [homD_val, jw_one]
  show jw q m ▷ X k δq 1 ≫ X k δq m ◁ 𝟙 (X k δq 1) = _
  erw [MonoidalSupercategory.whiskerLeft_id (R := k), Category.comp_id, whiskerRight_eq_wR1]

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.karoubi_add_f
statement:
theorem karoubi_add_f {C : Type*} [Category C] [Preadditive C] {P Q : Karoubi C} (f g : P ⟶ Q) :
    (f + g).f = f.f + g.f

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.homOut_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem homOut_val {m n : ℕ} {b : ZMod 2} (φ : X k δq (m + 1) ⟶ X k δq n) (hφ) :
    Envelope.toHom (homOut q (b := b) φ hφ).1 = eqToHom (X_tensor_one q m) ≫ φ

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.homIn_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem homIn_val {m n : ℕ} {b : ZMod 2} (ψ : X k δq n ⟶ X k δq (m + 1)) (hψ) :
    Envelope.toHom (homIn q (b := b) ψ hψ).1 = ψ ≫ eqToHom (X_tensor_one q m).symm

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.jwObj_p_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem jwObj_p_val (n : ℕ) (a : ZMod 2) (x y : PUnit) :
    Envelope.toHom ((jwObj q hq n a).p x y).1 = jw q n

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.mor_kIn_kOut
statement:
theorem mor_kIn_kOut {m n n' : ℕ} {b b' : ZMod 2} (ψ : X k δq n ⟶ X k δq (m + 1)) (hψ h1 h2)
    (φ : X k δq (m + 1) ⟶ X k δq n') (hφ h1' h2') :
    mor hq (kIn (q := q) (hq := hq) (b := b) ψ hψ h1 h2 ≫ kOut (b := b') φ hφ h1' h2') = ψ ≫ φ
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mor, Karoubi.comp_f]
  rw [mat_comp_unique]
  simp [kIn, kOut]

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.classJw_mul_one
statement:
theorem classJw_mul_one (N : ℕ) :
    classJw q hq (N + 1, 0) * classJw q hq (1, 0) =
      classJw q hq (N + 2, 0) + Zπ.π • classJw q hq (N, 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [classJw, classJw, K₀.mk_mul_mk, K₀.mk_eq_mk_of_iso (tensorIso q hq N), mk_bsum,
    ← classJw_one]
  simp [classJw]

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.oddCount_eq_length
statement:
theorem oddCount_eq_length {a b : Obj sig} (d : a ⟶ b) :
    Diagram.oddCount d = (Diagram.layers d).length
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Diagram.oddCount, Diagram.oddCountList]
  congr 1
  exact List.filter_eq_self.mpr fun L _ => rfl

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.evW_mem_parity
statement:
theorem evW_mem_parity {a b : ℕ} {u : List Step} (hu : Valid a u) (hb : ht a u = b) :
    evW R δ a u b ∈
      (pres R δ).homDeg (Presentation.parityDeg sig) (strands a) (strands b) (u.length : ZMod 2)
proof:
:= by
  set d : strands a ⟶ strands b := wordDiagram a u hu ≫ eqToHom (congrArg strands hb)
  have hs : steps d = u := by
    rw [← steps_wordDiagram a u hu]
    simp [d, steps, Diagram.layers_comp, Diagram.layers_eqToHom]
  have h := (pres R δ).diag_mem_homDeg (deg := Presentation.parityDeg sig) d
  rw [Diagram.degree_parityDeg, oddCount_eq_length, diag_eq_evW, hs] at h
  have hl : (Diagram.layers d).length = u.length := by rw [← hs]; simp [steps]
  rwa [hl] at h

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.evenSpan_le_parity
statement:
theorem evenSpan_le_parity (a b : ℕ) :
    evenSpan R δ a b ≤
      (pres R δ).homDeg (Presentation.parityDeg sig) (strands a) (strands b) 0
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.span_le.mpr ?_
  rintro _ ⟨u, hu, hb, he, rfl⟩
  have := evW_mem_parity (R := R) (δ := δ) hu hb
  rwa [ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff_even.mpr he] at this

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.cup_mem_parity
statement:
theorem cup_mem_parity {a i : ℕ} (hi : i ≤ a) :
    cup R δ a i ∈
      (pres R δ).homDeg (Presentation.parityDeg sig) (strands a) (strands (a + 2)) 1
proof:
:= by
  have := evW_mem_parity (R := R) (δ := δ) (a := a) (u := [.cup i]) (b := a + 2) ⟨hi, trivial⟩ rfl
  simpa using this

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.cap_mem_parity
statement:
theorem cap_mem_parity {a i : ℕ} (hi : i ≤ a) :
    cap R δ a i ∈
      (pres R δ).homDeg (Presentation.parityDeg sig) (strands (a + 2)) (strands a) 1
proof:
:= by
  have := evW_mem_parity (R := R) (δ := δ) (a := a + 2) (u := [.cap i]) (b := a)
    ⟨by omega, trivial⟩ rfl
  simpa using this

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.wR1_jw_eq
statement: theorem wR1_jw_eq (N : ℕ) : wR1 k δq (jw q (N + 1)) = jw q (N + 2) + gDec q N

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.vDec_comp_uDec
statement: theorem vDec_comp_uDec (N : ℕ) : vDec q N ≫ uDec q N = gDec q N

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.uDec_comp_vDec
statement:
theorem uDec_comp_vDec (hq : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → q ^ n ≠ 1) (N : ℕ) :
    uDec q N ≫ vDec q N = jw q N
proof:
:= by
  have hI : wR1 k δq (jw q (N + 1)) ≫ wR1 k δq (jw q (N + 1)) = wR1 k δq (jw q (N + 1)) := by
    rw [← wR1_comp, jw_idem hq]
  rw [uDec, vDec, Linear.smul_comp, Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc (wR1 k δq _), hI,
    jw_partial_trace hq, smul_smul, neg_mul, mul_neg, neg_neg, jwCoeff]
  rw [div_mul_div_comm, mul_comm (qint q (N + 1)), div_self, one_smul]
  exact mul_ne_zero (qint_ne_zero hq (by omega)) (qint_ne_zero hq (by omega))

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.vDec_comp_jw
statement:
theorem vDec_comp_jw (hq : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → q ^ n ≠ 1) (N : ℕ) :
    vDec q N ≫ jw q N = vDec q N
proof:
:= by
  rw [vDec, Category.assoc, ← wR2_comp_cap_right (jw_mem_evenSpan q N), ← Category.assoc,
    ← wR1_comp, jw_comp_wR1 hq]

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.jw_comp_uDec
statement:
theorem jw_comp_uDec (hq : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → q ^ n ≠ 1) (N : ℕ) :
    jw q N ≫ uDec q N = uDec q N
proof:
:= by
  rw [uDec, Linear.comp_smul, ← Category.assoc, comp_cup_right (jw_mem_evenSpan q N),
    Category.assoc, ← wR1_comp, wR1_comp_jw hq]

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.gDec_idem
statement: theorem gDec_idem (hq : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → q ^ n ≠ 1) (N : ℕ) : gDec q N ≫ gDec q N = gDec q N
proof:
:= by
  rw [← vDec_comp_uDec, Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc (uDec q N), uDec_comp_vDec hq,
    ← Category.assoc, vDec_comp_jw hq]

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.jw_comp_gDec
statement:
theorem jw_comp_gDec (hq : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → q ^ n ≠ 1) (N : ℕ) :
    jw q (N + 2) ≫ gDec q N = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← vDec_comp_uDec, vDec, ← Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc, jw_comp_wR1 hq,
    jw_comp_cap hq le_rfl, Limits.zero_comp]

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.gDec_comp_jw
statement:
theorem gDec_comp_jw (hq : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → q ^ n ≠ 1) (N : ℕ) :
    gDec q N ≫ jw q (N + 2) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← vDec_comp_uDec, Category.assoc, uDec, Linear.smul_comp, Category.assoc, wR1_comp_jw hq,
    cup_comp_jw hq le_rfl, smul_zero, Limits.comp_zero]

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.gDec_comp_vDec
statement:
theorem gDec_comp_vDec (hq : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → q ^ n ≠ 1) (N : ℕ) :
    gDec q N ≫ vDec q N = vDec q N
proof:
:= by
  rw [← vDec_comp_uDec, Category.assoc, uDec_comp_vDec hq, vDec_comp_jw hq]

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.uDec_comp_gDec
statement:
theorem uDec_comp_gDec (hq : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → q ^ n ≠ 1) (N : ℕ) :
    uDec q N ≫ gDec q N = uDec q N
proof:
:= by
  rw [← vDec_comp_uDec, ← Category.assoc, uDec_comp_vDec hq, jw_comp_uDec hq]

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.vDec_mem_parity
statement:
theorem vDec_mem_parity (N : ℕ) :
    vDec q N ∈ (pres k δq).homDeg (Presentation.parityDeg sig) (strands (N + 2)) (strands N) 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := Presentation.comp_mem_homDeg
    (evenSpan_le_parity _ _ (wR1_mem_evenSpan (jw_mem_evenSpan q (N + 1))))
    (cap_mem_parity (R := k) (δ := δq) (le_refl N))
  rwa [zero_add] at h

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.uDec_mem_parity
statement:
theorem uDec_mem_parity (N : ℕ) :
    uDec q N ∈ (pres k δq).homDeg (Presentation.parityDeg sig) (strands N) (strands (N + 2)) 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := Presentation.comp_mem_homDeg (cup_mem_parity (R := k) (δ := δq) (le_refl N))
    (evenSpan_le_parity _ _ (wR1_mem_evenSpan (jw_mem_evenSpan q (N + 1))))
  rw [add_zero] at h
  exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ h

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.gDec_mem_parity
statement:
theorem gDec_mem_parity (N : ℕ) :
    gDec q N ∈ (pres k δq).homDeg (Presentation.parityDeg sig) (strands (N + 2)) (strands (N + 2)) 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← vDec_comp_uDec]
  have := Presentation.comp_mem_homDeg (vDec_mem_parity (q := q) N) (uDec_mem_parity (q := q) N)
  rwa [show (1 : ZMod 2) + 1 = 0 by decide] at this

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.canon_zero
statement: theorem canon_zero (w : List (Fin 2)) : canon R δ 0 w = 𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.canon_succ_succ
statement:
theorem canon_succ_succ (n : ℕ) (w : List (Fin 2)) :
    canon R δ (n + 2) w = canon R δ n (del (firstPair w) w) ≫ cup R δ n (firstPair w)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.rep_add
statement:
theorem rep_add (i j : ℕ) (c : Fin 2) (r : List (Fin 2)) :
    List.replicate (i + j) c ++ r = List.replicate i c ++ (List.replicate j c ++ r)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.ins_rep_add
statement:
theorem ins_rep_add (p k : ℕ) (a b c : Fin 2) (r : List (Fin 2)) :
    ins (p + k) a b (List.replicate p c ++ r) = List.replicate p c ++ ins k a b r
proof:
:= by
  induction p with
  | zero => simp
  | succ p ih =>
    rw [show p + 1 + k = (p + k) + 1 by omega, List.replicate_succ, List.cons_append,
      List.cons_append]
    simp only [TemperleyLieb.Rep.ins, ih]

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.firstPair_ins_le
statement:
theorem firstPair_ins_le {p i : ℕ} (r : List (Fin 2)) (hi : i ≤ p + 1) :
    firstPair (ins i 0 1 (List.replicate p 0 ++ 0 :: 1 :: r)) = i ∧
      del i (ins i 0 1 (List.replicate p 0 ++ 0 :: 1 :: r)) =
        List.replicate p 0 ++ 0 :: 1 :: r
proof:
:= by
  have e : List.replicate p (0 : Fin 2) ++ 0 :: 1 :: r =
      List.replicate i 0 ++ (List.replicate (p + 1 - i) 0 ++ 1 :: r) := by
    rw [← rep_add, show i + (p + 1 - i) = p + 1 by omega, List.replicate_succ',
      List.append_assoc, List.singleton_append]
  refine ⟨?_, del_ins _ _ _ (by simp; omega)⟩
  rw [e, ins_rep]
  exact firstPair_rep i _

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.firstPair_ins_ge
statement:
theorem firstPair_ins_ge {p i : ℕ} (r : List (Fin 2)) (hi : p + 2 ≤ i)
    (hr : i ≤ p + 2 + r.length) :
    firstPair (ins i 0 1 (List.replicate p 0 ++ 0 :: 1 :: r)) = p ∧
      del p (ins i 0 1 (List.replicate p 0 ++ 0 :: 1 :: r)) =
        ins (i - 2) 0 1 (List.replicate p 0 ++ r)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, i = p + 2 + k := ⟨i - p - 2, by omega⟩
  have e1 : ins (p + 2 + k) 0 1 (List.replicate p 0 ++ 0 :: 1 :: r) =
      List.replicate p 0 ++ 0 :: 1 :: ins k 0 1 r := by
    rw [show p + 2 + k = p + (k + 2) by omega, ins_rep_add]
    rfl
  have e2 : ins (p + 2 + k - 2) 0 1 (List.replicate p 0 ++ r) =
      List.replicate p 0 ++ ins k 0 1 r := by
    rw [show p + 2 + k - 2 = p + k by omega, ins_rep_add]
  rw [e1, e2]
  exact ⟨firstPair_rep p _, del_rep p 0 0 1 _⟩

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.canon_comp_cup
statement:
theorem canon_comp_cup (n : ℕ) : ∀ (w : List (Fin 2)), IsDyck w → w.length = n →
    ∀ i ≤ n, PmEq (canon R δ n w ≫ cup R δ n i) (canon R δ (n + 2) (ins i 0 1 w))
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ n ih =>
  intro w hw hl i hi
  rcases eq_or_ne w [] with rfl | hne
  · obtain rfl : n = 0 := by simpa using hl.symm
    obtain rfl : i = 0 := by omega
    rw [canon_succ_succ]
    simp [canon_zero, firstPair, TemperleyLieb.Rep.ins, TemperleyLieb.Rep.del]
    exact PmEq.refl _
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := dyck_decomp hw hne
  generalize hp : firstPair w = p at hr
  have hlr : p + 2 + r.length = n := by rw [← hl, hr]; simp; omega
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ : ∃ n', n = n' + 2 := ⟨p + r.length, by omega⟩
  have hw0 : IsDyck (List.replicate p 0 ++ r) := by
    have := hw.del_pair (p := p) (by omega) (by rw [hr]; simp)
      (by rw [hr]; simp)
    rwa [hr, del_rep] at this
  have hc : canon R δ (n + 2) w = canon R δ n (List.replicate p 0 ++ r) ≫ cup R δ n p := by
    rw [canon_succ_succ, hp]
    conv_lhs => rw [hr, del_rep]
  by_cases hip : i ≤ p + 1
  · obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := firstPair_ins_le (p := p) (i := i) r hip
    rw [← hr] at h1 h2
    rw [canon_succ_succ (n + 2), h1, h2]
    exact PmEq.refl _
  · obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := firstPair_ins_ge (p := p) (i := i) r (by omega) (by omega)
    rw [← hr] at h1 h2
    rw [canon_succ_succ (n + 2), h1, h2, hc, Category.assoc,
      show cup R δ n p ≫ cup R δ (n + 2) i = -(cup R δ n (i - 2) ≫ cup R δ (n + 2) p) from
        (by rw [cup_cup (by omega) (by omega), neg_neg]),
      Preadditive.comp_neg, ← Category.assoc]
    exact ((ih n (by omega) (List.replicate p 0 ++ r) hw0 (by simp; omega) (i - 2)
      (by omega)).comp_right _).neg_left

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.canon_comp_cap
statement:
theorem canon_comp_cap (n : ℕ) : ∀ (w : List (Fin 2)), IsDyck w → w.length = n + 2 →
    ∀ i ≤ n, IsDyck (capT i w) ∧
      PmEq (canon R δ (n + 2) w ≫ cap R δ n i)
        (δ ^ loopPow (loopT i w) • canon R δ n (capT i w))
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ n ih =>
  intro w hw hl i hi
  have hne : w ≠ [] := by rintro rfl; simp at hl
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := dyck_decomp hw hne
  generalize hp : firstPair w = p at hr
  have hlr : p + r.length = n := by rw [hr] at hl; simp at hl; omega
  have hw0 : IsDyck (List.replicate p 0 ++ r) := by
    have := hw.del_pair (p := p) (by omega) (by rw [hr]; simp)
      (by rw [hr]; simp)
    rwa [hr, del_rep] at this
  have hl0 : (List.replicate p (0 : Fin 2) ++ r).length = n := by simp; omega
  have hc : canon R δ (n + 2) w = canon R δ n (List.replicate p 0 ++ r) ≫ cup R δ n p := by
    rw [canon_succ_succ, hp]
    conv_lhs => rw [hr, del_rep]
  have hins : w = ins p 0 1 (List.replicate p 0 ++ r) := by
    rw [hr, ins_rep]
  rw [hc]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rcases lt_trichotomy i p with hlt | rfl | hgt
  · rcases Nat.lt_or_ge (i + 1) p with hlt' | hge
    · 
      obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ : ∃ n', n = n' + 2 := ⟨n - 2, by omega⟩
      rw [cap_cup (by omega) (by omega), Preadditive.comp_neg, ← Category.assoc]
      obtain ⟨hd, h1⟩ := ih n (by omega) _ hw0 hl0 i (by omega)
      have h2 := canon_comp_cup (R := R) (δ := δ) n _ hd
        (by have := length_capT (i := i) (w := List.replicate p 0 ++ r) (by omega); omega)
        (p - 2) (by omega)
      obtain ⟨e1, e2⟩ := capT_ins_right hw0 (i := i) (p := p) (by omega) (by omega)
      rw [← hins] at e1 e2
      refine ⟨by rw [e1]; exact hd.ins_pair (by
        have := length_capT (i := i) (w := List.replicate p 0 ++ r) (by omega); omega), ?_⟩
      rw [e1, e2]
      refine PmEq.neg_left ?_
      refine (h1.comp_right _).trans ?_
      rw [Linear.smul_comp]
      exact h2.smul _
    · 
      obtain rfl : p = i + 1 := by omega
      rw [zigzagA_at (by omega), Category.comp_id]
      have e := capT_rep_pred i r
      rw [← hr] at e
      rw [e.1, e.2]
      refine ⟨hw0, ?_⟩
      simp only [loopPow, Bool.false_eq_true, ite_false, pow_zero, one_smul]
      exact PmEq.refl _
  · 
    rw [loop_at hi, Linear.comp_smul, Category.comp_id]
    have e := capT_rep_self i r
    rw [← hr] at e
    rw [e.1, e.2]
    refine ⟨hw0, ?_⟩
    simp only [loopPow, ite_true, pow_one]
    exact PmEq.refl _
  · rcases Nat.lt_or_ge (p + 1) i with hgt' | hle
    · 
      obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ : ∃ n', n = n' + 2 := ⟨n - 2, by omega⟩
      rw [cup_cap (by omega) (by omega), Preadditive.comp_neg, ← Category.assoc]
      obtain ⟨hd, h1⟩ := ih n (by omega) _ hw0 hl0 (i - 2) (by omega)
      have h2 := canon_comp_cup (R := R) (δ := δ) n _ hd
        (by have := length_capT (i := i - 2) (w := List.replicate p 0 ++ r) (by omega); omega)
        p (by omega)
      obtain ⟨e1, e2⟩ := capT_ins_left hw0 (i := i - 2) (p := p) (by omega) (by omega)
      rw [show i - 2 + 2 = i by omega, ← hins] at e1 e2
      refine ⟨by rw [e1]; exact hd.ins_pair (by
        have := length_capT (i := i - 2) (w := List.replicate p 0 ++ r) (by omega); omega), ?_⟩
      rw [e1, e2]
      refine PmEq.neg_left ?_
      refine (h1.comp_right _).trans ?_
      rw [Linear.smul_comp]
      exact h2.smul _
    · 
      obtain rfl : i = p + 1 := by omega
      obtain ⟨c, r, rfl⟩ : ∃ c r', r = c :: r' := by
        rcases r with _ | ⟨c, r'⟩
        · simp at hlr; omega
        · exact ⟨c, r', rfl⟩
      rw [zigzagB_at hi, Preadditive.comp_neg, Category.comp_id]
      have e := capT_rep_succ p c r
      rw [← hr] at e
      rw [e.1, e.2]
      refine ⟨hw0, ?_⟩
      simp only [loopPow, Bool.false_eq_true, ite_false, pow_zero, one_smul]
      exact (PmEq.refl _).neg_left

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.trackW_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem trackW_nil (w : List (Fin 2)) : trackW w [] = (w, 0)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.trackW_cup
statement:
@[simp] theorem trackW_cup (w : List (Fin 2)) (i : ℕ) (u : List Step) :
    trackW w (.cup i :: u) = trackW (ins i 0 1 w) u

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.trackW_cap
statement:
@[simp] theorem trackW_cap (w : List (Fin 2)) (i : ℕ) (u : List Step) :
    trackW w (.cap i :: u) =
      ((trackW (capT i w) u).1, (trackW (capT i w) u).2 + loopPow (loopT i w))

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.trackW_append
statement:
theorem trackW_append (w : List (Fin 2)) (u v : List Step) :
    trackW w (u ++ v) = ((trackW (trackW w u).1 v).1, (trackW (trackW w u).1 v).2 + (trackW w u).2)
proof:
:= by
  induction u generalizing w with
  | nil => simp
  | cons s u ih => cases s <;> simp [ih, add_assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.canon_comp_evW
statement:
theorem canon_comp_evW (u : List Step) : ∀ (k : ℕ) (w : List (Fin 2)), IsDyck w → w.length = k →
    Valid k u → IsDyck (trackW w u).1 ∧ (trackW w u).1.length = ht k u ∧
      PmEq (canon R δ k w ≫ evW R δ k u (ht k u))
        (δ ^ (trackW w u).2 • canon R δ (ht k u) (trackW w u).1)
proof:
:= by
  induction u with
  | nil =>
    intro k w hw hl _
    refine ⟨hw, hl, ?_⟩
    simp only [ht_nil, evW_nil_self, Category.comp_id, trackW_nil, pow_zero, one_smul]
    exact PmEq.refl _
  | cons s u ih => cases s with
    | cup i =>
      intro k w hw hl hu
      obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := ih (k + 2) (ins i 0 1 w) (hw.ins_pair (by rw [hl]; exact hu.1))
        (by simp [hl]) hu.2
      refine ⟨h1, h2, ?_⟩
      simp only [ht_cup, evW_cup, trackW_cup]
      rw [← Category.assoc]
      exact ((canon_comp_cup k w hw hl i hu.1).comp_right _).trans h3
    | cap i =>
      intro k w hw hl hu
      obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k', k = k' + 2 := ⟨k - 2, by have := hu.1; omega⟩
      obtain ⟨hd, hc⟩ := canon_comp_cap (R := R) (δ := δ) k w hw hl i (by have := hu.1; omega)
      obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := ih k (capT i w) hd
        (by have := length_capT (i := i) (w := w) (by have := hu.1; omega); omega) hu.2
      refine ⟨h1, h2, ?_⟩
      simp only [ht_cap, evW_cap, trackW_cap]
      rw [← Category.assoc]
      refine (hc.comp_right _).trans ?_
      rw [Linear.smul_comp, pow_add, mul_comm, mul_smul]
      exact h3.smul _

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.span_canon
statement:
theorem span_canon (N : ℕ) :
    Submodule.span R (Set.range fun w : DyckSeq N => canon R δ N w.1) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [Submodule.eq_top_iff']
  intro f
  induction f using hom_induction_evW with
  | word u hu hN =>
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := canon_comp_evW (R := R) (δ := δ) u 0 [] isDyck_nil rfl hu
    rw [canon_zero, Category.id_comp, hN] at h3
    rw [hN] at h2
    have hmem : canon R δ N (trackW [] u).1 ∈
        Submodule.span R (Set.range fun w : DyckSeq N => canon R δ N w.1) :=
      Submodule.subset_span ⟨⟨_, h1, h2⟩, rfl⟩
    rcases h3 with h | h <;> rw [h]
    · exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hmem
    · exact Submodule.neg_mem _ (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hmem)
  | zero => exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  | add f g hf hg => exact Submodule.add_mem _ hf hg
  | smul r f hf => exact Submodule.smul_mem _ r hf

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.brk_two
statement: theorem brk_two : brk 2 = T 1 + πL * T (-1)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.mul_brk_two_apply
statement:
theorem mul_brk_two_apply (f : LZ) (i : ℤ) :
    (f * brk 2).coeff i = f.coeff (i - 1) + f.coeff (i + 1) * Zπ.π
proof:
:= by
  rw [brk_two, mul_add, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_add, Finsupp.add_apply, ← single_eq_C_mul_T,
    LaurentPolynomial.T, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_mul_single_apply,
    AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_mul_single_apply, mul_one, neg_neg, ← sub_eq_add_neg]

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.brk_two_pow_apply
statement:
theorem brk_two_pow_apply (j : ℕ) :
    (brk 2 ^ j).coeff j = 1 ∧ ∀ i : ℤ, (j : ℤ) < i → (brk 2 ^ j).coeff i = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction j with
  | zero =>
    refine ⟨?_, fun i hi => ?_⟩
    · rw [pow_zero, ← LaurentPolynomial.T_zero, LaurentPolynomial.T_apply, ite_eq_left (by simp)]
    · rw [pow_zero, ← LaurentPolynomial.T_zero, LaurentPolynomial.T_apply,
        ite_eq_right (by omega)]
  | succ j ih =>
    refine ⟨?_, fun i hi => ?_⟩
    · rw [pow_succ (brk 2) j, mul_brk_two_apply]
      push_cast
      rw [add_sub_cancel_right, ih.1, ih.2 _ (by omega)]; simp
    · rw [pow_succ (brk 2) j, mul_brk_two_apply, ih.2 _ (by omega), ih.2 _ (by omega)]; simp

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.aeval_brk_two_injective
statement: theorem aeval_brk_two_injective : Function.Injective (Polynomial.aeval (R := Zπ) (brk 2))
proof:
:= by
  rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
  intro p hp
  by_contra hne
  have h := congrArg (fun f : LZ => f.coeff (p.natDegree : ℤ)) hp
  simp only [Polynomial.aeval_eq_sum_range] at h
  rw [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_sum, Finset.sum_apply', Finset.sum_eq_single p.natDegree] at h
  · rw [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_smul, Finsupp.smul_apply, (brk_two_pow_apply _).1, smul_eq_mul,
      mul_one] at h
    exact hne (Polynomial.leadingCoeff_eq_zero.mp h)
  · intro i hi hne'
    rw [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_smul, Finsupp.smul_apply,
      (brk_two_pow_apply i).2 _ (by simp at hi; omega), smul_zero]
  · simp

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.πL_mem_range
statement: theorem πL_mem_range : πL ∈ (Polynomial.aeval (R := Zπ) (brk 2)).range

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.brk_mem_range
statement: theorem brk_mem_range (n : ℕ) : brk n ∈ (Polynomial.aeval (R := Zπ) (brk 2)).range
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ n ih =>
    match n with
    | 0 => rw [show brk 0 = 0 from qbracket_zero ..]; exact Subalgebra.zero_mem _
    | 1 => rw [show brk 1 = 1 from qbracket_one ..]; exact Subalgebra.one_mem _
    | n + 2 =>
      have e : brk (n + 2) = brk (n + 1) * brk 2 - πL * brk n := by
        linear_combination -(qbracket_succ_mul_two xU πL n)
      rw [e]
      exact Subalgebra.sub_mem _ (Subalgebra.mul_mem _ (ih _ (by omega)) ⟨Polynomial.X, by simp⟩)
        (Subalgebra.mul_mem _ πL_mem_range (ih _ (by omega)))

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.genL_mem_range
statement: theorem genL_mem_range (x : ℕ × ZMod 2) : genL x ∈ (Polynomial.aeval (R := Zπ) (brk 2)).range

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.algebraMap_eq
statement:
theorem algebraMap_eq (c : Zπ) :
    algebraMap Zπ (K₀ (SKar k (STL k δq))) c = c • (1 : K₀ (SKar k (STL k δq)))

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.K₀ToLZ_algebraMap
statement:
theorem K₀ToLZ_algebraMap (c : Zπ) :
    K₀ToLZ q hq (algebraMap Zπ (K₀ (SKar k (STL k δq))) c) = C c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, rfl⟩ := Zπ.exists_eq_add_mul_π c
  have hπ : K₀ToLZ q hq (algebraMap Zπ (K₀ (SKar k (STL k δq))) Zπ.π) = πL := by
    rw [algebraMap_eq]
    change K₀ToLZlin q hq (Zπ.π • 1) = _
    rw [K₀ToLZlin_π_smul]
    change πL * K₀ToLZ q hq 1 = _
    rw [map_one, mul_one]
  simp only [map_add, map_mul, map_intCast, hπ]

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.range_aeval_brk_two
statement:
theorem range_aeval_brk_two :
    (K₀ToLZ q hq).range = (Polynomial.aeval (R := Zπ) (brk 2)).range.toSubring
proof:
:= by
  ext f
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩
    change K₀ToLZ q hq x ∈ (Polynomial.aeval (R := Zπ) (brk 2)).range
    have hx : x ∈ Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range (classJw q hq)) := by
      rw [span_classJw]; trivial
    induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem y hy =>
      obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hy
      rw [K₀ToLZ_classJw]; exact genL_mem_range z
    | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact Subalgebra.zero_mem _
    | add y z _ _ hy hz => rw [map_add]; exact Subalgebra.add_mem _ hy hz
    | smul a y _ hy => rw [map_zsmul]; exact Subalgebra.zsmul_mem _ hy a
  · rintro ⟨p, rfl⟩
    show Polynomial.aeval (R := Zπ) (brk 2) p ∈ (K₀ToLZ q hq).range
    induction p using Polynomial.induction_on with
    | C c => exact ⟨algebraMap Zπ _ c, by rw [K₀ToLZ_algebraMap, Polynomial.aeval_C,
        LaurentPolynomial.C_eq_algebraMap]⟩
    | add p p' hp hp' => rw [map_add]; exact Subring.add_mem _ hp hp'
    | monomial n c _ =>
      rw [map_mul, map_pow, Polynomial.aeval_X, Polynomial.aeval_C]
      refine Subring.mul_mem _ (RingHom.mem_range.mpr ⟨algebraMap Zπ _ c, ?_⟩)
        (Subring.pow_mem _ (RingHom.mem_range.mpr ⟨classJw q hq (1, 0), ?_⟩) _)
      · rw [K₀ToLZ_algebraMap, LaurentPolynomial.C_eq_algebraMap]
      · rw [K₀ToLZ_classJw]; simp [genL]

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.aeval_K₀PolyRing
statement:
theorem aeval_K₀PolyRing (x : K₀ (SKar k (STL k δq))) :
    Polynomial.aeval (brk 2) (K₀PolyRing q hq x) = K₀ToLZ q hq x
proof:
:= by
  let e3 := AlgEquiv.ofInjective (Polynomial.aeval (R := Zπ) (brk 2)) aeval_brk_two_injective
  let y : (Polynomial.aeval (R := Zπ) (brk 2)).range :=
    (RingEquiv.subringCongr (range_aeval_brk_two q hq)) ((K₀ToLZ q hq).rangeRestrict x)
  change Polynomial.aeval (brk 2) (e3.symm y) = _
  rw [← AlgEquiv.ofInjective_apply _ aeval_brk_two_injective]
  change ((e3 (e3.symm y) : (Polynomial.aeval (R := Zπ) (brk 2)).range) : LZ) = _
  rw [AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.K₀Poly_apply
statement: theorem K₀Poly_apply (x : K₀ (SKar k (STL k δq))) : K₀Poly q hq x = K₀PolyRing q hq x

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.K₀Poly_classJw_one_zero
statement: theorem K₀Poly_classJw_one_zero : K₀Poly q hq (classJw q hq (1, 0)) = Polynomial.X
proof:
:= by
  apply aeval_brk_two_injective
  rw [K₀Poly_apply, aeval_K₀PolyRing, K₀ToLZ_classJw, Polynomial.aeval_X]
  simp [genL]

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.K₀ToLZ_classJw_one_zero
statement: theorem K₀ToLZ_classJw_one_zero : K₀ToLZ q hq (classJw q hq (1, 0)) = brk 2

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.PmEq.refl
statement: theorem refl (x : M) : PmEq x x

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.PmEq.of_eq
statement: theorem of_eq (h : x = y) : PmEq x y

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.PmEq.of_eq_neg
statement: theorem of_eq_neg (h : x = -y) : PmEq x y

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.PmEq.symm
statement: theorem symm (h : PmEq x y) : PmEq y x
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with h | h
  · exact Or.inl h.symm
  · exact Or.inr (by rw [h, neg_neg])

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.PmEq.trans
statement: theorem trans (h₁ : PmEq x y) (h₂ : PmEq y z) : PmEq x z
proof:
:= by
  rcases h₁ with h₁ | h₁ <;> rcases h₂ with h₂ | h₂ <;> subst h₁ h₂
  · exact Or.inl rfl
  · exact Or.inr rfl
  · exact Or.inr rfl
  · exact Or.inl (neg_neg _)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.PmEq.neg_left
statement: theorem neg_left (h : PmEq x y) : PmEq (-x) y
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with h | h <;> subst h
  · exact Or.inr rfl
  · exact Or.inl (neg_neg _)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.PmEq.neg_right
statement: theorem neg_right (h : PmEq x y) : PmEq x (-y)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.PmEq.map
statement: theorem map {N : Type*} [AddCommGroup N] (f : M →+ N) (h : PmEq x y) : PmEq (f x) (f y)
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with h | h <;> subst h
  · exact Or.inl rfl
  · exact Or.inr (map_neg f _)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.PmEq.smul
statement: theorem smul {R : Type*} [Ring R] [Module R M] (r : R) (h : PmEq x y) : PmEq (r • x) (r • y)
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with h | h <;> subst h
  · exact Or.inl rfl
  · exact Or.inr (smul_neg r _)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.PmEq.zero_iff
statement: theorem zero_iff (h : PmEq x y) : x = 0 ↔ y = 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with h | h <;> subst h <;> simp

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.PmEq.comp_right
statement: theorem PmEq.comp_right {x y : A ⟶ B} (h : PmEq x y) (f : B ⟶ D) : PmEq (x ≫ f) (y ≫ f)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.PmEq.comp_left
statement: theorem PmEq.comp_left {x y : B ⟶ D} (h : PmEq x y) (f : A ⟶ B) : PmEq (f ≫ x) (f ≫ y)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.shiftW_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem shiftW_nil (m : ℕ) : shiftW m [] = []

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.shiftW_cons
statement:
@[simp] theorem shiftW_cons (m : ℕ) (s : Step) (u : List Step) :
    shiftW m (s :: u) = s.shift m :: shiftW m u

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.shiftW_append
statement:
@[simp] theorem shiftW_append (m : ℕ) (u v : List Step) :
    shiftW m (u ++ v) = shiftW m u ++ shiftW m v

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.Step.shift_cup
statement: @[simp] theorem Step.shift_cup (m i : ℕ) : (Step.cup i).shift m = .cup (m + i)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.Step.shift_cap
statement: @[simp] theorem Step.shift_cap (m i : ℕ) : (Step.cap i).shift m = .cap (m + i)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.shiftW_zero
statement: theorem shiftW_zero (u : List Step) : shiftW 0 u = u
proof:
:= by
  induction u with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons s u ih => cases s <;> simp [ih]

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.shiftW_shiftW
statement: theorem shiftW_shiftW (m n : ℕ) (u : List Step) : shiftW m (shiftW n u) = shiftW (m + n) u
proof:
:= by
  induction u with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons s u ih => cases s <;> simp [ih, add_assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.ht_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem ht_nil (a : ℕ) : ht a [] = a

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.ht_cup
statement: @[simp] theorem ht_cup (a i : ℕ) (u : List Step) : ht a (.cup i :: u) = ht (a + 2) u

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.ht_cap
statement: @[simp] theorem ht_cap (a i : ℕ) (u : List Step) : ht a (.cap i :: u) = ht (a - 2) u

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.valid_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem valid_nil (a : ℕ) : Valid a []

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.valid_cup
statement:
@[simp] theorem valid_cup (a i : ℕ) (u : List Step) :
    Valid a (.cup i :: u) ↔ i ≤ a ∧ Valid (a + 2) u

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.valid_cap
statement:
@[simp] theorem valid_cap (a i : ℕ) (u : List Step) :
    Valid a (.cap i :: u) ↔ i + 2 ≤ a ∧ Valid (a - 2) u

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.ht_append
statement: theorem ht_append (a : ℕ) (u v : List Step) : ht a (u ++ v) = ht (ht a u) v
proof:
:= by
  induction u generalizing a with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons s u ih => cases s <;> simp [ih]

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.valid_append
statement:
theorem valid_append {a : ℕ} {u v : List Step} :
    Valid a (u ++ v) ↔ Valid a u ∧ Valid (ht a u) v
proof:
:= by
  induction u generalizing a with
  | nil => simp
  | cons s u ih => cases s <;> simp [ih, and_assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.ht_shiftW
statement: theorem ht_shiftW (m a : ℕ) {u : List Step} (hu : Valid a u) : ht (m + a) (shiftW m u) = m + ht a u
proof:
:= by
  induction u generalizing a with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons s u ih => cases s with
    | cup i => simp only [shiftW_cons, Step.shift_cup, ht_cup]; exact ih (a + 2) hu.2
    | cap i =>
      simp only [shiftW_cons, Step.shift_cap, ht_cap]
      rw [show m + a - 2 = m + (a - 2) by have := hu.1; omega]; exact ih (a - 2) hu.2

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.valid_shiftW
statement: theorem valid_shiftW (m a : ℕ) {u : List Step} (hu : Valid a u) : Valid (m + a) (shiftW m u)
proof:
:= by
  induction u generalizing a with
  | nil => trivial
  | cons s u ih => cases s with
    | cup i => exact ⟨by have := hu.1; omega, ih (a + 2) hu.2⟩
    | cap i =>
      refine ⟨by have := hu.1; omega, ?_⟩
      rw [show m + a - 2 = m + (a - 2) by have := hu.1; omega]; exact ih (a - 2) hu.2

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.evW_nil_self
statement: @[simp] theorem evW_nil_self (a : ℕ) : evW R δ a [] a = 𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.evW_nil_of_ne
statement: theorem evW_nil_of_ne {a b : ℕ} (h : a ≠ b) : evW R δ a [] b = 0

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.evW_cup
statement:
@[simp] theorem evW_cup (a i : ℕ) (u : List Step) (b : ℕ) :
    evW R δ a (.cup i :: u) b = cup R δ a i ≫ evW R δ (a + 2) u b

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.evW_cap
statement:
@[simp] theorem evW_cap (a i : ℕ) (u : List Step) (b : ℕ) :
    evW R δ (a + 2) (.cap i :: u) b = cap R δ a i ≫ evW R δ a u b

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.evW_cap_of_lt
statement:
theorem evW_cap_of_lt {a : ℕ} (ha : a < 2) (i : ℕ) (u : List Step) (b : ℕ) :
    evW R δ a (.cap i :: u) b = 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases a with _ | _ | a
  · rw [evW]; intros; omega
  · rw [evW]; intros; omega
  · omega

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.evW_append
statement:
theorem evW_append (a : ℕ) (u v : List Step) {b : ℕ} (hb : ht a u = b) (c : ℕ) :
    evW R δ a (u ++ v) c = evW R δ a u b ≫ evW R δ b v c
proof:
:= by
  subst hb
  induction u generalizing a with
  | nil => simp
  | cons s u ih => cases s with
    | cup i => simp [ih]
    | cap i =>
      match a with
      | 0 => simp [evW_cap_of_lt]
      | 1 => simp [evW_cap_of_lt]
      | a + 2 => simp [ih]; rfl

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.PmEq.append_right
statement:
theorem PmEq.append_right {a : ℕ} {u u' : List Step} {b : ℕ} (hu : ht a u = b) (hu' : ht a u' = b)
    (h : PmEq (evW R δ a u b) (evW R δ a u' b)) (v : List Step) (c : ℕ) :
    PmEq (evW R δ a (u ++ v) c) (evW R δ a (u' ++ v) c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [evW_append a u v hu, evW_append a u' v hu']
  exact h.comp_right _

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.PmEq.evW_prefix
proof:
:= by
  rw [evW_append a w v hb, evW_append a w v' hb]
  exact h.comp_left _

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.PmEq.evW_cons_cup
StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.PmEq.evW_cons_cap
StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.evW_zigzagA
statement:
theorem evW_zigzagA {W i : ℕ} (h : i + 1 ≤ W) (v : List Step) (c : ℕ) :
    evW R δ W (.cup (i + 1) :: .cap i :: v) c = evW R δ W v c
proof:
:= by
  rw [evW_cup, evW_cap, ← Category.assoc, zigzagA_at h, Category.id_comp]

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.evW_zigzagB
statement:
theorem evW_zigzagB {W i : ℕ} (h : i + 1 ≤ W) (v : List Step) (c : ℕ) :
    evW R δ W (.cup i :: .cap (i + 1) :: v) c = -evW R δ W v c
proof:
:= by
  rw [evW_cup, evW_cap, ← Category.assoc, zigzagB_at h, Preadditive.neg_comp, Category.id_comp]

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.evW_loop
statement:
theorem evW_loop {W i : ℕ} (h : i ≤ W) (v : List Step) (c : ℕ) :
    evW R δ W (.cup i :: .cap i :: v) c = δ • evW R δ W v c
proof:
:= by
  rw [evW_cup, evW_cap, ← Category.assoc, loop_at h, Linear.smul_comp, Category.id_comp]

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.evW_cup_cup
statement:
theorem evW_cup_cup {W i j : ℕ} (hij : i + 2 ≤ j) (hj : j ≤ W + 2) (v : List Step) (c : ℕ) :
    evW R δ W (.cup i :: .cup j :: v) c = -evW R δ W (.cup (j - 2) :: .cup i :: v) c
proof:
:= by
  simp only [evW_cup, ← Category.assoc]
  rw [cup_cup hij hj, Preadditive.neg_comp, neg_neg]

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.evW_cap_cap
statement:
theorem evW_cap_cap {W i j : ℕ} (hij : i + 2 ≤ j) (hj : j + 2 ≤ W) (v : List Step) (c : ℕ) :
    evW R δ W (.cap j :: .cap i :: v) c = -evW R δ W (.cap i :: .cap (j - 2) :: v) c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ : ∃ n, W = n + 2 + 2 := ⟨W - 4, by omega⟩
  simp only [evW_cap, ← Category.assoc]
  rw [cap_cap hij (by omega), Preadditive.neg_comp]

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.evW_cup_cap
statement:
theorem evW_cup_cap {W i j : ℕ} (hij : i + 2 ≤ j) (hj : j ≤ W) (hi : i ≤ W) (v : List Step) (c : ℕ) :
    evW R δ W (.cup i :: .cap j :: v) c = -evW R δ W (.cap (j - 2) :: .cup i :: v) c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ : ∃ n, W = n + 2 := ⟨W - 2, by omega⟩
  simp only [evW_cup, evW_cap, ← Category.assoc]
  rw [cup_cap hij hj, Preadditive.neg_comp]

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.evW_cap_cup
statement:
theorem evW_cap_cup {W i j : ℕ} (hij : i + 2 ≤ j) (hj : j ≤ W) (v : List Step) (c : ℕ) :
    evW R δ W (.cup j :: .cap i :: v) c = -evW R δ W (.cap i :: .cup (j - 2) :: v) c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ : ∃ n, W = n + 2 := ⟨W - 2, by omega⟩
  simp only [evW_cup, evW_cap, ← Category.assoc]
  rw [cap_cup hij hj, Preadditive.neg_comp]

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.evW_farCap
statement:
theorem evW_farCap (u : List Step) {A : ℕ} (hu : Valid A u) {i j W : ℕ} (hij : i + 2 ≤ j)
    (hW : W = j + A) (v : List Step) (c : ℕ) :
    PmEq (evW R δ W (shiftW j u ++ .cap i :: v) c)
      (evW R δ W (.cap i :: (shiftW (j - 2) u ++ v)) c)
proof:
:= by
  induction u generalizing A W with
  | nil => exact PmEq.refl _
  | cons s u ih => cases s with
    | cup k =>
      obtain ⟨hk, hu⟩ := hu
      simp only [shiftW_cons, Step.shift_cup, List.cons_append]
      refine (PmEq.evW_cons_cup (ih hu (W := W + 2) (by omega))).trans ?_
      rw [evW_cap_cup (by omega) (by omega), show j + k - 2 = j - 2 + k by omega]
      exact (PmEq.refl _).neg_left
    | cap k =>
      obtain ⟨hk, hu⟩ := hu
      obtain ⟨W, rfl⟩ : ∃ W', W = W' + 2 := ⟨W - 2, by omega⟩
      simp only [shiftW_cons, Step.shift_cap, List.cons_append]
      refine (PmEq.evW_cons_cap (ih hu (W := W) (by omega))).trans ?_
      rw [evW_cap_cap (by omega) (by omega), show j + k - 2 = j - 2 + k by omega]
      exact (PmEq.refl _).neg_left

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.valid_nestW
statement: theorem valid_nestW (m A : ℕ) : Valid A (nestW m)
proof:
:= by
  induction m generalizing A with
  | zero => trivial
  | succ m ih =>
    refine ⟨Nat.zero_le _, ?_⟩
    have := valid_shiftW 1 (A + 1) (ih (A + 1))
    rwa [show 1 + (A + 1) = A + 2 by omega] at this

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.ht_nestW
statement: theorem ht_nestW (m A : ℕ) : ht A (nestW m) = A + (m + m)
proof:
:= by
  induction m generalizing A with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ m ih =>
    simp only [nestW, ht_cup]
    rw [show A + 2 = 1 + (A + 1) by omega, ht_shiftW 1 (A + 1) (valid_nestW m _), ih]
    omega

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.valid_capsW
statement: theorem valid_capsW (m A : ℕ) (h : m + m ≤ A) : Valid A (capsW m)
proof:
:= by
  induction m generalizing A with
  | zero => trivial
  | succ m ih => exact ⟨by omega, ih _ (by omega)⟩

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.ht_capsW
statement: theorem ht_capsW (m A : ℕ) : ht A (capsW m) = A - (m + m)
proof:
:= by
  induction m generalizing A with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ m ih => simp only [capsW, ht_cap, ih]; omega

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.evW_farCaps
statement:
theorem evW_farCaps (m : ℕ) (u : List Step) {A : ℕ} (hu : Valid A u) {W : ℕ}
    (hW : W = m + m + A) (v : List Step) (c : ℕ) :
    PmEq (evW R δ W (shiftW (m + m) u ++ capsW m ++ v) c)
      (evW R δ W (capsW m ++ u ++ v) c)
proof:
:= by
  induction m generalizing W with
  | zero =>
    simp only [add_zero, shiftW_zero, capsW, List.append_nil, List.nil_append]
    exact PmEq.refl _
  | succ m ih =>
    obtain ⟨W, rfl⟩ : ∃ W', W = W' + 2 := ⟨m + m + A, by omega⟩
    simp only [capsW, List.append_assoc, List.cons_append]
    refine (evW_farCap u hu (i := m) (j := m + 1 + (m + 1)) (by omega) (by omega) _ c).trans ?_
    refine PmEq.evW_cons_cap ?_
    rw [show m + 1 + (m + 1) - 2 = m + m by omega, ← List.append_assoc]
    have := ih (W := W) (by omega)
    simpa only [List.append_assoc] using this

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.evW_snake
statement:
theorem evW_snake (m : ℕ) {r W : ℕ} (hW : W = m + r) (v : List Step) (c : ℕ) :
    PmEq (evW R δ W (shiftW m (nestW m) ++ capsW m ++ v) c) (evW R δ W v c)
proof:
:= by
  induction m generalizing r W with
  | zero => simp only [nestW, shiftW_nil, capsW, List.nil_append]; exact PmEq.refl _
  | succ m ih =>
    simp only [nestW, shiftW_cons, Step.shift_cup, add_zero, shiftW_shiftW, capsW,
      List.cons_append, List.append_assoc]
    refine (PmEq.evW_cons_cup (evW_farCap (nestW m) (valid_nestW m (1 + r)) (i := m)
      (j := m + 1 + 1) (by omega) (by omega) _ c)).trans ?_
    rw [evW_zigzagA (by omega), show m + 1 + 1 - 2 = m by omega, ← List.append_assoc]
    exact ih (r := r + 1) (by omega)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.evW_farCup
statement:
theorem evW_farCup (u : List Step) {A : ℕ} (hu : Valid A u) {i j W : ℕ} (hij : i + 2 ≤ j)
    (hW : W + 2 = j + A) (v : List Step) (c : ℕ) :
    PmEq (evW R δ W (.cup i :: (shiftW j u ++ v)) c)
      (evW R δ W (shiftW (j - 2) u ++ .cup i :: v) c)
proof:
:= by
  induction u generalizing A W with
  | nil => exact PmEq.refl _
  | cons s u ih => cases s with
    | cup k =>
      obtain ⟨hk, hu⟩ := hu
      simp only [shiftW_cons, Step.shift_cup, List.cons_append]
      rw [evW_cup_cup (by omega) (by omega), show j + k - 2 = j - 2 + k by omega]
      exact (PmEq.evW_cons_cup (ih hu (W := W + 2) (by omega))).neg_left
    | cap k =>
      obtain ⟨hk, hu⟩ := hu
      obtain ⟨W, rfl⟩ : ∃ W', W = W' + 2 := ⟨W - 2, by omega⟩
      simp only [shiftW_cons, Step.shift_cap, List.cons_append]
      rw [evW_cup_cap (by omega) (by omega) (by omega), show j + k - 2 = j - 2 + k by omega]
      exact (PmEq.evW_cons_cap (ih hu (W := W) (by omega))).neg_left

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.nestW_succ'
statement: theorem nestW_succ' (m : ℕ) : nestW (m + 1) = nestW m ++ [.cup m]
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ m ih =>
    conv_lhs => rw [nestW, ih]
    conv_rhs => rw [nestW]
    simp [add_comm]

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.capsW_succ'
statement: theorem capsW_succ' (m : ℕ) : capsW (m + 1) = shiftW 1 (capsW m) ++ [.cap 0]
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ m ih =>
    conv_lhs => rw [capsW, ih]
    conv_rhs => rw [capsW]
    simp [add_comm]

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.evW_farCups
statement:
theorem evW_farCups (m : ℕ) (u : List Step) {W : ℕ} (hu : Valid W u) (v : List Step) (c : ℕ) :
    PmEq (evW R δ W (nestW m ++ shiftW (m + m) u ++ v) c) (evW R δ W (u ++ nestW m ++ v) c)
proof:
:= by
  induction m generalizing v with
  | zero =>
    simp only [nestW, add_zero, shiftW_zero, List.nil_append, List.append_nil]
    exact PmEq.refl _
  | succ m ih =>
    rw [nestW_succ']
    simp only [List.append_assoc, List.singleton_append]
    have h1 := evW_farCup (R := R) (δ := δ) u hu (i := m) (j := m + 1 + (m + 1))
      (W := W + (m + m)) (by omega) (by omega) v c
    rw [show m + 1 + (m + 1) - 2 = m + m by omega] at h1
    refine (PmEq.evW_prefix (nestW m) (ht_nestW m W) h1).trans ?_
    · have := ih (.cup m :: v)
      simpa only [List.append_assoc] using this

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.ht_mirrorSnake
statement:
theorem ht_mirrorSnake (m : ℕ) {W : ℕ} (hW : m ≤ W) :
    ht W (nestW m ++ shiftW m (capsW m)) = W
proof:
:= by
  rw [ht_append, ht_nestW, show W + (m + m) = m + (W + m) by omega,
    ht_shiftW m _ (valid_capsW m _ (by omega)), ht_capsW]
  omega

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.evW_snake'
statement:
theorem evW_snake' (m : ℕ) {W : ℕ} (hW : m ≤ W) (v : List Step) (c : ℕ) :
    PmEq (evW R δ W (nestW m ++ shiftW m (capsW m) ++ v) c) (evW R δ W v c)
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero => simp only [nestW, capsW, shiftW_nil, List.nil_append]; exact PmEq.refl _
  | succ m ih =>
    rw [nestW_succ', capsW_succ', shiftW_append, shiftW_shiftW]
    simp only [shiftW_cons, Step.shift_cap, shiftW_nil, add_zero, List.append_assoc,
      List.cons_append]
    have h1 := evW_farCup (R := R) (δ := δ) (capsW m) (valid_capsW m (W + m) (by omega))
      (i := m) (j := m + 2) (W := W + (m + m)) (by omega) (by omega)
      (.cap (m + 1) :: v) c
    rw [show m + 2 - 2 = m by omega, show m + 2 = m + 1 + 1 from rfl] at h1
    refine (PmEq.evW_prefix (nestW m) (ht_nestW m W) h1).trans ?_
    rw [← List.append_assoc]
    refine (PmEq.evW_prefix _ (ht_mirrorSnake m (by omega))
      (PmEq.of_eq_neg (evW_zigzagB (by omega) v c))).trans ?_
    exact ih (by omega)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.diag_mk_eq_evW
statement:
theorem diag_mk_eq_evW (ls : List (Layer sig)) :
    ∀ (a b : ℕ) (h : Chain (strands a) ls (strands b)),
      (pres R δ).diag (Diagram.mk ls h) = evW R δ a (ls.map toStep) b ∧
        Valid a (ls.map toStep) ∧ ht a (ls.map toStep) = b
proof:
:= by
  induction ls with
  | nil =>
    intro a b h
    have hab : a = b := by simpa using congrArg (fun o : Obj sig => o.word.length) h
    subst hab
    refine ⟨?_, trivial, rfl⟩
    rw [Diagram.mk_nil, Presentation.diag_eqToHom, List.map_nil, evW_nil_self]
    simp
  | cons L ls ih =>
    intro a b h
    obtain ⟨hv, hdom, hc⟩ := h
    obtain ⟨s, l, g, r⟩ := L
    cases g with
    | cup =>
      have hl : l.length + r.length = a := by
        have := congrArg (fun o : Obj sig => o.word.length) hdom
        simpa [Layer.dom] using this
      have hcod : Layer.cod ⟨s, l, .cup, r⟩ = strands (a + 2) :=
        obj_ext (by simp [Layer.cod]; omega)
      have hc' : Chain (strands (a + 2)) ls (strands b) := hcod ▸ hc
      have e : Diagram.mk (⟨s, l, .cup, r⟩ :: ls) ⟨hv, hdom, hc⟩ =
          dcup (m := a) (i := l.length) (by omega) ≫ Diagram.mk ls hc' := by
        apply Diagram.ext
        simp only [Diagram.layers_mk, Diagram.layers_comp, dcup, Diagram.layers_layer,
          List.singleton_append, List.cons.injEq, and_true]
        exact Layer.ext (Subsingleton.elim _ _) (list_unit_ext (by simp))
          rfl (list_unit_ext (by simp; omega))
      obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := ih (a + 2) b hc'
      refine ⟨?_, ⟨by simp only; omega, h2⟩, h3⟩
      rw [e, Presentation.diag_comp, h1, ← cup_def]
      simp only [List.map_cons, toStep, evW_cup]
    | cap =>
      have hl : l.length + 2 + r.length = a := by
        have := congrArg (fun o : Obj sig => o.word.length) hdom
        simp [Layer.dom] at this; omega
      obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ : ∃ a', a = a' + 2 := ⟨l.length + r.length, by omega⟩
      have hcod : Layer.cod ⟨s, l, .cap, r⟩ = strands a :=
        obj_ext (by simp [Layer.cod]; omega)
      have hc' : Chain (strands a) ls (strands b) := hcod ▸ hc
      have e : Diagram.mk (⟨s, l, .cap, r⟩ :: ls) ⟨hv, hdom, hc⟩ =
          dcap (m := a) (i := l.length) (by omega) ≫ Diagram.mk ls hc' := by
        apply Diagram.ext
        simp only [Diagram.layers_mk, Diagram.layers_comp, dcap, Diagram.layers_layer,
          List.singleton_append, List.cons.injEq, and_true]
        exact Layer.ext (Subsingleton.elim _ _) (list_unit_ext (by simp))
          rfl (list_unit_ext (by simp; omega))
      obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := ih a b hc'
      refine ⟨?_, ⟨by simp only; omega, h2⟩, h3⟩
      rw [e, Presentation.diag_comp, h1, ← cap_def]
      simp only [List.map_cons, toStep, evW_cap]

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.diag_eq_evW
statement:
theorem diag_eq_evW {a b : ℕ} (d : strands a ⟶ strands b) :
    (pres R δ).diag d = evW R δ a (steps d) b

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.valid_steps
statement: theorem valid_steps {a b : ℕ} (d : strands a ⟶ strands b) : Valid a (steps d)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.ht_steps
statement: theorem ht_steps {a b : ℕ} (d : strands a ⟶ strands b) : ht a (steps d) = b

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.hom_induction_evW
statement:
theorem hom_induction_evW {a b : ℕ} {p : (X R δ a ⟶ X R δ b) → Prop}
    (word : ∀ u : List Step, Valid a u → ht a u = b → p (evW R δ a u b)) (zero : p 0)
    (add : ∀ f g, p f → p g → p (f + g)) (smul : ∀ (r : R) f, p f → p (r • f))
    (f : X R δ a ⟶ X R δ b) : p f
proof:
:=
  (pres R δ).hom_induction (fun d => by
    rw [diag_eq_evW]; exact word _ (valid_steps d) (ht_steps d)) zero add smul f

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.strands_tensor
statement: theorem strands_tensor (m a : ℕ) : (strands m).tensor (strands a) = strands (m + a)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.wLs_comp
statement:
theorem wLs_comp (m : ℕ) {a b c : ℕ} (x : X R δ a ⟶ X R δ b) (y : X R δ b ⟶ X R δ c) :
    wLs R δ m (x ≫ y) = wLs R δ m x ≫ wLs R δ m y

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.wLs_add
statement:
theorem wLs_add (m : ℕ) {a b : ℕ} (x y : X R δ a ⟶ X R δ b) :
    wLs R δ m (x + y) = wLs R δ m x + wLs R δ m y

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.wLs_smul
statement:
theorem wLs_smul (m : ℕ) {a b : ℕ} (r : R) (x : X R δ a ⟶ X R δ b) :
    wLs R δ m (r • x) = r • wLs R δ m x

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.wLs_zero
statement: theorem wLs_zero (m : ℕ) {a b : ℕ} : wLs R δ m (0 : X R δ a ⟶ X R δ b) = 0

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.wLs_neg
statement:
theorem wLs_neg (m : ℕ) {a b : ℕ} (x : X R δ a ⟶ X R δ b) :
    wLs R δ m (-x) = -wLs R δ m x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← neg_one_smul R x, wLs_smul, neg_one_smul]

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.wLs_eqToHom
statement:
theorem wLs_eqToHom (m : ℕ) {a b : ℕ} (h : X R δ a = X R δ b) :
    wLs R δ m (eqToHom h) = eqToHom (by
      have := (pres R δ).obj_injective h
