      rw [show a = b by simpa using congrArg (fun o : Obj sig => o.word.length) this])
proof:
:= by
  have := (pres R δ).obj_injective h
  obtain rfl : a = b := by simpa using congrArg (fun o : Obj sig => o.word.length) this
  simp [wLs, Presentation.wL_id]

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.wLs_cup
statement:
theorem wLs_cup (m : ℕ) {a i : ℕ} (h : i ≤ a) :
    wLs R δ m (cup R δ a i) = cup R δ (m + a) (m + i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [cup_def h, cup_def (by omega), wLs, Presentation.wL_diag,
    (pres R δ).diag_eq_of_layers_eq' (Diagram.whiskerL (strands m) (dcup h))
      (dcup (m := m + a) (i := m + i) (by omega))
      (strands_tensor m a) (strands_tensor m (a + 2)) ?_]
  · simp
  · simp only [Diagram.layers_whiskerL, dcup, Diagram.layers_layer, List.map_cons, List.map_nil,
      List.cons.injEq, and_true]
    exact Layer.ext rfl (list_unit_ext (by simp [Layer.wl, strands])) rfl
      (list_unit_ext (by simp [Layer.wl]; omega))

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.wLs_cap
statement:
theorem wLs_cap (m : ℕ) {a i : ℕ} (h : i ≤ a) :
    wLs R δ m (cap R δ a i) = cap R δ (m + a) (m + i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [cap_def h, cap_def (by omega), wLs, Presentation.wL_diag,
    (pres R δ).diag_eq_of_layers_eq' (Diagram.whiskerL (strands m) (dcap h))
      (dcap (m := m + a) (i := m + i) (by omega))
      (strands_tensor m (a + 2)) (strands_tensor m a) ?_]
  · simp
  · simp only [Diagram.layers_whiskerL, dcap, Diagram.layers_layer, List.map_cons, List.map_nil,
      List.cons.injEq, and_true]
    exact Layer.ext rfl (list_unit_ext (by simp [Layer.wl, strands])) rfl
      (list_unit_ext (by simp [Layer.wl]; omega))

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.wLs_evW
statement:
theorem wLs_evW (m : ℕ) {a : ℕ} {u : List Step} (hu : Valid a u) (b : ℕ) :
    wLs R δ m (evW R δ a u b) = evW R δ (m + a) (shiftW m u) (m + b)
proof:
:= by
  induction u generalizing a with
  | nil =>
    by_cases hab : a = b
    · subst hab; simp only [evW_nil_self, shiftW_nil]
      rw [show (𝟙 (X R δ a)) = eqToHom rfl from rfl, wLs_eqToHom]; simp
    · rw [evW_nil_of_ne hab, wLs_zero, shiftW_nil, evW_nil_of_ne (by omega)]
  | cons s u ih => cases s with
    | cup i =>
      rw [evW_cup, wLs_comp, wLs_cup m hu.1, ih hu.2, shiftW_cons, Step.shift_cup, evW_cup]
      rfl
    | cap i =>
      obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ : ∃ a', a = a' + 2 := ⟨a - 2, by have := hu.1; omega⟩
      rw [evW_cap, wLs_comp, wLs_cap m (by have := hu.1; omega), ih (a := a) hu.2, shiftW_cons,
        Step.shift_cap]
      exact (evW_cap (m + a) (m + i) (shiftW m u) (m + b)).symm

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.Zπ.eq_zero_of_add_mul_π
statement: theorem Zπ.eq_zero_of_add_mul_π {a b : ℤ} (h : (a : Zπ) + (b : Zπ) * Zπ.π = 0) : a = 0 ∧ b = 0

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.xz_xU
statement: theorem xz_xU (k : ℤ) : xz (A := LZ) xU k = T k
proof:
:= by
  rw [xz]
  induction k using Int.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih => rw [zpow_add_one, Units.val_mul, ih, T_add]; rfl
  | pred n ih =>
    rw [zpow_sub_one, Units.val_mul, ih]
    show T (-(n : ℤ)) * T (-1) = T (-(n : ℤ) - 1)
    rw [← T_add]
    congr 1

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.πL_mul_πL
statement: theorem πL_mul_πL : πL * πL = 1

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.brk_succ
statement:
theorem brk_succ (n : ℕ) :
    brk (n + 1) = ∑ r ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), C (Zπ.π ^ r) * T ((n : ℤ) - 2 * r)
proof:
:= by
  rw [brk, qbracket_succ_eq]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r _ => ?_
  rw [xz_xU, map_pow]

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.genL_coeff
statement:
theorem genL_coeff (n : ℕ) (b : ZMod 2) (k : ℤ) :
    (genL (n, b)).coeff k = ∑ r ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
      if (n : ℤ) - 2 * r = k then Zπ.π ^ (b.val + r) else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [genL, brk_succ, Finset.mul_sum, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_sum, Finset.sum_apply']
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r _ => ?_
  rw [← map_pow, ← mul_assoc, ← map_mul, ← pow_add, ← single_eq_C_mul_T,
    AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single, Finsupp.single_apply]

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.genL_coeff_self
statement: theorem genL_coeff_self (n : ℕ) (b : ZMod 2) : (genL (n, b)).coeff n = Zπ.π ^ b.val
proof:
:= by
  rw [genL_coeff, Finset.sum_eq_single 0]
  · simp
  · intro r _ hr; rw [ite_eq_right]; omega
  · simp

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.genL_coeff_of_lt
statement:
theorem genL_coeff_of_lt {n : ℕ} (b : ZMod 2) {k : ℤ} (hk : (n : ℤ) < k) :
    (genL (n, b)).coeff k = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [genL_coeff]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun r _ => ?_
  rw [ite_eq_right]; omega

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.linearIndependent_genL
statement: theorem linearIndependent_genL : LinearIndependent ℤ genL
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [linearIndependent_iff']
  intro s g hsum i hi
  by_contra hgi
  set s' := s.filter fun j => g j ≠ 0
  have hne : s'.Nonempty := ⟨i, by simp [s', hi, hgi]⟩
  obtain ⟨i₀, hi₀, hmax⟩ := s'.exists_max_image (fun j => j.1) hne
  set N := i₀.1
  have hc := congrArg (fun p : LZ => p.coeff (N : ℤ)) hsum
  rw [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_sum, Finsupp.finsetSum_apply] at hc
  simp only [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_zero, Finsupp.coe_zero, Pi.zero_apply] at hc
  
  have hterm : ∀ j ∈ s, (g j • genL j).coeff (N : ℤ) =
      if j.1 = N then g j • Zπ.π ^ j.2.val else 0 := by
    intro j hj
    change g j • (genL j).coeff (N : ℤ) = _
    by_cases hgj : g j = 0
    · simp [hgj]
    · have hjN : j.1 ≤ N := hmax j (by simp [s', hj, hgj])
      obtain ⟨n, b⟩ := j
      split_ifs with h
      · simp only at h; subst h; rw [genL_coeff_self]
      · rw [genL_coeff_of_lt b (by simp only at hjN h; omega), smul_zero]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hterm, ← Finset.sum_filter] at hc
  
  set A := ∑ j ∈ s.filter (fun j => j.1 = N ∧ j.2 = 0), g j
  set B := ∑ j ∈ s.filter (fun j => j.1 = N ∧ j.2 = 1), g j
  have hAB : (A : Zπ) + (B : Zπ) * Zπ.π = 0 := by
    rw [← hc]
    have : s.filter (fun j => j.1 = N) = s.filter (fun j => j.1 = N ∧ j.2 = 0) ∪
        s.filter (fun j => j.1 = N ∧ j.2 = 1) := by
      ext j; simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_union]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
        rcases Supercategory.parity_eq_zero_or_one j.2 with h | h
        · exact Or.inl ⟨h1, h2, h⟩
        · exact Or.inr ⟨h1, h2, h⟩
      · rintro (⟨h1, h2, _⟩ | ⟨h1, h2, _⟩) <;> exact ⟨h1, h2⟩
    rw [this, Finset.sum_union]
    · simp only [A, B, Int.cast_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
      congr 1
      · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j hj => ?_
        simp only [Finset.mem_filter] at hj
        rw [hj.2.2]; simp
      · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j hj => ?_
        simp only [Finset.mem_filter] at hj
        rw [hj.2.2]; simp [zsmul_eq_mul, ZMod.val_one]
    · rw [Finset.disjoint_filter]
      rintro j - ⟨-, h0⟩ ⟨-, h1⟩
      rw [h0] at h1; exact absurd h1 (by decide)
  obtain ⟨hA, hB⟩ := Zπ.eq_zero_of_add_mul_π hAB
  have hi₀s : i₀ ∈ s := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi₀).1
  have hgi₀ : g i₀ ≠ 0 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi₀).2
  rcases Supercategory.parity_eq_zero_or_one i₀.2 with h | h
  · have : A = g i₀ := by
      show ∑ j ∈ s.filter (fun j => j.1 = N ∧ j.2 = 0), g j = g i₀
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single_of_mem i₀ (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hi₀s, rfl, h⟩)]
      intro j hj hji
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter] at hj
      exact absurd (Prod.ext hj.2.1 (hj.2.2.trans h.symm)) hji
    exact hgi₀ (this ▸ hA)
  · have : B = g i₀ := by
      show ∑ j ∈ s.filter (fun j => j.1 = N ∧ j.2 = 1), g j = g i₀
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single_of_mem i₀ (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hi₀s, rfl, h⟩)]
      intro j hj hji
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter] at hj
      exact absurd (Prod.ext hj.2.1 (hj.2.2.trans h.symm)) hji
    exact hgi₀ (this ▸ hB)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.genL_zero_zero
statement: theorem genL_zero_zero : genL (0, 0) = 1

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.genL_one
statement: theorem genL_one (n : ℕ) : genL (n, 1) = πL * genL (n, 0)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.basisK₀_eq_classJw
statement: theorem basisK₀_eq_classJw (x : ℕ × ZMod 2) : basisK₀ q hq x = classJw q hq x

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.K₀ToLZlin_classJw
statement: theorem K₀ToLZlin_classJw (x : ℕ × ZMod 2) : K₀ToLZlin q hq (classJw q hq x) = genL x

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.πsmul_πsmul
statement: theorem πsmul_πsmul (x : K₀ (SKar k (STL k δq))) : Zπ.π • Zπ.π • x = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [Algebra.smul_def, Algebra.smul_def, ← mul_assoc, ← map_mul, Zπ.π_mul_π, map_one, one_mul]

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.K₀ToLZlin_π_smul
statement:
theorem K₀ToLZlin_π_smul (x : K₀ (SKar k (STL k δq))) :
    K₀ToLZlin q hq (Zπ.π • x) = πL * K₀ToLZlin q hq x
proof:
:= by
  have : (K₀ToLZlin q hq).comp (DistribSMul.toLinearMap ℤ _ Zπ.π) =
      (LinearMap.mulLeft ℤ πL).comp (K₀ToLZlin q hq) := by
    refine (basisK₀ q hq).ext fun ⟨n, b⟩ => ?_
    simp only [LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, DistribSMul.toLinearMap_apply,
      LinearMap.mulLeft_apply, basisK₀_eq_classJw]
    rcases Supercategory.parity_eq_zero_or_one b with rfl | rfl
    · rw [← classJw_one, K₀ToLZlin_classJw, K₀ToLZlin_classJw, genL_one]
    · rw [K₀ToLZlin_classJw q hq (n, 1), classJw_one, πsmul_πsmul, K₀ToLZlin_classJw, genL_one,
        ← mul_assoc, πL_mul_πL, one_mul]
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun this x

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.K₀ToLZlin_classJw_mul_gen
statement:
theorem K₀ToLZlin_classJw_mul_gen (n : ℕ) :
    K₀ToLZlin q hq (classJw q hq (n, 0) * classJw q hq (1, 0)) = genL (n, 0) * brk 2
proof:
:= by
  rcases n with _ | N
  · rw [← one_eq_classJw, one_mul, K₀ToLZlin_classJw, genL_zero_zero, one_mul]
    simp [genL]
  · rw [classJw_mul_one, map_add, K₀ToLZlin_π_smul, K₀ToLZlin_classJw, K₀ToLZlin_classJw]
    simp only [genL, ZMod.val_zero, pow_zero, one_mul]
    rw [qbracket_succ_mul_two]

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.K₀ToLZlin_mul_gen
statement:
theorem K₀ToLZlin_mul_gen (x : K₀ (SKar k (STL k δq))) :
    K₀ToLZlin q hq (x * classJw q hq (1, 0)) = K₀ToLZlin q hq x * brk 2
proof:
:= by
  have : (K₀ToLZlin q hq).comp (LinearMap.mulRight ℤ (classJw q hq (1, 0))) =
      (LinearMap.mulRight ℤ (brk 2)).comp (K₀ToLZlin q hq) := by
    refine (basisK₀ q hq).ext fun ⟨n, b⟩ => ?_
    simp only [LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, LinearMap.mulRight_apply, basisK₀_eq_classJw]
    rcases Supercategory.parity_eq_zero_or_one b with rfl | rfl
    · rw [K₀ToLZlin_classJw, K₀ToLZlin_classJw_mul_gen]
    · rw [K₀ToLZlin_classJw q hq (n, 1), classJw_one, smul_mul_assoc, K₀ToLZlin_π_smul,
        K₀ToLZlin_classJw_mul_gen, genL_one, mul_assoc]
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun this x

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.K₀ToLZlin_mul_classJw
statement:
theorem K₀ToLZlin_mul_classJw (n : ℕ) : ∀ x : K₀ (SKar k (STL k δq)),
    K₀ToLZlin q hq (x * classJw q hq (n, 0)) = K₀ToLZlin q hq x * genL (n, 0)
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ n ih =>
  intro x
  match n, ih with
  | 0, _ => rw [← one_eq_classJw, mul_one, genL_zero_zero, mul_one]
  | 1, _ => rw [K₀ToLZlin_mul_gen]; simp [genL]
  | n + 2, ih =>
    have e : classJw q hq (n + 2, 0) =
        classJw q hq (n + 1, 0) * classJw q hq (1, 0) - Zπ.π • classJw q hq (n, 0) := by
      rw [classJw_mul_one]; abel
    rw [e, mul_sub, ← mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, map_sub, K₀ToLZlin_mul_gen, K₀ToLZlin_π_smul,
      ih (n + 1) (by omega), ih n (by omega)]
    simp only [genL, ZMod.val_zero, pow_zero, one_mul]
    have := qbracket_succ_mul_two xU πL (n + 1)
    rw [show n + 2 + 1 = n + 1 + 2 by omega, show n + 1 + 1 = n + 2 by omega] at *
    linear_combination (K₀ToLZlin q hq x) * this

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.K₀ToLZlin_mul
statement:
theorem K₀ToLZlin_mul (x y : K₀ (SKar k (STL k δq))) :
    K₀ToLZlin q hq (x * y) = K₀ToLZlin q hq x * K₀ToLZlin q hq y
proof:
:= by
  have : (K₀ToLZlin q hq).comp (LinearMap.mulLeft ℤ x) =
      (LinearMap.mulLeft ℤ (K₀ToLZlin q hq x)).comp (K₀ToLZlin q hq) := by
    refine (basisK₀ q hq).ext fun ⟨n, b⟩ => ?_
    simp only [LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, LinearMap.mulLeft_apply, basisK₀_eq_classJw]
    rcases Supercategory.parity_eq_zero_or_one b with rfl | rfl
    · rw [K₀ToLZlin_mul_classJw, K₀ToLZlin_classJw]
    · rw [classJw_one, mul_smul_comm, K₀ToLZlin_π_smul, K₀ToLZlin_π_smul,
        K₀ToLZlin_mul_classJw, K₀ToLZlin_classJw]
      ring
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun this y

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.K₀ToLZ_classJw
statement: @[simp] theorem K₀ToLZ_classJw (x : ℕ × ZMod 2) : K₀ToLZ q hq (classJw q hq x) = genL x

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.K₀ToLZ_injective
statement: theorem K₀ToLZ_injective : Function.Injective (K₀ToLZ q hq)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y h
  have hx : K₀ToLZ q hq x = Finsupp.linearCombination ℤ genL ((basisK₀ q hq).repr x) := by
    rw [K₀ToLZ, RingHom.coe_mk, MonoidHom.coe_mk, OneHom.coe_mk, K₀ToLZlin,
      Module.Basis.constr_apply, Finsupp.linearCombination_apply]
  have hy : K₀ToLZ q hq y = Finsupp.linearCombination ℤ genL ((basisK₀ q hq).repr y) := by
    rw [K₀ToLZ, RingHom.coe_mk, MonoidHom.coe_mk, OneHom.coe_mk, K₀ToLZlin,
      Module.Basis.constr_apply, Finsupp.linearCombination_apply]
  rw [hx, hy] at h
  exact (basisK₀ q hq).repr.injective (linearIndependent_genL h)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.range_K₀ToLZ
statement:
theorem range_K₀ToLZ :
    ((K₀ToLZ q hq).range : Set LZ) = Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range genL)
proof:
:= by
  have : (Set.range (K₀ToLZ q hq)) = Set.range (K₀ToLZlin q hq) := rfl
  rw [RingHom.coe_range, this, ← LinearMap.coe_range, K₀ToLZlin, Module.Basis.constr_range]

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.K₀Equiv_classJw
statement:
theorem K₀Equiv_classJw (x : ℕ × ZMod 2) :
    (K₀Equiv q hq (classJw q hq x) : LZ) = genL x

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.finrank_hom_zero
statement:
theorem finrank_hom_zero (P : SKar k (STL k δq)) :
    Module.finrank k (P ⟶ bsum ([] : List (SKar k (STL k δq)))) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have : Subsingleton (P ⟶ bsum ([] : List (SKar k (STL k δq)))) :=
    ⟨fun f g => (isZero_zero _).eq_of_tgt f g⟩
  exact Module.finrank_zero_of_subsingleton

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.finrank_hom_jwObj
statement:
theorem finrank_hom_jwObj (n m : ℕ) (b a : ZMod 2) :
    FiniteDimensional k (jwObj q hq n b ⟶ jwObj q hq m a) ∧
      Module.finrank k (jwObj q hq n b ⟶ jwObj q hq m a) = if n = m ∧ b = a then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : n = m ∧ b = a
  · obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := h
    rw [ite_eq_left ⟨rfl, rfl⟩]
    
    let e : k ≃ₗ[k] (jwObj q hq n b ⟶ jwObj q hq n b) :=
      LinearEquiv.ofBijective (LinearMap.toSpanSingleton k _ (𝟙 _))
        ⟨fun c d hcd => by
          simp only [LinearMap.toSpanSingleton_apply] at hcd
          by_contra hne
          have : (c - d) • 𝟙 (jwObj q hq n b) = 0 := by rw [sub_smul, hcd, sub_self]
          exact id_jwObj_ne_zero q hq n b ((smul_eq_zero.mp this).resolve_left (sub_ne_zero.mpr hne)),
         fun f => by
          obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := jwObj_isSchur q hq n b f
          exact ⟨c, by simp [hc]⟩⟩
    exact ⟨LinearEquiv.finiteDimensional e, by rw [← e.finrank_eq, Module.finrank_self]⟩
  · rw [ite_eq_right h]
    have : Subsingleton (jwObj q hq n b ⟶ jwObj q hq m a) :=
      ⟨fun f g => by
        rw [hom_jwObj_eq_zero q hq (by tauto) f, hom_jwObj_eq_zero q hq (by tauto) g]⟩
    exact ⟨inferInstance, Module.finrank_zero_of_subsingleton⟩

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.finiteDimensional_hom
statement:
theorem finiteDimensional_hom (n : ℕ) (b : ZMod 2) (Z : SKar k (STL k δq)) :
    FiniteDimensional k (jwObj q hq n b ⟶ Z)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨L, hL, ⟨e⟩⟩ := exists_iso_bsum_jwObj q hq Z
  suffices FiniteDimensional k (jwObj q hq n b ⟶ bsum L) from
    LinearEquiv.finiteDimensional (Linear.homCongr k (Iso.refl _) e.symm)
  clear e
  induction L with
  | nil =>
    have : Subsingleton (jwObj q hq n b ⟶ bsum ([] : List (SKar k (STL k δq)))) :=
      ⟨fun f g => (isZero_zero _).eq_of_tgt f g⟩
    infer_instance
  | cons P L ih =>
    obtain ⟨m, a, rfl⟩ := hL P (by simp)
    have := (finrank_hom_jwObj q hq n m b a).1
    have := ih fun Q hQ => hL Q (by simp [hQ])
    exact LinearEquiv.finiteDimensional (homBiprodEquiv q _ _ _).symm

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.multiplicity_jwObj
statement:
theorem multiplicity_jwObj (n m : ℕ) (b a : ZMod 2) :
    multiplicity q hq n b (K₀.mk (jwObj q hq m a)) = if n = m ∧ b = a then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [multiplicity, K₀.lift_mk, (finrank_hom_jwObj q hq n m b a).2]
  split_ifs <;> rfl

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.mk_bsum
statement:
theorem mk_bsum (L : List (SKar k (STL k δq))) :
    K₀.mk (bsum L) = (L.map K₀.mk).sum
proof:
:= by
  induction L with
  | nil => exact K₀.mk_zero
  | cons P L ih => simp [K₀.mk_biprod, ih]

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.linearIndependent_classJw
statement: theorem linearIndependent_classJw : LinearIndependent ℤ (classJw q hq)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [linearIndependent_iff']
  intro s g hsum i hi
  have := congrArg (multiplicity q hq i.1 i.2) hsum
  rw [map_sum, map_zero] at this
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single_of_mem i hi] at this
  · rwa [map_zsmul, classJw, multiplicity_jwObj, ite_eq_left ⟨rfl, rfl⟩, smul_eq_mul,
      mul_one] at this
  · intro j _ hji
    rw [map_zsmul, classJw, multiplicity_jwObj, ite_eq_right, smul_zero]
    intro h
    exact hji (Prod.ext h.1.symm h.2.symm)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.span_classJw
statement:
theorem span_classJw :
    Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range (classJw q hq)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [Submodule.eq_top_iff']
  intro x
  induction x using K₀.induction_on with
  | mk Z =>
    obtain ⟨L, hL, ⟨e⟩⟩ := exists_iso_bsum_jwObj q hq Z
    rw [K₀.mk_eq_mk_of_iso e, mk_bsum]
    refine list_sum_mem ?_
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨P, hP, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hy
    obtain ⟨n, a, rfl⟩ := hL P hP
    exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨(n, a), rfl⟩
  | zero => exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  | add x y hx hy => exact Submodule.add_mem _ hx hy
  | neg x hx => exact Submodule.neg_mem _ hx

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.basisK₀_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem basisK₀_apply (x : ℕ × ZMod 2) :
    basisK₀ q hq x = K₀.mk (jwObj q hq x.1 x.2)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.canonVec_zero
statement:
theorem canonVec_zero (w : List (Fin 2)) (t : Word (strands 0).word.length) :
    canonVec q 0 w t = 1

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.canonVec_succ_succ
statement:
theorem canonVec_succ_succ {n : ℕ} (w : List (Fin 2)) (h : firstPair w ≤ n)
    (t : Word (strands (n + 2)).word.length) :
    canonVec q (n + 2) w t = psign R (firstPair w) t.1 *
      (cupCoeff R q (t.1.getD (firstPair w) 0) (t.1.getD (firstPair w + 1) 0) *
        ext R _ (canonVec q n (del (firstPair w) w)) (del (firstPair w) t.1))
proof:
:= by
  rw [canonVec, canon_succ_succ, Functor.map_comp, ModuleCat.hom_comp, LinearMap.comp_apply,
    rep_cup_apply h]
  rfl

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.isUnit_psign
statement: theorem isUnit_psign (p : ℕ) (w : List (Fin 2)) : IsUnit (psign R p w)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.step_add_of_cupCoeff_ne_zero
statement:
theorem step_add_of_cupCoeff_ne_zero {a b : Fin 2} (h : cupCoeff R q a b ≠ 0) :
    step a + step b = 0
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases a <;> fin_cases b <;> simp_all

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.canonVec_triangular
statement:
theorem canonVec_triangular (n : ℕ) : ∀ (w : List (Fin 2)), IsDyck w →
    ∀ (hl : w.length = (strands n).word.length),
    (∀ t : Word (strands n).word.length, canonVec q n w t ≠ 0 → dle t.1 w) ∧
      IsUnit (canonVec q n w ⟨w, hl⟩)
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ n ih =>
  intro w hw hl
  simp only [strands_word_length] at hl
  rcases eq_or_ne w [] with rfl | hne
  · obtain rfl : n = 0 := by simpa using hl.symm
    refine ⟨fun t _ => ?_, by rw [canonVec_zero]; exact isUnit_one⟩
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := t
    obtain rfl : t = [] := by simpa [strands] using ht
    exact dle_refl _
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := dyck_decomp hw hne
  generalize hp : firstPair w = p at hr
  have hlr : p + 2 + r.length = n := by rw [← hl, hr]; simp; omega
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ : ∃ n', n = n' + 2 := ⟨p + r.length, by omega⟩
  have hw0 : IsDyck (List.replicate p 0 ++ r) := by
    have := hw.del_pair (p := p) (by omega)
      (by rw [hr]; simp)
      (by rw [hr]; simp)
    rwa [hr, del_rep] at this
  have hd : del p w = List.replicate p 0 ++ r := by rw [hr, del_rep]
  have hl0 : (List.replicate p (0 : Fin 2) ++ r).length = (strands n).word.length := by
    simp; omega
  obtain ⟨ih1, ih2⟩ := ih n (by omega) _ hw0 hl0
  have hins : w = ins p 0 1 (List.replicate p 0 ++ r) := by rw [hr, ins_rep]
  refine ⟨fun t ht => ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [canonVec_succ_succ q w (by omega), hp, hd] at ht
    obtain ⟨t, htl⟩ := t
    dsimp only at ht ⊢
    simp only [strands_word_length] at htl
    have h1 : cupCoeff R q (t.getD p 0) (t.getD (p + 1) 0) ≠ 0 := fun h => ht (by
      rw [h, zero_mul, mul_zero])
    have h2 : ext R _ (canonVec q n (List.replicate p 0 ++ r)) (del p t) ≠ 0 :=
      fun h => ht (by rw [h, mul_zero, mul_zero])
    have hdl : (del p t).length = (strands n).word.length := by
      have := length_del (p := p) (w := t) (by omega); simp; omega
    rw [ext_apply_of_length R _ hdl] at h2
    have := ih1 _ h2
    rw [← ins_getD_del (p := p) (w := t) (by omega), hins]
    exact dle_ins this (by rw [hdl]; simp; omega) (by simp)
      (step_add_of_cupCoeff_ne_zero q h1)
  · rw [canonVec_succ_succ q w (by omega)]
    dsimp only
    rw [hp, hd]
    have g0 : w.getD p 0 = 0 := by rw [hr]; simp
    have g1 : w.getD (p + 1) 0 = 1 := by rw [hr]; simp
    rw [g0, g1, Rep.cupCoeff_01, ext_apply_of_length R _ hl0]
    exact (isUnit_psign p w).mul ((Units.isUnit q).neg.mul ih2)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.eq_of_dle_of_potential
statement:
theorem eq_of_dle_of_potential {t w : List (Fin 2)} (h : dle t w) (hl : t.length = w.length)
    (hp : potential w.length t = potential w.length w) : t = w
proof:
:= by
  refine dle_antisymm h (fun k => ?_) hl
  have hk : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range (w.length + 1), bal (t.take k) = bal (w.take k) :=
    (Finset.sum_eq_sum_iff_of_le (fun k _ => h k)).mp hp
  rcases le_or_gt k w.length with hkl | hkl
  · exact (hk k (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega))).ge
  · have := hk w.length (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega))
    rw [List.take_of_length_le (by omega : w.length ≤ k),
      List.take_of_length_le (by omega : t.length ≤ k)]
    rw [List.take_of_length_le (by omega : t.length ≤ w.length), List.take_length] at this
    exact this.ge

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.potential_le_of_dle

theorem potential_le_of_dle {t w : List (Fin 2)} (h : dle t w) (N : ℕ) :

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.linearIndependent_canon
statement:
theorem linearIndependent_canon (N : ℕ) :
    LinearIndependent R (fun w : DyckSeq N => canon R (delta q) N w.1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [linearIndependent_iff']
  intro s g hsum i hi
  by_contra hgi
  have hne : (s.filter fun j => g j ≠ 0).Nonempty := ⟨i, by simp [hi, hgi]⟩
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hmax⟩ := (s.filter fun j => g j ≠ 0).exists_max_image
    (fun j => potential N j.1) hne
  simp only [Finset.mem_filter] at hw
  have hl : w.1.length = (strands N).word.length := by simp [w.2.2]
  let evl : (X R (delta q) 0 ⟶ X R (delta q) N) →ₗ[R] R :=
    { toFun := fun x => ((rep R q).map x).hom (fun _ => 1) ⟨w.1, hl⟩
      map_add' := fun x y => by simp [Functor.map_add]; rfl
      map_smul' := fun r x => by simp [Functor.map_smul]; rfl }
  have key := congrArg evl hsum
  rw [map_sum, map_zero] at key
  simp only [map_smul, smul_eq_mul] at key
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single_of_mem w hw.1] at key
  · have hu := (canonVec_triangular q N w.1 w.2.1 hl).2
    exact hw.2 ((hu.mul_left_eq_zero).mp key)
  · intro j hj hjw
    by_cases hgj : g j = 0
    · rw [hgj, zero_mul]
    · have hv : evl (canon R (delta q) N j.1) = canonVec q N j.1 ⟨w.1, hl⟩ := rfl
      rw [hv]
      refine by_contra fun hne' => ?_
      have hd := (canonVec_triangular q N j.1 j.2.1 (by simp [j.2.2])).1 _
        (right_ne_zero_of_mul hne')
      have h1 := hmax j (by simp [hj, hgj])
      have h2 := potential_le_of_dle hd N
      have heq : w.1 = j.1 := eq_of_dle_of_potential hd (by rw [w.2.2, j.2.2])
        (by rw [j.2.2]; simp only at h1 h2; omega)
      exact hjw (Subtype.ext heq).symm

statement: theorem isParityHomogeneous : (pres R δ).IsParityHomogeneous
proof:
:= by
  intro r
  cases r
  · refine ⟨0, Submodule.sub_mem _ (LinDiagram.of_mem_homDeg' ?_) (LinDiagram.of_mem_homDeg' ?_)⟩
    all_goals first | exact Diagram.degree_id _ _ |
      (simp [dcup, dcap, Presentation.parityDeg, sig]; try decide)
  · refine ⟨0, Submodule.add_mem _ (LinDiagram.of_mem_homDeg' ?_) (LinDiagram.of_mem_homDeg' ?_)⟩
    all_goals first | exact Diagram.degree_id _ _ |
      (simp [dcup, dcap, Presentation.parityDeg, sig]; try decide)
  · refine ⟨0, Submodule.sub_mem _ (LinDiagram.of_mem_homDeg' ?_)
      (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (LinDiagram.of_mem_homDeg' ?_))⟩
    all_goals first | exact Diagram.degree_id _ _ |
      (simp [dcup, dcap, Presentation.parityDeg, sig]; try decide)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.zigzagA_at
statement: theorem zigzagA_at {n i : ℕ} (h : i + 1 ≤ n) : cup R δ n (i + 1) ≫ cap R δ n i = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  have key := relation_at (R := R) (δ := δ) .zigzagA i (n - i - 1) (a := strands n)
    (b := strands n) (whisk_eq (by simp [Rel.width]; omega))
    (whisk_eq (by simp [Rel.width]; omega))
  simp only [relation, LinDiagram.whisker_sub, LinDiagram.whisker_of, LinDiagram.cast_sub,
    LinDiagram.cast_of, Presentation.lin_sub, Presentation.lin_of, sub_eq_zero] at key
  rw [cup_def h, cap_def (by omega), ← Presentation.diag_comp, ← (pres R δ).diag_id]
  refine Eq.trans ?_ (key.trans ?_) <;> apply Presentation.diag_eq_of_layers_eq
  · simp [dcup, dcap, shift, Layer.whisker, Rel.width, sig]; try omega
  · rfl

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.zigzagB_at
statement: theorem zigzagB_at {n i : ℕ} (h : i + 1 ≤ n) : cup R δ n i ≫ cap R δ n (i + 1) = -𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  have key := relation_at (R := R) (δ := δ) .zigzagB i (n - i - 1) (a := strands n)
    (b := strands n) (whisk_eq (by simp [Rel.width]; omega))
    (whisk_eq (by simp [Rel.width]; omega))
  simp only [relation, LinDiagram.whisker_add, LinDiagram.whisker_of, LinDiagram.cast_add,
    LinDiagram.cast_of, Presentation.lin_add, Presentation.lin_of, add_eq_zero_iff_eq_neg] at key
  rw [cup_def (by omega), cap_def h, ← Presentation.diag_comp, ← (pres R δ).diag_id]
  refine Eq.trans ?_ (key.trans (congrArg _ ?_)) <;> apply Presentation.diag_eq_of_layers_eq
  · simp [dcup, dcap, shift, Layer.whisker, Rel.width, sig]; try omega
  · rfl

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.loop_at
statement: theorem loop_at {n i : ℕ} (h : i ≤ n) : cup R δ n i ≫ cap R δ n i = δ • 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  have key := relation_at (R := R) (δ := δ) .loop i (n - i) (a := strands n)
    (b := strands n) (whisk_eq (by simp [Rel.width]; omega))
    (whisk_eq (by simp [Rel.width]; omega))
  simp only [relation, LinDiagram.whisker_sub, LinDiagram.whisker_smul, LinDiagram.whisker_of,
    LinDiagram.cast_sub, LinDiagram.cast_smul, LinDiagram.cast_of, Presentation.lin_sub,
    Presentation.lin_smul, Presentation.lin_of, sub_eq_zero] at key
  rw [cup_def h, cap_def h, ← Presentation.diag_comp, ← (pres R δ).diag_id]
  refine Eq.trans ?_ (key.trans ?_)
  · apply Presentation.diag_eq_of_layers_eq
    simp [dcup, dcap, shift, Layer.whisker, Rel.width, sig]; try omega
  · congr 1

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.diag_eq_of_swap
statement:
theorem diag_eq_of_swap {a b : Obj sig} {f f' : a ⟶ b} (L M : Layer sig)
    (hf : Diagram.layers f = [L.wr M.dom.word, M.wl L.cod])
    (hf' : Diagram.layers f' = [M.wl L.dom, L.wr M.cod.word]) :
    (pres R δ).diag f =
      ((-1 : ℤ) ^ (Diagram.oddCountList [L] * Diagram.oddCountList [M])) •
        (pres R δ).diag f'
proof:
:= by
  have hc := Diagram.chain f
  rw [hf] at hc
  obtain ⟨-, ha, -, -, hb⟩ := hc
  rw [Layer.wr_dom] at ha
  rw [chain_nil, Layer.wl_cod] at hb
  subst ha hb
  exact (Presentation.diag_eq_of_layers_eq _ (by rw [hf]; rfl)).trans
    (((pres R δ).diag_swap_layers L M).trans
      (congrArg _ (Presentation.diag_eq_of_layers_eq _ (by rw [hf']; rfl))))

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.cap_cap
statement:
theorem cap_cap {n i j : ℕ} (hij : i + 2 ≤ j) (hj : j ≤ n + 2) :
    cap R δ (n + 2) j ≫ cap R δ n i = -(cap R δ (n + 2) i ≫ cap R δ n (j - 2))
proof:
:= by
  rw [cap_def hj, cap_def (show i ≤ n by omega), cap_def (show i ≤ n + 2 by omega),
    cap_def (show j - 2 ≤ n by omega)]
  have key := diag_eq_of_swap (R := R) (δ := δ)
    (f := dcap (m := n + 2) (i := i) (by omega) ≫ dcap (m := n) (i := j - 2) (by omega))
    (f' := dcap (m := n + 2) (i := j) hj ≫ dcap (m := n) (i := i) (by omega))
    (gl i .cap 0) (gl (j - 2 - i) .cap (n + 2 - j))
    (by simp [dcap, Layer.wr, Layer.wl, Layer.dom, Layer.cod, sig]; omega)
    (by simp [dcap, Layer.wr, Layer.wl, Layer.dom, Layer.cod, sig]; omega)
  simp [Diagram.oddCountList, sig] at key
  rw [key, neg_neg]

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.cup_cup
statement:
theorem cup_cup {n i j : ℕ} (hij : i + 2 ≤ j) (hj : j ≤ n + 2) :
    cup R δ n (j - 2) ≫ cup R δ (n + 2) i = -(cup R δ n i ≫ cup R δ (n + 2) j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [cup_def (show j - 2 ≤ n by omega), cup_def (show i ≤ n + 2 by omega),
    cup_def (show i ≤ n by omega), cup_def hj]
  have key := diag_eq_of_swap (R := R) (δ := δ)
    (f := dcup (m := n) (i := i) (by omega) ≫ dcup (m := n + 2) (i := j) hj)
    (f' := dcup (m := n) (i := j - 2) (by omega) ≫ dcup (m := n + 2) (i := i) (by omega))
    (gl i .cup 0) (gl (j - 2 - i) .cup (n + 2 - j))
    (by simp [dcup, Layer.wr, Layer.wl, Layer.dom, Layer.cod, sig]; omega)
    (by simp [dcup, Layer.wr, Layer.wl, Layer.dom, Layer.cod, sig]; omega)
  simp [Diagram.oddCountList, sig] at key
  rw [key, neg_neg]

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.cup_cap
statement:
theorem cup_cap {n i j : ℕ} (hij : i + 2 ≤ j) (hj : j ≤ n + 2) :
    cup R δ (n + 2) i ≫ cap R δ (n + 2) j = -(cap R δ n (j - 2) ≫ cup R δ n i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [cup_def (show i ≤ n + 2 by omega), cap_def hj, cap_def (show j - 2 ≤ n by omega),
    cup_def (show i ≤ n by omega)]
  have key := diag_eq_of_swap (R := R) (δ := δ)
    (f := dcup (m := n + 2) (i := i) (by omega) ≫ dcap (m := n + 2) (i := j) hj)
    (f' := dcap (m := n) (i := j - 2) (by omega) ≫ dcup (m := n) (i := i) (by omega))
    (gl i .cup 0) (gl (j - 2 - i) .cap (n + 2 - j))
    (by simp [dcup, dcap, Layer.wr, Layer.wl, Layer.dom, Layer.cod, sig]; omega)
    (by simp [dcup, dcap, Layer.wr, Layer.wl, Layer.dom, Layer.cod, sig]; omega)
  simp [Diagram.oddCountList, sig] at key
  exact key

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.cap_cup
statement:
theorem cap_cup {n i j : ℕ} (hij : i + 2 ≤ j) (hj : j ≤ n + 2) :
    cup R δ (n + 2) j ≫ cap R δ (n + 2) i = -(cap R δ n i ≫ cup R δ n (j - 2))
proof:
:= by
  rw [cup_def hj, cap_def (show i ≤ n + 2 by omega), cap_def (show i ≤ n by omega),
    cup_def (show j - 2 ≤ n by omega)]
  have key := diag_eq_of_swap (R := R) (δ := δ)
    (f := dcap (m := n) (i := i) (by omega) ≫ dcup (m := n) (i := j - 2) (by omega))
    (f' := dcup (m := n + 2) (i := j) hj ≫ dcap (m := n + 2) (i := i) (by omega))
    (gl i .cap 0) (gl (j - 2 - i) .cup (n + 2 - j))
    (by simp [dcup, dcap, Layer.wr, Layer.wl, Layer.dom, Layer.cod, sig]; omega)
    (by simp [dcup, dcap, Layer.wr, Layer.wl, Layer.dom, Layer.cod, sig]; omega)
  simp [Diagram.oddCountList, sig] at key
  rw [key, neg_neg]

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.toBsum_comp_fromBsum
statement:
theorem toBsum_comp_fromBsum {A : 𝒞} (l : List (Piece A)) :
    toBsum l ≫ fromBsum l = (l.map fun p => p.a ≫ p.b).sum
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp [toBsum, fromBsum]
  | cons p l ih => simp [toBsum, fromBsum, ih]

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.retract_bsum_of_sum_eq_id
statement:
theorem retract_bsum_of_sum_eq_id {A : 𝒞} (l : List (Piece A))
    (h : (l.map fun p => p.a ≫ p.b).sum = 𝟙 A) : toBsum l ≫ fromBsum l = 𝟙 A

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.fromBsum_comp_toBsum
statement:
theorem fromBsum_comp_toBsum {A : 𝒞} (l : List (Piece A)) (h : Orthogonal l) :
    fromBsum l ≫ toBsum l = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => exact (isZero_zero 𝒞).eq_of_src _ _
  | cons p l ih =>
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := h
    have e1 : p.b ≫ toBsum l = 0 := by
      clear ih h3
      induction l with
      | nil => simp [toBsum]
      | cons q l ih' =>
        refine biprod.hom_ext _ _ ?_ ?_
        · simp [toBsum, (h2 q (by simp)).1]
        · simpa [toBsum] using ih' fun r hr => h2 r (by simp [hr])
    have e2 : fromBsum l ≫ p.a = 0 := by
      clear ih h3 e1
      induction l with
      | nil => simp [fromBsum]
      | cons q l ih' =>
        refine biprod.hom_ext' _ _ ?_ ?_
        · simp [fromBsum, (h2 q (by simp)).2]
        · simpa [fromBsum] using ih' fun r hr => h2 r (by simp [hr])
    change fromBsum (p :: l) ≫ toBsum (p :: l) = 𝟙 (p.obj ⊞ bsum (l.map Piece.obj))
    refine biprod.hom_ext' _ _ ?_ ?_ <;> refine biprod.hom_ext _ _ ?_ ?_
    · simp [toBsum, fromBsum, h1]
    · simp [toBsum, fromBsum, e1]
    · simp [toBsum, fromBsum, e2]
    · simp [toBsum, fromBsum, ih h3]

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.iso_bsum_of_retract
statement:
theorem iso_bsum_of_retract (L : List 𝒞) (hL : ∀ P ∈ L, IsSchur (k := k) P) :
    ∀ (Z : 𝒞) (σ : Z ⟶ bsum L) (τ : bsum L ⟶ Z), σ ≫ τ = 𝟙 Z →
      ∃ L' : List 𝒞, L'.Sublist L ∧ Nonempty (Z ≅ bsum L')
proof:
:= by
  induction L with
  | nil =>
    intro Z σ τ h
    refine ⟨[], List.Sublist.slnil, ⟨?_⟩⟩
    have hZ : IsZero Z := by
      rw [IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero, ← h, (isZero_zero 𝒞).eq_of_tgt σ 0, Limits.zero_comp]
    exact hZ.isoZero
  | cons P L ih =>
    intro Z σ τ h
    have hP := hL P (by simp)
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hP (biprod.inl ≫ τ ≫ σ ≫ biprod.fst)
    by_cases hc0 : c = 0
    · 
      set x : Z ⟶ Z := σ ≫ biprod.fst ≫ biprod.inl ≫ τ
      have hx : x ≫ x = 0 := by
        simp only [x, Category.assoc]
        rw [← Category.assoc biprod.inl τ, ← Category.assoc (biprod.inl ≫ τ) σ,
          ← Category.assoc ((biprod.inl ≫ τ) ≫ σ), show ((biprod.inl ≫ τ) ≫ σ) ≫ biprod.fst =
            biprod.inl ≫ τ ≫ σ ≫ biprod.fst by simp only [Category.assoc], hc, hc0]
        simp
      obtain ⟨L', hL', ⟨e⟩⟩ := ih (fun Q hQ => hL Q (by simp [hQ])) Z (σ ≫ biprod.snd)
        (biprod.inr ≫ τ ≫ (𝟙 Z + x)) (by
          have t : biprod.snd ≫ biprod.inr = 𝟙 (P ⊞ bsum L) - biprod.fst ≫ biprod.inl := by
            rw [← biprod.total]; abel
          have hστx : σ ≫ τ ≫ x = x := by rw [← Category.assoc, h, Category.id_comp]
          have e2 : σ ≫ biprod.fst ≫ biprod.inl ≫ τ ≫ x = x ≫ x := by simp [x]
          have hx' : σ ≫ biprod.fst ≫ biprod.inl ≫ τ = x := rfl
          simp only [Category.assoc]
          rw [← Category.assoc biprod.snd biprod.inr, t]
          simp only [Preadditive.sub_comp, Preadditive.comp_sub, Category.id_comp,
            Preadditive.comp_add, Category.comp_id, Category.assoc]
          rw [h, hστx, e2, hx', hx]
          abel)
      exact ⟨L', hL'.cons P, ⟨e⟩⟩
    · 
      set s : P ⟶ Z := biprod.inl ≫ τ
      set r : Z ⟶ P := c⁻¹ • (σ ≫ biprod.fst)
      have hsr : s ≫ r = 𝟙 P := by
        simp only [s, r, Linear.comp_smul, Category.assoc]
        rw [hc, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hc0, one_smul]
      have hq : (𝟙 Z - r ≫ s) ≫ (𝟙 Z - r ≫ s) = 𝟙 Z - r ≫ s := by
        simp only [Preadditive.sub_comp, Preadditive.comp_sub, Category.id_comp,
          Category.comp_id, Category.assoc]
        rw [← Category.assoc s r, hsr, Category.id_comp]
        abel
      obtain ⟨Z', i', e', hie, hei⟩ := IsIdempotentComplete.idempotents_split Z _ hq
      have hse : s ≫ e' = 0 := by
        have : s ≫ e' ≫ i' = 0 := by
          rw [hei, Preadditive.comp_sub, Category.comp_id, ← Category.assoc, hsr,
            Category.id_comp, sub_self]
        rw [← Category.comp_id (s ≫ e'), ← hie]
        simp only [Category.assoc] at this ⊢
        rw [← Category.assoc e' i' e', ← Category.assoc s (e' ≫ i') e', this, Limits.zero_comp]
      have hir : i' ≫ r = 0 := by
        have : i' ≫ e' ≫ i' ≫ r = 0 := by
          rw [← Category.assoc e' i' r, hei, Preadditive.sub_comp, Category.id_comp,
            Category.assoc, hsr, Category.comp_id, sub_self, Limits.comp_zero]
        rwa [← Category.assoc i' e', hie, Category.id_comp] at this
      
      obtain ⟨L', hL', ⟨e⟩⟩ := ih (fun Q hQ => hL Q (by simp [hQ])) Z'
        (i' ≫ σ ≫ biprod.snd) (biprod.inr ≫ τ ≫ e') (by
          have t : biprod.snd ≫ biprod.inr = 𝟙 (P ⊞ bsum L) - biprod.fst ≫ biprod.inl := by
            rw [← biprod.total]; abel
          have hστ' : σ ≫ τ ≫ e' = e' := by rw [← Category.assoc, h, Category.id_comp]
          have e3 : σ ≫ biprod.fst ≫ biprod.inl ≫ τ ≫ e' = 0 := by
            have : (biprod.inl : P ⟶ P ⊞ bsum L) ≫ τ ≫ e' = 0 := by
              rw [← Category.assoc]; exact hse
            rw [this, Limits.comp_zero, Limits.comp_zero]
          simp only [Category.assoc]
          rw [← Category.assoc biprod.snd biprod.inr, t]
          simp only [Preadditive.sub_comp, Preadditive.comp_sub, Category.id_comp,
            Category.assoc]
          rw [hστ', e3, hie, Limits.comp_zero, sub_zero])
      refine ⟨P :: L', hL'.cons_cons P, ⟨?_⟩⟩
      have hmid : biprod.desc s i' ≫ biprod.lift r e' = 𝟙 (P ⊞ Z') := by
        refine biprod.hom_ext' _ _ ?_ ?_ <;> refine biprod.hom_ext _ _ ?_ ?_
        · simp [hsr]
        · simp [hse]
        · simp [hir]
        · simp [hie]
      have hmid' : biprod.lift r e' ≫ biprod.desc s i' = 𝟙 Z := by
        rw [biprod.lift_desc, hei]; abel
      let e₁ : Z ≅ P ⊞ Z' := ⟨biprod.lift r e', biprod.desc s i', hmid', hmid⟩
      exact e₁ ≪≫ biprod.mapIso (Iso.refl P) e

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.strands_tensor_one
statement: theorem strands_tensor_one (a : ℕ) : (strands a).tensor (strands 1) = strands (a + 1)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.wR1_comp
statement:
theorem wR1_comp {a b c : ℕ} (x : X R δ a ⟶ X R δ b) (y : X R δ b ⟶ X R δ c) :
    wR1 R δ (x ≫ y) = wR1 R δ x ≫ wR1 R δ y

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.wR1_add
statement:
theorem wR1_add {a b : ℕ} (x y : X R δ a ⟶ X R δ b) :
    wR1 R δ (x + y) = wR1 R δ x + wR1 R δ y

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.wR1_smul
statement:
theorem wR1_smul {a b : ℕ} (r : R) (x : X R δ a ⟶ X R δ b) :
    wR1 R δ (r • x) = r • wR1 R δ x

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.wR1_zero
statement: theorem wR1_zero {a b : ℕ} : wR1 R δ (0 : X R δ a ⟶ X R δ b) = 0

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.wR1_neg
statement: theorem wR1_neg {a b : ℕ} (x : X R δ a ⟶ X R δ b) : wR1 R δ (-x) = -wR1 R δ x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← neg_one_smul R x, wR1_smul, neg_one_smul]

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.wR1_sub
statement:
theorem wR1_sub {a b : ℕ} (x y : X R δ a ⟶ X R δ b) :
    wR1 R δ (x - y) = wR1 R δ x - wR1 R δ y

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.wR1_id
statement: theorem wR1_id (a : ℕ) : wR1 R δ (𝟙 (X R δ a)) = 𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.wR1_cup
statement: theorem wR1_cup {a i : ℕ} (h : i ≤ a) : wR1 R δ (cup R δ a i) = cup R δ (a + 1) i
proof:
:= by
  rw [cup_def h, cup_def (by omega), wR1, Presentation.wR_diag,
    (pres R δ).diag_eq_of_layers_eq' (Diagram.whiskerR (dcup h) (strands 1))
      (dcup (m := a + 1) (i := i) (by omega)) (strands_tensor_one a) (strands_tensor_one (a + 2)) ?_]
  · simp
  · simp only [Diagram.layers_whiskerR, dcup, Diagram.layers_layer, List.map_cons, List.map_nil,
      List.cons.injEq, and_true]
    exact Layer.ext rfl rfl rfl (list_unit_ext (by simp [Layer.wr, strands]; omega))

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.wR1_cap
statement: theorem wR1_cap {a i : ℕ} (h : i ≤ a) : wR1 R δ (cap R δ a i) = cap R δ (a + 1) i
proof:
:= by
  rw [cap_def h, cap_def (by omega), wR1, Presentation.wR_diag,
    (pres R δ).diag_eq_of_layers_eq' (Diagram.whiskerR (dcap h) (strands 1))
      (dcap (m := a + 1) (i := i) (by omega)) (strands_tensor_one (a + 2)) (strands_tensor_one a) ?_]
  · simp
  · simp only [Diagram.layers_whiskerR, dcap, Diagram.layers_layer, List.map_cons, List.map_nil,
      List.cons.injEq, and_true]
    exact Layer.ext rfl rfl rfl (list_unit_ext (by simp [Layer.wr, strands]; omega))

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.wR1_eqToHom
statement:
theorem wR1_eqToHom {a b : ℕ} (h : X R δ a = X R δ b) :
    wR1 R δ (eqToHom h) = eqToHom (by
      have := (pres R δ).obj_injective h
      rw [show a = b by simpa using congrArg (fun o : Obj sig => o.word.length) this])
proof:
:= by
  have := (pres R δ).obj_injective h
  obtain rfl : a = b := by simpa using congrArg (fun o : Obj sig => o.word.length) this
  simp [wR1_id]

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.wR1_evW
statement:
theorem wR1_evW {a : ℕ} {u : List Step} (hu : Valid a u) (b : ℕ) :
    wR1 R δ (evW R δ a u b) = evW R δ (a + 1) u (b + 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction u generalizing a with
  | nil =>
    by_cases hab : a = b
    · subst hab; simp only [evW_nil_self, wR1_id]
    · rw [evW_nil_of_ne hab, wR1_zero, evW_nil_of_ne (by omega)]
  | cons s u ih => cases s with
    | cup i =>
      rw [evW_cup, wR1_comp, wR1_cup hu.1, ih hu.2, evW_cup]
    | cap i =>
      obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ : ∃ a', a = a' + 2 := ⟨a - 2, by have := hu.1; omega⟩
      rw [evW_cap, wR1_comp, wR1_cap (by have := hu.1; omega), ih (a := a) hu.2]
      exact (evW_cap (a + 1) i u (b + 1)).symm

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.valid_add
statement: theorem valid_add {a : ℕ} {u : List Step} (hu : Valid a u) (k : ℕ) : Valid (a + k) u
proof:
:= by
  induction u generalizing a with
  | nil => trivial
  | cons s u ih => cases s with
    | cup i => exact ⟨by have := hu.1; omega, by
        have := ih hu.2; rwa [show a + 2 + k = a + k + 2 by omega] at this⟩
    | cap i => exact ⟨by have := hu.1; omega, by
        have := ih hu.2; rwa [show a - 2 + k = a + k - 2 by have := hu.1; omega] at this⟩

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.ht_add
statement: theorem ht_add {a : ℕ} {u : List Step} (hu : Valid a u) (k : ℕ) : ht (a + k) u = ht a u + k
proof:
:= by
  induction u generalizing a with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons s u ih => cases s with
    | cup i => simp only [ht_cup]; rw [show a + k + 2 = a + 2 + k by omega]; exact ih hu.2
    | cap i =>
      simp only [ht_cap]; rw [show a + k - 2 = a - 2 + k by have := hu.1; omega]; exact ih hu.2

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.evW_slideCup
statement:
theorem evW_slideCup (u : List Step) {A : ℕ} (hu : Valid A u) (v : List Step) (c : ℕ) :
    evW R δ A (u ++ .cup (ht A u) :: v) c =
      ((-1 : R) ^ u.length) • evW R δ A (.cup A :: (u ++ v)) c
proof:
:= by
  induction u generalizing A with
  | nil => simp
  | cons s u ih => cases s with
    | cup i =>
      simp only [List.cons_append, ht_cup, evW_cup, List.length_cons]
      rw [ih hu.2, Linear.comp_smul, ← evW_cup, ← evW_cup,
        evW_cup_cup (by have := hu.1; omega) le_rfl, show A + 2 - 2 = A by omega, pow_succ,
        mul_neg_one, neg_smul, smul_neg, evW_cup]
    | cap i =>
      obtain ⟨A, rfl⟩ : ∃ A', A = A' + 2 := ⟨A - 2, by have := hu.1; omega⟩
      simp only [List.cons_append, ht_cap, evW_cap, List.length_cons, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
      rw [ih (A := A) hu.2, Linear.comp_smul, ← evW_cap]
      have := evW_cap_cup (R := R) (δ := δ) (W := A + 2) (i := i) (j := A + 2)
        (by have := hu.1; omega) le_rfl (u ++ v) c
      rw [show A + 2 - 2 = A by omega] at this
      rw [this, pow_succ, mul_neg_one, neg_smul, smul_neg, neg_neg]

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.evW_slideCap
statement:
theorem evW_slideCap (u : List Step) {A : ℕ} (hu : Valid A u) (v : List Step) (c : ℕ) :
    evW R δ (A + 2) (u ++ .cap (ht A u) :: v) c =
      ((-1 : R) ^ u.length) • evW R δ (A + 2) (.cap A :: (u ++ v)) c
proof:
:= by
  induction u generalizing A with
  | nil => simp
  | cons s u ih => cases s with
    | cup i =>
      simp only [List.cons_append, ht_cup, evW_cup, List.length_cons]
      rw [ih hu.2, Linear.comp_smul, ← evW_cup]
      have := evW_cup_cap (R := R) (δ := δ) (W := A + 2) (i := i) (j := A + 2)
        (by have := hu.1; omega) le_rfl (by have := hu.1; omega) (u ++ v) c
      rw [show A + 2 - 2 = A by omega] at this
      rw [this, pow_succ, mul_neg_one, neg_smul, smul_neg, evW_cap]
    | cap i =>
      obtain ⟨A, rfl⟩ : ∃ A', A = A' + 2 := ⟨A - 2, by have := hu.1; omega⟩
      simp only [List.cons_append, ht_cap, List.length_cons, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
      rw [evW_cap, ih (A := A) hu.2, Linear.comp_smul, ← evW_cap]
      have := evW_cap_cap (R := R) (δ := δ) (W := A + 2 + 2) (i := i) (j := A + 2)
        (by have := hu.1; omega) le_rfl (u ++ v) c
      rw [show A + 2 - 2 = A by omega] at this
      rw [this, pow_succ, mul_neg_one, neg_smul, smul_neg, neg_neg]

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.evW_mem_evenSpan
statement:
theorem evW_mem_evenSpan {a b : ℕ} {u : List Step} (hu : Valid a u) (hb : ht a u = b)
    (he : Even u.length) : evW R δ a u b ∈ evenSpan R δ a b

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.id_mem_evenSpan
statement: theorem id_mem_evenSpan (a : ℕ) : 𝟙 (X R δ a) ∈ evenSpan R δ a a
proof:
:= by
  rw [← evW_nil_self]; exact evW_mem_evenSpan trivial rfl (by simp)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.evenSpan_induction
statement:
theorem evenSpan_induction {a b : ℕ} {p : (X R δ a ⟶ X R δ b) → Prop}
    (word : ∀ u, Valid a u → ht a u = b → Even u.length → p (evW R δ a u b)) (zero : p 0)
    (add : ∀ x y, p x → p y → p (x + y)) (smul : ∀ (r : R) x, p x → p (r • x))
    {x : X R δ a ⟶ X R δ b} (hx : x ∈ evenSpan R δ a b) : p x
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem y hy => obtain ⟨u, hu, hb, he, rfl⟩ := hy; exact word u hu hb he
  | zero => exact zero
  | add y z _ _ hy hz => exact add y z hy hz
  | smul r y _ hy => exact smul r y hy

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.comp_mem_evenSpan
statement:
theorem comp_mem_evenSpan {a b c : ℕ} {x : X R δ a ⟶ X R δ b} {y : X R δ b ⟶ X R δ c}
    (hx : x ∈ evenSpan R δ a b) (hy : y ∈ evenSpan R δ b c) : x ≫ y ∈ evenSpan R δ a c
proof:
:= by
  refine evenSpan_induction (p := fun x => x ≫ y ∈ evenSpan R δ a c) (fun u hu hb he => ?_)
    (by rw [Limits.zero_comp]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _)
    (fun x z hx hz => by rw [Preadditive.add_comp]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hx hz)
    (fun r x hx => by rw [Linear.smul_comp]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ r hx) hx
  refine evenSpan_induction (p := fun y => evW R δ a u b ≫ y ∈ evenSpan R δ a c)
    (fun v hv hc hve => ?_) (by rw [Limits.comp_zero]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _)
    (fun y z hy hz => by rw [Preadditive.comp_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hy hz)
    (fun r y hy => by rw [Linear.comp_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ r hy) hy
  rw [← evW_append a u v hb]
  refine evW_mem_evenSpan (valid_append.mpr ⟨hu, hb ▸ hv⟩) (by rw [ht_append, hb, hc]) ?_
  rw [List.length_append]; exact he.add hve

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.wR1_mem_evenSpan
statement:
theorem wR1_mem_evenSpan {a b : ℕ} {x : X R δ a ⟶ X R δ b} (hx : x ∈ evenSpan R δ a b) :
    wR1 R δ x ∈ evenSpan R δ (a + 1) (b + 1)
proof:
:= by
  refine evenSpan_induction (p := fun x => wR1 R δ x ∈ evenSpan R δ (a + 1) (b + 1))
    (fun u hu hb he => ?_) (by rw [wR1_zero]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _)
    (fun x y hx hy => by rw [wR1_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hx hy)
    (fun r x hx => by rw [wR1_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ r hx) hx
  rw [wR1_evW hu]
  exact evW_mem_evenSpan (valid_add hu 1) (by rw [ht_add hu, hb]) he

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.comp_cup_right
statement:
theorem comp_cup_right {a b : ℕ} {x : X R δ a ⟶ X R δ b} (hx : x ∈ evenSpan R δ a b) :
    x ≫ cup R δ b b = cup R δ a a ≫ wR1 R δ (wR1 R δ x)
proof:
:= by
  refine evenSpan_induction (p := fun x => x ≫ cup R δ b b = cup R δ a a ≫ wR1 R δ (wR1 R δ x))
    (fun u hu hb he => ?_) (by simp [wR1_zero])
    (fun x y hx hy => by
      simp only [Preadditive.add_comp, hx, hy, wR1_add, Preadditive.comp_add])
    (fun r x hx => by
      simp only [Linear.smul_comp, hx, wR1_smul, Linear.comp_smul]) hx
  · rw [wR1_evW hu, wR1_evW (valid_add hu 1)]
    have h1 := evW_slideCup (R := R) (δ := δ) u hu [] (b + 2)
    rw [hb, evW_append a u _ hb, evW_cup, evW_nil_self, Category.comp_id, he.neg_one_pow,
      one_smul, List.append_nil, evW_cup] at h1
    exact h1

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.wR2_comp_cap_right
statement:
theorem wR2_comp_cap_right {a b : ℕ} {x : X R δ a ⟶ X R δ b} (hx : x ∈ evenSpan R δ a b) :
    wR1 R δ (wR1 R δ x) ≫ cap R δ b b = cap R δ a a ≫ x
proof:
:= by
  refine evenSpan_induction (p := fun x => wR1 R δ (wR1 R δ x) ≫ cap R δ b b = cap R δ a a ≫ x)
    (fun u hu hb he => ?_) (by simp [wR1_zero])
    (fun x y hx hy => by
      simp only [Preadditive.comp_add, hx, hy, wR1_add, Preadditive.add_comp])
    (fun r x hx => by
      simp only [Linear.comp_smul, hx, wR1_smul, Linear.smul_comp]) hx
  · rw [wR1_evW hu, wR1_evW (valid_add hu 1)]
    have h1 := evW_slideCap (R := R) (δ := δ) u hu [] b
    rw [hb, evW_append (a + 2) u _ (b := b + 2) (by rw [ht_add hu, hb]), evW_cap, evW_nil_self,
      Category.comp_id, he.neg_one_pow, one_smul, List.append_nil, evW_cap] at h1
    exact h1

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.jw_zero
statement: theorem jw_zero : jw q 0 = 𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.jw_one
statement: theorem jw_one : jw q 1 = 𝟙 _

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.jw_succ_succ
statement:
theorem jw_succ_succ (n : ℕ) : jw q (n + 2) = wR1 k δq (jw q (n + 1)) + jwCoeff q (n + 1) •
    (wR1 k δq (jw q (n + 1)) ≫ cap k δq n n ≫ cup k δq n n ≫ wR1 k δq (jw q (n + 1)))

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.jw_one_eq
statement: theorem jw_one_eq : jw q 1 = wR1 k δq (jw q 0)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.jw_mem_evenSpan
statement: theorem jw_mem_evenSpan (n : ℕ) : jw q n ∈ evenSpan k δq n n
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ n ih =>
  match n, ih with
  | 0, _ => rw [jw_zero]; exact id_mem_evenSpan 0
  | 1, _ => rw [jw_one]; exact id_mem_evenSpan 1
  | n + 2, ih =>
    rw [jw_succ_succ]
    have h1 := wR1_mem_evenSpan (ih (n + 1) (by omega))
    have hcc : cap k δq n n ≫ cup k δq n n ∈ evenSpan k δq (n + 2) (n + 2) := by
      have := evW_mem_evenSpan (R := k) (δ := δq) (a := n + 2) (u := [.cap n, .cup n])
        (b := n + 2) ⟨by omega, by simp⟩ (by simp) (by simp)
      simpa using this
    have h2 := comp_mem_evenSpan (comp_mem_evenSpan h1 hcc) h1
    simp only [Category.assoc] at h2
    exact Submodule.add_mem _ h1 (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ h2)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.jw_absorb
statement:
theorem jw_absorb (m : ℕ) (hI : jw q m ≫ jw q m = jw q m) :
    jw q (m + 1) ≫ wR1 k δq (jw q m) = jw q (m + 1) ∧
      wR1 k δq (jw q m) ≫ jw q (m + 1) = jw q (m + 1)
proof:
:= by
  match m, hI with
  | 0, _ => simp [jw_one, jw_zero, wR1_id]
  | m + 1, hI =>
    have hw : wR1 k δq (jw q (m + 1)) ≫ wR1 k δq (jw q (m + 1)) = wR1 k δq (jw q (m + 1)) := by
      rw [← wR1_comp, hI]
    rw [jw_succ_succ]
    constructor
    · simp only [Preadditive.add_comp, Linear.smul_comp, Category.assoc, hw]
    · simp only [Preadditive.comp_add, Linear.comp_smul, ← Category.assoc, hw]

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.delta_eq
statement: theorem delta_eq : δq = -qint q 2

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.jw_partialTrace
statement:
theorem jw_partialTrace (hq : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → q ^ n ≠ 1) (m : ℕ)
    (hI : jw q m ≫ jw q m = jw q m) :
    cup k δq m m ≫ wR1 k δq (jw q (m + 1)) ≫ cap k δq m m =
      -(qint q (m + 2) / qint q (m + 1)) • jw q m
proof:
:= by
  match m, hI with
  | 0, _ =>
    rw [jw_one, wR1_id, Category.id_comp, loop_at le_rfl, jw_zero, delta_eq]
    simp
  | m + 1, hI =>
    have hf := jw_mem_evenSpan q (m + 1)
    have hne : qint q (m + 2) ≠ 0 := qint_ne_zero hq (by omega)
    have t1 : cup k δq (m + 1) (m + 1) ≫ wR1 k δq (wR1 k δq (jw q (m + 1))) ≫
        cap k δq (m + 1) (m + 1) = δq • jw q (m + 1) := by
      rw [← Category.assoc, ← comp_cup_right hf, Category.assoc, loop_at le_rfl,
        Linear.comp_smul, Category.comp_id]
    have t2 : cup k δq (m + 1) (m + 1) ≫ wR1 k δq (wR1 k δq (jw q (m + 1))) ≫
        cap k δq (m + 1) m ≫ cup k δq (m + 1) m ≫ wR1 k δq (wR1 k δq (jw q (m + 1))) ≫
          cap k δq (m + 1) (m + 1) = -jw q (m + 1) := by
      rw [wR2_comp_cap_right hf, ← Category.assoc (cup k δq (m + 1) (m + 1)),
        ← comp_cup_right hf]
      simp only [Category.assoc]
      rw [← Category.assoc (cup k δq (m + 1) (m + 1)) (cap k δq (m + 1) m), zigzagA_at le_rfl,
        Category.id_comp, ← Category.assoc (cup k δq (m + 1) m) (cap k δq (m + 1) (m + 1)),
        zigzagB_at le_rfl, Preadditive.neg_comp, Category.id_comp, Preadditive.comp_neg, hI]
    have hexp : wR1 k δq (jw q (m + 2)) = wR1 k δq (wR1 k δq (jw q (m + 1))) +
        jwCoeff q (m + 1) • (wR1 k δq (wR1 k δq (jw q (m + 1))) ≫ cap k δq (m + 1) m ≫
          cup k δq (m + 1) m ≫ wR1 k δq (wR1 k δq (jw q (m + 1)))) := by
      rw [jw_succ_succ, wR1_add, wR1_smul, wR1_comp, wR1_comp, wR1_comp, wR1_cap le_rfl,
        wR1_cup le_rfl]
    rw [hexp, Preadditive.add_comp, Preadditive.comp_add, Linear.smul_comp, Linear.comp_smul]
    simp only [Category.assoc]
    rw [t1, t2, smul_neg, ← sub_eq_add_neg, ← sub_smul]
    congr 1
    have h2 := qint_mul_two q (m + 1)
    rw [delta_eq, jwCoeff]
    field_simp
    linear_combination -h2

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.jw_top
statement:
theorem jw_top (hq : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → q ^ n ≠ 1) (m : ℕ)
    (hT : cup k δq m m ≫ wR1 k δq (jw q (m + 1)) ≫ cap k δq m m =
      -(qint q (m + 2) / qint q (m + 1)) • jw q m)
    (hA : jw q (m + 1) ≫ wR1 k δq (jw q m) = jw q (m + 1) ∧
      wR1 k δq (jw q m) ≫ jw q (m + 1) = jw q (m + 1)) :
    jw q (m + 2) ≫ cap k δq m m = 0 ∧ cup k δq m m ≫ jw q (m + 2) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hg := jw_mem_evenSpan q m
  have hc : jwCoeff q (m + 1) * (qint q (m + 2) / qint q (m + 1)) = 1 := by
    have h1 := qint_ne_zero hq (show 0 < m + 1 by omega)
    have h2 := qint_ne_zero hq (show 0 < m + 2 by omega)
    rw [jwCoeff, show m + 1 + 1 = m + 2 from rfl]
    field_simp
  have hw : wR1 k δq (jw q (m + 1)) ≫ wR1 k δq (wR1 k δq (jw q m)) = wR1 k δq (jw q (m + 1)) := by
    rw [← wR1_comp, hA.1]
  have hw' : wR1 k δq (wR1 k δq (jw q m)) ≫ wR1 k δq (jw q (m + 1)) = wR1 k δq (jw q (m + 1)) := by
    rw [← wR1_comp, hA.2]
  rw [jw_succ_succ]
  constructor
  · rw [Preadditive.add_comp, Linear.smul_comp]
    simp only [Category.assoc]
    rw [hT, Linear.comp_smul, Linear.comp_smul, smul_smul, mul_neg, hc,
      ← wR2_comp_cap_right hg, ← Category.assoc, hw]
    simp
  · rw [Preadditive.comp_add, Linear.comp_smul]
    have e : cup k δq m m ≫ wR1 k δq (jw q (m + 1)) ≫ cap k δq m m ≫ cup k δq m m ≫
        wR1 k δq (jw q (m + 1)) = (cup k δq m m ≫ wR1 k δq (jw q (m + 1)) ≫ cap k δq m m) ≫
          cup k δq m m ≫ wR1 k δq (jw q (m + 1)) := by simp only [Category.assoc]
    rw [e, hT, Linear.smul_comp, smul_smul, mul_neg, hc, ← Category.assoc, comp_cup_right hg,
      Category.assoc, hw']
    simp

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.jw_low
statement:
theorem jw_low (m : ℕ)
    (hC : ∀ i ≤ m, jw q (m + 2) ≫ cap k δq m i = 0 ∧ cup k δq m i ≫ jw q (m + 2) = 0)
    {i : ℕ} (hi : i ≤ m) :
    jw q (m + 3) ≫ cap k δq (m + 1) i = 0 ∧ cup k δq (m + 1) i ≫ jw q (m + 3) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have e1 : wR1 k δq (jw q (m + 2)) ≫ cap k δq (m + 1) i = 0 := by
    rw [← wR1_cap hi, ← wR1_comp, (hC i hi).1, wR1_zero]
  have e2 : cup k δq (m + 1) i ≫ wR1 k δq (jw q (m + 2)) = 0 := by
    rw [← wR1_cup hi, ← wR1_comp, (hC i hi).2, wR1_zero]
  rw [jw_succ_succ]
  constructor
  · simp only [Preadditive.add_comp, Linear.smul_comp, Category.assoc, e1, Limits.comp_zero,
      smul_zero, add_zero]
  · simp only [Preadditive.comp_add, Linear.comp_smul, ← Category.assoc, e2, Limits.zero_comp,
      smul_zero, add_zero]

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.jw_idem_of
statement:
theorem jw_idem_of (m : ℕ)
    (hA : jw q (m + 2) ≫ wR1 k δq (jw q (m + 1)) = jw q (m + 2))
    (hC : jw q (m + 2) ≫ cap k δq m m = 0) :
    jw q (m + 2) ≫ jw q (m + 2) = jw q (m + 2)
proof:
:= by
  nth_rewrite 2 [jw_succ_succ]
  rw [Preadditive.comp_add, Linear.comp_smul, ← Category.assoc, hA, ← Category.assoc, hC]
  simp

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.jw_spec
statement:
theorem jw_spec (hq : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → q ^ n ≠ 1) (m : ℕ) :
    jw q m ≫ jw q m = jw q m ∧ jw q (m + 1) ≫ jw q (m + 1) = jw q (m + 1) ∧
      (∀ i ≤ m, jw q (m + 2) ≫ cap k δq m i = 0 ∧ cup k δq m i ≫ jw q (m + 2) = 0)
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero =>
    have hI0 : jw q 0 ≫ jw q 0 = jw q 0 := by rw [jw_zero, Category.comp_id]
    have hI1 : jw q 1 ≫ jw q 1 = jw q 1 := by rw [jw_one, Category.comp_id]
    refine ⟨hI0, hI1, fun i hi => ?_⟩
    obtain rfl : i = 0 := by omega
    exact jw_top q hq 0 (jw_partialTrace q hq 0 hI0) (jw_absorb q 0 hI0)
  | succ m ih =>
    obtain ⟨hI0, hI1, hC⟩ := ih
    have hA1 := jw_absorb q (m + 1) hI1
    have hT1 := jw_partialTrace q hq (m + 1) hI1
    have hC1 : ∀ i ≤ m + 1, jw q (m + 3) ≫ cap k δq (m + 1) i = 0 ∧
        cup k δq (m + 1) i ≫ jw q (m + 3) = 0 := by
      intro i hi
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge i (m + 1) with h | h
      · exact jw_low q m hC (by omega)
      · obtain rfl : i = m + 1 := by omega
        exact jw_top q hq (m + 1) hT1 hA1
    refine ⟨hI1, ?_, hC1⟩
    exact jw_idem_of q m (jw_absorb q (m + 1) hI1).1 (jw_top q hq m (jw_partialTrace q hq m hI0)
      (jw_absorb q m hI0)).1

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.jw_idem
statement: theorem jw_idem (hq : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → q ^ n ≠ 1) (n : ℕ) : jw q n ≫ jw q n = jw q n

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.jw_comp_cap
statement:
theorem jw_comp_cap (hq : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → q ^ n ≠ 1) {m i : ℕ} (hi : i ≤ m) :
    jw q (m + 2) ≫ cap k δq m i = 0

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.cup_comp_jw
statement:
theorem cup_comp_jw (hq : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → q ^ n ≠ 1) {m i : ℕ} (hi : i ≤ m) :
    cup k δq m i ≫ jw q (m + 2) = 0

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.jw_comp_wR1
statement:
theorem jw_comp_wR1 (hq : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → q ^ n ≠ 1) (m : ℕ) :
    jw q (m + 1) ≫ wR1 k δq (jw q m) = jw q (m + 1)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.wR1_comp_jw
statement:
theorem wR1_comp_jw (hq : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → q ^ n ≠ 1) (m : ℕ) :
    wR1 k δq (jw q m) ≫ jw q (m + 1) = jw q (m + 1)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.jw_partial_trace
statement:
theorem jw_partial_trace (hq : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → q ^ n ≠ 1) (m : ℕ) :
    cup k δq m m ≫ wR1 k δq (jw q (m + 1)) ≫ cap k δq m m =
      -(qint q (m + 2) / qint q (m + 1)) • jw q m
proof:
:=
  jw_partialTrace q hq m (jw_idem hq m)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.id_X_zero_ne_zero
statement: theorem id_X_zero_ne_zero : 𝟙 (X k δq 0) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have := (basisCanon q 0).ne_zero ⟨[], isDyck_nil, rfl⟩
  rwa [basisCanon_apply, canon_zero] at this

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.jw_ne_zero
statement: theorem jw_ne_zero (hq : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → q ^ n ≠ 1) (n : ℕ) : jw q n ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rw [jw_zero]; exact id_X_zero_ne_zero
  | succ n ih =>
    intro h
    have := jw_partial_trace hq n
    rw [h, wR1_zero, Limits.zero_comp, Limits.comp_zero, eq_comm, smul_eq_zero] at this
    rcases this with h1 | h1
    · rw [neg_eq_zero, div_eq_zero_iff] at h1
      rcases h1 with h1 | h1
      · exact qint_ne_zero hq (by omega) h1
      · exact qint_ne_zero hq (by omega) h1
    · exact ih h1

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.parity_X
statement:
theorem parity_X (m n : ℕ) (p : ZMod 2) :
    parity (R := k) (X k δq m) (X k δq n) p =
      (pres k δq).homDeg (Presentation.parityDeg sig) (strands m) (strands n) p

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.homD_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem homD_val {a b : ZMod 2} {m n : ℕ} (f : X k δq m ⟶ X k δq n) (hf) :
    Envelope.toHom (homD (q := q) (a := a) (b := b) f hf).1 = f

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.homD_comp
statement:
theorem homD_comp {a b c : ZMod 2} {l m n : ℕ} (f : X k δq l ⟶ X k δq m) (g : X k δq m ⟶ X k δq n)
    (hf : f ∈ (pres k δq).homDeg (Presentation.parityDeg sig) (strands l) (strands m) (a + b))
    (hg : g ∈ (pres k δq).homDeg (Presentation.parityDeg sig) (strands m) (strands n) (b + c))
    (hfg : f ≫ g ∈ (pres k δq).homDeg (Presentation.parityDeg sig) (strands l) (strands n) (a + c)) :
    homD f hf ≫ homD g hg = homD (q := q) (f ≫ g) hfg

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.homD_ext
statement:
theorem homD_ext {a b : ZMod 2} {m n : ℕ} {f g : genD q a m ⟶ genD q b n}
    (h : Envelope.toHom f.1 = Envelope.toHom g.1) : f = g

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.val_mem_parity
statement:
theorem val_mem_parity {a b : ZMod 2} {m n : ℕ} (f : genD q a m ⟶ genD q b n) :
    Envelope.toHom f.1 ∈
      (pres k δq).homDeg (Presentation.parityDeg sig) (strands m) (strands n) (a + b)
proof:
:= by
  have := f.2
  change Envelope.toHom f.1 ∈ parity (R := k) (X k δq m) (X k δq n) (0 + (a + b)) at this
  rwa [zero_add] at this

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.jw_mem_parity
statement:
theorem jw_mem_parity (n : ℕ) (a : ZMod 2) :
    jw q n ∈ (pres k δq).homDeg (Presentation.parityDeg sig) (strands n) (strands n) (a + a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ZModModule.add_self a, show (0 : ZMod 2) = 0 from rfl]
  exact evenSpan_le_parity _ _ (jw_mem_evenSpan q n)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.eq_zero_of_mem_both
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_mem_both {m n : ℕ} {f : X k δq m ⟶ X k δq n}
    (h0 : f ∈ (pres k δq).homDeg (Presentation.parityDeg sig) (strands m) (strands n) 0)
    (h1 : f ∈ (pres k δq).homDeg (Presentation.parityDeg sig) (strands m) (strands n) 1) :
    f = 0
proof:
:= by
  have e1 := proj_of_mem (R := k) (C := STL k δq) (X := X k δq m) (Y := X k δq n) h1
  have e0 := proj_of_mem_ne (R := k) (C := STL k δq) (X := X k δq m) (Y := X k δq n) h0
    (p := 1) (by decide)
  rw [← e1, e0]

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.mat_comp_single
statement:
theorem mat_comp_single {x y z : DD q} (f : (Mat_.embedding (DD q)).obj x ⟶ (Mat_.embedding (DD q)).obj y)
    (g : (Mat_.embedding (DD q)).obj y ⟶ (Mat_.embedding (DD q)).obj z) :
    (f ≫ g) PUnit.unit PUnit.unit = f PUnit.unit PUnit.unit ≫ g PUnit.unit PUnit.unit

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.mor_comp
statement:
theorem mor_comp {l m n : ℕ} {a b c : ZMod 2} (φ : jwObj q hq l a ⟶ jwObj q hq m b)
    (ψ : jwObj q hq m b ⟶ jwObj q hq n c) : mor hq (φ ≫ ψ) = mor hq φ ≫ mor hq ψ
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mor, Karoubi.comp_f, mat_comp_single, Underlying.comp_val, Envelope.toHom_comp]

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.mor_id
statement: theorem mor_id (n : ℕ) (a : ZMod 2) : mor hq (𝟙 (jwObj q hq n a)) = jw q n

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.mor_eq
statement:
theorem mor_eq {m n : ℕ} {a b : ZMod 2} (φ : jwObj q hq m a ⟶ jwObj q hq n b) :
    mor hq φ = jw q m ≫ mor hq φ ≫ jw q n
proof:
:= by
  have := congrArg (fun f => Envelope.toHom (f PUnit.unit PUnit.unit).1) φ.comm
  simpa only [mat_comp_single, Underlying.comp_val, Envelope.toHom_comp] using! this.symm

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.mor_mem_parity
statement:
theorem mor_mem_parity {m n : ℕ} {a b : ZMod 2} (φ : jwObj q hq m a ⟶ jwObj q hq n b) :
    mor hq φ ∈ (pres k δq).homDeg (Presentation.parityDeg sig) (strands m) (strands n) (a + b)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.jwObj_hom_ext
statement:
theorem jwObj_hom_ext {m n : ℕ} {a b : ZMod 2} {φ ψ : jwObj q hq m a ⟶ jwObj q hq n b}
    (h : mor hq φ = mor hq ψ) : φ = ψ
proof:
:= by
  apply Karoubi.hom_ext
  apply Mat_.hom_ext
  rintro ⟨⟩ ⟨⟩
  exact Underlying.hom_ext h

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.mor_zero
statement: theorem mor_zero {m n : ℕ} {a b : ZMod 2} : mor hq (0 : jwObj q hq m a ⟶ jwObj q hq n b) = 0

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.mor_smul
statement:
theorem mor_smul {m n : ℕ} {a b : ZMod 2} (c : k) (φ : jwObj q hq m a ⟶ jwObj q hq n b) :
    mor hq (c • φ) = c • mor hq φ

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.hom_jwObj_eq_zero
statement:
theorem hom_jwObj_eq_zero {m n : ℕ} {a b : ZMod 2} (h : m ≠ n ∨ a ≠ b)
    (φ : jwObj q hq m a ⟶ jwObj q hq n b) : φ = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply jwObj_hom_ext
  rw [mor_zero]
  rcases eq_or_ne m n with rfl | hmn
  · have hab : a ≠ b := h.resolve_left (not_not.mpr rfl)
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := jw_comp_comp_jw_self hq (mor hq φ)
    rw [← mor_eq] at hc
    refine eq_zero_of_mem_both q ?_ ?_
    · rw [hc]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (by simpa using jw_mem_parity q m 0)
    · have hab1 : a + b = 1 := by
        clear hc h φ
        revert a b; decide
      have := mor_mem_parity q hq φ
      rwa [hab1] at this
  · rw [mor_eq]; exact jw_comp_comp_jw_of_ne hq hmn _

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.jwObj_isSchur
statement: theorem jwObj_isSchur (n : ℕ) (a : ZMod 2) : IsSchur (k := k) (jwObj q hq n a)
proof:
:= by
  intro φ
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := jw_comp_comp_jw_self hq (mor hq φ)
  rw [← mor_eq] at hc
  exact ⟨c, jwObj_hom_ext q hq (by rw [hc, mor_smul, mor_id])⟩

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.id_jwObj_ne_zero
statement: theorem id_jwObj_ne_zero (n : ℕ) (a : ZMod 2) : 𝟙 (jwObj q hq n a) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have := congrArg (mor hq) h
  rw [mor_id, mor_zero] at this
  exact jw_ne_zero hq n this

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.wR1_mem_homDeg
statement:
theorem wR1_mem_homDeg {m n : ℕ} {p : ZMod 2} {f : X k δq m ⟶ X k δq n}
    (hf : f ∈ (pres k δq).homDeg (Presentation.parityDeg sig) (strands m) (strands n) p) :
    wR1 k δq f ∈ (pres k δq).homDeg (Presentation.parityDeg sig) (strands (m + 1))
      (strands (n + 1)) p
proof:
:= by
  have h := Presentation.comp_mem_homDeg (Presentation.eqToHom_mem_homDeg (P := pres k δq)
    (Presentation.parityDeg sig) (congrArg (pres k δq).obj (strands_tensor_one m).symm))
    (Presentation.comp_mem_homDeg ((pres k δq).wR_mem (Presentation.parityDeg sig) hf (strands 1))
      (Presentation.eqToHom_mem_homDeg (P := pres k δq) (Presentation.parityDeg sig)
        (congrArg (pres k δq).obj (strands_tensor_one n))))
  simpa using! h

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.wR1_list_sum
statement:
theorem wR1_list_sum {a b : ℕ} (l : List (X k δq a ⟶ X k δq b)) :
    wR1 k δq l.sum = (l.map (wR1 k δq)).sum
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp [wR1_zero]
  | cons x l ih => simp [wR1_add, ih]

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.splitPiece_sum
statement:
theorem splitPiece_sum {m : ℕ} (p : DPiece (q := q) m) :
    ((splitPiece q hq p).map fun p' => p'.α ≫ p'.β).sum = wR1 k δq (p.α ≫ p.β)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, b, α, β, hα, hβ, hαj, hjβ⟩ := p
  cases n with
  | zero => simp [splitPiece, wR1_comp]
  | succ N =>
    simp only [splitPiece, List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.sum_cons, List.sum_nil, add_zero]
    have e : (wR1 k δq α ≫ jw q (N + 2)) ≫ jw q (N + 2) ≫ wR1 k δq β +
        (wR1 k δq α ≫ vDec q N) ≫ uDec q N ≫ wR1 k δq β =
        wR1 k δq α ≫ (jw q (N + 2) + gDec q N) ≫ wR1 k δq β := by
      rw [← vDec_comp_uDec]
      simp only [Category.assoc, Preadditive.add_comp, Preadditive.comp_add]
      rw [← Category.assoc (jw q (N + 2)) (jw q (N + 2)), jw_idem hq]
    rw [e, ← wR1_jw_eq, ← wR1_comp, ← wR1_comp, ← Category.assoc, hαj]

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.pieces_sum
statement: theorem pieces_sum (m : ℕ) : ((pieces q hq m).map fun p => p.α ≫ p.β).sum = 𝟙 (X k δq m)
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero => simp [pieces]
  | succ m ih =>
    have key : ∀ L : List (DPiece (q := q) m),
        ((L.flatMap (splitPiece q hq)).map fun p => p.α ≫ p.β).sum =
          wR1 k δq ((L.map fun p => p.α ≫ p.β).sum) := by
      intro L
      induction L with
      | nil => simp [wR1_zero]
      | cons p L ihL =>
        rw [List.flatMap_cons, List.map_append, List.sum_append, ihL, splitPiece_sum,
          List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, wR1_add]
    rw [pieces, key, ih, wR1_id]

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.IsRetractJw.of_retract
statement:
theorem IsRetractJw.of_retract {Z Y : SKar k (STL k δq)} (hY : IsRetractJw q hq Y) (σ : Z ⟶ Y)
    (τ : Y ⟶ Z) (h : σ ≫ τ = 𝟙 Z) : IsRetractJw q hq Z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨L, hL, σ', τ', h'⟩ := hY
  refine ⟨L, hL, σ ≫ σ', τ' ≫ τ, ?_⟩
  rw [Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc σ', h', Category.id_comp, h]

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.IsRetractJw.of_iso
statement:
theorem IsRetractJw.of_iso {Z Y : SKar k (STL k δq)} (hY : IsRetractJw q hq Y) (e : Z ≅ Y) :
    IsRetractJw q hq Z
proof:
:=
  hY.of_retract q hq e.hom e.inv e.hom_inv_id

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.isRetractJw_zero
statement: theorem isRetractJw_zero : IsRetractJw q hq (bsum [])

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.IsRetractJw.biprodObj
statement:
theorem IsRetractJw.biprodObj {Y₁ Y₂ : SKar k (STL k δq)} (h₁ : IsRetractJw q hq Y₁)
    (h₂ : IsRetractJw q hq Y₂) : IsRetractJw q hq (Y₁ ⊞ Y₂)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨L₁, hL₁, σ₁, τ₁, e₁⟩ := h₁
  obtain ⟨L₂, hL₂, σ₂, τ₂, e₂⟩ := h₂
  refine ⟨L₁ ++ L₂, fun P hP => ?_, biprod.map σ₁ σ₂ ≫ (bsumAppendIso L₁ L₂).inv,
    (bsumAppendIso L₁ L₂).hom ≫ biprod.map τ₁ τ₂, ?_⟩
  · rcases List.mem_append.mp hP with h | h
    · exact hL₁ P h
    · exact hL₂ P h
  · rw [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
    apply biprod.hom_ext' <;> simp [reassoc_of% e₁, reassoc_of% e₂]

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.isRetractJw_bsum
statement:
theorem isRetractJw_bsum (l : List (SKar k (STL k δq))) (h : ∀ Y ∈ l, IsRetractJw q hq Y) :
    IsRetractJw q hq (bsum l)
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => exact isRetractJw_zero q hq
  | cons Y l ih =>
    exact IsRetractJw.biprodObj q hq (h Y (by simp)) (ih fun Z hZ => h Z (by simp [hZ]))

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.endG_injective
statement: theorem endG_injective (a : ZMod 2) (m : ℕ) : Function.Injective (endG q a m)
proof:
:= by
  intro f g h
  apply Karoubi.hom_ext
  apply Mat_.hom_ext
  rintro ⟨⟩ ⟨⟩
  exact Underlying.hom_ext h

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.parity_shift
StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.isRetractJw_gen
statement:
theorem isRetractJw_gen (a : ZMod 2) (m : ℕ) :
    IsRetractJw q hq ((SKar.of k (STL k δq)).obj (genD q a m))
proof:
:= by
  set l := (pieces q hq m).map (skarPiece q hq a)
  refine ⟨l.map Piece.obj, ?_, toBsum l, fromBsum l, retract_bsum_of_sum_eq_id l ?_⟩
  · intro P hP
    simp only [l, List.map_map, List.mem_map] at hP
    obtain ⟨p, -, rfl⟩ := hP
    exact ⟨p.n, a + p.b, rfl⟩
  · apply endG_injective q a m
    rw [map_list_sum, List.map_map, List.map_map]
    have : ((endG q a m) ∘ (fun p : Piece ((SKar.of k (STL k δq)).obj (genD q a m)) => p.a ≫ p.b)) ∘
        (skarPiece q hq a) = fun p => p.α ≫ p.β := by
      funext p
      simp only [Function.comp, endG, AddMonoidHom.coe_mk, ZeroHom.coe_mk, skarPiece,
        Karoubi.comp_f, mat_comp_single]
      rfl
    rw [this, pieces_sum]
    show 𝟙 (X k δq m) = Envelope.toHom ((𝟙 ((Mat_.embedding (DD q)).obj (genD q a m))) PUnit.unit
      PUnit.unit).1
    simp
    rfl

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.isRetractJw_of
statement: theorem isRetractJw_of (x : DD q) : IsRetractJw q hq ((SKar.of k (STL k δq)).obj x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨a, lam⟩⟩ := x
  have e : lam = X k δq (lam.as.word.length) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← (pres k δq).obj_toObj lam]
    exact congrArg _ (eq_strands _)
  have hx : (⟨⟨a, lam⟩⟩ : DD q) = genD q a (lam.as.word.length) := by
    rw [genD, ← e]
  rw [hx]
  exact isRetractJw_gen q hq a _

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.isRetractJw
statement: theorem isRetractJw (Z : SKar k (STL k δq)) : IsRetractJw q hq Z
proof:
:= by
  
  refine IsRetractJw.of_retract q hq ?_ (Karoubi.decompId_i Z) (Karoubi.decompId_p Z)
    (Karoubi.decompId Z).symm
  set M := Z.X
  set e := Mat_.isoBiproductEmbedding M
  set F : M.ι → Mat_ (DD q) := fun i => (Mat_.embedding (DD q)).obj (M.X i)
  let piece : M.ι → Piece ((toKaroubi _).obj M) := fun i =>
    ⟨(SKar.of k (STL k δq)).obj (M.X i),
      (toKaroubi _).map (e.hom ≫ biproduct.π F i),
      (toKaroubi _).map (biproduct.ι F i ≫ e.inv)⟩
  set l := (Finset.univ : Finset M.ι).toList.map piece
  have hsum : (l.map fun p => p.a ≫ p.b).sum = 𝟙 _ := by
    simp only [l, List.map_map]
    have : ((fun p : Piece ((toKaroubi _).obj M) => p.a ≫ p.b) ∘ piece) =
        fun i => (toKaroubi _).map (e.hom ≫ biproduct.π F i ≫ biproduct.ι F i ≫ e.inv) := by
      funext i
      simp only [Function.comp, piece, ← Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc]
    rw [this, Finset.sum_map_toList (f := fun i => (toKaroubi (Mat_ (DD q))).map
      (e.hom ≫ biproduct.π F i ≫ biproduct.ι F i ≫ e.inv))]
    rw [← Functor.map_sum]
    simp only [← Preadditive.sum_comp, ← Category.assoc]
    have ht : ∑ j, (e.hom ≫ biproduct.π F j) ≫ biproduct.ι F j = e.hom := by
      simp only [Category.assoc, ← Preadditive.comp_sum, biproduct.total, Category.comp_id]
    rw [ht, e.hom_inv_id, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id]
  refine IsRetractJw.of_retract q hq (isRetractJw_bsum q hq _ ?_) (toBsum l) (fromBsum l)
    (retract_bsum_of_sum_eq_id l hsum)
  intro Y hY
  simp only [l, List.map_map, List.mem_map] at hY
  obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ := hY
  exact isRetractJw_of q hq (M.X i)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.exists_iso_bsum_jwObj
statement:
theorem exists_iso_bsum_jwObj (Z : SKar k (STL k δq)) :
    ∃ L : List (SKar k (STL k δq)), (∀ P ∈ L, ∃ n a, P = jwObj q hq n a) ∧ Nonempty (Z ≅ bsum L)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨L, hL, σ, τ, h⟩ := isRetractJw q hq Z
  obtain ⟨L', hL', e⟩ := iso_bsum_of_retract (k := k) L (fun P hP => by
    obtain ⟨n, a, rfl⟩ := hL P hP
    exact jwObj_isSchur q hq n a) Z σ τ h
  exact ⟨L', fun P hP => hL P (hL'.subset hP), e⟩

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.Rep.nOdd_append
statement: theorem nOdd_append (u v : List (Fin 2)) : nOdd (u ++ v) = nOdd u + nOdd v
proof:
:= by
  induction u with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a u ih => simp [ih, Nat.add_assoc]

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.Rep.wpar_append
statement: theorem wpar_append (u v : List (Fin 2)) : wpar (u ++ v) = wpar u + wpar v

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.Rep.wpar_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem wpar_nil : wpar [] = 0

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.Rep.neg_one_pow_eq_sign
statement: theorem neg_one_pow_eq_sign (n : ℕ) : (-1 : k) ^ n = sign k (n : ZMod 2)
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.even_or_odd n with h | h
  · rw [h.neg_one_pow, (ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff_even).mpr h, sign_zero]
  · rw [h.neg_one_pow, (ZMod.natCast_eq_one_iff_odd).mpr h, sign_one]

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.Rep.psign_eq_sign
statement: theorem psign_eq_sign (p : ℕ) (w : List (Fin 2)) : psign k p w = sign k (wpar (w.take p))

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.Rep.sv_proj_apply
statement:
theorem sv_proj_apply (n : ℕ) (p : ZMod 2) (f : sv k n) (w : Word n) :
    (sv k n).proj p f w = if wpar w.1 = p then f w else 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one p with rfl | rfl
  · rw [SVec.proj_zero]
    change f w - (if wpar w.1 = 1 then f w else 0) = _
    rcases parity_eq_zero_or_one (wpar w.1) with h | h <;> simp [h]
  · rw [SVec.proj_one]; rfl

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.Rep.mem_sv_part
statement:
theorem mem_sv_part {n : ℕ} {p : ZMod 2} {f : sv k n} :
    f ∈ (sv k n).part p ↔ ∀ w : Word n, wpar w.1 ≠ p → f w = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [SVec.mem_part_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h w hw
    rw [← h, sv_proj_apply, ite_eq_right hw]
  · intro h
    funext w
    rw [sv_proj_apply]
    split_ifs with hw
    · rfl
    · exact (h w hw).symm

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.Rep.nOdd_del
statement:
theorem nOdd_del (p : ℕ) (w : List (Fin 2)) :
    nOdd w = nOdd (del p w) + (w.getD p 0).val + (w.getD (p + 1) 0).val
proof:
:= by
  induction p generalizing w with
  | zero =>
    rcases w with _ | ⟨a, _ | ⟨b, w⟩⟩ <;> simp [del]; omega
  | succ p ih =>
    rcases w with _ | ⟨a, w⟩
    · simp [del]
    · simp only [del, nOdd_cons, List.getD_cons_succ, ih w]; omega

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.Rep.nOdd_ins
statement:
theorem nOdd_ins (p : ℕ) (a b : Fin 2) (w : List (Fin 2)) :
    nOdd (ins p a b w) = nOdd w + a.val + b.val
proof:
:= by
  induction p generalizing w with
  | zero => simp [ins]; omega
  | succ p ih =>
    rcases w with _ | ⟨c, w⟩
    · simp [ins]
    · simp only [ins, nOdd_cons, ih w]; omega

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.Rep.cupCoeff_ne_zero
statement: theorem cupCoeff_ne_zero {q : kˣ} {a b : Fin 2} (h : cupCoeff k q a b ≠ 0) : a.val + b.val = 1
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases a <;> fin_cases b <;> simp_all

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.Rep.capCoeff_ne_zero
statement: theorem capCoeff_ne_zero {q : kˣ} {a b : Fin 2} (h : capCoeff k q a b ≠ 0) : a.val + b.val = 1
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases a <;> fin_cases b <;> simp_all

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.Rep.Supp.cupOp
statement:
theorem Supp.cupOp {q : kˣ} {r : ZMod 2} {F : Fn k} (hF : Supp r F) (p : ℕ) :
    Supp (r + 1) (cupOp k q p F)
proof:
:= by
  intro w hw
  rw [cupOp_apply]
  by_cases hc : cupCoeff k q (w.getD p 0) (w.getD (p + 1) 0) = 0
  · rw [hc, zero_mul, mul_zero]
  · rw [hF (del p w), mul_zero, mul_zero]
    intro h
    apply hw
    have := cupCoeff_ne_zero hc
    rw [wpar, nOdd_del p w, Nat.add_assoc, this, ← h, wpar]
    push_cast; ring

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.Rep.Supp.capOp
statement:
theorem Supp.capOp {q : kˣ} {r : ZMod 2} {F : Fn k} (hF : Supp r F) (p : ℕ) :
    Supp (r + 1) (capOp k q p F)
proof:
:= by
  intro w hw
  rw [capOp_apply]
  refine (mul_eq_zero_of_right _ (Finset.sum_eq_zero fun a _ => Finset.sum_eq_zero fun b _ => ?_))
  by_cases hc : capCoeff k q a b = 0
  · rw [hc, zero_mul]
  · rw [hF (ins p a b w), mul_zero]
    intro h
    apply hw
    have h1 := capCoeff_ne_zero hc
    have h2 : wpar (ins p a b w) = wpar w + 1 := by
      rw [wpar, wpar, nOdd_ins, Nat.add_assoc, h1]; push_cast; rfl
    rw [← h, h2, add_assoc, SVec.zmod2_one_add_one, add_zero]

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.Rep.Supp.op
statement:
theorem Supp.op {q : kˣ} {r : ZMod 2} {F : Fn k} (hF : Supp r F) (L : Layer sig) :
    Supp (r + 1) (op k q L F)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, l, g, r'⟩ := L
  cases g with
  | cup => exact hF.cupOp l.length
  | cap => exact hF.capOp l.length

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.Rep.Supp.opList
statement:
theorem Supp.opList {q : kˣ} {r : ZMod 2} {F : Fn k} (hF : Supp r F) (ls : List (Layer sig)) :
    Supp (r + ls.length) ((loc k q).opList ls F)
proof:
:= by
  induction ls generalizing r F with
  | nil => simpa using hF
  | cons L ls ih =>
    have := ih (hF.op (q := q) L)
    rw [LocalInterpretation.opList_cons, LinearMap.comp_apply]
    convert this using 1
    simp only [List.length_cons, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]; ring
    rfl

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.Rep.supp_ext
statement:
theorem supp_ext {n : ℕ} {r : ZMod 2} {f : sv k n} (hf : f ∈ (sv k n).part r) :
    Supp r (ext k n f)
proof:
:= by
  intro w hw
  by_cases hl : w.length = n
  · rw [ext_apply_of_length k f hl]
    exact mem_sv_part.mp hf ⟨w, hl⟩ hw
  · exact dite_eq_right hl

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.Rep.repS_map_apply
statement:
theorem repS_map_apply {X Y : STL k δq} (f : X ⟶ Y) (x : (repS k q).obj X) :
    (repS k q).map f x = ((rep k q).map f).hom x

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.Rep.repS_map_diag_apply
statement:
theorem repS_map_diag_apply {a b : Obj sig} (d : a ⟶ b) (x : (repS k q).obj ((pres k δq).obj a))
    (w : Word b.word.length) :
    (repS k q).map ((pres k δq).diag d) x w =
      (loc k q).opList (Diagram.layers d) (ext k _ x) w.1

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.Rep.repS_cup_vec
statement:
theorem repS_cup_vec (w : Word (strands 2).word.length) :
    (repS k q).map (cup k δq 0 0) (vec ⟨[], rfl⟩) w = cupCoeff k q (w.1.getD 0 0) (w.1.getD 1 0)

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.Rep.repS_cap_vec
statement:
theorem repS_cap_vec (a b : Fin 2) :
    (repS k q).map (cap k δq 0 0) (vec ⟨[a, b], rfl⟩) ⟨[], rfl⟩ = capCoeff k q a b

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.Rep.repS_map_diag_mem
statement:
theorem repS_map_diag_mem {a b : Obj sig} (d : a ⟶ b) :
    (repS k q).map ((pres k δq).diag d) ∈
      SVec.parityHom ((repS k q).obj ((pres k δq).obj a)) ((repS k q).obj ((pres k δq).obj b))
        ((Diagram.layers d).length : ZMod 2)
proof:
:= by
  refine SVec.mem_parityHom_of_apply_mem fun r x hx => mem_sv_part.mpr fun w hw => ?_
  rw [repS_map_diag_apply]
  exact (supp_ext hx).opList (q := q) _ _ hw

name: StringDiagrams.OddTemperleyLieb.Rep.wordAppend_symm_fst
statement:
@[simp] theorem wordAppend_symm_fst {m n L : ℕ} (h : m + n = L) (w : Word L) :
